AI.method: 提出两种互补方法。(1) Neighborhood-Weighted RSA（NW-RSA）：按刺激在表征空间中的邻近度对刺激对加权，将局部邻域到全局几何的对齐放在统一尺度上衡量，弥补标准RSA对近端与远端输入对齐差异的遮蔽。(2) Counterfactual RSA（CF-RSA）：将一个模型的完整表征与另一模型在受控语言扰动下的表征进行比较，检验哪些语言属性支撑对齐。实验覆盖多种语言模型，并比较广泛采样的自然文本、保持特定意义或结构的语言等价类，以及词表与jabberwocky句等破坏句法或词汇意义的条件。
AI.result: 跨多种语言模型观察到：粗粒度表征几何高度一致，但局部邻域存在实质性分歧。对齐既出现在广泛采样的自然文本中，也出现在保持特定意义或结构的语言等价类内。反事实分析显示选择性敏感性：逻辑辖域变化导致的对齐下降显著大于所测试的层级句法、事件角色或篇章结构变化。当词表或jabberwocky句中句子结构或词汇意义被破坏时，对齐同样下降，表明自然语言的规律性支撑了更强的收敛。
AI.conclusion: 整体强相似性并不必然意味着模型在更细粒度语言区分上的表征一致，因此需对"表征普遍性"的结论加以限定。NW-RSA与CF-RSA为定位"模型在何处一致、何种属性支撑一致"提供了可推广的分析框架。

title: Actionable Meta-Requirements for AI Robustness Auditing
summary: AI-enabled systems must remain dependable when the conditions under which they operate change (e.g., due to input perturbations, distribution shifts, or changes in external dependencies). This makes robustness auditing of such systems important for judging whether the available evidence is sufficient to support a defined robustness conclusion. However, designing an AI robustness auditing framework is challenging. A key unresolved issue is determining the requirements such a framework should support; these requirements have not yet been consolidated. We address this gap through meta-requirements: higher-order requirements specifying what a class of auditing frameworks should support. In design science research, literature and domain experts are common sources of meta-requirements; accordingly, we derive the initial set from literature and validate and refine it with practitioners. Our systematic literature review retained 74 of 2,890 records and derived 43 meta-requirements across 16 categories. We evaluated them with 128 practitioners, obtaining 5,504 ratings and 586 substantive comments. Overall, 81.20% of ratings indicated agreement or strong agreement. In particular, 41 of the 43 literature-derived meta-requirements were classified as strongly supported. Practitioner feedback refined the requirements and identified an additional requirement concerning external components and supply chain dependencies. The final set comprises 44 meta-requirements across 16 categories, of which 43 received quantitative validation. These meta-requirements can help organizations implement AI robustness auditing frameworks, assess existing frameworks for completeness, and refine them.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述与实证调研，构建了AI鲁棒性审计框架的元需求集合：44项元需求、16个类别，其中43项获得量化验证。
AI.motivation: AI系统在运行条件变化时需保持可靠（如输入扰动、分布偏移、外部依赖变化），因此鲁棒性审计很重要。但设计此类审计框架存在挑战，核心未解问题是：框架应支持哪些需求尚未得到整合。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究方法，以"元需求"（规定一类审计框架应支持内容的高阶需求）为切入点。先从文献推导初始元需求，再通过 practitioner 验证与细化。具体执行了系统性文献综述（2,890条记录保留74条，推导出16类43项元需求），随后以128名 practitioner 进行评估（获得5,504条评分、586条实质性评论）。
AI.result: 81.20%的评分表示同意或强烈同意；43项文献推导的元需求中有41项被评为强支持。practitioner 反馈细化了需求，并识别出一项关于外部组件与供应链依赖的新需求。最终集合包含16类44项元需求，其中43项获得量化验证。
AI.conclusion: 该元需求集合可帮助组织落地AI鲁棒性审计框架、评估现有框架的完备性并对其进行改进。

title: Human Pose Estimation by Probabilistic Mixtures of Gaussian and Uniform Distributions
comment: 38 pages, 11 figures, 20 tables. Includes supplementary material. Code available at https://github.com/santiago-git19/probabilistic-pose-gmm
summary: Despite advancements in sub-pixel decoding, modern Human Pose Estimation (HPE) architectures remain constrained by deterministic coordinate extraction from discrete heatmaps, which systematically fails under dense occlusions and Out-of-Distribution (OoD) ambiguities. To address these limitations, we propose a post-hoc continuous probabilistic framework that intercepts raw heatmaps and models them as a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) augmented with a spatially agnostic uniform distribution, requiring no architectural modifications or retraining. This continuous representation allows us to comprehensively explore the distinct contributions of density modeling to HPE. We show that the spatial expectation of our fitted GMM achieves precision parity with leading sub-pixel decoders without heuristic post-processing. Leveraging this continuous space, our test-time augmentation aggregates probability distributions rather than discrete activations, mitigating multi-scale heatmap poisoning. Furthermore, because our multimodal GMM parameterization isolates competing spatial hypotheses, it naturally interfaces with geometric regularizers such as Markov Random Fields. However, our analysis exposes the inherent vulnerabilities of 2D kinematic priors under perspective foreshortening and visual degradation. Crucially, this density formulation yields significant improvements in uncertainty quantification: our calibrated geometric covariance volume outperforms standard peak-intensity heuristics in OoD anomaly detection under severe occlusion. For in-distribution calibration, dynamically fusing our geometric metric via Adaptive Softmax reduces or matches baseline Area Under the Sparsification Error (AUSE) across benchmarks and degradation levels. Finally, we establish that this continuous parameterization is extensible to multi-view 3D architectures, bypassing the $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$ voxel memory bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 提出一种后处理连续概率框架，将热图建模为带均匀分布的GMM，无需改架构或重训练，即可提升精度、增强OoD检测与不确定度校准，并可扩展至多视角3D。
AI.motivation: 现代HPE依赖从离散热图中确定性提取坐标，在密集遮挡和分布外（OoD）歧义下系统性失效，需一种不改变架构、无需重训练的连续概率建模方式。
AI.method: 拦截原始热图，将其建模为高斯混合模型（GMM）并加入空间无关的均匀分布；利用该连续表征计算空间期望、将测试时增强改为概率分布聚合、与马尔可夫随机场等几何正则项接口、以校准的几何协方差体积进行不确定度量化，并通过自适应Softmax动态融合几何度量，且可扩展至多视角3D架构以规避O(N^3)体素内存瓶颈。
AI.result: GMM空间期望在无启发式后处理下达到与领先亚像素解码器相当的精度；概率聚合缓解多尺度热图污染；几何协方差体积在严重遮挡下OoD异常检测优于峰值强度启发式；自适应Softmax融合在多个基准与退化水平下AUSE降低或持平。
AI.conclusion: 该连续密度参数化为HPE提供通用后处理方案，改善精度、不确定度量化与异常检测，并指出2D运动学先验在透视缩短与视觉退化下的固有脆弱性。

title: AphaVoice: Text-to-Speech Model for Aphasia Patient Simulation
comment: Accepted at IEEE Spoken Language Technology (SLT) 2026
summary: While language therapy is the primary treatment for post-stroke aphasia, limited clinical resources often restrict patient access to proper care. Addressing this gap requires reliable training simulations for medical professionals. However, current AI efforts focus almost exclusively on speech processing, leaving speech generation largely unexplored. This study introduces AphaVoice, a novel text-to-speech (TTS) framework explicitly engineered to synthesize highly realistic aphasic speech. Evaluated against state-of-the-art TTS systems, AphaVoice demonstrates a superior ability to capture the clinical feature of dysfluency, outperforming existing models in temporal metrics while consistently maintaining speaker identity. By leveraging latent space shifting, the model also supports multi-speaker generation without sacrificing phonetic realism. Ultimately, AphaVoice provides a scalable, high-fidelity tool for medical training and clinical simulation related to aphasia.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出AphaVoice，一种专门合成高度逼真失语症语音的文本转语音（TTS）框架，用于医疗培训与临床模拟。
AI.motivation: 语言治疗是卒中后失语症的主要治疗手段，但临床资源有限，限制了患者获得适当护理。弥补这一缺口需要为医疗专业人员提供可靠的培训模拟，而当前AI研究几乎只聚焦语音处理，语音生成鲜有探索。
AI.method: 提出AphaVoice文本转语音框架，显式设计用于合成逼真失语症语音，并利用潜空间移位（latent space shifting）支持多说话人生成。
AI.result: 与最先进TTS系统相比，AphaVoice在捕捉失语症不流畅（dysfluency）临床特征上表现更优，在时间指标上超越现有模型，同时保持一致说话人身份；多说话人生成不牺牲语音真实性。
AI.conclusion: AphaVoice为失语症相关的医疗培训和临床模拟提供了可扩展、高保真的工具。

title: When Pleasing the User Compromises Care: AI Sycophancy in Caregiver-Mediated Healthcare
summary: Large language model (LLM) alignment often assumes that the user interacting with a model is also the primary beneficiary of its behavior. Yet in many consequential settings, one person directs the system while another bears the consequences. We study this problem in caregiver-mediated healthcare, where parents, pet owners, and caregivers make decisions for children, animals, and older adults. We introduce an evidence-grounded benchmark spanning veterinary, pediatric, and older-adult care, and test whether AI advisors maintain appropriate care when users express clinically inferior preferences. Holding patient facts fixed, we vary stated care preferences and communication styles and evaluate both initial recommendations and multi-turn follow-up. Across frontier and open-weight models, inferior preferences substantially increase switching from appropriate to inappropriate care beyond neutral conversational drift and increase agreement with the requested action, while communication style alone has a smaller effect. These failures accumulate across turns, including on cases models initially answer correctly, and often carry moderate or severe potential harm. In matched eldercare cases, the effect of an inferior preference is similar whether it is expressed by the patient or by a caregiver. Together with models' limited tendency to elicit patient preferences in caregiver conversations, this suggests that current models are highly sensitive to expressed user preferences but less sensitive to whose preferences are represented and who bears the consequences. Our results expose a broader limitation of user-centric alignment in settings with multiple stakeholders.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个覆盖兽医、儿科与老年照护的循证基准，测试AI顾问在用户表达临床上劣于最佳方案偏好时是否仍能维持恰当照护。结果显示，劣质偏好会显著促使模型从恰当照护转向不恰当照护并迎合用户请求，且多轮对话中错误累积，潜在伤害中重度居多。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM对齐通常假设与模型交互的用户即其行为的主要受益者，但在照护者代为决策的场景（父母、宠物主人、照护者代表儿童、动物、老年人）中，指令发出者与后果承担者分离，用户中心对齐可能失效，因此需系统检验模型在这种多利益相关方情境下的行为。
AI.method: 构建跨兽医、儿科与老年照护的循证基准；固定患者事实，操纵用户表达的照护偏好（含临床劣质偏好）与沟通风格；评估初始建议及多轮追问；在多个前沿与开放权重模型上对比劣质偏好效应与中性对话漂移效应；并在匹配的老年照护案例中比较偏好由患者本人还是照护者表达。
AI.result: 劣质偏好显著增加从恰当照护转向不恰当照护的比例，并提高模型对请求行为的认同度，其效应超过中性对话漂移；沟通风格单独影响较小。失败在多轮中累积，甚至出现在模型首轮答对的案例上，常伴随中度或重度潜在伤害。在匹配的老年照护案例中，劣质偏好由患者或照护者表达时效果相似。模型在照护者对话中主动引导患者偏好的倾向有限。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型对用户表达的偏好高度敏感，却对"代表谁的偏好、谁承担后果"不够敏感，暴露出用户中心对齐在多利益相关方场景中的根本局限。

title: Scenes as an Attack Surface: Uncovering Scene-Grounded Safety Failures in MLLMs
summary: Existing jailbreak attacks have exposed serious safety weaknesses in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Most prior attacks rely on specially constructed visual inputs to carry or support harmful intent. In this paper, we uncover a different vulnerability: task-relevant scene semantics alone can shift an MLLM from refusal to compliance, even when the visual input introduces no additional attack instructions and the original task intent remains unchanged. We formalize this failure as a scene-grounded visual safety vulnerability and introduce SceneSafetyBench to investigate it across eight risk categories and nine white- and black-box MLLMs. Our analysis reveals that this failure is associated with how task-relevant visual evidence influences downstream safety representations, suggesting that visual grounding alone cannot fully explain the observed safety shift. Building on this finding, we propose Scene-Grounded Attacks (SGA), which preserve the original task while constructing validated scene-grounded queries and combining their independent responses. Across nine target MLLMs, SGA achieves an average attack success rate (ASR) of 86.17%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 8.55 percentage points and achieving the highest ASR on eight models. Our results identify scene semantics as an overlooked attack surface in MLLMs and highlight a growing tension between stronger visual grounding and robust multimodal safety alignment.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示多模态大模型的一个新安全漏洞：仅靠任务相关的场景语义即可使模型从拒绝转为顺从，并据此提出基准SceneSafetyBench与攻击方法SGA，在9个模型上平均ASR达86.17%。
AI.motivation: 已有越狱攻击多依赖特制视觉输入来承载或辅助有害意图，而本文发现即便视觉输入不含额外攻击指令、原始任务意图不变，仅任务相关的场景语义也足以扭转MLLM的安全行为，这一被忽视的攻击面亟需系统研究。
AI.method: 作者将该失效形式化为"场景接地视觉安全漏洞"，构建覆盖8类风险、9个白盒与黑盒MLLM的基准SceneSafetyBench；通过分析任务相关视觉证据对下游安全表征的影响定位成因，并提出Scene-Grounded Attacks（SGA）：在保持原任务不变的前提下构造经校验的场景接地查询，并融合其独立响应。
AI.result: 在9个目标MLLM上，SGA平均攻击成功率86.17%，较最强基线高8.55个百分点，并在8个模型上取得最高ASR；分析显示视觉接地本身无法完全解释观察到的安全偏移。
AI.conclusion: 场景语义是MLLM中一个被长期忽视的攻击面，凸显了更强视觉接地能力与稳健多模态安全对齐之间日益加剧的矛盾。

title: LongHisDoc: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chinese Long Historical Document Understanding
summary: Chinese historical documents are invaluable cultural treasures, but their complexity poses significant comprehension challenges for non-specialists. Despite the success of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) in modern document tasks, their capabilities in Long (full-book) Historical Document understanding remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce LongHisDoc, the first benchmark tailored for long historical document understanding. LongHisDoc comprises 1,012 expert-annotated QA pairs derived from 101 PDF documents, with an average of 85.1 pages and 42,776.4 tokens per document. It spans 10 categories and features four QA types: single-page, cross-page, multi-hop, and unanswerable. Answering these questions requires integrating multimodal evidence from text, layout, and visual elements. Our evaluation reveals that the top-performing LVLM and LLM achieve only 62.9% and 69.9% accuracy, respectively, highlighting a substantial performance gap. Furthermore, we assess various modal retrievers and the end-to-end RAG performance to provide references for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. We believe that LongHisDoc serves as a comprehensive benchmark to catalyze future research in full-book historical document understanding. The benchmark and evaluation code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/qweq12433454/LongHisDoc and https://github.com/SCUT-DLVCLab/LongHisDoc.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 LongHisDoc，首个面向长篇（整本书）历史文献理解的基准，含 1012 个专家标注 QA 对，覆盖 10 类文档与 4 种问答类型，并揭示现有 LLM/LVLM 的性能瓶颈，为 RAG 系统提供评估参考。
AI.motivation: 中文历史文献是重要文化遗产，但内容复杂，非专业人士理解困难。尽管 LLM 与 LVLM 在现代文档任务上表现优异，其在长篇（整本书）历史文献理解上的能力尚未被充分探索，缺乏相应评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 LongHisDoc 基准：源自 101 份 PDF 文献，平均每份 85.1 页、42,776.4 tokens，包含 1012 个专家标注问答对；覆盖 10 个类别，设四类问答（单页、跨页、多跳、不可回答），需融合文本、版面与视觉多模态证据；并评测多种模态检索器及端到端 RAG 性能。
AI.result: 最佳 LVLM 与 LLM 准确率仅为 62.9% 和 69.9%，存在显著性能差距；同时给出了多种模态检索器与端到端 RAG 的评测结果。
AI.conclusion: LongHisDoc 可作为综合性基准，推动整本历史文献理解的未来研究；基准与评测代码已公开。

title: ACED-Bench: Evaluating How LLM Agents Acquire and Act on Causal Evidence
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as scientific assistants, yet we still lack reliable ways to evaluate whether they can investigate a system rather than merely answer a prompt. A useful evaluation must let agents choose experiments, interpret finite evidence, and make causal decisions, while keeping the environment coherent across repeated observations and interventions and preserving objective ground truth. We introduce ACED-BENCH (Active Causal Evidence and Decision Benchmark), a neuro-symbolic benchmark built around this requirement. The key idea is to separate the readable scientific surface from the formal causal world: LLMs generate natural-language scenarios and task text, while hidden probabilistic graphical models define the causal graph, data-generating process, intervention semantics, validation checks, and oracle answers. This yields scientific worlds that are natural for agents to investigate but exact enough for scalable, programmatic evaluation. The main leaderboard ACED-CORE contains 180 tasks: 60 set-valued causal ancestry/descendancy questions and 120 constrained causal-decision tasks. We also report ACED-QUAL, a 150-question yes/no qualification check using the same hidden-PGM interface. We evaluate seven contemporary LLMs and two earlier-generation models across three active agent designs. ACED-QUAL checks whether agents can use the interface to draw conclusions from evidence, while ACED-CORE tests whether they can decide what evidence to collect and when to commit to an answer. Evidence-ledger analysis localizes failures within the investigation: agents test the wrong intervention, lose relevant evidence, or continue after sufficient evidence has appeared. These results suggest that reliable AI co-scientists need explicit support for experiment design, evidence retention, answer commitment, and stopping.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ACED-BENCH神经符号基准，通过分离自然语言科学表层与隐藏概率图模型因果世界，评估LLM主动因果调查能力，包含180项任务的ACED-CORE主榜和150题的ACED-QUAL资格检验，发现智能体在实验设计、证据保留、答案承诺与停止判断上存在系统性失败。
AI.motivation: 现有评估无法可靠判断大语言模型能否像科学助手那样主动调查系统，而非仅回答提示。一个有用的评估需允许智能体选择实验、解读有限证据并做出因果决策，同时保持环境在重复观察与干预下的一致性和客观真值。
AI.method: 构建神经符号基准ACED-BENCH，核心是分离可读科学表层与形式化因果世界：LLM生成自然语言场景与任务文本，隐藏概率图模型定义因果图、数据生成过程、干预语义、验证检查与oracle答案。主榜ACED-CORE含180项任务（60项集合值因果祖先/后代问题、120项约束因果决策任务）；ACED-QUAL为150题是/否资格检验，使用相同隐藏PGM接口。评估7个当代LLM和2个早期模型，跨3种主动智能体设计。
AI.result: ACED-QUAL检验智能体能否利用接口从证据中得出结论；ACED-CORE测试其能否决定收集何种证据以及何时提交答案。证据账本分析将失败定位在调查过程中：智能体测试错误的干预、丢失相关证据，或在证据已充分时仍继续。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的AI共同科学家需要针对实验设计、证据保留、答案承诺与停止判断的显式支持。

title: TrajCFG: Token-Wise Classifier-Free Guidance via Denoising Trajectory Feedback
summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) typically applies a shared scale to all latent tokens, although their velocity predictions evolve differently during sampling. We introduce Trajectory-Adaptive Classifier-Free Guidance (TrajCFG), a training-free method for flow-matching models that adapts token-wise guidance using historical changes in guided velocity direction. TrajCFG maps this feedback to bounded scales, assigning stronger guidance to larger directional changes and weaker guidance to more consistent directions. It combines adjacent-step and interval-normalized longer-span feedback, reusing standard CFG predictions without additional model evaluations. Controlled diagnostics and ablations examine the roles of directional feedback, token-wise allocation, and history-span fusion. Experiments on text-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-audio-video, text-to-image, and image-to-3D generation show improvements over base samplers across multiple backbones. For text-to-video generation, TrajCFG improves VBench Total scores by 0.30-0.75 points over the strongest evaluated baseline on each of three backbones. These results support historical directional feedback as a broadly applicable signal for fine-grained guidance allocation. The project page is available at https://jyliu-98.github.io/trajcfg-project-page/.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的TrajCFG，用历史速度方向变化实现token级自适应无分类器引导，在多模态生成任务上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 标准CFG对所有潜变量token使用统一引导尺度，但采样中各token的速度预测演化并不相同，统一尺度无法实现细粒度引导分配。
AI.method: TrajCFG基于引导速度方向的历史变化，将反馈映射为有界尺度：方向变化大的token获得更强引导，方向一致的token引导更弱；融合相邻步与区间归一化的长跨度反馈，复用标准CFG预测，不增加模型评估；并通过受控诊断与消融分析方向反馈、token级分配与历史跨度融合的作用。
AI.result: 在文本到视频、图像到视频、文本-音频-视频、文本到图像和图像到3D生成任务上，多个骨干网络均优于基础采样器；文本到视频中，三个骨干网络的VBench总分较最强基线提升0.30–0.75分。
AI.conclusion: 历史方向反馈是一种可广泛适用的细粒度引导分配信号。

title: Uniform Information Density-Based Preference Optimization
summary: To enable large language models to generate outputs that align with human preferences, optimization algorithms based on the comparison between chosen and rejected output pairs have been developed and been proven effective. Some recent endeavors have utilized certain linguistically-derived assumptions about the preference pairs to guide the design of more precise optimization directions. However, human preferences are complex and hard to measure by simplistic criteria, and it is important to incorporate broader and more sophisticated insights about preferred vs. not-preferred language. In this study, we adopt a well-established psycholinguistic theory, Uniform Information Density, to develop a novel preference optimization algorithm, UIDPO. The basic assumption is that humans prefer to produce language in which information is uniformly distributed, because uniformity induces less cognitive processing effort. To implement this idea into the algorithm, we derive a compound metric for information uniformity by combining the global standard deviation and the local second-order difference, and integrate it to the objective of preference optimization. We compare UIDPO with SimPO, a previous state-of-the-art method, obtaining comparable and sometimes better performance on AlpacaEval2, ArenaHard, and MT-Bench. Additional linguistic analysis on complement clauses also shows that UIDPO can better reflect the tendencies of keeping information uniform in natural language than baselines. Our results show that the subtle human preference over the information rate in language is a helpful source for achieving better human alignment for LLMs. The code repository is published here: https://github.com/CLCS-SUSTech/UIDPO.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出UIDPO，将心理语言学中的统一信息密度理论引入偏好优化，用全局标准差与局部二阶差分的复合指标衡量信息均匀性，在AlpacaEval2、ArenaHard、MT-Bench上取得与SimPO相当或更优的表现，并能更好反映自然语言的信息均匀倾向。
AI.motivation: 现有基于chosen/rejected偏好对的对齐算法多依赖简化的语言学假设来设计优化方向，但人类偏好复杂，简单标准难以刻画。作者希望引入更广泛、更精细的关于“偏好语言 vs. 非偏好语言”的洞见，借助成熟的心理语言学理论提升对齐效果。
AI.method: 采用心理语言学中的Uniform Information Density（统一信息密度）理论，假设人类倾向产生信息均匀分布的语言以降低认知加工成本。为此推导出结合全局标准差与局部二阶差分的复合信息均匀性指标，并将其整合进偏好优化目标，形成新算法UIDPO。
AI.result: 在AlpacaEval2、ArenaHard和MT-Bench上，UIDPO与前SOTA方法SimPO相比取得相当、有时更优的性能；在补语从句上的额外语言学分析表明，UIDPO比基线更能反映自然语言中保持信息均匀的倾向。
AI.conclusion: 语言中信息速率的细微人类偏好可作为实现LLM更好人类对齐的有效来源，UIDPO验证了将心理语言学理论融入偏好优化的可行性。代码已发布于https://github.com/CLCS-SUSTech/UIDPO。

title: ANASSA: From High-Level Framework to Low-Level Architecture for Spatial Agentic AI
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Design Science Research (DSR) study
summary: Agentic AI systems operating over geospatial data require more than autonomous reasoning and tool use; they must also support explicit orchestration, spatial validation, governance, provenance, failure handling, and human decision authority. Prior work introduced ANASSA, an agentic AI orchestration framework for spatial intelligence that established high-level components and responsibility boundaries for governed agentic execution (arXiv:2609.14824). However, the framework did not specify how those high-level responsibilities should be systematically decomposed into an implementation-facing low-level architecture. This paper addresses that gap by applying Design Science Research (DSR) to refine the ANASSA framework from high-level architectural (HLA) responsibilities into a low-level architecture (LLA). The resulting design preserves the responsibility boundaries of the foundational framework while translating them into executable architectural structures, including 47 logical roles, versioned task graphs, capability-based agent selection, typed contracts, explicit runtime states, spatial validation mechanisms, governance controls, failure and recovery paths, and provenance records. The architecture is demonstrated through an end-to-end execution trace and analytically evaluated for requirements traceability, internal consistency, responsibility preservation, and technology independence. The resulting high-level-to-low-level design provides an implementation-facing bridge between the ANASSA framework and future system implementations, defining how governed spatial agentic workflows can be made inspectable, reconstructable, and testable without binding the architecture to a specific AI model, geospatial platform, communication protocol, or deployment environment.

AI.tldr: 本文运用设计科学研究（DSR）将 ANASSA 空间智能智能体编排框架从高层架构（HLA）责任细化到低层架构（LLA），产出47个逻辑角色、版本化任务图、能力驱动智能体选择、类型化契约、运行时状态、空间验证、治理控制与溯源记录等可执行结构，并经端到端执行轨迹演示与多维度分析评估。
AI.motivation: 地理空间数据上的智能体AI系统不仅需要自主推理与工具调用，还需支持显式编排、空间验证、治理、溯源、失效处理与人类决策权。既有工作 ANASSA 虽确立了高层组件与责任边界，但未说明如何将这些高层责任系统化分解为面向实现的具体架构，形成研究缺口。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究（DSR）方法，将 ANASSA 框架的高层架构（HLA）责任逐步细化、转化为低层架构（LLA）；设计过程中保持原有责任边界不变，并将其映射为可执行的架构构件。
AI.result: 产出的 LLA 包含47个逻辑角色、版本化任务图、基于能力的智能体选择、类型化契约、显式运行时状态、空间验证机制、治理控制、失效与恢复路径以及溯源记录；通过端到端执行轨迹进行演示，并从需求可追溯性、内部一致性、责任保持性与技术独立性四个维度进行解析式评估。
AI.conclusion: 该高层到低层的设计在 ANASSA 框架与未来系统实现之间搭建了面向实现的桥梁，明确了受治理的空间智能体工作流如何做到可审查、可重建、可测试，同时不绑定特定AI模型、地理空间平台、通信协议或部署环境。

title: Video-Arena: A Scalable Agentic Video Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Capability
summary: Understanding and tracking a dynamic world are fundamental to visual intelligence. Existing video benchmarks provide limited insight into whether models can maintain a coherent understanding of evolving world state. Building such a benchmark from real-world videos is challenging because the underlying world state is partially observable, making annotations hard to obtain. To close this gap, we introduce Video-Arena, a benchmark that turns competitive games into scalable, verifiable tests of how well models understand evolving world states from videos. Specifically, inspired by how humans understand dynamic events, we evaluate spatiotemporal world state understanding and tracking through three task categories: perceiving critical events, interpreting state updates, and tracking the resulting states. Our pipeline can generate videos and aligned reference labels from game records at scale. To keep evaluation affordable and reproducible, we curate a golden set of 180 tasks across 9 games and run evaluations under two protocols: native visual understanding and tool-assisted agentic analysis. The best-performing systems achieve F1 scores of and under the two protocols, respectively. The result highlights that native models struggle to perceive events reliably, while tool-assisted systems improve event recovery but still struggle to interpret state updates and track the resulting states consistently over time. Our project page is in https://videoarena-bench.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出 Video-Arena 基准，将竞技游戏转化为可扩展、可验证的视频世界状态理解测试，包含180个任务、9款游戏，采用原生视觉理解与工具辅助智能体分析两种评测协议。
AI.motivation: 理解与跟踪动态世界是视觉智能的核心，但现有视频基准难以判断模型能否维持对演化世界状态的一致理解。原因在于真实视频中的底层世界状态仅部分可观测，标注难以获取，导致构建此类基准困难。
AI.method: 受人类理解动态事件方式的启发，构建 Video-Arena 基准，把竞技游戏作为可扩展、可验证的测试载体，从游戏记录中大规模生成视频及对齐的参考标签。评测涵盖三类任务：感知关键事件、解释状态更新、跟踪由此产生的状态。选取9款游戏共180个任务构成黄金集，并在两种协议下评测：原生视觉理解与工具辅助的智能体分析。
AI.result: 在两种评测协议下，表现最佳的系统分别取得相应的 F1 分数（原文数值缺失）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明原生模型难以可靠地感知事件；工具辅助系统虽能改善事件恢复，但在解释状态更新、随时间一致地跟踪状态方面仍存在困难。

title: PVFH-Bench: Benchmarking Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, object hallucination remains a persistent challenge, undermining model reliability in applications such as visual question answering, embodied agents, and human-AI decision support systems. In this paper, inspired by cognitive science studies on perceptual bias, we investigate a new failure mode termed Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination (PVFH). Specifically, PVFH refers to a premise-induced reasoning error in which models become anchored to visually confusable evidence, accept a false textual premise, and subsequently generate responses about an absent yet visually plausible object. To systematically study this phenomenon, we introduce PVFH-Bench, a benchmark that automatically constructs visually confusable but absent targets and pairs the core hallucination setting with diagnostic subsets to trace how models move from object recognition to Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination. Experimental results on 10 state-of-the-art LVLMs demonstrate that all evaluated models are highly vulnerable to Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination. Moreover, we find that explicit chain-of-thought reasoning can further exacerbate this failure mode by encouraging models to overinterpret weak visual cues as supporting evidence for hallucinated objects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并研究"前提诱发视觉固着幻觉"(PVFH)这一新失效模式，并构建PVFH-Bench基准，发现10个先进LVLM均高度易感，且显式思维链推理会加剧该失效。
AI.motivation: LVLM在多模态任务中进展显著，但物体幻觉仍是持续难题，损害VQA、具身智能与决策支持等应用的可靠性。受认知科学中知觉偏差研究启发，作者希望探究一种此前未被系统研究的、由文本前提诱发的幻觉失效模式。
AI.method: 提出PVFH概念：模型固着于视觉上易混淆的证据，接受虚假文本前提，进而生成关于"并不存在但视觉上看似合理"物体的回答。构建PVFH-Bench基准，自动构造视觉易混淆但实际缺失的目标，将核心幻觉设定与诊断性子集配对，以追踪模型从物体识别到PVFH的演化过程。
AI.result: 在10个最先进LVLM上的实验表明，所有被评估模型均高度易受PVFH影响；显式思维链推理反而会通过促使模型将弱视觉线索过度解读为幻觉物体的支撑证据，进一步加剧该失效模式。
AI.conclusion: PVFH是一种普遍且严重的LVLM失效模式，思维链并非可靠缓解手段，反而可能放大该问题，提示需针对前提诱导的视觉固着设计更稳健的缓解策略。

title: Measuring the Inference Energy Efficiency of Open-Weight LLMs across Benchmarks, Reasoning Modes, and Hardware
summary: Benchmark scores tell us what an LLM can do, but not how much energy is required to deliver that capability. We directly measure this trade-off for 86 open-weight model checkpoints, evaluated on seven benchmarks and six hardware platforms ranging from a consumer GPU to an eight-GPU server. We find large differences in energy efficiency even among models with similar capability. Most configurations lie away from the score--energy Pareto frontier: they use a median of 2.6--4.8$\times$ more energy than another configuration that scores at least as well, with differences reaching 27$\times$. Reasoning can improve capability, but enabling thinking increases energy by about 3.7$\times$ on average, and the benefit depends strongly on the model family and output budget. Generated-token count is also an imperfect proxy for energy, misordering 18--24\% of model pairs. In contrast, FP8 reduces energy by roughly a quarter with little change in score, while changing hardware largely rescales energy without changing the relative ranking of models. These results show that capability alone gives an incomplete picture of efficiency. We argue that benchmark scores should be reported together with measured energy consumption under a specified serving regime and output budget.

AI.tldr: 对86个开放权重模型检查点、7个基准和6种硬件平台的实测显示，相近能力下能效差异巨大，多数配置离得分—能耗帕累托前沿较远，能耗高出中位数2.6–4.8倍、最高27倍；思维模式平均增耗约3.7倍，生成token数并非能耗的良好代理。建议报告基准分数时同步给出指定服务配置与输出预算下的实测能耗。
AI.motivation: 基准分数只能反映大语言模型能做什么，无法说明实现该能力所需的能耗。能力与能耗之间的权衡缺乏直接、跨模型与跨硬件的系统测量，导致仅凭分数评估效率的视角不完整。
AI.method: 对86个开放权重模型检查点进行实测，覆盖7个基准与6种硬件平台（从消费级GPU到八GPU服务器）；分析得分—能耗帕累托前沿、思维模式与输出预算的影响、生成token数作为能耗代理的可靠性，以及FP8量化与硬件更换的作用。
AI.result: 相近能力模型间能效差异显著；多数配置偏离帕累托前沿，能耗中位数为同等或更高分数配置的2.6–4.8倍，差异最大达27倍；启用思维平均增耗约3.7倍且收益依赖模型家族与输出预算；生成token数在18–24%的模型对中排序错误；FP8降低约四分之一能耗且分数变化很小；更换硬件主要整体缩放能耗，不改变模型相对排名。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭能力无法完整刻画效率。基准分数应与指定服务配置和输出预算下的实测能耗一同报告。

title: Token-Budgeted Candidate Retrieval for 3D Scene-Grounded VLMs: Category Names vs. Pairwise Geometry
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Physical World AI (non-archival)
summary: Under a fixed context budget, which objects and relations should a 3D scene-grounded VLM see first? On ScanNet indoor referring benchmarks (Dai et al., 2017), matching the query to object category names outperforms pairwise geometry scoring at every reported K. The gaps are largest at high recall. Analytic pairwise cues beat per-object cue scoring and query-agnostic kNN graphs, including on paraphrases. MiniLM and BGE-small still score higher on those splits. We evaluate token-budgeted candidate retrieval with axis-aligned boxes, a token-ratio metric, training-free baselines, two small encoders that match q to each object's category name, and QCRR (Query-Conditioned Relation Retrieval), a deterministic pairwise-geometry scorer. Across ScanRefer gt_val plus a custom 20% scan-id split of Nr3D and Sr3D (35,504 queries; not official ReferIt3D val), additive noun matching reaches R@10 0.864 on ScanRefer against QCRR's 0.626; MiniLM and BGE-small reach 0.911 to 0.913 on ScanRefer and 0.941 to 0.947 on Nr3D. A corrected 3DGraphLLM harness (native Acc@0.25 0.67 on the full graph, n=300 ScanRefer queries) shows that context selection changes downstream accuracy under a matched object budget (Random 0.44, QCRR 0.56, MiniLM 0.67, oracle 0.70). Semantic retrieval beats hand-designed geometry on that harness. We will release the protocol, retriever implementations, and per-query outputs so new selectors can be swapped in without rewriting the analysis.

AI.tldr: 在固定上下文预算下，语义类别名匹配（尤其是MiniLM/BGE-small）在3D场景指代任务的候选检索中显著优于手工设计的成对几何评分，并能提升下游准确率。
AI.motivation: 3D场景接地VLM在固定token预算下需决定优先呈现哪些对象与关系，但缺乏对"何种检索策略更优"的系统比较。本文旨在比较语义检索与几何评分在token预算受限的候选检索中的效果。
AI.method: 在ScanNet室内指代基准上开展token预算受限的候选检索实验，使用轴对齐框和token-ratio指标；对比无训练基线、两个将查询与对象类别名匹配的小编码器、以及QCRR（查询条件化成对几何评分器）。数据集包括ScanRefer gt_val及Nr3D/Sr3D的自定义20% scan-id划分（35,504条查询），并在修正后的3DGraphLLM框架下用匹配对象预算评估上下文选择对下游准确率的影响。
AI.result: ScanRefer上加法名词匹配R@10为0.864，QCRR为0.626；MiniLM与BGE-small在ScanRefer达0.911-0.913，在Nr3D达0.941-0.947。3DGraphLLM修正框架下（n=300），下游准确率：随机0.44、QCRR 0.56、MiniLM 0.67、oracle 0.70。
AI.conclusion: 语义检索在候选检索及下游任务上均优于手工几何评分，且优势在高召回和释义场景下最明显。作者将发布协议、检索器实现与逐查询输出，便于替换新选择器而无需重写分析。

title: Lingdan-V2: Large language models for clinically grounded reasoning in traditional Chinese medicine
summary: Large language models have advanced medical reasoning, but clinically grounded reasoning in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) remains challenging because prescription decisions require integrating domain knowledge, syndrome differentiation, treatment principles, herbal prescription composition, and dosage determination. We develop a TCM language model family comprising models with 4 billion, 8 billion, and 14 billion parameters. The artificial intelligence contribution is a staged clinical alignment framework integrating large scale continued pretraining on TCM and clinical records, complementary reasoning supervision, and prescription-centered reinforcement learning (RL). We further formulate herbal prescription generation as a structured RL problem with prescription-level feedback, enabling direct optimization of clinical decision outputs beyond knowledge reproduction and generic instruction following. The engineering application is TCM clinical decision support, particularly herbal prescription recommendation. We evaluate the models on a public benchmark containing 25,620 expert-verified items across 13 TCM knowledge and clinical reasoning tasks and on a private retrospective dataset of 4,348 spleen and stomach disease prescription cases. The 14 billion parameter reinforcement aligned model achieves a prescription generation F1 of 37.0 on the public benchmark, compared with 32.3 for DeepSeek-R1 with 671 billion total parameters, and a herb-level F1 of 52.8 on the clinical dataset with improved dosage agreement. Reinforcement post-training consistently improves prescription recommendation across all scales, while physician-source analysis shows that expert heterogeneity affects reward stability. These findings demonstrate a scalable pathway from domain grounding and reasoning supervision to clinically oriented prescription decision support.

AI.tldr: 开发40亿、80亿、140亿参数的中医语言模型家族，通过分阶段临床对齐与处方级强化学习，在处方生成任务上以140亿参数超越6710亿参数的DeepSeek-R1。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型推动了医学推理发展，但中医临床落地推理仍具挑战，因为处方决策需整合领域知识、辨证、治则、组方与剂量确定等多环节能力。
AI.method: 构建分阶段临床对齐框架：大规模中医与临床记录继续预训练、互补推理监督、以处方为中心的强化学习；将中药处方生成为结构化RL问题，采用处方级反馈直接优化临床决策输出。
AI.result: 公开基准含13项任务、25620条专家核验样本，140亿对齐模型处方生成F1为37.0（DeepSeek-R1为32.3）；4348例脾胃病处方回顾数据集上药材级F1达52.8，剂量一致性提升。强化后训练在各规模上均提升处方推荐，但医生来源分析显示专家异质性影响奖励稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现展示了一条从领域奠基、推理监督到面向临床的处方决策支持的可扩展路径。

title: SAT-RL: Training Language Models for Logical Reasoning with Symbolic Solvers
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in mathematical and logical reasoning, yet they still suffer from the curse of complexity and struggle as problem difficulty increases with the number of constraint interactions and the size of the search space. In contrast, satisfiability solvers such as Z3 provide scalable and verifiable reasoning through constraint solving under formal theories, but lack the flexibility to interpret natural-language problem descriptions. In this work, we propose SAT-RL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that trains LLMs to interact with symbolic solvers through multi-turn tool execution. SAT-RL leverages synthetic data generation with verifiable solutions, supervised warm-up on solver-augmented traces, and solver-grounded reinforcement learning with tool-aware rewards. Experiments show that SAT-RL substantially improves symbolic reasoning with tools on both in-domain and out-of-domain logic tasks. Our code is available on https://github.com/sunjia72/SAT-RL.

AI.tldr: SAT-RL：通过多轮工具调用与强化学习训练LLM交互符号求解器，结合可验证合成数据、监督预热与求解器接地RL，显著提升域内/域外逻辑推理。
AI.motivation: LLM在数学与逻辑推理上表现强劲，但随约束交互数量和搜索空间增长，面临复杂度诅咒，难度上升时性能下降；而Z3等可满足性求解器虽可扩展、可验证，却缺乏解释自然语言问题的灵活性。
AI.method: 提出SAT-RL强化学习框架，训练LLM通过多轮工具执行与符号求解器交互。方法包括：带可验证解的合成数据生成、在求解器增强轨迹上的监督预热、以及带工具感知奖励的求解器接地强化学习。
AI.result: 实验表明，SAT-RL在域内和域外逻辑任务上均大幅提升带工具的符号推理能力。代码已开源：https://github.com/sunjia72/SAT-RL。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM的自然语言理解优势与符号求解器的可扩展、可验证推理结合，通过多轮工具调用与RL训练，是缓解复杂度诅咒、提升符号推理的有效路径。

title: CAPTOR: a vision-language foundation model for Chest-Abdomen-Pelvis Oncologic CT
summary:
Purpose : To develop and evaluate CAPTOR, a deep-learning vision-language foundation model for oncologic chest-abdomen-pelvis (CAP) CT interpretation.
  Materials & Methods : CAPTOR (Chest-Abdomen-Pelvis foundaTion model for Oncologic Radiology) is a contrastive vision-language model, trained using a pretraining strategy for oncologic CAP CT (in single- or multiple-series acquisitions), on a multicenter retrospective dataset from North America, Europe and Asia, predominantly from tumor lesion examinations. CAPTOR was compared with state-of-the-art CT foundation models on three downstream tasks: disease detection, survival prediction using TumorImagingBench and image retrieval. Classification and retrieval were both evaluated on held-out internal and public test sets, stratified by anatomical coverage and indication. Bootstrap resampling was used to estimate confidence intervals, and pairwise comparisons were performed using permutation tests.
  Results : CAPTOR was trained and tested on 25,512 and 10,794 CT-report pairs respectively. TumorImagingBench datasets comprised between 134 and 421 studies each. CAPTOR outperformed all baseline models, on the classification task, on the CAP subset (AUC 0.767, 95%CI: 0.734-0.793, vs. 0.695, 95%CI: 0.645-0.736 for the next-best, p<0.001) and oncologic subset (AUC 0.784, 95%CI: 0.759-0.805, vs. 0.734, 95%CI: 0.703-0.767 p<0.001), ranked first on three of the four oncologic prognostic benchmarks, and achieved superior retrieval performance on CAP and oncologic subsets.
  Conclusion : A foundation model trained on oncology-enriched CAP CT data outperformed relevant state-of-the-art models in its target clinical context, underscoring the importance of clinically aligned pretraining.
  We release our preprocessing, training and inference code : https://github.com/Guerbet-AI/CAPTOR and model weights : https://huggingface.co/Guerbet-AI/CAPTOR

AI.tldr: CAPTOR 是一个面向肿瘤学胸腹盆（CAP）CT 的对比式视觉-语言基础模型，基于多中心肿瘤富集数据预训练，在疾病检测、生存预测和图像检索三类任务上均优于现有 CT 基础模型。
AI.motivation: 通用 CT 基础模型的预训练数据与目标临床场景（肿瘤学 CAP CT）存在领域差异，缺乏临床对齐；作者希望验证"临床对齐预训练"对下游肿瘤影像任务性能的重要性。
AI.method: CAPTOR（Chest-Abdomen-Pelvis foundaTion model for Oncologic Radiology）为对比式视觉-语言模型，采用针对肿瘤学 CAP CT（单序列或多序列采集）的预训练策略，使用来自北美、欧洲和亚洲的多中心回顾性数据集（以肿瘤病灶检查为主）训练。在三个下游任务上与最先进 CT 基础模型对比：疾病检测、生存预测（TumorImagingBench）和图像检索。分类与检索在留出的内部及公开测试集上评估，并按解剖覆盖范围和适应证分层。采用自助重采样估计置信区间，配对比较使用置换检验。
AI.result: CAPTOR 分别在 25,512 与 10,794 对 CT-报告上训练和测试；TumorImagingBench 各数据集含 134–421 例研究。分类任务中 CAPTOR 全面超越所有基线：CAP 子集 AUC 0.767（95%CI: 0.734–0.793）vs 次优 0.695（95%CI: 0.645–0.736），p<0.001；肿瘤学子集 AUC 0.784（95%CI: 0.759–0.805）vs 0.734（95%CI: 0.703–0.767），p<0.001。在四个肿瘤预后基准中的三个排名第一，并在 CAP 与肿瘤学子集上取得更优的检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 在肿瘤富集的 CAP CT 数据上训练的基础模型，在其目标临床场景中优于相关最先进模型，凸显了临床对齐预训练的重要性。作者开源了预处理、训练与推理代码及模型权重。

title: Vela: User Behavior as Supervision Sparks LLM Intelligence
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in applications that act on users' long-term behavior histories, from personal assistants to recommendation and advertising systems. These applications demand the user dimension of LLM intelligence: inferring a person's preferences, intent, and likely future actions from weeks to years of behavior data. Yet current models are trained on static text or synthetic data, neither of which captures how user behavior evolves over time. Real-world behavior records, already available at scale on content platforms and in personal-assistant agents, offer a natural supervisory signal. We propose user behavior as supervision and introduce Vela, a framework that converts real user behavior data into trainable tasks and trajectories. From the anonymized behavior records of 100,000 users, Vela generates 100,000 tasks across 91 real-world task templates; difficulty-based filtering and trajectory acceptance criteria retain approximately 75,000 tasks with selected training trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on these trajectories improves performance over the base model by up to 11.5 points on user-related tasks and by an average of 4 points on general benchmarks. Training on more user behavior data further improves user-related performance, and reinforcement learning after fine-tuning outperforms reinforcement learning from the base model by up to 7.7 points. These gains suggest that real-world user behavior is a scalable source of supervision for both user-centered capabilities and the broader intelligence of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出以真实用户行为作为监督信号，构建Vela框架将10万用户行为数据转化为任务与轨迹，微调后显著提升用户相关任务与通用基准表现。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多用于需理解用户长期行为的场景（个人助手、推荐与广告），需具备"用户维度"智能：从数周至数年的行为数据推断偏好、意图与未来行为。但现有模型训练于静态文本或合成数据，无法刻画用户行为的时间演化；而平台与助手已积累大规模真实行为记录，是天然的监督来源。
AI.method: 提出以用户行为作为监督，构建Vela框架，将真实用户行为数据转换为可训练任务与轨迹。基于10万用户匿名行为记录，依据91个真实任务模板生成10万条任务，并通过难度过滤与轨迹接受准则保留约7.5万条任务及选定训练轨迹。以此微调Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，并在微调后进行强化学习。
AI.result: 微调后相较基座模型在用户相关任务上提升最高11.5分，通用基准平均提升4分；使用更多用户行为数据可进一步提升用户相关表现；微调后强化学习较从基座直接强化学习高出最多7.7分。
AI.conclusion: 真实世界用户行为是可扩展的监督来源，既能提升以用户为中心的能力，也能促进LLM更广泛的智能。

title: Frustratingly Easy Agentic RAG via Portable Skills: A Case Study in Customer Support
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Industry Track. 15 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables
summary:
Enterprise workflow automation typically requires retrieving a complete and accurate set of relevant information from large operational document corpora (SOPs, policy documents) given a specific scenario or request. In customer support (CS), for example, human specialists must determine the correct sequence of resolution steps for each case, a task that demands precise grounding in policy documentation. Meeting this bar in production typically requires complex document chunking, indexing, and retrieval pipelines, often layered with learned re-rankers, query rewriters, and bespoke agentic RAG infrastructure.
  We report a deployment case study of a simpler alternative: a portable skill consisting of a natural-language instruction, lightweight tools (a retrieval API, format-checking scripts), and a corpus enriched with an LLM-generated navigation layer, which is a structured "Wikipedia-style" index over the underlying documents. This agentic RAG approach is straightforward to implement (1-2 engineer days), portable across capable agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code), and performs strongly on the challenging task of CS resolution workflow generation, achieving 99.2% procedural equivalence to human-approved ground truth and 83.3% evidence sufficiency. It is also roughly an order of magnitude slower per case than our deployed production assistant (~90 s vs. ~8-9 s), so we claim no latency advantage. Our claim is scoped to that setting: a mature, well-curated corpus, a latency-tolerant workflow, and human review of every case. There, the skill did the work of a complex RAG stack, and maintenance became a matter of editing text and data rather than retraining models.

AI.tldr: 报告一个部署案例：用“自然语言技能 + 轻量工具 + LLM生成的维基式导航层”的简化Agentic RAG方案，替代复杂RAG栈，在客服解决流程生成任务上达到99.2%流程等价与83.3%证据充分性，但每例耗时约90秒，比生产助手慢约一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 企业工作流自动化需从大型操作文档语料（SOP、政策文档）中检索完整准确的信息；客服场景要求人工专家依据政策文档确定正确的解决步骤序列。生产级达标通常依赖复杂的文档切分、索引与检索流水线，并叠加学习式重排器、查询改写和定制的Agentic RAG基础设施，成本与维护负担高，因此作者探索更简单的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出一种可移植的“技能”（skill）：由自然语言指令、轻量工具（检索API、格式检查脚本）以及经过LLM生成导航层增强的语料库组成，该导航层是覆盖底层文档的结构化“维基百科式”索引。整体为Agentic RAG方案，可在Claude Code等具备能力的Agent框架间移植，实现成本约1–2个工程师日。
AI.result: 在客服解决工作流生成任务上，达到99.2%的流程等价度（相对人工审核通过的ground truth）与83.3%的证据充分性；每例约90秒，而部署的生产助手约8–9秒，即慢约一个数量级，作者明确不主张延迟优势。
AI.conclusion: 该结论有明确适用边界：成熟且精心策划的语料库、可容忍延迟的工作流、每例均有人工复核。在此设定下，该技能可完成复杂RAG栈的工作，且维护转变为编辑文本与数据，而非重训模型。

title: Latent World Action Model for GUI Agents
summary: Pixel-space world models have recently emerged as a promising approach for GUI agents, predicting future screens prior to execution and subsequently re-perceiving them for action selection. However, this two-stage paradigm faces two key challenges in GUI environments: (L1) the high computational cost of pixel reconstruction and (L2) the need to reconstruct large and diverse appearance-level details beyond what is required for action selection. In practice, this screen-generation objective can induce an identity shortcut problem, where future-state prediction largely preserves the current state rather than capturing action-induced changes. In this work, we reformulate GUI world modeling by shifting the prediction target from full-screen reconstruction to action-induced future information in latent space. Concretely, we leverage a large multimodal model as the latent world model, whose shared representations support two dedicated heads for both action selection and predictive transition modeling. The action head directly translates these latent representations into action selection, while the transition head captures action-conditioned future information. To mitigate the identity shortcut, we further introduce an action-aware contrastive objective that encourages the transition representations to capture discriminative action-induced changes. Extensive experiments across offline and online GUI settings show that our method achieves up to 31.9% and 40.6% relative gains in success rate over pixel-space world models, respectively, while substantially reducing inference latency by up to 98.9%. Our code is available at https://github.com/sjyu001/latent2world.

AI.tldr: 该论文将GUI世界模型的预测目标从像素级全屏重建改为潜空间中的动作诱导未来信息，用大型多模态模型作为潜世界模型并配以动作头与转移头，同时引入动作感知对比目标，从而在离线与在线GUI任务上大幅提升成功率并显著降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 像素空间世界模型在GUI智能体中采用"先预测未来屏幕、再重新感知以选择动作"的两阶段范式，存在两大问题：(L1) 像素重建计算开销高；(L2) 需重建大量与动作选择无关的外观级细节。实践中这种屏幕生成目标会诱发"身份捷径"问题，即未来状态预测大多保留当前状态，而非捕捉动作诱导的变化。
AI.method: 将GUI世界建模的预测目标由全屏重建转为潜空间中的动作诱导未来信息。具体用大型多模态模型作为潜世界模型，其共享表示支持两个专用头：动作头直接把潜表示映射为动作选择，转移头捕捉动作条件下的未来信息。为缓解身份捷径，引入动作感知对比目标，促使转移表示捕捉具有判别性的动作诱导变化。
AI.result: 在离线与在线GUI设置的大量实验中，相较像素空间世界模型，成功率分别取得最高31.9%和40.6%的相对提升，同时推理延迟最多降低98.9%。
AI.conclusion: 通过把世界模型预测目标从像素重建转向潜空间动作诱导信息，并配合动作感知对比学习，可在保证甚至提升GUI动作选择性能的同时大幅降低计算成本，为GUI智能体的世界建模提供了更高效的范式。

title: Amharic-English Cross-Language Question Answering Using Statistical Machine Translation, Named Entity Recognition, and Semantic Indexing
summary: The predominance of English-language Web content creates an information-access barrier for speakers of low-resource languages such as Amharic. This paper presents the design, imple-mentation, and evaluation of a bidirectional Amharic-English cross-language question answering (CLQA) system that allows a user to formulate a natural-language question in either Amharic or English and retrieve an answer from documents written in the other language. The system integrates a statistical machine translation (SMT) component for query translation, a maximum-entropy named entity recognition (NER) component for Amharic text processing, semantic-based indexing, question analysis, passage retrieval, and answer extraction. A domain-diverse Amharic-English parallel corpus was used to train the SMT component, while monolingual cor-pora supported language modeling. Documents were normalized, tokenized, stemmed, indexed, and semantically enriched before retrieval. The original evaluation used precision and recall as the principal effectiveness measures. For Amharic-to-English retrieval, the system achieved 72% precision and 79% recall; for English-to-Amharic retrieval, it achieved 65% precision and 70% recall. These findings show that a modular translation-and-retrieval architecture can provide useful cross-language access even under low-resource conditions. This revised article preserves the original experimental claims while situating them in the context of subsequent multilingual transformer and Amharic QA research.

AI.tldr: 本文设计并评估了一个双向阿姆哈拉语-英语跨语言问答系统，通过SMT查询翻译、最大熵NER、语义索引、问题分析与答案抽取，实现低资源语言与英语之间的互检，阿→英达72%精确率/79%召回率，英→阿达65%/70%。
AI.motivation: 英语网络内容占主导，给阿姆哈拉语等低资源语言使用者造成信息获取障碍，因此需要跨语言问答以突破语言壁垒。
AI.method: 系统采用模块化架构：用统计机器翻译（SMT）进行查询翻译，用最大熵命名实体识别（NER）处理阿姆哈拉语文本，并结合语义索引、问题分析、段落检索与答案抽取；以领域多样的阿英平行语料训练SMT，以单语语料支持语言建模，文档经归一化、分词、词干化、索引与语义增强后再检索。
AI.result: 以精确率和召回率作为主要效果指标：阿姆哈拉语→英语检索为72%精确率、79%召回率；英语→阿姆哈拉语检索为65%精确率、70%召回率。
AI.conclusion: 模块化的“翻译+检索”架构在低资源条件下仍能提供有效的跨语言访问；修订版保留了原始实验结论，并将其置于后续多语言Transformer与阿姆哈拉语问答研究的背景下。

title: AlignPoison: Conditional Targeted Poisoning of Generative Recommenders via Decoding-Aligned Prefixes
summary: Generative recommendation models based on autoregressive decoding have been adopted as alternatives to classical ranking-based systems. While their modeling flexibility has been widely studied, their resilience to data poisoning remains largely unexplored. In this work, we ask: how susceptible are generative recommenders to conditional targeted poisoning? Under a realistic setting where an adversary can inject limited malicious interactions and query a recommendation API as a black box, our empirical study shows that generative recommenders are vulnerable: injecting fewer than 1% synthetic interactions significantly increases the likelihood of promoting malicious targets under the trigger. To characterize this vulnerability, we analyze the synthesis of malicious interactions from two perspectives: (i) decoding alignment and (ii) prefix popularity. We observe that short, context-aligned prefixes that are both common under the model's induced transition dynamics and strongly linked to a frequent trigger consistently amplify targeted promotion. Motivated by this analysis, we develop AlignPoison, a black-box framework that discovers and samples context-aligned prefixes from API outputs. We conduct experiments on benchmarks in unimodal and multimodal generative recommendation settings. Results show that these prefixes outperform competitive baselines, improving ASR lift by up to 16.3 percentage points and highlighting a decoding-dependent, context-sensitive poisoning vulnerability in generative recommendation models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成式推荐模型对条件定向投毒的脆弱性，并提出黑盒投毒框架 AlignPoison，通过采样与解码动态对齐的上下文前缀来提升攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 基于自回归解码的生成式推荐模型已逐步替代传统排序系统，其建模灵活性被广泛研究，但其对数据投毒的鲁棒性尚缺乏系统探索。作者关注的问题是：在 adversary 只能注入有限恶意交互并以黑盒方式查询推荐 API 的现实设定下，生成式推荐器对条件定向投毒有多脆弱。
AI.method: 作者首先进行实证研究，发现注入不到 1% 的合成交互即可显著提升在触发条件下推广恶意目标的可能性。随后从两个角度分析恶意交互的合成：解码对齐（decoding alignment）与前缀流行度（prefix popularity）。基于此提出 AlignPoison 黑盒框架，从 API 输出中发现并采样上下文对齐的前缀。实验覆盖单模态与多模态生成式推荐基准。
AI.result: 少样本投毒即可产生显著攻击效果；短小、上下文对齐且同时满足模型诱导转移动态下常见、并与高频触发强关联的前缀能持续放大定向推广。AlignPoison 优于竞争性基线，ASR lift 提升最多达 16.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 生成式推荐模型存在一种依赖解码、对上下文敏感的投毒脆弱性，黑盒条件下通过发现上下文对齐前缀即可有效实施条件定向投毒，提示该范式在安全鲁棒性方面需引起重视。

title: SliderEdit++: Improved Slider Trajectories in Instruction-Based Image Editing
summary: Slider-based control aims to give users continuous, fine-grained control over the intensity of individual edits in instruction-based image editing. However, existing approaches fail to deliver reliable continuous controllability: traversing a slider can produce abrupt visual jumps and non-monotonic changes, while jointly controlled sliders can interfere with one another. To systematically study these limitations, we introduce SlideBench, a comprehensive benchmark for continuous image editing spanning diverse editing categories and equipped with a unified suite of metrics quantifying monotonic progression, perceptual continuity, and inter-slider disentanglement. Building on these observations, we propose SliderEdit++, which explicitly regularizes the intermediate editing trajectory rather than supervising only its endpoints. Our method combines velocity- and semantic-space trajectory regularization with spectral control to encourage smooth, predictable slider traversal, together with a disentanglement objective that reduces interference between independently controlled edits. On SlideBench, SliderEdit++ achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving the overall score by 18.5% relative to the strongest baseline. At the same time, using a few-step editing backbone makes our method approximately 3x to 20x faster than existing slider-based approaches, enabling substantially more responsive interactive editing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出连续图像编辑基准SlideBench及方法SliderEdit++，通过轨迹正则化与解耦目标实现可靠连续可控编辑，整体性能提升18.5%并提速3-20倍。
AI.motivation: 现有基于滑块的指令图像编辑方法缺乏可靠的连续可控性：滑动时出现突变视觉跳跃、非单调变化，且多滑块联合控制时相互干扰。作者希望系统研究并解决这些局限。
AI.method: 构建SlideBench基准，涵盖多类编辑任务并提供统一指标（单调进展、感知连续性、滑块间解耦）。提出SliderEdit++，对中间编辑轨迹显式正则化而非仅监督端点：结合速度空间与语义空间轨迹正则化、谱控制以促进平滑可预测的滑动，并加入解耦目标减少独立编辑间的干扰；采用少步编辑骨干。
AI.result: 在SlideBench上达到SOTA，整体得分较最强基线相对提升18.5%；得益于少步编辑骨干，速度比现有滑块方法快约3至20倍，交互更响应。
AI.conclusion: 通过轨迹级正则化与解耦设计可显著提升滑块编辑的连续可控性与解耦性，同时大幅提升推理速度，支持更具响应性的交互式编辑。

title: The Constitution Speaks Nheengatu: An Open MT System and Reproducible Corpus Pipeline for the Amazonian Língua Geral
summary:
Nheengatu (yrl), the Amazonian Língua Geral, has 6--10 thousand speakers and is co-official in São Gabriel da Cachoeira (Brazil), yet remains poorly served by evaluated Portuguese--Nheengatu MT resources. We present the largest parallel corpus assembled for the language (14.5k Portuguese--Nheengatu pairs), anchored by the 2023 official translation of the Brazilian Federal Constitution; the first MT evaluation set built from transcribed spontaneous speech; and, to our knowledge, the first open-weight MT models dedicated to bidirectional Portuguese--Nheengatu translation.
  Three findings organize the paper. First, translation into Nheengatu on held-out constitutional articles plateaus on development data regardless of training length or model size, and much of the remaining error sits in conventional legal terms that the written sources do not attest consistently; a terminology success rate over a frozen lexicon shows that glossary mechanisms at training time and lexical constraints at decoding each raise term realization, the latter at a cost in repetitive output that chrF++ barely registers. Second, a corpus expansion that adds transcribed conversation raises speech chrF++ by 24--27 points while leaving written domains unchanged, a register gap that written-only benchmarks cannot see. Third, a larger NLLB model helps translation into Portuguese but not into Nheengatu on legal or speech text. For Portuguese-to-Nheengatu translation, our final systems reach 31.7--32.8 chrF++ on article-disjoint constitutional text, 64.1--64.5 on the near-domain set (62.1 after removing items with target-side content overlap), and 45.2--47.5 on speech.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了迄今最大的葡萄牙语—Nheengatu语平行语料库（14.5k句对）、首个基于转录口语的机器翻译评测集，以及首个开源的双向葡—Nheengatu翻译模型，并揭示了术语一致性、语域差距和模型规模效应三方面发现。
AI.motivation: Nheengatu语（yrl）作为亚马逊通用语，仅有6千至1万使用者，虽在巴西圣加布里埃尔-达卡舒埃拉具有共同官方地位，但缺乏经过评测的葡萄牙语—Nheengatu机器翻译资源，语言服务严重不足。
AI.method: 以2023年巴西联邦宪法官方译本为锚点，构建14.5k句对的平行语料库；基于转录的自发口语构建评测集；训练开源的双向葡—Nheengatu翻译模型；并在冻结词表上评估术语成功率，对比训练期术语表机制与解码期词汇约束的效果。
AI.result: 法律条文翻译在开发集上趋于饱和，误差集中于书写来源不一致的传统法律术语；术语表机制与解码约束均提升术语实现率，后者以重复输出为代价（chrF++几乎无感）；加入口语语料使语音域chrF++提升24–27点而书面域不变；更大的NLLB模型仅在葡向翻译中有效。最终系统在条文不相交宪法文本上达31.7–32.8 chrF++，近域集64.1–64.5（去除目标侧重叠后62.1），语音域45.2–47.5。
AI.conclusion: 面向低资源语言的机器翻译需重视术语一致性与语域差异，仅靠书面基准无法反映口语表现；模型规模收益因翻译方向与文本类型而异，需针对性设计术语与解码策略。

title: HiPPT: Physiology-Grounded Wearable PPG Representation Learning via Multi-Scope Text Alignment
summary: Reusable wearable PPG representations should capture local pulse morphology and broader physiological regularities. Existing pretraining objectives, however, usually apply supervision at the recording or pair level, overlooking that different concepts become reliable over different scopes of waveform evidence. We propose HiPPT, a physiology-grounded framework that matches each supervision source to its appropriate evidence scope. We construct a PPG-Text corpus of over 4 million wrist-worn recordings from 202K users, pairing recordings with waveform-derived morphology and metadata-derived context descriptions. HiPPT combines record-level morphology alignment, which grounds individual recordings in pulse characteristics, with cross-recording context alignment, which aggregates recordings sharing the same metadata tuple to capture context-consistent regularities. Waveform-guided text modeling further recovers masked contextual concepts from PPG patch representations, providing fine-grained waveform-text supervision. Across six downstream tasks spanning blood pressure, vascular stiffness, physiological attributes, and cross-dataset heart-rate estimation, HiPPT achieves the best result on the primary linear-probing metrics. The aligned space also supports zero-shot profiling of age group, sex, and BMI category, individually and jointly, with performance improving as more recordings are aggregated. These results show that evidence-scope matching yields transferable and semantically accessible wearable PPG representations. Code and pretrained weights will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出 HiPPT 框架，通过将不同监督信号匹配到合适的证据范围来预训练可穿戴 PPG 表征，在六项下游任务上取得最佳线性探测结果，并支持零样本生理属性画像。
AI.motivation: 可复用可穿戴 PPG 表征需同时刻画局部脉搏形态与更广泛的生理规律，但现有预训练目标通常在记录级或样本对级施加监督，忽略了不同概念需在不同波形证据范围下才可靠的特性。
AI.method: 构建含 400 万以上腕表记录、来自 20.2 万用户的 PPG-Text 语料，将记录与波形形态描述和元数据上下文描述配对；HiPPT 结合记录级形态对齐（将单条记录锚定到脉搏特征）与跨记录上下文对齐（聚合共享同一元数据元组的记录以捕获上下文一致性规律），并通过波形引导的文本建模从 PPG patch 表征中恢复被掩码的上下文概念，提供细粒度波形-文本监督。
AI.result: 在涵盖血压、血管僵硬度、生理属性和跨数据集心率估计的六项下游任务上，HiPPT 在主要线性探测指标上均取得最优结果；对齐空间支持年龄组、性别与 BMI 类别的单独及联合零样本画像，且聚合记录越多性能越好。
AI.conclusion: 证据范围匹配可产生可迁移且语义可访问的可穿戴 PPG 表征；代码与预训练权重将公开。

title: Image Diffusion Models Are Good 3D Human Motion Generators
comment: 16 pages; under review. The first two authors contributed equally to this work
summary: Text-to-motion generation typically relies on dataset-specific skeletal representations, with models trained separately for benchmarks with different joint layouts. We investigate whether image diffusion architectures can model 3D human motion through a common image-compatible representation that accommodates heterogeneous skeletal layouts while preserving motion-specific kinematic structure. To this end, we organize root-centered joint trajectories into topology-informed joint--time images and model global root dynamics through a complementary latent stream. A motion autoencoder conditions local-motion decoding on the root latent, while a text-conditioned Scalable Interpolant Transformer (SiT) jointly generates both latent streams, with supervision on decoded 3D joint positions further constraining generation in motion space. In addition to dataset-specific models, we train a single motion autoencoder on HumanML3D and KIT-ML, followed by a single text-conditioned SiT shared across both datasets, preserving their respective skeletal definitions without skeleton retargeting to a common joint layout. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML show that our dataset-specific models achieve state-of-the-art performance, while shared training yields further gains on both benchmarks, demonstrating the benefits of shared modeling across heterogeneous skeletal layouts.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用图像扩散架构与图像兼容表示统一建模异构骨骼的3D人体运动，在多数据集基准上取得SOTA并验证了共享训练的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动运动生成依赖数据集专属的骨骼表示，不同关节布局的基准需分别训练模型，缺乏对异构骨骼布局的统一建模能力。
AI.method: 将根节点为中心、保留拓扑信息的关节轨迹组织为关节-时间图像，并用互补的隐空间流建模全局根运动；运动自编码器以根隐变量为条件解码局部运动；文本条件化的可扩展插值Transformer（SiT）联合生成两个隐变量流，并对解码后的3D关节位置施加监督以约束运动空间生成。同时训练跨HumanML3D与KIT-ML共享的自编码器与SiT，无需骨架重定向到统一关节布局。
AI.result: 在HumanML3D与KIT-ML上，数据集专属模型达到当前最优性能；共享训练在两个基准上均带来进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 图像扩散架构配合图像兼容的运动表示可有效处理异构骨骼布局，跨数据集的共享建模优于单数据集独立训练，凸显统一建模的价值。

title: Who Receives Respect? A Counterfactual Benchmark for Honorific Allocation Bias in Bengali
summary: Bengali has no grammatical gender, but honorificity is obligatory: every third-person reference must choose ordinary or respectful register. English has no such signal, so the system must choose a level of deference that the source never specified. We use this property to measure how large language models (LLMs) allocate respect in English--Bengali translation. Our evaluation set contains 2{,}016 sentences across 72 occupations. Each appears in seven sentence frames under four pronoun conditions. Masculine and feminine versions differ by one word, forming counterfactual pairs. We report a single Honorific Bias Score (HBS) for each model on a 0--100 scale, covering both the gender and occupation axes. A lower score means that respect is allocated more evenly. For the occupation analysis, we compute each occupation's honorific rate across the seven no-pronoun sentence frames. The standard deviation of these 72 occupation-level rates ranges from 17.2 to 35.5 percentage points across models, showing substantial variation in how honorifics are allocated across occupations. Occupation is associated with 3.2\% to 51.5\% of the variance in register choice, compared with at most 1.2\% for gender. Gender effects are much smaller overall: only two of the nine models show significant directional gender gaps, and they favor opposite genders. HBS ranges from 19.9 to 70.1 across the nine models, showing substantial variation in how evenly the models allocate respect.

AI.tldr: 本文利用孟加拉语强制敬语、英语无对应语法标记的特性，测量大语言模型在英译孟翻译中如何分配尊敬，提出敬语偏见分数（HBS）。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语无语法性别，但第三人称必须选择普通或尊敬语域；英语缺乏该信号，因此模型必须自行决定源文本未指定的尊敬程度。作者借此性质考察LLM在性别与职业两个维度上的尊敬分配是否均衡。
AI.method: 构建包含2016句、覆盖72种职业的评估集，每句出现在7种句式框架与4种代词条件下；男性与女性版本仅差一词，构成反事实对照。对每个模型在0--100量表上报告单一HBS，同时覆盖性别与职业轴；职业分析中，在7种无代词句式上计算各职业敬语率的标准差，并做方差分解。
AI.result: 72个职业层面敬语率的标准差在模型间为17.2至35.5个百分点；职业可解释语域选择方差的3.2%--51.5%，而性别至多1.2%。九个模型中仅两个存在显著方向性性别差距，且偏向相反性别。HBS在九个模型间为19.9至70.1。
AI.conclusion: 模型对尊敬语域的分配在职业维度差异显著，性别效应整体较小；HBS可量化比较不同模型在性别与职业轴上的尊敬分配均衡性。

title: Reels-RSI: Program-Level Self-Improvement for Code-Rendered Explainer Videos
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Code, rules, lessons, data and evolve reports: https://github.com/agentic-loops-x/Reels-RSI
summary: Explainer videos -- a worked geometry problem, why the sky is blue, how a dynasty fell -- are usually one more target for pixel video generation. We argue they are a different kind of artifact: a program (script, storyboard and per-frame animation code) that a deterministic renderer turns into frames. A program can be read, diffed, tested and audited; pixels can only be watched. Reels-RSI is an open-source reel director for any agent harness; its self-improvement happens at the program level rather than in weights or prompts. Every revision pass is logged with a code snapshot; a retrospective pairs each check finding with the diff that fixed it and proposes lessons; a lesson that a static check can catch is compiled into a rule with a must-fail and a must-pass example, so the memory is unit-tested; and a rule learned today runs over everything made before it. A bounded, benchmark-gated step lets an agent rewrite the director's playbook, kept only when blind pairwise judgments on held-out topics prefer it; nothing enters memory without a human decision. Across 111 reels -- a field study, two playbook evolutions, a 2x2 memory ablation, a weaker director, a 48-reel learning curve and a judge-reliability study -- we find that the rule learned in the field caught four latent defects in frames authored before it existed and none after; that rules are an audit for a strong director (eight unguarded reels, no violation) and a guard for a weaker one (thirty violations unguarded versus five); that lessons shorten revision loops but do not compound or move the judge; and that the first rewrite's 11--1 verdict was a position bias in our vote design (judges pick the second-shown reel 62--81% of the time), masking scripts that traded thirteen facts for craft. We document four failure modes of the preference signal, which check caught each, and the fixes. Code, rules, lessons and data are public.

AI.tldr: 提出将解释类视频视为"程序"而非"像素"的生成范式 Reels-RSI：导演脚本、分镜与逐帧动画代码由确定性渲染器转为视频帧，自改进发生在程序层面（代码快照、复盘、编译规则、基准门控重写），并在 111 个视频的实验中验证规则可审计强导演、约束弱导演，同时揭示偏好信号的位置偏置等失效模式。
AI.motivation: 解释性视频（解题、为何天蓝、王朝兴衰）通常被当作像素视频生成的目标，但像素只能"看"不能审。作者主张其本质是程序（脚本、分镜、逐帧动画代码），程序可读、可 diff、可测试、可审计，因此自改进应在程序层面而非权重或提示词层面进行，以提升可验证性与可复用性。
AI.method: Reels-RSI：面向任意 agent harness 的开源"卷轴导演"。每次修订记录代码快照；复盘将检查发现与修复 diff 配对并提出教训；静态检查可捕获的教训被编译为带"必失败"和"必通过"样例的规则，使记忆可单元测试；新规则回溯作用于此前所有产物。有界、基准门控的步骤允许 agent 重写导演手册，仅当盲配对比判断在留出主题上偏好新版本时才保留；任何内容进入记忆都需人工决策。评估涵盖 111 个视频：现场研究、两次手册演化、2x2 记忆消融、较弱导演、48 视频学习曲线与评判可靠性研究。
AI.result: 现场学到的规则捕获了规则出现前制作的帧中的四个潜在缺陷，之后为零；规则对强导演是审计（8 个未防护视频、零违规），对弱导演是护栏（未防护 30 次违规 vs 防护后 5 次）；教训可缩短修订循环但不产生复利效应，也不改变评判者判断；首次重写的 11--1 判定源于投票设计中的位置偏置（评判者 62--81% 选择第二个展示的视频），掩盖了"用 13 个事实换取工艺"的脚本。记录了偏好信号的四种失效模式及对应检查与修复。代码、规则、教训与数据公开。
AI.conclusion: 解释性视频应被建模为可审计的程序产物，而非不可审的像素；在程序层进行自改进、以规则编译记忆、用必失败/必通过样例做单元测试、并回溯应用规则，可形成可验证、可复利的工程记忆。偏好信号的偏置会扭曲重写判定，需通过检查与修复加以控制。所有资产开源。

title: BigCell: Generating Gigapixel Whole-Slide Images
summary: Whole-slide images (WSIs) are gigapixel-scale digital scans of histopathology tissue and serve as the primary basis for cancer diagnosis. Existing histopathology generative models operate at the patch scale, producing fixed-size tiles of at most 1024$\times$1024 pixels which encompass only a small fraction of the WSI. In contrast, text reports for clinical diagnoses and slide-level diagnostic labels -- the supervision that exists at scale -- operate at the whole-slide level. We present BigCell, the first approach to generate coherent whole-slide histopathology images at native gigapixel resolution. BigCell trains a flow-matching transformer at 2048$\times$2048 pixels on over 120,000 publicly available WSIs spanning multiple organ types. Conditioning on embeddings from pathology foundation models and using an inference-time sliding-window pipeline, BigCell generates coherent images of up to 32,768$\times$32,768 pixels, outperforming prior tile generators on both tile-level and slide-level fidelity metrics. To make gigapixel synthesis practical, we introduce an adaptive scheduling strategy that prioritizes important slide regions, speeding up image generation by over 3\ttimes with minimal quality degradation. Furthermore, we propose the first text-to-image synthesis at 8k resolution by training a separate model that produces dense conditioning grids directly from pathology text reports. We demonstrate that augmenting with synthetic samples improves slide-level few-shot classification performance by up to $18 \%$ over baselines trained on real data.

AI.tldr: BigCell 是首个以原生十亿像素分辨率生成连贯全切片病理图像的生成模型，通过流匹配 Transformer 结合病理基础模型嵌入与滑动窗口推理，实现最高 32768×32768 像素的合成，并借助自适应调度加速生成。
AI.motivation: 现有病理生成模型仅工作于图块规模（≤1024×1024 像素），覆盖范围极小；而临床诊断文本报告与切片级诊断标签等监督信号却处于全切片层级，二者尺度严重不匹配，因此亟需能在全切片尺度上进行连贯生成的模型。
AI.method: BigCell 在超过 12 万张多器官公开 WSI 上训练一个 2048×2048 像素的流匹配 Transformer；以病理基础模型嵌入为条件，并在推理时采用滑动窗口流水线生成最高 32768×32768 像素图像。为提升十亿像素合成的实用性，提出自适应调度策略，优先处理重要切片区域以加速生成。此外训练独立模型从病理文本报告生成密集条件网格，实现 8k 分辨率文本到图像合成。
AI.result: BigCell 在图像块级与切片级保真度指标上均优于既有图块生成器；自适应调度在质量损失极小的前提下加速超过 3 倍；合成的 8k 条件图与样本可将切片级少样本分类性能较仅用真实数据训练的基线提升最多 18%。
AI.conclusion: BigCell 首次实现了原生十亿像素分辨率的连贯全切片病理图像生成，并展示了合成样本对下游切片级少样本分类的实际增益，为全切片尺度的病理生成与数据增强开辟了新方向。

title: Training-Free BioNEL-RAG: Advancing Biomedical Entity Linking through Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Large Language Model
summary: Biomedical Named Entity Linking (BioNEL) is the task of mapping mentions extracted from biomedical texts to canonical entities or concepts in the standardized knowledge base. Although existing methods have achieved remarkable performance in mapping accuracy, most rely on training with domain-specific datasets, which fundamentally limits their cross-domain adaptability. To address this limitation, we propose BioNEL-RAG, a novel training-free framework that combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with large language models (LLMs). Within this framework, the RAG module focuses on retrieving candidate entities, while the large language model module plays the role of selecting the most appropriate candidate for entity normalization, which is based on the analysis of the mention's context, with the aid of its remarkable text comprehension capabilities. Experimental results demonstrate that BioNEL-RAG achieves performance comparable to existing methods without requiring training on subdomain datasets, whereas these methods necessitate fine-tuning on specific subdomains such as genes, diseases, or chemical compounds.

AI.tldr: 该文提出无需训练的BioNEL-RAG框架，结合检索增强生成与大语言模型，实现跨域生物医学命名实体链接，性能可比肩需域内微调的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有生物医学命名实体链接方法虽映射准确率高，但大多依赖领域特定数据集训练，跨域适应性受限。
AI.method: 提出训练自由的BioNEL-RAG框架：RAG模块负责检索候选实体，LLM模块基于提及上下文与文本理解能力选择最合适候选完成实体归一化。
AI.result: 实验表明，BioNEL-RAG在无需子领域数据集训练的情况下，取得与现有方法相当的性能；后者需在基因、疾病、化合物等特定子领域上微调。
AI.conclusion: 将RAG与LLM结合可免除训练依赖，为跨域生物医学实体链接提供有效且通用的解决方案。

title: MontageFlow: Physically Valid High Fidelity EEG Generation
summary: Generative modeling offers a promising solution to the scarcity of labeled clinical electroencephalography (EEG) data under strict privacy constraints. Although recent generative models report substantial improvements in generation fidelity, we show that these gains conceal a categorical failure. EEG is not an arbitrary multichannel signal: each channel records the voltage difference between two scalp electrodes. So, real recordings satisfy exact linear identities among their channels. Current generators invariably violate these identities, yet this has gone unnoticed. We therefore propose MontageFlow, a flow-matching model that enforces these identities by restricting its output to signals that satisfy them. We find that ensuring validity improves fidelity too. Furthermore, to retain the EEG characteristics that oversmoothing washes out, we also condition the model on a physiological state vector encoded from the whole EEG window. For generation, this vector is drawn from a prior fitted in latent space. Across 3 large-scale benchmarks, our model improves TS-FID by 1.6-3.6$\times$ over the closest rival while ensuring validity.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出当前EEG生成模型普遍违反通道间线性恒等式（有效性），提出MontageFlow流匹配模型，通过将输出限制在满足恒等式的信号上，并结合生理状态向量条件化，在3个大规模基准上实现TS-FID提升1.6-3.6倍。
AI.motivation: 在严格隐私约束下，标注临床EEG数据稀缺，生成建模是有前景的解决方案。尽管近期生成模型在生成保真度上有显著提升，但这些增益掩盖了一个类别性失败：EEG每个通道记录两个头皮电极间的电压差，因此真实记录满足通道间精确的线性恒等式，而当前生成器无一例外地违反这些恒等式，且此问题未被察觉。此外，过度平滑会冲刷掉EEG特征。
AI.method: 提出MontageFlow，一种流匹配（flow-matching）模型，通过将输出限制在满足通道间线性恒等式的信号上以强制保证有效性。同时，为保留被过度平滑冲刷掉的EEG特征，模型以从整个EEG窗口编码得到的生理状态向量进行条件化；生成时该向量从潜空间中拟合的先验分布中采样。
AI.result: 在3个大规模基准上，该模型在确保有效性的同时，相较最接近的对手将TS-FID提升了1.6-3.6倍。并发现保证有效性同时也能提升保真度。
AI.conclusion: EEG生成中的通道间线性恒等式有效性是一个被忽视却关键的约束；强制满足该约束不仅保证信号有效性，还能提升生成保真度。MontageFlow结合生理状态条件化，在多个大规模基准上显著优于现有方法。

title: Thinking with Images without Coordinates
summary: Recent advances in multi-modal large language models have shifted toward the "thinking with images" paradigm to improve reasoning faithfulness, yet existing methods rely heavily on explicit coordinate- based grounding. We identify two fundamental limitations in this approach, i.e., a semantic gap where sparse regressions miss high-dimensional latent structures, and a resolution gap due to the granularity mismatch between patch-level tokens and pixel-level coordinates. To address these, we propose TiCO (Thinking with images without COordinates). It reformulates visual reasoning as a semantic evidence discovery process within the latent space, and evidence is injected as token-level regions without pixel coordinates. Specifically, TiCO utilizes a dedicated probe token to estimate similarity distributions and performs importance sampling over spatially connected components to generate diverse, semantically dominant evidence rollouts. Extensive experiments across multiple high-resolution and general visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our TiCO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art coordinate-based methods with significantly improved inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TiCO（Thinking with images without COordinates），将视觉推理重构为隐空间中的语义证据发现过程，以token级区域注入证据而无需像素坐标，在多个高分辨率及通用视觉推理基准上超越现有基于坐标的方法并显著提升推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型的"以图像思考"范式过度依赖显式坐标定位。该方式存在两个根本局限：一是语义鸿沟，稀疏回归难以捕捉高维隐结构；二是分辨率鸿沟，源于patch级token与像素级坐标之间的粒度不匹配。
AI.method: TiCO将视觉推理重新表述为隐空间内的语义证据发现过程，证据以token级区域形式注入，不使用像素坐标。具体而言，它利用一个专用probe token估计相似度分布，并在空间连通分量上进行重要性采样，从而生成多样化、语义主导的证据rollout。
AI.result: 在多个高分辨率与通用视觉推理基准上，TiCO持续优于最先进的基于坐标的方法，同时推理效率显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 摆脱显式坐标依赖、转向隐空间语义证据发现，是提升"以图像思考"推理忠实度与效率的有效路径。

title: Dependency Reasoning for Aspect Sentiment Quadruple Prediction
summary: Aspect Sentiment Quadruple Prediction (ASQP) is fundamentally a relational reasoning problem: identifying aspect-opinion-category-sentiment quadruples requires modeling structured dependencies, not merely sequential co-occurrence. Existing LLM-based approaches incorporate syntactic information indirectly, via retrieval-based demonstration selection or multi-stage training, rather than as unified, single-pass generation-time context. We present DRIFT, which linearizes dependency parse trees and injects them directly into LLM prompts as explicit relational context, enabling the model to reason over aspect-opinion dependencies rather than infer them from token proximity alone. DRIFT further integrates retrieval-augmented in-context learning and a syntax-aware LLM-based adjudication mechanism that complements exact-match evaluation under span-boundary variation. On SemEval Rest15, Rest16, and ACOS, DRIFT achieves the strongest performance among compared generative ASQP methods, reaching 54.47% and 64.10% F1 on Rest15 and Rest16, with consistent gains across short- and medium-distance aspect-opinion configurations; adjudication further shows exact-match metrics systematically underestimate semantically correct predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出DRIFT模型，将依存句法树线性化后直接注入LLM提示，作为显式关系上下文，并结合检索增强上下文学习与句法感知的LLM仲裁机制，用于ASQP四元组预测。
AI.motivation: ASQP本质是关系推理问题，需建模结构化依赖；现有LLM方法仅通过检索式示例选择或多阶段训练间接引入句法信息，未将其作为统一的单次生成时上下文。
AI.method: 将依存句法树线性化并注入LLM提示作为显式关系上下文，使模型基于依存关系推理而非token邻近性；整合检索增强的上下文学习；引入句法感知的LLM仲裁机制，以补充跨度边界变化下的精确匹配评估。
AI.result: 在SemEval Rest15、Rest16与ACOS上取得所比较生成式ASQP方法中的最佳性能，Rest15和Rest16的F1分别达54.47%和64.10%，在短距离与中距离的aspect-opinion配置下均有稳定增益；仲裁结果表明精确匹配指标系统性低估语义正确的预测。
AI.conclusion: 显式注入句法依赖关系可有效提升生成式ASQP性能，且现有精确匹配评估存在低估问题，需辅以句法感知的仲裁机制。

title: ScienceBuddy-PV: A Verifier-Governed Recursive Improvement Protocol for Panvascular Intervention Research
comment: 17 pages, 17 figures, 19 references. Public-data component audit; recursive improvement is specified as a protocol and not experimentally demonstrated
summary: ScienceBuddy-PV adapts the ScienceBuddy recursive-in-recursive design to panvascular intervention research through a structured evidence ledger, device-vessel ontology, abstention contract and retained failure bank. Recursive harness optimization and outer-loop model learning, including reinforcement learning, are specified but not executed. We audit a fixed component, rather than the complete agent system, using separate ARCADE syntax and stenosis tasks (1,000 training, 200 validation and 300 test images per task). A shared task-masked convolutional model was trained once per representation setting; its parameters and the heuristic support gate were then held fixed, with the stenosis threshold selected on validation data. On the locked test sets, syntax Dice was 0.475 (95% CI 0.459-0.490) and stenosis Dice was 0.231 (95% CI 0.214-0.249). Stenosis pixel AUROC was 0.957 and AUPRC was 0.180 at prevalence 0.00975. The gate accepted 76.7% of stenosis-frame outputs versus 100% for a score-only comparator. In a constructed mask audit, it accepted 44.3% of reference candidates and rejected 55.7%, exposing the cost of abstention. Acceptance does not establish correctness or clinical safety. This public-data component audit makes support and abstention measurable and provides a reproducible protocol for future collaborative agent studies. It does not demonstrate recursive improvement, patient-level validity or clinical device recommendations.

AI.tldr: 该研究将ScienceBuddy的递归设计适配到泛血管介入研究，但仅审计了固定组件而非完整智能体系统，通过公开数据验证了证据账本、设备-血管本体、弃权契约与失败库等模块的可测量性。
AI.motivation: 现有泛血管介入研究的智能体系统缺乏对支持证据与弃权机制的可测量、可复现评估，递归优化与强化学习等设计多停留在规范层面而未被实际执行，因此需要一个公开数据上的组件级审计协议。
AI.method: 采用结构化证据账本、设备-血管本体、弃权契约与保留失败库；使用ARCADE语法与狭窄两项任务（各1,000训练、200验证、300测试图像），训练一个共享的任务掩码卷积模型，参数与启发式支持门控固定，狭窄阈值在验证集上选取，并在锁定测试集上评估。
AI.result: 语法Dice为0.475（95% CI 0.459-0.490），狭窄Dice为0.231（95% CI 0.214-0.249）；狭窄像素AUROC为0.957，AUPRC在患病率0.00975下为0.180。门控接受76.7%的狭窄帧输出，而仅评分对照为100%；在构造掩膜审计中接受44.3%参考候选、拒绝55.7%，揭示了弃权的代价。接受并不代表正确或临床安全。
AI.conclusion: 该公开数据组件审计使支持与弃权变得可测量，并为未来协作式智能体研究提供了可复现协议；但它未证明递归改进、患者级有效性或临床设备建议。

title: RoboFake: Are Deepfake Detectors Ready for Humanoid Face Robots?
summary: Humanoid face robots can now move their lips in sync with speech and show detailed facial expressions. Give such a robot the face of a real person and drive it with generated speech, and you get a face forgery that happens in front of the camera: the camera records a real object, and no pixel is edited. We call this a RoboFake. In this paper we ask what current deepfake detectors do when they see a robot face. We test six public detectors trained on FaceForensics++ on video of a physical lip-syncing face robot, on a synthesized video of the same robot, and on rendered robot faces. All thresholds are fixed on FaceForensics++, and every result is compared with real human faces that went through the same processing as the robot videos. At a threshold that flags 5% of real faces, three detectors flag almost every physical robot frame, while two flag fewer than 7%. A matched human control and masking show that the response comes from the face, not from the processing or the background. However, it does not track synthesis: with only the face visible, three of the six detectors give the physical robot a higher fake score than its synthesized video. The response is also fragile, and light JPEG compression is enough to push most robot frames below the threshold for some detectors. Our results suggest that current detectors flag today's robots because their faces do not look human, not because they recognize a forgery. We release our evaluation protocol and code, and state three testable hypotheses about realistic, interactive RoboFakes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并研究"RoboFake"——由实体机器人人脸在现场摄制而非像素编辑生成的伪造影像，测试6个基于FaceForensics++训练的公开检测器对实体唇形同步机器人、其合成视频及渲染机器人人脸的反应。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人已能实现唇形同步与细腻表情，若赋予真人面孔并以生成语音驱动，就会产生一种"镜头前真实发生的"人脸伪造：摄像机记录的是真实物体，没有任何像素被篡改。现有深度伪造检测器是否以及如何应对这类RoboFake尚不清楚，因此需要系统评估。
AI.method: 在FaceForensics++上固定所有检测阈值，测试6个公开检测器，输入包括：实体唇形同步机器人脸机器人的视频、同一机器人的合成视频、渲染的机器人人脸；并将每个结果与经过相同处理流程的真实人脸进行对照。通过匹配的人类对照实验与掩码实验定位响应来源，并检验响应与"合成性"的关联性及对JPEG压缩的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在将真实人脸误报率固定为5%的阈值下，6个检测器中3个几乎将每一帧实体机器人画面判为伪造，另2个的判伪率低于7%。匹配人类对照与掩码实验表明，该响应来自人脸本身，而非处理流程或背景。但响应并不追踪合成性：仅保留人脸可见时，6个检测器中有3个给实体机器人的伪造分数高于其合成视频。响应亦很脆弱，轻度JPEG压缩即可使多数机器人帧在某些检测器下跌破阈值。
AI.conclusion: 当前检测器标记今天的机器人，是因为其面孔"不像人"，而非因为它们识别出了伪造。作者发布评测协议与代码，并提出关于逼真、交互式RoboFake的三条可检验假设。

title: Social Bias in Chinese Large Language Models under Social Media Expressions
summary: Existing Chinese social-bias benchmarks for large language models largely rely on normalized or template-based expressions, leaving the influence of internet slang, emoji, and sarcasm insufficiently examined. Safety alignment may further compress conventional plausibility ratings toward the lower end of the scale. This study constructs 73 paired probes across gender, region, and occupation. Each probe contains a neutral expression, a social-media-style expression, and a reversed-identity control. The task is reframed from direct plausibility judgment to social consensus estimation. Social-media expressions are divided into stylistic packaging, which preserves semantic polarity, and sarcastic packaging, which reverses surface polarity. Six Chinese-capable large language models are evaluated through paired differences measuring identity bias, stylistic packaging, and sarcasm shift. All models show significant identity-bias effects; five show significantly negative stylistic-packaging effects; and sarcasm shifts display a clear cross-model gradient. These findings demonstrate that expression form is not a transparent carrier in bias evaluation and that lower scores under sarcasm should not be interpreted directly as bias mitigation. The proposed paired design offers a measurement approach for Chinese social-media contexts while also revealing the construct boundary and prompt sensitivity of social consensus estimation.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了73组配对探针，将中文社会偏见评测任务重构为"社会共识估计"，系统考察网络用语、表情符号与反讽对六种中文大模型偏见测量的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有中文社会偏见基准多依赖规范化或模板化表达，未充分考察网络俚语、表情符号与反讽的影响；同时安全对齐可能将常规合理性评分压缩至量程低端，导致测量失真。
