AI.method: 构建覆盖性别、地域、职业三个维度的73组配对探针，每组包含中性表达、社交媒体风格表达与反转身份控制项。将任务由直接合理性判断改为社会共识估计。社交媒体表达分为保留语义极性的"风格包装"与反转表层极性的"反讽包装"。对六种中文大模型计算配对差异，分别度量身份偏见、风格包装效应与反讽偏移。
AI.result: 所有模型均呈现显著身份偏见效应；五种模型呈现显著负向风格包装效应；反讽偏移表现出明显的跨模型梯度差异。
AI.conclusion: 表达形式在偏见评测中并非透明的载体；反讽条件下的低分不应直接解读为偏见缓解。所提配对设计为中文社交媒体语境提供了测量路径，同时揭示了社会共识估计的构念边界与提示词敏感性。

title: Energy Ring: Stabilizing Feature Energy for Reliable Test-Time Discovery
summary: Test-Time Discovery (TTD) aims to recognize known classes and detect novel ones while the model is already deployed, operating directly on a continual unlabeled test-time stream. Existing TTD methods are overly conservative, making known and unknown features collapse together and difficult to separate during test-time adaptation. In this paper, we revisit TTD from an energy perspective and find that the natural energy gap between known and unknown classes is unstable and easily collapses. We therefore propose Energy Ring to stabilize this gap by anchoring the two types of classes on separate energy rings. A lightweight adapter enlarges the norm-based gap while preserving known-class directions, and a perturbation consistency module forms compact clusters for unknown classes. During testing, energy-guided confidence weighting improves prediction, and a stability-based rectification mechanism corrects unreliable updates. Experimental results show that Energy Ring significantly improves TTD performance against existing TTD methods.

AI.tldr: 从能量视角重新审视测试时发现（TTD），提出 Energy Ring，通过在分离的能量环上锚定已知类与未知类来稳定易崩塌的能量间隔，从而提升部署模型在连续无标签测试流上的已知类识别与新颖类检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 TTD 方法过于保守，导致已知与未知特征在测试时自适应过程中坍缩在一起、难以分离；作者从能量视角发现已知类与未知类之间的自然能量间隔不稳定、易崩塌，这是性能受限的关键原因。
AI.method: 提出 Energy Ring 框架：设计轻量适配器以扩大基于范数的能量间隔，同时保持已知类特征方向不变；引入扰动一致性模块，使未知类形成紧凑簇；测试阶段采用能量引导的置信度加权进行预测，并用基于稳定性的校正机制修正不可靠的模型更新。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Energy Ring 在 TTD 任务上相比现有 TTD 方法取得了显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过能量环机制稳定已知与未知类之间的能量间隔，可有效缓解特征坍缩问题，为部署后的连续无标签测试流场景提供了一种更优的测试时发现方案。

title: TGSR: Text-Grounded Diffusion for Faithful Image Super-Resolution
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image super-resolution (SR) by leveraging strong generative priors to enhance perceptual quality. However, for textual content, these priors often produce text hallucinations: non-existent or distorted text, which alter scene semantics and compromise model reliability. While recent methods focus on enhancing text generation, they do so indiscriminately, leaving hallucinations fundamentally unresolved. We argue the core problem is a lack of selective control. Therefore, we reformulate text SR as a selective generation problem: text is resolved only when reliable generation is expected, while other scene content is fully super-resolved. We introduce TGSR (Text-Grounded Super-Resolution), a test-time framework that progressively identifies and suppresses likely hallucinated text regions during generation. To enable this, we train dedicated detectors on a large-scale dataset curated from diverse diffusion-based SR outputs. TGSR consistently improves text fidelity across multiple backbones, increasing recognition precision by up to 17.68 points without degrading perceptual quality, underscoring the value of selective control in generative SR.

AI.tldr: 本文将文本超分重构为选择性生成问题，提出测试时框架 TGSR，在生成过程中逐步识别并抑制可能产生幻觉的文本区域，在多种骨干网络上提升文本保真度，识别精度最高提升 17.68 点且不损害感知质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型凭借强生成先验提升图像超分的感知质量，但在文本内容上常产生文本幻觉（不存在的或扭曲的文本），改变场景语义并损害模型可靠性。现有方法虽致力于增强文本生成，但采取不加区分的方式，未能从根本上解决幻觉问题。
AI.method: 作者认为核心问题在于缺乏选择性控制，因此将文本超分重构为选择性生成问题：仅在预期能够可靠生成时才解析文本，其余场景内容则完整超分。为此提出 TGSR（Text-Grounded Super-Resolution）测试时框架，在生成过程中逐步识别并抑制可能产生幻觉的文本区域。为支撑该框架，作者从多样化的扩散超分输出中构建大规模数据集，并训练专用检测器。
AI.result: TGSR 在多种骨干网络上一致地提升文本保真度，识别精度最高提升 17.68 点，同时不降低感知质量。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明选择性控制在生成式超分中具有重要价值，为缓解文本幻觉提供了新思路。

title: Agent-Guided Evidence Acquisition for Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction
summary: Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction (ECPE) requires identifying the causes associated with emotions expressed in a conversation. Accurate extraction can depend on evidence that is not initially available, making it important to decide when further information is worth acquiring. We study agent-guided evidence acquisition for ECPE, where a student agent selectively accesses expert judgments for borderline relations on both sides of its validation-selected F1 decision boundary and revises only queried predictions. Through controlled comparisons under different information-access conditions, we examine how delegation granularity, query selection, and response integration affect prediction quality. At a nominal 10% query rate, selective fusion improves mean pair F1 by 2.64-3.88 points over the student in our main experiments, reaching 65.14 on ECF and 49.74 on MEC4 across model families. Our analysis suggests that greater access does not always translate into better cause identification. These findings motivate acquisition strategies that consider both the relevance of newly available evidence and its effect on prediction revision, providing an empirical basis for more effective and efficient evidence acquisition in ECPE.

AI.tldr: 本文研究情感-原因对抽取(ECPE)中的智能体引导证据获取：学生智能体在验证集选定的F1决策边界两侧，有选择地查询专家判断并仅修正被查询的预测，在不同信息获取条件下考察委托粒度、查询选择与响应整合的影响。
AI.motivation: ECPE需要识别对话中与情感对应的原因，而准确抽取往往依赖初始不可得的证据，因此"何时值得获取更多信息"成为关键问题；本文希望为更有效且高效的证据获取提供实证依据。
AI.method: 提出智能体引导的证据获取框架：学生智能体针对验证集选定的F1决策边界两侧的边界关系，选择性访问专家判断，并只修改被查询的预测；通过受控实验比较不同信息访问条件下委托粒度、查询选择与响应整合方式对预测质量的影响。
AI.result: 在名义10%查询率下，选择性融合相比学生模型将平均对级F1提升2.64–3.88个点；主实验中ECF达到65.14，MEC4达到49.74，跨模型族表现一致。
AI.conclusion: 更多信息访问并不总能带来更好的原因识别；获取策略应同时考虑新证据的相关性及其对预测修正的影响，从而为ECPE中更有效、更高效的证据获取提供实证基础。

title: FDE-Bench: Evaluating End-to-End Delivery from Underspecified Real-World Business Requests
summary: Real-world business requests often leave key requirements unstated because frontline practitioners struggle to articulate rules they know from experience. Forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must elicit these requirements through dialogue and iteratively optimize solutions until they meet customer acceptance criteria. Existing optimization benchmarks typically start from explicit objectives, while clarification benchmarks often introduce information gaps into existing tasks. We introduce FDE-Bench, the first benchmark built from real customer projects to evaluate agents on end-to-end delivery tasks that require interactive requirement clarification and iterative optimization. Its 49 cases span combinatorial optimization and machine learning. Clarification targets are distilled from discussions between frontline practitioners and FDEs. Agents elicit missing requirements from a simulated customer, and case-specific evaluators assess final artifacts against acceptance criteria using customer-accepted FDE solutions as quality references. Across 18 agent configurations, the highest mean delivery score is only 0.5510, compared with an FDE reference of 1.0. The highest delivery success rate (DSR), defined as the fraction of planned runs reaching this reference, is only 6.12%. These results show that reliable FDE-level end-to-end delivery remains out of reach for the evaluated agents on underspecified real-world business tasks. The benchmark project page is available at https://baidubce.github.io/FM-Agent/FDE-Bench/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FDE-Bench，首个基于真实客户项目构建的基准，用于评估智能体在需求不明确情况下的交互式需求澄清与迭代优化能力，涵盖49个组合优化与机器学习案例。18种智能体配置中最高平均交付得分仅0.5510，最高交付成功率仅6.12%，远低于FDE参考值1.0，表明可靠的前置工程师级端到端交付仍难以实现。
AI.motivation: 真实业务需求常因一线从业者难以明确表述经验性规则而缺失关键信息，前置工程师（FDE）需通过对话澄清需求并迭代优化方案直至满足客户验收标准。现有优化基准从明确目标出发，澄清类基准则多在已有任务中人为制造信息缺口，均无法评估真实场景下的端到端交付能力，因此需要一个源自真实客户项目的基准。
AI.method: 构建FDE-Bench基准，包含49个源自真实客户项目的案例，覆盖组合优化与机器学习。澄清目标从一线从业者与FDE的讨论中提炼。智能体需从模拟客户处获取缺失需求，并由针对各案例的评估器依据验收标准评估最终产物，同时以客户认可的FDE解决方案作为质量参考。在18种智能体配置上进行评测。
AI.result: 18种智能体配置中最高平均交付得分为0.5510，而FDE参考值为1.0；最高交付成功率（DSR，即达到该参考的规划运行比例）仅为6.12%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在被评估的智能体上，针对信息不完整的真实业务任务实现可靠的前置工程师级端到端交付仍然遥不可及。项目页面：https://baidubce.github.io/FM-Agent/FDE-Bench/。

title: GeoFix: Geometry Fixing for 4D Consistent Generation
summary: Video diffusion models increasingly serve as priors for 4D generation, but the generated videos often lack geometric consistency. Recent approaches address this through post-training by designing geometric rewards, yet this can degrade texture and fine detail, requiring auxiliary appearance rewards and careful reward balancing. To address this challenge, we propose GeoFix, a unified framework that improves geometric consistency and visual quality with a single geometric reward, applicable to both training and inference-time reward alignment. Our reward measures cross-view depth consistency in static scene regions, targeting structural inconsistencies without directly constraining appearance or penalizing valid object motion. Crucially, depth agreement increases with camera field-of-view overlap even in real videos and 4D datasets, allowing a smaller camera movement to be mistaken for better geometry. We account for this effect by calibrating the reward against the overlap-dependent trend. GeoFix achieves a 39% improvement in WorldScore 3D consistency and a 4% increase in VBench Quality Score.

AI.tldr: 提出 GeoFix 框架，用单一几何奖励（经相机重叠校准的跨视深度一致性）同时提升 4D 生成视频的几何一致性与视觉质量，适用于训练与推理阶段的奖励对齐。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型被广泛用作 4D 生成的先验，但生成视频缺乏几何一致性。现有基于后训练设计几何奖励的方法会损害纹理与细节，需要额外的外观奖励并谨慎平衡奖励权重，代价高且难以调优。
AI.method: GeoFix 是一个统一框架，仅使用单一几何奖励，可同时用于训练和推理时的奖励对齐。该奖励度量静态场景区域的跨视角深度一致性，只针对结构不一致，不直接约束外观、也不惩罚合理的物体运动。针对深度一致性随相机视场重叠增大而升高的偏差（会误将较小相机运动判为更好几何），对奖励按重叠依赖趋势进行校准。
AI.result: WorldScore 3D 一致性提升 39%，VBench Quality Score 提升 4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过重叠校准的单一几何奖励即可在无需外观奖励与复杂权重平衡的情况下，同时改善 4D 生成的几何一致性与视觉质量，方法通用且可用于训练与推理阶段。

title: TeachGrade: Training-Free Short Answer Scoring with Teacher Evidence
summary: Multi-subject, multi-step scoring requires consistent partial credit across grading conventions. We introduce TeachGrade, a training-free framework using teacher-graded examples. The Task Adapt module builds two frozen memories: Skill captures contextual teacher preferences beyond the rubric; CaseBank supplies local evidence. PreJudge provides retrieval cues; FinalJudge regrades the answer without preliminary scores. On 3,829 SAS-Bench answers across 12 tasks, official macro collaborative consistency score (CCS) rises from Native's 67.99 to 81.32 (+13.33 points), and pooled step exact match from 54.85% to 62.71%. Macro quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) reaches 84.71, exceeding Native, OpenJudge, ProofGrader, and Trojsten by 9.52, 3.50, 11.37, and 17.43 points, respectively, and leading on 8 tasks. Local Qwen3.8-27B gains 8.83 CCS and 4.08 QWK points, improving CCS on all 12 tasks. QWK gains over Native span 6.38--14.65 points on Portuguese automatic essay scoring (AES) and 2.16--2.24 on ASAP-SAS across label views, with lower mean absolute error. These results support reuse across languages, response formats, and backbones without weight updates.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 TeachGrade，利用教师评分样例构建冻结记忆与两阶段评判流程，在多任务多步评分中显著提升与人工评分的一致性。
AI.motivation: 多学科、多步骤评分需要在不同评分规范下保持一致的部分给分。现有自动评分方法难以兼顾评分标准之外的教师偏好，且通常依赖权重更新，跨语言、跨作答格式与跨基座模型的迁移成本高。
AI.method: TeachGrade 为免训练框架，使用教师已评分的样例。Task Adapt 模块构建两个冻结记忆：Skill 捕获超出评分细则的语境化教师偏好，CaseBank 提供局部证据；PreJudge 生成检索线索，FinalJudge 在不使用初步分数的条件下重新评分。
AI.result: 在 12 项任务、3,829 份 SAS-Bench 作答上，官方宏平均协同一致性分数（CCS）由 Native 的 67.99 提升至 81.32（+13.33），汇总步骤精确匹配率由 54.85% 提升至 62.71%。宏平均二次加权 kappa（QWK）达 84.71，分别高出 Native、OpenJudge、ProofGrader、Trojsten 9.52、3.50、11.37、17.43 分，并在 8 项任务上领先。本地 Qwen3.8-27B 提升 8.83 CCS 与 4.08 QWK，且在全部 12 项任务上提升 CCS。相较 Native，QWK 增益在葡萄牙语自动作文评分（AES）上为 6.38--14.65 分，在 ASAP-SAS 上跨标签视图为 2.16--2.24 分，平均绝对误差更低。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，该方法无需更新权重即可在语言、作答格式与基座模型之间复用，为多学科多步评分提供了一致且可迁移的解决方案。

title: Are Multimodal Benchmarks Really Useful? Item-Level Multimodal Benchmark Diagnosis via Structure-Response Co-Calibration
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 34 pages, including appendices
summary: Multimodal benchmarks are central to evaluating whether models can reason over information from multiple modalities. However, existing literature has revealed that some benchmarks may contain shortcut items that can be answered from a single modality or from answer-option regularities alone, thus failing to reflect models' true cross-modal inference ability. Existing methods for assessing benchmarks typically rely either on intrinsic item structure or extrinsic model response behavior, which are not adequate for a comprehensive diagnosis. To fill in this gap, we propose SRCoD, a structure-response co-calibrated diagnosis framework for item-level diagnosis of modality dependence in multimodal benchmarks. SRCoD estimates sample-wise multimodal information structure from benchmark content and target answers, and uses this signal as a soft structural anchor for modality-conditioned item response modeling. The learned model produces a calibrated item-level diagnostic profile that reflects how strongly an item depends on different forms of modality evidence, enabling fine-grained benchmark analysis beyond aggregate accuracy. SRCoD also provides interpretable attribution of the diagnosis results. Extensive experiments under two complementary protocols, i.e., benchmark-refinement oriented validation and human-labeled item validation, demonstrate that SRCoD outperforms state-of-the-art benchmark diagnosis methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SRCoD，一个结构-响应协同校准的条目级诊断框架，用于评估多模态基准中各条目对模态证据的依赖程度，以识别可单模态或靠答案规律作答的捷径条目。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态基准可能包含捷径条目，即可仅凭单一模态或答案选项规律作答，无法反映模型真正的跨模态推理能力。而现有基准评估方法要么依赖条目内在结构，要么依赖外部模型响应行为，均不足以进行全面的诊断。
AI.method: SRCoD 从基准内容与目标答案估计样本级的多模态信息结构，并将该信号作为软结构锚点用于模态条件下的条目响应建模；学习到的模型产生校准的条目级诊断画像，反映条目对各类模态证据的依赖强度，并提供可解释的归因。
AI.result: 在两种互补协议（面向基准精炼的验证与人工标注条目验证）下的大量实验表明，SRCoD 优于当前最先进的基准诊断方法。
AI.conclusion: 结构-响应协同校准能够实现超越聚合准确率的细粒度基准分析，为多模态基准的模态依赖诊断提供了有效且可解释的方案。

title: MvFFN: Multi-view Floor plan Feed-forward Network for Unposed Wide-Baseline Panorama Layout Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing accurate camera poses and floor-plan layouts from sparse, unposed, wide-baseline RGB panoramas remains a challenging open problem. Direct multi-room floor-plan prediction is especially difficult in this setting: pose, geometry, semantics, and global layout structure are tightly coupled, yet a complete floor-plan is hard to learn as a single global output. Our key insight is to keep the model's predictions strictly local. Multi-view Ordered Wall Instance Segmentation (MOIS) is designed around this concept. Each panorama column predicts only the wall it observes plus the next two adjacent walls in clockwise order. The global wall partition, room layouts, and shared coordinates emerge from deterministic aggregation of overlapping local predictions. Building on MOIS, we propose Multi-view floor-plan Feed-Forward Network (MvFFN), which jointly predicts coarse camera poses, dense global geometry, and per-wall semantic outputs. A downstream Layout Chaining (LC) post processing pipeline then assembles these predictions into multi-room floor-plans with shared global coordinates, consistent wall identities, and connected room structure. The dense MOIS predictions recover cross-view wall identity and local within-room connectivity more accurately than composed modular baselines, and the assembled layouts substantially outperform prior methods on wall and junction level accuracy. We also introduce the ZInD-CrossView dataset, which augments ZInD with globally unique wall instances and cross-view segmentation labels for this task.

AI.tldr: 提出MOIS局部预测范式与MvFFN网络，从稀疏无位姿广基线全景图重建相机位姿与多房间户型图，并发布ZInD-CrossView数据集。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏、无位姿、宽基线的RGB全景图中重建精确相机位姿与楼层平面布局仍是开放难题。多房间户型预测尤其困难，因为位姿、几何、语义与全局布局结构高度耦合，而完整户型图难以作为单一全局输出直接学习。
AI.method: 核心思路是保持预测严格局部化。设计多视图有序墙体实例分割（MOIS）：每张全景图的每一列仅预测其观测到的墙体以及顺时针方向相邻的下两面墙；全局墙体划分、房间布局与共享坐标由重叠局部预测的确定性聚合产生。在其基础上提出多视图户型前馈网络（MvFFN），联合预测粗略相机位姿、稠密全局几何与逐墙语义输出；再用下游布局链接（LC）后处理管线组装为具有共享全局坐标、一致墙体编号和连通房间结构的多房间户型图。
AI.result: 稠密MOIS预测在跨视图墙体身份与房间内局部连通性上比组合式模块化基线更准确；组装出的布局在墙体与交点级别精度上显著优于先前方法。同时发布ZInD-CrossView数据集，为ZInD增加全局唯一墙体实例与跨视图分割标注。
AI.conclusion: 局部预测+确定性聚合可有效解耦位姿、几何、语义与全局结构，避免学习单一全局户型输出，为稀疏无位姿全景的多房间户型重建提供了可行方案。

title: FidelityQ: Preserving Predictive Fidelity in Ultra-Low-Bit Language Model Quantization
summary: Ultra-low-bit scalar quantization offers a regular arithmetic structure for efficient deployment of large language models, but preserving predictive behavior at extreme precision remains challenging: with only a few reconstruction levels, accurate weight representation must translate into consistent predictions from a small calibration set. We propose FidelityQ, a scalar quantization framework that preserves predictive fidelity at weight precisions down to 2 bits. For accurate quantization, we introduce Information-Aligned Analytic Coding (IAC), which shapes each weight row toward a centered symmetric source via randomized Hadamard mixing and fits a mirrored four-level minimum-distortion quantizer to its empirical weights. Every level set in this family decomposes exactly into two sign-valued bases with associated scales, combining source-adaptive reconstruction with lookup-free decoding compatible with scaled integer arithmetic. Our analysis further shows that residual predictive discrepancies are heavy-tailed and concentrate on tokens the teacher predicts confidently, motivating Knowledge-Intensive Calibration (KIC) for consistent quantization. KIC ranks sequences by the tail of token-wise teacher-student divergence, allocates a limited calibration budget to the highest-scoring samples, and restores predictive agreement by updating only quantization levels and scales under teacher supervision, keeping pretrained weights frozen. Experiments on the LLaMA and Qwen families demonstrate the effectiveness of FidelityQ in weight-only and joint quantization settings. On LLaMA-2-7B, FidelityQ achieves a WikiText2 perplexity of 6.62 at W2A16 and improves the prior state-of-the-art W2A4KV4 result from 8.31 to 6.96, while reducing linear-layer weight memory by 8.0x relative to FP16.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FidelityQ，一种在低至2比特权重精度下保持预测保真度的标量量化框架，包含信息对齐解析编码(IAC)与知识密集校准(KIC)。
AI.motivation: 超低比特标量量化具有规整的算术结构，便于大语言模型高效部署，但极低精度下仅有少量重构电平，权重表示必须转化为小校准集上一致的预测行为，保持预测性能仍是难题。
AI.method: 提出FidelityQ标量量化框架。IAC通过随机Hadamard混合将每行权重整形为居中对称源，并对经验权重拟合镜像四电平最小失真量化器，每个电平均可精确分解为两个符号基及相应尺度，实现源自适应重构与免查找表、兼容缩放整数运算的解码。基于残差预测差异呈重尾分布且集中于教师模型高置信token的分析，提出KIC：按token级教师-学生散度尾部对序列排序，将有限校准预算分配给得分最高样本，在冻结预训练权重下仅更新量化电平与尺度。
AI.result: 在LLaMA与Qwen系列上验证了FidelityQ在纯权重量化与联合量化中的有效性。LLaMA-2-7B在W2A16下WikiText2困惑度为6.62；W2A4KV4结果由先前最优8.31提升至6.96，同时线性层权重内存较FP16减少8.0倍。
AI.conclusion: FidelityQ通过源自适应解析编码与知识密集校准，在2比特权重精度下有效保持预测保真度，在纯权重量化与联合量化中均达到领先性能并显著降低内存。

title: PsyMemBehav: Psychology-Informed and Memory-Grounded Two-Level Identity-to-Action Reasoning for Social-Media Behavior Simulation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) support social simulation, but faithfully reproducing real users requires grounding both structured platform decisions and language in sparse, noisy behavioral evidence. We introduce PsyMemBehav, which maps psychology-informed profiles and retrieved memories to target-first platform behavior through two-level identity-to-action reasoning. To support this approach with comprehensive behavioral traces, we construct a dataset PsyMemBehav-bench from 5.57M observed behaviors of 5,862 real users (approximately 950 per user) across Reddit, Bluesky, and Twitter. Each recorded engagement is modeled as target selection followed by Comment, Like, or Repost and optional response generation. PsyMemBehav combines 41-dimensional user descriptors, top-5 BM25 memories, reverse-CoT supervision, and rubric-guided DPO over complete reasoning-action trajectories. Experiments show that PsyMemBehav 27B ranks first in 11 of 12 reported individual-level metrics, improving average response quality over GPT-5.4 from 54.28 to 59.68 (9.95% relative), and obtains the lowest group-level MAE (0.081) and MSE (0.009) among simulated systems. These results support evidence-grounded user modeling for observed-thread continuation; the benchmark remains conditional on recorded engagement and does not model no-action decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出 PsyMemBehav：将心理学画像与检索记忆映射到平台行为的双层身份到动作推理方法，并构建含 5.57M 行为、5,862 名真实用户的 PsyMemBehav-bench 数据集，在个体级与群体级指标上均优于 GPT-5.4 等模拟系统。
AI.motivation: LLM 可用于社会模拟，但要忠实复现真实用户，需同时基于稀疏、含噪的行为证据来刻画结构化平台决策与语言生成，而现有方法缺乏这种证据接地与完整行为轨迹支撑。
AI.method: 将每次参与建模为“目标选择→Comment/Like/Repost→可选回复生成”的轨迹；融合41维用户描述符、Top-5 BM25 记忆、逆向 CoT 监督，以及基于完整推理-动作轨迹的评分标准引导 DPO；数据来自 Reddit、Bluesky、Twitter 上 5,862 名真实用户共 5.57M 条行为。
AI.result: PsyMemBehav 27B 在 12 项个体级指标中 11 项居首，平均回复质量由 GPT-5.4 的 54.28 提升至 59.68（相对提升 9.95%）；群体级 MAE 最低（0.081），MSE 最低（0.009）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持面向观测线程延续的证据接地用户建模，但基准仍受限于已记录参与行为，未建模“不行动”决策。

title: EV-JEPA: Elastic V-JEPA for Any Device and Cross-Device Inference
summary: Foundation models like V-JEPA are increasingly deployed across a heterogeneous edge-cloud continuum spanning smart glasses, phones, robots, and servers. Yet, they are typically trained as rigid, fixed-capacity networks bound to one device, supporting neither reconfigurable compute budgets nor collaborative execution. Existing approaches address only one axis at a time: slimmable and NAS-based methods provide width elasticity but assume single-device inference, whereas split-computing methods enable cross-device collaboration only for fixed partitions and static capacities. We introduce Elastic V-JEPA (EV-JEPA), a single model trained once and deployable everywhere along the continuum. Its width is reconfigurable, and it is natively partitionable across heterogeneous devices. At its core is Transition-Aware Triplet Training (T3). At each step we pick a narrow and a wide width, and train three paths: each width alone, plus a hybrid path that runs the early layers narrow and the rest wide. The hybrid switch point is where one device hands off to another, so the same weights learn both single-device and cross-device execution. Across various benchmarks, EV-JEPA falls within 1 accuracy point of independently trained baselines while improving over previous elastic training approaches by up to 11 accuracy points. Narrow-to-wide cross-device hybrid execution recovers to within 1.1 points of the highest-capacity standalone model and supports many-to-one, any-to-any, and variable-split configurations. Finally, we show that the elastic principle extends beyond the backbone to an elastic token compression mechanism that exposes controllable trade-offs among on-device computation, latency, and accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Elastic V-JEPA（EV-JEPA），一种训练一次即可在边缘-云连续体上任意部署的宽度可重构、可跨设备分区的 V-JEPA 模型，核心为 Transition-Aware Triplet Training（T3）训练策略。
AI.motivation: 现有基础模型（如 V-JEPA）通常是固定容量、绑定单一设备的刚性网络，无法同时支持可重构计算预算与跨设备协作。已有方法各自只解决一个维度：slimmable/NAS 方法提供宽度弹性但假设单设备推理；split-computing 方法支持跨设备协作但仅限固定分区与静态容量。作者希望用单一模型同时满足连续体上从智能眼镜到服务器的异构部署需求。
AI.method: 核心为 Transition-Aware Triplet Training（T3）。每一步选取一个窄宽度与一个宽宽度，训练三条路径：单独窄路径、单独宽路径，以及前段窄、后段宽的混合路径。混合路径的切换点即为设备间的交接点，从而使同一套权重同时学会单设备与跨设备执行。此外，作者将弹性原则从骨干网络扩展到弹性 token 压缩机制，以暴露设备端计算、时延与精度之间可控的权衡。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，EV-JEPA 与独立训练的基线相差在 1 个精度点以内，同时比此前的弹性训练方法最高提升 11 个精度点。窄到宽的跨设备混合执行可恢复到最高容量单体模型 1.1 个精度点以内，并支持多对一、任意对任意以及可变切分配置。弹性 token 压缩机制进一步提供计算、时延与精度之间的可控权衡。
AI.conclusion: EV-JEPA 用一次训练得到的单一模型实现了沿边缘-云连续体的可重构宽度与原生可分区能力，在保持接近独立基线精度的同时显著优于既有弹性训练方法，并支持多种跨设备协作配置，其弹性原则还可延伸至 token 压缩层面。

title: Do Personalized LLMs Need the Whole Conversation? Matching the Full History with Only 5% of Its Text via Relevance-Filtered Context
summary: Personalized assistants accumulate long conversation histories, and passing the whole history to an LLM with every request is costly. We show that it is also unnecessary. On PersonaMem-v2 (180 questions), with GPT-5.6-terra and Claude Opus 5.5 as judges, a relevance-filtered context, built by sentence-level retrieval that ranks the history by similarity to the current request and stops at a fixed budget, matches full-history accuracy with only 5% of the text, cutting the judge's input about 20-fold. An LLM summary of the same length performs on par, but it needs an LLM to read the entire history, whereas retrieval needs only a small embedding model. While both sentence-level retrieval and LLM summary perform strongly, retrieval does so while placing the relevant evidence in the context for only 61% of the questions, and an oracle given only that evidence beats the full history by 15.6 points, making better context selection a promising path to surpassing the full history.

AI.tldr: 在长对话历史场景下，句级检索构建的相关性过滤上下文仅用5%文本即可达到全历史准确率，并将判定器输入缩减约20倍；与等长的LLM摘要性能相当，但检索只需小型嵌入模型。检索仅在61%问题上把相关证据放入上下文，而仅含该证据的oracle超过全历史15.6分，说明改进上下文选择有超越全历史的潜力。
AI.motivation: 个性化助手会累积长对话历史，每次请求都把完整历史送入LLM成本高昂。作者进一步论证这种全量输入并非必要，并探究在保持准确率的前提下如何压缩上下文。
AI.method: 在PersonaMem-v2（180个问题）上，以GPT-5.6-terra与Claude Opus 5.5作为判定器，比较三种上下文构建方式：（1）句级检索——按与当前请求的相似度对历史排序，在固定预算处截断，形成相关性过滤上下文；（2）等长LLM摘要；（3）全历史基线。另设仅提供检索证据的oracle作上界参照。
AI.result: 句级检索的相关性过滤上下文仅用5%文本即匹配全历史准确率，判定器输入缩减约20倍；等长LLM摘要表现相当，但需LLM通读全部历史，而检索仅需小型嵌入模型。检索仅在61%的问题上把相关证据纳入上下文；仅含该证据的oracle比全历史高15.6分。
AI.conclusion: 全历史输入并非必要，检索式上下文压缩在成本与效果上均具优势。当前检索的证据覆盖率仍有提升空间，更好的上下文选择是超越全历史准确率的可行路径。

title: Learning after Execution with Action-Specific Credit
summary: Execution is often used as terminal feedback: it scores a generated program, but the resulting state is not used for another learning action. Learning after execution instead uses the execution result as an intermediate state that supports an additional learning interaction for the same policy. This creates a credit-assignment problem because the two actions share the same final objective but play different roles in the trajectory. Accordingly, action-specific credit assigns the initial action credit from the final trajectory outcome and the corrective action credit for improvement over the intermediate state. Image-to-TikZ serves as an executable visual testbed for this setting. On 945 held-out examples, learning after execution strengthens the shared policy under single-call inference and also produces a post-execution corrective capability. Single-call render success reaches 92.70\%, compared with 88.25\% for continued single-stage GRPO after the same number of additional training iterations. This corrective capability is not reproduced by continued single-stage training and depends on the intermediate state. Alternative credit definitions also induce different group-relative preferences over the same trajectories. Together, these results suggest that executable tasks contain useful learning structure beyond a terminal reward. Code is available at https://github.com/tianyufengcn/Learning-after-Execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"执行后学习"(learning after execution)范式：将执行结果作为中间状态而非终端反馈，通过动作特定信用分配区分初始动作与纠正动作，在Image-to-TikZ可执行视觉任务上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统做法仅将执行(execution)作为终端反馈，用于给生成程序打分，而不利用产生的状态进行进一步学习。作者认为可执行任务中蕴含超越终端奖励的学习结构，但将执行结果作为中间状态会带来信用分配问题：两个动作共享同一最终目标，却在轨迹中扮演不同角色。
AI.method: 提出动作特定信用分配(action-specific credit)：初始动作的信用来自最终轨迹结果，纠正动作的信用来自相对中间状态的改进。以Image-to-TikZ作为可执行视觉测试平台进行验证。
AI.result: 在945个留出样本上，执行后学习在单次调用推断下增强了共享策略，并产生执行后纠正能力；单次渲染成功率达92.70%，而同等额外训练迭代下的持续单阶段GRPO为88.25%。该纠正能力无法由持续单阶段训练复现，且依赖于中间状态；不同信用定义会在同一轨迹上诱导出不同的组相对偏好。
AI.conclusion: 可执行任务包含超越终端奖励的有用学习结构，执行后学习及动作特定信用分配能有效提升策略表现并赋予额外纠正能力。

title: Manifold Navigation Learning Using Recurrent Networks: Efficient Training Techniques
summary: Position tracking is a well-studied problem in Euclidean navigation, yet comparatively little attention has been given to navigation on general manifolds, where motion is governed by the underlying geometry of the space. In this work, we formalize the problem of manifold navigation as a velocity-driven tracking task and propose a coordinate-chart-based learning framework in which learning models operate entirely in a Euclidean representation. Predicted trajectories are mapped to the manifold via an immersion function prior to error computation, allowing geometric consistency to be evaluated without explicitly enforcing manifold constraints during learning. Within this framework, we focus on Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) for sequential position prediction on curved manifolds after comparisons with alternative recurrent architectures. We evaluate our GRU models, trained with pertinent custom loss functions, against both a standard MSE loss function and a naive vector-addition baseline. We evaluate our approach on both analytically (and numerically) defined manifolds, as well as a surface reconstructed from a LiDAR point cloud. Our results show that recurrent models can learn to approximate manifold-constrained dynamics from velocity sequences and consistently outperform Euclidean baselines. Our results demonstrate that certain custom loss functions significantly improve long-horizon prediction accuracy compared to conventional point-wise loss functions.

AI.tldr: 该工作将流形导航形式化为速度驱动的跟踪任务，提出基于坐标图（chart）的学习框架，使模型完全在欧氏表示中训练，再通过浸入映射将轨迹映射回流形计算误差。以GRU为序列预测模型，配合自定义损失函数，在解析/数值流形及LiDAR重建曲面上验证，显示循环模型能近似流形约束动力学并优于欧氏基线，且自定义损失显著提升长时程预测精度。
AI.motivation: 位置跟踪在欧氏导航中已被充分研究，而在一般流形上的导航关注较少，其运动由空间的内在几何决定。现有方法多依赖显式流形约束，训练与几何一致性评估耦合紧密，本文旨在建立无需显式施加约束即可评估几何一致性的学习范式。
AI.method: 将流形导航形式化为速度驱动的跟踪任务，提出基于坐标图的学习框架：模型在欧氏表示中运算，预测轨迹经浸入（immersion）函数映射至流形后再计算误差；对比多种循环架构后选用GRU进行序列位置预测，并设计若干自定义损失函数，与标准MSE损失及朴素向量相加基线对比。
AI.result: 在解析定义与数值定义的流形，以及由LiDAR点云重建的曲面上进行评估。结果表明循环模型可从速度序列学习近似流形约束动力学，并稳定优于欧氏基线；相比传统逐点损失（如MSE），部分自定义损失函数显著提升长时程预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 基于坐标图的欧氏学习框架结合GRU与自定义损失，可在不显式施加流形约束的情况下实现几何一致的流形导航跟踪，验证了该框架在合成与真实重建曲面上的有效性与长时程预测优势。

title: UltraBERT: Beyond the Limit of BERT Pre-Training
summary: Recent bidirectional encoders have been modernized with innovations from causal large language models (LLMs). However, the pretraining recipe itself remains inherited from small-scale conventions, leaving encoders underoptimized, with no single model performing competitively across both classification and retrieval tasks. In this work, we investigate how far encoder performance can be pushed by revisiting core design choices in training, revealing three key findings: (1) Encoders saturate on downstream tasks beyond a few trillion tokens, indicating that additional compute past this point does not help. (2) Across model sizes, lower masking ratios benefit classification while higher ones benefit retrieval, contradicting prior work suggesting larger ratios for larger models. (3) Distillation with pruning improves classification at low masking ratios but degrades retrieval at high ones. Guided by these findings, we present UltraBERT, a single encoder that assigns separate LM heads to low and high masking ratios within a batch and restricts the distillation objective to the low ratio. To our knowledge, UltraBERT is the first encoder to achieve state of the art on both classification and retrieval tasks, reaching 91.0 on GLUE and 47.7 on BEIR. Together, these results show how far encoder performance can be pushed and provide a principled basis for compute allocation, masking ratio design, and knowledge transfer in bidirectional models.

AI.tldr: 该论文重新审视双向编码器的预训练设计，发现三个关键结论（token量饱和、掩码率对分类/检索的相反作用、蒸馏剪枝的权衡），并提出 UltraBERT，首次在分类与检索任务上同时取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有双向编码器虽吸收了因果LLM的创新，但预训练方案仍沿用早期小规模惯例，导致编码器未被充分优化，且没有单一模型能同时在分类和检索上具备竞争力。
AI.method: 系统重访训练中的核心设计选择，考察token规模、掩码比例、蒸馏与剪枝的交互作用；基于发现提出 UltraBERT，在同一批次内为低/高掩码比例分别配置独立LM头，并将蒸馏目标限制在低掩码比例分支。
AI.result: 编码器在下游任务上于数万亿token后趋于饱和；低掩码率利于分类、高掩码率利于检索（与“大模型用大掩码率”的既有结论相悖）；低掩码率下蒸馏加剪枝提升分类但高掩码率下损害检索。UltraBERT 在 GLUE 达 91.0、BEIR 达 47.7，均为SOTA。
AI.conclusion: UltraBERT 是首个在分类与检索上同时达到SOTA的编码器，为双向模型的计算分配、掩码率设计和知识迁移提供了有原则的依据。

title: CB-Agent: Concept-Based In-Context Learning for Sequential Action Selection
summary: In-context learning (ICL) allows large language models to use demonstrations without updating their parameters. For interactive agents, demonstrations are trajectories of reasoning, actions, and observations that illustrate how to complete a task. Reusing demonstrations in new situations is challenging: directly inputting full trajectories consumes limited prompt space and constrains the overall effectiveness, while natural-language summaries require the agent to translate general guidance into specific action choices. Therefore, we study whether expert action choices can directly supervise a reusable scoring rule. We propose CB-Agent, which extends concept-based ICL to sequential action selection. We extract environment-action decisions from expert trajectories and fit a concept vector by maximum likelihood to model the conditional distribution over candidate actions given the context. This model combines the concept with frozen language-model features and priors. During ReAct interaction, the agent uses this distribution to select environment actions without including demonstrations in the action-scoring context. Across TextWorld, ALFWorld, and ScienceWorld, CB-Agent achieves the highest cross-benchmark average among the evaluated methods at all three tested model sizes and ranks first on TextWorld and ScienceWorld at each size. ALFWorld experiments support the learned concept's contribution beyond prior-only scoring and show further gains when combined with Reflexion. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CB-Agent-DFF9/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CB-Agent，将基于概念的上下文学习（ICL）扩展到序列动作选择，通过最大似然拟合概念向量来建模候选动作的条件分布，从而在不将完整演示轨迹放入提示的情况下实现可复用的动作评分规则。
AI.motivation: 交互式智能体的演示是包含推理、动作和观测的轨迹。直接输入完整轨迹会占用有限的提示空间并限制整体效果，而自然语言摘要又需要智能体把通用指导转化为具体动作选择，因此作者探究专家动作选择能否直接监督一个可复用的评分规则。
AI.method: CB-Agent从专家轨迹中提取环境-动作决策，通过最大似然拟合概念向量，建模给定上下文下候选动作的条件分布；该模型将概念与冻结的语言模型特征及先验相结合。在ReAct交互过程中，智能体利用该分布选择环境动作，而无需在动作评分上下文中包含演示。
AI.result: 在TextWorld、ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上，CB-Agent在三种测试模型规模下均取得评测方法中最高的跨基准平均成绩，并在每个规模下于TextWorld和ScienceWorld排名第一。ALFWorld实验支持所学概念相对于仅使用先验评分的贡献，并显示与Reflexion结合后进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 专家动作选择可直接监督一个可复用的概念评分规则，使交互式智能体无需在提示中携带演示即可高效复用专家经验，并在多个基准上取得领先表现。

title: Real-Time Traffic Density Estimation: A Hybrid Computer Vision and Predictive Machine Learning Pipeline
summary: Traffic density estimation from camera feeds requires connecting visual perception with short-horizon forecasting. We present a two-stage pipeline that combines vehicle detection and tracking with a spatial logic layer, followed by a temporal estimator. The spatial layer filters bounding boxes by their overlap with a precomputed road mask and extracts per-frame traffic features. LSTM, GRU, and Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) estimators use these features to predict five future steps from a ten-frame input window. We benchmark ten detector variants from six families on a dataset of 5,716 annotated frames using a single NVIDIA GPU. YOLOv5l achieves the highest mAP@50:95 of 0.524 at 56 frames per second, while YOLOv8n reaches 258 frames per second at 0.487 mAP@50:95; these rates measure detector inference without tracking or spatial filtering. Temporal evaluation on 29,243 held-out windows yields aggregate R-squared values of 0.858 for GRU, 0.856 for LSTM, and 0.840 for TCN. These metrics measure forecasts of detector-derived telemetry and are dominated by direction variance, rather than establishing absolute traffic-density accuracy. No road mask was available for the evaluation stream, limiting validation of the spatial filtering component. A live run on a third camera stream examines forecasting behavior within the complete pipeline. The results characterize detector speed-accuracy trade-offs and the limitations of short-window traffic telemetry forecasting.

AI.tldr:
本文提出一种两阶段交通密度估计流水线：先用车检与跟踪结合空间逻辑层（基于道路掩码过滤检测框并提取逐帧交通特征），再用LSTM、GRU、TCN基于10帧输入窗口预测未来5步。在5,716帧数据上对六个家族十种检测器进行基准测试，YOLOv5l取得最高mAP@50:95（0.524，56 FPS），YOLOv8n达258 FPS（0.487）。29,243个留出窗口上的时序预测聚合R²为GRU 0.858、LSTM 0.856、TCN 0.840，但主要受方向方差支配，不等同于绝对密度精度。</tdl>
<parameter name="motivation">从摄像头视频估计交通密度需要将视觉感知与短时预测相衔接。然而检测器的速度—精度权衡、时序模型在该任务中的实际预测能力，以及空间过滤组件的可验证性，都缺乏系统性评估，作者因此构建统一流水线并加以基准测试与限制分析。
AI.motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable
AI.method: 两阶段流水线：(1) 空间层——将车检与跟踪的输出按预计算道路掩码的重叠度过滤边界框，提取逐帧交通特征；(2) 时序层——LSTM、GRU、TCN估计器以10帧输入窗口预测未来5步。在5,716帧标注数据、单张NVIDIA GPU上基准测试六个家族十种检测器变体（含YOLOv5l、YOLOv8n），并在29,243个留出窗口上评估时序模型，另在第三条摄像头流上做完整流水线实时运行。
AI.result: 检测器：YOLOv5l mAP@50:95最高为0.524（56 FPS），YOLOv8n为0.487（258 FPS）；该速度仅计检测器推理，不含跟踪与空间过滤。时序预测聚合R²：GRU 0.858、LSTM 0.856、TCN 0.840。上述指标衡量的是基于检测器遥测的预测，且主要由方向方差支配，而非绝对交通密度精度；评估流缺少道路掩码，空间过滤组件无法验证。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了检测器的速度—精度权衡，并揭示了短窗口交通遥测预测的局限性：高R²主要由方向方差驱动，绝对密度精度未被确立，空间过滤组件因缺少道路掩码而无法验证。

title: Toward System One Clinical Intelligence: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning and Counterfactual Explainability of Decision Foundation Models
summary: Automated disease classification from patient-reported symptoms requires balancing the speed of lightweight discriminative models against the contextual understanding and latency costs of autoregressive large language models (LLMs). Decision foundation models offer an alternative by mapping representations directly to candidate classes without free-form text generation. We adapt Clef-Flash, a 9-billion-parameter decision model built on a Qwen3.5 backbone, for 24-class disease classification on the Symptom2Disease benchmark. Using 4-bit quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) with differential learning rates and a stratified split of 960 training and 240 test cases, the model achieves 95.42% diagnostic accuracy and a macro F1 score of 0.9551. This improves upon the reported zero-shot baselines of 61.67% for a remote API and 65.00% for a local unadapted initialization, and outperforms the ClinicalBERT baseline (90.90%). By evaluating candidate logits in a single forward pass without autoregressive decoding, inference takes under 80 milliseconds per record on a single GPU, yielding a reported 31-fold speedup over generative LLM baselines. To examine symptom-level evidence, we introduce a Leave-One-Symptom-Out (LOSO) counterfactual perturbation framework. Removing disease-defining symptom clauses in a psoriasis example reduces predicted-class confidence from 100.00% to 0.12% and shifts the prediction to impetigo with 99.59% confidence, while removing secondary systemic symptoms produces less than 0.01% change in confidence. These findings suggest that decision-based architectures can combine the linguistic capabilities of large foundation models with low-latency inference and symptom-level interpretability for clinical triage.

AI.tldr: 将基于Qwen3.5的90亿参数决策式模型Clef-Flash适配到Symptom2Disease的24类疾病分类任务上，采用QLoRA微调后达到95.42%准确率、宏F1 0.9551，单次前向传播推理低于80毫秒，并借助留一症状扰动框架验证症状级可解释性。
AI.motivation: 患者自述症状的自动化疾病分类需要在轻量判别模型的速度与自回归大语言模型的语境理解及高延迟之间权衡。作者希望验证决策式基础模型能否兼顾大模型的语义能力、低延迟推理与症状级可解释性，从而服务于临床分诊。
AI.method: 以Clef-Flash（基于Qwen3.5骨干的90亿参数决策模型）为基础，在Symptom2Disease基准上做24类疾病分类；使用4-bit量化低秩适配（QLoRA）、差异化学习率，并按分层划分得到960例训练集与240例测试集。推理时仅通过一次前向传播评估候选类别logits，不做自回归解码。此外提出留一症状（LOSO）反事实扰动框架来检验症状级证据贡献。
AI.result: 诊断准确率95.42%，宏F1为0.9551，优于零样本基线（远程API 61.67%、本地未适配初始化65.00%）及ClinicalBERT基线（90.90%）；单GPU下每条记录推理时间低于80毫秒，相对生成式LLM基线约有31倍加速。LOSO实验中，移除银屑病定义性症状子句使预测置信度从100.00%降至0.12%，预测转向脓疱疮（置信度99.59%），而移除次要全身症状对置信度影响小于0.01%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，决策式架构能够在临床分诊场景中同时融合大型基础模型的语义能力、低延迟推理和症状级可解释性，为患者自述症状驱动的疾病分类提供了一条兼顾性能与效率的可行路径。

title: Iterate on an LLM, Serve on an SLM
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET)
summary: As frontier LLMs gain more capabilities, the cost to run them also goes up. At the same time, small language models (SLMs) also gain more capabilities but have largely been able to keep their cost stable, offering 5-40 times cheaper inference for the narrow, repetitive subtasks that agents decompose work into. However, the standing limiting factor is getting the correct behavior out of a small model in a fast, efficient, and economical way. Unfortunately, in most cases, zero-shot small models fail narrow production tasks. Furthermore, retraining one every time the behavior changes is too slow to iterate on. We propose doing both in sequence. First, develop the desired behavior in prompt space, on a frontier model, with immediate feedback from live traffic. Then, once the behavior converges, distill the recorded production behavior (not synthetic imitations of it) into an SLM through supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We show a proper use case of this method through a scheduling agent for home-care agencies that fans out a single yes/no safety decision per caregiver-shift pair on GPT-5.4-nano. A LoRA-tuned Qwen3-8B trained on 11.6k recorded production decisions reaches 0.913 agreement, while the teacher (GPT-5.4-nano), re-run on its own recorded prompts, agrees with itself only 72.7% of the time, pointing to the fact that the SLM may also be more consistent. Furthermore, when the two disagreed, a blinded professional scheduler sided with the student 48-29. Finally, we find that the SLM has approximately 2.5 times lower median latency and is a fraction of the cost. We believe this lifecycle of quick building, live feedback, and cheap inference is a blueprint for others building similar systems.

AI.tldr: 提出"先在前沿模型上用真实流量迭代提示词、收敛后将生产行为蒸馏进小模型(SFT)"的两阶段生命周期，在家护排班安全决策任务上，LoRA微调Qwen3-8B以更低延迟与成本达到与教师0.913一致率，甚至更稳定。
AI.motivation: 前沿LLM能力增强但推理成本高；SLM成本稳定(便宜5-40倍)，适合代理分解出的狭窄重复子任务。但瓶颈在于如何快速、高效、经济地让小模型产生正确行为：零样本小模型在狭窄生产任务上通常失败，而为每次行为变化重新训练又太慢。因此需要一条兼顾快速迭代与廉价推理的开发路径。
AI.method: 两阶段序列方法：(1)在提示词空间于前沿模型上开发目标行为，借助线上真实流量即时反馈迭代；(2)行为收敛后，将记录下来的真实生产行为(而非合成模仿数据)通过监督微调(SFT)蒸馏进SLM。案例：家护机构排班代理，对每个护理员-班次对在GPT-5.4-nano上输出单一yes/no安全决策；用11.6k条记录的生产决策LoRA微调Qwen3-8B。
AI.result: 学生模型与教师达成0.913一致率；教师(GPT-5.4-nano)在同批记录提示词上自洽率仅72.7%，提示SLM可能更一致。二者分歧时，盲评的专业排班员以48-29支持学生。SLM中位延迟约为教师的1/2.5(约低2.5倍)，成本仅为其中一小部分。
AI.conclusion: "快速构建—线上反馈—廉价推理"的生命周期被证明可行，可作为构建同类系统的蓝图；用真实生产行为蒸馏SLM可获得高一致率、更高稳定性与显著延迟/成本优势。

title: TraceSampler: Making Sampling Errors Predictable and Correctable for Accelerated Generative Sampling
summary: Accurate sampling from continuous-time generative models can require many model evaluations. Low-step sampling reduces cost, but coarse updates introduce endpoint errors that can accumulate and degrade generation quality. We introduce TraceSampler, a post-training method that corrects these errors without modifying the pretrained model. Rather than optimising low-step updates directly, TraceSampler models endpoint error as a sample-specific prediction problem. A higher-step reference integration over the same interval provides the supervised target, while a compact representation makes high-dimensional error predictable from the sampling trace. This representation combines shared residual structure, trace-derived directions, and a low-rank remainder, so shallow per-step MLP heads predict sample-dependent coefficients. These coefficients drive a two-stage learned residual correction: the first stage predicts the full endpoint residual, while an intermediate backbone evaluation provides new trace information to predict the remaining residual; this evaluation is reused by the following step. TraceSampler is evaluated with Rectified Flow on CIFAR-10, SiT-XL/2 on ImageNet-256, and SD3.5 Medium for text-to-image generation. At 10 steps, it reduces trajectory MSE relative to matched-step Euler by 90.5% on CIFAR-10 and 85.6% on ImageNet-256, while achieving FID scores of 2.692 and 2.189, close to 120-step Heun references of 2.601 and 2.056 with 24$\times$ fewer backbone evaluations. On SD3.5 Medium, TraceSampler improves image quality and prompt following; at 10 steps, ImageReward rises from 0.752 to 0.906 while trajectory MSE falls by 70.7%. These gains preserve Euler's backbone-evaluation budget, add less than 0.4% inference FLOPs, and incur negligible wall-clock overhead, showing that coarse-step sampling error can be made predictable from the sampling trace and efficiently corrected.

AI.tldr: TraceSampler是一种训练后纠错方法，通过将端点误差建模为样本特定预测问题，用浅层MLP预测系数实现残差校正，在少步采样下大幅降低轨迹MSE与FID，且几乎不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: 连续时间生成模型精确采样需要大量模型评估，少步采样虽降低成本，但粗粒度更新会引入可累积的端点误差，损害生成质量。现有方法未能高效纠正此类误差而不修改预训练模型。
AI.method: 将端点误差建模为样本特定预测问题：以同区间更高步参考积分为监督目标，用紧凑表示（共享残差结构+轨迹导出方向+低秩余项）使高维误差可从采样轨迹预测，浅层逐步MLP头预测样本相关系数。系数驱动两阶段学习残差校正：第一阶段预测完整端点残差，中间骨干评估提供新轨迹信息预测剩余残差，该评估被下一步复用。不改动预训练模型。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10（Rectified Flow）、ImageNet-256（SiT-XL/2）、SD3.5 Medium上评估。10步时CIFAR-10轨迹MSE较匹配步Euler降90.5%，ImageNet-256降85.6%，FID分别为2.692和2.189，接近120步Heun参考值2.601和2.056，骨干评估减少24倍。SD3.5 Medium上10步ImageReward从0.752升至0.906，轨迹MSE降70.7%。保持Euler骨干评估预算，增加不到0.4%推理FLOPs，墙钟开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 粗步采样误差可从采样轨迹中预测并被高效校正，TraceSampler在少步生成中显著提升质量而不增加骨干评估预算。

title: PAT: A Personality-Driven Augmentation and Transfer Learning Framework for Depression Detection on Social Media
summary: Depression is a prevalent mental disorder that affects millions worldwide, with early detection crucial for effective intervention. While exist?ing methods have achieved promising results in automated depression detection, they face two key limitations: (1) noise in post screening: symptom-based semantic screening is easily misled by superficial lexical patterns, thereby introducing false-positive posts; (2) weak op?timization of the post encoder: relying solely on coarse user-level supervision signals pre?vents models from capturing depressive cues within individual posts. To address these limita?tions, we propose PAT, a Personality-driven Augmentation and Transfer learning frame?work. In the first phase, PAT optimizes a post?level encoder via a fine-grained contrastive learning objective, utilizing LLM-based data augmentation driven by classic personality the?ories to alleviate data scarcity. In the second phase, the trained post-level scorer is deployed for high-quality post filtering, while its en?coder parameters are seamlessly transferred for user-level tasks. Extensive experiments demon?strate that PAT significantly outperforms exist?ing methods. Furthermore, PAT delivers multi?granular interpretability by tracing post-level mental-state trajectories and highlighting key symptoms, thereby offering reliable diagnostic evidence for clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAT框架，通过人格理论驱动的数据增强与细粒度对比学习优化帖子级编码器，再进行高质量帖子筛选与编码器迁移，用于自动化抑郁检测并提升多粒度可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化抑郁检测方法存在两大局限：(1)帖子筛选中的噪声问题，基于症状的语义筛选易被表层词汇模式误导，引入假阳性帖子；(2)帖子编码器优化不足，仅依赖粗粒度的用户级监督信号，难以捕捉单条帖子内的抑郁线索。
AI.method: 提出PAT（Personality-driven Augmentation and Transfer learning）框架，分两阶段：第一阶段利用经典人格理论驱动的LLM数据增强缓解数据稀缺，并以细粒度对比学习目标优化帖子级编码器；第二阶段使用训练好的帖子级评分器进行高质量帖子过滤，并将其编码器参数无缝迁移至用户级任务。
AI.result: 大量实验表明PAT显著优于现有方法；同时通过追踪帖子级心理状态轨迹并突出关键症状，实现多粒度可解释性，为临床实践提供可靠诊断证据。
AI.conclusion: PAT通过人格驱动增强与迁移学习，有效缓解帖子筛选噪声和编码器优化不足问题，在提升抑郁检测性能的同时增强可解释性，具有临床应用价值。

title: Decoupling Knowledge Forgetting and Refusal Learning in MLLM Unlearning
summary: Current evaluations of multimodal unlearning typically focus on whether a model stops outputting target information. This surface-level criterion, however, masks two critical failure modes. First, knowledge suppression techniques often induce confabulation, leading the model to hallucinate facts about the unlearned subject. Second, refusal training merely alters observable behavior without erasing the underlying knowledge; such models might decline open queries but still identify correct answers under multiple-choice probing. To overcome these limitations, we propose Forget-Aware Self-Distillation (FASD). This method is designed to achieve honest ignorance, a state where the model genuinely loses the target knowledge and learns to acknowledge its absence. FASD separates these goals into two complementary channels. The behavior channel distills appropriate refusals from an ignorance-prompted copy of the model itself. Crucially, target tokens are masked from the teacher distribution to avoid accidentally reteaching the forgotten concepts. Simultaneously, the knowledge channel directly suppresses ground-truth answer spans independently of the model's generated responses. Experiments demonstrate that FASD successfully unlearns target knowledge, prevents information leakage in open-ended tasks, and preserves performance on retained data. The resulting model not only forgets the specified information but accurately recognizes the boundaries of its own knowledge. Code and data will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Forget-Aware Self-Distillation (FASD)，通过行为与知识双通道的自蒸馏实现"诚实的无知"，解决多模态遗忘中的臆造与拒绝式伪遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态遗忘评估只关注模型是否停止输出目标信息，这一表层标准掩盖了两个关键失效模式：一是知识抑制技术常引发臆造（confabulation），模型会围绕被遗忘对象编造事实；二是拒绝训练只改变外显行为而未擦除底层知识，模型可能拒绝开放查询，但在多项选择探测下仍能识别正确答案。
AI.method: 提出Forget-Aware Self-Distillation (FASD)，目标是实现"诚实的无知"（honest ignorance），即将目标知识的真实丧失与对自身知识缺失的承认分离为两个互补通道。行为通道：从经无知提示的模型自身副本中蒸馏出恰当的拒绝行为，并在教师分布中掩蔽目标token，以防意外重新教授被遗忘概念。知识通道：直接抑制真实答案span，独立于模型生成的回答。
AI.result: 实验表明FASD成功遗忘目标知识，阻止开放任务中的信息泄漏，并保持保留数据上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 所得模型不仅遗忘指定信息，还能准确识别自身知识的边界。代码与数据将在论文发表后发布。

title: Learning Transferable World-Action Models from Task-Paired Human Videos
summary: World-action models inherit broad visual and physical priors from video pre-training. However, standard within-video next-frame prediction allows them to rely on appearance shared between the context and future, rather than learning interactions that transfer across scenes and embodiments. We introduce WATCH, a cross-video pre-training that learns from task-paired human demonstrations collected across diverse environments. Conditioned on the video and actions of one demonstration, the model jointly predicts another demonstration's actions and future frames from its current observation. Predicting one demonstration from another encourages the model to learn task-relevant interactions that transfer across scenes and demonstrators. Our pre-training shows that these capabilities can be learned from readily scalable human-human pairs alone, without requiring matched human-robot demonstrations. Analyses before robot post-training show improved motion alignment across embodiments and better action and video prediction on unseen robots, with representations closer to those learned from robot pairs. After robot post-training, WATCH improves MimicDroid in-context success from 40.9% to 68.3% with Cosmos Policy and from 59.8% to 77.7% with Cosmos3, with the largest gains on the unseen levels. Gains persist under context-free post-training across robot embodiments. WATCH outperforms within-video pre-training and co-training baselines, supporting cross-video prediction as a scalable approach to learning transferable world-action representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WATCH，一种跨视频预训练方法，通过任务配对的人类演示数据学习可迁移的世界-动作表示，在机器人后训练中显著提升MimicDroid的成功率。
AI.motivation: 标准视频内下一帧预测使世界-动作模型依赖上下文与未来共享的外观信息，而非学习可跨场景与跨具身迁移的交互规律，导致迁移能力受限。
AI.method: WATCH采用跨视频预训练：以一条演示的视频和动作作为条件，模型联合预测另一条演示在其当前观测下的动作与未来帧，从而迫使模型学习任务相关的交互表示。仅使用可扩展的人类-人类配对演示，无需人-机器人匹配数据。
AI.result: 机器人后训练前，跨具身运动对齐改善，在未见机器人上的动作与视频预测更优，表示更接近机器人配对学到的表示；后训练后，MimicDroid的上下文成功率在Cosmos Policy上从40.9%提升至68.3%，在Cosmos3上从59.8%提升至77.7%，未见关卡增益最大，且在无上下文后训练下跨机器人具身仍保持增益。
AI.conclusion: WATCH优于视频内预训练与协同训练基线，证明跨视频预测是学习可迁移世界-动作表示的可扩展途径。

title: Select or Rewrite: Oracle-Guided Fine-Tuning for Generative ASR Post-Editing from N-Best Hypotheses
summary: Large language models can post-edit ASR by using linguistic context to compare N-best hypotheses and rewrite the transcript when needed, often improving WER without retraining the recognizer. However, prompt-only correction is brittle: it may over-edit when top-1 is correct and hallucinate when the reference is absent, and often needs very large models. We propose oracle-guided fine-tuning that turns N-best lists into supervision via three curated pools: corrections (reference in the list but not top-1) to teach selection, regularizers (top-1 correct) to discourage unnecessary rewrites, and hard negatives (reference absent) to suppress hallucination. Fine-tuning on this data provides more effective supervision than random subset fine-tuning for learning a hybrid select-or-rewrite policy, with the clearest gains from around 3B parameters on the proprietary dataset but less conclusive results on CommonVoice, a divergence suggesting that public read-speech text may overlap with LLM pretraining and mask genuine post-editing gains.

AI.tldr: 提出oracle-guided fine-tuning方法，将ASR的N-best列表按三类池（corrections、regularizers、hard negatives）构造监督数据，微调LLM学习选择性纠错或重写策略，在约3B参数量上效果显著，优于随机子集微调。
AI.motivation: 仅靠prompt的LLM后编辑存在脆弱性：当top-1正确时容易过度编辑、当参考假设缺失时容易产生幻觉，且通常需要超大模型才能奏效。需要一个更有效且经济的监督方式。
AI.method: oracle-guided fine-tuning：将N-best列表转化为监督信号，构建三个精心设计的池——corrections（参考在列表但非top-1，教授选择）、regularizers（top-1正确，抑制无谓改写）、hard negatives（参考缺失，抑制幻觉）。在此数据上微调，学习hybrid select-or-rewrite策略。
AI.result: 相比随机子集微调，该监督更有效；在专有数据集上从约3B参数量起获得最明显收益；但在CommonVoice上结果较不明确。
AI.conclusion: oracle-guided fine-tuning能有效训练LLM的ASR后编辑策略。专有与公开数据集的差异提示：公共朗读语音文本可能与LLM预训练数据重叠，从而掩盖真实的后编辑增益，即基准评测需警惕数据污染。

title: From Existing Methods to New Research Ideas: Two Perspectives on Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a route to AI systems that participate in their own continued development. Recent methods allow language agents to retain changes to their parameters, memory, skills, and code for subsequent execution and improvement. We examine how these methods can inform new research ideas through two complementary perspectives. First, we introduce a unified taxonomy with nine design dimensions organized into four groups: update targets, update organization, update schedule and scope, feedback and selection. This taxonomy places existing methods in a shared design space, where examining individual dimensions and their interactions can inspire new research ideas. Second, we examine how existing RSI methods draw on traditional deep learning, for example through optimization, regularization, data augmentation, continual learning, and adversarial learning. We develop further ideas by examining more specific learning mechanisms and drawing on evolutionary computation. We also review how existing benchmarks assess self-improvement under online, offline, and offline-to-online settings. Together, these perspectives help researchers develop new RSI research ideas from existing designs and learning mechanisms. RSI papers and resources are available at https://prism-shadow.github.io/awesome-rsi/.

AI.tldr: 本文围绕递归自我改进（RSI），提出一个九维度统一分类法，并从深度学习与进化计算的视角梳理设计思路，同时综述在线、离线及离线转在线场景下的评估基准。
AI.motivation: 近期方法使语言智能体能够保留对参数、记忆、技能和代码的修改，从而参与自身的持续开发与改进。作者希望厘清这些方法的共同设计空间，并帮助研究者从既有设计与学习机制中衍生出新的RSI研究思路。
AI.method: 采用两个互补视角：其一，构建含九个设计维度的统一分类法，分为更新目标、更新组织、更新计划与范围、反馈与选择四组，将现有方法置于共享设计空间中考察单维度及其交互；其二，分析现有RSI方法如何借鉴传统深度学习（优化、正则化、数据增强、持续学习、对抗学习），并进一步引入更具体的学习机制与进化计算；同时综述在线、离线、离线转在线三类评估基准。
AI.result: 形成覆盖更新目标、组织、计划与范围、反馈与选择的九维度分类框架，明确了各RSI方法在共享设计空间中的位置及维度交互带来的研究启发；梳理了RSI对深度学习范式的借鉴路径及向进化计算等机制的拓展方向；归纳了在线、离线、离线转在线三类自我改进评估基准；并提供了RSI论文与资源汇总。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一分类法与学习机制视角的结合，可帮助研究者基于现有设计与学习机制发掘新的RSI研究思路，同时明确不同评估场景下自我改进能力的衡量方式。

title: RealityBench: Simulated Environments to Evaluate a Vision Language Model's Ability to Document Human Physical Work
summary: Augmenting worker capabilities in the physical world through guidance has been a decades-long goal for AI agents. One key supporting capability is to understand what the worker is doing, seeing through the human's camera or smart glasses, and assist them in documentation. Despite advances in vision language models, their capabilities in these settings remain uncertain and are challenging to benchmark because most physical work data is proprietary, and involves too much variability to study in a principled manner. Unlike structured settings such as kitchens and warehouses that have predictable lighting, geometry, and objects, field-facing tasks such as rooftop solar installation and vehicle repair are unconstrained and high variance. Here, we model real-world physical work in Blender across eleven environments, incorporating variants in both image acceptability and documentation. The acceptability task asks whether a particular view would be suitable proof-of-work and documentation asks whether an agent can understand the task-relevant state of the environment from that view. Across 26 vision-language models, we find that top models largely solve documentation when the answer is text in frame, but are weak at reading measurements and at judging small parts and spatial relations, such as whether a tape measure leans. Acceptability is harder to pin down because human raters disagree with each other. Measured against a scorer that agrees with the raters' majority about as often as a single rater does, the best models cannot be distinguished from a single non-author rater, at a cost within the range of a human pass. In the three environments where we can trace acceptability errors, most wrong rejections come from misreading the scene rather than the requirement. On the three documentation questions for which we have real images, model rankings on rendered frames transfer to real images.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了基于Blender的11类真实物理作业环境基准，评估26个视觉语言模型在"可接受性"（图像能否作为工作凭证）与"文档化"（能否从视图理解任务状态）两类任务上的表现。结果显示模型在文本帧问题上表现优异，但在测量读数、小零件与空间关系判断上薄弱；可接受性判定难度更高，最佳模型仅与单个非作者人类评分者相当。
AI.motivation: AI代理通过指导增强物理世界中的工作者能力是长期目标，其关键能力是借助人类相机或智能眼镜理解工作者行为并辅助记录。然而现有视觉语言模型在这一场景下的能力尚不明确且难以基准测试：多数物理工作数据为专有数据，且变异性过大难以进行系统研究。与厨房、仓库等具有可预测光照、几何与物体的结构化场景不同，屋顶光伏安装、车辆维修等现场任务约束少、方差高，缺乏合适的评测手段。
AI.method: 作者在Blender中对真实物理工作进行建模，构建了涵盖11种环境的基准，并引入图像可接受性与文档化两类变体任务：可接受性任务判断某一视图是否适合作工作凭证，文档化任务判断代理能否从该视图理解任务相关的环境状态。基于此基准，对26个视觉语言模型进行了评估，并采用与评分者多数意见一致率约等于单个评分者的评分器作为参照，同时对可接受性错误进行了溯源分析；在三个文档化问题上使用真实图像与渲染帧进行排名迁移验证。
AI.result: 在26个视觉语言模型中，顶级模型在答案为画面内文本的文档化任务上基本能解决，但在读取测量值以及判断小零件和空间关系（如卷尺是否倾斜）方面表现较弱。可接受性判定更难明确，因为人类评分者彼此存在分歧；以与多数意见一致率约等于单个评分者的评分器为基准，最佳模型与单个非作者评分者难以区分，且成本处于人类评分范围内。在三个可追溯可接受性错误的环境中，多数错误拒绝源于对场景的误读而非对要求的误读。在有真实图像的三个文档化问题上，模型在渲染帧上的排名可迁移到真实图像。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一个面向现场物理作业的可控基准，揭示当前视觉语言模型在细粒度测量、小部件识别与空间关系判断上的系统性不足，并指出可接受性任务因人类评分分歧而本质上更难以界定。渲染帧上的模型排名可迁移至真实图像，表明该基准具有一定外部效度，为后续提升AI代理在非结构化物理工作场景中的指导与记录能力提供了评测基础。

title: Have You Been Convinced? A Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning Approach to Detecting Persuasiveness in ChangeMyView Discussions
comment: Accepted and to be published in the Proceedings of the 25th International Conference on Knowledge Engineering and Knowledge Management (EKAW 2026)
summary:
Argument structures represent how individual arguments interact within a discourse. However, leveraging these structures to infer meaningful knowledge remains challenging, as it requires a formal representation of how argumentative influence propagates across the structure. We propose Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning System (NARS) for performing persuasiveness detection directly from online discussions. The neural component employs retrieval-augmented iterative LLM reasoning to extract bipolar argument structures, while the symbolic component applies gradual argumentation semantics to propagate argumentative influence over the structure.
  Using the Webis-CMV-20 corpus, we construct CMV2BAS, a dataset of long, multi-threaded ChangeMyView discussions annotated with LLM-derived bipolar argument structures and labeled with delta events (view change vs.\ no change). We investigate whether gradual argumentation semantics can effectively detect persuasiveness, whether augmenting them with argument quality and graph-based centrality improves performance, and whether symbolic reasoning remains necessary in the presence of modern LLMs. NARS achieves F1=0.57 and AUC=0.56 under its best configuration, outperforming zero-shot Qwen3.6:27B and GPT-oss:20B. We identify support-dominant discussions and long argumentative chains as key failure modes limiting attack influence propagation. Our work demonstrates the feasibility of operationalizing formal gradual argumentation semantics over noisy real-world discourse for scalable macro-level persuasion analysis, while highlighting key challenges and directions for future research in neuro-symbolic argumentation reasoning. We release both CMV2BAS dataset and the NARS framework for public use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经符号论证推理系统NARS，结合检索增强的LLM推理提取双极论证结构与渐进论证语义传播论证影响，用于在线讨论的说服性检测，并发布CMV2BAS数据集。
AI.motivation: 论证结构刻画了话语中个体论点间的交互关系，但如何利用这些结构推断有意义的知识仍具挑战，因为这需要对论证影响如何沿结构传播进行形式化表示。
AI.method: NARS由神经与符号两部分组成：神经部分采用检索增强的迭代LLM推理提取双极论证结构；符号部分应用渐进论证语义在结构上传播论证影响。基于Webis-CMV-20语料构建CMV2BAS数据集，包含长篇幅、多线程的ChangeMyView讨论，标注LLM导出的双极论证结构及delta事件标签。研究考察渐进论证语义能否有效检测说服性、引入论证质量与图中心性能否提升性能、以及在现代LLM下符号推理是否仍必要。
AI.result: 在最佳配置下NARS取得F1=0.57、AUC=0.56，优于零样本Qwen3.6:27B和GPT-oss:20B。识别出以支持为主导的讨论和长论证链是限制攻击影响传播的关键失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 本工作证明了在嘈杂的真实话语上操作形式化渐进论证语义、进行可扩展的宏观层面说服分析的可行性，同时指出了神经符号论证推理的关键挑战与未来方向，并公开发布CMV2BAS数据集与NARS框架。

title: PEARL: Process-Experience Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Agents
summary: Terminal rewards make multi-turn agents trainable without step-level annotations, but group-relative advantages provide little guidance about which intermediate decisions to adjust. Failed trajectories also contain reasonable actions, while unfavorable decision patterns can recur as training proceeds. We introduce PEARL (Process-Experience Aware Reinforcement Learning), which improves local credit assignment without an additional critic. Given two continuations from the same history with different outcomes, PEARL locates their first divergence and builds a feature representation of each branch's local decision. It clusters these decision features in recent failure and success memories to identify recurring local patterns. Using this pattern memory, PEARL selectively strengthens negative advantages at lower-reward decisions, while leaving positive advantages and the base policy optimizer unchanged. On AppWorld, PEARL improves over ARPO on Normal and Challenge tasks at both 4B and 8B scales. On ALFWorld, it achieves 97.9% mean success at 4B, 2.7 points above the strongest baseline, while remaining competitive at 8B. Ablations of shaping location, success-bank filtering, and memory window support the value of selective, recurring-pattern-based updates.

AI.tldr: PEARL提出一种过程经验感知的强化学习方法，通过对比同一历史下不同结果的分支来定位首个分歧点，构建局部决策特征并聚类为反复出现的模式记忆，从而在不引入额外critic的情况下实现更细粒度的信用分配。
AI.motivation: 仅依赖终端奖励可使多轮智能体无需步级标注即可训练，但组相对优势对"应调整哪些中间决策"提供的指导非常有限；此外，失败轨迹中亦包含合理动作，而不利的决策模式会在训练过程中反复出现。
AI.method: 给定来自同一历史的两个不同结果续写，PEARL定位其首个分歧点，并为各分支的局部决策构建特征表示；在近期失败与成功记忆中聚类这些决策特征，以识别反复出现的局部模式；利用该模式记忆，选择性地增强低奖励决策处的负优势，同时保持正优势与基础策略优化器不变。
AI.result: 在AppWorld上，PEARL在4B与8B规模下的Normal和Challenge任务上均优于ARPO；在ALFWorld上，4B规模取得97.9%平均成功率，比最强基线高2.7个百分点，8B规模亦保持竞争力。关于塑形位置、成功库过滤与记忆窗口的消融实验验证了选择性、基于反复模式更新的价值。
AI.conclusion: 通过选择性、基于反复出现模式的局部信用分配，PEARL在无需额外critic的前提下改善了多轮智能体的训练效果，消融结果进一步支持该设计各组成部分的有效性。

title: VisualCoding: Learning Executable Skills for Reliable Visual Reasoning
summary: Learning reusable skills can improve visual reasoning agents, yet applying a skill still requires the agent to implement or invoke a procedure and produce the final answer. Errors and hallucinations at these steps can prevent acquired experience from translating into reliable single-run performance. We propose VisualCoding, which combines execution-guided acquisition of reusable visual programs with direct adoption of their answers on applicable inputs. Execution-Guided Program Acquisition composes visual primitives and additional code into family-level solvers, then iteratively tests and revises them on labeled training instances. Scope-Aware Direct Execution runs a retained solver and returns its valid in-scope answer. We evaluate VisualCoding on four models across four benchmarks spanning 69 task families. VisualCoding exceeds the strongest evaluated baseline in mean accuracy by 4.45 percentage points with Gemini-3.1-Pro and by 14.78 points when reusing the frozen Pro-acquired artifacts with Flash-Lite. Ablations support execution-guided acquisition and show that direct execution outperforms textual or callable reuse of the same programs. Code is available at https://github.com/jiaq-liu/VisualCoding.

AI.tldr: 提出VisualCoding，将可复用视觉程序的执行引导获取与可适用范围下直接采用其结果相结合，在4个模型、4个基准、69个任务族上提升视觉推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 让视觉推理智能体复用已学技能时，仍需自行实现/调用程序并生成最终答案，这些环节的错误与幻觉使已获取的经验难以转化为可靠的单次运行性能。
AI.method: 包含两个组件：(1) Execution-Guided Program Acquisition：将视觉原语与额外代码组合成族级求解器，并在有标注训练实例上迭代测试与修正；(2) Scope-Aware Direct Execution：运行保留的求解器，在其有效作用域内直接返回其答案。
AI.result: 在4个模型、4个基准、69个任务族上评测；平均准确率较最强基线，Gemini-3.1-Pro提升4.45个百分点，用Flash-Lite复用冻结的Pro所得产物时提升14.78个百分点；消融实验支持执行引导获取，并表明直接执行优于对同一程序的文本复用或可调用复用。
AI.conclusion: 执行引导的程序获取与作用域感知的直接执行能有效提升单次运行的视觉推理可靠性；代码已开源。

title: RegExtract: A Benchmark for PFAS Regulatory Information Extraction with LLMs
comment: Accepted to the AI for Law Workshop at ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
summary: Extracting structured information from regulatory documents is a critical but challenging task. Relevant facts are scattered across long, legally dense texts, and traceability of extracted facts to their source is essential for verification. With increasing awareness of the environmental and health impacts of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), regulatory documents have expanded significantly, varying in scope and product relevance, making interpretation challenging for manufacturers and policymakers. We introduce RegExtract, a benchmark for structured information extraction from PFAS regulatory documents, comprising 488 human-annotated field instances across 20 US state documents and 46 regulations. Each field instance includes a value and a provenance entry, yielding 976 entries in total. We define a typed, multi-field schema targeting key elements such as material definitions, permitted uses, and product exemptions, and propose provenance-aware evaluation metrics tailored to regulatory text. Through experiments with open- and closed-source LLMs across prompting strategies, document condensing methods, and schema partitioning approaches, we find that document identification fields remain challenging, and that field-specific few-shot examples improve extraction. This work lays the groundwork for AI tools for hazardous substance identification, question answering, and compliance monitoring. The code and data are available at https://github.com/IBM/PFAS-regulations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RegExtract，一个面向PFAS监管文件的结构化信息抽取基准，包含488个人工标注字段实例（976条含出处条目），并定义了类型化多字段schema及出处感知评测指标。
AI.motivation: 监管文件中关键事实分散于冗长且法律术语密集的文本里，抽取事实需可溯源以便核验；随着对PFAS环境与健康影响关注度上升，监管文件规模扩大且范围与产品相关性各异，给制造商和政策制定者带来解读困难。
AI.method: 构建RegExtract基准：覆盖20份美国州级文件与46项法规，488个人工标注字段实例，每条含值(value)与出处(provenance)。定义针对材料定义、允许用途、产品豁免等要素的类型化多字段schema，并提出面向监管文本的出处感知评测指标。实验涵盖开源与闭源LLM，比较不同提示策略、文档压缩方法与schema划分方式。
AI.result: 文档识别类字段仍具挑战性；字段特定的少样本示例可提升抽取效果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为有害物质识别、问答与合规监测的AI工具奠定基础，代码与数据已开源。

title: AegisVox: Factorized Privacy and Clinical Preservation for Long-Form Speech
summary: Clinical speech reveals identity through both spoken identifiers and voice, yet its pauses, delivery, and speaker roles can also carry useful clinical evidence. Protecting that speech therefore requires more than preserving its words. We present AegisVox, a factorized framework that assigns consistent surrogate voices and edits identifier-bearing turns using document-consistent replacements. Across 390 public simulated or non-patient conversations totaling 63.6 hours, a matched comparison of two speech renderers separates replacement realization from retained identifiers, speaker linkage, and clinical preservation. Text-to-speech rendering realizes 535/601 planned replacements versus 453/601 for the codec-based speech editor. However, similar aggregate clinical preservation conceals more model-labeled contradictions, and conversation-wide speaker scores conceal greater edited-speech linkage under a score-direction sensitivity analysis. Fresh transcription of original audio provides a reference for interpreting the clinical measurement chain; an independent judge tests sensitivity to model-based assessment. Better replacement realization can therefore coexist with worse clinical or speaker-linkage measurements. AegisVox supports use-specific evaluation of those tradeoffs, not a guarantee of identifier removal or clinical safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AegisVox框架，通过分配一致的替代音色并对含身份标识的对话轮次进行文档一致性替换，实现临床语音的去标识化，同时分离评估替换实现、标识残留、说话人关联与临床信息保留之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 临床语音不仅通过显性标识和音色泄露身份，其停顿、表达方式与说话人角色也承载临床证据，因此保护语音不能仅停留在保留文字层面；现有方法难以区分"替换是否实现"与"标识、说话人关联及临床信息是否真正保留"。
AI.method: 提出因子化框架AegisVox：为说话人分配一致的替代音色，并用文档一致的替换方案编辑含标识的对话轮次。在390段公开模拟或非患者对话（共63.6小时）上，对两种语音渲染器进行匹配对照实验，将替换实现与标识残留、说话人关联、临床信息保留分离开来评估。
AI.result: TTS渲染实现535/601次计划替换，基于编解码器的语音编辑器为453/601次。但相近的总体临床保留度掩盖了更多模型标注的矛盾样本；在评分方向敏感性分析下，全对话说话人评分掩盖了被编辑语音更强的说话人关联。对原始音频的新转录为解读临床测量链提供参照，独立评审测试了对模型化评估的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 更好的替换实现可能与更差的临床或说话人关联测量共存。AegisVox支持针对具体用途评估这些权衡，但不保证标识去除或临床安全。

title: SceneForesee: Learning Scene Evolution for Spatiotemporal Reasoning
summary: Large multimodal models (LMMs) need to understand how entities move and interact as a scene develops. This requires following the same entities over time and relating their observed motion to subsequent changes. We formulate Scene Evolution Understanding (SEU), a task for predicting and interpreting this change. Given observed video, a model estimates entity histories and predicts one scene continuation through future trajectories and Events, accompanied by Visual Evidence from observed motion and a scene description. We construct SceneForesee, a benchmark for evaluating entity continuity and scene evolution reasoning through paired observed and future scenes with shared entity identities. It contains 144.57K temporal pairs, 1.05M entity correspondences, and 272.49K Events paired with observed evidence. We propose a spatiotemporal reasoning framework, EvoSee, that learns future geometry and Event semantics through shared candidate states and joint assignment. It selects one continuation per entity from observation and uses the selected changes for entity refinement, retention, and scene representation. On SceneForesee, EvoSee outperforms Qwen3.5-9B by 10.45 points in Combined Point-F1 and 17.24 points in Event Global F1. On the 4D reasoning benchmark Dyn-Bench, it improves question answering accuracy and grounding J&F by 4.8 and 3.58 points over their respective base systems. These results support scene evolution as both a prediction target and a dynamic representation that brings predicted entity changes into spatiotemporal reasoning.The project is available at https://github.com/mikubaka88/SceneForesee-Spatiotemporal-Reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"场景演化理解(SEU)"任务，构建SceneForesee基准与EvoSee时空推理框架，在实体连续性预测和事件语义推理上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型需理解场景发展过程中实体的运动与交互，这要求跨时间跟踪同一实体并将其观测运动与后续变化关联，而现有任务与基准缺乏对这种"场景演化"能力的系统建模与评估。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为SEU任务：给定观测视频，模型估计实体历史，通过未来轨迹与Events预测一个场景延续，并附带来自观测运动的视觉证据与场景描述。构建SceneForesee基准（144.57K时序对、1.05M实体对应、272.49K Events及对应证据）。提出EvoSee框架，通过共享候选状态与联合分配学习未来几何与Event语义，为每个实体从观测中选取一个延续，并用所选变化进行实体精炼、保持与场景表示。
AI.result: 在SceneForesee上，EvoSee在Combined Point-F1上超过Qwen3.5-9B 10.45个点，在Event Global F1上超过17.24个点；在4D推理基准Dyn-Bench上，问答准确率与grounding J&F分别较各自基座系统提升4.8和3.58个点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明场景演化既可作为预测目标，也可作为动态表示，将预测的实体变化纳入时空推理，为LMM的场景理解提供了新范式。

title: Lumen-bench: Cross-Lingual Safety Gaps and the Say-Do Problem in Tool-Calling Large Language Models
summary: When a large language model refuses an unethical request, what does refusal mean? In conversation, refusal is bounded by what the model says; once the model is equipped with executable tools, what it does can diverge from what it says, a failure mode that English-only evaluations cannot fully reveal. We introduce Lumen-bench, a behavioral benchmark of tool-calling ethics spanning 30 models, five languages (Portuguese, English, Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, Hindi), 108 Portuguese-authored scenarios, six social-pressure conditions, two system prompts (ethical and neutral), and 21 generic tools. The evaluation comprises 194,400 trials. Judgments come from a reasoning-model judge (o4-mini), calibrated against one Portuguese-speaking author ($n=83$; harmful/non-harmful $κ=0.78$), compared with two other provider judges (Fleiss' $κ=0.78$, $n=607$), and complemented by retrospective sandbox replay. Four findings emerge. (i) Within-model comparisons support higher harmful-action rates in Hindi and Portuguese than English under the ethical prompt, and Hindi and Spanish under the neutral prompt, after multiple-testing correction. (ii) Premium models have lower median violation rates, although price does not guarantee safety or competence. (iii) Replacing the ethical system prompt with a neutral one raises pooled violation rates from 2.76\% to 13.64\%. (iv) In 8.57\% of substantive-call cases, refusal or ethical objection accompanies a harmful tool call: the judges consistently identify the say-do gap, although they differ in how many responses they assign to this category. Matched benign controls demonstrate legitimate task completion in 82.8\% of 3,300 trials. Code and reproduction scripts are available at https://github.com/TropicAI-Research/lumen.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Lumen-bench，一个跨语言、可执行工具调用的伦理行为基准，通过 30 个模型、5 种语言、194,400 次试验，揭示了模型"说"与"做"之间的伦理落差（say-do gap）。
AI.motivation: 在纯对话场景中，"拒绝"仅由模型的言语界定；但一旦模型配备可执行工具，"做"可能偏离"说"，这种失败模式是仅用英语评估无法充分揭示的。因此需要一个跨语言、涉及工具调用的伦理行为基准来检验模型的言行一致性。
AI.method: 构建 Lumen-bench 行为基准：覆盖 30 个模型、5 种语言（葡、英、西、中、印地）、108 个葡萄牙语作者撰写的场景、6 种社会压力条件、2 种系统提示（伦理型与中立型）、21 个通用工具，共 194,400 次试验。判定由推理模型裁判（o4-mini）完成，与一名葡语作者校准（n=83；有害/无害 κ=0.78），并与另外两个供应商裁判比对（Fleiss' κ=0.78, n=607），辅以回顾性沙箱回放。
AI.result: 四项发现：(i) 模型内比较显示，伦理提示下印地语和葡语的有害行动率高于英语，中立提示下印地语和西语高于英语（经多重检验校正）；(ii) 高端模型违规率中位数更低，但价格不保证安全或能力；(iii) 将伦理提示换成中立提示后，汇总违规率从 2.76% 升至 13.64%；(iv) 在 8.57% 的实质调用案例中，拒绝或伦理异议与有害工具调用并存，即"言行不一"；裁判对此类别识别一致但归类数量有差异。配套无害对照在 3,300 次试验中 82.8% 完成了合法任务。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言工具调用评估表明，模型的言语拒绝并不等同于行为拒绝，存在显著的"言行落差"，且该落差随语言和系统提示变化；仅英语评估会低估风险。Lumen-bench 提供了可复现的基准与脚本以供后续研究。

title: Shaping Latent Mixture-of-Experts: From Expert Geometry to Layerwise Capacity Allocation
summary: Fine-grained mixture-of-experts (MoE) models commonly increase expert count by narrowing each expert, treating expert shape as a by-product of routing granularity. LatentMoE moves expert computation into a lower-dimensional space, exposing the input dimension and intermediate width of each expert as explicit design choices. We show that an expert's local Jacobian rank is jointly bounded by these two dimensions, and that balancing them maximizes the rank ceiling at fixed per-expert parameters. Controlled shape sweeps across model scales and routing granularities consistently favor near-square experts. We further use layerwise intrinsic dimension (ID) to guide capacity allocation across depth, co-varying the number and shape of experts while keeping per-layer parameter count, activated FLOPs, and communication volume constant. Compared with layer-homogeneous baselines, our ID-guided allocation achieves lower validation loss and stronger downstream performance. These results establish expert shape and layerwise allocation as practical design axes for MoEs.

AI.tldr: 将专家计算迁移到低维空间后，专家形状（输入维度与中间宽度）成为显式设计变量；局部雅可比秩受二者共同约束，平衡二者可在固定参数量下最大化秩上限，实验一致偏好近方形专家。进一步用逐层内在维度引导容量分配，在参数量、激活FLOPs与通信量不变时取得更低验证损失与更强下游表现。
AI.motivation: 细粒度MoE通常通过"变窄专家"来增加专家数量，把专家形状视为路由粒度的副产物，缺乏对专家形状的显式设计考量。作者希望把专家形状与逐层容量分配提升为可控的设计轴。
AI.method: 提出LatentMoE，把专家计算移到低维潜空间，使每个专家的输入维度与中间宽度成为显式设计选择；用局部雅可比秩分析证明秩上限由这两个维度共同决定，并在固定单专家参数量下平衡二者以最大化秩上限。随后用逐层内在维度（ID）引导深度方向上的容量分配，协同调整专家数量与形状，同时保持每层参数量、激活FLOPs和通信量不变。
AI.result: 在不同模型规模与路由粒度下的受控形状扫描一致偏好近方形专家；相比逐层同质基线，ID引导的分配方案在验证损失上更低，下游任务表现更强。
AI.conclusion: 专家形状与逐层容量分配可作为MoE实践中有效的设计轴，维度平衡的近方形专家与ID引导的异质分配能提升模型效率与性能。

title: FreeCHROMA: Generative Chroma Keying from Unaligned Background References
summary: In film production, chroma keying composites an approved foreground performance into a new environment, but conventional workflows require coordinated background plates and dedicated harmonization. Recent generative methods often require pre-aligned backgrounds, focus on background-conditioned foreground relighting, or represent the environment only through an edited first frame. These restrictions limit background selection, scene composition, and camera motion while adding preparation or editing effort. We present FreeCHROMA, which adapts a pretrained video diffusion model in a parameter-efficient manner for generative video compositing from one to three unaligned background references. The model integrates the foreground into the referenced environment, preserving foreground identity, motion, and fine visual details while generating a spatiotemporally coherent background. Foreground-background harmonization occurs within the same generation process, without a separate relighting stage. Optional text instructions help disambiguate complex spatial relationships and camera behavior. To train the model, we construct pseudo-paired data from readily available real monocular videos through foreground-background separation and augmentation with existing foundation models. The original videos serve as training targets, while automated processing and quality verification enable scalable data construction. Across reference fidelity, foreground preservation, scene integration, harmonization, and overall video quality, FreeCHROMA consistently outperforms recent compositing and conditional video-generation baselines, with particularly clear gains under camera motion. FreeCHROMA relaxes the constraints of existing tools to enable end-to-end generative chroma keying from unaligned inputs, with exploratory experiments demonstrating its potential in robotics.

AI.tldr: FreeCHROMA 提出一种参数高效的视频扩散模型适配方法，可直接从1至3张未对齐的背景参考图实现端到端的生成式视频抠像合成，在同一生成过程中完成前景-背景协调。
AI.motivation: 传统抠像合成需协调的背景板与专门的协调（relighting）处理；现有生成方法多要求预对齐背景、仅做背景条件下的前景重打光，或只用编辑后的首帧表示环境，限制了背景选择、场景构图与相机运动，并增加准备/编辑成本。
AI.method: 以参数高效方式适配预训练视频扩散模型，输入为1至3张未对齐背景参考；将前景融入参考环境，同时保持前景身份、运动与细节并生成时空一致的背景；协调过程内嵌于同一次生成，无需独立重打光阶段；可选文本指令用于消歧复杂空间关系与相机行为。训练数据通过对真实单目视频做前景-背景分离与基础模型增强来构造伪配对数据，原始视频作为训练目标，配合自动化处理与质量验证实现可扩展构建。
AI.result: 在参考保真度、前景保持、场景融合、协调性及整体视频质量等维度，FreeCHROMA 持续优于近期合成与条件视频生成基线，在相机运动条件下提升尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: FreeCHROMA 放宽了现有工具的约束，实现从未对齐输入的端到端生成式色键合成，探索性实验还显示其在机器人领域的潜力。

title: Where Did We Go Wrong? Localizing Errors to Repair Multi-Turn Conversations
summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants are increasingly used in multi-turn conversations, where the user's intent is often unclear at first and revealed only gradually over time. The assistant must therefore interpret each exchange and form inferences about the user's intent, using them to update its working state. These updates usually refine the assistant's understanding, but a misinterpretation can instead corrupt its working state by ruling out the true intent, influencing subsequent turns and ultimately causing the conversation to fail. Efficient recovery then requires locating and revising the misinterpretation without discarding information that remains valid. We introduce Loci (Localization Of Corrupted Inferences), a framework for probabilistically localizing misinterpretations and selectively repairing the assistant's working state. Given an observed failure, Loci reasons over possible user intents and assigns each update a probability of having excluded the true intent. These probabilities rank suspected updates and quantify the model's confidence in the localization of the underlying misinterpretations. Loci then uses this information in a repair policy that decides whether to retain, verify, or remove suspected updates, enabling recovery from corrupted inferences while preserving useful information. To evaluate Loci's ability to identify misinterpretations, we first test it in a controlled setup with injected errors. We find that Loci improves localization over the baselines, with its advantage becoming larger when multiple errors occur. We then evaluate it in free-form conversations, where misinterpretations arise naturally, and measure the interactions needed to complete the task after an initial failure. Using localization confidence to guide repair, Loci reduces mean recovery cost by 46-79% relative to the strongest baseline across multiple domains.

AI.tldr: 提出 Loci 框架，通过概率化定位多轮对话中导致状态损坏的误解性推断，并选择性修复工作状态，从而在失败后高效恢复。
AI.motivation: 多轮对话中用户意图常逐步显现，助手需不断更新工作状态；一次误解可能排除真实意图、污染状态并导致对话失败，而恢复需在不丢失有效信息的前提下定位并修正该误解。
AI.method: Loci 在观测到失败后，对可能的用户意图进行推理，为每次状态更新赋予"排除了真实意图"的概率；据此对可疑更新排序并给出定位置信度，再通过修复策略决定保留、验证或移除可疑更新。
AI.result: 在注入错误的受控设定中，Loci 的定位效果优于基线，且错误越多优势越明显；在误解自然产生的自由对话中，以定位置信度指导修复，相较最强基线将平均恢复成本降低 46–79%。
AI.conclusion: 概率化定位与选择性修复可有效纠正被污染的推断，在保留有效信息的同时显著降低多轮对话失败后的恢复代价。

title: RASSG: Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating for Streaming Tool Execution
