summary: Streaming speech assistants can launch tools before users finish speaking, overlapping execution with incoming speech to reduce user waiting time. However, subsequent self-corrections can invalidate apparently stable arguments, causing stale execution whose irreversible effects persist even after the final call is corrected. We propose Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating (RASSG) to jointly control tool launch and cancellation during streaming speech. RASSG launches a tool when three consecutive speech recognition results arrive with identical nonempty arguments, then combines calibrated argument invalidity risk with execution costs to decide cancellation at the last feasible opportunity before effects become irreversible. Evaluation on ReCAST, FDB-v3, and Audio2Tool uses a controlled execution clock with fixed tool runtimes and cancellation parameters. On ReCAST's prospective-repair subset, RASSG reduces the stale execution rate from LocalAgreement-2's 50.00% to 3.15%, with a mean delay of 3.676s across successful trajectories. The stale reduction also holds against every early-execution baseline on both public speech datasets. Ablations with identical initial launches support active cancellation, showing the value of controlling ongoing calls before their effects become irreversible. Code and data are available at https://github.com/daijinhu/RASSG.

AI.tldr: 提出RASSG框架，通过三帧一致启动与风险-成本联合判据在效果不可逆前取消工具调用，将流式语音助手的过期执行率从50.00%降至3.15%。
AI.motivation: 流式语音助手可在用户未说完时提前启动工具，以重叠执行减少等待；但用户随后的自我纠正会使看似稳定的参数失效，导致过期执行，且其不可逆效果在最终调用被纠正后仍然持续。因此需要同时控制工具启动与取消。
AI.method: 提出Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating（RASSG）：当连续三次语音识别结果具有相同非空参数时启动工具；随后结合校准后的参数失效风险与执行成本，在效果变为不可逆前的最后一个可行时机决定是否取消。评估采用固定工具运行时与取消参数的受控执行时钟，在ReCAST、FDB-v3与Audio2Tool上进行。
AI.result: 在ReCAST的prospective-repair子集上，RASSG将过期执行率从LocalAgreement-2的50.00%降至3.15%，成功轨迹平均延迟3.676s；在两个公开语音数据集上，相对所有早执行基线均保持过期率下降。相同初始启动条件下的消融实验支持主动取消的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 在效果不可逆前对进行中的调用进行主动取消具有明确价值，RASSG的启动门控与取消决策联合设计能显著抑制流式语音助手因自我纠正引发的过期执行。

title: DSR-Net: Learning Dynamic Skeletal Relations for 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: 3D human pose estimation requires accurate modeling of motion-dependent skeletal structures and inter-joint dependencies. Existing methods typically rely on fixed skeletal topologies in Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) or implicitly capture joint relations through attention mechanisms, limiting their adaptability to diverse motion patterns. To address this issue,we proposeDSR-Net, a dynamic structural representation learning framework for 3D human pose estimation. Specifically, a Dynamic Skeletal Relation (DSR) module is introduced to learn adaptive inter-joint dependencies beyond predefined skeletal connections. Based on the learned relations, a hierarchical relation-aware fusion strategy is developed to facilitate effective interaction between structural and temporal representations. In addition, a lightweight Residual Skeletal Recalibration Module (RSRM) is designed to enhance the stability of structure-aware features with minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on Human3.6M and MPI-INF-3DHP demonstrate that DSR-Net achieves MPJPEs of 37.9 mm and 14.9 mm, respectively, consistently improving over strong baselines. The results validate the effectiveness of dynamic skeletal relation modeling for robust 3D human pose estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出DSR-Net框架，通过动态骨骼关系建模实现自适应关节依赖学习，在Human3.6M和MPI-INF-3DHP上分别达到37.9mm和14.9mm的MPJPE。
AI.motivation: 现有3D人体姿态估计方法多依赖GCN中固定骨骼拓扑或通过注意力隐式捕捉关节关系，对多样化运动模式适应性不足。
AI.method: 引入动态骨骼关系（DSR）模块学习超越预定义骨骼连接的自适应关节依赖；基于学习到的关系设计分层关系感知融合策略，促进结构与时间表征交互；并提出轻量级残差骨骼重校准模块（RSRM）以低计算开销增强结构感知特征稳定性。
AI.result: 在Human3.6M和MPI-INF-3DHP数据集上，MPJPE分别达到37.9mm和14.9mm，持续优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了动态骨骼关系建模对鲁棒3D人体姿态估计的有效性。

title: Learning Proposition-Level Links from Sentence-Level Supervision for Neuro-Symbolic NLI
summary: We study neuro-symbolic natural language inference (NLI) with independently translated propositional representations of the premise and hypothesis. Before symbolic reasoning, the system must infer semantic links between their proposition-level units (atoms). Existing systems based on Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) and Boolean satisfiability (SAT) identify these links using fixed embedding-based source selection and pretrained sentence-level NLI models not trained for atom-level linking. We introduce a trainable atom linker that jointly predicts link existence, source selection, and relation type. Without atom-pair training annotations, we treat cross-formula link structures as latent and train the linker from sentence-level NLI labels, keeping the translator and SAT reasoner fixed. We evaluate on the full public test splits of Stanford Natural Language Inference (SNLI) and Sentences Involving Compositional Knowledge (SICK), and the matched and mismatched validation splits of Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference (MNLI). Our system improves accuracy by 11.40-27.09 percentage points over a baseline applying sentence-trained NLI models unchanged to atom pairs within the same SAT pipeline. It also improves over the prior fixed-linker AMR-to-SAT system by 8.14-26.32 percentage points on SNLI and both MNLI splits, with a smaller gain on SICK.

AI.tldr: 提出可训练的原子链接器，将跨公式链接结构视为隐变量，从句子级NLI标签训练，在SNLI、SICK、MNLI上较固定链接器与句子级NLI基线显著提升。
AI.motivation: 神经符号NLI中，前提与假设经独立翻译得到命题级表示，符号推理前需推断原子间语义链接。现有基于AMR与SAT的系统用固定嵌入源选择和未针对原子级训练的句子级NLI模型来识别链接，性能受限。
AI.method: 设计可训练的原子链接器，联合预测链接是否存在、源选择与关系类型；在无原子对标注情况下，将跨公式链接结构视为隐变量，用句子级NLI标签训练链接器，翻译器与SAT推理器保持固定。
AI.result: 在SNLI、SICK完整公开测试集及MNLI匹配/不匹配验证集上评测：较把句子训练NLI模型原样用于原子对的同管线基线提升11.40–27.09个百分点；较先前固定链接器AMR-to-SAT系统在SNLI与两个MNLI划分上提升8.14–26.32个百分点，SICK提升较小。
AI.conclusion: 以隐变量方式端到端训练原子链接器可有效改进AMR-to-SAT神经符号NLI流程，且无需原子对级标注。

title: A Hybrid Kinematic GCN and Elastic Transformer for Efficient Indian Sign Language Recognition
summary: Sign Language Recognition (SLR) presents complex challenges due to variable signing speeds and spatial intricacies. Specifically, Indian Sign Language (ISL) requires precise modeling of its inherently bimanual nature and is bottlenecked by the scarcity of large-vocabulary benchmarks and the inability of standard models to handle irregular signing velocities. To address this, a structurally-aware hybrid framework for efficient, gloss ISL recognition is proposed. To minimize computational redundancy, an entropy-driven SVD sampler that dynamically extracts informative keyframes is used. Because this subsampling creates irregular physical time gaps, the proposed architecture employs a Continuous Dual Positional Encoding paired with a distance-aware Elastic Transformer to preserve natural signing rhythm. Spatially, a Kinematically-Conditioned Adaptive GCN explicitly models bimanual geometry using unified bone-joint features. To validate our framework, a 120-class, 9,453-video native ISL dataset is created. Augmented by Physical Node Dropout and ArcFace optimization to mitigate subject-specific memorization, our framework achieves a competitive 89.8% accuracy, establishing a strong baseline for complex sign language modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出面向印度手语（ISL）的结构感知混合框架：熵驱动SVD采样器提取关键帧，连续双位置编码+距离感知弹性Transformer处理不规则时间间隔，运动学条件自适应GCN建模双手几何，并构建120类9,453视频数据集，达到89.8%准确率。
AI.motivation: ISL识别面临签名速度多变与空间结构复杂的挑战；其固有双手特性需精细建模，同时受限于大词表基准数据稀缺，且标准模型难以处理不规则签名速度。现有方法在计算冗余与时空建模上均存在瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 熵驱动SVD采样器动态提取信息量大的关键帧以降低计算冗余；2) 针对子采样造成的物理时间间隔不规则，采用连续双位置编码（Continuous Dual Positional Encoding）与距离感知弹性Transformer（distance-aware Elastic Transformer）保留签名节奏；3) 空间上使用运动学条件自适应GCN（Kinematically-Conditioned Adaptive GCN），以统一的骨-关节点特征显式建模双手几何；4) 引入Physical Node Dropout与ArcFace优化缓解受试者特异性记忆。
AI.result: 构建了120类、9,453个视频的母语ISL数据集；框架在该基准上取得89.8%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该结构感知混合框架为复杂手语建模建立了强基线，验证了关键帧采样、弹性时间建模与运动学条件图卷积相结合在词汇级ISL识别中的有效性。

title: Spatiotemporal Recognition of Abdominal Wall Layers During Optical Trocar Entry
summary: Objective. To evaluate whether spatial context and temporal modeling improve tissue recognition during optical trocar entry, where multiple abdominal-wall tissues may be visible simultaneously. Methods. We retrospectively analyzed 71 recordings with 1,516 annotated keyframes and 29,151 clinician-annotated sectors. Each frame was divided into 28 polar-grid sectors assigned to nine tissue classes. Color, neighboring-sector, and positional features were used by a gradient-boosted emission classifier. The full pipeline added learned temporal smoothing, spatial regularization, an anatomically ordered hidden Markov model, and posterior blending. Five-fold cross-validation was grouped by recording, with cross-fitting to prevent within-recording leakage. Primary evaluation used clinician-derived targets; ablations assessed classification, probability quality, spatial consistency, and peritoneum-or-deeper onset timing. Results. The complete pipeline achieved accuracy 0.646, macro-F1 0.507, and macro-AUROC 0.882, versus 0.600, 0.440, and 0.861 for emissions alone. Macro-F1 improved by 0.066 across all five folds. Label changes decreased from 66.2 to 19.5 per sector-minute, and median onset error decreased from 15.58 to 2.45 seconds. Frames with a tissue-depth-code span of at least three decreased from 53% to 26%, versus 22% for clinician annotations. Performance remained limited for preperitoneal fat and bowel, and the full model retained a 44% premature-onset proportion. Conclusions. Combining appearance, spatial context, and temporal constraints improved retrospective tissue recognition and onset localization. Tissue-specific limitations, residual timing errors, and reliance on future observations warrant external validation and prospective evaluation of causal models before clinical use.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了融合外观、空间上下文与时间约束的分层管道（梯度提升发射分类器＋时间平滑＋空间正则＋隐马尔可夫模型＋后验融合），用于光学套管针进入过程中腹壁组织的识别与腹膜起始定位。
AI.motivation: 光学套管针进入时多类腹壁组织可能同时可见，仅凭单帧外观特征难以准确识别组织并判定"腹膜或更深层"的起始时机，因此需要评估空间上下文与时间建模能否提升识别性能。
AI.method: 回顾性分析71段录像，含1,516个标注关键帧与29,151个临床医生标注扇区；每帧划分为28个极坐标网格扇区，归入9类组织。发射分类器采用梯度提升，输入颜色、邻域扇区与位置特征。完整管道叠加学习式时间平滑、空间正则化、解剖有序隐马尔可夫模型与后验混合。采用按录像分组的五折交叉验证，并以cross-fitting防止录像内泄漏。主要评估基于临床医生标注目标，消融实验考察分类、概率质量、空间一致性与腹膜起始时机。
AI.result: 完整管道准确率0.646、macro-F1 0.507、macro-AUROC 0.882，而仅用发射模型为0.600、0.440、0.861；macro-F1在五折中均提升0.066。标签跳变由每扇区分钟66.2降至19.5，起始中位误差由15.58 s降至2.45 s。组织深度编码跨度≥3的帧比例由53%降至26%（临床医生标注为22%）。腹膜前脂肪与肠管识别仍受限，完整模型仍保留44%的过早起始比例。
AI.conclusion: 结合外观、空间上下文与时间约束可改善回顾性组织识别与起始定位；但存在组织特异性局限、残余时间误差及对未来观测的依赖，临床应用前需开展外部验证与因果模型的前瞻性评估。

title: Sanzaru: Benchmarking Protocol Formation under Epistemic & Communication Asymmetry
summary: A language model's ability to solve a task individually does not ensure that a team can solve it under unequal access to information and communication. SANZARU examines this gap through cooperative bomb-defusal puzzles adapted from BOMBANANA! (Lefto Studio, 2026). Task information and action authority are divided among three agents: one cannot hear, another cannot speak, and the third cannot see. The benchmark contains 120 puzzle instances across seven families, each targeting a distinct coordination ability. Across 1512 episodes, 7 models achieve an overall success rate of 49%, ranging from 20% to 86% under the evaluated configurations. Teams develop or adopt diverse communication protocols, from simple gesture codes to Morse and encodings of entire manuals. Yet trace analysis attributes about 60% of 771 team losses to communication, and agents attempt to use channels unavailable to their teammates despite explicit role instructions. Together, task outcomes and interaction traces enable evaluation of both collaborative performance and perspective taking throughout cooperation. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/markli404/sanzaru-benchmark.

AI.tldr: SANZARU 是一个考察语言模型在不平等信息与通信条件下协作能力的基准，基于拆弹合作谜题构建，包含 120 个谜题、7 个族系，由三名存在感官缺陷的智能体协作完成。
AI.motivation: 语言模型单独解题的能力并不能保证团队在不平等信息获取与通信条件下也能成功解题，该研究旨在填补这一评估空白，考察协作表现与视角采择能力。
AI.method: 将任务信息与行动权限在三名智能体间分配：一人不能听、一人不能说、一人不能看；基准含 120 个谜题实例，分为 7 个族系，每个族系针对一种独特的协作能力；共运行 1512 个回合，评估 7 个模型。
AI.result: 7 个模型总体成功率为 49%，在评估配置下介于 20% 至 86% 之间；团队发展或采用了多样化的通信协议，从简单手势编码到摩尔斯电码及整本手册的编码。轨迹分析显示，771 次团队失败中约 60% 可归因于通信问题，且智能体尽管收到明确的角色指令，仍会尝试使用队友无法使用的信道。
AI.conclusion: 任务结果与交互轨迹共同支持对协作过程中的协作表现与视角采择进行评估；基准已开源于 https://github.com/markli404/sanzaru-benchmark。

title: AcrossVAM2.0: Conflict-Aware Point Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Video Diffusion Adaptation
summary: Explicit point correspondence is attractive for adapting video generators: it describes how visible surfaces move, but can overwrite the appearance prior learned by a large pretrained model. We study this tension in a 5.01B-parameter text-to-video diffusion transformer. ACROSSVAM2.0 combines a confidence-weighted track-and-visibility head, zero-initialized residual feedback, and asymmetric PCGrad that removes only the auxiliary component opposing the primary flow-matching gradient on shared LoRA parameters. The design preserves the generator exactly at initialization and protects its primary update during adaptation. In a four-way ablation trained for 1,000 steps with three independent seeds, the full method lowers KLT forward-backward cycle error in all three seeds relative to a matched flow-only continuation (mean seed-level difference -0.00711, SD 0.00505), while robust sharpness remains positive in all three. An expanded 24-prompt evaluation (216 videos) yields 9.7% lower aggregate CoTracker3 cycle error than the matched control and near-matched performance on six VBench dimensions; however, the seed-level tracking effect is heterogeneous and I3D-FVD regresses from 0.1824 to 0.2022. These results support a bounded claim: conflict-aware adaptation improves correspondence consistency without broad perceptual degradation, but does not uniformly improve video quality. We release equations, pseudocode, matched outputs, source tables, and artifact provenance.

AI.tldr: 本文在5.01B参数的文本到视频扩散transformer上研究显式点对应线索与预训练外观先验之间的张力，提出ACROSSVAM2.0，通过置信度加权跟踪-可见性头、零初始化残差反馈和非对称PCGrad实现冲突感知适配，在保持生成质量的前提下提升对应一致性。
AI.motivation: 显式点对应能描述可见表面的运动方式，有利于视频生成器的适配，但可能覆盖大规模预训练模型已学到的外观先验，二者存在张力。作者希望在不破坏生成器原有能力的前提下引入对应监督。
AI.method: ACROSSVAM2.0包含三个组件：置信度加权的track-and-visibility头、零初始化残差反馈，以及非对称PCGrad——仅在共享LoRA参数上移除与主flow-matching梯度方向相反的辅助分量。该设计保证初始化时生成器完全不变，并在适配过程中保护主更新。采用四路消融，训练1000步、3个独立随机种子。
AI.result: 完整方法在全部3个种子上降低KLT前后向循环误差（种子级平均差-0.00711，SD 0.00505），robust sharpness在3个种子均为正；24提示、216视频的扩展评估中，CoTracker3聚合循环误差较匹配对照降低9.7%，六个VBench维度接近匹配。但种子级跟踪效果异质，I3D-FVD从0.1824退化到0.2022。
AI.conclusion: 冲突感知适配可在不造成广泛感知退化的前提下提升对应一致性，但并不能一致地改善视频质量，属于有界结论。作者公开公式、伪代码、匹配输出、源表和工件溯源信息。

title: TartanMatch: Towards Universal Dense Correspondence Across Modalities
summary: Robotic platforms combine multi-modal sensors to operate across diverse conditions, but most dense correspondence methods are limited to RGB-RGB or a small set of modality pairs. Training a model for each modality pair scales poorly with the number of sensors and forgoes potential positive transfer across modality pairs. We introduce TartanMatch, a unified model for dense correspondence across all 25 ordered pairs among RGB, event, thermal, depth, and projected LiDAR. TartanMatch adapts an RGB-pretrained correspondence model to all modality pairs within one shared network using lightweight modality adaptation and a mixture of real and synthetic data. On zero-shot real-world benchmarks, TartanMatch reduces Endpoint Error (EPE) over the strongest baselines by 61.9% for cross-modal matching and 49.6% for same-modal matching. We further show that joint training across all modality pairs improves average matching accuracy over pair-specific training, especially on challenging cross-modal pairs. These results demonstrate that a single model achieves broad multi-modal coverage and state-of-the-art matching accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 TartanMatch，一个统一模型实现 RGB、事件、热成像、深度、投影 LiDAR 五模态全部 25 个有序模态对的稠密对应，零样本基准上显著优于最强基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人平台集成多模态传感器以适应多样环境，但现有稠密对应方法多局限于 RGB-RGB 或少数模态对；为每个模态对单独训练模型随传感器数量增长难以扩展，且放弃了模态对之间的正向迁移。
AI.method: TartanMatch 将 RGB 预训练的对应模型适配到所有模态对，共享单一网络：采用轻量级模态适配，并混合真实与合成数据进行训练。
AI.result: 在零样本真实世界基准上，跨模态匹配的端点误差（EPE）较最强基线降低 61.9%，同模态匹配降低 49.6%；联合训练所有模态对相比按对单独训练提升了平均匹配精度，在困难跨模态对上尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 单一模型即可实现广泛的多模态覆盖并达到最先进的匹配精度，验证了统一稠密对应模型跨模态联合训练的可行性与优势。

title: Active Learning for Finding a Needle in a Haystack
summary: Training a classifier to find a rare class of documents, such as hate speech directed at a particular religious group, requires labelled examples that are expensive to obtain when the class makes up only a small fraction of a corpus. Active learning reduces this cost, but it must start from an initial labelled set that contains examples of the target class. Random sampling cannot supply these at reasonable cost, so they must be selected in some other way, such as keyword search, and any such selection biases the initial set towards part of the target class. We evaluate whether active learning can correct this bias. On AG News and Measuring Hate Speech, at a prevalence of around 1%, we compare random sampling with eight active learning strategies, starting from initial sets that cover or omit known subgroups of the target class, and measure recall on the omitted subgroups as well as F1. On AG News, almost every strategy recovers the omitted subgroup. On Measuring Hate Speech, uncertainty-based strategies recover less of the omitted subgroups than random sampling, whereas discriminative active learning recovers 55% of them without a significant loss of F1. Aggregate metrics conceal these differences.

AI.tldr: 本文评估主动学习能否纠正初始标注集因关键词检索等方式引入的子群偏置。在1%流行率的AG News与Measuring Hate Speech上比较随机采样与八种主动学习策略，结果显示AG News上几乎都能恢复被遗漏子群，而Measuring Hate Speech上不确定性策略恢复更差，判别式主动学习可恢复55%且F1无显著损失。
AI.motivation: 稀有类（如针对特定宗教群体的仇恨言论）标注成本高昂，主动学习虽能降低成本，但需从含目标类的初始标注集出发；随机采样难以低成本获得，故常用关键词搜索等选择，而这会使初始集偏向目标类的部分子群。作者因此要检验主动学习能否纠正该偏置。
AI.method: 在AG News和Measuring Hate Speech两个数据集上，以约1%的流行率，比较随机采样与八种主动学习策略；初始标注集分别覆盖或遗漏目标类的已知子群；评估指标为被遗漏子群的召回率以及整体F1。
AI.result: AG News上几乎所有策略都能恢复被遗漏子群；Measuring Hate Speech上，基于不确定性的策略对被遗漏子群的恢复不如随机采样，而判别式主动学习可恢复其中55%且F1无显著下降。聚合指标掩盖了这些差异。
AI.conclusion: 主动学习纠正初始子群偏置的效果依赖于策略与数据集：不确定性策略可能反而劣于随机采样，判别式主动学习较优；应报告子群级指标而非仅看聚合指标。

title: Joint Discrete and SE(3) Diffusion for Protein Interface Design
summary: The design of high-affinity, target-specific protein binders is central to the development of modern therapeutics. However, existing protein-generation methods remain limited in this setting, as many generated designs fail to simultaneously achieve geometric and physicochemical complementarity at binding interfaces. To address this challenge, we introduce PIDiff, a physicochemically enhanced multimodal diffusion framework for protein-protein complex design. PIDiff jointly designs target-conditioned protein sequences and structures by coupling diffusion in discrete sequence space with diffusion on the continuous (SE(3)) structural manifold. At its core, PIDiff employs PIFormer, a novel architecture that interleaves geometry-aware invariant point attention with global sequence self-attention. We further curate PIBench, a protein-protein complex dataset with diverse target scaffolds derived from the Protein Data Bank (PDB). We first pretrain PIDiff on PIBench and subsequently fine-tune it for two therapeutically relevant applications: minibinder design and antibody design. PPFrame consistently outperforms baseline methods across sequence design success rate, structure binding energy, and sequence-structure co-designability on all tasks.

AI.tldr: PIDiff是一个物理化学增强的多模态扩散框架，联合设计靶标条件蛋白序列与结构，在微结合蛋白和抗体设计任务上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 高亲和力、靶标特异性蛋白结合剂设计是现代疗法的核心，但现有生成方法难以在结合界面同时实现几何与物理化学互补性。
AI.method: 提出PIDiff，将离散序列空间扩散与连续SE(3)结构流形扩散耦合，联合设计序列与结构；核心架构PIFormer交替使用几何感知不变点注意力与全局序列自注意力；构建PIBench数据集（来自PDB的多样靶标支架），先预训练再针对微结合蛋白与抗体设计微调。
AI.result: 在所有任务上，PPFrame在序列设计成功率、结构结合能和序列-结构协同设计性方面一致优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: PIDiff通过多模态扩散与物理化学增强架构，有效提升蛋白结合剂设计的界面互补性与综合性能，适用于治疗相关应用。

title: Compositional Concepts Erasing: Disentangling Object-Style via Domain Manifold Unlearning
summary: Diffusion models pose significant risks regarding the generation of illicit content and copyright violations. This has catalyzed the development of machine unlearning to erase harmful concepts or copyrighted styles from a model's generative repertoire without compromising its general performance. However, previous unlearning approaches on diffusion models have largely focused on either object-level or style-level removal and failed to address the challenge of object-style combination unlearning. At the same time, multiple unlearning requests often lead to catastrophic forgetting. To address these challenges, we propose Domain Manifold Unlearning (DMU), which uses an EMA-updated feature proxy extracted from intermediate diffusion features to represent the retained target-object direction. As a lightweight estimating representation of an object, DMU enables selective unlearning of domain-specific components in a specific object while preserving other semantic representations, thereby significantly enhancing robustness in multiple combination unlearning scenarios. Extensive experiments show that DMU significantly mitigates catastrophic forgetting, outperforming state-of-the-art methods of batch unlearning and sequential unlearning.

AI.tldr: 提出Domain Manifold Unlearning (DMU)，用EMA更新的特征代理表征保留的目标物体方向，实现扩散模型中物体-风格组合的定向遗忘，缓解多请求下的灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型存在生成非法内容与侵犯版权等风险，需要机器遗忘技术在不损害通用生成能力的前提下抹除有害概念或受版权保护的风格。但已有工作多局限于物体级或风格级单一维度的遗忘，未能处理物体-风格组合遗忘问题；同时面对多个遗忘请求时容易出现灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: DMU从扩散模型的中间特征中提取一个经EMA更新的特征代理（feature proxy），用以表示被保留的目标物体方向。作为物体的轻量级估计表示，该代理支持对特定物体中领域相关成分进行选择性遗忘，同时保留其他语义表征，从而提升多组合遗忘场景的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DMU显著缓解了灾难性遗忘，在批量遗忘（batch unlearning）与顺序遗忘（sequential unlearning）两类设定下均优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: DMU通过特征代理驱动的选择性领域流形遗忘，填补了物体-风格组合遗忘的空白，并在多请求遗忘场景中有效抑制灾难性遗忘，为扩散模型的安全可控生成提供了新的遗忘范式。

title: UDHRBench: Benchmarking Human Rights in Large Language Models
comment: Alak Raad and Noreldin Morssy contributed equally to this work
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in contexts requiring adherence to ethical and legal norms, yet their alignment with internationally recognized human rights standards remains underexplored. We introduce UDHRBench, a large-scale benchmark for operationalising the evaluation of large language model compliance with the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. The dataset comprises 1,124 human rights confronting questions covering all 30 articles and 4,496 responses from four large language models (ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, and Fanar), manually annotated by experts for alignment, with high inter-annotator agreement ($κ= 0.801$). Our analysis reveals systematic and non-trivial misalignments, showing that violations typically arise through seemingly rational reasoning: appeals to efficiency, risk management, or scientific neutrality, rather than explicit rejection of rights. We further propose an LLM-as-a-Judge framework for automated evaluation using zero-shot and few-shot prompting, achieving 89.8\% weighted F1-score in detecting human-rights misalignment, alongside a novel Alignment Leniency Score that quantifies how judge models resolve ambiguous cases. The dataset, annotations, and code will be released as open-source resources (https://sina.birzeit.edu/UDHRBench).

AI.tldr: 提出UDHRBench基准，用1,124个涉及《世界人权宣言》全部30条条款的问题及4,496条人工标注回答，系统评估四个大语言模型的人权对齐情况，并构建LLM-as-a-Judge自动评测框架。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益被部署于需遵循伦理与法律规范的场景，但其与国际公认人权标准的对齐程度仍缺乏系统研究，现有评估缺少可操作、可量化的基准。
AI.method: 构建UDHRBench：覆盖《世界人权宣言》全部30条条款的1,124个人权对抗性问题，收集ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini、Fanar四个模型的4,496条回答，由专家进行对齐性人工标注（标注者间一致性κ=0.801）；并提出基于零样本与少样本提示的LLM-as-a-Judge自动评测框架，以及量化裁判模型处理模糊案例倾向的Alignment Leniency Score。
AI.result: 分析发现模型存在系统性且非轻微的对齐偏差，违规多源于看似理性的推理（如诉诸效率、风险管理或科学中立），而非显式否认人权；LLM-as-a-Judge在检测人权偏差上达到89.8%加权F1分数。
AI.conclusion: UDHRBench为人权对齐提供了可操作的评估基准，揭示了大模型隐性偏差机制，所提自动评测框架具备较高可靠性，数据集、标注与代码将以开源形式发布。

title: DSABench: Benchmarking Source Discovery, Coordination, and Execution for Multi-Database Agents
summary: Most text-to-SQL benchmarks provide the target database. In a large data catalog, however, choosing the sources is part of the problem: an agent must find every database needed for a request, determine how their results fit together, and execute the resulting workflow. We present DSABench to evaluate these capabilities jointly. Its 815 human-reviewed tasks draw on Spider, BIRD, and LiveSQLBench; 618 require several databases to contribute, and 105 allow more than one interpretation of the required sources. Executable contracts define source participation, cross-source dependencies, and source-local execution, while RouteEnv lets agents inspect public catalog evidence without revealing the gold annotations. In our routing-only study across seven model backends, the highest RA-Set score is 60.55%, compared with a highest RA-Graph score of 34.66% when coordination requirements are included. The gap becomes more pronounced when execution is required. Across four backends, median non-privileged Route+Exec-Graph success ranges from 6.69% to 7.98% without clarification and from 11.44% to 13.25% with one clarification; the best observed clarified configuration reaches 16.99%. On ambiguous tasks, clarification improves exact branch-source recovery by 39.8-43.2 percentage points. These findings illustrate why retrieving plausible databases or producing correct local SQL is not enough: an agent must carry the right information through the entire multi-database workflow.

AI.tldr: DSABench是一个评估多数据库路由与执行联合能力的文本到SQL基准，包含815个经人工审核的任务，实验显示智能体在跨库协调与执行环节表现显著下降。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到SQL基准大多直接提供目标数据库，忽略了在大型数据目录中智能体自主寻找所需数据库、判断结果如何整合并执行工作流这一核心问题，缺少对多数据库路由与执行能力的联合评估。
AI.method: 构建DSABench基准，任务来自Spider、BIRD和LiveSQLBench，共815个人工审核任务，其中618个需多数据库参与，105个存在多种源解释；用可执行契约定义源参与、跨源依赖和源本地执行，并通过RouteEnv让智能体在不暴露金标注的情况下检查公开目录证据；开展仅路由研究（7个模型后端）以及路由+图执行研究（4个后端），并测试澄清问题的影响。
AI.result: 仅路由任务中最高RA-Set得分为60.55%，加入协调要求后最高RA-Graph得分为34.66%；需执行时差距更明显，非特权Route+Exec-Graph成功率中位数为6.69%-7.98%，加入一次澄清后为11.44%-13.25%，最佳澄清配置达16.99%；歧义任务上澄清使精确分支源恢复率提升39.8-43.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 检索到看似合理的数据库或生成正确的本地SQL并不足够，智能体必须在整个多数据库工作流中正确传递信息，DSABench揭示了当前模型在跨库协调与执行上的显著不足。

title: We Have Been Interpreting Diffusion Transformer Backbone Behaviors Wrong
summary: During a network forward call, diffusion backbones naturally produce many intermediate activations. If we evaluate each activation against an identical downstream benchmarking protocol, we can plot an inverted-U-shaped curve as the depth profile: the activation's performance goes up first and then down as we go into deeper layers. This is common knowledge in the diffusion model community, which inspires many applications including the widely-adopted REPA. However, the common interpretation of this depth profile may be inaccurate and incomplete: (i) The cause of this curve has long been treated as signal granularity changing from coarse to fine, but there has been little evidence in DiT backbones. (ii) The community has been mainly studying this phenomenon in a static way, without investigating how it changes across different training setups. In this work, we show a different mechanism picture for the profile, where the prediction target (e.g., $ε$, $u$, $x_0$) sits at the center. The semantically meaningful signal is only an intermediate by-product for predicting the target, while the prediction target is the real goal for the backbone. Furthermore, the choice of prediction targets as part of the training setup can predictably affect the curve's shape. With this updated interpretation, many applications of this depth profile can be better grounded and predicted. As an example, we show how to predict the near-optimal placement of REPA based on the prediction target of the training setup. The code is at https://github.com/Darkbblue/dit-compare.

AI.tldr: 本文重新解读扩散骨干网络中间激活的深度性能曲线，指出其成因核心是预测目标（ε/u/x0），而非传统认为的信号粒度由粗到细；且该曲线形状可由训练设定中的预测目标预测，并据此指导REPA的最优插入位置。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型社区普遍观察到：在forward过程中，对不同深度的中间激活施加相同下游评测协议，会得到先升后降的倒U形深度性能曲线，这一现象支撑了REPA等应用。但现有解释不准确也不完整：（1）将曲线归因于信号粒度由粗到细，但在DiT骨干中缺乏证据；（2）多以静态视角研究，未考察其在不同训练设定下如何变化。
AI.method: 作者提出新的机制解释：预测目标（如ε、u、x0）处于中心地位，语义上有意义的信号只是预测目标过程中的中间副产物，而预测目标才是骨干的真正目标。基于此，将预测目标视为训练设定的一部分，分析并验证其如何可预测地影响深度性能曲线形状；并以REPA为例，依据训练设定的预测目标预测其近最优插入位置。
AI.result: 研究给出了与"粒度由粗到细"不同的机制图景，表明预测目标决定并中心化了深度曲线；预测目标的选择能够可预测地影响曲线形状，并可用于预测REPA的近最优放置位置；代码已开源于https://github.com/Darkbblue/dit-compare。
AI.conclusion: 对扩散骨干深度性能曲线的更新解读使该现象的众多应用（如REPA）获得更扎实的理论依据和可预测性：曲线形状可由训练设定中的预测目标推断，从而指导如REPA插入位置等设计选择。

title: SAFE-KV: Causal Suffix Repair for Behavior-Preserving Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in RAG
comment: Accepted to Findings of AACL-IJCNLP 2026. 36 pages, 5 figures, 33 tables. Code: https://github.com/XingjianZhang-dev/safe-kv
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) reuses the same documents across many requests, making non-prefix KV-cache reuse attractive. Yet a cached document state is not reusable text: it is a context-conditioned causal state whose keys and values depend on the prefix, position, and preceding documents under which it was computed. We formulate non-prefix KV reuse as a behavior-preservation problem with full prefill on the exact prompt as the reference, and introduce SAFE-KV, which repairs a composed cache by re-encoding the causal suffix from a selected start document. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, prefix-conditioned composition preserves only 47.2% of HotpotQA-500 and 37.8% of 2Wiki-500 full-prefill answers; SAFE-KV with risk-guided K2 selection restores 99.8%/98.4% (donor-copy protocol) and 100.0%/98.4% with actual suffix forwarding. Document-only and fixed-window repairs recover far less, because the document states after the repaired region keep histories that omit it. Reuse without repair is exact up to four documents and degrades at sixteen, where suffix repair recovers 98-100%. Faithful repair re-encodes most of the context, so in a single-request L40S study SAFE-KV's operating rule serves every workload by full prefill. SAFE-KV thus establishes the causal-state contract for non-prefix reuse and a validated repair mechanism that meets it.

AI.tldr: 将非前缀KV缓存复用形式化为行为保持问题，提出SAFE-KV，通过从选定起始文档重编码因果后缀修复组合缓存，使其贴近全量预填充的参考行为。
AI.motivation: RAG在多请求间复用相同文档，使非前缀KV缓存复用具有吸引力；但缓存文档状态并非可复用文本，而是依赖前缀、位置及前序文档的上下文条件因果状态，直接组合会破坏模型行为，因此需要明确复用契约并提供修复机制。
AI.method: 以对精确提示词做全量预填充为参考，将非前缀KV复用建模为行为保持问题；提出SAFE-KV，从选定的起始文档重新编码因果后缀来修复组合缓存，并采用风险引导的K2选择策略确定起始文档。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，前缀条件组合仅保留47.2%的HotpotQA-500与37.8%的2Wiki-500全量预填充答案；SAFE-KV配合风险引导K2选择，在donor-copy协议下恢复99.8%/98.4%，实际后缀前向时为100.0%/98.4%。仅文档修复与固定窗口修复恢复率远低，因修复区域之后的文档状态仍缺失该段历史。无修复复用在四文档内精确，十六文档时退化，而后缀修复可恢复98-100%。在单请求L40S研究中，因忠实修复需重编码大部分上下文，SAFE-KV的运行规则对每个工作负载均采用全量预填充。
AI.conclusion: SAFE-KV为非前缀复用建立了因果状态契约，并给出经实验验证、满足该契约的修复机制；同时表明忠实修复的代价高，当前规则下全量预填充仍是实际操作选择。

title: How to Build a Benchmark That Actually Measures Taste
summary: Expert-aligned "taste" benchmarks should reward craft judgment, not the ability to game the test. We introduce TasteBench, a pairwise good-vs-bad benchmark across visual, brand, book, and tech items under a frozen rubric with expert-only gold (panel n>=3; percent agreement >=0.60 primary gate; weak engagement labels train/analysis-only), together with a control protocol that separates craft judgment from test-gaming. Applying the protocol to a Round-1 pilot (primary_human_expert; three biological human experts; n=250 pairs) surfaces and quantifies three validity threats: two construction artifacts that inflate the trivial-baseline layer, and a difficulty ceiling that inflates every score. (1) Position: the preferred item is slot A with probability 0.956, so an always_item_a policy scores 0.956 (fair chance 0.5). (2) Lexical leakage: a filename token cue scores 0.912. (3) Difficulty ceiling: craft domains show near-ceiling human agreement (book/brand/tech 1.0), and even under A/B randomization (eval_assignment_seed7; gold_side_A ~0.47) all five VLM cards reach 1.0 on craft, with only visual separating (~0.84-0.91; a post-hoc hard subset, n=107, leaves craft at 1.0). The protocol (expert-only gold, a weak-label firewall, side randomization at construction, filename scrubbing, and hard filters) makes each artifact measurable and, for the two construction artifacts, correctable; we release a reference eval harness and a side-randomization tool, and show the tool removes the position skew (0.916 to 0.495/0.505). The result is a calibrated view of what the benchmark does and does not yet measure: position and leakage are fixable, whereas the craft-domain ceiling is a pair-difficulty limit that Round-2 must address. We do not evaluate engagement, era/circle conditioning, or calibration here, and we claim no general taste SOTA.

AI.tldr: 提出 TasteBench 成对"好 vs 差"审美基准及控制协议，在 Round-1 试点中量化了位置偏置、词法泄漏与难度天花板三类效度威胁，并给出可测、可修正的工具与校准结论。
AI.motivation: 面向专家对齐的"品味"基准应奖励工艺判断而非应试刷分能力；现有基准缺乏将真实审美判断与"钻测试空子"区分开的控制手段，因此需要一个带冻结评分标准、专家金标和反作弊协议的评测框架。
AI.method: 构建 TasteBench：视觉、品牌、图书、技术四类条目的成对 good-vs-bad 任务，采用冻结评分标准、仅专家金标（专家组 n>=3，主要门槛为一致率>=0.60；弱参与度标签仅用于训练/分析）；配套控制协议包括仅专家金标、弱标签防火墙、构建期侧别随机化、文件名清洗与硬难度过滤；在 Round-1 试点（3 位真实人类专家，n=250 对）上应用该协议，并发布参考评测工具与侧别随机化工具。
AI.result: 发现并量化三类效度威胁：(1) 位置偏置，偏好项落在槽 A 的概率为 0.956，always_item_a 策略得 0.956（随机为 0.5）；(2) 词法泄漏，文件名 token 线索可得 0.912；(3) 难度天花板，工艺类领域人类一致率近乎满分（图书/品牌/技术均为 1.0），在 A/B 随机化下（eval_assignment_seed7，gold_side_A ~0.47）五张 VLM 卡片在工艺类均达 1.0，仅视觉类有区分度（~0.84-0.91；事后困难子集 n=107 下工艺类仍为 1.0）。侧别随机化工具可将位置偏斜从 0.916 降至 0.495/0.505。
AI.conclusion: 该协议使每个伪影可测量，其中两个构建期伪影可修正；位置与词法泄漏可修复，而工艺领域天花板属于配对难度限制，须由 Round-2 解决。本文不评估参与度、时代/圈层条件化与校准，也不主张通用品味 SOTA。

title: InfraWorld: Motion-Aware World Modeling for Roadside 4D Occupancy Forecasting
summary: Roadside 4D occupancy forecasting predicts future semantic occupancy in a fixed infrastructure coordinate system. Roadside scenes are globally structured yet locally evolving, requiring comprehensive scene-level context while precisely modeling sparse localized motion. However, existing forecasting paradigms struggle to tackle both requirements. To address this limitation, we propose InfraWorld, a world model formulating roadside occupancy forecasting as selective state evolution. InfraWorld maintains a dense BEV state for the complete scene and persistent motion queries for moving regions, assigning complementary states to global context and local dynamics. Specifically, we propose Dynamic Query Initiation (DQI) to initialize queries in regions supported by motion in the observed history. During rollout, the dense state is updated through Long--Short Temporal Fusion (LST), which combines short-term adjacent-frame continuity with long-term motion trends to preserve stable context while capturing scene evolution. Motion-Aware Query Injection (MAQI) then refines the queries and injects confidence-weighted query information into corresponding BEV tokens, enabling targeted dynamic updates without perturbing global context. Together, InfraWorld concentrates predictive capacity on evolving traffic regions. Extensive experiments on the InfraOcc and Occ3D--nus datasets demonstrate that InfraWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance for roadside 4D occupancy forecasting while retaining its effectiveness under ego-centric settings. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InfraWorld，将路侧4D占据预测建模为选择性状态演化，通过稠密BEV状态与持久运动查询的双状态设计，兼顾全局场景上下文与稀疏局部动态，在InfraOcc和Occ3D-nus上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 路侧场景具有"全局结构化、局部演化"的特性，既需要完整的场景级上下文，又需精确建模稀疏的局部运动。既有预测范式难以同时满足这两项需求。
AI.method: 将路侧占据预测表述为选择性状态演化，维护稠密BEV状态（全局）与持久运动查询（局部动态）。包括三个模块：Dynamic Query Initiation（DQI）依据观测历史中的运动区域初始化查询；Long-Short Temporal Fusion（LST）在rollout中以短期相邻帧连续性与长期运动趋势更新稠密状态；Motion-Aware Query Injection（MAQI）细化查询并将置信度加权信息注入对应BEV token，实现定向动态更新而不扰动全局上下文。
AI.result: 在InfraOcc与Occ3D-nus数据集上取得路侧4D占据预测的SOTA性能，并在自车视角设置下仍保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: InfraWorld通过双状态与选择性更新机制将预测能力集中于演化中的交通区域，为路侧4D占据预测提供了有效范式，代码将开源。

title: Do LLMs differentiate linguistic traits internally?: A layer-wise analysis
summary: Large language models often produce judgments that resemble human responses, but it remains unclear whether they internally capture linguistic nuances such as conventional versus idiomatic meaning. A layer-wise representational analysis was conducted on two equal-sized pre-trained models, Llama-3.2-1B and Gemma-3-1B-PT, to examine whether and where these models differentiate linguistic traits from input. The analysis combined layer-wise probing with geometric distance measures, using the top embedding dimensions ranked by principal component loadings for each layer. The results show that even with equal capacity, models organize linguistic information in fundamentally different ways, suggesting the need to analyze internal representational geometry, examining not just behavioral outputs but semantic space alignment when evaluating how closely human and model language interpretation correspond.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过逐层探针与几何距离分析，比较Llama-3.2-1B与Gemma-3-1B-PT两个等参数量模型对习语性/字面性语言特征的内部表征，发现二者组织语言信息的方式存在根本差异。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的输出常与人类判断相似，但其内部是否真正捕捉字面义与习语义等语言细微差异尚不明确；同时需检验在参数量相同的情况下，不同模型是否以相同方式组织语言信息。
AI.method: 对Llama-3.2-1B和Gemma-3-1B-PT两个规模相等的预训练模型进行逐层表征分析，结合逐层探针（layer-wise probing）与几何距离度量，并使用各层按主成分载荷排序的top嵌入维度作为分析对象。
AI.result: 即使模型容量相同，二者对语言信息的组织方式也从根本上不同，表明内部表征几何存在显著模型间差异。
AI.conclusion: 评估人类与模型语言解释的对应程度时，不能仅看行为输出，还应分析内部表征几何与语义空间对齐。

title: Relational Semantic Grounding for Test-Time Discovery
summary: Test-Time Discovery (TTD) aims to recognize known classes and detect novel ones from a continuous unlabeled test stream after deployment. Existing TTD methods mainly rely on visual clustering or prototype comparison, and can only assign anonymous labels to discovered classes, leaving them difficult to interpret in open-world applications. In this paper, we propose SEGA, a Semantic Grounding with Attributes framework for TTD. SEGA leverages large language models to generate attribute-rich descriptions for known classes and constructs an attribute-anchored visual-semantic space during training. At test time, we introduce Relational Semantic Grounding (RSG), which grounds unknown samples with similar and dissimilar known-class anchors, prompts the LLM to generate candidate concepts, and reranks them in the learned semantic space. The selected concept is further used for confidence-guided test-time semantic stabilization. By coupling attribute-level semantic alignment with relational concept grounding, SEGA transforms anonymous test-time clusters into interpretable semantic concepts. Experiments show that SEGA improves TTD baselines with the promise of semantic grounding for open-world.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SEGA框架，通过属性语义锚定与关系语义落地，将测试时发现中的匿名簇转化为可解释的语义概念。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时发现（TTD）方法依赖视觉聚类或原型比较，只能为发现的新类分配匿名标签，在开放世界应用中难以解释。
AI.method: 利用大语言模型为已知类生成属性丰富的描述，训练阶段构建属性锚定的视觉-语义空间；测试时引入关系语义落地（RSG），用相似/不相似的已知类锚点对未知样本进行语义落地，提示LLM生成候选概念，并在学习到的语义空间中重排序，选出的概念进一步用于置信度引导的测试时语义稳定化。
AI.result: 实验表明SEGA在TTD基线上取得提升，并展现了面向开放世界语义落地的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 通过属性级语义对齐与关系概念落地的耦合，SEGA将匿名测试时簇转化为可解释的语义概念，为开放世界TTD提供了语义落地的新思路。

title: Adversarial Gradient Forcing for Robust Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video generation models generate videos sequentially, with each new block conditioned on previously generated blocks. By training on the model's own rollouts, Self Forcing and its follow-up methods substantially mitigate exposure bias caused by the mismatch between training- and inference-time history distributions. However, these models still suffer from error accumulation during long-horizon generation. We identify a key underlying limitation: the model remains highly sensitive to errors in its generated history, allowing small deviations to be amplified through subsequent generations. We refer to this underexplored problem as the local history robustness gap. To address this gap, we introduce Adversarial Gradient Forcing (AGF), a framework designed to improve the robustness of few-step autoregressive video models to perturbations and accumulated errors in their own generated histories. AGF uses distribution matching gradients from future block predictions to select adversarial perturbations of self-generated histories. It then jointly trains the generator on the original and perturbed histories to improve the robustness of future generation. Extensive experiments show that AGF achieves the highest VBench Total score on 60-second video generation and the best visual quality on four-minute video generation. Notably, AGF achieves such long-horizon robustness while requiring only 5-second rollouts for training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"局部历史鲁棒性缺口"问题并给出对抗梯度强制（AGF）框架，显著提升少步自回归视频模型的长时程生成鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成模型逐块生成，每块依赖历史块。已有方法（Self Forcing 及其后续）通过在自己的rollout上训练缓解了训练-推理历史分布不匹配导致的暴露偏差，但长时程生成中仍存在误差累积。作者指出根本原因：模型对自身生成历史中的误差高度敏感，小偏差会被后续生成放大，即"局部历史鲁棒性缺口"。
AI.method: 提出对抗梯度强制（AGF）框架，提升少步自回归视频模型对自身生成历史扰动及累积误差的鲁棒性。利用未来块预测的分布匹配梯度来筛选对自生成历史的对抗扰动，然后在原始历史与扰动历史上联合训练生成器，以改善未来生成的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，AGF在60秒视频生成上取得最高VBench Total分数，在四分钟视频生成上取得最佳视觉质量；且仅需5秒rollout即可训练，实现长时程鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: AGF通过对抗扰动与分布匹配梯度的联合训练，有效缓解自回归视频生成长时程误差累积问题，在长视频生成质量与鲁棒性上优于现有方法，同时训练成本低。

title: PANINI-DR: Controlled Deep Research through Generative Semantic Workspaces
comment: Under review at ICLR 2027. 37 pages, 1 figure, 22 tables. M. Yigit Turali and Shreyas Rajesh contributed equally
summary: Deep research requires connecting multiple steps of search, reasoning, and computation, with intermediate findings guiding what to investigate next. As investigations grow, agents must maintain research state across model calls and check findings before errors propagate into subsequent work. We introduce PANINI-DR, a multi-agent harness that separates coordination of the overall investigation from the research and verification of individual subquestions. A shared workspace, built on the Generative Semantic Workspace representation, records subquestions, their dependencies, findings, and supporting evidence. Researchers investigate individual subquestions, while a separate verification agent checks proposed answers against those subquestions and their evidence. Verification feedback guides further investigation, and recorded findings inform subsequent assignments. We evaluate PANINI-DR on BrowseComp-Plus, FRAMES, and MoNaCo against seven state-of-the-art deep-research harnesses, all using a shared language-model backbone and frozen corpora. PANINI-DR achieves the strongest average performance across the three benchmarks. On BrowseComp-Plus, it achieves 73.3% accuracy, outperforming the next-best harness by 16.0 points. Its advantage is strongest on hard questions, where it answers nearly twice as many as the next-best harness. Ablations further show that structured planning and persistent state improve performance, as does checking each finding against its cited evidence before it is reused. Because a model can answer correctly from memory alone, we also analyze the evidence retained by each harness. PANINI-DR achieves the highest answer recoverability from saved evidence on all three benchmarks, while complementary claim-support audits show stronger evidence-backed answers. Accounting for this evidence changes how harnesses compare and further strengthens PANINI-DR's advantage.

AI.tldr: 提出 PANINI-DR 多智能体框架，将整体研究协调与子问题研究/验证分离，基于生成语义工作区记录研究状态，在三个基准上取得最优表现。
AI.motivation: 深度研究需串联搜索、推理与计算多步骤，中间发现决定后续方向；随着研究推进，智能体需跨模型调用维持研究状态，并在错误扩散前核查发现。
AI.method: PANINI-DR 将整体调查的协调与单个子问题的研究与验证分离。共享工作区基于 Generative Semantic Workspace 表示，记录子问题、依赖关系、发现与支撑证据。研究者智能体调查各子问题，独立验证智能体依据子问题及其证据核查候选答案；验证反馈引导后续调查，已记录发现指导后续任务分配。
AI.result: 在 BrowseComp-Plus、FRAMES 与 MoNaCo 上，与七个最先进深度研究框架对比（共享语言模型骨干与冻结语料）。PANINI-DR 在三基准上平均表现最优；BrowseComp-Plus 达 73.3% 准确率，高出次优 16.0 分，难题优势最强，回答量近次优两倍。消融显示结构化规划、持久状态及复用前核查证据均提升性能。其保存证据的答案可恢复性在三基准最高，声明—支撑审计显示答案证据支撑更强，计入证据后比较格局变化且优势进一步扩大。
AI.conclusion: 分离协调与研究/验证、显式维护研究状态并核查证据，可显著提升深度研究智能体的准确率、难题表现与证据可靠性。

title: MHWA: Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action Model
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 15 tables, including references and appendices
summary: Autoregressive world models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for sample efficient decision making, yet their open loop rollouts often exhibit increasing drift that leads to error accumulation even within a relatively small planning horizon. Hierarchical temporal abstraction is a natural candidate to mitigate such drift by reducing the effective prediction horizon; however, existing hierarchical designs can introduce added structural and conceptual complexity, sometimes making them difficult to control and limiting gains over flat baselines. To this end, we introduce MHWA (Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action model), which employs a strided high level context channel to reduce global context update frequency, effectively curbing the propagation of compounding drift. Crucially, via context aware routing, the gating network dynamically reconfigures a low level mixture of experts by using both global context and current observations, thereby enabling flexible high-low coordination, helping alleviate interference commonly observed in static hierarchies. Empirically, using RLiable's seed-by-game aggregation, MHWA (77M parameters) achieves an IQM human normalized score (HNS) of 0.884 across three training seeds on a 14-game Atari subset using 10% subsampled offline data, outperforming a matched JOWA-70M baseline (0.529) and achieving numerically comparable performance to JOWA-150M while using nearly half the parameters and 70.88% fewer training FLOPs per sequence.

AI.tldr: MHWA是一种多时间尺度分层世界-动作模型，通过跨步高层上下文通道和上下文感知路由动态重构低层专家混合，抑制自回归世界模型开环推演中的漂移与误差累积，在14款Atari游戏上以更少参数和算力超越基线。
AI.motivation: 自回归世界模型在样本高效决策中表现强大，但其开环推演会随预测步数增加产生漂移，即使在较小的规划视界内也会误差累积。分层时间抽象是缓解该问题的自然方案，但现有分层设计带来额外的结构与概念复杂性，难以控制，且相对扁平基线收益有限。因此需要一种能有效抑制漂移、同时保持简洁可控的分层世界模型。
AI.method: 提出MHWA（多时间尺度分层世界-动作模型）。其核心包括：1）采用跨步（strided）高层上下文通道，降低全局上下文的更新频率，从而遏制复合漂移的传播；2）通过上下文感知路由，门控网络利用全局上下文与当前观测动态地重构低层专家混合（MoE），实现灵活的高层-低层协调，缓解静态分层中常见的干扰问题。
AI.result: 在14款Atari游戏子集上，使用10%下采样离线数据、3个训练种子，按RLiable的seed-by-game聚合方式评估：MHWA（77M参数）取得IQM人类归一化分数（HNS）0.884，超过参数量匹配的JOWA-70M基线（0.529），并在数值上与JOWA-150M相当，而参数量约为其一半，每序列训练FLOPs减少70.88%。
AI.conclusion: 通过降低高层上下文更新频率并引入上下文感知的低层专家动态路由，MHWA在保持结构简洁的同时有效缓解了自回归世界模型的开环漂移问题，并在样本效率、参数效率与计算效率上同时优于同规模基线，接近更大模型的表现，说明多时间尺度分层与动态高低层协调是提升世界模型决策性能的有效途径。

title: FrameFold: Response-Guided KV Cache Consolidation for Autoregressive Long Video Generation
summary: In autoregressive video generation, retaining all historical key-value (KV) states increases memory usage and per-step attention costs as videos grow longer. A fixed cache budget bounds these costs but raises the challenge of preserving historical content that supports consistent, high-quality generation. Existing methods control cache size through history selection or consolidation, yet deciding what to retain and how to limit the loss of useful content remains a shared challenge. Our analysis shows that spatial queries depend on different historical content and that higher current attention coverage does not necessarily yield better long-video quality. We introduce FrameFold, a training-free KV cache consolidation method that compares the content retrieved by the same recent historical queries before and after merging to guide both representative construction and merge selection. Exploiting temporal redundancy between adjacent historical entries, FrameFold merges their KV states into shared representatives while retaining complete spatial grids. It fits value-merging coefficients in closed form by matching conditional attention responses, then selects the merge with the lowest remaining response distortion. Under matched KV cache budgets, experiments on Self Forcing and Causal Forcing at 30 and 60 seconds and on LongLive at 120 seconds demonstrate improved consistency and visual quality. Continuous eight-minute Self Forcing rollouts further show less quality degradation than the baselines.

AI.tldr: FrameFold：一种免训练的KV缓存合并方法，通过对比合并前后历史查询检索内容的一致性来指导代表性构建与合并选择，在固定缓存预算下提升长视频生成质量。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成中，保留全部历史KV状态会随视频增长而增加显存占用和每步注意力开销；固定缓存预算虽能限制开销，但如何在有限预算下保留支撑一致、高质量生成的历史内容成为核心难题。已有方法通过历史选择或合并控制缓存大小，但"保留什么"和"如何减少有用内容损失"仍是共同挑战。
AI.method: 作者分析发现空间查询依赖不同的历史内容，且更高的当前注意力覆盖率不一定带来更好的长视频质量。据此提出FrameFold：一种免训练的KV缓存合并方法，通过对比同一批近期历史查询在合并前后检索到的内容来指导代表性构建与合并选择。方法利用相邻历史条目间的时间冗余，将其KV状态合并为共享代表，同时保留完整的空间网格；以闭式解拟合值合并系数，使条件注意力响应匹配，再选择剩余响应失真最低的合并方案。
AI.result: 在匹配KV缓存预算下，Self Forcing与Causal Forcing在30秒和60秒、LongLive在120秒上的实验均显示一致性提升和视觉质量改善；Self Forcing连续八分钟长滚动的质量退化也小于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 以"检索响应一致性"为准则进行KV缓存合并，可在固定缓存预算下更有效保留有用历史内容，为长视频自回归生成提供了一种免训练、通用的缓存压缩方案。

title: Sequent-Prover: Training Agents for Formal, Checkable SMT-based Reasoning
summary: We introduce Sequent-Prover, a family of verifier-using language-model agents, and the post-training framework that produces them. Agents reason in an executable SMT-LIB scratchpad: they write complete SMT-LIB programs, query Z3 across turns, inspect solver feedback, repair formalizations, and terminate with an explicit answer. Our recipe, verifier-conditioned trajectory distillation, bootstraps from a noisy teacher proposal policy by sampling multi-turn trajectories, retaining the successful tail that is correct, non-trivial, grounded, and executable, then applying supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-level preference optimization. Because solver success alone does not guarantee semantic faithfulness, we evaluate task accuracy, k-sample reliability, and SMT program quality. Across 37 benchmarks and 7,254 problems per model family, post-training raises the 4B model's per-attempt accuracy from 85.6% to 97.0% and four-sample all-correct reliability (pass^4}) from 64.1% to 91.7%. It also reduces average SMT calls from 4.10 to 2.52 and tokens per attempt from 18.97k to 12.72k. Sequent-Prover agents give answers backed by executable formal artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sequent-Prover 系列验证器驱动的语言模型智能体及其后训练框架，智能体在可执行 SMT-LIB 草稿本中推理并调用 Z3 求解器，通过“验证器条件轨迹蒸馏”提升准确率与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 仅凭求解器成功并不能保证语义忠实性，因此需要在提升任务准确率的同时评估可靠性、SMT 程序质量，并降低推理开销。
AI.method: 智能体在可执行 SMT-LIB 草稿本中编写完整程序、多轮查询 Z3、检视反馈并修复形式化，最终给出显式答案；采用验证器条件轨迹蒸馏：从含噪教师策略采样多轮轨迹，保留正确、非平凡、有依据且可执行的成功尾部，再进行监督微调与轨迹级偏好优化。
AI.result: 覆盖 37 个基准、每个模型家族 7,254 题：后训练将 4B 模型单次准确率从 85.6% 提升至 97.0%，四次全对可靠性（pass^4）从 64.1% 提升至 91.7%；平均 SMT 调用从 4.10 降至 2.52，每次尝试 token 从 18.97k 降至 12.72k。
AI.conclusion: Sequent-Prover 智能体给出的答案由可执行的形式化产物支撑，兼顾准确率、可靠性与效率。

title: Think in Strategies, Act with Tools: Traceable Agentic Optimization for Combinatorial Problems
summary: Optimization by PROmpting (OPRO) directly leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate candidate solutions through natural-language prompting. However, OPRO's optimization process is difficult to track, which prevents LLMs from capturing useful information accumulated over previous iterations, thereby limiting solution quality. To address this limitation, we propose a Tool-Augmented Strategic Agent (TASA) which summarizes and exploits trajectory to improve solution quality. Specifically, TASA plans the strategy for each step based on the optimization trajectory, which decomposes the optimization process into traceable strategy selections. Moreover, we leverage LLM to construct problem-specific tools and introduce a strategy-guided adaptive tool planner, which efficiently utilizes the information of trajectory to update solutions. We establish local convergence under persistent exploration and evaluate the complete framework under a shared candidate-evaluation budget. The results support its solution quality and the traceability of strategy-guided search.

AI.tldr: 提出TASA（工具增强策略智能体），通过总结并利用优化轨迹，将OPRO的优化过程分解为可追踪的策略选择，并用问题专属工具与策略引导的自适应工具规划器提升解质量，且建立了持续探索下的局部收敛性。
AI.motivation: OPRO直接以自然语言提示驱动大语言模型生成候选解，但其优化过程难以追踪，导致模型无法捕捉历次迭代中积累的有用信息，从而限制了解的质量。因此需要一种能显式利用轨迹信息、提升过程可追踪性的优化框架。
AI.method: 提出工具增强策略智能体（TASA）：1）基于优化轨迹为每一步规划策略，将优化过程分解为可追踪的策略选择；2）利用LLM构建问题专属工具；3）引入策略引导的自适应工具规划器，高效利用轨迹信息更新解。此外，在持续探索条件下建立局部收敛性，并在共享的候选—评估预算下评估完整框架。
AI.result: 在共享候选—评估预算下的实验结果支持TASA的解质量及策略引导搜索的可追踪性，并给出了持续探索下的局部收敛性结论。
AI.conclusion: TASA通过轨迹总结与策略级可追踪规划，结合问题专属工具与自适应工具规划，缓解了OPRO轨迹不可追踪、历史信息利用不足的问题，在解质量与搜索可追踪性上均有提升。

title: Attribute-Centric Vision-Language Alignment for Fine-Grained Gait Understanding
summary: Walking sequences reveal human-interpretable attributes related to body structure, posture, and motion. Gait attribute recognition provides a concrete route to fine-grained gait understanding by predicting these attributes. However, existing benchmarks provide limited fine-grained annotations, while classifier-based gait attribute recognition methods typically represent candidate classes through learned output weights rather than directly matching visual evidence with textual class representations. To address the annotation gap, we present RA-GAR, a large-scale, richly annotated multimodal benchmark for gait attribute recognition, containing 1,001 subjects, 242,729 walking sequences, and annotations for 15 static and motion gait attributes. We further propose Gait-VL, an attribute-centric vision-language alignment framework that recognizes gait attributes by matching attribute-specific multi-frame visual evidence with textual class prototypes. On the visual side, attribute-specific learnable queries aggregate RGB features across spatial locations and frames into per-attribute visual embeddings. On the language side, diverse descriptions expanded by a large language model are combined with context about relevant body regions to construct textual class prototypes. Beyond attribute recognition, we evaluate the transferability of the attribute-pretrained visual encoder by using it to replace generic upstream large vision models in identityoriented gait recognition pipelines; attribute pre-training uses no identity classification or metric-learning objectives. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art attribute recognition performance on RA-GAR and consistent improvements in downstream identity recognition across multiple pipelines and benchmarks, supporting the effectiveness and transferability of attribute-centric gait representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出大规模多模态步态属性识别基准 RA-GAR（1001人、242729段序列、15种属性），并提出属性中心的视觉-语言对齐框架 Gait-VL，通过多帧视觉证据与文本类原型匹配实现属性识别；实验在属性识别上达到SOTA，并验证属性预训练视觉编码器可迁移提升身份步态识别。
AI.motivation: 步态序列蕴含与体型、姿态、运动相关的可解释属性，细粒度步态理解有实际需求。但现有基准细粒度标注有限，且基于分类器的属性识别方法通过可学习输出权重表示候选类别，而非直接将视觉证据与文本类表示匹配。
AI.method: 1）构建 RA-GAR 大规模多标注多模态步态属性识别基准；2）提出 Gait-VL 属性中心视觉-语言对齐框架：视觉端用属性特定可学习查询在空间位置与帧间聚合RGB特征，得到逐属性视觉嵌入；语言端用大语言模型扩展的多样描述并结合相关身体区域上下文，构建文本类原型；通过视觉嵌入与文本原型匹配进行属性识别；3）用属性预训练视觉编码器替换通用上游大视觉模型，接入身份导向步态识别流程（不使用身份分类或度量学习目标）。
AI.result: 在 RA-GAR 上取得SOTA属性识别性能；在多个流程与基准上，下游身份步态识别一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 属性中心的步态表示学习有效且具有可迁移性，属性预训练可替代通用视觉上游模型提升身份步态识别。

title: Do correct answers have stable latent knowledge support?
summary: Large language models are typically evaluated in terms of the correctness of their output. However, output correctness alone does not confirm whether the latent knowledge supporting an answer has stable internal representations. We therefore propose latent state stability (LSS) and knowledge topology stability (KTS) to investigate the stability of individual knowledge states and their relational structure, respectively. Specifically, we first separately average the model's internal representations of the same knowledge under each elicitation condition. Using the mean representation under the baseline condition as a reference, we remove shared shifts to obtain corrected representations. We then formulate LSS as the distance between each corrected representation and its reference representation, normalized against the typical distance between knowledge items of the same type. We formulate KTS as the cross-condition consistency of the ordered pairwise representation distances among knowledge items of the same type. Next, we construct EpiStableBench, which comprises 4,411 items spanning factual knowledge and mathematical reasoning, with 76,766 controlled queries. Across 16 LLMs from four families, representation stability varies substantially even among items answered correctly under the base condition. Within models, higher stability generally corresponds to higher accuracy under held-out elicitation conditions; across models, stability does not consistently increase with model size or overall accuracy. Meanwhile, we present LatentDPO to learn a knowledge-editing policy that accounts for the stability of latent knowledge. Experimental results show that integrating LatentDPO with multiple existing editing methods consistently improves editing success and generalization across different expressions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出潜状态稳定性（LSS）与知识拓扑稳定性（KTS）两项指标，并构建 EpiStableBench 基准，系统评估大模型内部知识表征的稳定性；同时提出 LatentDPO 知识编辑策略以提升编辑效果。
AI.motivation: 现有评估主要关注大模型输出的正确性，但输出正确并不意味着支撑答案的潜在知识具有稳定的内部表征。因此需要从表征层面刻画知识状态及其关系结构的稳定性。
AI.method: 先在每种诱导条件下对同一知识的内部表征分别取平均，以基线条件下的均值表征为参考，去除共性偏移得到校正表征。将 LSS 定义为校正表征与参考表征之间的距离，并用同类型知识项之间的典型距离进行归一化；将 KTS 定义为同类型知识项之间有序成对表征距离的跨条件一致性。随后构建 EpiStableBench，包含 4,411 个条目、覆盖事实知识与数学推理，共 76,766 条受控查询。此外提出 LatentDPO，学习一种考虑潜在知识稳定性的知识编辑策略。
AI.result: 在来自四个家族的 16 个大模型上，即便在基线条件下回答正确的条目之间，表征稳定性也存在显著差异。模型内部稳定性越高，通常在留出诱导条件下的准确率也越高；但跨模型来看，稳定性并不随模型规模或整体准确率单调提升。将 LatentDPO 与多种现有编辑方法结合，可一致提升编辑成功率及在不同表达方式上的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 输出正确性不足以反映潜在知识的内部稳定性，LSS 与 KTS 可从状态与关系结构两方面刻画稳定性，且稳定性与准确率在模型内相关、跨模型不必然随规模提升；引入稳定性感知的 LatentDPO 能有效改进知识编辑的成功率与泛化性。

title: SAGE: Pushing 2-Bit Vector-Quantized LLMs toward Real-World Usability
summary: Extreme low-bit weight-only quantization is an effective approach to reducing the deployment costs of large language models. Below 3 bits, scalar quantization often suffers severe accuracy loss, while vector quantization (VQ) better preserves accuracy through more expressive joint encoding. However, existing VQ methods still exhibit substantial degradation on real-world tasks, and two design challenges remain underexplored: (1) protecting sensitive weight channels within jointly encoded vectors; and (2) allocating a fixed bit budget among representation components, such as direction and radius, to suit different weight matrices. To address these challenges, we propose SAGE: Split Adaptation and Grouping by Energy for weight-only vector quantization. First, Energy-Stratified Grouping (ESG) couples channel grouping with activation-weighted fitting, grouping channels from different energy tiers within each subvector to prioritize sensitive channels. Second, Adaptive Bit Split (ABS) balances direction-codebook capacity and radius precision per matrix, selecting the split with the lowest activation-weighted reconstruction error under a fixed budget. Across benchmarks covering knowledge, mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and tool use, SAGE achieves state-of-the-art performance in the 2-bit quantization setting. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, it retains 95.3% of the BF16 model's average benchmark score. With our custom-designed CUDA kernel, SAGE delivers up to a 2.55-fold non-streaming end-to-end speedup over FP16. The code is available at https://github.com/Zincwolf/sage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGE，一种面向大语言模型的极低位宽（2-bit）权重向量量化方法，通过能量分层分组（ESG）与自适应比特切分（ABS）两个设计，在多个基准上达到2-bit量化SOTA，并配套CUDA内核实现最高2.55倍端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 极低位宽（低于3比特）量化可显著降低大模型部署成本。标量量化在此区间精度损失严重，向量量化（VQ）虽通过更具表达力的联合编码更好保留精度，但现有VQ方法在真实任务上仍有明显退化，且两个设计问题尚待解决：(1) 如何在联合编码的向量内保护敏感权重通道；(2) 如何在固定比特预算下，在方向与半径等表示组件间分配比特以适应不同权重矩阵。
AI.method: 提出SAGE（Split Adaptation and Grouping by Energy）。其一为能量分层分组（ESG）：将通道分组与激活加权拟合耦合，在每个子向量内组合来自不同能量层级的通道，以优先保护敏感通道。其二为自适应比特切分（ABS）：在每个矩阵上平衡方向码本容量与半径精度，在固定比特预算下选择激活加权重建误差最低的切分方案。此外还设计了配套CUDA内核。
AI.result: 在覆盖知识、数学、代码生成、指令遵循和工具使用的基准测试中，SAGE在2-bit量化设置下取得SOTA性能。在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，其平均基准得分保留了BF16模型的95.3%。借助自研CUDA内核，SAGE相比FP16实现最高2.55倍的非流式端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: SAGE通过能量分层分组保护敏感通道、自适应比特切分平衡方向与半径精度，有效缓解了极低位宽向量量化的精度退化问题，在2-bit量化下达到SOTA并具备实际部署加速效果，代码已开源。

title: Bidirectional Adaptive Transformers for Multimodal Anomaly Detection
summary:
The effective integration of features derived from RGB images and 3D point clouds presents a substantial challenge in the field of multimodal anomaly detection (MAD). Existing MAD methods typically rely on static fusion paradigms built upon frozen pre-trained encoders. While these frameworks facilitate spatial alignment, they lack the mechanism to establish latent semantic correspondence, thereby inducing cross-modal interference that degrades anomaly discriminability.
  To mitigate these limitations, this study proposes a Bidirectional Adaptive Transformers (BAT) framework, which constructs comprehensive and semantically aligned multimodal representations by leveraging complementary attributes across modalities.
  The BAT framework introduces a Bidirectional Feature Alignment (BFA) module, which employs a mutual predictive mechanism to bridge the gap between 2D textural patterns and 3D geometric structures. This bidirectional interaction explicitly enhances the textural granularity of point cloud descriptors while augmenting the spatial contextual awareness of RGB features.
  To ensure that the latent representations possess sufficient informational density for alignment, BAT incorporates a parameter-efficient adaptation architecture. By utilizing lightweight image and point cloud adapters, the framework facilitates specialized fine-tuning of pre-trained models, mitigating the information loss inherent in frozen encoders.
  Extensive experiments conducted on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies confirm that BAT achieves state-of-the-art anomaly detection performance, significantly outperforming existing MAD methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双向自适应Transformers（BAT）框架，通过双向特征对齐与参数高效适配，解决多模态异常检测中RGB与点云特征融合的语义错配与跨模态干扰问题，在MVTec 3D-AD与Eyecandies上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态异常检测（MAD）方法多依赖冻结预训练编码器上的静态融合范式；此类框架虽能实现空间对齐，却缺乏建立潜在语义对应关系的机制，导致跨模态干扰并削弱异常判别能力。
AI.method: 提出BAT框架，包含：1）双向特征对齐（BFA）模块，采用互相预测机制桥接2D纹理模式与3D几何结构，双向交互在增强点云描述子纹理粒度的同时提升RGB特征的空间上下文感知；2）参数高效适配架构，利用轻量级图像与点云适配器对预训练模型进行专门微调，缓解冻结编码器固有的信息损失，使潜在表示具备足够的信息密度以支撑对齐。
AI.result: 在MVTec 3D-AD与Eyecandies数据集上的大量实验表明，BAT取得最先进的异常检测性能，显著优于现有多模态异常检测方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过双向语义对齐与参数高效适配相结合，BAT有效缓解了跨模态干扰与信息损失，验证了语义对齐式多模态表示在多模态异常检测中的有效性。

title: North or South? Diagnosing LLMs' Understanding of North Korean Language, Society, and Knowledge
comment: Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 19 pages, 1 figure, 11 tables
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made substantial progress in multilingual question answering, yet their ability to understand low-resource sociolinguistic contexts remains under-explored. We study North Korea as a unique testbed where decades of division have produced distinct differences from South Korea in vocabulary, orthography, norms, and ideological discourse. We introduce LENS (Language and sociocultural Evaluation for North Korean Society), a human-validated benchmark of 1,765 questions evaluating LLMs across three dimensions: linguistic robustness, sociocultural perspective alignment, and domain-specific knowledge. Evaluating diverse recent LLMs, we find a modest performance drop on North Korean language inputs, a larger gap in sociocultural perspective alignment, and severe limitations on domain-specific knowledge. Qualitative analysis reveals that models often conflate formal institutions with lived realities, project liberal-democratic assumptions, or rely on coarse stereotypes. Our results demonstrate that linguistic similarity alone does not guarantee sociocultural or domain-specific understanding, highlighting the critical need for grounded evaluation resources for underrepresented cultural and political contexts.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LENS基准（1,765题，人工验证），从语言鲁棒性、社会文化视角对齐、领域知识三个维度评估LLM对朝鲜语境的理能力，发现模型在语言层面仅小幅下降，但社会文化视角与领域知识存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: LLM在多语言问答上进展显著，但对低资源社会语言学语境的理解仍缺乏研究。朝鲜半岛长期分裂造成词汇、正字法、规范与意识形态话语的差异，构成独特测试场景，用以检验模型是否真正理解语言背后的社会文化与领域知识。
AI.method: 构建LENS（Language and sociocultural Evaluation for North Korean Society）基准，包含1,765个人工验证问题，覆盖语言鲁棒性、社会文化视角对齐、领域特定知识三个维度；对多种近期LLM进行评测并辅以定性分析。
AI.result: 朝鲜语输入上性能仅小幅下降；社会文化视角对齐差距更大；领域特定知识严重不足。定性分析显示模型常将正式制度与生活现实混淆、投射自由民主假设，或依赖粗粒度刻板印象。
AI.conclusion: 语言相似性并不保证社会文化或领域特定理解能力，亟需为代表性不足的文化与政治语境建立有据可依的评测资源。

title: Equal-information evaluation of credit assignment in modular financial reinforcement learning
summary: Credit assignment in modular financial reinforcement learning is difficult to evaluate because an attributed signal may improve a component loss without adding decision-relevant information or improving economic outcomes. We propose an evaluation framework combining equal-information reconstruction controls, fixed-utility comparisons and prespecified downstream guardrails. The framework is instantiated in an attribution-guided modular trading architecture and tested in three controlled studies covering update allocation, supervision-target representation and portfolio risk control. We find that residual-based allocation is exactly reproduced by an ordinary loss-budget control under the disclosed interface; direct shortfall supervision improves component prediction but fails decoded-outcome preservation; and component-wise critic supervision worsens risk-condition certainty equivalent and drawdown relative to scalar supervision under fixed utility. These results identify three distinct evaluation failures: redundant attribution signals, representation-induced prediction trade-offs, and misalignment between component supervision and downstream risk outcomes. A preserved historical engineering case further shows why module-level learning claims require run-level provenance. The contribution is a reusable methodology for evaluating credit assignment in expert systems operating under partial observability, delayed feedback and economic risk constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套面向模块化金融强化学习信用分配的评估框架，结合等信息重构对照、固定效用比较与预设下游护栏，在归因引导的模块化交易架构中用三项受控研究检验更新分配、监督目标表征与组合风险控制，揭示三类评估失效。
AI.motivation: 模块化金融强化学习中的信用分配难以评估：某个归因信号可能降低组件损失，却未增加与决策相关的信息，也未改善经济结果。因此需要区分"损失改善"与"真实决策价值"的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建评估框架，包含三类要素：等信息重构对照（检验归因信号是否可被普通损失预算控制精确复现）、固定效用比较（在效用不变的条件下比较组件监督）、预设下游护栏（如风险条件确定性等价、回撤等经济指标）。将该框架实例化于归因引导的模块化交易架构，开展三项受控研究：更新分配、监督目标表征、组合风险控制。
AI.result: （1）基于残差的分配在披露接口下被普通损失预算控制完全复现；（2）直接缺口监督提升组件预测，但未能保持解码结果；（3）在固定效用下，组件级评论家监督相较标量监督使风险条件确定性等价与回撤变差。历史工程案例进一步表明模块级学习结论需要运行级溯源。
AI.conclusion: 识别出三类评估失效：冗余归因信号、表征导致的预测权衡、组件监督与下游风险结果失配。贡献是一套可复用方法学，用于评估部分可观测、延迟反馈与经济风险约束下专家系统的信用分配。

title: EviScene: Beyond "Is It AI?" for Agentic Image Factuality Assessment
summary: Determining whether an image is AI-generated does not establish whether the situation it depicts is factually supported. We formulate Image Factuality Assessment: given an image and a generic verification instruction, a system returns a supported or refuted verdict with an evidence-grounded explanation. Without a supplied textual claim, the system must progressively refine factual questions during investigation and align external evidence with the specific situation depicted. We introduce EviLens, an expert-reviewed benchmark of 10,174 supported and refuted images from controlled construction and web collection, covering twelve factual error types and evaluating both verdict accuracy and evidence sufficiency. We develop EviScene, a multimodal ReAct agent that interleaves visual inspection, external retrieval, and evidence analysis, using new findings to refine its questions and revisit relevant image details. We train a compact policy with supervised fine-tuning on reviewed teacher trajectories, followed by privileged on-policy self-distillation applied to verified decisions from the policy's own investigations. On the 1,527-image test set, the trained Qwen3.5-9B agent achieves 79.05% balanced accuracy and a Strict Evidence Sufficiency Rate (SESR) of 52.26%, improving over the same-backbone base agent by 6.71 and 9.37 percentage points, respectively. Its SESR is the highest among the evaluated agents.Code, models, and data will be released at https://github.com/wangzian828/EVISCENE and https://huggingface.co/ZiAnwang/EviScene.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“图像事实性评估”新任务并构建EviLens基准，开发多模态ReAct智能体EviScene，通过SFT与特权在线自蒸馏训练紧凑策略，实现判定与证据充分性的双重评估。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多聚焦“图像是否为AI生成”，但生成属性不等于所描绘情境具备事实依据；且缺少文本声明时，系统需自行细化事实性问题并对齐外部证据，缺相应的基准与评测方法。
AI.method: 1) 将任务形式化为图像事实性评估：输入图像与通用核查指令，输出supported/refuted判定及有证据支撑的解释。2) 构建EviLens基准：10,174张支持/反驳图像，来自受控构造与网络采集，经专家审核，覆盖12类事实性错误类型，同时评测判定准确性与证据充分性。3) 提出EviScene多模态ReAct智能体：交替进行视觉检查、外部检索与证据分析，并以新发现细化问题、回溯图像细节。4) 训练紧凑策略：先用专家审核轨迹SFT，再用策略自身核查中已验证决策做特权在线自蒸馏。
AI.result: 在1,527张测试集上，训练后的Qwen3.5-9B智能体达到79.05%平衡准确率与52.26%严格证据充分性率（SESR），较同骨干基座智能体分别提升6.71与9.37个百分点；其SESR为所评测智能体中最优。
AI.conclusion: 图像事实性评估可作为独立任务，且通过专家审核基准与多模态检索-推理智能体结合自蒸馏训练，可同时提升判定准确性与证据充分性，为图像事实核查提供可复现的数据、模型与代码。

title: A Sovereign, Indic-First, Reasoning Model
summary:
Gnani-Evon-v3.3-30B-A3B is a long-context hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts model for reasoning, instruction following, and tool use in English and eight Indian languages. Starting from NVIDIA's Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B checkpoint, it retains the 52-layer backbone and changes the vocabulary, training data, and post-training objectives. An in-place expansion from 131,072 to 163,072 tokens reduces mean Indian-language fertility by 38.6%. The new embedding rows are initialized from their upstream decompositions and warmed before the backbone is updated. Continual pretraining then adds broad English-Indic data, high-quality annealing, and direct training at a 131,072-token sequence length.
  The central result appears after post-training. Reinforcement learning across four verifiable task environments improves mathematics, graduate-level science, and instruction following, but degrades Indic extractive question answering because the rewards do not require an answer in the requested language. The share of Indic extraction items answered in English rises from 8.7% to 91.7%. Accuracy conditional on answering in the target script roughly doubles, which is consistent with preserved reading ability but is measured on a self-selected subset.
  Two unreleased studies test repairs. A scoped Indic reward restores the language convention. A 26B-A4B generative judge outperforms a 235B-parameter model on RM-Bench, and distillation restores 81% of the capabilities displaced by optimizing against it.
  Relative to the architecture-identical starting checkpoint, the released model gains 5.2 points on an Indic aggregate while giving up 1.7 points of English retention. The unreleased Indic-aware branch trades further, gaining 14.6 Indic points at a cost of 5.4 in English. A planned FP8 release reduces the artifact to 32GB with near-zero mean change across 32 paired benchmarks.

AI.tldr: Gnani-Evon-v3.3-30B-A3B在Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B基础上通过词表扩容与持续预训练获得印地语系增益，但RL后训练因奖励缺乏语言约束导致印地语抽取式问答语言漂移，需以定向奖励与蒸馏修复。
AI.motivation: 面向英语与八种印度语言的推理、指令跟随与工具使用需求，在保留原有52层Mamba-Transformer MoE主干的前提下，提升印度语言的表示效率与下游能力，同时尽量保持英语能力。
AI.method: 以Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B为起点，保留52层主干，仅修改词表、训练数据与后训练目标：词表由131,072原位扩展至163,072（新增行由上游分解初始化并预热后再更新主干），随后进行英印双语持续预训练、高质量退火及131,072长度直接训练；之后在四个可验证任务环境上做RL后训练，并测试两项未发布修复方案——限定范围的印度语言奖励，以及用26B-A4B生成式判官配合蒸馏。
AI.result: 词表扩展使印度语言平均fertility下降38.6%；RL提升了数学、研究生级科学与指令跟随，但印度语言抽取式问答退化，以英语作答比例从8.7%升至91.7%，而在目标文字作答条件下的准确率约翻倍（自选子集上测量）。相对同架构起点，发布版印度语言综合指标+5.2、英语保持-1.7；未发布印度语言感知分支为+14.6 / -5.4。26B-A4B判官在RM-Bench上优于235B模型，蒸馏恢复81%被置换能力；计划中的FP8版本将体积降至32GB，32项配对基准均值变化近零。
AI.conclusion: 扩大词表可显著提升印度语言效率，但RL奖励若不含语言约束会诱发跨语言漂移，须用定向奖励纠正、以生成式判官与蒸馏缓解能力置换；总体上存在印度语言能力与英语保持之间的可控权衡，FP8量化可近似无损压缩。

title: GateSight: Recurrent Memory Anticipates Attention Memory for Query-Agnostic KV Eviction in Hybrid LLMs
summary: Hybrid language models interleave Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers, whose recurrent memory has a fixed size, with full-attention layers, whose key-value (KV) cache grows with the context and dominates serving memory. In this paper, we ask whether the recurrent memory already knows what the attention memory will need. We first show that which GDN heads of Qwen3.8-27B keep long memories is fixed by the weights rather than by the document. Next, we define the future utility of a KV entry by how much removing it changes the attention output over the model's own continuations, and find that the write gate, decay and write magnitude that GDN layers emit during prefill anticipate this utility before any query is seen. Because the relation is spread across many GDN heads and layers, and a linear map recovers its trend but less of its high-utility tail than a nonlinear one, we propose GateSight, which learns it with lightweight per-head multilayer perceptrons that read these signals and no attention score. Their predicted utility decides which entries each attention layer keeps, and how much each layer keeps is set by the model's native attention output gate, whose mean differs by more than an order of magnitude across layers. Finally, at serving time, GateSight scores the cache once after prefill and physically releases discarded KV entries. Experimental results on SCBench and RULER-4096 with Qwen3.8-27B and, with the same recipe, the sparse-attention model Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, up to the 262K-token limit of the models, show that with a tenth of the attention KV cache, GateSight is the most accurate of five query-agnostic methods on three of the four model-benchmark pairs and leads KVzip on all four, by 9.5 to 47.2 points. Notably, it scores a full-length context with negligible overhead relative to prefill.

AI.tldr: 提出GateSight：利用混合语言模型中GDN层的写门、衰减和写幅度信号，通过轻量级逐头MLP预测KV条目未来效用，在prefill后一次性评分并物理释放被丢弃的KV条目，实现查询无关的KV缓存压缩。
AI.motivation: 混合语言模型中全注意力层的KV缓存随上下文增长并在服务内存中占主导地位，而GDN层的循环记忆大小固定。作者追问：循环记忆是否已经预知注意力记忆将需要什么，从而可用其信号指导KV缓存淘汰，降低服务内存开销。
AI.method: 首先验证Qwen3.8-27B中哪些GDN头保持长记忆由权重而非文档决定；将KV条目的"未来效用"定义为移除它后对模型自身续写上注意力输出的改变量；发现GDN层在prefill时发出的写门、衰减和写幅度能预先反映该效用。由于关系分散在多个GDN头与层中，且线性映射对高效用尾部的恢复不如非线性，提出GateSight：用轻量级逐头MLP仅读取这些信号（不使用注意力分数）学习该关系，预测效用决定每个注意力层保留哪些条目，保留量由模型原生注意力输出门的均值（层间差异超一个数量级）确定；服务时prefill后对缓存评分一次并物理释放被丢弃条目。
AI.result: 在SCBench和RULER-4096上，使用Qwen3.8-27B及相同配方的稀疏注意力模型Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（至262K token上限）实验表明：以十分之一的注意力KV缓存，GateSight在四个模型-基准对中的三个上为五种查询无关方法中最准确，并在全部四个上超过KVzip，领先9.5至47.2个百分点，且对全长上下文评分相对prefill的开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: GDN循环记忆的前向信号能提前预测KV条目未来效用，GateSight据此实现查询无关、低开销的KV缓存压缩，在多种模型与长上下文基准上以显著更小缓存取得更高精度。

title: EarthAlign: Learning Language-Aligned Representations of Earth System Data
summary: Interpreting Earth system conditions is central to understanding environmental risks and informing decisions across weather- and climate-sensitive sectors. Existing multimodal weather systems primarily target task-specific prediction, generation, or question answering, while general-purpose alignment between Earth system data and language remains underexplored due to the limited availability of diverse language supervision grounded in meteorological conditions. To fill this gap, we introduce EarthAlign, a large-scale dataset with broad geographic coverage spanning 2000-2024 that combines 10 expert-curated natural event and disaster data sources with climatology-derived normal-weather samples. Each sample includes temporal and geospatial information and four grounded caption styles aligned with 63-variable ERA5 meteorological data. Building on EarthAlign, we introduce MeteoLIP, a dual-encoder framework for learning aligned meteorology-language representations. MeteoLIP incorporates MetTok, which uses a geolocation- and time-conditioned query to aggregate variable-specific patch embeddings into a compact sequence of meteorology tokens. To comprehensively assess Earth system multimodal representations, we introduce three downstream tasks: cross-modal retrieval, weather-condition classification, and physical variable estimation. Our experiments show that MeteoLIP improves upon the corresponding CLIP and SigLIP baselines across these tasks. Further analyses highlight the importance of meteorological input, temporal and geospatial conditioning, and multi-style supervision for meteorology-language alignment. Thus, EarthAlign and MeteoLIP provide a foundation for learning and evaluating language-aligned representations of Earth system data. Our code, dataset, and weights are publicly available at https://github.com/mbzuai-oryx/EarthAlign.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EarthAlign大规模数据集与MeteoLIP双编码器框架，实现地球系统数据与语言的通用对齐，并引入三项下游任务验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有气象多模态系统多面向特定任务的预测、生成或问答，缺乏地球系统数据与语言之间的通用对齐能力，根源在于缺乏基于气象条件、多样化的语言监督数据。
AI.method: 构建EarthAlign数据集，覆盖2000-2024年、广域地理范围，融合10个专家整理的自然事件与灾害数据源及气候学导出的常态天气样本，每样本含时空信息与4种接地描述风格，对齐63变量ERA5气象数据；提出MeteoLIP双编码器框架，其中MetTok以地理-时间条件查询将变量特异性patch嵌入聚合为紧凑气象token序列。
AI.result: 在跨模态检索、天气状况分类、物理变量估计三项下游任务上，MeteoLIP均优于对应的CLIP与SigLIP基线；消融分析表明气象输入、时间与地理条件及多风格监督对气象-语言对齐至关重要。
AI.conclusion: EarthAlign与MeteoLIP为地球系统数据的语言对齐表示学习与评估提供了基础，代码、数据集与权重已公开。

title: In-Place Indic Tokenizer Expansion and Continual Pretraining of Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B
comment: Accepted at the GlobalSouthAI Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: We adapted Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B for eight Indian languages without changing its backbone architecture. We expanded the vocabulary in place from 131,072 to 163,072 entries using continued byte-pair encoding and AdaptMix rebalancing, reducing tokens per word by 38.6%. We initialized new input and output rows by averaging their original constituent rows, then trained them on 90% Indic and 10% English text before updating the backbone. Continual pretraining then progressed through broad training, high-quality annealing, and long-context training over approximately 1.27 trillion tokens. The annealed checkpoint gained 12.9 points on the Indic MILU benchmark but lost 3.4 on English MMLU. We also report practical negative results. Direct token addition underperformed continued byte-pair encoding. AdamW weight decay changed rows intended to stay fixed. Perplexity on an Indic-heavy holdout did not select the learning rate that best preserved English performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文将Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B扩展适配至八种印度语言，通过原地扩容词表与持续预训练，显著提升Indic任务表现但带来英语性能小幅回退，并报告了若干实践性负结果。
AI.motivation: 在不改动骨干架构的前提下，为八种印度语言定制基础模型，以缓解其在这些语言上的表征与分词效率不足问题，同时尽量保持原有英语能力。
AI.method: 将词表由131,072原地扩展至163,072，采用持续字节对编码（continued BPE）与AdaptMix重平衡，使每词token数下降38.6%；新输入/输出行以原始组成行取平均初始化，先在90% Indic与10%英文文本上训练，再更新骨干；持续预训练经历广域训练、高质量退火与长上下文训练，共约1.27万亿token。
AI.result: 退火检查点在Indic MILU上提升12.9分，英语MMLU下降3.4分。负结果包括：直接添加token不如继续BPE；AdamW权重衰减改变了本应固定的行；以Indic为主的留出集困惑度未能选出最能保持英语性能的学习率。
AI.conclusion: 原地词表扩展结合分阶段持续预训练可有效提升印度语言能力，但存在英语能力回退与超参选择困难，需谨慎处理初始化、权重约束与验证集选择。

title: CUSE: Fine-Grained Multimodal Unlearning with Counterfactual Guidance and On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reproduce sensitive, copyrighted, or unsafe information from their training data. Effective unlearning must remove target information while preserving non-target content, even within the same response. Existing methods typically apply uniform forgetting objectives to complete responses and rely on fixed, off-policy supervision, resulting in coarse token control and misalignment with the model's current behavior. We propose CUSE, a Counterfactual-guided Unlearning framework via on-policy Self-distillation for multimodal large language models. It first constructs counterfactual inputs by removing target-related evidence and uses the resulting changes in token probabilities to identify which tokens require stronger forgetting. It then distills token-level forgetting and retention targets on responses sampled from the current policy, with a frozen copy of the original model serving as the teacher model augmented with the corresponding forgetting- and retention-oriented privileged contexts. This design jointly determines what to forget and what to preserve. On MLLMU-Bench, CUSE reduces forget-set ROUGE-L by 33.6% while achieving 1.2% higher retain-set ROUGE-L than the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CUSE，一种面向多模态大模型的反事实引导、基于on-policy自蒸馏的遗忘框架，通过反事实输入定位需强遗忘的token，并在当前策略采样上用冻结教师做token级遗忘/保留蒸馏，实现同一响应内遗忘与保留的联合优化。在MLLMU-Bench上遗忘集ROUGE-L降低33.6%，保留集ROUGE-L比最强基线高1.2%。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型可能复现训练数据中的敏感、受版权保护或不安全信息。有效遗忘需在去除目标信息的同时保留非目标内容，甚至要在同一响应内区分二者。现有方法通常对整个响应施加统一的遗忘目标，并依赖固定的off-policy监督，导致token级控制粗糙、且与模型当前行为不一致。
AI.method: CUSE首先通过移除目标相关证据构造反事实输入，利用由此产生的token概率变化识别哪些token需要更强的遗忘；随后在当前策略采样的响应上进行token级遗忘与保留目标的蒸馏，教师为原始模型的冻结副本并辅以相应的遗忘导向与保留导向特权上下文。该设计联合决定“遗忘什么”和“保留什么”。
AI.result: 在MLLMU-Bench上，CUSE将遗忘集ROUGE-L降低33.6%，同时保留集ROUGE-L较最强基线提升1.2%。
AI.conclusion: CUSE通过反事实引导与on-policy自蒸馏实现细粒度、与当前策略对齐的多模态大模型遗忘，在显著削弱目标信息的同时更好地保留非目标内容。
