title: DuSRFlow: Dual-Lens Super-Resolution via Parallax-Aware Flow Estimation and Complementary Reference Warping
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM)
summary: Dual-lens super-resolution (DuSR) aims to enhance a wide-angle low-resolution (LR) image by exploiting a telephoto reference (Ref) image. A central challenge in DuSR is reliable reference utilization under large parallax, occlusion, and cross-camera imaging discrepancies. Existing methods often employ off-the-shelf monocular optical flow models to provide geometric priors. However, their assumptions of photometric consistency and smooth motion are violated in dual-lens scenarios, leading to unreliable alignment and degraded reference-based reconstruction. To address these issues, we propose DuSRFlow, a dual-lens super-resolution framework that improves reference utilization from both correspondence learning and reference aggregation. First, we introduce DuFlowNet, a dedicated dual-lens flow estimator for robust cross-view alignment. To train DuFlowNet without ground-truth flow annotations, we develop a real--synthetic data fusion strategy that composites synthetic foreground objects onto real dual-lens image pairs, generating controllable large-parallax samples while preserving realistic cross-camera imaging characteristics. Second, we observe that reference reliability is highly spatially uneven in DuSR, where unreliable local reference responses may suppress the utilization of reliable cues. We therefore propose a Complementary Reference Warping strategy that coordinates patch-based warping and kernel-free-guided deformable warping according to local reference reliability, producing a more reliable reference representation before LR--Ref fusion. In addition, we construct DuSR-RealV2, a challenging real-world benchmark with complex depth variations, large parallax, and occlusion. Extensive experiments on multiple DuSR benchmarks demonstrate that DuSRFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance in reconstruction quality, perceptual quality, and cross-dataset generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出DuSRFlow双镜头超分框架，通过专用双镜头光流估计器DuFlowNet、真实-合成数据融合训练策略与互补参考变换策略，提升大视差、遮挡及跨相机差异下的参考利用可靠性，并在多个基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 双镜头超分辨率（DuSR）利用长焦参考图像增强广角低分辨率图像，其核心挑战在于大视差、遮挡和跨相机成像差异下可靠地利用参考信息。现有方法直接采用单目光流模型提供几何先验，但其光度一致性与平滑运动假设在双镜头场景中不成立，导致对齐不可靠、参考重建性能下降。
AI.method: 1) 提出DuFlowNet，专用双镜头光流估计器实现鲁棒跨视角对齐；2) 设计真实-合成数据融合策略，将合成前景物体合成到真实双镜头图像对上，无需光流真值标注即可生成可控大视差样本并保留真实跨相机成像特性；3) 观察到参考可靠性在空间上高度不均匀，提出互补参考变换策略（Complementary Reference Warping），依据局部参考可靠性协调基于patch的变换与无核引导的可变形变换；4) 构建DuSR-RealV2真实世界基准，包含复杂深度变化、大视差与遮挡。
AI.result: 在多个DuSR基准上的大量实验表明，DuSRFlow在重建质量、感知质量以及跨数据集泛化能力上均达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过从对应关系学习和参考聚合两方面改进参考利用，DuSRFlow有效解决了双镜头场景下光流假设失效与参考可靠性空间不均的问题，并借助新构建的挑战性真实基准验证了其优越性与泛化性。

title: From Candidate Tokens to Final Outcomes: Decoding Relative Long-Horizon Candidate Value from Reasoning Model Representations
summary: Large reasoning models generate reasoning trajectories token by token. At a given prefix, multiple next-token candidates may be plausible, yet shape subsequent reasoning and differ in their chances of leading to the correct answer. Whether these differences are reflected in internal representations remains unclear. To study this question, we define relative long-horizon candidate value to quantify within-prefix differences and construct the Reasoning Candidate-Token Value (RCTV) dataset, pairing mathematical reasoning prefixes with plausible next-token candidates and their empirical long-horizon candidate values. Using RCTV, we examine hidden states, multilayer perceptron outputs, and attention outputs at candidate positions with sparse linear probes. Experimental results provide evidence that relative long-horizon candidate value is linearly decodable from these representations at multiple layers. Candidate-value probes can also outperform probability- and embedding-based baselines. Furthermore, a controlled online intervention experiment shows that using the decoded signals to guide token selection during generation can improve the chances of eventual success. Our findings provide evidence that internal representations encode information about relative long-horizon candidate value, offering insights into how local candidate-level representations relate to long-horizon reasoning outcomes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"相对长程候选价值"概念并构建RCTV数据集，通过稀疏线性探针证明该价值可从大推理模型的隐藏状态、MLP输出和注意力输出中线性解码，且解码信号可用于在线干预以提升推理成功率。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型逐token生成推理轨迹，同一前缀下多个候选下一token可能都合理，但会塑造不同后续推理并导致不同的最终正确率。这种候选间的长程价值差异是否反映在模型内部表示中尚不清楚。
AI.method: (1) 定义相对长程候选价值，量化同一前缀内候选token之间的差异；(2) 构建RCTV数据集，将数学推理前缀与合理的下一token候选及其经验长程候选价值配对；(3) 在候选位置使用稀疏线性探针对隐藏状态、多层感知机输出和注意力输出进行探测；(4) 与基于概率和基于嵌入的基线对比；(5) 开展受控在线干预实验，用解码信号指导生成过程中的token选择。
AI.result: 相对长程候选价值在多个层级的表示中均可线性解码；候选价值探针优于概率与嵌入基线；用解码信号指导token选择的在线干预能提升最终推理成功的概率。
AI.conclusion: 内部表示中编码了关于相对长程候选价值的信息，揭示了局部候选级表示与长程推理结果之间的联系。

title: How Should a Camera-First AI Agent Work?
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Position/contract paper on time-critical camera-first agents (systems/timing).Primary cs.AI;
summary: Camera-first agents must act on the visual world as it unfolds. We argue that the central obstacle for future camera-first agents is not recognition ability - multimodal models (vision-language and live/streaming alike) generalize well through language and remain the right tool for semantic reasoning - but time. Many visual targets are ephemeral: they appear, are query-relevant, and leave within a short window. Binding memory to the same end-to-end path as reasoning means that by the time a monolithic pipeline completes, the evidence is gone. We formalize this as Ephemeral-Target Interaction (ETI) and a Perceptual Deadline Contract separating a hard memory deadline from a soft reasoning deadline, grounded in the bounded, passive nature of sensory and working memory. We propose a two-deadline architecture: an always-on, bounded, non-semantic fast path; an active remembering mechanism that commits a moment to durable memory before it is overwritten (event-driven in v1); and a deferred deliberation layer (multimodal model + tools). We instantiate the contract on real MOT17 track windows, a consistency check, and calibrate the single-path baseline from measured frontier-model latency: even a short answer takes 1.2-9.3 s, and an agentic identify-and-search longer. Answers can be late; evidence cannot be missed.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出相机优先智能体的核心瓶颈不是识别能力而是时间，提出"短暂目标交互"(ETI)问题与"感知截止契约"，并设计双截止架构：常开、有界、非语义的快路径；主动记忆机制将瞬间写入持久记忆；以及延迟的多模态推理层。在MOT17轨迹窗口上验证契约，并以实测前沿模型延迟（1.2–9.3秒）校准单路径基线。
AI.motivation: 相机优先智能体需在视觉世界实时展开时做出行动。许多视觉目标是短暂的：它们出现、与查询相关，并在短时间内消失。将记忆绑定到与推理相同的端到端路径上，会导致单块流水线完成时证据已消失。作者认为核心障碍是时间而非识别能力，多模态模型通过语言泛化良好，仍是语义推理的正确工具。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为短暂目标交互(Ephemeral-Target Interaction, ETI)与感知截止契约(Perceptual Deadline Contract)，将硬记忆截止与软推理截止分离，基于感官记忆与工作记忆的有界、被动特性。提出双截止架构：(1)常开、有界、非语义的快路径；(2)主动记忆机制，在被覆写前将某一时刻提交到持久记忆（v1为事件驱动）；(3)延迟的审议层（多模态模型+工具）。在真实MOT17轨迹窗口上实例化契约并进行一致性检查。
AI.result: 在MOT17轨迹窗口上实例化契约并完成一致性检查；根据实测的前沿模型延迟校准单路径基线，即使简短回答也需1.2–9.3秒，智能体式识别并搜索耗时更长。核心结论：答案可以迟到，证据不能错过。
AI.conclusion: 未来相机优先智能体的关键约束是时间而非识别能力；应通过双截止架构将硬记忆截止与软推理截止解耦，确保短暂证据在被覆写前被提交到持久记忆，而语义推理可延迟进行。答案可以迟到，证据不能错过。

title: Automatic assembly modeling through attention-based assembly feature mate prediction and assembly feature pattern recognition
summary:
Assembly modeling plays an important role in constructing product models, yet it is still mainly performed via interactive operations that are experience-dependent and labor-intensive. Data-driven strategies hold promise for automating this process; however, existing approaches either predict poses that cannot directly generate editable B-Rep assembly constraints or require prescribed part pairs or predefined assembly faces.
  To reduce the large candidate space of constraint prediction without predefined assembly faces, we propose a data-driven framework based on assembly feature mate prediction. The framework performs automatic assembly modeling from unassembled B-Rep parts, using assembly features to group the geometric entities of local mating interfaces and restrict candidate formation. Given the lack of suitable assembly feature annotations in existing datasets, we construct a large-scale dataset through an automatic annotation pipeline. Using the annotated dataset, we train an attention-based network to predict assembly feature mates, with Engineering Compatibility Fusion (ECF) incorporating explicit engineering compatibility into learned matching scores. To improve the accuracy of automatic assembly modeling, we use assembly feature patterns (AFPs) to guide the matching process. Finally, a post-processing search selects assembly feature mate and AFP mate candidates, whose associated constraints are generated and solved to complete assembly modeling.
  Experimental results show that the framework achieves assembly constraint accuracies of 74.79% on the six-assembly comparison set and 64.09% on the extended test set of 16 assemblies, which includes the comparison set. With ground-truth face labels supplied as additional input, the corresponding accuracies increase to 81.78% and 80.93%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于装配特征配合预测的数据驱动框架，实现从未装配B-Rep零件自动建模装配约束，并构建大规模自动标注数据集与注意力网络（含ECF与AFP引导），在六装配集与16装配扩展测试集上分别达到74.79%和64.09%的约束准确率，提供真实面标签时提升至81.78%和80.93%。
AI.motivation: 装配建模目前主要依赖人工交互，费时且依赖经验；现有数据驱动方法要么预测的位姿无法直接生成可编辑的B-Rep装配约束，要么需要预先指定零件对或预定义装配面，限制了自动化与通用性。因此需要一种无需预定义装配面的约束预测方法，以缩减庞大的候选空间。
AI.method: 提出基于装配特征配合（assembly feature mate）预测的数据驱动框架：从无装配的B-Rep零件出发，用装配特征对局部配合界面的几何实体进行分组，限制候选生成空间；由于现有数据集缺少装配特征标注，通过自动标注流水线构建大规模数据集；训练基于注意力的网络预测装配特征配合，并引入工程兼容性融合（ECF）将显式工程兼容性融入学习到的匹配分数；利用装配特征模式（AFP）引导匹配过程；最后通过后处理搜索选择装配特征配合与AFP配合候选，生成并求解相应约束以完成装配建模。
AI.result: 在六装配对比集上装配约束准确率为74.79%，在包含该对比集的16装配扩展测试集上为64.09%；当额外提供真实面标签（ground-truth face labels）作为输入时，准确率分别提升至81.78%和80.93%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架验证了以装配特征配合预测替代预定义装配面的可行性，可从未装配B-Rep零件自动生成并求解可编辑装配约束，在无需人工指定零件对或装配面的条件下取得较高约束准确率，且引入真实面标签后性能进一步提升。

title: Sensitivity or Criterion? Measuring and Moving When Language Models Act
summary: Before an agent acts, it must decide whether action is warranted. A single accuracy cannot distinguish failure to recognize a warranted action from reluctance to act. Signal-detection theory separates sensitivity from criterion, but criteria estimated from authored binary labels depend on each benchmark's example mix. We introduce FlipAct, a diagnostic of tool use in physical states. A rule over annotated tool properties computes each answer and a graded evidence score, fixing the Yes/No boundary at zero across models. Questions form 2-by-2 quads that hold required knowledge fixed while the state flips. The slope of the fitted Yes-rate curve measures sensitivity; its crossing at one half measures criterion. Across 44 open models, sensitivity rises with size within a family, and its ranking agrees with three of four external when-to-act benchmarks. Models respond to evidence sign rather than magnitude, accepting actions that leave the state no better about as often as helpful ones. When Yes means act, most models are conservative across rephrasings; in some, this partly reflects a preference for No. Criterion is not determined by size. Activation steering shifts criterion with weights fixed; distillation from a model's own steered copy puts the shift into its weights without a significant sensitivity change. The distilled shift transfers to six external benchmarks, including two without Yes/No answers, while criterion-free AUC is preserved on the five benchmarks where it is available. Accuracy improves where models start conservative and declines or remains within error where they start permissive. Project page: https://sixundong.com/projects/flipact

AI.tldr: 提出 FlipAct 诊断框架，将工具使用/行动决策分解为"敏感性"与"判定标准"两维，用翻转物理状态的 2×2 问题四组分离二者。44 个开源模型上，敏感性随规模上升、与多数外部基准排序一致；判定标准与规模无关，可通过激活引导或自蒸馏迁移至权重，并泛化到六个外部基准。
AI.motivation: 单一准确率无法区分"未识别出应当行动"与"倾向不行动"两类失败，而现有二进制标注基准估计的判定标准又受各基准样本构成影响，因此需要一个能解耦敏感性（能否识别可行动证据）与判定标准（行动门槛）的诊断方法。
AI.method: 构建 FlipAct：基于标注的工具属性规则计算答案及分级证据分数，将 Yes/No 边界固定在零（跨模型统一阈值）；问题按 2×2 四组设计，在保持所需知识不变的前提下翻转物理状态。对 Yes 率曲线做拟合，其斜率度量敏感性，其过零点（1/2 处）度量判定标准。另用激活引导在固定权重下移动判定标准，并自蒸馏到模型权重。
AI.result: 44 个开源模型中，族内敏感性随规模上升，排序与四个外部 when-to-act 基准中的三个一致；模型主要响应证据符号而非幅度，接受"无益行动"的频率与接受有益行动相近；当 Yes 代表行动时，多数模型在多种改写下偏保守，部分源于对 No 的偏好；判定标准与规模无关。激活引导可在权重不变下改变判定标准，自蒸馏可将该偏移写入权重且敏感性无显著变化。蒸馏后的偏移可迁移到六个外部基准（含两个无 Yes/No 答案者），在五个可用基准上保留与标准无关的 AUC；模型初始保守时准确率提升，初始宽松时下降或处于误差范围内。
AI.conclusion: 行动决策评估应分离敏感性与判定标准；判定标准是一种可独立操控、可迁移的属性，而非规模的函数，且可经引导与蒸馏稳定注入模型权重并泛化到外部任务。

title: ProgAgent: Learning Tool Orchestration through Programmatic Training
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to orchestrate diverse tools over long-horizon tasks. Existing agents typically use Direct Tool Calling (DTC), where the model invokes tools sequentially, and tool responses accumulate in the model context, which can lead to context rot and orchestration breakdown. In contrast, Programmatic Tool Calling (PTC) invokes tools through executable code and stores intermediate results in runtime variables rather than appending them to the context. Prior work has explored PTC mainly as an inference-time optimization, but its benefits for agentic training remain unclear, and suitable verifiable training tasks are scarce. In this work, we introduce ProgAgent, a full PTC training stack, comprising a pipeline for synthesizing verifiable long-horizon tasks, a lightweight PTC runtime, and a two-stage training recipe. Using only 215 tasks instantiated at four environment scales, ProgAgent yields higher pass rates than the evaluated baselines of comparable size across four benchmarks. On LOCA-bench, ProgAgent-14B achieves a 30.7% pass rate at a 64k-token environment state, where these baselines score zero. Cross-harness experiments show that PTC-trained models outperform DTC-trained models under both evaluation interfaces, suggesting that the benefits of PTC training extend beyond the interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ProgAgent，一个完整的程序化工具调用（PTC）训练栈，包含可验证长程任务合成流程、轻量级 PTC 运行时和两阶段训练方案。仅用 215 个任务即可让 14B 模型在四个基准上超越同规模基线，并在 LOCA-bench 64k 环境下达到 30.7% 通过率（基线为零）。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体多采用直接工具调用（DTC），即顺序调用工具并将响应累积进模型上下文，容易导致上下文腐化和编排崩溃。程序化工具调用（PTC）通过可执行代码调用工具、把中间结果存入运行时变量而非上下文，可缓解该问题。但此前工作主要将 PTC 视为推理时优化，其在智能体训练中的收益尚不明确，且缺乏合适的可验证训练任务。
AI.method: 提出 ProgAgent 全栈方案，包含三部分：（1）合成可验证长程任务的流程；（2）轻量级 PTC 运行时；（3）两阶段训练配方。训练任务仅 215 个，实例化于四种环境规模。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，ProgAgent 通过率高于同规模对比基线。在 LOCA-bench 上，64k token 环境状态时 ProgAgent-14B 达 30.7% 通过率，而基线得分为零。跨执行框架实验显示，PTC 训练模型在 DTC 与 PTC 两种评估接口下均优于 DTC 训练模型。
AI.conclusion: PTC 训练的收益不局限于接口本身，具有良好的迁移性，为长程智能体训练提供了高效的数据与训练范式。

title: Can Synthetic UAV Benchmarks Be Trusted? Real-Synthetic Validation for UAV Model Selection
summary: Synthetic UAV imagery can expand pre-deployment test evidence when task-specific Real data are scarce, but visual plausibility or semantic label alignment alone does not establish validity for model selection. We study when Synthetic evaluation preserves the model-selection conclusions obtained from Real UAV data through two complementary cases under fixed evaluation protocols. In a requirement-specific road-debris benchmark, four language-conditioned perception systems obtain lower absolute F1 on Synthetic data, yet the point-estimate ordering and top-ranked model are preserved; bootstrap analysis yields no supported pairwise reversal, and size-matched resampling preserves the top-model decision. In contrast, a closed-set stress test on a separately materialized business corpus, using four VisDrone-compatible detectors over eight empirically supported classes, changes the point-estimate top-ranked detector and reverses three of six pairwise point-estimate preference directions. A complementary audit of five UAV business scenarios further reveals substantial Real-Synthetic mismatch in class composition, object density, and target scale, including systematic under-representation of small targets. These results show that Synthetic UAV benchmark trust is conditional: semantic coverage is insufficient, and validity must be established empirically for the task, operating regime, and model panel of interest.

AI.tldr: 合成无人机影像可扩展部署前测试证据，但其评价能否保持真实数据下的模型选择结论是有条件的：语义覆盖不足以保证有效性，须针对具体任务、运行工况与模型集合进行实证检验。
AI.motivation: 真实任务相关数据稀缺，合成无人机影像常被用于扩充部署前测试证据；但仅凭视觉合理性或语义标签对齐，无法证明其可用于模型选择，因此需要研究合成评价在何种条件下能保持真实数据得到的模型选择结论。
AI.method: 在固定评价协议下开展两个互补案例：(1) 需求特定的道路碎片基准，比较四个语言条件感知系统的合成与真实评价，采用自举分析检验成对反转，并用规模匹配重采样检验最优模型决策；(2) 在独立构建的业务语料上进行闭集压力测试，使用四个VisDrone兼容检测器、八个有实证支持的类别，比较合成与真实的点估计排序与成对偏好方向。另对五个无人机业务场景进行审计，分析类别组成、目标密度与目标尺度的真实—合成失配。
AI.result: 道路碎片基准中，合成数据上四个系统的绝对F1较低，但点估计排序与最优模型保持一致；自举分析未发现被支持的成对反转，规模匹配重采样也保持最优模型决策。业务语料压力测试中，最优检测器发生改变，六个成对点估计偏好方向中有三个发生反转。审计进一步显示真实—合成在类别组成、目标密度与目标尺度上存在显著失配，包括小目标的系统性欠表征。
AI.conclusion: 合成无人机基准的可信度是条件性的：语义覆盖并不充分，其有效性必须针对所关注的任务、运行工况与模型集合进行实证验证，不能默认合成评价可替代真实数据用于模型选择。

title: AlphaPilot: Multi-Turn Tool-Using LLM Agents for Adaptive Alpha Mining with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Formulaic alpha mining seeks interpretable expressions that rank assets by future returns. The task is challenging because it demands simultaneous processing of unstructured market descriptions, historical data, and quantitative evaluation of candidate factors, yet most existing methods exploit only a subset of these signals. We introduce AlphaPilot, a reinforcement-learning framework that trains multi-turn tool-using LLM agents for adaptive alpha mining. The agent conditions on market descriptions, proposes factor expressions, queries real-data evaluator feedback, and updates a retained factor pool across turns. This design jointly leverages market text, LLM financial knowledge, real data, and evaluation feedback. At inference time, AlphaPilot performs day-by-day search and pool updates to adapt to shifting market regimes. Across three independent runs in out-of-sample rolling backtests on CSI300 and CSI500, AlphaPilot achieves mean total returns of 42.93% and 54.19%, with mean Sharpe ratios of 2.46 and 2.86, respectively. It attains the highest mean total return, Sharpe, and RankIC among the evaluated methods on both universes.

AI.tldr: AlphaPilot：基于强化学习的多轮工具调用LLM智能体框架，用于自适应公式化alpha挖掘，在CSI300与CSI500滚动回测中取得最高累计收益、Sharpe与RankIC。
AI.motivation: 公式化alpha挖掘需同时处理非结构化市场描述、历史数据与候选因子的量化评估，而现有方法通常只利用其中部分信号，难以胜任该挑战。
AI.method: 训练多轮工具使用的LLM智能体：以市场描述为条件提出因子表达式，查询真实数据评估器反馈，并在多轮中更新保留因子池，联合利用市场文本、LLM金融知识、真实数据与评估反馈；推理阶段逐日搜索并更新因子池以适应市场状态变化。
AI.result: 在CSI300与CSI500样本外滚动回测的三次独立运行中，平均总收益分别为42.93%和54.19%，平均Sharpe分别为2.46和2.86；在两个股票池上均取得所评估方法中最高的平均总收益、Sharpe和RankIC。
AI.conclusion: AlphaPilot通过强化学习驱动的多轮工具调用智能体，整合市场文本、真实数据与评估反馈，实现自适应alpha挖掘，并在样本外回测中优于对比方法。

title: LYNX: Analytical Program Synthesis via Grounding and Closed-Loop Refinement
summary: LLM-powered data analytics aims to translate natural language instructions into executable analytical programs over underlying data. However, existing approaches, whether treating LLMs as intent-to-code translators or as standalone analytical engines, often fail to reliably align domain semantics with complex schemas and heterogeneous metadata, resulting in brittle execution and semantically inconsistent analytical outputs in real-world workloads. We present LYNX, a multi-agent framework that formulates LLM-driven analytics as a schema- and knowledge-constrained analysis problem rather than a single-pass generation task. LYNX organizes analytical synthesis into a closed-loop workflow of planning, generation, verification, and refinement through three role-specialized agents that collaboratively enforce schema grounding, semantic consistency, and execution correctness. To address domain ambiguity and schema misalignment, LYNX integrates Semantic-Structural Distillation and Stage-Aware Allocation (SSD-SAA). A delta-guided iterative revision continuously diagnoses and repairs semantic and execution-level failures, substantially improving synthesis robustness. We evaluate LYNX on two NL-to-SQL benchmarks, BIRD-SQL Mini-Dev and the more challenging Spider 2.0-Lite. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance and efficiency, achieving 10.66% to 59.54% execution accuracy across lightweight and commercial models, while reducing token consumption by 70.53% compared with the prior most efficient method. Our framework displays high generalization over different backbones, from open-source, lightweight models to the latest commercial models. Additional case studies on quantitative finance analytics and complex multi-relational SQL workloads further demonstrate the framework's robustness, scalability, and practical applicability in real-world analytical scenarios.

AI.tldr: LYNX是一个多智能体框架，将LLM数据分析重构为受模式与知识约束的闭环分析问题（规划-生成-验证-精炼），在NL-to-SQL基准上显著提升执行准确率并大幅降低Token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM数据分析方法（将LLM视为意图到代码的翻译器或独立分析引擎）难以将领域语义与复杂模式及异构元数据可靠对齐，导致真实工作负载中执行脆弱、分析输出语义不一致，本质上是单次生成的范式缺陷。
AI.method: 提出LYNX多智能体框架，把LLM驱动分析表述为受模式与知识约束的分析问题。通过三个角色专门化智能体构建规划、生成、验证、精炼的闭环工作流，协同保障模式落地、语义一致与执行正确；引入语义-结构蒸馏与阶段感知分配（SSD-SAA）应对领域歧义和模式错位；采用delta引导的迭代修订持续诊断并修复语义与执行层面的失败。
AI.result: 在BIRD-SQL Mini-Dev与Spider 2.0-Lite两个NL-to-SQL基准上取得强性能与高效率：轻量级与商用模型上执行准确率达10.66%至59.54%，相比此前最高效方法Token消耗降低70.53%；对开源轻量模型到最新商用模型的多种骨干均展现良好泛化性。
AI.conclusion: LYNX验证了以约束式多智能体闭环替代单次生成的有效性；量化金融分析与复杂多关系SQL工作负载的案例研究进一步表明其鲁棒性、可扩展性及在真实分析场景中的实用价值。

title: TAG: Calibrating SAM3 for Universal Image Segmentation without Dense Supervision
summary: The recent Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) extends powerful promptable segmentation from spatial cues to concepts, raising the prospect of a single foundation model for universal image segmentation. However, this promise often fails to translate into reliable performance on downstream segmentation tasks. In this work, we empirically identify concept recognition, rather than mask quality, as the primary bottleneck: SAM3 accurately delineates the objects it recognizes yet struggles to robustly determine which concepts are present. Driven by this, we present \textit{\underline{T}ext \underline{A}nchor re-\underline{G}rounding (\TAG{})}, a simple yet effective framework that rectifies the concept recognition of SAM3 on the target domain without dense annotations. Specifically, \TAG{} introduces an \textit{Anchor Residual Pathway} comprising image-conditioned, low-rank adapters to re-ground text anchors in the target distribution and modulate subsequent text-conditioned interactions. Guided solely by image-level category labels, \TAG{} jointly optimizes binary cross-entropy with \textit{Soft Boundary Ranking} objectives to calibrate presence confidence and distinguish present concepts from confusable negatives. Building upon this, we devise \textit{Confidence-Weighted Distillation} to couple rich semantic context of a multimodal large language model with fine-grained spatial priors of SAM3, thereby achieving effective calibration in the absence of manual annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \TAG{} unlocks SAM3's segmentation potential with only 3.1M trainable parameters, achieving impressive performance across diverse scenarios, and notably, even surpassing leading mask-supervised methods on several metrics. \href{https://github.com/MiSsU-HH/TAG_SAM3}{Our code will be publicly available at GitHub \faGithub}.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别出SAM3在下游分割任务中的主要瓶颈是"概念识别"而非"掩码质量"，并提出TAG框架，仅用图像级标签即可纠正SAM3的概念识别，以3.1M可训练参数实现显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: SAM3将可提示分割从空间线索扩展到概念层面，有望成为通用图像分割的基础模型，但其在下游任务中往往无法转化为可靠性能。作者通过实证发现，瓶颈在于概念识别而非掩码质量——SAM3能精确勾勒已识别的目标，却难以稳健判断哪些概念实际存在。
AI.method: 提出TAG（Text Anchor re-Grounding）框架：1）引入Anchor Residual Pathway，由图像条件化的低秩适配器构成，用于在目标分布上重新锚定文本锚点并调制后续的文本条件交互；2）仅以图像级类别标签为监督，联合优化二元交叉熵与Soft Boundary Ranking目标，校准存在性置信度并区分真实存在概念与易混淆负类；3）设计Confidence-Weighted Distillation，将多模态大语言模型的丰富语义上下文与SAM3的细粒度空间先验耦合，在无人工标注情况下实现有效校准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TAG仅用3.1M可训练参数即释放了SAM3的分割潜力，在多样场景中取得出色性能，并在若干指标上超越了领先的掩码监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 概念识别是限制SAM3下游分割性能的关键因素，TAG通过文本锚点重新锚定与置信度加权蒸馏，可在无密集标注条件下有效校准概念识别，验证了轻量适配即可解锁SAM3的通用分割能力。

title: Concept Representations in Vector Space: Quantifying Sharedness and Idiosyncrasy of Meaning
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures. Preprint under review at Open Mind: Discoveries in Cognitive Science. Data, code and pre-registration: https://osf.io/dc6an
summary: Concepts are the basic units through which we navigate the world and communicate meaning. But do you and I really mean the same thing when we think or speak about a concept? The present study develops a measurement framework for modeling and analyzing interindividual variation in concept representations through sentence embeddings, dense vector representations mapping entire utterances into a shared geometric space. The framework is developed in a theoretical argument and validated, demonstrated, and subjected to robustness checks in a pre-registered study. Short personal definitions, elicited from $N = 125$ participants, are encoded as sentence embeddings and submitted pairwise to a crossed random effects model yielding two concept-level quantities: sharedness ($S_b$), the expected dissimilarity between two randomly drawn individuals, and idiosyncrasy ($I_b$), the person-specific share of total dyadic variance. Two validity tests support the approach: the embedding space fully recovers concept and domain organization from participant definitions even with the target word excluded, and a parameter-free classifier achieves 0.630 accuracy in a within-participant extensional prediction task against a chance baseline of 0.500 and a consistency ceiling of 0.893. The framework finds theoretically interpretable variation in $S_b$ and establishes $I_b$ as a reliable source of dyadic variance across concepts. Results replicate across three encoders varying in architecture and capacity, providing a reproducible and scalable instrument for the empirical study of meaning variation.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个基于句嵌入的测量框架，用于建模和分析概念表征的个体间差异，并通过预注册研究验证其有效性与稳健性。
AI.motivation: 概念是人类理解世界和交流意义的基本单位，但不同个体对同一概念的理解可能存在差异。现有研究缺乏可扩展、可复现的工具来量化这种个体间概念表征变异。
AI.method: 从125名参与者处收集简短的个人定义，编码为句嵌入，并以配对方式输入交叉随机效应模型，得到两个概念层面指标：共享度（S_b，随机抽取两人之间的期望不相似度）和特异性（I_b，个体特异性的二元方差占比）。
AI.result: 嵌入空间在排除目标词的情况下仍能完整恢复概念和领域组织；无参数分类器在参与者内扩展预测任务中达到0.630准确率（随机基线0.500，一致性上限0.893）；S_b呈现理论可解释的变异，I_b是概念间二元方差的可靠来源；结果在三种不同架构和容量的编码器上均可复现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为意义变异的实证研究提供了可复现且可扩展的测量工具，确立了共享度和特异性作为刻画概念表征个体差异的有效指标。

title: Counterfactual Regret for Reflective Agents with Lean-Verified Guarantees
summary: Reflective language agents reuse feedback and memory to adapt across tasks without updating model weights. However, existing guarantees for policy selection and action generation do not by themselves establish when local reflection yields long-term performance guarantees for the complete agent under resource constraints. In this paper, we address this gap by deriving sufficient conditions for sublinear counterfactual regret from local generation and deployment guarantees, while retaining the native controller. Specifically, we establish a resource-sensitive transfer that bounds full-state deployment discrepancies along actual execution paths and preserves the own-history laws of both learner and comparator. Besides, local generation reliability yields a cumulative generation opportunity bound, linking policy acquisition to long-term performance through an explicit quality, coverage, and hard-budget tradeoff. To verify these guarantees, we formalize the conditional proof chain for all thirteen numbered theoretical results in Lean, including a native instance with repeated policy growth and imperfect validation.

AI.tldr: 本文将反思语言智能体的长期性能保证归约为反事实遗憾，从局部生成与部署保证推导出次线性反事实遗憾的充分条件，并在Lean中形式化验证了全部十三条理论结果。
AI.motivation: 反思型语言智能体在不更新模型权重的情况下复用反馈与记忆以跨任务适应，但现有关于策略选择与动作生成的保证本身并不能说明：在资源约束下，局部反思何时能为完整智能体带来长期性能保证。论文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 在保留原生控制器（native controller）的前提下，建立从局部生成与部署保证到次线性反事实遗憾的充分条件。具体包括：（1）资源敏感的迁移界，约束实际执行路径上的全状态部署差异，并保持学习器与比较器各自的自身历史律（own-history laws）；（2）由局部生成可靠性得到的累积生成机会界，通过显式的质量—覆盖—硬预算权衡，将策略获取与长期性能联系起来。此外，使用Lean对全部十三条编号理论结果的条件证明链进行形式化验证，并包含一个具有重复策略增长与不完美验证的原生实例。
AI.result: 推导出次线性反事实遗憾的充分条件；获得资源敏感迁移界与累积生成机会界两项核心结果；明确给出质量、覆盖与硬预算之间的显式权衡关系；并在Lean中形式化验证了全部十三条理论结果，包括带重复策略增长和不完美验证的原生实例。
AI.conclusion: 局部反思可在资源约束下为完整反思语言智能体提供长期性能保证，其充要路径由资源敏感迁移界与累积生成机会界共同刻画，并已通过Lean形式化验证获得机器可检查的支撑。

title: Prospective Forcing: Learning to Look Ahead for Autoregressive Long Video Diffusion
summary: Autoregressive video generators synthesize long videos through chunk-wise rollouts, yet they are typically trained to predict only the immediate future. This limited prediction horizon makes it challenging to maintain video quality over extended rollouts. To address this problem, we introduce Prospective Forcing, a multi-head prediction framework that injects long-range predictive signals into autoregressive video representations. Built on a rolling-window generator, Prospective Forcing attaches lightweight, offset-specific heads that share the same conditioning information and independently predict chunks at different future temporal offsets. By extending supervision beyond the next chunk, these heads encourage the shared history representation to retain information useful for longer-horizon prediction, supporting temporally consistent generation. At inference time, we accelerate sampling by using accepted future-chunk predictions to skip full-window backbone executions. We equip the head with learnable embeddings to generate multiple candidates for the next chunk, and a learned verifier either selects a candidate or rejects all and falls back to standard autoregressive generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Prospective Forcing，一种多头预测框架，通过向自回归视频表征注入长程预测信号，提升长视频生成质量并加速采样。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成器通过分块滚动合成视频，但通常只训练预测紧邻的下一块（immediate future）。有限的预测视野导致在长时间滚动生成中难以维持视频质量，即长程时间一致性差。
AI.method: 基于滚动窗口生成器，构建 Prospective Forcing 框架：挂载轻量级、偏移特定的预测头（offset-specific heads），共享相同的条件信息，分别独立预测不同未来时间偏移处的视频块。监督信号超越下一块，迫使共享历史表征保留对更长视野预测有用的信息。推理阶段，利用被接受的未来块预测跳过后端全窗口执行以加速采样；预测头配备可学习嵌入以生成下一块的多个候选，再由学习到的验证器选择某一候选，或全部拒绝并回退到标准自回归生成。
AI.result: 多头长程监督鼓励共享历史表征保留长程预测所需信息，支持时间一致的生成；推理时借助被接受的未来块预测跳过后端计算，实现采样加速。
AI.conclusion: Prospective Forcing 通过扩展监督视野至多偏移未来，缓解自回归视频生成预测视野有限的问题，兼顾长时视频质量与推理效率。

title: REPRO: Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimizer for Automated LLM Red-Teaming
summary:
Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial prompts that bypass their safety training. Existing automated red-teaming methods either require privileged access unavailable in production, rely on manually engineered per-model templates, or optimize a single objective without population-level diversity. We present REPRO (Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimization), a pure black-box framework that discovers adversarial prompts through evolutionary optimization driven entirely by a compressed open-weight 7B reflective model on a single consumer GPU. REPRO introduces two mechanisms absent from prior work, both isolated in a component ablation: semantic crossover, an LLM-guided multi-parent recombination operator, and Bayesian strategy selection via Thompson Sampling informed by structured failure analysis.
  We catalog REPRO's behavior on AdvBench, JailbreakBench, and HarmBench across 36 target models from 11 families, including GPT-5-nano, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and Grok-4.1. Under our protocol REPRO reaches 100\% attack success rate (ASR) on every evaluated target in a single turn, at a median of 24 target queries per behavior. Two properties of the protocol qualify that figure. The judge scoring candidates during optimization also produces the reported ASR, and search halts when it accepts, so ASR reports whether search succeeded within the iteration budget rather than success at a fixed budget. All baseline figures are transcribed from their original papers, which use different judges, budgets, and model versions. We therefore present this as a catalog of model coverage under one protocol rather than a head-to-head ranking, and develop both qualifications in the paper.

AI.tldr: 提出REPRO：纯黑盒进化式对抗提示优化框架，仅用单张消费级GPU上的7B开源反思模型驱动，含语义交叉与Thompson采样策略选择两机制；在36个目标模型上单轮ASR达100%，中位24次查询/行为。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化红队方法存在三类局限：需要生产环境不具备的特权访问、依赖逐模型人工设计模板、或仅优化单一目标而缺乏种群级多样性。因此需要一个无需特权、无需人工模板、且具备种群多样性的纯黑盒框架。
AI.method: REPRO（Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimization）为纯黑盒进化优化框架，由压缩的7B开源反思模型在单张消费级GPU上全程驱动。引入两个新机制并通过组件消融分别隔离验证：一是语义交叉（semantic crossover），即LLM引导的多父代重组算子；二是基于Thompson采样的贝叶斯策略选择，由结构化失败分析提供信息。
AI.result: 在AdvBench、JailbreakBench和HarmBench上，覆盖11个家族共36个目标模型（含GPT-5-nano、Claude-3.5-Sonnet、Gemini-2.5-Pro、Grok-4.1）。在作者协议下，REPRO对每个评估目标单轮即达100%攻击成功率（ASR），中位数为每行为24次目标查询。
AI.conclusion: 100% ASR需两项限定：优化中用于评分的judge同时产出所报ASR；搜索在被接受时即停止，故ASR反映的是迭代预算内搜索是否成功，而非固定预算下的成功率。基线数据均转自原论文，其judge、预算与模型版本各异，故本文定位为同一协议下的模型覆盖目录而非直接对比排名，两项限定在正文中展开讨论。

title: GREAT-ESDD: Graph Edge Attention Network for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions
summary: Online, same-day delivery requires operators to constantly update their routes, and the routing cost for deliveries increases with the number of customers. Out-of-home (OOH) delivery options can help companies handle increasing customer numbers while keeping delivery costs low. We develop a dynamic pricing-and-routing framework for this online ordering scenario with home and OOH delivery options. First, we develop a neural solver for the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) based on the Graph-Edge-Attention-Network (GREAT). We train it to solve CVRP with varying instance sizes and starting conditions, allowing it to reoptimize partially executed routes under changing conditions. It is fast while achieving solution quality competitive with traditional baselines. Our solver processes several CVRP instances in parallel in batches and we use it to solve the candidate routing problems that arise from an incoming customer's choice of home or OOH delivery. This provides an estimate of the delivery cost increase per option, which we use to set dynamic prices. Further, it directly provides the updated route once the customer decides. We trade off delivery fees against routing costs and steer customers toward OOH delivery when home delivery would be costly. However, effective steering requires us to know the customer preferences. To learn those online, we use Thompson sampling with a Laplace-approximated posterior. We call the resulting framework GREAT-ESDD (GREAT for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions). Compared to a traditional routing solver, it increases profit by around 11% under a similar pricing decision time budget. Moreover, we show that we can estimate customer preferences successfully, outperforming a static pricing strategy after only 5 days of simulated operations.

AI.tldr: 提出GREAT-ESDD框架，结合图神经网络CVRP求解器与汤普森采样动态定价，引导客户选择OOH配送以提升利润。
AI.motivation: 在线同日达配送中，路由成本随客户数量增加而上升；引入户外（OOH）配送选项可在客户规模扩大时控制成本，但需在动态定价与路径优化间权衡，并在线学习客户偏好以实现有效引导。
AI.method: 基于Graph-Edge-Attention-Network构建CVRP神经求解器，训练以处理不同规模与起始条件，可对部分执行路径重优化；批量并行求解客户选择家庭或OOH配送产生的候选路径问题，估计各选项的配送成本增量并据此设定动态价格；采用拉普拉斯近似后验的汤普森采样在线学习客户偏好。
AI.result: 在相近定价决策时间预算下，相比传统路径求解器利润提升约11%；模拟运营仅5天后即可成功估计客户偏好，优于静态定价策略。
AI.conclusion: GREAT-ESDD能有效权衡配送费与路由成本、引导客户选择OOH配送，并快速在线学习偏好，实现利润提升与成本控制。

title: TGuide: Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Historical Trajectory Guidance
summary: Can autoregressive video diffusion be accelerated further when only four denoising steps remain? Existing feature caching approaches struggle in this regime, as large feature changes between denoising timesteps undermine both direct reuse and lightweight predictors. We observe that features across video chunks remain strongly correlated at matching denoising timesteps, offering a complementary source of guidance. Building on this insight, we introduce TGuide, a framework that accelerates autoregressive video diffusion through a lightweight Anchor-Transport-Correct (ATC) predictor guided by historical sampling trajectories. Our ATC combines two complementary references: the current chunk's preceding-step features preserve its spatial structure, while the previous chunk's same-timestep features provide information at the target denoising stage. By integrating these references through spatial retrieval and adaptive correction, ATC improves velocity prediction accuracy despite the large gaps between denoising steps. To mitigate error accumulation across both denoising steps and video chunks, we train the predictor on its own autoregressive rollouts, allowing it to adapt to states shaped by its own earlier predictions. An optional confidence-aware scheduler further adjusts the quality-efficiency trade-off. Experiments on Self Forcing, Causal Forcing, and HY-WorldPlay show that TGuide preserves generation quality while achieving denoising speedups of up to $1.89\times$ over the original 4-step generators. On Self Forcing, TGuide generalizes from 81-frame training videos to 333-frame generation, approximately four times the training length, while exceeding the original model's VBench score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TGuide 框架，利用历史采样轨迹中的跨视频块特征相关性，通过轻量级 Anchor-Transport-Correct（ATC）预测器加速自回归视频扩散，在仅剩 4 步去噪时仍可提速至 1.89×。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散在仅剩少量去噪步骤（如 4 步）时，现有特征缓存方法因去噪时间步之间特征变化剧烈，导致直接复用与轻量预测器均失效。作者观察到：在相同去噪时间步上，不同视频块之间的特征仍保持强相关性，可作为互补的引导信息来源。
AI.method: 提出 TGuide 框架，核心是轻量级 Anchor-Transport-Correct（ATC）预测器，由历史采样轨迹引导。ATC 融合两类互补参考：当前块前一步特征（保留空间结构）与上一块同时间步特征（提供目标去噪阶段信息），并通过空间检索与自适应校正整合，提升大步长下的速度预测精度。为缓解去噪步与视频块双重的误差累积，使用预测器自身的自回归 rollout 进行训练，使其适应由自身早期预测形成的状态；另设可选的置信度感知调度器调节质量-效率权衡。
AI.result: 在 Self Forcing、Causal Forcing 与 HY-WorldPlay 上的实验表明，TGuide 在保持生成质量的同时，相对原始 4 步生成器最高实现 1.89× 的去噪加速。在 Self Forcing 上，TGuide 可从 81 帧训练视频泛化至 333 帧（约 4 倍训练长度）生成，且 VBench 得分超过原模型。
AI.conclusion: 跨视频块在匹配去噪时间步上的特征相关性为少步自回归视频扩散加速提供了有效互补信号；ATC 预测器结合自回归 rollout 训练与置信度感知调度，可在极低步数下兼顾速度与质量并支持长序列泛化。

title: A Step in the Right Place: Understanding and Optimizing Timestep Placement in Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Continuous diffusion language models represent an emerging paradigm for language modeling. They generate text in parallel by iteratively refining continuous representations and mapping them back to tokens through a decoder. However, realizing the efficiency advantage of parallel generation requires maintaining generation quality with only a few denoising steps. Even when the number of steps is fixed, their placement along the denoising trajectory remains flexible. In this paper, we demonstrate that changing timestep placement alone can substantially alter the final latent representations and thereby affect the decoded token distributions. Building on these findings, we introduce StepTune, an algorithm that searches for timestep placements that improve generation quality. The search is conducted on a small calibration set and guided by a language-aware objective, with the model and sampling budget fixed. Once calibrated, the timestep placement is fixed and reused across inputs. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in unconditional generation perplexity and conditional task metrics across all evaluated sampling budgets. In particular, StepTune enables 16-step sampling with a frozen model to outperform its native 64-step baseline on both XSum summarization and WMT14 translation and reduces end-to-end latency by approximately $3.8\times$. These results establish timestep placement as a practical means of improving the quality-efficiency trade-off in continuous diffusion language models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出StepTune，通过在固定去噪步数预算下搜索最优时间步放置，提升连续扩散语言模型的生成质量与效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型通过迭代细化连续表示并解码为token来并行生成文本，但要实现并行生成的效率优势，需在少量去噪步数下保持生成质量。即使步数固定，时间步在去噪轨迹上的放置仍具灵活性，而这一自由度此前未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: 作者首先证明仅改变时间步放置就能显著改变最终潜表示，进而影响解码token分布。据此提出StepTune：在小型校准集上进行搜索，以语言感知目标为导向，在模型与采样预算固定的条件下寻找更优的时间步放置；校准完成后该时间步放置被固定并跨输入复用。
AI.result: 在评估的所有采样预算下，StepTune在无条件生成困惑度和条件任务指标上均取得一致提升。特别是使用冻结模型进行16步采样时，在XSum摘要与WMT14翻译任务上均超越其原生64步基线，并降低端到端延迟约3.8倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，时间步放置是改善连续扩散语言模型质量-效率权衡的一种实用手段。

title: CESNET-TimeSeries26: A Multi-Year Network Traffic Time Series Dataset for Annual Seasonality, Concept Drift, and Long-Term Anomaly Detection
summary: Forecast-based models are fundamental to network traffic management and anomaly detection. However, it is essential to evaluate these forecasting models over extended periods of time in order to assess their adaptability to unexpected phenomena and shifts in underlying patterns. This kind of long-term evaluation requires multi-year data to account for yearly seasonality and behavioral drift. Existing public datasets are too short to support such long-horizon forecasting tasks. We introduce CESNET-TimeSeries26, comprising 995 days of continuous traffic time series from the CESNET3 network, together with a single subnet spanning approximately 4.5 years. The dataset captures 278,466 IP addresses, 285 institutions, and 566 institutional subnets at three aggregation intervals. The dataset provides a definitive longitudinal benchmark for evaluating forecasting models in both operational management and security monitoring. We demonstrate that annual seasonality is the dominant periodic component. Moreover, we show that a forecasting model can exploit the annual component only when its training window covers at least one complete annual cycle, which no sub-year dataset provides.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了 CESNET-TimeSeries26，包含 995 天连续的 CESNET3 网络流量时间序列及约 4.5 年的单子网数据，用于支持长期网络流量预测基准评估。
AI.motivation: 现有网络流量预测模型缺乏长期评估，难以反映其对突发事件和底层模式漂移的适应能力；长期评估需要跨越多年数据以涵盖年度季节性和行为漂移，而现有公开数据集时长过短。
AI.method: 构建 CESNET-TimeSeries26 数据集：来自 CESNET3 网络 995 天连续流量时间序列，另含约 4.5 年单子网数据；覆盖 278,466 个 IP 地址、285 个机构、566 个机构子网，提供三种聚合间隔；并分析年度季节性及训练窗口对预测模型利用年度分量的影响。
AI.result: 数据集为运营管理和安全监控中的预测模型提供纵向基准；分析表明年度季节性是主导周期成分；预测模型只有在训练窗口至少覆盖一个完整年度周期时才能利用年度分量，而现有不足一年的数据集无法满足这一条件。
AI.conclusion: CESNET-TimeSeries26 弥补了长期网络流量预测评测数据不足的问题，可作为评估模型适应性和年度季节性建模能力的标准化纵向基准。

title: TETRIS-4DGS: Efficient Post-Training Compression of 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) has emerged as a powerful dynamic scene representation, supporting real-time high quality rendering but suffers from prohibitive storage overhead. Existing methods typically attempt to solve this by treating compression as a per-scene optimization problem, limiting generalizability and applicability where low-latency compression is required. In this work, we leverage existing image and video codecs and propose a generalized post-training compression framework for 4DGS to address these issues. Specifically, we apply importance-based adaptive quantization to Gaussians according to their importance levels, effectively refining bitrate allocation while remaining fully compatible with existing codecs. To further improve compression efficiency, we utilize the statistical properties of 4DGS and propose motion- and importance-aware packing to reorganize attributes into codec-friendly 2D maps. Our approach can achieve over 40x compression rate in seconds while maintaining high quality, facilitating the practical deployment of 4DGS.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向4D高斯泼溅（4DGS）的通用后训练压缩框架，基于现有图像/视频编解码器，通过重要性自适应量化与运动/重要性感知打包，在数秒内实现40倍以上压缩且保持高质量。
AI.motivation: 4DGS支持实时高质量动态场景渲染，但存储开销过大。现有方法将压缩视为逐场景（per-scene）优化问题，泛化性差，难以满足低延迟压缩需求。
AI.method: 1) 复用现有图像与视频编解码器，构建通用后训练（post-training）压缩框架；2) 依据高斯的重要性等级进行重要性自适应量化，优化比特分配，且与现有编解码器完全兼容；3) 利用4DGS的统计特性，提出运动与重要性感知的打包（packing），将属性重排为利于编解码器的2D图。
AI.result: 在保持高质量的前提下，数秒内可实现超过40倍的压缩率。
AI.conclusion: 该通用后训练压缩框架有效缓解4DGS存储瓶颈，兼顾泛化性与低延迟，推动4DGS的实际部署。

title: Apertus 1.5: From Open Text Models to Open Multimodal Reasoners
summary: Language models are becoming infrastructure, and infrastructure built in the open, by public institutions, on documented data, is the alternative to dependence on a few providers; Apertus shows this is viable at scale. Apertus 1.5 extends the fully open Apertus family from text to multimodal reasoning. Continued pretraining of the Apertus 1.0 models, on 4T additional tokens for the 8B and 2T for the 70B, adds image and audio understanding and extends the context window fourfold to 262,144 tokens; multimodality enters through the tokenizer, the language-model head remains restricted to text, and the architecture is unchanged. Supervised finetuning, long-context finetuning, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, and preference alignment complete the released models. Thinking is a flag of the chat template rather than a separate model, and lifts mathematical reasoning by up to 20 points on the 8B model. The released models improve over their predecessors on nearly every benchmark; among fully open models of its class, the 8B leads on knowledge, instruction following, and cultural benchmarks, and its instruction following surpasses all compared models, including open-weight ones. On image and audio understanding, a first for the family, the models are competitive with fully open multimodal models, strongest on document understanding and long-form and lower-resource speech recognition, while specialized vision and audio models remain ahead on perception and transcription of English and other high-resource languages. As in Apertus 1.0, we train only on openly available data, respect crawler opt-outs retroactively, and exclude restrictively licensed material. We release the model weights, data preparation and training recipes, and evaluation suites under permissive licenses; openness extends to values, with the Apertus charter guiding alignment stages published alongside the models.

AI.tldr: Apertus 1.5 将完全开放的 Apertus 系列从文本扩展到多模态推理：在 Apertus 1.0 基础上继续预训练（8B 增加 4T token、70B 增加 2T token），引入图像与音频理解并将上下文窗口扩展四倍至 262,144 token，随后经监督微调、长上下文微调、可验证奖励强化学习与偏好对齐，在知识、指令跟随、文化基准及文档理解、长时与低资源语音识别上表现突出。
AI.motivation: 语言模型正成为基础设施，而在开放环境中由公共机构基于有据可查的数据构建的基础设施，是摆脱对少数供应商依赖的替代方案；Apertus 1.0 已证明这一路径在大规模下可行，本文旨在将这一完全开放的路线从文本推进到多模态推理。
AI.method: 在 Apertus 1.0 上继续预训练（8B 增加 4T token，70B 增加 2T token），新增图像与音频理解并将上下文窗口扩展四倍至 262,144 token；多模态通过 tokenizer 引入，语言模型 head 仍限定为文本，架构保持不变。训练流程包括监督微调、长上下文微调、可验证奖励强化学习与偏好对齐；思考能力作为 chat template 的标志而非独立模型实现。
AI.result: 所发布模型在几乎所有基准上优于前代；在同级完全开放模型中，8B 在知识、指令跟随与文化基准上领先，其指令跟随超过所有对比模型（含开放权重模型）；多模态方面（系列首次）与完全开放多模态模型相当，在文档理解、长时与低资源语音识别上最强，但在英语及高资源语言的感知与转写方面，专用视觉与音频模型仍更优。思考标志使 8B 数学推理最高提升 20 分。
AI.conclusion: 与 Apertus 1.0 一致，仅使用公开可获取数据训练，追溯尊重爬虫退出机制，排除限制性许可材料；在宽松许可下发布模型权重、数据准备与训练配方及评测套件，并以 Apertus 章程指导对齐阶段，使开放性延伸至价值观层面。

title: ASIWorld: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents in a Persistent Survival Sandbox
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Project website: https://asigameworld.github.io/
summary: Evaluating autonomous agents requires examining whether they can translate goals into coherent action across extended interactions. In persistent environments, this requires coordinating interdependent actions under incomplete observations, accounting for delayed effects, and adapting as earlier decisions shape subsequent opportunities. We introduce ASIWorld, a survival sandbox that combines persistent world and character state with character-scoped observations and a programmable asynchronous interface to study sustained goal execution. Agents pursue interdependent production and exploration tasks through direct actions or agent-authored programs that continue running between model calls. The evaluation assesses task success, the attainment of development achievements, and survival costs, complemented by an analysis of execution behavior. In an exploratory study of nine agent configurations using a common harness, eight complete the production task and six complete both tasks. Analyses of execution trajectories and performance across difficulty levels reveal different preparation, combat, and recovery behaviors among configurations with similar task outcomes. Incomplete preparation is associated with stalled progression, while configurations that complete the tasks differ in survival costs and the fulfillment of additional achievement criteria. These findings illustrate the value of assessing sustained goal execution through both task outcomes and the behaviors and costs associated with achieving them.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ASIWorld 生存沙盒环境，用于评估自主智能体在持续环境中的长程目标执行能力，通过任务成功、发展成就与生存代价多维指标，揭示相似任务结果下行为差异。
AI.motivation: 评估自主智能体需考察其能否在长程交互中把目标转化为连贯行动。持续环境要求在不完整观测下协调相互依赖的动作、处理延迟效应，并随早期决策改变后续机会而自适应，现有评估难以刻画这种持续目标执行能力。
AI.method: 构建 ASIWorld 生存沙盒：持久化的世界与角色状态、以角色为范围的观测、可编程异步接口；智能体通过直接动作或可在模型调用间隙持续运行的自治程序，完成相互依赖的生产与探索任务。评估任务成功率、发展成就达成度与生存代价，并辅以执行行为分析。以统一测试框架对九种智能体配置开展探索性研究。
AI.result: 九种配置中，八种完成生产任务，六种同时完成两项任务；执行轨迹与不同难度下的表现分析显示，任务结果相近的配置在准备、战斗与恢复行为上存在差异；准备不充分与进程停滞相关，完成任务的不同配置在生存代价与额外成就标准达成度上亦有差别。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明，评估持续目标执行应同时关注任务结果以及达成过程中的行为与代价，而非仅依赖最终成败指标。

title: SPARE: Shared Perception and Adaptive Retrieval of Evidence for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding requires answering questions from the observed video, with evidence drawn from recent observations or earlier events. Historical context can improve recall but may interfere with judgments based on recent frames. Its usefulness depends on both when it is introduced and which clips are selected, while relevance alone does not guarantee sufficient evidence for an answer. We propose SPARE, a framework that combines adaptive historical retrieval with visual encoder sharing. A lightweight gate predicts whether recent observations provide sufficient evidence to answer the question. When additional evidence is predicted to be necessary, a multimodal embedding model retrieves relevant historical clips to supplement the current context. LoRA instruction tuning trains the understanding model to use recent observations and retrieved history jointly and abstain when the evidence remains insufficient. To reduce redundant visual parameters, the understanding and retrieval branches share a visual encoder while retaining separate language backbones. Four linear adapters align the shared features with the retrieval model through distillation at the visual token and final retrieval embedding levels. With visual-only inputs, SPARE achieves 77.78% on the evaluated Real-time and Backward task groups of OVO-Bench and 73.31% on StreamingBench. Compared with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct evaluated at 2 fps, SPARE improves accuracy by 20.68 percentage points on OVO-Bench and 14.15 percentage points on StreamingBench.

AI.tldr: SPARE 通过自适应历史检索与视觉编码器共享，提升流式视频理解性能，在 OVO-Bench 和 StreamingBench 上显著超越 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解既需依赖近期帧，也可能需要早期事件证据；历史上下文可提升召回，但也可能干扰基于近期帧的判断，其有效性取决于引入时机与片段选择，且"相关"并不等于"证据充分"。
AI.method: 提出 SPARE 框架：用轻量门控预测近期观测是否足以回答，不足时由多模态嵌入模型检索相关历史片段补充上下文；用 LoRA 指令微调使理解模型联合利用近期观测与检索历史，并在证据不足时弃答；理解与检索分支共享视觉编码器但保留独立语言骨干，并用四个线性适配器通过视觉 token 与最终检索嵌入层面的蒸馏对齐共享特征。
AI.result: 仅用视觉输入时，SPARE 在 OVO-Bench 的 Real-time 与 Backward 任务组达 77.78%，在 StreamingBench 达 73.31%；相比以 2 fps 评估的 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，分别提升 20.68 和 14.15 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 自适应历史检索结合视觉编码器共享，可在不增加冗余视觉参数的前提下有效增强流式视频理解，并带来显著精度提升。

title: An Interpretable Linguistically-Grounded Analysis of Scene Saliency in Movie Screenplays
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Main Track, Long Paper
summary: We investigate the factors affecting salience in movie screenplay by posing two research questions: 1. {\em Does Uniform Information Density (UID) predict salient scenes?} 2. {\em What other linguistic properties distinguish salient scenes from non-salient background?} We answer both questions through a controlled corpus study on the MENSA corpus, paired with a Linguistically-Grounded Salience Model (LGSM), a dual-stream classifier that fuses a frozen BERT encoder with explicit linguistic features through adaptive gating. The UID picture is layered in long-form discourse. Per-scene UID summaries carry no independent signal once length is controlled, but at the token level salient scenes match non-salient material in the bulk while specifically suppressing the rarest, hardest-to-predict tokens in the upper tail. UID therefore lives at the within-scene token level rather than as a per-scene aggregate. Salient scenes also show a moderate and sustained cast of central characters (following an inverted-U pattern), strong third-person usage, syntactically simpler language, and more abstract vocabulary about motivation and conflict. LGSM exploits this signature and improves recall on salient scenes over a strong semantic baseline while yielding better downstream summaries.

AI.tldr: 本文围绕电影剧本"显著性"的成因，提出两个研究问题：均匀信息密度（UID）能否预测显著场景，以及还有哪些语言属性可区分显著场景与背景，并通过MENSA语料库的受控研究与LGSM模型予以回答。
AI.motivation: 探究影响电影剧本中场景显著性的因素，检验UID假说在长文本话语中的适用性，并寻找区分显著场景与非显著背景的语言学特征，从而服务于剧本理解与下游摘要等任务。
AI.method: 构建MENSA语料库上的受控研究，并提出"语言学扎根的显著性模型"（LGSM）——一个双流分类器，将冻结的BERT编码器与显式语言学特征通过自适应门控机制融合；同时在场景级与词元级两个粒度上分析UID效应。
AI.result: UID图景在长文本话语中是分层的：在控制长度后，场景级UID汇总无独立信号；但在词元层面，显著场景在主体区域与非显著材料一致，却特异性地抑制位于上尾的最稀有、最难预测的词元。显著场景还表现出中等且持续的核心角色群（呈倒U形）、强第三人称使用、句法更简单，以及更多关于动机与冲突的抽象词汇。LGSM利用该特征签名，在显著场景召回率上优于强语义基线，并产生更好的下游摘要。
AI.conclusion: UID并非以场景级聚合形式发挥作用，而是存在于场景内部的词元层面。显著场景具有可识别且可利用的语言学签名，LGSM证实该签名能提升显著场景识别与下游摘要性能。

title: A Reference Architecture for Integrating Agentic AI into Enterprise Software: Responsibilities, Interactions, and Variability
summary: Agentic AI moves generative AI applications toward systems that coordinate reasoning, enterprise context, model inference, and external actions. Integrating these capabilities into enterprise software introduces diverse architectural concerns, from orchestration, knowledge and memory, and model access to tools and actions, security, runtime infrastructure, and evaluation. Existing research and industry architectures address many of these concerns but differ in scope, abstraction, responsibility organization, interaction representation, and assumptions about which capabilities are required. This paper presents a technology-neutral reference architecture for enterprise agentic AI integration. We synthesize architectural capabilities from research publications, industry architecture guidance, and interoperability specifications by architectural purpose, organize them into ten responsibilities, and define boundary invariants, typed cross-responsibility interactions, and variation points that distinguish responsibilities from condition-dependent capabilities and replaceable realization mechanisms. We instantiate the architecture as an ESG portfolio-analysis and pre-trade compliance agent over an existing service-oriented ESG metric computation and reporting system, and complement the case with a mapping of an independently published agentic architecture. The case realizes seven of the ten responsibilities; different questions take different interaction paths, controls activate only under their conditions, and the probed boundary invariants hold. The independent architecture maps onto the proposed responsibilities without requiring an additional one. These results provide initial evidence for the architecture's organization and applicability rather than its completeness. The deployment and recorded results are available as a replication package.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向企业智能体AI集成的技术中立参考架构,归纳十项职责及边界不变量,并通过ESG合规智能体案例验证。
AI.motivation: 企业软件集成智能体AI涉及编排、知识记忆、模型访问、工具动作、安全、运行时与评估等多元架构关注点;现有研究与工业架构在范围、抽象、职责划分、交互表示及能力假设上存在差异,缺乏统一的技术中立参考架构。
AI.method: 综合研究文献、行业架构指南与互操作规范,按架构目的提炼能力并组织为十项职责,定义边界不变量、类型化跨职责交互及变化点(区分职责、条件依赖能力与可替换实现机制);并以现有面向服务的ESG指标计算与报告系统为基础,实例化为ESG组合分析与交易前合规智能体。
AI.result: 案例实现了十项职责中的七项;不同问题走不同交互路径,控制仅在相应条件激活,探测的边界不变量成立;独立发表的智能体架构可映射到所提职责而无需新增职责。
AI.conclusion: 结果为该架构的组织方式与适用性提供初步证据,而非其完备性;部署与记录结果作为复现包提供。

title: Competition Domains Matter: Selective Head Globalization for Training-Free Sparse Attention in Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Training-free sparse attention is a practical route to efficient video diffusion transformer inference, yet existing methods typically fix the competition domain at each query row for every attention head. Prior work primarily addresses how to estimate token-level importance within this fixed domain; whether the domain itself should adapt to head heterogeneity remains under-specified. We introduce EG-Sparse, a training-free framework that routes low-entropy heads to a grouped cross-head pool while retaining per-row local selection for high-entropy heads, using only scores already materialized by the sparse pipeline. A controlled diagnostic fixes the ranking score and varies only the competition rule: grouped cross-head selection reduces low-entropy-head reconstruction error by 9.8%, whereas forcing high-entropy heads into an all-head global pool increases it by 7.9%. Across four configurations, EG-Sparse achieves higher video quality while reducing attention density and GPU denoising latency compared with strong training-free sparse-attention baselines. Mechanism ablations further show that selective domain adaptation outperforms uniform, random, and fixed domain-assignment policies. These results support competition-domain adaptation as a distinct design axis within centroid-guided training-free sparse attention.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 EG-Sparse，依据注意力头熵值自适应选择竞争域：低熵头使用分组跨头池，高熵头保留逐行局部选择，从而在降低注意力密度与延时同时提升视频质量。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练稀疏注意力方法在每个查询行上采用固定竞争域，仅关注固定域内的token重要性估计，忽视了注意力头异质性对竞争域本身设计的影响，该问题尚未被明确。
AI.method: EG-Sparse 为免训练框架，仅利用稀疏流程已materialized的分数进行路由。低熵头被路由到分组跨头池（grouped cross-head pool），高熵头保留逐行局部选择。通过受控诊断实验固定排序分数、仅改变竞争规则来验证设计。
AI.result: 分组跨头选择使低熵头重建误差降低9.8%；强制高熵头进入全头全局池则使其误差上升7.9%。在四种配置下，EG-Sparse 相比强基线提升了视频质量，同时降低注意力密度与GPU去噪延迟。机制消融显示选择性域适应优于均匀、随机与固定域分配策略。
AI.conclusion: 竞争域自适应构成质心引导免训练稀疏注意力的一个独立设计轴，头异质性驱动的域路由有效。

title: The Fragility and Dynamics of LLM Pruning-Recovery Steps
summary: Structural pruning followed by a recovery stage is the standard recipe for compressing large language models (LLMs), yet the two stages are typically designed and tuned in isolation. In this work, we study how their interaction shapes the compressed model, sweeping ordering, the data that drives each stage, and the alignment of their training objectives. We find that instruction-following is the first capability to collapse under pruning, well before knowledge, reasoning, or core language modeling, and that much of the pruning in-domain loss is likely not knowledge loss but a domain-agnostic failure to respond coherently to the prompt. We find in our setting that in-domain data is the strongest pruning signal, whereas instruction-style data recovers the most. Stage order matters little, but only marginally. We further analyze how the importance ranking drifts before and after pruning. Together these results give practitioners a concrete recipe for composing pruning and recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究结构化剪枝与恢复阶段的相互作用，发现指令遵循能力最先在剪枝中崩塌，域内数据是最强剪枝信号而指令数据恢复效果最好，两阶段顺序影响甚微，并据此给出实用配方。
AI.motivation: LLM压缩中结构化剪枝加恢复是标准流程，但两阶段通常被孤立设计与调优，二者交互如何影响压缩后模型尚不清楚，需要系统研究以指导实践。
AI.method: 扫掠剪枝与恢复的顺序、各阶段所用数据，以及两阶段训练目标的对齐方式，进行分析性实验；并分析剪枝前后重要性排序的漂移情况。
AI.result: 指令遵循能力在剪枝下最先崩溃，早于知识、推理和核心语言建模；剪枝的域内损失很可能并非知识损失，而是与领域无关的提示响应连贯性失效；域内数据是最强剪枝信号，指令风格数据恢复效果最佳；阶段顺序影响很小。
AI.conclusion: 剪枝与恢复的交互机制得到澄清，为从业者组合剪枝与恢复提供了具体配方。

title: EvoCowork: A Benchmark for Real-World Office Tasks
summary: Office workflows are a demanding testbed for self-improving agents because their deliverables must be correct, natively editable, and mutually consistent. A central question is whether gains on feedback tasks reflect reusable procedures rather than task-specific fixes. We introduce EvoCowork, a 240-task benchmark for evaluating harness-level recursive self-improvement across four office modalities, with model weights held fixed. The benchmark covers presentations, documents, spreadsheets, and cross-office workflows, and scores submitted artifacts for content, native structure, formulas, cross-file consistency, and visual quality where needed. Its protocol separates feedback, revision selection, and final testing: methods learn from single-modality tasks, then are evaluated on unseen single-modality tasks and cross-office workflows under a shared initial harness and explicit budgets. In static evaluations of two models and four harnesses, the best configuration scores 42.25 overall and 30.62 on cross-office tasks. Starting from the same MSA harness with GLM 5.3, ACE and AHE improve in-domain scores by 4.90 and 2.64 points, respectively, but change cross-office scores by only +0.03 and -1.72. Thus, gains on the file types that provide feedback do not necessarily transfer to coordinated workflows. EvoCowork makes this distinction explicit while recording the capability, transfer, and cost of harness evolution. Code and task packages: https://github.com/DeepThinkingZhouLiu/cowork-evolution-benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoCowork——一个针对办公场景、评估"驾驭层"递归自我改进的 240 任务基准，涵盖演示文稿、文档、表格及跨办公工作流，在冻结模型权重的前提下分离反馈、修订选择与最终测试，揭示反馈任务收益难以迁移到跨文件协同工作流。
AI.motivation: 办公工作流对自我改进智能体是高要求测试场景：交付物必须正确、可原生编辑且相互一致。核心疑问在于，反馈任务上的提升究竟来自可复用的程序性能力，还是仅针对特定任务的修补。现有评测缺乏显式区分这两者的协议与指标。
AI.method: 构建 240 任务的 EvoCowork 基准，覆盖四种办公模态（演示文稿、文档、表格、跨办公工作流），固定模型权重，仅演化"驾驭层"（harness）。评分维度包括内容、原生结构、公式、跨文件一致性与必要的视觉质量。协议分为反馈、修订选择与最终测试三阶段：方法在单模态任务上学习，随后在未见过的单模态任务与跨办公工作流上、于统一初始驾驭层与显式预算下评测。
AI.result: 在两个模型与四种驾驭层的静态评测中，最优配置总分为 42.25，跨办公任务为 30.62。以 GLM 5.3 从相同 MSA 驾驭层出发，ACE 与 AHE 的域内分数分别提升 4.90 与 2.64 分，但跨办公分数仅变化 +0.03 与 -1.72。说明在提供反馈的文件类型上获得的收益未必迁移到协同工作流。
AI.conclusion: EvoCowork 显式区分域内提升与跨办公迁移，并记录驾驭层演化的能力、迁移性与成本，为评估办公场景下智能体的可复用程序性自我改进提供了标准化测试平台。

title: CAST-ASD: Causal Attention over Speakers and Time for Online Active Speaker Detection
summary: We present CAST-ASD (Causal Attention over Speakers and Time), a causal joint model for active speaker detection (ASD). Recent ASD models improve performance by jointly processing all faces in a scene, but operate offline, with the full clip available before any frame is labelled. Low-latency causal detectors instead process each face independently. CAST-ASD combines joint face reasoning with fully causal inference. It applies scene-level attention across faces within the current frame and causal temporal attention over each face's history, enabling information sharing across speakers with zero lookahead. Its parameter count does not grow with the number of faces. On MSDWild, where most negative face-frames contain a visible competing speaker, CAST-ASD reduces competing-speaker false alarms by 32% relative to the causal per-face detector it extends, with larger gains as scene occupancy increases. It outperforms all causal baselines on both validation splits while using only one-tenth the inter-speaker parameters of a three-block fixed-roster convolution. Code and models are available at https://github.com/prathamg007/CAST-ASD.

AI.tldr: CAST-ASD是一种全因果的联合说话人检测模型，在帧内对多张人脸做场景级注意力、在时序上对人脸历史做因果注意力，实现零前瞻信息共享且参数量不随人脸数增长。
AI.motivation: 现有ASD模型虽通过联合处理场景中所有人脸提升性能，但需离线获取完整片段；低延迟的因果检测器则独立处理每张人脸，无法利用说话人间信息。作者希望兼顾联合推理与完全因果、低延迟推断。
AI.method: 提出CAST-ASD：在当前帧内对所有人脸施加场景级注意力，并对每张人脸的历史施加因果时序注意力，从而实现零前瞻（zero lookahead）的说话人间信息共享；参数数量不随场景中人脸数量增长。
AI.result: 在MSDWild上（多数负样本人脸帧中存在可见的竞争说话人），相比所扩展的因果逐人脸检测器，竞争说话人误报减少32%，且随场景人数增加收益更大；在两个验证划分上均优于所有因果基线，同时说话人间参数仅为三块固定名单卷积的十分之一。代码与模型已开源。
AI.conclusion: CAST-ASD证明联合人脸推理可与完全因果、低延迟推断相结合，在保持参数高效的同时显著降低竞争说话人误报，为在线ASD提供了有效方案。

title: Towards Robust Calibration Dataset for Domain-General Mixture of Experts Pruning
summary: Post-training expert pruning is a promising deployment technique for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The calibration set is an integral part of the pruning process, however, its correlation with evaluation performance is largely misunderstood and unintuitive. In this work, we present an empirical study of the robustness of calibration perturbations, specifically in MoE models. Showing how calibration size, language, and data distribution affect layer-wise expert pruning for gpt-oss-20b. Our findings reveal that (1) domain-general pruning quality receives minimal benefit from scaling calibration data beyond small sample sizes, (2) cross-lingual calibration transfers effectively, with English-only calibration maintaining strong performance across seven languages of varying typologies and scripts, and (3) a diverse calibration data resembling the pretraining distribution can yield comparable or superior performance to test-distribution data. Ultimately, we provide practical insights as a recipe for better understanding calibration for more effective domain-general expert pruning.

AI.tldr: 本文对 MoE 模型后训练专家剪枝中的校准集鲁棒性进行了实证研究，考察校准集规模、语言与数据分布对 gpt-oss-20b 逐层专家剪枝的影响，并给出实用建议。
AI.motivation: 校准集是 MoE 专家剪枝流程的关键组成部分，但其与评估性能之间的关系在很大程度上被误解且不直观，缺乏系统性实证认识。
AI.method: 以 gpt-oss-20b 为对象，对校准集施加扰动，开展鲁棒性实证研究，系统变化校准集规模、语言（英语单语 vs 跨语言）以及数据分布（域内/测试分布 vs 类预训练分布），评估逐层专家剪枝效果。
AI.result: (1) 校准数据规模超出小样本量后，对通用领域剪枝质量的增益极小；(2) 跨语言校准迁移有效，仅用英语校准即可在七种不同语系与文字的语言上保持较强性能；(3) 接近预训练分布的多样化校准数据可取得与测试分布数据相当甚至更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究为理解校准集在 MoE 通用领域专家剪枝中的作用提供了实用洞见与操作配方，表明校准集规模收益有限、跨语言迁移可行且数据多样性重于分布匹配。

title: Pre-Registered Genesis Accounting for Recursive Self-Improvement: First Audited Operator-Genesis Events in a Physics-Discovery Runtime
summary: Claims of recursive self-improvement are easy to make and hard to falsify: did improvement come from re-using designer-provided mechanisms, or from mechanisms the system authored itself? We introduce a pre-registered, two-tier accounting: M1 counts machine-generated content instances within a designer-provided vocabulary, while M2 counts machine-authored mechanism types (new operators registered into the runtime's own vocabulary, with a held-out-validation certificate). We report the first audited M2 genesis events. In the primary event, depth-limited compositional search over elementary operators, judged by held-out R^2 on real NIST hydrogen Balmer measurements, produced the operator sq(inv(n)) = 1/n^2 -- the Rydberg-level form -- which no standard-library transform could express (held-out R^2: -0.546 best standard transform vs. 1.0000000 composed). A protocol flaw (independent variable built by inverting the very law under test) was caught in audit and repaired via an independent-label protocol; extrapolation to unseen levels (n=8,9 trained on n<=7) attains relative error ~10^-6, four to six orders beyond the best standard operator. A second event independently recovered sqrt(inv(a)) -- Kepler's velocity law -- from JPL ephemeris vectors. Also incorporated: an audited compounding channel (first domain-level measurement: 1.109x accuracy ratio on a real held-out domain) and blind, decurated genesis exams whose honest tally is zero. The Kepler event passes line audit; the hydrogen gap reproduces on He II; the certificate is threshold-stable. Against eleven prior systems, the contribution is the measurement and governance of machine-authored mechanisms, not the search algorithm or rediscovered physics. Limitations: exams were curated by agents who knew the textbook answer, triggers manual, grammar observer-injected; both events demonstrate capability to author, not yet autonomous genesis.

AI.tldr: 论文提出预注册的双层计量框架（M1统计设计者词汇内机器生成内容，M2统计机器自创机制类型并要求留出验证证书），报告首个经审计的M2机制创生事件：组合搜索在NIST氢巴尔末谱数据上生成1/n²（里德伯形式），在JPL星历上独立重现开普勒速度定律，并附带复合通道与去策划盲测（诚实计数为零）。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进的主张容易提出却难以证伪：改进究竟来自复用设计者提供的机制，还是来自系统自主创作的机制，此前缺乏可审计的区分标准。作者旨在建立可预注册、可审计的计量与治理口径，从而判定"机器自创机制"是否真实发生。
AI.method: 采用预注册双层计量：M1计入设计者词汇内的机器生成内容实例；M2计入机器自创机制类型（注册进运行时自身词汇的新算子，并附留出验证证书）。对初等算子做深度受限组合搜索，以真实NIST氢巴尔末测量上的留出R²为判据；审计中修正了"自变量由被测定律反演构造"的协议缺陷，改用独立标签协议，并在n≤7训练、n=8,9外推。另设审计式复合通道与去策划盲测创生考试，并以He II复现、证书阈值稳定性、逐行审计做稳健性检验。
AI.result: 主事件生成算子sq(inv(n))=1/n²，标准库变换最优留出R²为-0.546，组合算子达1.0000000；外推至未见能级相对误差约10⁻⁶，超出最优标准算子四至六个数量级。第二事件从JPL星历独立复原sqrt(inv(a))（开普勒速度定律）。复合通道给出首个领域级测量：真实留出域上1.109倍精度比。去策划盲测创生考试的诚实计数为零。开普勒事件通过逐行审计，氢能级差距在He II上复现，证书阈值稳定。
AI.conclusion: 相对十一个既有系统，本文贡献在于机器自创机制的测量与治理，而非搜索算法或重新发现的物理规律。局限：考题由知晓教科书答案的智能体策划、触发为人工、语法为观察者注入；两项事件仅证明具备"创作"能力，尚未实现自主创生。

title: HumanPhys: A Human-Centric Physical-World Perception Benchmark for Real-World Visual Reasoning
summary: We introduce HumanPhys, a human-centric benchmark for real-world physical perception, and a training corpus emitted by the same pipeline. Each question targets a physically grounded quantity related to people, including depth, inter-person distance, gaze angle, displacement, velocity, heading-step trajectory, blink count, and contact-deformation strength. The rendered probes additionally test illumination inference from body and face cues and camera ego-motion, both with and without a person in the frame. All labels are derived programmatically from sensor calibration, source metadata, or renderer state, rather than written by annotators or produced by estimators on the benchmark frames. HumanPhys systematically probes six dimensions of human-centric physical perception: spatial state, kinematics, blink events, deformation, illumination, and camera pose. To the best of our knowledge, no existing MLLM benchmark-and-training corpus jointly supervises this set of human-centered physical quantities under direct metadata- or renderer-derived labels. The six dimensions appear only partially dissociable across the tested MLLMs. We benchmark a range of open- and closed-source MLLMs on HumanPhys and find that all six capability dimensions remain challenging for current models. We hope HumanPhys will support future research on multimodal systems that perceive and reason about people in the physical world.

AI.tldr: 提出HumanPhys——一个以人为中心的真实世界物理感知基准及同流程生成训练语料，从传感器标定/元数据/渲染状态程序化生成标签，覆盖六个物理感知维度，当前MLLM均表现困难。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM基准缺少对"人"相关物理量（深度、距离、视线、运动学、形变、光照、相机自运动）的统一监督与评测；标签多依赖人工标注或估计器，存在噪声与泄露风险。作者希望提供标签直接源自元数据/渲染状态、可系统探测人类中心物理感知的基准与训练语料。
AI.method: 构建HumanPhys基准与配套训练语料，同一条数据生成流程产出。任务覆盖深度、人际距离、注视角度、位移、速度、朝向-步态轨迹、眨眼次数、接触形变强度，以及由身体/面部线索推断光照与相机自运动（含有人/无人场景）。所有标签由传感器标定、源元数据或渲染器状态程序化导出，非人工书写、非在基准帧上跑估计器得到。系统探测六个维度：空间状态、运动学、眨眼事件、形变、光照、相机位姿。
AI.result: 在HumanPhys上评测多种开源与闭源MLLM，六个能力维度对现有模型均具挑战性；六个维度在被测MLLM中仅部分可分离（partially dissociable）。据作者所知，尚无既有基准与训练语料在直接元数据/渲染器标签下联合监督这一组人类中心物理量。
AI.conclusion: HumanPhys填补了人类中心物理感知评测与训练的空白，标签客观可靠、维度覆盖系统，可作为多模态系统感知与推理真实世界人物物理属性的研究基础，推动后续工作。

title: Feedback as an Interface: Controlling Form and Detail in LLM Translation Refinement
summary: Feedback presentation shapes how LLMs use evaluator judgments during translation refinement. We introduce a machine translation protocol that keeps the evaluator score, main issue, and recommendation fixed while varying feedback form and supporting detail. Across seven models and six translation directions, low-load feedback outperforms high-load feedback in all 42 translator-direction settings under xCOMET. On the 29,400-record rewriting subset, mean xCOMET scores multiplied by 100 are 83.30 for low-load feedback and 80.67 for high-load feedback; the full-matrix original-translation reference mean is 83.46. MetricX-24 supports the low-load advantage on a stratified subset. A no-feedback second pass yields a small improvement over the original translations, and direct evaluator prompting reproduces the low-load advantage without a separate rewriting stage. These results show that compact feedback limits the quality loss from evaluator-guided refinement in the evaluated high-resource MT settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究反馈呈现形式对LLM翻译修订的影响，提出在评估器分数、主要问题和建议固定不变的前提下，仅改变反馈形式与支撑细节的机器翻译协议。实验表明低负荷反馈优于高负荷反馈，能减少评估器引导修订带来的质量损失。
AI.motivation: 反馈呈现方式会影响LLM如何利用评估器判断进行翻译修订，但反馈形式与支撑细节的具体作用尚不明确。作者希望厘清反馈信息量对翻译质量的影响。
AI.method: 设计机器翻译协议：固定评估器分数、主要问题和建议三项内容，仅变换反馈形式（低负荷 vs 高负荷）与支撑细节。在7个模型、6个翻译方向上实验，并在29,400条记录的重写子集上评估，以xCOMET为主指标、MetricX-24为辅助指标。另设无反馈二次翻译和直接提示评估器两个对照条件。
AI.result: 在全部42个翻译器-方向设置中，低负荷反馈的xCOMET均优于高负荷反馈。重写子集上，低负荷反馈均分83.30，高负荷80.67，原始翻译参考均分83.46。MetricX-24在分层子集上支持低负荷优势。无反馈二次翻译相较原始翻译略有提升，直接提示评估器无需单独重写阶段即可复现低负荷优势。
AI.conclusion: 在被评估的高资源机器翻译场景中，紧凑反馈可限制评估器引导修订带来的质量损失；反馈信息量而非内容本身是影响修订质量的关键因素。

title: PEAM: On-device Communication Agent for Personalized, Efficient and Autonomous Mobile Network Configuration
summary: The growing deployment of compact large language models on smartphones is enabling autonomous on-device decision-making, such as emerging mobile GUI agents. However, many mobile decisions, such as network configuration when users switch apps or connectivity conditions change, must satisfy stringent latency constraints to preserve user experience. In this paper, we propose PEAM, an on-device LLM-based communication agent that autonomously generates personalized network-configuration rules executable within milliseconds. Specifically, PEAM first fine-tune the on-device LLM with a dataset constructed from manually annotated real-user data to integrate the communication knowledge into the local model. PEAM then operates in two phases. In the rule-generation phase, which is performed when the device is idle, such as overnight, PEAM analyzes historical network-configuration records in batches and reflects across batches to consolidate consistent evidence, reduce local bias, and derive robust configuration rules. To enable more accurate and stable rule generation over time, PEAM further constructs a user profile from high-confidence rules to capture the user's network preferences and incorporates this profile into each rule-generation cycle. In the rule-execution phase, PEAM is invoked when the communication context changes, such as when users switch apps or connectivity conditions change, and searches the rule library to identify and execute the appropriate rule. Experiments demonstrate that PEAM, based on a fine-tuned 4B model, achieves 99.13% correct network configuration decisions, while 92.50% of the rules generated by PEAM are valid, outperforming the traditional expert-rule based method by 4.41% and 84.50%, respectively.

AI.tldr: PEAM是一种端侧LLM通信智能体，通过两阶段机制自动生成毫秒级可执行的个性化网络配置规则。
AI.motivation: 移动端GUI智能体等场景需要自主决策，但网络配置等决策有严格时延约束，传统专家规则方法在准确性与规则有效性上存在不足。
AI.method: 先用人工标注真实用户数据微调端侧LLM注入通信知识；规则生成阶段在设备空闲时批量分析历史配置记录，跨批次反思整合一致证据、降低局部偏差，并基于高置信规则构建用户画像反馈至生成循环；规则执行阶段在通信上下文变化时检索规则库并执行。
AI.result: 基于微调4B模型，PEAM实现99.13%正确网络配置决策，92.50%生成规则有效，分别比传统专家规则方法高4.41%和84.50%。
AI.conclusion: PEAM验证了端侧LLM在时延敏感的通信决策中生成个性化可执行规则的有效性，显著优于传统专家规则方法。

title: Demiurge: Forging Navigable 4D Worlds via Autoregressive Video Rerendering
summary: Recent advances in video diffusion enable novel-view video synthesis from a single input video, supporting world modeling, embodied intelligence, and robotic simulation. However, existing methods process camera trajectories independently, lacking the cross-trajectory consistency needed for coherent, navigable 4D worlds. We introduce Demiurge, an autoregressive video rerendering pipeline built on a dynamic 4D point-cloud memory cache. It promotes cross-trajectory consistency through four components: (1) an appearance video diffusion model that synthesizes photorealistic novel-view videos conditioned on the 4D memory; (2) a memory-consistent video depth completion model that aligns known-region depths with cached geometry and completes missing regions, mitigating scale ambiguity and discontinuities during memory updates; (3) memory-aware dual-stream warping that provides high-fidelity visual guidance and occlusion cues for novel-view synthesis; and (4) geometry-aware video refinement that enhances perceptual quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and three key capabilities: coherent spatiotemporal lattice construction over dense multi-view trajectories; large-parallax video rerendering under challenging camera motions, including 180-degree rotations with no input-view overlap; and geometry-faithful outputs that can be directly optimized into high-quality 3D Gaussian Splatting representations with minimal artifacts. Project page: https://hanxinzhu-lab.github.io/demiurge_project_page/.

AI.tldr: Demiurge：基于动态4D点云记忆缓存的自回归视频重渲染管线，通过跨轨迹一致性实现从单视频合成可导航4D世界。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散方法独立处理各条相机轨迹，缺乏跨轨迹一致性，无法构建连贯、可导航的4D世界。
AI.method: 构建在动态4D点云记忆缓存之上的自回归视频重渲染管线，含四个组件：(1) 以4D记忆为条件的外观视频扩散模型；(2) 记忆一致的视频深度补全模型，对齐已知区域深度并补全缺失区域；(3) 记忆感知双流warping，提供高保真视觉引导与遮挡线索；(4) 几何感知视频精修。
AI.result: 实现SOTA性能，具备三项能力：密集多视角轨迹上连贯时空晶格构建；大视差重渲染（含180度旋转、无输入视角重叠）；几何保真输出可直接优化为高质量3D高斯泼溅表示。
AI.conclusion: 通过记忆缓存与跨轨迹一致性设计，支持世界建模、具身智能与机器人仿真等应用。

title: Rate-Resolved Text Evaluation with Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: A single evaluation score can rank generation systems but rarely reveals what failed. We propose rate-resolved text evaluation, which turns the masking rate of masked diffusion language models into a diagnostic axis. By reconstructing text under different fractions of masked tokens, one diffusion score becomes a vector of band-conditioned scores that reflect reconstruction difficulty at varying levels of visible context. On SummEval, preserving this rate structure yields complementary signal: the best masking-rate band improves fusion with autoregressive likelihood over a collapsed diffusion scalar, survives a sample-shuffle control that breaks rate ordering, and adds residual signal to a fixed prompted judge. A second diffusion model reproduces the effect more weakly. On WMT MQM zh-en, roundtrip mask-and-reconstruct probing produces a tunable localization curve in which ranking-oriented AUROC and span-detection F1 peak at different masking rates. Factuality benchmarks bound the interpretation: band semantics are model- and task-dependent, so each application requires empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"速率分辨文本评价"（rate-resolved text evaluation），将掩码扩散语言模型的掩码率转化为诊断维度：通过在不同掩码比例下重建文本，把单个扩散分数扩展为随掩码率变化的分数向量，以反映不同可见上下文水平下的重建难度。
AI.motivation: 单一评价分数虽能对生成系统排序，却几乎无法揭示"具体哪里失败"。作者希望让评价分数具备诊断能力，因此寻找一个可解释、可控的维度来拆解扩散模型的评分信号。
AI.method: 以掩码扩散语言模型的掩码率为诊断轴：在不同掩码比例下执行重建，将扩散标量分数展开为"分带条件分数"向量。在 SummEval 上做融合实验（与自回归似然融合）、样本打乱对照（破坏速率顺序）以及固定提示评判器的残差信号测试；在 WMT MQM zh-en 上用往返掩码-重建探测生成可调定位曲线；并用事实性基准界定解释边界。另用第二个扩散模型做复现验证。
AI.result: SummEval 上，保留速率结构带来互补信号：最佳掩码率分带在与自回归似然融合时优于坍缩的扩散标量，能通过打乱样本的对照，并在固定提示评判器之上提供残差信号；第二个扩散模型复现该效应但更弱。WMT MQM zh-en 上，往返掩码-重建探测产生可调定位曲线，排序导向的 AUROC 与跨度检测 F1 在不同掩码率处达到峰值。事实性基准显示分带语义依赖模型与任务，需逐案实证验证。
AI.conclusion: 掩码率是一个有效的诊断维度，可把单一扩散分数转化为具互补信息的分带信号并支持错误定位；但分带语义随模型与任务而变，因此每次应用都需经验验证，不能直接套用。

title: WeatherBridge: Forecast-Aware Multi-Source Input Adaptation for Pretrained Weather Forecasting Models
summary: Data-driven weather forecasting models are commonly trained on ERA5, yet operational deployment must use timely initial states from physics-based numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems whose distributions differ substantially from ERA5. Direct initialization with these states can degrade autoregressive forecasts, motivating input adaptation that keeps the pretrained forecasting model unchanged. Here, we introduce WeatherBridge, a unified, source-conditioned adapter that maps heterogeneous operational NWP initial states to ERA5 reference states without updating the pretrained forecasting model. WeatherBridge predicts the structured residual corrections with a Swin-UNet and injects source embeddings across multiple spatial scales, allowing the model to capture shared atmospheric structure and source-specific discrepancies. Its training objective combines latitude-weighted ERA5 reconstruction with One-step Rollout Alignment (ORA), which backpropagates one-step forecast error through a frozen FuXi model to optimize the adapted states for both initial state fidelity and downstream forecast compatibility. We evaluate WeatherBridge using daily GFS, HRES, and CMA initializations from 1 January to 22 November 2025 across six variables and lead times up to 240 hours. Relative to raw source initialization of FuXi, WeatherBridge reduces the mean RMSE of FuXi over the 6- 240-hour rollout for 17 of 18 source-variable combinations, with a median reduction of 10.2% and a maximum reduction of 46.3%. The adapter trained with frozen FuXi also improves FengWu forecasts on GFS inputs without retraining either the adapter or FengWu. These results demonstrate that forecast-aware input adaptation can improve forecasts from heterogeneous operational NWP inputs and transfer across pretrained ERA5-based forecasting models.

AI.tldr: 提出WeatherBridge，一个源条件适配器，将异构业务NWP初始场映射到ERA5参考态，在不更新预训练预报模型的前提下提升自回归预报效果。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动的天气预报模型通常在ERA5上训练，但业务部署必须使用来自物理NWP系统的实时初始场，其分布与ERA5差异显著；直接用这些初始场初始化会导致自回归预报性能退化，因此需要在不改动预训练预报模型的情况下进行输入适配。
AI.method: WeatherBridge采用Swin-UNet预测结构化残差修正，并在多个空间尺度注入源嵌入以同时捕捉共享大气结构与源特有差异；训练目标结合纬度加权的ERA5重建损失与One-step Rollout Alignment（ORA），通过冻结的FuXi模型反向传播一步预报误差，使适配后的初始场兼顾初始态保真度与下游预报兼容性。
AI.result: 使用2025年1月1日至11月22日的GFS、HRES、CMA初始场，在6个变量、最长240小时预报时效上评估：相比FuXi原始源初始化，WeatherBridge在18个"源-变量"组合中的17个降低了6–240小时平均RMSE，中位降幅10.2%，最大降幅46.3%；用冻结FuXi训练的适配器还能在无需重训适配器或FengWu的情况下提升FengWu在GFS输入上的预报。
AI.conclusion: 预报感知的输入适配能够改善来自异构业务NWP初始场的预报，并可跨基于ERA5预训练的预报模型迁移。

title: PURE: Refining Feed-forward 3D Reconstruction with Unlabeled Post-training
