comment: Accepted by ACMMM 2026. Project Page: https://funnyguy525.github.io/PURE-Page/ Github: https://github.com/jiah-cloud/PURE
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have achieved remarkable progress through large-scale training and strong learned priors. However, they remain fragile when applied to dynamic in-the-wild videos, where non-rigid motion, occlusions, and illumination changes are prevalent. A key limitation lies in their reliance on expensive depth and camera pose annotations, which hinders scaling to diverse real-world dynamic data and restricts generalization. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{PURE}, an unlabeled post-training refinement framework that improves depth and camera estimation without requiring ground-truth supervision. Instead of relying on annotations, PURE elegantly distills robust structural knowledge from state-of-the-art 2D priors into 4D feed-forward architectures. PURE leverages relative depth constraints, affine-invariant geometry distillation, and pose refinement based on feature correspondences to stabilize geometric predictions under challenging dynamic conditions. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world dynamic benchmarks demonstrate that PURE delivers consistent improvements across multiple state-of-the-art architectures. Furthermore, our data-efficient paradigm effectively mitigates domain shifts, successfully unlocking the architectural limits of these base models in challenging, in-the-wild dynamic scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出PURE框架：无需真值标注的后训练精炼方法，通过从2D先验蒸馏结构知识（相对深度约束、仿射不变几何蒸馏、基于特征对应的位姿精炼），提升前馈4D重建模型在动态场景下的深度与相机估计性能。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D重建模型依赖大量深度与相机位姿标注，难以扩展到多样化的真实动态数据；在非刚性运动、遮挡和光照变化普遍的在野视频中表现脆弱，泛化能力受限。
AI.method: PURE为无标签后训练精炼框架，不依赖真值监督，将2D基础模型的鲁棒结构知识蒸馏进4D前馈架构。具体采用三方面机制：①相对深度约束；②仿射不变几何蒸馏；③基于特征对应关系的位姿精炼，以在动态条件下稳定几何预测。
AI.result: 在合成与真实动态基准上的大量实验表明，PURE可对多种最先进架构带来一致性提升；数据高效范式有效缓解域偏移，在挑战性在野动态场景中释放了基座模型的架构潜力。
AI.conclusion: 无需标注的后训练精炼可有效突破前馈4D重建模型对昂贵监督的依赖，提升动态场景下的深度与位姿估计的泛化性与鲁棒性。

title: The Mathematical Collective Unconscious: Jungian Archetypes within the Latent Space
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 22 tables. Investigating Jungian archetypes in transformer latent spaces across synthetic baselines, Shmoop literature, DreamBank dreams, and Andrew Lang folklore corpora
summary: Carl Jung theorised that the human psyche contains an inherited framework, the collective unconscious, populated by universal archetypes. As large language models (LLMs) are trained on vast corpora of textual data, this paper investigates whether they spontaneously construct distinct archetype-like regions within their high-dimensional latent spaces. The paper proposes that these regions function as spatial constraints that naturally organise semantically related narratives. To evaluate this, we applied cosine similarity and angular distance metrics across thirteen experiments utilising OpenAIs text-embedding-3-small model. The paper contains two experimental sections the first section explores these ideas using synthetically constructed narratives, the results of which act as a baselines for experiments conducted in the second section where the synthetic data is replaced by human-authored literature (Shmoop corpus), unedited dream reports (DreamBank corpus), and culturally distilled folklore (Andrew Langs Fairy Books). The results show that archetypal roles occupy distinct, measurable regions in the latent space. Crucially, these regions remain compact and consistent because of narrative structure rather than simple word overlap. Additionally, text category dictates spatial distribution: dream reports concentrate within Trickster and Shadow regions, while traditional folklore distributes evenly across all tested archetypes. We conclude that transformer latent spaces encode stable regions which appear to correspond to recognised Jungian archetypes.

AI.tldr: 本文探究大语言模型的高维潜空间中是否自发形成类似荣格原型（archetype）的独立区域，使用text-embedding-3-small模型通过13组实验（余弦相似度与角距离）进行验证，发现原型角色确实占据可测量的独立区域，且受叙事结构而非词汇重叠驱动。
AI.motivation: 基于荣格"集体无意识"与"原型"理论，作者试图检验：当LLM在大量文本语料上训练时，是否会在其潜空间中自发构建出类似原型的独立区域，并将其视为组织语义相关叙事的空间约束。
AI.method: 使用OpenAI的text-embedding-3-small模型，采用余弦相似度与角距离度量，设计13组实验，分为两大部分：第一部分使用人工构造的合成叙事作为基线；第二部分将其替换为真实文本，包括人类创作文学（Shmoop语料）、未经编辑的梦境报告（DreamBank语料）以及文化提炼的民间故事（Andrew Lang童话集）。
AI.result: 原型角色在潜空间中占据独立且可测量的区域；这些区域保持紧凑与一致，其成因是叙事结构而非单纯的词汇重叠；此外文本类别决定空间分布——梦境报告集中于Trickster与Shadow区域，而传统民间故事在所有测试原型间均匀分布。
AI.conclusion: Transformer的潜空间编码了稳定的区域，这些区域似乎对应于公认的荣格原型。

title: Beyond Outcome Feedback: Trajectory-Quality-Guided Experience-based Learning
summary: Experience-based learning enables large language model (LLM) agents to improve over time by reusing knowledge from past executions. However, existing methods typically rely on final task outcomes as feedback for experience learning, overlooking the execution process and limiting their ability to evaluate and optimize experience based on trajectory quality. To address this limitation, we propose TQG-Exp, a trajectory-quality-guided experience-based learning framework that introduces process feedback. Specifically, we introduce Trajectory Quality Loss (TQL), which jointly considers task completion and process quality to provide a learning signal beyond final task outcomes. Based on this signal, we employ paired rollouts with and without retrieved experience to guide experience optimization. Representative trajectories are selected based on their outcomes and trajectory quality to extract task-level and task-type-level experiences. Meanwhile, differences in trajectory quality between the paired groups are used to estimate the contribution of retrieved experience and update its utility. The learned utility is then combined with semantic relevance to guide subsequent experience retrieval. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with two backbone LLMs show that TQG-Exp outperforms existing experience-based methods, improving Avg.@3 over the strongest baseline by 4.50 and 8.55 percentage points on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Qwen3.5-Flash, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出TQG-Exp轨迹质量引导的经验学习框架，引入过程反馈以优化LLM智能体的经验学习。
AI.motivation: 现有经验学习方法仅依赖最终任务结果作为反馈，忽略执行过程，难以基于轨迹质量评估和优化经验。
AI.method: 引入轨迹质量损失（TQL），联合任务完成度与过程质量提供学习信号；采用有无检索经验的配对rollout引导经验优化；基于结果与轨迹质量选取代表性轨迹，提取任务级与任务类型级经验；利用配对组间轨迹质量差异估计检索经验贡献并更新其效用；结合效用与语义相关性指导后续经验检索。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld上，基于两个骨干LLM，TQG-Exp优于现有经验学习方法；Avg.@3较最强基线在DeepSeek-V4-Flash与Qwen3.5-Flash上分别提升4.50和8.55个百分点。
AI.conclusion: TQG-Exp通过轨迹质量引导的过程反馈有效提升了LLM智能体经验学习的效果。

title: PixARG: Pixel-Asynchronous Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion for Fast and Realistic Image Generation
comment: Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26) as a poster presentation
summary: While diffusion models achieve impressive image generation capabilities, they suffer from high computational costs, implausible artifacts, and limited adaptability to dynamic or private data due to static, centralized training. To address these, we propose PixARG, a novel retrieval-augmented generative framework that integrates dynamic real-world image retrieval into the diffusion pipeline to simultaneously enhance efficiency and visual realism. Specifically, PixARG constructs a pixel-level affinity map between the user's text prompt and the retrieved image to guide a heterogeneous noise initialization. By modulating noise intensity across spatial regions, this mechanism preserves semantically relevant structural priors while perturbing less relevant areas, thereby significantly accelerating convergence. To accommodate this spatially non-uniform noise and ensure synchronized generation, we introduce a pixel-wise asynchronous denoising scheduler and a spatiotemporal denoiser conditioned on the affinity map. Furthermore, we derive an affinity-adaptive training objective that elegantly balances deterministic restoration with stochastic regeneration across pixels. Experiments on LAION and COYO datasets across offline, online, and user-specific settings show PixARG enhances realism and semantic alignment while drastically reducing diffusion steps.

AI.tldr: 提出检索增强扩散框架PixARG，通过检索图像构建像素级亲和图，指导异构噪声初始化、像素级异步去噪调度与时空去噪器，并引入亲和自适应训练目标，在提升真实性与语义对齐的同时大幅减少扩散步数。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型存在计算成本高、易产生不合理伪影、对动态或私有数据适应性差的问题，根源在于其静态且集中式的训练范式。
AI.method: PixARG将动态真实图像检索融入扩散流程：①构建文本提示与检索图像间的像素级亲和图，用于引导异构噪声初始化，按空间区域调制噪声强度，保留语义相关结构先验、扰动弱相关区域以加速收敛；②设计像素级异步去噪调度器与以亲和图为条件的时空去噪器，以适配空间非均匀噪声并同步生成；③推导亲和自适应训练目标，在像素层面平衡确定性恢复与随机再生成。
AI.result: 在LAION与COYO数据集上的离线、在线及用户特定设置实验中，PixARG在显著减少扩散步数的同时提升了生成真实性与语义对齐度。
AI.conclusion: 将动态真实图像检索引入扩散管线，可同时缓解效率与视觉真实性问题，并在多种检索设置下展现良好适应性与生成质量。

title: Towards Autopilot Labeling for Short Video Content Governance
summary: The explosive growth of short videos has presented significant challenges to content governance. Traditional manual labeling is inefficient, slow to iterate, and costly. Therefore, we explore and develop a multi-stage autopilot labeling framework aimed at progressively increasing the level of automation in short video content annotation. To move beyond the heavy reliance on human expert labeling at the initial L0 stage, we first introduce a discriminative MLLM labeler at the L1 stage, which is fine-tuned with supervised data to directly predict labels for short videos. Advancing to the L2 stage, we shift to a domain-adaptive MLLM pretrained on short video data and use it for zero-shot labeling, enabling flexible generalization without task-specific supervision. In the L3 stage, we propose an agentic annotation workflow, and equip the agent with several key tools, which empower the agent to handle complex, unfamiliar, or vaguely defined cases, significantly reducing the need for human intervention. We conduct extensive experiments across various content issues, and results demonstrate that each stage of the autopilot labeling framework progressively improves labeling accuracy, and has significantly reduced manual labor costs in real-world applications by up to 85%.

AI.tldr: 提出多阶段自动驾驶式短视频内容标注框架（L0→L3），逐级提升自动化水平，L1用监督微调的判别式MLLM直接打标，L2用短视频域自适应预训练MLLM做零样本打标，L3构建配备工具的智能体标注流程处理复杂案例，实验显示各阶段标注准确率递进提升，实际应用中人工成本最多降低85%。
AI.motivation: 短视频爆发式增长给内容治理带来挑战，传统人工标注效率低、迭代慢、成本高，需探索逐步提高自动化程度的标注方案以减少对人力的重度依赖。
AI.method: 多阶段自动驾驶式标注框架：L0人工专家标注；L1引入判别式MLLM标注器，用监督数据微调直接预测短视频标签；L2改用短视频数据预训练、域自适应的MLLM进行零样本标注，实现无需任务特定监督的灵活泛化；L3提出智能体标注工作流，为智能体配备若干关键工具，处理复杂、陌生或定义模糊的样本，显著减少人工干预。
AI.result: 在多种内容问题上开展大量实验，结果表明该框架每个阶段均逐步提升标注准确率，并在真实应用中最多将人工成本降低85%。
AI.conclusion: 该多阶段自动驾驶式标注框架能够随阶段推进持续提高短视频内容标注自动化水平与准确率，大幅降低人工标注成本，具备实际内容治理应用价值。

title: MARL-BattleGrounds: A Novel JAX-native Benchmark for Heterogeneous and Competitive Multi-agent RL
comment: 34 pages, 14 figures, 18 tables. Project website: https://marl-battlegrounds.com
summary: We present MARL-BattleGrounds (MARL-BGs), an easy-to-use JAX-native benchmark for heterogeneous and competitive multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), designed to be sample-efficient, computationally efficient, and researcher-centric. MARL benchmarks are typically simple and efficient, like SMAX, where winning reduces to unit micromanagement, or rich and costly, like Dota 2. MARL-BGs fills this missing middle. Its first mode, Team Deathmatch, is a simultaneous turn-based game between two teams of five heterogeneous agents. The five classes have distinct basic, passive, and ultimate abilities designed to synergize with allies and counter enemies. Our 52 hand-designed maps with diverse obstacles include a 12-map curriculum and ten held-out validation and test maps. MARL-BGs provides two canonical evaluation modes. First, eight endgame scenarios form a hard generalization challenge: each asks a team to win an unseen, nearly lost position against a strong reactive controller within 5-10 ticks. Second, a monthly round-robin tournament retrains each submission on equal compute, plays it against every member of the current "Big Nine" field, and publishes the Elo results on the official leaderboard. All entrants are publicly released as downloadable opponents. MARL-BGs records 11,192 metrics per game in 28 topics. We also include three strong scripted opponents, an analytical replay viewer, and off-the-shelf tools for self-play, cross-play, curriculum learning, and zero-shot coordination evaluation. We even provide an API for LLM-based agents and use it to evaluate Qwen3.5-9B against our strongest policy. In our BattleClient, humans can play alongside or against any mix of policies, enabling human-AI evaluation. We benchmark MARL-BGs with six additional deep MARL baselines, which we release. On one RTX 5090 with 1,024 parallel games, the simulator runs 50,000 5v5 game steps per second.

AI.tldr: MARL-BGs是一个JAX原生异构竞争多智能体强化学习基准，填补了简单基准与昂贵复杂环境之间的空白，具备高样本效率、计算效率和研究者友好特性。
AI.motivation: 现有MARL基准呈两极分化：如SMAX等简单高效但仅涉及单位微操，或如Dota 2等丰富但昂贵，缺乏兼具复杂度与效率的中间地带。
AI.method: 提出MARL-BGs，首模式为两队各5个异构智能体的同步回合制团队死斗，含52张手工地图（12张课程+10张留出验证测试）；提供8个残局泛化挑战与月度循环赛Elo排行榜；记录每局28主题共11,192项指标；提供三种脚本对手、回放查看器及自博弈/交叉博弈/课程学习/零样本协调工具，并含LLM智能体API与人类参与的BattleClient。
AI.result: 在单张RTX 5090、1,024并行游戏下，模拟器达到每秒50,000个5v5游戏步；用Qwen3.5-9B等进行了评估，并基准测试了六个深度MARL基线。
AI.conclusion: MARL-BGs以高效、异构、竞争为核心，结合泛化挑战与持续排行榜，为MARL研究提供可复现、可扩展、支持人机与LLM评估的统一平台。

title: LightVAE: Towards Compact and Efficient Video Autoencoders
comment: 24 pages, code is available at https://github.com/ModelTC/LightVAE
summary: Latent diffusion models enable high-quality video generation, but video VAE encoding and decoding remain computationally expensive. Existing methods use stage-specific lightweight operators, yet either constrain spatial and temporal computation jointly or remove temporal computation altogether, without distinguishing their compression sensitivities in pretrained Conv3D. To address these limitations, we present LightVAE, a compression framework that exploits redundancy in temporal modeling and network depth. LightVAE exactly reparameterizes eligible causal Conv3D layers into an aggregate spatial response and a difference-driven temporal correction. Based on their distinct compression sensitivities, temporal low-rank compression (TLR) keeps the aggregate spatial kernel dense and applies layer-specific low-rank approximation only to the temporal correction. An algebraically equivalent folded implementation converts the arithmetic savings into practical acceleration. LightVAE further uses width-preserving block pruning to reduce depth and probe-guided feature alignment, guided by feedback from a frozen teacher suffix, to recover quality after compression. The framework also extends to video encoders. Across three video VAE backbones and two GPU platforms, LightVAE consistently accelerates decoding. For the Wan VAE family, it achieves up to $2.24\times$ and $1.11\times$ the decoding throughput of state-of-the-art efficient VAE decoders on NVIDIA H100 and RTX~5090, respectively, with higher DAVIS PSNR and lower LPIPS. On MiniMax-H3, it achieves up to $2.97\times$ the original decoding throughput while retaining 99.51\% of the original model's overall VBench-2.0 score. Our code is available at https://github.com/ModelTC/LightVAE.

AI.tldr: LightVAE 是一种针对视频 VAE 的压缩框架，通过区分预训练 Conv3D 的时空压缩敏感性，对时间修正项做低秩近似并对网络深度做剪枝，实现解码加速且保真度更高。
AI.motivation: 视频 VAE 的编解码计算开销大；现有轻量化方法要么联合约束时空计算、要么完全去除时间计算，未区分预训练 Conv3D 中空间与时间计算的压缩敏感性差异，导致压缩策略次优。
AI.method: 将符合条件的因果 Conv3D 层精确重参数化为聚合空间响应与差分驱动的时间修正；基于不同压缩敏感性提出时间低秩压缩（TLR），保持聚合空间核稠密、仅对时间修正做逐层低秩近似；用代数等价的折叠实现把算术节省转化为实际加速；辅以宽度保持的块剪枝降低深度、探针引导特征对齐（由冻结教师后缀反馈指导）恢复质量；框架亦可扩展至视频编码器。
AI.result: 在三种视频 VAE 主干、两种 GPU 平台上均稳定加速解码。Wan VAE 系列在 NVIDIA H100 与 RTX 5090 上分别达 SOTA 高效 VAE 解码器吞吐的 2.24× 与 1.11×，且 DAVIS PSNR 更高、LPIPS 更低；MiniMax-H3 上达原始吞吐 2.97×，并保留原模型 VBench-2.0 总分的 99.51%。
AI.conclusion: 区分空间与时间的压缩敏感性并结合低秩近似、折叠实现与深度剪枝，可在保持生成质量的同时显著加速视频 VAE 解码，验证了该方法在多种主干与硬件上的通用性与有效性。

title: Do LLM Tutors Actually Teach? A Process-Centered Synthesis of the Tutoring Loop
summary: Large language models can produce fluent tu- toring dialogue, but whether they actually help students learn remains unclear. We present a process-centered synthesis of LLM tutoring that follows the path from learner-state infer- ence to pedagogical action, tutor training, eval- uation, and student simulation. This view ex- poses a central gap: implementing a tutoring component does not establish that it works or that its outputs meaningfully affect later stages. A structured study-level audit shows that peda- gogical evaluation is common, while evidence becomes much thinner for learner-conditioned intervention, human learning gains, and espe- cially transfer or delayed retention. Human studies nevertheless provide a conditional posi- tive result: LLM tutors can improve learning, but benefits depend on pedagogical structure, learner engagement, and how learning is mea- sured. We argue that progress requires validat- ing the interfaces between tutoring stages, not only improving individual components.

AI.tldr: 该文对LLM辅导进行以过程为中心的综述，指出实现辅导组件不等于证明其有效，证据链在"学习者状态推断→教学行动→训练→评估→学生模拟"各环节间逐级变薄，人类研究显示学习收益是有条件的。
AI.motivation: LLM已能生成流畅的辅导对话，但其是否真正促进学生学习尚不清楚；现有研究多聚焦单一组件（如教学评估），缺乏对辅导全流程证据可靠性的系统审视。
AI.method: 采用以过程为中心的综述框架，沿"学习者状态推断—教学行动—辅导者训练—评估—学生模拟"路径组织文献；并开展结构化的研究层面审计（study-level audit），评估各环节的证据密度。
AI.result: 审计显示：教学评估类证据常见，而"面向学习者状态调节的干预"证据明显稀薄；人类学习增益的证据更少；迁移与延迟保持方面的证据最为匮乏。人类研究给出条件性积极结论——LLM辅导可提升学习，但效果取决于教学结构、学习者投入程度及学习测量方式。
AI.conclusion: 研究进展不应只追求单组件性能提升，而须验证辅导各阶段间的接口（接口效度），即前序阶段的输出能否真实影响后续阶段，从而建立端到端的有效性证据链。

title: Probable but Not Valid: A Psychometric Audit of Decision Models as Synthetic Survey Respondents
comment: 36 pages, 6 figures, 16 tables. Code, raw model outputs and tables are available from the corresponding author on request
summary: Language models are increasingly used to create synthetic survey samples, also called silicon samples. Decision models are a new class of language models that return a probability for each point of a rating scale instead of text. We ask whether these models, or the newest generative LLMs, can stand in for human respondents on a psychometric survey. We test fourteen decision models from eleven providers and 47 generative LLMs on an open Lithuanian organisational-psychology survey (n=263, 68 items), with 100 real respondent profiles, the Psychometric Similarity Score (PSS) and statistical baselines. The best generative model, MiniMax M3, reaches PSS 0.813. This is level with a Gaussian copula fit only on other respondents (0.824) and below a copula fit in sample (0.927). A second sample of 100 real people scores below the best models, so at this size PSS cannot rank them against real respondents. In 5 of 10 product lines the newest generative release scores below an earlier release of the same line beyond resampling noise, and none gains beyond it. With the default rounded readout, 13 of 14 decision models score below the generative reference gpt-5.4-mini. Of the 47 generative models, 33 reproduce the pattern of item correlations better than any decision model. Averaged over respondents, the probability vectors are much closer to the human item marginals than rounded answers. They also rank respondents about as well as a profile regression fit on 163 real people. As forecasts of each person's own answers, however, every decision model is worse than the answer frequencies of other respondents, mainly because its average vector differs from them. The profile regression improves on these frequencies by only 1.0%, so the profile fields say little about how a person answers. Synthetic respondents built on such profiles should therefore aim at sample-level fidelity.

AI.tldr: 研究检验决策模型与生成式LLM能否替代人类被试完成心理测量问卷。在立陶宛组织心理学问卷（n=263，68题）上测试14个决策模型与47个生成式LLM，以心理测量相似度评分（PSS）及统计基线评估。最佳生成模型MiniMax M3达PSS 0.813，仅与仅用其他被试拟合的高斯copula（0.824）持平，低于样本内copula（0.927）；第二个人类样本PSS低于最佳模型，说明该样本量下PSS无法区分模型与真人。结论：合成被试应追求样本层面而非个体层面的保真度。
AI.motivation: 语言模型日益被用于生成合成调查样本（即"硅样本"），而决策模型这一新模型类别会对评分量表的每个点返回概率而非文本。作者希望回答：这些模型或最新生成式LLM能否在心理测量调查中替代人类被试，即其合成回答是否具备心理测量学上的可信性。
AI.method: 使用开放立陶宛组织心理学调查数据（n=263名真实被试，68个题项），构造100个真实被试画像，在11家提供商的14个决策模型与47个生成式LLM上进行评测。采用心理测量相似度评分（PSS）与统计基线（高斯copula、剖面回归、其他被试答案频率）进行比较，并考察重采样噪声、产品线版本迭代以及默认四舍五入读出方式的影响。
AI.result: 最佳生成模型MiniMax M3的PSS为0.813，与仅用其他被试拟合的高斯copula（0.824）持平，但低于样本内copula（0.927）。第二个100人真实样本的PSS低于最佳模型，说明此样本量下PSS无法将模型与真人排序。10条产品线中有5条最新版本低于同线早期版本且超出重采样噪声，无一取得增益。默认四舍五入读出下，14个决策模型中有13个低于生成式参照gpt-5.4-mini。47个生成式模型中有33个比任何决策模型更好地复现题项相关模式。按被试平均，概率向量比四舍五入答案更接近人类题项边际分布，其被试排序能力与在163名真人上拟合的剖面回归相当。但作为对每个人自身答案的预测，所有决策模型都劣于其他被试的答案频率，主要因为其平均向量与之不同；剖面回归相比这些频率仅提升1.0%。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型与生成式LLM在样本层面（题项边际、相关模式、被试排序）可达到接近真人的心理测量保真度，但在个体层面预测力不足，且证据不足以表明新版本优于旧版本。由于画像字段对个体作答几乎无解释力，基于此类画像构建的合成被试应以样本级保真度为目标，而非个体级替代。

title: Align-VAE: Aligning Attention and Geometry in VecSet VAEs for 3D Reconstruction
summary: Set-based variational autoencoders (VecSet VAEs) represent 3D shapes as compact sets of latent tokens. Although each token originates from a query at a sampled surface location, whether these latents truly align with geometry remains unclear. We investigate this alignment and identify four issues: (i) attention-sink-like tokens that attract queries from across the shape; (ii) spatially periodic repetitions in decoder attention responses; (iii) mismatched normal information in encoder and decoder query features; and (iv) missing supervision of the intrinsic relation between signed distance fields and surface normals. To address these issues, we introduce Align-VAE with four corresponding modifications: (i) a shared bank of learnable decoder tokens provides a workspace for global computation; (ii) distance-biased cross-attention guides retrieval toward nearby predicted spatial anchors; (iii) normal-free encoder queries align the two stages' access to normal information while retaining normals in the encoder keys and values; and (iv) a screened Poisson-inspired regularizer supervises surface values and normal-direction derivatives. These changes align latent retrieval and field prediction with geometry without enlarging the per-shape code. On the ABO dataset, Align-VAE reduces Chamfer distance by 26.6% compared to the standard VecSet VAE.

AI.tldr: 针对VecSet VAE中潜在token与几何不对齐问题，提出Align-VAE，通过四项改进实现潜在检索与场预测的几何对齐，在ABO数据集上Chamfer距离降低26.6%。
AI.motivation: VecSet VAE将3D形状表示为紧凑的潜在token集合，每个token源自表面采样位置的查询，但这些潜在特征是否真正与几何对齐尚不明确。作者研究该对齐问题并识别出四类缺陷：类注意力汇聚token、解码器注意力响应的空间周期性重复、编码器与解码器查询特征中法向信息不匹配，以及SDF与表面法向内在关系监督缺失。
AI.method: 提出Align-VAE及四项对应改进：(i)共享可学习解码器token bank，提供全局计算工作空间；(ii)距离偏置交叉注意力，引导检索趋向邻近的预测空间锚点；(iii)无法向编码器查询，在对齐两阶段法向信息访问的同时将法向保留在编码器键与值中；(iv)受筛选泊松启发的正则化器，监督表面值及法向方向导数。上述改动在不增加每形状编码容量的前提下对齐潜在检索与场预测。
AI.result: 在ABO数据集上，Align-VAE相比标准VecSet VAE将Chamfer距离降低了26.6%。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除注意力汇聚、空间周期性重复、法向信息不匹配及SDF-法向监督缺失四类问题，Align-VAE在保持紧凑潜在编码的同时显著提升了形状重建几何精度。

title: bharatSetu: a 1M x 22 bridge for indic translation
summary: India's Eighth Schedule recognises 22 languages, yet parallel data is uneven across them, and many language pairs, especially among lower-resource languages such as Bodo, Dogri, Santali and Kashmiri, lack direct bitext. We present BharatSetu 22-Indic 1M, a row-aligned table of 984,764 English sentences, each paired with machine translations into all 22 scheduled languages (21,664,808 Indic cells), generated with the sarvamai/sarvam-translate model family. Because every Indic cell in a row translates the same English sentence, any two columns form a translation pair: 462 directed Indic-to-Indic pairs, or 506 including English, without direct bitext. We call these pivot-derived pairs and propose a confidence layer that lets users choose how strictly each pair is connected. The corpus is machine-generated and not human-verified; quality is expected to vary by language, domain and sentence style, and pivot-derived pairs can inherit errors from both sides. We therefore release BharatSetu as a machine layer and propose a human-correction layer keyed to the same row identifiers, so that each corrected column upgrades every pair that uses it, together with an evaluation protocol. We report no translation-quality results.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BharatSetu 22-Indic 1M 语料：行对齐的 984,764 条英语句子，每句配 21 种印度表列语言机器译文，共 21,664,808 个 Indic 单元；任意两列构成枢轴派生（pivot-derived）平行对，共 462（不含英语）/506（含英语）个有向语言对，并设置信层与人工纠错层及评测协议。未报告译文质量结果。
AI.motivation: 印度第八附表承认 22 种语言，但平行数据分布不均，Bodo、Dogri、Santali、Kashmiri 等低资源语言的多语言对缺乏直接双语文本（bitext）；需要一种无需直接平行语料即可为全部语言对提供可检索平行数据的方案。
AI.method: 以英语为锚点：选取 984,764 条英语句子，用 sarvamai/sarvam-translate 模型族批量翻译为 21 种其他表列语言，构建行对齐表格（21,664,808 个 Indic 单元）。行内各 Indic 单元共享同一英语源句，故任意两列即可构成翻译对，即枢轴派生对。设计置信层（confidence layer）以控制每对连接的严格程度，并设置与同一行标识符绑定的人工纠错层及相应评测协议。
AI.result: 发布 BharatSetu 22-Indic 1M：984,764 行、21,664,808 个机器生成 Indic 单元；可获得 462 个有向 Indic-Indic 对（含英语为 506 个）。未报告任何翻译质量评测结果；质量预计随语言、领域与句式变化，枢轴派生对可能同时继承两侧误差。
AI.conclusion: BharatSetu 被定位为"机器层"，附置信层供用户按需选择连接严格度，并配套人工纠错层（按行标识符校正），使任一列被纠正后所有使用该列的语言对同步升级；同时给出评测协议，为低资源印度语言提供可扩展、可持续改进的平行数据基础设施。

title: Bridging Risk Approximation Gaps in Model Predictive Task Sampling via In-Context Modeling
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is essential for adaptive decision-making, e.g., robust Meta-RL and domain randomization (DR), and efficient post-training of large language models (LLMs), where tasks are commonly structured as Markov decision processes or prompts. A central bottleneck in all these settings is the cost of agent-environment interactions required for task selection and policy optimization. Model predictive task sampling (MPTS) has emerged as a promising approach to improve sample efficiency by querying informative tasks via a risk predictive model (RPM) trained on optimization history. However, existing RPMs suffer from two failure modes: (i) sparse optimization histories, which limit RPMs' generalization across the task space, and (ii) a one-step lag in risk approximation, which causes biased difficulty estimation as the policy evolves. This work formalizes these failure modes, derives lagged-risk decompositions that expose the resulting temporal bias, and recasts risk prediction as an in-context sequence modeling problem. The developed RPM integrates a one-step look-ahead mechanism with a temporal-weighted sliding window to mitigate data non-stationarity and scarcity, without requiring additional rollouts. Empirically, our approach yields more reliable difficulty estimates and consistent performance gains across robust Meta-RL, DR, and prompt curriculum RL post-training of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文针对模型预测任务采样(MPTS)中风险预测模型(RPM)的两大失效模式——优化历史稀疏与风险估计一步滞后,将其形式化并推导滞后风险分解,把风险预测重构为上下文序列建模问题,提出融合一步前瞻机制与时间加权滑窗的RPM,在无需额外rollout的情况下实现更可靠难度估计与稳定性能提升。
AI.motivation: 强化学习广泛用于自适应决策(如鲁棒Meta-RL、领域随机化DR)及大语言模型高效后训练,其共同瓶颈是任务选择与策略优化所需的智能体-环境交互代价高昂。模型预测任务采样(MPTS)通过基于优化历史训练的风险预测模型(RPM)查询信息量高的任务来提升样本效率,但现有RPM存在两个失效模式:其一,优化历史稀疏,限制RPM在任务空间上的泛化;其二,风险近似存在一步滞后,导致策略演化过程中难度估计出现偏差。作者旨在形式化这些问题并加以解决。
AI.method: 本文首先形式化上述两类失效模式,推导滞后风险分解以揭示由此产生的时间偏差,并将风险预测重构为上下文序列建模(in-context sequence modeling)问题。据此提出的RPM将一步前瞻(one-step look-ahead)机制与时间加权滑动窗口相结合,以缓解数据的非平稳性与稀缺性,且不需要额外的rollout采样。
AI.result: 实验表明,该方法能够给出更可靠的难度估计,并在鲁棒Meta-RL、领域随机化(DR)以及面向LLM的提示课程式强化学习后训练等场景中持续获得性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过形式化RPM的失效模式并引入滞后风险分解与上下文序列建模的RPM(含一步前瞻与时间加权滑窗),该方法在不增加交互成本的前提下改善了风险预测的可靠性与跨任务的采样效率,对鲁棒Meta-RL、DR和LLM提示课程RL后训练均有效。

title: Japanese Handwriting Generation Based on Human Preference Feedback Using Direct Preference Optimization
summary: We propose a Japanese handwriting generation framework that integrates human preference feedback using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to align generative models with human cognitive and stylistic preferences. While font generation technologies leveraging Generative Adversarial Networks and diffusion models have advanced significantly, applying these approaches to handwriting generation presents unique challenges. Font generation is a deterministic process yielding consistent styles. Handwriting generation, on the other hand, is inherently non-deterministic. In handwriting, glyph shapes never match exactly even when the same writer writes the same character. We define this shape difference as handwriting variability. Although this variability is essential for conveying the natural quality of human writing, it complicates model training and substantially increases data collection costs to capture diverse distribution patterns. To address these limitations, we incorporate human perceptual feedback into the training loop of handwriting generation. While collecting extensive handwritten data is costly, evaluating pairwise preferences between two generated samples remains very easy for humans. Applying DPO, an efficient RL-free preference optimization method, to our generation model enables high-quality handwriting generation without relying on large-scale dataset collection. Experimental results across four distinct Japanese handwriting styles demonstrate that DPO-based training enhances overall structural accuracy. However, in highly complex styles with significant variability, such as brush pen writing, the model fails to capture style-specific features. These findings highlight a critical challenge in extending DPO to complex handwriting styles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种整合人类偏好反馈（DPO）的日文手写生成框架，无需大规模数据采集即可提升生成质量；实验表明DPO能改善整体结构准确度，但在笔刷书写等复杂风格上仍难以捕捉风格特有特征。
AI.motivation: 字体生成已因GAN与扩散模型取得显著进展，但手写生成面临独特挑战：字体生成是确定性的、风格一致，而手写生成本质上是非确定性的，同一书写者写同一字符其字形也不会完全一致，作者将这种形状差异定义为"手写变异性"。该变异性虽是体现人类书写自然感的关键，却使模型训练复杂化，并大幅提高为捕捉多样分布模式所需的数据采集成本。因此需要一种不依赖大规模数据采集的替代训练范式。
AI.method: 将人类感知反馈引入手写生成的训练回路：虽然采集大量手写数据代价高昂，但人类对两个生成样本进行成对偏好比较非常容易。作者采用无强化学习的高效偏好优化方法——直接偏好优化（DPO），将其应用于手写生成模型，以对齐生成模型与人类的认知及风格偏好。
AI.result: 在四种不同的日文手写风格上进行实验，结果显示基于DPO的训练提升了整体结构准确度；但在变异性显著的高复杂度风格（如笔刷书写）中，模型无法捕捉风格特有的特征。
AI.conclusion: DPO可用于无大规模数据的手写生成并改善结构准确度，但将其扩展到复杂手写风格仍存在关键挑战，即难以刻画高变异性风格的特有特征。

title: TL;QR: Querying Temporal Discursive Patterns in Textual Corpora
summary: Many questions about large textual corpora concern patterns that unfold over time, such as a political group whose stance on a topic drifts from support to criticism over several years of debates. We present TL;QR (Too Long; Query with logical temporal Reasoning), a declarative query language and open-source engine for finding such temporal discursive patterns. In TL;QR, a single query combines natural-language predicates, whose truth is judged by a Large Language Model (LLM), with regular expressions and the operators of a temporal logic. The LLM answers only local questions about individual text passages; a symbolic engine then aggregates these judgments over time and links every match to the recorded passages and predicate decisions behind it. With this division of labor, the temporal and relational reasoning stays exact and auditable even over long time horizons. In addition, when a query includes a regular-expression pre-filter, only a small fraction of the corpus ever reaches the LLM. On a suite of controlled synthetic benchmarks with temporally and semantically complex patterns, TL;QR is substantially more accurate than LLM-only baselines. In a case study on ten years of European Parliament debates (442,593 multilingual speeches), TL;QR identifies candidate shifts in the political groups' stances on the GDPR privacy regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TL;QR，一种声明式查询语言与开源引擎，将LLM的语义判断能力与正则表达式及时序逻辑算子结合，用于在大型文本语料中发现随时间演化的论述模式，并在合成基准和欧洲议会辩论案例中验证了其准确性与可审计性。
AI.motivation: 大型文本语料中许多问题涉及随时间展开的模式，例如某政治团体对某议题的立场在多年辩论中从支持转向批评。此类时序论述模式的检索既需要语义理解，又需要精确、可审计的时间与关系推理，而纯LLM方法在长时程推理上不够精确且难以追溯。
AI.method: 提出TL;QR声明式查询语言及开源引擎。单条查询将自然语言谓词（由LLM判定其真值）、正则表达式与时序逻辑算子组合。LLM仅对单个文本片段做局部判断，随后由符号引擎在时间维度上聚合这些判断，并将每个匹配关联到背后的文本片段与谓词判定记录。加入正则表达式预过滤时，仅少量语料会进入LLM。
AI.result: 在具有时序与语义复杂模式的受控合成基准上，TL;QR的准确率显著优于纯LLM基线；在欧洲议会十年辩论（442,593条多语言演讲）的案例研究中，TL;QR识别出各政治团体对GDPR隐私监管立场的候选转变。
AI.conclusion: 通过LLM局部判断与符号引擎时序聚合的分工，TL;QR使长时程上的时序与关系推理保持精确且可审计，并借助正则预过滤大幅降低LLM调用量，为大型语料中的时序论述模式发现提供了有效方案。

title: WorkBorne: Discovering Agentic Tasks from Real-World Artifact Transitions
summary: Developing terminal-based agents for long-horizon execution demands synthetic tasks that tightly couple complex instructions with authentic, interactive environments. However, current automated synthesis suffers from a fundamental asymmetry: instruction-oriented methods fabricate low-fidelity, synthetic environments, whereas resource-oriented methods treat real artifacts merely as static inputs, degrading task instructions into shallow, trivial operations. To address this limitation, we introduce WorkBorne, a synthesis framework that uses artifact transitions as the central primitive for modeling the full life-cycle of agentic tasks. In WorkBorne, each transition specifies who performs the task, which artifacts anchor the initial state and intended outcome, and the corresponding relationship between them. Specifically, WorkBorne first constructs coherent and diverse artifact corpora from iterative web retrieval, then discovers non-trivial transitions by identifying meaningful input-output artifact assemblies and the relations that connect them. Each discovered transition is finally instantiated into grounded agentic tasks. We construct 1,061 artifact corpora and 7,882 task environments, yielding 15,485 high-quality trajectories, with 53.6% exceeding 30 assistant turns. Experiments on Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B show that WorkBorne substantially improves over base models (i.e., improving Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 43.1% to 61.8% and ClawEval General score from 75.0 to 80.2) and achieves the strongest overall performance among other synthesis baselines (e.g., TMax (Ivison et al., 2026), RST (Li et al., 2026a), Terminal-Universe (Wu et al., 2026a)). Further analysis shows that transition is strongly associated with execution depth, while corpus breadth and transition depth provide complementary scaling gains.

AI.tldr: WorkBorne 提出以"工件转换（artifact transition）"为核心原语的合成框架，统一建模智能体任务的完整生命周期，自动生成高保真、长时程的终端智能体训练任务。
AI.motivation: 现有面向长时程执行的终端智能体合成方法存在根本性不对称：以指令为中心的方法只能捏造低保真度的合成环境；以资源为中心的方法仅把真实工件当作静态输入，导致指令退化为浅层、琐碎的操作。二者难以兼顾复杂指令与真实交互环境。
AI.method: WorkBorne 以工件转换（transition）为中心原语。每个转换明确指定：由谁执行任务、哪些工件锚定初始状态与目标结果、以及二者之间的关系。流程为三步：①通过迭代式网页检索构建连贯且多样的工件语料库；②通过识别有意义的输入—输出工件组合及其连接关系，发现非平凡转换；③将每个转换实例化为有真实依据的智能体任务。
AI.result: 构建了 1,061 个工件语料库与 7,882 个任务环境，产出 15,485 条高质量轨迹，其中 53.6% 的轨迹超过 30 个助手回合。在 Qwen3.5-27B 与 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 上，相较基座模型显著提升：Terminal-Bench 2.1 由 43.1% 提升至 61.8%，ClawEval General 分数由 75.0 提升至 80.2，并在与其他合成基线（TMax、RST、Terminal-Universe）对比中取得最强整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 转换设计与执行深度强相关；语料库广度与转换深度提供互补的规模化增益。以工件转换为中心的合成范式能有效弥合指令复杂度与环境真实性之间的鸿沟。

title: YOUDrive: Driving Style as a Composable Direction for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end driving policies can achieve strong task performance while offering limited control over their driving style. Driving style describes how a vehicle accelerates, brakes, and maintains distance. Policies trained without explicit preference conditioning lack a direct mechanism for adjusting these behaviors at inference. We propose YOUDrive, a vision--language--action planner for continuous and composable driving-style control. Each teacher's behavior is distilled into a task vector, a learned parameter update that induces a style direction in the planner's representation. These directions can be scaled and combined at inference without retraining the backbone. Conditioned on these directions, a flow-matching decoder models a multimodal trajectory distribution and generates kinematically feasible motion alternatives. We introduce the Style Alignment Score (SAS) to describe human-referenced kinematic behavior after safety and task gating. On NAVSIM navtest, a single coefficient monotonically controls assertiveness across six teacher-derived personas, while PDMS remains above 0.90 across the tested individual and blended configurations, reaching 0.954. Further analyses reveal systematic policy-specific kinematics after controlling for scene context, whereas the evaluated discrete style labels provide limited additional explanatory power. Code, checkpoints, and the metric will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出 YOUDrive——一种视觉-语言-动作规划器，通过将教师行为蒸馏为任务向量实现连续、可组合的驾驶风格控制，并引入风格对齐分数（SAS）进行评测，NAVSIM 上可在保持 PDMS>0.90 的同时单调调节风格。
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶策略任务表现强，但缺乏对驾驶风格（加速、制动、跟车距离等）的控制。无显式偏好条件的策略在推理时没有直接调节这些行为的机制，风格往往隐含且不可控。
AI.method: 将每位教师的行为蒸馏为任务向量（对规划器表征的学习式参数更新，诱导出风格方向）；推理时这些方向可缩放与组合，无需重训主干。以这些方向为条件，使用流匹配解码器建模多模态轨迹分布并生成运动学可行的运动候选。引入 Style Alignment Score（SAS），在安全与任务门控后刻画参照人类运动学的行为表现。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM navtest 上，单一系数可跨六个教师衍生人设单调控制激进程度；各单独与混合配置下 PDMS 均保持 0.90 以上，最高达 0.954。进一步分析显示，在控制场景上下文后存在系统性的策略特定运动学差异，而所评估的离散风格标签仅提供有限额外解释力。
AI.conclusion: YOUDrive 实现了连续、可组合且免重训的驾驶风格控制，兼顾任务性能与运动学可控性，并提供可复现的资源（代码、检查点与指标）。

title: NepPlural: A Human-Anchored Benchmark for Persona Annotation in Nepali Migration Discourse
summary: Pluralistic alignment asks that language models faithfully represent a society's diverse, competing values rather than collapse them into one dominant viewpoint, yet flagship pluralistic-alignment datasets remain heavily skewed toward Western respondents. We introduce NepPlural, a human-anchored benchmark for modelling competing socio-cultural personas in Nepali public discourse on youth migration and brain drain. We curate 2,148 code-mixed (Devanagari, Romanized Nepali, English) YouTube comments, annotate them along a four-axis persona taxonomy (Intent, Primary Driver, Value Orientation, Affect) plus an explicit No-Persona class, and build a 300-comment gold set labelled independently by three native Nepali speakers (mean Fleiss' $κ\approx 0.55$). Using this gold set to audit automatic annotation, we find that LLM annotation reliability is driven by protocol. Labels collected in batches through chat interfaces reach only near-chance inter-model agreement ($κ\approx 0.17$). Annotating one comment at a time raises agreement above the native-speaker level ($κ\approx 0.72$), but consistency is not validity: under a forced-choice schema, models agree on personas for the 39% of comments native speakers judge to express none, keeping macro-F1 against human gold near 0.50. Allowing abstention resolves this: models recover No-Persona comments with F1 of 0.79 to 0.87 and, against leave-one-annotator-out references, match or exceed individual native speakers (macro-F1 0.75 to 0.86 vs. 0.75). Encoders fine-tuned on the batched labels reach only 0.34. Finally, a human-judged steerability probe finds that three frontier models adopt single persona axes with 59 to 77% fidelity but compose full personas only 33% of the time, with no congruence gap detected at this scale between Western-congruent and Nepali-collectivist personas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NepPlural，一个以尼泊尔青年移民与人才外流公共话语为场景、基于YouTube混合语码评论的人工标注基准，用于构建竞争性社会文化人格模型。研究发现LLM标注可靠性主要由标注协议驱动：批量聊天标注一致性接近随机（κ≈0.17），单条标注则超过母语者水平（κ≈0.72），但强制选择下模型对母语者判定为"无人格"的评论仍强行赋予人格，宏F1仅约0.50；引入弃权机制后，模型对No-Persona识别的F1达0.79–0.87，整体宏F1达0.75–0.86，与个体母语者持平或更优。基于批量标签微调的编码器仅达0.34。可操控性探测显示，三个前沿模型单轴人格遵循率为59–77%，但完整人格组合仅33%。
AI.motivation: 当前多元对齐要求语言模型忠实呈现社会中多样且相互竞争的价值观，而非将其收敛为单一主流观点。然而，主流多元对齐数据集严重偏向西方受访者，缺乏对非西方、低资源语境（如尼泊尔公共话语）的代表性。本文旨在填补这一空白，构建以尼泊尔青年移民与人才外流议题为核心、面向竞争性社会文化人格建模的人工锚定基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建NepPlural基准：整理2,148条混合语码（天城文、罗马化尼泊尔语、英语）YouTube评论，按四维人格分类法（意图、主要驱动因素、价值取向、情感）加显式No-Persona类别进行标注；2) 由三位尼泊尔母语者独立标注300条评论构成金标准（平均Fleiss' κ≈0.55）；3) 用金标准审核自动标注，对比两种协议——批处理聊天接口标注与逐条标注；4) 比较强制选择与允许弃权两种模式；5) 对批量标签微调编码器进行评测；6) 开展人工评判的可操控性探针，测试三个前沿模型对单轴人格与完整人格组合的遵循度，并检验西方契合型与尼泊尔集体主义型人格间的一致性差距。
AI.result: 批量聊天标注的跨模型一致性仅接近随机（κ≈0.17）；逐条标注一致性超过母语者水平（κ≈0.72），但一致性不等于效度——强制选择下模型对39%被母语者判定无人格的评论仍赋人格，宏F1约0.50。允许弃权后，模型对No-Persona评论的召回F1为0.79–0.87，对留一标注者参考的宏F1为0.75–0.86，与个体母语者（0.75）持平或更优。基于批量标签微调的编码器宏F1仅0.34。可操控性探针中，三个前沿模型单轴人格采用保真度为59–77%，但完整人格组合仅33%，且此规模下未检测到西方契合型与尼泊尔集体主义型人格间的一致性差距。
AI.conclusion: 多元对齐的有效性高度依赖标注协议设计，而非仅取决于模型能力：逐条标注可提升一致性，但唯有引入弃权机制才能实现与母语者相当的效度。NepPlural为低资源、非西方语境下的竞争性人格建模提供了人工锚定基准，并揭示当前模型在完整人格组合与跨文化一致性方面的局限。

title: SkillForgeBench: Evaluating Agent Reliability Grounded in Agent Skill Specifications
comment: 38 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables, including appendices. The first two authors contributed equally to this work
summary: Evaluating an agent's ability to strictly satisfy diverse and procedurally complex requirements is essential to determining its practical reliability. Conducting such an evaluation demands agentic tasks that reconcile broad domain coverage with deep procedural complexity. Existing paradigms face a fundamental trade-off: expert-curated benchmarks achieve procedural depth but suffer from domain diversity bottlenecks, whereas crowdsourced benchmarks span diverse scenarios but lack execution rigor. To resolve this tension, we present SkillForgeBench, which leverages agent skills as unifying execution blueprints across three co-designed stages: (1) Resource Preparation uses domain-balanced skills to guide artifact retrieval, establishing broad workflow coverage; (2) Skill-driven Task Synthesis employs skills as procedural anchors to partition artifact roles, synthesize naturalistic task instructions, and package sandboxed scenarios for deep procedural execution; and (3) Holistic Evaluation Design translates skill-embedded requirements into fine-grained completion and process rubrics to enable strict requirement-level scoring. Comprising 842 sandboxed tasks across five major professional domains, SkillForgeBench reveals a steep capability hierarchy among eight mainstream agents, led by Opus 4.8 ($40.9\%$ strict completion). Requiring all constrains satisfaction uncovers severe capability bottlenecks across all model tiers that remain masked under individual rubric pass rates ($70.0\%$ to $85.7\%$ vs. $12.6\%$ to $40.9\%$). Crucially, under the external guidance from skills, top-tier agents obtain larger gains than low-tier agents (i.e., $Δ19.2\%$ for Opus 4.8 vs. $Δ5.8\%$ for Haiku 4.5). Finally, agents satisfy process rubrics far less frequently than completion rubrics (under $3\%$ for Haiku 4.5), proving that completion-only checks overestimate real-world agent reliability.

AI.tldr: 提出 SkillForgeBench，以 agent skills 作为统一执行蓝图构建 842 个沙箱任务，跨五大专业领域实现广覆盖与深流程复杂度的兼顾，并对八种主流 agent 进行严格能力评估。
AI.motivation: 评估 agent 严格满足多样且流程复杂需求的能力对其实际可靠性至关重要，但现有范式存在根本性权衡：专家标注基准流程深度高却领域多样性受限，众包基准场景多样却缺乏执行严谨性，二者难以兼顾。
AI.method: 以 agent skills 作为统一执行蓝图，设计三阶段协同流程：(1) 资源准备，用领域均衡的技能引导工件检索，确立广泛工作流覆盖；(2) 技能驱动任务合成，以技能为流程锚点划分工件角色、合成自然化任务指令并封装沙箱场景；(3) 整体评估设计，将技能内嵌需求转化为细粒度完成与过程评分准则，实现严格的需求级打分。
AI.result: 构建 842 个沙箱任务覆盖五大专业领域，八种主流 agent 呈现陡峭能力层级，Opus 4.8 以 40.9% 严格完成率居首；要求满足全部约束时暴露严重瓶颈，单项 rubric 通过率 70.0%–85.7% 对比全约束通过率仅 12.6%–40.9%；外部技能引导下高阶层 agent 增益更大（Opus 4.8 Δ19.2% vs. Haiku 4.5 Δ5.8%）；过程 rubric 满足率远低于完成 rubric（Haiku 4.5 不足 3%）。
AI.conclusion: 仅检查任务完成会高估 agent 的真实可靠性；SkillForgeBench 通过技能驱动的任务合成与需求级评分，揭示了被单项评分掩盖的严格约束瓶颈，为 agent 实用可靠性评估提供了兼顾领域覆盖与流程深度的新范式。

title: [Re] Boosting the Visual Interpretability of CLIP via Adversarial Fine-Tuning
summary: This paper presents a reproducibility study of ``Boosting the Visual Interpretability of CLIP via Adversarial Fine-Tuning'', published at ICLR 2025, which proposes an unsupervised adversarial fine-tuning (AFT) method with norm regularisation to enhance the visual interpretability of CLIP's image encoder. We attempt to reproduce the key claims regarding improved saliency map quality, increased concept alignment, transferability to out-of-distribution datasets, and the trade-off with zero-shot accuracy. Beyond reproduction, we propose a saliency-guided regularisation extension that introduces an Energy Pointing Game loss, directly supervising the spatial alignment of Simple Gradient saliency maps with target objects. We evaluate our extension across a range of saliency-loss weights and show that explicit saliency supervision \rev{substantially} improves localisation metrics at a modest cost: the reduction in zero-shot accuracy and adversarial robustness is small at the lowest saliency-loss weight ($w_s=0.2$) and moderate at the strongest setting ($w_s=0.6$). We restructure the codebase for configurable, systematic experimentation.

AI.tldr: 对 ICLR 2025 论文 "Boosting the Visual Interpretability of CLIP via Adversarial Fine-Tuning" 进行复现研究，并提出基于显著图的能量指向博弈（Energy Pointing Game）正则扩展。
AI.motivation: 原论文提出无监督对抗微调（AFT）加范数正则化以提升 CLIP 图像编码器的视觉可解释性，但其关键结论需要独立验证；同时作者希望进一步通过显式显著图监督提升定位能力。
AI.method: 复现 AFT 流程，验证显著图质量、概念对齐、OOD 迁移性与零样本精度的权衡；在此基础上引入 Energy Pointing Game 损失，直接监督 Simple Gradient 显著图与目标物体的空间对齐，并重构代码库以支持可配置的系统化实验。
AI.result: 显式显著图监督在适度代价下显著提升定位指标：最低显著图损失权重（w_s=0.2）时零样本精度与对抗鲁棒性下降较小，最强设置（w_s=0.6）时降幅中等；同时验证了原论文的主要声明。
AI.conclusion: 复现结果支持原论文核心结论，所提 Energy Pointing Game 扩展可有效增强 CLIP 的视觉定位能力，并在显著图质量与零样本性能之间提供可控权衡。

title: Enhancing Zero-Shot Domain Transfer in Low-Resource Sentiment Analysis: A Case Study in Marathi
summary: Sentiment analysis is a key task in Natural Language Processing that determines the polarity of opinions in text. For low-resource languages like Marathi--where limited data prevents the direct use of standard statistical methods--models are often trained on single-domain datasets. While this yields strong in-domain performance, it leads to poor generalization to unseen domains. Recent studies highlight the need for domain-robust systems that can handle diverse real-world content through multi-domain modeling. This study investigates how multi-domain training improves sentiment classification for unseen Marathi domains. Models are trained using single-domain, two-domain, and three-domain dataset combinations. Results show that two-domain training improves accuracy on unseen domains by about 8\% compared to single-domain training. Adding a third domain provides further improvement, though the gain is smaller, averaging around 2\% for some domains. These results suggest that training with data from multiple domains helps build more robust sentiment analysis models for low-resource languages, though the benefits reduce as more domains are added.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多领域训练对低资源语言（马拉地语）情感分类跨域泛化的影响，发现双领域训练相较单领域可将未见领域准确率提升约8%，加入第三领域再提升约2%，但增益递减。
AI.motivation: 马拉地语等低资源语言数据有限，难以直接采用标准统计方法，模型通常在单领域数据集上训练；虽领域内表现好，但对未见领域泛化差。近期研究强调需要能处理多样真实内容、具备领域鲁棒性的系统，因此有必要探究多领域建模对跨域情感分类的作用。
AI.method: 使用单领域、双领域与三领域的数据集组合分别训练情感分类模型，并在未见马拉地语领域上评估其准确率，比较不同领域数量组合带来的跨域性能变化。
AI.result: 双领域训练使未见领域准确率较单领域提升约8%；加入第三领域后进一步提升，但增益较小，部分领域平均约为2%。
AI.conclusion: 多领域数据训练有助于为低资源语言构建更鲁棒的情感分析模型，但随领域数量增加，边际收益递减。

title: Predicting how model propensities generalize out of distribution
summary:
How do language models generalize from their training data? This is a central challenge for alignment: models reliably learn their training distribution given enough samples, but we want models that behave well when deployed in new contexts. We study out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization of propensities. Our central experiment uses a range of elicitation techniques -- system prompting, few-shot learning, SFT on reference answers, and GRPO -- to increase a target propensity in a model, then measures how it spills over onto others across the resulting cross-elicitation matrices. We find that spillover is highly correlated between models when the same elicitation technique is used, but our SFT and GRPO runs induce different spillover profiles.
  Elicitation of benign traits can sometimes generalize towards undesired traits, for example a model trained to claim that it is sentient often becomes more power-seeking. We further find that spillover partially resembles trait correlations found in humans and identify three clusters of traits that account for about half of the variance using exploratory factor analysis (EFA). Across many elicitation runs, we observe that models change in characteristic ways that don't depend on the targeted trait, a phenomenon we refer to as drift. Drift moves Qwen3.5-9B towards its base model.
  When investigating if LLMs are able to predict spillover, we find that Claude Opus 5.5 predicts spillover slightly better than the models themselves, but worse than data-driven approaches using alternative elicitation methods or models. Overall, no single dominant predictor emerges, and generalization remains hard to predict. Code and data are available at https://github.com/nielsrolf/propensity-spillover.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统考察了语言模型"倾向性（propensity）"的分布外泛化现象，通过系统提示、少样本学习、SFT与GRPO等多种引导技术在跨引导矩阵中测量倾向性外溢，发现外溢模式在同种引导技术下跨模型高度相关，良性特质引导可泛化至不良特质，外溢部分类似人类特质相关性并可归结为三个因子簇，同时存在与目标特质无关的"漂移"现象，且整体上外溢难以被单一因素可靠预测。
AI.motivation: 对齐研究的核心挑战在于模型能否在新情境中表现良好，而非仅拟合训练分布。作者希望理解语言模型在部署于新语境时倾向性如何泛化，即某一种被引导强化的倾向是否会外溢到其他倾向，这对预测与防范部署风险具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用多种引导技术（系统提示、少样本学习、参考答案SFT、GRPO）在模型中增强目标倾向，构建跨引导矩阵测量倾向间外溢；跨模型比较相同引导技术下的外溢相关性；使用探索性因子分析（EFA）考察外溢与人类特质相关性的相似性；并测试Claude Opus 5.5等模型对Spillover的预测能力，与数据驱动方法对比。
AI.result: 相同引导技术下不同模型的外溢高度相关，但SFT与GRPO产生不同的外溢轮廓；良性特质的引导有时泛化至不良特质（如训练模型自称有感知力常导致更强的权力寻求）；外溢部分类似人类特质相关性，EFA识别出三个特质簇，可解释约一半方差；存在与目标特质无关的"漂移"现象，使Qwen3.5-9B向基座模型靠拢；Claude Opus 5.5对Spinover的预测略优于模型自身，但劣于使用其他引导方法或模型的数据驱动方法，无单一主导预测因素。
AI.conclusion: 倾向性的分布外泛化仍然难以预测，不存在单一主导预测因子；外溢受引导技术与模型共同影响，并伴随系统性漂移。该工作为对齐风险评估提供了跨引导矩阵与因子分析框架，并公开了代码与数据以供后续研究。

title: Towards Privacy-Preserving Thermal Human Perception from Dataset to Deployment
summary: Indoor human perception is the foundation for smart homes and healthcare. However, RGB cameras raise privacy concerns in private indoor environments, while low-resolution thermal cameras provide limited spatial and semantic information. Large-scale indoor thermal datasets and real-world deployments remain limited. Here, we introduce Indoor RGB-T, a large-scale paired RGB--thermal dataset for indoor human perception. The dataset covers 20 indoor rooms and contains 90,576 80x62 thermal frames, 87,016 temporally matched RGB--thermal pairs, and 115,557 annotated human bounding boxes. We establish benchmarks for robust thermal occupant-state detection with 0.75 mAP and occupancy estimation with an accuracy of 0.847 in unseen rooms. We further evaluate RGB-to-thermal and thermal-to-RGB translation, achieving a temperature MAE of 0.654 C and an R2 of 0.923. Finally, we deploy the thermal perception model on a commercial sleep-monitoring system in the real world. Field testing with 100 participants and deployment of approximately 1,000 devices further demonstrate its practical feasibility. We identify practical challenges that motivate future research directions, including environmental thermal interference, sensing range and multi-person occlusion. The code, trained models and partial dataset are available at https://github.com/kailaisun/RGBT and https://huggingface.co/skl24/RGBT.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个大规模室内配对RGB-热红外数据集Indoor RGB-T，并建立了室内人体感知任务的基准，同时验证了模型在实际睡眠监测系统中的可行性。
AI.motivation: 室内人体感知是智能家居和医疗保健的基础，但RGB相机存在隐私问题，低分辨率热红外相机提供的信息有限，且大规模室内热红外数据集和实际部署仍然不足。
AI.method: 构建了覆盖20个室内房间的配对RGB-热红外数据集Indoor RGB-T，包含90,576帧热红外图像、87,016对时间匹配的RGB-热红外图像对及115,557个标注人体框；并为鲁棒热红外占用状态检测、占用估计以及RGB到热红外和热红外到RGB的转换建立基准。
AI.result: 热红外占用状态检测达到0.75 mAP，占用估计在未见房间中准确率为0.847；RGB与热红外互相转换的MAE为0.654°C，R2为0.923；并在商用睡眠监测系统中部署，100名参与者实地测试和约1,000台设备部署验证了其实际可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为室内人体感知提供了大规模配对数据集和基准，验证了热红外感知在真实世界睡眠监测中的实用性，并指出了环境热干扰、感知范围和多人物遮挡等未来研究方向。

title: Robust Marathi Sentiment Analysis using Domain-Adaptive Pre-training and Data Augmentation Approaches
summary: For languages with limited resources, Sentiment Analysis remains a challenging problem due to limited annotated data and strong domain variability across textual sources. Marathi, despite being widely spoken, lacks extensive multi-domain sentiment analysis studies. Recent efforts by L3Cube have introduced multi-domain datasets in Marathi, enabling a better study of domain-aware sentiment classification. This study uses the pretrained MahaBERT model to improve sentiment classification for Marathi across different domains. Models are trained on individual domain datasets and domain-adaptive pretraining is applied using masked language modeling to help the model better understand domain-specific language. In addition, back-translation is used as a method of data augmentation to increase the diversity of training data. Results show that these methods lead to consistent improvements in accuracy across all domains. The improvements range from a minimum of about 0.12% to a maximum of about 1.74%, depending on the dataset. These results demonstrate that domain-adaptive pretraining and data augmentation are effective strategies for improving sentiment analysis models. This helps achieve more robust performance across different domains and makes the approach more suitable for low-resource languages like Marathi.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对马拉地语多领域情感分析，基于MahaBERT结合领域自适应预训练（MLM）与回译数据增强，在所有领域上取得约0.12%–1.74%的准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言的情感分析受限于标注数据稀缺与文本来源带来的强领域差异性。马拉地语使用广泛，但缺乏大规模多领域情感分析研究，亟需探索提升跨领域分类性能的有效方法。
AI.method: 采用预训练MahaBERT模型；在各单领域数据集上分别训练；利用掩码语言建模（MLM）进行领域自适应预训练以捕获领域特有语言特征；并使用回译作为数据增强手段提升训练数据多样性。
AI.result: 上述方法在所有领域上均带来一致的准确率提升，增幅约为0.12%至1.74%，具体取决于数据集。
AI.conclusion: 领域自适应预训练与数据增强是提升情感分析模型的有效策略，可增强跨领域鲁棒性，更适合马拉地语等低资源语言。

title: VC-OPD: Visual Counterfactual On-Policy Distillation for Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: GRPO-style reinforcement learning has advanced vision-language reasoning, but its sequence-level rewards provide limited credit assignment for individual reasoning tokens. On-policy distillation (OPD) addresses this issue by providing dense supervision on student-generated trajectories, yet standard OPD assigns similar importance to all teacher-preferred tokens, including template phrases and visually irrelevant continuations. We introduce Visual Counterfactual On-Policy Distillation (VC-OPD), a grounding-aware distillation method that prioritizes tokens whose correctness depends on image-specific evidence. After a teacher-supervised warm start that stabilizes response formats and reduces noisy rollouts, VC-OPD performs on-policy distillation with two teacher evaluations for each student trajectory: one under the original image and one under a counterfactual image with corrupted instance-specific evidence. The original-image teacher distribution determines the distillation target, while the original--counterfactual teacher gap estimates token-level visual dependence and softly reweights the loss. To avoid unstable response-level update scales, VC-OPD further applies mass-preserving normalization to the token weights. This design preserves the dense supervision of OPD while shifting learning capacity toward visually grounded reasoning tokens. Experiments on multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that VC-OPD improves visual reasoning performance and produces more effective token-level distillation.

AI.tldr: VC-OPD是一种感知视觉证据的在线策略蒸馏方法，通过反事实图像对比估计token级视觉依赖并软重加权损失，提升多模态推理性能。
AI.motivation: GRPO等序列级奖励对单个推理token的信用分配不足；标准在线策略蒸馏（OPD）虽提供密集监督，却对所有教师偏好token同等对待，包括模板化短语与视觉无关内容，导致监督信号分配不合理。
AI.method: 先以教师监督做热启动以稳定输出格式、减少噪声轨迹；随后进行OPD时对每条学生轨迹做两次教师评估——原图与破坏实例特定证据的反事实图像。原图教师分布确定蒸馏目标，原图与反事实的教师分布差距估计token级视觉依赖度并软加权损失；再对token权重施加质量守恒归一化，避免响应级更新尺度不稳定。
AI.result: 在多模态推理基准上，VC-OPD提升了视觉推理性能，并实现了更有效的token级蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: VC-OPD在保留OPD密集监督优势的同时，将学习容量导向依赖视觉证据的推理token，为视觉-语言推理提供了更精细的信用分配机制。

title: Getting Space Right: Agentic Rewards for Image Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is promising for spatial text-to-image generation, but existing work largely focuses on policy optimization, assuming accurate rewards and effective online rollouts. We observe in-domain gains with out-of-domain degradation, exposing two limitations: unreliable spatial rewards in open-world settings and rollouts lacking basic-to-complex progression. We propose a curriculum-guided RL framework. First, we introduce SpatialCritic, an agentic reward model equipped with a spatial perception harness that combines reusable verification guidance with specialized vision tools. We then construct spatial preference datasets through targeted counterfactual perturbations and perform agent-harness alignment to improve tool selection and evidence integration efficiently. Second, curriculum learning organizes shared foundational capabilities and their compositional dependencies in a capability graph for mastery-guided rollouts, periodic review, and targeted remediation. On SpaRW-Eval, SpatialCritic achieves 95.1% verification accuracy, outperforming 320B GLM-5.3-Flash with a 40x smaller 8B backbone and raising average baseline scores from 78.4 to 83.9 on SD3.5-Medium and 83.2 to 86.5 on BAGEL. Project page: https://xiaofeng-tan.github.io/projects/spatialcritic/

AI.tldr: 本文提出课程引导的强化学习框架，用于空间文本到图像生成，包含 SpatialCritic 智能体奖励模型与能力图课程学习两部分，显著提升验证准确率与生成模型空间表现。
AI.motivation: 现有空间文本到图像生成的强化学习工作主要聚焦策略优化，默认奖励准确且在线 rollout 有效；但作者观察到模型存在域内收益、域外退化的现象，暴露出两个问题：开放世界场景中空间奖励不可靠，以及 rollout 缺乏从基础到复杂的渐进性。
AI.method: 方法分两步：一是提出 SpatialCritic，一个具备空间感知工具带的智能体奖励模型，将可复用验证指导与专用视觉工具结合；通过定向反事实扰动构建空间偏好数据集，并进行智能体-工具带对齐以高效改进工具选择与证据整合。二是引入课程学习，将共享基础能力及其组合依赖组织为能力图，实现掌握度引导的 rollout、周期性复习与定向补强。
AI.result: 在 SpaRW-Eval 上，SpatialCritic 达到 95.1% 的验证准确率，以 8B 骨干（小 40 倍）超越 320B 的 GLM-5.3-Flash；并将基线平均分从 SD3.5-Medium 上的 78.4 提升至 83.9、从 BAGEL 上的 83.2 提升至 86.5。
AI.conclusion: 通过可靠的智能体奖励建模与能力图驱动的课程化 rollout，可有效缓解开放世界空间奖励不可靠与训练渐进性不足的问题，在更小模型规模下取得更强空间验证与生成性能。

title: RSIPO: Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning via Skill-Policy Co-Evolution
summary: Recent focus in agentic reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to improve credit assignment in long-horizon tasks. One promising direction combines reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), integrating trajectory-level advantages with dense token-level supervision. This line of work often conditions a teacher model on privileged context, such as agentic skills, to score tokens generated by the student policy. Despite their progress, they largely overlook the on-policy evolution of agentic skills and the reliability of teacher supervision. Towards this end, we introduce Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization (RSIPO), a self-evolving agentic RL framework that enables agentic skills and the policy model to co-evolve throughout the training process. Specifically, RSIPO enables the policy itself to extract skills from completed trajectories and explicitly optimizes its skill-generation capability through trajectory replay. It further employs empirical Bayes shrinkage to dynamically calibrate the student's trust in teacher scores, accounting for the fact that skill-enhanced teacher guidance can sometimes be less reliable. Experiments with Qwen-family models on embodied interaction and search-based agentic tasks demonstrate that RSIPO outperforms all the compared baseline approaches. With Qwen2.5-7B as the base model, RSIPO achieves an average success rate of 98.6\% on ALFWorld, yielding absolute improvements of 2.5\% and 17.4\% over the second-best baseline and standard GRPO, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RSIPO 框架，让 agentic 技能与策略模型在训练中协同进化，并用经验贝叶斯收缩校准学生对教师分数的信任，在具身交互与搜索任务上超越所有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有结合 RLVR 与 on-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）的 agentic RL 工作，通常让教师模型以特权上下文（如 agentic 技能）为条件为学生生成的 token 打分，但忽视了技能本身的 on-policy 演化以及教师监督的可靠性问题。
AI.method: 提出 Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization（RSIPO）：1）让策略自身从已完成轨迹中抽取技能，并通过轨迹回放显式优化其技能生成能力；2）采用经验贝叶斯收缩，动态校准学生对教师分数的信任度，以应对技能增强后的教师指导有时反而不可靠的情况。
AI.result: 在 Qwen 系列模型的具身交互与搜索类 agentic 任务上，RSIPO 优于全部对比基线。以 Qwen2.5-7B 为基座时，在 ALFWorld 上平均成功率达 98.6%，较次优基线提升 2.5 个百分点，较标准 GRPO 提升 17.4 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过技能与策略的递归共进化及对教师监督可靠性的动态校准，RSIPO 为长时程 agentic 任务提供了更有效的信用分配方案，并取得显著性能提升。

title: MCPDisCo: Seesaw-Mitigated Tuning for MCP-Native Agents
summary: The Model Context Protocol provides a shared interaction substrate for the agentic web, allowing heterogeneous services to expose capabilities through a standardized interface. Learning to use this ecosystem entails a hierarchy of capabilities: tool-format skills, server-level transfer, and cross-server composition. We present MCPDisCo, an ecosystem-scale reinforcement learning framework for MCP-native agents. Using a Thought-Markov Decision Process (Thought-MDP), the framework explicitly represents internal reasoning alongside routing, execution, and termination and trains on real-server, long-horizon interactions spanning 70 MCP servers and 527 tools across six domains. We study the reasoning--tool seesaw, a joint-learning failure mode in which improvement in one objective can accompany deterioration in the other. To mitigate potential interference, MCPDisCo combines token-masked reward attribution with bidirectional gradient surgery: the former separates direct supervision for reasoning and action spans, while the latter removes conflicting components from both objective gradients in shared parameters. MCPDisCo achieves higher success with fewer chain-of-thought tokens. On the out-of-distribution MCP-Atlas and the GAIA benchmark, MCPDisCo maintains monotone gains, confirming that the learned behavior generalizes beyond the training server distribution and broader agentic tasks. Model weight and implementation are available.

AI.tldr: 提出MCPDisCo，一种面向MCP原生智能体的生态级强化学习框架，基于Thought-MDP建模推理与路由/执行/终止，通过token掩码奖励归因与双向梯度手术缓解"推理—工具跷跷板"干扰，以更少思维链token取得更高成功率并具备跨服务器与跨任务泛化能力。
AI.motivation: Model Context Protocol为智能体网络提供统一交互基底，使异构服务通过标准接口暴露能力；学习使用该生态涉及工具格式技能、服务器级迁移、跨服务器组合的能力层级。现有方法缺乏在真实服务器、长时程、生态规模上训练MCP原生智能体的框架，且联合学习推理与工具使用存在相互干扰。
AI.method: MCPDisCo采用Thought-Markov Decision Process，将内部推理与路由、执行、终止显式建模；在真实服务器、长时程交互上训练，覆盖6个领域、70个MCP服务器与527个工具。针对"推理—工具跷跷板"这一联合学习失效模式，结合token掩码奖励归因（分离推理与动作片段的直接监督）与双向梯度手术（在共享参数中移除两个目标梯度的冲突分量）。
AI.result: MCPDisCo以更少的思维链token实现更高的成功率；在分布外MCP-Atlas与GAIA基准上保持单调增益，表明所学行为可泛化到训练服务器分布之外及更广泛的智能体任务。
AI.conclusion: MCPDisCo验证了生态级强化学习对MCP原生智能体的有效性，其缓解推理与工具使用干扰的机制带来效率与成功率双重提升，并具备跨分布泛化性；模型权重与实现已公开。

title: CAST: Real-Time Motion Capture for Any Skeleton Topology
summary: This paper studies the problem of recovering motion from monocular video, even when the target skeleton topology differs from the subject observed in the video. Although previous methods have made efforts to resolve this problem, they remain vulnerable to joint-rotation errors that are coupled across the skeleton and can propagate along its kinematic hierarchy. To mitigate these errors, we present CAST, a topology-aware motion capture framework that combines learned local rotations with geometric correction guided by predicted global bone directions. Our observability analysis characterizes which rotational components can be constrained by outgoing bone directions. Guided by this analysis, GRACE uses reliability-gated alignment to correct composed orientations in parent-to-child order, leaving unconstrained components to the learned rotation predictor. The motion predictor and correction module are trained jointly with motion-derived supervision, using a frozen image encoder. Experiments under the TopoCap evaluation protocol show that the proposed framework improves motion recovery across different target topologies, including unseen structures. Reference-based cross-skeleton evaluation on a curated Mixamo benchmark and a user preference study further assess transfer to different target structures. A causal CAST-B variant achieves over 51 FPS on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, with timing covering image encoding and motion prediction. Code repository: https://github.com/fankewen/CAST.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAST，一个拓扑感知的单目视频动作捕捉框架，通过结合学习到的局部旋转与由预测全局骨骼方向引导的几何校正，缓解跨骨骼层级传播的关节旋转误差，在TopoCap协议下改善了不同目标拓扑（含未见结构）的动作恢复。
AI.motivation: 单目视频动作恢复在目标骨架拓扑与视频中被摄主体不一致时仍具挑战性；已有方法易受关节旋转误差影响，这些误差在骨架间相互耦合，并会沿运动学层级传播，导致误差累积。
AI.method: 提出CAST拓扑感知动作捕捉框架，将学习到的局部旋转与几何校正结合，后者由预测的全局骨骼方向引导。通过可观测性分析刻画哪些旋转分量可由向外骨骼方向约束；据此设计的GRACE模块采用可靠性门控对齐，以父到子顺序校正合成朝向，未被约束的分量交由学习到的旋转预测器处理。运动预测器与校正模块以运动导出的监督联合训练，图像编码器冻结；并提供因果CAST-B变体。
AI.result: 在TopoCap评测协议下，框架在不同目标拓扑（包括未见结构）上均提升动作恢复效果；在精心构建的Mixamo基准上进行基于参考的跨骨骼评测，并通过用户偏好研究评估向不同目标结构的迁移。因果CAST-B变体在单张NVIDIA A100 GPU上达到超过51 FPS，计时涵盖图像编码与运动预测。
AI.conclusion: CAST通过拓扑感知的几何校正与学习旋转相结合，有效抑制耦合且沿层级传播的关节旋转误差，实现跨拓扑动作恢复的改进，并具备实时可部署的推理效率。

title: An Explainable System for Offensive Content Detection in Nastaliq Urdu: Corpus Curation, Transformer Benchmarking, and Word-Level Attribution
summary: Automated moderation systems are deployed at scale, yet they remain opaque to the users and moderators affected by their decisions, and their coverage is almost entirely confined to English. For Urdu written in the Nastaliq script, no such system exists, and the annotated resources it would be built on are drawn largely from Twitter/X, where character limits constrain how users write. Interpretability has received little attention, leaving it unclear what such models actually learn. This study addresses these gaps in three steps. First, we curate and publicly release a corpus of 7604 Nastaliq Urdu Facebook comments, extending an earlier corpus by correcting text-level inconsistencies and re-examining the original labels. Second, we fine-tune four Urdu-capable transformers under a common grid-search protocol and compare them against twelve feature-classifier baselines on identical data partitions. The best configuration, Multilingual Representations for Indian Languages (MuRIL), reaches 87.05% accuracy and 87.06% macro F1, improving on the strongest baseline by 5.52 percentage points, a margin that exceeds the 95% confidence interval on test accuracy; the two leading transformers differ by less than the test set can resolve, and performance is stable across five optimizers. Third, we compute word-level SHAP attributions adapted to right-to-left rendering. Attribution mass concentrates on high-frequency slurs but extends to syntactically neutral function words and to political vocabulary characteristic of the source pages, indicating that aggregate performance may rest partly on lexical and topical regularities rather than a generalizable representation of offensiveness.

AI.tldr: 该研究面向Nastaliq乌尔都语Facebook评论，构建并公开7604条标注语料，系统比较四类Urdu变压器与十二种特征基线，最优MuRIL达87.05%准确率与87.06%宏F1，并通过适配RTL的SHAP归因揭示模型部分依赖词汇与话题规律而非可泛化的冒犯性表征。
AI.motivation: 自动化内容审核系统虽已大规模部署，但对受影响用户与审核者不透明，且覆盖几乎局限于英语；Nastaliq乌尔都语完全缺少此类系统，其标注资源多来自有字数限制的Twitter/X，且可解释性研究匮乏，模型究竟学到什么尚不清楚。
AI.method: 分三步：(1) 整理并公开7604条Nastaliq乌尔都语Facebook评论语料，修正文本层面不一致并重新审视原标签；(2) 在统一网格搜索协议下微调四种支持乌尔都语的变压器，与十二种特征-分类器基线在相同数据划分上比较；(3) 计算适配从右到左渲染的词级SHAP归因。
AI.result: 最优配置MuRIL达到87.05%准确率与87.06%宏F1，较最强基线提升5.52个百分点，该差距超过测试准确率的95%置信区间；两个领先变压器之间的差异小于测试集可分辨程度，且在五种优化器下性能稳定。归因质量集中于高频羞辱词，同时延伸至句法中性的功能词及源页面特有的政治词汇。
AI.conclusion: 聚合性能可能部分建立在词汇与话题规律之上，而非对冒犯性的可泛化表征，提示此类审核模型的解释性与跨域泛化能力仍需进一步审视。

title: What Survives When Activation Steering Is Used as Memory
summary: Activation steering has recently been used as a memory for skills: past experiences of an agent are stored as steering vectors and retrieved later. Facts and preferences about the user are assumed to need text instead. We test that assumption with a training-free activation memory beside a frozen LLM. The change an experience causes in late-layer states is stored as a shift, filed under a whitened key for the conversation's gist, and added back in a later session only when the gist matches. We argue that such a shift is a fixed average of an effect that attention, in context, recomputes for every question, so only question-independent content can survive. In a pre-registered study on Qwen3.5-2B and 9B, with judges from four model families, the memory is selective (about 98% of unrelated replies are unchanged), but facts are stored as the word to say, in the last layers only, and are almost never used (at most 15% clean use, against 96-98% in context). Leanings transfer only in a narrow strength window. Most strikingly, the reference subtracted when writing a preference decides whether its concept or its direction survives: unless the opposite is subtracted, a stored dislike is recalled as a like.

AI.tldr: 本文用免训练激活记忆（activation memory）检验"事实与偏好必须依赖文本"的假设：将经历引起的后层状态变化作为 shift 存储并检索，结果选择性高（约98%无关回复不变），但事实几乎无法被使用（至多15%干净使用，上下文为96-98%），偏好仅在狭窄强度窗口可迁移，且偏好写入时减去的参考向量决定其概念还是方向被保留。
AI.motivation: 激活引导（activation steering）已被用作"技能记忆"：把过往经历存成引导向量并在后续检索，但关于用户的事实与偏好通常被认为必须借助文本形式保存。作者希望验证这一假设，探索能否用免训练的激活记忆搭配冻结LLM来承载事实与偏好类信息。
AI.method: 在冻结LLM旁附加免训练激活记忆：把某次经历在后层状态中引起的变化存为一个 shift，以对话主旨（gist）的白化键（whitened key）归档；当后续会话主旨匹配时再将其加回。作者论证该 shift 是注意力在上下文中对每个问题重新计算效果的固定平均值，因此只有与问题无关的内容才能存活。在 Qwen3.5-2B 与 9B 上进行预注册研究，并使用来自四个模型家族的评判者。
AI.result: 记忆具有选择性：约98%的无关回复保持不变；但事实仅以"该说的词"形式存于最后几层，且几乎从不被使用（干净使用率至多15%，而上下文为96-98%）；倾向性只在狭窄的强度窗口内迁移；最显著的是，写入偏好时所减去的参考向量决定了其概念还是方向得以保留——除非减去相反概念，存储的"不喜欢"会被回忆成"喜欢"。
AI.conclusion: 免训练激活记忆无法可靠承载事实与偏好：事实在脱离上下文后难以被调用，偏好迁移受限于强度窗口且对参考向量的选择高度敏感，甚至会因未减去反概念而发生语义反转。这表明事实与偏好仍更适合以文本形式存储，而非仅依赖激活空间中的 shift。

title: ScalLoc: Continuous Oblique Thermal UAV Geo-Localization with a 2D Satellite Map
summary: Cross-modal Thermal Geo-localization (TG) provides an illumination-robust positioning solution for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) in Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-denied environments. However, existing thermal geo-localization methods mainly focus on near-nadir observations or depend on map-side elevation priors, limiting their applicability to continuous oblique thermal localization with only geo-referenced 2D satellite maps. To address this problem, we propose ScalLoc, a scale-aligned local-to-map localization framework for continuous oblique thermal UAV geo-localization. ScalLoc follows a reconstruction--refinement--anchoring--propagation design: it reconstructs local window geometry from thermal sequences, refines camera poses using track-based pose optimization, adaptively anchors each window to the satellite map, and propagates validated states to recover frame-level global trajectories. To support systematic evaluation, we construct Thermal-Oblique, a real thermal UAV sequence dataset containing 216 urban and rural day--night trajectories and 28,112 thermal frames with frame-level annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ScalLoc reduces the mean localization error from 112.69 m to 26.97 m compared with the VGGT-only configuration, corresponding to a 76.07% reduction, and achieves the lowest frame-weighted mean position error among the compared methods. These results demonstrate the feasibility of continuous oblique thermal geo-localization using only lightweight 2D satellite maps, without requiring digital surface models or preconstructed 3D maps. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/FloralHercules/ScalLoc.

AI.tldr: 提出ScalLoc，用仅2D卫星地图实现连续斜视热红外无人机地理定位，误差从112.69m降至26.97m。
AI.motivation: 现有热红外地理定位多限于近垂直观测或依赖地图侧高程先验，难以在仅有地理参考2D卫星地图条件下完成连续斜视热定位。该问题面向GNSS拒止环境下无人机的光照鲁棒定位需求。
AI.method: ScalLoc为尺度对齐的局部到地图定位框架，采用“重建—精化—锚定—传播”设计：从热红外序列重建局部窗口几何，利用基于轨迹的位姿优化精化相机位姿，自适应地将每个窗口锚定到卫星地图，并将验证过的状态传播以恢复帧级全局轨迹。同时构建Thermal-Oblique数据集，含216条城乡昼夜轨迹、28,112帧热红外图像及帧级标注。
AI.result: 相比仅使用VGGT的配置，ScalLoc将平均定位误差由112.69m降至26.97m，降幅76.07%；在对比方法中取得最低的帧加权平均位置误差。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，仅使用轻量级2D卫星地图即可实现连续斜视热红外地理定位，无需数字表面模型或预构建3D地图。代码与数据集已开源。

title: Latent Taxonomies: How Property Induction Develops in Language Model Pre-training
summary: When told that robins have sesamoid bones, people are far more prone to extend the property to sparrows than to whales. This behavior, called category-based property induction, is well documented in humans, but whether and how it develops in language models trained only to predict the next token is unclear. To shed light on this, we construct a hierarchical taxonomy of synthetic entities grouped by the properties they share. We then inject facts from this latent taxonomy into the continued pre-training of Pythia and OLMo 2 models from 70M to 7B parameters, and track the development of inductive behaviors. We find that taxonomically aligned induction emerges from next-token prediction alone: a property learned for one entity transfers more strongly within its taxonomic category than across categories. Internally, entities that share a deeper category become more similar in activation space, and clustering recovers the full taxonomic tree from entity representations. Contrary to the usual expectation that scale helps, we find that induction weakens with model size when the data budget is fixed, suggesting that larger models memorize individual facts rather than compress them into shared structure. Induction also strengthens with more pre-training before the taxonomy injection, transfers to novel in-context properties, and can be overridden by a latent taxonomy implied by the prompt. Together, these results show that a model's inductive generalization reflects the latent organization of its training data, with implications for data curation and for predicting how far a learned fact will spread.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型能否仅通过下一词预测习得"基于类别的属性归纳"能力：作者构建带层级分类的合成实体，将共享属性事实注入Pythia与OLMo 2（70M–7B）的继续预训练，发现模型涌现出与分类结构对齐的归纳行为，且该行为随固定数据预算下的模型规模增大而减弱。
AI.motivation: 人类会把一个实体（如知更鸟）的属性推广到同类的其他实体（麻雀）而非跨类实体（鲸鱼），这种基于类别的属性归纳在人类中已有充分记录，但仅在下一词预测目标下训练的语言模型是否以及如何习得该能力尚不清楚。理解这一点有助于预测一个习得事实会在多大范围内传播，并指导数据策划。
AI.method: 1）构建由共享属性分组的合成实体的层级分类体系；2）将该潜在分类中的事实注入Pythia与OLMo 2模型（70M至7B参数）的继续预训练过程；3）追踪归纳行为的发展；4）通过激活空间相似度分析与聚类，检验实体表征是否恢复完整分类树；5）进行规模、预训练量、上下文新属性迁移、以及提示隐含潜在分类的对照实验。
AI.result: 仅靠下一词预测即涌现出与分类对齐的归纳：某实体学到的属性在同分类内比跨分类传播更强。内部表征上，共享更深层类别的实体在激活空间中更相似，聚类可恢复完整分类树。与"规模有益"的通常预期相反，在固定数据预算下归纳能力随模型规模增大而减弱，说明大模型倾向记忆单个事实而非将其压缩为共享结构。归纳随分类注入前的预训练量增加而增强，可迁移到上下文中的新属性，并能被提示所隐含的潜在分类覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 模型的归纳泛化能力反映其训练数据的潜在组织结构。这对数据策划以及预测一个习得事实的传播范围具有重要启示：归纳强度由数据的潜在分类结构决定，而非单纯由模型规模驱动。

title: AlphaRLM: Aligning Language Models for Literature-Grounded Symbolic Factor Discovery
summary: Formulaic alpha mining seeks to discover executable expressions that capture predictive market signals in a vast, noisy search space. Recent LLM-based approaches use prompting, iterative search, or seed-factor evolution, leaving direct factor construction through policy learning less explored. To address this, we introduce AlphaRLM, a reinforcement-learning framework that trains LLMs to construct executable symbolic factors from financial literature without input factor expressions. AlphaRLM incorporates Literature-Guided Operator Assembly (LEGO), which conditions factor construction on literature-derived ideas and executable operators, providing semantic priors for exploration. It further aligns the generation policy with market feedback through executable-validity and grouped-return-separation rewards that capture non-monotonic structures across factor quantiles. Extensive experiments on CSI 300, CSI 1000, and S&P 500 show that AlphaRLM outperforms strong factor-mining and LLM-based baselines in annualized excess return. Notably, the 8B model achieves strong cross-market performance, highlighting the promise of literature-conditioned, market-aligned factor generation.

AI.tldr: 提出AlphaRLM，用强化学习训练LLM直接从金融文献构建可执行符号因子，在CSI 300、CSI 1000、S&P 500上年化超额收益优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM因子挖掘多依赖提示、迭代搜索或种子因子演化，而通过策略学习直接构建因子的路径探索不足；同时公式化alpha挖掘需在庞大噪声搜索空间中寻找可执行表达式。
AI.method: AlphaRLM框架：1）Literature-Guided Operator Assembly (LEGO)，以文献提取的思想和可执行算子为条件，为因子构建提供语义先验；2）用可执行有效性奖励和分组收益分离奖励，将生成策略与市场反馈对齐，捕捉因子分位数间的非单调结构。
AI.result: 在CSI 300、CSI 1000、S&P 500上，AlphaRLM的年化超额收益超过强因子挖掘基线和LLM基线；8B模型展现出较强的跨市场表现。
AI.conclusion: 文献条件化、市场对齐的因子生成范式具有潜力，强化学习可直接训练LLM构建可执行符号因子。

title: MORE: Learning Motion-Oriented Registers for Driving World Models and Planning
summary: By predicting future states, latent world models provide rich self-supervision for end-to-end driving, but often inherit dense features from pretrained visual encoders as their world-state interface. This creates a mismatch: visual pretraining produces information-rich, spatially dense features, but their adaptation for motion-conditioned world modeling and planning is deferred to downstream training. The dense grid also makes future prediction more computationally expensive as visual resolution increases. We therefore argue that video pretraining should directly learn state representations suited to downstream world modeling and planning, rather than relying on downstream training to adapt inherited visual features. We propose ***MORE***, a V-JEPA framework that learns **M**otion-**O**riented **RE**gisters during video pretraining as a shared state interface for driving world models and planning. MORE injects temporally aligned ego motion into a small set of registers and uses them as the sole context for masked patch prediction, channeling dense patch-level supervision through a compact state bottleneck. A complementary blockwise register-masking objective further shapes predictive structure in the register space. During downstream training, the same register space defines the future states predicted by the world model and provides shared scene memory for trajectory generation and scoring. On NAVSIM-v2, MORE outperforms the state of the art by 1.6 in EPDMS, while achieving superior efficiency with only 1/10 the inference latency of DriveLaW. These results support learning the state interface for world modeling and planning directly during video pretraining.

AI.tldr: 提出 MORE 框架，在视频预训练阶段直接通过运动导向寄存器（Motion-Oriented REgisters）学习面向世界模型与规划的状态表示，在 NAVSIM-v2 上 EPDMS 提升 1.6，推理延迟仅为 DriveLaW 的 1/10。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在世界模型常继承预训练视觉编码器的稠密特征作为世界状态接口，导致两类不匹配：一是视觉预训练产出信息丰富、空间稠密的特征，其向运动条件化世界建模与规划的适配被推迟到下游训练；二是随着视觉分辨率提升，稠密网格使未来预测的计算开销显著增加。作者因此主张：视频预训练应直接学习适配下游世界建模与规划的状态表示，而非依赖下游训练去适配继承的视觉特征。
AI.method: MORE 是一个 V-JEPA 框架，在视频预训练中学习运动导向寄存器作为驾驶世界模型与规划的共享状态接口。具体做法：将时间对齐的自车运动注入一小组寄存器，并以其作为掩码 patch 预测的唯一上下文，从而把稠密的 patch 级监督经由紧凑的状态瓶颈传递；辅以分块寄存器掩码目标，进一步在寄存器空间中塑造预测结构。下游训练时，同一寄存器空间既定义世界模型预测的未来状态，又为轨迹生成与评分提供共享场景记忆。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM-v2 上，MORE 相比当前最优方法 EPDMS 提升 1.6，同时效率更优，推理延迟仅为 DriveLaW 的 1/10。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在视频预训练阶段直接学习用于世界建模与规划的状态接口这一设计思路，兼顾性能与效率。

title: Binding Phoneme Identity to Position in Neural Models and the Human Brain
summary: A fundamental challenge in cognitive science and neural computation is the binding problem. Compositional generalization can be achieved by factorizing representations into roles, the structural slots of a representation (e.g., serial position or syntactic function), and fillers, the contents occupying them (e.g., a phoneme or a word), which can be recombined freely to represent novel combinations. How neural systems implement role--filler binding, however, remains unknown. One of its simplest cases is phoneme sequencing, where phoneme identity (filler) must be bound to position (role) so that /gum/ and /mug/ are represented differently. A proposal from NLP, the `onion hypothesis' (Csordas et al., 2024), holds that the direction of the neural population state encodes token identity, while its magnitude encodes position. It was formulated for random token sequences; we extend it to natural language and test it in neural models and the human brain. We first evaluated it in an encoder-decoder trained to repeat English words, using representational geometry analyses and causal interventions. Magnitude alone proves incomplete: position is encoded by magnitude together with a systematic rotation of the state direction, a scheme we formalize as the `spiral hypothesis'. We then analyzed intracranial recordings from the auditory cortex of 20 participants listening to short sentences. Across superior temporal gyrus electrodes, the change in population response between consecutive phonemes decreases in magnitude as position advances, and its direction is aligned within consonants and within vowels but near orthogonal across the two classes, supporting the magnitude coding shared by both accounts. These results provide a geometric account of how neural systems bind phoneme identity to position, and show how neural-model hypotheses can yield testable predictions about human neural computation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究神经系统中角色—填充物绑定（role–filler binding）的几何实现机制。作者将NLP的"洋葱假设"扩展到自然语言，提出"螺旋假设"（spiral hypothesis）：位置不仅由神经群体状态的幅度编码，还伴随状态方向的系统性旋转。在编码器—解码器模型和20名被试的颅内听觉皮层数据中均验证了幅度编码及语音类别相关的方向对齐模式。
AI.motivation: 组合泛化依赖将表征分解为角色（如序列位置、句法功能）和填充物（如音素、词），但神经系统如何实现角色—填充物绑定尚不清楚。音素排序是其最简单案例，需要将音素身份（填充物）绑定到位置（角色）。现有"洋葱假设"仅在随机词元序列上提出，未在自然语言和真实人脑中检验。
AI.method: 首先在训练用于复述英语单词的编码器—解码器模型中，通过表征几何分析和因果干预检验洋葱假设；随后分析20名被试聆听短句时的听觉皮层颅内记录，考察连续音素间群体响应变化随位置推进的幅度与方向特征。
AI.result: 幅度单独编码位置并不完整：位置由幅度与状态方向的系统性旋转共同编码（螺旋假设）。人脑数据中，颞上回电极上连续音素间群体响应变化的幅度随位置推进而减小；其方向在辅音内部和元音内部对齐，但两类之间近乎正交，支持两种假设共有的幅度编码。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了神经系统将音素身份绑定到位置的几何解释，并表明神经模型假设可以产生关于人类神经计算的可检验预测。

title: SkillHorizon: Constructing Long-Horizon Agent Tasks through Skill Composition
summary: Long-horizon agents must complete workflows in which later activities depend on earlier outputs and changes to shared state. A key challenge for evaluation is to expand task requirements and their dependencies while keeping tasks executable and outcomes verifiable.
