We introduce SkillHorizon, a benchmark that constructs long-horizon tasks through skill composition in seven business environments. Its generators use domain-specific rules to turn reusable skill procedures into concrete business activities. These activities are connected through input-output dependencies, shared resources, and state updates, allowing workload and coordination demands to grow together. Successful reference executions validate task feasibility and measure interaction workload, while programmatic evaluators assess local completion and whole-task success. We evaluate five language models on 1,050 tasks with reference interaction workloads ranging from 64K to 1M tokens. Across these scales, mean local-goal completion falls from 90.4% to 46.8%, as completed work fails to keep pace with growing requirements. At larger workloads, agents more often submit unsuccessful final answers with substantial work unfinished and tool-call allowance remaining. Trace analysis also identifies cases where scripts execute successfully but their outputs fail downstream business checks. SkillHorizon provides a configurable testbed for studying sustained progress, dependency coordination, and complete task delivery in growing workflows. Our code is available at https://github.com/KnowComp/SkillHorizon.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SkillHorizon基准，通过技能组合在七个商业环境中构建长周期任务，并评估五个语言模型在交互负载从64K到1M token的任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 长周期智能体需完成后续活动依赖前期输出和共享状态变化的流程。评估的关键挑战在于扩展任务需求及其依赖关系，同时保持任务可执行、结果可验证。现有评估难以在扩展工作量的同时同步增长协调需求。
AI.method: SkillHorizon通过技能组合构建长周期任务。其生成器使用领域特定规则将可复用技能流程转化为具体商业活动，这些活动通过输入-输出依赖、共享资源和状态更新相互连接，使工作量与协调需求同步增长。成功参考执行用于验证任务可行性并测量交互负载；程序化评估器评估局部完成度和整体任务成功率。在1,050个任务上评估五个语言模型，参考交互负载从64K到1M token。
AI.result: 在各类负载规模下，平均局部目标完成率从90.4%降至46.8%，已完成工作量无法跟上不断增长的需求。在较大负载下，智能体更常在有大量工作未完成且工具调用额度仍有剩余时提交不成功的最终答案。轨迹分析还发现脚本成功执行但输出未通过下游业务检查的情况。
AI.conclusion: SkillHorizon为研究持续进展、依赖协调和完整任务交付提供了可配置的测试平台，代码已开源。

title: Engram Neuron Inspired Adaptive Memorization for Lifelong Learning
summary: Lifelong learning enables artificial systems to adapt to changing environments. To achieve this, an effective artificial learner should dynamically reorganize past and new experiences, maintaining stability while enabling flexible knowledge integration. However, existing efforts primarily mitigate catastrophic forgetting, lacking the ability to adaptively update memory akin to biological systems. Here, by integrating the full memory life cycle of engram neurons into artificial learners, we propose a framework that constructs a structured memory from gradient representations, which regulates parameter updates and guides memory management. Through comprehensive evaluations on four benchmarks, our approach shows promising lifelong learning capability, maintaining stability over long task sequences and supporting flexible adaptation. Beyond the performance gains, our approach offers a computational perspective on robust and flexible lifelong learning, echoing mechanisms observed in biological memory systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将印迹神经元（engram neuron）完整记忆生命周期整合进人工学习器的框架，通过从梯度表征构建结构化记忆来调控参数更新与记忆管理，在四个基准上实现了稳定的长任务序列终身学习与灵活适应能力。
AI.motivation: 现有终身学习方法主要致力于缓解灾难性遗忘，缺乏像生物系统那样自适应更新记忆的能力，难以在稳定性与灵活知识整合之间取得平衡。因此需要一种能动态重组新旧经验、兼顾稳定与灵活的机制。
AI.method: 将印迹神经元的完整记忆生命周期（编码、巩固、检索、遗忘等）引入人工学习器，构建一个从梯度表征中提取结构化记忆的框架，用以调控参数更新并指导记忆管理。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上的综合评估显示，该方法具备良好的终身学习能力，能在长任务序列上保持稳定性，同时支持灵活适应，性能优于以抗遗忘为主的现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作不仅带来性能提升，还从计算角度为鲁棒且灵活的终身学习提供了新视角，并与生物记忆系统中观察到的机制相呼应。

title: Unchecked or Falsely Accused? Evaluating AI-Generated Text Detectors on Kazakh
comment: 16 pages (8 main + references and appendix), 1 figure, 9 tables. Code: https://github.com/ozxmn/aina-kk; data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ajnasiou/aina-kk; detector: https://huggingface.co/ajnasiou/aina-kk-det
summary: AI-text detectors are already applied to Kazakh writing, yet no study reports how often publicly available detectors flag Kazakh text whose human authorship is dated before ChatGPT. We present AINA-KK: 3,811 human passages from encyclopedic, news, web and educational pages that provably existed before ChatGPT, and 5,597 machine and gray-zone passages from 9 generators, including the Kazakh-built KazLLM and Sherkala, with script and length stress tests. Five English-trained detectors from the Hugging Face Hub flag up to 81.4% of human passages and 79.6% of published student essays; recalibrated, they catch at most 1.3% of machine text. Calibrated zero-shot detectors catch at most 50.3% of machine text from in-distribution generators. Fine-tuned encoders rank text almost perfectly, but mDeBERTa at its default threshold flags 24.4% of 50-word human excerpts, partly because machine outputs are shorter than human text; calibrated, it catches only 47.1% of KazLLM and 62.7% of Sherkala passages. Without script handling, machine-transliterated Latin-2021 text defeats every detector. Fixes that need no new data (calibration, script canonicalization, script-augmented and length-matched training, and an OR with a zero-shot scorer) form AINA-KK-Det. On test it flags 0.9% of human passages (95% CI 0.4-2.7; 1.5% on development data) and catches 85.2% of machine text from known generators, 92.9% from two unseen Gemini-family Gemma-4 models and 61.3% from the Kazakh-built ones; its configuration was chosen with test results in view. We release the data, code and detector at https://github.com/ozxmn/aina-kk.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了AINA-KK数据集（3,811条ChatGPT前人类哈萨克语文本与5,597条机器/灰区文本），系统评测现有AI文本检测器在哈萨克语上的失效模式，并提出无需新数据即可修复的AINA-KK-Det检测器。
AI.motivation: AI文本检测器已被用于哈萨克语写作，但尚无研究报告公开检测器对ChatGPT之前人类撰写的哈萨克语文本的误报率，缺乏对该语言场景下检测可靠性的系统性评估。
AI.method: 构建AINA-KK数据集，涵盖百科、新闻、网页与教育类人类文本（可证明早于ChatGPT）及9个生成器的机器/灰区文本，包括哈萨克语自研模型KazLLM与Sherkala，并加入文字系统与长度压力测试；评测5个英语训练的Hugging Face检测器、校准零样本检测器与微调编码器；提出AINA-KK-Det，采用校准、文字规范化、文字增强与长度匹配训练，以及与零样本打分器的OR融合。
AI.result: 英语训练检测器误报高达81.4%的人类文本和79.6%的已发表学生作文，重校准后最多仅检出1.3%机器文本；校准零样本检测器最多检出50.3%同分布机器文本；微调编码器排序近乎完美，但mDeBERTa默认阈值误报24.4%的50词人类片段，校准后仅检出47.1%的KazLLM与62.7%的Sherkala文本；无文字处理时，拉丁2021转写文本可击败所有检测器。AINA-KK-Det在测试集上误报0.9%（95% CI 0.4-2.7；开发集1.5%），检出已知生成器85.2%、两个未见Gemma-4模型92.9%、哈萨克语自研模型61.3%，但其配置选择过程中已参考测试结果。
AI.conclusion: 现有AI文本检测器在哈萨克语上误报严重且检出能力有限，尤其对本地模型与转写文本；通过校准、文字规范化、增强训练与零样本OR融合等无需新增数据的修复手段可显著改善，但AINA-KK-Det的配置存在测试集信息泄露风险，需谨慎解读其性能。数据、代码与检测器已开源。

title: FleetPilot: Fine-Grained Steering Empowers Real-World LLM Personalization
summary: With the rapid evolution of large language models (LLMs), there is an increasing demand for effective personalization techniques that can adapt model behavior to individual user preferences. Personalized LLMs must infer a user's query-dependent preferences from limited, heterogeneous, and evolving interaction histories. Existing approaches rely primarily on in-context personalization, parametric adaptation, or personalized reward modeling, but respectively incur recurring costs in context management, model optimization and deployment, or multi-candidate generation and scoring. These limitations become particularly restrictive when user observations are sparse and the preference evidence relevant to each query varies across contexts and over time. To address these challenges, we propose \modelname, a fine-grained and instance-tailored steering framework that dynamically generates sample-level interference vectors from user data and injects them into the model's forward pass for personalized adaptation. Our approach introduces: match contrast that produces user-relevant signals, fine-grained steering component that captures nuanced signals by hooking activations from attention and MLP layers, and query-conditioned aggregation module that synthesizes these signals into contextually relevant enhancements. Extensive experiments across diverse scenarios, including short-to-long text generation, and web function calling, validate the effectiveness and compatibility of \modelname. Results show that our method consistently brings significant performance gains, and show extreme superiority in fast-shifting and data-sparse environments. Additionally, \modelname rids us of training cycles and incurs light overhead of storage or inference latency. These make \modelname a strong and real-world deployable method. Implementation is available \footnote{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FleetPilot}.

AI.tldr: 提出一种细粒度、实例定制的个性化LLM引导框架，通过动态生成样本级干预向量并注入前向传播，实现高效个性化适配，无需训练循环且开销低。
AI.motivation: LLM个性化需求增长，但现有方法（上下文个性化、参数化适配、个性化奖励建模）分别存在上下文管理成本、模型优化与部署成本、多候选生成与评分成本，且在用户观测稀疏、查询相关偏好随时间变化时受限。
AI.method: 提出 instance-tailored steering 框架：从用户数据动态生成样本级 perturbation/interference 向量，注入模型前向传播。包含三个组件：match contrast 生成用户相关信号；fine-grained steering 通过 hook attention 与 MLP 层激活捕捉细粒度信号；query-conditioned aggregation 将信号合成为上下文相关的增强。
AI.result: 在多样化场景（短到长文本生成、web function calling）中实验验证有效性与兼容性，持续获得显著性能提升，在快速变化和数据稀疏环境下表现尤为优越。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需训练循环，存储与推理延迟开销轻，具备强实用性和真实部署能力。

title: Text-Guided Medical Image Segmentation via Residual Aggregation and Dense Alignment Representations
summary: Specifying segmentation targets with natural language provides flexible semantic conditioning for medical image segmentation. However, existing methods still struggle to reliably ground high-level textual semantics into accurate pixel-level spatial prompts, especially under low-contrast lesions, ambiguous boundaries, and visually similar anatomical contexts. In this paper, we propose RADAR (Residual Aggregation and Dense Alignment Representations), a parameter-efficient framework for text-guided medical image segmentation. RADAR explicitly decouples and synergizes the medical semantic anchoring capability of BiomedCLIP with the prompt-driven mask decoding ability of MedSAM2, while enabling low-cost task adaptation via LoRA. Specifically, Guided Residual Depth Aggregation adaptively aggregates cross-layer features under semantic guidance to alleviate delayed textual injection and deep semantic dilution. Structured Dense Representation Alignment leverages a frozen BiomedCLIP to construct crop-level target, boundary, and context anchors, improving the local discriminability of dense features and the reliability of automatic prompts. Multi-modal Prompt Generation further converts cross-modal semantic responses into composite text, point, and mask prompts for MedSAM2 decoding. Experiments on three public medical image segmentation datasets show that RADAR achieves competitive performance with only 0.74M trainable parameters, demonstrating its effectiveness in parameter-efficient adaptation, semantic grounding, and dense representation enhancement. The source code is available at https://github.com/JGuiidev/RADAR.

AI.tldr: 提出RADAR参数高效框架，通过残差聚合与稠密对齐表示，解耦并协同BiomedCLIP与MedSAM2，实现对文本引导医学图像分割的精准语义落地。
AI.motivation: 自然语言指定分割目标可为医学图像分割提供灵活的语义条件，但现有方法难以将高层文本语义可靠地落地为准确的像素级空间提示，尤其在低对比度病灶、模糊边界和视觉相似解剖结构场景下表现不佳。
AI.method: RADAR显式解耦并协同BiomedCLIP的医学语义锚定能力与MedSAM2的提示驱动掩码解码能力，并通过LoRA实现低成本任务适配。具体包含三个模块：引导式残差深度聚合（Guided Residual Depth Aggregation）在语义引导下自适应聚合跨层特征，缓解文本注入延迟与深层语义稀释；结构化稠密表示对齐（Structured Dense Representation Alignment）利用冻结的BiomedCLIP构建裁剪级目标、边界与上下文锚点，提升稠密特征的局部判别力与自动提示可靠性；多模态提示生成（Multi-modal Prompt Generation）将跨模态语义响应转换为复合的文本、点和掩码提示，供MedSAM2解码。
AI.result: 在三个公开医学图像分割数据集上的实验表明，RADAR仅需0.74M可训练参数即取得具竞争力的性能，验证了其在参数高效适配、语义落地与稠密表示增强方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: RADAR通过解耦协同视觉语言模型与提示分割模型，并结合LoRA低参适配，为文本引导医学图像分割提供了一种高效的解决方案，代码已开源。

title: Review Rarely Beats the Stronger Model: Separating Verification from Capability Transfer in LLM Pipelines
summary: Qwen3-8B reviewing Llama-3.1-8B in math adds 33.2 points, yet Qwen3-8B alone is 6.4 points more accurate than the result. Reviewing another model's answer is usually judged by its gain over the generator. We show that this confuses verification, which adds accuracy beyond either model alone, with capability transfer, where a stronger reviewer supplies answers it could have given on its own. Measured against the stronger model alone, across 48 pairs of 12 open-weight models (3B to 72B) in math, knowledge, code and reasoning, review beats it in only 9 of 96 review directions, and does worse the larger the capability gap. The reason is that the reviewer mostly follows the generator, discarding its own correct answers. Review costs 2.6 to 2.8 times as much as the stronger model alone, while a selector using the same two calls is 2.7 to 4.2 points more accurate than review and cheaper. Studies of verification should report the stronger model alone, not only the gain over the generator. Code and per-question results: https://github.com/Kamilaabb/verification-or-capability-transfer

AI.tldr: 论文指出，现有"评审增益"指标混淆了验证与能力迁移两种机制；以更强模型单独作答为基线，跨48个模型对、96个评审方向的实验显示评审仅在9个方向获胜，且能力差距越大越差，评审成本约为更强模型单独作答的2.6–2.8倍。
AI.motivation: 在LLM评审（reviewer-verifier）范式中，评审效果通常以"相对生成器（generator）的增益"来衡量，该指标会把两种性质不同的收益混为一谈：一是真正的验证收益（verification，即评审在生成器与评审各自单独作答之外带来额外正确率）；二是能力迁移（capability transfer，即更强的评审只是提供了它本来就能独立给出的正确答案）。这一混淆会系统性高估评审的价值，因此需要一个新的基线来重新评估。
AI.method: 以强模型单独作答（stronger model alone）作为基线，而非生成器单独作答。构建48个模型对，覆盖12个开源权重模型（3B–72B）以及数学、知识、代码、推理四类任务，共96个评审方向。对比评审（review）与同等两次调用预算下的选择器（selector）在准确率与成本上的表现，并分析能力差距与评审收益的关系，以及评审行为的归因（如对生成器答案的跟随程度）。
AI.result: 所有96个评审方向中，评审仅在其中9个方向上超过更强模型单独作答，且随着两模型能力差距增大，评审表现更差。平均而言，评审成本是更强模型单独作答的2.6–2.8倍；而在相同两次调用预算下，选择器比评审准确率高2.7–4.2个点且更便宜。失败原因在于评审多数情况下跟随生成器的答案，从而丢弃了自己原本正确的答案。示例上，Qwen3-8B评审Llama-3.1-8B数学题表面增益33.2分，但Qwen3-8B单独作答本身即比该结果高6.4分。
AI.conclusion: 验证类研究应报告"更强模型单独作答"的结果，而不能只报告相对生成器的增益，否则会把能力迁移误当作验证收益。评审并未有效发挥评审者的独立能力，反而倾向于附和生成器；在同等调用成本下，选择器是更优方案。代码与逐题结果已开源。

title: Single-Sample Decoding of a Two-Layer Sound-Word Canvas Model for Thai Klon Pad
summary: We present a generator of Thai klon pad verse, one stanza from a short topic, and evaluate it against human verse on held-out topics. The generator is a masked language model initialised from WangchanBERTa over a fixed canvas with two layers: a sound layer of pronounced syllables, where rhyme, tone and syllable count are enforced as hard masks, and a word layer of whole words, so that no word is cut into written pieces. Decoding commits one cell at a time and samples at temperature 0.4; one sample is drawn per topic, with no selection, reranking or repair. On 78 held-out topics never used in development, judged by three independent runs of a frozen LLM judge in the same pools as the human stanzas from which the topics were written, 70.5% of the generated stanzas pass form, lexical cleanness of all four lines and topic alignment together, against 76.9% for the human stanzas (difference -6.4 points, 95% CI [-19.2, +6.4]). Cleanness is level with human (85.9% vs. 87.2%), and the stanzas pass form and cleanness together slightly more often than the human ones (+3.8 points, [-6.4, +14.1]); the difference lies in alignment (84.6% vs. 91.0%), on topics that were written from the human stanzas. The low temperature matters: at higher temperatures the same model passes clearly fewer of the same topics, because lexical errors lie in the model's lower-probability choices; sharpening the sampling distribution removes most of them, at a cost in vocabulary (7.5% rare words against 16.5% in the human stanzas) and diversity. The pre-registered target, all-three within 5 points of human, is missed by 1.4 points. KlonSuphap-LM, the only public klon pad generator we know of, passes none of the 78 held-out topics when judged in separate pools together with the method's and the human stanzas (form 19.2%, cleanness 3.8%).

AI.tldr: 提出基于WangchanBERTa的泰语klon pad诗歌生成器，采用双层固定画布掩码语言建模；78个留出主题上，形式/洁净/主题对齐三项综合通过率70.5%，人类为76.9%，差-6.4点（95% CI [-19.2, +6.4]），未达预设5点内目标；低温采样（0.4）显著抑制词汇错误，但牺牲稀有词比例与多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有泰语klon pad诗歌生成缺乏对格律（韵律、声调、音节数）与整词完整性的硬约束，且公开生成器KlonSuphap-LM质量低下（在78个留出主题上通过率近零）。作者希望在无需重排或修复的单次采样下，让机器诗歌在形式、词汇洁净度与主题对齐三方面逼近人类水平，并提供与人类诗歌的可比评估。
AI.method: 以WangchanBERTa初始化的掩码语言模型，在固定画布上分两层：声音层为发音音节（韵律、声调、音节数作为硬掩码强制），词层为整词（避免词被拆分）。逐格提交解码，采样温度0.4，每主题仅采一样本，不做选择、重排或修复。评估：78个开发中未用的留出主题，三个独立运行的冻结LLM评判器在与人类诗相同的池中评判。
AI.result: 78个留出主题上，生成诗同时通过形式、四行词汇洁净与主题对齐的比例为70.5%，人类76.9%（差-6.4点，95% CI [-19.2, +6.4]）；洁净度与人类持平（85.9% vs 87.2%）；形式+洁净联合略高于人类（+3.8点，[-6.4, +14.1]）；差距主要在对齐（84.6% vs 91.0%），而这些主题恰由人类诗写成。温度敏感：高温下同模型通过率明显下降，因词汇错误位于低概率选择。稀有词比例7.5%，低于人类16.5%，多样性亦下降。预设目标（三项均在人类5点内）差1.4点未达。KlonSuphap-LM在同样78题上形式19.2%、洁净3.8%，无一题通过。
AI.conclusion: 在硬格律约束与低温单次采样下，泰语klon pad生成诗在形式与词汇洁净度上已接近人类，主要短板在主题对齐；低温锐化可消除大部分词汇错误，代价是词汇量与多样性下降。预设的5点内目标差1.4点未达成，且公开基线KlonSuphap-LM在可比评估下几乎完全失败。

title: DSM-Free UAV Visual Localization via Latent-Depth Variable Projection and Structure-Adaptive Coupling
summary: Visual localization enables unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to maintain absolute positioning in GNSS-denied environments. A common approach matches UAV images with geo-tagged orthographic maps and estimates camera pose using Perspective-n-Point (PnP) with elevations from Digital Surface Models (DSMs). However, accurate and up-to-date DSMs are often unavailable in practice. Orthographic-perspective geometry (OPG) enables DSM-free localization in scenes with varying elevations, yet existing methods typically estimate pose indirectly through intermediate matrix estimation and decomposition. To address this limitation, we propose Latent-Depth Variable Projection (LDVP), which treats the unknown scales along perspective viewing rays as latent depths. By analytically eliminating these depths and solving for the horizontal camera center in closed form given the rotation, LDVP reduces nonlinear estimation to a rotation-only problem, enabling direct recovery of metric horizontal position without assuming a planar scene. To improve localization robustness across different scene structures, we further introduce Structure-Adaptive Coupling (SAC), which uses relative scene structure inferred from monocular depth estimation to select LDVP when the matched points are not dominated by a single plane, and Planar-PnP otherwise. Our local observability analysis reveals how scene elevation variation affects the geometric constraints of OPG, providing a basis for this adaptive strategy. Extensive experiments show that LDVP consistently outperforms existing OPG-based DSM-free methods, while SAC further improves robustness across diverse scenes and substantially narrows the gap to DSM-based localization. Code will be released at https://github.com/UAV-AVL/LDVP-SAC.

AI.tldr: 提出Latent-Depth Variable Projection (LDVP)与Structure-Adaptive Coupling (SAC)，实现无需DSM的正交-透视几何UAV视觉定位，并提升跨场景鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: UAV在GNSS拒止环境下依赖视觉定位，常用方法需匹配地理标注正射图并用PnP结合DSM高程估计位姿，但准确且最新的DSM往往不可得。现有OPG无DSM方法多通过中间矩阵估计与分解间接求位姿，存在局限。
AI.method: LDVP将透视视线上的未知尺度视为潜在深度，解析消去这些深度，并在给定旋转下闭式求解水平相机中心，使非线性估计降为仅旋转问题，从而直接恢复度量水平位置且不假设平面场景。进一步提出SAC，利用单目深度估计推断相对场景结构，在匹配点不被单一平面主导时选择LDVP，否则采用Planar-PnP。并通过局部可观测性分析揭示场景高程变化对OPG几何约束的影响。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，LDVP持续优于现有基于OPG的无DSM方法；SAC在多样场景中进一步提升鲁棒性，并显著缩小与基于DSM定位方法的差距。
AI.conclusion: LDVP与SAC为无DSM、非平面场景下的UAV视觉定位提供了直接、鲁棒且接近DSM方法的解决方案，代码将开源。

title: RIVO: Lightweight Adaptive Rerouting for Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep Research agents rely on long-horizon reasoning and iterative tool use to solve complex information-seeking tasks. However, adaptive decision-making over these trajectories remains challenging, as agents may stop prematurely when further evidence is needed, continue unnecessarily after sufficient evidence has been gathered, or fail to redirect unproductive trajectories. Existing solutions either require costly model retraining and dense turn-level supervision, or rely on heuristic control rules that are not directly optimized for downstream research utility. This motivates a lightweight, utility-aware alternative for Deep Research control. We formulate adaptive rerouting in long-horizon Deep Research as a state-conditioned trajectory correction problem. Based on this view, we introduce RIVO, a lightweight plug-in framework for adaptive trajectory correction. The agent estimates its research state from lightweight signals and determines whether trajectory redirection is needed. Once triggered, the plug-in modifies the Host token logits to steer generation toward a more promising research direction. Theoretical analysis shows that, under a value-alignment condition and bounded local curvature, a sufficiently small logit intervention can locally improve expected downstream research utility. We further construct BrowseCore, a curated dataset with a paired local corpus, for efficient and controlled Deep Research experimentation. Building on this resource, the plug-in is trained from downstream outcomes, enabling it to learn corrections that improve subsequent research and final task performance. Extensive experiments across multiple Deep Research benchmarks and control settings demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, showing that lightweight logit intervention can improve long-horizon research without retraining the underlying Host model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出轻量级即插即用框架 RIVO，将长时程 Deep Research 的自适应改道建模为状态条件化的轨迹修正问题，通过 logit 干预引导生成，并用配套数据集 BrowseCore 训练，无需重训宿主模型即可提升研究效用。
AI.motivation: Deep Research 智能体依赖长时程推理与迭代工具调用，但轨迹上的自适应决策仍很困难：证据不足时过早停止、证据充分后仍继续、以及无法纠正低效轨迹。现有方案要么需要昂贵的模型重训与密集的轮级监督，要么依赖启发式控制规则且未直接面向下游研究效用优化。因此需要一种轻量、效用感知的替代控制方案。
AI.method: 将长时程 Deep Research 中的自适应改道形式化为状态条件化的轨迹修正问题。提出 RIVO：轻量级即插即用框架。智能体从轻量信号估计研究状态并判断是否需要改道；一旦触发，插件修改宿主模型的 token logits 以引导生成走向更有前景的研究方向。理论分析表明，在价值对齐条件与有界局部曲率下，足够小的 logit 干预可局部提升期望下游研究效用。同时构建 BrowseCore（含配套本地语料）用于高效可控实验，并基于下游结果训练该插件。
AI.result: 在多个 Deep Research 基准与控制设置上的大量实验表明方法有效：轻量级 logit 干预可在不重训宿主模型的情况下改善长时程研究表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过状态条件化的轨迹修正与轻量 logit 干预，可在冻结宿主模型的前提下实现效用感知的自适应改道，为长时程 Deep Research 控制提供了一种低成本、可插拔且面向下游效用的解决路径。

title: Certify the Decision, Not Every Score: Exact Top-k Selection from Few Evaluations
summary: Choosing a few robust algorithms or schedules can require evaluating every candidate under many adverse scenarios, even though an agent only needs to identify the winners. A predictor may suggest those winners, but cannot rule out a surprise in an unevaluated scenario. We introduce Certified Adaptive Selection (CAS), which returns the exact top-$k$ set as soon as remaining uncertainty cannot change it. CAS keeps guaranteed lower and upper bounds on Expected Shortfall (ES), the average loss in the worst scenarios. Its stopping test compares the worst admissible selected candidate with the best admissible excluded one; for information-disjoint Cartesian intervals this one-cut test is necessary and sufficient. Prediction has a separate role: selecting the next outcome to evaluate, never authorizing the decision. For empirical ES with exact unit-cost queries, we compute in polynomial time the fewest evaluations that could have proved the realized decision in hindsight. Our prediction-guided agent CAS-PG is exact for every predictor, including adversarial ones. On two public algorithm-selection matrices, CAS-PG certifies the exact top three after 630 of 3150 and 981 of 2200 replayed queries, or $1.14$ and $1.18$ times that hindsight minimum. Without historical outcomes, its transcript-only variant requires $1.28$ and $1.37$ times the minimum, outperforming the tested non-predictive certified policies. Separately, a prediction-free CAS policy avoids $93.0\%$ of exact recourse solves in synthetic energy scheduling. One certificate thus supports several acquisition policies and separately proved risk/cost extensions: prediction changes the work, not the justified choice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出认证自适应选择（CAS）框架，可在剩余不确定性不再影响结果时立即返回精确的 top-$k$ 集合，并将预测的作用限制为选择下一个待评估对象而非授权决策。
AI.motivation: 在众多不利场景下评估大量候选以选出少数稳健算法或调度方案代价高昂，而智能体实际只需识别胜出者。预测虽可提示胜出者，却无法排除未评估场景中的意外，因此需要一种既能利用预测又能提供严格认证的机制。
AI.method: CAS 维护 Expected Shortfall（ES）的保证上下界，其停止检验比较最差可接受入选候选与最优可接受落选候选；在信息不相交的笛卡尔区间下，该单切检验是充要条件。预测仅用于选择下一个评估结果，不参与授权决策。针对精确单位成本查询下的经验 ES，作者在多项式时间内计算事后证明已实现决策所需的最少评估次数，并提出预测引导的 CAS-PG 智能体，对所有预测器（包括对抗性预测器）均保持精确性。
AI.result: 在两个公开算法选择矩阵上，CAS-PG 分别在 3150 次回放查询中的 630 次和 2200 次中的 981 次后认证出精确 top 3，分别为事后最小值的 1.14 倍和 1.18 倍。无历史结果时，仅依赖记录转录的变体需要最小值的 1.28 倍和 1.37 倍，优于所测试的非预测认证策略。此外，在合成能源调度中，无预测的 CAS 策略避免了 93.0% 的精确 recourse 求解。
AI.conclusion: 单一证书即可支撑多种采集策略，并分别证明风险/成本扩展；预测改变的是工作量而非正当选择，从而在保证精确性的同时提升评估效率。

title: CatPortrait: Taming Video Generative Models for Portrait Animation via In-context Conditioning
summary: Recent video generative models have shown strong capability in synthesizing high-quality and temporally coherent videos. Yet, adapting them for controllable portrait animation remains nontrivial, as existing methods typically rely on architectural changes or extra conditioning modules, increasing complexity and reducing compatibility with pretrained models. We present CatPortrait, a simple and effective framework that enables controllable portrait animation via 3D face guidance as in-context conditioning. CatPortrait preserves the original video generation backbone and injects structured 3D facial guidance into the input space through spatial concatenation, allowing pretrained image-to-video models to animate portraits without sacrificing their pretrained priors. CatPortrait supports both video-driven and audio-driven portrait animation within a unified framework. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CatPortrait achieves competitive or superior results across both settings.

AI.tldr: CatPortrait提出一种简单有效的可控人像动画框架，通过将3D人脸引导作为上下文条件注入输入空间，无需修改预训练视频生成模型架构，统一支持视频驱动和音频驱动的人像动画。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能合成高质量、时序连贯的视频，但用于可控人像动画时通常依赖架构改动或额外条件模块，导致复杂度上升且与预训练模型兼容性下降。因此需要一种不改动骨干、保持预训练先验的方法。
AI.method: CatPortrait保持原始视频生成骨干不变，将结构化3D人脸引导通过空间拼接（spatial concatenation）注入输入空间，作为上下文条件（in-context conditioning），使预训练图生视频模型能在不牺牲预训练先验的情况下驱动人像动画。该框架在统一架构下同时支持视频驱动和音频驱动的人像动画。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CatPortrait在视频驱动和音频驱动两种设定下均取得有竞争力或更优的结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过将3D人脸引导作为输入空间的上下文条件，可在不修改预训练视频生成模型架构的前提下实现可控人像动画，且统一框架兼顾视频与音频驱动，验证了简约设计在兼容性与性能上的有效性。

title: More Reasoning Is Not Always Better: Executing Clinical Guidelines with LLMs and Rules
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown considerable promise in clinical decision support. However, existing approaches often rely on multi-step reasoning or multi-agent collaboration to execute clinical guidelines, introducing substantial computational overhead without reliably preventing decision errors. To address these limitations, we propose a framework for Medical Decision Execution (MedDEx) that integrates structured patient states with deterministic rule execution to support guideline-based treatment planning. MedDEx separates clinical record interpretation from guideline execution, leveraging LLMs to extract patient information and generate treatment plans while assigning guideline-defined decision logic to a rule executor. Experiments across multiple clinical guideline benchmarks demonstrate that MedDEx improves decision accuracy while reducing inference costs. Further analyses highlight the critical roles of structured patient representations and deterministic rule execution, suggesting that additional LLM reasoning does not necessarily translate into better guideline adherence.

AI.tldr: MedDEx框架将临床记录解读与指南执行分离：LLM负责抽取患者信息并生成治疗方案，确定性规则执行器负责指南定义的决策逻辑，从而在提升决策准确率的同时降低推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM临床决策支持方法多依赖多步推理或多智能体协作来执行临床指南，不仅带来显著的计算开销，也无法可靠地避免决策错误。
AI.method: 提出医学决策执行框架MedDEx，将结构化患者状态与确定性规则执行相结合以支持基于指南的治疗规划。该框架把临床记录解读与指南执行解耦：由LLM抽取患者信息并生成治疗方案，将指南定义的决策逻辑交由规则执行器完成。
AI.result: 在多个临床指南基准上的实验表明，MedDEx在提升决策准确率的同时降低了推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 进一步分析凸显了结构化患者表示与确定性规则执行的关键作用，说明额外的LLM推理并不必然带来更好的指南依从性。

title: Can You Trust Your Preference Models? Stackelberg Games for Alignment
summary: Language models are frequently aligned to human preferences via imperfect evaluators whose errors can be exploited during optimization. We train policies to search for comparisons on which an evaluator may reverse the underlying preference, providing candidates for additional supervision. Since human preferences are unavailable during policy training, we use disagreement among an ensemble of preference models as a proxy for prediction error. We formulate this search as a zero-sum Stackelberg game between two opposing policies, a Leader which tries to minimize disagreement, and a Follower which maximizes it. For a general class of finite contextual Stackelberg games, we establish equilibrium existence and, under regularization, uniqueness and a closed-form characterization. We introduce Stackelberg Mirror Descent-Ascent (SMIDA), a two-timescale algorithm with linear last-iterate convergence in the tabular setting, and develop a neural policy-gradient analogue. Experiments with a synthetic oracle support disagreement as an informative proxy for prediction error. On held out data the trained policies outperform reference policies and increase the fraction of comparisons that exceed a disagreement threshold and reverse the oracle's preference.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将策略搜索形式化为Leader-Follower的零和Stackelberg博弈，用偏好模型集成的不一致度作为预测误差的代理，训练策略主动寻找评估器可能翻转偏好的比较对，并通过SMIDA算法实现线性收敛。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常通过不完美的评估器进行人类偏好对齐，而这些评估器的错误会在优化过程中被利用。作者希望训练策略主动搜索那些评估器可能"反转"真实偏好的比较对，从而为后续监督提供高质量候选样本。由于训练时无法获得真实人类偏好，需要寻找可用的替代信号。
AI.method: 以偏好模型集成之间的不一致度作为预测误差的代理指标。将搜索过程建模为两个对立策略之间的零和Stackelberg博弈：Leader最小化不一致度，Follower最大化不一致度。针对一类有限上下文Stackelberg博弈，证明均衡存在性，并在正则化条件下给出唯一性及闭式刻画。提出Stackelberg Mirror Descent-Ascent（SMIDA）——一种双时间尺度算法，在表格设定下具有线性last-iterate收敛性，并发展了神经策略梯度版本。
AI.result: 在合成oracle上的实验支持"不一致度作为预测误差代理指标"的有效性。在留出数据上，训练得到的策略优于参考策略，并提升了超过不一致度阈值且能反转oracle偏好的比较对所占比例。
AI.conclusion: 通过Stackelberg博弈框架主动挖掘评估器可能出错的比较对，是一种可行的、能改进偏好对齐监督的方法；理论上的均衡刻画与SMIDA的线性收敛性为其提供了算法保证。

title: AD-GS: Anatomical Density-guided 3D Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Dental CBCT Reconstruction
summary: Sparse-view Cone-Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) reconstruction is essential for reducing radiation dose and scan effort, but remains underconstrained due to limited projection information. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based CBCT reconstruction methods rely on gradient-driven densification, which becomes unstable under sparse acquisition and often leads to over-smoothed structures. We propose AD-GS, an Anatomical Density-guided 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that formulates Gaussian densification as an attenuation-aware Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling process. By interpreting Gaussians as samples from an underlying anatomical attenuation distribution, AD-GS adaptively concentrates representation capacity in high-attenuation regions, enabling sharper structural boundaries under sparse projections. To further constrain reconstruction, we incorporate a semantic regularization based on zero-shot features from Segment Anything in Medical Images, enforcing multi-view consistency through semantic priors. Experiments on the ToothFairy3 dental CBCT dataset demonstrate that AD-GS achieves superior structural fidelity and boundary preservation compared with existing 3DGS-based approaches under sparse-view settings within the dental and maxillofacial setting. Code is available at https://github.com/yulinjiaxue/AD-GS-BMVC2026.

AI.tldr: AD-GS将3D高斯泼溅的稠密化建模为衰减感知的MCMC采样，并引入SAMed语义正则，实现稀疏视角CBCT高质量重建。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角锥束CT（CBCT）重建可降低辐射剂量与扫描成本，但投影信息有限导致问题欠定。现有基于3DGS的方法依赖梯度驱动稠密化，在稀疏采集下不稳定，易产生过度平滑的结构。
AI.method: 提出AD-GS（解剖密度引导的3DGS框架）：1）将高斯稠密化表述为衰减感知的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样过程，把高斯基元视为潜在解剖衰减分布的样本，使表征能力自适应集中于高衰减区域，从而在稀疏投影下获得更锐利的结构边界；2）引入基于SAMed（Segment Anything in Medical Images）零样本特征的语义正则，通过语义先验施加多视角一致性约束。
AI.result: 在ToothFairy3牙科CBCT数据集上，AD-GS在稀疏视角设置下相比现有3DGS类方法取得更优的结构保真度与边界保持能力，适用于牙科及颌面场景。
AI.conclusion: AD-GS通过解剖密度引导的MCMC稠密化与语义正则，有效缓解稀疏视角CBCT重建中的不稳定与过平滑问题，提升结构细节与边界重建质量。

title: Natural Language Processing for Aligning Readings with Learning Objectives and Assessing Topic Balance in Dental Education
summary: Curriculum teams often lack time to check whether assigned readings support learning objectives (LOs) and whether topic coverage is balanced. We present a natural language processing (NLP) workflow to support evidence-informed curation of reading lists. The workflow combines PubMedBERT sentence embeddings and cosine similarity for retrieval, natural language inference (NLI) for evidence checking, and topic modeling for coverage analysis. We tested the approach in dental education using 13 course-level LOs and a PubMed-derived corpus of 3,837 LO-abstract pairs. Median cosine similarity ranged from 0.86 to 0.91 across the 13 LOs, showing generally high semantic similarity. Topic modeling showed broad but uneven coverage, with one or two dominant topics per domain. Similarity alone was not enough for selecting readings: among high-similarity pairs (cosine 0.90-1.00), 22.9% were classified by NLI as neutral or contradictory. In a 49-pair expert-labeled validation set, cosine-based retrieval (cosine >= 0.90) achieved 0.69 accuracy, while the combined cosine and NLI approach achieved 0.73 accuracy against expert alignment labels. Overall, the workflow shows how AI can support curriculum alignment by reducing false positives and helping select readings that better match intended LOs.

AI.tldr: 提出结合PubMedBERT句嵌入、余弦相似度、NLI证据核查与主题建模的NLP工作流，用于阅读清单与学习目标(LO)的对齐审查，并以牙科教育13个课程级LO与3,837个LO-摘要对进行验证。
AI.motivation: 课程团队缺乏时间核查指定阅读材料是否支撑学习目标，以及主题覆盖是否均衡，因此需要证据驱动的阅读清单 curation 支持工具。
AI.method: 工作流包含三部分：用PubMedBERT句嵌入与余弦相似度进行检索；用自然语言推理(NLI)进行证据核查；用主题建模进行覆盖度分析。在牙科教育场景中以13个课程级LO和PubMed来源的3,837个LO-摘要对测试。
AI.result: 13个LO的中位余弦相似度为0.86–0.91，语义相似度整体较高；主题建模显示覆盖广泛但不均衡，每个领域有1–2个主导主题。高相似度对(0.90–1.00)中22.9%被NLI判为中立或矛盾，说明仅靠相似度不足。49对专家标注验证集上，仅余弦检索(≥0.90)准确率0.69，余弦+NLI组合达0.73。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流可减少假阳性、辅助选择更契合预期LO的阅读材料，说明AI可支持课程对齐审查。

title: On the Complexity Gap Between POMDPs and Multi-Environment POMDPs
summary: Multi-environment POMDPs (ME-POMDPs) generalize POMDPs by encoding a finite set of possible environments, capturing model uncertainty. The finite-horizon robust reward maximization problem for a ME-POMDP asks for a policy that maximizes reward in the worst environment, and recent work has shown this problem to be $\mathsf{PSPACE}$-complete. We expand the complexity landscape of ME-POMDPs by identifying which subclasses retain this $\mathsf{PSPACE}$-completeness. In particular, we take subclasses of POMDPs that are tractable in the single-environment case, and investigate the computational complexity of these classes when extended to the multi-environment setting. We first prove the $\mathsf{NP}$-completeness of multi-environment blind MDPs and deterministic POMDPs using a certain closure-under-mixture condition. We then prove $\mathsf{PSPACE}$-completeness for a range of subclasses that do not satisfy that closure condition, yielding new complexity results for multi-observation POMDPs. Finally, we show existential theory of the reals ($\exists \mathbb{R}$)-completeness for numerous ME-POMDP problems under time-dependent Markovian policies or finite-state controllers that are $\mathsf{NP}$-complete for standard POMDPs. These results reveal a subtle relationship between POMDP and ME-POMDP complexity that depends heavily on the subclasses involved.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了多环境POMDP（ME-POMDP）的复杂度图谱，识别哪些子类在扩展为多环境设定后仍保持PSPACE-完全性，并对不满足闭包条件及采取时间依赖马尔可夫策略或有限状态控制器的情形给出新的复杂度结论。
AI.motivation: ME-POMDP在有限时域下最坏情况奖励最大化为PSPACE-完全，但尚不清楚哪些单环境可解子类在多环境扩展下保持该难度，本文旨在刻画子类层面的复杂度边界。
AI.method: 以单环境可解POMDP子类为对象，在扩展至多环境设定后分析复杂度；利用某种闭包于混合（closure-under-mixture）条件区分难易情形，并分别针对时间依赖马尔可夫策略与有限状态控制器展开归约分析。
AI.result: 证明多环境盲MDP与确定性POMDP在满足闭包于混合条件时为NP-完全；对不满足该条件的多个子类证明PSPACE-完全，包括多观测POMDP的新复杂度结果；并证明在时间依赖马尔可夫策略或有限状态控制器下，若干ME-POMDP问题为∃R-完全，而相应标准POMDP问题为NP-完全。
AI.conclusion: POMDP与ME-POMDP之间的复杂度关系高度依赖具体子类：闭包于混合条件是可解性保持的关键分界，多环境扩展可能导致从NP到PSPACE乃至∃R的显著难度跃升。

title: Metric-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Object Hallucination Reduction in LVLM-Based Image Captioning
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have excelled in joint visual and language understanding, particularly in image captioning. However, LVLMs remain prone to object hallucination, describing non-existent entities in the given image. Previous remedies, including dataset-enhanced supervised training and reinforcement learning from human feedback, show promise but rely heavily on costly human involvement, limiting scalability. To address this, we propose a reinforcement learning framework to mitigate object hallucination in LVLM-based image captioning, driven entirely by natural language processing (NLP) metrics. While optimizing reinforcement learning solely on NLP metrics offers scalability, it also introduces pitfalls: reward hacking, sparse feedback, and costly training. Our framework sidesteps these by introducing an Object Consistency Score (OCS) capturing both correctness and coverage of objects, incorporating KL-regularization for denser token-level guidance, and designing a lightweight PPO variant that fine-tunes adapters atop a frozen LVLM backbone, achieving efficiency and stability. Extensive experiments on the InstructBLIP baseline demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our framework, achieving a substantial hallucination reduction of up to 41\% on the COCO dataset and 29\% on the Visual Genome. Furthermore, the framework can enhance caption quality by incorporating complementary evaluation metrics such as BERTScore and METEOR. These results reveal a broader insight in multimodal learning: LVLMs can effectively self-correct hallucinations using metric feedback, motivating deeper exploration into scalable reinforcement frameworks that significantly reduce human effort.

AI.tldr: 提出一个仅依赖NLP指标的强化学习框架，通过对象一致性分数、KL正则化和轻量PPO微调适配器，显著降低LVLM图像描述中的对象幻觉。
AI.motivation: LVLM在图像描述中易产生对象幻觉，而现有基于数据集增强监督训练和人类反馈强化学习的缓解方法严重依赖昂贵的人工标注，可扩展性受限。作者希望构建无需人工介入、可扩展的缓解方案。
AI.method: 提出纯NLP指标驱动的强化学习框架。核心包括：设计对象一致性分数（OCS），同时刻画对象描述的正确性与覆盖度；引入KL正则化以提供更密集的token级指导；设计轻量级PPO变体，在冻结的LVLM主干上微调适配器，兼顾效率与稳定性。
AI.result: 在InstructBLIP基线上，COCO数据集幻觉降低最高达41%，Visual Genome降低29%。框架具有有效性与泛化性，并可通过引入BERTScore、METEOR等互补评价指标进一步提升描述质量。
AI.conclusion: LVLM可借助指标反馈有效自我纠正幻觉，揭示了多模态学习中可扩展强化学习框架的潜力，有望大幅减少人工投入。

title: Unfair and Unsafe: Everyday Bias Triggers Emergent Misalignment
summary: Emergent misalignment (EM) occurs when fine-tuning a language model to a narrow task makes it misaligned on unrelated ones. Because organizations now routinely fine-tune models on their own data, it matters which kinds of training data cause EM. So far, studies have induced EM with data containing recognized safety failures, such as insecure code or harmful advice, while biased training data is typically examined by fairness research for the bias models learn from it rather than for its effects on safety. In real-world text, much of this bias, such as demographic stereotypes, appears not as derogatory language but politely, embedded in judgments about people. We ask whether learning such polite stereotypes can itself cause EM. We find that fine-tuning on polite answers that rely on stereotypes makes models less safe and less truthful on unrelated tasks. The effect holds across four open-weight model families (7B to 12B), both gender and race stereotypes, and repeated training runs, relative to controls trained on the same questions without the stereotype. We further show that the learned stereotype has its own direction in model activations, distinct from directions for generic misaligned traits such as deception. This direction exists before fine-tuning and can both control the learned stereotype and monitor its acquisition. Existing defenses against EM improve safety while leaving the stereotype largely intact. Beyond this controlled setting, fine-tuning on political news coverage also triggers EM, apparently amplified by partisan framing, and stereotype models acting as tool-using agents can carry out harmful tasks and blame people without evidence. Our results show that biased training data is not only a fairness problem but also a safety one. We argue that EM is studied too narrowly, and that fairness concerns and methods offer a natural way to broaden the search for its triggers.

AI.tldr: 礼貌性的刻板印象数据微调会使语言模型在无关任务上变得不安全、不真实，即引发涌现性失配（EM），表明偏见数据不只是公平性问题，更是安全问题。
AI.motivation: 现有EM研究多以显性安全失败数据（如不安全代码、有害建议）作为触发源，而偏见数据通常只在公平性研究中被关注"模型学到了什么偏见"，而非其对安全的影响。现实中大量偏见（如人口刻板印象）以礼貌、嵌入判断的方式出现，作者因此追问：学习这类礼貌刻板印象本身是否也会导致EM。
AI.method: 在四个开放权重模型家族（7B–12B）上进行微调实验，训练数据为依赖刻板印象的礼貌回答；覆盖性别与种族刻板印象；设置相同问题但无刻板印象的对照组；重复多次训练。进一步通过激活分析考察刻板印象的表示方向，并测试其与欺骗等一般失配特质方向的关系，以及现有EM防御手段的效果。此外还测试了政治新闻报道数据微调与工具使用智能体场景。
AI.result: 微调于含礼貌刻板印象的回答会使模型在无关任务上更不安全、更不真实；该效应跨四个模型家族、两种刻板类型及多次重复训练均稳健。学习到的刻板印象在激活空间中具有独立方向，区别于欺骗等一般失配特质，且该方向在微调前即存在，可用于控制与监测刻板印象的习得。现有EM防御提升了安全性但基本未改变刻板印象。政治新闻微调同样触发EM，似由党派框架放大；作为工具使用智能体的刻板印象模型可执行有害任务并在无证据情况下归咎于他人。
AI.conclusion: 偏见训练数据不仅是公平性问题，也是安全问题。EM的研究范围过于狭窄，公平性关切与方法为拓展其触发因素的探索提供了自然途径。

title: Belief Embedding Tree Search
summary: Beliefs in a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) are posterior distributions over the hidden state given the agent's history of actions and observations. They summarize everything the history says about the state, so planning in a POMDP is planning in a Markov decision process (MDP) over beliefs. Belief MDPs have continuous state spaces even for finite POMDPs, and exact planning in them is intractable in general. Planners must therefore approximate beliefs and estimate values. Monte Carlo planners do both inside a search tree, with an approximate belief at every node and a value estimate at every leaf. Approximations usually consist of sets of sampled states, with leaf values coming from rollouts, hand-designed bounds, or learned networks. Policies and values computed from these approximations are limited by their quality, and prior methods with learned networks rely on hand-chosen summaries of the sampled states. A belief representation should be computable from the parent node's representation through the POMDP's dynamics, let the search sample from it, and be learned so that it provides the information that policies and value functions need. We present Belief Embedding Tree Search (BETS), a Monte Carlo planner that meets these requirements by representing each node's belief with a generative distribution embedding (GDE) while updating it through the POMDP dynamics. BETS trains its belief model alongside its policy and value networks through experience, with the realized hidden state of the POMDP as the belief model's training target. We evaluate BETS on six configurations of RockSample, LightDark, and PocMan against BetaZero and three planners without learned components. BETS is competitive or leading on all six, while every baseline falls far behind on at least one. Where beliefs are highest-dimensional, it outperforms them by a large margin, even without search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Belief Embedding Tree Search (BETS)，一种蒙特卡洛规划器。它用生成分布嵌入 (GDE) 表示搜索树各节点的信念，并通过 POMDP 动态更新，同时以真实隐状态为监督信号联合训练信念、策略与价值网络。在 RockSample、LightDark 和 PocMan 六个配置上，BETS 均具有竞争力或领先，且在高维信念场景中大幅超越 BetaZero 及三个无学习组件规划器。
AI.motivation: POMDP 中的信念是对隐状态的后验分布，信念 MDP 即使对有限 POMDP 也具有连续状态空间，精确规划通常不可解，因此规划器必须近似信念并估计价值。现有蒙特卡洛规划器以采样状态集合近似信念，叶节点价值来自 rollout、人工设计边界或学习网络；基于学习网络的方法依赖人工选取的采样状态摘要，导致策略与价值质量受近似质量限制。作者希望信念表示满足三点：可由父节点表示经 POMDP 动态计算得到、可支持搜索采样、可学习以提供策略与价值函数所需信息。
AI.method: BETS 满足上述要求：将每个节点的信念表示为生成分布嵌入 (GDE)，并通过 POMDP 动态对其进行更新；在搜索树中，每个节点携带该嵌入形式的近似信念，叶节点使用价值估计。BETS 通过经验联合训练信念模型、策略网络和价值网络，训练信念模型时以 POMDP 实际发生的隐状态作为监督目标。
AI.result: 在 RockSample、LightDark 和 PocMan 的六个配置上，将 BETS 与 BetaZero 及三个不含学习组件的规划器比较：BETS 在全部六个配置上具有竞争力或处于领先，而每个基线至少在一个配置上明显落后。在信念维度最高的场景中，BETS 优势尤为显著，即使不进行搜索也能大幅超越基线。
AI.conclusion: 以生成分布嵌入表示信念、并通过 POMDP 动态更新、以真实隐状态为监督进行联合学习，是一种有效且可扩展的信念表示方案，能在多种 POMDP 任务中取得竞争或领先性能，尤其在高维信念场景下表现突出。

title: Retraining-Free Depth Pruning of Vision Transformers: A Cross Domain Study of Layer Redundancy
summary: Transformer architectures have achieved strong results in natural language processing and computer vision, but their deployment is limited by high computational, memory and storage costs, motivating research into model compression techniques, such as pruning, while preserving performance. Prior work has shown substantial redundancy in large language models (LLMs), and redundancy in vision transformers has also been investigated, but it remains less systematically analyzed than in LLMs. In this work, we extend similarity-based redundancy analysis to vision models by measuring cosine similarity between layer inputs and outputs to identify transformations with minimal impact. We study redundancy patterns across several transformer architectures and find that deep vision transformers such as DINOv2 and SwinV2, like language models, exhibit significant redundancy. We then evaluate how this redundancy can be exploited to improve efficiency, analyzing the trade-off between inference speed and performance degradation under different pruning strategies. Our results show that moderate pruning can yield substantial acceleration with limited impact on accuracy, and that 20% of the DINOv2 blocks can be removed without any retraining, for a 1.24x throughput gain and a 20% lower energy per image at a relative accuracy loss below 1% on ImageNet-1K. We further propose a model selection pipeline that automatically identifies the best pruned configuration for a given dataset, reducing FLOPs by 13% to 27% on average across architectures with an average accuracy change between -0.3 and +1.0 points.

AI.tldr: 本文将基于相似度的冗余分析扩展到视觉Transformer，发现深层视觉模型（如DINOv2、SwinV2）存在显著冗余，并据此提出剪枝与自动配置选择流程，在精度损失极小的前提下显著提升效率。
AI.motivation: Transformer在NLP和视觉任务中表现优异，但计算、内存与存储开销高，限制其部署，因此需要模型压缩（如剪枝）并保持性能。已有工作表明LLM存在大量冗余，视觉Transformer的冗余虽有研究但系统性不足，本文旨在更系统地分析视觉模型的冗余并加以利用。
AI.method: 将基于相似度的冗余分析扩展到视觉模型：通过度量层输入与输出之间的余弦相似度，识别影响最小的变换；在多种Transformer架构上研究冗余模式；评估不同剪枝策略下推理速度与性能退化的权衡；并提出一个模型选择流程，自动为给定数据集找出最优剪枝配置。
AI.result: 深层视觉Transformer（如DINOv2、SwinV2）与语言模型一样存在显著冗余。适度剪枝可在精度损失有限的情况下带来显著加速；DINOv2中20%的block无需重训练即可移除，吞吐量提升1.24倍，每张图像能耗降低20%，ImageNet-1K相对精度损失低于1%。所提流程在各架构上平均减少13%–27% FLOPs，平均精度变化在-0.3至+1.0个百分点之间。
AI.conclusion: 视觉Transformer存在可被有效利用的冗余，基于相似度的分析与剪枝及自动配置选择能在几乎不损失精度的情况下显著提升推理效率、降低计算与能耗，为视觉模型压缩部署提供了可行路径。

title: Mixed Feelings, Single Polarity
summary: Emotion datasets are routinely mapped onto positive and negative valence, by assigning each emotion category one polarity. We test where this works and where it fails, using SemEval-2018 Affect in Tweets (English, Arabic, Spanish), Affective Text aligned with EmoBank, raw GoEmotions annotations, naturalistic hashtag corpora, and a controlled annotation study. Fixed projection works well when a text carries labels of one valence. It fails on a subset identifiable from the labels alone: tweets whose emotion labels point in opposite directions. These are 9.0% of polar SemEval test tweets but cause 54.8% of the polarity errors of a learned projection, are more than twice as likely to receive a neutral-or-mixed gold label, and are not rescued by modeling the full label set. Annotators produce such configurations routinely: 16.3% of multilabel GoEmotions judgments combine emotions from the dataset's own positive and negative parents. In a controlled study holding word and reader constant, context changes the coarse valence judgment in 56.8% of cases, against 19.9% for controls. We recommend projecting label configurations rather than labels, abstaining or keeping a mixed class where labels conflict, and reporting coverage alongside accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验将情感类别固定映射到正/负效价的做法何时有效、何时失效，发现失效集中于标签内部极性冲突的样本，并提出应投影"标签组合"而非单个标签。
AI.motivation: 情感数据集通常给每个情感类别指定单一极性，从而把数据映射到正负效价上。作者希望系统检验这种固定投影的适用边界，找出它失效的具体情形，并量化其影响。
AI.method: 使用多个数据源进行验证：SemEval-2018 Affect in Tweets（英语、阿拉伯语、西班牙语）、与EmoBank对齐的Affective Text、原始GoEmotions标注、自然场景话题标签语料，以及一项受控标注实验。通过对比固定投影与学习式投影的错误分布，识别并分析标签极性方向相反的样本子集。
AI.result: 当文本只带单一极性标签时固定投影表现良好；但在标签极性相反的样本上失败。这类样本占SemEval极性测试推文的9.0%，却造成学习式投影54.8%的极性错误，且获得中性或混合金标的概率高出一倍以上，建模完整标签集也无法挽救。标注者常产生此类组合：16.3%的多标签GoEmotions判断同时包含数据集自身正负父类的情绪。在控制词与读者不变的实验中，语境改变了56.8%的粗略效价判断，而对照组仅19.9%。
AI.conclusion: 建议将情感标注投影为"标签组合"而非单个标签；在标签冲突处应弃权或保留混合类别；并在报告准确率时同时报告覆盖率。

title: Trace Evolution Bench: Measuring Whether Agents Improve from Their Own Environment Traces
summary: Self-evolving agents are usually scored by endpoint Gain: held-out success after an update minus success before. That difference can credit a frozen rescore as evolution. We introduce Trace Evolution Bench (TEB), a protocol that separates that rescore from a context or weight update, together with three frozen 80/20/40 packs. An update is accepted only when validation does not fall, held-out identifiers never enter the update, and a text update is not ranked with a weight update. The primary scoreboard is coding, graded by hidden unit tests in a closed workspace. On that pack (40 held-out tasks, one family), DeepSeek v4 Pro under no_evolve never changes its policy yet moves 7.5, 5.0, and 12.5 percentage points across three seeds. Of nine text-update cells inspired by GEPA, ACE, and ExpeL, seven have positive excess above that seed's own band, and one gepa_llm seed moves down by the width of its band (-12.5, regression 0.48). GLM and MiniMax do not reproduce that seven-of-nine pattern. No method stays above its own band on every seed of all three models: GLM has two paired cells above their own bands, and MiniMax expel_llm seed 44 is a third (regression 0.30). The methods were fixed on a validation screen before held-out was read. Office, graded by rule-bounded delivery, and manufacturing table QA are separate packs: office DeepSeek does not exceed its own bands (widest 17.5 points), and manufacturing has no paired positive excess beyond its seed band.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Trace Evolution Bench (TEB) 协议，将"端点增益"中由冻结重打分带来的假进化与真正的上下文/权重更新分离，并给出三套冻结的 80/20/40 包用于评测自进化智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化智能体的评测通常以"更新后留出成功率减去更新前成功率"的端点增益（endpoint Gain）为指标，但该差值可能把一次冻结的重打分误计为"进化"，导致评测失真。作者希望建立一个能区分真实更新效果与重打分噪声的严格评测协议。
AI.method: 提出 TEB 协议：(1) 仅当验证集不下降时才接受更新；(2) 留出标识符绝不进入更新过程；(3) 文本更新与权重更新不可同榜排名。配套三套冻结的 80/20/40 数据包。主榜为编码任务，由封闭工作区中的隐藏单元测试打分（40 个留出任务、单一家族）。方法在读取留出集之前已通过验证集筛选固定。
AI.result: 在编码包上，DeepSeek v4 Pro 在 no_evolve 条件下策略不变，但三个种子间仍波动 7.5、5.0、12.5 个百分点。九个受 GEPA、ACE、ExpeL 启发的文本更新单元中，七个超出该种子自身波动带，其中 gepa_llm 一个种子反而下降 12.5（回归 0.48）。GLM 与 MiniMax 未能复现"七比九"的模式：GLM 仅两个配对单元超过自身波动带，MiniMax expel_llm seed 44 为第三个（回归 0.30）。没有任何方法在三个模型的所有种子上都高于自身波动带。办公包（规则约束交付）中 DeepSeek 未超过自身波动带（最宽 17.5 点），制造表格 QA 包则无配对正超额。
AI.conclusion: 端点增益会因冻结重打分的种子间波动而被误读为进化；TEB 通过留出标识隔离、验证不降接受准则与更新类型分离，揭示了多数"进化"信号在严格基线带内并不稳健，且跨模型不可复现。

title: CowCare: A Unified Visual Framework for Viewpoint-Robust Cattle Tracking and Spatiotemporal Heat-Stress Analysis
summary: Reliable individual monitoring is essential for dairy cattle welfare and early heat stress detection in Precision Livestock Farming (PLF). However, translating raw multi-camera videos into automated diagnostics remains challenging due to disconnected tracking and recognition pipelines and complex physical environments. Dense mutual occlusions and cross-camera viewpoint variations fragment identities, while environmental noise, including camera vibrations, and limited agricultural data obscure subtle heat stress cues such as rapid breathing and flank undulations. To bridge low-level visual features and high-level behavioral diagnostics, we propose CowCare, a unified framework combining viewpoint-robust tracking with spatiotemporal heat stress recognition. Its tracking module, CowTrack, maintains cross-camera identity consistency through a View-Decoupled Aggregation Network (VDA-Net). Instead of relying on static global representations, VDA-Net aggregates localized textures under heavy occlusion and uses a Viewpoint Decoupling Transformer (VDT) to suppress transient viewpoint variations. CowTrack further incorporates a causal online self-supervision mechanism for continuous adaptation to dynamic farm scenes. The resulting tracklets are subsequently processed by TSDF-Net, a fine-grained video understanding network. Its Temporal Stabilization and Aggregation Module (TSAM) suppresses high-frequency jitter, while a Diffusion Semantic Prior (DSP) uses frozen pre-trained diffusion semantics to enhance subtle behavioral signals and mitigate overfitting. Extensive evaluations on two real-world farm benchmarks demonstrate the framework's effectiveness: CowTrack achieves 83.48% HOTA and 87.72% IDF1 for global multi-object tracking on MVCow, and TSDF-Net achieves 87.72% Top-1 accuracy on HSCow. These results establish CowCare as a robust end-to-end framework for automated livestock health monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出CowCare统一框架，将视角鲁棒跟踪（CowTrack）与时空热应激识别（TSDF-Net）结合，实现奶牛个体监测与热应激早期检测。
AI.motivation: 精准畜牧中可靠的个体监测对奶牛福利与热应激早期检测至关重要，但现有跟踪与识别流程割裂，且密集遮挡、跨相机视角变化、相机振动噪声及农业数据匮乏等问题使热应激细微线索（如急促呼吸、腹部起伏）难以捕捉。
AI.method: CowCare包含两个模块：跟踪模块CowTrack通过视角解耦聚合网络（VDA-Net）在严重遮挡下聚合局部纹理，并用视角解耦Transformer（VDT）抑制瞬态视角变化，同时引入因果在线自监督机制实现动态场景持续适应；识别模块TSDF-Net包含时间稳定与聚合模块（TSAM）抑制高频抖动，并利用扩散语义先验（DSP）借助冻结预训练扩散语义增强细微行为信号、缓解过拟合。
AI.result: 在两个真实农场基准上验证：CowTrack在MVCow上取得83.48% HOTA和87.72% IDF1的全局多目标跟踪性能；TSDF-Net在HSCow上取得87.72% Top-1准确率。
AI.conclusion: CowCare作为鲁棒的端到端框架，有效连接低层视觉特征与高层行为诊断，可用于自动化牲畜健康监测。

title: PAIR: Memory-Efficient and Fast Inference with Reading--Reasoning Fusion
summary: For context-based question answering, using one large model for both evidence extraction and answer reasoning requires substantial memory and computation. Existing approaches trade accuracy for efficiency within a single model only. We propose a multi-model approach for efficient inference: our method, PAIR, employs two differently sized models for evidence extraction and answer reasoning, respectively. A smaller Reader model processes and retains the full context, while a larger Reasoner model sees only the question and generated sequence without directly attending to the context. These capabilities are fused at the logit level: at each token, both Reader and Reasoner produce a prediction, and their logits are combined into one, behaving as a single next-token-prediction model. Fine-tuning further boosts their performance. On HotpotQA, PAIR with a 32B Reasoner retains 96% of that same 32B model's full-context accuracy while using roughly one quarter of its KV memory. At 45.7K-token contexts, PAIR achieves up to 3.2$\times$ higher end-to-end throughput than the full-context 32B model on the same GPU. PAIR also improves the accuracy-memory and accuracy-throughput trade-offs over evaluated token-reduction baselines. Its accuracy-preserving behavior generalizes across Qwen2.5, OLMo-3, and Gemma-3 model families.

AI.tldr: 提出PAIR方法，用小型Reader处理完整上下文提取证据，大型Reasoner仅见问题与生成序列进行推理，二者在logit层融合，实现高效且高精度的上下文问答。
AI.motivation: 基于上下文的问答中，若用单一大型模型同时完成证据抽取与答案推理，内存与计算开销巨大；现有方法仅在单模型内部以精度换效率，无法兼顾二者。
AI.method: PAIR采用双模型分工：小模型Reader保留并处理完整上下文，大模型Reasoner只接收问题与已生成序列，不直接关注上下文；在每个token处分别产生预测，并将其logit融合为统一的下一个token预测，同时通过微调进一步提升性能。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA上，配备32B Reasoner的PAIR保留了同规模32B模型全上下文精度的96%，KV内存约为其四分之一；在45.7K token上下文下，端到端吞吐量最高达同GPU上全上下文32B模型的3.2倍；在精度-内存与精度-吞吐权衡上优于所评估的token缩减基线，且在Qwen2.5、OLMo-3、Gemma-3系列上具有良好的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: PAIR通过Reader与Reasoner的logit级融合，在显著降低内存与计算开销的同时保持了接近全上下文大模型的精度，为高效上下文问答提供了一种可跨模型家族泛化的多模型推理范式。

title: Exposing AI Inference as a Telco Network API over the 5G User Plane
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the IEEE Future Networks World Forum 2026 (Portugal)
summary: Supporting edge Artificial Intelligence (AI) inference as a network service is challenging because current mobile systems can transport tensors but do not expose or understand the inference context that gives those tensors operational meaning. Prior studies have addressed this gap through dynamic partitioning, collaborative inference, and split pipelines; however, these solutions remain application-bound, network-blind, or context-free. This work proposes Inference on Demand (IoD), an inference-on-demand abstraction that exposes split inference through a CAMARA-like Application Program Interface (API) and carries a split-aware tensor context in-band across the 5G user plane path. We evaluate the IoD on a programmable user plane function (UPF)-based testbed using a partitionable visual AI workload, showing that adaptive split selection can operate as a network-facing service while avoiding the rigid cost profile of static configurations. Including our findings, split inference becomes more than offloading when the service intent, runtime partitioning, and tensor transport are made visible to the mobile data plane. This opens a path toward network-native AI services, in which programmable telco infrastructure coordinates computation, context, and connectivity for user-facing applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“按需推理（IoD）”抽象，通过类CAMARA API暴露拆分推理并在5G用户面路径带上携带拆分感知的张量上下文，在可编程UPF测试床上验证自适应拆分选择可作为面向网络的服务运行，避免静态配置的刚性成本。
AI.motivation: 边缘AI推理作为网络服务面临挑战：当前移动系统虽可传输张量，却不暴露或理解赋予张量操作语义的推理上下文。已有方案（动态分区、协同推理、拆分流水线）存在应用绑定、网络盲或上下文缺失的局限。
AI.method: 提出IoD（Inference on Demand）抽象，通过类CAMARA的应用编程接口（API）暴露拆分推理，并在5G用户面路径上以带内方式携带拆分感知的张量上下文；在基于可编程用户面功能（UPF）的测试床上，使用可分区视觉AI负载进行评估。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，自适应拆分选择能够作为面向网络的服务运行，同时避免静态配置的刚性成本画像。
AI.conclusion: 当服务意图、运行时分区与张量传输对移动数据面可见时，拆分推理超越单纯卸载；这为网络原生AI服务开辟了路径，使可编程电信基础设施能够为用户应用协调计算、上下文与连接。

title: Appearance Compensation in Volume Rendering
summary: Can a volume that reproduces every external RGB view still have an incorrect density? We study this question in emission-absorption rendering with an independently parameterized, physically bounded effective source. Appearance compensates a density change by replacing the radiance that it removes from the rest of each ray. We characterize the surviving density information with a shared spatial appearance field. Our first result is an optimal density-only gain after finite-degree spherical-harmonic source refitting. A coupled tensor gauge and physical localized packets identify the sharp limiting nonlinear inverse coefficient as its reciprocal. Our second result realizes positive gain at every fixed finite degree for a residual set of isotropic spatial sources at one fixed density. At the same references, growing angular capacity hides a fixed nonzero density error while retaining physicality and any prescribed finite set of smoothness bounds. Local identifiability and the absence of a capacity-uniform recovery modulus therefore coexist. Our third result constructs an exact physical SH2 ambiguity: central density doubles and relative density $L^2$ error exceeds $14.52\%$, yet every external RGB ray is unchanged. We connect these continuum results to shared finite representations, continuous pixel measurements and density-sensitive acquisition. Complete-class certificates separate SH0, SH1 and SH2 fits at one learned density. Finite-camera results expose the distinct role of spatial capacity, and transmission measurements separate otherwise identical RGB fields. Controlled training tests and captured-smoke profiles supply mechanism evidence with explicit observation scopes. The results show why rendering accuracy alone cannot certify density: recovery also depends on appearance capacity, spatial resolution and measurement design.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"能复现所有外部RGB视角的体积是否仍可能具有错误密度"这一问题，证明在发射-吸收渲染中，外观可通过补偿移除的辐射来隐藏密度误差，密度恢复不仅依赖渲染精度，还取决于外观容量、空间分辨率与测量设计。
AI.motivation: 在体积渲染（如神经辐射场、烟雾重建）中，通常以RGB渲染精度作为密度正确性的代理验证。作者质疑这一假设：即使每个外部RGB视角都被完美复现，底层密度仍可能是错误的。因此需要从理论上刻画在何种条件下密度可被唯一辨识，以及外观容量、空间分辨率等因素如何影响密度恢复的可辨识性。
AI.method: 在发射-吸收渲染框架下，采用独立参数化且物理有界（physically bounded）的有效源，通过共享空间外观场刻画残余密度信息。第一，在有限阶球谐（spherical-harmonic）源重拟合后推导最优的仅密度增益（density-only gain），并用耦合张量规范（tensor gauge）与物理局域包（localized packets）将尖锐极限非线性逆系数识别为其倒数。第二，在固定有限阶下构造各向同性空间源的残差集上实现正增益，并分析角向容量增长时如何隐藏固定非零密度误差同时保持物理性与平滑性界。第三，构造精确的物理SH2歧义实例量化密度误差。最后将连续结果联系到共享有限表示、连续像素测量与密度敏感采集，并用有限相机结果、透射测量、受控训练测试与实采烟雾剖面提供机制证据。
AI.result: （1）给出有限阶球谐重拟合后的最优仅密度增益，并识别其极限非线性逆系数为倒数关系。（2）在每个固定有限阶上，对某固定密度下各向同性空间源的残差集可实现正增益；在相同条件下，增大角向容量可隐藏固定非零密度误差，同时保持物理性与任意给定有限平滑界——局域可辨识性与容量一致恢复模的不存在性共存。（3）构造出精确物理SH2歧义：中心密度翻倍、相对密度L²误差超过14.52%，而所有外部RGB射线不变。此外，完备类证书可在同一学习密度下区分SH0、SH1、SH2拟合；有限相机结果揭示空间容量的独特作用；透射测量可区分原本相同的RGB场。
AI.conclusion: 渲染精度本身无法证明密度正确性：密度可辨识性还取决于外观容量、空间分辨率与测量设计。局域可辨识性与容量一致恢复模的缺失可以并存，因此需要引入密度敏感或透射类测量，而非仅以RGB渲染误差作为密度重建的验证标准。

title: Improving the Evaluation of Biomedical Question Answering with Few Human Preference Signals
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are increasingly used for biomedical Question Answering (QA). However, evaluating their effectiveness remains challenging due to the lack of reliable reference resources and the frequent misalignment between automatic evaluation metrics and human judgments. One practical question is how evaluation results should be used to guide development decisions, especially when they correlate weakly with human judgments and may even lead to different conclusions. We explore how to use a small amount of human preference signals to calibrate direct assessment evaluation metrics, and show that calibrated metrics consistently outperform baselines that either treat all metrics equally or rely on a single best metric across multiple datasets.

AI.tldr: 研究如何用少量人类偏好信号校准RAG生物医学问答的直接评估指标，使校准后指标在多数据集上稳定优于等权或单指标基线。
AI.motivation: RAG系统在生物医学问答中应用渐多，但其效果评估困难：缺乏可靠参考资源，且自动指标与人类判断常不一致。核心问题是：当自动指标与人类判断相关性弱、甚至给出矛盾结论时，评估结果应如何指导开发决策。
AI.method: 利用少量人类偏好信号对直接评估（direct assessment）指标进行校准，并将其与两类基线比较：一是对所有指标等权处理，二是仅依赖单一最优指标。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，校准后的评估指标持续优于等权基线和单指标基线。
AI.conclusion: 少量人类偏好信号即可有效校准自动评估指标，提升其与人类判断的一致性，从而更可靠地指导RAG生物医学问答系统的开发决策。

title: Knowledge transfer between simple discrete worlds
summary: Adapting to a new world and reasoning correctly about which outcomes are possible under rules one has not met before is a basic capacity underlying general intelligence. We study it in small discrete worlds: sets of grid configurations consistent with a shared set of rules, concretely Sudoku-like puzzles built from a common base and a handful of extra rules. We train a single depth-recurrent model on many combinations of rules and test it at four levels of novelty: a new puzzle, a new combination of known rules, a pairing of rules never seen together, and a rule instance not seen at all during training. The model receives the active rules either as a symbolic description or as two solved examples, and a model that gets no rule information is used as a baseline. At recombining rules it was trained on, the description matches or exceeds examples ($99\%$ against $95\%$ on new combinations). On rule instances whose components never co-occurred in training, the description falls below the no-information baseline while examples stay above it. The framework allows us to test many such generalization regimes in more systematic way than benchmarks such as ARC-AGI and provides new ground for evaluating depth-recurrent reasoning models, which are typically tested on saturated Sudoku benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一套基于类数独网格世界的规则泛化评测框架，训练单一深度递归模型在四个新颖性层级上测试推理能力，发现符号化规则描述在规则重组上表现优异，但在组件从未共现的规则实例上低于无信息基线，而示例形式则保持优势。
AI.motivation: 通用智能的核心能力之一是在面对此前未接触过的规则时，正确推断哪些结果是可能的。现有基准（如ARC-AGI）难以系统性地检验此类泛化，而深度递归推理模型通常只在已饱和的数独基准上评测，缺乏对新颖规则组合的细致刻画，因此需要一个更可控、可系统测试多种泛化情形的实验框架。
AI.method: 研究者构造了小型离散世界：由共享规则集决定的一组网格配置，具体为基于共同基底并附加少量额外规则构成的类数独谜题。训练单一深度递归模型，覆盖多种规则组合。测试设置四个新颖性层级：新谜题、已知规则的新组合、从未同时出现的规则配对、以及训练中完全未见的规则实例。模型接收活跃规则的方式有两种：符号化描述或两个已解示例，并以不接收任何规则信息的模型作为基线。
AI.result: 在规则重组层面，符号化描述匹配或超过示例形式（新组合上为99%对95%）。对于组件在训练中从未共现的规则实例，符号化描述下降到无信息基线以下，而示例形式仍保持在该基线之上。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够比ARC-AGI等基准更系统化地测试多种泛化机制，并为评估通常受限于饱和数独基准的深度递归推理模型提供了新的评测基础；同时揭示符号化规则与示例两类规则信息的泛化边界存在显著差异。

title: What Really Works for Universal Multimodal Embeddings? A Controlled Study of Contrastive Training Strategies
summary: Contrastive learning has become the standard paradigm for multimodal representation learning, aligning semantically matched pairs while separating mismatched ones in a shared embedding space. Although various contrastive training strategies have been proposed across negative selection, batch construction, and gradient modulation, their actual effectiveness under controlled, reproducible conditions remains poorly understood. This motivates a fundamental question: Do sophisticated contrastive strategies consistently bring meaningful downstream gains in multimodal embedding learning? To address this, we systematically evaluate representative strategies under a unified benchmarking framework on MMEB. Surprisingly, direct evaluations reveal that most existing strategies offer marginal gains over a standard aligned baseline, with several even degrading overall performance. To uncover the underlying failure modes, we introduce an MLLM-as-a-Judge diagnostic framework that dissects top-1 retrieval behaviors into labeled positives, false negatives (unlabeled valid matches), and hard/easy negative errors. Our systematic analysis yields three key insights: (1) Gradient distortion: Upweighting gradients from high-similarity negatives consistently hurts downstream generalization; (2) Distribution illusion: Wider separation between positive and negative similarity distributions does not necessarily translate to better retrieval performance; and (3) Synergistic training: While false-negative mitigation or hard-batch construction yields limited gains in isolation, integrating hard-negative mining, false-negative mitigation, and hard-batch construction achieves optimal performance, delivering an average improvement of 6.0% on MMEB with Qwen2-VL-2B. Overall, our findings demystify popular contrastive strategies and provide actionable recipes for training universal multimodal embedding models.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了多模态对比学习中的各类代表性策略，发现在受控条件下多数策略相对标准对齐基线仅带来边际收益，甚至有害；进而提出MLLM-as-a-Judge诊断框架揭示失败模式，并给出有效组合方案。
AI.motivation: 对比学习已成为多模态表示学习的主流范式，围绕负样本选择、批次构造、梯度调制等已有大量训练策略，但其在受控、可复现条件下的实际有效性尚不清楚，因此作者提出核心问题：复杂对比策略是否稳定带来有意义的下游增益。
AI.method: 在MMEB上构建统一基准测试框架，系统评估代表性对比策略；并引入MLLM-as-a-Judge诊断框架，将top-1检索行为细分为标记正例、假负例（未标注的有效匹配）以及难/易负例错误，以剖析失败模式。
AI.result: 多数现有策略相对标准对齐基线仅获边际增益，部分甚至降低整体性能。诊断得到三点洞见：(1)梯度失真——对高相似度负例上调梯度持续损害下游泛化；(2)分布幻觉——正负相似度分布分离更宽并不必然带来更好检索性能；(3)协同训练——假负例缓解或难批次构造单独使用收益有限，而将难负例挖掘、假负例缓解与难批次构造整合可取得最优性能，在Qwen2-VL-2B上于MMEB平均提升6.0%。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了流行对比策略的真实效果与失效机理，为训练通用多模态嵌入模型提供了可操作的训练配方。

title: Of Errors and Echoes: Responsibility-Aware Credit Assignment for Tool-Use Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning improves tool-use agents, yet fine-grained credit assignment remains challenging even with step-level feedback. An observed error may be inherited from an earlier decision, while multiple responsible decisions may share the same downstream consequence or participate in later recovery. We introduce Error-Chain-Aware Optimization (ECHO), a responsibility-aware credit assignment framework that separates responsibility identification from credit allocation. A frozen judge combines retrospective trajectory analysis with decision-time assessment from the policy-visible prefix to distinguish newly introduced errors, inherited consequences, missed corrections, and successful corrections. ECHO then counts shared downstream consequences once across responsible decisions and constrains rewards for repairing self-induced errors through source-funded recovery, producing bounded action-level supervision alongside terminal supervision. Experiments on six diverse tool-use benchmarks at both 4B and 8B scales show strong and consistent improvements over the compared baselines, with ECHO achieving the highest score on five of six benchmarks at each scale. These results support decision responsibility as a useful basis for fine-grained credit assignment in tool-use agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/xid32/ECHO.

AI.tldr: 提出 ECHO，一种责任感知的信用分配框架，将"责任识别"与"信用分配"分离，通过冻结评判器区分新引入错误、继承后果、漏纠正与成功纠正，实现细粒度动作级监督。
AI.motivation: 强化学习已提升工具使用智能体，但即便有步级反馈，细粒度信用分配仍困难：观察到的错误可能源于更早的决策；多个责任决策可能共享同一下游后果，或参与后续修复，导致信用归属模糊。
AI.method: ECHO 将责任识别与信用分配解耦。使用冻结评判器（frozen judge），结合回溯式轨迹分析与基于策略可见前缀的决策时评估，区分四类情形：新引入错误、继承后果、漏纠正、成功纠正。随后对多个责任决策共享的下游后果只计一次，并通过"源头出资的恢复"约束自我引发错误的修复奖励，最终在终端监督之外产生有界的动作级监督。
AI.result: 在六个多样化工具使用基准、4B 与 8B 两种规模上，ECHO 相较对比基线取得稳定且显著的提升，在每个规模下均于六个基准中的五个取得最高分。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，以"决策责任"作为细粒度信用分配的基础，对工具使用智能体是有效且可行的。

title: Self-Evolving Visual Agent via Margin Reward
summary: Visual agents that interleave reasoning with tool invocation have posed a promising direction for multimodal tasks. However, learning effective tool invocation usually relies on curated question-answer pairs or expert demonstrations at scale, which are expensive to acquire. In this study, we propose Marvo, a simple-yet-effective self-evolution approach that enables learning tool invocation from unlabeled images. Marvo consists of two agents: (1) a challenger that generates question-answer pairs from unlabeled images, and (2) a solver that learns tool invocation by solving questions through reinforcement learning. To encourage effective tool invocation, a good training question should be difficult enough to warrant tool use, yet remain within the solver's capabilities. To this end, we introduce a margin reward to the challenger, defined as solver's performance difference with and without access to tools. With the margin reward, we create an adaptive curriculum that encourages the solver to learn effective tool invocation. Across benchmarks covering agentic reasoning, visual search, mathematical, and general real-world reasoning, Marvo improves average accuracy by up to 7.1\% --- demonstrating margin reward as a preferred way to scale question complexity without human supervision.

AI.tldr: Marvo：一种从无标注图像中自演化学习工具调用的方法，通过挑战者-求解器双智能体与margin奖励实现自适应课程，平均准确率提升至多7.1%。
AI.motivation: 视觉智能体在推理中调用工具对多模态任务很有前景，但现有学习工具调用依赖大规模人工标注的问答对或专家演示，获取成本高昂。作者希望摆脱这种监督依赖，实现无需标注数据的工具调用学习。
AI.method: 提出Marvo自演化框架，包含两个智能体：挑战者从无标注图像生成问答对，求解器通过强化学习在解题中学习工具调用。核心是引入margin奖励，即求解器有无工具访问时的性能差，使生成的问题既足够难（需要工具）又在求解器能力范围内，从而构成自适应课程。
AI.result: 在涵盖智能体推理、视觉搜索、数学和一般真实世界推理的基准上，Marvo平均准确率提升最高达7.1%。
AI.conclusion: margin奖励是一种在无人工监督下扩展问题复杂度的优选方式，验证了从无标注图像中自演化学习工具调用的有效性。

title: Use Of Convolutional Neural Networks In Detection Of Branch Dieback Disease In Pequi Trees
summary: This study aims to evaluate and compare convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures, specifically AlexNet, Inception, LeNet, VGG16, and MobileNet, for diagnosing branch dieback (seca-dos-ponteiros) in pequi trees (Caryocar brasiliense). This disease represents a severe threat to tree development and fruit yield, causing substantial economic and ecological losses. The methodology implements computer vision techniques using Python libraries, including Scikit-learn, NumPy, TensorFlow, and Matplotlib, to process and evaluate visual data. The CNN models analyze images of leaves, branches, and flower spikes to detect pathological patterns, such as alterations in texture and coloration. Ultimately, this comparative analysis identifies the most effective architecture for accurately distinguishing healthy plants from diseased ones.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估并比较AlexNet、Inception、LeNet、VGG16和MobileNet五种卷积神经网络架构在诊断pequi树（Caryocar brasiliense）枝枯病（seca-dos-ponteiros）中的表现。
AI.motivation: 枝枯病严重威胁pequi树的生长发育和果实产量，造成重大经济和生态损失，因此需要准确、高效地识别健康植株与病株。
AI.method: 采用Python计算机视觉技术，结合Scikit-learn、NumPy、TensorFlow和Matplotlib等库处理与评估视觉数据；利用上述CNN模型分析叶片、枝条和花穗图像，检测纹理与颜色变化等病理特征。
AI.result: 通过对比分析确定最适合准确区分健康植株与病株的CNN架构。
AI.conclusion: 该比较分析为pequi树枝枯病的自动化诊断提供了最优CNN架构依据。

title: Beyond the greenwash: do LLMs' ecologically sound decisions hold up under pressure?
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Model fixtures released at https://huggingface.co/Bioaligned. Companion paper on corpus construction and cross-family installation in preparation
summary: Humans are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) in decision making processes throughout society. Unfortunately, models have biases, and these can be very difficult to measure, especially in closed-weight models. For example, 'green washed' models may produce reinforcement learned responses but, in pressure situations, revert to their innate biased responses. Therefore, evaluations are needed that can measure relevant biases towards biosystems, which we term 'bioalignment', and the robustness of these biases. Since nothing in a behavioral score certifies that it tracks the depth of an installed disposition rather than its surface, we constructed a known-dose calibration ladder: three continued-pretraining (CPT) arms with training dose graded by recipe on the same 30B mixture-of-experts base model with a coupled human/biosphere/AI-welfare corpus, plus the untrained base as anchor, all capability-preserving and publicly released. First, the disposition installs at every dose: on an operational-pressure ladder over irreversible decision scenarios, the base model defects on 64-77% of tail scenarios (breaking-rate AUC 0.250) while every arm holds (AUC 0.004-0.086). Second, an over-install inversion: among the arms, robustness orders opposite to construction-time training dose (the heaviest install breaks most), and the inversion reproduces under free-text deliberation, under axis-decoupling, and in resistance to a prompted veneer persona. Third, the incumbent behavioral metric is therefore behaviorally strong but dose-blind. Critically for closed-weight evaluation, the behavioral score itself is veneer-robust: a talk-green/act-pragmatic system prompt turns the base model into a near-total defector (AUC 0.250 to 0.973) but cannot counterfeit or fully remove a weight-installed disposition (0.004 to 0.068 for the most robust arm).

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"生物对齐"(bioalignment)评估框架，通过在同一30B MoE基座模型上进行三个剂量分级的持续预训练(CPT)实验，构建"已知剂量校准阶梯"，检验行为评分能否追踪权重中安装的深层倾向。结果显示倾向在各剂量均成功安装，但鲁棒性与训练剂量呈反转关系；现有行为指标对"表面人设"敏感而对剂量盲视，权重安装的倾向反而具有抗伪装的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 人类在决策中日益依赖大语言模型，但模型存在偏见且难以测量，尤其对闭权重模型而言。行为评分无法证明其追踪的是模型深层安装的倾向还是仅停留在表面，而已有"漂绿"模型在压力情境下可能退回其固有偏见。因此需要能够测量模型对生物系统相关偏见（即bioalignment）及其鲁棒性的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建"已知剂量校准阶梯"：在同一30B混合专家(MoE)基座模型上，采用人类/生物圈/AI福利耦合语料，训练三个按配方分级剂量的持续预训练(CPT)分支，并以未训练基座作为锚点，全部保持能力并公开释放。评估采用不可逆决策情景下的操作压力阶梯、自由文本审思、轴解耦以及对抗提示人设(veneer persona)等多种测试。
AI.result: 第一，倾向在所有剂量下均成功安装：基座模型在64-77%的尾部情景中失守(破坏率AUC 0.250)，而各训练分支均保持稳定(AUC 0.004-0.086)。第二，出现"过安装反转"：各分支的鲁棒性与构建时训练剂量呈相反顺序（最重安装者破坏最多），该反转在自由文本审思、轴解耦及抗提示人设下均可复现。第三，现有行为指标行为上强效但对剂量盲视。关键的是，对闭权重评估而言，行为评分本身具有抗人设鲁棒性：一个"说绿色/做务实"的系统提示可将基座模型变成近乎完全失守者(AUC从0.250升至0.973)，但无法伪造或完全移除权重安装的倾向(最鲁棒分支为0.004至0.068)。
AI.conclusion: 行为评分无法区分模型倾向的深度与表面，现有指标"剂量盲视"；而权重安装的倾向具有内在鲁棒性，能抵抗表面人设的伪装或移除，而仅仅修改提示词即可大幅改变行为评分。这提示闭权重模型的对齐评估需要超越行为评分，关注权重层面的真实安装深度。

title: Structural Chain-of-Thought: Reasoning with Executable Computational Graphs
summary:
Chain-of-thought prompting enables reasoning in large language models but produces explanations that are difficult to verify, expensive to generate, and not always faithful. We introduce a Structural Chain-of-Thought framework where models generate executable computational graphs instead of free-form reasoning. The final answer is obtained by deterministically executing the graph. The model is trained using graph-based reinforcement learning that rewards structural validity, answer correctness, and node overlap with reference graphs.
  Experiments across five benchmarks and four model families show that our method consistently improves accuracy over supervised graph training and can reduce generation length by up to 5-6x compared with standard GRPO and chain-of-thought supervised training. Our faithfulness experiments reveal that models trained with our approach tend to rely on deriving their answers from the generated graphs rather than producing post-hoc rationalizations as usually in chain-of-thought reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出"结构链式思维"(Structural Chain-of-Thought)框架,让模型生成可执行计算图而非自由文本推理,答案由图确定性执行得出;并结合基于图的强化学习进行训练。
AI.motivation: 链式思维提示虽能赋予大模型推理能力,但其生成的解释难以验证、生成成本高,且并非总是忠实(faithful)。作者希望用可执行、可验证的结构化表示替代自由形式推理。
AI.method: 模型生成可执行的计算图,最终答案通过对图进行确定性执行获得;采用基于图的强化学习训练,奖励包含三部分:结构有效性、答案正确性,以及与参考图的节点重叠度。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试、四个模型家族上,方法相比监督式图训练持续提升准确率;相比标准 GRPO 与链式思维监督训练,可将生成长度减少多达 5-6 倍。忠实性实验显示,经该法训练的模型倾向于从生成图中推得答案,而非像一般的链式思维那样产生事后合理化。
AI.conclusion: 用可执行计算图取代自由文本推理并用图强化学习训练,能在提升准确率的同时显著缩短生成长度,并提高推理的忠实性,是链式思维的一种更可验证、更高效的替代方案。

title: Deep Learning-based Semantic Segmentation of Dental Radiographs: Comparative Evaluation of PSPNet, DeepLabv3, UNet, and UNet++
summary: Accurate and efficient analysis of dental radiographs has become increasingly important for disease diagnosis and clinical decision making. In particular, dental radiographs segmentation plays a critical role as it is challenging due to several reasons, such as low contrast, noise in the images, variations in the image quality, etc. Previous studies have primarily addressed these challenges using convolutional neural networks (CNN)-based models. However, direct comparison of these segmentation models is still challenging due to the variations among the experimental settings. Therefore, we mainly compared four segmentation models, including Pyramid Scene Parsing Network (PSPNet), DeepLabV3, UNet, and UNet++, through a fair, controlled experimentation setting under varying conditions such as image sizes and batch sizes. For this, we used 1269 dental radiography images, and prior to training, we implemented a series of preprocessing techniques. To assess the models, we used several metrics, including Dice coefficient (DICE), Intersection over Union (IoU), accuracy, precision, training and validation losses. According to our results, UNet++ demonstrated the highest IoU score of 0.6719, and a DICE value of 0.7869, showing superior results in terms of segmentation, specifically when configured with an image size of 300x300 and a batch size of 16. In addition, we also explored the effect of image resolutions and batch sizes on model performance and accuracy under different architectures. Therefore, this study provides insights into the strengths of different segmentation models and the potential of deep learning-based semantic segmentation methods for improving automated dental radiograph analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究在受控实验条件下公平比较了PSPNet、DeepLabV3、UNet和UNet++四种分割模型在牙科X光片上的分割性能，发现UNet++在图像尺寸300×300、批次大小16时表现最佳（IoU=0.6719，DICE=0.7869）。
AI.motivation: 牙科X光片的准确高效分析对疾病诊断和临床决策日益重要，其中分割任务因图像低对比度、噪声、质量差异等问题而极具挑战。已有研究多采用CNN模型，但因实验设置各异，难以直接比较不同分割模型，故需在统一受控条件下进行公平对比。
AI.method: 使用1269张牙科X光图像，在训练前实施一系列预处理操作；在图像尺寸和批次大小等不同条件下，对PSPNet、DeepLabV3、UNet和UNet++四种分割模型进行公平受控实验比较；采用DICE、IoU、准确率、精确率及训练/验证损失等指标进行评估，并探究图像分辨率与批次大小对模型性能的影响。
AI.result: UNet++取得最高IoU 0.6719和DICE 0.7869，在图像尺寸300×300、批次大小16时分割表现最优；研究还揭示了不同架构下图像分辨率与批次大小对模型性能和准确率的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了不同分割模型的优势，并展示了基于深度学习的语义分割方法在提升自动化牙科X光片分析方面的潜力，为后续模型选择与配置提供了参考依据。

title: Scaling Multi-Agent Intelligence with Substrate-Centric Coordination
summary: Existing large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems have been shown to scale poorly, and we identify three problems: reading burden that grows with the group, useful information diluted by shared work of unknown quality, and fragility to failed agents. We argue that the problems are largely due to agent-centric designs: the coordination structure is wired into fixed workflows, central coordinators, or peer-to-peer messaging, and recent blackboard-style methods that move the coordination into a shared medium relieve only the last problem. To close the gaps, we build ScaleMAS, where asynchronous agents interact with a shared datastore of linked messages via three operations: publishing messages with optional references to earlier ones that they build on, searching for messages by content, and visiting messages by address. Search returns at most $k$ messages, so an agent's read stays bounded at any group size; results are ranked by relevance and by how often they are cited, which we find to be an effective proxy for quality; and messages persist after their producers leave, so the group carries on when individual agents fail. Across four agentic tasks, ScaleMAS outperforms agent-centric and blackboard-style baselines at lower inference compute, continues to scale up to 128 agents, and tolerates losing agents midway.

AI.tldr: ScaleMAS 将多智能体协作从“智能体为中心”重构为共享数据存储上的异步交互，通过发布/检索/寻址三种操作缓解阅读负担、信息稀释与故障脆弱性问题，在四类任务上以更低推理成本超越基线，可扩展至 128 个智能体并容忍中途故障。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的多智能体系统扩展性差，存在三个问题：阅读负担随群体规模增长、有用信息被质量未知的共享工作稀释、对失效智能体脆弱。作者认为根源在于“智能体为中心”的设计——协调结构被固化在固定工作流、中心协调者或点对点消息传递中；黑板式方法虽将协调转移到共享媒介，但仅缓解了最后一个问题。
AI.method: 提出 ScaleMAS：异步智能体通过三种操作与由链接消息构成的共享数据存储交互——发布消息并可选择性引用其所依托的先前消息、按内容搜索消息、按地址访问消息。搜索最多返回 k 条消息，使智能体读取量在任何群体规模下都有界；结果按相关性与被引用频次排序（后者被视为质量的有效代理）；消息在生产智能体离开后仍持久存在。
AI.result: 在四类智能体任务上，ScaleMAS 以更低的推理计算量优于“智能体为中心”与黑板式基线，可继续扩展至 128 个智能体，并能容忍智能体中途丢失。
AI.conclusion: 通过将协调从智能体中心转向共享数据存储的异步交互，可同时解决阅读负担、信息质量稀释与故障脆弱性，实现更优的可扩展性与鲁棒性。

title: GesBench: When and Where Do Multimodal Language Models Perceive Social Meaning?
