On diagnostics, Model also increases sensitivity to numerically consequential digit changes, while Match improves robustness to informative partial views. Adding Tune yields higher target-supervised embedding aggregates for each tested Stage-1 parent, and the two-stage recipes obtain higher aggregate scores than Tune alone. The same pattern is observed at 4B, 9.6B, and 27B parameters when model embeddings are used for downstream prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段后训练策略MoMaTune（Model、Match再Tune），针对解码器语言模型在数值数据上"值内敏感度"与"字段间结构"监督不足的问题，先做无标签稠密next-token预测与同记录一致性对齐，再做下游目标监督微调，在169,285条记录、339/340为数值字段的八个公开数据集上显著提升掩码值插补与正确上下文指标，并在1.5B至27B参数规模上保持优势。
AI.motivation: 解码器语言模型在语言理解与生成上进展显著，但在数值数据上仍存在明显失败。原因是数值样本以"特征名+值"（如fat:3.4）的文本形式序列化，而常规任务适配仅对下游预测目标施加损失，导致两类结构监督薄弱：一是值内敏感度（digit position决定数值大小的关系），因为token交叉熵不含显式数值度量；二是字段间结构（同一记录内各测量值的统计依赖关系），因为仅目标微调不对测量值及其依赖提供直接损失。
AI.method: 提出MoMaTune（Model, Match, then Tune）两阶段后训练策略，围绕上述监督缺口组织。阶段1：Model，对无标签序列化记录密集施加普通next-token预测；可选加入Match，即同记录一致性目标，对齐同一示例不同部分视图的表示。阶段2：Tune，针对下游目标预测进行监督微调。在169,285条记录、八个公开数据集上评估，340个输入字段中339个为数值字段。
AI.result: 在1.5B参数下，Model将八数据集掩码值插补聚合指标从0.106提升至0.401，三数据集正确上下文增益从0.058提升至0.167。诊断实验显示，Model增强了对数值关键数字变化的敏感度，Match提升了对信息性部分视图的鲁棒性。加入Tune后，每个测试的Stage-1父模型都获得更高的目标监督嵌入聚合指标，且两阶段配方聚合分数高于单独Tune。在4B、9.6B、27B参数下，使用模型嵌入进行下游预测时观察到相同模式。
AI.conclusion: 针对数值数据中值内敏感度与字段间结构两类弱监督，MoMaTune通过先无标签稠密预测（可选同记录一致性对齐）再目标监督微调的两阶段后训练，能有效改善解码器语言模型的数值表示与下游预测，且效果随参数规模（1.5B、4B、9.6B、27B）稳定保持。

title: HGA-Quant: Heterogeneity-Aware Quantization for AutoRegressive Visual Generation Models
summary: Recently, AutoRegressive Visual Generation (ARVG) models have emerged as a competitive paradigm for high-quality image synthesis. However, their substantial computational and memory demands make them difficult to deploy on resource-constrained edge devices. Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) provides a promising solution to reduce the computational and memory costs of ARVG models, yet existing methods often suffer from substantial image quality degradation under low-bit quantization. In this paper, we propose a training-free PTQ framework for ARVG, consisting of Tail-Aware Bounded-init Grid Refinement (T-BGR) and Coarse-to-Fine Activation Precision Scheduling (CAPS). T-BGR introduces a tail-aware reconstruction objective for weight quantizer calibration, assigning greater importance to distribution-tail coefficients and preserving fine-grained information without introducing additional parameters or high-precision branches. CAPS performs coarse-to-fine activation precision scheduling by jointly considering the importance and computational cost of different generation stages, enabling efficient mixed-precision allocation under a given bit budget. Extensive experiments on multiple ARVG backbones demonstrate that our framework consistently improves robustness under aggressive low-bit quantization. Notably, on Infinity, our framework achieves near full-precision image generation quality at an effective W4A5.6 activation precision, while existing methods at W4A6 still exhibit noticeable quality degradation or inconsistent performance. Code is available at https://github.com/lxm-lc/HGA-Quant.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个无需训练的ARVG后训练量化框架，含T-BGR与CAPS两个组件，在低比特下显著提升图像生成质量。
AI.motivation: 自回归视觉生成（ARVG）模型图像合成质量高，但计算与内存开销大，难以部署到资源受限的边缘设备；现有后训练量化方法在低比特下图像质量严重下降。
AI.method: 提出免训练PTQ框架，包含：（1）Tail-Aware Bounded-init Grid Refinement（T-BGR）：在权重量化器校准中引入尾部感知重建目标，对分布尾部系数赋予更高权重，在不增加参数或高精度分支的情况下保留细粒度信息；（2）Coarse-to-Fine Activation Precision Scheduling（CAPS）：联合考虑不同生成阶段的重要性和计算成本，在给定比特预算下进行由粗到细的激活精度调度，实现高效混合精度分配。
AI.result: 在多个ARVG骨干网络上实验表明，该框架在激进低比特量化下持续提升鲁棒性；在Infinity上以有效W4A5.6达到接近全精度的图像生成质量，而现有方法在W4A6仍存在明显质量下降或性能不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该免训练PTQ框架能有效降低ARVG模型的计算与内存开销，并在低比特量化下保持高质量图像生成，代码已开源。

title: PersonaFactor: Preference Factors with Dynamic Selection for LLM Personalization
summary: Although users may express different personalization needs across tasks, these task-specific behaviors can reflect shared underlying preference mechanisms. Existing LLM personalization methods often focus on surface-level interactions or undifferentiated histories, overlooking the shared mechanisms underlying these behaviors. We introduce PersonaFactors, a framework that distills reusable and interpretable personalization factors from heterogeneous user interactions. We construct a library of thirteen PersonaFactors by extracting evidence-grounded rationales and clustering recurring patterns across tasks, and develop a dynamic factor-guided generation framework that selects factors relevant to each user's history and current request. Across four personalization benchmarks and four backbone models, Dynamic PersonaFactor achieves the best score on every reported metric. Representation analyses further show that PersonaFactors and user history induce partially overlapping low-dimensional representations, and that their joint use yields complementary shifts. Taken together, these findings suggest that factor-based and history-based personalization can mutually reinforce each other.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PersonaFactors 框架，从异质用户交互中提炼可复用、可解释的个性化因子，并构建动态因子引导的生成框架，在四个基准和四个骨干模型上全部指标最优。
AI.motivation: 用户在不同任务中表达的个性化需求各异，但这些任务特定行为背后可能共享相同的偏好机制。现有 LLM 个性化方法多聚焦表层交互或无差别历史，忽视了这些行为背后的共享机制。
AI.method: 通过提取有证据支撑的推理依据（evidence-grounded rationales）并对跨任务反复出现的模式进行聚类，构建包含十三个 PersonaFactors 的因子库；并开发动态因子引导生成框架，为每个用户的历史与当前请求选择相关因子。
AI.result: 在四个个性化基准与四个骨干模型上，Dynamic PersonaFactor 在所有报告指标上均取得最佳分数。表征分析显示，PersonaFactors 与用户历史诱导出部分重叠的低维表征，二者联合使用产生互补性偏移。
AI.conclusion: 基于因子与基于历史的个性化可以相互增强，表明从异质交互中提炼共享偏好机制是提升 LLM 个性化的一种有效路径。

title: ClinEdge: An Expert-Graded Benchmark of Real Patient Edge Cases Where Frontier Multimodal Models Fail
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures. 32 real, de-identified clinical cases; 224 expert-graded evaluations across seven frontier multimodal AI systems
summary:
Most benchmarks for large language models in medicine are built from licensing examinations and theoretical questions. The few that draw on real clinical data do so only in part, and rarely require a model to read a patient's own imaging. ClinEdge addresses this gap with 32 real, de-identified patient cases from active clinical practice, each evaluated across seven frontier systems for a total of 224 expert-graded evaluations. Each case pairs primary imaging with a short vignette, contains a feature known to defeat pattern-matched reasoning, and is scored against the patient's documented clinical course. The suite is built for depth rather than volume. Grading followed a two-stage expert process. First, a senior orthopaedic surgeon graded all 224 responses on a weighted rubric and a pass-or-fail verdict. Second, a panel of nineteen physicians, largely senior specialists at teaching medical colleges, independently reviewed every case and every one of the 224 grades. All seven production systems were evaluated through their public interfaces, and all 224 conversations are preserved as replayable links.
  Performance was poor across all systems, and the failures were shared: different vendors missed the same findings and converged on the same wrong plans. From the experts' notes we catalogue 18 recurring failure modes in five families. The models stop reading an image at the first finding. They give generic plans and lean toward over-treatment. They trust a misleading history over correct imaging. Their answers vary across systems and runs, and change with question format. Failing answers were delivered fluently and without any expressed uncertainty. Four cases are released in full; the remaining 28 are held out, and we invite frontier AI labs and healthcare AI companies to evaluate their models against them (research@futrbridge.com)

AI.tldr: ClinEdge 是一个基于 32 例真实去标识化临床病例的医学大模型基准，采用影像+简要病史的任务设计，对 7 个前沿系统共 224 份回答进行专家两阶段评分，发现所有系统表现均差且失败模式高度趋同。
AI.motivation: 现有医学大模型基准多源自执照考试与理论题，少数使用真实临床数据者也仅部分覆盖，且很少要求模型阅读患者本人的影像资料，因而无法检验贴近真实诊疗的推理能力，ClinEdge 旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建 32 例来自在诊临床实践的真实去标识化病例，每例将原始影像与简短临床简介配对，并嵌入已知能击穿模式匹配推理的特征，以患者记录的临床病程作为评分参照。对 7 个前沿系统在其公开接口上共收集 224 份专家评分评估。评分分两阶段：先由一位资深骨科外科医生按加权量规给出评分与通过/不通过判定，再由 19 位医师（多为教学医学院的资深专科医生）组成的专家组独立复核全部病例及全部 224 项评分。全部 224 段对话以可回放链接形式保留。
AI.result: 所有系统表现均差，且失败具有共性：不同厂商漏掉相同的影像发现并收敛到相同的错误方案。基于专家评注，共归纳出 5 大类、18 种反复出现的失败模式。具体包括：模型在读到影像的第一个发现后就停止阅读；给出泛化方案并倾向过度治疗；更信任误导性病史而非正确影像；答案在不同系统与不同运行之间波动，并随问题格式改变；错误回答以流畅、且不表达任何不确定性的方式给出。
AI.conclusion: 真实临床影像场景下前沿大模型表现不佳且错误模式系统性趋同，暴露出模式匹配式推理的深层缺陷。基准以深度而非规模为导向，其中 4 例完整公开、28 例保留为留出集，作者邀请前沿 AI 实验室与医疗 AI 公司通过 research@futrbridge.com 对其模型进行评估。

title: Channel Match: Calibrating Shape Latents for Few-Step 3D Generation
summary: Recent native 3D generators achieve high-quality asset creation by modeling structured 3D latents with flow-based transformers, but their high-resolution generation remains computationally expensive due to costly iterative sampling. In this work, we introduce a few-step distillation framework for native 3D generation, enabled by continuous self-consistency training with a custom JVP FlashAttention kernel and an analytic velocity regression objective for sparse structured 3D latents. To stabilize joint optimization, we further introduce an adaptive loss weighting strategy that automatically balances them without manual tuning. Beyond acceleration, we reveal a previously overlooked failure mode of few-step native 3D generation: sampling-induced latent distribution drift preserves geometric correctness but disrupts downstream PBR texture synthesis, causing texture artifacts on geometrically valid assets. To address this issue, we propose Channel Match, a training-free adaptive per-channel latent calibration method that restores the latent distribution without modifying either generator. We validate our approach on TRELLIS.2 at the $1024^3$ resolution setting. Our two-step model achieves $4.5\times$ faster geometry sampling while maintaining geometry quality comparable to the many-step teacher, and Channel Match further improves rendering quality by recovering the latent interface between geometry and appearance generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向原生3D生成的少步蒸馏框架，结合连续自一致性训练、自定义JVP FlashAttention内核与解析速度回归目标，并引入自适应损失加权；同时发现少步采样导致的隐分布漂移会破坏PBR纹理合成，提出免训练逐通道校准方法Channel Match予以修复。
AI.motivation: 原生3D生成器虽能通过流式Transformer建模结构化3D隐变量实现高质量资产创建，但高分辨率生成因迭代采样代价高昂。此外，少步采样可能带来未被察觉的副作用（如影响下游纹理合成），需在加速的同时保证下游任务可用性。
AI.method: 1）少步蒸馏框架：采用连续自一致性训练，配合自定义JVP FlashAttention内核，并针对稀疏结构化3D隐变量设计解析速度回归目标；2）引入自适应损失加权策略，自动平衡各损失项无需人工调参；3）揭示少步采样导致的隐分布漂移问题；4）提出Channel Match——免训练的自适应逐通道隐变量校准方法，在不修改任何生成器的前提下恢复隐分布。
AI.result: 在TRELLIS.2的$1024^3$分辨率设置上验证：两步模型实现$4.5\times$的几何采样加速，几何质量与多步教师模型相当；Channel Match进一步通过恢复几何与外观生成间的隐接口，提升了渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 少步蒸馏可显著加速原生高分辨率3D生成且保持几何质量；但需注意采样诱导的隐分布漂移对下游PBR纹理合成的负面影响，Channel Match可作为免训练的有效补救方案，恢复几何-外观生成接口，整体提升渲染质量。

title: CultureBot: A Framework for Retrieval-Augmented Exploration of Cultural Heritage Data
summary: Digital cultural heritage collections encode rich relations among objects, places, periods, providers, images, and source institutions, yet users typically access them through keyword search and faceted browsing. We present CULTUREBOT, an interactive framework for natural-language exploration of cultural heritage collections that combines knowledge-graph-guided retrieval, lexical-semantic retrieval, and source-linked generation. CULTUREBOT maps user queries to structured catalogue relations, enriches retrieved records with textual evidence, and generates answers that link back to the underlying repository records. We instantiate the framework on 81,852 SearchCulture records and release an online demonstration. In an expert evaluation involving six cultural-heritage specialists, 55 persona-grounded queries, and 250 evaluations, the graph-guided system was rated significantly higher than two general-purpose assistants and a non-graph ablation, with the largest gains in evidence grounding, diversity, reasoning, and completeness. These results support graph-guided retrieval as a practical way to expose the relational structure of cultural collections through conversational access while preserving links to catalogue evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出 CULTUREBOT：融合知识图谱引导检索、词汇—语义检索与来源链接生成的交互式框架，实现文化遗产藏品的自然语言探索，并在 81,852 条 SearchCulture 记录上实例化。
AI.motivation: 数字文化遗产藏品蕴含对象、地点、时期、提供者、图像与来源机构之间的丰富关系，但用户通常只能通过关键词检索与分面浏览访问，难以利用其关系结构。
AI.method: CULTUREBOT 将用户查询映射到结构化目录关系，结合知识图谱引导检索与词汇—语义检索，为检索记录补充文本证据，并生成可回链到底层仓储记录的答案；同时在 81,852 条 SearchCulture 记录上实例化并发布在线演示。
AI.result: 由 6 位文化遗产专家、55 条基于人物角色的查询、250 次评估构成的专家评测显示，图谱引导系统显著优于两个通用助手与一个去图谱消融版本，在证据落地、多样性、推理与完整性方面提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 图谱引导检索是在会话式访问中呈现文化藏品关系结构、同时保留目录证据链接的可行途径。

title: RECAP: Calibrating Low-Bit Reasoning Models on the History They Read
summary: Low-bit quantization reduces the cost of serving reasoning models but can substantially degrade long chains of thought. Each step reads cached keys and values spanning thousands of tokens, allowing quantization errors to accumulate along the trajectory. Standard calibration operates on short segments that omit the earlier context needed by later reasoning steps. Even when this context is retained, cache reconstruction error alone does not capture how quantization errors affect subsequent attention. We present RECAP, a post-training quantization method that calibrates reasoning models on the history they read. Dynamic-prefix calibration separates long historical context from short-block reconstruction. It regenerates prefix keys and values with the current quantizer and rotates the active block to supervise every position along the trajectory. Prefix read geometry further supervises historical cache errors according to their effects on attention outputs, weighting key and value errors asymmetrically. With both components applied only during calibration, RECAP outperforms the baseline across multiple reasoning models and quantization settings. Under W4A4KV4, RECAP improves accuracy over the baseline by 13.3 percentage points on MATH500 with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and 15.8 points on AIME-120 with Qwen3-4B. These results highlight the importance of preserving historical dependencies during calibration for low-bit reasoning.

AI.tldr: RECAP是一种训练后量化方法，通过在推理模型实际读取的长历史上下文上进行校准，结合动态前缀校准与前缀读取几何，缓解低比特量化对长思维链的损害，在W4A4KV4下显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 低比特量化降低推理模型服务成本，但会严重损害长思维链。每步需读取覆盖数千token的缓存键值，量化误差沿轨迹累积；标准校准仅作用于短片段，缺失后续推理步骤所需的早期上下文，且即使保留上下文，仅用缓存重构误差也无法刻画量化误差对后续注意力的影响。
AI.method: 提出RECAP训练后量化方法，在模型读取的历史上校准。动态前缀校准将长历史上下文与短块重构分离，用当前量化器重新生成前缀键值，并旋转活动块以监督轨迹上每个位置；前缀读取几何依据历史缓存误差对注意力输出的影响进行监督，对键和值误差进行非对称加权。两个组件仅在校准阶段使用。
AI.result: 在多个推理模型与量化设置下优于基线。W4A4KV4下，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B在MATH500上准确率较基线提升13.3个百分点，Qwen3-4B在AIME-120上提升15.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在低比特推理中校准时保留历史依赖关系至关重要。

title: TempoKV: Predictive KV Cache Quantization for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models enable streaming generation of long videos but suffer from significant memory overhead due to the rapidly growing KV cache. Existing KV cache quantization methods are primarily designed for LLMs and transfer poorly to video models, where activations exhibit different statistics and strong spatiotemporal redundancy. We observe that the video KV cache is largely predictable over time, with a clear asymmetry. Keys are highly predictable from their temporal history, while values depend primarily on the current key and need a short history of preceding values. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{\method}, a training-free predictive KV cache quantization framework for AR video generation. \method predicts keys and values according to their distinct dependencies and stores only the residuals at low precision. Both predictors are lightweight, calibrated once offline by linear regression on a small set of BF16 samples, and remain fixed across prompts and generation runs. Experiments on Self-Forcing, Causal Forcing, and LongCat-Video-13B show that \method consistently achieves higher generation quality than existing KV cache quantization methods at comparable or higher compression ratios, reaching up to $6.71\times$ KV cache compression with the best overall quality--efficiency tradeoff. Our code will be released on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练预测式KV缓存量化框架，利用键与值的不同时序依赖，仅低精度存储残差，实现AR视频生成最高6.71倍KV缓存压缩。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型支持长视频流式生成，但KV缓存快速增长导致显著显存开销。现有KV缓存量化方法主要为LLM设计，难以迁移到视频模型，因为视频激活统计分布不同且具有强时空冗余。
AI.method: 观察到视频KV缓存随时间高度可预测且存在明显不对称性：键可由其时间历史高度预测，值主要依赖当前键并需要短历史前序值。据此提出免训练预测式KV缓存量化框架，按各自依赖分别预测键和值，仅低精度存储残差；两个预测器均轻量，通过小规模BF16样本上的线性回归离线校准一次，并在不同提示词与生成过程中保持固定。
AI.result: 在Self-Forcing、Causal Forcing和LongCat-Video-13B上，方法在相当或更高压缩比下持续取得优于现有KV缓存量化方法的生成质量，最高达6.71倍KV缓存压缩，并具最佳质量—效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 视频KV缓存的键值不对称可预测性可被有效利用，免训练、离线校准的残差量化方案在保持生成质量的同时大幅压缩KV缓存，为AR视频生成的高效长视频流式推理提供可行路径。

title: CivWorldBench: Evaluating Language World Models in Structured Multi-Agent Sandbox Worlds
summary: The growing use of language models for forecasting motivates a broader evaluation of their world-model capabilities. Such evaluation must go beyond predictive accuracy to assess hidden-state inference and intervention prediction. Real-world forecasting benchmarks offer limited access to hidden-state ground truth and controlled experiments. We introduce CivWorldBench, a benchmark built on a multi-agent strategy game engine with recorded internal states, controlled observations, and paired intervention rollouts. Its 1,900 decision points from 475 worlds support three task levels: association forecasting, belief inference, and intervention prediction. Reference predictors support attributable evaluation of capability gaps, with an expert harness and empirical ceiling estimates contextualizing scores. Stored trajectories make intermediate predictions verifiable, while agent-play experiments test whether world-model capabilities support decision-making. The main panel comprises eleven frontier language models. Composite benchmark scores correlate with real-world forecasting leaderboards on matched model panels, more closely than with a general-capability index, supporting its use as a proxy for real-world forecasting capability. Strong association forecasts do not consistently extend to belief inference or intervention prediction, and effect magnitudes remain poorly calibrated despite informative direction predictions. Process verification reveals errors missed by final-answer evaluation, and structured reasoning improves intervention prediction for the strongest model in the process study. Agent-play experiments identify useful assisted plans and motivate evaluating decision-relevant capabilities beyond association forecasting. These findings identify hidden-state inference, intermediate-state prediction, and effect calibration as priorities for world-model training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CivWorldBench基准，基于多智能体策略游戏引擎评估语言模型的世界模型能力，涵盖关联预测、信念推断与干预预测三个任务层级，并揭示隐藏状态推断与效应校准是当前模型的薄弱环节。
AI.motivation: 语言模型被日益用于预测任务，因此需要更全面地评估其世界模型能力。传统评估仅关注预测准确率，无法衡量隐藏状态推断与干预预测；而真实世界预测基准又缺乏隐藏状态真值与可控实验条件，难以进行归因分析。
AI.method: 构建CivWorldBench基准，基于带内部状态记录的多智能体策略游戏引擎，包含受控观测与配对干预轨迹。从475个世界提取1,900个决策点，支持三个任务层级：关联预测、信念推断、干预预测。设置参考预测器以支持能力差距的归因评估，并配有专家测试工具与经验上限估计；存储轨迹使中间预测可验证，并通过智能体博弈实验检验世界模型能力是否支撑决策。主评测面板包含十一个前沿语言模型。
AI.result: 综合基准得分与真实世界预测排行榜（在匹配模型面板上）的相关性高于与通用能力指数的相关性；强关联预测能力并不能稳定迁移到信念推断或干预预测；效应量估计校准较差，尽管方向预测具有信息量；过程验证可发现最终答案评估遗漏的错误；结构化推理提升了最强模型的干预预测表现；智能体博弈实验识别出有用的辅助方案。
AI.conclusion: CivWorldBench可作为真实世界预测能力的代理指标。研究发现隐藏状态推断、中间状态预测与效应校准是世界模型训练的重点方向，并表明需评估超越关联预测的、与决策相关的世界模型能力。

title: OntoAR-HAR: Ontology-Guided Agentic RAG with Personalized Memory for Human Activity Recognition
summary: LLMs increasingly support sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR) by linking motion signals with activity semantics and physical knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds decisions in sensor examples and domain features, enabling training-free target-user inference with less dependence on raw numerical arrays. However, existing LLM/RAG-based HAR typically searches single-level activity spaces using static population knowledge. Consequently, they compare many unrelated candidates using the same static population evidence and overlook personalized motion patterns. We propose OntoAR-HAR, an ontology-guided agentic RAG framework combining static population and personalized knowledge. Its tree-structured activity ontology decomposes classification into local decisions among semantically related activities. The static store supplies node-constrained examples, while offline-discovered executable signal features provide numerical evidence for local distinctions. During inference, the personalized store collects selected user observations, which the LLM integrates with static knowledge and signal features while traversing the ontology to an activity label. Cross-subject and heterogeneous-sensing experiments show complementary gains from hierarchical retrieval and personalized memory across multiple LLM backbones, achieving state-of-the-art performance. By explicitly modeling hierarchical relations across activity granularities, OntoAR-HAR also addresses the long-overlooked semantic inclusion problem and avoids treating related labels as independent categories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OntoAR-HAR，一种本体引导的智能体式 RAG 框架，联合静态群体知识与个性化知识，通过树状活动本体将分类分解为语义相关活动间的局部决策，在跨被试与异构传感实验中取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM/RAG 的 HAR 方法通常在单一层级活动空间中使用静态群体知识进行检索，导致用相同的群体证据比较大量无关候选，忽视了个体化运动模式，同时也未建模活动粒度间的语义包含关系。
AI.method: 提出 OntoAR-HAR：以树状活动本体将分类分解为语义相关活动间的局部决策；静态存储提供节点约束样本；离线发现的可执行信号特征提供数值证据用于局部区分；推理时个性化存储收集目标用户观测，LLM 融合静态知识、信号特征并沿本体遍历至活动标签。
AI.result: 跨被试与异构传感实验表明，分层检索与个性化记忆在多种 LLM 骨干上带来互补增益，达到当前最优性能。
AI.conclusion: OntoAR-HAR 通过显式建模跨活动粒度的层级关系，解决了长期被忽视的语义包含问题，避免将相关标签视为独立类别，实现了无需训练的目标用户推断。

title: BaT-SAM: Introducing Inductive Bias into SAM via a Mixture of Convolutional Experts for Brain Tumor Segmentation
summary: Accurate brain tumor segmentation from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for diagnosis and treatment planning; however, manual delineation is labor-intensive and time-consuming. Existing approaches are either task-specific with limited generalization or rely on user-provided prompts during inference. We present BaT-SAM, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework that enables fully automatic brain tumor segmentation with the Segment Anything Model (SAM). BaT-SAM injects local inductive bias into SAM's frozen Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder via Conv-LoRA, where image features are processed by a sparsely gated mixture of multi-scale convolutional experts. This design compensates for the limited translation-equivariant inductive bias of vanilla ViTs while fine-tuning fewer than 5M parameters (less than 1% of the full model). To remove the need for user prompts, we further introduce a lightweight self-prompting box regressor that is jointly optimized with the adapter using scheduled sampling and predicts tumor locations directly from image embeddings. On the BRISC2025 benchmark, BaT-SAM achieves a weighted mean IoU of 0.832 while outperforming state-of-the-art benchmarks. It further demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization, achieving Dice scores of 0.702 on Figshare and 0.784 on the LGG MRI Segmentation dataset.

AI.tldr: BaT-SAM 是一种参数高效的自适应框架，通过引入 Conv-LoRA 与自提示框回归器，让冻结权重的 SAM 实现全自动脑肿瘤分割，在 BRISC2025 上达到 0.832 加权平均 IoU，并具备良好的跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: MRI 脑肿瘤的精确分割对诊断和治疗规划至关重要，但人工勾画耗时耗力。现有方法要么任务专一、泛化性有限，要么依赖推理时用户提供提示，难以实现全自动且通用的分割。
AI.method: 提出 BaT-SAM：在 SAM 冻结的 ViT 编码器中通过 Conv-LoRA 注入局部归纳偏置，图像特征经稀疏门控的多尺度卷积专家混合处理，以弥补原 ViT 平移等变归纳偏置不足；仅微调不到 5M 参数（不到全模型 1%）。同时引入轻量级自提示框回归器，采用 scheduled sampling 与适配器联合优化，直接从图像嵌入预测肿瘤位置，去除用户提示依赖。
AI.result: 在 BRISC2025 基准上取得 0.832 的加权平均 IoU，优于现有最先进方法；跨数据集泛化表现良好，Figshare 上 Dice 为 0.702，LGG MRI Segmentation 数据集上为 0.784。
AI.conclusion: BaT-SAM 以极低的参数开销实现了全自动脑肿瘤分割，兼顾高精度与跨数据集泛化能力，为参数高效地适配大基础模型到医学分割任务提供了一条可行路径。

title: The interpreter as developer: An autoethnographic design study of building a computer-assisted interpreting tool through human-LLM co-creation
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures. The CAI tool is openly available at https://github.com/omnigx/whisper_interpreter and archived at Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22255011
summary: Real-time AI captioning now serves audiences at multilingual events, yet computer-assisted interpreting (CAI) tools are still built for interpreters, rarely by them. This article reports an autoethnographic design study in which a professional interpreter with no programming training built a local-first CAI system through expert-led 'vibe coding', co-creating with an LLM architect and a coding agent. Analysis of the complete development dialogues shows how tacit professional knowledge, from segmentation to booth infrastructure, was externalized into design after generic defaults failed in use. In a demanding public scientific event, three mechanisms of in-booth appropriation emerge under a firmly human-led division of labor; telemetry from a first fully instrumented assignment shows a fully local chain sustaining a median translation latency of 0.94 s across 971 utterances. The case is read as lead-user innovation newly enabled by generative AI, with implications for the technological literacy of interpreters and the future of interpreter training.

AI.tldr: 专业口译员无编程背景，借"氛围编程"与LLM架构师、编码代理协作，自建本地优先的CAI系统；完整开发对话显示默会职业知识被外化进设计，实测971条话语下中位翻译延迟0.94秒。
AI.motivation: 实时AI字幕已服务多语活动受众，但计算机辅助口译（CAI）工具多由技术人员为口译员开发，口译员极少参与设计。本文旨在让口译员自身成为设计主体，探索生成式AI能否支持其主导开发。
AI.method: 采用自我民族志设计研究：一名无编程训练的职业口译员在专家引导的"氛围编程"下，与LLM架构师和编码代理共同构建本地优先CAI系统。分析完整开发对话，追踪默会知识（从切分到同传厢基础设施）在通用默认方案失效后如何被外化为设计；并在一次要求严苛的公共科学活动中观察同传厢内三种挪用机制，配合首次全仪器化任务的遥测数据。
AI.result: 在坚定以人为主导的分工下出现三种同传厢内挪用机制；首次全仪器化任务遥测显示，全本地链路在971条话语上维持中位翻译延迟0.94秒。
AI.conclusion: 该案例可解读为生成式AI新近赋能的领先用户创新，对口译员技术素养及口译训练的未来具有启示意义。

title: CHEAR: Confusion-Hierarchy Evidence-Aware Reasoning for Cost-Efficient Human Activity Recognition
summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer a new approach to wearable-sensor-based human activity recognition. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) further introduces similar motion examples and discriminative sensor knowledge, enabling decisions grounded in observations relevant to the current query. More evidence, however, does not necessarily mean better-organized evidence. When online prompts and LLM agents primarily orchestrate inference, decisions about which activities to compare and when to invoke discriminative knowledge remain concentrated at inference time. As the activity vocabulary grows, the model must repeatedly process more candidates and associated knowledge, whereas pruning candidates too early risks excluding the true activity. We propose confusion-hierarchy evidence-aware reasoning (CHEAR), which moves part of this knowledge organization offline. CHEAR constructs and validates an activity hierarchy from recurrent cross-subject retrieval errors and builds corresponding activity-pair knowledge. At inference time, the hierarchy orders candidate comparisons; the LLM retains candidates progressively, and local discriminative knowledge is accessed only for the remaining activities. Across eight datasets, CHEAR achieves 86.79\% mean cross-subject accuracy, a 75.91\% candidate reduction rate, and 96.44\% true-activity retention. Per-sample token use is 85.15\% lower on average than in a variant without the hierarchical structure. Mean accuracy across eight cross-dataset transfer directions is 88.81\%. These results show that organizing candidates and discriminative knowledge around observed activity confusions reduces online LLM input while maintaining recognition performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CHEAR（混淆层级证据感知推理），将部分知识组织从推理时移到离线阶段，通过从跨被试检索错误中构建活动层级结构和活动对知识，实现候选逐步剪枝和按需访问判别知识。
AI.motivation: LLM结合RAG为可穿戴传感器人体活动识别提供了新途径，但更多证据不等于更好组织的证据。当在线提示和LLM代理主导推理时，比较哪些活动、何时调用判别知识的决策都集中在推理时；随着活动词汇增长，模型需反复处理更多候选和相关知识，而过早剪枝又可能排除真实活动。
AI.method: CHEAR离线构建并验证活动层级结构（基于反复出现的跨被试检索错误），并建立相应的活动对知识。推理时，层级结构引导候选比较顺序，LLM逐步保留候选，仅对剩余活动访问局部判别知识。
AI.result: 在八个数据集上，CHEAR达到86.79%平均跨被试准确率、75.91%候选缩减率和96.44%真实活动保留率。相比无层级结构的变体，每样本token使用平均降低85.15%。八个跨数据集迁移方向平均准确率为88.81%。
AI.conclusion: 围绕观察到的活动混淆来组织候选和判别知识，可减少在线LLM输入，同时保持识别性能。

title: StimFlow: Synthesizing Brain Activity from Images via Stimulus-conditioned Flow Matching
summary: The inherent variability of fMRI responses across trials encourages a generative view of the stimulus-to-response mapping. Prior generative encoders often operate in compressed latent spaces and condition predominantly on semantic features, which provide limited low-level cues for early visual cortex. We propose StimFlow, which synthesizes fMRI directly in native voxel space using conditional flow matching with a linear path. This design aligns training and inference distributions, enabling competitive performance with a single sample and reducing reliance on averaging. To match the visual hierarchy, StimFlow combines structural DINOv2 features with semantic CLIP features, which prove complementary along the cortical processing stream. With a single sample, StimFlow achieves a per-voxel Pearson correlation of 0.371, matching baselines that average five draws. Generation in voxel space allows direct ROI analysis and concept localization without a decoder. Furthermore, it recovers over half of full-data performance from just one hour of scans, supporting efficient cross-subject adaptation.

AI.tldr: StimFlow 提出在原生体素空间用条件流匹配直接生成 fMRI 响应，结合 DINOv2 结构特征与 CLIP 语义特征，单样本即达 0.371 的体素级 Pearson 相关。
AI.motivation: fMRI 响应在试次间存在固有变异性，适合用生成式视角建模刺激到响应的映射。但现有生成式编码器多在压缩潜空间操作，且主要依赖语义特征，对早期视觉皮层缺乏低层线索。
AI.method: 提出 StimFlow：采用线性路径的条件流匹配（conditional flow matching），直接在原生体素空间合成 fMRI；同时融合 DINOv2 的结构特征与 CLIP 的语义特征，以匹配视觉皮层的层级处理。
AI.result: 单样本条件下体素级 Pearson 相关达 0.371，与取五次平均的基线相当；体素空间生成支持无需解码器的 ROI 分析与概念定位；仅用一小时扫描数据即可恢复超过一半的全数据性能。
AI.conclusion: 在原生体素空间进行生成式建模并结合结构-语义互补特征，可高效、可解释地刻画刺激到 fMRI 响应的映射，并支持高效的跨被试适配。

title: PATMT2: Two-stage domain adaptation for multilingual patent translation
summary: We present PatMT2 (Patent Machine Translation, v2), a two-stage LoRA pipeline that adapts the Hy-MT2-7B dedicated translation model to four-language (Chinese/English/Japanese/Korean) patent translation. On six translation directions, the Stage-2 checkpoint reaches a macro-average BLEU of 43.39 (BF16) to 43.57 (AWQ INT4), improving over the Hy-MT2-7B base by up to +8.8 BLEU and also exceeding Qwen3-32B and several external systems on the same average. We then measure the cost of adaptation: probing 38 languages absent from the fine-tuning data, the model still produces correct, fluent output on 34, while four low-resource languages collapse into distinct, reproducible failure modes. We treat these as diagnostic cases rather than retention rates, and report their mechanisms without attributing them to a single cause. Paired bootstrap tests confirm the translation gains over all baselines (p < 0.001).

AI.tldr: PatMT2 采用两阶段 LoRA 微调专用翻译模型 Hy-MT2-7B，实现中英日韩四语专利翻译，六方向宏平均 BLEU 达 43.39–43.57，并系统分析了适配带来的跨语言代价。
AI.motivation: 专利翻译对术语准确性和行文规范性要求高，通用或专用翻译模型在四语（中/英/日/韩）多方向场景下性能仍有提升空间，且微调适配可能损害未见语言的翻译能力，需要量化这一代价。
AI.method: 提出两阶段 LoRA 流水线，在专用翻译模型 Hy-MT2-7B 上适配中英日韩四语专利翻译；在六个翻译方向上评估 BLEU（含 BF16 与 AWQ INT4 两种精度），并探测 38 种未见语言以考察适配代价，采用配对 bootstrap 检验验证显著性。
AI.result: Stage-2 模型六方向宏平均 BLEU 为 43.39（BF16）至 43.57（AWQ INT4），较基座最高提升 +8.8 BLEU，并超过 Qwen3-32B 及若干外部系统；38 种未见语言中 34 种仍输出正确流畅，4 种低资源语言出现可复现的失败模式；配对 bootstrap 显示相对所有基线的提升均显著（p < 0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 两阶段 LoRA 适配能显著提升四语专利翻译质量且量化后仍保持增益，但会引发少数低资源语言的失效；作者将这些案例作为诊断样本报告其机制，而非归因于单一原因，也未将其视为语言保留率指标。

title: SuperAI: Merging Capabilities Across Heterogeneous Foundation Models
summary: Enabling the reuse and composition of knowledge and capabilities distributed across foundation models is an important step toward building scalable artificial intelligence (AI) systems. However, architectural differences and incompatible representations make it difficult to transfer and integrate these capabilities through a unified cross-model interface. To address this challenge, we propose SuperAI, a cross-architecture multi-model fusion framework that integrates complementary capabilities from multiple source models into a host model through orthogonal alignment of low-dimensional task-relevant representations. Specifically, we first extract task-relevant representations from the source models and the host model using shared anchor samples, and apply principal component analysis (PCA) to construct low-dimensional functional subspaces with the same dimensionality. Next, we use orthogonal Procrustes mappings to align the source and host coordinate systems, establishing cross-model correspondences while preserving the internal geometry of each source subspace. Finally, we train a lightweight residual multilayer perceptron (MLP) with joint supervision on task outputs and source-model increments, learning input-dependent residual increments that are injected into the host model for multi-model capability fusion. Experiments on three host models across 15 capability domains show that SuperAI achieves higher average domain scores than the evaluated cross-architecture fusion methods and better preserves general capabilities as the number of source models increases. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of orthogonal alignment, nonlinear residual mapping, and joint supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出SuperAI跨架构多模型融合框架，通过低维任务相关表示的orthogonal alignment实现源模型能力向host模型的迁移融合。
AI.motivation: 基座模型的能力与知识分散在不同模型中，架构差异与表示不兼容导致难以通过统一跨模型接口进行能力迁移与整合，阻碍可扩展AI系统的构建。
AI.method: 先用共享anchor样本提取源模型与host模型的任务相关表示，经PCA构建同维度低维功能子空间；再用orthogonal Procrustes映射对齐源与host坐标系，在保持各源子空间内部几何结构的同时建立跨模型对应关系；最后训练轻量级residual MLP，以任务输出与源模型增量联合监督，学习输入相关的残差增量并注入host模型实现多模型能力融合。
AI.result: 在3个host模型、15个能力领域上的实验表明，SuperAI的平均领域得分高于所评估的跨架构融合方法，且在源模型数量增加时更好地保持通用能力；消融研究验证了orthogonal alignment、非线性残差映射与联合监督的有效性。
AI.conclusion: orthogonal alignment结合非线性残差映射与联合监督的跨架构融合框架，可在不破坏host模型通用能力的前提下有效整合多源模型能力，并随源模型规模扩展保持稳定。

title: Across Viewpoints and Time: Trajectory-Generalizable Physical Attacks on World Models and Video Understanding Models
summary: World models and video understanding models are increasingly deployed in dynamic visual environments, yet their robustness to physical adversarial threats remains largely underexplored. We study whether a single physical adversarial texture can mislead the victim model across different real-world scenarios where observing viewpoints vary along uncontrolled object--camera trajectories. We identify that heterogeneous video semantics and trajectories induce poorly aligned gradients for optimizing the adversarial texture. To address that, we propose the Trajectory-aware adversarial Alignment and Refinement Attack (TARA), which incorporates trajectory-aware optimization to capture the evolving geometric variations of a printed texture under real-world scenarios. To improve cross-instance optimization compatibility, TARA incorporates trajectory-aware contrastive alignment to encourage attacked representations from diverse video--trajectory instances to approach a shared adversarial region and then performs trajectory-aware task refinement to translate the aligned representation into task-level prediction errors. For reproducible evaluation, we develop a geometry-grounded tracking pipeline that provides physically plausible adversarial regions with temporally consistent trajectories on EPIC-KITCHENS-100 and Something-Something V2. We further collect real-world print-and-recapture videos to validate attack effectiveness under physical deployment conditions. Together, the annotated benchmarks and real-world captured data form a reproducible testbed for future evaluation. Notably, our results reveal that a single printable adversarial texture can persistently disrupt world models and video understanding models under physical conditions, highlighting the fundamental security challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出轨迹感知的对抗对齐与精炼攻击 TARA，用单一可打印对抗纹理在真实物理条件下持续欺骗世界模型与视频理解模型，并构建可复现的评测基准。
AI.motivation: 世界模型与视频理解模型日益部署于动态视觉环境，但其对物理对抗威胁的鲁棒性研究不足；观测视点沿不可控的物体—相机轨迹变化，导致现有对抗纹理优化困难。
AI.method: 作者识别出异构视频语义与轨迹导致梯度对齐差的问题，提出 TARA：包含轨迹感知优化以刻画打印纹理在真实场景下的几何变化；轨迹感知对比对齐使多样视频—轨迹实例的受攻击表征趋近共享对抗区域；以及轨迹感知任务精炼，把对齐表征转化为任务级预测错误。并构建几何约束的跟踪流水线，在 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 与 Something-Something V2 上生成物理合理、时序一致的对抗区域。
AI.result: 在 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 和 Something-Something V2 上通过几何约束跟踪流水线获得物理合理的对抗区域与一致轨迹；并采集真实打印—重录视频验证物理部署下的攻击有效性；结果表明单一可打印对抗纹理可在物理条件下持续干扰世界模型与视频理解模型。
AI.conclusion: 标注基准与真实采集数据共同构成可复现测试平台，揭示单一可打印对抗纹理对世界模型和视频理解模型构成的基础性安全挑战。

title: Ontology-Based Post-Coordinated Expression Assembly: from Clinical Narrative to Queryable Knowledge Graphs
summary: Clinical oncology documentation records decisive information in free text, where it remains readable but not retrievable at scale, leaving cohort identification dependent on incomplete diagnostic codes or manual review. The current standard, coding individual terms, captures what a document mentions, not what it asserts: meaning lies in how those terms relate to one another. We present a method for deriving queryable knowledge graphs from clinical narratives, conforming to the Extended Grammar of SNOMED CT across multiple ontologies. The method specifies how entities should be annotated and related. It defines five relation classes, each bound to a construction rule that assembles the entities and relations into post-coordinated expressions. A deterministic implementation, UNIGRAPHE, applies those rules to construct knowledge graphs from annotated text. Applied to expert-annotated real-world oncology documentation, UNIGRAPHE reconstructed 5,299 annotations into 2,196 post-coordinated expressions and shows that relation structure is the missing piece to make clinical narrative formally queryable.

AI.tldr: 提出从临床叙事文本构建可查询知识图谱的方法，遵循SNOMED CT扩展语法，定义五类关系及构造规则，通过确定性实现UNIGRAPHE将标注转为后协调表达式，实现临床叙事的正式可查询化。
AI.motivation: 临床肿瘤学文档以自由文本记录关键信息，可读但难以规模化检索，导致队列识别依赖不完整的诊断编码或人工审查。现有标准仅对单个术语编码，只能捕捉文档"提及了什么"而非"断言了什么"，而语义存在于术语间的关系之中。
AI.method: 提出从临床叙事推导可查询知识图谱的方法，跨多个本体遵循SNOMED CT扩展语法。方法规定了实体如何被标注与关联，定义五类关系，每类绑定一条构造规则，将实体与关系组装为后协调表达式。确定性实现UNIGRAPHE应用这些规则从标注文本构建知识图谱。
AI.result: 将UNIGRAPHE应用于专家标注的真实世界肿瘤学文档，将5,299条标注重构为2,196个后协调表达式。
AI.conclusion: 关系结构是使临床叙事正式可查询的关键缺失环节。

title: MultiFlow: Vision-Driven Multimodal fMRI Encoding via Stimulus-Informed Source Flow Matching
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026
summary: Current fMRI encoding models frame prediction as deterministic regression, yet identical stimuli evoke a distribution of neural responses (arising from physiological noise, hemodynamic variability, and cognitive fluctuations) that a single point estimate cannot capture. This work introduces MultiFlow, a generative fMRI encoding framework based on Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) and a formulation termed Stimulus-Informed Source Flow Matching (SISFM). SISFM generalises CFM by conditioning the source distribution on the stimulus: a learnable temporal convolution shapes the source mean with an HRF-length receptive field, while a variance head shrinks its scale, shortening the expected transport path. SISFM is instantiated with a Diffusion Transformer (DiT-X) decoder parameterising the velocity field, with sub-layer Attention Residuals, heterogeneous fusion of ten frozen vision, audio, language, and audiovisual backbones, and per-subject Yeo-network heads. On the Algonauts 2025 dataset, a single MultiFlow checkpoint recovers most of the benefit of large deterministic ensembles: it trails the 1000-model TRIBE ensemble in-distribution by 0.003 PCC (0.3163 vs. 0.3195), and the strongest in- and out-of-distribution ensembles (VIBE-20, MedARC-50) by 0.010 and 0.009 PCC, using a single trained model rather than an ensemble of 20-1000. The same checkpoint also provides stimulus-conditioned uncertainty estimates and sample-based diversity.

AI.tldr: MultiFlow：基于条件流匹配的生成式fMRI编码框架，以单模型逼近大规模确定性集成，并提供不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 现有fMRI编码模型将预测建模为确定性回归，但同一刺激会引发神经响应的分布（源于生理噪声、血流动力学变异与认知波动），单点估计无法刻画该分布。
AI.method: 提出MultiFlow生成式编码框架，核心为刺激知情源流匹配（SISFM）：推广条件流匹配，将源分布以刺激为条件——可学习时间卷积以HRF长度感受野塑造源均值，方差头收缩其尺度以缩短期望传输路径；采用DiT-X解码器参数化速度场，含子层注意力残差、十个冻结视觉/音频/语言/视听骨干的异质融合，以及逐被试Yeo网络头。
AI.result: 在Algonauts 2025数据集上，单个MultiFlow检查点恢复了大确定性集成的大部分收益：分布内PCC仅落后1000模型TRIBE集成0.003（0.3163 vs. 0.3195），落后最强分布内/外集成（VIBE-20、MedARC-50）分别为0.010和0.009 PCC；同一检查点还提供刺激条件化不确定性估计与基于采样的多样性。
AI.conclusion: 以单个训练模型替代20–1000模型集成即可接近其性能，同时赋予fMRI编码生成式建模能力（不确定性与多样性），表明流匹配是神经响应分布式预测的有效范式。

title: Video-Based Sexual Harassment Detection Using Fine-Tuned Video Transformers
summary: Sexual harassment represents a pervasive societal challenge, with a substantial proportion of incidents remaining unreported due to insufficient evidence and delayed intervention mechanisms. Smart surveillance systems capable of detecting such incidents in real-time could assist law enforcement and serve as a deterrent. However, video-based harassment detection poses significant challenges, including variations in clothing, illumina- tion, partial occlusions, low resolution, and diverse camera view- points. Despite its social importance, this problem has received limited research attention, primarily due to the scarcity of large- scale annotated video datasets. To address this gap, we extend the Sexual Harassment Video (SHV) dataset to 600 short video clips sourced from YouTube and annotated into harassment and non-harassment categories using consistent labeling guidelines. We fine-tune three state-of-the-art video transformer models, VideoMAE, ViViT, and TimeSformer, pretrained on Kinetics- 400, for binary harassment classification. Experimental results show that all three models achieve competitive classification performance, with TimeSformer attaining the highest test accu- racy of 92.27%, outperforming VideoMAE 91.71% and ViViT 91.16% on the extended SHV test set. Our analysis reveals that performance is notably influenced by dataset size, video quality, frame sampling strategy, and model architecture. This work presents a comprehensive evaluation of modern video transformers for this sensitive real-world task.

AI.tldr: 将性骚扰视频数据集SHV扩展至600段短视频，微调VideoMAE、ViViT、TimeSformer三个视频Transformer进行二分类检测，TimeSformer以92.27%测试准确率最高。
AI.motivation: 性骚扰是普遍的社会挑战，大量事件因证据不足与干预滞后而未被举报。实时智能监控系统可协助执法并起到威慑作用。然而视频性骚扰检测面临服装、光照、遮挡、低分辨率、视角多变等困难，且因缺乏大规模标注视频数据集，相关研究十分有限。
AI.method: 将性骚扰视频数据集（SHV）扩展至600段来自YouTube的短视频，按统一标注准则标注为骚扰与非骚扰两类；基于Kinetics-400预训练的VideoMAE、ViViT、TimeSformer三种SOTA视频Transformer模型进行二分类微调。
AI.result: 三个模型均取得有竞争力的分类性能，在扩展后的SHV测试集上TimeSformer测试准确率最高为92.27%，优于VideoMAE的91.71%和ViViT的91.16%。分析表明性能显著受数据集规模、视频质量、帧采样策略和模型架构影响。
AI.conclusion: 本文对现代视频Transformer在该敏感现实任务上进行了全面评估，为视频性骚扰检测提供了数据集扩展与基准性能参考。

title: Communication, Vocalisation, and Language
comment: A written version of my argument with with Roger, with input from Bruce. 6 pages and one (Venn) diagram
summary: The contention is that the current batch of Large Language Models don't *understand* language, but they *do* it. Rather than LLMs forming some kind of ``distributed representation'' of symbols, the claim is that LLMs are capturing ``Cultural Intelligence'' and grounding symbols in what the sociologists call practices.

AI.tldr: 该文主张：当前大语言模型并不"理解"语言，但确实能够"做"语言。LLM并非形成符号的分布式表征，而是捕捉"文化智能"，并将符号锚定在社会学家所称的"实践"之中。
AI.motivation: 针对LLM是否真正"理解"语言的争论，作者试图跳出"分布式表征"这一认知主义解释框架，重新界定LLM能力的性质与来源。
AI.method: 理论/概念分析路径：借社会学"实践"（practices）概念与"文化智能"概念，对LLM的符号处理机制进行重新诠释。
AI.result: 提出LLM的能力应被理解为对文化实践模式的捕捉与再现，而非对符号内在意义的理解或分布式语义表征。
AI.conclusion: "理解"与"做"应当区分：LLM虽不"理解"语言，却能"做"语言，其根基在于文化智能与实践的锚定，而非符号表征。

title: TRACE: Temporal Risk Assessment and Concept Editing for Safer Language Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can produce harmful content while generating a response. A useful safeguard should not only detect this risk during generation but also intervene while leaving safe responses largely unchanged and provide an auditable record of the internal patterns supporting its decisions. We propose TRACE (Temporal Risk Assessment and Concept Editing), a framework that tracks harmful-response risk during generation, selectively edits token activations, and leaves an auditable trace of its detection and steering decisions. TRACE learns a codebook of recurring activation patterns, with each codebook vector representing a latent concept. At inference time, it assigns each token activation to the nearest codebook vector to obtain the corresponding concept. A gated recurrent unit (GRU) processes the activations and their assigned concept features to predict completed-response harmfulness and a monotone cumulative streaming risk. During steering, activations assigned to harmful concepts are steered along directions defined by nearby benign targets. An external LLM labels the learned concepts post hoc, making detection sequences and harmful-to-benign edit records interpretable. Experiments across three generators and the WildGuard and S-Eval benchmarks show that TRACE improves streaming F1 over Kelp in five of six comparisons while remaining competitive on completed-response detection. TRACE's selective steering reduces Harmbench attack success with little change in refusal on originally safe responses. The post-hoc audit reveals recurring semantic structure in the learned concepts and distinct traces associated with harmful detection, safe generation, and activation edits.

AI.tldr: TRACE 是一个在生成过程中追踪有害风险、选择性编辑激活并提供可审计记录的框架。
AI.motivation: 现有安全防护不仅需在生成时检测风险，还需在干预的同时尽量不影响安全响应，并提供支持其决策的内部模式可审计记录。
AI.method: 学习一个由潜在概念构成的激活模式码本；推理时将每个 token 激活分配到最近码本向量获得概念；用 GRU 处理激活与概念特征，预测完整响应的有害性及单调累积流式风险；对有害概念的激活沿邻近良性目标方向进行引导；外部 LLM 事后标注学习到的概念以实现可解释性。
AI.result: 在三个生成器及 WildGuard、S-Eval 基准上，TRACE 在六项比较中的五项优于 Kelp 的流式 F1，同时在完整响应检测上保持竞争力；选择性引导降低了 Harmbench 攻击成功率，且对原本安全响应的拒绝率影响很小；事后审计显示学习概念具有反复出现的语义结构，并存在与有害检测、安全生成和激活编辑相关的不同轨迹。
AI.conclusion: TRACE 可在生成过程中检测并干预有害风险，兼顾安全响应不变性与可审计性，并通过实验验证其流式检测、选择性引导和可解释性优势。

title: UniForge3D: Joint 3D Reconstruction and Generation in a Shared Anchor-Guided Space
summary: Generating complete 3D assets from sparse, unposed images requires preserving observed geometry while completing unseen regions. Joint reconstruction and generation offers a way to address both goals: reconstruction recovers the geometry observed in the input images, while generation contributes learned shape priors. However, combining camera-relative reconstruction with canonical-space generation introduces a coordinate mismatch that makes direct geometric interaction more difficult. Moreover, conditioning each 3D location on all views without accounting for their relevance may mix useful geometric evidence with unrelated image content, hindering local detail recovery. We present UniForge3D, which jointly models reconstruction and generation in a shared anchor-guided space, resolving their coordinate mismatch. This space follows the anchor view's azimuth while keeping the object upright. The two branches exchange features bidirectionally to predict per-view point maps and a complete sparse voxel structure. We further condition point-map prediction on the generated structure to establish pixel-to-voxel correspondences and select the most informative input view for each voxel. Features from the selected views then guide detailed shape generation, helping preserve observed geometric details. Our method achieves state-of-the-art appearance and geometry results on Toys4K and GSO, generating complete 3D assets with improved fidelity. Project webpage: https://xishuxishu.github.io/uniforge3d-project/

AI.tldr: UniForge3D 提出在共享 anchor 引导空间内联合建模重建与生成，解决坐标失配问题，并利用生成结构指导点图预测、选择信息量最大的视图，实现从稀疏无位姿图像生成高保真完整3D资产。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏、无位姿图像生成完整3D资产需同时保留已观测几何并补全未见区域。联合重建与生成可兼顾两者：重建恢复输入图像中的几何，生成提供学习到的形状先验。但相机相对坐标系的重建与规范空间生成之间存在坐标失配，导致难以直接进行几何交互；同时，若对每个3D位置不加区分地条件化所有视图，会混合有效几何证据与无关图像内容，损害局部细节恢复。
AI.method: 提出 UniForge3D，在共享的 anchor 引导空间中联合建模重建与生成以解决坐标失配。该空间采用 anchor 视图的方位角并保持物体直立。两个分支双向交换特征，预测逐视图点图与完整稀疏体素结构。进一步以生成结构条件化点图预测，建立像素到体素的对应关系，并为每个体素选择信息量最大的输入视图；所选视图的特征再用于引导细节形状生成，以保留观测到的几何细节。
AI.result: 在 Toys4K 与 GSO 数据集上取得最先进的外观与几何结果，生成的完整3D资产具有更高保真度。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享 anchor 引导空间统一重建与生成的坐标框架，并结合结构引导的点图预测与视图选择机制，UniForge3D 有效缓解了坐标失配与视图条件化噪声问题，验证了联合重建-生成范式在稀疏无位姿输入下生成完整3D资产的优越性。

title: Intent-Triggered Anchoring for Multi-Token Format Units in Parallel Decoding of Diffusion Language Models
summary: In parallel decoding, diffusion language models commit several tokens per forward pass, so co-committed tokens cannot see each other, breaking multi-token format units that parsers need. On ECHO, an open-weight one-step chest X-ray (CXR) report generator, 32.7-36.7% of evaluation reports lack a parseable Impression heading and score as empty. We propose intent-triggered anchoring, a training-free decoding rule that completes a format unit once the model commits its first token, inserting only units with a unique, content-free completion; fallbacks write the unit when the model stops or loops without starting it. On three CXR evaluation sets, the rule raises readable rates from 63.3-67.3% to 100.0% with no regressions and a 95th-percentile latency ratio of 0.68-1.28 against official decoding. Broken headings state findings absent from the reference; adding the heading at the end leaves them in 15.5-31.0% of reports, our rule in at most 0.6%. For math answer markers, the rule raises accuracy in the most parallel setting of five diffusion language models by 5.8-20.8 points on GSM8K and 5.1-17.1 on GSM-Symbolic, held out from tuning. With lenient answer extraction, gains are 3.3-12.5 and 2.7-6.3 points; the rule adds 1.4-8.6 points over a stop-only fallback for four of the five models.

AI.tldr: 提出"意图触发锚定"（intent-triggered anchoring）这一免训练解码规则：当模型提交某格式单元的首个token时即完成整个格式单元，仅在存在唯一且内容无关补全时插入；回退策略在模型停顿或空转时补写起始单元。在CXR报告生成与数学推理两类任务上显著提升可解析率与准确率，且延迟几乎无损。
AI.motivation: 并行解码中，扩散语言模型单次前向提交多个token，被同时提交的token彼此不可见，导致解析器所需的跨token格式单元（如"Impression"标题、数学答案标记）被打断。在ECHO这一开放权重单步CXR报告生成器上，32.7%–36.7%的评估报告因缺少可解析的Impression标题而被判为空；同时破损标题会陈述参考中并不存在的内容，损害输出可靠性。
AI.method: 提出intent-triggered anchoring：一种免训练的解码规则。核心机制是"意图触发"——一旦模型提交某格式单元的第一个token，便强制补全该单元；仅当该格式单元具有唯一且与内容无关的补全时才执行插入。设置回退（fallback）机制：当模型停止或进入循环而未启动该格式单元时，由回退策略写出该单元。方法不修改模型参数，可直接套用于官方解码流程。
AI.result: 在三个CXR评估集上，可读率从63.3%–67.3%提升至100.0%，无性能回退，相对官方解码的第95百分位延迟比为0.68–1.28。破损标题问题上，若仅在末尾追加标题，仍有15.5%–31.0%的报告保留错误内容，而该规则最多仅0.6%。在数学答案标记上，于五个扩散语言模型最并行的设置下，GSM8K准确率提升5.8–20.8个百分点，GSM-Symbolic（留出未调优）提升5.1–17.1个百分点；宽松答案抽取下增益为3.3–12.5与2.7–6.3个百分点，其中四个模型相对"仅回退"基线额外提升1.4–8.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 并发提交token导致的格式单元断裂是并行扩散解码的共性缺陷，可通过免训练的意图触发锚定规则有效修复。该方法在医学报告结构化生成与数学推理答案抽取两类任务上兼顾可读性、正确性与延迟效率，且具备跨模型泛化能力。

title: Fewer Bits, More Tries: Recovering Capability Under Memory Constraints
summary: Large language models are generally more capable than smaller ones, but their memory requirements can make local deployment difficult. We ask whether part of this capability gap can instead be recovered by running a smaller or more compressed model multiple times and selecting among its outputs using public or model-generated tests. Single-user local inference can leave hardware underutilized, allowing parallel candidate generation to trade additional test-time computation for accuracy at modest latency cost. Across four code-generation benchmarks, verified retry recovers substantial accuracy lost to model size or compression. A 7B Qwen model with eight parallel attempts essentially matches a 32B model on MBPP+ and exceeds it on the other three benchmarks, while using about $4\times$ less model memory, running up to $6\times$ faster, and using less energy, as measured on Nvidia GPU. We observe similar tradeoff across model sizes, compression levels and hardware choices, although exact benefit depends on the hardware profile and problem setting. These results show that model capacity can be traded for verified test-time computation when correct solutions remain reachable within a modest retry budget.

AI.tldr: 通过并行多次采样并用测试验证筛选，小模型可在代码生成任务上以更低内存和能耗达到大模型精度。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能力更强但内存需求高，难以本地部署；单用户本地推理时硬件利用率低，存在利用测试时计算弥补能力差距的空间。
AI.method: 对较小或压缩后的模型进行多次并行候选生成，利用公开测试或模型生成的测试对输出进行验证与筛选（verified retry），以少量延迟换取精度。
AI.result: 在四个代码生成基准上，7B Qwen 模型八次并行尝试在 MBPP+ 上基本追平 32B 模型，并在其余三个基准上超越；内存约为后者 1/4，速度最高快 6 倍，能耗更低（Nvidia GPU 实测）。该权衡在多种模型规模、压缩级别和硬件下均成立，但具体收益取决于硬件配置与问题设定。
AI.conclusion: 当正确解在适度重试预算内可达时，可用验证式测试时计算替代模型容量，从而在本地部署中实现更优的内存、速度与能耗权衡。

title: VideoEvoHarness: Self Evolving Agent Harness from Unlabeled Videos for Video Understanding
summary: Video understanding agents rely on a harness to acquire evidence, use tools, and reason, but improving it requires substantial effort. Recent self evolution methods seek to optimize harnesses through execution feedback to reduce human intervention. However, existing methods often rely on annotated video questions and answers or focus on updating model parameters, leaving harness evolution from unlabeled videos underexplored. VideoEvoHarness jointly evolves a Questioner and a Solver harness from unlabeled videos with frozen model parameters. The Questioner constructs questions and computes reference answers directly from video memory records. Question quality assessments and Solver execution trajectories guide question generation policy revisions. The Solver supports evolving skills, strategies, hyperparameters, and tools using execution feedback. Executable strategies define workflows in code, reducing repeated interpretation of natural language instructions. Each round, candidate harnesses are compared on identical validation questions, with validated improvements retained for later use. Experiments on benchmarks and a dedicated benchmark question set, using videos disjoint from evolution videos, show higher overall accuracy than initially and transfer gains across backbones. Overall accuracy on this set also improves progressively across rounds. This supports our foundational framework for harness evolution from unlabeled videos, opening a promising direction for self evolving video agents. Code is available at https://github.com/Wei-Xin-Xu/VideoEvoHarness.

AI.tldr: VideoEvoHarness：在冻结模型参数条件下，从无标注视频中联合进化 Questioner 与 Solver 两套 harness，实现视频理解智能体的自我进化。
AI.motivation: 视频理解智能体依赖 harness 获取证据、调用工具并推理，但人工改进 harness 成本高。已有自我进化方法多依赖标注的视频问答数据或更新模型参数，从无标注视频中进化 harness 的方向仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出 VideoEvoHarness，在模型参数冻结的前提下，从无标注视频中联合进化 Questioner 和 Solver。Questioner 直接基于视频记忆记录构造问题并计算参考答案，问题质量评估与 Solver 执行轨迹用于修正问题生成策略；Solver 借助执行反馈进化技能、策略、超参数与工具，并以可执行代码定义工作流策略，减少自然语言指令的重复解释。每轮在相同验证问题上比较候选 harness，保留经验证的改进。
AI.result: 在基准及专门的基准问题集上（所用视频与进化视频不重叠），整体准确率高于初始版本，并可在不同骨干模型间迁移增益；该集合上的整体准确率随轮次逐步提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为从无标注视频进化 harness 提供了基础框架，为自我进化视频智能体开辟了有前景的方向，代码已开源。

title: Support or Magnitude? Characterizing Neuron Relevance for Instruction Data Selection
summary: Model-internal signals, such as neuron activations and gradients, have been used for instruction data selection, yet how neuron relevance should be characterized remains underexplored. In particular, should selection prioritize the magnitude of relevance or how broadly it is distributed across neurons? To investigate this question, we construct sample-level relevance profiles using AttnLRP-guided attribution and introduce two complementary criteria: Effective Relevance Support (ERS), which measures the effective support of positive relevance, and Positive Relevance Magnitude (PRM), which captures its average strength. Our analyses reveal that these characterizations produce distinct sample rankings and selection preferences despite sharing the same underlying relevance profiles. On Qwen2 models, PRM exhibits stronger associations with activation-based selection, whereas ERS produces substantially different rankings. These differences extend to task composition, within-task sample preferences, and semantic selection patterns, with varying degrees of agreement across backbones. Experiments across three language models and five downstream benchmarks demonstrate the practical value of relevance-guided selection, with ERS achieving the best overall average performance rank among the evaluated methods. Our findings highlight that how neuron relevance is distributed and characterized, rather than its magnitude alone, matters for instruction data selection.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究神经元相关性表征方式对指令数据选择的影响，提出ERS与PRM两种互补准则，发现相关性的分布方式而非强度本身对选择更关键，ERS在三个模型、五个基准上取得最佳平均排名。
AI.motivation: 模型内部信号（神经元激活、梯度）已用于指令数据选择，但"神经元相关性"应如何刻画仍缺乏探究：选择应优先考虑相关性的强度，还是其在神经元间分布的广度？该问题尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 基于AttnLRP归因构建样本级相关性剖面，提出两个互补准则：ERS（有效相关性支撑度），度量正相关性的有效支撑范围；PRM（正相关性强度），刻画其平均强度。在Qwen2等模型上比较二者产生的样本排序、选择偏好，并分析任务组成、任务内样本偏好与语义选择模式。
AI.result: 尽管共享同一相关性剖面，ERS与PRM产生显著不同的样本排序与选择偏好；在Qwen2上PRM与基于激活的选择关联更强，ERS排序差异明显。差异体现在任务组成、任务内偏好和语义选择模式上，且跨主干网络一致性程度不同。在三个语言模型、五个下游基准上，相关性引导选择具有实用价值，ERS总体平均性能排名最佳。
AI.conclusion: 神经元相关性的分布方式与刻画方式（而非仅其强度）对指令数据选择至关重要，ERS式刻画更有助于提升选择效果。

title: Analyzing the Dynamics of WSBM-based Echo State Networks using InputDSA
comment: 9 pages excluding refs and appendices, 9 figures
summary: Bridging the structural gap between biological brains and artificial neural networks presents a pathway to altered computational dynamics. This paper introduces a Reservoir Computing framework that replaces random networks with biologically realistic modularity by applying the Weighted Stochastic Block Model (WSBM) to Echo State Networks (ESNs). This topological parameterization constructs reservoirs reflecting latent functional sub-circuits. Furthermore, the integration of Input Dynamical Similarity Analysis (InputDSA) provides a mechanism to isolate and compare how structural priors modulate intrinsic recurrent dynamics versus external inputs. By evaluating these architectures, we establish that structural diversity does not necessarily predicts behavioral diversity across the selected network subset. Furthermore, our demixed analysis confirms Anna Karenina principle of dynamics, demonstrating that environmental constraints enforce dynamical convergence in successful agents, while failing networks degenerate into idiosyncratic trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文在回声状态网络（ESN）中引入加权随机块模型（WSBM）构建具有生物模块化结构的储备池，并结合输入动力相似性分析（InputDSA）分离结构与输入对循环动力学的影响，发现结构多样性并不必然导致行为多样性，且支持动力学的安娜·卡列尼娜原则。
AI.motivation: 生物大脑与人工神经网络之间存在结构鸿沟，随机连接网络难以反映真实神经系统的功能子回路特性，需要引入更贴近生物现实的模块化拓扑来探究结构先验如何影响计算动力学。
AI.method: 以WSBM对ESN储备池进行拓扑参数化，构建反映潜在功能子回路的模块化储备池；再引入InputDSA机制，以隔离并比较结构先验对内在循环动力学与外部输入驱动的作用，并在所选网络子集上进行评估。
AI.result: 结构多样性并不必然预示行为多样性；解混分析证实了动力学的安娜·卡列尼娜原则——在环境约束下成功智能体动力学趋于收敛，而失败网络则退化为特异化的轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 生物启发式模块化结构可作为调节储备池计算动力学的有效先验，但结构多样性到行为多样性的映射并非直接；环境的成功约束倾向于强制动力学收敛，可作为网络筛选与设计的判据。

title: OmniRSI: Taming Latent Diffusion for Unified Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Generation
comment: Under review. Code and datasets will be provided in the https://github.com/MiliLab/OmniRSI
summary: Multimodal remote sensing image generation emerges as a promising paradigm for recovering complete and complementary observations from heterogeneous and partially observed remote sensing data. However, existing methods predominantly depend on sensor-specific fine-tuning of natural image generation models, limiting unified multimodal generation capacity due to the absence of shared representations and robust conditioning mechanisms. To address these challenges, we propose OmniRSI, a unified multimodal remote sensing image generation model. Specifically, we develop a remote sensing-specific variational autoencoder that captures multimodal priors and promotes a locally smooth latent space for unified representation and robust reconstruction across diverse observed data. Building upon that, we fully adapt Stable Diffusion 3.5 with a ControlNet branch to support unified multimodal generation and translation conditioned on textual and visual cues. Besides, we devise a training-free cyclic latent alignment mechanism that iteratively enriches incomplete visual conditions with generated multimodal information, progressively improving guidance reliability while preserving observed measurements. We also construct RSI-MM, a large-scale dataset comprising 11.5M multi-resolution images with text annotations and partially paired data for training and evaluation. Extensive experiments verify that OmniRSI achieves superior performance in multimodal reconstruction, generation and translation.

AI.tldr: 提出OmniRSI统一多模态遥感图像生成模型，含遥感专用VAE、ControlNet分支稳定扩散、免训练循环潜对齐机制，并构建RSI-MM数据集，在多模态重建、生成与翻译上取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态遥感图像生成旨在从异构且部分观测的遥感数据中恢复完整互补的观测。然而现有方法多依赖对自然图像生成模型进行传感器特定微调，缺乏共享表示与稳健的条件机制，限制统一多模态生成能力。
AI.method: 1）设计遥感专用变分自编码器，捕获多模态先验并促进局部平滑的潜空间，实现统一表示与跨观测数据的稳健重建；2）在Stable Diffusion 3.5上通过ControlNet分支进行充分适配，支持以文本和视觉线索为条件的统一多模态生成与翻译；3）提出免训练的循环潜对齐机制，用生成的多模态信息迭代丰富不完整视觉条件，在保留观测测量的同时逐步提升引导可靠性；4）构建RSI-MM大规模数据集。
AI.result: 构建RSI-MM数据集，包含1150万多分辨率图像、文本标注及部分配对数据，用于训练与评估；大量实验验证OmniRSI在多模态重建、生成与翻译任务上均取得优越性能。
AI.conclusion: OmniRSI通过统一表示、稳健条件机制与循环潜对齐，实现了统一的遥感多模态图像生成，并验证其有效性，为遥感多模态生成提供了新范式与数据支撑。

title: Spectral-Driven Adaptive-Rank Optimizer for Large Language Model Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
comment: 23 pages, 11 figures, 8 tables. Working in progress
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is reshaping how large language models (LLMs) acquire reasoning capabilities, yet the optimizers used remain largely inherited from teacher-forcing training. This raises a fundamental question: does RLVR induce a distinct optimization geometry that calls for a different optimizer? We investigate this question through the spectral structure of LLM gradients and find that gradient energy progressively concentrates into a shrinking effective subspace, which is characteristic of RLVR, as it is absent under supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and is largely removed when the verifiable reward is replaced by a random one. Moreover, the rank required to capture a fixed fraction of gradient energy steadily decreases over training, revealing that the effective dimensionality of useful updates itself evolves with training. These findings motivate a new optimization principle: rather than prescribing the update rank externally, an optimizer should adapt its rank to the evolving spectral structure of the gradient. We introduce Ares (Adaptive Rank-Effective Spectral Optimization), which estimates the effective update rank from the gradient's spectral energy distribution, tracks its evolution, and confines the gradient signal driving each update to the resulting low-rank subspace. Across LLMs of different scales, Ares improves accuracy over widely used optimizers and generalizes across RLVR algorithms and tasks. Results suggest that effective optimization may require optimizers to be designed around the geometry and dynamics of the training process. We release the code and data at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/Ares.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析LLM梯度的谱结构，发现RLVR会诱导梯度能量向不断收缩的低秩子空间集中，据此提出自适应秩有效谱优化器Ares，在多种规模LLM和任务上超越常用优化器。
AI.motivation: RLVR正在改变LLM推理能力的获取方式，但其优化器大多沿用teacher-forcing训练的遗产。作者提出一个根本性问题：RLVR是否诱导了独特的优化几何，从而需要不同的优化器？
AI.method: 从LLM梯度的谱结构入手进行实证分析：观察到梯度能量逐渐集中到收缩的有效子空间，这特征反映RLVR特性——在SFT下不存在，且当可验证奖励被随机奖励替换时基本消失；同时捕获固定比例梯度能量所需的秩随训练稳定下降。基于此提出优化原则：不外部指定更新秩，而是让优化器自适应梯度的演化谱结构。据此设计Ares（自适应秩有效谱优化），从梯度的谱能量分布估计有效更新秩，跟踪其演化，并将驱动每次更新的梯度信号限制在所得低秩子空间内。
AI.result: 在不同规模的LLM上，Ares相比广泛使用的优化器提升了准确率，并跨RLVR算法和任务泛化良好。
AI.conclusion: 有效优化可能要求优化器围绕训练过程的几何与动力学来设计。代码与数据已发布于https://github.com/RUCAIBox/Ares。

title: A Decade of PhotoMappers: A Longitudinal Study of Crowdsourced Disaster Photos Geolocalization with Vision-Language Models and Geospatial Reasoning
summary: Crowdsourced disaster imagery provides timely, ground-level observations when conventional disaster mapping is delayed or incomplete, yet its geographic value depends on where observations are produced, how they are interpreted, and whether they can be reliably located as actionable Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT). Using more than a decade of PhotoMappers, a crowdsourced disaster-mapping initiative, this study examines the changing geography of disaster information and asks how emerging GeoAI models compare with human geographic interpretation. We combine longitudinal spatial analysis with cross-view geolocalization using street view imagery (SVI) and remote sensing imagery (RSI), and evaluate vision-language models (VLMs) reasoning through 30 indicators spanning geographic cues and reasoning evidence. The results reveal a geographically and temporally uneven archive shaped by changing disaster types, Community Lifelines, and operational priorities. Integrating VGI, SVI, and RSI with Sinkhorn re-ranking achieves 40.90% R@1, 61.10% R@5, and 69.45% R@10, while yearly R@1 varies markedly from 25.00% to 65.07%. Geographic reasoning is similarly uneven: Qwen3.6-27B achieves an overall agreement of 67% compared with 51% for InternVL3-8B, with both models showing greater difficulty with localized and place-specific evidence than broad spatial configurations. We argue that the value of GeoAI lies less in replacing volunteered geographic interpretation than in complementing it, scaling candidate retrieval while retaining human judgment for ambiguous and consequential cases. This provides a pathway toward more human-centered and responsible GeoAI for disaster mapping. All data and code are openly available at https://github.com/bobleegogogo/PhotoMappers-VLM.

AI.tldr: 基于PhotoMappers十余年数据，结合纵向空间分析与跨视角地理定位（VGI+SVI+RSI，Sinkhorn重排序），并评估VLM地理推理，发现灾害信息地理分布与模型推理均不均衡，主张GeoAI应补充而非替代人工地理判读。
AI.motivation: 众包灾害影像可在地图制图滞后时提供地面观测，但其地理价值取决于观测产生位置、解释方式及能否可靠定位为可行动的地理空间情报（GEOINT）。
AI.method: 使用逾十年PhotoMappers数据，结合纵向空间分析与基于街景影像（SVI）和遥感影像（RSI）的跨视角地理定位；引入Sinkhorn重排序；通过30项涵盖地理线索与推理证据的指标评估视觉语言模型（VLM）。
AI.result: 档案地理与时间分布不均，受灾害类型、社区生命线及运营优先级影响。VGI+SVI+RSI结合Sinkhorn重排序达40.90% R@1、61.10% R@5、69.45% R@10；逐年R@1在25.00%–65.07%间波动。地理推理同样不均：Qwen3.6-27B总体一致率67%，InternVL3-8B为51%，且两模型对局部化与地点特定证据比宽泛空间构型更难。
AI.conclusion: GeoAI的价值不在于替代志愿地理判读，而在于补充：扩展候选检索，同时将模糊与高后果案例保留给人工判断，通向更以人为本、负责任的灾害制图GeoAI。数据与代码已开源。

title: Harnessing SPAD Noise: Test-Time Gated Attention for Indoor Depth Estimation
summary: Monocular depth estimation (MDE) has emerged as a cost-effective alternative to hardware-dependent 3D sensing modalities, yet predicting precise metric depth remains a persistent challenge due to intrinsic scale ambiguity, edge bleeding, and limited zero-shot generalization in unseen environments. Recent multi-modal approaches incorporate 1D/3D Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) data to resolve these ambiguities, but they mainly treat SPAD noise as a harmful artifact required for denoising or leave the noise ignored. In this paper, we present an essentially different insight: native SPAD noise is an informative prior that implicitly encodes deterministic environmental characteristics. Driven by this paradigm shift, we introduce a novel, lightweight Test-Time Gated Attention framework by Harnessing SPAD Noise, therefore dubbed HSN. Tailored for indoor scenarios, HSN leverages the synergistic combination of 1D SPAD histograms and Gate Adapters (GAs). Through three complementary optimization phases, it generates channel-wise gated attention vectors to dynamically adjust encoder feature maps at inference time, effectively resolving ambiguous scale and boundary challenges without the heavy computational overhead or dense 3D modalities that other TTA methods suffer from. Extensive experiments on challenging real-world indoor benchmarks show that HSN achieves state-of-the-art metric depth accuracy in in-domain settings, while exhibiting even greater potential under zero-shot generalization to unfamiliar environments. Furthermore, interpretability analysis reveals that the proposed gated attention mechanism adaptively shifts attention toward deeper semantic layers under intensifying SPAD noise. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出HSN框架，将SPAD原生噪声视为可编码环境确定性特征的有信息先验，而非需去除的噪声，通过Test-Time Gated Attention结合1D SPAD直方图与Gate Adapters，在推理时动态调整编码器特征图，实现高精度单目度量深度估计。
AI.motivation: 单目深度估计（MDE）因内在尺度模糊、边缘渗色及对未见环境的零样本泛化能力有限，精确度量深度预测仍是难题。现有多模态方法虽引入1D/3D SPAD数据以缓解歧义，但多将SPAD噪声视为有害伪影加以去噪或直接忽略，未能挖掘其潜在价值。作者主张SPAD原生噪声隐含确定性环境特征，是一种有信息先验。
AI.method: 提出轻量级Test-Time Gated Attention框架HSN（Harnessing SPAD Noise），面向室内场景，结合1D SPAD直方图与Gate Adapters（GAs），通过三个互补优化阶段生成通道级门控注意力向量，在推理时动态调整编码器特征图，以解决尺度模糊与边界问题，避免其他TTA方法的高计算开销或密集3D模态依赖。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的真实室内基准上，HSN在域内设置下取得最先进的度量深度精度，在零样本泛化到陌生环境时展现出更大潜力。可解释性分析表明，随着SPAD噪声增强，所提出的门控注意力机制会自适应地将注意力转向更深的语义层。代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: 将SPAD噪声从需抑制的伪影重新定义为隐含环境确定性的信息先验，配合轻量级测试时门控注意力机制，可有效提升单目度量深度估计的精度与零样本泛化能力，且计算开销低。

title: PatTransBench: an ipc-stratified, multi-dimensional benchmark for patent machine translation evaluation
summary: We present PatTransBench, a 12,000-item Chinese-English/Japanese/Korean patent machine translation (PatMT) benchmark with a four-dimensional evaluation protocol. The benchmark comprises 6,000 short-text (sentence/claim) and 6,000 long-text (paragraph) pairs, evenly split across three language pairs and both translation directions, built via IPC-section-stratified sampling and dualthreshold quality gating from upstream patent-family parallel corpora. The evaluation protocol spans literal n-gram overlap (BLEU, ROUGE-L, chrF), cross-lingual semantic textual similarity (CLSTS), 38-probe-language consistency testing, and serving performance under concurrency. A case study on PatMT2-7B and its fp8/AWQ4/AutoRound-4bit variants reveals direction-dependent quantization effects masked by aggregate scores and non-monotonic language-failure patterns across quantization schemes that are invisible to single-metric evaluation. We plan to release the benchmark, protocol, and case-study results upon publication to support reproducible PatMT evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出PatTransBench，一个12000条中英/日/韩专利机器翻译基准，含四维评估协议，并通过7B模型量化案例研究揭示聚合分数掩盖的量化效应。
AI.motivation: 现有专利机器翻译评估缺乏覆盖多语言对、多文本粒度、并结合语义与部署性能的系统性基准与协议，单指标评估会掩盖方向相关的量化效应和语言失效模式。
AI.method: 构建PatTransBench：基于上游专利族平行语料，采用IPC部类分层采样与双阈值质量门控，生成6000短文本（句子/权利要求）与6000长文本（段落）配对，均匀覆盖三个语言对及双向翻译；设计四维评估协议：字面n-gram重叠（BLEU、ROUGE-L、chrF）、跨语言语义文本相似度（CLSTS）、38探针语言一致性测试、并发下的服务性能；并对PatMT2-7B及其fp8/AWQ4/AutoRound-4bit变体开展案例研究。
AI.result: 案例研究显示量化效应具有方向依赖性且被聚合分数掩盖，不同量化方案下的语言失效模式呈非单调，单指标评估无法察觉。
AI.conclusion: PatTransBench为专利机器翻译提供可复现的多维评估基准与协议，并计划发表时公开基准、协议及案例研究结果。

title: State Representation Shapes Long-Horizon Agent Learning and Transfer: An Empirical Study
summary: An end-to-end success rate alone cannot distinguish failure to learn an action from failure to apply it as task state changes. We study this distinction in deterministic tool workflows that provide the current artifact state and candidate action recipes. Using 1.7B, 8B, and 27B Qwen models, we compare supervised learning across workflow horizons and cross the state representation used for training with the one used at evaluation. Horizon-matched supervision yields high completion, but an H4-trained 1.7B model transfers poorly to longer workflows under full-state observations. In an H16 crossover, compact-trained 1.7B adapters complete 50/50 held-out tasks in compact view and 0/50 in full view for each of three paired training seeds; full-trained outcomes vary across seeds. A separate 8B adapter pair shows a similar asymmetry. The view dependence also appears in paired-choice tasks where both candidate calls are executable and the correct choice depends on table contents; here, the compact mask does not consult the target action. An explicit relevance cue improves full-view execution but does not close the gap for the tested checkpoint. In a separate 27B ScienceWorld study, compact-state training improves local accuracy under both views, indicating that the transfer pattern depends on the task and observation construction. Together, these experiments identify representation-sensitive transfer as a bottleneck in the controlled workflows, without isolating content reduction from other changes to the observation.

AI.tldr: 论文研究工具工作流中"学不会动作"与"会做但无法随状态迁移应用"的区别：用Qwen 1.7B/8B/27B在确定性工作流上做受控监督实验，交叉训练/评估的状态表示，发现迁移对观测表示高度敏感（H16交叉实验中compact训练模型compact视图50/50、full视图0/50），并提出该表示敏感迁移是受控工作流的主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 端到端成功率无法区分两类失败：一是没有学会动作（learning failure），二是学会了动作但在任务状态变化时无法正确应用（application failure）。作者希望将二者解耦，考察状态表示（observation representation）对策略迁移的影响，即模型能否在不同观测表征之间迁移已学的动作知识。
AI.method: 在提供当前工件状态与候选动作配方（action recipes）的确定性工具工作流上，使用Qwen 1.7B、8B、27B进行监督学习。实验设计：1）比较不同工作流长度（horizon）下的训练，含H4与H16匹配/不匹配设置；2）交叉训练状态表示与评估状态表示（compact视图 vs full视图）；3）配对选择任务（两个候选调用均可执行，正确选择依赖表内容）；4）加入显式相关性线索（relevance cue）；5）另做27B ScienceWorld研究以检验结论的任务依赖性。
AI.result: horizon匹配的监督带来高完成率，但H4训练的1.7B模型在全状态观测下向更长工作流迁移很差。H16交叉实验中，compact训练的1.7B适配器在三个配对训练种子上均表现为compact视图50/50、full视图0/50；full训练的模型结果随种子波动。另一对8B适配器呈类似不对称。配对选择任务中也出现视图依赖，compact mask不查阅目标动作；显式相关性线索提升了full视图执行，但未在测试检查点上消除差距。27B ScienceWorld中，compact状态训练在两种视图下均提升局部准确率，说明迁移模式依赖任务与观测构造。
AI.conclusion: 这些实验将"表示敏感迁移"（representation-sensitive transfer）识别为受控工作流中的瓶颈；但尚未能把内容削减（content reduction）与其他观测变化分离开来，因此无法归因于单一因素。作者强调需要进一步解耦表示差异的各成分。

title: Rethinking Supervision in Document Unwarping: A Self-consistent Flow-free Approach
summary: In recent years, the proliferation of smartphones has led to an upsurge in the digitization of document files via these portable devices. However, images captured by smartphones often suffer from distortions, thereby negatively affecting digital preservation and downstream applications. To address this issue, we introduce DRNet, a novel deep network for document image rectification. Our approach is based on three key designs. Firstly, we exploit the intrinsic geometric consistency inherent in document images to guide the learning process of distortion rectification. Secondly, we design a coarse-to-fine rectification network to leverage the representations derived from the distorted document image, thereby enhancing the rectification result. Thirdly, we propose a unique perspective for supervising the learning of rectification networks, where undistorted document images are employed for supervision, which is free of warping mesh as ground truth in existing methods. Technically, both low-level pixel alignment and high-level semantic alignment jointly contribute to the learning of the mapping relationship between deformed document images and distortion-free ones. We evaluate our method on the challenging DocUNet Benchmark dataset, where it sets a series of state-of-the-art records, demonstrating the superiority of our approach compared to existing learning-based solutions. Additionally, we conduct a comprehensive series of ablation experiments to further validate the effectiveness and merits of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DRNet，一种用于文档图像畸变矫正的新型深度网络，基于几何一致性约束、由粗到细的矫正结构和无需形变网格真值的监督策略，在DocUNet基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 智能手机拍摄的文档图像普遍存在畸变，严重影响数字化保存与下游应用。现有基于学习的方法多依赖形变网格（warping mesh）作为真值，标注成本高且受限。
AI.method: 三项关键设计：（1）利用文档图像内在几何一致性引导矫正学习；（2）设计由粗到细的矫正网络，充分利用畸变图像表征提升结果；（3）提出以无畸变文档图像直接监督的监督视角，免去形变网格真值；技术上通过低层像素对齐与高层语义对齐联合学习畸变-无畸变映射关系。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的DocUNet Benchmark上刷新多项最优记录，优于现有基于学习的方案；并通过系列消融实验验证了各设计的有效性与优越性。
AI.conclusion: DRNet通过几何一致性、由粗到细结构与无网格真值监督，实现了高效的文档图像畸变矫正，性能领先且各组件均经实验验证有效。

title: Know Yourself and Know Your Neighbour: A Syntactically Informed Self-Supervised Compositional Sentence Representation Learning Framework using a Recursive Hypernetwork
summary: Sentence representation learning is still an open challenge in Natural Language Processing. In this work, we propose a new self-supervised framework for learning sentence representations, using a special type of neural network called a recursive hypernetwork. Our proposed model composes the representation of a sentence from representations of words by applying a recursive composition through the parse tree. We maintain a separate syntactic and semantic representation, and the semantic composition is guided by the information from the syntactic representation. To train this model, we introduce a novel set of six self-supervised tasks. By analysing the performance on 7 probing tasks, we validate that the generated sentence representation encodes richer linguistic information than both averaging baselines and state-of-the-art alternatives. Furthermore, we assess the impact of the six proposed self-supervised training tasks through ablation studies. We also demonstrate that the representations generated by our model are stable for sentences of varying length and that the semantic composition operators adapt to different syntactic categories\footnote{Code available: https://github.com/vasudev2020/codi/tree/main}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于递归超网络的自监督句子表示学习框架，通过句法树递归组合词表示，分离句法与语义表示并由句法信息指导语义组合，配合六种自监督任务训练，在7项探针任务上优于平均基线及现有方法。
AI.motivation: 句子表示学习仍是NLP的开放挑战，现有方法（如简单平均或主流替代方案）所编码的语言学信息有限，需要更丰富、更稳定的句子表示学习框架。
AI.method: 采用递归超网络，通过句法分析树将词表示递归组合为句子表示；分别维护句法与语义两种表示，语义组合由句法表示的信息引导；引入六种新型自监督任务进行训练，并通过消融实验评估各任务贡献。
AI.result: 在7项探针任务上，所生成句子表示比平均基线和当前最优替代方法编码了更丰富的语言学信息；消融实验验证了六种自监督任务的作用；表示对变化长度的句子保持稳定，且语义组合算子能适应不同句法类别。
AI.conclusion: 该递归超网络自监督框架能够生成语言学信息更丰富、跨句长稳定的句子表示，句法引导的语义组合机制有效，代码已开源。

title: CoverSynth: Coverage-Guided Generation of Retrieval Evaluation Sets
summary: Enterprise agents need retrieval evaluation sets that expose domain-specific failures and guide developers towards efficient deployment tradeoffs. Neither expert-human-authored sets nor current synthetic generation methods provide a methodology for achieving the necessary coverage, reliability, efficiency, and discriminability required for such decision-making. Simultaneously, the field does not have an assessment framework for determining when an evaluation set has satisfied these properties. We introduce an evaluation set assessment framework for these criteria and CoverSynth -- a generator specifically designed to satisfy these criteria without incurring the high cost of human expert labeling. Starting from an unannotated corpus, CoverSynth targets coverage across retrieval demands and system capabilities. Deterministic checks locate evidence quotes in their sources, while model-based checks assess semantic validity to guarantee reliable ground truth. Across five public enterprise-style corpora, our method provides informative variation in difficulty, revealing unseen failure modes such as an inability of agents to handle underspecified or ambiguous requests. On the RepLiQA corpus, 91\% of human-generated queries can be answered by all members on a panel of 12 retrieval systems, compared to only 12\% of CoverSynth-generated queries. Finally, in a repeated TechQA/RepLiQA study, 12 of 12 within-harness model contrasts have positive nominal 95\% intervals on generated sets, compared with 4 of 12 on human sets. CoverSynth makes coverage and evidence quality explicit construction objectives, producing corpus-grounded evaluations that reveal retrieval headroom and differences between agent configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出评估集评估框架与CoverSynth生成器，从无标注语料自动构建覆盖检索需求与系统能力的评测集，无需专家标注即可揭示企业级智能体的失败模式与系统差异。
AI.motivation: 企业级智能体需要能暴露领域特定失败、并指导部署权衡的检索评测集；现有专家人工撰写集与合成生成方法均无法同时满足覆盖性、可靠性、效率与区分度，学界也缺乏判断评测集是否达标的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出评测集评估框架（覆盖性、可靠性、效率、区分度四项准则）与CoverSynth生成器。从无标注语料出发，面向检索需求与系统能力实现覆盖；用确定性检查在原文中定位证据引文，用模型化检查评估语义有效性，以保证ground truth可靠。
AI.result: 在五个企业风格公开语料上产生有信息量的难度变化，揭示未见失败模式（如智能体无法处理欠指定或模糊请求）。RepLiQA上，人类生成查询中91%可被12个检索系统全体回答，而CoverSynth生成查询仅12%。重复TechQA/RepLiQA研究中，生成集上12/12模型对比有正向95%区间，人类集仅4/12。
AI.conclusion: CoverSynth将覆盖性与证据质量作为显式构建目标，生成基于语料的评测，能够揭示检索余量与不同智能体配置间的差异。

title: EmoTrace-Bench: Diagnosing Emotional Expression in Text-to-Video Generation through Controlled Cues and Intensity
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) models are increasingly used to generate videos with targeted emotional expressions, yet existing evaluation methods mainly rely on holistic video-text alignment and provide limited insight into whether failures arise from target-emotion expression, intensity control, or specific affective cues. We introduce EmoTrace-Bench, a fine-grained diagnostic benchmark that controls emotion intensity and selected affective cues in prompts and evaluates generated videos at multiple levels. EmoTrace-Bench contains 448 controlled prompts covering eight emotions, two intensity levels, and diverse cue conditions. Using 12 T2V models, we generate 5,376 videos and evaluate target-emotion presence, perceived intensity, and ten audiovisual dimensions of emotional expression with an automated evaluator calibrated and validated against human annotations on a subset of the data. Results reveal substantial differences across models and prompt designs.
