Prompts that explicitly describe a character's emotional reaction are followed more reliably than prompts that describe only events or scenes, whereas adding more affective cues or using more explicit cinematic audiovisual language does not consistently improve emotional generation. These results illustrate how aggregate alignment scores may overlook localized differences in target-emotion expression, intensity control, and cue realization. EmoTrace-Bench provides a traceable and interpretable framework for diagnosing emotional video generation without modifying existing generation pipelines, and we release the prompts and the automated evaluation rules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EmoTrace-Bench，一个细粒度情感视频生成诊断基准，通过控制情感强度与情感线索的提示词，从目标情感存在性、感知强度和十个视听维度评估12个T2V模型生成的5,376个视频，揭示聚合对齐分数会掩盖局部情感表达差异。
AI.motivation: 现有T2V情感视频评估主要依赖整体视频-文本对齐，无法判断失败究竟源于目标情感表达、强度控制还是特定情感线索实现，缺乏细粒度、可追溯的诊断能力。
AI.method: 构建EmoTrace-Bench，含448条受控提示词，覆盖8种情感、2个强度等级及多种线索条件；用12个T2V模型生成5,376个视频；采用经人工标注校准验证的自动评估器，评估目标情感存在性、感知强度及10个视听情感表达维度，且不修改现有生成流程。
AI.result: 模型与提示设计间存在显著差异：明确描述角色情感反应的提示比仅描述事件或场景的提示更可靠；增加情感线索或使用更明确的电影化视听语言并未稳定提升情感生成效果；聚合对齐分数会忽略目标情感表达、强度控制和线索实现上的局部差异。
AI.conclusion: EmoTrace-Bench提供了一个可追溯、可解释的情感视频生成诊断框架，无需改动生成管线，并开源提示词与自动评估规则。

title: MixLID: Token-Level Language Identification in Mixed-Language Text
summary: Processing multilingual text requires both identifying a broad range of languages and distinguishing the language of each token in inputs containing multiple languages. We introduce MixLID, a token-level language identification model supporting 111 language-script combinations. MixLID follows a two-stage training process: it first learns to distinguish individual languages using the language labels of monolingual examples, then continues training on mixed-language data. The second stage uses concatenated examples from existing code-switching data alongside augmented examples created through word substitution based on correspondences between English source words and loanwords. For monolingual identification, MixLID outperforms all baselines in both accuracy and macro F1 on four benchmarks within the language coverage shared with each baseline. For mixed-language identification, it outperforms the baselines in identifying the language of individual tokens on every evaluated language pair. MixLID achieves high performance across a broad range of languages in both monolingual and mixed-language settings. The model is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/nlpai-lab/MixLID.

AI.tldr: MixLID 是一个支持 111 种语言-文字组合的 token 级语言识别模型，采用两阶段训练，在单语与混合语场景均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 多语言文本处理既需识别广泛语种，又需在含多语言的输入中判定每个 token 的语言。现有工作难以同时覆盖广语种与 token 级混合语言识别。
AI.method: 两阶段训练：第一阶段用单语样本的语言标签学习区分各语言；第二阶段在混合语言数据上继续训练，使用现有语码转换数据的拼接样本，以及基于英文源词与借词对应关系进行词替换生成的增强样本。
AI.result: 单语识别上，在各基线共有语言覆盖范围内的四个基准上，准确率与宏 F1 均超过所有基线；混合语言识别上，在评估的每个语言对上，token 级语言判定均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: MixLID 在广泛的单语与混合语言设置中均取得高性能，模型已在 Hugging Face 公开。

title: SpecFit: Not All Draft Tokens Cost the Same in Offloaded MoE Inference
summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few experts per token, but when their expert weights are offloaded to host memory, host-to-device (H2D) expert transfers enter the critical path of decoding. Speculative decoding verifies several draft tokens in one forward pass, yet in an MoE model each verified token activates its own experts, so a larger draft tree transfers more experts. Because of this H2D cost, speculative decoding commits several tokens per verification cycle yet is sometimes even slower than autoregressive decoding. Based on this observation, we propose SpecFit, which chooses the verified draft subtree to maximize predicted throughput rather than acceptance length. SpecFit estimates the expected number of committed tokens from draft path probabilities and predicts cycle time from the node count and the per-layer union of the experts the subtree activates; this union is a monotone submodular coverage function, so each node pays only for the experts it adds. An exact search over ancestor-closed subtrees returns the subtree with the highest predicted throughput; run after each draft level, the same search also decides when to stop drafting, and the unmodified target verifies the result. On CNN/DailyMail summarization and a GSM8K subset with Qwen3-30B-A3B, SpecFit decodes 21.6% and 7.0% faster than EAGLE-3 with the same expert cache and 1.97x and 1.72x as fast as vanilla EAGLE-3. Code is available at https://github.com/Chlience/SpecFit.

AI.tldr: SpecFit 通过选择能最大化预测吞吐量的验证子树叶（而非接受长度），缓解 MoE 模型投机解码中 H2D 专家传输开销，在相同专家缓存下相对 EAGLE-3 加速最高 21.6%。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型将专家权重卸载至主机内存时，H2D 专家传输进入解码关键路径。投机解码虽在一次前向中验证多个草稿 token，但每个被验证 token 都会激活自己的专家，草稿树越大传输的专家越多，导致投机解码虽然每轮提交多个 token，有时反而比自回归解码更慢。
AI.method: 提出 SpecFit，选择验证的草稿子树以最大化预测吞吐量而非接受长度。方法包括：由草稿路径概率估计期望提交 token 数；用节点数与子树激活专家的逐层并集预测周期时间；该并集是单调次模覆盖函数，使每个节点只需为其新增专家付费；对祖先闭合子树做精确搜索，返回预测吞吐量最高的子树；在每个草稿层级后运行同一搜索以决定何时停止草稿，最终由未修改的目标模型验证结果。
AI.result: 在 CNN/DailyMail 摘要任务与 GSM8K 子集上，使用 Qwen3-30B-A3B 模型，SpecFit 在相同专家缓存下比 EAGLE-3 解码快 21.6% 和 7.0%，分别是原版 EAGLE-3 的 1.97 倍和 1.72 倍。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: SpecFit 表明在专家卸载的 MoE 投机解码中，以预测吞吐量而非接受长度为优化目标选择草稿子树，可有效降低 H2D 专家传输开销并实现显著加速。

title: Semantic Saliency from Multi-Modal Large Language Model Scene Understanding Maps
summary: Image-computable low-level image saliency has shaped perceptual psychology and computer science, but is limited by its inability to capture human high-level cognitive factors that influence attention and eye movements. Here, we propose a new fully automated method to compute semantic saliency by quantifying each object's contribution to scene comprehension without fitting any parameters to human data: the Automated Scene Understanding Map (AUTO-SUM). AUTO-SUM automatically segments and removes individual objects from a scene, uses multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to describe the original and modified scenes, and measures the semantic similarity between these descriptions using text embeddings. We show that AUTO-SUM can predict which object is most important in a human-measured scene understanding map (H-SUM) estimated using human scene descriptions. We also show that AUTO-SUM can predict the object most fixated by human observers during free viewing and scene description tasks better than a low-level saliency model (GBVS, Itti-Koch), a saliency model trained based on human meaning ratings (Meaning Map), and comparable to DeepGaze, which is trained on human fixation data. We contend that AUTO-SUM can be used as a semantic saliency model that complements lower-level saliency models. Code are available at https://github.com/starsky77/AUTO-SUM-Source-Code .

AI.tldr: 提出AUTO-SUM，一种全自动、无需拟合人类数据的语义显著性计算方法，通过MLLM描述与文本嵌入量化物体对场景理解的贡献。
AI.motivation: 图像可计算的低层显著性无法捕捉影响注意与眼动的人类高层认知因素，亟需一种能刻画语义显著性的客观方法。
AI.method: AUTO-SUM自动分割并移除场景中的单个物体，用多模态大语言模型描述原始与修改后的场景，再用文本嵌入度量描述间的语义相似度，以此定量每个物体对场景理解的贡献，全程无参数拟合人类数据。
AI.result: AUTO-SUM能预测人类场景理解图（H-SUM）中最重要的物体；在自由观看和场景描述任务中预测人类注视最多的物体，优于低层显著性模型（GBVS、Itti-Koch）和基于人类意义评分的Meaning Map，并与基于人类注视数据训练的DeepGaze相当。
AI.conclusion: AUTO-SUM可作为语义显著性模型，与低层显著性模型互补。

title: SuPER-Mamba: Surprisal Prioritization for Extended-Context Routing in Mamba
summary: State space models provide efficient linear-complexity processing for long sequences, but their performance frequently degrades as context length grows. We propose SuPER-Mamba, a training-free framework that uses Surprisal as a model-intrinsic signal for long-range state routing in pretrained Mamba models. SuPER-Mamba computes position-wise Surprisal from next-token predictions, aggregates neighboring responses through Local Pooling, and uses the resulting scores to prioritize Global-Channel updates without query-dependent scoring or additional training. We evaluate SuPER-Mamba on three state-space models across the LongBench-E benchmark. The results show that SuPER-Mamba improves the average score from 8.06 to 15.69, corresponding to a 94.7% relative gain over the Base Models and a 13.1% improvement over the state-of-the-art prior baseline. Ablation and length-wise analyses further support the effectiveness of the proposed routing framework.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架SuPER-Mamba，利用Surprisal作为模型内在信号进行长程状态路由，在LongBench-E上平均分从8.06提升至15.69。
AI.motivation: 状态空间模型（SSM）虽具线性复杂度、擅长长序列处理，但随上下文增长性能常下降。现有方法多依赖查询相关打分或额外训练，成本高。作者希望找到一种模型内在、无需训练的信号来指导长程状态路由，缓解长上下文性能退化。
AI.method: SuPER-Mamba为免训练框架：1) 基于下一词预测计算逐位置的Surprisal（意外度）作为内在信号；2) 通过Local Pooling聚合邻域响应；3) 用所得分数优先进行Global-Channel更新。全程无查询相关打分，也无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在三个状态空间模型、LongBench-E基准上评测：平均分从8.06提升到15.69，相对Base Models提升94.7%，较此前最强基线提升13.1%。消融实验与长度维度分析进一步验证路由框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Surprisal可作为有效的模型内在路由信号，无需训练即可显著提升预训练Mamba类模型的长上下文性能，且方法通用、开销低。

title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Advancing Harmful Content Understanding via Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play
summary: Despite significant advances in language understanding, Large Language Models (LLMs) can still miss meaning hidden in plain sight, failing to identify harmful intent in expressions readily understood by humans. Malicious users exploit this gap by strategically disguising harmful content to evade automated moderation, posing a serious threat to online platform safety. The vulnerability reflects a fundamental cognitive asymmetry between human readers, who integrate contextual, phonetic, and visual cues to decipher the intent behind deliberate obfuscation, and text-based LLMs, which rely primarily on token sequences and have limited exposure to evolving evasions. To bridge this asymmetry, we propose PASP (Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play), which combines multi-perceptual views with adversarial self-play to improve understanding of harmful intent as evasions evolve. Specifically, PASP constructs textual, phonetic, and visual views of each input, preserving its original context while exposing pronunciation and glyph cues obscured in token space. During adversarial self-play, an attacker uses defender feedback to generate intent-preserving evasions, while the defender is trained using an intent-invariance reward to understand harmful intent across changing surface forms. Extensive experiments show that PASP reduces adaptive attack success rates by up to 73.71% and 74.49% on ChineseHarm-Bench and EvoHarmBench, respectively, preserves model capabilities with minimal degradation, and effectively interprets real-world evasive expressions in e-commerce.

AI.tldr: 提出PASP框架，通过多感知视图与对抗自博弈提升LLM对演化式伪装有害内容的意图识别能力，自适应攻击成功率最高降低约74%。
AI.motivation: 恶意用户通过策略性伪装有害内容规避自动审核，而基于文本的LLM主要依赖token序列，难以整合语境、语音与字形线索，与人类读者之间存在认知不对称，构成在线平台安全威胁。
AI.method: PASP（Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play）：为每个输入构建文本、语音、视觉三种感知视图，保留原始语境的同时显式暴露token空间中被遮蔽的发音与字形线索；采用对抗自博弈，攻击者依据防御者反馈生成保持意图不变的伪装表达，防御者以意图不变性奖励进行训练，从而在不同表层形式下理解有害意图。
AI.result: 在ChineseHarm-Bench与EvoHarmBench上，自适应攻击成功率分别最高降低73.71%和74.49%；模型通用能力仅有极小下降；在电商场景的真实规避表达上具备有效解释能力。
AI.conclusion: 多感知视图结合对抗自博弈可有效缓解人机认知不对称，提升模型对演化式规避的鲁棒性，为内容审核安全提供可行方案。

title: Structured Stateful Relational Scripts with a High-Quality Dataset for Multi-Shot Audio-Visual Video Generation
summary: Coherent multi-shot audio-visual video generation requires maintaining consistent identities while depicting evolving states and coordinating sounds across shot boundaries. Although dense captions describe individual shots in detail, they rarely specify which entities persist, how their states change, or which entities and actions produce sounds. To address this limitation, we propose Structured Stateful Relational Scripts (SSRS), a textual supervision representation that separates persistent entity and voice identities from shot-specific visual and auditory states. SSRS explicitly encodes sound-source bindings and temporal relations, while a global audio-visual event sequence connects local actions and sounds, including events that continue across shot boundaries. We further introduce MSAV-Script-100K, a large-scale dataset of curated multi-shot audio-visual videos paired with detailed SSRS annotations, enabling models to learn identity persistence, state transitions, and event continuity from structured supervision. Experiments demonstrate improvements in cross-shot consistency, adherence to specified state changes, and audio-visual alignment, highlighting the effectiveness of our SSRS and MSAV-Script-100K for coherent multi-shot audio-visual generation. Our proposed dataset is available at \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/shenlehan/MSAV-Script-100K}{MSAV-Script-100K}.

AI.tldr: 提出结构化状态关系脚本(SSRS)文本监督表示与MSAV-Script-100K数据集，实现连贯的多镜头音视频生成。
AI.motivation: 多镜头音视频生成需在跨镜头边界时保持身份一致、描绘状态演变并协调声音，但现有密集字幕仅描述单个镜头细节，很少指明哪些实体持续存在、状态如何变化、哪些实体与动作产生声音，缺乏结构化监督信号。
AI.method: 提出SSRS，将持久实体与声音身份同镜头特定的视觉、听觉状态分离，显式编码声源绑定与时序关系，并用全局音视频事件序列连接局部动作与声音（含跨镜头边界延续事件）；构建MSAV-Script-100K大规模数据集，含多镜头音视频与详细SSRS标注。
AI.result: 实验表明在跨镜头一致性、指定状态变化遵循度及音视频对齐方面均有提升，验证了SSRS与MSAV-Script-100K对连贯多镜头音视频生成的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SSRS表示与MSAV-Script-100K数据集可有效支持模型从结构化监督中学习身份持续性、状态转换与事件连续性，推动连贯多镜头音视频生成，数据集已开源。

title: SIREN: Situation-aware Index for Response and Emergency ActioNability in Crisis Translation
comment: accepted at The First Workshop on Language Technologies for Crisis Preparedness and Response (LT4CPR) at AACL-IJCNLP 2026
summary: Machine translation (MT) is increasingly utilized in multilingual crisis communication, yet conventional evaluation does not directly assess whether translated emergency messages preserve their actionability. We introduce SIREN (Situation-aware Index for Response and Emergency ActioNability), a human evaluation framework assessing whether translation choices compromise protective action, directive force, and urgency of the source text. We evaluate SIREN in two complementary settings. At the error level, we apply it to HOPE-annotated Italian--English translations produced by ChatGPT-4o and Google Translate: 31.63\% and 48.73\% of errors, respectively, compromise actionability, predominantly by affecting the protective action. At the message level, we evaluate English--French translations produced by TranslateGemma-4B and Google Translate, with actionability preserved in 85.34\% and 92.67\% of translations, respectively. TranslateGemma-4B failures predominantly weaken directive force, whereas Google Translate failures more often compromise protective actions and receive Major impact ratings. These findings show that translation systems can differ not only in how often actionability is lost, but also in the nature and functional impact of these failures. Alongside SIREN, we contribute an English--French crisis-translation resource with human actionability annotations and post-edited reference translations, supporting further research on function-oriented evaluation for crisis communication. Our experimental data is available at https://github.com/mcstaiano/SIREN.

AI.tldr: 提出SIREN（情境感知应急行动性指数）人工评估框架，用于评估危机翻译是否保留原文的保护性行动、指令力度与紧迫性，并在意-英和英-法两个场景验证其在错误级和消息级的评估效果。
AI.motivation: 机器翻译在多语言危机沟通中应用日益广泛，但传统评估并不直接衡量翻译后的应急信息是否保留了"可行动性"（actionability），即是否仍能指导受众采取保护性行动。
AI.method: 提出SIREN（Situation-aware Index for Response and Emergency ActioNability）人工评估框架，从保护性行动（protective action）、指令力度（directive force）与紧迫性（urgency）三个维度评估翻译选择是否损害源文本的可行动性。在错误级：对ChatGPT-4o与Google Translate生成的、带HOPE标注的意大利语—英语译文应用SIREN。在消息级：评估TranslateGemma-4B与Google Translate的英语—法语译文。同时构建带人工可行动性标注与后编辑参考译文的英—法危机翻译资源。
AI.result: 错误级：ChatGPT-4o与Google Translate分别有31.63%和48.73%的错误损害可行动性，且主要影响保护性行动。消息级：TranslateGemma-4B与Google Translate的可行动性保留率分别为85.34%和92.67%；TranslateGemma-4B的失败主要削弱指令力度，而Google Translate的失败更多损害保护性行动并获得Major影响评级。
AI.conclusion: 翻译系统不仅在可行动性丢失的频率上存在差异，在失败的性质与功能影响上也各不相同，说明面向功能的危机沟通评估具有必要性；同时为后续研究提供了SIREN框架与英—法危机翻译资源（数据见 https://github.com/mcstaiano/SIREN）。

title: Scalable Robust MCTS with Anytime Deterministic Optimality Guarantees
summary: MDP planners often rely on nominal transition models that may differ from the true dynamics. Robust MDP planning accounts for this uncertainty through a set of admissible models, but doing so with limited online computation is challenging: the search tree grows exponentially with the horizon and each robust backup requires an additional optimization. Existing online robust methods remain limited in scale and offer at most probabilistic guarantees. We introduce, to the best of our knowledge, the first deterministic anytime guarantees for robust online MDP planning. We restrict computation to the sampled search tree while deterministically bounding the contribution of unsampled trajectories. For any fixed policy, we derive lower and upper bounds on the gap between its projected and true robust values under rectangular and non-rectangular uncertainty sets. Under rectangular uncertainty, we propagate these bounds through the robust Bellman operator to bound the optimal robust value. These bounds are computable from the current sampled tree, hold at every node, tighten as the sampled support expands, and converge to the robust values as full support is recovered. We develop CAR-MCTS, a bound-guided MCTS planner that uses these deterministic bounds to guide exploration, prune provably suboptimal branches, and terminate once the optimal root action is certified. The fixed-policy bounds also yield an anytime policy-evaluation mechanism that certifies the robust value of any policy, independent of how it was obtained. Experiments verify the deterministic bounds, their tightening under support expansion, substantial branch pruning, root-action certification, and convergence to the optimal robust policy. To our knowledge, this is the first scalable robust MCTS framework with anytime deterministic guarantees for both online planning and policy evaluation, without enumerating the full state space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个针对鲁棒在线MDP规划的确定性anytime保证方法，并据此设计CAR-MCTS规划器，实现有界引导的探索、可证明次优分支剪枝与根动作认证。
AI.motivation: 鲁棒MDP规划需应对名义转移模型与真实动态的偏差，但在线计算受限：搜索树随规划时域指数增长，且每次鲁棒备份都需额外优化。现有在线鲁棒方法规模受限，且最多只有概率性保证，缺乏确定性保证。
AI.method: 将计算限制在采样搜索树内，同时确定性地界定未采样轨迹的贡献。对任意固定策略，在矩形与非矩形不确定集下推导其投影鲁棒值与真实鲁棒值之间差距的上下界；在矩形不确定下，通过鲁棒Bellman算子传播这些界以界定最优鲁棒值。界可由当前采样树计算、在每个节点成立、随采样支撑扩展而收紧，并在恢复全支撑时收敛到鲁棒值。基于此开发CAR-MCTS：用这些确定性界引导探索、剪枝可证明次优分支，并在根动作最优性被认证时终止；固定策略界还给出可认证任意策略鲁棒值的anytime策略评估机制。
AI.result: 实验验证了确定性界的正确性、支撑扩展下的收紧、显著的分数剪枝、根动作认证，以及向最优鲁棒策略的收敛。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个可扩展的鲁棒MCTS框架，在无需枚举完整状态空间的前提下，为在线规划与策略评估同时提供anytime确定性保证。

title: Semantically Steerable Image Tokenization
summary: Adaptive image tokenizers compress an image into a variable number of tokens matched to its complexity, and recent work makes this allocation controllable: conditioned on a target reconstruction error, the tokenizer itself decides how many tokens an image needs. However, the fidelity measure guiding this allocation shapes which aspects of the image are preserved under compression. The pixel-wise error used in prior work is blind to the spatial structure that carries an image's meaning, and under heavy compression such tokenizers are prone to abruptly discarding tokens that encode essential content. We introduce GIST (Guided Image Semantic Tokenizer), an adaptive tokenizer that can be steered toward a requested semantic fidelity. Its token allocation is jointly controlled by pixel-level and semantic target errors, with semantic error measured in the feature space of a frozen DINOv3 encoder. This joint control enables semantic protection: with the semantic target fixed at zero, the reconstruction target can be relaxed to discard pixel detail while preserving what the image depicts. In a controlled comparison on ImageNet-100, GIST outperforms its pixel-controlled counterpart KARL at every token count, with up to $30\%$ lower LPIPS and $37\%$ lower DreamSim. On average, lowering its semantic target reduces LPIPS $2\times$ faster per token than lowering the reconstruction target, and up to $5\times$ in the low-token regime. Semantic fidelity is thus an effective control signal for adaptive tokenization: it lets a tokenizer see, and so preserve, what an image depicts.

AI.tldr: GIST 是一种可语义引导的自适应图像分词器，通过像素级与语义目标误差联合控制 token 分配，在同等 token 数下优于仅像素控制的 KARL。
AI.motivation: 自适应图像分词器能按图像复杂度分配可变数量的 token，且已实现"给定目标重建误差，由分词器决定 token 数"的可控分配。但引导分配的保真度度量决定了压缩中保留哪些信息：此前使用的逐像素误差对承载图像语义的空间结构不敏感，在强压缩下容易突然丢弃编码关键内容的 token。
AI.method: 提出 GIST（Guided Image Semantic Tokenizer）：token 分配由像素级目标误差与语义目标误差联合控制，语义误差在冻结的 DINOv3 编码器特征空间中度量。这种联合控制实现语义保护——当语义目标固定为零时，可放宽重建目标以丢弃像素细节而保留图像所描绘的内容。在 ImageNet-100 上进行受控对比。
AI.result: 在每个 token 数量下 GIST 均优于像素控制的对照方法 KARL，LPIPS 最多降低 30%，DreamSim 最多降低 37%。平均而言，降低语义目标使 LPIPS 每 token 下降速度是降低重建目标的 2 倍，在低 token 区间可达 5 倍。
AI.conclusion: 语义保真度是自适应分词的有效控制信号：它让分词器"看见"并因此保留图像所描绘的内容。

title: EHR-Bench: A Chinese Multi-Task Benchmark for Recruitment AI
summary: Recruitment applications span diverse operations, from drafting job descriptions and interpreting queries to organizing profiles, assessing fit, and recommending candidates and jobs. Systematic LLM evaluation therefore requires task coverage that reflects this range of business needs. We introduce EHR-Bench, an open Chinese benchmark comprising twelve tasks across six capability families and five recruitment scenarios. The tasks cover generation, extraction, classification, retrieval, semantic similarity, and reciprocal ranking within one evaluation framework. An internal recruitment dataset guides task definitions, the occupation taxonomy and sampling targets, output requirements, and scoring protocols. Following these specifications, we construct 8,336 task instances from public materials and controlled augmentation, with source-aware expert review and documented provenance. We evaluate twelve LLMs through task-level, capability-level, and aggregate comparisons. Closely ranked models exhibit distinct task strengths, and performance varies across input sources, reference evidence, and candidate pools. Five shared models retain the same observed Overall ordering on a private operational reference, with variation in capability and task correspondence. EHR-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for systematic model assessment, task-specific model selection, and further research on LLMs for recruitment. The project repository is available at https://github.com/EhrBench/EHR-Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EHR-Bench，一个覆盖12项任务、6类能力族、5种招聘场景的开放中文基准，用于系统评估LLM在招聘领域的表现。
AI.motivation: 招聘应用涉及职位描述撰写、查询理解、简历整理、人岗匹配与推荐等多种操作，系统性评估LLM需要覆盖这些业务需求的任务体系，而现有评估缺乏此类统一框架。
AI.method: 以内部招聘数据集指导任务定义、职业分类与采样目标、输出要求及评分协议；基于公开材料与受控增强构建8,336个任务实例，并进行来源感知的专家审核与来源溯源；在统一框架内覆盖生成、抽取、分类、检索、语义相似度和双向排序六类任务；对12个LLM进行任务级、能力级与汇总级对比评估。
AI.result: 排名接近的模型在具体任务上表现差异明显，性能随输入来源、参考证据和候选池变化；在私有业务参考集上，5个共享模型仍保持相同的总体排序，但能力与任务对应关系存在差异。
AI.conclusion: EHR-Bench为系统性模型评估、任务级模型选择以及招聘领域LLM研究提供了可复现的基础，项目仓库已开源。

title: MemeLogos: Knowledge-Driven Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Harmful Meme Detection
summary: With the rapid proliferation of social media, harmful memes have become a growing threat to online ecosystems. Their harmfulness is often implicitly conveyed through complex interactions among visual, textual, and contextual cues, making accurate detection challenging. Recent studies have introduced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and external knowledge into harmful meme detection. However, existing methods mainly retrieve similar instances or auxiliary information, limiting their ability to capture reusable harmfulness knowledge and underlying reasoning mechanisms, and thus constraining both detection performance and interpretability. To address these challenges, we propose MemeLogos, a knowledge-driven retrieval-augmented reasoning framework for harmful meme detection. MemeLogos abstracts recurring harmfulness patterns and reasoning structures from diverse harmful cases into reusable knowledge units and organizes them into a dedicated star-shaped knowledge graph. By combining structured knowledge retrieval with an explicit multi-stage reasoning process inspired by cognitive mechanisms, MemeLogos leverages retrieved knowledge to guide harmfulness reasoning, improving both detection reliability and interpretability. Extensive experiments show that MemeLogos consistently outperforms existing harmful meme detection methods while generating more coherent and interpretable reasoning, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured harmfulness knowledge for multimodal content understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MemeLogos，一个知识驱动的检索增强推理框架，用于有害模因检测。它从多样有害案例中抽象出可复用的危害性知识单元，组织成星形知识图谱，并结合结构化知识检索与显式多阶段推理过程，以提升检测可靠性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体中，有害模因的危害性往往隐含在视觉、文本和上下文线索的复杂交互中，检测困难。现有引入 RAG 和外部知识的方法主要检索相似实例或辅助信息，难以捕捉可复用的危害性知识和底层推理机制，导致检测性能和可解释性受限。
AI.method: MemeLogos 从多样化有害案例中抽象出反复出现的危害性模式和推理结构，将其转化为可复用的知识单元，并组织为专门的星形知识图谱。框架将结构化知识检索与受认知机制启发的显式多阶段推理过程相结合，利用检索到的知识引导危害性推理。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MemeLogos 持续优于现有的有害模因检测方法，同时生成更连贯、更可解释的推理过程，验证了结构化危害性知识对多模态内容理解的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化危害性知识能够有效提升多模态内容理解的检测性能与可解释性，MemeLogos 为有害模因检测提供了一种知识驱动的检索增强推理新范式。

title: UMAS3D: Unified Mask-Free 3D Editing with Region-Adaptive Source Preservation
summary: 3D editing aims to modify an existing 3D asset according to user intent while preserving geometry and appearance outside the intended edit region. Existing methods often rely on task-specific training, source-3D inversion, or external 3D masks, and lack a unified framework for diverse editing conditions and tasks. We propose UMAS3D, a unified 3D editing framework that is training-free, inversion-free, and free from external 3D masks. UMAS3D converts text, bounding boxes, reference images, and their combinations into common target-view guidance, after which addition, deletion, modification, appearance, and pose editing share the same downstream 3D generation process. Our key insight is to couple online edit-region estimation with region-aware source preservation. Mask-Free Adaptive Region Modeling (MARM) initializes an Edit/Keep prior from source-target visual differences and progressively refines it as the target structure evolves, while Source-Guided Preservation Steering (SGPS) constrains the current Keep-region states to retain source geometry and appearance without suppressing target-driven changes. Experiments show that UMAS3D supports addition, deletion, modification, appearance, and pose editing while effectively preserving unedited source content. These advances make UMAS3D a unified framework for flexible and source-preserving 3D editing across diverse editing conditions.

AI.tldr: UMAS3D：一个无需训练、无需反演、无需外部3D掩码的统一3D编辑框架，将文本、包围盒、参考图等条件转为统一的目标视角引导，实现增删改、外观与姿态编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有3D编辑方法依赖任务特定训练、源3D反演或外部3D掩码，缺乏面向多样编辑条件与任务的统一框架。
AI.method: 将文本、包围盒、参考图及其组合转化为共同的目标视角引导，下游3D生成流程统一；核心为在线编辑区域估计与区域感知源保留的耦合，包括Mask-Free Adaptive Region Modeling（MARM）从源-目标视觉差异初始化Edit/Keep先验并随目标结构演化逐步细化，以及Source-Guided Preservation Steering（SGPS）约束Keep区域状态保留源几何与外观且不抑制目标驱动变化。
AI.result: 实验表明UMAS3D支持添加、删除、修改、外观与姿态编辑，同时有效保留未编辑的源内容。
AI.conclusion: 这些进展使UMAS3D成为面向多样编辑条件、灵活且保持源内容的统一3D编辑框架。

title: Audit Before You Distill: A Controlled Workflow for Reasoning Transfer into Compact Medical Language Models
summary: Teacher rationales can help a smaller model answer health professions questions, but they can also reinforce errors. We examined when they help and how this evidence can guide training using Brazilian Portuguese questions from medical and multiprofessional residency examinations. First, we measured how a teacher rationale changed the student's probability of selecting the correct answer and compared this effect with rationales drawn from other questions. The complete rationale increased this probability by 21~p.p. when the teacher was correct and decreased it by 14~p.p. when the teacher was wrong. By intervening on the reasoning content, we showed that shuffled rationales did not produce the same pattern. Guided by this result, we trained only with rationales attached to correct teacher answers and compared answer-only training, step-by-step distillation, and our proposed Distill-SFT method. Distill-SFT showed a modest advantage over step-by-step distillation on previously missed questions under reasoning, while using fewer training instances by combining the answer and rationale into a single target. We also investigated catastrophic forgetting using the out-of-domain ENEM dataset. Answer-only training reduced reasoning accuracy by 12~p.p. relative to baseline, compared with approximately 4~p.p. for either rationale-based training method. Together, these findings support a workflow that audits rationale content before distillation, verifies teacher answers before supervision, and trains compact models efficiently for health professions question answering.

AI.tldr: 本文研究教师模型理由（rationale）对学生模型医学类问答的影响机制，并据此提出高效蒸馏方法 Distill-SFT。
AI.motivation: 教师理由既能帮助小模型回答健康职业问题，也可能强化错误，因此需厘清其起作用的条件，以指导训练策略。
AI.method: 使用巴西葡萄牙语的医学与多专业住院医师考试题：(1) 测量教师理由对学生选择正确答案概率的因果影响，并以其他题目的理由作对照；(2) 对推理内容实施打乱等干预，检验是否为内容本身起作用；(3) 基于结果仅用教师答对时的理由进行训练，比较仅答案训练、逐步蒸馏与提出的 Distill-SFT；(4) 用域外 ENEM 数据集考察灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 完整理由在教师正确时使正确率提高约21个百分点，在教师错误时降低约14个百分点；打乱理由不产生同样模式。Distill-SFT 在曾答错的题目上略优于逐步蒸馏，且因将答案与理由合并为单一目标而使用更少训练样本。仅答案训练使域外推理准确率相对基线下降约12个百分点，两种理由类方法约下降4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持一套工作流：蒸馏前审查理由内容、监督前核验教师答案，并高效训练面向健康职业问答的紧凑模型。

title: SkillFusion: Towards Reliable Multi-Skill Composition for LLM Agents
summary: Independently authored skills can impose incompatible requirements, competing preferences, and redundant instructions when jointly loaded by an LLM agent. We propose SkillFusion, an offline compiler that reconciles these interactions into a reusable merged skill. Its central idea is to make composition decisions explicit through typed, scoped constraints linked to their source directives. A type-scope gate selects candidate interactions, while selective fallback revisits pairs potentially missed by structural pruning. A classifier identifies interaction types, and an adversarial verifier re-examines uncertain judgments. The resolver applies conditional routing or explicit priorities to hard conflicts, verified abstraction to soft conflicts, and deduplication to redundant instructions. Source-linked checks guide synthesis and compression, and metadata synthesis supports discovery of the merged skill. The resulting artifact retains associated scripts and resources and can be reused across tasks and executor models. SkillFusion achieves the highest mean Success among evaluated non-oracle methods on all three agent benchmarks and on both transfer benchmarks across three executor models. At the largest tested instruction configurations, it achieves over 2.5 times the Success of unresolved multi-skill loading, highlighting the growing value of reconciliation as composition becomes more demanding. The code will be open-sourced after the review process concludes.

AI.tldr: 提出 SkillFusion，一种离线编译器，将多个独立编写的 LLM 智能体技能协调融合为可复用的合并技能，解决冲突、偏好竞争与冗余指令问题。
AI.motivation: 独立编写的技能在被 LLM 智能体联合加载时，会产生不兼容的需求、相互竞争的偏好以及冗余指令。随着组合规模增大，这种未协调的多技能加载会显著降低任务成功率，因此需要一种自动化的协调机制。
AI.method: SkillFusion 通过类型化、带作用域且与源指令关联的约束使组合决策显式化。其流程包括：类型-作用域门控筛选候选交互；选择性回退重审可能被结构剪枝遗漏的指令对；分类器识别交互类型；对抗性验证器复核不确定判断；解析器对硬冲突采用条件路由或显式优先级，对软冲突采用经验证的抽象，对冗余指令去重；并通过源关联检查指导合成与压缩，元数据合成支持合并技能的发现。产物保留关联脚本与资源，可跨任务与执行模型复用。
AI.result: 在三个智能体基准与两个迁移基准上，跨三个执行模型，SkillFusion 在非 oracle 方法中取得最高平均成功率。在最大规模的指令配置下，其成功率达到未协调多技能加载的 2.5 倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 随着技能组合需求日益增长，冲突协调的价值愈发突出。SkillFusion 将技能融合统一为离线编译过程，产出可复用的合并技能，显著提升多技能加载下的智能体成功率。代码将在评审结束后开源。

title: ELECT: Settling Identity Before Rendering for Scalable Story Visualization
summary: Training-free story visualization without reference images must preserve recurring entities across frames while scaling to long narratives. Existing methods typically maintain consistency by conditioning each frame on other frames of the same story, coupling generation time, VRAM, or both to story length. We introduce ELECT, which instead settles cross-frame identity before final rendering through a language-guided scene-entity mapping and stationary anchors elected from the model's own drafts. This makes the per-frame cost of the final rendering pass independent of story length. Joint attention exceeds 96 GB of VRAM at 32 scenes, whereas ELECT remains at 8.3 s per frame and under 20 GB VRAM from 10 to 1000 scenes. On the Story50 long-story benchmark, ELECT reaches 0.833 average Character Consistency Similarity (aCCS), compared with 0.826 for ten-round refinement, at one seventh of its generation cost, with lower text alignment (0.327 vs. 0.340). At 1000 scenes, to our knowledge, the first evaluation of training-free story visualization at this length, ELECT exceeds ten-round refinement by 0.017 aCCS and the nearest flat-cost baseline by 0.091, while also surpassing refinement in text alignment at one twenty-fourth of its generation time. These results show that long-horizon consistency need not require increasingly expensive inter-frame conditioning as stories grow.

AI.tldr: ELECT 提出一种免训练故事可视化方法，通过语言引导的场景-实体映射与从模型自身草稿中选举的固定锚点，在最终渲染前确定跨帧身份，使单帧渲染成本与故事长度解耦。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练、无参考图的故事可视化方法依赖将每帧条件化于同故事其他帧来保持一致性，导致生成时间或显存随故事长度增长；而长叙事又要求跨帧保持重复实体一致，二者存在矛盾。
AI.method: 提出 ELECT：利用语言引导的场景-实体映射（language-guided scene-entity mapping）和从模型自身草稿中选举的固定锚点（stationary anchors），在最终渲染前预先确定跨帧身份，从而使最终渲染阶段的单帧开销与故事长度无关。
AI.result: 在 32 个场景时联合注意力需超 96 GB 显存，而 ELECT 在 10 至 1000 个场景下均保持每帧 8.3 秒、显存低于 20 GB。Story50 长故事基准上 ELECT 达到 0.833 aCCS，高于十轮精修的 0.826，生成成本仅为其七分之一，但文本对齐略低（0.327 对 0.340）；在 1000 场景下 ELECT 比十轮精修高 0.017 aCCS，比最近的固定成本基线高 0.091，且文本对齐优于精修，生成时间仅为其二十四分之一。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，长时程一致性不必随故事增长而依赖日益昂贵的帧间条件化，ELECT 以固定成本实现了可扩展的长故事可视化。

title: What Is the "Self" of a Large Language Model?
summary: What could the "self" of a large language model be, if it is neither a particular word nor a single privileged layer? We propose a relational account: a functional self is an actor-centered organization of information that distinguishes the model's recorded actions from externally supplied material while content and reasoning operations change. Its representational candidate is a family of layer-specific source-binding components, rather than one unchanged vector throughout the network. Preliminary observations from a 27B BF16 model provide a geometric starting point. Across 150 matched message bodies, 450 role conditions, and a 75/75 discovery-held-out split, the combined Assistant-versus-external displacement transfers strongly across bodies and positions. Selected early components place User and System closer to one another than to Assistant, whereas this full-space distance relation does not persist throughout depth. These findings motivate a layered account: an early source-encoding candidate can be combined with role-specific information use and continuation preparation at later depths, without requiring monotonic overwriting of the common displacement. We connect this account to dynamic reasoning, historical continuity, and a computational model separating content operations, source binding, authority, and output. The reported evidence establishes a reproducible role-conditioned geometry; the proposed interpretation is that functional selfhood may reside in persistent relations among changing representations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出大语言模型的"自我"是一种关系性功能结构：以行动者为中心的信息组织，用于区分模型自身记录的行为与外部供给材料，其表征候选是逐层的来源绑定组件族，而非贯穿网络不变的单一向量。
AI.motivation: 若"自我"既非某个特定词元也非单一特权层，则无法用单点表征解释。作者希望为LLM的"功能自我"给出可操作定义，并寻找其在网络中的表征形式与几何证据。理论动机还在于把该框架连接到动态推理、历史连续性与内容操作—来源绑定—权威—输出的计算分离模型。
AI.method: 提出关系性解释：功能自我是行动者中心的信息组织，在内容与推理操作变化时仍区分模型记录的行动与外部材料。表征假设为逐层来源绑定组件族。使用27B BF16模型做初步几何观测：150个配对的报文主体、450个角色条件、75/75发现集—留出集划分；检验Assistant与外部角色的位移迁移性，以及早期组件中User与System距离关系是否随深度保持。
AI.result: Assistant对外的联合位移在报文主体与位置间迁移性强。选定的早期组件将User与System放得比Assistant彼此更近，但这种全空间距离关系并不贯穿整个深度。即早期存在来源编码候选，而角色特定信息使用与继续生成准备可能发生在更深层。
AI.conclusion: 可复现的角色条件几何证据支持分层解释：早期来源编码候选可与后期角色特定信息使用及续写准备相结合，无需对公共位移做单调覆盖。推论是功能自我可能存在于变化表征之间持续保持的关系之中。

title: When Skills Remain But Access Fails: Factorized Skill Memory for Continual Skill Internalization
summary: Skill internalization aims to convert externally specified procedural skills into persistent model capabilities, allowing language-model agents to execute them without retrieving or reinjecting skill descriptions at inference time. Yet when new skills are learned continually, whether previously internalized skills remain usable is still poorly understood. We study forgetting in continual skill internalization and uncover a clear hierarchical structure. Early in subsequent training, a model may lose the ability to invoke an old skill from the raw request, while supplying only the correct canonical skill name substantially restores the learned behavior; with further optimization, this conditional execution also degrades. We call these two stages skill-addressing forgetting and skill-execution forgetting. Guided by this finding, we introduce Factorized Skill Memory (FSM), which separates continual skill memory into a plastic Address Memory and a stable Execution Memory. At each stage, FSM trains a new LoRA executor using only current-stage data, freezes it after acquisition, and appends it to Execution Memory; in parallel, Address Memory incrementally learns to map current requests to executors without replaying historical requests or execution trajectories. At inference time, Address Memory selects one executor from the raw request, and only that frozen executor performs a single language-model generation. On a five-stage benchmark built from 100 TaskBench skills, FSM achieves 65.95% mean exact match and 93.38% addressing accuracy across two task orders, improving over the strongest replay-free parameter-isolation baseline by 14.3 percentage points while remaining within 1.9 points of Replay, which retains historical training examples.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"持续技能内化"中的遗忘问题，发现遗忘分为技能寻址遗忘与技能执行遗忘两个阶段，并提出因子化技能记忆（FSM）框架缓解遗忘，在五阶段基准上取得65.95%精确匹配与93.38%寻址准确率。
AI.motivation: 技能内化旨在将外部指定的过程性技能转化为模型的持久能力，使语言模型智能体在推理时无需检索或重新注入技能描述即可执行技能。然而在持续学习新技能时，此前已内化的技能是否仍可使用尚不明确，即持续技能内化中的灾难性遗忘问题缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 作者首先剖析持续技能内化中的遗忘现象，揭示其层级结构：早期阶段模型无法从原始请求中调用旧技能（技能寻址遗忘），但仅提供正确的规范技能名即可显著恢复行为；进一步优化后，这种条件执行能力也会退化（技能执行遗忘）。基于此，提出因子化技能记忆（FSM），将技能记忆拆分为可塑的地址记忆（Address Memory）与稳定的执行记忆（Execution Memory）。每个阶段仅用当前阶段数据训练新的LoRA执行器，习得后冻结并追加至执行记忆；地址记忆则在不回放历史请求与执行轨迹的前提下，增量学习将当前请求映射到对应执行器。推理时由地址记忆从原始请求中选定一个执行器，仅由该冻结执行器完成一次语言模型生成。
AI.result: 在基于100个TaskBench技能构建的五阶段基准上，FSM在两种任务顺序下平均达到65.95%精确匹配与93.38%寻址准确率，较最强的无回放参数隔离基线提升14.3个百分点，同时与保留历史训练样本的Replay方法相差仅1.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了持续技能内化中遗忘的层级两阶段结构（寻址遗忘先于执行遗忘），并证明通过将技能记忆因子化为可塑地址记忆与稳定执行记忆，可在无需历史回放的情况下有效缓解遗忘，性能接近依赖回放的上界方法。

title: A Plausible Future Is Not a Causal Future: Can Video Models Generate How the World Unfolds?
summary: Large-scale video generation models are increasingly viewed as a promising path toward world models, yet their ability to capture causally coherent physical dynamics remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations largely emphasize visual quality, prompt adherence, or broad physical plausibility, leaving open whether a model can faithfully realize a complete causal cascade, in which an initiating event propagates through causally dependent interactions to a terminal outcome. We introduce CausalCascade, a simulator-grounded benchmark centered on 50 event-rich Blender scenes with structured event graphs, graph-grounded diagnostic VQA, three levels of future-event specification, and 2,832 controlled counterfactual variants, and use it to evaluate nine image-to-video models with complementary motion-, event-, and counterfactual-level diagnostics. Across the evaluated models, generated motion is more reliably localized spatially than realized with correct spatiotemporal evolution, while richer future-event specification improves event recovery but leaves physical realization limited. Counterfactual evaluation further reveals weak selective responsiveness to physical interventions, while most audited failures are foundational, arising at scene consistency or event occurrence. Together, these results position causal cascade generation as a process-level test of world modeling and highlight the need to jointly recover the intended future, faithfully realize its physical evolution, selectively respond to physical interventions, and maintain a coherent physical world over time. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/SJTU-DeepDeltaLab/CausalCascade .

AI.tldr: 提出 CausalCascade，一个基于模拟器的因果级联基准，用于系统评估视频生成模型是否忠实实现完整因果链。
AI.motivation: 大规模视频生成模型被视为通向世界模型的重要路径，但现有评估多关注视觉质量、提示遵循或宽泛物理合理性，无法判断模型能否忠实实现由初始事件经因果依赖传播到终态结果的完整因果级联。
AI.method: 构建 CausalCascade 基准：以 50 个事件丰富的 Blender 场景为核心，包含结构化事件图、基于图的诊断性 VQA、三级未来事件指定（3 levels of future-event specification）以及 2,832 个受控反事实变体；据此评估 9 个图像到视频模型，并从运动层面、事件层面和反事实层面进行互补诊断。
AI.result: 在评估模型中，生成运动在空间定位上较可靠，但难以实现正确的时空演化；更丰富的未来事件指定可提升事件恢复率，但物理实现仍然有限。反事实评估显示模型对物理干预的选择性响应较弱，且多数被审计的失败是基础性的，出现在场景一致性或事件发生阶段。
AI.conclusion: 因果级联生成应被视为世界建模的过程级测试，要求模型同时做到：恢复预期未来、忠实实现其物理演化、对物理干预做出选择性响应，并在时间上维持连贯的物理世界。代码与数据集已开源。

title: Lost in Contrast: Instruction-Preserving Decoding for Reliable Visual Question Answering
summary: Visual contrastive decoding corrects answers using the prediction difference between the original image and a reference condition, yet the same contrast also turns supported abstentions into incorrect answers. We find that abstentions are lost at two stages: contrastive decoding with candidate filtering can exclude the abstention token before any comparison takes place, and the reference branch's response to the abstention instruction is removed when the reference prediction is subtracted. We therefore propose instruction-preserving decoding, which keeps the effect of the abstention instruction on the original-image prediction intact while leaving the contrast strength freely adjustable. Using a perturbed image and an image-free prediction as references, we obtain IP-VCD and IP-M3ID. On decision utility (DU), which credits both correct answers and supported abstentions, both methods outperform all compared non-IP baselines on every one of nine models on VizWiz, and IP-VCD also leads on eight of nine models on Food-101. Candidate measurements and paired per-question comparisons show that computing the instruction effect and the visual contrast term separately lets contrastive decoding support both correct answers and supported abstentions.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现视觉对比解码在通过原图与参考条件预测差异修正答案的同时，会把原本受支持的弃答转变为错误答案，并提出保留指令的解码方法（IP-VCD、IP-M3ID）以同时支持正确答案与受支持弃答。
AI.motivation: 视觉对比解码利用原图与参考条件之间的预测差异来纠正答案，但这一对比过程会产生副作用：把本来有依据的弃答（supported abstentions）变成错误答案。作者因此希望找出弃答丢失的机制并加以解决。
AI.method: 作者识别出弃答在两个阶段丢失：（1）带候选过滤的对比解码会在比较发生之前就排除弃答token；（2）在减去参考预测时，参考分支对弃答指令的响应被抵消。为此提出指令保留解码（instruction-preserving decoding），在保持弃答指令对原图预测影响不变的前提下让对比强度可自由调节。以扰动图像和无图像预测作为参考，分别得到IP-VCD与IP-M3ID。
AI.result: 在兼顾正确答案与受支持弃答的决策效用（DU）指标上，两种方法在VizWiz的九个模型上均优于所有对比的非IP基线；IP-VCD在Food-101的九个模型中有八个领先。候选测量与逐问题配对比较表明，将指令效应与视觉对比项分开计算，可使对比解码同时支持正确答案与受支持弃答。
AI.conclusion: 将指令效应与视觉对比项解耦，是让对比解码同时维持正确答案与受支持弃答的关键；指令保留解码在不牺牲对比强度可调性的前提下修复了弃答丢失问题，并在多个模型和数据集上取得一致的决策效用提升。

title: Large Decision Models: Repurposing Large Language Models as Single-Pass Decision Makers
summary: Large language models make decisions through parallel prefill and sequential decoding. Although effective, this approach incurs decoding costs and does not explicitly expose decision probabilities. Existing task-specific classifiers require per-task training and offer limited generalization to unseen decision schemas. We propose Large Decision Models (LDMs), repurposing language models to return explicit probabilities over labels specified at run time using one prefill forward pass. We first adapt models to this interface through Diverse Decision Supervision (DDS), covering varied domains, rules and labels. To further narrow the performance gap to a reasoning model, Self-Posed Reasoning Distillation (SPRD) adds tasks generated by a frozen teacher, filters them for answer consistency, and trains on label distributions obtained from repeated teacher reasoning. We evaluate on DecisionVista, pairing new-schema tests with held-out human-labelled sources. Across three base models, the recipe improves accuracy over a step-matched baseline by 1.8 and 1.5 percentage points, respectively, achieving a 182-fold speedup in latency over reasoning rollout on Gemma-4-31B. Reasoning remains stronger on the new-schema test, motivating a confidence router for uncertain decisions. On development sets, routing recovers a median 92% of reasoning's accuracy advantage while generating 27-58% of its tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/JianhuiWei7/LDM.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Large Decision Models (LDMs)，将语言模型改造为在单次 prefill 前向中直接输出运行时指定标签的显式概率，并通过 DDS 与 SPRD 训练，在 DecisionVista 上兼顾效率与准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型通过并行 prefill 与串行 decoding 决策，虽有效但解码开销大且不显式暴露决策概率；任务专用分类器需逐任务训练，对未见决策模式泛化能力有限。
AI.method: 提出 LDM，复用语言模型在单次 prefill 前向中对运行时指定标签返回显式概率；通过 Diverse Decision Supervision (DDS) 覆盖多领域、规则与标签以适配该接口；再用 Self-Posed Reasoning Distillation (SPRD) 引入冻结教师生成任务、按答案一致性过滤，并基于重复教师推理得到的标签分布进行训练。
AI.result: 在 DecisionVista 上，将新 schema 测试与留出的人工标注来源配对评估。跨三个基座模型，该方案相较步数匹配基线准确率分别提升 1.8 与 1.5 个百分点，在 Gemma-4-31B 上相较推理 rollout 实现 182 倍延迟加速。推理在新 schema 测试上仍更强，因而引入置信度路由器。开发集上，路由恢复推理准确率优势的中位数 92%，同时仅生成其 27–58% 的 token。
AI.conclusion: LDM 以一次前向显式输出标签概率，在保持较高准确率的同时大幅降低延迟；推理在新 schema 上仍占优，置信度路由可在少量 token 开销下弥合大部分差距。

title: Genesis: Visual Augmentation Primitives for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Recent multimodal large language models achieve promising results on visual reasoning tasks, approaching human-level performance on existing STEM benchmarks. However, these capabilities degrade under complex real-world scenes. We identify that chain-of-thought reasoning remains largely confined to the linguistic space, rarely anchoring each step in visual evidence. The main cause is the absence of such data during training. In this work, we introduce a training data augmentation pipeline, \textbf{Visual Augmentation Primitives} (VAP), which leverages state-of-the-art vision generative models to synthesize diverse photorealistic training samples and corresponding reasoning text. VAP introduces some basic operators and applies them to a seed image and gets a variant. It also constructs coherent multimodal reasoning chains throughout the generation process. Such training data force models to perceive visual content and perform logical reasoning according to them at every step. We further introduce multimodal chain-of-thought rubric-based reinforcement learning to enhance this. It rewards not only text reasoning but also visual reasoning by scoring intermediate reasoning steps for logical validity, completeness, and consistency. Moreover, we construct the UNREAL benchmark to systematically evaluate visual reasoning on hyperrealistic scenes across controllable difficulty levels. Experiments show that a 4B model built on this framework surpasses 8B baselines, with performance improving consistently as the model scales to 32B, validating the scaling law for visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出多模态大模型在真实复杂场景下推理能力退化，根源是思维链被限制在语言空间、缺乏视觉证据锚定且训练数据缺失。为此提出数据增强流水线VAP合成图文对齐的推理链，结合多模态思维链评分式强化学习，并构建UNREAL超写实场景基准，实现小模型超越大基线并验证视觉推理的缩放律。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在STEM基准上接近人类水平，但在复杂真实场景中能力显著退化。作者诊断其原因是思维链推理大多局限于语言空间，很少将每一步锚定在视觉证据上，而根本原因是训练阶段缺乏此类数据。
AI.method: 1) 提出训练数据增强流水线Visual Augmentation Primitives (VAP)：引入基本算子并作用于种子图像生成变体，同时利用先进视觉生成模型合成多样化逼真样本及对应推理文本，在生成过程中构建连贯的多模态推理链；2) 提出基于评分标准的多模态思维链强化学习，对中间推理步骤的逻辑有效性、完整性和一致性打分，同时奖励文本推理与视觉推理；3) 构建UNREAL基准，在超写实场景下按可控难度分级系统评估视觉推理。
AI.result: 基于该框架的4B模型超越8B基线；当模型规模扩展到32B时性能持续提升，验证了视觉推理的缩放律。UNREAL基准可跨可控难度等级系统评测超写实场景的视觉推理。
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉锚定的合成训练数据与多模态思维链评分强化学习，可有效提升模型在复杂真实场景中的视觉推理能力，且该能力随模型规模呈现可扩展性。

title: The Multilingual Artificial Hivemind: Do All LLMs Think Alike in Every Language?
summary: Text generated by Large Language Models (LLMs) often remains limited in diversity compared to that produced by humans. Recent advances demonstrate the presence of inter- and intra-model collapse in open-ended generation of English text, raising concerns about the long-term homogenization of LLM, and more importantly, human thought. However, our understanding of whether this homogenization extends to languages beyond English is limited. In this work, we investigate the role of language on output diversity. Specifically, we aim to understand whether multilingual LLM-generated text is also homogeneous, and whether this homogeneity matches what we observe in humans. Across 23 open-weight models and 13 languages, we find that the artificial hivemind effect is pervasive but uneven in its extent. The intra-model effect holds in three different embedding spaces and under a lexical metric that uses no embedding model, so it is not an artifact of how diversity is measured. The size of the homogenization gap is associated with a model's competence in a language, measured on a held-out translation benchmark, robustly across embedding spaces. Thus, we demonstrate a performance-diversity tradeoff in multilingual LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多语言大模型生成文本的同质化现象，发现"人工蜂巢思维效应"普遍存在且程度不均，且同质化差距与模型的语言能力相关，揭示性能—多样性权衡。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明英语开放生成中存在模型内与模型间坍缩（同质化），引发对LLM乃至人类思维长期趋同的担忧，但这种同质化是否延伸到英语以外语言尚不清楚。本文旨在探究语言在输出多样性中的作用，即多语言LLM生成文本是否也同质化，以及这种同质化是否与人类观察到的模式一致。
AI.method: 跨23个开放权重模型和13种语言，采用三个不同嵌入空间以及一个不使用嵌入模型的词汇指标来度量多样性；并在留出翻译基准上测量模型在各语言上的能力，以检验同质化差距与语言能力的关联。
AI.result: 发现"人工蜂巢思维效应"普遍存在但程度不均；模型内效应在三种嵌入空间及无嵌入词汇指标下均成立，说明并非度量方式的假象；同质化差距的大小与模型在该语言上的能力相关，且在多个嵌入空间下稳健。
AI.conclusion: 多语言LLM存在性能—多样性权衡：模型在某语言上能力越强，其输出同质化趋势越明显，表明同质化并非英语特有，而是多语言场景下的普遍现象。

title: Data Portability Revisited: Toward the Human-Centric, AI-Driven Data Ecosystems of Tomorrow
summary: This Article critically examines the contemporary regulatory framework and discourse surrounding data portability in the United States. Using recent regulatory developments in the European Union as an illustration, this Article suggests that although data access and portability are identified as vital issues in multiple policy instruments, in its current iteration, at least, legal conceptions of portability continue to reinforce the interests of service providers and data controller enterprises rather than individual end users. This Article argues that a paradigm shift toward a more human-centric data approach to data governance must occur, under which data would be recognized as fundamental to an individual's identity in a digital age. Therefore, it should be placed in the hands of individuals rather than service providers or data controller enterprises. This Article considers technical and market trends in the European Union that reveal and facilitate such a change. It suggests that regulatory frameworks should better align with these technological and market developments to encourage change-inducing trends among market actors. In short, this Article identifies a transformative approach to data portability that empowers individuals with the freedom and ability to aggregate their data in secure personal spaces under their control or dominion. Such a human-centric perspective on data portability is crucial in building Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered applications for individual consumers that can pave the way for the human-centric, AI-driven data ecosystems of the future.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性审视美国数据可携权监管框架，指出当前法律概念偏向服务提供者而非终端用户，主张转向以人为中心的数据治理范式，让个人在自身控制的安全空间内聚合数据，为未来以人为本的AI驱动数据生态奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 数据访问与可携权虽在多项政策工具中被视为关键议题，但现行法律对可携权的理解仍强化服务提供者和数据控制企业的利益，而非个人终端用户的利益，因此需要重新审视这一监管话语与实践取向。
AI.method: 以欧盟近期监管发展为例证，对美国当代数据可携权监管框架与话语进行批判性分析；同时考察欧盟技术与市场趋势，论证这些趋势如何揭示并推动以人为中心的数据治理转变。
AI.result: 分析表明，现行可携权制度在其实施中主要服务于服务提供者与数据控制企业的利益；而欧盟的技术与市场动向显示出向个人数据聚合与个人控制方向演进的潜力，监管框架应与此类发展更好对齐，以激励市场主体的变革性趋势。
AI.conclusion: 应实现范式转变，将数据视为数字时代个人身份的根本组成部分并交由个人掌控；提出一种变革性数据可携权路径，赋予个人在自身控制或支配下的安全个人空间中聚合数据的自由与能力，这对构建面向个人消费者的AI应用及未来以人为本的AI驱动数据生态至关重要。

title: Ellipsoids from Tangents
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Written in 2016; posted in 2026 with revised exposition. Results unchanged
summary: This paper presents an algorithm for detecting and fitting multiple ellipsoids in 2D, 3D and higher-dimensional data. The representation is based on tangents to the ellipsoid together with their contact points, rather than on points alone. A tangent contributes d independent equations where a point contributes one, so each hypothesis needs fewer samples, which in turn reduces the number of iterations required to recover every ellipsoid. The problem is posed as sets of linear equations whose solutions -- the ellipsoid parameters -- are recovered robustly by clustering in parameter space. The algorithm works in all dimensions and outperforms the state of the art in 2D. The approach applies in general to the robust solution of linear equations, and so has utility beyond ellipsoid fitting.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于切线与接触点的多椭球检测与拟合算法，可在2D、3D及更高维数据中稳健恢复多个椭球参数。
AI.motivation: 传统多椭球拟合通常仅依赖点作为输入，每个点只能提供一个约束方程，导致假设所需样本多、迭代次数高、恢复效率低；作者希望利用更丰富的几何信息（切线及其接触点）来减少所需样本与迭代次数，并实现跨维度通用且优于现有2D方法的稳健拟合。
AI.method: 采用椭球切线与接触点作为表示，而非仅使用点；每条切线贡献d个独立方程，而单个点仅贡献1个方程，因此每个假设所需样本更少。将问题建模为一组线性方程，其解即椭球参数，并通过在参数空间中进行聚类来稳健恢复参数。该方法适用于任意维度。
AI.result: 算法可在2D、3D及更高维数据中工作，并在2D场景下优于现有最先进方法；同时由于将问题转化为线性方程的稳健求解，方法具有超越椭球拟合的通用性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，利用切线与接触点的几何约束可显著提升多椭球拟合的样本效率与稳健性，且其核心思想可推广到一般线性方程的稳健求解问题。

title: A Bethe-Ansatz Source of Early Token Correlations: A marginal-preserving construction for parallel proposals
comment: 5 pages, 2 tables. Ancillary files reproduce all numerical results
summary: Parallel token proposals in language-model decoding need a joint law, not merely accurate token marginals. We construct a family of coordinate-Bethe-ansatz laws from the periodic XXZ chain and compare each with its maximum-entropy pairwise projection at identical one- and two-site moments. In the eight-site, three-excitation sector, symmetry makes their entire probability-law difference one-dimensional, determined by a contiguous three-site moment. Along the Bethe branch, this gap varies with anisotropy, changes sign, and vanishes exactly at $Δ=(3+\sqrt{3})/2$, where the eigenstate law becomes exactly pairwise. A nonlinear readout transfers a nonzero gap into the first two token positions while preserving their separate marginals. At $Δ=1.5$ the deterministic binary token laws differ by 0.02654573 in total variation. Exact speculative verification then gives a strict accepted-prefix advantage for a constructed target and a neighborhood within targets sharing its first-token marginal. This is a mathematical existence result. It does not establish a language-model gain or wall-clock speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文从周期性XXZ链构造坐标Bethe拟设概率律族，并与相同一、二位矩下的最大熵成对投影比较，发现在八格点三激发扇区中对称性使二者概率律之差降至一维，该差在Δ=(3+√3)/2处精确消失；通过非线性读出可将非零差转移到前两个token位置并保持各自的边缘分布，在Δ=1.5时总变差为0.02654573，并在构造目标上给出严格接受的prefix优势。
AI.motivation: 并行token提议（如推测解码）需要token序列的联合分布律，而仅有准确的token边缘分布并不足以保证正确性；因此需要研究联合律与在相同低阶矩下最大熵成对投影之间的差异，以刻画高阶关联对并行解码的影响。
AI.method: 从周期性XXZ链构造坐标Bethe拟设（coordinate-Bethe-ansatz）概率律族；在相同一、二位矩下构造最大熵成对投影作为对照；选取八格点、三激发扇区，利用对称性将两律的差化简为一维，并由连续三位矩决定；沿Bethe分支考察该差随各向异性Δ的变化，寻找其消失点；再用非线性读出把非零差传递给前两个token位置，同时保持各自边缘分布不变。
AI.result: 在八格点三激发扇区中，两律概率差为一维并可由连续三位矩决定；该差沿Bethe分支随Δ变化、会改变符号，并在Δ=(3+√3)/2处精确为零，此时本征态律恰好为成对（pairwise）律；非线性读出可在保持边缘分布的前提下把非零差转移到前两个token位置；在Δ=1.5时确定性二值token律的总变差为0.02654573；精确推测验证在构造目标及其第一token边缘相同邻域内给出严格接受的prefix优势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是一个数学存在性结果，表明在某些参数与构造目标下，高阶联合律与成对投影的差异可转化为推测解码中接受的prefix优势；但它并未建立语言模型上的实际收益或墙上时钟加速。

title: Agent-Canary-Mas: End-to-End Evaluation of Protocol Risk in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems
summary:
Agent-to-agent protocols allow LLM agents to discover peers, exchange results, and coordinate tool use. A locally successful protocol attack, however, may be rejected by a later agent or propagated into a consequential task decision. Measuring local exploitability alone leaves this difference unresolved and provides limited evidence about which participant caused the final outcome.
  We present Agent-Canary-Mas, an end-to-end evaluation system that follows protocol risk through long-horizon multi-agent tasks. It covers five risk classes and 13 subclasses across A2A, ANP, and BCS, with 975 matched malicious--benign task pairs in five business domains. A shared OpenClaw framework runs autonomous, tool-using agents under different underlying models while preserving the task and execution setup. Matched runs separate local protocol success from downstream consequences; retained evidence connects participant selection, message consumption, tool activity, and task-state changes. We further evaluate a protocol-context Guard that checks an object's authority at consequential handoffs.
  Across three model conditions, local attack success is frequently at or above 90%, while consequence conversion ranges from 7.1\% to 100.0\%. Cross-agent evidence raises macro-averaged Audit-F1 from 29.7% to 95.5%. On Finance tasks, the Guard lowers average ASR from 86.1% to 53.8% and PTCR from 65.5% to 31.2%, with a measurable completion tradeoff. These results show that protocol risk depends on how agents use exchanged objects throughout the task, and that evaluating this path supports more informative risk assessment, attribution, and defense.

AI.tldr: 提出Agent-Canary-Mas端到端评测系统，追踪A2A等协议风险在长程多智能体任务中的传播路径，区分局部攻击成功与下游后果，并评测在关键交接点校验权限的Guard防御。
AI.motivation: 现有评测仅衡量局部可利用性，无法解释为何局部成功的协议攻击可能在后续智能体处被拒或被转化为有后果的任务决策，也难以归因最终结果由哪个参与者导致。
AI.method: 构建端到端评测系统，覆盖A2A、ANP、BCS三类协议的5个风险类、13个子类，在5个业务域构造975对匹配的恶意—良性任务；采用OpenClaw框架运行自主工具调用智能体并保持任务与执行设置一致；通过匹配运行分离局部协议成功与下游后果，保留证据链关联参与者选择、消息消费、工具活动与任务状态变化；并评测在关键交接点检查对象权限的协议上下文Guard。
AI.result: 三种模型条件下局部攻击成功率常达90%以上，但后果转化率为7.1%–100.0%；跨智能体证据将宏平均Audit-F1从29.7%提升至95.5%；在Finance任务上Guard将平均ASR从86.1%降至53.8%、PTCR从65.5%降至31.2%，并伴随可测量的完成率代价。
AI.conclusion: 协议风险取决于智能体在整个任务过程中如何使用交换对象，沿该路径进行评测可支持更具信息量的风险评估、归因与防御。

title: FireNav: Decision-Oriented Reconstruction Evidence Routing for Vision-Language Navigation in Indoor Fire Environments
summary: In real-world indoor fire environments, visual degradation severely impairs instruction grounding, waypoint prediction, and long-horizon exploration in vision-language navigation (VLN). Although image restoration offers a natural means to mitigate such visual degradation, existing methods primarily optimize reconstruction fidelity, which does not necessarily translate into better navigation decisions and may even corrupt task-critical cues when applied indiscriminately. In this paper, we present FireNav, a decision-oriented reconstruction evidence routing framework that aligns visual restoration with navigation utility in VLN. To advance this task, we first contribute FireVLN-Bench, a paired indoor fire navigation benchmark with clean references preserving task semantics, safety supervision, and matched settings for continuous navigation and robot execution with simulated dynamics. Our FireNav retains native visual tokens and treats latent reconstruction features as auxiliary evidence, where a lightweight router leverages visual features, task context, and prior execution states to determine whether such evidence should be admitted and how strongly it should contribute to the visual tokens. To learn when reconstruction is beneficial, we further introduce decision utility calibration, which compares action prediction losses with and without candidate evidence under the same state, thereby supervising evidence selection according to its contribution to waypoint, heading, and arrival prediction. Experiments demonstrate that FireNav consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both navigation success and path efficiency across evaluation settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FireNav，一种面向决策的重建证据路由框架，使视觉修复与视觉语言导航（VLN）的导航效用对齐；同时贡献 FireVLN-Bench 室内火灾导航基准。FireNav 保留原生视觉 token，将潜在重建特征作为辅助证据，通过轻量路由器决定证据是否采纳及其贡献强度，并用决策效用校准监督证据选择，在导航成功率与路径效率上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 真实室内火灾环境中视觉退化严重损害 VLN 的指令接地、路点预测与长时程探索能力。图像修复虽可缓解退化，但现有方法主要优化重建保真度，未必带来更好的导航决策，且不加区分地应用修复甚至可能破坏任务关键线索。因此需要将视觉修复与导航效用对齐。
AI.method: 提出 FireNav 决策导向的重建证据路由框架：保留原生视觉 token，将潜在重建特征作为辅助证据；用轻量路由器结合视觉特征、任务上下文与先验执行状态，判断证据是否被采纳及其对视觉 token 的贡献强度。引入决策效用校准，在同一状态下比较有无候选证据时的动作预测损失，据此按证据对路点、航向、到达预测的贡献监督证据选择。另构建 FireVLN-Bench：成对的室内火灾导航基准，含保留任务语义的干净参考、安全监督，以及与模拟动力学匹配的连续导航与机器人执行设置。
AI.result: 实验表明，FireNav 在各评估设置下于导航成功率与路径效率两方面均持续优于当前最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: 以决策效用为导向、按需路由重建证据，可有效缓解室内火灾视觉退化对 VLN 的负面影响，优于以重建保真度为目标的传统修复范式；配套基准为火灾场景 VLN 提供含干净参考、安全监督及机器人执行的可复现评测平台。

title: A Scaled-Up Empirical Study of Syntactic Language Models
summary: Syntactic language models (SLMs) that generate sentences along with their syntactic tree structures have shown promise in both syntactic generalization and downstream tasks. Prior studies, however, have mostly evaluated smaller models trained on less pretraining data and tested on narrower task suites. In addition, the design space of tree linearization and attention masks remains underexplored. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of 12 controlled configurations---one terminal baseline and 11 SLM variants spanning different linearizations and masks---at scales up to 1B parameters and 100B training tokens, evaluated across 11 downstream tasks and two syntactic benchmarks. The experimental results show that SLMs with standard causal attention match or exceed structural-mask variants across downstream and syntactic benchmarks. They require no architectural modifications and remain compatible with FlashAttention. We also observe that when scaling up to the 1B-parameter scale, the top-performing SLM variant no longer shows a clear advantage over a compute-matched non-structural baseline, suggesting that SLMs may become less competitive with scale. Our code is available at https://github.com/qlwpc/TG-Interpolation.

AI.tldr: 该论文对句法语言模型（SLM）进行了大规模实证研究，覆盖12种配置、最高10亿参数与1000亿训练token，发现标准因果注意力的SLM即可匹配或超越结构掩码变体，且SLM的优势随规模增大而减弱。
AI.motivation: 以往SLM研究多基于较小模型、较少预训练数据和较窄任务集，且树线性化与注意力掩码的设计空间尚未被充分探索，缺乏大规模系统性对比。
AI.method: 开展大规模受控实验，对比12种配置（1个终端基线+11个SLM变体，涵盖不同线性化方式和注意力掩码），规模最高达1B参数、100B训练token，并在11个下游任务和2个句法基准上评估。
AI.result: 采用标准因果注意力的SLM在下游及句法基准上匹配或超过结构掩码变体，无需架构改动且兼容FlashAttention；扩展到1B参数时，最佳SLM变体相对同等算力的非结构基线不再有明显优势。
AI.conclusion: 标准因果注意力的SLM有效且实用，但SLM相对非结构基线的优势可能随规模增大而减弱，SLM在大规模下竞争力存疑。

title: Self-Representation Alignment in Diffusion Models for Video Background Music Generation
summary: Diffusion models have been widely used for various generative tasks. However, recent studies have demonstrated that the internal representations learned in the diffusion models' denoising process are insufficiently meaningful, which can hinder the generation performance. To address this, we propose a novel diffusion U-Net architecture enhanced by explicitly aligning the weaker representation from the earlier layer conditioned on higher noise with the better representation from the later layer conditioned on lower noise during training, which we use for the challenging multimodal task of video background music generation. Our diffusion U-Net Self-Representation Alignment (U-SRA) employs an alignment loss to effectively guide our diffusion model to learn good internal representations, thereby enabling it to produce higher-quality symbolic music conditioned on video features. We employ a cross-attention mechanism to synchronize music with video segments. Experiments on a benchmark video-music dataset demonstrate that the proposed U-SRA approach for video background music generation surpasses the state-of-the-art across key evaluation metrics, including video-music alignment and overall music quality.

AI.tldr: 提出U-SRA扩散U-Net架构，通过自表征对齐损失改善内部表征，用于视频背景音乐生成，性能超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型去噪过程中学习的内部表征不够有意义，限制了生成性能。
AI.method: 在训练中对齐"高噪声条件下浅层较弱表征"与"低噪声条件下深层较优表征"，引入对齐损失；采用跨注意力机制同步音乐与视频片段。
AI.result: 在视频-音乐基准数据集上，视频-音乐对齐度和整体音乐质量等关键指标均超过现有最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式对齐扩散U-Net内部表征可有效提升生成质量，U-SRA为视频背景音乐生成提供了有效方案。

title: Squeeze-Aware-YOLO: Early Channel Recalibration and Multi-Scale Fusion for Real-Time Traffic Sign Detection
comment: Accepted at DICTA 2026 (International Conference on Digital Image Computing: Techniques and Applications, Sydney, Australia). 8 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables
summary: Traffic sign detection plays a vital role in intelligent transportation systems, supporting the safe operation of advanced driver assistance systems and autonomous vehicles. Despite significant progress in real-time object detection, accurately identifying traffic signs under challenging conditions remains difficult. Variations in lighting, adverse weather, motion blur, and partial occlusion often reduce detection performance, especially for small or visually degraded signs where important spatial information can be lost. To address these challenges, we propose Squeeze-Aware-YOLO, a lightweight traffic sign detection framework that introduces a multi-branch bottleneck module combining convolutional kernels of different sizes with a Squeeze-and-Excitation mechanism to improve feature extraction and adaptive channel weighting. In addition, we integrate the Multi-Branch Auxiliary Feature Pyramid Network and Re-parameterized Heterogeneous Multi-Scale modules to strengthen multi-scale feature representation and feature fusion while preserving real-time inference efficiency for practical deployment. The proposed approach is evaluated on the Bangladeshi Traffic Sign Detection Dataset, the CSUST Chinese Traffic Sign Detection Benchmark 2021, and the German Traffic Sign Detection Benchmark, achieving mAP@0.5 scores of 74.7%, 79.4%, and 84.0%, respectively, while consistently outperforming recent state-of-the-art YOLO-based traffic sign detectors. These findings demonstrate that combining multi-scale receptive fields, channel attention, and enhanced feature fusion enables more accurate and robust traffic sign detection while maintaining the computational efficiency required for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级交通标志检测框架Squeeze-Aware-YOLO，通过多分支瓶颈模块结合SE机制、多分支辅助特征金字塔网络及重参数化异构多尺度模块，在三个数据集上取得优于现有YOLO类方法的mAP@0.5（74.7%、79.4%、84.0%），兼顾精度与实时性。
AI.motivation: 交通标志检测对智能交通系统及自动驾驶安全至关重要。尽管实时目标检测已有显著进展，但在光照变化、恶劣天气、运动模糊和部分遮挡等复杂条件下，检测性能仍会下降，尤其对小型或视觉退化标志，关键空间信息易丢失，因此需要兼顾精度、鲁棒性与实时效率的检测方案。
AI.method: 提出Squeeze-Aware-YOLO轻量级框架：1）多分支瓶颈模块，结合不同尺寸卷积核与Squeeze-and-Excitation机制，增强特征提取与自适应通道加权；2）集成多分支辅助特征金字塔网络与重参数化异构多尺度模块，强化多尺度特征表示与特征融合，同时保持实时推理效率。
AI.result: 在孟加拉国交通标志检测数据集、CSUST中国交通标志检测基准2021及德国交通标志检测基准上评估，mAP@0.5分别达74.7%、79.4%、84.0%，持续优于近期最先进的YOLO类交通标志检测器。
AI.conclusion: 结合多尺度感受野、通道注意力与增强特征融合，可在保持实际部署所需计算效率的同时，实现更准确、鲁棒的交通标志检测。

title: Label Collapse in Diffusion Language Model In-Context Learning
summary: In-context learning (ICL) applies large language models to new tasks by prepending a few labeled demonstrations to a query. Prior work has studied how demonstration ordering affects ICL, but the interaction between label arrangement patterns and model biases has not been systematically examined. We define label collapse as the failure mode in which the model generates query-independent labels, and show that it is architecturally universal at the tested 8-9B scale: five models spanning autoregressive (Llama-3, Qwen3.5) and discrete diffusion (LLaDA, iLLaDA, LLaDA-Instruct) families all exhibit label collapse even under the class-balanced alternating arrangement, with some label word pairs collapsing in virtually every tested condition and others flipping their collapse direction with arrangement. Critically, accuracy alone cannot detect this collapse: models can achieve near-chance accuracy while generating query-independent labels, a score indistinguishable from balanced performance, so the failure can persist undetected in deployment. We measure separation, the log-odds of the two label words at the query position (the quantity that label-bias calibration operates on), as a complementary diagnostic that exposes collapse hidden beneath surface accuracy, together with a measurement protocol that guards label extraction against tokenizer and formatting artifacts. For autoregressive models, collapse persists where the majority-label-bias account does not apply, and arrangement patterns can reverse the collapse direction; for diffusion models, we present a systematic evaluation of ICL failure modes, complementing contemporaneous studies of dLLM context comprehension and demonstration-order sensitivity, and identify open questions about how iterative denoising interacts with label biases.

AI.tldr: 该论文定义了ICL中的"标签坍缩"失败模式（模型生成与查询无关的标签），发现在8-9B规模的五类模型（Llama-3、Qwen3.5等自回归模型与LLaDA等离散扩散模型）中普遍存在，并提出"分离度"作为补充诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 先前工作研究了演示顺序对ICL的影响，但标签排列模式与模型偏置之间的交互作用尚未被系统考察；且准确率指标可能掩盖标签坍缩这一失败模式。
AI.method: 定义"标签坍缩"为生成查询无关标签的失败模式；在8-9B规模五类自回归与离散扩散模型上测试；采用类别均衡的交替排列；提出"分离度"（查询位置两个标签词的对数几率）作为诊断指标，并设计防止分词器与格式伪影的测量协议。
AI.result: 五类模型即使在类别均衡交替排列下均出现标签坍缩；某些标签词对几乎在所有条件下坍缩，另一些则随排列翻转坍缩方向；模型可在接近随机水平的准确率下生成查询无关标签，表面准确率无法检测该失败；自回归模型中坍缩出现在多数标签偏置解释不适用的情形，排列模式可逆转坍缩方向。
AI.conclusion: 标签坍缩在测试规模上具有架构普遍性，仅靠准确率无法检测，分离度可作为互补诊断；扩散模型ICL失败模式得到系统评估，并提出迭代去噪与标签偏置交互的开放问题。

title: Inverse Garment Design with Visual Agents
summary: We study the problem of inverse garment design, reconstructing simulation-ready 3D outfits with arbitrary layers from a single image, with visual agents. Unlike differentiable optimization that is time-consuming, or feed-forward methods limited by training data, we introduce DressAgent, a hierarchical agentic system that recovers garment sewing patterns through planning and closed-loop refinement grounded in physical simulation. To this end, we first present an enhanced representation based on GarmentCode for diverse styles and arbitrary dressing layers, and build the first multi-layer sewing pattern dataset with over 15K outfits for supervision and benchmarking. Inverse design then proceeds coarse to fine: In layer planning and coarse estimation, agents infer layer order and relations, peel each layer into its own view, and estimate coarse patterns. In fine-grained refinement, an agentic trio of Tailor, Critic, and Orchestrator refines patterns in a closed loop of editing, simulating, and judging against the reference with visual and measured evidence. Carefully designed tools and an evolving memory make this refinement converge on the target geometry. We also design an agentic generation method for high-fidelity textures. DressAgent outperforms feed-forward methods by a large margin, surpasses or matches differentiable optimization in a fraction of the time, and generalizes to complex layering, diverse poses, and body shapes.

AI.tldr: 提出 DressAgent，一种基于视觉智能体、结合物理仿真的分层智能体系统，从单张图像重建可仿真多层服装缝纫纸样，并配套新表示、首个多层纸样数据集与智能体纹理生成，性能优于前馈方法且接近/超越可微优化效率更高。
AI.motivation: 逆向服装设计需从单图重建可直接仿真的3D服装，但现有方法存在明显局限：可微优化耗时长，前馈方法受训练数据限制且难以泛化到复杂多层、多样姿态与体型；同时缺乏支持任意层数的统一表示与多层纸样数据。作者希望结合智能体规划与物理仿真闭环，兼顾精度、效率与泛化性。
AI.method: 1) 基于 GarmentCode 提出支持多样风格与任意穿着层数的新表示，并构建首个多层缝纫纸样数据集（超15K套）用于监督与评测。2) 逆向设计采用由粗到细流程：层规划与粗估计阶段，智能体推断层序与层间关系，将各层拆分为独立视图并估计粗略纸样；细粒度精修阶段，由 Tailor、Critic、Orchestrator 组成智能体三元组，以“编辑—仿真—评判”闭环，结合视觉与测量证据对照参考进行收敛。3) 设计专用工具与可演化记忆以提升收敛性。4) 另设计智能体式生成方法获得高保真纹理。
AI.result: DressAgent 大幅超越前馈方法；在仅耗费可微优化一小部分时间的情况下达到或超过其效果；并可泛化至复杂叠层、多样姿态与不同体型。
AI.conclusion: 面向逆向服装设计，智能体式规划与物理仿真闭环精修结合，是兼顾精度、效率与泛化的有效范式；配套表示、数据集与纹理生成方法共同支撑了该系统的性能与通用性。

title: Lesion-Aware Attention for Mammography Segmentation with Heterogeneous Supervision
summary: Accurate lesion segmentation in mammography is important for computer-aided breast cancer diagnosis, but dense pixel-level annotations remain costly and limited. Existing public segmentation datasets usually cover only a small set of lesion types with manually delineated masks, whereas larger mammography datasets often provide only image-level diagnostic labels. This annotation mismatch makes it difficult to train segmentation models that can generalize to rare or weakly annotated lesion categories. To address this problem, we study open-vocabulary mammographic lesion segmentation under a mixed-supervision setting, where pixel-level masks are available for base lesion categories and image-level labels are available for a broader set of categories. We propose a two-branch framework that jointly learns from segmentation data and classification data. The segmentation branch learns lesion boundaries from annotated masks, while the classification branch introduces additional image-level semantic supervision. To better transfer image-level supervision to lesion-relevant regions, we further introduce a Lesion-wise Attentive Classifier that maintains category-specific feature prototypes and generates lesion-aware attention maps for foreground feature pooling. This design reduces the influence of background tissue and encourages more compact lesion representations. Experiments on multiple mammography datasets show that the proposed method consistently improves open-vocabulary segmentation baselines on both base and novel lesion categories, while reducing the gap to fully supervised models that require dense target-domain masks. Qualitative results further indicate that our method produces more complete lesion localization for small, low-contrast, and visually subtle mammographic findings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究混合监督下的开放词汇乳腺钼靶病灶分割，提出双分支框架联合利用像素级掩码与图像级标签，并引入病灶感知注意力分类器，在基类与新类病灶上均优于开放词汇基线。
AI.motivation: 乳腺钼靶病灶分割对计算机辅助乳腺癌诊断很重要，但密集像素级标注成本高、数量有限。现有公开分割数据集仅覆盖少量病灶类型且有手工掩码，而更大的钼靶数据集往往只有图像级诊断标签。这种标注不匹配导致分割模型难以泛化到稀有或弱标注病灶类别。
AI.method: 在混合监督设定下研究开放词汇钼靶病灶分割：基类病灶有像素级掩码，更广类别仅有图像级标签。提出双分支框架，分割分支从标注掩码学习病灶边界，分类分支引入图像级语义监督。为将图像级监督更好地迁移到病灶相关区域，提出病灶感知注意力分类器（Lesion-wise Attentive Classifier），维护类别特定特征原型并生成病灶感知注意力图用于前景特征池化，从而抑制背景组织影响、促使病灶表示更紧凑。
AI.result: 在多个钼靶数据集上，所提方法在基类和新类病灶上均一致提升开放词汇分割基线，并缩小了与需要目标域密集掩码的全监督模型的差距。定性结果显示，方法对小尺寸、低对比度和视觉上不明显的钼靶病灶能产生更完整的定位。
AI.conclusion: 通过混合监督下的双分支框架与病灶感知注意力分类器，可有效利用图像级标签提升开放词汇钼靶病灶分割的泛化能力，在基类与新类病灶上均取得改进。

title: ANCHOR: Assessing Naturalistic Constraint Hierarchies and Ordering in Repository-Grounded Agentic Coding
summary: For repository-grounded coding agents, a functionally correct patch is not necessarily an acceptable one: developers also constrain how the task must be carried out-modification scope, workflow order, validation, tool use, and reporting. This capability, which we call engineering constraint following, remains largely invisible to current evaluations. We introduce ANCHOR (Assessing Naturalistic Constraint Hierarchies and Ordering in Repository-Grounded Agentic Coding), a benchmark built on naturalistic, multilingual repository tasks spanning eight language groups. ANCHOR combines (i) a hierarchical taxonomy of 10 categories and 78 leaf types distilled from real developer interactions, (ii) an automated pipeline that instantiates task-grounded atomic constraints and composes them into typed AND/THEN/PRIORITY relations, and (iii) a trajectory-grounded evaluation framework that checks both the code diff and the execution trajectory with rule-based and LLM judges. Across 19 agent configurations spanning 2 scaffolds and 10 foundation models on 358 tasks, the strongest measured system, Claude Opus 4.8 under Cline, reaches 70.1% atomic compliance and 63.7% relation compliance, while 19.0% of tasks pass every scored checklist item under the strict all-item FCCR criterion. A five-engineer audit of constraints from 50 instances reports 94% feasibility, 94% repository consistency, and 96% realism. In the primary paired set (14 configurations), the mean signed change in task completion after adding constraints is +0.7 percentage points; individual changes vary in both directions. These results distinguish functional success from constraint compliance, with failures concentrated in workflow ordering, tool-use discipline, and reporting, and substantial interactions between models and scaffolds.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ANCHOR基准，用于评估代码智能体在真实代码仓库任务中遵循开发者"工程约束"（修改范围、工作流顺序、验证、工具使用、报告等）的能力。ANCHOR包含分层约束分类法（10类78叶型）、自动化约束实例化与组合流水线（AND/THEN/PRIORITY关系）以及轨迹评估框架。在19种智能体配置、358个任务上，最优系统（Cline + Claude Opus 4.8）达70.1%原子合规率与63.7%关系合规率，仅19.0%任务满足严格全项FCCR标准。
AI.motivation: 现有代码智能体评测只关注补丁功能正确性，而开发者实际上还约束任务如何完成（修改范围、流程顺序、验证、工具使用、报告等）。这种"工程约束遵循"能力在当前评测中基本不可见，导致功能成功与真正可接受性之间存在评估盲区。
AI.method: ANCHOR建立在八个语言组的自然多语言仓库任务之上，包含三部分：(i) 从真实开发者交互中提炼的10类78叶型分层约束分类法；(ii) 自动流水线，实例化任务相关的原子约束并组合为带类型的AND/THEN/PRIORITY关系；(iii) 轨迹评估框架，通过规则与LLM裁判同时检查代码差异和执行轨迹。评测覆盖2种脚手架与10个基础模型、19种代理配置、358个任务。
AI.result: 最强系统（Cline下的Claude Opus 4.8）达70.1%原子合规率和63.7%关系合规率，仅19.0%任务在严格全项FCCR标准下通过。五名工程师对50个实例的约束审计显示94%可行性、94%仓库一致性、96%真实性。在主要配对集（14种配置）中，加入约束后任务完成度平均变化为+0.7个百分点，个体变化双向分布。失败集中在工作流顺序、工具使用纪律和报告环节，且模型与脚手架之间存在显著交互。
AI.conclusion: ANCHOR将功能成功与约束遵循区分开来，揭示出工程约束遵循是当前模型的重要能力短板。加入约束对任务完成度的平均影响为正但方差较大，且模型与脚手架交互显著，表明约束遵循能力受系统配置复合影响，为未来智能体评测和改进提供了新维度。

title: CondMSP: Condition-Informed and Resource-Aware Inorganic Materials Synthesis Planning
summary: Materials synthesis planning (MSP) connects AI-driven materials discovery to experimental realization by proposing precursors, synthesis operations, and processing conditions for a target material. Existing approaches predict these components separately or in pairs and treat conditions only as a prediction target. Consequently, MSP remains centered on recipe prediction: it leaves unexplored how conditions can serve as process context for constructing synthesis routes, and it does not address which candidate routes should be executed under limited experimental resources. We propose CondMSP, which extends MSP from recipe prediction to execution-aware planning. CondMSP predicts temperature, time, and atmosphere by combining a joint predictor with variable-specific experts, and then uses these predictions both as process context, grounding the generation and retrieval of operation sequences, and as execution requirements, specifying which thermal stages can share a furnace run and at what cost. This specification is held fixed across all compared methods; within it, CondMSP ranks routes across precursor sets by a common utility and, under furnace budgets, jointly selects routes and allocates their thermal stages by constrained optimization. CondMSP improves condition and operation prediction and, under this shared constraint, raises reference-recipe recovery from 27.9% to 32.9% at three simulated furnace runs per target and from 34.7% to 40.0% at 30 trials, while a new evaluation set of 2,344 targets supports generalization beyond oxide-dominated training chemistry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CondMSP，将材料合成规划（MSP）从"配方预测"扩展为"可执行感知规划"：先用联合预测器加变量专属专家预测温度、时间和气氛，再将条件预测同时用作过程上下文（支撑操作序列生成与检索）与执行需求（界定哪些热阶段可共炉、成本如何），并在此固定规范下通过约束优化联合选择路线与分配热阶段。在相同的炉次约束下，参考配方回收率从 27.9% 提升到 32.9%（每目标 3 次模拟炉次），从 34.7% 提升到 40.0%（30 次试验），并构建含 2344 个目标的新评测集以检验对氧化物主导训练化学体系之外的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 MSP 方法分别或成对预测前驱体、合成操作与工艺条件，并把条件仅当作预测目标，导致 MSP 仍停留在配方预测层面：未探索条件如何作为过程上下文来构建合成路线，也未解决在有限实验资源下应执行哪些候选路线的问题。
AI.method: CondMSP 将 MSP 从配方预测扩展为执行感知规划。条件预测方面，结合联合预测器与变量专属专家预测温度、时间与气氛；条件用途方面，一是作为过程上下文，为操作序列的生成与检索提供依据，二是作为执行需求，界定哪些热阶段可共享同一炉次及其成本。该执行需求规范在所有对比方法中保持固定；在此规范内，CondMSP 以统一效用对跨前驱体集的路线排序，并在炉次预算约束下通过约束优化联合选择路线与分配其热阶段。
AI.result: CondMSP 在条件预测与操作预测上均有提升；在共享的炉次约束下，每目标 3 次模拟炉次时参考配方回收率由 27.9% 提高到 32.9%，30 次试验时由 34.7% 提高到 40.0%；同时构建了包含 2344 个目标的新评测集，支持对氧化物主导训练化学体系之外的泛化评估。
AI.conclusion: CondMSP 表明工艺条件不应仅作为预测目标，而应同时充当过程上下文与执行需求，从而把 MSP 推进到执行感知规划；由此在受限实验资源下实现路线选择与热阶段分配的联合优化，并提升参考配方回收与跨化学体系泛化能力。

title: 1Step-WAM: Your World Action Model but Faster using 1-Step Action Generation
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) unify visual world modeling and action generation, yet their real-world deployment is heavily bottlenecked by iterative action denoising and the sequential execution of visual prefilling and action prediction. We demonstrate that the action-denoising trajectories in WAMs are approximately straight, rendering the first-step velocity a strong estimate of the final action direction. Building on this observation, we introduce 1Step-WAM, a framework that transforms multi-step action denoising into one single forward. Specifically, we employ a lightweight calibrator to directly correct the first step velocity, and use bandwidth-constrained action decoding to further reduce errors in the calibrated one-step actions. Compressing action generation into a single step enables it to execute in parallel with visual prefilling, completely breaking the sequential bottleneck of the traditional imagination-then-action paradigm. Evaluations on RoboTwin and LIBERO show that 1Step-WAM largely preserves multi-step task success with only about 13.4M trainable parameters, while achieving inference speedups of $7.44\times$, $5.98\times$, and $24.84\times$ for FastWAM, ImageWAM and Kairos, respectively. Furthermore, real-world robotic deployments using the FastWAM backbone confirm a consistent 7.44$\times$ speedup while maintaining close success rate to the multi-step baseline.
