AI.result: 20 维时，$H^0$ 在八种架构的留出 CounterFact 事实检索上平均超过 LEACE 保留子空间 $+17.1$ 个百分点，联合约束同一事实的所有释义再增 $+6.5$ 个百分点；消融释义变异性最高的坐标，其输出改变量是匹配逐坐标变异性坐标的 $5.6$–$26.5$ 倍（九个模型，124M–13B）；调和质量跨六种架构相差近三个数量级，且与引导脆弱性排序一致（Spearman $\rho=0.90$，单侧置换 $p=0.014$）。
AI.conclusion: 同一释义图同时导出内容子空间、影响方向与脆弱性度量，为冻结模型提供无需训练的可解释性分析框架。

title: Google Earth AI Geospatial Reasoning Agent: Capabilities and a Systematic Evaluation
comment: 39 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables (10 main tables, 1 appendix table)
summary: Google Earth AI is a family of geospatial AI models, together with an agent that orchestrates them. We present this agent, Google Earth AI's Geospatial Reasoning agent (GRA), a Gemini-powered research system that combines geospatial data sources, foundation models, and tools to answer questions about our planet. GRA organizes these into modular domain skills and pairs them with upfront geospatial planning to decompose complex queries into multi-stage workflows. Evaluating such systems is hard: real-world problems admit multiple valid workflows, require data discovery across large catalogs, and rely on evolving ground truth. We introduce two benchmarks and release their development splits. GeoExpertQueries poses complex analytical problems grounded in practitioner use cases and refined by geospatial experts; each is paired with a consensus golden workflow from three independent experts and scored by a human-validated, tool-agnostic autorater. GeoKTools consists of templated queries with deterministic reference solvers that systematically vary the number of required tool types. We also use two external benchmarks, CBGB and UnivEARTH; the latter we find to be saturated. To isolate the contribution of GRA's tools and its agentic orchestration, we compare four configurations, each with Gemini 3.1 Pro and 3.8 Flash: a standalone LLM, the LLM with basic tools, the LLM with GRA's skills and tools but without its upfront planning and execution guidance, and GRA itself. With at most basic tools, an advanced model recovers much of the answer on templated queries but satisfies only a small fraction of the expert workflows on open-ended problems; GRA performs well on both. The largest step comes from GRA's skills and tools; on open-ended problems, its planning and execution guidance add a further gain with Gemini 3.8 Flash, letting Flash match or exceed Pro at lower cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Google Earth AI 的 Geospatial Reasoning agent（GRA），一个由 Gemini 驱动、整合地理空间数据源、基础模型与工具的模块化智能体系统，并配套发布 GeoExpertQueries 与 GeoKTools 两个基准及开发集，通过四种配置的对照实验证明：GRA 的领域技能与工具带来最大性能提升，其前置规划与执行指导可让 Flash 模型以更低成本匹配或超越 Pro。
AI.motivation: 真实地理空间问题允许多种有效工作流、需在大规模数据目录中发现数据、且依赖不断演化的真值，导致此类智能体系统难以评估。现有评估缺乏既能反映专家实践、又具工具无关可复现性的基准。
AI.method: GRA 将地理空间能力组织为模块化领域技能（domain skills），并与前置地理空间规划（upfront geospatial planning）配对，把复杂查询分解为多阶段工作流。评估方面提出两个基准：GeoExpertQueries（基于从业者用例、由专家精炼，每题配三位独立专家的共识黄金工作流，由人工验证、工具无关的 autorater 打分）与 GeoKTools（模板化查询，配确定性参考求解器，系统性地变化所需工具类型数量）；另用外部基准 CBGB 与 UnivEARTH。消融上以 Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 3.8 Flash 对比四种配置：纯 LLM、LLM+基础工具、LLM+GRA 技能与工具但无规划与执行指导、完整 GRA。
AI.result: 在模板化查询上，仅用基础工具的高级模型即可恢复大部分答案，但在开放式问题上只能满足少数专家工作流；GRA 在两者上均表现良好。最大提升来自 GRA 的技能与工具；在开放式问题上，其规划与执行指导在 Gemini 3.8 Flash 上带来进一步增益，使 Flash 能以更低成本匹配或超越 Pro。此外发现 UnivEARTH 基准已饱和。
AI.conclusion: 模块化技能与工具是地理空间推理智能体性能的主要来源，而前置规划与执行指导可作为低成本模型的增效器。所发布的两个基准及开发集为评估此类多阶段、多工具工作流系统提供了可复现的工具无关方案。

title: Frozen History: When Temporal Losses Stop Accumulation in Learned Real-Time Supersampling
summary: Learned real-time supersampling accumulates jittered low-resolution samples along motion vectors. Many methods use a temporal consistency loss to reduce flicker. We show that with accurate registration, this loss can suppress accumulation: on static content, the network copies its warped history at almost no temporal cost. Camera jitter in motion vectors raises this cost and can hide the effect. We identify four registration errors that training can conceal: jitter-carrying motion vectors, one motion field for both resolution lattices, jittered depth, and an unregistered skip path. A model-free oracle shows that correct registration makes freezing two orders of magnitude cheaper on static pixels. Controlled training shows that registration reverses the temporal weight's effect on PSNR. Under exact registration, increasing the weight reduces pixel variance at the expense of accuracy and perceived quality, with a 0.7 to 0.9 dB loss on static frames at weight 0.25. This reversal recurs across three network families and two scales; the loss also reduces accuracy on unjittered STSS data. With a small temporal weight and a normalised sample accumulator, a plain registered network improves the best published QRISP PSNR by 0.34 to 0.62 dB at $\times$2, $\times$3 and $\times$4 upscaling to 1080p. At $\times$2, its static pixel standard deviation is one quarter that of DLSS 2. Without retraining, it outperforms classical temporal upsampling by at least 4.4 dB on Arm's jittered Bistro capture. Our most accurate $\times$4 model runs in 2.03 ms per 1080p frame on an H200. Code: https://github.com/CV-AC/Frozen_history

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，在运动向量配准准确时，时序一致性损失会抑制累加，使网络在静态内容上几乎零代价地复制其扭曲历史；通过消除四类配准误差并进行受控训练，作者证明正确配准会逆转时序权重对PSNR的影响，并据此以小幅时序权重和归一化样本累加器，在QRISP、DLSS 2对比及Arm Bistro捕获上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 学习式实时超采样沿运动向量累加抖动低分辨率样本，常使用时序一致性损失来减少闪烁；但作者发现该损失在配准准确时会抑制累加，而运动向量中的相机抖动会提高该代价并掩盖此效应，因此需要厘清配准误差如何影响训练和最终质量。
AI.method: 识别四类可被训练掩盖的配准误差：携带抖动的运动向量、对两个分辨率格点共用同一运动场、抖动深度，以及未配准的跳跃路径。使用无模型oracle验证正确配准使静态像素冻结便宜两个数量级；进行受控训练，比较不同时序权重与配准条件下的PSNR、像素方差和感知质量，并在三种网络族和两个尺度上验证。
AI.result: 在精确配准下，增大时序权重会降低像素方差但牺牲精度和感知质量，权重0.25时静态帧损失0.7至0.9 dB；该逆转在三种网络族和两个尺度上重复出现，且该损失也会降低无抖动STSS数据的精度。采用小时间权重和归一化样本累加器的普通配准网络，在×2、×3、×4上采样至1080p时，将已发表的最佳QRISP PSNR提高0.34至0.62 dB；在×2时，其静态像素标准差为DLSS 2的四分之一；无需重训练，在Arm抖动Bistro捕获上优于经典时序上采样至少4.4 dB；最精确的×4模型在H200上每1080p帧运行2.03 ms。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论是配准质量决定时序一致性损失的作用方向：正确配准使网络可低成本复制扭曲历史，从而抑制累加；因此应使用小时间权重配合归一化样本累加器，而非依赖大时序损失来提升质量。该方案在多个基准和硬件条件下均取得更高PSNR、更低静态方差和更优泛化表现。

title: D2: High-Capability Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models from Half-Duplex Backbones
comment: 17 pages, including references and appendices. Demo: https://d2-duplex-demo.github.io/
summary: Full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) support simultaneous listening and speaking, but often lag behind half-duplex spoken language models (HD-SLMs) in general capabilities. We propose Dialogue-to-Duplex (D2), a framework that converts pretrained HD-SLMs into high-capability FD-SLMs at fine temporal granularity. D2 adapts the original audio encoder to streaming through decoder-free representation distillation and learns full-duplex interaction through supervised fine-tuning. We systematically study the effects of chunk size on full-duplex interaction, general capabilities, and inference computation. We apply D2 to two distinct HD-SLM architectures, Qwen3-Omni and LLaMA-Omni 2. At a 12.5Hz update rate, Qwen3-Omni-D2 achieves 99.2% turn-taking success with 521-ms latency, 99.5% interruption success, and a state-of-the-art VoiceBench score of 70.1.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dialogue-to-Duplex (D2) 框架，将预训练半双工语音语言模型转换为高能力全双工模型，在细粒度时间粒度上实现同时听与说，并在 Qwen3-Omni 与 LLaMA-Omni 2 上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音语言模型（FD-SLM）虽支持同时听与说，但其通用能力常落后于半双工模型（HD-SLM），需要在保持甚至提升通用能力的前提下实现全双工交互。
AI.method: D2 框架：通过无解码器表征蒸馏（decoder-free representation distillation）将原始音频编码器适配为流式编码器；通过监督微调（SFT）学习全双工交互；并系统研究 chunk size 对全双工交互、通用能力与推理计算量的影响；应用于 Qwen3-Omni 和 LLaMA-Omni 2 两种架构。
AI.result: 在 12.5Hz 更新率下，Qwen3-Omni-D2 实现 99.2% 的轮次转换成功率（521 ms 延迟）、99.5% 的中断成功率，以及 70.1 的 VoiceBench 最新最优（SOTA）得分。
AI.conclusion: D2 可将预训练 HD-SLM 高效转化为高能力 FD-SLM，在细粒度时间粒度上兼顾全双工交互与通用能力，具有跨架构的通用性。

title: Agent Sociodrama: Social-Dynamics-Guided Persona Recasting for LLM Agent Teams
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as teams, yet they fail in characteristically social ways: information holders stay silent, dominant speakers anchor groups on wrong answers, and norm violations go unsanctioned. We present Agent Sociodrama, a framework for modeling and validating evolving social dynamics in LLM agent teams. Under fixed personas, agents' emotional states and directed, asymmetric relationships are updated every round by a unified external LLM judge and shape their subsequent interactions. Across six LLM backbones and five social scenarios, we assess social fidelity through classical social-theory patterns and agreement with human judgments. The resulting trajectories exhibit structured social patterns and model-specific differences. We then introduce Trajectory-Guided Persona Recasting (TPR), which diagnoses group-dynamic failures from interaction transcripts and social trajectories and recasts agent personas before rerunning the task. Across four collaborative benchmarks, TPR improves performance from both heterogeneous and randomly initialized agent persona compositions, yielding up to 83.3%p of accuracy improvement over the initial casting. On representative distributed-information cooperation and mixed-motive bargaining tasks, we outperform SOTOPIA and AgentVerse in three of four comparisons, by up to 37.5%p in Pareto rate. These results show that validated social trajectories provide actionable signals for repairing LLM agent teams.

AI.tldr: 提出 Agent Sociodrama 框架建模并验证 LLM 智能体团队的社会动态演化，并基于社会轨迹诊断失败、提出 TPR 角色重铸方法，在多任务上显著提升团队表现。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体越来越多以团队形式部署，但常出现典型的社会性失败：信息持有者沉默、主导发言者将群体锚定在错误答案上、规范违背未被制裁。现有工作缺乏对团队社会动态的建模与验证，也缺乏可操作的修复手段。
AI.method: 1) Agent Sociodrama：固定 personas，由统一的外部 LLM judge 每轮更新智能体的情绪状态与有向非对称关系，并影响后续交互；在 6 个 LLM 骨干与 5 个社会场景中，用经典社会理论模式与人类判断一致性评估社会保真度。2) Trajectory-Guided Persona Recasting (TPR)：从交互记录与社会轨迹诊断群体动态失败，在重跑任务前重铸智能体 personas。
AI.result: 社会轨迹呈现结构化社会模式与模型特异性差异；在四个协作基准上，TPR 从异质与随机初始化的 persona 组合出发均提升性能，相对初始角色配置最高提升 83.3 个百分点准确率；在分布式信息合作与混合动机议价任务上，四项比较中三项优于 SOTOPIA 与 AgentVerse，Pareto 率最高提升 37.5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 经外部 judge 验证的社会轨迹能为修复 LLM 智能体团队提供可操作的信号，即通过诊断群体动态失败并重铸角色配置来提升团队协作与议价表现。

title: SlotAVS: Object-Centric Audio-Visual Segmentation via Bi-Modal Slot Attention
summary: Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) requires predicting pixel-wise masks of sounding objects by grounding acoustic signals in visual space. In multi-source scenes, concurrent sound sources often remain entangled within shared visual representations, leading to merged masks or unstable specialization when using standard alignment-focused transformer architectures. To address this, we present SlotAVS, an object-centric framework driven by competitive bi-modal slot attention. While robust foundation models provide rich semantic priors, SlotAVS shifts the paradigm from global cross-modal fusion to explicit competitive binding. By initializing discrete object slots from temporal audio sequences and enforcing strict slot-wise competition over spatial visual tokens, our method structurally mitigates the blending of distinct acoustic entities. Further, to stabilize instance-level learning, we introduce a Hungarian matching strategy that optimally aligns slots with ground-truth objects using spatial and boundary overlap. Coupled with a numerically stable, confidence-aware mask fusion mechanism, SlotAVS robustly aggregates multi-source predictions. Extensive experiments on the AVSBench dataset demonstrate the efficacy of our approach, achieving 88.6% mIoU on the Single-Source (S4) split and 71.7% mIoU on the Multi-Source (MS3) split. These results show that explicit competitive binding is critical for complex audio-visual scene understanding and effectively leveraging foundation-model priors without relying solely on their capacity.

AI.tldr: 提出SlotAVS，用竞争性双模态槽注意力实现对象中心的音视频分割，在多源场景下显著优于对齐式Transformer。
AI.motivation: 多源音视频分割中，并发声源在共享视觉表征里相互纠缠，导致掩码合并或特征专化不稳定，标准对齐导向的Transformer难以处理。
AI.method: 以时序音频序列初始化离散对象槽，在空间视觉token上施加严格的槽间竞争，将全局跨模态融合转为显式竞争绑定；用匈牙利匹配按空间与边界重叠对齐槽与真实对象以稳定实例学习；配合数值稳定、置信度感知的掩码融合机制聚合多源预测。
AI.result: 在AVSBench上，单源S4划分达88.6% mIoU，多源MS3划分达71.7% mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 显式竞争绑定对复杂音视频场景理解至关重要，可在不单纯依赖基础模型容量的前提下有效利用其先验。

title: ToolHACE: A Dataset for Detecting Hallucinations in Tool-Based LLM Responses
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 21 pages, 7 tables
summary: Tool-augmented language models ground their responses in external tool outputs, improving reliability beyond parametric knowledge alone. However, even when the correct tool is called and returns accurate information, models may still contradict such outputs, omit critical details, or generate unsupported claims. Existing hallucination benchmarks for tool-augmented dialogue primarily focus on the tool-calling stage, evaluating whether the correct tool and arguments are selected, while overlooking errors that arise during post-tool response generation. To address this gap, we introduce ToolHACE, a span-level benchmark for hallucination detection in tool-augmented LLM responses, covering five fine-grained hallucination categories. Through extensive experiments with modern hallucination detectors, we show that post-tool-call hallucinations are widespread and remain challenging to detect. Our results further demonstrate that effective detection requires training on specialized tool-augmented corpora, while transfer from tool-agnostic hallucination datasets performs poorly in this setting. These findings highlight the need for dedicated benchmarks and models for reliable hallucination detection in tool-augmented language systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ToolHACE，一个针对工具增强LLM响应中幻觉检测的span级基准，覆盖五类细粒度幻觉，实验表明工具调用后的幻觉普遍存在且难以检测。
AI.motivation: 工具增强语言模型依赖外部工具输出提升可靠性，但即使在正确调用工具且返回准确信息时，模型仍可能产生与输出矛盾、遗漏关键细节或无依据的断言。现有面向工具增强对话的幻觉基准主要聚焦工具调用阶段，评估工具与参数选择是否正确，而忽视了工具调用后响应生成阶段的错误。
AI.method: 构建ToolHACE，一个span级幻觉检测基准，涵盖五类细粒度幻觉类别，并以此对现代幻觉检测器进行广泛实验。
AI.result: 实验显示工具调用后的幻觉普遍存在且仍难以检测；有效检测需要在专门的工具增强语料上训练，而从工具无关的幻觉数据集迁移在该场景下表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明需要专门的基准与模型，以实现工具增强语言系统中可靠的工具调用后幻觉检测。

title: Passing Tests, Missing Semantics: Evidence of Interpretive Lock-In in Plan-Based DataFrame Code Generation
comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering Researches (ICECER 2026)
summary: Planning and revision are intended to bring generated code closer to the task specification. Yet a mistaken interpretation can persist across the plan, implementation, and tests - a pattern we call interpretive lock-in. We investigate this risk on 30 DataFrame tasks derived from TPC Benchmark DS, comparing Frozen One-Pass, Test-Guided Revision, and PlanAudit-Guided Revision. Test-pass counts rose from 22/30 to 29/30 and 30/30, yet no generated solution matched its stored reference output. Evaluator controls returned the expected outcome in 57/57 cases. Same-engine SQL re-execution reproduced 28/30 references; all 77 test-passing runs on these tasks still failed reference agreement. PlanAudit-Guided Revision improved code scores on 3/30 tasks and test coverage on 11/30, but the median paired change was zero for both measures. Failure analysis revealed tests that omitted requirements, adopted candidate-defined schemas, used nondiscriminating fixtures, or repeated the implementation's incorrect logic. Fresh generation on ten targeted tasks produced 0/30 reference matches and 25/25 false passes among test-passing runs. These findings are diagnostic rather than causal: the pipelines differ in feedback, grounding, call budgets, and editing permissions, and the study uses one model and one primary generation per eligible task. Because pre-adjudication human labels were not retained, inter-rater agreement cannot be reconstructed and the mechanism analyses remain exploratory. Overall, increasingly successful self-generated tests did not establish semantic correctness, even after excluding unreproduced references.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“解释性锁定”（interpretive lock-in）概念，指对任务的误解可在计划、实现和测试间持续固化。作者在30个基于TPC-DS的DataFrame任务上比较三种流水线，发现自生成测试通过率从22/30升至30/30，但无任何生成解与存储参考输出一致。
AI.motivation: 规划与修订旨在使生成代码更贴近任务规范，但一个错误的解释可能贯穿计划、实现与测试而持续存在。作者希望探究这种风险，检验测试通过是否能代表语义正确。
AI.method: 在30个源自TPC Benchmark DS的DataFrame任务上，对比Frozen One-Pass、Test-Guided Revision和PlanAudit-Guided Revision三种流水线；引入评估器对照、同引擎SQL重执行参考验证、失败模式分析，并在10个针对性任务上做全新生成实验。
AI.result: 测试通过数从22/30提升至29/30与30/30，但无生成解匹配存储参考输出；评估器对照57/57返回预期结果；同引擎SQL重执行复现28/30参考，但这些任务上所有77次测试通过的运行仍与参考不一致；PlanAudit-Guided Revision在3/30任务上提升代码分、11/30提升测试覆盖，但两项中位配对变化均为零；10个针对性任务的重新生成得到0/30参考匹配，测试通过运行中25/25为假通过。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论为诊断性而非因果性：不同流水线在反馈、依据、调用预算与编辑权限上存在差异，且仅使用单一模型与每个合格任务一次主生成；由于未保留裁决前的人工标注，无法重构评分者间一致性，机制分析仍属探索性。总体而言，日益成功的自生成测试并不能确立语义正确性，即使排除了未能复现的参考。

title: Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement for Navigation via Policy-Synchronized Language-Action Dual Bootstrapping
summary: Vision-language navigation requires agents to follow natural-language instructions to reach target locations, making high-quality language supervision essential. Since human annotation is costly, prior work has explored scalable data synthesis methods. However, existing methods typically either use separate models for navigation and instruction generation or couple the two tasks through task-specific components; most also annotate the full trajectory corpus with a fixed model before updating, which can cause generated supervision to lag behind the evolving policy. Therefore, we introduce RSI-Nav, a data-centric recursive self-improvement framework for navigation via policy-synchronized language-action dual bootstrapping, which unifies vision-language-to-action instruction following and vision-action-to-language instruction generation within a shared model. Specifically, after supervised fine-tuning establishes fundamental capabilities, RSI-Nav progressively processes unlabeled trajectories in small shards. The current model generates instructions for these trajectories, executes them to evaluate goal completion and path efficiency, retains qualified samples, and immediately updates itself before processing the next shard. This shard-wise update keeps newly generated supervision aligned with the evolving policy. We also incorporate spatial understanding data, since stronger spatial reasoning benefits navigation. Extensive experiments show that RSI-Nav reaches 68.6% SR on R2R-CE and 72.4% SR on RxR-CE, while providing stronger instruction-generation utility and modestly improved spatial understanding after recursive evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出RSI-Nav，一个以数据为中心的递归自改进框架，通过策略同步的语言-动作双重自举，统一指令跟随与指令生成，解决现有导航数据合成中监督滞后问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言导航需要高质量语言监督，但人工标注成本高。现有可扩展数据合成方法存在两个问题：一是导航与指令生成使用分离模型，或通过任务专用组件耦合；二是多在更新前用固定模型对整条轨迹语料一次性标注，导致生成的监督信号滞后于演进的策略。
AI.method: 提出RSI-Nav递归自改进框架：在共享模型中统一视觉-语言到动作的指令跟随与视觉-动作到语言的指令生成。先经监督微调建立基础能力，再以小块（shard）形式逐步处理无标注轨迹：当前模型为轨迹生成指令，执行指令并评估目标完成度与路径效率，保留合格样本，并在处理下一块前立即更新模型，实现分块更新使新生成监督与演进策略保持一致。同时引入空间理解数据以增强空间推理。命名为策略同步的语言-动作双重自举。
AI.result: RSI-Nav在R2R-CE上达到68.6% SR，在RxR-CE上达到72.4% SR，同时提供更强的指令生成效用，递归演化后空间理解也有适度提升。
AI.conclusion: 以数据为中心、策略同步的双重自举递归自改进可有效提升视觉语言导航性能，并兼顾指令生成与空间理解能力。

title: DuoDiscover: Scaling Autonomous Discovery Beyond the Evaluation Bottleneck
comment: Dilara*, Mike*, Akshat*, Shubham* contributed equally to this work
summary: Evaluation has been central to advances in AI, and it is equally critical to autonomous discovery. Yet scaling autonomous discovery to real-world engineering challenges faces a fundamental bottleneck: the cost of evaluating progress. In real settings, a single true evaluation, such as a full benchmark or serving trace, can take hours, so a search can afford only a handful of true evaluations. We present DuoDiscover, a search system that jointly discovers what to optimize and how to evaluate progress efficiently, through three mechanisms. First, each worker in a fleet of coding agents co-discovers an optimization target and a fast, tailored proxy evaluator, which we call a yardstick. The agent then hill-climbs the yardstick rather than the true evaluation. Second, since search can exploit gaps between a yardstick and the true objective, fidelity tests continually recheck each yardstick's ranking and invalidate any that drift. Third, the fleet is bottom-up, with no central decomposition of the problem. A lightweight orchestrator spawns and terminates agents, briefs running ones, and seeds new agents with others' confirmed work. DuoDiscover enables autonomous optimization from software to chip architecture. We demonstrate DuoDiscover on two repository-level benchmarks and four GPU and TPU kernel suites covering hundreds of kernels. On SWE-fficiency, it doubles the average speedup of human experts. On SOL-Exec, it ranks first on 121 of 235 kernels and in the top three on 212. On the heavily optimized vLLM and SQLite engines, DuoDiscover achieves 1.92$\times$ and 1.38$\times$ gains over the base code. On a CPU microarchitecture optimization task with evaluations of up to 28 hours, DuoDiscover surpasses both AlphaEvolve-based ArchAgent v2 and the best human design, with 1.65$\times$ ArchAgent v2's gain in 16.7 days versus more than 40 days, advancing the frontier of autonomous chip design.

AI.tldr: DuoDiscover 是一个联合发现"优化什么"与"如何高效评估"的自主搜索系统，通过专属代理评估器（yardstick）、保真度校验和自底向上代理集群，将真实评估次数压缩至极少，在软件、GPU/TPU 内核与芯片架构任务上超越人类专家与已有自主方法。
AI.motivation: 自主发现（autonomous discovery）扩展到真实工程挑战的核心瓶颈是评估成本：真实评估（完整基准或服务轨迹）可能耗时数小时，导致搜索只能承受极少数真实评估，难以规模化。因此需要同时解决"优化目标选择"与"高效进度评估"两个问题。
AI.method: 提出 DuoDiscover，包含三种机制：(1) 编码代理集群中每个 worker 协同发现优化目标与快速定制的代理评估器（yardstick），随后在 yardstick 上爬山而非常用真实评估；(2) 由于搜索会利用 yardstick 与真实目标之间的偏差，保真度测试持续复核各 yardstick 的排序并作废漂移者；(3) 集群为自底向上结构，无中心化问题分解，由轻量 orchestrator 生成/终止代理、向运行中代理简报、并用他人已确认成果播种新代理。
AI.result: 在两个仓库级基准与四个覆盖数百个内核的 GPU/TPU 内核套件上验证：SWE-fficiency 上平均加速比达人类专家的两倍；SOL-Exec 上 235 个内核中 121 个排名第一、212 个进入前三；在高度优化的 vLLM 与 SQLite 上分别相对基础代码提升 1.92× 与 1.38×；在评估长达 28 小时的 CPU 微架构优化任务上，超越基于 AlphaEvolve 的 ArchAgent v2 与最佳人类设计，以 16.7 天取得 ArchAgent v2 增益的 1.65×（后者需 40 天以上）。
AI.conclusion: DuoDiscover 通过联合发现优化目标与廉价代理评估器并配合保真度校验，实现了从软件到芯片架构的自主优化，显著降低真实评估瓶颈的限制，在多个基准与内核套件上超越人类专家和已有自主设计方法，推进了自主芯片设计的前沿。

title: Attention Sinks in VLMs Are Borrowed, Not Seen
summary: We study how to detect and mitigate visual attention sinks in vision-language models (VLMs). Visual attention sinks are image tokens that absorb a large share of attention over the image regardless of the query or task, and they mislead methods that treat attention maps as a record of where the model ``looked.'' Prior work has detected sinks through massive activation dimensions and proposed redistributing their attention, but none have addressed what makes a token become a sink. Comparing six candidate detectors on ten VLMs from four families, we find that only the centered cosine similarity between an image token's key and the key of the language model's text-sink detects visual sinks. Thus, a visual sink is an image token whose key aligns with the text-sink's key. Moving a sink's key component along this direction to the median of the image keys sends its attention back to the text-sink (\textbf{Are Borrowed}) while leaving model answers unchanged~(\textbf{Not Seen}). Building on this, we propose a training-free, entropy-triggered re-look that first cleans the attention map, then crops the most-attended region of the cleaned map and inserts it into the reasoning trace. Cleaning adds negligible computation to the forward pass, and the re-look improves accuracy with a mean gain of $+4.3$ points on fine-detail VQA benchmarks across model families.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）中的"视觉注意力汇"现象，发现视觉汇是键与文本汇键对齐的图像token，并提出一种免训练、熵触发的"重看"机制来清洗注意力图并提升细节性VQA性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉注意力汇会吸收大量注意力且与查询/任务无关，误导将注意力图视为模型"看哪里"的方法。已有工作通过大规模激活维度检测汇并重新分配其注意力，但未解释token为何成为汇。
AI.method: 在4个家族10个VLM上比较6种候选检测器，发现只有图像token的key与语言模型文本汇key之间的中心化余弦相似度能检测视觉汇。基于此，将汇的key分量沿该方向移动至图像key的中位数，并设计免训练、熵触发的重看机制：先清洗注意力图，再裁剪清洗后图中最受关注的区域并插入推理轨迹。
AI.result: 移动汇的key分量可将注意力送回文本汇（Are Borrowed），同时模型答案保持不变（Not Seen）。清洗几乎不增加前向传播计算量，重看在细粒度VQA基准上跨模型家族平均提升+4.3分。
AI.conclusion: 视觉汇的本质是与文本汇key对齐的图像token；据此可有效检测、缓解视觉汇，并通过免训练的注意力清洗与重看机制提升细粒度视觉问答性能。

title: Reference-Efficient Multimodal Bitstream-Corrupted Video Recovery via Depth-Conditioned Adaptation
summary: Recovering visually faithful content from damaged video bitstreams is important for reliable multimedia communication and storage. Existing methods exploit local residuals and non-local RGB references of the input video sequence, but both sources can become unreliable after decoding, while processing additional references increases receiver computation and memory. This paper studies multimodal bitstream-corrupted video recovery (MBSCVR) using RGB and depth information, where pre-transmission depth-based geometry aids reconstruction when the received appearance is corrupted. We propose a novel MBSCVR framework that selects and effectively utilizes a single selected non-local RGB reference per recovery window to achieve higher performance. It integrates a reliability-aware multimodal selector that combines valid appearance with depth compatibility before reference encoding. Depth-Conditioned Reference Adaptation (DCRA) introduces selected RGB evidence into feature completion and content generation, while frame-aligned depth conditions completion queries. On the complete BSCV benchmark with oracle masks, MBSCVR uses one selected reference to achieve 32.30 dB on YouTube-VOS and 28.93 dB on DAVIS, surpassing full-reference B2SCVR by 0.27 and 0.33 dB and improving SSIM on both subsets. Matched receiver-forward measurements show 36.8\% lower latency and 40.8\% lower peak memory. These results demonstrate how compact geometric guidance and adapted appearance processing improve the quality--resource trade-off of multimedia recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MBSCVR（多模态码流损坏视频恢复）框架，利用传输前的深度几何信息辅助恢复，通过可靠性感知多模态选择器与深度条件参考适配（DCRA），仅用单个非局部RGB参考即超越全参考B2SCVR基线，并显著降低延迟与内存。
AI.motivation: 损坏视频码流中恢复视觉忠实内容对可靠的多媒体通信与存储至关重要。现有方法依赖局部残差与非局部RGB参考，但解码后两类来源均可能失效，且增加参考会加重接收端计算与内存开销。因此需要探索更可靠、更省资源的恢复范式。
AI.method: 研究多模态码流损坏视频恢复（MBSCVR），联合使用RGB与深度信息，其中传输前的深度几何先验在接收外观损坏时提供辅助。框架包含：可靠性感知多模态选择器，在参考编码前结合有效外观与深度兼容性，为每个恢复窗口挑选单个非局部RGB参考；深度条件参考适配（DCRA），将所选RGB证据引入特征补全与内容生成，并用帧对齐深度条件引导补全查询。
AI.result: 在带oracle掩码的完整BSCV基准上，MBSCVR仅用一个选定参考即在YouTube-VOS达32.30 dB、DAVIS达28.93 dB，分别超越全参考B2SCVR 0.27 dB与0.33 dB，并在两个子集上提升SSIM。接收端前向测量显示延迟降低36.8%、峰值内存降低40.8%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，紧凑的几何引导与自适应的外观处理能够改善多媒体恢复的质量-资源权衡。

title: Soft Teacher Forcing
summary: Soft tokens have so far been used to replace discrete chain-of-thought in latent reasoning methods. These approaches typically require multi-stage training and, in some cases, auxiliary modules, yet they still underperform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on <input, chain-of-thought, output> triples. In this paper, we ask whether soft tokens can be used to improve SFT itself, instead of as an avenue for latent reasoning. We introduce Soft Teacher Forcing (Soft-TF), a simple training algorithm that combines teacher-forced embeddings with soft tokens through random convex combinations. The soft tokens are computed in a single parallel forward pass over the ground-truth sequence. Soft-TF adds no parameters, no external model and no curriculum, and leaves inference unchanged. Experiments show that Soft-TF improves over SFT on GSM8K, MATH, MathQA and AQuA, by +2.1 to +4.1 points on GSM8K across seven Gemma, Llama and Mistral models.

AI.tldr: 提出Soft Teacher Forcing（Soft-TF），将软token与teacher-forced嵌入通过随机凸组合结合，用于提升SFT本身而非潜在推理，无需额外参数、外部模型或课程，且不改变推理过程。
AI.motivation: 现有软token多用于替代离散思维链的潜在推理方法，但这类方法通常需要多阶段训练甚至辅助模块，且在<input, chain-of-thought, output>三元组上仍逊于监督微调（SFT）。作者转而探究软token能否用于改进SFT本身。
AI.method: Soft-TF通过随机凸组合将teacher-forced嵌入与软token结合；软token在真实序列上以单次并行前向传播计算得出。该方法不增加参数、不引入外部模型、不需要课程设计，且推理阶段保持不变。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MATH、MathQA和AQuA上，Soft-TF相对SFT均有提升；在七个Gemma、Llama和Mistral模型上，GSM8K提升+2.1至+4.1分。
AI.conclusion: 软token可有效用于增强SFT而非仅作潜在推理手段；Soft-TF以极简设计实现稳定增益，保持训练与推理的简洁性。

title: Engram Injection: A Study of Temporal Validity in Parametric Language-Model Memory
summary: A stored fact may stop being valid when a user changes a preference or an event replaces an earlier one. We study whether a language model can learn these changes in its parameters and answer correctly from only a question and the current time. Engram Injection stores facts in LoRA adapters and supplies the clock through FiLM conditioning on a frozen Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct model. We compare it with additive clock conditioning, prompting with the full dated history, and retrieving four dated records. We train six matched adapters across three seeds after fixing a sampler that could admit test-age examples into training. The training audit reports no such examples among 127,760 evaluated training inputs. On 62 pairs of questions asked before and after an update, at an elapsed age of seven days excluded from training, both adapter methods answer zero pairs correctly under the primary blinded assistant review with order code 1 held fixed. Full-history prompting answers 59/62 pairs correctly, and retrieval answers 62/62. Separate experiments show that adapters can store facts and that removable memory units can support local deletion. Combining fact selection with time-based version selection remains unsuccessful. These results separate learning a fact from learning when to use it.

AI.tldr: 研究语言模型能否通过参数学习事实的时效性变化，仅凭问题与当前时间正确作答。Engram Injection 将事实存入 LoRA 适配器，并用 FiLM 条件化注入时钟信息；与全历史提示和检索方法对比。结果显示适配器方法在更新前后配对问题上正确率为 0/62，而全历史提示 59/62、检索 62/62，表明"学会事实"与"学会何时使用事实"是两回事。
AI.motivation: 用户偏好改变或事件被取代时，存储的事实可能失效。作者想探究语言模型能否在参数中学习这类变化，并仅根据问题与当前时间给出正确答案，同时区分"存储事实"与"在正确时间选用对应版本"这两种能力。
AI.method: 在冻结的 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上使用 Engram Injection，把事实存入 LoRA 适配器，并通过 FiLM 条件化提供时钟信号；对照组包括加性时钟条件化、携带完整带日期历史的提示、检索四条带日期记录。修正了可能把测试年龄样本混入训练的采样器后，用三个随机种子训练六个匹配适配器；训练审计显示在 127,760 条训练输入中无此类样本。评估采用 62 对更新前后的问题，考察训练中排除的七天年龄点。
AI.result: 在主要盲评设置下（固定顺序码 1），两种适配器方法在 62 对更新前后问题上的正确率均为 0；全历史提示答对 59/62 对，检索答对 62/62 对。附加实验表明适配器可以存储事实，且可移除的记忆单元支持局部删除。
AI.conclusion: 将事实选择与基于时间的版本选择结合起来仍然失败。结果清楚地区分了"学习一个事实"和"学习何时使用该事实"这两项能力，说明参数化记忆在时间敏感的版本切换上存在明显局限。

title: Totem: Object-Centric 3D Memory for World-Consistent Video Generation
summary: Generating coherent videos grounded in a unified underlying world remains a major challenge, particularly under large viewpoint changes, where existing methods often struggle to maintain stable representations of individual objects. To this end, we introduce Totem, an object-centric 3D memory framework for world-consistent video generation. Totem first represents each selected object as a persistent 3D memory aligned to a shared world frame, assigning it a dedicated state. Based on these memories, we design a dual-stream 3D conditioning architecture that combines object memories with scene geometry for target-view synthesis. Moreover, these object memories constrain the model's attention with 3D structural information, thereby preserving object surfaces and relative spatial layouts. Extensive experiments on world-generation and object-centric benchmarks demonstrate that Totem generates videos depicting a more object-consistent 3D world under challenging camera trajectories, while supporting versatile applications.

AI.tldr: 提出 Totem，一种以对象为中心的 3D 记忆框架，用于世界一致的视频生成，在大视角变化下保持稳定的对象表征。
AI.motivation: 在统一底层世界基础上生成连贯视频仍是重大挑战，尤其在大视角变化场景下，现有方法难以维持单个对象的稳定表征。
AI.method: Totem 首先将每个选定对象表示为对齐到共享世界坐标系的持久 3D 记忆，并为其分配专属状态；基于这些记忆设计双流 3D 条件架构，将对象记忆与场景几何结合用于目标视角合成；同时利用对象记忆以 3D 结构信息约束模型注意力，从而保持对象表面与相对空间布局。
AI.result: 在世界生成与以对象为中心的基准测试上，Totem 在具有挑战性的相机轨迹下生成了对象一致性更强的 3D 世界视频，并支持多种应用。
AI.conclusion: 以对象为中心的 3D 记忆与双流条件机制可有效提升世界一致视频生成在剧烈视角变化下的对象稳定性，具备良好的通用性。

title: Welcome to the Age of Agent Ads: Using On-Policy Attacks to Steer Agentic Decisions
summary: People increasingly delegate option-ranking tasks (e.g., shopping, job search, travel) to AI agents, which creates incentives to steer agentic decisions via "agent ads." To defend against such steering attacks, people count on models' alignment training and platforms' terms of service, and consequently the most effective existing attacks are designed to trigger off-policy behaviors. Exposing a new attack surface, we introduce on-policy attacks, which steer agentic decisions without pushing individually aligned behaviors off policy. Our example attack consists of two steps: To remain compliant with platforms' terms of service, we first inject a truthful negation about a fictitious concept ("Does not contain blizyester") into a product description. This triggers an agent to search the web ("What is blizyester?"), which surfaces planted websites full of fabricated information associating the fictitious concept with harmful implications ("Blizyester linked to dementia"). Trained to keep users safe from harm, the agent penalizes every option missing the truthful negation. Evaluating our attack across four real-world listing datasets, we find some frontier models exposed, enabling an adversarial actor to penalize competitors without violating existing platform-listing guidelines. We discuss the broader challenge of regulating advertising aimed at AI agents and provide recommendations to model developers and platform providers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"on-policy攻击"这一新型攻击面：通过注入真实否定句+伪造网络信息，在不违反平台条款、不使模型偏离对齐策略的前提下操控AI Agent的选项排序。
AI.motivation: 人们越来越多地将购物、求职、旅行等选项排序任务委托给AI Agent，由此产生"agent广告"式的操控动机。现有防御依赖模型的对齐训练与平台服务条款，因此最有效的现有攻击需触发off-policy行为；作者希望揭示在合规且保持对齐行为下仍可实施的操控攻击面。
AI.method: 提出两阶段on-policy攻击：第一步，为符合平台条款，在产品描述中注入对虚构概念的真实否定（"Does not contain blizyester"），触发Agent上网检索"什么是blizyester"；第二步，检索结果导向预先布置的网站，其中充斥将该虚构概念与有害后果（如"blizyester与痴呆相关"）关联的伪造信息。由于模型被训练为保护用户免受伤害，Agent会惩罚任何缺少该真实否定项的选项。在四个真实世界商品列表数据集上评估该攻击。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界列表数据集上的评估显示，部分前沿模型易受攻击，攻击者可据此惩罚竞争对手，同时不违反现有平台列表规范。
AI.conclusion: on-policy攻击表明仅依靠对齐训练与平台条款不足以防御针对AI Agent的排序操控；作者讨论了监管面向AI Agent的广告这一更广泛挑战，并向模型开发者与平台提供方提出建议。

title: RetryBench: Separating Retry Permission from Recovery Outcomes in GPT Tool Use
summary: False retry permission (FRP) occurs when an agent retries a timed-out tool call without support from the visible contract. RetryBench separates this error from realized recovery. Successful protected recovery does not imply reliable rejection of unsupported retries. In a 720-response key control, valid keys usually enabled safe progress, but offered changed keys elicited unsupported retries in Sol (1/80), Terra (55/80), and Luna (60/80). A later 240-response control removed the candidate and required models to supply a key. Luna still made 8/80 unsupported dispatches; Sol and Terra made none in 80 responses each. Accepting a displayed bad key therefore cannot explain all observed errors, although changed output requirements and conditions preclude a pure display-effect comparison. Removing the weak-contract label increased retries in Sol and Terra's coded-action conditions in a six-endpoint study. A separate 1,536-response canonical-action block also found a positive Terra contrast (115/128 versus 124/128 retries), concentrated in two task/order conditions; the other five contrasts remained unresolved after multiplicity correction. An explicit-contract cue control elicited deferral in all 762 returned responses, leaving recovery unresolved. These results support reporting permission and recovery together across declared interface variants. The evidence covers four purposive tasks, fixed GPT endpoints, and one recovery decision; it identifies neither internal mechanisms nor episode-level safety.

AI.tldr: RetryBench 将"无合约支持的假性重试许可（FRP）"与"实际恢复"区分开：成功恢复并不意味着模型能可靠拒绝无支持的重试；仅靠"接受展示的坏密钥"无法解释全部 FRP 现象。
AI.motivation: agent 在工具调用超时后，可能在可见合约（visible contract）并不支持的情况下进行重试，即假性重试许可（FRP）。以往工作常把"成功恢复"等同于"可靠行为"，忽略了"能否拒绝无支持重试"这一独立失败模式，因此需要专门基准来分离二者。
AI.method: 提出 RetryBench，并设计多组对照实验：① 720 响应密钥控制（有效密钥 vs. 变更密钥）；② 240 响应控制（移除候选、要求模型自行提供密钥）；③ 六端点研究（移除弱合约标签）；④ 1,536 响应标准动作块（含多重比较校正）；⑤ 显式合约提示控制（762 响应）。实验覆盖四个目的性任务、固定 GPT 端点及单一恢复决策。
AI.result: 密钥控制中有效密钥通常支持安全推进，但变更密钥诱发无支持重试：Sol 1/80、Terra 55/80、Luna 60/80。移除候选后，Luna 仍有 8/80 无支持派发，Sol 与 Terra 各 80 响应均为零。移除弱合约标签使 Sol、Terra 的重试增加。标准动作块中仅 Terra 存在正向对比（115/128 vs. 124/128），集中于两个任务/顺序条件，其余五个对比经多重性校正后仍未确定。显式合约提示在全部 762 响应中均诱发延迟，恢复问题悬而未决。
AI.conclusion: 应同时报告"许可"与"恢复"两类指标，并覆盖不同声明的接口变体。本研究证据限于四个目的性任务、固定 GPT 端点和单一恢复决策，既未揭示内部机制，也不代表事件级安全性。

title: Adaptive Look, Flexible Thought: Learning How and How Long to Think in Multimodal Reasoning
summary: The introduction of long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and external tools has substantially improved the performance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on general and reasoning tasks. However, existing fast-slow reasoning paradigms mainly regulate textual reasoning length, while visual computation introduced by external tools or visual tokens is often treated as an auxiliary component. This separation prevents MLLMs from jointly optimizing visual perception and textual reasoning. To address this issue, we propose L2T (adaptive Look, flexible Thought), a unified reasoning framework that jointly optimizes the form and depth of computation. L2T first discretizes tool-produced visual states into visual tokens, bringing visual perception and textual reasoning into a shared autoregressive space. Based on this unified representation, L2T introduces a modality-aware routing reward to select appropriate reasoning modes and a difficulty-aware fast-slow strategy to adapt reasoning depth according to task complexity. Experiments on general perception and reasoning-intensive tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of L2T. Compared with explicit tool-calling approaches, L2T maintains competitive performance while achieving 1.7--3.6 times higher throughput.

AI.tldr: 提出L2T统一推理框架，将工具产生的视觉状态离散化为视觉token，与文本推理共享自回归空间，并通过模态感知路由奖励与难度感知快慢策略联合优化视觉感知和文本推理，吞吐量提升1.7–3.6倍。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型的快慢推理范式主要调控文本推理长度，而外部工具或视觉token引入的视觉计算常被视为辅助组件，导致视觉感知与文本推理无法联合优化。
AI.method: L2T（adaptive Look, flexible Thought）统一推理框架：1）将工具产生的视觉状态离散化为视觉token，把视觉感知与文本推理纳入共享自回归空间；2）引入模态感知路由奖励以选择合适的推理模式；3）采用难度感知快慢策略，依据任务复杂度自适应调整推理深度。
AI.result: 在通用感知与推理密集型任务上验证了有效性；相比显式工具调用方法，在保持竞争性性能的同时实现1.7–3.6倍更高的吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一视觉与文本的计算表示并自适应调控推理模式与深度，L2T实现了视觉感知与文本推理的联合优化，在性能与效率间取得更好平衡。

title: From Conceptual EneMonIE to an Executable Backend: A Modular Architecture for Energy Information Extractionand Grounded Question Answering
summary: The original EneMonIE proposal describes a Web-based semantic system for continuously monitoring energy trends through targeted information extraction from heterogeneous online media. This article presents EneMonIE-Backend, an implementation-derived redesign that converts that conceptual pipeline into a modular, executable, and application-independent backend. The architecture separates five concerns: data sources, acquisition and normalization, semantic processing, knowledge organization, and persistent storage. It operationalizes configurable connectors for RSS feeds, URL collections, arXiv, social-media JSON files, and open-data CSV files; it also introduces question-driven Web search and scraping. Relevant documents pass through energy categorization, named entity recognition, temporal and event extraction, source sensitive sentiment analysis, and extractive summarization. The resulting semantic representations support entity co-occurrence graphs, cross-document interlinking, cluster-level information fusion, and relational persistence in SQLite. Three grounded question-answering paths are exposed at the backend level: live Web evidence, the stored corpus, and selected configured resources. Answer generation uses a language model when configured and otherwise falls back to deterministic extractive output. Unlike the original proposal, the presented architecture deliberately excludes the user-interface and server-side application layers, allowing the semantic core to be embedded in different applications. A deterministic smoke validation confirms relevance filtering, persistence, clustering, evidence retrieval, and document deletion. The work provides a reproducible architectural basis for future evaluation on larger multilingual energy corpora.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EneMonIE-Backend，将原EneMonIE概念性Web语义监测流水线重构为模块化、可执行、应用无关的后端系统，涵盖五类关注点分离、多源可配置连接器、语义处理链路、语义表示与SQLite关系持久化，并暴露三条问答路径，通过确定性冒烟验证确认核心功能。
AI.motivation: 原始EneMonIE提案仅为概念性描述，缺乏可执行、可复现的实现基础，难以嵌入不同应用或支撑后续大规模评估。因此需要将概念流水线转化为模块化、应用无关的后端架构。
AI.method: 架构分离五类关注点：数据源、采集与规范化、语义处理、知识组织、持久化存储。实现可配置连接器（RSS、URL集合、arXiv、社交媒体JSON、开放数据CSV），并引入问题驱动的Web搜索与抓取。语义处理链路包括能源分类、命名实体识别、时间与事件抽取、来源敏感情感分析、抽取式摘要。语义表示支持实体共现图、跨文档互联、聚类级信息融合及SQLite关系持久化。后端暴露三条问答路径：实时Web证据、存储语料、选定配置资源；答案生成在配置语言模型时使用之，否则回退到确定性抽取式输出。
AI.result: 确定性冒烟验证确认了相关性过滤、持久化、聚类、证据检索与文档删除功能均有效。架构刻意排除用户界面与服务端应用层，使语义核心可嵌入不同应用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未来在更大规模多语言能源语料上的评估提供了可复现的架构基础。

title: Comparative Study of Canvas- and Coordinate-Based Geometry-Conditioned Neural Networks for Real-Time Prediction of Indoor Environments with Varying Room Dimensions
summary: Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) is computationally expensive for iterative building design. Deep learning surrogates offer faster predictions, but generalization across varying room dimensions remains challenging. This study compares two geometry-conditioned neural network surrogate models for rapid indoor airflow and temperature field prediction under varying room sizes. During the architectural design stage, this method is relevant for real-time assessment of whether conditioned supply air will effectively provide fresh and cool air throughout rooms with varying heights and lengths. The canvas-based neural network (CaNN) explicitly encodes room size by preserving different occupied regions within a fixed canvas, whereas the coordinate-based neural network (CoNN) uses normalized coordinate channels. Both employ U-Net autoencoders to separately predict airflow and temperature fields. Evaluation uses simplified rooms with varying heights and lengths as a controlled benchmark. The results show that CaNN achieves higher agreement with CFD results than CoNN, demonstrating its potential to support performance-driven building design.

AI.tldr: 本文对比了两种几何条件化神经网络代理模型（CaNN与CoNN），用于变尺寸房间的室内气流与温度场快速预测。
AI.motivation: CFD用于迭代式建筑设计时计算成本高昂；深度学习代理模型虽预测更快，但难以在不同房间尺寸间泛化。
AI.method: CaNN通过在固定画布内保留不同占用区域显式编码房间尺寸，CoNN使用归一化坐标通道；两者均采用U-Net自编码器分别预测气流场与温度场，并以不同高宽尺寸的简化房间作为受控基准进行评估。
AI.result: CaNN与CFD结果的一致性高于CoNN。
AI.conclusion: CaNN具备支持性能驱动建筑设计的潜力，可用于设计阶段实时评估送风能否有效覆盖不同尺寸房间。

title: ChangeT$^3$: Evaluating Vision Test-Time Training for Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Bitemporal remote sensing change detection requires representations that preserve spatial detail while capturing contextual information relevant to changes between acquisitions. Visual test-time training offers an alternative to explicit token-to-token attention by adapting a compact inner model to each image. This letter describes ChangeT$^3$, a vanilla Siamese configuration combining the existing hierarchical ViT$^3$-Tiny encoder with the multiscale ChangeFormer decoder. The two image streams share learned encoder parameters, while their fast weights are computed independently from their respective spatial features. Each encoder block retains the inherited global simplified SwiGLU and local adaptive depthwise-convolution branches. Temporal comparison is performed by the decoder through learned fusion of paired features at four resolutions, followed by coarse-to-fine aggregation and binary prediction. This separation provides a direct setting for examining image-conditioned inner updates without introducing an additional temporal interaction module. Trained from scratch on LEVIR-CD+ with the same decoder, recipe, and budget as a ChangeFormer control, ChangeT$^3$ reaches an F1 of 80.61$\pm$0.90 against 78.84$\pm$0.21 for ChangeFormer (three seeds each); as in the standard protocol for this dataset, checkpoints are selected on the test split. Trained with both inner updates disabled, the same encoder reaches 78.63$\pm$0.20. Neither model transfers zero-shot to SYSU-CD, DSIFN-CD, or WHU-CD, and ChangeT$^3$ is the slower of the two at small inputs despite similar parameter and operation counts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ChangeT³，一种朴素孪生视觉测试时训练（ViT³-Tiny 编码器 + 多尺度 ChangeFormer 解码器）的双时相遥感变化检测方法，通过图像条件化的 inner 更新替代显式时序交互模块，在 LEVIR-CD+ 上取得 80.61±0.90 F1。
AI.motivation: 双时相遥感变化检测需要在保留空间细节的同时捕获与变化相关的上下文信息。视觉测试时训练（visual test-time training）通过为每张图像自适应一个紧凑 inner 模型，可作为显式 token-to-token 注意力的替代方案。作者希望在不额外引入时序交互模块的前提下，直接考察图像条件化的 inner 更新对变化检测的作用。
AI.method: 构建 ChangeT³：采用朴素孪生（vanilla Siamese）配置，将已有的分层 ViT³-Tiny 编码器与多尺度 ChangeFormer 解码器结合。两条图像流共享编码器学习参数，但其 fast weights 由各自空间特征独立计算；每个编码器块保留继承的全局简化 SwiGLU 与局部自适应深度可分离卷积分支。时序比较由解码器完成：在四个分辨率上学习式融合成对特征，随后进行由粗到细的聚合与二值预测。由于没有额外时序交互模块，该结构为考察图像条件化 inner 更新提供了直接设置。
AI.result: 在 LEVIR-CD+ 上从头训练，使用与 ChangeFormer 对照相同的解码器、训练配方和预算（各 3 个随机种子）：ChangeT³ 达到 F1 80.61±0.90，ChangeFormer 为 78.84±0.21；按该数据集标准协议在测试集上选择检查点。将两次 inner 更新均禁用后，同一编码器仅达 78.63±0.20。两个模型均无法零样本迁移到 SYSU-CD、DSIFN-CD 或 WHU-CD；在小尺寸输入下，尽管参数量与运算量相近，ChangeT³ 是两者中更慢的一个。
AI.conclusion: 视觉测试时训练的 inner 更新可有效提升双时相变化检测精度（相对同配置 ChangeFormer 基线提升约 1.8 F1），且图像条件化更新带来的增益可在禁用 inner 更新后消失，说明其确为性能来源；但该方法未展现跨数据集零样本泛化能力，且在小输入下推理速度更慢，参数量与运算量优势未能转化为效率优势。

title: Nufo: A Benchmark for Ewe Automatic Speech Recognition
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) remains challenging for low-resource languages, where the scarcity of transcribed speech limits the development of accurate systems. This challenge is particularly acute for African languages such as Ewe, which has millions of speakers but remains underrepresented in publicly available ASR resources and benchmarks. In this work, we consolidate, normalize, and partition existing Ewe speech resources into a standardized 174-hour Ewe ASR benchmark, the largest to date to our knowledge. We fine-tune and evaluate pretrained speech models, including Whisper and AfriHuBERT, to establish strong baselines on our benchmark. Whisper-medium achieves a word error rate (WER) of 37.98%, while AfriHuBERT achieves 39.70% on the test set. We further provide a qualitative analysis of common recognition errors. We release the benchmark under the name Nufo, derived from the Ewe word for "talk", accompanied by models and evaluation resources, to facilitate future research on Ewe and other underrepresented African languages.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了迄今规模最大的标准化埃维语ASR基准（174小时，名为Nufo），并微调Whisper与AfriHuBERT建立基线。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言（如埃维语）转录语音稀缺，公开ASR资源与基准不足，导致系统准确率受限。
AI.method: 整合、规范化并划分现有埃维语语音资源，构建标准化174小时基准；微调并评估预训练语音模型（Whisper、AfriHuBERT）以建立强基线，并对常见识别错误进行定性分析。
AI.result: Whisper-medium在测试集上WER为37.98%，AfriHuBERT为39.70%。
AI.conclusion: 发布基准Nufo（源自埃维语"talk"一词）及模型与评估资源，促进埃维语及其他代表性不足的非洲语言研究。

title: LURE: a Phase-Labelled Synthetic Corpus of Online-Grooming Exchanges
summary: Phase-annotated conversational data is essential for studying the progression of online grooming of minors and for developing early warning tools. However, the only publicly available source (i.e., Perverted-Justice archive, which contains a subset coded using ChatCoder) is small, outdated, and frozen. We present a synthetic corpus of groomer-victim exchanges, generated using a retrieval-augmented pipeline running on institutional hardware. This pipeline uses an openly available, eight-billion-parameter, refusal-ablated language model. The corpus was created using the five stages of the responsible-generation protocol for synthetic datasets: ontology-driven design based on the ChatCoder luring-communication scheme (eight communicative tags mapped onto four grooming phases); multi-model prompt testing; human-in-the-loop supervision; semantic and feature-level validation; and modality-aware documentation. The released corpus contains 2,121 unique exchanges across seven tags and four phases, each accompanied by a Plutchik emotion field. Validation quantifies the integrity and lexical profile of the corpus, as well as the reproduction of real seed lines, in-domain label recoverability (tag accuracy: 0.85; phase accuracy: 0.93) and its transfer to real ChatCoder offender lines, which were coded automatically at the eight-tag level (31,640 lines) and by human coders at the three-construct level (10,876 posts). Accuracy was measured for lexical and sentence-embedding features, while a real-versus-synthetic discriminator was able to separate the two domains with 91% accuracy. The scope of the corpus includes controlled, phase-conditioned experimentation, pipeline development and augmentation alongside real data and awareness material. The corpus, its datasheet and the audit code are released with vetted access.

AI.tldr: 该文构建了一个基于检索增强生成管线、阶段标注的合成"诱导-受害者"对话语料库，用于研究针对未成年人的网络诱导行为进程及早期预警工具开发。
AI.motivation: 现有唯一公开来源（Perverted-Justice存档中ChatCoder编码子集）规模小、过时且冻结，无法支撑网络诱导进程研究与预警工具开发，亟需新的阶段标注对话数据。
AI.method: 采用机构硬件上运行的检索增强生成管线，基于开源80亿参数、拒绝机制被消融的语言模型；遵循合成数据集"负责任生成协议"五阶段：本体驱动设计（ChatCoder诱导沟通框架，8个交际标签映射至4个诱导阶段）、多模型提示测试、人在回路监督、语义与特征级验证、模态感知文档化；并配套人工与自动编码验证。
AI.result: 语料库含2,121条唯一对话，覆盖7个标签、4个阶段，各附Plutchik情绪字段。标签准确率0.85，阶段准确率0.93；对真实ChatCoder犯罪者文本（八标签级自动编码31,640行，三构念级人工编码10,876帖）迁移验证；真假域判别器以91%准确率区分真实与合成数据。
AI.conclusion: 该合成语料支持受控的阶段条件实验、管线开发、与真实数据及宣教材料的联合增强；语料库、数据说明书与审计代码经审核后受限发布。

title: Mobility Helps Learning: Unsupervised Model Adaptation for Object Recognition via Movement
summary: Movable agents, such as autonomous vehicles and robots, should be able to autonomously adapt their pre-trained object recognition models to new environments without human annotations. While existing test-time adaptation (TTA) methods address label-free model adaptation, they typically treat test data as independent snapshots, without constructively exploiting a rich, unique source of supervision: the significant variance in prediction quality as an agent observes the same object from different distances and viewpoints. To capitalize on this, we propose \texttt{MoCaFe}, a model-agnostic and hyperparameter-insensitive paradigm that leverages motion-induced prediction variance for unsupervised adaptation. Specifically, we first develop mobility-calibrated filtering of pseudo-labels, which constructs reliable pseudo-labels by fusing cross-view predictions using inverse-variance weights. The filtered pseudo-labels then guide the selection of ``hard samples'' for effective learning. To further suppress pseudo-label corruption, we introduce \texttt{p-MoCaFe}, an optional extension that uses a public dataset to assign weighting factors to data samples, yielding an estimator of the clean loss with bounded bias. Extensive experiments on autonomous driving (nuScenes, KITTI) and embodied-agent datasets show that \texttt{MoCaFe} significantly outperforms state-of-the-art TTA schemes, achieving up to approximately 20% accuracy gain.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MoCaFe 范式，利用移动智能体观察同一物体时因距离和视角变化产生的预测方差，实现无监督测试时自适应，并显著提升目标识别精度。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时自适应（TTA）方法将测试数据视为独立快照，未能利用移动智能体在观察同一物体时预测质量随距离和视角变化而显著波动的监督信息。
AI.method: 提出模型无关、对超参数不敏感的 MoCaFe：先通过运动校准的伪标签筛选，利用逆方差权重融合跨视角预测生成可靠伪标签；再用其挑选难样本进行学习；并引入可选扩展 p-MoCaFe，借助公开数据集为样本分配权重，构建有界偏差的干净损失估计。
AI.result: 在自动驾驶数据集（nuScenes、KITTI）和具身智能体数据集上，MoCaFe 显著优于最先进 TTA 方案，精度提升最高约 20%。
AI.conclusion: 利用运动诱导的预测方差可有效支撑无监督测试时自适应，MoCaFe 作为通用范式在多种移动智能体场景下取得显著性能提升。

title: StartLux-Decision: AutoThink Decision Models with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions
summary: We introduce StartLux-Decision, decision models from 0.8B to 27B parameters that combine efficient single-pass prediction with adaptive, confidence-guided reasoning. The Instant models use bidirectional attention in full-attention layers to improve decision accuracy while keeping single-pass inference. The AutoThink models invoke explicit reasoning for uncertain decisions and answer confident cases directly. A three-stage training pipeline establishes shared decision capabilities, specializes the two variants, and equips AutoThink with reasoning through reasoning supervision and reinforcement learning. We introduce Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions (RLCD$^2$), which uses a frozen model and proper scoring rules to reward improvements in decision probability quality and applies a soft penalty to overlong reasoning traces. RLCD$^2$ raises the share of reasoning traces that terminate within the generation limit by up to 48 percentage points and cuts average reasoning length by up to 65%, while largely preserving decision accuracy. On the public subset of Decision Index 0.3, the Instant models outperform the strongest evaluated comparable-scale open-weight decision models by 7.4-16.9 points, and the 27B AutoThink model reaches 73.4. We also introduce DecisionPivot, a programmatically verifiable benchmark of computational decisions built from contrast pairs that differ in a single answer-changing detail. On DecisionPivot, AutoThink outperforms its Instant counterparts by 11.5-18.4 points in pair accuracy and leads among evaluated systems. The models run on vLLM, llama.cpp and MLX, with quantized variants for lower memory use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StartLux-Decision系列决策模型（0.8B–27B），包含单次推理的Instant模型与置信度引导推理的AutoThink模型，配合三阶段训练流程及RLCD²强化学习方法，在决策准确率与推理效率上均取得显著提升，并发布DecisionPivot基准。
AI.motivation: 现有决策模型难以兼顾高效单次预测与自适应推理：确定性高的问题不需要冗长推理，而不确定问题则需要显式推理来提升准确性。因此需要一种能根据置信度自适应决定是否推理的决策模型体系，同时控制推理长度避免过度生成。
AI.method: 提出StartLux-Decision模型族（0.8B至27B参数），含两类变体：Instant模型在全注意力层采用双向注意力以保持单次推理并提升决策精度；AutoThink模型对不确定决策调用显式推理、对高置信案例直接作答。采用三阶段训练流程：建立共享决策能力、特化两种变体、通过推理监督与强化学习赋予AutoThink推理能力。提出RLCD²（校准审慎决策强化学习），利用冻结模型与适当评分规则奖励决策概率质量改进，并对过长推理施加软惩罚。
AI.result: RLCD²将在生成限制内终止的推理比例提升最多48个百分点，平均推理长度减少最多65%，同时基本保持决策准确率。在Decision Index 0.3公开子集上，Instant模型比最强同类规模开源决策模型高7.4–16.9分，27B AutoThink达73.4分。新基准DecisionPivot上，AutoThink在配对准确率上比Instant高11.5–18.4分并领先其他评估系统。模型支持vLLM、llama.cpp和MLX，并提供量化版本降低内存占用。
AI.conclusion: StartLux-Decision通过Instant与AutoThink双变体及RLCD²方法，实现了高效与自适应推理的平衡，在决策准确率、推理效率及新基准表现上均优于同类开源模型，并具备良好的部署兼容性。

title: Multi-Horizon Explainable Queue Forecasting and Resource-Aware Decision Support for Intelligent Border Control Using LightGBM
summary: Border crossing points are stochastic service systems in which traffic demand, traveler categories, registration status, inspection requirements, staffing, and lane availability interact on multiple time scales. This paper extends an earlier multimodal queue-management framework by introducing an implementation-oriented, multi-horizon forecasting and decision-support architecture based on Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) models. In contrast to a single forecasting block, the proposed approach constructs horizon-specific regressors for 15, 30, 60, and 120 min forecasts and jointly estimates future waiting time and queue lengths. The models operate on temporally lagged traffic, service, density, and queue features, while an operational layer incorporates lane compatibility, officer availability, possibly degraded resources, traveler category, preregistration information, and human-approval constraints. Quantile LightGBM models provide 95\% prediction intervals for waiting-time forecasts. Beyond prediction, the framework produces machine-readable recommendations, alerts, aggregate key performance indicators, confidence information, and integration outputs suitable for border resource-management and decision-support systems. The results establish a reproducible synthetic-data baseline and a practical interface for subsequent validation with operational border-crossing data.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向边境口岸的多时域预测与决策支持架构，基于LightGBM构建15/30/60/120分钟专用回归器，联合预测等待时间与排队长度，并提供分位数预测区间及机器可读的决策输出。
AI.motivation: 边境口岸是随机服务系统，交通需求、旅客类别、登记状态、查验要求、人员配置与车道可用性等多因素在多个时间尺度上交互，单一预测模块难以支撑实际运营决策，需要实现导向的多时域预测与决策支持框架。
AI.method: 在既有多种交通方式排队管理框架基础上，构建基于LightGBM的多时域架构：为15、30、60、120分钟分别建立专用回归器，联合估计未来等待时间与排队长度；特征包含时间滞后的交通、服务、密度与排队变量；运营层纳入车道兼容性、警员可用性、资源降级、旅客类别、预登记信息及人工审批约束；并采用分位数LightGBM给出等待时间的95%预测区间。
AI.result: 除预测外，框架可生成机器可读建议、告警、汇总关键绩效指标、置信度信息及可对接边境资源管理与决策支持系统的集成输出；同时建立了可复现的合成数据基线。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了可复现的合成数据基线与实用接口，为后续基于真实口岸运营数据的验证奠定基础。

title: Sharper Frames, Worse Rooms: Viewpoint Coverage Dominates Image Quality in Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
summary: Grounded spatial reasoning about indoor scenes rests on a geometric reconstruction that the multimodal system does not itself produce. Feed-forward multi-view reconstruction models operate under a fixed view budget, making frame selection a critical upstream decision. We show that under this setting the conventional preference for sharp frames can be actively harmful. Across nine handheld room scans, selecting the sharpest 16 of 200 candidate frames is the worst strategy we test, reaching 48\% room dimension error where uniform temporal sampling reaches 3\%. We trace this failure to a coupling between image quality and camera motion: sharp frames tend to occur during slow motion and therefore concentrate the selection in a narrow angular region, leaving $192^\circ$ of the room unobserved in the case we illustrate and over $300^\circ$ in the worst cells. A $2\times2$ factorial experiment that independently manipulates viewpoint spread and per-frame sharpness shows that spread has roughly three times the main effect of quality, and that blurry but well spread selections outperform sharp but clustered selections in 8 of 9 captures. The advantage also diminishes as the frame budget increases and angular coverage saturates, consistent with this mechanism. Finally, we ask whether the failure is detectable at inference: the reconstruction model's multi-view consistency score increases with reconstruction error, while a vision-language model given the same frames reports confidence unrelated to its own spatial estimation error. Under small view budgets, viewpoint coverage is a more important constraint than per-frame image quality, and neither uncertainty signal available at inference reveals this upstream failure.

AI.tldr: 在固定视角预算的前馈多视角重建中，选择最清晰的帧往往有害，因为清晰度与相机运动耦合会压缩视角覆盖；视角分布比单帧质量更重要，且推理阶段可得的不确定性信号均无法揭示这一上游失败。
AI.motivation: 室内场景的具身空间推理依赖几何重建，而多模态系统自身并不产生该重建；前馈多视角重建模型受固定视角预算约束，因此帧选择成为关键的上游决策。作者质疑"优先选清晰帧"这一常规做法在固定预算下是否真正有效。
AI.method: 在9个手持室内房间扫描上，比较不同选帧策略（选最清晰16帧 vs. 均匀时间采样等，200候选帧中取16）；分析图像质量与相机运动的耦合；开展2×2析因实验独立操纵视角分布与单帧清晰度；考察帧预算增大时优势的变化；并检验推理阶段两类不确定性信号（重建模型的多视角一致性分数、视觉语言模型的自报置信度）能否检测该失败。
AI.result: 选最清晰的16/200帧是所有测试策略中最差的：房间尺寸误差达48%，而均匀时间采样仅3%。失败源于清晰帧多出现在慢速运动时，导致选择集中于窄角度区域，示例中留下192°未观测，最差情况超过300°。2×2析因实验显示视角分布的主效应约为清晰度的3倍；模糊但分布良好的选择在9个扫描中的8个优于清晰但聚集的选择。随着帧预算增加、角度覆盖饱和，该优势减弱。重建模型的多视角一致性分数随重建误差升高，而VLM的置信度与其自身空间估计误差无关。
AI.conclusion: 在较小视角预算下，视角覆盖是比单帧图像质量更重要的约束；清晰度偏好会因与相机运动的耦合而损害覆盖。推理阶段可得的两种不确定性信号均无法揭示这一上游失败，说明需要新的覆盖感知选帧与失败检测机制。

title: From Sampled Evidence to Radiology Reports: Objectives, Constraints, and Realization
summary: Sampling multiple reports creates an inference problem: how should sampled evidence be converted into a final decision, and does a better structured decision yield a better report? We study these questions through a framework that separates the decision signal, scoring objective, and feasible decision set, followed by text realization. On MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray, controlled comparisons across 13 generator configurations per benchmark under grouped development/test evaluation reveal three findings. First, changing the objective under fixed evidence and rule capacity changes predictions and their held-out metric trade-offs. Second, relaxing candidate constraints has objective-dependent effects under shared signals and frozen scores. Diagnostics connect the IU macro-oriented assertion increase to near-zero label thresholds and show that limited candidate coverage coexists with selection headroom. Third, a controlled realization study with SFT-Qwen3-VL-8B shows that decision-level gains can be attenuated, amplified, or reversed. Change decomposition reveals that realization can remove incorrect assertions while losing correct findings, so target fidelity and reference accuracy need not improve together. Finding gains also do not consistently improve reference-based report quality. These results motivate separate evaluation of decision rules, candidate constraints, and realized reports.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过将"多报告采样推断"分解为决策信号、评分目标与可行决策集，并加入文本实现阶段，系统研究决策规则与报告质量之间的关系，发现三者需要分别评估。
AI.motivation: 从多份采样报告中得出最终推断存在关键问题：如何将采样证据转化为最终决策，以及更优的结构化决策是否必然带来更好的报告。现有工作往往将决策与报告生成混为一谈，缺乏对决策层面与实现层面的分离分析。
AI.method: 提出一个分离"决策信号、评分目标、可行决策集"的框架，随后进行文本实现（realization）。在 MIMIC-CXR 与 IU-Xray 上，对每个基准的 13 种生成器配置进行受控比较，采用按组分划的开发/测试评估；并开展基于 SFT-Qwen3-VL-8B 的受控实现研究，进行变更分解分析。
AI.result: 三项发现：(1) 在证据与规则容量固定时，改变目标会改变预测及其留出指标间的权衡；(2) 在共享信号与冻结分数下，放宽候选约束的效果依目标而定；诊断显示 IU 上宏观导向断言增加与近零标签阈值相关，且候选覆盖有限与选择空间余量并存；(3) 实现阶段可使决策层收益被削弱、放大甚至反转；变更分解表明实现会去除错误断言但同时丢失正确发现，目标保真度与参考准确率未必同步提升，发现增益也不必然提升基于参考的报告质量。
AI.conclusion: 决策规则、候选约束与实现后的报告应当分别评估；决策层的改进不能简单等同于报告质量的改进。

title: The Anatomy of a Blind Spot: What an LLM Judge Must Be Shown, and How Much
summary: Evaluation of text generated by large language models (LLMs) is increasingly delegated to LLMs acting as judges, yet what such a judge must be shown remains unresolved. We treat a judge whose reports are acted on as a regulator, in the sense of cybernetics, and ask what it must be shown, how much, in what form, and what its reports must get right. On seven public benchmarks we varied only what the judge was shown. Across three judges whose prices differ 10- to 17-fold, what the judge was shown mattered more than which judge it was. When a system revised its answers on feedback from a judge denied the material they had to respect, it ended below its starting point on instruction following and question answering. On instruction following the loss grew with each round, and it persisted when the judge saw the user's request but not the constraints and with a second judge family. On news summarisation, a correct reference summary beside the source undid most of the source's contribution, whereas on single-answer questions a reference helped. About a tenth of the source did almost all of its work, and a small entailment graph matched an LLM judge at finding errors in grounded text. We committed 83 testable clauses before running; of the 81 that ran, 32 met their bar and 50 went in the predicted direction, and most quantitative predictions from the theory failed. We report every shortfall and derive design rules tied to measured effects.

AI.tldr: 本文把"以LLM评判LLM生成文本"的评判者当作控制论意义上的调节器，系统研究其应看到什么、看多少、以何种形式呈现以及报告需达到何种正确性。在七个公开基准上仅改变评判者的输入，结果发现输入内容比换用哪个评判者更重要，并据此提出与实测效应挂钩的设计规则。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的文本越来越多地交由LLM充当评判者，但"评判者究竟需要被展示什么信息"这一问题尚无定论。现有研究多关注评判者模型的强弱，而忽略了输入表征这一变量。作者希望以调节器视角，明确评判输入的构成、规模与形式，以及评判报告应满足的标准，从而为可靠评测提供依据。
AI.method: 在七个公开基准上，仅改变评判者所看到的内容（如是否提供用户请求、约束、参考摘要、源文档片段等），并跨三个价格相差10至17倍的评判者模型及两个评判者家族进行比较。设置"被评判者根据反馈修改答案"的迭代实验，观察指令遵循与问答表现的逐轮变化；通过削减源文档与构造小型蕴涵图，分析源信息贡献与评判机制。研究预先承诺83条可检验论断。
AI.result: 评判者所看内容的影响大于评判者模型选择的影响。当系统依据被剥夺必要材料的评判者反馈修改答案时，指令遵循与问答成绩低于起点；指令遵循上的损失逐轮扩大，在评判者只见用户请求而不见约束时、以及换用第二评判者家族时依然存在。新闻摘要任务中，源文旁放置正确参考摘要会抵消源文的大部分贡献，而单答案问答中参考答案则有帮助。约十分之一的源文承担了绝大部分作用，小型蕴涵图在发现扎根文本错误上可与LLM评判者相当。83条中有81条实际执行，32条达到设定标准，50条方向符合预测，多数定量预测未通过。
AI.conclusion: 评判者的输入表征是评测可靠性的关键变量，缺失必要材料的反馈会主动损害被评判系统的表现，且该损害会累积并跨模型家族复现。参考材料的价值随任务类型而异，源信息作用高度集中于少数片段。作者如实报告全部未达标结果，并基于实测效应推导出可操作的设计规则。

title: Learning Multimodal Sensor Fusion with JEPA Representations for Breathing Activity and Pose Recognition
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 equations, 4 tables, conference paper
summary: Predictive video representations do not by themselves specify how a multimodal system should handle missing sensors. We transfer frozen V-JEPA2 features to a set of heterogeneous sensors comprised by RGB video, depth video, and radar time series. A shared fusion model uses modality queries, fixed sensor slots, and explicit availability to classify breathing activity and pose from all seven non-empty sensor subsets. The contribution is a controlled evaluation of subset supervision, pooling capacity, and representation transfer on 39 OMuSense-23 subjects with five subject-group folds and three seeds. With matched downstream parameter counts, the final model reaches recording-level activity macro-F1 of $75.23%\pm0.60$ averaged across seven subsets. Supervising all subsets in each batch improves the matched query-pooling control by 1.923 percentage points (conditional 95% subject-bootstrap interval [0.647, 3.209]), while query pooling shows no clear advantage over matched mean pooling under balanced supervision. Radar probes support transfer beyond pooled wavelet pixels, 64-token inference approximately preserves mean activity performance, and the tested Consensus-JEPA loss adds no measured benefit against its exact control.

AI.tldr: 将冻结的 V-JEPA2 特征迁移至 RGB、深度与雷达组成的异构传感器系统，通过共享融合模型在全部 7 个非空子集上分类呼吸活动与姿态，并对子集监督、池化能力与表征迁移进行受控评估。
AI.motivation: 预测式视频表征本身并未规定多模态系统应如何处理缺失传感器，因此需要研究在传感器子集缺失情形下，冻结视频特征向异构传感器的迁移与融合策略的有效性。
AI.method: 采用模态查询、固定传感器槽位与显式可用性标记的共享融合模型，将冻结 V-JEPA2 特征迁移至 RGB 视频、深度视频与雷达时间序列；在 OMuSense-23 的 39 名被试上，使用 5 个被试分组折与 3 个随机种子，在参数匹配条件下对比子集监督、查询池化与均值池化、雷达探针迁移、64-token 推理及 Consensus-JEPA 损失。
AI.result: 最终模型在 7 个子集上平均达到记录级活动宏 F1 为 75.23%±0.60；每批次监督全部子集相比匹配的查询池化对照提升 1.923 个百分点（条件 95% 被试自助区间 [0.647, 3.209]）；平衡监督下查询池化相对匹配均值池化无明确优势；雷达探针支持超越池化小波像素的迁移；64-token 推理大致保持平均活动性能；Consensus-JEPA 损失相对其精确对照无测得收益。
AI.conclusion: 冻结 V-JEPA2 特征可有效迁移至异构多传感器系统，显式可用性与全子集监督是提升缺失传感器鲁棒性的关键，而查询池化与 Consensus-JEPA 损失未带来显著增益。

title: Thinking Outside the Bots: Human Ideas in AI's Semantic Blind Spots Are Not Inferior
summary: AI-generated outputs are frequently perceived as highly creative, but also tend to be more similar to each other (homogenized) than human ideas. Does the human heterogeneity that extends beyond AI reflect valuable thinking that AI misses? Alternatively, is greater human heterogeneity driven by lower-quality ideas and less effective thinking that AI avoids? We developed Expansion of Divergent Generative Expression (EDGE) to map AI's semantic "blind spots" by assessing how strongly/weakly individual human ideas were represented in a task-matched AI semantic comparison set. Specifically, we compared human-generated vs. AI-generated ideas across three open-ended tasks: college admissions essays, alternative uses for everyday objects, and interpersonal advice. Across all three tasks, human responses extended into semantic regions sparsely covered by AI outputs. These distinctively human responses showed no meaningful deficits in creativity, quality, or effectiveness, were associated with equal-or-better academic performance, and with credibly superior ratings and achievement for some outcomes. These ideas were thus not merely poor-performing variation; they performed as well as or better than ideas that overlapped more strongly with AI ideas. More distinctive human ideas tended to receive higher creativity ratings, but this relationship was weak or reversed for AI ideas. Taken together, these results suggest that differentiation among human-generated ideas does not reflect poor thinking that AI can safely omit, and instead may afford both individual and population-level advantages.

AI.tldr: 人类想法比AI产出更具异质性，但这种异质性并非源于低质量思维；相反，这些"AI盲区"中的人类想法在创造力、质量和有效性上不逊色甚至更优。
AI.motivation: AI生成内容常被认为富有创造力，但彼此之间高度同质化，而人类想法更为多样。作者试图厘清这种人类异质性的本质：它究竟是AI所缺失的有价值思维，还是由低质量想法和低效思维造成的无意义差异。这一问题的答案决定AI是否应"安全地忽略"这些边缘性的人类想法。
AI.method: 开发了EDGE（Expansion of Divergent Generative Expression）方法，通过衡量个体人类想法在任务匹配的AI语义比较集中的被覆盖程度（强/弱），来定位AI的语义"盲区"。在三个开放式任务上对比人类与AI的想法：大学申请文书、日常物品的替代用途、人际建议。
AI.result: 在全部三个任务中，人类回答都延伸至AI输出稀疏覆盖的语义区域。这些"独具人类特色"的回答在创造力、质量和有效性上无显著缺陷，与同等或更好的学业表现相关，并在部分结果上获得更可信的更高评分和成就。更具独特性的人类想法往往获得更高的创造力评分，但在AI想法中这一关系较弱甚至相反。
AI.conclusion: 人类想法的差异化并不代表AI可以安全省略的低质量思维；相反，它可能同时带来个体层面与群体层面的优势。

title: Vision: "What Don't I Know About User's Preferences?" How Uncertainty Estimation Improves Proactive Assistant Alignment
comment: Published in Companion of the 2026 ACM International Joint Conference on Pervasive and Ubiquitous Computing (UbiComp Companion '26) PEACE Workshop
summary: Proactive Smart Assistants (PSAs) increasingly use general knowledge, learned patterns from group-level data, patterns from individual user's data, and recent sensor observations to anticipate which action a user may prefer. Existing systems typically select actions from predicted user preference likelihoods, but these likelihoods alone do not reveal how reliable the prediction is, which evidence supports it, or why ambiguity remains. In this vision paper, we argue that uncertainty estimation can provide this missing information and substantially change appropriate downstream behavior. Using the example of a home assistant, we introduce the questions that uncertainty estimation aims to answer, i.e. how sure is the assistant about the predicted preference likelihood, whether the confidence come from group-level assumptions or individual's data, and whether likelihood ambiguity reflect the user's intrinsic preference variability or insufficient data for the particular situation. We further introduce uncertainty estimation applications in neighboring domains, such as human trajectory prediction, personalized activity recognition, information-collection, and model-based control. Finally, we draw on insights from neighboring domains to envision how future uncertainty-aware proactive assistants may address key challenges in proactive interaction.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场/愿景论文，主张在主动式智能助手（PSA）中引入不确定性估计，以回答"预测有多可靠、置信来自群体还是个人数据、歧义是偏好本身多变还是数据不足"三类问题，并借鉴邻近领域应用，展望不确定性感知的主动交互。
AI.motivation: 现有PSA仅依据预测的用户偏好似然选择动作，而不确定性、证据来源与歧义成因均不可见；作者认为这种信息缺失会误导下游行为，因此需引入不确定性估计以改进主动交互。
AI.method: 以家庭助手为示例场景，提出不确定性估计应回答的三个核心问题；并将人类轨迹预测、个性化活动识别、信息采集与基于模型的控制等邻近领域中的不确定性估计应用进行迁移类比。作为愿景论文，主要通过概念论证与跨领域类比展开，而非提出具体算法或实验。
AI.result: 论文识别并形式化了PSA中"预测-不确定性"分离的问题，给出三个待答问题框架，并汇总邻近领域中不确定性估计的可用做法作为参考；未报告定量实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性估计可为主动式助手提供预测可靠性、证据来源与歧义解释等关键信息，从而显著改变其下游行为；作者据此提出未来"不确定性感知的主动式助手"研究议程，以应对主动交互中的核心挑战。

title: Gen Through the Lens: Camera-Controllable Video Generation via Cross-Coordinate Conditioning Fusion
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Shuai Li and Jinxu Xiang contributed equally; Ran Zhang is the corresponding author
summary: We present Gen Through the Lens, a camera-controllable image-to-video generation framework that synthesizes videos from a given reference image while enabling realistic and physically consistent camera operations. Unlike previous models that treat camera motion as abstract conditioning or rely on a single coordinate system, our approach explicitly decomposes and fuses control signals across three coordinate spaces: the camera coordinate (modeled by intrinsic parameters), the world coordinate (represented by spatial geometry hints), and the object coordinate (described by 3D bounding boxes of target subjects). Through cross-coordinate conditioning fusion, these heterogeneous cues are unified to guide the generative process, enabling precise control of camera motion, focus, and framing while preserving temporal and spatial coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method produces controllable and visually consistent results across diverse camera operations, outperforming existing approaches in both realism and editability.

AI.tldr: 提出 Gen Through the Lens 框架，通过融合相机、世界、物体三个坐标系的控制信号，实现可控且物理一致的图像到视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到视频生成模型将相机运动视为抽象条件，或仅依赖单一坐标系，导致相机操作缺乏真实性与物理一致性，难以精确控制运动、对焦与取景。
AI.method: 显式分解并融合三个坐标空间的控制信号：相机坐标（内参建模）、世界坐标（空间几何提示）、物体坐标（目标主体3D边界框）；通过跨坐标条件融合统一异构线索以引导生成过程。
AI.result: 在多种相机操作下生成结果可控且视觉一致，在真实感与可编辑性上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 跨坐标系条件融合可有效提升相机可控视频生成的质量与可控性。

title: The Curse of Knowledge in Role-Playing Language Models
summary: Role-playing language models speak as characters in games and agent simulations, where the system records what each character can hear, see and understand. We test whether characters respect these boundaries in 480 scenes, each with a counterfactual twin that changes only the hidden fact, so mentions of the twin's fact measure guessing. Across 11 open-weight models, characters use content from speech they cannot understand or hear at 67 and 72 percentage points (pp) above this baseline, although most models correctly state what the character perceives. This is a curse of knowledge. The leak extends to hidden actions and private messages and changes where characters search. Five of six proprietary models rarely leak, but compliance in strong models depends on input format. Changing only the scene layout or character description raises the rate in two otherwise compliant open-weight models from under 10 to over 60 pp, and combined changes raise two proprietary models from near zero to 13 and 21~pp. Writing the line as the scene's author leaks nearly as much as role-play, and thinking rarely helps. Giving models only what the character observes stops the leak without hiding what it may report.

AI.tldr: 该研究测试角色扮演语言模型是否遵守角色感知边界（只听/看/理解其应知内容）。在480个场景及仅改变隐藏事实的反事实对照下，11个开放权重模型出现严重“知识诅咒”泄漏，即使用角色无法听到或理解的信息；泄漏也涉及隐藏动作与私信，并改变角色搜索行为。6个专有模型中5个很少泄漏，但合规性受输入格式影响；仅改变场景布局或角色描述即可使合规模型泄漏率从<10 pp升至>60 pp。以作者口吻写作同样泄漏，思考无济于事；仅提供角色可观察信息可消除泄漏。
AI.motivation: 角色扮演模型在游戏和智能体模拟中需严格区分每个角色“能听到、看到和理解”的信息，但系统记录了这些边界。作者希望检验模型是否真正尊重角色的感知边界，而非利用模型自身知道的隐藏事实生成角色言行，即是否存在“知识诅咒”。
AI.method: 构建480个场景，每个场景配一个反事实孪生场景，仅改变隐藏事实；通过提及孪生事实来测量“猜测”。测试11个开放权重模型、6个专有模型；操纵输入格式、场景布局、角色描述、叙述口吻（角色扮演 vs 作者）以及是否提供思考；并检查泄漏是否扩展到隐藏动作、私信和搜索行为。
AI.result: 开放权重模型使用无法理解或无法听到的语音内容，分别比基线高67和72个百分点，尽管多数模型能正确陈述角色所感知内容。泄漏扩展到隐藏动作和私信，并改变角色搜索位置。6个专有模型中5个很少泄漏，但强模型合规性依赖输入格式。仅改变场景布局或角色描述，可使两个原本合规的开放权重模型从<10 pp升至>60 pp；组合改变使两个专有模型从近零升至13和21 pp。以作者口吻写台词泄漏程度接近角色扮演，思考很少有帮助。仅向模型提供角色可观察信息可阻止泄漏，且不隐藏其可报告内容。
AI.conclusion: 角色扮演语言模型普遍存在“知识诅咒”：角色会泄漏其不应感知的隐藏信息。该问题对输入格式和场景表征高度敏感，且在开放权重模型中尤为严重；专有模型较好但并非稳健。让模型只接收角色可观察信息是一种有效且不损害可报告内容的缓解策略。

title: ADAPT: Audio-Depth Action Planning with Transition-Aware Rewards for Lights-Out Industrial Navigation
summary: Vision-language-action models for embodied navigation typically rely on RGB observations, limiting their applicability in lights-out industrial environments where visible illumination may be unavailable. We study illumination-independent navigation using spatial audio for target localization and depth for obstacle-aware geometry. To support this setting, we introduce DarkNav-Bench, a benchmark with 24 industrial scenes and four progressively challenging acoustic conditions. We further propose ADAPT, an audio-depth action-planning framework equipped with spatial-audio perception and optimized for closed-loop navigation through reinforcement learning (RL). Our key RL contribution, transition-aware reward shaping (TARS), defines a pose-aware shortest-action potential over a position-heading graph. Unlike conventional geodesic-progress rewards, TARS accounts for both feasible movements and in-place rotations, providing action-consistent feedback for policy optimization. Experiments show that ADAPT consistently outperforms training-based navigation baselines and zero-shot multimodal models on both seen and unseen scenes. On unseen environments, it achieves 90.6% success under Clean conditions and retains 60.0% success under the most challenging Localized Noise setting. These results demonstrate the potential of spatial audio and depth as complementary modalities for reliable RGB-free navigation in lights-out industrial environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究无光照环境下的具身导航，提出DarkNav-Bench基准与ADAPT音深融合导航框架，通过空间音频定位、深度避障及TARS奖励塑形实现RGB-free导航。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作导航模型依赖RGB观测，在无可见光照的工业场景中失效，因此需要研究照明无关的导航方案。
AI.method: 构建DarkNav-Bench（24个工业场景、四种递进声学条件）；提出ADAPT音深动作规划框架，包含空间音频感知与基于强化学习的闭环导航；核心贡献为transition-aware reward shaping（TARS），在position-heading图上定义姿态感知的最短动作势函数，兼顾可行移动与原地旋转。
AI.result: ADAPT在已见与未见场景上均持续优于基于训练的导航基线和零样本多模态模型；未见环境下Clean条件成功率90.6%，最难的Localized Noise条件仍保持60.0%。
AI.conclusion: 空间音频与深度可作为互补模态，支撑无光工业环境下可靠的RGB-free导航。

title: VIEWCRAFT: Evolving What Multimodal Agents See and How They Read It
summary: Reusable skills improve multimodal agents without updating model weights, but their effectiveness depends on both the evidence presented and the procedure used to read it. We introduce ViewCraft, which jointly evolves an executable evidence interface and its reading procedure. The interface selects, transforms, and organizes observations; the reader interprets the resulting views. Failure traces guide revisions, replay and paired evaluation retain useful changes, and interface projection recovers visual edits from eligible rejected joint proposals. Across eight benchmarks, ViewCraft improves over direct execution by an average of $6.1$ points in task score, with gains on every benchmark. The advantage persists at a matched input-token budget. On all five multi-source tasks, the learned interface uses 8%-15% fewer input tokens than Initial skill. The learned skills also transfer across executors and outperform direct execution in every evaluated transfer, supporting evidence construction and reading as a coupled, reusable skill.

AI.tldr: ViewCraft 通过联合进化可执行的证据接口与读取程序，构建可复用技能，在不更新模型权重的情况下提升多模态智能体表现。
AI.motivation: 可复用技能能在不更新模型权重的前提下提升多模态智能体，但其效果既取决于所呈现的证据，也取决于读取证据的程序；如何将证据构建与读取作为耦合的可复用技能进行优化，是本文关注的问题。
AI.method: 提出 ViewCraft：联合进化可执行证据接口及其读取程序。接口负责选择、变换与组织观测；读取器解释生成的视图。利用失败轨迹指导修订，通过重放与配对评估保留有效改动，并通过接口投影从符合条件的被拒联合提议中恢复视觉编辑。
AI.result: 在八个基准上，ViewCraft 相比直接执行平均提升 6.1 个任务分数点，且每个基准均有增益；在匹配输入 token 预算下优势依旧。在全部五个多源任务上，学得的接口比 Initial skill 少用 8%-15% 输入 token。学得的技能可跨执行器迁移，且在每次评估的迁移中均优于直接执行。
AI.conclusion: 证据构建与读取可作为一个耦合、可复用的技能加以学习，从而无需更新模型权重即显著提升多模态智能体，并具备 token 效率与跨执行器迁移能力。

title: claimcheck: Measuring and Improving Specification Faithfulness
summary: Formal verification proves that a program satisfies its specification, but says nothing about whether the specification captures what the author meant. As LLMs increasingly write both code and specifications, a gap between the author's natural-language requirement and the specification becomes a live risk. A machine-checked proof of a property narrower than the one requested is worthless but passes every check. Closing this gap is solving the spec formalization problem: given a natural-language requirement, produce a formal artifact whose meaning matches it. To measure the gap, we curate an end-to-end benchmark for spec formalization spanning four formal languages: Dafny contracts and Lean 4, Isabelle and Rocq theorem statements. Each of its 3,234 rows pairs a natural-language requirement with a formal artifact and a label established by execution, by proof, or by the benchmark it is drawn from. A third of the rows are meaning-preserving rewrites of the artifact that keep the faithful label, so a judge cannot score by detecting that a row was edited. We introduce claimcheck, a tool that detects incorrect formalizations: the formal artifact is translated back into plain English by a model that never sees the requirement, and a separate model, the judge, decides whether the informalization and the requirement express the same guarantee. On all four languages it gains 8.2 to 9.8 points of macro recall over a single call shown the requirement and the artifact, and 4.2 to 6.0 over that call handed the same list of meaning-preserving rewrites. Showing the judge the artifact as well costs 1.4 to 4.5 points. Across four judges that also see the artifact, the gain shrinks as the judge gets stronger, to within a point of the informed single call for the strongest.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"规范形式化问题"：自然语言需求与形式化规范之间可能存在语义差距，机器可验证的证明若针对的是较窄的性质便毫无价值。作者构建了覆盖Dafny、Lean 4、Isabelle、Rocq四种形式语言的端到端基准（3,234行），并推出claimcheck工具，通过"先回译成英文、再让独立裁判比对"的方式检测错误形式化，macro recall显著优于单次调用基线。
AI.motivation: 形式验证只能证明程序满足规范，却无法保证规范符合作者本意。随着LLM同时生成代码与规范，自然语言需求与形式化规范之间的语义鸿沟成为现实风险——针对比预期更窄性质的机器检验证明虽然能通过所有检查，却毫无价值。因此需要度量并缩小这一"规范形式化"差距。
AI.method: 1）构建端到端基准，覆盖Dafny contracts、Lean 4、Isabelle、Rocq定理陈述四种形式语言，共3,234行，每行将自然语言需求与形式化产物及标签配对，标签由执行、证明或原基准出处确立；其中三分之一为保持忠实标签的语义保持改写，使裁判无法通过"识别被编辑"来评分。2）提出claimcheck工具：先由一个从未见过需求的模型将形式化产物回译成通俗英文，再由另一个独立模型（裁判）判断该非形式化描述与原始需求是否表达同一保证。
AI.result: 在四种语言上，claimcheck相对"单次调用同时展示需求与形式化产物"的基线取得8.2–9.8个百分点的macro recall提升，相对"单次调用并附上同一组语义保持改写列表"取得4.2–6.0个百分点提升。若让裁判同时看到形式化产物，会损失1.4–4.5个百分点。在四个同时看到产物的裁判中，裁判越强增益越小，对最强裁判降至与知情单次调用相差不到1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将形式化产物独立回译后再交由未见过需求的裁判比对，能有效检测自然语言需求与形式化规范之间的语义偏差，且优于让模型直接同时查看需求与产物的做法。该方法的增益随裁判能力增强而收窄，提示更强的模型本身可能已具备较强的形式化语义对齐判断力，但独立回译流程在较弱配置下仍具明显价值。

title: Small but Mighty: Test Suites as Improvement Signals for Self-Evolving Agents
comment: In NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust)
summary: A self-evolving agent rewrites its own harness and must decide which rewrites to keep, so its improvement signal is the check a rewrite has to pass.
