By combining historical PV fields with satellite-derived future shortwave radiation guidance and meteorological forecasts, the framework predicts future regional generation states, which subsequently provide location-specific guidance for individual-station forecasting. Experiments involving 496 distributed PV systems, including 446 source stations and 50 held-out target stations, demonstrate that these regional fields can be effectively forecast and used to improve station-level predictions. The proposed approach reduces station-level MAE by approximately 10.0% relative to the best-performing single-station temporal baseline and by 2.5% relative to a graph-based regional forecasting approach using the same source fleet. These findings establish an explicit spatial-field modeling paradigm that connects regional generation dynamics with individual-site forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文将分布式光伏集群预测从离散站点时间序列建模重构为显式空间结构化区域发电场预测问题，提出SatPV-Field框架，通过将分布式光伏测量转化为类图像发电场并建模其时空演化来提升站点级预测精度。
AI.motivation: 密集分布式光伏的超短期预测面临两大挑战：外部气象与卫星产品空间分辨率不足以刻画快速局地变化；异构光伏系统在相似大气条件下发电响应差异显著。同时，密集光伏集群本身提供空间分布式测量，可揭示区域发电动态。因此需要一种能显式利用空间结构信息的新预测范式。
AI.method: 提出SatPV-Field区域到局部预测框架：将分布式光伏测量转化为类图像的区域发电场，建模其时空演化；融合历史光伏发电场、卫星反演的未来短波辐射引导以及气象预报，预测未来区域发电状态，并进一步为单站预测提供位置特定引导。实验使用496个分布式光伏系统（446个源站，50个留出目标站）。
AI.result: 区域发电场可被有效预测并用于改善站点级预测。相比最佳单站时序基线，站点级MAE降低约10.0%；相比使用相同源集群的图神经网络区域预测方法，MAE降低2.5%。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了显式空间场建模范式，将区域发电动态与单站点预测相连接，为密集分布式光伏超短期预测提供了有效的新思路。

title: Unravel: Recovering an Interactive 3D Scene from a Single Image
summary: We present Unravel, a training-free framework that turns a single image into an interactive 3D scene, where every object is an independent and movable asset. Existing generators either produce one entangled geometry in which no object can be moved, or predict all objects in one feed-forward pass, where a wrong guess cannot be detected or repaired. Unravel instead takes a different approach: it first takes the scene apart, and then puts it back together. Starting from the input image, an agentic harness that iteratively peels the image layer by layer, and adopts point cloud as major modality for spatial relationship recovery. Specifically, a vision-language model plans which objects are fully visible, an image editor removes them and restores the occluded regions. Every edit is verified before being incorporated into the reconstruction. This process gradually turns occluded parts of the scene into direct observation, allowing objects to be reconstructed when they are best exposed rather than hallucinated from the original image alone. The scene is then rebuilt in reverse removal order, so that the supporting objects are naturally placed before the objects they support. Since a single-view image only reveals part of an object, we treat the observed points as a lower bound on its size: an asset may grow to cover its points, but can not shrink away from them. Finally, we physically settle the reconstructed scene to remove floating objects and interpenetrations, followed by an agentic audit that corrects remaining placement errors. Extensive experiments on diverse indoor scenes show that Unravel recovers more objects, places them more faithfully, and produces scenes that are more physically-plausible than existing methods.

AI.tldr: Unravel：一种免训练框架，将单张图像转换为可交互的3D场景，每个物体均为独立可移动资产。通过迭代"剥离—重建"流程，实现更完整的物体恢复、更忠实的摆放与更强的物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有生成器存在两类局限：一是生成单一纠缠几何体，物体不可移动；二是一次前馈预测全部物体，错误猜测无法检测或修复。核心动机是让被遮挡物体在最佳暴露时机被重建，而非仅凭原始单视图臆测。
AI.method: 免训练框架，先拆解再重组：(1) 智能体化流程迭代逐层剥离图像，以点云为主要模态恢复空间关系；视觉语言模型规划完全可见物体，图像编辑器移除并修复遮挡区域，每次编辑须经验证后纳入重建；(2) 按移除的逆序重建场景，使支撑物先于被支撑物放置；(3) 将单视图观测点视为物体尺寸下界，资产可增长覆盖其点云但不可缩小偏离；(4) 物理沉降消除悬浮与互穿，随后由智能体化审计修正残余摆放错误。
AI.result: 在多样化室内场景上的大量实验表明，Unravel 相比现有方法能恢复更多物体、摆放更忠实，并生成物理合理性更高的场景。
AI.conclusion: 通过"先剥离、后重组"的逆序重建范式，结合点云空间关系恢复、尺寸下界约束与物理沉降及智能体审计，Unravel 在无需训练的前提下实现了可交互、可移动的3D场景构建，显著优于现有方法。

title: Decouple to Forget: Semantic Mediation for Sensitive Unlearning in Large Language Models
summary: Machine unlearning for large language models seeks to remove specified knowledge while preserving general capability, yet current methods often treat an entire response as the unit of forgetting. This coarse granularity causes unnecessary utility loss when the forget target is only a small set of sensitive facts embedded within otherwise benign explanations. In this paper, we introduce Decouple to Forget (D2F), a targeted unlearning method inspired by semantic mediation that separates sensitive factual content from non-sensitive meaning and surface expression. For each example to be forgotten, D2F extracts a fact-level "mediator" representation from the answer, identifies which parts are sensitive, and removes only those parts while leaving the rest of the structure intact. We then generate counterfactual answers grounded in this mediator that preserve non-sensitive content but exclude sensitive facts, employing preference-based contrastive optimization to reduce the likelihood of information leakage while maintaining helpfulness and fluency. Experiments across various benchmark datasets show that D2F achieves a better balance between forgetting and retention than strong baseline methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/JingyueCong/D2F.

AI.tldr: 本文提出D2F方法，将遗忘目标从整段回答细化为事实级敏感内容，通过语义中介解耦敏感事实与非敏感含义和表达，实现定向遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法以整段回答为遗忘单元，当遗忘目标只是嵌入在良性解释中的少量敏感事实时，会导致不必要的通用能力损失。需要更细粒度的遗忘粒度。
AI.method: D2F受语义中介启发：对每个待遗忘样本，从答案中抽取事实级"中介"表示，识别其中敏感部分，仅移除该部分而保留其余结构；随后基于该中介生成排除敏感事实、保留非敏感内容的反事实答案，并用偏好对比优化降低信息泄漏概率，同时维持有用性与流畅性。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，D2F在遗忘效果与通用能力保留之间取得了优于强基线方法的平衡。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 事实级细粒度解耦的定向遗忘策略能有效缓解遗忘与保留之间的权衡问题，为LLM机器遗忘提供更精细的解决思路。

title: Beyond Perfect Teammates: Multi-Agent Collaboration with Unreliable Colleagues
summary: LLM-based multi-agent collaboration is increasingly used to solve complex tasks by dividing work among specialized agents and integrating complementary expertise. Yet existing systems and evaluations largely rest on an implicit perfect-colleague assumption: collaborators provide correct and complete information and respond promptly to requests. In realistic teamwork, however, collaborators may return information that does not answer the intended question, provide insufficient detail to support a decision, or fail to respond to a request. To separate task-solving competence from the ability to recover an unreliable evidence-gathering process, we introduce the Unreliable Colleagues Benchmark (UnCoBench), which organizes behavioral failures through Misaligned, Incomplete, and Missed settings. The main agent need to verify contextual correctness, diagnose information gap and track unresolved dependencies in order to obtain the correct evidence for solving the task. We also introduce a verifiable and scalable automated generation pipeline that pairs LLM-based scenario generation with executable checks of answer uniqueness and role necessity. Results across ten models show that similar reliable-setting performance can result in different robustness to unreliable evidence. Trace analysis reveals frequent omissions of corrective follow-up, and the recovery behavior involves inefficient waiting and redundant queries. These findings show that robust collaboration requires not only sound reasoning, but also targeted action to diagnose evidence failures, recover relevant information, and integrate it into decisions. Our data and source code are available at https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/UnCoBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Unreliable Colleagues Benchmark (UnCoBench)，用于将多智能体任务求解能力与不可靠证据收集过程中的恢复能力分离评估。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体协作系统与评测普遍隐含"完美同事假设"，即协作者总会提供正确完整信息并及时响应。但现实团队协作中，协作者可能返回答非所问的信息、细节不足或完全不响应，因此需要单独衡量智能体在不可靠证据收集下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建 UnCoBench，将行为失效组织为 Misaligned、Incomplete、Missed 三类设定；主智能体需验证上下文正确性、诊断信息缺口并追踪未解决依赖以获取正确证据。同时提出可验证、可扩展的自动化生成流水线，结合 LLM 场景生成与答案唯一性、角色必要性的可执行校验。
AI.result: 在十个模型上的结果显示，相近的可靠设定表现可能对应差异显著的不可靠证据鲁棒性。轨迹分析发现纠错性追问常被遗漏，恢复行为存在低效等待与冗余查询。
AI.conclusion: 稳健协作不仅需要健全推理，还需针对性行动来诊断证据失效、恢复相关信息并整合进决策。数据与源码已开源。

title: Esports World Model Dataset
summary: Interactive world models must capture how multiple participants jointly change a shared environment while observing different parts of it. Competitive games make this challenge concrete: players cooperate and compete, while fog of war, team vision and camera placement determine what each can see. Modeling these interactions requires data that connect individual observations and actions to shared state and events. We introduce the Esports World Model Dataset (EWM), a collection of human gameplay spanning StarCraft II, Dota 2 and Counter-Strike 2, with 3,053 games and maps and approximately 4,880 player-view hours, including estimated hours for the ongoing CS2 extension. It includes 4,628 completed StarCraft II views, all ten perspectives for 303 Dota 2 matches, and up to ten views per round in CS2. Across these views, replay-clock alignment connects rendered video with game-native actions, structured state and events from the same match. The three games expose complementary observation conditions: private fog of war, shared team vision and first-person viewpoints. In StarCraft II, player-specific entity records further distinguish live observations from remembered snapshots and link co-observed entities across opposing views. Together with temporal alignment, these records allow researchers to distinguish legitimate information differences from disagreement about shared state. By connecting human decisions, shared dynamics and player-specific information, EWM supports research toward jointly controlled multiplayer world models and interactive environments populated by teammates and opponents learned from human play.

AI.tldr: 本文提出电子竞技世界模型数据集（EWM），涵盖《星际争霸II》《Dota 2》《反恐精英2》的人体游戏数据，包含3,053场游戏与地图、约4,880玩家视角小时，通过回放时钟对齐视频、动作、结构化状态与事件，支持多智能体共享动态与个体观测差异的联合建模研究。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型需建模多个参与者如何共同改变共享环境、同时各自只能观测环境的一部分。竞技游戏将这一挑战具体化：玩家既合作又竞争，而战争迷雾、团队视野与镜头位置决定了各人能看到的范围。建模此类交互需要将个体观测与动作同共享状态、事件相连接的数据，而现有数据难以同时提供个体视角、共享状态与动作之间的对应关系。
AI.method: 构建EWM数据集，采集跨三款游戏的人类游戏过程。数据规模为3,053场游戏与地图、约4,880玩家视角小时（含CS2扩展部分的估算小时）。具体包含：4,628个已完成的星际争霸II视图；303场Dota 2比赛的全部十个视角；CS2每回合至多十个视角。以回放时钟对齐（replay-clock alignment）将渲染视频与游戏原生动作、结构化状态及同一场比赛的事件连接。三款游戏提供互补的观测条件：私有战争迷雾、共享团队视野、第一人称视角。在星际争霸II中，玩家专属实体记录区分实时观测与记忆快照，并跨对立视角链接共同观测的实体。
AI.result: 形成覆盖三款游戏、多视角、带时序对齐的联合数据集；星际争霸II的玩家专属实体记录可区分实时观测与记忆快照，并跨对立视角关联共观实体；结合时序对齐，使研究者能够区分"合法的信息差异"与"对共享状态的真实分歧"。
AI.conclusion: EWM通过连接人类决策、共享动态与玩家专属信息，为联合控制的多玩家世界模型以及由人类对局中学到的队友与对手所构成的交互式环境研究提供数据支撑。

title: Worth Their Weights? Evaluating Generative Models for Discourse Parsing
summary: Rhetorical Structure Theory (RST) parsing has historically been dominated by discriminative models based on pretrained encoder-only language models. The recent availability of high-quality generative language models has made it unclear whether RST parsing is better approached as a generative task. In this work, we investigate whether generative language models are better at parsing RST than traditional discriminative ones. We find that at matched parameter counts, discriminative parsers perform much better than generative ones, though much larger generative models sometimes outperform them. Generative models hold a particular advantage in elementary discourse unit (EDU) segmentation, and we report new state-of-the-art results on the RST-DT benchmark in end-to-end parsing as well as segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文比较生成式与判别式语言模型在RST解析中的表现，发现同参数量下判别式更优，但超大规模生成式模型可超越，且生成式模型在EDU切分上具优势，并在RST-DT上刷新端到端解析与切分的SOTA。
AI.motivation: RST解析长期由基于预训练编码器语言模型的判别式方法主导，而高质量生成式语言模型的出现使"RST解析是否更适合建模为生成任务"这一问题变得不明确，因此需要系统比较两类范式。
AI.method: 在控制参数量的条件下，对判别式与生成式语言模型进行RST解析（含EDU切分与端到端解析）的对比实验，并在RST-DT基准上评测。
AI.result: 参数量匹配时，判别式解析器显著优于生成式解析器；但规模大得多的生成式模型有时能超越判别式方法。生成式模型在基本篇章单元（EDU）切分上表现尤为突出，并在RST-DT的端到端解析与切分任务上取得新的最优结果。
AI.conclusion: RST解析并非天然更适合生成式建模范式；判别式模型在同等规模下仍具明显优势，生成式模型的收益主要来自超大规模以及在EDU切分上的结构优势，同时刷新了RST-DT的两项SOTA。

title: Imitation Holds a Key to Evolution: Localized Repair and Verified Skill Acquisition for Adaptive Agents
summary: An agent can retain successful trajectories without learning which part of an experience should repair a new discrepancy. We formulate passive imitation (PI) as an architectural loop that localizes a violated contract, extracts a local goal, proposes an effect-matched skill, tests a small patch, and retains evidence after full-task verification. We instantiate this loop as a deterministic symbolic controller and analyze its finite repair-query complexity under explicit identifiability and noninterference assumptions. Across ten simulated tool worlds, PI solves all 600 cold held-out composition tasks with three allowed small trials, compared with 6.17% for a whole-trajectory control, while an equally expressive compositional repair control matches PI. On an unseen tool revision, PI achieves 70.0% success versus 24.0% without small trials and 79.0% with self-trial enumeration; an exploratory 24-task adaptation stream subsequently raises first-submission success to 100%, supporting a limited correction-and-retention mechanism rather than a unique incentive advantage or general intelligence. The CPU-only implementation, integrity checks, and reproducible results are available at https://github.com/FriendOfYishan/PI.

AI.tldr: 本文将被动模仿（PI）形式化为一个定位契约违反、提取局部目标、提出效果匹配技能、测试小补丁并在全任务验证后保留证据的架构循环，用确定性符号控制器实现并分析有限修复查询复杂度，在十个模拟工具世界中以三次小试验解决全部600个冷启动留出组合任务。
AI.motivation: 智能体可以保留成功轨迹，却未学习经验中哪一部分应修复新的不一致（discrepancy），这一能力缺口是本文研究的出发点。
AI.method: 将PI建模为架构循环：定位被违反的契约、提取局部目标、提出效果匹配的技能、测试小补丁、在全任务验证后保留证据；以确定性符号控制器实例化，并在显式可辨识性与非干扰假设下分析其有限修复查询复杂度。
AI.result: 在十个模拟工具世界中，PI在允许三次小试验下解决全部600个冷启动留出组合任务，而整轨迹对照仅6.17%；同等表达力的组合修复对照与PI相当。在未见工具修订上，PI成功率为70.0%，无小试验为24.0%，自试验枚举为79.0%；随后一个探索性24任务适应流将首次提交成功率提升至100%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一种有限的修正—保留机制，而非独特激励优势或通用智能；CPU-only实现、完整性检查与可复现结果已公开。

title: Geometric Parrots: Rule Absence vs. Rule Fragility in Spatial and Physical Reasoning for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer many geometric and physical reasoning questions correctly, yet still behave inconsistently in interaction, for example, abandoning a correct answer when confronted with a confident but incorrect user assertion. Standard single-turn accuracy cannot distinguish such capitulations from beneficial corrections because it scores each response in isolation. We introduce GRIP, a controlled benchmark with 34 procedurally generated reasoning domains, 100,000 images, and 600,000 questions spanning geometric, spatial, visual, and physical reasoning. Each scene is generated by deterministic code, and every answer is derived directly from the underlying scene state, providing exact ground truth without human annotation. On GRIP, we propose Dual-Loop Evaluation. A closed loop probes each image with a five-step compositional question ladder to localize where reasoning fails. An open loop then re-elicits the model's answer under controlled challenges, including peer-model responses and unsupported user assertions. Because ground truth is known exactly, answer changes can be signed as corrections (wrong-to-right) or capitulations (right-to-wrong), separating two failure modes: rule absence and rule fragility. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/bilaljawaid980/GRIP-Benchmark, with further details at https://bilaljawaid980.github.io/grip-benchmark/.

AI.tldr: 提出GRIP基准与Dual-Loop评测，用于区分VLM的推理缺陷（规则缺失）与在对抗性质疑下的答案动摇（规则脆弱），实现精确真值下的修正/让步判定。
AI.motivation: 现有单轮准确率无法区分模型是被用户自信但错误的断言所说服（让步），还是合理修正；VLM在多轮交互中可能放弃正确答案，这一失败模式被传统指标掩盖。
AI.method: 构建GRIP：程序化生成34个推理域、10万图像、60万问题，覆盖几何/空间/视觉/物理推理；场景由确定性代码生成，答案直接由场景状态导出，无需人工标注。提出Dual-Loop评测：闭环用五步组合式问题阶梯逐图定位推理失败点；开环在受控挑战（同行模型回答、无依据的用户断言）下重新诱导答案，并根据精确真值将答案变化标注为修正（错→对）或让步（对→错）。
AI.result: 在GRIP上，Dual-Loop评测可将失败模式分离为规则缺失（rule absence）与规则脆弱（rule fragility）两类，并通过答案符号化判定实现修正与让步的量化区分。
AI.conclusion: GRIP提供可控、无标注、精确真值的多域推理基准与评测流程，弥补单轮准确率的不足，为诊断VLM在交互中的推理稳定性与抗压能力提供工具；数据集与项目页面已公开。

title: The Image Still Has a Say: Final-Answer Repair for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought
summary: Although chain-of-thought prompting has improved multimodal reasoning, it is still difficult to produce correct final answers, as the reasoning can drift away from the image. Besides, the trace is already fixed when the answer is generated, leaving no room for self-correction. Considering the image is still available at the final-answer step, we think it is reasonable to fix the answer there without rewriting the reasoning. As such, the problem becomes to correct the final answer using the image under fixed reasoning. Unlike methods that improve trace generation through training, resampling, or decoding-time grounding, we repair the final-answer readout while keeping the reasoning trace fixed. The motivation is based on our finding that a wrong option can become prematurely committed in the reasoning while the correct option still has stronger image support in middle-to-deep layers. Thus, we propose Text-to-Visual Evidence Reallocation (TVER), a training-free method for final-answer repair. Specifically, TVER selects answer-related text and question-matched image patches, and moves bounded attention from text to patches. Furthermore, the patches are chosen in a middle-to-deep layer window based on question relevance. Our method improves answers across benchmarks and backbones, with gains in both multiple-choice and open-answer evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练的 Text-to-Visual Evidence Reallocation (TVER)，在推理链固定的前提下利用图像修复多模态推理的最终答案。
AI.motivation: 多模态思维链虽提升推理能力，但推理易偏离图像导致最终答案错误；且答案生成时推理链已固定，缺乏自我纠错空间。作者观察到：错误选项可能在推理中被过早锁定，而正确选项在中深层仍具更强图像支持，故在最终答案读取阶段借助图像进行修正。
AI.method: TVER 不改写推理链，而是重分配注意力：选取答案相关文本与问题匹配的图像块，将受限的注意力从文本转移到图像块；图像块在中深层窗口内依据问题相关性进行筛选，全程无需训练。
AI.result: 在多个基准和骨干模型上，方法同时提升了多项选择与开放答案两种评测的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 在固定推理轨迹条件下，通过图像证据重分配修复最终答案读取是一种有效且免训练的纠错路径。

title: Large Language Model Assisted Transportation Planning through a Differentiable User Equilibrium Layer
summary: Transportation planning has traditionally required substantial expertise in network modeling, traffic assignment, and optimization. As a result, strategic analyses such as network design, capacity expansion, and model calibration remain inaccessible to non-expert decision makers. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) provide an opportunity to bridge this gap by enabling natural-language interaction with complex transportation planning tools. However, existing LLM-based systems primarily serve as interfaces to simulation software and lack the ability to efficiently search, evaluate, and optimize transportation solutions. This study proposes an integrated human-AI transportation planning framework that combines a large language model, a model context protocol (MCP) interface, an open-source transportation planning engine (AequilibraE), and a differentiable user equilibrium (UE) assignment layer. The framework allows non-expert users to execute network analyses and improve solutions for optimization. A differentiable UE layer is developed by directly differentiating the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions of the Beckmann traffic assignment problem. The proposed framework is demonstrated through two representative planning tasks: calibration of travel time functions from observed traffic counts and network design under budget constraints. The examples illustrate how differentiable transportation models and LLM agents can jointly democratize transportation planning and substantially reduce barriers between domain expertise and transportation decision making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个集成人类与AI的交通规划框架，结合大语言模型、MCP接口、开源交通规划引擎AequilibraE和可微分用户均衡分配层，使非专业用户能以自然语言完成网络分析与方案优化。
AI.motivation: 传统交通规划需要网络建模、交通分配与优化方面的专业知识，导致网络设计、容量扩充、模型标定等战略分析对非专业决策者难以触达。现有基于LLM的系统多仅作为仿真软件的交互界面，缺乏高效搜索、评估和优化交通方案的能力。
AI.method: 构建集成人类-AI交通规划框架：LLM + 模型上下文协议（MCP）接口 + 开源交通规划引擎AequilibraE + 可微分用户均衡（UE）分配层。可微分UE层通过对Beckmann交通分配问题的KKT条件直接求导实现。
AI.result: 通过两个代表性规划任务验证：基于观测交通量标定行驶时间函数，以及预算约束下的网络设计。案例表明可微分交通模型与LLM智能体可协同降低交通规划的专业门槛。
AI.conclusion: 可微分交通模型与LLM智能体的结合能够推进交通规划的民主化，显著削弱领域专业知识与交通决策之间的壁垒。

title: EventLens: Event-Structure Reinforcement Learning for Video Understanding
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables. Project page: https://lostgreen.github.io/EventLens/
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong results on video question answering, yet often fail to recover the temporal structure that makes a video coherent. They may merge neighboring events, miss single-event progression, or infer implausible relations across events. We study structured temporal understanding as the ability to recover event structure from visual evidence, including event boundaries, single-event progression, and multi-event relations. We argue that this gap arises from a mismatch between current post-training objectives and temporal reasoning, where caption-style supervision allows models to rely on language shortcuts rather than visual temporal grounding. To address this, we propose EventLens, a vision-centric reinforcement learning framework that learns video understanding through event-structure recovery. Instead of reconstructing captions, EventLens trains models to recover temporal structure under controlled perturbations, such as altered temporal granularity, reversed progression, and shuffled event order. We instantiate this framework with a three-level temporal ontology and derive three verifiable task families: event segmentation, progression discrimination, and multi-event relation reasoning. These tasks admit deterministic rewards, enabling task-specialized GRPO training without human preference labels or learned reward models. We further introduce multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MT-OPD) to consolidate specialized policies into a unified model. Experiments on Qwen3-VL backbones show consistent improvements on temporal grounding and event-sensitive reasoning benchmarks, while preserving general video-QA performance. Learning curves further demonstrate that EventLens achieves comparable downstream transfer with significantly reduced training cost compared to direct mixed RL optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EventLens——一个以视觉为中心的强化学习框架，通过"事件结构恢复"来训练视频理解，缓解 MLLM 依赖语言捷径、时序结构崩塌的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在视频问答上表现强劲，但难以恢复使视频连贯的时序结构：常把相邻事件合并、漏掉单事件进程、或推断出跨事件的非合理关系。作者认为根源在于当前后训练目标与时序推理不匹配——字幕式监督让模型依赖语言捷径，而非视觉时序 grounding。
AI.method: 提出 EventLens：1）视觉中心的 RL 框架，不重建字幕，而是在受控扰动下恢复时序结构（改变时间粒度、反转进程、打乱事件顺序）；2）基于三级时序本体构造三个可验证任务族：事件分割、进程判别、多事件关系推理，均可给出确定性奖励，从而支持任务专用 GRPO 训练，无需人工偏好标注或学习式奖励模型；3）引入多教师同策略蒸馏（MT-OPD）将各专用策略整合为统一模型。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-VL 骨干上，时序 grounding 与事件敏感推理基准均取得一致提升，同时保持通用 video-QA 性能；学习曲线显示，相比直接混合 RL 优化，EventLens 以显著更低的训练成本达到相当的下游迁移效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过可验证的事件结构恢复任务与确定性奖励，EventLens 有效提升 MLLM 的时序理解能力且不牺牲通用视频问答性能，并以蒸馏方式低成本整合多任务专长，为视频时序推理的后训练提供了新范式。

title: LatentRiskBench: Measuring State-Dependent Risks in Enterprise Agents
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Industry Track. 18 pages, 3 figures
summary: Enterprise agents face safety risks that cannot be determined from individual actions alone. Existing safety benchmarks largely evaluate action-local risks, overlooking failures whose safety depends on workflow state. In such state-dependent risks, the same action may be safe in one context but violate policy in another. Hence, we introduce LatentRiskBench for evaluating such state-dependent risks in enterprise settings. It pairs risky trajectories with benign counterparts that share the same terminal action but differ in latent policy-relevant states, requiring models to reconstruct workflow context rather than rely on action-level cues. We also introduce new metrics for state-dependent risk evaluation, including a suite of residual risk (RR) measures. Experiments on the benchmark show that action-level evaluation detects only 0.09 of state-dependent violations, whereas state-level evaluation reaches 0.96. Existing guardrail methods largely overlook such risks unless they are explicitly applied to workflow states. Case studies on a commercial deployed scenario further show that the safety metrics embedded in the benchmark provide a more realistic measure of safety for enterprise agents. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/JingyueCong/LatentRiskBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 LatentRiskBench，用于评估企业智能体中依赖工作流状态的潜在风险，并引入残余风险（RR）度量；实验表明动作级评估仅能检出 0.09 的状态依赖违规，而状态级评估可达 0.96。
AI.motivation: 企业智能体的安全风险无法仅从单个动作判定：同一动作在不同工作流状态下可能合规也可能违规。现有安全基准主要评估动作局部风险，忽略了安全依赖于工作流状态的失败模式。
AI.method: 构建 LatentRiskBench：将风险轨迹与良性轨迹配对，二者共享相同终端动作但潜在的政策相关状态不同，迫使模型重建工作流上下文而非依赖动作级线索；同时提出面向状态依赖风险评估的新指标，包括一组残余风险（RR）度量。
AI.result: 在基准上的实验显示：动作级评估仅检出 0.09 的状态依赖违规，状态级评估达到 0.96。现有防护栏方法大多忽略此类风险，除非被显式应用于工作流状态。商业部署场景的案例研究进一步表明，基准内置的安全指标能更真实地衡量企业智能体的安全性。
AI.conclusion: 企业智能体安全评估需从动作级转向状态级；LatentRiskBench 及其 RR 指标提供了更贴近部署现实的状态依赖风险评估方式，数据与代码已开源。

title: Phantom Merge: When Your Large Language Model Agents Pick One but Tell You About Another
summary: LLM agents increasingly operate over multiple entities, where reliable response generation requires not only retrieving relevant evidence but also preserving its association with the correct entity. We identify Phantom Merge (PM), an entity-evidence binding failure in which an agent attributes unsupported claims to its committed entity, potentially even when the task is completed correctly. We formalize PM at the claim level and characterize its prevalence and error subtypes across four agent domains and four backbone families. To address this problem, we propose a two-stage framework for claim-level risk estimation and correction. First, Anchor-Grounded Risk (AGR) combines a representational readout of the agent's pre-emission hidden state with Jacobian-based functional information, providing complementary slot-level and anchor-value risk scores. Second, Fixed-Anchor Correction (FAC) audits flagged claims and selectively revises them using observed anchor evidence or removes them when no supported replacement is available. On the held-out Shopping detection cohort, AGR-slot achieves an AUROC of 96.2% and an average precision of 97.3%, outperforming the evaluated detection baselines. In the end-to-end Shopping mitigation evaluation, FAC reduces trajectory-level PM from 51.4% to 6.2%, with an output-to-original claim ratio of 80.7%. These results demonstrate the prevalence of entity-specific grounding failures and the effectiveness of combining internal risk estimation with evidence-constrained claim correction. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LabRAI/PhantomMerge.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别并形式化了LLM智能体中的"实体-证据绑定失效"问题——Phantom Merge（PM），并提出两阶段框架（AGR风险估计 + FAC纠正）来检测与修正此类错误。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地在多实体场景下运行，可靠响应生成不仅需要检索相关证据，还需保持证据与正确实体的关联。作者发现智能体可能将缺乏支持的论断归因于其承诺的实体，即使任务本身被正确完成，这构成一种实体-证据绑定失效。
AI.method: 1) 在claim层面形式化Phantom Merge（PM），刻画其流行度与错误子类型（覆盖4个智能体领域、4个骨干模型族）。2) 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段Anchor-Grounded Risk（AGR），结合智能体发射前隐状态的表征读数与基于Jacobian的功能信息，给出槽位级与锚点值级的风险分数；第二阶段Fixed-Anchor Correction（FAC），对标记的claim进行审核，利用观测到的锚点证据进行选择性修正，若无受支持的替换则删除该claim。
AI.result: 在留出的Shopping检测队列上，AGR-slot达到AUROC 96.2%、平均精度97.3%，优于所评估的检测基线。在端到端Shopping缓解评估中，FAC将轨迹级PM从51.4%降至6.2%，输出与原始claim比例为80.7%。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了实体特定Grounding失效的普遍性，以及结合内部风险估计与证据约束的claim纠正的有效性。代码已公开于 https://github.com/LabRAI/PhantomMerge。

title: EgoAlign: Situated 3D Understanding without Situation Descriptions
summary: Situated 3D Question Answering requires models to interpret a 3D scene relative to an agent's pose. Existing methods commonly convey that pose through a natural-language situation description, which may be unavailable or costly to obtain in real-world deployments. While some methods additionally incorporate numerical pose, we find that randomly shuffling the agent pose causes little performance degradation, indicating limited functional dependence on the numerical pose. To address this gap, we introduce EgoAlign, a simple 3D language model that represents a scene in an agent-centric coordinate frame, together with a dedicated egocentric alignment stage comprising four complementary tasks: object category recognition, egocentric direction prediction, metric distance estimation, and spatial relation prediction. This stage teaches the model to consistently interpret scene geometry relative to the agent's pose before task-specific fine-tuning. EgoAlign achieves the strongest performance on SQA3D, Real-3DQA, and MSQA among compared methods while remaining highly efficient. More importantly, removing textual situation descriptions yields comparable or better downstream performance, whereas shuffling EgoAlign's numerical pose causes substantial degradation. These results show that EgoAlign establishes agent-centric spatial context directly from numerical pose without requiring textual situation descriptions.

AI.tldr: EgoAlign通过以智能体为中心的坐标系表示场景并引入自我中心对齐阶段，使模型直接从数值位姿建立以智能体为中心的空间上下文，无需文本情境描述。
AI.motivation: 现有Situated 3D QA方法主要依赖自然语言情境描述来传达智能体位姿，但这在真实部署中可能无法获得或获取成本高昂。作者发现随机打乱智能体位姿几乎不导致性能下降，说明现有方法对数值位姿的功能依赖有限。
AI.method: 提出EgoAlign，一个简单的3D语言模型：在以智能体为中心的坐标框架中表示场景，并设计了专门的自我中心对齐阶段，包含四个互补任务——物体类别识别、自我中心方向预测、度量距离估计和空间关系预测。该阶段在任务特定微调之前，教会模型一致地相对于智能体位姿解释场景几何。
AI.result: EgoAlign在SQA3D、Real-3DQA和MSQA上取得了对比方法中的最强性能，同时保持高效率。更重要的是，移除文本情境描述可获得相当或更好的下游性能，而打乱EgoAlign的数值位姿则导致显著性能下降。
AI.conclusion: EgoAlign能够直接从数值位姿建立以智能体为中心的空间上下文，无需文本情境描述，证明了数值位姿在该框架中具有实质性的功能作用。

title: Encoding Context into LLM Weights: What Makes It Context?
summary: Longer contexts allow large language models (LLMs) to condition their predictions on more information, but inference costs grow prohibitively with context length. An emerging alternative uses test-time updates to encode context as temporary changes to model weights. However, encoding this information into weights that already represent general knowledge obscures its role as context, so the LLM may fail to use it properly to condition subsequent inference. To restore this contextual role, we first associate each context with an identifier during encoding, thereby distinguishing the newly encoded information from pre-existing knowledge. Invoking the identifier at inference then enables the LLM to recite the encoded context. Nevertheless, successful recitation does not ensure that the LLM will use the recalled information as context. We therefore further introduce a prompting framework that explicitly guides the LLM to use this information as context. Across diverse controlled tasks and practical benchmarks, our method outperformed the baseline using only off-the-shelf LLMs, showing its advances in context encoding.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于标识符与提示框架的测试时权重更新方法，使LLM能够区分并正确使用编码进权重的上下文信息。
AI.motivation: 长上下文能提升LLM预测质量，但推理成本随上下文长度急剧增长。现有替代方案通过测试时更新将上下文编码为模型权重的临时改变，然而这些权重原本承载通用知识，新编码信息与既有知识混淆，导致其作为"上下文"的角色被掩盖，LLM可能无法正确利用这些信息来条件化后续推理。
AI.method: 方法分两步：1）编码阶段为每个上下文关联一个标识符，使新编码信息与模型预存知识相区分；推理时调用该标识符即可让LLM复述已编码的上下文。2）由于成功复述并不保证LLM会将召回信息当作上下文本使用，进一步引入提示框架，显式引导LLM把该信息作为上下文本进行条件推理。
AI.result: 在多种受控任务和实际基准测试上，该方法均优于仅使用现成LLM（off-the-shelf LLM）的基线，在上下文编码方面展现出优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过标识符区分新编码信息与预存知识，并配合提示框架引导其作为上下文本使用，可有效恢复测试时权重更新中上下文的功能性角色，在降低长上下文推理成本的同时提升模型对编码信息的使用效果。

title: Pollard: Governed Semantic Execution Trees for Framework-Independent AI Agent Control and Replay
summary: Agent frameworks can persist checkpoints, trace tool calls, and limit resource use, but these facilities often assign different identities to execution, governance, and replay. We present Pollard, a framework-independent runtime based on governed semantic execution trees. A step identity commits to canonical input, kind, attempt, and parent identity; the same tree records completion, refusal, resource settlement, and branch history. Strict replay returns a verified stored result without invoking the wrapped operation, while a transactional store coordinates reservations across concurrent workers. Under a signed deterministic freeze, two state-model replicas each executed the evaluation transitions without an invariant violation, retained-lease PostgreSQL groups were tested against exact limits, strict replay avoided external calls, and all semantic mutations were detected with no false alarms on the controls. A multi-pair framework matrix preserved reference behavior and verified the trees. A separate cost-capped hosted study exercised live provider paths, and every completed Pollard trial produced a verified tree. Together, the studies support the core mechanisms under explicit lease, boundary, and seal-custody assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Pollard：一种框架无关的运行时，基于受治理的语义执行树，统一执行、治理与重放的身份标识，并支持严格重放与跨并发工作器的事务性资源预留。
AI.motivation: 现有 Agent 框架虽支持检查点持久化、工具调用追踪与资源限制，但这些设施在执行、治理与重放之间往往赋予不同的身份标识，导致语义一致性难以保证。
AI.method: 引入步骤身份，承诺规范输入、种类、尝试次数与父身份；同一棵树记录完成、拒绝、资源结算与分支历史。严格重放返回经过验证的存储结果而不调用被包装操作；事务性存储协调并发工作器间的预留。
AI.result: 在签名确定性冻结下，两个状态模型副本执行评估迁移均无不变式违规；保留租约的 PostgreSQL 组在精确限额下通过测试；严格重放避免外部调用；所有语义变更均被检测且控制组无误报。多对框架矩阵保持参考行为并验证执行树；成本受限的托管研究覆盖实时提供方路径，每个完成的 Pollard 试验均产生经验证的树。
AI.conclusion: 在明确的租约、边界与封装保管假设下，上述研究共同支持 Pollard 核心机制的有效性。

title: DIGS: Distribution-Informed Gaussian Splatting for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D Gaussian segmentation typically binds semantic features to the per-Gaussian state via per-scene gradient training (1-4 h) or the more recent closed-form distillation. Both commit each primitive to a single feature; therefore, boundary Gaussians spanning multiple 2D instances are forced into a hard decision that degrades retrieval accuracy and yields unstable mask boundaries at render time. We present DIGS, a training-free framework with two stages, class-agnostic mapping and multi-modal encoding, that decouples instance discovery from linguistic naming. At the Gaussian level, our distribution-informed representation maintains an explicit top-$M$ label distribution per primitive, updated by a tempered Dirichlet rule; preservation of multi-peaked label distributions at boundary primitives allows a late-argmax renderer to recover clean instance boundaries. A bidirectional state machine aggregates these distributions into a persistent class-agnostic instance ontology. The instance-level encoding stage then fuses the CLIP visual embedding of each instance's isolated 3D footprint with the CLIP-text embedding of an LLM-generated attribute description, disambiguating visually similar instances. On a single A100, DIGS completes mapping and instance encoding on LERF-OVS in 1.0-3.2 min per scene, depending on whether LLM fusion is enabled, and serves native 3D queries in 5.4 ms. It reaches 71.95% mean mIoU on LERF-OVS, outperforming both the training-free SFS and training-based LaGa baselines. DIGS also achieves the highest mean mIoU on LERF-Mask and 3D-OVS and surpasses Gaga and ObjectGS on Replica under their respective evaluation protocols. Code is available at https://github.com/ZephyrZos/DIGS.

AI.tldr: DIGS是一种免训练的开放词汇3D高斯分割框架，通过解耦实例发现与语言命名，在边界高斯的分布建模基础上实现高质量实例边界与高效推理。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇3D高斯分割方法（逐场景梯度训练1-4小时或闭式蒸馏）将每个高斯基元绑定到单一语义特征，导致跨越多个2D实例的边界高斯被迫做硬决策，从而降低检索精度并在渲染时产生不稳定的掩码边界。
AI.method: DIGS为两阶段免训练框架：类无关映射与多模态编码，解耦实例发现与语言命名。在高斯层面采用分布感知表示，为每个基元维护显式top-M标签分布，并由退火Dirichlet规则更新；边界基元保留多峰标签分布，使后置argmax渲染器恢复清晰实例边界。双向状态机将这些分布聚合为持久类无关实例本体。实例级编码阶段融合实例孤立3D足迹的CLIP视觉嵌入与LLM生成属性描述的CLIP文本嵌入，以区分视觉相似的实例。
AI.result: 单张A100上，DIGS在LERF-OVS每场景映射与实例编码耗时1.0-3.2分钟（取决于是否启用LLM融合），原生3D查询延迟5.4毫秒。在LERF-OVS上达到71.95%平均mIoU，优于免训练的SFS与训练的LaGa基线；在LERF-Mask和3D-OVS上取得最高平均mIoU，并在Replica上按各自评测协议超过Gaga与ObjectGS。
AI.conclusion: DIGS以分布感知的高斯表示与多模态实例编码实现免训练的开放词汇3D高斯分割，兼顾边界质量、检索精度与推理效率，并在多个基准上超越训练型与免训练基线。

title: Pushback in a Haystack: Language Models Respond to Factual Errors Ambiguously and Ineffectively
summary: The sycophancy of language models, or their failure to push back against faulty user input, is now widely studied. However, if LMs do push back, is sycophancy solved? We show that LMs vary in how they present pushback, and thus vary in how effectively they correct user beliefs. We introduce a phrase-level, human-validated response labeling framework to uncover fine-grained insights into how LMs push against and/or affirm false inputs. We develop and apply our framework on model responses in five languages: English, German, Chinese, Hindi, and Yoruba. We find that when models do push back against users' false assertions, they tend to use indirect phrasing and mix in affirmation, with more indirectness in Hindi and Yoruba than in other languages considered. In a large-scale human study (n = 300), we find that the pushback ambiguity we identified may fail to correct and prevent users' factual misconceptions.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，语言模型即使"反驳"用户错误输入，也不等于解决了谄媚问题：模型的反驳方式存在差异，且这种差异会影响其纠正用户错误信念的效果。作者提出了一套短语级、经人工验证的响应标注框架，并在英、德、中、印地、约鲁巴五种语言上分析模型响应。结果显示，模型反驳时倾向使用间接措辞并混入肯定，且印地语和约鲁巴语的间接性更强；大规模人类研究（n=300）表明，这种反驳的模糊性可能无法纠正和防止用户的事实性误解。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注语言模型的谄媚现象，即模型不能反驳用户错误输入。但作者的动机在于质疑一个隐含假设：只要模型会反驳，谄媚问题就算解决了。作者认为反驳本身的形式和呈现方式存在差异，而不同的反驳方式对纠正用户信念的有效性可能不同，因此需要更细粒度地考察模型如何表达反驳。
AI.method: 1）提出一套短语级、经人工验证的响应标注框架，用于刻画模型如何反驳和/或肯定错误输入；2）在五种语言（英语、德语、中文、印地语、约鲁巴语）的模型响应上应用该框架进行分析；3）开展大规模人类研究（n=300），检验所识别的反驳模糊性对用户事实性误解纠正的影响。
AI.result: 模型在反驳用户错误断言时，倾向于使用间接措辞并混入肯定性表达；这种间接性在印地语和约鲁巴语中比在其他所考察语言中更强。人类研究（n=300）显示，作者所识别出的反驳模糊性可能无法纠正并防止用户的事实性误解。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型"会反驳"并不等于谄媚问题已解决。反驳的表达方式（间接性与肯定混用）会削弱其纠正用户错误信念的效果，且这种问题在不同语言间存在差异，尤其体现在印地语和约鲁巴语中。研究提示需关注反驳的呈现方式，而非仅关注是否反驳。

title: Uncovering Robustness Weaknesses in LLM Agents via Persona Evolution with Task-Integrity Constraints
summary: Interactive-agent evaluations commonly rely on standardized LLM-based user simulators that exhibit broadly cooperative behavior, potentially overlooking failures that arise under diverse but realistic user interactions. This can lead to overly optimistic estimates of agent robustness and provide limited failure signals for training agents that generalize across users. Existing approaches largely rely on predefined user behaviors, which may miss agent- or domain-specific weaknesses, while failure-oriented search can reduce task success by invalidating the underlying task rather than exposing genuine robustness failures. To fill this gap, we introduce TIPER, a task-integrity-preserving persona evolution method that automatically discovers agent-specific user policies exposing robustness weaknesses while keeping the underlying task valid and solvable. TIPER evolves persistent user personas through reflection-guided behavioral mutations and task-wise Pareto selection under a task-integrity constraint. Across four interactive-agent benchmarks, TIPER yields lower held-out avg@3 scores in all 12 GPT-5.4 settings, with observed reductions of 5.8 to 33.7 percentage points, and in all 28 agent-domain pairs spanning seven agents, with a median observed reduction of 22.9 points. Further analysis yields a behavior-to-failure taxonomy that connects discovered user behaviors to recurring agent failure modes. Together, these results show that TIPER enables more diagnostic robustness evaluation of interactive agents and provides informative failure analysis for future agent robustness improvement. Code repository: https://github.com/UCSB-NLP-Chang/TIPER.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TIPER，一种任务完整性保持的人格演化方法，通过反思引导的行为变异与任务级 Pareto 选择，自动发现能暴露智能体鲁棒性弱点的用户策略，同时保持任务有效可解。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式智能体评估多依赖标准化、普遍合作的 LLM 用户模拟器，可能忽略多样化但真实用户交互下的失败，导致对智能体鲁棒性的估计过于乐观，且难以为跨用户泛化训练提供有效失败信号。已有方法依赖预定义用户行为，难以覆盖智能体或领域特有的弱点；而以失败为导向的搜索又可能因使任务失效而降低任务成功率，而非真正暴露鲁棒性缺陷。
AI.method: TIPER 演化持续性的用户人格，采用反思引导的行为变异，并在任务完整性约束下进行任务级 Pareto 选择，从而自动发现智能体专属的用户策略。
AI.result: 在四个交互式智能体基准上，TIPER 在全部 12 个 GPT-5.4 设置中均降低 held-out avg@3 分数，观测降幅为 5.8 至 33.7 个百分点；在跨越七个智能体的全部 28 个智能体-领域组合中均有效，中位观测降幅为 22.9 个百分点。进一步分析得到行为到失败的分类体系，将发现的用户行为与反复出现的智能体失败模式关联起来。
AI.conclusion: TIPER 能够实现更具诊断性的交互式智能体鲁棒性评估，并为未来智能体鲁棒性改进提供有信息量的失败分析。代码仓库：https://github.com/UCSB-NLP-Chang/TIPER。

title: VGGA: Geometry-Grounded Autoencoder for Video Generation
summary: Autoencoders are the core component of latent video generative models, compressing high-dimensional videos into compact latent spaces for downstream generation. However, existing video autoencoders are primarily optimized for pixel-level reconstruction, providing limited supervision for learning structured latent representations. We argue that videos should not be treated merely as signals to be reconstructed, but rather as 2D projections of dynamic 3D worlds that exhibit explicit and well-structured geometric properties. Building on this insight, we propose \textbf{V}ideo \textbf{G}eometry \textbf{G}rounded \textbf{A}utoencoder (\textbf{VGGA}), a geometry-aware video autoencoder that explicitly incorporates geometric constraints into the reconstruction process. Specifically, VGGA grounds the learned representations along three complementary geometric dimensions: \emph{Structural Depth}, \emph{Motion Correspondence}, and \emph{Projective Warping}. These objectives are unified within a Video Geometry Decoder, which employs a shared spatio-temporal upsampling trunk to jointly optimize geometric learning and RGB reconstruction. Through these geometry-grounded objectives, VGGA encourages the latent representations to capture the underlying 3D structure and motion of dynamic scenes. VGGA consistently improves video generation across both geometry-centric and human-motion domains, reducing gFVD by 28.1\% on RealEstate10K and 37.7\% on Taichi-HD. Notably, these substantial generation improvements are achieved while maintaining comparable reconstruction quality, demonstrating that geometry-grounded representation learning yields a more effective latent space for video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出几何感知视频自编码器VGGA，将深度、运动对应与投影变换三重几何约束融入重建，以提升潜空间结构化程度，从而显著改善视频生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有视频自编码器主要针对像素级重建优化，对潜表示的结构化监督有限，导致潜空间未能有效刻画动态场景的三维结构与运动。
AI.method: 将视频视为动态三维世界的二维投影，从结构深度（Structural Depth）、运动对应（Motion Correspondence）、投影变换（Projective Warping）三个互补几何维度约束表示学习；通过Video Geometry Decoder中的共享时空上采样主干，联合优化几何学习与RGB重建。
AI.result: 在几何中心任务与人体运动任务上均稳定提升视频生成：RealEstate10K上gFVD降低28.1%，Taichi-HD上降低37.7%，同时重建质量保持相当水平。
AI.conclusion: 几何锚定的表示学习能获得更有效的视频生成潜空间，在不牺牲重建质量的前提下显著提升生成性能。

title: Understanding Machine Taste: Aesthetic Agreement Across Foundation Models in K-pop
summary: As foundation models enter creative industries, understanding their aesthetic preferences becomes an important step toward AI-assisted creative decision making. In this work, we investigate how foundation models evaluate creative content and characterize their ``machine taste'' using K-pop songs and music videos as a testbed. We formulate aesthetic evaluation as a pairwise ranking problem and systematically examine pairwise inter-model agreement, group-level consensus, and cross-modal preference alignment. Our results reveal stronger pairwise inter-model agreement and group-level consensus in visual evaluation than in audio evaluation, while preferences across the two modalities remain weakly aligned. We further examine how visual consensus rankings relate to real-world popularity using historical YouTube viewership data, finding positive but varying correlations across artist groups. These findings provide initial insights into machine aesthetic preferences and lay the groundwork for future AI-assisted creative decision making that considers creative content, artist identity, audience preferences, and market dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该研究以K-pop歌曲与MV为测试平台，将基础模型的审美评价形式化为成对排序问题，考察模型间一致性、群体共识、跨模态偏好对齐及其与真实流行度的关联。
AI.motivation: 随着基础模型进入创意产业，理解其"机器审美偏好"成为AI辅助创意决策的重要前提，但相关实证认识仍不足。
AI.method: 以K-pop歌曲和音乐视频为测试对象，将审美评价建模为成对排序任务，系统分析成对模型间一致性、组级共识与跨模态偏好对齐，并用YouTube历史观看数据检验视觉共识排序与真实流行度的关系。
AI.result: 视觉评价中的成对模型一致性与组级共识均强于音频评价；两种模态的偏好仅弱对齐；视觉共识排序与真实流行度呈正相关但相关程度因艺人群体而异。
AI.conclusion: 研究初步揭示了基础模型的审美偏好特征，为兼顾创意内容、艺人身份、受众偏好与市场动态的AI辅助创意决策奠定基础。

title: Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting under Moving-Solid Interaction
summary: We propose the task of Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting: predicting the spatiotemporal evolution of a future dense 3D liquid velocity field conditioned on how a solid object moves through it. This task provides an upstream physical forecasting primitive for systems that need to reason about motion-conditioned liquid response, including robotic liquid manipulation, digital twins, and rigid-fluid video generation. Existing works have made efforts in predicting flow around static or prescribed solid geometries and synthesizing visually plausible fluid motion. Yet these approaches provide limited coverage for interactive liquid dynamics, as they are not capable of forecasting how a moving solid induces a future full-domain liquid response. In this forecasting scenario, the hydrodynamic effect is condensed near an evolving liquid-solid interface, but the prediction target is a global spatiotemporal rollout. To address this challenge, we propose a two-level recurrent forecasting framework, TIDE/TIDES: TIDE isolates localized interface-driven forecasting, while TIDES adds transport-aware coupling and explicit stabilization to reduce accumulated rollout error. Across adapted neighboring baselines, controlled component ablations, motion/size OOD tests, and long-horizon evaluation, TIDES achieves the best forecasting performance and the ablations identify localized interaction, transport coupling, and stabilization as the key contributors. Together, our task formulation, benchmark, and TIDE/TIDES study establish a controlled foundation for moving-solid-conditioned dense liquid forecasting. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/jongwonryu/TIDE-TIDES.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"交互式4D体积液体预测"新任务，并设计TIDE/TIDES两级循环预测框架，在该任务上取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多针对静态或预设固体几何周围的流场预测，或仅合成视觉上合理的流体运动，无法预测运动固体如何诱发未来的全域液体响应，难以支撑机器人液体操控、数字孪生、刚-流视频生成等需要推理运动条件液体响应的系统。
AI.method: 提出两级循环预测框架TIDE/TIDES：TIDE聚焦于局部界面驱动的预测；TIDES在此基础上加入输运感知耦合与显式稳定化机制，以抑制长程推演中的误差累积。
AI.result: 在适配的邻近基线、受控组件消融、运动/尺寸OOD测试以及长时程评估中，TIDES均取得最佳预测性能；消融实验表明局部交互、输运耦合与稳定化是性能提升的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过任务定义、基准和TIDE/TIDES研究，为运动固体条件下的稠密液体预测建立了受控基础，代码已开源。

title: MP-MNCA: Morphology-Prior Masked Neighbor Cross-Attention for Efficient Spatial Domain Identification
comment: Both authors contributed equally to this work
summary: Spatial transcriptomics jointly captures molecular state, tissue morphology, and spatial organization, yet spatial-domain methods are typically compared only at late training checkpoints, obscuring differences in convergence efficiency. We introduce MP-MNCA, a morphology-prior masked neighbor cross-attention framework that preserves the full 3,000 dimensional highly-variable-gene representation while selectively routing molecular information across spatial neighbors, with histological similarity incorporated as a continuous attention prior under a self-supervised masked neighbor-contrastive objective. Across 12 heterogeneous human dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) sections, MP-MNCA is evaluated against established spatial-domain baselines using both convergence trajectories and epoch-wise spatial-domain visualizations. Our results show that MP-MNCA (i) reaches coherent spatial-domain structure in substantially fewer training epochs, as reflected quantitatively by convergence curves and qualitatively by progressive spatial grids, and (ii) maintains strong clustering quality, achieving a mean peak refined ARI of 0.546 versus 0.549 for the strongest baseline (STAIG), while attaining the highest mean refined NMI of 0.657 versus 0.640. Moreover, MP-MNCA outperforms STAIG on 7 of 12 sections in ARI and 11 of 12 in NMI, demonstrating faster convergence without sacrificing spatial-domain quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MP-MNCA框架，通过形态学先验掩码邻居交叉注意力与自监督掩码邻居对比目标，在保留全维高变基因表征的同时选择性聚合空间邻居信息，在12个DLPFC切片上实现更快收敛且不损失空间域聚类质量。
AI.motivation: 现有空间域识别方法通常仅在训练后期检查点进行比较，掩盖了收敛效率的差异，难以反映模型的训练动态与效率表现。
AI.method: MP-MNCA采用形态学先验掩码邻居交叉注意力框架：保留完整的3000维高变基因表征，选择性在空间邻居间路由分子信息，并将组织学相似度作为连续注意力先验，结合自监督掩码邻居对比目标进行训练。评估采用收敛轨迹与逐epoch空间域可视化，与既有空间域基线在12个DLPFC切片上对比。
AI.result: MP-MNCA在显著更少的训练epoch内形成连贯的空间域结构（收敛曲线量化、空间网格可视化定性验证）；平均峰值精炼ARI为0.546（最强基线STAIG为0.549），平均精炼NMI最高为0.657（STAIG为0.640）；在12个切片中ARI有7个、NMI有11个优于STAIG。
AI.conclusion: MP-MNCA在保持与最强基线相当或更优的空间域聚类质量的同时，显著提升收敛效率，证明快速收敛与高质量空间域识别可以兼得。

title: Geometric Structure Predicts Per-Example Neighborhood Loss Under PCA Truncation
summary: Dimensionality reduction can preserve the average performance of text embeddings even when a substantial fraction of their dimensions is removed. Aggregate metrics, however, do not reveal whether degradation is distributed uniformly across examples. We study per-example neighborhood stability under PCA truncation across static word embeddings and modern sentence encoders. Per-item neighbor retention varies widely and is predictable from geometric properties of the representation and its alignment with the retained PCA subspace. The fraction of centered-vector energy retained by the truncated subspace is strongest for CBOW and RI, with neighborhood contrast leading on SkipGram and the modern/Matryoshka settings (GTE approximately tied), while local density is associated with retention in marginal analysis but adds little unique information once energy and contrast are controlled (R-squared increments 0.001 to 0.010). Local intrinsic dimensionality accounts for more variation than density on modern sentence encoders in pairwise comparison. On SciFact, query density predicts retrieval degradation under aggressive compression; on NFCorpus the primary 32d association does not replicate, and a direct variance-restriction test leaves that null unresolved. Average compression performance conceals systematic per-example variation that geometry makes visible.

AI.tldr: 降维在平均指标上能保持文本嵌入性能，但逐样本的邻域稳定性差异很大，且可由表示的几何性质（能量保留、邻域对比度、局部内在维度）预测。
AI.motivation: 聚合指标掩盖了降维退化是否在样本间均匀分布，因此需要研究逐样本的邻域稳定性及其几何可预测性。
AI.method: 在静态词嵌入（CBOW、SkipGram、RI）与现代句编码器（含Matryoshka、GTE）上，对PCA截断后的逐项邻居保留率进行回归分析，比较中心向量能量保留比例、邻域对比度、局部密度与局部内在维度等几何量的预测贡献。
AI.result: 逐项邻居保留率波动较大；能量保留对CBOW和RI最强，邻域对比度在SkipGram及现代/Matryoshka设置中领先（GTE基本持平）；局部密度在边缘分析中与保留率相关，但控制能量与对比度后增量R²仅0.001–0.010；现代句编码器上局部内在维度比密度解释更多变异。SciFact上查询密度可预测激进压缩下的检索退化，NFCorpus上主32维关联未复现，方差限制检验仍为未决零结果。
AI.conclusion: 平均压缩性能掩盖了系统性的逐样本差异，而这些差异可由表示的几何性质显式揭示。

title: ProCARE: Real-World Study Automation via Profile-Grounded Evidence Contracts
comment: 42 pages, 5 figures, including appendix. Accepted by NeurIPS'26. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/ZyFanTJ/ProCARE
summary: Real-world studies (RWS) analyze routinely collected healthcare data, such as electronic health records and insurance claims, to estimate treatment effects, monitor safety, and identify risk factors outside randomized trials. Automating RWS with large language model agents is appealing but brittle: valid analyses depend on dataset-specific clinical semantics, including index dates, follow-up windows, patient/event-level units, and outcome boundaries that are often implicit in observational data. This leads to schema mismatches, temporal errors, inconsistent analytical granularity, and unsupported clinical claims. We present ProCARE, a profile-grounded framework that reformulates RWS automation as constrained compilation. ProCARE converts heterogeneous data profiles into Evidence Contracts specifying available variables, temporal attributes, distributions, and evidentiary limits, and compiles study objectives into RWS-IR, a strongly typed intermediate representation for variables, time relations, analysis units, and statistical tasks. Deterministic validation and localized repair then check and revise generated workflows across schema mapping, cohort construction, variable derivation, analysis, and interpretation. On 36 EHR-based benchmark tasks, ProCARE outperforms strong LLM-agent baselines in code executability, semantic consistency, and conclusion traceability, with automated violation diagnoses showing moderate-to-substantial agreement with blinded expert review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProCARE，一个基于数据剖面（profile）的框架，将真实世界研究（RWS）自动化重构为"约束编译"过程，通过Evidence Contracts与强类型中间表示RWS-IR，结合确定性验证与局部修复，提升LLM智能体自动生成RWS工作流的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 真实世界研究依赖常规采集的医疗数据（如电子健康记录、保险理赔）估计疗效、监测安全性与识别风险因素。用大语言模型智能体自动化RWS虽具吸引力但很脆弱：有效分析依赖数据集特定的临床语义（索引日期、随访窗口、患者/事件级分析单元、结局边界等），而这些语义在观察性数据中往往是隐含的，导致模式不匹配、时间错误、分析粒度不一致及缺乏依据的临床结论。
AI.method: ProCARE将异构数据剖面转化为Evidence Contracts，明确可用变量、时间属性、分布与证据边界；将研究目标编译为RWS-IR——一种用于变量、时间关系、分析单元与统计任务的强类型中间表示；随后通过确定性验证与局部修复，在模式映射、队列构建、变量派生、分析与解释各环节检查并修正生成的工作流。
AI.result: 在36个基于EHR的基准任务上，ProCARE在代码可执行性、语义一致性与结论可追溯性方面优于强LLM智能体基线，其自动化违规诊断与盲法专家评审达到中等至显著一致性。
AI.conclusion: 将RWS自动化形式化为受约束的编译过程，并借助显式证据契约与强类型中间表示，可有效缓解隐含临床语义带来的脆弱性，提升自动化分析流程的可靠性与可验证性。

title: Look Back to Move Forward: Learning to Revisit for Agentic Compositional Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image models have made remarkable progress in visual fidelity and instruction following, yet complex compositional generation remains challenging. Existing agentic approaches address this limitation through iterative generation and editing, adapting their actions based on interaction history. However, they typically fix the continuation state (i.e., the image from which refinement proceeds) to the latest image. Since iterative editing is not necessarily monotonic, the agent may continue refining from the latest image even when it has already degraded. In this work, we introduce GenRevisit, an agentic framework that extends action selection to joint continuation-state and action selection. The agent can not only use interaction history to adjust editing instructions but also select an image candidate to edit, jointly deciding where to continue from and how to refine. We train GenRevisit with SFT followed by agentic reinforcement learning. To address the coarse credit assignment of final outcome reward in GRPO, which assigns the same trajectory-level advantage to all actions, we further propose Normalized Action Credit Assignment (NACA) to redistribute positive advantage according to each action's contribution to reducing the remaining objective. On GenEval2, GenRevisit achieves GM scores of 84.3 and 74.4 with Qwen-Image-2512 and Z-Image-Turbo, surpassing the strongest baselines using the same generators by 12.7 and 10.9 points respectively. GenRevisit achieves state-of-the-art performance on GenEval, GenEval++, and GenEval2 among baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出GenRevisit智能体框架，将图像生成的迭代精修建模为"续接状态+动作"联合选择，并设计NACA归一化动作信用分配缓解GRPO的粗粒度信用分配问题，在多个评测上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体式文生图方法通过迭代生成与编辑来改善复杂组合生成，但普遍将续接状态固定为最新图像。由于迭代编辑并非单调改进，智能体可能在图像已退化时仍从最新图像继续精修，导致错误累积、性能受限。
AI.method: 提出GenRevisit框架：将动作选择扩展为续接状态与动作的联合选择，智能体既可依据交互历史调整编辑指令，也能从历史图像中挑选候选进行编辑，即联合决定"从哪里继续"与"如何精修"。训练采用SFT后接智能体强化学习。针对GRPO中最终结果奖励信用分配过粗（同一轨迹内所有动作共享相同轨迹级优势）的问题，提出Normalized Action Credit Assignment（NACA），按每个动作对降低剩余目标的贡献重新分配正优势。
AI.result: 在GenEval2上，使用Qwen-Image-2512与Z-Image-Turbo分别取得GM分数84.3与74.4，较使用相同生成器的最强基线高出12.7与10.9分；在GenEval、GenEval++和GenEval2上均达到基线中的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 联合选择续接状态与动作能够有效缓解迭代编辑非单调性带来的退化累积问题，配合NACA细粒度信用分配，GenRevisit在复杂组合文生图任务上显著优于现有智能体式方法，并在多个评测基准上实现SOTA。

title: Auditing Failure Attribution: Label Predictability and Judge Behavior
summary: Failure-attribution benchmarks ask an LLM judge which step or agent caused a failure. A high score should mean the judge checked the faulty step against the run (a cross-step check). However, spurious signals (surface cues) that predict the annotation can produce a high score. In this paper, we propose four tests to separate checking from cue use. Input restriction asks whether partial input predicts the annotation. Cue following checks whether moved cues change answers. Residual accuracy scores judges where cue-only predictors fail. Aggregation asks whether the failure mix or metric changes rankings. Real observations motivate these tests: on three benchmarks, simple predictors match or beat GPT-4.1. In two Who&When Pro systems, a classifier reading one step's reasoning finds 95-100% of faulty steps, motivating input restriction. In one of them, error injection leaves no reasoning after the faulty step; judges fine-tuned on its labels beat GPT-4.1 by 41 points. Adding task-related reasoning after that step moves this cue: fine-tuned judges lose 31-99 points, but zero-shot judges lose at most 9, motivating cue following. On Aegis, blaming every agent matches GPT-4.1 on micro-F1 but trails by 19 points in exact-set accuracy, motivating aggregation. We recommend reporting these tests when developing failure-attribution benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出四种检验（输入限制、线索跟随、残差准确率、聚合），用于区分LLM评判者在失败归因任务中是真正进行了跨步骤核查，还是仅利用了表面线索，并建议在开发此类基准时报告这些检验结果。
AI.motivation: 失败归因基准要求LLM评判者判断是哪一步或哪个智能体导致了失败，高分本应意味着评判者将故障步骤与整个运行过程进行了跨步骤核查。然而，能够预测标注结果的虚假表面线索也可能带来高分。作者用真实观察说明这一风险：在三个基准上，简单预测器即可匹敌或超过GPT-4.1；在Who&When Pro的两个系统中，仅读取单步推理的分类器就能找出95-100%的故障步骤；在Aegis上，"归咎所有智能体"的策略在micro-F1上可匹敌GPT-4.1。这些现象表明高分可能源于线索利用而非真正核查，因此需要一套诊断工具。
AI.method: 作者提出四种检验：1）输入限制（input restriction）：检验仅凭部分输入能否预测标注；2）线索跟随（cue following）：检验移动线索后答案是否改变，通过注入错误使故障步骤后无推理，再用该标签微调评判者，并在故障步骤后添加任务相关推理来移动线索；3）残差准确率（residual accuracy）：仅在纯线索预测器失败的样本上评估评判者；4）聚合（aggregation）：检验失败混合比例或指标变化是否改变排序结果。
AI.result: 真实观察结果包括：三个基准上简单预测器匹配或超过GPT-4.1；在Who&When Pro两个系统中，读取单步推理的分类器识别出95-100%的故障步骤；其中一个系统中错误注入后故障步骤后无推理，在其标签上微调的评判者比GPT-4.1高41分；在故障步骤后添加任务相关推理后，微调评判者下降31-99分，而零样本评判者最多下降9分；在Aegis上，全归咎策略在micro-F1上匹敌GPT-4.1，但在精确集合准确率上落后19分。
AI.conclusion: 作者建议在开发失败归因基准时报告这四种检验，以确认高分数反映的是真正的跨步骤核查能力，而非表面线索的利用，从而提高基准的有效性和可信度。

title: Label-Centric Knowledge Retrieval for Zero-Shot Text Classification
summary: Flagship large language models (LLMs) offer rich general knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, but their high inference cost and latency limit their use for large-scale data labeling. We study zero-shot text classification with semantically meaningful labels and task descriptions, without task-specific labeled examples or classifier feedback. We propose \textbf{SLKR} (Semantic Label Knowledge Retrieval), a label-centric retrieval-augmented generation framework that separates offline knowledge construction from lightweight online inference. Offline, a flagship LLM independently generates label definitions, retrieval keywords, and boundary rules for potentially confusable label pairs, forming a reusable label-knowledge store. Because this construction operates over the label space rather than the input corpus, its one-time flagship cost can be amortized across large-scale inference. Online, hybrid semantic and lexical retrieval first identifies the top-$K$ candidate labels and then selects up to $M$ input-relevant boundary rules connecting candidate-label pairs. A lightweight LLM performs the final classification in a single call using the retrieved definitions and rules. Across three public benchmarks and a real-world multilingual book-classification dataset, SLKR achieves the best results on all four datasets with Qwen3.5-4B and on three of four with Ministral-3-3B, while using compact input contexts and no task-specific labeled examples. Boundary ablations further show that retrieving a small set of input-relevant rules preserves performance close to using all boundaries with substantially less context, supporting efficient reuse of flagship-generated label knowledge for lightweight classification.

AI.tldr: 提出SLKR框架，利用旗舰LLM离线构建标签知识库，轻量LLM在线检索后单次调用完成零样本文本分类，在四个数据集上取得领先效果。
AI.motivation: 旗舰大模型通用知识与推理能力强，但推理成本高、延迟大，难以用于大规模数据标注；而零样本文本分类又缺乏任务特定标注样本与分类器反馈。
AI.method: SLKR（语义标签知识检索）将离线知识构建与轻量在线推理分离。离线阶段由旗舰LLM针对标签空间（而非输入语料）生成标签定义、检索关键词，以及易混淆标签对的边界规则，构成可复用标签知识库，成本可摊销；在线阶段先以语义与词汇混合检索选出Top-K候选标签，再挑选至多M条与输入相关的边界规则，轻量LLM仅一次调用结合检索到的定义与规则完成分类。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准和一个真实多语言图书分类数据集上，SLKR使用Qwen3.5-4B在全部四个数据集上取得最佳结果，使用Ministral-3-3B在四个中的三个上取得最佳；且输入上下文紧凑，无需任务特定标注样本。
AI.conclusion: 边界消融表明，仅检索少量与输入相关的规则即可接近使用全部边界的性能，同时显著减少上下文，验证了旗舰模型生成的标签知识可被高效复用于轻量级分类。

title: Seg2Click: Learning Pixel-Level Action Masks for GUI Visual Grounding
summary: Visual grounding is a central challenge for GUI agents, requiring an instruction to be mapped to a target within a crowded screenshot. Coordinate generation with single-point supervision reduces a spatially extended target to one position, despite the presence of many valid click locations. Region-based patch scoring alleviates this ambiguity, but its spatial decisions remain tied to visual-token footprints that may span the target, neighboring controls, and background. To address these limitations, we propose Seg2Click, which reformulates GUI grounding as executable-region prediction: identifying where a click can validly execute the given instruction. Using bounding-box supervision, Seg2Click predicts an executable-region mask and computes the final click point through a deterministic rule. This formulation captures the spatial extent of valid click locations and enables finer localization beyond the visual-token grid, making it well suited to small, densely arranged controls without requiring a verifier or zoom-in pass. Experiments across five backbone configurations from two model families demonstrate the effectiveness of Seg2Click. Seg2Click-9B achieves 92.06\%, 94.10\%, and 55.22\% on ScreenSpot, ScreenSpot-v2, and ScreenSpot-Pro, respectively, while matched-backbone comparisons show improvements over both coordinate generation and patch-based grounding. Code will be available at https://github.com/jcwang0602/Seg2Click.

AI.tldr: Seg2Click将GUI视觉定位重塑为可执行区域预测，用边界框监督预测可点击区域掩码并确定性推导点击点，在ScreenSpot系列上显著超越坐标生成与patch打分方法。
AI.motivation: GUI视觉定位要求在密集截图中把指令映射到目标。单点监督的坐标生成把有空间延展的目标压缩为单一位置，忽略多个合法点击点；基于区域patch打分虽缓解歧义，但决策受限于视觉token足迹，可能跨越目标、邻近控件与背景。
AI.method: 提出Seg2Click：将GUI定位重构为可执行区域预测，即识别指令可有效执行的点击范围。仅使用边界框监督，预测可执行区域掩码，再通过确定性规则计算最终点击点，从而突破视觉token网格的精度限制，无需验证器或放大（zoom-in）过程。
AI.result: 在来自两个模型家族的五个骨干配置上验证有效性。Seg2Click-9B在ScreenSpot、ScreenSpot-v2、ScreenSpot-Pro上分别达92.06%、94.10%、55.22%；同骨干对比显示优于坐标生成与基于patch的定位方法。
AI.conclusion: 可执行区域预测能更好刻画有效点击的空间范围，适合小而密集排列的控件，且无需额外验证或放大步骤，是一种高效、精确的GUI定位范式。

title: Connecting the Dots: Enduring Performance Gaps in ASR Systems Between Standard and Minority English Varieties
comment: Accepted to IEEE SLT 2026. 11 pages including appendix, 1 figure, 6 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/smfsamir/longitudinal-asr-eval
summary: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) system evaluations have consistently revealed performance disparities along lines of race, gender, socioeconomic status, and language variety. While these disparities are well-documented, they are often (implicitly or explicitly) treated as issues that subsequent, larger, and more universal models will correct. We challenge this assumption of steady progress in reducing accent-related performance disparities, conducting a longitudinal evaluation of 16 prominent systems released between 2021-2025 across 8 datasets representing diverse English accent varieties. We find that the performance disparity between Mainstream US English (MUSE) and minority accents is stubborn, not reliably declining as a function of time. Specifically, while systems are reliably performant on MUSE, minority accents are subject to risks of large performance degradations between generations of systems, sometimes worsening by 65% absolute Word Error Rate. We argue that standard ASR benchmarks enact an implicit language policy privileging Mainstream US English varieties. As such, these performance disparities reflect systemic failures of language technology development infrastructure that disproportionately affect underrepresented speaker populations.

AI.tldr: 对2021-2025年发布的16个ASR系统在8个英语口音数据集上的纵向评估表明：主流美式英语(MUSE)与少数族裔口音之间的性能差距顽固存在，并未随时间可靠缩小，且少数口音在不同代际间可能出现高达65%绝对词错率(WER)的急剧恶化。
AI.motivation: ASR评估中普遍存在种族、性别、社会经济地位和语言变体维度的性能差异。这类差异常被隐含或显式地假设为将由后续更大、更通用的模型自动修正。作者旨在挑战这一"持续进步"假设，检验口音相关性能差距是否随时间推移而稳步缩小。
AI.method: 开展纵向评估(longitudinal evaluation)：选取2021-2025年间发布的16个代表性ASR系统，在代表多样化英语口音变体的8个数据集上进行跨系统、跨代际的对比测量，重点考察MUSE与少数口音之间的性能差距及其时间趋势。
AI.result: MUSE与少数口音之间的性能差距顽固存在，并未作为时间的函数可靠下降。系统在MUSE上表现稳定良好，但少数口音面临跨代际大幅性能退化的风险，部分情况下绝对词错率(WER)恶化达65%。
AI.conclusion: 标准ASR基准隐含了一种偏袒主流美式英语变体的语言政策(language policy)。这些性能差异并非可通过模型规模化自然消解的暂时性问题，而是语言技术开发基础设施的系统性失败，对代表性不足的说话人群体造成不成比例的影响。

title: Correct Choices, Failed Sequences: Choice2Seq Benchmarks Correctness Retention Across Output Interfaces
summary: A model may select the correct answer yet fail to construct it through a sequence of local decisions. We introduce Choice2Seq, a diagnostic benchmark that measures correctness retention across complete-answer selection and sequential construction in independent runs on the same problems and candidate sets. Sequence Composition Rate (SCR) measures the fraction of correctly selected items that are also answered correctly through local construction. Jev achieves 97.1% and 99.5% selection accuracy on arithmetic and lexical retrieval, yet retains only 33.0% and 2.1% of those correct choices under serial construction, respectively. Substantial gaps also emerge for StartLux and Qwen, including when Qwen emits characters directly. Restricting local options to candidate-supported characters improves construction, while explicit position indexing improves copying fidelity, even for incorrect selections. These interventions distinguish task correctness, plan fidelity, and output compliance. Matched dialogue-state evaluations reveal that local field construction largely preserves Jev's correct states but reduces Qwen's mean-turn accuracy, highlighting task- and interface-dependent differences. Sequence-level confidence and request-cost analyses further characterize completed outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Choice2Seq诊断基准，用以衡量模型在"选择正确答案"与"通过局部决策逐步构造答案"之间的一致性，并定义序列构造率(SCR)量化正确选择的保留程度。
AI.motivation: 模型可能在整体选择时给出正确答案，但在通过一系列局部决策逐步构造答案时失败；现有评测未将"整答选择正确性"与"序列构造能力"在同一问题与候选集上解耦测量，导致能力评估存在盲区。
AI.method: 构建Choice2Seq基准：在同一问题、同一候选集合上独立运行"整答选择"与"序列构造"两类任务；提出序列构造率(SCR)，即被正确选择的条目中同时在局部构造中答对的比例。在算术与词汇检索任务上评测Jev、StartLux和Qwen（含直接输出字符的设定）；并施加两类干预——将局部选项限制为候选支持字符、显式位置索引；另开展匹配对话状态评测与序列级置信度、请求成本分析。
AI.result: Jev在算术与词汇检索上的选择准确率分别为97.1%与99.5%，但在序列构造下仅保留33.0%与2.1%的正确选择。StartLux与Qwen亦存在显著差距，Qwen直接输出字符时同样如此。限制局部选项为候选支持字符可改善构造，显式位置索引提升复制保真度，即便对错误选择亦然。匹配对话状态评测显示局部字段构造基本保持Jev的正确状态，但降低Qwen的平均轮次准确率。
AI.conclusion: 这些干预区分了三类能力：任务正确性、规划保真度与输出合规性；局部构造表现随任务与接口而变化，序列级置信度与请求成本分析进一步刻画了完整输出。

title: MFlowHOI: Whole-Body Human-Object Interaction Generation via Part-Aware MeanFlow
summary: Whole-body human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires coordinating body and finger motion, object trajectories, and time-varying contacts. Existing methods typically rely on iterative diffusion or test-time optimization, resulting in high inference costs. Direct one-step generation is highly desired in downstream applications due to efficient inference. However, it is challenging because these HOI components differ substantially in structure and scale. We present MFlowHOI, an efficient one-step framework for whole-body HOI generation. A Contact-Aware Multipart RVQVAE organizes body, hand, object, and contact signals into a structured latent space, with a shared decoder preserving their global coordination. An ST-DiT then models temporal and cross-part dependencies in this space and generates a complete interaction in a single MeanFlow evaluation. Predicted object-local contact correspondences further enable geometric refinement and interaction-preserving transfer to photorealistic 3D Gaussian avatars with different body proportions. Experiments demonstrate that MFlowHOI outperforms existing base generators in motion quality and text alignment while substantially reducing inference time.

AI.tldr: MFlowHOI：基于Contact-Aware Multipart RVQVAE与ST-DiT的一次性全身人-物交互生成框架
AI.motivation: 全身人-物交互生成需协调身体与手指运动、物体轨迹及时变接触，但现有方法依赖迭代扩散或测试时优化，推理成本高；下游应用需要高效的一次性直接生成，而各交互组件在结构与尺度上差异显著，直接生成极具挑战。
AI.method: 提出一次性的MFlowHOI框架：用Contact-Aware Multipart RVQVAE将身体、手、物体与接触信号组织为结构化隐空间，并通过共享解码器保持全局协调；再用ST-DiT在该隐空间中建模时间与跨部件依赖，单次MeanFlow评估生成完整交互；预测的物体局部接触对应关系进一步支持几何细化与交互保持的迁移，可转移到不同身体比例的照片级3D高斯化身。
AI.result: 实验表明，MFlowHOI在运动质量与文本对齐上优于现有基础生成器，同时显著降低推理时间。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化隐空间、单步MeanFlow生成与接触引导的细化迁移，MFlowHOI实现了高效且高质量的全身人-物交互生成，兼顾下游可迁移性。

title: Efficiently Learning To Reason or Not to Reason: Root-token Policy Optimization for Adaptive Thinking
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance by externalizing explicit reasoning traces before producing the answer, yet suffer from overthinking challenge that allocates uniformly heavy computation to queries of varying difficulty. While proprietary models mitigate this via opaque routing, open-source LRMs still lack an efficient mechanism to internalize adaptive reasoning due to both expensive training cost and limited disclosure of training recipes. In response, we introduce RPO (Root-token Policy Optimization), a framework that enables LRMs to self-determine when to reason by training only the initial root token (e.g., whether to invoke the <think> tag) via group relative reward and group-wise advantages. By focusing on this pivotal branching point, RPO drastically reduces training overhead and VRAM usage. Across multiple model families and scales, RPO learns difficulty-aware adaptive thinking at just ~2% of the training compute of prior adaptive-reasoning methods.

AI.tldr: 提出RPO框架，仅训练根token（如是否生成<think>标签）实现难度感知的自适应推理，训练开销仅为先前方法的约2%。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）对难度各异的查询统一施加沉重计算，存在"过度思考"问题；闭源模型靠不透明的路由机制缓解，而开源LRMs缺乏高效的自适应推理内部化机制，受限于高昂训练成本与训练配方公开不足。
AI.method: RPO（Root-token Policy Optimization）：只训练初始的根token（例如是否调用<think>标签），采用组相对奖励（group relative reward）与组内优势（group-wise advantages），聚焦这一关键分支点，从而大幅降低训练开销与显存占用。
AI.result: 在多个模型家族与规模上，RPO学到难度感知的自适应思考能力，训练计算量仅为先前自适应推理方法的约2%。
AI.conclusion: 通过仅优化根token这一分支点，RPO以极低训练成本为开源LRMs提供了高效的自适应推理内部化方案，缓解过度思考问题。

title: OneShot: Label-Efficient Detector Weighting for Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time series (TS) anomaly detection (AD) lacks a universal detector, with the best choice determined by the series rather than by the algorithm. Existing methods therefore either select one detector for each series or average a pool of them. However, both assume that no label ever arrives, while a deployed monitor does receive them, since an operator confirms the alarms it raises. In this paper, we propose ONESHOT, which uses a single confirmed anomaly to weight the pool rather than to choose one detector from it. Specifically, we score each detector on the confirmed anomaly, and those scores become the weights of a soft mixture over the whole pool. We show that a single confirmed anomaly is enough to come close to the best detector for the series. Across 152 univariate and 73 multivariate series, ONESHOT outperforms the strongest single detector, averaging the whole pool, and even picking the best detector on the confirmed event. Code is available at: https://github.com/seunghan96/one_shot.

AI.tldr: 提出ONESHOT：利用单个已确认异常对检测器池进行加权，而非选择单一检测器。
AI.motivation: 时间序列异常检测缺乏通用检测器，最优选择取决于序列本身而非算法。现有方法要么为每个序列选择一个检测器，要么对检测器池取平均。但两者都假设永远没有标签到达，而实际部署中的监控器会收到标签，因为操作员会确认其发出的警报。
AI.method: ONESHOT利用单个已确认异常对池进行加权，而不是从中选择一个检测器。具体地，在已确认异常上对每个检测器打分，这些分数成为整个池上软混合的权重。
AI.result: 在152个单变量和73个多变量序列上，ONESHOT优于最强的单一检测器、整个池的平均，甚至在已确认事件上挑选最佳检测器。单个已确认异常足以接近该序列的最佳检测器。
AI.conclusion: 单个已确认异常即可用于对检测器池进行软加权，从而在无需完全标签的情况下逼近最优检测器性能，代码已开源。

title: EgoWholeView: Camera-Only Head-Mounted Capture of Body and Bimanual Hand Motion for Embodied Demonstrations
summary: Head-mounted body and bimanual motion capture supports self-avatars, teleoperation, and embodied demonstrations. However, a single egocentric camera is vulnerable to a limited field of view, scale ambiguity, and hand-object occlusion. We present EgoWholeView, a wearable capture system of six synchronized wide-angle RGB cameras with a role-specialized pipeline. The outward views localize the rig in a world frame, while an overlapping downward pair independently predicts SMPL-X body and MANO hand parameters. Both predictors are adapted to egocentric fisheye data. To combine the two, reliability cues measured from the predictions themselves weight the fusion of body and hand joint rotations, while shape is aggregated across views and frames. The pair's baseline fixes metric scale, and triangulation recovers root translation. Relative to monocular prediction, fusion reduces PA-MPJPE by 3.7% for the body and 11.2% for the hands, and temporal refinement lowers angular-acceleration magnitude by 32.2% and 31.0%, respectively. On our six-camera recording, the pipeline produces body and hand states in a shared world frame using benchmark-fitted gates without retuning, and temporal refinement lowers hand acceleration magnitude by 41.08%. Using only RGB cameras and no third-person view, EgoWholeView offers a low-cost, portable route to egocentric interaction data.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoWholeView，一种六目同步广角RGB可穿戴动捕系统，通过角色分工流水线实现世界坐标系下的全身与双手联合捕捉。
AI.motivation: 单目自我中心相机视野受限、尺度模糊且存在手-物遮挡，难以支撑自化身躯、遥操作与具身示范等应用。
AI.method: 六路同步广角RGB相机；外向视角定位装置于世界坐标系；重叠的向下双目相机对独立预测SMPL-X身体与MANO手部参数，均适配鱼眼自我中心数据；利用预测自身导出的可靠性线索对体/手关节旋转进行加权融合，形状跨视角与跨帧聚合；双目基线确定度量尺度，三角化恢复根节点平移。
AI.result: 相比单目预测，融合使身体PA-MPJPE降低3.7%、手部降低11.2%；时序精修使角加速度幅值分别降低32.2%与31.0%；在六目录制中，管线可直接沿用基准拟合的门控（无需重调）输出共享世界坐标系下的体/手状态，时序精修使手部加速度幅值再降41.08%。
AI.conclusion: 仅用RGB相机、无需第三人称视角，EgoWholeView为自我中心交互数据采集提供了低成本、可便携的方案。

title: Many Right Answers, One Training Example: Removing Responder Noise from GRPO for LLM Recommenders
summary: A recommendation request on Reddit draws several replies, each naming different titles. When an LLM recommender is trained on such threads with reinforcement learning (RL), which replies should a generated list be rewarded against? The state-of-the-art recipe, Rank-GRPO, picks one reply per training example, so the advantage mostly records which reply was drawn (85% of its variance) rather than how good the list is. We argue that RL should train on the request, not on each answer, and propose ReMaRk: it scores every list once against the union of all replies' titles and samples each request equally. This makes RL cheaper. On seven backbones and three datasets, ReMaRk reaches the validation recall of 2,000 per-reply RL steps in 25 to 53% of the steps and leads at that budget; trained until neither improves, it is never significantly behind Rank-GRPO and in four of seven pairs reaches Rank-GRPO's best with fewer GPU-hours. The same reward helps on ProtoQA, where about 100 people answer each question, which points to a simple rule for RL with several valid human answers: reward them jointly.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ReMaRk，指出Rank-GRPO逐条回复训练导致优势信号主要反映"抽到哪条回复"而非列表质量，主张RL应以请求为单位，将生成列表与所有回复标题的并集统一打分；该方法在七个骨干、三个数据集上以更少步数和GPU时达到或接近Rank-GRPO表现。
AI.motivation: Reddit推荐请求下常有多条各提名不同标题的回复，用RL训练LLM推荐器时，应以哪些回复作为奖励依据并不明确。现有SOTA方法Rank-GRPO每个训练样本只选取一条回复，其优势估计约85%的方差来自"抽中哪条回复"这一随机因素，而非列表本身的好坏，导致奖励信号失真且效率低下。
AI.method: 提出ReMaRk：将RL训练单元从"每条回复"改为"每个请求"；对每个请求，将模型生成的列表与全部回复标题的并集进行一次统一打分，并对每个请求等概率采样。从而在单次打分中利用多条有效人类答案，避免逐回复采样的方差与冗余计算。
AI.result: 在七个骨干模型、三个数据集上：ReMaRk仅用25%–53%的步数即达到Rank-GRPO 2,000步逐回复RL的验证召回率，并在该预算下领先；训练至双方均不再提升时，ReMaRk从未显著落后于Rank-GRPO，且在七组对比中的四组以更少GPU时达到Rank-GRPO的最佳表现。同一奖励机制在ProtoQA（每题约100人作答）上同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 当一条训练实例存在多个有效人类答案时，不应逐条回复分别训练，而应联合奖励，即"reward them jointly"；以请求为单位的RL训练更高效、更稳定，并可推广到多答案问答等场景。

title: Learning to GUIDE the Group: Self-Learning LLM Facilitation Across Multi-Party Tasks
summary: As large language models are increasingly adopted as multi-party communication facilitators, there is a growing demand for agents capable of balancing diverse group dynamics across contexts. However, existing LLM facilitators are often fine-tuned for task-specific objectives; generalized LLM-based facilitation methods that can adapt to different types of tasks and diverse group dynamics are underdeveloped. To address this gap, we present GUIDE (Generalized Unified Intervention for Dynamic Exchanges, a framework for developing generalized LLM-based facilitators across different multi-party contexts. GUIDE evaluates facilitation across both objective task outcomes and subjective metrics, including psychological safety and perceived friction. Within this framework, we study whether LLMs can self-learn generalized facilitation strategy offline to real-time interventions. We first collect multi-party human interactions guided by task-specific expert LLM facilitators (N=432 conversations). We then employ a self-learning method in which an LLM induces an actionable strategic playbook from conversations and iteratively refines it using feedback from an LLM judge aligned with human annotators (N=20), developing a single generalized facilitator that outperforms the three task-specific expert facilitators on held-out conversations 61.4% win rate. Finally, we evaluate these improvements empirically; in a real-time online empirical study, the self-learned generalized facilitator preserves facilitator performance and group productivity, improves speaking comfort and reduces interpersonal friction, while using 24.7% fewer turns and 29.0% fewer words than the expert prompts. These findings provide empirical evidence that LLMs can learn generalizable, task-agnostic social facilitation from task-specific human interactions, on-par with hand-crafted task-specific prompts across diverse group settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GUIDE框架，通过离线自学习从任务特定的人机多方对话中提炼通用引导策略，训练出可跨任务灵活适配的LLM引导者，其在客观任务与主观体验指标上均优于专家提示，并更高效省话。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM引导者多针对特定任务微调，缺乏能适应不同任务类型与群体动态的通用引导方法，难以满足多样化多方沟通场景的需求。
AI.method: 构建GUIDE框架，从客观任务结果与主观指标（心理安全感、感知摩擦）两方面评估引导效果；采集432场由任务特定专家LLM引导的多方人类对话；采用自学习方法，由LLM从对话中归纳可操作的策略手册，并借助与人类标注者对齐的LLM评判反馈迭代优化，形成单一通用引导者。
AI.result: 通用引导者在留出对话上以61.4%胜率超越三个任务特定专家引导者；实时在线实验显示其保持引导表现与群体生产力，提升发言舒适度、减少人际摩擦，且用词轮次减少24.7%、字数减少29.0%。
AI.conclusion: LLM能够从任务特定的人类互动中学习可泛化、任务无关的社交引导能力，在多样化群体环境中达到与手工任务特定提示相当的水平。

title: Graph3R: Unifying View Graph Initialization with Feed-Forward Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward reconstruction recovers camera poses and dense geometry from image sets whose views are assumed to come from a single scene. In practice, uncurated image collections often contain views from disjoint scenes, and reconstructing these views jointly can corrupt camera poses and geometry. Existing pipelines typically resolve view associations in separate stages before final reconstruction, leaving view graph initialization and reconstruction inference only loosely coupled. We introduce Graph3R, which unifies view graph initialization with feed-forward reconstruction through a shared geometric representation. A lightweight verification head predicts pairwise covisibility from the multi-view features of $π^3$ to construct a view graph. This graph classifies the input views into scene groups. For each group, we mask the shared features before decoding camera poses and dense geometry. Reusing the multi-view features allows Graph3R to reconstruct disjoint scenes separately with a single backbone pass. Across three benchmarks, Graph3R improves average maximum recall at 100% precision by upto 8.99 percentage points over the baseline, while improving reconstruction quality on mixed-scene inputs. Regarding the multi-session mapping task, Graph3R improves cross-session localization and achieves competitive pose estimation accuracy, while delivering a runtime speedup of approximately $35.9\times$ over the baseline when reconstructing the query group. By integrating learned view association with geometric inference, our approach takes a step toward end-to-end reconstruction from uncurated image collections.

AI.tldr: Graph3R 将视图图初始化与前馈重建统一在共享几何表示中，可对无标注图像集合中的不连通场景分别重建，在精度与速度上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 前馈重建假设所有视图来自同一场景，但实际图像集合常包含多个不连通场景，联合重建会破坏相机位姿与几何；现有流程将视图关联与重建分为独立阶段，导致视图图初始化与重建推理耦合松散。
AI.method: 基于 π³ 的多视图特征，用轻量验证头预测成对共视性以构建视图图；该图将输入视图划分为场景组，对每组在解码相机位姿与稠密几何前对共享特征进行掩码，复用多视图特征使单一主干一次前向即可分别重建不连通场景。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，100% 精度下的平均最大召回率较基线提升最高 8.99 个百分点，并改善混合场景输入的的重建质量；在多会话建图任务中提升跨会话定位，取得有竞争力的位姿估计精度，重建查询组时相对基线约 35.9× 加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习式视图关联与几何推理的整合，该方法向从无标注图像集合进行端到端重建迈进一步。

title: Beyond Belief Nesting: Rethinking Higher-Order Theory of Mind in Large Language Models
summary: Theory of mind (ToM), the ability to reason about others' mental states, underlies effective communication and coordination. Its higher-order form enables reasoning over nested perspectives in strategic interactions. However, existing evaluations often equate belief-nesting depth with reasoning order, allowing nominally higher-order questions to admit lower-order shortcuts. We formalize effective order through the distinct events supporting successive belief prefixes, revealing widespread order inflation across existing benchmarks. We introduce HopToM, with certified full-order questions and controls for lower-order alternatives.
