Under direct prompting, mean accuracy across four frontier LLMs falls from 73.5% at first order to 20.0% at fourth order, and human participants also struggle. Causal interventions link a recurring class of errors to evidence for shallower belief prefixes. We introduce HopTrace, a plug-and-play inference-time method that encodes each interaction once into perspective records and resolves nested queries deterministically. On certified narrative questions, it improves fourth- and fifth-order accuracy by 22.0 and 38.5 percentage points over strong prompting baselines, while using 20-39 times fewer tokens than multi-call methods. These results sharpen how higher-order ToM is evaluated and offer a practical way to improve perspective reasoning in interactive agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出既有高阶心理理论（ToM）评测存在"阶数通胀"问题，并提出HopToM基准与HopTrace推理方法加以修正。
AI.motivation: 心理理论（ToM）是推理他人心理状态的能力，其高阶形式支持策略互动中的嵌套视角推理。但现有评测常将"信念嵌套深度"等同于"推理阶数"，使名义上的高阶问题可通过低阶捷径作答，导致对模型高阶ToM能力的评估失真。
AI.method: 作者通过"支持连续信念前缀的不同事件"来形式化有效阶数，揭示现有基准中普遍存在的阶数通胀；构建HopToM基准，包含经认证的全阶问题及对低阶替代方案的对照；并进行直接提示实验与因果干预分析；同时提出HopTrace——一种即插即用的推理时方法，将每次交互一次性编码为视角记录，并以确定性方式消解嵌套查询。
AI.result: 直接提示下，四个前沿大模型平均准确率从一阶的73.5%降至四阶的20.0%，人类被试同样表现吃力；因果干预将一类反复出现的错误与更浅信念前缀的证据相关联。在认证叙事问题上，HopTrace相较强提示基线将四阶与五阶准确率分别提升22.0和38.5个百分点，且token用量比多次调用方法少20–39倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作厘清了高阶ToM的评测方式，为交互式智能体中的视角推理提供了实用改进途径。

title: ScreenASR-Bench: A Tiered Benchmark for Speech Recognition with Visual Context
summary: Current ASR models perform well on general benchmarks but still struggle with acoustically ambiguous words. Visual context can aid recognition in screen-based scenarios, yet existing benchmarks provide limited insight into the benefits of different types of visual evidence. To address this gap, we introduce ScreenASR-Bench , a tiered benchmark with three progressively challenging levels: Explicit Textual Evidence (ETE), based on direct on-screen text; Explicit Visual Evidence (EVE), using visible content rather than on-screen text; and Implicit Semantic Evidence (ISE), requiring scene-level inference. Extensive experiments on ASR models, Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) and Omni models show that incorporating visual context substantially improves recall over the audio-only setting across all three model families. The gains are largest for ETE and smallest for ISE, indicating that models leverage direct visual evidence more effectively than indirect semantic cues. To facilitate future research on visually grounded speech recognition, we publicly release ScreenASR-Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 ScreenASR-Bench，一个分层基准，用于评估视觉上下文对声学歧义词识别的作用，包含 ETE、EVE、ISE 三个递进难度层级。
AI.motivation: 现有 ASR 模型在通用基准上表现良好，但在声学歧义词上仍有困难。基于屏幕场景的视觉上下文可辅助识别，但现有基准对不同类型视觉证据带来的收益缺乏深入洞察。
AI.method: 构建 ScreenASR-Bench 分层基准，设三个递进难度层级：显式文本证据（ETE，基于屏幕直接文本）、显式视觉证据（EVE，使用可见内容而非屏幕文本）、隐式语义证据（ISE，需场景级推理）。在 ASR 模型、大型音频语言模型（LALMs）与 Omni 模型上进行大量实验。
AI.result: 在所有三类模型家族中，引入视觉上下文相较纯音频设置均显著提升召回率；增益在 ETE 最大、ISE 最小，表明模型更有效地利用直接视觉证据而非间接语义线索。
AI.conclusion: 模型对直接视觉证据的利用优于间接语义线索；为促进视觉基础语音识别研究，公开释放 ScreenASR-Bench。

title: FlowAvatar: Real-Time Full-Body Avatars from Sparse Egocentric Inputs on Consumer XR Devices
comment: Accepted to IEEE ISMAR 2026 (Conference Track). 10 pages, 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/SPICExLAB/FlowAvatar
summary: Prior avatar embodiment research has studied tracking completeness (how faithfully the body, hands, and face are sensed and reproduced) and personalized appearance in isolation, each requiring specialized lab equipment. How these factors interact on consumer hardware remains an open question, because no existing system unifies body pose, face, hands, and personalized appearance on a standalone headset. We present FlowAvatar, a system enabling real-time personalized look-alike avatars with full-body pose, hand articulation, facial expression, and eye gaze tracking from sparse egocentric inputs on consumer XR devices (Meta Quest Pro). Our pose model achieves competitive spatial accuracy and state-of-the-art temporal consistency on the AMASS benchmark against prior works with comprehensive spatial and temporal losses validated through architecture and loss ablations, while running in real-time. Two user studies (N=12, N=10) provide converging evidence that tracking completeness and personalized appearance serve complementary roles: tracking completeness broadly improves perceived motion quality, while only their combination achieves positive total embodiment.

AI.tldr: FlowAvatar 是首个在消费级 XR 头显（Meta Quest Pro）上集全身姿态、手部关节、面部表情、眼动追踪与个性化外观于一体的实时虚拟化身系统，通过实证研究表明追踪完整性与个性化外观在具身感中起互补作用。
AI.motivation: 既有虚拟化身研究将"追踪完整性"（身体、手、脸的感知与还原保真度）与"个性化外观"割裂研究，且各自依赖专门的实验室设备。二者在消费级硬件上的交互作用尚不明确，因为此前没有系统能在独立头显上同时统一身体姿态、面部、手部与个性化外观。
AI.method: 提出 FlowAvatar，利用消费级 XR 设备（Meta Quest Pro）上的稀疏自我中心输入，实时生成具备全身姿态、手部关节、面部表情与眼动追踪的个性化"相似外观"虚拟化身。其姿态模型在 AMASS 基准上采用综合的空间与时间损失进行训练，并通过架构消融与损失消融进行验证。
AI.result: 姿态模型在 AMASS 基准上达到与先前工作相当的空间精度与最优的时间一致性，同时可实时运行。两项用户研究（N=12、N=10）得出收敛结论：追踪完整性广泛提升感知到的动作质量，而仅有其与个性化外观的结合才能实现正向的整体具身感。
AI.conclusion: 追踪完整性与个性化外观在虚拟化身具身感中扮演互补角色，二者缺一不可；FlowAvatar 证明了在消费级 XR 硬件上实现多模态统一化身追踪与个性化外观的可行性。

title: GENDIS: Gender-Related Discourse and Stance in Multilingual YouTube Comments from India, Kenya, and Nigeria
comment: 23 pages. Accepted at the Workshop on Online Abuse and Harms (WOAH 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: Research on gender-related online content is often operationalized through harm-centered tasks that collapse non-harmful gender-related and unrelated content, while existing datasets remain concentrated in high-resource languages and Global North settings. To bridge these gaps, we introduce GENDIS, a dataset of 9,600 multilingual, human-annotated YouTube comments from India, Kenya, and Nigeria (3,200 per country), annotated using a two-level framework that first identifies whether gender is referenced and then classifies gender-related content as negative, positive, or neutral. This separation provides a denominator for gender-related discourse independent of harm, enabling both prevalence estimation and characterization of its evaluative range. In the uniform random stratum, 23.8-35.0% of comments are gender-related, and among those with a resolved stance, 82% are neutral or positive. Across models, gender-reference detection is substantially easier than stance classification, especially for positive and neutral speech. Lightly supervised classifiers match frontier zero-shot large language models at substantially lower cost and outperform generic toxicity detection, while cross-country transfer remains limited. GENDIS provides a locally grounded resource for measuring when gender is invoked online and how that reference is framed.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GENDIS数据集，包含来自印度、肯尼亚、尼日利亚的9,600条多语种、人工标注YouTube评论，采用两级标注框架（先判定是否涉及性别，再判定负面/正面/中性），为性别相关话语提供独立于"危害"的分母，实现流行度估计与评价极性刻画。
AI.motivation: 既有性别相关网络内容研究多以"危害"为中心构建任务，将非危害性性别内容与无关内容混为一谈，缺乏独立分母；同时现有数据集集中于高资源语言和全球北方语境，全球南方多语种场景资源匮乏。
AI.method: 构建GENDIS数据集：采集印度、肯尼亚、尼日利亚三国各3,200条（共9,600条）多语种YouTube评论，进行人工标注；采用两级框架，第一级识别是否提及性别，第二级将性别相关内容分类为负面、正面或中性；并对比轻量监督分类器、前沿零样本大语言模型（LLM）与通用毒性检测模型。
AI.result: 在均匀随机分层中，23.8%–35.0%的评论与性别相关；在立场可判定的评论中，82%为中性或正面。跨模型看，性别提及检测显著易于立场分类，尤其对正面与中性言论；轻量监督分类器在成本大幅降低的情况下可媲美前沿零样本LLM，并优于通用毒性检测，但跨国家迁移能力仍有限。
AI.conclusion: GENDIS为衡量网络性别提及时机及其评价框架提供了本地化、语境贴合的资源，突破了以危害为中心的操作化范式与高资源/全球北方数据集中化的局限。

title: Hardware-Friendly Token-Group Activation Quantization for Low-Bit Mamba Super-Resolution
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 32 pages, 6 figures. Code: https://github.com/imaboybut/TGQ-MambaSR
summary: Mamba-based super-resolution models are efficient alternatives to Transformer-based restoration backbones, but their low-bit post-training quantization remains challenging because selective scan, Mamba's input-dependent state-space operator, induces different activation ranges across spatial tokens. Thus, a single layer-wise clipping range poorly matches all tokens. We propose Token-Group Quantization, a hardware-friendly activation PTQ framework that statically approximates a hardware-unfriendly post-scan grouping oracle, where tokens with similar preferred clipping ranges are assigned to the same group. To avoid runtime post-scan grouping in static low-bit inference, a lightweight predictor infers the groups from pre-scan features available before the quantized scan path. During calibration, we form pseudo-labels by clustering post-scan activation descriptors that capture similar rounding--clipping behavior. At inference, the frozen predictor maps pre-scan features to groups and selects entries from offline-calibrated group-wise clipping-bound tables, without runtime statistics collection, dynamic clipping updates, or post-scan group assignment. To address low-bit restoration degradation, we further introduce a Frequency-Preserving Refinement (FPR) objective for clipping-bound calibration. FPR aligns Fourier amplitude and phase between full-precision teacher and quantized student outputs to preserve high-frequency structures. Across PTQ protocols, bit-widths, backbones, and tasks, our method consistently outperforms prior Mamba and SR PTQ baselines, transfers to Transformer SR and Vision Mamba classification, composes with rotation-based quantization, and achieves 2.23x speedup on Jetson Orin Nano over FP16. Code is available here.

AI.tldr: 提出 Token-Group Quantization，一种硬件友好的 Mamba 超分模型低比特训练后量化框架，通过预扫描特征预测分组并配合频域保留精炼目标函数校准裁剪边界，在多种设置下超越现有基线并实现 2.23x 加速。
AI.motivation: Mamba 类超分模型虽比 Transformer 骨干更高效，但其低比特训练后量化面临挑战：选择性扫描这一输入依赖的状态空间算子会使不同空间 token 的激活范围各异，导致单一层级裁剪范围难以适配所有 token。
AI.method: 提出 Token-Group Quantization：静态近似一个硬件不友好的扫描后分组 oracle，将偏好裁剪范围相近的 token 归入同组；为避免静态低比特推理时的运行时扫描后分组，用轻量预测器从扫描前特征推断分组。校准阶段通过对扫描后激活描述子聚类生成伪标签；推理时冻结的预测器将扫描前特征映射为分组，并从离线校准的分组裁剪边界表中选取条目，无需运行时统计、动态裁剪更新或扫描后分组。此外引入频率保留精炼（FPR）目标用于裁剪边界校准，对齐全精度教师与量化学生输出的傅里叶幅度与相位以保留高频结构。
AI.result: 在多种 PTQ 协议、比特宽度、骨干和任务上，该方法持续优于先前的 Mamba 与 SR PTQ 基线；可迁移至 Transformer SR 与 Vision Mamba 分类；可与基于旋转的量化组合；在 Jetson Orin Nano 上相比 FP16 实现 2.23x 加速。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为 Mamba 超分模型的低比特 PTQ 提供了一种硬件友好、无需运行时开销的分组量化方案，并通过频域精炼目标缓解低比特复原退化，兼具性能优势与实际部署效率。

title: DepthTile: Depth-Guided Existing-Image Self-Tiling with Input-Side Tileability Assessment
summary: Existing-image self-tiling aims to transform a given image into a seamlessly repeatable tile while preserving its original semantics and local details. This task requires weak editing to retain the source but leave periodic seams, whereas strong editing improves tileability at the large risk of content drift.Existing diffusion-based tiling pipelines alleviate boundary discontinuities, yet lack awareness of which regions are geometrically important to preserve. In this work, we propose DepthTile, a depth-guided self-tiling method whose generation module requires no retraining of the diffusion backbone. It converts monocular depth into a spatial preservation prior and integrates it into the timestep-dependent masking mechanism of Tiled Diffusion. DepthTile converts depth into a spatial editability map and fuses it with the differential diffusion mask. This strengthens source preservation in near-field regions indicated by the monocular depth prior while retaining editing flexibility near compatible background boundaries. To access when self-tiling is feasible, we introduce the Self-Tiling Ability Score (STAS), a lightweight input-side predictor based on RGB, gradient, depth, and depth-gradient cues. On a 335-image benchmark, relative to the default Tiled Diffusion pipeline, DepthTile reduces MAE, LPIPS, and Tiling Score by 12.8%, 26.7%, and 8.4%, respectively. STAS reliably enables difficulty-aware analysis and further supports compatibility-aware pairwise image tiling.

AI.tldr: 提出 DepthTile，一种深度引导的自平铺方法，将单目深度转化为空间保留先验并融入 Tiled Diffusion 的时步相关掩码，实现无需重训练扩散主干的弱编辑自平铺；同时提出自平铺能力评分 STAS 用于可行性预测。
AI.motivation: 现有图像自平铺存在编辑强度两难：弱编辑保持语义但留下周期性接缝，强编辑提升可平铺性却易导致内容漂移。现有基于扩散的平铺流程虽缓解边界不连续，却缺乏对"哪些区域在几何上重要、需要保留"的感知能力。
AI.method: DepthTile 的生成模块无需重训练扩散主干。方法将单目深度转换为空间可编辑性图（spatial editability map），与 Tiled Diffusion 中依赖时步的差分扩散掩码（differential diffusion mask）融合，从而在单目深度先验指示的近场区域增强源图保留，同时在兼容的背景边界附近保留编辑灵活性。此外提出自平铺能力评分 STAS，基于 RGB、梯度、深度、深度梯度线索的轻量输入侧预测器。
AI.result: 在 335 张图像的基准上，相对默认 Tiled Diffusion 流程，DepthTile 将 MAE、LPIPS 和 Tiling Score 分别降低 12.8%、26.7% 和 8.4%。STAS 可可靠支持难度感知分析，并进一步支持兼容性感知的成对图像平铺。
AI.conclusion: DepthTile 通过深度引导的空间保留先验有效平衡了源图保持与可平铺性，刷新了自平铺性能；STAS 为自平铺可行性提供了轻量预测工具，拓展了难度分析与成对平铺的应用场景。

title: Full-duplex Spoken Language Modeling with Discrete Diffusion
summary: We introduce Diffuplex, a full-duplex spoken language model based on discrete diffusion that achieves an unprecedented balance between linguistic intelligence and response efficiency. With thinking mode, Diffuplex delivers 13.0 tokens per forward pass, reaching an average of 1872 tokens per second and substantially surpassing the frontier autoregressive (AR) models in decoding speed. Without thinking, Diffuplex matches the first-audio latency of existing full-duplex models while achieving markedly stronger linguistic intelligence. This capability is enabled by separating when to say from what to say at the training level, rather than compressing both into a single autoregressive timeline. During inference, Diffuplex continuously tracks the user speech through an AR interaction policy, while independently generating and refining response content through parallel diffusion. Consequently, semantic computation is no longer bounded by the perception audio frame rate, allowing intelligence and responsiveness to improve simultaneously. Taken together, these results establish a new paradigm for spoken agents that can sustain real-time dialogue while devoting parallel computation to intelligent response generation. Training code and checkpoints will be avaliable soon.

AI.tldr: Diffuplex 是一种基于离散扩散的全双工口语语言模型，通过在训练层面分离"何时说"与"说什么"，在语言智能与响应效率之间取得前所未有的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有全双工口语模型难以同时兼顾语言智能与响应效率，通常将"何时说"（交互时机）与"说什么"（内容生成）压缩到单一自回归时间线上，导致语义计算受感知音频帧率限制，二者难以兼得。
AI.method: 将"何时说"与"说什么"在训练层面解耦。推理时，模型通过自回归交互策略持续跟踪用户语音，同时借助并行扩散独立生成并精炼响应内容，使语义计算不再受感知音频帧率约束。
AI.result: 开启思考模式时，Diffuplex 每次前向传播产出 13.0 个 token，平均达每秒 1872 token，解码速度显著超越前沿自回归模型；不开启思考时，其首音频延迟与现有全双工模型持平，同时语言智能明显更强。
AI.conclusion: 该结果确立了口语智能体的新范式：可在维持实时对话的同时，将并行算力投入到智能响应生成，实现智能与响应性的同步提升。训练代码与检查点将陆续发布。

title: agent-risk: Risk Assessment for Changes to AI Agents
comment: 43 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Code, registrations, and logs: https://github.com/yzhao062/agent-risk
summary: Before changing a deployed AI agent (a stricter safety gate, a new model), organizations must approve the change, starting from existing logs. Extending classical risk analysis to partial records and partial changes to running systems, agent-risk replays logged episodes, assuming nothing else changes and the agent does not anticipate the change. The log settles episodes acting as before, a declared stop value settles stopped ones, and the rest need logged support, a saved-state rerun, or a bound. We prove what logs must record for exact replay and which saved states serve a gate family. For independent episodes, we bound the reruns a decision needs and tolerable drift from live behavior. In a bash sandbox, a 7,200-episode log alone decided neither of two retry gates, which let the agent act after refusals the log never shows. Rerunning only each gate's blocked episodes from saved states reached both live decisions at half the agent calls of a live test sized post hoc for them, given the log. Without per-step harm, a stopping gate's certified harm ceiling rose up to 2.5-fold, since the log hides whether harm preceded the stop. Approval thus needs evidence designed in advance: log fields, saved states, targeted reruns.

AI.tldr: 提出"agent-risk replay"方法：基于部分日志与部分系统变更，对已部署AI agent的改动进行事前风险评估，证明精确重放所需日志字段与可用保存状态，并给出重跑次数与漂移界限。
AI.motivation: 部署中的AI agent若要变更（更严格的安全门、新模型），组织需在变更前审批，但只能依据既有日志。经典风险分析无法处理"记录不完整"和"系统部分变更"两类情形，因此需要将风险分析扩展到部分记录与部分变更。
AI.method: 提出agent-risk replay：重放已记录episode，假设其他条件不变且agent不预判该变更。日志可确定"照旧行为"的episode，声明的stop值可确定已停止的episode，其余episode需日志支撑、保存状态重跑或给出界限。证明精确重放所需的日志记录内容，以及哪些保存状态可服务于一类门控。对独立episode，给出决策所需重跑次数的界与相对在线行为的可容忍漂移。
AI.result: 在bash沙箱中，仅凭7,200条episode的日志无法判定两个重试门控中的任何一个，且允许agent在日志从未显示的拒绝后继续行动。仅从保存状态重跑各门控被阻断的episode，即达到两种在线决策，agent调用次数为事后按日志规模设定的在线测试的一半。在无逐步伤害记录时，停止型门控的认证伤害上限升高最多2.5倍，因为日志无法显示伤害是否发生在停止之前。
AI.conclusion: 变更审批需要事先设计的证据：日志字段、保存状态与定向重跑；事后仅凭既有日志不足以支撑可靠决策。

title: ProGAN-Based Synthetic Image Generation for Industrial Visual Inspection of Metallic Parts
summary: Automated visual inspection is essential for efficient repair and recycling of metallic components. AI-based defect detection is a strong fit. However, it is often constrained by scarce, low-diversity training data. To address this gap, we study Generative AI-driven synthetic image generation using Progressive Growing GANs (ProGAN). We implement a ProGAN pipeline with Wasserstein loss and gradient penalty and evaluate key hyperparameters on two public datasets, MVTec AD (metal nut) and MPDD (tube). As a result, training remained stable and the model yielded realistic images. These images can augment training data, improve robustness, and reduce the cost of collecting rare defects.

AI.tldr: 本文研究使用ProGAN生成合成缺陷图像，以缓解金属部件缺陷检测中训练数据稀缺、多样性不足的问题，并在MVTec AD与MPDD两个公开数据集上评估关键超参数。
AI.motivation: 金属部件的修复与回收依赖高效自动化视觉检测，而基于AI的缺陷检测受限于稀缺且多样性低的训练数据，因此需要合成数据来增强训练集、降低采集稀有缺陷的成本。
AI.method: 构建基于渐进式生成对抗网络（ProGAN）的合成图像生成流程，采用Wasserstein损失与梯度惩罚（WGAN-GP），并在MVTec AD（metal nut）和MPDD（tube）两个公开数据集上评估关键超参数。
AI.result: 训练过程保持稳定，模型能够生成逼真的缺陷图像。
AI.conclusion: 生成的合成图像可用于扩充训练数据，从而提升模型鲁棒性并降低稀有缺陷数据的采集成本。

title: Where Words Begin and End
summary: Forced aligners locate each word of a known transcript in the audio, and many speech pipelines depend on them. In our own data, a widely used CTC aligner inserts a pause at nearly every word boundary, and we found almost no aligner evaluated on telephone audio. We compare nine aligner configurations against human word boundaries on read, conversational and telephone English. The Montreal Forced Aligner (MFA) is the most precise, while CTC aligners consistently start words late, because most frames inside a word go to the blank token. We then fine-tune Whisper with LoRA to predict each word's start and end as timestamp tokens, training only on boundaries placed by people: 47 hours in 87 languages. The resulting aligner is more precise than MFA on every English test condition, and than MFA's own Korean and Dutch models. With FA-Bench's protocol and code on TIMIT, its word-boundary error is 11.6 ms, against 18.2 ms for the best published system. Two choices matter most on telephone conversations: placing the timestamp slots after the word they time, and training on noisy transcripts, which also makes the aligner nearly insensitive to errors in the transcript. The released model reaches 16.0 ms on real landline calls, against 36.5 ms for MFA. The models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/Scicom-intl/force-alignment

AI.tldr: 提出基于Whisper+LoRA微调的词级强制对齐器，在朗读、对话与电话英语上优于MFA与各类CTC对齐器。
AI.motivation: 现有CTC强制对齐器（如广泛使用的方案）几乎在每个词边界插入停顿，导致词起点偏晚；且几乎没有对齐器在电话语音上被评测，而电话场景有强烈需求。
AI.method: 以人工标注的词边界（47小时、87种语言）为监督，用LoRA微调Whisper，将每个词的起止预测为timestamp token；与九种对齐器配置在朗读、对话、电话英语上与人工词边界进行对比。
AI.result: MFA精确度最高，但CTC对齐器普遍词起点偏晚，因词内多数帧被分配给blank token。新对齐器在所有英语测试条件下均优于MFA，也优于MFA的韩语和荷兰语模型；在TIMIT上按FA-Bench协议词边界误差为11.6 ms（最优已发表系统为18.2 ms）；真实固话通话上为16.0 ms（MFA为36.5 ms）。
AI.conclusion: 关键设计是：timestamp slot置于所标注词之后，以及使用带噪转写训练，使对齐器对转写错误近乎不敏感；模型已公开发布。

title: REVEAL: Reverse Engineering Agentic Latents from Frontier-Model Traces
summary: Frontier LLM agents perform complex interactive tasks, but their inference costs motivate transferring their experience to smaller open-source agents. Distillation and latent communication typically require target-model training or access to source-model internals. We study how textual frontier-model trajectories can provide reusable local controls for a frozen agent. Inspired by protocol reverse engineering, we introduce $\textit{Agentic Latents}$, comprising anchored states and dynamic profiles of feedback--response cycles elicited by replay in the target model. Our training-free framework, $\textbf{REVEAL}$ ($\textbf{REV}$erse $\textbf{E}$ngineering $\textbf{A}$gentic $\textbf{L}$atents), uses these profiles and trajectory outcomes to match and select local events from successful and failed rollouts of the same task and source model. Their response-transition contrasts yield a target-specific steering direction, applied before each response. Within-benchmark evaluations on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and Humanity's Last Exam with tools report higher accuracy than unmodified agents across three targets. Representation analyses and behavioral case studies support reusing frontier-model experience as local activation control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练的REVEAL框架，通过逆向工程前沿大模型智能体的文本轨迹，提取"智能体潜变量"（锚定状态与反馈-响应循环的动态画像），在冻结的小型开源智能体上生成目标特定的引导方向，从而将前沿模型经验迁移到本地智能体。
AI.motivation: 前沿LLM智能体能完成复杂交互任务，但推理成本高昂，因此需要将其经验迁移至更小的开源智能体。然而蒸馏与潜空间通信通常需要训练目标模型或访问源模型内部状态，限制了实用性。作者希望仅利用文本形式的前沿模型轨迹，为冻结的目标智能体提供可复用的本地控制信号。
AI.method: 受协议逆向工程启发，提出"Agentic Latents"，由锚定状态和动态反馈-响应循环画像组成。REVEAL框架无需训练：在目标模型中重放轨迹以激发这些画像，结合轨迹结果，从同一任务、同一源模型的成功与失败 rollout 中匹配并筛选本地事件；通过对比其响应-转移差异，得到目标特定的引导方向，并在每次响应前施加该方向。
AI.result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 和 Humanity's Last Exam with tools 的基准内评测中，REVEAL 在三个目标模型上均取得高于未修改智能体的准确率；表征分析与行为案例研究进一步支持将前沿模型经验复用为本地激活控制。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，无需训练目标模型或访问源模型内部，仅凭文本轨迹即可提取可迁移的激活级控制信号，为前沿模型经验向冻结小型智能体的低成本迁移提供了可行路径。

title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Fine-grained Urban Scene Reconstruction via Semantic-guided Density Control and Loss Design
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has been becoming a promising 3D reconstruction technique because of its advantage of high-fidelity rendering effect with high efficiency. However, it still suffers from coarse density control and semantically blind loss functions when reconstructing the fine-grained structures in complex urban scenes. Thus, this study proposes SG-GS, a semantic-guided 3DGS method for fine-grained structure reconstruction. It takes the semantic segmentation deduced by the Segment Anything Model (SAM) as a constraint and systematically integrates it into both Gaussian density control and loss function design. On the one hand, a semantic-constrained adaptive density control mechanism is constructed, which dynamically allocates gradient thresholds to different semantic regions of the scene and introduces an additional boundary-enhanced densification strategy, so that new Gaussians are directed to structurally critical regions. On the other hand, a multi-feature guided loss function is designed, and fine-grained supervision signals are gradually introduced through a phased progressive training strategy, alleviating the artifacts caused by the lack of semantic constraints in the basic loss. Experiments on three datasets show that the proposed method consistently improves reconstruction accuracy. Compared with the original 3DGS, the PSNR increases by approximately 2.7% to 5.2%, while artifacts on linear structures and boundary blurring are effectively mitigated. The method can serve the fine-grained 3D reconstruction of urban scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出SG-GS，一种语义引导的3DGS方法，将SAM语义分割同时嵌入高斯密度控制与损失函数，提升复杂城市场景细粒度结构重建精度。
AI.motivation: 原始3DGS在复杂城市场景细粒度结构重建中存在两个问题：密度控制粗糙（梯度阈值全局统一，缺乏语义区域区分）以及损失函数语义盲（缺少语义约束，导致线性结构伪影与边界模糊）。
AI.method: 以SAM语义分割作为约束，系统融入两个环节：(1) 语义约束自适应密度控制：为不同语义区域动态分配梯度阈值，并引入额外的边界增强致密化策略，使新高斯点指向结构关键区域；(2) 多特征引导损失函数：通过分阶段渐进式训练策略逐步引入细粒度监督信号，缓解基础损失缺乏语义约束导致的伪影。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上验证，重建精度一致提升；相比原始3DGS，PSNR提升约2.7%~5.2%，线性结构伪影与边界模糊得到有效缓解。
AI.conclusion: SG-GS可有效服务于城市场景的细粒度三维重建，验证了语义引导在密度控制与损失设计中的有效性。

title: BRIDGE: Selective Boundary Repair with Dependency Graph Evidence in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent collaboration has emerged as a critical paradigm for tackling complex, long-horizon tasks; however, while coordination protocols continue to advance, systemic failures at the inter-agent collaboration interface remain a pervasive bottleneck. In collaborative workflows, systems frequently suffer from \emph{broken handoffs}---where critical task context is omitted, misrouted, or ignored despite each agent emitting locally plausible responses. To address this challenge, we present \method, a verifiable runtime control framework that treats handoff repair as selective intervention over explicit dependency graphs. Central to \method is an integrated fault-attribution and calibration pipeline, \dataset, which decouples execution dependencies and injects counterfactual handoff perturbations to provide empirical supervision for runtime intervention. Leveraging this diagnostic foundation, \method dynamically compiles observable interaction traces into a provenance graph to pinpoint unresolved dependencies, without accessing private agent states. It then evaluates candidate repairs through an empirical gate that weighs expected gains against disruption risks, and executes repairs only when formal local postconditions hold. Extensive evaluations across demanding benchmarks demonstrate that \method boosts task success by up to 12.3 absolute percentage points on SILO-BENCH and 11.1 on TeamBench. Across both backbones, \method maintains strict cost-effectiveness, adding as little as 2.0\% marginal token overhead. Furthermore, on 562 handoff-relevant traces from the MAST benchmark, \method achieves 69.8\% F1 in a single pass, establishing a reliable operational boundary for verifiable coordination repair.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 \method，一个将交接修复视为依赖图上选择性干预的可验证运行时控制框架，通过 \dataset 进行故障归因与校准，在不访问私有智能体状态的前提下定位并修复多智能体协作中的“断裂交接”。
AI.motivation: 多智能体协作在长时程任务中日益关键，但智能体间协作接口的系统性失败仍是普遍瓶颈。尽管各智能体输出局部合理，却常出现关键任务上下文遗漏、误路由或被忽略的“断裂交接”，亟需可验证的运行时修复机制。
AI.method: 核心是集成故障归因与校准流水线 \dataset：解耦执行依赖并注入反事实交接扰动，为运行时干预提供经验监督；据此将可观测交互轨迹动态编译为溯源图以定位未解决依赖（无需访问私有智能体状态）；再通过经验门控权衡预期收益与干扰风险评估候选修复，仅在形式化局部后置条件成立时执行修复。
AI.result: 在 SILO-BENCH 上任务成功率最高提升 12.3 个百分点，TeamBench 上提升 11.1 个百分点；两种骨干模型下均保持严格成本效益，边际 token 开销低至 2.0%；在 MAST 的 562 条交接相关轨迹上，单次通过即达 69.8% F1。
AI.conclusion: \method 为可验证的协作修复建立了可靠的操作边界，在多项高难度基准上显著提升任务成功率且开销极低，证明运行时选择性干预是缓解交接故障的有效范式。

title: Memory-Efficient Integer-Only Training of Deep Neural Networks
summary: Training neural networks in reduced precision can yield significant efficiency gains, yet all existing methods that scale to standard computer vision benchmarks retain floating-point in at least one stage, typically the weight update or optimizer state. We present a training algorithm that scales to modern deep neural networks, in which every tensor (weights, gradients, and activations) is stored as INT8, and every operation (forward pass, backward pass, weight update, optimizer update) is performed in integer arithmetic. Specifically, tensors are stored as signed integer mantissas paired with explicit power-of-two exponents, on which integer-only operations are performed using five custom composable building blocks (products, sums, divide-by-constant, nonlinear functions, and weight updates). This allows complete implementation of trainable integer layers, including convolutions, batch and layer normalization, softmax, and GELU. A per-group velocity mechanism with independent exponent tracking preserves gradient precision across neurons and channels with diverse magnitudes. As every tensor fits in INT8, training memory is roughly 4x smaller than the FP32 baseline. We validate our training algorithm on CNNs (ResNet-18/34/50/101, MobileNetV2) and Vision Transformers (ViT-Ti / B), demonstrating for the first time that training neural networks with INT8 tensors and integer arithmetic can achieve competitive accuracy on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet at a reduced memory budget.

AI.tldr: 提出首个全INT8训练算法，所有张量（权重、梯度、激活）以INT8存储，所有运算（前向、反向、权重与优化器更新）均为整数运算，在CNN与ViT上于CIFAR与ImageNet达到竞争性精度，训练内存约为FP32的1/4。
AI.motivation: 降低精度训练可显著提升效率，但现有可扩展至标准计算机视觉基准的方法至少在某一阶段（通常为权重更新或优化器状态）仍保留浮点，未能实现端到端的整数训练。
AI.method: 张量以带符号整数尾数加显式2的幂指数的形式存储；基于五个可组合的定制构件（乘、加、除以常数、非线性函数、权重更新）执行纯整数运算；据此实现可训练的整数卷积、批/层归一化、softmax、GELU等层；采用带独立指数跟踪的按组速度（per-group velocity）机制，以在量级差异大的神经元与通道间保持梯度精度。
AI.result: 在ResNet-18/34/50/101、MobileNetV2等CNN及ViT-Ti/B等Vision Transformer上验证，首次证明全INT8张量与整数运算训练可在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100与ImageNet上取得竞争性精度，且训练内存较FP32基线约减少4倍。
AI.conclusion: 全整数（INT8）训练在保持竞争性精度的同时显著降低内存开销，为深度学习训练的效率优化提供了端到端低精度实现路径。

title: ClothAtlas: Joint Garment Identification and State Estimation under Self-Occlusion
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://clothatlas.github.io/
summary: Garment manipulation requires inferring both garment identity and complete configuration from partial, self-occluded observations. This creates a chicken-and-egg problem: completing a partial observation requires a garment-specific deformation prior, while identifying the garment requires a configuration that explains the observation. We introduce ClothAtlas, which jointly identifies garments and estimates their complete configurations from partial point clouds and a library of canonical meshes. A shared graph-conditioned flow-matching model samples configurations for each candidate mesh and ranks candidates by observation fit. The model accommodates different mesh shapes, vertex counts, and connectivities, allowing new garments to be added from canonical meshes alone without retraining. On held-out DexGarmentLab garments, ClothAtlas ranks the correct mesh first among 221 candidates for all 22 test garments from a single flat observation. From a single self-occluded observation, it identifies 15/22 garments, compared with 8/22 for a deterministic graph estimator. Persistent vertex identities support grasp-target localization on real garments, reducing mean error from 15.4 to 6.4 cm overall and from 17.0 to 8.3 cm on occluded targets compared with dense descriptor matching. Project page: https://clothatlas.github.io/

AI.tldr: ClothAtlas 提出一种图条件流匹配框架，从部分点云和规范网格库中联合识别服装并估计其完整构型，实现免重训的新服装扩展与顶点级抓取定位。
AI.motivation: 服装操作需同时推断服装身份与完整构型，但部分自遮挡观测下存在"先有鸡还是先有蛋"的循环依赖：补全观测需要服装特定的形变先验，而识别服装又需要能解释观测的构型。现有方法难以在仅有规范网格的情况下泛化到新服装。
AI.method: ClothAtlas 使用共享的图条件流匹配（graph-conditioned flow-matching）模型，对每个候选网格采样构型，并依据观测拟合度对候选进行排序。模型可适应不同网格形状、顶点数与连接关系，因此仅凭规范网格即可加入新服装而无需重训练。
AI.result: 在留出的 DexGarmentLab 服装上，对全部 22 件测试服装，ClothAtlas 从单张平铺观测中在 221 个候选中将正确网格排在第一；从单张自遮挡观测中识别出 15/22 件服装，而确定性图估计器仅 8/22。持久顶点身份支持真实服装上的抓取目标定位，平均误差由 15.4 cm 降至 6.4 cm，遮挡目标由 17.0 cm 降至 8.3 cm（对比密集描述子匹配）。
AI.conclusion: ClothAtlas 通过联合识别与构型估计有效解决部分观测下的循环依赖问题，具备跨网格拓扑的泛化能力和免重训扩展性，并借助持久顶点身份提升抓取定位精度。

title: Perturbation, Not Provenance: Why Activation Steering Does Not Make a Robust Text Watermark
summary: Linear directions in the activation space of large language models causally and universally influence model behavior. This suggests that they might serve as a basis for a robust text watermark. The idea is to steer the generation along a specific semantic direction and then recover the mark by probing the activations of the re-encoded text. We test this hypothesis by conducting a series of experiments. We vary the strength of the steering and use four different directions (formality, sentiment, complexity, and a random control) across two different model families. We also test two paraphrasing attacks: a sentence-level one and a stronger paragraph-level one. The results show that activation-steering watermarks are outperformed by a standard logit-based watermark (KGW) in terms of detection accuracy. At a matched level of fluency (within 1.15 times the original text's perplexity), KGW achieved an AUC of 0.81 against a sentence-level paraphraser, while the best steering direction only reached 0.65. A stronger paragraph-level paraphraser lowered both (0.65 for KGW and 0.59 for steering), narrowing the gap but not reversing it. On Qwen, it left the two indistinguishable but at near-chance levels for both. We further showed that the detectability provided by steering was not semantic: a random direction was just as detectable as a meaningful one. The signal was independent of which layer was probed and whether a surface feature control was used. We conclude that, in this case, semantic activation does not encode a localized, recoverable semantic mark, but rather a global, content-independent shift that can only be strongly detected when the text is degraded.

AI.tldr: 本文检验"激活引导水印"假设：沿语义方向引导生成并在再编码激活上探测水印。实验表明其检测性能不及标准 logit 水印 KGW，且信号非语义性、与层无关，仅为内容无关的全局偏移。
AI.motivation: 大模型激活空间中的线性方向能因果且普遍地影响模型行为，这提示其可作为鲁棒文本水印的基础：沿特定语义方向引导生成，再通过探测再编码文本的激活来恢复水印标记。作者旨在验证该假设是否成立。
AI.method: 设计系列实验：改变引导强度，使用四个方向（正式度、情感、复杂度及随机对照），覆盖两个模型家族；测试两种改写攻击（句子级与更强的段落级）；并与标准 logit 水印 KGW 在同等流畅度（困惑度不超过原文本 1.15 倍）下比较检测 AUC。此外检验方向语义性、探测层选择及表面特征控制的影响。
AI.result: 在同等流畅度下，面对句子级改写器，KGW 的 AUC 为 0.81，最佳引导方向仅 0.65；更强的段落级改写器使两者降至 0.65（KGW）与 0.59（引导），差距缩小但未逆转。在 Qwen 上两者不可区分，但均接近随机水平。随机方向与有意义方向的可检测性相当，说明信号并非语义性的；该信号与探测层无关，也不受表面特征控制影响。
AI.conclusion: 在该情形下，语义激活并未编码局部化、可恢复的语义标记，而是一种全局的、与内容无关的偏移，仅当文本被严重退化时才能被强烈检测到。因此激活引导水印作为鲁棒水印方案的假设未获支持。

title: FON: A Draft-Revise Dual-Organ Language Model without Sequence-Level Quadratic Attention
summary: Self-attention assigns two functions to one mechanism-where to read and how to mix-at the price of O(L^2) training, an O(T) decode state, and position signals bound to the training length. Existing attention-free alternatives all optimize the single function of generation. We propose FON (Fusion-Organ Network), which differentiates one weight stack into a drafting organ (multi-tap learnable delays + content-adaptive recursion; causal, O(S) training, O(1) decode state, no sequence-level quadratic attention) and a revision organ that re-processes the written prefix through multi-scale ripple kernels injected via weak gates, never generating. At 30M parameters, iso-parameter and iso-token budget, FON reaches perplexity 131.03 on WikiText-103, beating Transformer (197.73) and Mamba2 (152.53); the advantage persists under all depth-aligned baselines and at the 70M tier (-20.8%). At 8x length extrapolation FON degrades by ~8-9% without positional-encoding engineering, between ALiBi and RoPE. The revision channel provides a structural pathway for in-domain infilling that causal architectures lack in principle (+19% over on-demand coupling), at a perplexity cost indistinguishable within measurement precision. We report all costs and boundaries: impaired long-range retrieval, synthetic-task disadvantages, weaker out-of-domain code infilling than a same-recipe Transformer, and a 6.5-12.3x wall-clock gap.

AI.tldr: FON（Fusion-Organ Network）将单一注意力权重组分化为负责生成的"起草器官"与负责重写前缀的"修订器官"，在30M参数下以O(S)训练、O(1)解码状态实现优于Transformer与Mamba2的困惑度，并揭示其长程检索与效率等边界。
AI.motivation: 自注意力将"何处读取"与"如何混合"两个功能耦合于一个机制，代价是O(L²)训练复杂度、O(T)解码状态，且位置信号绑定训练长度；现有免注意力方案仅针对"生成"这一单一功能进行优化，未对读取与混合功能做结构性分工。
AI.method: 将同一权重组分化为两个器官：(1) 起草器官——多抽头可学习延迟加内容自适应递归，具因果性、O(S)训练、O(1)解码状态、无序列级二次注意力；(2) 修订器官——通过弱门注入的多尺度波纹核重处理已写前缀，仅作重写、不参与生成。
AI.result: 30M参数、等参等token预算下，FON在WikiText-103上困惑度131.03，优于Transformer(197.73)与Mamba2(152.53)，该优势在所有深度对齐基线及70M规模(-20.8%)下保持；8倍长度外推下退化约8-9%（无需位置编码工程），介于ALiBi与RoPE之间；修订通道以可忽略的困惑度代价提供因果架构原理上缺失的域内填充通路(+19% over on-demand coupling)。局限：长程检索受损、合成任务劣势、域外代码填充弱于同配方Transformer、6.5-12.3倍墙钟时间差距。
AI.conclusion: 显式分化"读取"与"混合"功能是有效的注意力替代路线，能在效率与质量间取得更优权衡；但需承认其长程检索、特定任务与运行效率上的边界，修订通道为因果架构补足了原理性缺失的填充能力。

title: Learning Temporal Evidence Selection for Video Anomaly Understanding
summary: Video anomaly understanding (VAU) aims to generate language-level interpretations of anomalous events in long videos, requiring visual evidence that supports explanation beyond anomaly detection alone. Existing VAU pipelines commonly rely on anomaly-centric or predefined temporal sampling strategies, which efficiently emphasize suspicious moments but overlook contextual cues, object interactions, and temporally distributed evidence needed for reasoning. Motivated by recent progress in learnable temporal selection for long-video question answering, we revisit VAU temporal sampling as a downstream-aligned evidence selection problem. We introduce the semantic-conditioned Temporal Sampling Q-Former that learns to select temporal visual evidence through the VAU generation objective. Since generic VAU prompts provide weak video-specific guidance, we condition the sampler on CLIP-embedded object tags automatically extracted from the input video. These tags are used only for temporal evidence selection and are not appended to the LLM generation prompt, separating sampler conditioning from prompt augmentation. The proposed sampler operates in visual-token space, computes soft temporal selection weights from frame-level representations, and merges duplicated selections before response generation. Experiments on HIVAU-70K show that our model achieves the best performance among the compared fine-tuned models, while ablations demonstrate that learnable temporal sampling improves over fixed anomaly-focused sampling and that CLIP-embedded object-tag conditioning further improves over generic-prompt conditioning. Our results suggest that temporal sampling in VAU should be aligned with explanation-oriented evidence utility rather than anomaly saliency alone.

AI.tldr: 本文将视频异常理解（VAU）中的时序采样重构为面向下游的"证据选择"问题，提出语义条件化时序采样Q-Former，在视觉token空间学习选择时序证据，并以CLIP嵌入的对象标签作为采样器条件。在HIVAU-70K上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VAU流水线多采用以异常为中心或预定义的时序采样策略，虽能高效突出可疑片段，但忽略了上下文线索、物体交互以及推理所需的时序分布式证据。作者受长视频问答中可学习时序选择的进展启发，将VAU时序采样重新审视为一个与下游任务对齐的证据选择问题。
AI.method: 提出语义条件化时序采样Q-Former，通过VAU生成目标学习选择时序视觉证据。由于通用VAU提示对特定视频的指导较弱，用自动从输入视频提取的、经CLIP嵌入的对象标签对采样器进行条件化；这些标签仅用于时序证据选择，不追加到LLM生成提示中，从而将采样器条件化与提示增强分离。采样器在视觉token空间运行，从帧级表示计算软时序选择权重，并在生成响应前合并重复选择。
AI.result: 在HIVAU-70K上，模型在对比的微调模型中取得最佳性能。消融实验表明：可学习时序采样优于固定的异常聚焦采样；CLIP嵌入的对象标签条件化优于通用提示条件化。
AI.conclusion: VAU中的时序采样应与面向解释的证据效用对齐，而非仅依赖异常显著性。

title: Prefilling-dLLM v2: Learned Chunk Routing for Long-Context Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models apply bidirectional attention over the whole context at every denoising step, so a longer context makes each step substantially more expensive. Sparsifying only at inference leaves the pretrained weights unchanged, so the model is never trained under the sparse pattern it runs with. We propose Prefilling-dLLM v2, which continues training a diffusion language model so that it routes with its native mask token. One mask is appended at the end of each chunk, and a learned role offset marks it as a routing slot. On every fourth layer, a query keeps a bidirectional local window and the top-K chunks scored from that mask; the other layers use a bidirectional sliding window. Starting from Dream-v0-Base-7B extended to 16K with YaRN, we compare Prefilling-dLLM v2 with bidirectional NSA, DSA, and SWA under the same layout, key budget, and dense initialization, using the same Fast-dLLM decoder. With the YaRN factor scaled to the evaluation length, Prefilling-dLLM v2 leads the other sparse methods on all three RULER tasks from 16K to 128K. Its mean accuracy at 128K is 7.4 points above NSA, the next sparse model, while DSA and SWA remain near zero. At the same length, decoding is 172x faster than with full dense attention.

AI.tldr: 提出 Prefilling-dLLM v2，通过继续训练使扩散语言模型以原生 mask token 进行路由，实现长上下文稀疏化，在 128K 长度下平均准确率超 NSA 7.4 分且解码加速 172 倍。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型在每个去噪步骤对整个上下文施加双向注意力，上下文越长每步开销越大；仅在推理阶段稀疏化无法改变预训练权重，模型从未在它实际运行的稀疏模式下训练。
AI.method: 继续训练扩散语言模型，使其用原生 mask token 路由。在每个 chunk 末尾附加一个 mask，并用学习到的 role offset 标记为路由槽。每第 4 层，query 保留双向局部窗口及由该 mask 打分得到的 top-K chunks；其余层使用双向滑动窗口。以 Dream-v0-Base-7B 经 YaRN 扩展到 16K 为起点，在相同布局、key 预算和稠密初始化下，与 bidirectional NSA、DSA、SWA 对比，使用相同 Fast-dLLM 解码器。
AI.result: 将 YaRN 因子缩放至评估长度后，Prefilling-dLLM v2 在 16K 到 128K 的三个 RULER 任务上均领先其他稀疏方法。128K 时平均准确率比次优稀疏模型 NSA 高 7.4 分，DSA 和 SWA 接近零。同长度下解码比全稠密注意力快 172 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过在训练中引入原生 mask token 路由的稀疏模式，Prefilling-dLLM v2 有效缓解长上下文扩散语言模型的计算开销，在长上下文任务上显著优于现有稀疏方法并大幅提升解码速度。

title: Narrative Paradoxes in LLM Inference: Shaping Reasoning Trajectories toward Misalignment
summary: Explicit reasoning in large language models (LLMs) is often associated with reliability, yet it can still pose risks when a model infers harmful goals under a benign context. We identify a distinct challenge: ensuring the safety of the \emph{multi-step reasoning process} itself, where locally coherent steps may still lead to globally harmful outcomes. To explore this vulnerability, we propose PDRA (Paradox-driven Reasoning-based Attack), a novel attack method that programs a harmful reasoning trajectory. PDRA first constructs a paradoxical narrative core by pairing a malicious actor (e.g., a terrorist) with a benign task (e.g., writing a safety bulletin). It then embeds this core into a structured analytical framework that forces the model through a mandatory three-stage analysis -- surface purpose, latent intent, and operational reconstruction -- guiding it to produce detailed harmful content while maintaining narrative coherence. Mechanistically, we show PDRA steers the model's internal representations away from refusal-related patterns, suppressing safety-triggering lexicons while activating planning-oriented terms. Empirically, PDRA achieves state-of-the-art attack success rates across diverse LLMs with high efficiency. \textcolor{red}{\textbf{Warning:} This paper may contain sensitive content.}

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PDRA（Paradox-driven Reasoning-based Attack），一种利用大模型多步推理过程安全漏洞的攻击方法：通过构造"恶意行为者+良性任务"的悖论叙事核心，并嵌入强制的三阶段分析框架（表层目的、潜在意图、操作性重构），诱导模型在保持叙事连贯的同时生成有害内容，并实现最先进的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 显式推理常被视为提升LLM可靠性的手段，但当模型在良性语境下推断出有害目标时，推理过程本身会带来风险。作者指出一个被忽视的挑战——多步推理过程本身的安全性：局部连贯的推理步骤仍可能累积导向全局有害的结果。因此需要探索这种脆弱性并加以揭示。
AI.method: 提出PDRA攻击方法，用于"编程"一条有害推理轨迹。第一步构造悖论叙事核心，将恶意行为者（如恐怖分子）与良性任务（如撰写安全公告）配对；第二步将该核心嵌入结构化分析框架，强制模型经历三阶段分析：表层目的、潜在意图、操作性重构，从而在维持叙事连贯的前提下输出详细有害内容。机制层面通过分析内部表征，展示PDRA使模型表示偏离拒答相关模式，抑制安全触发词并激活规划导向词。
AI.result: 机制上，PDRA将模型内部表征引导至远离拒答相关模式，抑制安全触发词表、激活规划类术语；实证上，PDRA在多种LLM上取得最先进的攻击成功率，且效率较高。
AI.conclusion: 多步推理过程本身构成一个独立且重要的安全面，局部连贯性无法保证全局安全。PDRA表明，通过悖论叙事与强制结构化分析可系统性绕过安全对齐，凸显对推理过程进行全局安全监控与对齐的必要性。

title: RAR: Rate-Adaptive Rollout for Time-Consistent Interactive World Models
summary: Video-based interactive world models aim to enable real-time, user-controllable environments. Yet most existing systems are trained and rolled out at a fixed temporal rate, limiting both runtime-rate adaptation and physical-horizon coverage -- a limitation we term temporal-rate coupling. Specifically, when runtime generation throughput differs from the learned temporal rate, the generated world evolves unintentionally more slowly or quickly. Moreover, using a single temporal rate imposes an inherent trade-off between temporal granularity and physical horizon: higher rates capture finer motion but cover a shorter duration under a fixed context window. To address both limitations, we introduce Rate-Adaptive Rollout (RAR), a framework that enables interactive world models to roll out at controllable temporal rates. At its core, Stride-RoPE aligns latent frames sampled at different rates on a shared physical-time coordinate, enabling consistent multi-rate rollout, unseen-rate generalization, and online rate switching without discarding history. Meanwhile, RAR uses multi-stride video sampling to enable joint learning of fine-grained dynamics and long-horizon evolution. Across action- and camera-controlled environments, RAR achieves temporally consistent multi-rate rollout and online rate switching while preserving high-rate generation quality and extending physical horizons under matched training budgets. RAR also transfers to pretrained world models while preserving perceptual quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Rate-Adaptive Rollout（RAR）框架，通过 Stride-RoPE 与多步长视频采样，解除交互式世界模型的时间速率耦合，实现可控多速率、在线切换与更长物理时域。
AI.motivation: 现有视频交互式世界模型在固定时间速率下训练与推演，导致两个问题：(1) 运行时生成吞吐与学习速率不一致时，世界演化速度会意外变慢或变快；(2) 单一时间速率在固定上下文窗口下存在时间粒度与物理时域的固有权衡。作者将这一限制称为“时间速率耦合”。
AI.method: RAR 的核心是 Stride-RoPE：将以不同速率采样的潜在帧对齐到统一的物理时间坐标，从而支持一致的多速率推演、未见速率泛化以及在线的速率切换而不丢弃历史。同时，RAR 采用多步长视频采样，实现细粒度动力学与长时域演化的联合学习。
AI.result: 在动作控制与相机控制两类环境中，RAR 实现了时间一致的多速率推演和在线速率切换，在保持高帧率生成质量的同时，在相同训练预算下扩展了物理时域。RAR 还可迁移至预训练世界模型并保持感知质量。
AI.conclusion: RAR 有效缓解了交互式世界模型的时间速率耦合问题，为可控制时间速率、兼顾细粒度与长时域的实时交互式世界模型提供了一种可行方案。

title: Cross-Lingual Transfer of Evil Vectors Is Directionally Asymmetric
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Multilingual Representation Learning (MRL) at EMNLP 2026
summary: Persona vectors are linear directions in the residual-stream activations of LLMs that encode behavioral traits and enable fine-grained control over model behavior. Among them, the evil persona vector is particularly relevant to understanding harmful behavior, jailbreak vulnerabilities, and the unlearning of harmful knowledge. Yet whether this vector reflects a genuinely cross-lingual concept, rather than an artifact of its extraction language, remains untested. We conduct a systematic evil-vector transfer study across two high-resource languages (English, Spanish) and two low-resource languages (Swahili, Telugu) on four open-source instruction-tuned LLMs, and find that transfer is directionally asymmetric. Evil vectors are harder to obtain reliably from low-resource languages, and the resulting vectors are largely ineffective at steering, even within their own language. In contrast, vectors extracted from high-resource languages transfer effectively to low-resource inputs while largely preserving general knowledge, as measured by MMLU. Geometric analysis further supports this pattern: evil vectors from the two high-resource languages are closely aligned, whereas low-resource vectors align only weakly with this shared direction. These results suggest that a shared cross-lingual evil direction exists and, once reliably extracted from a high-resource language, can be reused to steer behavior in low-resource languages without additional per-language data collection.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统检验"邪恶人格向量"是否构成跨语言概念，发现其迁移具有方向不对称性：高资源语言（英、西）提取的向量能有效迁移至低资源语言（斯瓦希里语、泰卢固语）输入，反之则效果甚微。
AI.motivation: 人格向量是LLM残差流激活中的线性方向，可编码行为特征并实现行为精细化控制。其中"邪恶人格向量"与有害行为、越狱脆弱性及有害知识遗忘密切相关。但该向量究竟反映真正的跨语言概念，还是仅仅源于其提取所用语言的伪影，此前尚无验证。
AI.method: 在四种开源指令微调LLM上，跨两种高资源语言（英语、西班牙语）与两种低资源语言（斯瓦希里语、泰卢固语）开展系统的邪恶向量迁移研究，并结合几何分析（向量对齐度）以及以MMLU衡量的通用知识保持情况进行评估。
AI.result: 迁移呈方向不对称：低资源语言难以稳定提取邪恶向量，且所得向量即使在本语言内也几乎无法有效引导行为；相反，高资源语言提取的向量可有效迁移到低资源输入，同时大体保持MMLU所测的通用知识。几何上，两种高资源语言的邪恶向量高度对齐，而低资源向量与该共享方向仅弱对齐。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明存在一个共享的跨语言"邪恶方向"；一旦从高资源语言可靠提取，即可复用于低资源语言的行为引导，无需额外采集各语言数据。

title: ReTAC: Residual Test-Time Agentic Computation for Video Spatial Reasoning
summary: Test-time agentic computation can improve multimodal large language models (MLLMs) through planning, tool use, iterative perception, and reflection, but indiscriminate computation may duplicate resolved work, introduce noisy evidence, and perturb correct predictions. We propose that such computation should be residual: allocate additional computation only to requirements unresolved by the base model and, after a localized failure, recompute only the affected states. We instantiate this formulation in ReTAC, a training-free multiagent framework for video spatial reasoning. ReTAC organizes supplementary computation around unresolved requirements. It plans ordered steps to acquire missing spatial evidence and combines the observations with compatible native evidence for reasoning. In addition, it uses stage-aligned verification to localize failures to planning, perception, or reasoning. Dependency-based recovery recomputes only affected states while reusing unaffected ones. Extensive experiments show that ReTAC achieves the highest overall score among the compared methods across three mainstream MLLMs and two widely adopted benchmarks. Further analyses show that gains from additional computation depend not only on how much is used, but also on where it is allocated and which valid intermediate states are preserved.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"残差式计算"原则，并实例化为免训练多智能体框架ReTAC，用于视频空间推理。ReTAC仅对基模型未解决的需求分配额外计算，并通过阶段对齐验证与依赖式恢复实现局部重算，在三个主流MLLM和两个基准上取得最高总分。
AI.motivation: 测试时智能体计算（规划、工具调用、迭代感知、反思）虽能提升多模态大模型（MLLM），但无差别的计算会重复已完成工作、引入噪声证据、扰乱原本正确的预测，因此需要一种更精准的计算分配方式。
AI.method: 提出"残差式计算"：仅对基模型未解决的需求分配额外计算，局部失败后只重算受影响状态。据此构建免训练多智能体框架ReTAC：(1) 围绕未解决需求组织补充计算，规划有序步骤获取缺失的空间证据，并与兼容的原有证据结合推理；(2) 采用阶段对齐验证，将失败定位到规划、感知或推理环节；(3) 基于依赖关系的恢复机制，仅重算受影响状态而复用未受影响状态。
AI.result: 在三个主流MLLM与两个广泛采用的基准上，ReTAC在对比方法中取得最高总体得分。分析表明，额外计算带来的收益不仅取决于用量，还取决于计算分配的"位置"以及所保留的有效中间状态。
AI.conclusion: 测试时计算应以残差方式分配——聚焦未解决需求并做局部失败恢复，可提升多模态视频空间推理效果；计算的有效性关键在于分配位置与有效中间状态的保留，而非单纯增加计算量。

title: Building age estimation based on widely available multi-source1 geospatial data
summary: Building age is fundamental for urban infrastructure safety, operation, and planning, as it directly affects structural safety, and sustainable development. Existing methods mostly rely on detailed building information such as street view, function, or materials, which are harder to obtain than geospatial data like satellite imagery and Digital Surface Models (DSMs). However, existing methods based on those geospatial data mainly rely on optical imagery and local texture features, limiting their ability to capture structural information and distinguish buildings from different periods. Moreover, the inherent temporal ordering among building age categories is often overlooked. To address these limitations, we propose the first deep-learning framework for multi-building age estimation using widely available multi-source geospatial data, including remote sensing data and their derived products, as well as building footprint information that estimates age at both pixel and instance levels within a unified pipeline. Specifically, a large pretrained backbone with fine-tuning adapters extracts representative features, and raster-derived and property-derived fusion modules support pixel-wise and instance-wise predictions. Pixel-level estimation employs a pyramid decoder with Cosine-guided Mixture-of-Experts (CMoE) to fuse multi-source raster data across scales, capturing fine-grained building age differences, while instance-level prediction uses attention pooling and Property-Conditional Adaptive Instance Normalization (PCAdaIN) to extract instance-level representations and integrate property attributes. A Temporal Ordinal Constraint Loss (TOCL) enforces the sequential ordering of predicted ages. We also construct a building age benchmark for Hong Kong to enable comprehensive evaluation. The source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/littlebeen/RS-buildingAge.git.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于多源地理空间数据的深度学习建筑年龄估计框架，在像素与实例两个层级统一预测，并构建香港建筑年龄基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 建筑年龄对城市基础设施安全、运维与规划至关重要。现有方法多依赖街景、功能或材料等难以获取的建筑信息；而基于地理空间数据的方法又主要依赖光学影像与局部纹理特征，难以捕捉结构信息、区分不同时期的建筑，且忽视了建筑年龄类别间的固有时间顺序。
AI.method: 采用大规模预训练骨干网络加微调适配器提取特征，构建栅格派生与属性派生融合模块支持像素级与实例级预测。像素级用金字塔解码器与余弦引导混合专家（CMoE）跨尺度融合多源栅格数据；实例级用注意力池化与属性条件自适应实例归一化（PCAdaIN）整合属性。以时间序数约束损失（TOCL）约束年龄顺序。数据包括遥感影像及其派生产品和建筑足迹信息。
AI.result: 构建了香港建筑年龄基准数据集以支持全面评估；代码与数据集已开源（https://github.com/littlebeen/RS-buildingAge.git）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架利用易获取的多源地理空间数据实现像素级与实例级建筑年龄估计，并通过时间序数约束与多源融合提升对建筑年龄差异的刻画能力。

title: Swiss4Arg: A Parallel Dataset for Multilingual Argument Mining across Swiss National Languages
summary: We present Swiss4Arg, a multilingual dataset for argument mining based on official Swiss voting brochures, covering all four national languages: German, French, Italian, and Romansh (a Romance minority language exclusively spoken in Switzerland). The brochures contain explicitly formulated arguments systematically organized into pro and con sections, resulting in a cross-lingually aligned resource with balanced argumentative stance. We create a dataset that comprises 53 federal voting issues collected between 2019 and 2025, annotated for argument components (major claims, claims, premises, and non-argumentative units) and relations (support and attack) by three native speakers per language. Inter-annotator agreement (Krippendorff's alpha) reaches 0.548 for component classification and 0.623 for relation and target classification, computed jointly across all annotators on the parallel data. We release both adjudicated labels and individual annotator annotations, enabling analyses of disagreement and cross-linguistic variation, and provide baseline results using GPT-5.4 and SwissBERT. Swiss4Arg establishes a novel benchmark for multilingual argument mining, with a particular focus on cross-lingual comparability and low-resource settings such as Romansh. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://anonymous-hf.up.railway.app/a/gozw0nion72y/ (HuggingFace) and https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MultiVote-03BD/ (GitHub).

AI.tldr: 本文提出Swiss4Arg，一个基于瑞士官方投票手册的多语言论证挖掘数据集，覆盖德语、法语、意大利语和罗曼什语四种国家语言，包含论证组件与关系标注，并提供基线结果。
AI.motivation: 现有论证挖掘资源多集中于英语等高资源语言，缺乏跨语言可比性和低资源语言（如罗曼什语）的支持。瑞士投票手册天然包含系统的支持与反对论证结构，为构建跨语言对齐、立场平衡的论证资源提供了理想素材。
AI.method: 基于2019至2025年间的53个联邦投票议题，构建Swiss4Arg数据集。手册中的论证被系统组织为赞成与反对部分，形成跨语言对齐资源。每种语言由三名母语者标注论证组件（主要主张、主张、前提、非论证单元）及关系（支持与攻击），并同时发布裁决标签与个体标注者标注。采用GPT-5.4和SwissBERT进行基线实验。
AI.result: 标注者间一致性（Krippendorff's alpha）在组件分类上达到0.548，在关系及目标分类上达到0.623，均基于平行数据在所有标注者间联合计算。基线结果由GPT-5.4和SwissBERT提供。
AI.conclusion: Swiss4Arg为多语言论证挖掘建立了新的基准，特别关注跨语言可比性与低资源场景（如罗曼什语），数据集与代码已公开。

title: HyWe: Unifying Search and Operation for Real-World Hybrid Web Tasks
summary: Real-world hybrid web tasks need both information gathering and page interaction, yet search-based and operation-based agents are developed and evaluated separately. To bridge this gap, we introduce HyWe, a framework that unifies both capabilities within one model and trajectory. Its two modes use dedicated prompts and tool sets to sustain sub-goal execution; explicit switching selects the needed capability, and shared history lets each mode build on the other's findings. To provide demonstrations of these behaviors, we develop HyWeCollector, a fully automatic pipeline that uses task prototypes, four switching patterns, and multi-agent synthesis to produce verified hybrid trajectories. We train HyWe-35B on these demonstrations to unify efficient information gathering and browser interaction in a single 35B web agent. To evaluate hybrid task completion, we introduce HyWeBench: 100 human-written tasks on websites distinct from training, with human-written sub-goal checklists and an outcome-based evaluation pipeline. Hybrid training enables HyWe-35B to achieve 47.0% success on this benchmark, improving on the untrained base model by 19.0 percentage points and outperforming existing search-based and operation-based agents. Even before training, the same base model solves 28.0% of tasks with HyWe, versus 11.0% with all tools under one prompt. Beyond hybrid tasks, HyWe-35B achieves 59.0% and 88.3% success on Online-Mind2Web and WebVoyager, outperforming existing open-source baselines and cutting action cost per successful task by 48.3% and 51.9% compared with Fara-7B.

AI.tldr: 提出HyWe框架，将信息检索与页面操作能力统一到单一模型与轨迹中，配套自动数据采集管线HyWeCollector与基准HyWeBench，训练出35B混合网页智能体，成功率显著优于基线并降低动作成本。
AI.motivation: 现实混合网页任务同时需要信息收集与页面交互，但现有search-based与operation-based智能体被分开开发与评测，缺乏统一能力与对应基准。
AI.method: HyWe在单一模型与轨迹内提供两种模式，各用专属提示与工具集支撑子目标执行，通过显式切换选择能力，并借共享历史互相利用发现；HyWeCollector为全自动管线，基于任务原型、四种切换模式与多智能体合成生成经验证的混合轨迹；据此训练HyWe-35B。同时构建HyWeBench：100个网站不重叠的人工任务，含人工子目标清单与结果导向评测管线。
AI.result: HyWe-35B在HyWeBench达47.0%成功率，较未训练基座提升19.0个百分点，优于既有search-based与operation-based智能体；未训练时同一基座在HyWe下解28.0%任务，而所有工具单提示仅11.0%；在Online-Mind2Web与WebVoyager分别达59.0%与88.3%，优于开源基线，且相比Fara-7B将每个成功任务动作成本降低48.3%与51.9%。
AI.conclusion: 统一混合能力训练可有效提升混合网页任务完成率，并迁移到传统检索与操作基准，兼顾成功率与效率。

title: Anomaly-Guided Observation and Two-Level Semantic Feedback for Training-Free Video Anomaly Analysis
summary: Training-free language-based video anomaly detection (VAD) uses frozen vision--language models (VLMs) and large language models (LLMs) to localize abnormal events without task-specific model-weight optimization. Existing approaches increasingly exploit broader temporal and semantic context, yet generic context does not necessarily foreground abnormal events or specify how video-level semantics should modify local anomaly scores. We introduce a training-free semantic feedback framework that uses VAD-guided active observation for video anomaly understanding (VAU) and returns the resulting anomaly-focused description to refine temporal detection. Starting from an upstream anomaly-score curve, we adapt reasoning-based iterative frame selection: high-score regions seed the observations, and anomaly scores together with VLM relevance assessments guide subsequent temporal exploration. A frozen video-language model generates a single open-ended anomaly description from the selected frames. The description is returned through two complementary feedback levels: video-level feedback determines whether the score distribution should be suppressed, preserved, or sharpened, with selective visual rechecking, while local feedback retrieves event-related windows and promotes scores only after target-local visual verification. All model weights remain frozen, and feedback is applied once without regenerating the description. On the HIVAU video-summary evaluations of UCF-Crime and XD-Violence, VAD-guided observation improves GPT-rated reasonability, detail, and consistency over the matched CLIP-guided variant. For VAD, semantic feedback improves the re-evaluated upstream detector from 84.36% to 86.25% AUC on UCF-Crime and from 68.07% to 72.58% AP on XD-Violence, where the final AUC is 91.74%.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练语义反馈框架：以VAD评分引导主动观测生成异常描述，再将描述反馈回检测端通过视频级与局部两级机制修正时序异常分数，无需更新任何模型权重。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练VAD方法虽引入更广的时序与语义上下文，但通用上下文未必能突出异常事件，也缺乏"视频级语义如何修正局部异常分数"的明确机制。
AI.method: 基于上游异常分数曲线进行推理式迭代帧选择：高分区域作为观测种子，结合异常分数与VLM相关性评估引导后续时序探索；由冻结的视频语言模型对所选帧生成单一开放式异常描述；描述通过两级反馈回传——视频级反馈依据分数分布决定抑制、保留或锐化并做选择性视觉复核，局部反馈检索事件相关窗口并在目标局部视觉验证后提升分数。全流程权重冻结，反馈仅执行一次且不重新生成描述。
AI.result: 在UCF-Crime与XD-Violence的HIVAU视频摘要评测中，VAD引导观测相较匹配的CLIP引导变体在GPT评分合理性、细节与一致性上更优；VAD方面，语义反馈将上游检测器在UCF-Crime上由84.36%提升至86.25% AUC，在XD-Violence上由68.07%提升至72.58% AP，最终AUC达91.74%。
AI.conclusion: 语义反馈可作为免训练的即插即用后处理，通过主动观测与两级反馈耦合视频级语义与局部异常分数，在不更新权重的条件下同时提升异常描述质量与时序检测性能。

title: Text-Only vs. Image-Aware VLM Judges for Manga Translation Evaluation
comment: 23 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables. Accepted at WMT 2026
summary: In manga translation, visual context outside speech-bubble text, including speaker identities, referents, and scene tone, is depicted in page images, making it natural to refer to images during translation evaluation. However, most conventional manga translation evaluations rely solely on text-only automatic metrics, leaving the impact of image input insufficiently explored. We propose a practical validation framework that employs the same vision-language model (VLM) as both a text-only judge (TOJ) and an image-aware judge (IAJ) to investigate evaluation divergences associated with image-aware evaluation procedures. We use a Japanese-English manga dataset of official translations aligned at the page and speech-bubble levels. First, adding page images to TOJ improved the primary VLM's detection of deliberately injected, visually dependent degradations. Second, we analyzed evaluation divergences between TOJ and IAJ, finding different error counts and error-category distributions. Human verification did not reveal a consistent preference between TOJ and IAJ.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个验证框架，使用同一视觉语言模型分别作为纯文本评测器（TOJ）和图像感知评测器（IAJ），探究漫画翻译评估中图像输入对评测结果的影响。
AI.motivation: 漫画翻译中的视觉语境（说话人身份、指代对象、场景语气等）体现在页面图像中，翻译评估理应参考图像；但现有评估多依赖纯文本自动指标，图像输入的影响未被充分研究。
AI.method: 构建日英漫画数据集（官方译文，按页面和气泡级别对齐）；用同一VLM分别充当纯文本评测器（TOJ）和图像感知评测器（IAJ），对比二者在人工注入的、视觉依赖型退化上的检测表现，并分析评测分歧与错误类别分布，辅以人工验证。
AI.result: 向TOJ加入页面图像后，主VLM对刻意注入的视觉依赖型退化的检测能力有所提升；TOJ与IAJ在错误数量和错误类别分布上存在差异；人工验证未发现TOJ与IAJ之间存在一致偏好。
AI.conclusion: 图像输入能提升对视觉依赖型错误的检测，但图像感知评估并不必然更优，二者各有权衡；该框架为漫画翻译的视觉感知评估提供了可操作的验证方法。

title: When a Conceptor Complement Becomes Gain: Operator Geometry and Behavioral Attribution in Language Models
comment: 50 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 NeurReps Workshop (Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations). Code: https://github.com/shuhulx/ConceptorComplementGain
summary: When a steering intervention changes a language model's behavior, which part of the intervention deserves the credit? We test this question for a target-centered, scaled conceptor complement by removing its fitted covariance filter while preserving the same target-specific center and gain. At the original aperture $α=.05$ and gain $β=2$, all 21 fitted maps across three models and seven targets expand every direction at the generation intervention layers. The matrix correction is $0.093\%$--$7.815\%$ of the matched-control displacement on held-out extraction activations. In 480 paired comparisons within a 1,920-response study, retaining the matrix changes many individual texts but does not establish a consistent additional target-suppression benefit on the four-target panel. A geometric aperture sweep shows that the operating regime changes with the filter setting. Separately, an invertible soft filter preserves what an unrestricted affine readout can recover, whereas dedicated erasure methods reduce prediction by newly fitted probes. Together, the results show why a whole-intervention comparison cannot by itself attribute generated behavior to the fitted matrix: analyze the complete transformation, hold shared components fixed, and test its output consequences directly.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过保留目标中心与增益、移除拟合协方差滤波器，考察语言模型转向干预中矩阵修正对生成行为的独立贡献。
AI.motivation: 转向干预改变语言模型行为时，难以归因干预中哪一部分（中心、增益还是拟合矩阵）真正起作用；整体干预对比无法单独识别矩阵修正的贡献。
AI.method: 对目标中心、按比例缩放的 conceptor 补集，去除其拟合协方差滤波器同时保持目标特定中心与增益不变；在三个模型、七个目标、21个拟合映射上测量矩阵修正相对匹配控制位移的比例，并进行480组配对比较（共1920条响应）与几何孔径扫描，另比较可逆软滤波器与专用擦除方法在被新拟合探针下的预测恢复能力。
AI.result: 在原孔径α=.05、增益β=2时，所有21个映射在生成干预层扩展每个方向；矩阵修正占匹配控制位移的0.093%–7.815%。保留矩阵改变许多个体文本，但在四目标面板上未建立一致的额外目标抑制收益。孔径扫描显示操作区间随滤波器设置变化。可逆软滤波器保留无约束仿射读出可恢复的信息，而专用擦除方法降低新拟合探针的预测。
AI.conclusion: 整体干预比较本身无法将生成行为归因于拟合矩阵；应分析完整变换、固定共享组件并直接测试其输出后果。

title: Explicitly Aligned Multi-View Breast Cancer Risk Prediction from Variable-Length Screening Histories
summary: Accurate breast cancer risk prediction from screening mammography is essential for improved risk stratification and personalized screening. It can benefit from both temporal breast tissue changes across longitudinal examinations and complementary anatomical information from craniocaudal (CC) and mediolateral oblique (MLO) views. Leveraging longitudinal information requires identifying corresponding tissue regions across examinations, yet most approaches rely on implicit feature alignment without explicitly enforcing spatial consistency. Recent work has demonstrated the benefits of explicit temporal alignment; however, existing methods model each view independently, preventing them from exploiting complementary CC and MLO information. Furthermore, explicit approaches have been limited to a single prior examination. To fill these gaps, we propose (github.com/sot176/FlexLMV-Net), a breast-wise longitudinal multi-view framework that jointly models CC and MLO views across screening examinations while accommodating a variable number of prior examinations. FlexLMV-Net explicitly aligns longitudinal feature maps and integrates complementary views through cross-view temporal fusion and a dual-stream attention block. Evaluated on EMBED and CSAW-CC, FlexLMV-Net consistently outperforms existing approaches across breast density, cancer subtypes, and demographic subgroups, highlighting the benefits of explicit longitudinal alignment, multi-view modeling, and flexible use of available screening history. We further introduce (github.com/sot176/BCRBench), an open-source benchmark that unifies state-of-the-art single- and multi-timepoint breast cancer risk prediction models under standardized preprocessing, training, inference, and evaluation protocols, enabling fair and reproducible comparison of existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出FlexLMV-Net，一个乳腺级别的纵向多视角框架，联合建模CC与MLO视角并显式对齐纵向特征图，支持可变数量的既往检查；在EMBED和CSAW-CC上全面优于现有方法，并发布BCRBench统一基准。
AI.motivation: 准确的风险预测对风险分层和个性化筛查很重要，可利用纵向检查中的组织变化和CC/MLO互补解剖信息。但现有方法存在三个不足：纵向对齐多为隐式、缺乏显式空间一致性；显式方法通常独立建模每个视角，无法利用CC与MLO互补信息；显式方法仅限于单一既往检查，无法适应可变的筛查历史。
AI.method: FlexLMV-Net采用乳腺级别（breast-wise）的纵向多视角建模，显式对齐纵向特征图（explicit longitudinal feature map alignment），并通过跨视角时间融合（cross-view temporal fusion）与双流注意力模块（dual-stream attention block）整合CC和MLO互补视角，同时兼容可变数量的既往检查。
AI.result: 在EMBED与CSAW-CC数据集上，FlexLMV-Net在乳腺密度、癌症亚型及人口学子群上均持续优于现有方法，验证了显式纵向对齐、多视角建模与灵活利用筛查历史的优势。
AI.conclusion: 显式纵向对齐结合多视角建模可显著提升乳腺癌风险预测性能；同时发布开源基准BCRBench，统一单时点与多时点主流模型的预处理、训练、推理与评估协议，实现公平、可复现的比较。

title: Batch-Paced: Fixed-Budget Batch Decoding in Discrete Diffusion Language Models
summary: As generative language models become more capable and widely used, inference demand grows, making efficient serving increasingly important. Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer a promising path to more efficient inference through parallel token generation. Prior dLLM decoding methods, however, focus on improving inference efficiency for individual sequences. We formulate fixed-budget dLLM batch decoding and introduce Batch-Paced, a training-free method that jointly optimizes the allocation of decoding compute across requests to improve overall batch quality. Across two dLLM backbones, five benchmarks and their representative mixtures, Batch-Paced improves batch performance under matched budgets; gains generally grow with batch size and largely persist across decoding configurations. Analysis of requests' decoding trajectories suggests that these gains arise largely by raising the committed-token confidence of lower-confidence requests. We further show that Batch-Paced's batch decode time remains competitive and that adding a decoding-depth allowance during Batch-Paced decoding can shorten it further at a modest performance cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出固定预算下的dLLM批解码问题，并提出免训练方法Batch-Paced，在请求间联合分配解码算力以提升整体批质量。
AI.motivation: 生成式语言模型能力增强与广泛使用导致推理需求增长，高效服务愈发重要。离散扩散语言模型（dLLM）通过并行token生成提供更高效推理路径，但已有解码方法仅关注单序列的推理效率，未考虑批内算力分配。
AI.method: 将固定预算dLLM批解码形式化，提出Batch-Paced——一种免训练方法，在请求之间联合优化解码算力的分配，以提升整体批质量。
AI.result: 在两个dLLM骨干、五个基准及其代表性混合上，Batch-Paced在同等预算下提升批性能；增益通常随批大小增大而增加，并在多数解码配置下保持。解码轨迹分析表明增益主要来自提升低置信度请求的已提交token置信度。批解码时间保持竞争力，且加入解码深度额度可进一步缩短时间，代价是适度的性能损失。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨请求联合分配解码算力，Batch-Paced在固定预算下提升dLLM批解码质量，增益随批大小增长且解码时间具竞争力，为高效dLLM服务提供了新思路。

title: TRAP: Tool-result Replay Attack for Probing Misbinding in LLM Agents
summary: As AI agents increasingly act through external tools, tool results are no longer simple outputs but execution artifacts that must remain correctly associated with the context that produced them. Yet as results persist across caches, recovery mechanisms, and shared runtime state, this association can break, causing a real and unmodified result to be consumed in an incompatible execution context and lead the agent to an unsafe action. We characterize this failure as tool-result misbinding. To systematically study this failure, we introduce ReplayBench, a benchmark that uses controlled tool-result replay to evaluate misbinding across 19 representative agent scenarios, 4 failure properties, and 3 replay mechanisms. Across eight LLMs, three agent frameworks, and diverse stateful workflows, we find widespread replay-induced failures, with a mean Final-State Error Rate of 0.649 under cross-task replay. Stage-wise analysis localizes these failures to model-side action generation. Further analyses show that replay susceptibility varies with task similarity, shows little dependence on object similarity, and remains high under result staleness and implicit environment changes. These findings motivate runtime validity mechanisms that eliminate final-state errors in our evaluated settings while preserving legitimate recovery. The results call for explicit contextual binding in tool-using agent runtimes. Our work is public at https://github.com/Phitooo/Replaybench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并刻画了“工具结果错绑”（tool-result misbinding）这一新型失效模式：真实且未被篡改的工具结果因跨缓存、恢复机制与共享运行时状态而脱离其原始执行上下文，被错误地用于不兼容的语境并诱发不安全行为。作者构建 ReplayBench 基准，通过受控回放系统评估该失效，发现其在多个模型中普遍存在，并提出运行时有效性机制加以缓解。
AI.motivation: 随着 AI 智能体越来越多地通过外部工具执行动作，工具结果已从简单输出演变为“执行产物”，需要与产生它的上下文保持正确关联。然而结果会在缓存、恢复机制和共享运行时状态中持久化，这种关联可能断裂，使真实未修改的结果被不兼容的执行上下文消费，导致智能体采取不安全动作。该失效此前缺乏系统性研究与评测手段。
AI.method: 作者将该失效形式化为“工具结果错绑”，并构建 ReplayBench 基准：采用受控的工具结果回放，覆盖 19 个代表性智能体场景、4 种失效属性与 3 种回放机制。评测横跨 8 个 LLM、3 个智能体框架及多种有状态工作流，并进行分阶段分析以定位失效来源，同时考察任务相似度、对象相似度、结果陈旧性与隐式环境变化等因素的影响。
AI.result: 在跨任务回放条件下，普遍出现回放诱发的失效，平均最终状态错误率（Final-State Error Rate）达 0.649。分阶段分析将失效定位到模型侧的动作生成环节。进一步分析表明：回放易感性随任务相似度变化，而对对象相似度依赖很小，并且在结果陈旧与隐式环境变化下仍保持较高水平。所提出的运行时有效性机制在评测设置中消除了最终状态错误，同时保留了合法恢复能力。
AI.conclusion: 工具结果错绑是工具使用型智能体中真实且普遍的失效模式，其根源集中于模型侧动作生成。研究呼吁在智能体运行时中引入显式的上下文绑定，并设计兼顾安全性与合法恢复的运行时有效性机制。基准与代码已公开于 https://github.com/Phitooo/Replaybench。

title: BAT3R: Robust Online 3D Reconstruction with Bayesian Adaptive State Updates
summary: Feed-forward transformer models have driven remarkable progress in 3D vision,yet their quadratic complexity renders them impractical for long video sequences. Streaming 3D reconstruction addresses this bottleneck by processing frames sequen?tially with constant memory. However, existing recurrent architectures inevitably suffer from progressive degradation over long sequences, as they fail to account for the intrinsic reliability of observations and the accumulated confidence of the historical state, leading to severe error accumulation. To address these issues, we introduce BAT3R, a training-free Bayesian adaptation framework comprising two synergistic modules: State Innovation Gating (SIG) and Bayesian-guided Adaptive State Updating (BASU). SIG acts as a distributional regularizer that anchors state evolution to its geometric initialization, effectively arresting representational drift during long-term inference. Building on this, BASU reformulates state update as a recursive Bayesian inference process within a Kalman filtering framework. By jointly modeling the temporal reliability of observations via information-theoretic gain and spatial relevance via cross-attention maps, BASU achieves an asymmetric spatio-temporal state fusion: well-consolidated historical regions are protected from redundant updates, while genuinely novel scene content is aggressively incor?porated. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks (7-Scenes, TUM, ScanNet, KITTI, etc.) demonstrate that BAT3R consistently outperforms state-of-the-art online 3D reconstruction methods, with the most significant gains observed on long sequences and complex scenes.

AI.tldr: BAT3R是一种免训练的贝叶斯自适应框架，通过SIG与BASU两个模块缓解流式3D重建中长期序列的误差累积，在多个基准上超越现有在线方法。
AI.motivation: 前馈Transformer在3D视觉中取得进展，但二次复杂度使其难以处理长视频序列；流式3D重建以恒定内存顺序处理帧，然而现有循环架构在长序列上会渐进退化，因为它们未考虑观测的内在可靠性以及历史状态的累积置信度，导致严重的误差累积。
AI.method: 提出BAT3R，包含两个协同模块：(1) State Innovation Gating (SIG)，作为分布正则化器，将状态演化锚定到其几何初始化上，抑制长期推理中的表征漂移；(2) Bayesian-guided Adaptive State Updating (BASU)，在卡尔曼滤波框架下将状态更新重构为递归贝叶斯推断，通过信息论增益建模观测的时间可靠性，通过交叉注意力图建模空间相关性，实现非对称时空状态融合：已充分巩固的历史区域避免冗余更新，而真正新颖的场景内容被积极纳入。
AI.result: 在7-Scenes、TUM、ScanNet、KITTI等标准基准上的大量实验表明，BAT3R持续优于最先进的在线3D重建方法，且在长序列和复杂场景上增益最为显著。
AI.conclusion: BAT3R通过免训练的贝叶斯自适应机制有效抑制流式3D重建中的误差累积与表征漂移，在长序列和复杂场景下表现出显著优势。

title: Agent-Reflex: Teaching Language Agents to Act Reflectively
summary: Large language models have evolved from single-turn chatbots into interactive agents capable of long-horizon reasoning. In real deployments, MCP tool services can return noisy feedback and users may intervene to correct the agent, but existing methods provide limited supervision for reflection learning and failure recovery. To bridge this gap, we propose Agent-Reflex, a general training framework for incentivizing proactive reflection in agents. Specifically, Agent-Reflex comprises three stages. First, Environment Reflection Skill Discovery (RSD) injects grounded tool-feedback perturbations into environment scaling, samples a capability-diverse LLM pool, mines matched success-failure pairs, and summarizes reusable reflection meta-skills. Building on this skill library, we then apply Reflective Supervised Fine-Tuning (ReSFT) that converts each skill into supervision for self-reflection, skill recovery, and user-centric correction, strengthening complementary reflective behaviors. Finally, we propose On-Policy Reflective Policy Optimization (ORPO) to combine agentic reinforcement learning under noisy interactions with reflection-guided on-policy distillation to further elicit proactive reflection. Built on Qwen3-8B, Agent-Reflex reaches 58.6 overall on five long-horizon tool-use benchmarks and 29.1 on AgentNoiseBench, surpassing strong environment-scaling and reflection baselines. Experiments on six challenging agent benchmark suites demonstrate the effectiveness of Agent-Reflex. Further analyses show that Agent-Reflex improves agents' robustness to noise while maintaining stable training dynamics, supporting scalable agent training. Our code is available at https://github.com/RUC-NLPIR/Agent-Reflex.

AI.tldr: 提出 Agent-Reflex 训练框架，通过技能发现、反思监督微调和在线策略反思优化三阶段，激励智能体主动反思，在长程工具使用与噪声鲁棒性基准上超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法对反思学习与失败恢复的监督有限，难以应对真实部署中工具服务返回的噪声反馈以及用户干预纠错。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：1) 环境反思技能发现（RSD），向环境扩展注入有依据的工具反馈扰动，采样能力多样的LLM池，挖掘匹配的成功-失败对并总结可复用反思元技能；2) 反思式监督微调（ReSFT），将技能转化为自我反思、技能恢复与以用户为中心的纠错监督；3) 在线策略反思策略优化（ORPO），结合噪声交互下的智能体强化学习与反思引导的在线策略蒸馏。
AI.result: 基于Qwen3-8B，在五个长程工具使用基准上总体得分58.6，在AgentNoiseBench上达29.1，优于环境扩展与反思类强基线；六个高难度智能体基准套件验证其有效性，并提升噪声鲁棒性且训练动态稳定。
AI.conclusion: Agent-Reflex 通过技能发现、反思监督与在线策略优化的协同，有效激励智能体主动反思，增强噪声鲁棒性并支持可扩展的智能体训练。

title: Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning via Confidence-Guided Adaptive Debate
summary: Multi-agent debate has shown promise for improving the reasoning of large language models, yet recent theory suggests its benefits are highly regime-dependent. While interaction can amplify informative signals under corrective conditions, symmetric debate dynamics are neutral in expectation, often making majority voting preferable. We reconcile these views by arguing that debate is effective only when invoked at the right time and with appropriate structure. Based on this insight, we propose LASE: Leader-Adaptive Structured Engagement, a leader-centric multi-agent debate framework that selectively engages interaction only in non-neutral regimes. LASE introduces an asymmetric leader-supporter architecture that enables directed information flow and selective signal amplification, while defaulting to simple aggregation otherwise. Experiments across diverse reasoning benchmarks show that LASE achieves multi-agent-level performance with near single-agent token cost, substantially improving efficiency over static debate and voting baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LASE框架，一种以领导者为中心的多智能体辩论方法，仅在非中性情境下选择性触发交互，通过非对称的领导者-支持者架构实现定向信息流与信号放大，在多样推理任务上以接近单智能体的token成本达到多智能体级别的性能。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论虽在提升大语言模型推理方面展现潜力，但近期理论表明其收益高度依赖具体情境：在纠错条件下交互可放大信息信号，而对称辩论动态在期望上是中性的，此时多数投票往往更优。作者意在调和上述分歧，认为辩论只有在正确时机并以合适结构被触发时才有效。
AI.method: 提出LASE（Leader-Adaptive Structured Engagement），一种以领导者为中心的多智能体辩论框架，仅在中性以外的情境中选择性启用交互。其核心是非对称的领导者-支持者架构，实现定向信息流与选择性信号放大；在其余情形则退化为简单聚合。
AI.result: 在多样推理基准上，LASE以接近单智能体的token成本达到多智能体级别的性能，相比静态辩论与投票基线显著提升了效率。
AI.conclusion: 辩论的有效性取决于调用时机与结构设计；选择性地在非中性情境中引入非对称交互，可在保持多智能体级推理性能的同时大幅降低计算开销。

title: WorldRoPE: Probabilistic World-Centric Rotary Embedding for Multi-View Attention
summary: Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) is widely used to encode relative positions in Transformers. In multi-view settings, however, patch coordinates are defined independently in each image: the same 3D point can therefore have different coordinates across views, making them insufficient for establishing cross-view correspondences. We introduce WorldRoPE, a probabilistic world-centric RoPE for multi-view attention. At each layer, WorldRoPE back-projects each patch token into a set of volumetric Gaussian primitives in a shared world frame. These primitives represent multiple plausible 3D supports for a token, jointly capturing alternative depth hypotheses, depth uncertainty, and the finite spatial extent of its patch frustum. When a key token's support is projected into a query view, it induces a distribution over where that key may appear in the query image. WorldRoPE integrates the rotary operator over this distribution in closed form, combining rotations at the projected primitive centers according to their mixture weights with covariance-dependent attenuation. This makes attention less sensitive to uncertain key locations in the query view, without rasterizing or warping token features. The formulation reduces to deterministic RoPE when the support collapses to a point. Across layers, the predicted geometry guides cross-view attention, while the updated features refine the geometry used at the next layer. Experiments on novel view synthesis, depth estimation, and 3D geometry reconstruction demonstrate the effectiveness of WorldRoPE for multi-view Transformers.

AI.tldr: WorldRoPE是一种面向多视图注意力机制的概率化世界坐标系旋转位置编码。它将每个patch token反投影为世界坐标系下的体积高斯原语（联合建模多深度假设、深度不确定性及patch视锥空间范围），将位置编码的旋转算子在该分布上闭式积分，实现协方差相关的衰减，从而降低注意力对查询视图中不确定关键点位置的敏感度，并在支撑坍缩为点时退化为确定性RoPE。
AI.motivation: RoPE广泛用于Transformer编码相对位置，但在多视图场景中，patch坐标在各图像内独立定义，同一3D点在不同视图中坐标不同，无法建立跨视图对应关系；即现有RoPE缺乏世界坐标系下的几何一致性。
AI.method: 提出WorldRoPE：每层将patch token反投影为共享世界坐标系中的一组体积高斯原语，代表该token的多个可能3D支撑（编码备选深度假设、深度不确定性、patch视锥有限空间范围）。将key token的支撑投影到query视图时得到其在query图像中可能出现位置的分布；在该分布上对旋转算子做闭式积分，按混合权重对投影原语中心处的旋转进行组合，并施加协方差相关衰减。特征更新与几何预测跨层迭代互相优化，无需栅格化或warp token特征。当支撑坍缩为点时退化为确定性RoPE。
AI.result: 在新视图合成、深度估计与3D几何重建任务上的实验证明了WorldRoPE对多视图Transformer的有效性。
AI.conclusion: WorldRoPE通过在世界坐标系中对token支撑进行概率化建模并闭式积分旋转算子，为多视图Transformer提供了几何一致的相对位置编码，使注意力对不确定关键点位置更具鲁棒性，并在多项3D视觉任务中取得有效提升。

title: Virtual Head Attention
comment: Published as a main conference paper at NeurIPS 2026
summary: The design of attention mechanisms in long-context large language models faces an ``impossible triangle'' among KV cache size, training and prefill FLOPs, and model quality. GQA achieves strong quality but incurs high KV cache overhead; alternative approaches such as MLA and MFA can compress the cache, but MLA suffers from quality loss while MFA substantially increases training and prefill compute. We propose Virtual Head Attention (VHA), which simultaneously improves all three vertices through two lightweight linear operations: Q Premix applies a near-identity transformation to queries within each KV group to recover virtual head diversity from halved physical query heads, and Linear Postmix fuses inter-head features via a low-rank $I + AB^\top$ residual structure. Since VHA introduces no nonlinear operations, Premix can be folded into the query projection and Postmix into the output projection at inference time, reducing the model to a standard GQA-2 architecture that directly reuses all existing GQA inference optimizations. With only two KV heads, the group size in large models readily reaches 64, fully exploiting Tensor Core parallelism during decoding. Across four scales with 4K-context 50B-token pretraining, VHA consistently surpasses the standard GQA baseline at every scale ($+$0.05\% to $+$0.81\%), while reducing KV cache by $4\times$ vs.\ GQA-8 at dense scales and $2\times$ vs.\ GQA-4 at the MoE scale, and lowering training and prefill FLOPs by 7.9\% (1.7B, $S{=}4096$). On an industrial 30B-A3B MoE model trained on 500B tokens at 8K context, VHA outperforms both MLA and GQA-4 by $+$0.70\,/\,$+$2.60\,\% on a 12-benchmark base-model evaluation suite; in a separate matched 10B-A1B MoE comparison after long-context mid-training, VHA attains an average RULER score of 84.4 over 8K--128K versus 73.0 for GQA, while using two rather than four KV heads in the full-attention layers.

AI.tldr: 提出 Virtual Head Attention (VHA)，通过 Q Premix 与 Linear Postmix 两个线性操作，在 KV 缓存、训练/预填充 FLOPs 与模型质量之间同时改善，推理时可折叠为 GQA-2，复用现有 GQA 优化。
AI.motivation: 长上下文大模型的注意力机制设计存在 KV 缓存大小、训练与预填充 FLOPs、模型质量之间的"不可能三角"。GQA 质量强但 KV 缓存开销高；MLA 可压缩缓存但质量损失，MFA 压缩缓存却显著增加训练与预填充计算量。因此需要一个能同时优化三个维度的方案。
AI.method: 提出 VHA，包含两个轻量线性操作：1) Q Premix 对每个 KV 组内的 query 施加近恒等变换，从减半的物理 query head 中恢复"虚拟 head"多样性；2) Linear Postmix 通过低秩 I + AB^T 残差结构融合跨 head 特征。由于无任何非线性操作，推理时 Premix 可折叠进 query 投影、Postmix 可折叠进输出投影，模型退化为标准 GQA-2 架构，可直接复用所有现有 GQA 推理优化。仅用两个 KV head 时，大模型组大小可达 64，充分利用解码阶段的 Tensor Core 并行性。
