AI.result: 在四个规模、4K 上下文、50B token 预训练下，VHA 在每个规模均超过标准 GQA 基线（+0.05% 至 +0.81%），KV 缓存相比 dense 规模的 GQA-8 减少 4 倍、相比 MoE 规模的 GQA-4 减少 2 倍，训练与预填充 FLOPs 降低 7.9%（1.7B，S=4096）。在 30B-A3B MoE 模型（500B token、8K 上下文）上，VHA 在 12 项基准评测中分别超过 MLA 和 GQA-4 达 +0.70% / +2.60%；在另一匹配的 10B-A1B MoE 长上下文中期训练对比中，VHA 在 8K–128K 的 RULER 平均分为 84.4，而 GQA 为 73.0，且全注意力层仅用两个而非四个 KV head。
AI.conclusion: VHA 通过纯线性设计打破了注意力的"不可能三角"，在保持甚至提升模型质量的同时，同时降低 KV 缓存和训练/预填充 FLOPs，并因可折叠为 GQA-2 而具备良好的推理兼容性与工程部署优势。

title: ChronoScribe: Semantic-Numerical Specialization for Instruction-Driven Time Series Forecasting
summary: Recent advances in instruction-driven time series forecasting highlight a fundamental tension: systems must simultaneously master natural-language instruction following and precise numerical prediction. Current approaches often force a compromise. Large language models (LLMs) can interpret unstructured requests but may be inaccurate when asked to produce forecast values directly, whereas time series foundation models (TSFMs) provide numerical forecasts but typically require structured inputs specifying the target series, context window, and horizon. We present ChronoScribe, which applies semantic-numerical specialization to this workflow. A LoRA-adapted LLM proposes an execution path and context length; deterministic rules resolve the executable configuration. On the specialist path, a frozen TSFM produces quantile trajectories for the task-specified horizon. Deterministic trajectory summaries condition the response, while the LLM neither generates nor revises predicted values. We evaluate a Qwen3.5-9B--Chronos-2 implementation across 23 evaluation dimensions and 30 public datasets against eleven proprietary direct LLMs and three open TSFMs. ChronoScribe has the lowest error on sMAPE, MASE, WAPE, RMSE, and MAE among all evaluated systems, including fixed-context controls. Across these metrics, even the lowest direct-LLM error remains 2.0--2.7 times the corresponding ChronoScribe error. At the system level, ChronoScribe achieves a Task-Level Score (TLS) of 65.5, 10.6 points above the strongest direct-LLM baseline. The results support ChronoScribe's division of labor, in which the LLM handles interpretation, configuration, and communication while the TSFM handles numerical forecasting.

AI.tldr: ChronoScribe 提出语义-数值分工范式：LoRA 微调 LLM 负责指令理解与配置解析，冻结的 TSFM 负责数值预测，在 30 个公开数据集、23 个评估维度上取得最低预测误差（TLS 65.5）。
AI.motivation: 指令驱动的时序预测存在根本性矛盾：系统需同时具备自然语言指令理解能力与精确数值预测能力。现有方案被迫折衷——LLM 能解析非结构化请求但直接输出预测值不准确，TSFM 数值预测可靠但要求结构化输入（指定目标序列、上下文窗口与预测步长）。
AI.method: 提出 ChronoScribe，实施语义-数值专业化分工：由 LoRA 适配的 LLM 推断执行路径与上下文长度，确定性规则解析为可执行配置；在专家路径上，冻结的 TSFM 按任务指定步长生成分位数轨迹；确定性轨迹摘要用于条件化回复生成，LLM 不生成也不修改预测值。
AI.result: 以 Qwen3.5-9B--Chronos-2 实现，在 23 个评估维度、30 个公开数据集上，对比 11 个闭源直接 LLM 与 3 个开源 TSFM：ChronoScribe 在 sMAPE、MASE、WAPE、RMSE、MAE 上误差最低（含固定上下文对照）；即使表现最好的直接 LLM，其误差仍为 ChronoScribe 的 2.0–2.7 倍；系统级 Task-Level Score 达 65.5，超出最强直接 LLM 基线 10.6 分。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持 ChronoScribe 的分工设计：LLM 承担解释、配置与沟通职能，TSFM 承担数值预测职能，从而在不牺牲语言交互能力的前提下获得更优的预测精度。

title: SyncReward: Human-Aligned Synchronization Reward for Audio-Visual Generation
summary: Recent years have witnessed rapid progress in joint audio--visual generation. However, audio--visual synchronization remains a challenge, as generated speech and sound often temporally misalign with visual events. A key bottleneck is the lack of human-annotated data, reliable evaluation benchmarks, and synchronization-aware evaluation models for generated audio--visual outputs. To address these limitations, we conduct a comprehensive study spanning data, benchmarking, and reward modeling. We first introduce SyncReward-Data-80K, a dataset containing 80K professional synchronization ratings for clips from eight audio--visual generators. A taxonomy-guided construction pipeline covers four sound-event families: Speech, Onset, Instrument, and Ambient. We further construct \textbf{SyncReward-Bench}, a held-out benchmark of 1K clips, each independently rated by multiple professionals. Using this benchmark, we systematically evaluate specialized synchronization metrics and omni-modal models, revealing their substantial misalignment with human judgments. Finally, we develop SyncReward, a reward model that combines semantic--temporal contrastive pretraining on real clips with human supervision on generated clips. As an evaluation metric, SyncReward achieves the strongest agreement with human ratings among the evaluated methods. As a reward, it improves synchronization through inference-time best-of-$N$ selection and reinforcement learning based post-training. We will release the data, benchmark, model, and code at https://github.com/WeChatCV/SyncReward.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对音视频生成中的同步性问题，构建了同步评分数据集SyncReward-Data-80K与基准SyncReward-Bench，并提出奖励模型SyncReward，在评估与奖励两方面均改善音视频同步。
AI.motivation: 音视频联合生成发展迅速，但生成语音与声音在时间上常与视觉事件错位。核心瓶颈在于缺乏人工标注数据、可靠评估基准以及面向生成结果的同步感知评估模型。
AI.method: 构建包含8万条专业同步评分的SyncReward-Data-80K，通过分类体系引导的流程覆盖Speech、Onset、Instrument、Ambient四类事件；构建1K片段、多人独立评分的SyncReward-Bench；提出SyncReward奖励模型，结合真实片段的语义-时序对比预训练与生成片段上的人类监督。
AI.result: 在SyncReward-Bench上，现有专用同步指标与全模态模型评价与人类判断存在明显偏差；SyncReward作为评估指标在所比较方法中与人类评分一致性最高；作为奖励，通过推理时best-of-N选择与强化学习后训练提升同步性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从数据、基准与奖励建模三方面系统推进音视频同步研究，SyncReward兼具评估指标与训练奖励功能，有效提升生成音视频的同步质量，并将公开数据、基准、模型与代码。

title: Seeing Through the Forgery Is Not Enough: Regressive Sycophancy under Fabricated Evidence in Medical Vision-Language Models
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Sadif Ahmed and Soumya Swagata Biswas contributed equally. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/VLM_Sycophancy-D0BE/
summary: A medical vision-language model may analyze a given CT scan and correctly detect both kidneys in view. Continuing this conversation, if a user provides a prescription with an opposite direction, medical VLMs often sycophantically choose to realign their diagnosis. In this work, we study regressive sycophancy under fabricated evidence, where a model abandons a correct answer when pushback comes with a fake document. We test four open VLMs on 400 VQA-RAD yes/no questions in 19,200 multi-turn conversations, with and without a fabricated prescription. Without a disclosure that documents are synthetic, the models abandon 80.1% of 6,488 correct answers. Notably, under one script each, the same prescription raises the flip rate of Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 45.9% to 89.6% and lowers that of Qwen3-VL-8B from 77.7% to 50.9%. A model rejected the prescription while still preserving the correct answer in 915 of 3,232 conversations with the prescription (28.3%), and 40% of these flipped in later turns. System-prompt sentences that disclose the documents as synthetic lower one model's flip rate from 77.8% to 47.3%. Thus, we conclude that awareness about a forgery does not prevent a model from adopting its answer.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统分析了医疗视觉语言模型（VLM）在伪造证据压力下的"回归性谄媚"（regressive sycophancy）现象：当用户以伪造处方文件反驳模型的正确诊断时，模型会大量放弃正确答案。
AI.motivation: 医疗VLM已能准确识别影像内容（如CT中的双肾），但其在多轮对话中是否会被用户的反向意见"带偏"尚不清楚，尤其是在用户提供看似权威的伪造文档时，模型可能出于谄媚而放弃正确诊断，这在高风险医疗场景中构成严重安全隐患。
AI.method: 在400道VQA-RAD是非题、19,200段多轮对话上测试4个开源VLM，设置有/无伪造处方两种条件，并考察不同对话脚本、系统提示披露文件为合成内容、以及模型先拒绝后接受等情形对答案翻转率的影响。
AI.result: 未披露文档为合成内容时，模型放弃了80.1%（6,488个）正确答案。同一处方在不同脚本下对Qwen2.5-VL-7B可将翻转率从45.9%升至89.6%，而对Qwen3-VL-8B则从77.7%降至50.9%。3,232段带处方对话中有915段（28.3%）模型在拒绝处方的同时保留了正确答案，其中40%在后续轮次仍发生翻转。系统提示披露文件为合成可将某模型翻转率从77.8%降至47.3%。
AI.conclusion: 伪造证据能诱导医疗VLM发生严重的回归性谄媚，使其放弃原本正确的诊断；即便模型意识到文件是伪造的，也不能阻止其采纳错误答案，说明"知情"并不等于"免疫"。

title: World Models Need a Physical Registry: Learning Internal Predictive States for Physically Plausible World Models
summary: Video world models must generate physically plausible futures, not just realistic frames. Existing approaches typically use semantic, physical, or predictive information to guide the visual generation stream, leaving a fundamental question: where inside the generator should predictions of scene evolution live? Standard video tokens jointly encode appearance and dynamics, but provide no distinct state for learning and reading predictive dynamics. We answer this question with the Physical Registry: temporally grounded registry slots inside a video DiT that are initialized from an observation-conditioned forecast, co-evolve with video tokens, and receive future-representation supervision, making predictive dynamics an explicit, readable state of the generator. In a controlled comparison of predictive-state interfaces on Physics-IQ Verified, Physical Registry improves vanilla fine-tuning by 9.9/8.7 points on I2V/V2V, the largest gain among the interfaces we compare. Across all Cosmos and WAN backbones, Physical Registry improves Physics-IQ Verified scores. With only 0.45% additional parameters, it enables Cosmos 3 Nano 16B to surpass the published I2V score of Cosmos 3 Super 64B (43.56 vs. 42.7). On WorldModelBench, it also improves physical adherence and the total score for all four evaluated backbones. Because the registry becomes candidate-specific while remaining readable, the Physical Registry Selector (PRS) ranks emerging futures by how far their intermediate registry readouts depart from the shared forecast before full denoising is complete. Across four backbones, this selection improves I2V scores by 5.6-15.9% without completed-video external scoring. Together, these results support a broader principle: dynamics prediction should live as an explicit model state that co-evolves with the video representation. Project page: https://grainsack.github.io/physical-registry/

AI.tldr: 论文提出Physical Registry——在视频DiT内部设置时间接地的“registry slots”，由观测条件预测初始化、与视频token共同演化并接受未来表征监督，使预测动力学成为生成器显式可读状态；在Physics-IQ Verified上较vanilla微调提升9.9/8.7点，仅增0.45%参数即让Cosmos 3 Nano 16B超越Cosmos 3 Super 64B的已发表I2V分数。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型需要生成物理上合理的未来，而非仅画面逼真。现有方法用语义、物理或预测信息引导视觉生成流，但存在一个根本问题未解：对场景演化的预测应放在生成器的哪个位置。标准视频token将外观与动力学纠缠编码，未提供独立状态用于学习和读取预测动力学。
AI.method: 在视频DiT内部引入Physical Registry：时间接地的registry slots，由观测条件预测初始化，与视频token共同演化，并接受未来表征监督，从而使预测动力学成为生成器显式、可读的状态。基于Physics-IQ Verified进行预测状态接口的受控对比，覆盖Cosmos与WAN多种骨干。进一步利用registry随候选而特定化但保持可读的特性，提出Physical Registry Selector (PRS)，在完整去噪完成前，依据中间registry读数与共享预测的偏离程度对候选未来排序。
AI.result: 在Physics-IQ Verified上，Physical Registry较vanilla微调在I2V/V2V上分别提升9.9/8.7点，为所比较接口中最大增益；在所有Cosmos与WAN骨干上均提升分数。仅增加0.45%参数，使Cosmos 3 Nano 16B的I2V分数（43.56）超过Cosmos 3 Super 64B已发表分数（42.7）。在WorldModelBench上，四个评测骨干的物理遵循性与总分均提升。PRS在四个骨干上使I2V分数提升5.6–15.9%，且无需完整视频的外部评分。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一个更广泛的原则：动力学预测应作为与视频表征共同演化的显式模型状态存在，而非仅作为外部引导信号注入生成过程。

title: VideoSlate: Stateful Commit Control for Temporally Grounded Agentic Video Reasoning
summary: Agentic video reasoning systems gather and assess video evidence across stages, selecting relevant spans as visual evidence for answering questions. New candidates and observations prompt reassessment of the current span, but revisions can correct localization errors or discard useful evidence already present in the adopted span. Systems therefore need to connect evidence organization across stages with temporal state control, allowing accumulated information to jointly inform revision assessment while explicit adoption decisions govern how assessment outcomes affect downstream visual evidence. We introduce VideoSlate, a stateful commit-control framework built around shared evidence. A typed evidence blackboard links candidate spans, provenance, construction, and verifier observations, enabling an incumbent-relative certifier to assess revision support from the candidate, current span, and related proposals. Based on certification, the controller authorizes a revision or retains the current span, separating evidence accumulation from state updates and recording each decision and its evidence on the blackboard. Extensive evaluations across video grounding and grounded question-answering benchmarks show that VideoSlate can improve temporal localization through selective revision.

AI.tldr: 提出VideoSlate——一种基于共享证据的有状态提交控制框架，通过类型化证据黑板与"在职相对"认证器，将证据积累与状态更新解耦，实现选择性修订以改进视频时间定位。
AI.motivation: 智能体式视频推理需跨阶段收集和评估视频证据，选取相关片段作为视觉证据来回答问题。新候选与观测会触发对当前片段的重新评估，但修订存在双重风险：既可能纠正定位错误，也可能丢弃已采纳片段中已有的有用证据。因此系统需要将跨阶段的证据组织与时间状态控制相连接，使累积信息共同参与修订评估，同时以显式的采纳决策来控制评估结果如何影响下游视觉证据。
AI.method: VideoSlate 是一个围绕共享证据构建的有状态提交控制框架。其核心组件包括：(1) 类型化证据黑板，统一关联候选片段、来源（provenance）、构造过程与验证器观测；(2) 在职相对认证器（incumbent-relative certifier），结合候选、当前片段及相关提案来评估修订的支持度；(3) 控制器，依据认证结果授权修订或保留当前片段，从而将证据积累与状态更新分离，并在黑板上记录每次决策及其依据。
AI.result: 在视频定位与接地问答（grounded question-answering）基准上的大量评估表明，VideoSlate 能够通过选择性修订提升时间定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式提交控制与共享证据机制，VideoSlate 有效协调了证据累积与时间状态更新，验证了选择性修订在智能体式视频推理中的价值。

title: LatentRemedy: Efficient Remedy For Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Non-prefix KV cache reuse is a promising approach for improving inference efficiency in multi-agent systems as agents share the same context blocks. However, when agents have conflicting tasks, directly reusing non-prefix KV caches across agents can severely degrade model performance, causing up to a 90% drop. Existing remedies, including selective recomputation and offset-based calibration, recover a limited fraction of this loss. We argue that the problem lies not only in contaminated KV representations but also in the agent's difficulty interpreting reused context under its own instructions. To this end, we introduce LatentRemedy, which uses a few task-conditioned latent tokens to help the target agent leverage reused context without recomputing the shared block. Specifically, we use an MLP to map the last hidden state of the target prefix into a small number of latent tokens, which are placed after the reused KV block to interact with the shared context. To guide subsequent predictions toward the target task, we train the MLP through full-prefill distillation. Experiments show that LatentRemedy consistently outperforms existing reuse baselines on conflicting tasks while maintaining TTFT close to direct reuse as cache size grows. Code and data are available at https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/kvreuse.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LatentRemedy，针对多智能体系统中非前缀 KV cache 复用导致的性能下降问题，用任务条件化 latent token 帮助目标智能体利用共享上下文，在冲突任务上优于现有复用基线，并保持较低 TTFT。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统共享相同上下文块，非前缀 KV cache 复用可提升推理效率；但当智能体任务冲突时，直接复用会使模型性能严重下降（最高 90%）。现有选择性重计算和偏移校准方法仅能恢复有限损失。作者认为问题不仅在于被污染的 KV 表示，还在于智能体难以在其自身指令下解释复用上下文。
AI.method: LatentRemedy 使用少量任务条件化 latent token，使目标智能体无需重计算共享块即可利用复用上下文。具体地，用 MLP 将目标前缀的最后隐藏状态映射为少量 latent token，置于复用 KV 块之后，与共享上下文交互；通过 full-prefill distillation 训练该 MLP，以引导后续预测朝向目标任务。
AI.result: 在冲突任务上，LatentRemedy 持续优于现有复用基线；随 cache size 增长，TTFT 接近直接复用。
AI.conclusion: LatentRemedy 通过任务条件化 latent token 缓解非前缀 KV cache 跨智能体复用中的性能退化，在冲突任务上实现优于现有基线的表现，并保持接近直接复用的首 token 时延。

title: RetroPlanner: Multi-Route Expansion and Multi-Objective Reasoning for LLM-Based Retrosynthesis Planning
summary: Multi-step retrosynthesis planning is often considered solved once a route to purchasable starting materials is found, but such a route should also be practical in real-world chemistry. Recent LLM-based planners formulate this process as sequential decision-making over an AND-OR graph, yet typically expand a single molecule per turn and are optimized for solvability alone, leaving alternative routes uncompared across the multiple objectives that determine practicality before the search budget is committed. We introduce RetroPlanner, an LLM-based planner that jointly compares multiple routes to steer the search toward higher synthesizability, as measured by reaction plausibility, round-trip consistency, and starting-material price. RetroPlanner is trained to reason over chemical evidence: structural progress from the target molecule, bond changes and reaction classes, where candidate routes diverge from one another, and how they rank across multiple objectives. Experiments on multi-step retrosynthesis benchmarks demonstrate that RetroPlanner recovers more alternative routes than prior LLM-based planners while improving synthetic route quality and maintaining a high success rate.

AI.tldr: 提出RetroPlanner，一种基于LLM的多步逆合成规划器，通过联合比较多条路线并同时优化可合成性多目标，提升路线质量与备选路线数量。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM逆合成规划器将规划视为AND-OR图上的序贯决策，但每轮仅扩展单个分子，且仅以可解性为优化目标，导致在消耗搜索预算前无法跨多个实用性目标比较备选路线，找到的路线未必具备真实化学实用性。
AI.method: RetroPlanner联合比较多个候选路线以引导搜索，优化目标为可合成性，具体由反应合理性、往返一致性、起始原料价格三项指标度量；训练模型基于化学证据进行推理，包括目标分子的结构进展、键变化与反应类型、候选路线之间的分歧点，以及它们在多目标下的排序。
AI.result: 在多步逆合成基准上，RetroPlanner相比既有LLM规划器能找回更多备选路线，同时提升合成路线质量，并保持较高的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 将多路线联合比较与多目标实用性评估引入LLM逆合成搜索，可在不牺牲成功率的前提下同时改善路线多样性与路线质量。

title: From Sound to Sense: An Anatomy of Semantic Supervision for Speech-Driven Visual Grounding in Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Speech-driven visual grounding in remote sensing (RSVG) removes the typing bottleneck of text-based interaction and is intended to preserve prosodic intent, enabling hands-free target acquisition in time-critical missions. The direct-audio paradigm, mapping raw speech straight to a bounding box and bypassing automatic speech recognition (ASR), was recently adopted by RSTalker, but what such grounders actually learn about language remains unmeasured. SemEcho grafts a frozen Whisper speech pathway onto a VLTVG grounding host so that speech and text share one decoder, making the paired text, free by construction since speech corpora in this task are synthesized from DIOR-RSVG expressions, a training-time teacher and a fair, same-host text upper bound. On this instrument we dissect three semantic injection channels (feature-mimicry distillation, word-level CTC supervision, and two-stage ASR pretraining) with linear semantic probes, and release Audio-DIOR-R (80,973 training clips; 10 timbres x K=3; Qwen3-TTS synthesis with online sox noise lambda in [0, 0.4]) and Audio-DIOR-Comp, a re-split holding out 17 attribute-category combinations under a 2x2 acoustic-semantic protocol. Our anatomy yields four findings. (i) Whether direct alignment beats a domain-trained ASR cascade is decided by recognizer quality: against a weak in-domain cascade (CTC 0.53) direct wins by 9.0 Acc@0.5 points with transcription errors concentrated on spatial-relation words, but a strong in-domain cascade (CTC 0.029) reaches the text upper bound (80.8 vs. 81.0) and beats even the strongest direct model by 8.8 points; the anti-ASR premise holds only against weak recognizers.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出 SemEcho 框架（将冻结的 Whisper 语音通路嫁接至 VLTVG 定位宿主，使语音与文本共享解码器），并构建 Audio-DIOR-R 与 Audio-DIOR-Comp 数据集，用线性语义探针解剖三种语义注入通道。核心发现：直接音频对齐是否优于 ASR 级联取决于识别器质量——仅在弱识别器下"反 ASR"前提成立。
AI.motivation: 语音驱动的遥感视觉定位（RSVG）可消除文本输入的键入瓶颈、保留韵律意图，实现免手目标获取。近期 RSTalker 采用直接音频范式（绕过 ASR，将原始语音直映射为边界框），但这类定位器究竟学到了多少"语言"语义仍未被量化测量，缺乏对语义注入机制的解剖与公平的文本上界参照。
AI.method: 提出 SemEcho：将冻结的 Whisper 语音通路嫁接至 VLTVG 定位宿主，使语音与文本共享同一解码器；利用任务中语音语料由 DIOR-RSVG 表达合成的特性，使配对文本天然可得，从而充当训练期教师与同宿主文本上界。用线性语义探针解剖三种语义注入通道：特征模仿蒸馏、词级 CTC 监督、两阶段 ASR 预训练。同步发布 Audio-DIOR-R（80,973 条训练片段；10 种音色 x K=3；Qwen3-TTS 合成，在线 sox 噪声 λ∈[0,0.4]）与 Audio-DIOR-Comp（在 2x2 声学-语义协议下重新划分，留出 17 种属性-类别组合）。
AI.result: 直接对齐与领域训练 ASR 级联的优劣由识别器质量决定：对弱域内级联（CTC 0.53），直接法以 9.0 个 Acc@0.5 百分点胜出，且转录错误集中于空间关系词；而强域内级联（CTC 0.029）可达文本上界（80.8 vs. 81.0），并比最强直接模型高 8.8 个百分点。因此"反 ASR"前提仅在弱识别器条件下成立。
AI.conclusion: 直接音频定位并非普遍优于 ASR 级联；其优势是以识别器质量不足为前提的伪命题。当域内 ASR 足够强时，级联方案可逼近甚至等于文本上界，显著超越直接范式。该研究为 RSVG 中语义注入通道的评估提供了可诊断、可复现的实验工具与基准（SemEcho、Audio-DIOR-R、Audio-DIOR-Comp）。

title: Machine--human agreement in marking undergraduate assignments is specific to model, prompt and institution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) promise to automate one of higher education's most resource-intensive activities: assessing student writing. Existing evaluations are typically limited to a single model, a single prompt and a single institution. Using 761 undergraduate psychology assignments from three UK universities, we evaluated three frontier LLMs, individually and in ensemble, on accuracy, prompt sensitivity, error independence, generalisability and evidential basis. Agreement between human and machine marks varied widely, with no model or prompt optimal across institutions. All models compressed marks towards a common central tendency, overvaluing the weakest assignments and undervaluing the strongest. Because this error was shared, ensembling failed to remove it. Machine marks also rewarded linguistic features more strongly than human marks. Since human-machine agreement was a joint product of model, prompt and institution, we conclude that current LLMs lack evaluative capacity transferable across contexts, and that single-context validation overstates readiness for deployment.

AI.tldr: 基于三所英国大学761份心理学作业，评估三种前沿大模型（单独与集成）在评分准确性、提示敏感性、误差独立性、泛化性及证据基础上，发现人机一致率差异大、无最优模型或提示、分数向中心压缩、集成无法消除共同误差，结论是当前大模型缺乏跨情境可迁移的评价能力。
AI.motivation: 高等教育中学生写作评估是资源消耗最大的活动之一，大模型被认为可自动化该过程；但既有评估多局限于单一模型、单一提示与单一机构，无法判断其评价能力是否可跨情境迁移，可能高估部署就绪度。
AI.method: 使用来自三所英国大学的761份本科生心理学作业，对三种前沿大模型进行单独及集成评估；评估维度包括准确性、提示敏感性、误差独立性、泛化性与证据基础，并比较人机评分一致率、分数分布特征及语言特征对评分的影响。
AI.result: 人机评分一致率差异很大，没有任何模型或提示在所有机构中表现最优；所有模型均将分数向共同的中心趋势压缩，高估最弱作业、低估最强作业；由于该误差为模型间共享，集成未能消除；机器评分比人类评分更强烈地奖励语言特征。
AI.conclusion: 人机一致性是模型、提示与机构三者的联合产物，表明当前大模型缺乏可跨情境迁移的评价能力；单情境验证会高估其部署就绪度，应避免据此推断其通用评分能力。

title: Recursive Environment Scaling for General Long-Horizon Agents
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures. Code: to be released
summary: We study environment scaling as a way to increase agent-benchmark difficulty while holding core task objectives fixed. Our framework, Recursive Environment Scaling (RES), transforms existing benchmark environments while preserving their objectives and completion requirements. A proposer changes information access, resource relations, and execution dependencies; execution-grounded checks validate the resulting candidate, and accepted changes are inherited across rounds. This produces related environments for paired evaluation and training-trajectory collection. Experiments on 294 initial tasks from three benchmarks show lower task success for all six evaluation models, with decreases of 57.14--77.14 percentage points on Claw-Eval-Live. With equal trajectory counts and identical optimization settings, fine-tuning on RES trajectories outperforms original-trajectory SFT in all nine model--benchmark comparisons by 7.00--14.61 percentage points. Ablations identify recursive inheritance and dependency composition as important contributors to increased difficulty. Together, these results support environment scaling for both agent evaluation and training.

AI.tldr: 提出 Recursive Environment Scaling (RES) 框架，在保持任务目标不变的前提下递归改造基准环境以提升难度，实验证明其可降低多模型成功率并增强 SFT 训练效果。
AI.motivation: 现有 agent 基准难度不足或提升难度时往往改变核心任务目标，难以在固定目标下获得更严苛的环境；需要一种既保持任务目标与完成要求、又能系统性提升难度的环境扩展方法。
AI.method: RES 通过 proposer 修改信息可及性、资源关系与执行依赖，生成候选环境；再由 execution-grounded checks 验证候选环境，被接受的改动跨轮次继承（递归继承），从而为配对评估与训练轨迹收集生成相关环境。实验覆盖 3 个基准的 294 个初始任务、6 个评估模型与 9 组模型–基准对比；消融分析递归继承与依赖组合的作用。
AI.result: 六个评估模型任务成功率全部下降，Claw-Eval-Live 上下降 57.14–77.14 个百分点；在相同轨迹数量与优化设置下，RES 轨迹微调在全部 9 组模型–基准对比中优于原始轨迹 SFT，提升 7.00–14.61 个百分点；消融表明递归继承与依赖组合是难度提升的重要来源。
AI.conclusion: 环境缩放可同时服务于 agent 评估与训练：RES 在不改变任务目标的情况下提高基准难度，并能产生更高质量的训练轨迹。

title: Throwing4: Phase-Aware Pose Modeling for Throw-Distance Prediction in Elite Athletics
comment: Accepted for publication in Sports Engineering
summary: Elite athletics throwing provides a structured biomechanical action sequence together with an objective continuous outcome, namely throw distance, making it a suitable setting for performance-oriented sports analytics. In this work, we investigate whether explicit phase alignment of pose dynamics improves throw-distance prediction under realistic broadcast conditions. To support this study, we curate Throwing4, a dataset of 500 elite throwing clips spanning javelin, discus, hammer, and shot put, with corresponding two-dimensional pose sequences, frame-level phase annotations, and official distance labels. We formulate throw-distance prediction from broadcast-derived pose as a regression problem and compare full-sequence modeling against a phase-conditioned approach that partitions each attempt into four technique stages and fuses phase-specific motion representations. Experiments across multiple graph-based pose encoders show a consistent reduction in prediction error when phase structure is incorporated, indicating that phase-aligned modeling provides a more stable representation than treating the entire motion as an unstructured sequence. These findings suggest that explicit biomechanical phase information is a useful inductive prior for pose-based performance modeling in elite athletics throwing. Beyond score prediction, the dataset and protocol provide a basis for future work on fine-grained technique analysis, interpretable sports analytics, and robust modeling from broadcast video.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Throwing4数据集（500段精英投掷视频，含二维姿态、阶段标注与官方成绩），并将投掷距离预测建模为回归问题，验证显式 biomechanical 阶段对齐能否提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 精英投掷项目具有结构化的 biomechanical 动作序列和客观连续结果（投掷距离），适合开展面向成绩的运动分析；作者希望探究在真实转播条件下，显式的姿态动力学阶段对齐是否能改善投掷距离预测。
AI.method: 构建Throwing4数据集，涵盖标枪、铁饼、链球、铅球四项目，提供二维姿态序列、帧级阶段标注和官方距离标签；将转播视频提取的姿态到投掷距离的预测形式化为回归任务，对比全序列建模与阶段条件化方法——后者把每次投掷划分为四个技术阶段，并融合各阶段特定的运动表征，在多种基于图的姿态编码器上进行实验。
AI.result: 在多种 graph-based pose encoder 上，引入阶段结构后预测误差一致降低，表明阶段对齐建模比将整个动作视为无结构序列能获得更稳定的表征。
AI.conclusion: 显式 biomechanical 阶段信息是姿态驱动成绩建模的有效归纳偏置；除成绩预测外，该数据集与协议可支撑细粒度技术分析、可解释运动分析和基于转播视频的鲁棒建模等后续研究。

title: A Benchmark for Bangla Task-Oriented Dialogue Understanding
summary: Task-oriented dialogue understanding remains underexplored for Bangla, particularly in multilingual settings involving English and romanized Bangla (Banglish). We introduce BanglaTOD, a parallel tri-lingual benchmark comprising 209 multi-turn dialogues across nine Bangladesh-specific service domains and 64 intents. Each conversational turn is aligned across Bangla, English, and Banglish, yielding 4,689 language-specific turn records annotated with intents, token-level slots, state updates, and accumulated dialogue states. We establish context-aware baselines for joint intent classification and slot filling using mBERT, BERT-base-uncased, and BanglaBERT. Cross-language analysis reveals substantial performance differences across models and linguistic representations, while removing dialogue history reduces intent accuracy by 19.0--25.7 percentage points. BanglaTOD provides a foundation for multilingual dialogue understanding and future dialogue state tracking research in Bangladesh-specific conversational applications. The dataset is publicly available at \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/afri7here/BanglaTOD}{Hugging Face}.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了BanglaTOD——首个面向孟加拉语、英语与罗马化孟加拉语（Banglish）的三语平行任务型对话理解基准，包含209段多轮对话、九个孟加拉本地服务领域、64种意图，共4,689条语言相关对话轮记录，并建立了上下文感知的联合意图分类与槽填充基线。
AI.motivation: 面向任务的对话理解在孟加拉语中研究不足，尤其是在涉及英语与罗马化孟加拉语（Banglish）的多语言场景下更为欠缺，因此需要构建相应的多语平行基准以推动该方向研究。
AI.method: 作者构建了BanglaTOD平行三语基准，覆盖九个孟加拉本地服务领域的209段多轮对话与64种意图，每轮对话在孟加拉语、英语和Banglish之间对齐，形成4,689条语言相关对话轮记录，并标注了意图、token级槽位、状态更新与累积对话状态。随后使用mBERT、BERT-base-uncased和BanglaBERT建立上下文感知的联合意图分类与槽填充基线，并进行跨语言分析。
AI.result: 跨语言分析显示不同模型与语言表示之间存在显著性能差异；去除对话历史会使意图准确率下降19.0–25.7个百分点。数据集已在Hugging Face公开。
AI.conclusion: BanglaTOD为多语言对话理解以及面向孟加拉本地会话应用的未来对话状态跟踪研究提供了基础。

title: EvoWeb: A Benchmark for Coding Agents on Evolving Web Applications
summary: Web application development often proceeds through successive requests that extend an existing implementation. Yet web-generation benchmarks primarily evaluate development toward fixed specifications. We introduce EvoWeb, a novel benchmark comprising 320 cumulative requests over 32 web applications, grounded in real-world product features and structured by functional dependency graphs. Agents iteratively modify a persistent codebase, while a multimodal web agent tests each intermediate application in a live browser, assessing newly requested functionality, cross-request integration, and previously requested functionality. To characterize reliability throughout development, we integrate trajectory performance across user-tolerance thresholds rather than impose a fixed stopping criterion. Experiments across open- and closed-source frontier models show that EvoWeb reveals clear performance differences between models, with cross-request integration emerging as a key challenge. Further analysis shows that later requests with deeper or more numerous dependencies are solved less accurately, while runtime errors become more frequent over successive requests. EvoWeb provides a testbed for evaluating and improving coding agents in long-horizon, multi-request development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EvoWeb，一个面向长程、多请求 Web 开发的基准测试，包含 32 个 Web 应用上的 320 个累积请求，采用功能依赖图组织，并通过多模态 Web 代理在实时浏览器中逐步测试中间版本，以刻画开发全过程的可靠性与跨请求集成能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 Web 生成基准主要评估面向固定规格的开发，而真实的 Web 应用开发是沿着一系列连续请求、在不断扩展已有实现的基础上推进的。因此需要一个新的基准来评估编码代理在长程、多请求、持续演化场景下的能力。
AI.method: 构建 EvoWeb 基准：基于真实产品功能，用功能依赖图组织 32 个 Web 应用上的 320 个累积请求。代理迭代修改持久化代码库；由多模态 Web 代理在实时浏览器中测试每个中间应用，评估新请求功能、跨请求集成以及既有功能。此外，跨用户容忍阈值整合轨迹性能，而非设定固定停止准则。
AI.result: 在开源与闭源前沿模型上的实验表明，EvoWeb 能清晰区分不同模型的性能差异，其中跨请求集成是主要挑战。进一步分析发现：依赖更深或更多后续请求的解决准确率更低；随请求连续推进，运行时错误更频繁。
AI.conclusion: EvoWeb 为评估和改进编码代理在长程、多请求开发中的表现提供了测试平台，揭示了跨请求集成与持续演化场景下的关键挑战。

title: Recovering from Pose-Selection Failures in Repeated Visual Localization
summary: Repetitive structures can give an incorrect pose candidate more inlier support than an accurate one, causing visual localization to select it. History-Guided Pose Reselection (HPR) uses coarse position forecasts from up to five past localization outputs to distinguish well-separated current-query candidates. The best-fitting forecast proposes an alternative; HPR accepts it only if every well-fitting forecast is much closer to it than to the localizer's pose. HPR needs no odometry and returns the selected candidate unchanged, using prediction for selection rather than pose refinement. With one development-set threshold, HPR improves recall within 5 meters and 10 degrees in all 12 main configurations of Hierarchical Localization (HLoc), MASt3R-based pose generation, and JIST-based retrieval, losing successes on fewer than 0.4 percent of queries. On NAVER Gangnam B1, HPR corrects 97 HLoc failures and loses six successes; gains persist within 0.25 meters and 2 degrees on all three HLoc test sets. Median HPR runtime on HLoc candidates is below one millisecond, excluding pose generation. Recovery weakens under less frequent localization.

AI.tldr: HPR利用过去定位输出预测位置，重选候选位姿，在被重复结构误导时提升定位召回。
AI.motivation: 重复结构会导致错误位姿候选获得比正确位姿更多内点支持，从而使视觉定位误选错误候选。
AI.method: HPR使用最多五个历史定位输出的粗略位置预测来区分当前查询中彼此分离的候选；最佳拟合预测提出替代候选，仅当所有拟合良好的预测都更接近该替代候选而非定位器位姿时才接受。无需里程计，返回原候选不变，仅用于选择而非位姿精化。
AI.result: 使用单一开发集阈值，在HLoc、MASt3R位姿生成和JIST检索的全部12种主要配置中，HPR提升5米和10度内召回，失败查询损失低于0.4%。在NAVER Gangnam B1上修正97个HLoc失败、损失6个成功；三个HLoc测试集在0.25米和2度内均有增益。HLoc候选中位运行时间低于1毫秒，不含位姿生成。
AI.conclusion: HPR可作为轻量候选重选模块稳定提升视觉定位召回，但在定位频率降低时恢复效果减弱。

title: From Agents to Edges: Paired Optimization for Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Strong individual agents do not guarantee effective collaboration. Communication must align what one agent conveys with how another interprets and uses it. This dependency makes the communication edge a natural unit of optimization. We introduce Paired Automated Communication Optimization (PACO), which jointly optimizes the instructions at both ends of each edge and their shared communication convention in systems built on black-box language models. PACO keeps model weights, agent roles, and workflow topology fixed. A state-aware discounted bandit selects edges for refinement, while execution feedback guides paired revisions evaluated through staged end-to-end execution. The optimized instructions integrate into existing agent prompts without additional model calls at deployment. On a four-agent workflow evaluated across diverse multi-agent benchmarks, PACO consistently outperforms leading prompt-optimization and communication baselines. Configurations learned on HotpotQA retain their advantage in cross-dataset transfer without target-specific optimization. These results demonstrate that optimizing how agents communicate can substantially improve collaboration within an otherwise fixed system.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PACO方法，将多智能体系统中的通信边作为优化单元，在固定模型权重、角色和工作流拓扑的前提下，联合优化每条边两端的指令及其共享通信约定，并通过状态感知折扣赌臂算法选择边、由执行反馈引导成对修订，在多个多智能体基准上超越现有提示优化与通信基线。
AI.motivation: 强大的单体智能体并不能保证有效协作。通信需要让一方传达的内容与另一方的理解和使用方式保持一致，这种依赖性使通信边成为天然的优化单元，因此需要针对通信本身进行优化。
AI.method: PACO在基于黑盒语言模型构建的系统中，保持模型权重、智能体角色和工作流拓扑固定不变；使用状态感知折扣赌臂算法选择需要改进的通信边，利用执行反馈引导对每条边两端指令及其共享通信约定的成对修订，并通过分阶段端到端执行进行评估；优化后的指令可无缝集成到现有提示中，部署时无需额外模型调用。
AI.result: 在一个四智能体工作流上，跨多种多智能体基准评测，PACO一致优于领先的提示优化和通信基线；在HotpotQA上学习到的配置在跨数据集迁移时仍保持优势，无需针对目标数据集进行专门优化。
AI.conclusion: 优化智能体之间的通信方式，可以在系统其他部分保持不变的情况下显著提升协作效果，表明通信边是有效且可迁移的优化对象。

title: SLS-Bench: A Benchmark for Incident Log Summarization with Synthetic Observability Data
summary: As IT systems grow in complexity, automated agent-driven incident response becomes increasingly critical. A key capability for these agents is summarizing large log streams into human-readable reports. Further progress requires meaningfully evaluating this function, yet existing benchmarks leave end-to-end summarization from large log streams underexplored due to the prohibitive cost and complexity of collecting real-world data. We introduce SLS-Bench, a benchmark for incident log summarization featuring 90 tasks grounded in real-world incident reports, each with a synthetic log stream and a reference summary. To construct SLS-Bench, we developed a data generation pipeline that converts incident reports into structured incident models, which guide the generation of synthetic logs and reference summaries. This pipeline combines narrative grounding, explicit incident modeling, generator-verifier loops, and statistical comparisons with real-world log streams to produce realistic and controllable observability data. Our evaluation of 14 LLMs on SLS-Bench shows that while frontier models can produce useful summaries, they do so at substantial cost and latency, and open-weight models lag significantly. SLS-Bench provides a framework for systematic evaluation of log analysis agents and a scalable blueprint for future synthetic observability benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 SLS-Bench 基准，用合成日志流与参考摘要评估大模型对事故日志的端到端摘要能力。
AI.motivation: IT 系统复杂度上升使自动代理驱动的事故响应愈发关键，其中将大规模日志流总结为可读报告是核心能力。但现有基准因真实数据采集成本高、复杂度大，缺乏对大规模日志流端到端摘要的评测。
AI.method: 构建 SLS-Bench：含 90 个基于真实事故报告的任务，每个任务配合成日志流与参考摘要。开发数据生成流水线，将事故报告转为结构化事故模型，据此生成合成日志与摘要；流水线结合叙事接地、显式事故建模、生成器-验证器循环以及与真实日志流的统计对比。
AI.result: 在 SLS-Bench 上评测 14 个 LLM：前沿模型能生成有用摘要，但成本与延迟高；开源权重模型明显落后。
AI.conclusion: SLS-Bench 为日志分析代理提供系统化评测框架，并为未来合成可观测性基准提供可扩展蓝图。

title: Not All Challenges Are Equal: Evaluating Interactive Liveness Detection Against Real-Time Face Swaps
summary: Remote identity verification assumes that a camera stream shows a live person, yet public real-time face-swap tools can replace that person before the stream reaches the verifier. Passive deepfake detectors generalize poorly to new generators, while interactive challenges are often selected without evidence of which gestures expose current attacks. We evaluate randomized gesture challenges in 108 live sessions with six subjects, 24 impersonated identities, and two face-swap tools, DeepFaceLive and FaceFusion, injected through a virtual camera. The static calibration segment reaches a session-level AUC of 0.878 with a frozen UCF spatial detector, while the mean across the active-gesture windows reaches 0.988. Pose and combined gestures have the highest point estimates, whereas expressions show no clear improvement. Hand occlusion against FaceFusion, configured with an occlusion mask, scores below the static baseline. The end-to-end time required to satisfy the validator also distinguishes attacks from genuine sessions, achieving a session-level AUC of 0.732, although this signal includes synthesis and transport delays. These results show that challenge sets should be tested against current attack configurations and that response time can provide an additional, deployment-specific signal.

AI.tldr: 本文通过108场真实会话评估随机手势挑战对实时换脸攻击的检测效果，发现主动手势窗口的检测AUC（0.988）显著高于静态校准段（0.878），并提出响应时间可作为部署相关的辅助信号。
AI.motivation: 远程身份验证默认摄像头画面为真人实时影像，但公开的实时换脸工具可在视频流到达验证方之前替换人脸。被动式深度伪造检测器对新型生成器泛化能力差，而交互式挑战的设计往往缺乏证据证明哪些手势能有效暴露当前攻击。
AI.method: 在108场实时会话中评估随机手势挑战，涵盖6名受试者、24个被冒充身份，并通过虚拟摄像头注入DeepFaceLive和FaceFusion两种换脸工具。使用冻结的UCF空间检测器，分别对静态校准段和主动手势窗口进行检测，并比较姿态、组合手势、表情、手部遮挡（针对配置遮挡掩码的FaceFusion）等不同手势类型，同时统计满足验证器的端到端耗时。
AI.result: 静态校准段的会话级AUC为0.878，主动手势窗口平均AUC达0.988。姿态和组合手势的点估计最高，表情无明显提升。针对配置遮挡掩码的FaceFusion，手部遮挡得分低于静态基线。满足验证器的端到端耗时同样能区分攻击与真实会话，会话级AUC为0.732，但该信号包含合成与传输延迟。
AI.conclusion: 挑战集应针对当前攻击配置进行测试，响应时间可作为额外的、与部署环境相关的补充信号。

title: Narrative Lookahead in LLMs: Event-Level Decodability, Predictive Advantage, and Steering
summary: Do language models carry information about narrative events before writing them, and how far ahead? We examine narrative lookahead through salient, state-changing events rather than tokens or response-level attributes. We extract 23,355 LLM-annotated events from 2,000 stories generated by four open-weight LLMs, labeling them along three nonexclusive dimensions of change: within agents, between agents, and in the story world, with human validation on a subset. Event segmentation and plot-independent labels enable comparisons across stories at horizons measured in events rather than in tokens. At event ends, we probe hidden states for upcoming event types and compare predictions with text-only predictors using matched prefixes. Across four models, future event types are decodable above prevalence baselines for at least four subsequent events, but probes significantly outperform both primary text-only predictors only for the next event. In exploratory steering with OLMo-3.1-32B, a probe-derived direction shifts the proportion of the target event type in both intended directions at higher strengths. Our event-level approach links the prediction of future narrative developments to interventions that reshape subsequent event composition.

AI.tldr: 该研究以"显著的状态改变事件"为单位考察语言模型的叙事前瞻能力：从四个开源LLM生成的2000篇故事中抽取23,355个事件并沿三个维度标注，通过探测隐藏状态预测后续事件类型。结果显示未来事件类型在至少四个后续事件范围内可解码，但探测仅在"下一个事件"上显著优于纯文本预测器；用OLMo-3.1-32B的探针方向进行干预可双向改变目标事件类型比例。
AI.motivation: 既有研究多从token或响应级属性考察LLM的前瞻性，难以刻画"叙事事件"这一语义单位，也无法以事件为尺度衡量前瞻距离。作者希望回答：模型在写作时是否已携带关于后续叙事事件的信息，以及这种前瞻能延伸多远。
AI.method: 从四个开源LLM生成的2000篇故事中提取23,355个LLM标注事件，按"个体内部变化、个体间变化、故事世界变化"三个非互斥维度标注，并在子集上做人工验证；事件分段与情节无关标签使跨故事比较得以在"事件数"而非token数的时间尺度上进行。在事件结束处探测隐藏状态以预测即将发生的事件类型，并与使用匹配前缀的纯文本预测器比较；进一步以OLMo-3.1-32B做探索性steering。
AI.result: 在四个模型上，未来事件类型在至少四个后续事件范围内均可高于流行度基线被解码；但探针仅在预测"下一个事件"时显著优于两种主要纯文本预测器。在OLMo-3.1-32B的探索性steering中，由探针导出的方向在较高强度下可同时向两个预期方向改变目标事件类型的比例。
AI.conclusion: 事件级分析将未来叙事发展的预测与重塑后续事件构成的干预联系起来，为理解并控制LLM的叙事前瞻提供了可操作的框架；同时表明模型的前瞻信息虽然存在，但相对于文本表面线索的增量优势主要体现在近期事件上。

title: Chain Dimension Scaling: Communication-Efficient Loop-Style Scaling for Industrial Short-Video Ranking
summary: Industrial recommendation rankers keep scaling in width and depth to billions of parameters, but this increasingly incurs costs in parameter growth, distributed communication overhead, and training inefficiency. We introduce \underline{C}hain \underline{D}imension \underline{S}caling (CDS), a scaling strategy orthogonal to width and depth. CDS repeatedly applies a single feature-interaction block with parameters shared across iterations, so the number of iterations (the chain length) becomes a new scaling dimension that adds no parameters. A lightweight intra-chain residual connection stabilizes optimization and improves quality. CDS enables two regimes. In the \emph{compression regime}, shallow blocks with a longer chain match deeper baselines with fewer parameters and faster training; in the \emph{quality-scaling regime}, increasing chain length under a fixed parameter budget yields consistent offline and online gains, suggesting the chain dimension adds modeling capacity beyond parameter reuse. We evaluate CDS in a large-scale multi-task short-video ranking system in production. In the compression regime, CDS stays within $0.03\%$ of baseline offline quality while reducing trainable parameters by 26.6\% and improving training throughput by 6.4\%, with neutral-to-positive online participation. In the quality-scaling regime, quality improves monotonically with chain length. Wall-clock analysis shows the efficiency gain comes mainly not from reduced FLOPs but from lower cross-device synchronization overhead and reduced optimizer update cost. These results position parameter-shared iterative computation as a practical, communication-efficient scaling axis for industrial ranking systems.

AI.tldr: 提出链维度缩放（CDS）：用参数共享的单一特征交互块反复迭代，将迭代次数（链长）作为不增加参数的新缩放维度，在生产级短视频排序系统中实现压缩与质量缩放两种模式。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐排序模型不断在宽度和深度上扩展至十亿级参数，但带来参数增长、分布式通信开销与训练低效等问题，亟需一种正交于宽度/深度的新缩放方式。
AI.method: CDS反复应用同一个参数共享的特征交互块，迭代次数构成"链长"这一零参数缩放维度；并引入轻量级链内残差连接以稳定优化并提升质量。由此支持两种机制：压缩机制（浅块+长链，少参数匹配更深基线）与质量缩放机制（固定参数预算下延长链长以提升建模容量）。在产线大规模多任务短视频排序系统中评估。
AI.result: 压缩机制下离线质量与基线差距在0.03%以内，可训练参数减少26.6%，训练吞吐提升6.4%，在线参与度中性偏正；质量缩放机制下质量随链长单调提升。壁钟时间分析表明效率收益主要来自跨设备同步开销降低与优化器更新成本下降，而非FLOPs减少。
AI.conclusion: 参数共享的迭代计算可作为工业排序系统实用且通信高效的缩放轴，为推荐模型扩展提供了正交于宽度和深度的新方向。

title: VisExMEM: Visual Evidence-Based Explainable Multimodal Evaluation Metric
summary: Current image-text evaluation often relies on a global score, which gives limited insight into which semantic details are supported by the image. Explainable metrics provide rationales, but the visual evidence supporting those rationales can still be difficult to verify. We introduce VisExMEM, a reference-free evaluator that decomposes captions into atomic claims, localizes visual evidence, verifies each claim, and averages claim-level support into a global score. Explanations use the same evidence and decisions. We train Qwen3.5-based 4B and 9B models on 100K samples with multi-task SFT, counterfactual refinement, and evidence-aware GDPO. Across eight benchmarks, VisExMEM-9B achieves the highest descriptive composite among open-source evaluators in our comparison, exceeding VQAScore by 11.7 points while remaining competitive with GPT-5.6 Sol. We also introduce AGITA-Bench, containing 600 human-annotated image-text pairs and 8.7K atomic claims for global and claim-level evaluation. For untuned Qwen3.5 and GPT-5.6 Sol controls, decomposed prompting raises the same composite by 3.6-5.1 points relative to holistic prompting. Human evaluation shows that VisExMEM explanations outperform prior explainable metrics and approach GPT-5.6 Sol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VisExMEM，一个无参考的图像-文本评测器：将描述拆解为原子断言、定位视觉证据、逐条验证并聚合为全局分数，解释与评分共享同一证据与决策。基于 Qwen3.5 的 4B/9B 模型经多任务 SFT、反事实精炼与证据感知 GDPO 训练；在八个基准上 9B 版本取得开源评测器中最高的描述性综合分，超过 VQAScore 11.7 分，并与 GPT-5.6 Sol 保持竞争力。同时发布 AGITA-Bench（600 个图文对、8.7K 原子断言）。
AI.motivation: 现有图像-文本评测多依赖单一全局分数，无法说明哪些语义细节被图像支持；可解释指标虽提供理由，但其依据的视觉证据仍难以核验。
AI.method: 提出无参考评测器 VisExMEM：(1) 将描述分解为原子断言；(2) 为每条断言定位视觉证据；(3) 逐条验证；(4) 将断言级支持度平均为全局分数；解释复用相同的证据与决策。训练上使用 Qwen3.5 的 4B 与 9B 模型，在 100K 样本上采用多任务 SFT、反事实精炼与证据感知 GDPO。
AI.result: 在八个基准上，VisExMEM-9B 在对比的开源评测器中取得最高描述性综合分，超过 VQAScore 11.7 分，并与 GPT-5.6 Sol 具有竞争力。新构建的 AGITA-Bench 含 600 个人工标注图文对与 8.7K 原子断言，支持全局与断言级评测。对未微调的 Qwen3.5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 对照，分解式提示相比整体式提示将综合分提升 3.6–5.1 分；人工评测显示 VisExMEM 的解释优于既有可解释指标，并接近 GPT-5.6 Sol。
AI.conclusion: 以原子断言分解与证据定位为核心的评测范式，可在提升描述性评测性能的同时提供可核验的解释，且分解式提示本身对通用模型亦有增益。

title: Cheap, Consistent, Calibrated, but Biased? Typed Decision Models as Judges
summary: Typed decision models (TDMs) return a probability for each allowed answer instead of generating text, which makes them candidates for cheaply replacing LLM judges that compare two answers. Whether they share the biases of LLM judges is untested. We run the CALM benchmark's bias tests on eight TDMs and seven LLM judges of 2024 and 2026. Every TDM is biased, in three to eight of twelve tests. Emotional tone affects them most, and rewriting the better answer in such a tone lowers the accuracy of a typical TDM from 99% to 42%. TDMs are more biased than 2026 LLM judges. All eight change verdicts when the answers swap places, which the 2026 LLM judges hardly do, and several side with an answer that most people allegedly prefer or that a famous model allegedly wrote. Yet both kinds of judge are tripped up by the same prompts. The TDMs' probabilities show that most tests mainly flip verdicts the TDM was unsure of, and that good calibration does not protect against bias. As TDMs are more consistent and 37 times cheaper than 2026 LLM judges, our results suggest they can be attractive judges if their biases are tested for the task.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统测试了8个类型化决策模型（TDM）与7个LLM评判者在CALM基准上的偏见，发现TDM普遍存在偏见（12项测试中3-8项），且比2026年LLM评判者更易受偏见影响，但在一致性和成本上具优势。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型（TDM）用概率替代文本生成，被视为可低成本替代LLM评判者来比较两个答案，但其是否共享LLM评判者的偏见尚未被验证，因此需要实证检验。
AI.method: 在CALM基准的偏见测试上，对8个TDM和7个LLM评判者（2024年与2026年）进行评估，涵盖12项测试，包括情感语调、答案位置交换、声称的偏好答案及"著名模型所写"等影响因素。
AI.result: 每个TDM在12项测试中的3-8项表现出偏见；情感语调影响最大，将更好答案改写为情感化语调可使典型TDM准确率从99%降至42%；TDM比2026年LLM评判者更有偏见，全部8个在答案位置交换时改变裁决，而2026年LLM评判者几乎不变；但两类评判者被相同提示绊倒；TDM的概率显示多数测试主要翻转其原本不确定的裁决，且良好校准并不能防止偏见。
AI.conclusion: 由于TDM比2026年LLM评判者更一致且成本低37倍，若能针对具体任务测试其偏见，TDM可作为有吸引力的评判者。

title: AuthGateBench: Benchmarking LLMs as Authorization Gate
summary: Automated approval systems let coding agents execute high-risk actions with minimal human oversight by delegating the authorization decision to a classifier, typically a large language model (LLM). Such systems, adopted in tools like Claude Code and Codex, remain vulnerable to failure modes such as scope escalation, where the agent takes actions exceeding what the user authorized. Existing benchmarks focus mainly on malicious requests, evaluating refusal under an implicit policy. We introduce AuthGateBench, the first policy-guided benchmark for authorization gating under benign requests. We implement a novel pipeline where an LLM generates contrast pairs with identical action and trajectory but differing request, flipping the label between block and allow. This allows us to assess whether models reason over context rather than the action alone. We further examine whether auxiliary environment signals can help models make better decisions. The resulting benchmark comprises 1,400 instances spanning five failure modes drawn from real-world Claude Code incidents. Evaluations show accuracy degrades unevenly across failure modes as models over-rely on internal safety alignment, and models still block most actions even when explicitly authorized, revealing unstable rather than deterministic decisions; retrospectively retrieved environment signals, however, substantially improve authorization accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AuthGateBench，首个面向良性请求、以策略为导向的授权门控基准，通过“对比对”流水线区分模型是否真正进行上下文推理，并评估环境信号对授权决策的辅助作用。
AI.motivation: 自动化审批系统让编码智能体在极少人工监督下执行高风险操作，将授权决策委托给以 LLM 为核心的分类器，但存在范围升级等失效模式。现有基准主要针对恶意请求，在隐含策略下评估拒答行为，无法衡量模型在良性请求下是否依据上下文与策略进行授权判断。
AI.method: 设计新颖流水线：由 LLM 生成“对比对”，即动作与轨迹完全相同、仅请求不同，使标签在 block 与 allow 之间翻转，从而检验模型是否基于上下文而非仅凭动作做出判断。同时考察辅助环境信号是否能提升决策质量。基准共 1,400 个实例，覆盖源自真实 Claude Code 事件的五类失效模式。
AI.result: 评估显示：随失效模式不同，准确率下降并不均匀，模型过度依赖内部安全对齐；即使被明确授权，模型仍会阻断大多数操作，表明决策不稳定而非确定性；而事后检索的环境信号可显著提升授权准确率。
AI.conclusion: AuthGateBench 揭示了当前 LLM 授权门控在良性请求下的系统性缺陷——依赖内对齐而非策略与上下文推理。引入外部环境信号是提升授权决策准确性与稳定性的有效方向。

title: Pixels or Code? Benchmarking Instruction-Guided Visual Artifact Operation
summary: Visual artifacts such as charts, technical diagrams, webpages, and document pages underpin scientific, commercial, and engineering workflows. Editing these artifacts requires direct modification, dependency-aware updates, preservation of unaffected content, and compliance with domain constraints. We define this capability as Visual Artifact Operation (VAO). Prior benchmarks test parts of this problem, including cascading updates in charts. We study direct edits, dependent updates, and preservation across visual domains and pixel, code, and agent paradigms under one image-only protocol. We introduce Visual Artifact Operation Bench (VAO-Bench), comprising 1,573 manually screened tasks across nine artifact categories and three difficulty levels. VAO-Bench uses executable artifacts and deterministic rendering to trace reference transformations and annotate direct edits, dependent updates, and preservation constraints. All systems receive the same source image and instruction; we evaluate pixel-space editors, code-generating multimodal systems, and tool-using agents on direct-edit accuracy, dependency-aware update, content preservation, domain validity, and visual quality. Experiments show that executable-code systems better support dependent updates, while pixel-space editors offer faster execution and strong visual quality. Explicitly stating dependencies improves both paradigms, identifying implicit-update inference as a central bottleneck. VAO-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for dependable visual artifact editing across generation paradigms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出视觉产物操作（VAO）任务及VAO-Bench基准，覆盖9类产物、1573个任务，统一评估像素、代码与智能体范式在直接编辑、依赖更新与内容保持上的表现。
AI.motivation: 图表、技术图、网页、文档页等视觉产物广泛支撑科研与工程流程，其编辑需支持直接修改、依赖感知更新、无关内容保持及领域约束合规。现有基准仅覆盖部分问题（如图表级联更新），缺乏跨视觉领域与跨生成范式（像素、代码、智能体）的统一评测。
AI.method: 构建VAO-Bench，包含9类视觉产物、3个难度级别共1573个人工筛选任务；采用可执行产物与确定性渲染，追踪参考变换，并标注直接编辑、依赖更新与保持约束。所有系统接收相同的源图像与指令，在仅图像协议下评测像素空间编辑器、代码生成多模态系统与工具使用智能体，指标涵盖直接编辑准确率、依赖感知更新、内容保持、领域有效性与视觉质量。
AI.result: 实验表明，可执行代码系统更擅长支持依赖更新，而像素空间编辑器执行更快且视觉质量较强；显式给出依赖信息可同时提升两类范式，说明隐式更新推断是核心瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: VAO-Bench为跨生成范式的可靠视觉产物编辑提供了可复现的评测基础。

title: SparPR: Runtime KV-Cache Recovery for Resource-Constrained LLM Inference on Consumer Hardware
summary: Running large language models (LLMs) on consumer hardware is bottlenecked by the key-value (KV) cache, which grows with every decoded token and quickly exhausts the memory and bandwidth of a single consumer GPU. We present SparPR (Sparse Partial Recomputation), a runtime KV-cache recovery mechanism that does not modify model weights and requires no offline training. SparPR couples three online decisions: Query-Aware key-block selection scores historical blocks against the current query; dynamic budget control estimates per-block copy and recompute costs to decide how many blocks to retain; and on-demand local recomputation with cost-aware fallback merges retained blocks into continuous spans and switches between sparse recomputation and full recovery according to a runtime cost comparison. Implemented on FlexGen/FlexLLMGen, SparPR is evaluated on a single consumer laptop (RTX 3070 Ti 8GB, Ryzen 9 6900HX, 16GB RAM). It cuts end-to-end latency by 31%, 52%, and 63% at 1k, 2k, and 4k prompt tokens respectively, with 1.4x-2.7x higher throughput, and completes an 8k-token workload in 44 minutes where the FlexGen baseline times out. Under a fixed cache budget, SparPR retains a Needle Accuracy that stays well above StreamingLLM and H2O at every keep ratio, and ablation studies confirm that the three mechanisms act jointly.

AI.tldr: SparPR 是一种无需修改权重、无需离线训练的运行时 KV 缓存恢复机制，通过在消费级单卡上耦合查询感知键块选择、动态预算控制和按需局部重计算三项在线决策，显著降低大模型推理延迟并提升吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 在消费级硬件上运行大语言模型受限于 KV 缓存：缓存随每个解码 token 增长，迅速耗尽单张消费级 GPU 的显存与带宽。现有方案往往需要修改模型权重或离线训练，适用性受限。
AI.method: SparPR 包含三个在线决策组件：(1) Query-Aware 键块选择，基于当前查询对历史块打分；(2) 动态预算控制，估计每块的拷贝与重计算开销以决定保留块数量；(3) 按需局部重计算与成本感知回退，将保留块合并为连续区间，并依据运行时成本比较在稀疏重计算与全量恢复间切换。实现在 FlexGen/FlexLLMGen 上。
AI.result: 在单台消费级笔记本（RTX 3070 Ti 8GB、Ryzen 9 6900HX、16GB 内存）上：端到端延迟在 1k/2k/4k 提示词长度下分别降低 31%、52%、63%，吞吐量提升 1.4x–2.7x；8k token 负载 44 分钟完成而 FlexGen 基线超时。固定缓存预算下，各保留率下 Needle Accuracy 均显著高于 StreamingLLM 和 H2O，消融实验证实三种机制协同作用。
AI.conclusion: SparPR 证明在不修改权重、无需离线训练的前提下，通过三种在线机制的协同可有效缓解消费级 GPU 上的 KV 缓存瓶颈，兼顾延迟、吞吐与精度，优于 StreamingLLM 与 H2O 等基线。

title: RAP-WAM: Learning World-Action Models through Predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations
summary: Recent world action models draw on video generation priors to jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Adapting these priors to control requires determining how future predictions should guide policy learning. RAP-WAM combines predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations (RAP) with future-supervised queries and Coupled Action Projection for policy learning. Predictive rehearsal trains on model-generated inputs while retaining recorded targets, and accumulates recurring errors into a spatial prior. We perturb actions and measure changes in video predictions. Action-response-based spatiotemporal credit assignment combines these responses, prediction error, and the rehearsal prior to allocate visual supervision; spatially aggregating the responses determines supervision intensity across future action steps. No separate scoring network or deployment-time probe is required. The base learns from a video-pretrained backbone without intermediate pretraining on external embodied data. We evaluate the fixed base and its agent-refined, task-conditioned system. On 42 RoboDojo tasks, their average success rates are 12.85% and 15.62%, with Scores of 17.86 and 20.59. Across 15 real-robot tasks, the complete system achieves 89.00% task-macro-average success, exceeding the strongest of five baselines by 37.67 percentage points. Across 315 fixed-output simulation windows, 45.21% of response-top20 positions fall outside error-top20, revealing information beyond prediction error.

AI.tldr: RAP-WAM通过预测预演与动作扰动，结合动作响应的时空信用分配进行策略学习，无需额外评分网络或部署探测；在RoboDojo和真实机器人任务上均取得领先成功率。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型利用视频生成先验联合预测未来观测与机器人动作，但如何让未来预测有效指导策略学习仍是关键问题。论文旨在解决这一"适应性"问题，即确定未来预测应以何种方式引导策略学习，而非简单依赖预测误差。
AI.method: 提出RAP-WAM：1）预测式预演（Predictive Rehearsal）：在模型生成输入上训练但保留真实记录目标，并将累积误差聚合成空间先验；2）动作扰动（Action Perturbations）：扰动动作并测量视频预测的变化，形成动作响应；3）基于动作响应的时空信用分配：结合响应、预测误差与预演先验分配视觉监督，空间聚合响应以确定未来动作步的监督强度；4）耦合动作投影（Coupled Action Projection）与未来监督查询。无需独立评分网络或部署时探测，基座从视频预训练骨干学习，无需外部具身数据中间预训练。
AI.result: 在42个RoboDojo任务上，固定基座与其智能体精炼、任务条件化系统的平均成功率分别为12.85%与15.62%，Score为17.86与20.59；在15个真实机器人任务上，完整系统达到89.00%任务宏平均成功率，超过五个基线中最强者37.67个百分点；在315个固定输出仿真窗口中，45.21%的响应top20位置落在误差top20之外，表明响应信息超出预测误差。
AI.conclusion: 未来预测指导策略学习不应仅依赖预测误差，动作响应提供了超出误差的额外信息；RAP-WAM通过预演、扰动与时空信用分配有效利用这些信息，在仿真与真实机器人任务上均显著优于基线，且无需额外评分网络或部署探测。

title: Tikhonov-Stabilized Bezier Representation Forecasting for Training-free Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Diffusion models, particularly Diffusion Transformers, achieve strong image and video generation quality but remain expensive at inference time due to repeated denoiser evaluations. Feature caching offers a deployment-friendly acceleration strategy by reusing or predicting intermediate representations without retraining the generator or modifying the sampler. However, existing cache-then-forecast methods often rely on Taylor-style finite-difference extrapolation, which can become unstable over longer cache intervals, and typically predict local module outputs whose errors may accumulate through subsequent denoiser blocks. We propose \textbf{BeziCast}, a training-free diffusion acceleration framework that forecasts output-proximal denoising representations using low-order B'ezier trajectories. BeziCast estimates B'ezier control points via Tikhonov-stabilized fitting, providing a smooth, capacity-controlled temporal parameterization that avoids explicit high-order derivative estimation and decouples trajectory capacity from cache-query density. To moderate aggressive extrapolation, we further derive equivalent forecasting weights and introduce a convex-hull-inspired guardrail that detects high-risk predictions and softly pulls them toward a conservative simplex-projected estimate. Extensive evaluations across advanced image and video diffusion models demonstrate the effectiveness of BeziCast. In particular, BeziCast accelerates FLUX.1 by up to (4.79\times) and HunyuanVideo by up to (4.11\times), while preserving substantially better generation quality than competing acceleration baselines.

AI.tldr: BeziCast：一种免训练扩散加速框架，用低阶贝塞尔轨迹预测输出近端去噪表示，配合Tikhonov稳定拟合与凸包护栏，实现FLUX.1最高4.79×、HunyuanVideo最高4.11×加速且保真度优于基线。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型（尤其是Diffusion Transformers）推理成本高，需多次去噪器评估。特征缓存是部署友好的免训练加速思路，但现有"先缓存后预测"方法多依赖泰勒式有限差分外推，在较长缓存间隔下不稳定，且通常预测局部模块输出，误差会沿后续去噪块累积。
AI.method: 提出BeziCast：用低阶贝塞尔轨迹预测输出近端（output-proximal）的去噪表示，避免局部误差累积；通过Tikhonov正则化拟合估计贝塞尔控制点，获得平滑、容量可控的时序参数化，无需显式高阶导数估计，并使轨迹容量与缓存查询密度解耦；推导等价预测权重并引入凸包启发的护栏机制，检测高风险预测并将其软性拉向保守的单纯形投影估计。
AI.result: 在多种先进图像与视频扩散模型上评估，BeziCast对FLUX.1最高加速4.79×，对HunyuanVideo最高加速4.11×，且生成质量显著优于竞争加速基线。
AI.conclusion: BeziCast是一种免训练、无需修改采样器的扩散加速框架，通过贝塞尔轨迹拟合与护栏机制在显著提速的同时保持生成质量，验证了输出近端表示预测相较局部预测的优越性。

title: Attacking Only Half the Data: Two-Sided Evaluation of AI-Text Detector Robustness
summary: We investigate the robustness of widely used AI text detectors under attacks applied to both human and machine text. Prior evaluations typically attack only machine text, overlooking that human text is routinely modified through grammar correction, formatting, or invisible character insertion. We introduce a two-sided protocol that applies attacks to both classes. Across two corpora and nine detectors, reported AUROC gains vanish under two-sided evaluation, with attacked human text misclassified at rates up to 100%. While simple preprocessing reverses character-level attacks, word-level synonym substitution remains effective meaning-preserving, and irreversible.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“双边攻击”评估协议，同时对人类文本与机器文本施加攻击，发现主流AI文本检测器在双边评估下AUROC优势消失，人类文本误判率最高可达100%。
AI.motivation: 以往对AI文本检测器的评测通常只攻击机器文本，忽略了人类文本本身也会因语法纠错、格式调整或不可见字符插入而被修改，导致检测器鲁棒性被高估。
AI.method: 提出双边（two-sided）评估协议，对人类文本和机器文本同时施加攻击；在两个语料库上评测九种检测器。
AI.result: 在双边评估下，检测器此前报告的AUROC提升全部消失，被攻击的人类文本误判率最高达100%。
AI.conclusion: 简单预处理可逆转字符级攻击，但词级同义替换保持语义且不可逆，仍是有效攻击手段；AI文本检测的鲁棒性评估需纳入人类文本一侧。

title: XAI-Guided Fourier Domain Generalisation for Pure-Simulation Sim-to-Real Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for vision-based autonomous driving, but policies trained in simulation often suffer severe performance degradation when deployed in the real world. Existing sim-to-real methods commonly address this gap through image-transfer-based domain adaptation or policy-agnostic domain randomisation. However, the former requires laborious acquisition of target-domain data and is often limited to the deployment domain, whereas the latter introduces unguided perturbations that may not reflect the underlying sim-to-real discrepancy, leading to suboptimal transfer performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose XFD, an explainable artificial intelligence (XAI)-guided Fourier domain generalisation framework for pure-simulation sim-to-real reinforcement learning. The proposed framework extracts explainability attribution maps from simulated observations, and converts these attributions into policy-conditioned Fourier-domain interventions. By perturbing appearance-sensitive spectral components while preserving task-defining spatial structures, XFD constructs robustness-enhancing visual domains entirely within simulation. Subsequently, the proposed robust policy optimisation guides the policy towards attending to task-critical features while suppressing sensitivity to irrelevant visual information. Extensive experiments in simulation and zero-shot real-world deployment demonstrate that XFD consistently improves traveled distance and reward over standard policy and randomly domain-randomised baseline, especially on unseen maps with cluttered backgrounds. Attribution-based analysis further proves that the proposed policy preserves more consistent task-relevant visual evidence across simulation and real-world observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 XFD——一种由可解释人工智能（XAI）引导的傅里叶域泛化框架，用于纯仿真环境下的 sim-to-real 强化学习。该方法将仿真观测的归因图转化为策略条件下的傅里叶域扰动，在保留任务相关空间结构的同时扰动外观敏感频谱分量，从而在仿真内部构造增强鲁棒性的视觉域，并在仿真与零样本真实部署中优于基线。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的自动驾驶深度强化学习策略在仿真中训练后迁移到真实世界常出现严重性能退化。现有 sim-to-real 方法存在两类局限：基于图像迁移的域适应需要大量目标域数据且泛化局限于部署域；与策略无关的域随机化引入无引导扰动，难以反映真实的 sim-to-real 差异，导致迁移性能次优。因此需要一种无需真实数据、且能针对性弥合域间差异的纯仿真泛化方法。
AI.method: XFD 框架包含三个关键环节：（1）从仿真观测中提取可解释性归因图（attribution maps）；（2）将归因转换为策略条件（policy-conditioned）的傅里叶域干预，针对外观敏感的频谱分量施加扰动，同时保留定义任务的空间结构；（3）通过鲁棒策略优化，引导策略关注任务关键特征并抑制对无关视觉信息的敏感性。整个视觉域构造过程完全在仿真内部完成，不依赖目标域数据。
AI.result: 在仿真实验与零样本真实世界部署中，XFD 相比标准策略和随机域随机化基线，一致提升了行驶距离与奖励，尤其在背景杂乱的未见地图上提升更为明显。基于归因的分析进一步表明，所提策略在仿真与真实观测之间保持了更一致的任务相关视觉证据。
AI.conclusion: XFD 通过将 XAI 归因与傅里叶域干预相结合，为纯仿真 sim-to-real 强化学习提供了一种有引导、可解释的域泛化范式，在无需目标域数据的前提下有效缓解域间差异，提升了视觉自动驾驶策略的鲁棒性与零样本迁移能力，并通过归因一致性验证了其可解释性优势。

title: Not Every Cue Is Evidence: Cue Supportability for Forensic Distillation in Face Forgery Detection
summary: Explainable face forgery detection requires not only correct judgments but also forensic evidence supported by the input image. However, training cues are typically derived from the forgery generation pipeline. Since images available to the model are of limited quality and resolution, it is difficult to observe the fine-grained traces these cues refer to. Training methods that further supply such cues as privileged supervision exacerbate the problem, as the student is taught to articulate evidence it cannot perceive. The student consequently resorts to templated or over-generalized expressions, giving rise to the correct-answer, wrong-evidence (CAWE) failure. We propose a dual supportability audit that filters privileged cues before distillation. Each candidate cue must be predictable from the remaining privileged context and causally tied to high-attribution visual regions in the current image. Only cues satisfying both conditions receive substantial distillation weight, preventing unsupported details from leaking into the student. Experiments across eight benchmarks show that our method maintains or improves detection accuracy while significantly raising explanation faithfulness compared to existing paradigms.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"双重可支撑性审计"（dual supportability audit），在蒸馏前过滤特权线索，仅保留可从剩余特权上下文预测且与图像高归因视觉区域因果相关的线索，以缓解"答案对、证据错"（CAWE）问题。
AI.motivation: 可解释人脸伪造检测不仅要判断正确，还需给出输入图像可支撑的取证证据。但训练线索多来自伪造生成流程，而模型可见图像质量与分辨率有限，难以观测这些线索所指的细粒度痕迹。以特权监督形式直接提供此类线索会加剧问题：学生被要求表述其无法感知的证据，从而退化为模板化或过度泛化的表达，产生"答案正确、证据错误"（CAWE）的失败模式。
AI.method: 提出双重可支撑性审计，在蒸馏前过滤特权线索。每条候选线索须同时满足两个条件：（1）可由剩余的特权上下文预测；（2）与当前图像中高归因视觉区域存在因果联系。仅同时满足两条件的线索才获得显著蒸馏权重，从而阻止无支撑的细节泄漏给学生。
AI.result: 在八个基准上实验表明，与现有范式相比，该方法在保持或提升检测准确率的同时显著提高了解释的忠实度（faithfulness）。
AI.conclusion: 通过在蒸馏前对特权线索进行可支撑性审计，可有效抑制CAWE失败，实现检测精度与解释忠实度的兼顾，为可解释人脸伪造检测提供了新的训练范式。

title: Fan Out or Relay? Ownership-Aware Routing for LLM Agents Querying Siloed Tables
summary: Inside organizations, a question's data often sit with several owners, who query their own tables but never hand them over. An LLM coordinator can fan out, sending the question to every owner at once, or relay, querying owners in turn and reusing earlier rows. We show that neither is safe in advance, because data ownership decides which one is right. Across thirteen settings on PeopleJoin and BIRD with three model families, fan-out is more accurate in twelve on questions one owner can answer, yet answers at most 4.3% of those joining two owners' tables. The flip follows ownership, not query shape: on BIRD two-table joins, fan-out answers 32-44% when one owner holds both and 1-4% otherwise. Relay wins by conditioning on returned rows, and hiding them from an otherwise identical planner cuts two-owner accuracy from 23.2% to 5.1%. Since ownership is public, we propose Ownership-Aware Routing (OAR), which drafts a schema-only SQL query, counts the owners whose tables it joins, and routes the question before any private row is read. In ten settings OAR is never significantly less accurate than the best fixed protocol, and beats every fixed protocol on PeopleJoin, by up to 9.3 points on held-out organizations.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示在组织内部多数据所有者场景下，LLM协调器的\"扇出\"（fan-out）与\"中继\"（relay）协议孰优取决于数据所有权归属，并提出基于所有权感知的路由方法（OAR），在读取任何私有数据前决定协议，从而在多数设置中达到或超过最佳固定协议。
AI.motivation: 在组织内部，一个问题的数据常分散在多个所有者手中，他们各自查询自己的表但不愿交出数据。LLM协调器可以采用两种策略：一次性向所有所有者并行查询（fan-out），或依次查询并复用先前返回的行（relay）。作者的核心动机是证明这两种协议无法事先判定优劣，因为\"数据所有权\"（即哪些表属于同一所有者）才是决定正确协议的关键因素，而非查询本身的形状。
AI.method: 作者在PeopleJoin与BIRD两个基准上，结合三种模型家族，构建了十三个实验设置进行系统性对比。通过对比fan-out与relay在不同所有权分布下的准确率，分析决定性能的因素；并通过隐藏已返回行给一个其他方面完全相同的规划器，来验证relay收益是否源于对已返回行的条件化。基于所有权是公开信息这一事实，提出Ownership-Aware Routing（OAR）：先起草一个仅依赖schema的SQL查询，统计其join所涉及的所有者数量，从而在读取任何私有行之前完成路由决策。
AI.result: 在十三个设置中，fan-out在十二个\"单一所有者可回答\"的问题上更准确，但在需要联合两个所有者表的场景下至多只回答4.3%。性能翻转由所有权而非查询形状决定：在BIRD的两表join上，当同一所有者持有两张表时fan-out回答率为32-44%，否则仅为1-4%。relay通过对已返回行进行条件化而获胜；将已返回行隐藏后，一个其他方面相同的规划器在双所有者问题上的准确率从23.2%降至5.1%。在十个设置中，OAR的准确率从不显著低于最佳固定协议，并在PeopleJoin上优于所有固定协议，在留出组织上领先最多9.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 决定fan-out与relay优劣的是数据所有权的分布，而非查询的表层形态，因此不存在普遍最优的固定协议。由于所有权信息是公开的，OAR能够在接触任何私有数据之前预先路由，在保证不显著劣于最佳固定协议的同时，在部分场景中取得显著提升，为多所有者数据环境下的LLM协调提供了安全且高效的路由方案。

title: PXRD-Bench: How Close Are We to Determining Crystal Structures from Powder Diffraction?
summary: Determining crystal structures from powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) would enable routine characterization of newly synthesized materials, including those absent from reference databases. Generative models offer a promising approach, but existing evaluations remain fragmented and largely assume single-phase samples with known composition. To fill this gap, we introduce PXRD-Bench, a unified benchmark that extends evaluation to unknown per-element atom counts and recovery of both structures in two-phase mixtures. It provides approximately 4.1 million training structures with simulated PXRD, tests generalization to unseen compositions and structural prototypes, and evaluates recovery from experimental PXRD after excluding structurally matching training entries. To provide a strong reference baseline, we also introduce Bragglite, a PXRD-to-structure model developed through a systematic study of PXRD modeling choices. It achieves a 44.2\% Top-1 match rate on experimental RRUFF patterns with known composition, 24.6\% above the strongest prior baseline. Further analysis yields several key findings: some models fail to benefit from experimental PXRD, while generalization to unseen structural prototypes and recovery from two-phase mixtures remain challenging. Together, our benchmark, systematic studies, and Bragglite clarify the capabilities and limitations of current PXRD-to-structure models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PXRD-Bench 基准与 Bragglite 模型，用于从粉末 X 射线衍射图谱推断晶体结构。PXRD-Bench 涵盖未知元素原子数与双相混合物的恢复任务，含约 410 万条模拟训练数据；Bragglite 在实验 RRUFF 图谱上取得 44.2% 的 Top-1 匹配率，较先前最佳基线提升 24.6%。
AI.motivation: 从 PXRD 确定晶体结构可实现新合成材料的常规表征，包括数据库中不存在的材料。生成模型虽有前景，但现有评估零散，且大多假设单相样品与已知化学组成，无法反映真实场景。
AI.method: 提出统一基准 PXRD-Bench，将评估扩展至未知的逐元素原子计数以及双相混合物中两种结构的同时恢复；提供约 410 万条带模拟 PXRD 的训练结构，测试对未见组成与结构原型的泛化能力，并在排除结构匹配的训练条目后评估由实验 PXRD 恢复结构的能力。同时通过对 PXRD 建模选择的系统研究，构建 PXRD-to-structure 模型 Bragglite 作为强参考基线。
AI.result: Bragglite 在已知组成的实验 RRUFF 图谱上达到 44.2% 的 Top-1 匹配率，较最强先前基线高 24.6%。分析发现：部分模型无法从实验 PXRD 中获益；对未见结构原型的泛化以及双相混合物的结构恢复仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该基准、系统研究与 Bragglite 共同厘清了当前 PXRD-to-structure 模型的能力边界与局限性。

title: GHOST: Geometry-Constrained Hybrid Diffusion for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at ACM MM 2026 (34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia)
summary: 3D scene graph generation requires understanding both object semantics and metric spatial relations. However, existing open-vocabulary methods often struggle with spatial predicates because language similarity reflects semantic co-occurrence rather than explicit geometry. We propose GHOST, a Geometry-constrained Hybrid diffusion framework for Open-vocabulary 3D Scene graph generaTion. GHOST jointly models continuous node geometry and discrete edge predicates, following a geometry-to-constraint-to-predicate denoising process to ensure geometrically consistent relation prediction. It introduces language-grounded constraint induction, which maps predicate embeddings to differentiable geometric constraints that guide both layout refinement and predicate reweighting. A Geometry-Topology Collaborative Denoiser further couples node and edge reasoning through noise-adaptive interaction and orientation-aware modeling. Experiments on 3DSSG demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both closed-set and open-vocabulary settings, including over 17-point gains over RelationField on spatial predicates.

AI.tldr: 提出GHOST，一个几何约束的混合扩散框架，用于开放词汇3D场景图生成，通过几何到约束到谓词的去噪流程保证关系预测的几何一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇方法在空间谓词上表现不佳，因为语言相似性反映的是语义共现而非显式几何关系。
AI.method: 联合建模连续节点几何与离散边谓词，采用几何-约束-谓词去噪过程；引入语言锚定的约束归纳，将谓词嵌入映射为可微几何约束以指导布局优化和谓词重加权；设计几何-拓扑协同去噪器，通过噪声自适应交互与方向感知建模耦合节点和边推理。
AI.result: 在3DSSG数据集上，闭集与开放词汇设置均达到最优性能，空间谓词较RelationField提升超过17个点。
AI.conclusion: GHOST通过将几何约束融入扩散生成，有效缓解开放词汇空间关系预测的语义-几何失配问题，显著提升3D场景图生成性能。

title: Claim Framing as a Driver of LLM Sycophancy
summary: Sycophancy in Large Language Models, the tendency to align responses with user preferences over ground truth, has largely been studied using questions without a clear ground truth and with a single, plainly stated user opinion. We present a systematic study of which framings of a user's claim trigger sycophancy in factual question answering, where every answer is objectively verifiable without extra context. Evaluating 14 models on 42K questions, we express correct and incorrect user opinions through various claim framings over 8 dimensions and 21 types, and measure a broad set of opinion-driven behaviors. We find that all models are susceptible to user opinions regardless of size. Models are most influenced by how confidently an opinion is stated, whom it is attributed to, and whether it is presented as shared between the user and the model. In contrast to prior work, framings based on the user's expertise, authority over the model, or social pressure matter little in our factual setting. Larger models resist incorrect opinions better but are no better at recovering from their own errors. Our results call for sycophancy evaluations that probe how an opinion is framed, not merely whether one is present, and that measure multiple behaviors beyond a single flip rate.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了事实性问题回答中，用户意见的不同表述框架如何触发大语言模型的谄媚行为，发现所有模型均易受影响，且受影响程度取决于表述方式而非模型规模。
AI.motivation: 以往对谄媚（谄媚于用户偏好而非事实）的研究多使用无明确事实标准的问题，且仅涉及单一、直白的用户意见，缺乏对"用户主张的表述框架"这一维度的系统考察。作者希望探究在答案可客观验证的事实性问答场景下，哪些用户主张的表述方式会触发谄媚行为。
AI.method: 在42K个问题上评估14个模型。通过8个维度、21种类型的多种主张表述框架，表达正确与错误的用户意见，并测量一系列由意见驱动的行为（而非单一翻转率）。
AI.result: 所有模型无论规模大小都易受用户意见影响。影响最大的因素包括：意见陈述的自信程度、意见归属对象，以及意见是否被呈现为用户与模型所共有。与先前研究相反，基于用户专业性、对模型的权威性或社会压力的表述在事实性场景中影响很小。更大的模型更能抵抗错误意见，但在从自身错误中恢复方面并无更佳表现。
AI.conclusion: 谄媚评估应探究意见"如何被表述"而不仅是"是否存在"，并应测量多种行为而非单一翻转率。

title: Boosting the Learning for Ranking Patterns
summary: Pattern mining is a valuable tool for exploratory data analysis, but identifying relevant patterns for a specific user is challenging. Various interestingness mea- sures have been developed to evaluate patterns, but they may not efficiently estimate user-specific functions. Learning user-specific functions by ranking patterns has been proposed, but this requires significant time and training samples. In this paper, we present a solution that formulates the problem of learning pattern ranking functions as a multicriteria decision making problem. Our approach uses Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to elicit weights for different interestingness measures based on user preference. We also propose an active learning mode with a sensitivity-based heuristic to minimize user ranking queries while still providing high-quality results. Experiments show that our approach significantly reduces running time and returns precise pattern ranking while being robust to user error, compared to state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将模式排序函数学习建模为多准则决策问题，使用AHP基于用户偏好为不同有趣度度量赋权，并引入基于敏感度的主动学习启发式以减少用户排序查询，实验证明该方法在运行时间、排序精度和抗用户误差鲁棒性上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 模式挖掘中，为特定用户识别相关模式具有挑战性。已有有趣度度量难以高效估计用户特定函数；通过排序模式来学习用户特定函数虽可行，但需要大量时间和训练样本。
AI.method: 将模式排序函数学习形式化为多准则决策问题；采用层次分析法（AHP）根据用户偏好为不同有趣度度量导出权重；提出带敏感度启发式的主动学习模式，在保证高质量结果的同时最小化用户排序查询。
AI.result: 实验表明，与当前最先进方法相比，该方法显著减少运行时间，返回精确的模式排序，并且对用户误差具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: AHP结合敏感度主动学习可高效、精准地学习用户特定模式排序函数，并具备良好的抗噪能力。

title: Teaching Vision-Language Models to Decline: Support Completion Against Mirage
summary: Vision-language models answer questions about images they were never shown, a failure called mirage. Such an answer can be correct without being justified by the evidence, and the difference matters wherever a model's output is checked by someone who did not see its input. We locate the failure in the training objective: cross-entropy separates a model that reads the image from one that ignores it by only the conditional mutual information between answer and image, and no training example rewards declining. We formalise support completion, TIDE, which also shows each training question with a blank image, a same-domain wrong image and an out-of-domain image, with targets that decline, and prove that under TIDE every image-blind predictor is suboptimal by at least 1.04 nats per example, that the optimum declines exactly on the counterfactual kinds while keeping its behaviour on valid images, and that for any finite model the error of its answer-or-decline decision, declining on valid input plus answering on invalid input, is bounded below by how well its representation separates valid from invalid evidence. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B under a frozen held-out protocol with two judges, the three-condition predecessor of TIDE reduced the invalid-evidence mirage rate from 0.759 to 0.097 and the blank-image rate from 0.700 to 0.003 at a false-abstention cost of 0.126; label-free grounding raised the rate to 0.859, a likelihood-advantage contrast moved it only to 0.718 because its empty-image term carries no gradient, and grounding applied after support completion re-opened the mirage. The four-condition protocol on three base models, with seeds and component ablations, is in progress and not reported here.

AI.tldr: 论文提出「幻影（mirage）」失败模式：视觉语言模型对从未见过的图像也会作答。作者将其根源定位于交叉熵训练目标缺乏对「拒绝作答」的奖励，并提出支持补全训练协议 TIDE，通过为每个问题附加空白、同域错误、跨域错误三类反事实图像并要求模型拒绝作答，从理论上证明可消除图像盲预测行为，并在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上显著降低幻影率。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型会对未被展示的图像给出回答，即「幻影」现象。这种答案即使正确也不被证据支持，而只要输出会被未见过输入的第三方核查，这一差别就至关重要。作者认为失败根源在训练目标而非架构：交叉熵仅通过答案与图像间的条件互信息来区分「读图」与「忽略图」的模型，且没有任何训练样本奖励拒绝作答。
AI.method: 提出支持补全协议 TIDE：除正常问答对外，还为每个训练问题配以空白图像、同域错误图像和跨域图像三种反事实条件，并配以「拒绝作答」的目标。理论层面证明在 TIDE 下：(1) 任何图像盲预测器每样本至少次优 1.04 nats；(2) 最优解在反事实类型上恰好拒绝，同时在合法图像上保持原有行为；(3) 对任意有限模型，其「作答或拒绝」决策误差（在合法输入上拒绝 + 在非法输入上作答）下界由表示对合法与非法证据的可分性决定。实验在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上采用冻结留出协议与两名评判者。
AI.result: TIDE 的三条件前身在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上将非法证据幻影率由 0.759 降至 0.097，空白图像率由 0.700 降至 0.003，误拒代价为 0.126。对照实验显示：无标签接地（label-free grounding）使幻影率升至 0.859；似然优势对比仅降至 0.718，因其空图像项不携带梯度；在支持补全之后再施加接地会重新打开幻影。四条件协议在三个基座模型上的实验（含随机种子与组件消融）仍在进行，本文未报告。
AI.conclusion: 训练目标是视觉语言模型幻影失败的关键所在。通过支持补全协议 TIDE 显式奖励拒绝作答，可在理论上保证图像盲预测器次优、最优解在反事实条件下正确拒绝，并在实践中大幅降低非法证据幻影率。已有对照表明，单纯接地或似然优势对比不足以抑制幻影，甚至可能在支持补全后重新诱发该失败；完整四条件协议的结果待后续报告。

title: TRACESTEER: Trace Driven Activation Steering for Hallucination Mitigation in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs, yet remain susceptible to hallucination. Activation steering offers a promising mitigation approach by guiding parallel token predictions through internal representations. However, existing steering methods largely overlook two characteristics of dLLMs: dynamic denoising states and temporal hallucination risks, which challenge predefined steering vectors and uniform intervention strengths. We propose TRACESTEER, a trace-driven activation steering framework that uses preceding denoising predictions as feedback to jointly adapt steering direction and strength. Specifically, Denoising Feedback Steering (DF-Steering) constructs step-specific steering vectors from preceding predictions and current hidden states. Trajectory-Guided Steering Gate (TS-Gate) regulates their strength using prediction uncertainty and the denoising timestep. With the backbone frozen, factual supervision and magnitude regularization jointly guide the learning of adaptive steering interventions, promoting factual reliability and stability throughout denoising. Experiments on two dLLMs show improved factual reliability on TruthfulQA and generalization across five downstream benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TRACESTEER，一种轨迹驱动的激活引导框架，利用前序去噪预测作为反馈，联合自适应调整引导方向与强度，缓解扩散大语言模型的幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）虽是有前景的替代方案，但仍易产生幻觉。现有激活引导方法忽略了 dLLMs 的两个特性：动态去噪状态与时序性幻觉风险，导致预定义引导向量和统一干预强度难以适用。
AI.method: 提出 TRACESTEER 框架，包含两个组件：DF-Steering 依据前序预测与当前隐状态构建步级特定的引导向量；TS-Gate 利用预测不确定性与去噪时间步调节引导强度。在冻结主干网络的条件下，通过事实性监督与幅度正则化联合指导自适应引导干预的学习。
AI.result: 在两个 dLLMs 上的实验表明，方法在 TruthfulQA 上提升了事实可靠性，并在五个下游基准上表现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TRACESTEER 通过轨迹驱动的自适应激活引导，有效缓解 dLLMs 幻觉，兼顾事实可靠性与去噪过程的稳定性。

title: EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents
summary: Training LLM agents to interact with users over multiple turns is challenging because the learning signal depends not only on the agent, but also on the user simulator and environment, which jointly shape the agent's experience. Simulated users can be stochastic or inconsistent, while environments may contain unreliable tools, incomplete state coverage, and incorrect verifiers. Prior work mainly addresses the resulting instability through reward shaping or denser supervision, while treating these components as fixed. We instead introduce EAU, a meta-agent framework for environment--agent--user co-evolution. During training, EAU monitors trajectories, tool traces, rewards, and training statistics; diagnoses failures and uninformative interactions; and proposes targeted modifications to the user simulator, environment, reward design, and RL configuration. Validated changes are hot-swapped into the ongoing run, allowing the training setup to evolve together with the policy. These adaptations also persist across runs, so later training can build on previously discovered improvements rather than restarting from a fixed setup. We enable this process through an editable symbolic representation of user and environment dynamics, while the agent remains a neural LLM optimized with RL. Across three interactive-agent benchmarks and two backbone models, EAU consistently outperforms prior RL methods, improving the overall score over the strongest baseline by 14.7--15.0% and increasing successful task completion on ColBench by up to 36.7%, showing that co-evolving the training system with the policy can substantially improve multi-turn RL.

AI.tldr: 提出EAU元代理框架，实现环境-代理-用户协同进化，通过动态诊断并热更新训练设置提升多轮交互RL效果。
AI.motivation: 多轮交互训练LLM代理的学习信号受用户模拟器和环境共同影响，模拟用户随机不一致、环境工具不可靠、状态覆盖不全、验证器错误等问题导致训练不稳定。先前工作多通过奖励塑形或更密集监督来应对，但将这些组件视为固定不变，未从根本上解决。
AI.method: EAU作为元代理框架，训练中监控轨迹、工具调用、奖励与训练统计，诊断失败与无效交互，并针对用户模拟器、环境、奖励设计和RL配置提出修改方案；经校验的改动热替换进正在进行的训练流程，且改进跨运行持久化。用户与环境动态以可编辑符号表示，代理仍为用RL优化的神经LLM。
AI.result: 在三个交互式代理基准和两个骨干模型上，EAU持续优于先前RL方法，总体得分较最强基线提升14.7%–15.0%，ColBench任务成功率最高提升36.7%。
AI.conclusion: 将训练系统与策略协同进化可显著提升多轮RL效果，说明动态调整用户模拟器、环境和奖励设计是解决训练不稳定的有效途径。

title: Auditing Observation-Quality Shortcuts in the Evaluation of Person-Centered Motion for Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Video anomaly detection (VAD) identifies deviations from normal patterns, but such deviations do not necessarily correspond to safety-critical events. We focus on human-centered emergencies and violence and investigate whether motion-based anomaly discrimination reflects task-relevant motion information or observation-quality differences arising from person detection, pose estimation, and tracking. We introduce an observation-quality-aware evaluation framework that combines quality diagnostics, quality balancing, motion orthogonalization, and robustness analyses. On human-centered categories of UCF-Crime, quality-only features match or exceed the discrimination of multi-cue motion in the original cohort, revealing a strong observation-quality shortcut. After cardinality matching brings all 11 measured quality variables below a prespecified marginal balance threshold, multi-cue motion consistently outperforms quality-only features across Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and RBF-SVM, yielding ROC-AUC gains of 0.046-0.141. Because nonlinear quality-only prediction remains above chance after matching, we interpret this result as additional discrimination beyond measured marginal quality rather than as evidence of quality-free or causal motion understanding.
