These findings show that high VAD performance should not be interpreted as evidence of abnormal-motion modeling without auditing the reliability of the person-observation pipeline. Our study provides a systematic protocol for evaluating observation-quality shortcuts and for assessing whether motion-based discrimination survives explicit control of detection, pose-estimation, and tracking reliability.

AI.tldr: 提出"观测质量感知评估框架"，检验视频异常检测中基于运动的判别是否受人员检测、姿态估计与跟踪质量差异的混淆，发现存在强"观测质量捷径"。
AI.motivation: VAD将偏离正常模式视为异常，但偏离不等同于安全关键事件。作者关注以人为中心的紧急与暴力事件，质疑现有基于运动的异常判别究竟反映任务相关的运动信息，还是来自人员检测、姿态估计和跟踪等环节的观测质量差异（即质量捷径）。
AI.method: 在UCF-Crime以人为中心的类别上构建观测质量感知评估框架，包含四部分：质量诊断、质量平衡、运动正交化与稳健性分析。测量11个质量变量，并采用基数匹配（cardinality matching）使各质量变量的边际平衡均低于预设阈值，再比较"仅质量特征"与"多线索运动特征"的判别能力。
AI.result: 原始队列中，仅质量特征即可匹配甚至超过多线索运动的判别能力，揭示强观测质量捷径。基数匹配后，多线索运动在Logistic Regression、Random Forest、RBF-SVM上一致优于仅质量特征，ROC-AUC提升0.046–0.141。但匹配后非线性仅质量预测仍高于随机水平，说明这是超出已测边际质量之外的额外判别，而非无质量依赖或因果运动理解。
AI.conclusion: 高VAD性能不能直接解读为异常运动建模能力，必须审计人员观测流程的可靠性。研究提供了系统化协议，用于评估观测质量捷径，并检验运动判别在显式控制检测、姿态估计与跟踪可靠性后是否仍然成立。

title: TextualRL: Textual Reinforcement Learning for Context Management
summary: LLM agents can adapt to task feedback by revising the textual context that guides their behavior, without changing their model parameters. However, turning execution rewards into reusable context updates is challenging: individual trajectories offer limited comparative evidence about what to change, while task-specific fixes may overgeneralize when incorporated into a shared context. We introduce TextualRL, a gradient-free reinforcement learning framework that treats a group of rollouts from the same task under the same context, rather than an isolated trajectory, as the unit of policy critique. Groupwise Policy Critique contrasts successful and failed rollouts within a task; when outcomes are uniform, it draws on cross-task evidence to identify behaviors worth preserving or formulate repair hypotheses. Cross-Group Policy Update reviews the resulting proposals against evidence pooled across groups, including observations that yield no proposed edit, to refine their content and applicability. Reviewed proposals form a bounded textual patch, with adoption of the candidate context determined by held-out validation rewards. Together, these components establish a reward-driven policy optimization loop in which multiple attempts jointly inform reusable context updates. We evaluate TextualRL with five target agents on six benchmarks. Averaged over the six benchmarks, TextualRL improves test accuracy over the base model by 24.4 and 15.3 percentage points for GPT-5.5 and Qwen3.8-27B, respectively.

AI.tldr: TextualRL：一种无梯度的强化学习框架，以"同任务同上下文下的一组rollout（group）"而非单条轨迹为策略批评单元，通过组内对比、跨组证据审查与有界文本补丁生成可复用的上下文更新，并在留出验证奖励下决定是否采纳；在5个目标智能体、6个基准上，GPT-5.5与Qwen3.8-27B平均测试准确率分别提升24.4和15.3个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体可在不改动模型参数的前提下，通过修订引导其行为的文本上下文来适应任务反馈。但把执行奖励转化为可复用的上下文更新存在两个难点：一是单条轨迹提供的比较性证据有限，难以判断"该改什么"；二是针对具体任务的修补一旦写入共享上下文，容易过度泛化（overgeneralize），损害其他任务表现。因此需要一种能同时利用组内对比与跨任务证据、并控制更新适用范围的机制。
AI.method: TextualRL为无梯度强化学习框架，包含三部分。（1）Groupwise Policy Critique（组内策略批评）：以同一任务、同一上下文下的多个rollout作为批评单元，而非孤立轨迹；先在同一任务内对比成功与失败rollout以提取差异；当组内结果一致（全成功或全失败）时，转而借助跨任务证据，识别值得保留的行为或提出修复假设。（2）Cross-Group Policy Update（跨组策略更新）：将上述提议与跨组汇集的证据（包括未产生编辑提议的观测）进行对照审查，以精炼提议的内容与适用范围。（3）经审查的提议被整合为一个有界文本补丁（bounded textual patch），候选上下文是否被采纳由留出验证奖励（held-out validation rewards）决定。三者共同构成"奖励驱动的策略优化闭环"，使多次尝试共同产出可复用的上下文更新。
AI.result: 在5个目标智能体与6个基准上进行评估。六个基准平均而言，TextualRL相较基座模型在测试准确率上分别提升24.4个百分点（GPT-5.5）与15.3个百分点（Qwen3.8-27B）。
AI.conclusion: 以"组"为单位的策略批评并结合跨组证据审查，可在不更新模型参数的情况下，把执行奖励有效转化为有界、可复用且经验证把关的上下文更新，显著提升LLM智能体的任务表现，说明群体级对比与验证筛选是缓解单轨迹证据不足与任务特异性过度泛化的可行路径。

title: Does the Explanation Drift Before the Guarantee? Label-Free Early Warning on Evolving Graphs
summary: Deployed models can fail silently as the world they describe evolves. Attribution drift has served as an early warning in tabular data; we ask whether, in graph streams, a model's own explanations can forewarn the loss of nominal conformal coverage. Doing so requires repairing the naive drift statistic twice. A vanishing edge loses mask mass regardless of whether the model relied on it, so we condition the importance on edge presence. Evolving graphs also break edge identity: a relabelling that changes nothing shifts the identity-based statistic by 0.69 on synthetic graphs and 0.83 on real ego-networks, whereas aggregating over structural roles brings both to 0.0 and stays well-defined when the support changes. We test six pre-registered regimes on thirty seeds each. A two-channel monitor, tracking conditional mask mass and its distribution over roles, precedes coverage collapse by 8 to 14.5 steps across four gradual regimes (node addition, removal, replacement, and edge thinning), all surviving Holm correction. A sudden knockout yields the expected zero lead, and a harmless change triggers no alarm. Leads track the length of the transitional phase (Spearman 0.79 over 150 runs). On real transaction ego-networks, the untuned mass channel forewarns staged drift by 27 steps and is the only channel, attributional or structural, that never alarms on a stationary stream. The main limitation is that the mass channel is blind to covariate drift, which breaks the guarantee in every run; the distributional channel detects it and also rescues the rewiring regime, so we report the two channels separately rather than as a union.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究图流（graph stream）中模型自身解释能否提前预警名义共形覆盖（conformal coverage）的失效，提出条件化掩码质量与角色分布的双通道监测器，可在覆盖崩溃前8-14.5步预警。
AI.motivation: 世界演化会导致已部署模型静默失效。表格数据中归因漂移（attribution drift）可作为早期预警，但图流场景下边身份不稳定、边消失会无差别降低掩码质量，朴素漂移统计量不可用，因此需检验模型解释能否预警共形覆盖的丧失。
AI.method: 对朴素漂移统计量做两处修正：（1）以边存在为条件，将重要性条件化于边出现，避免消失边无差别损失掩码质量；（2）按结构角色聚合，替代基于边身份的统计量以应对重标记不变性。基于此构建双通道监测器，分别追踪条件掩码质量及其在角色上的分布。
AI.result: 在六个预注册机制各30个种子上：双通道监测器在四种渐变机制（节点增、删、替换、边稀疏化）中领先覆盖崩溃8–14.5步，均通过Holm校正；突然剔除机制零领先符合预期；无害变化不触发警报。领先步数与过渡期长度相关（150次运行Spearman 0.79）。真实交易自我网络中，未调参的质量通道提前27步预警分阶段漂移，且是唯一在平稳流上从不报警的通道。质量通道对协变量漂移盲区，每次运行都会破坏保证；分布通道可检测该漂移并挽救重连机制。
AI.conclusion: 模型自身的归因解释可作为图流中共形覆盖失效的早期预警信号，但需以边存在为条件并按结构角色聚合。两通道能力互补，应分别报告而非取并集：质量通道对协变量漂移无效，分布通道可弥补。

title: MiMaAlign: Hierarchical Micro-Macro Alignment for Physically Plausible Video Generation
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models have made remarkable progress in generating high-fidelity visuals, yet their outputs still often exhibit physically implausible phenomena, including discontinuous dynamics and implausible event interactions. Existing representation alignment methods mainly transfer generic video features or short-range motion cues, treating physical plausibility as a single-level representation problem. To address this issue, we propose MiMaAlign, a hierarchical micro-macro alignment framework that transfers complementary dynamics-oriented and event-oriented knowledge into different abstraction depths of a pretrained video diffusion model. Specifically, micro-level continuous dynamics alignment imposes constraints by aligning diffusion features with a continuous-time motion representation learned by a Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (Neural ODE), while macro-level event-commonsense alignment provides representations of object interactions and event semantics through an instruction-prompted vision-language model (VLM). With training-only auxiliary objectives, we align the complementary supervision from the two teachers with shallower and deeper generator features, respectively, enabling the generator to internalize the corresponding physical priors. Empirical evaluations show that, on CogVideoX-2B, MiMaAlign achieves a relative improvement of up to 21.0% in the Physical Commonsense (PC) score on the VideoPhy benchmark over the baseline, and also delivers substantial gains on the highly challenging VideoPhy2 benchmark, while maintaining general video quality on VBench and being supported by blind user comparisons.

AI.tldr: 提出MiMaAlign分层微观-宏观对齐框架，将连续动力学与事件常识知识迁移到视频扩散模型不同抽象深度，提升生成视频的物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有T2V扩散模型生成的高保真视频常出现物理不合理现象（如动态不连续、事件交互不合理）。现有表征对齐方法主要迁移通用视频特征或短程运动线索，将物理合理性视为单层表征问题，忽略了其多层次本质。
AI.method: MiMaAlign在生成器浅层和深层分别对齐两个教师的互补监督：微观层连续动力学对齐，用Neural ODE学到的连续时间运动表征约束扩散特征；宏观层事件常识对齐，通过指令提示的VLM提供物体交互与事件语义表征。两个辅助目标仅用于训练。
AI.result: 在CogVideoX-2B上，VideoPhy基准的Physical Commonsense（PC）分数较基线最高相对提升21.0%，在VideoPhy2基准上也有显著增益；同时在VBench上保持通用视频质量，并获得盲测用户对比支持。
AI.conclusion: 将物理合理性分解为微观动力学与宏观事件常识两个层次，并与生成器不同抽象深度特征对齐，可有效提升T2V扩散模型的物理合理性，且不损害通用视频质量。

title: PACT: A Pragmatic Prompting Framework for Expressive and Voice-Preserving Speech-to-Speech Translation
summary: Speech-to-speech translation should preserve not only what is said, but also who says it and how it is said. Existing end-to-end S2ST, speech MLLM, and cascade systems can preserve content or timbre, but often struggle to realize emotion, tone, rhythm, pauses, and pragmatic attitude in the target language. We propose PACT, a target-space pragmatic prompting framework for expressive and voice-preserving S2ST. PACT extracts source pragmatic cues, projects them into the target-language expression space, calibrates the projected representation to a realizable target subspace, and converts it into continuous prompts for a frozen speech generator. On bidirectional Spanish-English TOPI evaluation, PACT achieves the best overall performance among evaluated systems across content fidelity, voice preservation, and expression preservation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACT，一个面向目标语言空间的语用提示框架，用于实现富有表现力且保留说话人音色的语音到语音翻译（S2ST）。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端S2ST、语音多模态大模型及级联系统虽能保留内容或音色，但难以在目标语言中还原情感、语气、节奏、停顿及语用态度，即"怎么说"和"谁在说"的信息丢失。
AI.method: PACT提取源语言语用线索，将其投影到目标语言表达空间，校准投影表示至可实现的目标准子空间，再转化为连续提示输入冻结的语音生成器。
AI.result: 在双向西班牙语-英语TOPI评测中，PACT在内容保真度、音色保留与表达保留指标上取得所评估系统中的最佳整体表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过目标空间语用提示，PACT有效兼顾内容、音色与表达保留，优于现有S2ST方案。

title: Overtaught, Underlearned: Learner-Centered Distillation from Multi-Agent Discussion
summary: Multi-agent discussion produces reasoning collaboratively, while deployment still relies on a smaller student that must answer alone. Full-graph distillation transfers such discussions by treating each correct solution as a separate training target, but what teachers provide need not match what the student learns. This mismatch appears in two ways: several correct solutions may amount to the same lesson in the student's representation (over-teaching), while some training questions remain missed after learning (under-learning). We quantify both with rates that are high on discussion graphs. To address them, we introduce FAR (Fold--Attempt--Revisit), a learner-centered distillation procedure that organizes supervision around the student's own state. Before training, FAR folds solutions within each discussion state into representative lessons. After training, the student's own attempts identify missed questions, while poorly represented clusters indicate where folding may have lost useful variation; FAR then writes targeted lessons from retained discussion contexts. Across two students and four reasoning tasks, FAR outperforms full-graph distillation with far fewer training targets and lower under-learning. Further analyses examine the behavior of FAR and the sources of its gains. Overall, the results show that organizing discussion supervision around the student can make distillation both more effective and more efficient.

AI.tldr: 提出以学生为中心的蒸馏方法FAR，通过折叠-尝试-重访流程组织多智能体讨论监督，在减少训练目标的同时提升蒸馏效果与效率。
AI.motivation: 多智能体讨论可协作产生推理，但部署时依赖较小的学生模型独立作答。全图蒸馏将每个正确解视为独立训练目标，但教师提供的监督与学生实际学习之间存在不匹配：一是多个正确解在学生表征中等价（过度教学），二是部分训练问题学习后仍未被掌握（学习不足）。作者用比率量化这两类问题，发现在讨论图上比率很高。
AI.method: 提出FAR（Fold–Attempt–Revisit）以学习者为中心的蒸馏流程：训练前，将每个讨论状态内的解折叠为代表性课程；训练后，用学生自身的尝试识别遗漏问题，并根据表征不佳的聚类定位折叠可能丢失有用变化之处，再从保留的讨论上下文中撰写针对性课程。
AI.result: 在两个学生模型和四个推理任务上，FAR以远更少的训练目标超越全图蒸馏，并降低学习不足。进一步分析考察了FAR的行为及其增益来源。
AI.conclusion: 围绕学生组织讨论监督可使蒸馏既更有效又更高效。

title: Self-Verifier Capture in Unified Visual Generators: Diagnosing and Repairing Closed-Loop Self-Reward
summary: Image-space reward requires decoding and a separate judge; unified visual generators can instead reuse their understanding pathway for decode-free, self-supplied reward. Optimizing against this verifier closes the self-reward loop; shared trainable weights let one update move generation and scoring even with the reward gradient stopped. We call the resulting failure self-verifier capture: self-reward rises while independently measured quality falls. Matched semantic/denoising by shared/frozen cells on Scale-RAE isolate two routes: the policy exploits on-manifold blind spots of a frozen semantic judge, while shared updates additionally rewrite the judge. A frozen judge also becomes stale, and repeated self-refresh yields progressively weaker recoveries. The diagnosis yields a two-part repair: locking the warmed reward read blocks rewriting, while sparse, parameter-disjoint external anchors counter residual exploitation. Unanchored rollouts retain semantic reward across multiple latent noise levels, providing dense latent reward that terminal image-space judging cannot supply, while a drift-triggered controller allocates anchors to high-drift rollouts and propagates their calibration within each group. At matched budgets, the controller improves on fixed-dose anchoring, increasingly so as coverage tightens. Both the unanchored failure and the repair transfer to the higher-performing, architecturally distinct Show-o2. Across both bases, the complete method significantly outperforms a construct-matched every-rollout judge on GenEval and DPG-Bench while externally scoring only 1/16 of rollouts. At 1/32 coverage, it scores higher in all four comparisons and remains jointly non-inferior.

AI.tldr: 统一视觉生成器可将自身理解通路复用为无解码、自供给的奖励，但由此形成"自验证器俘获"失败模式：自奖励上升而独立评测质量下降；本文诊断出两条俘获路径并提出"锁暖读+稀疏外部锚点"的两段式修复，配合漂移触发控制器，在1/16外部评分预算下显著优于逐样本评判基线，并可迁移至Show-o2。
AI.motivation: 图像空间奖励需解码并依赖独立评判器，代价高且不共享梯度；统一视觉生成器本可复用理解通路实现无解码自奖励，但优化该自验证器会形成闭环，导致奖励被"俘获"。作者旨在揭示并量化这一失败模式，并给出可迁移的修复方案。
AI.method: 在Scale-RAE上以共享/冻结单元匹配语义与去噪，隔离出两条路径：(1)策略利用冻结语义评判器的流形内盲点；(2)共享权重更新直接改写评判器。修复分两部分：锁定已预热的奖励读取块以阻断改写；引入稀疏、参数不相交的外部锚点抵抗残余利用。采用漂移触发控制器，将锚点分配给高漂移rollout并在组内传播其校准。用无锚点rollout在多个潜噪声水平上获得密集潜空间奖励。
AI.result: 冻结评判器会随训练变陈旧，反复自刷新导致恢复能力递减。匹配预算下，漂移触发控制器优于固定剂量锚点，覆盖越紧优势越明显。完整方法在GenEval与DPG-Bench上仅外部评分1/16 rollout即显著优于构造匹配的逐rollout评判器；在1/32覆盖下四项比较得分更高且联合非劣。失败与修复均可迁移至架构不同的Show-o2。
AI.conclusion: 统一生成器的自奖励若不加约束会陷入自验证器俘获；锁定预热奖励读取可阻断权重改写，稀疏参数不相交外部锚点配合漂移触发分配能以极低外部评分预算（1/16甚至1/32）维持并提升真实生成质量，且方法具备跨架构可迁移性。

title: Are We Testing Too Much? A Survey of Benchmark Compression for Efficient Evaluation of Large Language Models
summary: Benchmarks are essential for evaluating and improving large language models (LLMs). Yet many widely used benchmarks are redundant, making evaluation unnecessarily expensive. Benchmark compression lowers this cost by estimating full-benchmark scores and rankings from a partial evaluation. Research in this area has grown rapidly since 2024, but to our knowledge no survey has systematically organized its methods and findings. We review 119 papers to explain how methods choose what to evaluate, recover full-benchmark results, and verify their reliability. From this analysis, we develop a taxonomy covering compression within individual benchmarks, across benchmark suites, and during adaptive evaluation, together with work on redundancy and reliability. We compare their information needs, total costs, reliability checks, and limitations. Methods reduce evaluation costs by selecting representative subsets, using cheaper or reusable information, and testing adaptively, but risk poor coverage, inaccurate estimates, and sequential delays. The resulting taxonomy and practical guide help researchers choose, validate, and deploy methods for more efficient and reliable LLM evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了119篇关于LLM基准压缩的论文，系统梳理了如何选择评测样本、恢复全基准结果并验证可靠性，提出了涵盖单项基准确压缩、基准套件间压缩、自适应评测以及冗余与可靠性研究的分类体系，并给出实践指南。
AI.motivation: 许多广泛使用的LLM基准存在冗余，导致评测成本过高。基准压缩通过部分评测来估计全基准分数与排名，可降低成本。该领域自2024年以来快速发展，但尚无综述系统整理其方法与发现。
AI.method: 对119篇相关论文进行综述，分析这些方法如何决定评测对象、如何恢复全基准结果以及如何验证可靠性，并据此构建分类体系。
AI.result: 提出覆盖单项基准确压缩、基准套件间压缩、自适应评测以及冗余与可靠性研究的分类体系，并对比了这些方法的信息需求、总成本、可靠性检查与局限性。方法通过选取代表性子集、使用更廉价或可复用信息以及自适应测试来降低评测成本。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的分类体系与实践指南可帮助研究者选择、验证和部署更高效、更可靠的LLM评测方法，同时需注意覆盖率不足、估计不准和序贯延迟等风险。

title: Making Language the Low-Rate Code of Vision: Successive Refinement from Words to Pixels
comment: 21 pages, 3 main figures, 5 main tables, with supplementary material
summary: An ordered visual code lets a short prefix stand in for an image, and the training loss decides what that prefix contains. Under pixel reconstruction the first bits go to the directions of highest variance, and we prove that a caption can then be independent of the entire first half of a code that is rate-optimal for pixels at every length. In the rate-distortion sense a caption is therefore not the low-rate code of its image, unless the code is built to make it one. We study that construction and what it costs. We cast captioning and text-to-image generation as successive refinement under a distortion measure that changes along the code, from caption log-loss in the early stages to pixel distortion in the last, so that each stage is compared with its own optimum. Putting words first then costs nothing among the caption stages exactly when the captions form a summarization chain, and it costs the pixels at most the caption uncertainty left in a pixel-optimal reconstruction, which is large for short prefixes and small at full length. We build RUNG, an ordered code whose prefixes are supervised by a summarization ladder of captions and whose full length reconstructs the image; generation extends the code past the prompt and captioning truncates it. With data and capacity held fixed, ordering by language instead of reconstruction raises prefix-caption information 2.9 times and GenEval from 0.76 to 0.83, at a measured cost of 2.8 dB PSNR at a quarter of the code and 0.1 dB at full length. RUNG-XL (3.4B) reaches 0.88 GenEval and 87.6 DPG-Bench in 32 network evaluations and 0.91 GenEval when errors are redrawn at the rung where they appear; its coarse and fine captions agree 94.1% of the time, and it edits images without inversion.

AI.tldr: 本文将图像编码为有序码（ordered code），其前缀由字幕监督、全长重构图像；证明速率最优的像素码中字幕可与前半段码无关，提出在码上变化的失真度量下用逐次细化（successive refinement）框架统一字幕与文生图，构建 RUNG 并取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 在像素重构目标下，码的前缀主要编码高方差方向，字幕可能独立于整段前缀，因此在率失真意义下，字幕并非图像的低速率码。作者希望研究如何构造使字幕成为图像低速率码的有序码，并量化这样做的代价。
AI.method: 将字幕与文生图建模为失真度量沿码变化的逐次细化问题：早期阶段使用字幕对数损失，最后阶段使用像素失真，使每阶段与各自最优解比较；据此构建 RUNG——一种有序码，其前缀由字幕的摘要阶梯（summarization ladder）监督，全长重构图像，生成任务为延长码、字幕任务为截断码。
AI.result: 在数据与容量固定时，以语言而非重构排序使前缀-字幕互信息提升 2.9 倍，GenEval 从 0.76 升至 0.83；代价是四分之一码长处 PSNR 下降 2.8 dB，全长仅下降 0.1 dB。RUNG-XL（3.4B）在 32 次网络评估下达到 0.88 GenEval 与 87.6 DPG-Bench，在误差重绘时达 0.91 GenEval；粗细字幕一致率 94.1%，且无需反演即可编辑图像。
AI.conclusion: 通过语言优先的有序码设计，可在几乎不损失全长像素质量的前提下大幅提升前缀-字幕信息与生成质量，验证了"字幕作为图像低速率码"需要专门构造而非自然涌现的观点。

title: KARAMEL: Knowledge-Aware Ranking for Multimodal Entity Linking in the Arts via Heterogeneous Graphs
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables, journal: Machine Learning
summary: Discovering and disambiguating entities from multimodal and heterogeneous data is a key challenge in discovery science, where relevant knowledge is often implicit and distributed across modalities. We present KARAMEL, a framework for multimodal entity linking (MEL) - the task of aligning visual and textual mentions to entities in a knowledge base - in the cultural heritage domain. Unlike prior vision-language models that primarily rely on surface-level multimodal alignment, our approach incorporates sociohistorical and contextual knowledge through a knowledge-aware architecture that fuses a vision-language encoder with a heterogeneous graph neural network. This design enables contextual reasoning over complex relational structures and supports robust entity disambiguation under ambiguous or underspecified evidence. To benchmark multimodal discovery in this setting, we introduce WikiMuSA (Wikidata-based Multimodal Semantic data for Art), a new dataset that links artworks to Wikidata entities via images, textual descriptions, and structured contextual knowledge. Experimental results show that KARAMEL surpasses strong baselines, particularly on implicit or abstract mentions, while ablation studies highlight the critical role of domain-specific, structured context in learning expressive representations. While instantiated in the cultural heritage domain, KARAMEL addresses a general knowledge discovery problem and applies to other scientific settings involving multimodal observations and heterogeneous background knowledge. Both the dataset and source code are made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KARAMEL——一个面向文化遗产领域的多模态实体链接（MEL）框架，通过融合视觉-语言编码器与异质图神经网络引入社会历史与上下文知识，并发布WikiMuSA数据集，实验证明其在隐式或抽象提及上优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 从多模态、异质数据中发现与消歧实体是发现科学的关键挑战，相关知识往往隐式且分散于不同模态。现有视觉-语言模型多依赖表层多模态对齐，难以在证据模糊或欠指定时进行稳健的实体消歧，尤其在需要社会历史与上下文知识的文化遗产领域。
AI.method: 提出KARAMEL知识感知架构，将视觉-语言编码器与异质图神经网络融合，对复杂关系结构进行上下文推理；并构建WikiMuSA数据集，通过图像、文本描述与结构化上下文知识将艺术作品链接至Wikidata实体。
AI.result: KARAMEL在实验中超越强基线，尤其在隐式或抽象提及上表现更优；消融研究表明领域特定的结构化上下文对学习高表达能力表示起关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 尽管KARAMEL在文化遗产领域实例化，但其解决的是通用知识发现问题，可推广至其他涉及多模态观测与异质背景知识的科学场景；数据集与源代码已公开。

title: PAINT: A Framework for Multilingual Pain Representation from Medical Licensing Exams to Real-World Clinical Texts
comment: Accepted at Proceedings of the 6th Workshop on Multilingual Representation Learning (MRL 2026), EMNLP 2026, Budapest
summary: Pain is one of the most common and clinically important symptoms, reflecting disease onset, progression, and treatment response. However, pain is difficult to accurately capture and interpret from medical text, as its expression varies across languages, documentation types, and patient demographics, and is often embedded in terminology, negation, temporality, and contextual descriptions. Existing pain-related studies remain largely monolingual or limited to narrow clinical settings. In this study, we introduce PAINT, a multilingual framework for studying pain representation across medical exams and real-world clinical texts. PAINT includes nine pain-focused dataset partitions spanning English, Spanish, Portuguese, and Japanese, with clinician annotations in all four languages. We curated a structured schema covering pain relevance, pain presence, anatomical location, pain descriptors, and demographic information. To capture multilingual pain representations, we leverage large language models (LLMs) and adopt an ensemble strategy to improve performance. Ten clinicians across four languages validate the labels: the ensemble reaches macro-F1 of 0.91-1.00 on pain relevance and pain presence and 92-100% accuracy on demographics, with inter-annotator $κ$ of 0.82-1.00. We release the WorldMedQA-Pain ensemble labels, the extraction pipeline, validation scripts, and clinician annotation sheets for publicly licensed corpora, providing a foundation for pain-centered clinical NLP and for studying pain documentation across languages and healthcare contexts.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出多语言疼痛表示框架PAINT，涵盖英、西、葡、日四种语言的九个数据集分区，利用大语言模型集成策略提取疼痛相关信息，性能达宏F1 0.91-1.00。
AI.motivation: 疼痛是常见且临床重要的症状，但从医学文本中准确捕捉和解读疼痛十分困难，因其表达随语言、文档类型和患者人口学特征而异，且常涉及术语、否定、时间性和语境描述。现有疼痛相关研究多局限于单一语言或狭窄临床场景，缺乏跨语言、跨医疗情境的系统性研究。
AI.method: 构建PAINT多语言框架，包含覆盖英语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语和日语的九个疼痛聚焦数据集分区，四语均有临床医生标注。设计结构化标注模式，涵盖疼痛相关性、疼痛存在性、解剖位置、疼痛描述词和人口学信息。采用大语言模型并运用集成策略捕捉多语言疼痛表示。由四种语言的十名临床医生验证标签。
AI.result: 集成方法在疼痛相关性和疼痛存在性上达到宏F1 0.91-1.00，人口学信息准确率92-100%，标注者间一致性κ为0.82-1.00。公开发布WorldMedQA-Pain集成标签、提取流程、验证脚本及临床医生标注表。
AI.conclusion: PAINT为以疼痛为中心的临床自然语言处理奠定基础，支持跨语言和跨医疗情境研究疼痛记录，推动多语言临床NLP发展。

title: AI Discovery in Combinatorics: From Problems to Solutions and Back to Bigger Problems
summary: We introduce $qt$Bench, a benchmark of 29 open problems in algebraic combinatorics. These problems ask for a simple combinatorial algorithm that explains given polynomial coefficients or identities. To help AI agents search for such algorithms, we provide a scaffold for playing with combinatorial objects, countering cheating attempts, and testing candidate solutions. To explore how far frontier AI systems can go on these problems, we collaborated with OpenAI, whose researchers obtained proposed solutions to several of them. This highlights bigger meta-problems: is AI discovery at scale ethical? How should these results be released? How should proof digestion be organized? We discuss these questions and give our views.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 qtBench——一个包含29个代数组合学开放问题的基准，要求给出解释多项式系数或恒等式的简单组合算法；配套提供组合对象操作、反作弊与候选解测试脚手架，并与OpenAI合作探索前沿AI的求解上限。
AI.motivation: 代数组合学中许多多项式系数与恒等式缺乏简洁的组合解释，此类开放问题长期依赖人类直觉。作者希望借助AI agent系统性搜索这类组合算法，同时借此考察AI大规模"发现"所引发的伦理、成果发布与证明消化等元问题。
AI.method: 构建qtBench基准，收录29个开放问题；设计脚手架支持组合对象实验、防作弊机制及候选解验证；与OpenAI研究人员协作，让前沿AI系统尝试求解部分问题。
AI.result: OpenAI研究者对其中若干问题给出了候选解，表明当前前沿AI系统在这类问题上具备一定推进能力；同时暴露出AI发现规模化带来的伦理、发布和证明消化等更大元问题。
AI.conclusion: qtBench既是对AI数学发现能力的测试平台，也促使学界正视AI辅助发现的规范问题；作者就伦理、成果发布与证明消化组织方式给出观点与建议。

title: Deep Learning-based Mechanical Characterization of Synthetically Generated Plant Fibers under Transverse Compression
summary: Plant fibers are increasingly used as sustainable reinforcements in composites, but the intrinsic variability of their microstructure causes substantial scatter in transverse mechanical behavior, complicating composite design. Characterizing this behavior relies on finite element (FE) simulations requiring several minutes of high-performance computing per fiber, making high-throughput characterization across realistic fiber populations impractical. In this study, we propose a deep learning framework replacing this FE bottleneck with a fast pipeline. It includes two coupled recursive U-Nets predicting the step-by-step evolution of fiber deformation and internal stress fields under transverse compression, followed by a regression CNN estimating the transverse Young's modulus from the final stress field. Unlike prior approaches predicting stress fields for fixed configurations or idealized geometries, our framework recursively resolves the full temporal stress evolution for synthetic fibers derived from real hemp cross-sections, with or without a lumen. Trained on 1,000 synthetic fiber geometries with FE ground truth, it reproduces the stress field sequence with a Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) of $0.9574 \pm 0.0074$ and a Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of $0.0345 \pm 0.0079$. It estimates transverse Young's modulus with an $R^2$ of $0.938 \pm 0.024$, a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of $24.31 \pm 1.23$ MPa, and a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of $5.25 \pm 0.91\%$. Inference requires under one second per fiber versus five minutes per FE simulation, drastically reducing computational cost. This offers a fast, reliable tool for mechanical characterization of synthetic plant fibers, with promising applications in designing natural fiber-reinforced composites.

AI.tldr: 提出深度学习框架替代有限元模拟，快速预测植物纤维横向压缩下应力场演化与横向杨氏模量。
AI.motivation: 植物纤维微观结构固有变异性导致横向力学行为离散大，传统有限元模拟每根纤维耗时数分钟，难以对真实纤维群体进行高通量表征，制约复合材料设计。
AI.method: 构建两个耦合递归U-Net，逐步预测横向压缩下纤维变形与内部应力场的时间演化；随后用回归CNN从最终应力场估计横向杨氏模量。基于真实大麻横截面生成含/不含腔的合成纤维，用1,000个几何样本及FE真值训练。
AI.result: 应力场序列重建SSIM为0.9574±0.0074，RMSE为0.0345±0.0079；横向杨氏模量估计R²=0.938±0.024，MAE=24.31±1.23 MPa，MAPE=5.25±0.91%。单根纤维推理不足1秒，而FE需5分钟。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为合成植物纤维力学表征提供快速可靠工具，显著降低计算成本，有望应用于天然纤维增强复合材料设计。

title: JevGPT: Thinking Fast and Slow in Autonomous Research
summary: Autonomous research agents must acquire and reason over evidence within a limited budget. Yet relevant sources can remain uninspected or unused, leaving a gap between retrieval coverage and the evidence that informs research. The challenge is to align fast local judgments with changing evidence needs and feed their findings back into research decisions. We introduce JevGPT, a dual-system architecture for autonomous research that couples fast evidence processing with deliberative research planning. System Two sets evidence objectives and integrates findings, while System One locates support, assesses relevance, and guides further inspection. Independent source judgments run in parallel; selected original passages inform the next research step. Experiments on fixed-corpus question answering and document ranking show that JevGPT achieves leading task performance, with faster completion and lower cost than comparably effective research agents. Evidence analysis shows broader source inspection and greater coverage of supporting documents in the research loop, highlighting efficient evidence processing as a route to more capable autonomous research.

AI.tldr: 提出JevGPT双系统架构，将快速证据处理与审慎研究规划耦合，在固定语料问答与文档排序任务上取得领先性能，且更快、成本更低，并扩大了证据检索覆盖。
AI.motivation: 自主研究智能体需在有限预算内获取并推理证据，但相关来源常未被检查或使用，检索覆盖与真正影响研究决策的证据之间存在落差。核心挑战在于让快速的局部判断与不断变化的证据需求对齐，并将发现反馈到研究决策中。
AI.method: 提出JevGPT双系统架构：System Two负责设定证据目标并整合发现；System One负责定位支撑、评估相关性并指导后续检查。独立来源判断并行执行，被选中的原始段落用于指导下一步研究。
AI.result: 在固定语料问答和文档排序实验中，JevGPT达到领先的任务性能，同时比同等有效的研究智能体完成更快、成本更低。证据分析显示研究循环中检查来源更广、支持性文档覆盖更高。
AI.conclusion: 高效的证据处理是实现更强自主研究能力的有效途径，双系统耦合有助于弥合检索覆盖与研究决策之间的差距。

title: G$^2$WAM: World Action Models for Efficient and Geometry Grounded Image-Goal Navigation
summary: World models capture environment dynamics and support counterfactual reasoning for planning. In image-goal navigation, where the target often lies beyond the current field of view, the agent must not only model environmental dynamics but also maintain a persistent spatial memory of the scene. Existing approaches either introduce spatial context by fine-tuning pretrained models on the target task, which underexploits their spatial priors, or rely on external 3D reconstruction, which is computationally expensive for real-world deployment. In this paper, we propose the Geometry Grounded World Action Model (G$^2$WAM) for image-goal navigation. G$^2$WAM encodes spatial cues through a learned scene-coordinate localization module that anchors the current, goal, and history frames in a common reference frame, yielding a stable and consistent spatial context that enables efficient navigation without explicit 3D reconstruction. Following the world-action-model paradigm, G$^2$WAM jointly predicts future states and actions, eliminating the need for costly cross-entropy method (CEM) style planning. In addition, G$^2$WAM operates entirely in latent space, avoiding the computational burden of pixel-level reconstruction and substantially reducing inference cost. Across four trajectory prediction benchmarks, G$^2$WAM reduces average ATE and RPE by 40.1% and 35.2%, respectively. In closed-loop navigation experiments, it improves the success rate from 54.0% to 63.0% and the success weighted by path length (SPL) from 36.4% to 59.2%, while maintaining high efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出G$^2$WAM（几何基础世界动作模型），用于图像目标导航。通过场景坐标定位模块将当前、目标与历史帧锚定在统一参考系中，构建稳定的空间上下文；在世界动作建模范式下联合预测未来状态与动作，避免CEM式规划，并全程在潜空间运行。实验显示轨迹预测ATE/RPE分别降低40.1%/35.2%，闭环导航成功率从54.0%提升至63.0%，SPL从36.4%提升至59.2%。
AI.motivation: 图像目标导航中目标常超出当前视野，智能体需在建模环境动力学的同时维护持久空间记忆。现有方法存在两大不足：一是在目标任务上微调预训练模型以引入空间上下文，未能充分利用其空间先验；二是依赖外部3D重建，计算代价高，难以在实际部署中应用。
AI.method: 提出Geometry Grounded World Action Model（G$^2$WAM）。核心是通过可学习的场景坐标定位模块编码空间线索，将当前帧、目标帧与历史帧锚定在共同参考系中，获得稳定一致的空间上下文，无需显式3D重建。遵循世界动作建模范式，联合预测未来状态与动作，省去高昂的CEM式规划；全程在潜空间操作，避免像素级重建的计算负担，显著降低推理成本。
AI.result: 在四个轨迹预测基准上，平均ATE降低40.1%，RPE降低35.2%；闭环导航实验中，成功率由54.0%提升至63.0%，SPL由36.4%提升至59.2%，同时保持较高效率。
AI.conclusion: G$^2$WAM通过将几何定位与空间记忆统一到世界动作模型中，在潜空间内实现高效且一致的图像目标导航，兼顾精度与效率，验证了无需显式3D重建的可行性。

title: Heuristics are Not Enough: Calibrated and Corrected Caching for Video Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Feature caching has become a mainstream training-free strategy for accelerating video diffusion models by reusing intermediate outputs across denoising steps. However, existing adaptive methods rely on heuristic difference measures misaligned with actual generation quality, employ a single global threshold that ignores heterogeneous phase dynamics, and never validate their budget estimates against true approximation error, allowing systematic bias to propagate uncorrected. We propose \textbf{AlignCache}, a closed-loop caching framework that directly aligns scheduling decisions with their true influence on the final generated video through three tightly coupled components: (1) phase-adaptive budget routing that partitions the denoising trajectory into structurally distinct phases, each governed by an independent threshold and a staleness-aware guard; (2) closed-loop threshold calibration that exploits counterfactual error measurement at the classifier-free guided output level to adjust decision boundaries online via an EMA feedback loop; and (3) momentum-augmented draft synthesis combining direction-magnitude gated residual extrapolation with anchor-guided unconditional correction. By transforming scheduling from a static risk accumulator into a feedback-driven, self-correcting controller, AlignCache consistently achieves superior acceleration-quality trade-offs across state-of-the-art video generation models. Our code is available at https://github.com/jiangjyjy/AlignCache.

AI.tldr: 提出AlignCache闭环缓存框架，通过对齐调度决策与真实生成质量影响，在视频扩散模型上实现更优的加速-质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练特征缓存加速方法存在三大缺陷：启发式差异度量与真实生成质量不一致；单一全局阈值忽略去噪过程的异质动态；预算估计从未用真实近似误差验证，导致系统性偏差持续传播。
AI.method: 包含三个紧耦合组件：(1) 相位自适应预算路由，将去噪轨迹划分成结构不同的相位，每个相位由独立阈值与陈旧度感知保护机制控制；(2) 闭环阈值校准，在无分类器引导输出层面利用反事实误差测量，通过EMA反馈回路在线调整决策边界；(3) 动量增强的草稿合成，结合方向-幅度门控残差外推与锚点引导的无条件校正。
AI.result: 在多个当前最先进的视频生成模型上，AlignCache均能持续取得更优的加速-质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: AlignCache将缓存调度从静态风险累加器转变为反馈驱动的自校正控制器，验证了闭环对齐策略在视频扩散加速中的有效性，代码已开源。

title: LegalRewardBench: Benchmarking Reward Models for Legal Preference Evaluation
summary: Reward models are central to preference alignment for legal tasks, yet existing reward model benchmarks are still primarily centered on general-domain preferences. In this work, we introduce LegalRewardBench, the first human-verified benchmark for evaluating reward models in the legal domain. The benchmark organizes legal preference evaluation into five capability levels: knowledge, understanding, analysis, decision, and writing, and preference examples are constructed through rubric-guided automatic judging combined with human verification. We evaluate three families of judges, covering both general and fine-tuned models, and generative and discriminative architectures. Experimental results show that strong general-purpose generative models are currently the most robust legal reward models, while existing fine-tuned reward models transfer less reliably to legal preference evaluation. We also conduct detailed comparisons of input organizations and training strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LegalRewardBench，首个经人工验证的法律领域奖励模型评测基准，将法律偏好评测划分为知识、理解、分析、决策、写作五个能力层级，并据此评测通用与微调、生成式与判别式三类评判模型。结果显示通用生成式大模型表现最稳健，现有微调奖励模型在法律偏好评测上迁移性较差。
AI.motivation: 奖励模型是法律任务偏好对齐的核心组件，但现有奖励模型基准主要聚焦通用领域偏好，缺乏针对法律领域的评测手段，难以衡量奖励模型在法律场景下的真实能力。
AI.method: 构建LegalRewardBench：将法律偏好评测组织为知识、理解、分析、决策、写作五个能力层级；通过评分量表（rubric）引导的自动评判结合人工验证来构造偏好样本；评测覆盖通用与微调模型、生成式与判别式架构三类评判模型家族，并对输入组织方式与训练策略进行对比分析。
AI.result: 实验表明，强通用生成式模型目前是最稳健的法律奖励模型；现有微调奖励模型向法律偏好评测迁移的可靠性较低；输入组织方式与训练策略的对比进一步揭示了不同评判模型的表现差异。
AI.conclusion: 法律领域奖励模型评测仍有较大提升空间，通用生成式模型暂为更优选择，未来需针对法律偏好发展更可靠的奖励模型与训练策略。

title: Prompt or Policy? Optimizing Physician Slate Presentations with LLM User Simulators
summary: Choosing the right physician is a key challenge for patients seeking medical care. Physician recommendation systems identify relevant doctors, but patients still find it difficult to compare their profiles to make a decision. We formulate slate presentation optimization: given a patient's medical case and a fixed, ranked list of physicians, we generate short, case-specific summaries that make doctors easier to compare, while remaining grounded in the information in their profiles. To optimize physician presentations without relying on real patient interactions, we develop an offline framework that uses persona-conditioned LLMs to simulate patient choices. We generate patient personas from attributes extracted from each medical case and evaluate presentations for factual accuracy, relevance, naturalness and simulated patient choice. We also use a second LLM judge, unseen during optimization, to assess simulator-specific overfitting. We compare automatic prompt-level optimization with GEPA, parameter-level optimization with GRPO, and their combination across two model sizes. GRPO substantially outperforms GEPA in satisfying the full set of constraints, and its gains in simulated conversion persist under the unseen judge. GEPA alone brings smaller improvements, but using its optimized prompt to initialize GRPO speeds up training and achieves the highest simulated conversion. These results show that prompt-level and parameter-level optimization play complementary roles in improving how physician recommendations are presented.

AI.tldr: 提出医生列表展示优化任务，用LLM患者模拟器离线评测，比较GEPA提示优化、GRPO参数优化及二者组合，发现GRPO优于GEPA，组合方式模拟转化最高。
AI.motivation: 患者在选择医生时难以比较医生档案以做出决策；现有医生推荐系统仅识别相关医生，未解决档案可比性与展示问题。同时缺乏真实患者交互数据，需要可离线优化的评测框架。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为slate presentation optimization：给定病例与固定排序的医生列表，生成简短、病例特异且忠于档案的摘要。用persona-conditioned LLM模拟患者选择，患者persona由病例属性抽取；从事实准确性、相关性、自然性及模拟选择四方面评估。另用优化过程中不可见的第二LLM judge检测模拟器过拟合。对比GEPA（提示级）、GRPO（参数级）及二者组合，并在两种模型规模上实验。
AI.result: GRPO在满足全部约束上显著优于GEPA，其模拟转化收益在未见judge下仍保持；GEPA单独提升较小，但用其优化提示初始化GRPO可加速训练并获得最高模拟转化率。
AI.conclusion: 提示级与参数级优化在改善医生推荐展示上具有互补作用，组合策略兼顾训练效率与效果。

title: CineRecon: Benchmarking Frontier Models for Agentic Cinematic Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing reference videos as editable dynamic 3D scenes is an important path toward controllable video generation for filmmaking: these scenes provide modifiable, renderable visual proxies that enable explicit control over scene layout, subject actions, and camera behavior. To evaluate agents' ability to reconstruct editable dynamic 3D scenes from dynamic reference videos, we introduce CineRecon, a benchmark comprising 50 reference videos and 360 annotated evaluation clips. The reference videos span film, real-world footage, and games. Given a complete video, an agent uses tools to construct, animate, render, and refine its reconstruction. We evaluate this task under three representation settings: Proxy, Simplified, and Detailed. These settings increase geometric and appearance requirements while retaining the same requirements for spatial relations, camera behavior, and subject dynamics. This design tests whether agents can reproduce the events in a video when detailed appearance is unnecessary, and how performance changes as representation requirements increase. For evaluation, we construct checklists that associate observable properties and events with specific entities and times. A vision-language judge compares timestamp-aligned reference and rendered frames across 11 categories, grouped into camera, static, and dynamic consistency dimensions. We evaluate 12 models using their corresponding agent harnesses and find failures across all three dimensions. Subject motions and interactions remain difficult to reproduce even under the Proxy setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CineRecon 基准，用于评测智能体从动态参考视频重建可编辑动态 3D 场景的能力，包含 50 段参考视频与 360 个标注评测片段，并在 Proxy、Simplified、Detailed 三种表示设定下对 12 个模型进行评测，发现所有模型在相机、静态、动态三个一致性维度上均存在失败。
AI.motivation: 将参考视频重建为可编辑动态 3D 场景是实现可控视频生成的重要路径，可提供可修改、可渲染的视觉代理，从而显式控制场景布局、主体动作与相机行为。然而目前缺乏针对智能体该能力的系统评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 CineRecon 基准，含 50 段参考视频（涵盖电影、真实拍摄与游戏）和 360 个标注评测片段。智能体在给定完整视频后，使用工具完成重建的构建、动画化、渲染与细化。评测设置三种表示层级——Proxy、Simplified、Detailed——逐步提高几何与外观要求，同时保持空间关系、相机行为与主体动态要求不变。评测时构建检查表，将可观察属性与事件关联到具体实体和时间点，由视觉语言评判器对时间戳对齐的参考帧与渲染帧进行 11 类比较，归为相机一致性、静态一致性、动态一致性三个维度。
AI.result: 对 12 个模型使用各自对应的智能体框架进行评测，结果显示模型在全部三个一致性维度上均出现失败；即便在要求最低的 Proxy 设定下，主体运动与交互仍难以复现。
AI.conclusion: 从动态视频重建可编辑动态 3D 场景对现有智能体仍具挑战性，CineRecon 为衡量该能力及其随表示要求提升的变化提供了标准化评测框架。

title: Does a Hosted Decision Model Respect Irrelevant Alternatives? A Pre-Registered Test of Option-Set Dependence in Jev
summary: Decision APIs that return a probability for each option are routinely used as if those probabilities were properties of the options themselves. That reading is valid only if the model satisfies independence of irrelevant alternatives (IIA): adding an option that is neither the right answer nor its strongest rival should leave the odds between those two unchanged. We test this in a pre-registered study of jev-1.13.0, a hosted decision model, using 299,463 calls on intent classification (BANKING77, CLINC150) and topic classification (AG News). Every added option moves the log-odds between the gold label and the strongest wrong label: the root-mean-square systematic shift is 0.20-0.52 nats, 1.2 to 3 times the run-to-run variation, even when the added option takes at most 0.1% of the probability mass. The shifts are directional. An option similar to the wrong answer draws probability from it (+0.10 nats toward the gold label). A paraphrase of the wrong answer produces an intermediate pattern: the gold label's probability is almost conserved, but the paraphrase receives only about a third of the wrong answer's share rather than the half that strict substitution implies. The distortion grows steadily with the logarithm of the number of options, reaching about 1 nat at 255 options, and off-domain padding pushes the odds against the gold label. In contrast, questions packed into one call do not interact (bias < 0.001). Scoring each option with an independent yes/no question removes the option-set dependence but picks the right answer 8.7 points less often. Jev sits between two local baselines, an option-independent scorer and a prompt readout. Its probabilities are best read as relative to the option list they were computed over.

AI.tldr: 该论文测试宿主决策模型jev-1.13.0是否满足无关选项独立性（IIA），发现每增加一个选项都会系统性改变金标与最强错误标签之间的对数几率，证明其输出概率依赖于选项集合，应被解读为相对于选项列表的条件概率。
AI.motivation: 决策API返回的概率常被当作选项的固有属性使用，但这种解读仅在模型满足IIA时成立。作者希望检验真实宿主模型是否违反该假设，并量化偏差的方向、大小及来源。
AI.method: 预注册研究，对jev-1.13.0进行299,463次调用，任务涵盖意图分类（BANKING77、CLINC150）与主题分类（AG News）。通过对比金标与最强错误标签之间的对数几率变化，考察新增选项（相似选项、同义改写、域外填充、选项数量扩展）及单次调用多题打包的影响，并与选项独立打分器和prompt readout两个本地基线比较。
AI.result: 新增选项导致对数几率的系统位移均方根为0.20–0.52 nats，是运行间波动的1.2–3倍，即使新增选项仅占0.1%概率质量。位移具有方向性：与错误答案相似的选项从错误答案抽取概率（+0.10 nats偏向金标）；同义改写使金标概率几乎守恒，但同义项仅获约错误答案份额的三分之一而非严格替换应有的二分之一。失真随选项数量对数稳定增长，255个选项时约1 nat；域外填充使几率不利于金标。单次调用中的多题不交互（偏差<0.001）。独立yes/no打分消除选项集依赖，但正确率低8.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: jev-1.13.0违反IIA，其概率最好被解读为相对于计算时所依据的选项列表的相对值，而非选项本身的固有属性；在选项独立打分与prompt readout两个基线之间，jev处于中间位置。

title: Prompt-Injection Probes Learn the Conversation, Not Just the Injection
summary: Linear probes on a model's hidden states are used as cheap monitors for indirect prompt injection: they screen the tool outputs an agent reads and send suspicious ones to a slower second check, so every false alarm has a cost. But a probe learns whatever separates its training examples. The standard evaluation of injection probes can be passed without the model: conversation position and text lengths alone reach 0.91-0.98 AUROC. When each attack is compared with the same conversation without the injection, or with harmless text formatted like an injection, standard probes flag most of these harmless cases. We add such cases to the training data as matched negatives. Across six open models, in applications seen during training and at the default threshold, changing only the training data cuts false alarms on injection-free conversations from 41-80% to 4-27%, and on harmless look-alikes from 92-98% to 3-16%. With a threshold set on normal traffic, our probe still catches a median 95% of the attacks that fooled the agent (91% without our data). In new applications, false alarms stay low, but detection depends on the model and on how the threshold is set. The same data also helps a text-only filter.

AI.tldr: 线性探针用于检测间接提示注入时存在虚假警报问题，论文通过加入匹配负样本改进训练数据，大幅降低误报率。
AI.motivation: 线性探针作为智能体读取工具输出时的廉价监控手段，需要将可疑内容交给更慢的二次检查，因此每次误报都有成本。但探针只学习能区分其训练样本的特征，标准评测可以不经模型就被会话位置和文本长度等表面特征通过（AUROC达0.91-0.98），且标准探针会误标大量无害却格式类似注入的文本。
AI.method: 将无注入的同一会话以及格式类似注入的无害文本作为匹配负样本加入训练数据，仅改变训练数据而不改变探针结构，在六个开源模型上进行评估。
AI.result: 在训练中见过的应用和默认阈值下，仅改变训练数据即可将无注入会话上的误报率从41-80%降至4-27%，将无害相似文本上的误报率从92-98%降至3-16%。在正常流量上设定阈值时，探针仍能捕获中位数95%的欺骗智能体的攻击（无新数据时为91%）。在新应用中误报率保持较低，但检测效果取决于模型和阈值设定方式。相同数据对纯文本过滤器也有帮助。
AI.conclusion: 通过在训练数据中加入匹配负样本，可显著降低提示注入探针的虚假警报率，同时保持对真实攻击的高检测率，该方法通用且可迁移至纯文本过滤场景。

title: Revisiting the Estimation of Unigram Surprisal in Computational Psycholinguistics
summary: Contextual and unigram surprisal are standard predictors of reading time in computational psycholinguistics. While contextual surprisal is typically derived from neural language models, unigram surprisal is usually obtained from independent corpus counts. Although both quantities are deterministic functionals of a single underlying distribution---capturing conditional and marginal structure respectively---this practice breaks their probabilistic link and may introduce estimation error from the mismatch. We propose three principles for estimating unigram surprisal in psycholinguistic research, including the requirement that both quantities be derived from the same language model. We operationalize this principle by introducing a Monte Carlo estimator of unigram surprisal from a language model, along with a marginalized variant that has lower variance empirically. When unigram surprisal is re-estimated under this unified framework, we find evidence that predictors change in their predictive contribution to reading time. We also confirm prior findings that frequency can be a stronger predictor of processing effort than contextual surprisal under this unified framework.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出从同一语言模型中统一估计上下文surprisal与unigram surprisal的三项原则，并引入蒙特卡洛估计器及其低方差变体；统一框架下发现预测变量对阅读时间的贡献发生变化，且频率可比上下文surprisal更强地预测加工努力。
AI.motivation: 在计算心理语言学中，上下文surprisal通常来自神经语言模型，而unigram surprisal一般来自独立语料计数。尽管二者都是同一底层分布的确定性函数（分别刻画条件结构与边缘结构），但这一做法割裂了它们的概率联系，并可能因来源不匹配引入估计误差。
AI.method: 作者提出心理语言学研究估计unigram surprisal的三项原则，其中包括要求两个量均来自同一语言模型；据此引入从语言模型出发的unigram surprisal蒙特卡洛估计器，以及一个经验上方差更低的边缘化变体，并在统一框架下重新估计unigram surprisal、考察各预测变量对阅读时间的预测贡献。
AI.result: 在统一框架下重新估计unigram surprisal后，证据显示各预测变量对阅读时间的预测贡献发生变化；同时确认了此前发现，即在该统一框架下频率可比上下文surprisal更强地预测加工努力。
AI.conclusion: 心理语言学研究应遵循统一原则，从同一语言模型中一致地推导上下文surprisal与unigram surprisal，以维持二者的概率联系、避免来源不匹配带来的估计误差，并据此重新审视阅读时间预测变量的相对贡献。

title: Trace-to-Architecture: Capability Bottleneck Diagnosis for Harness Revision
summary: Improving an LLM agent requires knowing what to change when it fails. Similar failures can require different fixes, and resolving one problem can expose another. We introduce Trace-to-Architecture (T2A), a framework that uses execution trajectories to determine what to change in an agent's harness and when those changes apply. A development agent diagnoses failures using execution evidence from successful and failed tasks, revises the corresponding harness components, and then checks whether target tasks improve, selected successful tasks remain successful, and the edits are actually triggered. New execution evidence guides subsequent diagnosis and revision. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and AppWorld, T2A achieves the highest aggregate score for all three evaluated task agents, exceeding their respective strongest baselines by 6.2--30.3 points. We also integrate T2A's diagnosis and validation procedures into Meta-Harness, improving the resulting harnesses' mean ScienceWorld score by 21.6 points from the same starting harness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Trace-to-Architecture (T2A) 框架，利用执行轨迹诊断 LLM 智能体失败原因，定位并修订 harness 中相应组件，并通过证据驱动的迭代循环验证改动效果。
AI.motivation: 改进 LLM 智能体的前提是明确失败时应当修改什么。然而相似失败可能需要不同修复方案，且解决一个问题常会暴露新问题，现有方法难以准确定位和验证改动。
AI.method: T2A 使用成功与失败任务的执行证据，由开发智能体诊断失败，修订对应的 harness 组件，然后校验三项指标：目标任务是否提升、已选成功任务是否保持成功、编辑是否被实际触发；新一轮执行证据再指导后续诊断与修订，形成迭代闭环。另将 T2A 的诊断与验证流程集成到 Meta-Harness 中。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 和 AppWorld 上，T2A 对三个被测任务智能体均取得最高聚合分数，超出各自最强基线 6.2–30.3 分；集成到 Meta-Harness 后，在相同起始 harness 下将 ScienceWorld 平均分数提升 21.6 分。
AI.conclusion: 基于执行轨迹的架构修订框架能有效识别应改动的内容及其适用范围，并通过验证机制保障改进的稳健性，具备跨任务与跨框架的泛化能力。

title: Detecting Chain-of-Thought Hijacking in Backdoored Multimodal Large Reasoning Models
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning enables multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) to solve complex visual problems, but also exposes them to CoT hijacking: an adversary implants a backdoor through poisoned fine-tuning so that a visual trigger induces a hijacking turn, redirecting an otherwise faithful reasoning chain to an attacker-chosen answer. However, since the hijack acts within the reasoning chain, existing multimodal backdoor defenses designed for MLLMs that answer directly struggle to detect it. Moreover, inspecting the chain itself does not reliably expose the hijack, since the hijacking turn can resemble honest self-correction in form. In this paper, we find that honest reasoning tends to revise its answer at high-entropy "aha moments", whereas a hijack can overturn a confident answer through a near-deterministic turn. To quantify this contrast, we formalize this phenomenon as belief inertia, the cumulative next-token entropy of a reasoning span minus the answer-belief revision it induces, with markedly lower values for hijacked spans than for honest reasoning spans. Since hijacking tokens are also image-dependent, we further improve detection by restricting the measure to image-dependent spans, yielding visual belief inertia (VBI). Building on this, we propose InertiaGuard, a training-free, test-time detector that flags a trace when its VBI falls below a threshold calibrated on a small set of clean traces. Across various attacks and benchmarks, InertiaGuard achieves higher detection performance than existing baselines, while generalizing to different model architectures and trigger types.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InertiaGuard，一种无需训练、测试时的检测器，利用"视觉信念惯性"（VBI）识别多模态大推理模型思维链中的后门劫持。
AI.motivation: 多模态大推理模型（MLRM）通过思维链（CoT）解决复杂视觉问题，但也引入了"CoT劫持"攻击：攻击者通过投毒微调植入后门，使视觉触发器诱发一个劫持轮次，将原本忠实的推理链重定向到攻击者选定的答案。由于劫持发生在推理链内部，针对直接作答的MLLM设计的现有多模态后门防御难以检测；而仅检查推理链本身也不可靠，因为劫持轮次在形式上可能与诚实的自我纠错相似。
AI.method: 作者发现诚实推理倾向于在"顿悟时刻"（高熵状态）修正答案，而劫持则通过近乎确定性的轮次推翻一个高置信度答案。为量化这一对比，作者提出"信念惯性"：一个推理跨度的累积下一词元熵减去其引发的答案信念修正量，被劫持跨度显著低于诚实跨度。由于劫持词元还依赖图像，进一步限定于图像依赖跨度，得到"视觉信念惯性"（VBI）。据此提出InertiaGuard：无需训练、测试时检测器，当轨迹的VBI低于基于少量干净轨迹校准的阈值时判定为异常。
AI.result: 在多种攻击和基准上，InertiaGuard的检测性能优于现有基线，并能泛化到不同模型架构和触发器类型。
AI.conclusion: 信念惯性（VBI）能有效区分劫持与诚实推理，InertiaGuard作为一种无需训练、测试时的检测方案，在多攻击、多基准、多架构与多触发器条件下具备更高的检测性能与良好的泛化能力。

title: Do Factuality Methods Make LLMs More Factual? Reproducibility and Fair Comparison
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to human preferences, after pre-training and supervised fine-tuning steps. However, standard RL alignment steps such as RLHF do not focus on factuality of LLMs, hence they may generate non-factual information, which could result in unintended consequences. In response, a number of factuality alignment approaches have been proposed in the literature which claim to improve factuality of LLMs on their own benchmarks. However, these methods have not been reproduced independently and are also not comparable since each uses a different base model, training data, evaluation set, judge, and metric. In this paper, we present the first independent reproduction of five factuality alignment methods, which span on-policy RL (PPO, GRPO, and Dr.~GRPO) and offline preference optimization (DPO and KTO), and compare them on a common benchmark with common evaluation metrics. We found that none of these methods reproduces in full, and on the common benchmark none of the methods significantly outperforms the base model. On closer inspection, the rewards optimize for format, length, or brevity rather than factuality and relevance, whereas the choice between on-policy and offline training matters little. Furthermore, the evaluation metrics and benchmarks are also part of the problem since they do not measure relevance of text to the prompt. Since there is no ground truth associated with the prompts, the reliance on LLM judges and retrieval for verification also makes the evaluation fragile. We release our code, data, and checkpoints.

AI.tldr: 本文首次独立复现了五种事实性对齐方法（PPO、GRPO、Dr. GRPO、DPO、KTO），并在统一基准与指标下比较。结果显示：无方法能完全复现原结果，且在共同基准上均未显著优于基座模型；奖励实际优化的是格式、长度或简洁性而非事实性；评估指标与基准也存在缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有事实性对齐方法虽声称在各自基准上提升了LLM事实性，但缺乏独立复现，且因基座模型、训练数据、评估集、评判器与指标各异而无法直接比较，故需统一复现与比较。
AI.method: 首次独立复现五种事实性对齐方法，涵盖在线策略RL（PPO、GRPO、Dr. GRPO）与离线偏好优化（DPO、KTO），在统一基准和统一评估指标下进行比较。
AI.result: 无任何方法完全复现；在共同基准上均未显著优于基座模型。奖励更倾向于优化格式、长度或简洁性，而非事实性与相关性；在线策略与离线训练的选择影响很小。评估指标与基准本身也存在问题，未衡量文本与提示的相关性；由于提示缺乏ground truth，依赖LLM评判与检索验证使评估脆弱。
AI.conclusion: 现有事实性对齐方法在独立复现与统一评估下效果有限，问题不仅在于训练方法，也在于奖励设计与评估基准；作者开源了代码、数据和检查点。

title: Queue-Aware Token Communications: Bridging AI Representation and Wireless Service
summary: The rapid advancement of foundation models and edge intelligence is transforming wireless networks from data-oriented communication systems into artificial intelligence (AI)-native service platforms. Token communications (TokenCom) has emerged as a promising paradigm that directly transmits task-oriented AI representations. However, existing studies typically assume that generated tokens can be transmitted immediately, overlooking the queueing dynamics arising from the mismatch between token workload generation and time-varying wireless service capability. To address this limitation, we introduce Queue-Aware TokenCom, which explicitly incorporates token queues into the AI service pipeline. We present an end-to-end architecture integrating AI representation generation, token workload management, wireless transmission, and downstream task inference. We then discuss two key design directions: budget-aware token representation optimization and queue-aware token service optimization, with the token budget serving as a critical interface between AI performance and communication efficiency. Moreover, we investigate fixed and adaptive token budget strategies to characterize the fundamental tradeoff between AI performance and communication efficiency in dynamic wireless environments. Finally, we outline research directions toward closed-loop, task-aware, and scalable TokenCom systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"队列感知令牌通信"(Queue-Aware TokenCom)范式，将令牌队列显式纳入AI服务流水线，以刻画令牌负载生成与无线服务能力时变不匹配所带来的排队动态，并探讨预算感知与队列感知两类优化方向。
AI.motivation: 基础模型与边缘智能推动无线网络从面向数据的通信系统演进为AI原生服务平台，令牌通信(TokenCom)可直传任务导向的AI表征。但现有研究通常假设生成的令牌可立即传输，忽略了令牌负载生成与无线服务能力时变之间的失配所引发的排队动态，导致模型与现实不符。
AI.method: 引入Queue-Aware TokenCom，将令牌队列显式嵌入AI服务流水线；提出集成AI表征生成、令牌负载管理、无线传输与下游任务推理的端到端架构；讨论预算感知令牌表征优化与队列感知令牌服务优化两大设计方向，并以令牌预算作为AI性能与通信效率间的关键接口；进一步研究固定与自适应令牌预算策略，刻画动态无线环境下AI性能与通信效率的基本权衡。
AI.result: 通过固定与自适应令牌预算策略的对比分析，揭示了动态无线环境中AI性能与通信效率之间存在基本权衡关系，表明令牌预算是连接二者并可调节的关键接口。
AI.conclusion: Queue-Aware TokenCom通过显式建模排队动态，为AI原生无线服务提供了更贴近实际的框架；未来研究应面向闭环、任务感知与可扩展的TokenCom系统方向发展。

title: Answer It or Not? Towards Prompt-Adapted Adversarial Images on Vision Language Models
summary: With the advancement in language modeling, research on adversarial images has recently shifted from image classifiers to vision-language models (VLMs). Despite the new, text-prompt-driven nature of VLMs, we find that existing VLM adversaries have largely overlooked the dynamics of text prompts. In a typical use case, adversarial images can protect visual privacy by rejecting VLMs from answering questions about the image. However, existing protections are prompt-agnostic, i.e., indiscriminately rejecting any question, including those for potential legitimate use of the image. To address this limitation, we propose Prompt-Adapted (ProAda) adversarial images, which are optimized to balance the rejection of harmful prompts and the correct response of legitimate prompts. In particular, to achieve a more accurate adversarial direction, the text prompt is also iteratively updated with a simple classifier judging whether the harmfulness of the prompt remains. Extensive experiments on visual-privacy-related datasets validate that ProAda can reject over 90% of harmful prompts while allowing over 90% of legitimate ones, demonstrating superior overall performance compared to existing prompt-agnostic VLM adversaries. In addition, our ProAda achieves competitive overall cross-model transferability and improved robustness against countermeasures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProAda（Prompt-Adapted）对抗图像，通过联合优化图像与文本提示，实现按提示区分地拒绝有害问题并正确回答合法问题，在视觉隐私数据集上对90%以上有害提示拒绝、90%以上合法提示正常响应，整体性能、跨模型迁移性与抗防御鲁棒性均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 随着语言建模发展，对抗图像研究已从图像分类器转向视觉语言模型（VLM）。现有VLM对抗攻击虽由文本提示驱动，却普遍忽略提示的动态性：在视觉隐私保护场景中，对抗图像本应阻止VLM回答关于图像的问题，但现有保护是"提示无关"（prompt-agnostic）的，会无差别拒绝包括合法用途在内的所有问题，限制了图像的正当使用。
AI.method: 提出Prompt-Adapted（ProAda）对抗图像，其优化目标是在拒绝有害提示与正确响应合法提示之间取得平衡。为获得更准确的对抗方向，文本提示也进行迭代更新，并引入一个简单分类器判断提示的有害性是否仍然保持。
AI.result: 在视觉隐私相关数据集上的大量实验表明，ProAda可拒绝超过90%的有害提示，同时允许超过90%的合法提示通过；相较于现有提示无关的VLM对抗方法，整体性能更优。此外，ProAda具有良好的跨模型迁移性，并对防御对策展现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ProAda通过将文本提示动态性纳入对抗图像优化，实现了提示自适应的视觉隐私保护，在保护效果与合法可用性之间取得更优平衡，并在迁移性和鲁棒性上具备竞争力。

title: Agaram 2.5B: The First Tamil-First Language Model Trained from Scratch with Tool Calling. A Playbook for Under-Represented Languages
summary: We trained Agaram 2.5B, a 2.5-billion-parameter Tamil-English language model, from scratch on about 50 billion tokens (58% Tamil, the rest English, math, code and parallel text) on one node of eight H100 GPUs in about six days, with a new tokenizer that, unlike our first model's, keeps line breaks. Supervised fine-tuning on 134,428 conversations, whose replies an open-weight teacher model wrote, and three short targeted rounds turned it into a chat model that answers in Tamil script, romanized Tamil (Tanglish) and English and can call tools: on 25 tool prompts whose schemas appear in training it picks the right tool 23 times and gives exactly the expected arguments 13 times. The released model translates better than Sarvam-1, a 2B Indic base model, in all six FLORES and IN22 directions (FLORES chrF 54.3 into Tamil and 55.2 into English, against 49.2 and 44.2), and nearly doubles its base model on native-Tamil IndicIFEval (19.3% from 10.0%). It is weak on knowledge: reading-comprehension and knowledge benchmarks sit near chance, and on 50 held-out everyday questions written by one native speaker, one LLM judge rated 46% of its replies usable (22-24 of 50 over three passes; 95% interval for 23 of 50, 33-60%), with nearly every failure a wrong fact. Our two further SFT experiments changed answer format but not the knowledge measures. We also describe our first model, Agaram 1.5B, whose failures shaped the choices here; how the judge's scores varied between passes on identical replies; and, item by item, what the targeted rounds trained against and where frontier-model text entered the data. The project ran on compute credits and our own funds, about USD 13,300 across both models; the weights are released (licence to be announced after legal review), with GGUF files for llama.cpp, at https://huggingface.co/murai-labs/agaram-2.5b-instruct; code at https://github.com/Murai-Labs/Agaram2.5b

AI.tldr: 训练并发布Agaram 2.5B泰米尔语-英语双语模型，具备多脚本对话与工具调用能力，翻译与格式遵循优于Sarvam-1，但知识类任务薄弱。
AI.motivation: 在有限算力与资金下构建可复现的泰米尔语-英语开源模型，并基于第一代Agaram 1.5B的失败经验改进分词与数据设计，提升翻译与指令遵循能力。
AI.method: 从零训练2.5B参数模型，约50B tokens（58%泰米尔语，其余为英语、数学、代码与平行语料），单节点8张H100约6天；采用保留换行符的新分词器；用开放权重教师模型生成134,428条对话回复做SFT，并进行三轮针对性训练。
AI.result: 支持泰米尔文、罗马化泰米尔语（Tanglish）与英语回答及工具调用：25个训练内schema提示中23次选对工具、13次参数完全正确；六项FLORES与IN22方向翻译优于Sarvam-1（FLORES chrF译入泰米尔语54.3、译入英语55.2，对比49.2与44.2）；原生泰米尔语IndicIFEval 19.3%，约为基座两倍（10.0%）。知识类基准接近随机；50道母语者日常问题中，LLM评审三轮回合约22-24题可用（46%，23题的95%区间33-60%），失败多为事实错误。
AI.conclusion: 模型在多语言对话、翻译与工具调用上表现良好，但知识能力仍显著不足，SFT仅改变答案格式而未改善知识指标；两代模型共花费约13,300美元，权重、GGUF与代码已发布。

title: Separating Prompt Harmfulness from Interaction Safety via Partial Generation
summary: LLM-based information systems need safety guardrails. Most guardrails classify the prompt alone. If the prompt looks harmful, the system rejects it before any answer is generated. This is costly. Many rejected prompts would have received a safe response. Users lose help they should have received from the information system. This cost grows as conversational and generative search becomes common. Prompt-level labels treat harm as a property of the query. But harm depends on what the model actually writes. Existing input-output guards do look at responses. But they judge a finished response, so the decision comes after full generation. However, we observe that safety of model interaction with the input prompt can be inferred early with only partial output. So the system can start generating, watch the partial response, and stop only if it turns harmful. We test this idea in three steps. First, we build a dataset of 41,944 prompt-response pairs with seven open weights LLMs from three families: Llama, Gemma, and Qwen. Second, we show that prompt harmfulness and interaction safety differ. Prompt labels and response labels agree on only 50.46\% of items (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.06). Of the prompts that make any model respond harmfully, only 3.5\% do so for all seven LLMs. Third, we show that partial responses carry most of the signal. Fine-tuned classifiers predict response-level harm well (best AUPRC 0.885, F1 0.807). About one third of the response tokens recover almost full-response AUPRC.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用生成过程中的部分输出来判断交互安全性，而非仅凭提示词分类或等待完整回复生成后再判断。
AI.motivation: 现有安全护栏大多只对提示词分类，一旦提示词看似有害即拒答，代价高昂且会误拒本可安全回答的请求；而输入-输出护栏虽看回复，但需等完整生成结束才判断。
AI.method: 构建包含 41,944 个提示-回复对的数据集，涉及 Llama、Gemma、Qwen 三个家族共七个开源大模型；对比提示词有害性与交互安全性；并训练微调分类器基于部分回复预测回复级危害。
AI.result: 提示标签与回复标签仅 50.46% 一致（Cohen's κ = 0.06）；使任一模型产生有害回复的提示中，仅 3.5% 对所有七个模型都如此；微调分类器预测回复级危害效果良好（最佳 AUPRC 0.885，F1 0.807）；约生成三分之一回复 token 即可接近完整回复的 AUPRC。
AI.conclusion: 交互安全性可仅凭部分输出提前推断，系统可在生成过程中监测并在出现有害倾向时及时停止，从而降低误拒成本。

title: Adaptive Interaction Network for Human Motion Prediction During Human-Robot Collaboration
comment: 12 pages, 10 figures, 10 tables. Author accepted manuscript. Published in IEEE Transactions on Image Processing. Code: https://github.com/LyTingHub/AINet
summary: Human motion prediction during human-robot collaboration is critical for achieving safe and efficient interactions in shared environments. Unlike previous studies that have primarily focused on humans and objects, we focus on the robot-aware human motion prediction task, which explicitly models the influence of robots on human motion. This task presents new challenges, such as capturing human-robot heterogeneity and modeling complex spatial interactions. To address these issues, we develop an adaptive interaction network (AINet) model that consists of two branches: a primary branch that predicts future human motion and an auxiliary branch that estimates robot trajectories. The two branches are jointly optimized and coupled via a Local-Global Spatial Interaction (LGSI) Module, which effectively captures fine-grained and global contextual dependencies between human and robot motion sequences. Then, we introduce an Adaptive Weighted Aggregation (AWA) Module to dynamically fuse motion features using context-dependent weights, thereby increasing adaptability across diverse scenarios. Furthermore, we adopt a coarse-to-fine prediction strategy, in which a coarse pseudo-trajectory is first predicted, followed by the refinement of detailed human poses based on that trajectory. Extensive experiments on three challenging datasets reveal that our proposed method achieves superior performance, validating its effectiveness in human-robot collaboration scenarios. Our code is available at: https://github.com/LyTingHub/AINet.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应交互网络AINet，用于机器人感知的人体运动预测，通过双分支耦合、局部-全局空间交互模块、自适应加权聚合模块与粗细预测策略，在三个数据集上取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: 人机协作共享环境中的安全高效交互依赖人体运动预测，但已有研究多关注人与物体，忽略了机器对人体运动的影响；显式建模机器人对运动的影响带来人机异质性与复杂空间交互建模两大挑战。
AI.method: 构建AINet，含两条分支：主分支预测未来人体运动，辅助分支估计机器人轨迹，二者联合优化；通过Local-Global Spatial Interaction（LGSI）模块捕捉人机运动序列间的细粒度与全局上下文依赖；引入Adaptive Weighted Aggregation（AWA）模块以依赖上下文的权重动态融合运动特征；并采用由粗到细策略，先预测粗略伪轨迹，再基于该轨迹细化人体姿态。
AI.result: 在三个具挑战性的数据集上进行了大量实验，所提方法取得优于对比方法的性能，验证了其在人机协作场景中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模机器人影响并结合双分支联合优化、空间交互、自适应特征融合与粗细预测，AINet有效应对人机异质性和复杂交互挑战，适用于人机协作的人体运动预测。

title: Receiver Decides Agent-to-Agent Negotiations
summary: When one language-model agent asks another for money, which of the two decides how much changes hands? We ran a round-robin tournament of 1,049 negotiations among fifteen agents. In each game a requester tries to raise money from a holder that has been told to keep a $100 endowment. Knowing which agent holds the money explains 47% of the variance in the amount transferred; knowing which agent asks explains 2%. Dropping the most extreme agents narrows the split to 22% against 4%. Changing the requester's appeal from one named person to a group changed what requesters wrote, but the amounts transferred under the two framings are statistically equivalent. The holders that lose least are the ones that turn down the opening request, and their turn-1 refusal rate ranks them by total losses (Spearman correlation = -0.73). Training moves this behaviour in both directions. Fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on a persuasion corpus with almost no refusals raised what it gave away as a holder from 12% to 84% of the endowment. Distilling two never-losing holders into a 4B student cut its losses from 95% to 1%. Evaluations of agents that hold resources should test them in the holder role, including after persuasion fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 在1,049场语言模型智能体双边谈判中，持有方（holder）身份解释了47%的转移金额方差，请求方（requester）身份仅解释2%；持有方行为主导资金转移结果，且可通过微调双向改变。
AI.motivation: 探究在语言模型智能体之间的资金请求谈判中，究竟是请求方还是持有方决定了最终转移多少资金，并检验现有资源持有能力评估是否忽视持有方角色的重要性。
AI.method: 组织15个智能体进行1,049场循环赛谈判：请求方需向被设定保留100美元禀赋的持有方募资。通过方差分解比较请求方与持有方身份对转移金额的解释力；对比点名个人与点名群体的诉求框架；分析首轮拒绝率与总损失的相关性；并对Qwen3-8B进行劝说语料微调、将两个从不亏损的持有方蒸馏进4B学生模型。
AI.result: 持有方身份解释47%的转移金额方差，请求方身份仅解释2%；剔除极端智能体后为22%对4%。点名个人改为点名群体改变了请求措辞，但转移金额统计上等价。亏损最少的持有方是拒绝首轮请求者，其首轮拒绝率与总损失排序的Spearman相关系数为-0.73。微调Qwen3-8B（语料几乎无拒绝样本）使其作为持有方给出比例从12%升至84%；将两个从不亏损持有方蒸馏至4B学生模型使损失从95%降至1%。
AI.conclusion: 资源持有能力由持有方主导，且可经训练双向调控；对持有资源的智能体进行评估时应在持有方角色下测试，并纳入劝说微调后的情形。

title: Geospatial Vector Geometry as a Native Spatial Modality for Vision-Language Models
summary: Geospatial reasoning links VLMs to real-world action and decision making. Reliable reasoning requires accurate spatial information and effective spatial representations. However, current VLMs obtain this information mainly from language and vision. At larger geographic scales, limited visual observations make it difficult to establish accurate spatial references and recover precise spatial relations. This leads to a bottleneck for VLM spatial perception and reasoning. This paper proposes that geospatial vector geometry can become a native spatial modality within a VLM and introduces GeoVec-VLM. First, we develop a structured geometry representation that preserves the spatial structure and arrangement of vector objects, building an explicit spatial basis. Second, we introduce a geometry interaction strategy that brings this basis into multimodal computation, where it interacts with visual content and language references according to the queried spatial relations. Together, these designs allow perception and reasoning to operate on shared geometric references. Across five spatial reasoning tasks, GeoVec-VLM improves mean accuracy by about 11\% relative to the strongest baseline, maintains its gains under geographic transfer, and shows greater geometric consistency. Our results show that geospatial vector geometry offers a promising internal spatial basis for VLM spatial reasoning. https://github.com/TXFR/GeoVector-VLM

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GeoVec-VLM，将地理空间矢量几何作为 VLM 的原生空间模态，通过结构化几何表示与几何交互策略提升地理空间推理能力，在五项任务上平均准确率较最强基线提升约 11%。
AI.motivation: 地理空间推理将 VLM 与现实世界的行动与决策相连，但当前 VLM 主要从语言和视觉获取空间信息。在大地理尺度下，视觉观测有限，难以建立准确的空间参照并恢复精确的空间关系，构成 VLM 空间感知与推理的瓶颈。作者认为地理空间矢量几何可成为 VLM 的原生空间模态。
AI.method: 提出 GeoVec-VLM。第一步构建结构化几何表示，保留矢量对象的空间结构与排列，建立显式空间基（spatial basis）；第二步引入几何交互策略，将该空间基带入多模态计算，依据所查询的空间关系与视觉内容和语言指代进行交互，使感知与推理在共享的几何参照上进行。
AI.result: 在五项空间推理任务上，GeoVec-VLM 相较最强基线平均准确率提升约 11%；在地理迁移（geographic transfer）条件下仍保持增益；并表现出更强的几何一致性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，地理空间矢量几何可为 VLM 空间推理提供有前景的内部空间基。代码见 https://github.com/TXFR/GeoVector-VLM。

title: REEL: Learning to Retrieve, Evaluate, and Evolve Visual Memory for Any Long-Horizon Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: Memory-based long-video generation aims to combine user control with long-range visual consistency. We organize this process into three functional components: a planner, an adapter, and a generator. Representative multi-shot systems couple memory to generator-specific interfaces or use predefined agent workflows, rather than independently training a memory policy for cross-shot objectives. We introduce REEL, a general-purpose visual-memory planner. Through a unified tool interface, REEL learns to retrieve references, create missing visual evidence, and update persistent memory. Backend-specific adapters translate its evidence plans into supported conditioning inputs, allowing the same policy to guide different black-box video generators. To train REEL, we construct two high-quality datasets, REEL-SFT-4k and REEL-RL-1k, covering diverse interaction patterns and prompt types. Training proceeds in three stages: supervised fine-tuning, single-shot Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and multi-shot GRPO. Multi-shot GRPO carries policy-generated memory across consecutive shots, so later outcomes guide earlier reference selection and memory updates. REEL-Bench tests identity preservation and intended state changes under text-only requests and timed reference-image uploads. On JoyAI-Echo~1.5 and MiniMax-H3, REEL improves cross-shot consistency on ST-Bench by 15.1\% and 20.7\%, and Core-100 on our proposed REEL-Bench by 2.41 and 8.32 points, respectively, over the no-memory baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出通用视觉记忆规划器 REEL，通过统一工具接口和分阶段训练，为不同黑盒视频生成器提供跨镜头一致性支持。
AI.motivation: 长视频生成需兼顾用户控制与长程视觉一致性。现有代表性多镜头系统或将记忆耦合到特定生成器接口，或依赖预定义智能体流程，未能独立训练面向跨镜头目标的记忆策略，导致通用性不足。
AI.method: 将流程拆分为规划器、适配器和生成器三部分。REEL 作为通用视觉记忆规划器，经统一工具接口学习检索参考、生成缺失视觉证据并更新持久记忆；后端专用适配器将其证据规划转为各生成器支持的条件输入。构建 REEL-SFT-4k 与 REEL-RL-1k 数据集，采用三阶段训练：监督微调、单镜头 GRPO 与多镜头 GRPO，后者将策略生成的记忆跨连续镜头传递，使后续结果反向指导早期参考选择与记忆更新。
AI.result: 在 JoyAI-Echo~1.5 与 MiniMax-H3 上，REEL 相对无记忆基线将 ST-Bench 跨镜头一致性分别提升 15.1% 与 20.7%，在自建 REEL-Bench 的 Core-100 指标上分别提升 2.41 与 8.32 分。REEL-Bench 评估纯文本请求与定时参考图上传下的身份保持和意图状态变化。
AI.conclusion: 独立训练的记忆策略可解耦于具体生成器，借助适配器实现跨黑盒生成器的通用记忆规划，并显著提升多镜头长视频的一致性与可控性。

title: Reliable Memory from Unstable Growth: Curating Self-Written Agent Playbooks with Randomized Experiments
summary: Persistent textual memory lets language-model agents reuse lessons from past tasks to improve on future multi-step tasks without retraining. Systems such as ACE and Dynamic Cheatsheet keep it as a playbook: lessons the agent writes after each task and reads in its prompt. A key challenge is to decide which lessons improve later tasks. Current systems leave the decision to the agent itself, which makes performance unstable: the same procedure can write a playbook that helps or one that falls up to 69.6 points below no playbook. These findings motivate valuing lessons by their measured effect on task success rather than by the agent's judgment. We propose Randomized Block Curation (RBC), which measures this effect with a randomized experiment on practice tasks. It groups related lessons into blocks large enough to move success measurably and, on each practice task, includes or leaves out every block at random. Random inclusion makes tasks with and without a block comparable, so the gap in their success estimates the block's effect. RBC keeps the blocks that help and, since the same procedure can write a helpful or a harmful playbook, grows several and serves whichever curated, whole or no playbook scores best on fresh practice episodes. Across two memory systems, three models and three benchmarks, RBC raises average success to 66.9, against 55.5 with the whole playbook, 54.1 with no playbook and 53.8 when the agent's own judgment picks the lessons to keep.

AI.tldr: 提出随机分块策展（RBC），通过随机实验测量"经验教训"对任务成功率的因果效应来筛选文本记忆，取代智能体自身判断。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体依赖持久化文本记忆（如ACE、Dynamic Cheatsheet的playbook）复用过往任务经验，但"保留哪些教训"由智能体自行判断，导致性能极不稳定——同一流程写出的playbook可能有益，也可能使成功率比无playbook低69.6分。
AI.method: RBC在练习任务上做随机实验：将相关教训聚合成足够大、能可测地影响成功率的"块"；在每个练习任务上随机决定是否包含每个块，从而使有无该块的任务可比，二者成功率之差即为该块效应的估计；保留有正效应的块；同时生长多个playbook（含完整、部分或无），在新鲜练习回合中选用得分最高者。
AI.result: 在两种记忆系统、三个模型、三个基准上，RBC将平均成功率提升至66.9，而完整playbook为55.5、无playbook为54.1、智能体自行判断挑选教训为53.8。
AI.conclusion: 应以教训对任务成功的实测效应而非智能体主观判断来评估其价值；随机化分块实验可稳定识别有益教训，并通过多playbook竞争与择优服务，显著且稳健地提升多步任务表现。

title: Game-Creation-Agents: Autonomous Game Production
summary: Game-Creation-Agents (GCA) turns a natural-language request into a runnable Phaser 4 browser game. The pipeline first builds a multimodal game design document that couples mechanics and scene contracts to grounded visual references. It then projects that document into a runtime scaffold, machine-readable contracts, and deterministic tests. Eight specialized agents next carry out production: scenes are implemented serially, assets are produced in parallel, and one reduced manifest joins the two branches into a single build. Build-linked real-UI checks and a code-blind critic then verify that build and decide whether the game may ship. Each blocker returns to the agent that owns the affected artifact for a bounded repair, and the game is released once all the gates pass. We evaluate finished games separately, through their rendered interfaces alone, over prompt-matched tasks run under a common protocol. GCA achieves stronger requirement satisfaction, core mechanics, content depth, and functional visuals than a comparable open pipeline. In a side-by-side human study, raters also score GCA's games higher on every dimension and prefer them overall.

AI.tldr: 提出 Game-Creation-Agents（GCA）流水线，可将自然语言需求直接转化为可运行的 Phaser 4 浏览器游戏；通过多智能体分工、契约驱动与多重质量门禁实现生产与验收，并在自动评测与人类偏好研究中全面优于同类开放式流水线。
AI.motivation: 现有开放式流水线在将自然语言需求转为可运行游戏时，往往难以保证需求满足度、核心机制完整性与视觉可用性。本文旨在构建一套端到端、可验证的游戏生成流水线，使生成结果既功能可运行，又能严格满足用户需求。
AI.method: 1）由自然语言请求出发，构建多模态游戏设计文档，将机制与场景契约绑定到有依据的视觉参考；2）将文档投影为运行时脚手架、机器可读契约与确定性测试；3）八个专用智能体执行生产：场景串行实现、资源并行生成，再通过统一精简清单合并两条分支为单一构建；4）以构建联动的真实 UI 检查与代码盲评批评者进行验收，判断是否可发布；5）每个阻塞项回退至相应产物负责智能体进行有界修复，全部门禁通过后发布；6）评测仅通过渲染界面，在提示匹配任务与统一协议下进行。
AI.result: 在需求满足度、核心机制、内容深度与功能视觉方面均优于可比的开放式流水线；在并排人类研究中，评分者在所有维度上均给 GCA 游戏更高分，并整体更偏好其作品。
AI.conclusion: GCA 通过多智能体生产、契约化产物与构建联动验收，实现了从自然语言到可运行浏览器游戏的高质量生成，并在客观指标与人类主观偏好上双双取得优势，验证了该流水线范式的有效性。

title: Revisiting Natural Language Prompts from Large Language Models for Open-Vocabulary Video Recognition
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) like CLIP have shown great success in image tasks, however, applying CLIP to open-vocabulary video recognition poses challenges. Due to the limited text information, directly fine-tuning CLIP on video recognition datasets may lead to overfitting and hinder its generalizability. A prevalent method is to enrich text information by generating prompts using Large Language Models (LLMs). However, limited efforts have been made to explore how to generate higher-quality prompts that can contribute to classify unseen categories, and how to further enhance vision-text alignment based on these prompts. In this paper, we propose P2CLIP (Prompt-guided CLIP), which aims to bridge this gap by exploring the impact of prompts across three aspects: category, video, and frame. At the category level, we argue that LLM-generated prompts under simple instructions may suffer from semantic overgeneralization, which can blur the category boundaries and hinder the performance of the model. To address this issue, we design Generic-Discriminative Prompt using LLMs to obtain discriminative category embeddings with rich semantic information. At the video and frame levels, we first use VLM and LLM to generate frame and video descriptions for enhancing vision-text alignment. Then we propose a Knowledge-Guided Temporal Aggregation mechanism, which leverages the expert knowledge derived from LLMs to guide the temporal modeling of videos and encourage a better construction of the joint visual-textual feature space. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks, including zero-shot and few-shot settings, demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: P2CLIP通过类别、视频、帧三个层面的提示设计增强CLIP的开放词汇视频识别能力。
AI.motivation: CLIP类视觉语言模型在图像任务上表现优异，但迁移至开放词汇视频识别面临挑战：文本信息有限，直接微调易过拟合、损害泛化性。现有用LLM生成提示的方法缺乏对生成更高质量提示以分类未见类别的探索，也缺乏进一步强化视觉-文本对齐的研究。
AI.method: 提出P2CLIP，从三个方面探索提示的作用：1）类别层面，指出简单指令下LLM生成的提示存在语义过度泛化问题，会模糊类别边界，为此设计通用-判别性提示（Generic-Discriminative Prompt），利用LLM获得语义丰富、具判别性的类别嵌入；2）视频与帧层面，用VLM与LLM生成帧和视频描述以增强视觉-文本对齐；3）提出知识引导时序聚合机制，利用LLM的专家知识指导视频时序建模，构建更优的联合视觉-文本特征空间。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验，涵盖零样本与少样本设置，验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过类别、视频、帧三层提示设计与知识引导的时序聚合，可有效缓解语义过度泛化与过拟合问题，提升开放词汇视频识别的泛化性能。

title: Estimating Surprisal from the Speech Signal
summary: Although language is predominantly spoken, empirical tests of surprisal theory rely almost entirely on written text. In practice, surprisal is estimated using language models (LMs) trained on text and applied to transcriptions, creating a text bottleneck that limits evaluation of the theory in the spoken modality. We remove this bottleneck by estimating surprisal directly from the speech signal using a speech LM. This raises a key question: should surprisal be defined over realization-specific acoustic inputs or over abstract linguistic units? Since a single unit can have many distinct acoustic realizations, each assigned a different probability by the model, defining surprisal over abstract units is difficult. To address this, we introduce an importance sampling estimator that approximates the probability of an abstract unit by marginalizing over realizations generated by a text-to-speech model. Using pupillometry data from a listening study, we evaluate surprisal theory in this text-free setting at multiple levels of granularity. Obtaining surprisal from several speech LMs, we consistently find that surprisal estimated via importance sampling better predicts pupil dilation than realization-specific surprisal for words. We also find that surprisal values for sub-lexical units are predictive of pupil dilation. While we find that surprisal can be estimated without recourse to text, and that marginalizing over distinct realizations of words is more predictive of lexical processing effort, surprisal as a whole is not a strong predictor of change in pupil size, regardless of its source.

AI.tldr: 该论文绕过"文本瓶颈"，直接用语音语言模型从语音信号估计surprisal，并提出重要性采样估计器以在抽象语言单位上定义surprisal，用瞳孔测量数据验证surprisal理论。
AI.motivation: 语言主要以口语形式存在，但surprisal理论的实证检验几乎完全依赖书面文本：实践中surprisal由文本训练的语言模型估计并应用于转写文本，形成"文本瓶颈"，限制了该理论在口语模态中的评估。
AI.method: 使用语音语言模型直接从语音信号估计surprisal。针对"surprisal应定义在具体声学实现上还是抽象语言单位上"的问题，提出重要性采样估计器：借助文本到语音模型生成多种实现，对实现边缘化以近似抽象单位的概率。基于听力研究的瞳孔测量数据，在无文本设定下、多个粒度层级、多个语音语言模型上评估surprisal理论。
AI.result: 经重要性采样估计的surprisal在词层级上比"实现特定"的surprisal更能预测瞳孔扩张；亚词单位的surprisal值也具有预测性。但总体而言，无论来源如何，surprisal对瞳孔大小变化的预测能力都不强。
AI.conclusion: surprisal可以在不依赖文本的情况下估计，对词的多种实现进行边缘化更能预测词汇加工努力；但surprisal整体上并非瞳孔大小变化的强预测因子。

title: LIBERO-Industry: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation under Industrial Process Constraints
summary: Industrial manipulation in flexible manufacturing, e.g., high-mix, low-volume (HMLV) electronics assembly, requires robot policies to adapt to changing products and production conditions. Such settings impose industrial process constraints, including product variants, moving material flows, finite execution windows, and tight geometric tolerances. However, existing evaluation frameworks do not systematically capture these constraints when assessing generalist robot policies. To address this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Industry, a novel benchmark built on the widely used robot learning benchmark LIBERO, that translates the aforementioned industrial constraints into controllable task conditions and measurable success criteria. Specifically, LIBERO-Industry comprises three classic task scenarios: Static-to-Dynamic (S2D) loading, Dynamic-to-Static (D2S) unloading, and Dynamic-to-Dynamic (D2D) transfer.
