The suites contain 216 tasks in total that systematically vary object geometry, conveyor speed, interaction-window duration, and geometric acceptance region size. Extensive experiments across five generalist robot policies (including vision-language-action models and world-action models) show that performance progressively degrades as industrial constraints are introduced and combined. Under a shared fine-tuning and evaluation protocol, the LIBERO-Industry co-training condition achieved higher observed target-transfer completion than the original-LIBERO condition.

AI.tldr: 提出 LIBERO-Industry 基准，将工业约束（产品变体、移动物料流、有限执行窗口、严苛几何公差）转化为可控任务条件与可测成功标准，含 216 个任务，评估五类通用机器人策略。
AI.motivation: 高混合低量（HMLV）电子装配等柔性制造场景要求机器人策略适应产品与生产条件变化，并满足工业过程约束；但现有评测框架未系统刻画这些约束，导致对通用机器人策略的评估与真实工业需求脱节。
AI.method: 基于 LIBERO 构建 LIBERO-Industry 基准，设三类场景：Static-to-Dynamic（S2D）上料、Dynamic-to-Static（D2S）下料、Dynamic-to-Dynamic（D2D）转运；共 216 个任务，系统变化物体几何、传送带速度、交互窗口时长与几何允收区域尺寸。在统一微调与评测协议下对五种通用机器人策略（含 VLA 模型与世界动作模型）进行广泛实验。
AI.result: 随工业约束被引入并叠加，策略性能逐步下降；在共享微调与评测协议下，LIBERO-Industry 协同训练条件相较原始 LIBERO 条件取得更高的目标转运完成度。
AI.conclusion: LIBERO-Industry 为工业柔性制造中的通用机器人策略提供了系统化、可量化的评测手段，揭示现有策略在工业约束下的性能退化，并表明工业基准协同训练有助于提升目标转运任务表现。

title: EvoSpatial: Experience-Driven Skill and Tool Evolution for Spatial Reasoning Agents
summary: Spatial reasoning agents can inspect tool outputs and repair errors, but reusing these lessons requires preserving both the computation and the conditions that make it valid. We introduce EvoSpatial, a framework that learns from execution experience by updating a library of linked skills and tools. Skills describe procedures, geometric assumptions, and verification steps; tools implement the operations those procedures require. When solving a task, the agent retrieves relevant skills and synthesizes reusable computational functions if existing tools are insufficient. After each task, execution feedback and evidence checks guide skill revision and tool consolidation, without ground-truth answers or benchmark scores. Across 20 benchmarks, EvoSpatial averages 63.9, 4.0 percentage points above the average reported by SpatialClaw. The evolved library also improves held-out and cross-benchmark performance when updates are disabled, and trajectories generated with evolved skills improve supervised fine-tuning, even without external skills at evaluation. Keeping checked procedures on record, together with the tools that support them, lets an agent carry spatial reasoning experience from one task to the next.

AI.tldr: EvoSpatial 通过在执行经验中演化“技能库+工具库”来实现空间推理错误修复经验的复用，在20个基准上平均63.9分，较SpatialClaw高4.0个百分点。
AI.motivation: 空间推理智能体虽能检查工具输出并修复错误，但要复用这些经验，必须同时保留计算过程及其成立条件（几何假设、验证步骤），现有方法缺乏对经验的可复用化沉淀机制。
AI.method: 提出 EvoSpatial 框架：从执行经验中学习，维护一个由相互关联的技能与工具构成的库。技能描述过程、几何假设与验证步骤；工具实现相应操作。求解任务时，检索相关技能，若现有工具不足则合成可复用的计算函数。任务完成后，依据执行反馈与证据校验进行技能修订与工具整合，整个过程不依赖标准答案或基准分数。
AI.result: 在20个基准上平均得分63.9，比SpatialClaw报告的平均值高4.0个百分点；演化后的库在禁用更新时仍能提升留出集与跨基准性能；用演化技能生成的轨迹可提升监督微调效果，即便评估时无外部技能。
AI.conclusion: 将经过校验的过程与支撑它们的工具一同记录留存，使智能体能够把空间推理经验从一个任务迁移到下一个任务。

title: Copying Is Not Grounding: Training Faithful Long-Form RAG with Authored-Sentence Credit
summary: In search engines and assistants, long-form RAG answers can mislead readers with claims their sources do not support. Faithfulness rewards, the share of supported sentences, train models toward fewer such claims. We show that these rewards are hacked by copying. A sentence copied from the passages is supported almost by construction, so trained models learn to copy rather than ground what they write. Common defenses only move the hack: a KL or copy penalty leaves copying in place or trades it for shorter, emptier answers and refusals. GRPO, the standard RL algorithm, makes it worse by giving every sentence its answer's advantage, reinforcing copied and grounded sentences alike. We propose Authored-Sentence Credit (ASC) , which fixes both by moving GRPO's reward and advantage from the answer to the sentence level. The reward credits only sentences that are authored rather than copied, say more than the question, and are supported by the passages. The advantage compares each sentence with every sentence sampled for the question, so one that earns no credit ranks last and is never reinforced. Across four models and two in-domain, three held-out corpora, only ASC lowers the error rate of authored sentences and writes more supported ones in every setting, by 38% and 46% at the median under held-out evaluators, giving readers more grounded information. It takes none of these shortcuts, and two LLM judges comparing whole answers prefer no baseline to the base model but rate ASC's answers on par with it. We conclude that a faithfulness reward should credit what a model writes, not what it copies.

AI.tldr: 长文本RAG答案的忠实度奖励会被"复制"行为套利：复制段落中的句子几乎天然被支持，模型因此学会抄袭而非真正基于证据作答。作者提出句子级信用分配方法ASC，将GRPO的奖励与优势从答案级下移到句子级，仅在"自撰、信息量高于问题、且被段落支持"时给予信用，从而在四个模型、五个语料上同时降低自撰句子错误率并增加被支持内容。
AI.motivation: 搜索引擎与助手生成的RAG长答案可能包含来源不支持的论断，会误导读者。常用忠实度奖励（被支持句子占比）本应减少此类论断，但存在被利用的漏洞：直接从检索段落中复制的句子几乎"天然"被支持，模型因此学会复制而非进行真正的证据落地（grounding）。常见防御手段（KL惩罚、复制惩罚）只是转移而非消除该套利——要么保留复制，要么以更短、更空洞的答案和拒答为代价。标准RL算法GRPO进一步加剧问题：它把整条答案的优势值分配给每个句子，使被复制与被真正落地的句子同等被强化。
AI.method: 提出Authored-Sentence Credit（ASC），将GRPO的奖励与优势从答案级迁移到句子级。(1)奖励：仅对同时满足三个条件的句子给分——由模型自撰而非复制、比问题提供更多信息、且被检索段落支持。(2)优势：将每个句子与同一问题下采样的所有句子比较，未获得任何信用的句子排名最后，因而不会被强化。由此同时修正奖励套利与优势错配两个问题。
AI.result: 在四个模型、两个域内语料与三个留出语料上，ASC是唯一在所有设定下都降低自撰句子错误率并写出更多被支持句子的方法：在留出评测器下中位数分别改善38%与46%，为读者提供更多有依据的信息。ASC未采取上述任何捷径（不靠复制、不靠变短或拒答），且两个LLM评判器在整条答案对比中，认为没有任何基线优于基础模型，而ASC的答案与基础模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 忠实度奖励应奖励模型"写了什么"，而非"抄了什么"；句子级、区分自撰与复制的信用分配（ASC）能在不牺牲答案质量与信息量的前提下，有效提升RAG长答案的忠实度。

title: Same Operation, Different Permission: Evaluating Whether Guardrails Honor Authorization
summary: As language-model agents write code, move money and change records on behalf of users, deciding whether an action is authorized has become a central safety problem. Guardrails are often placed in front of these actions, yet few evaluations ask whether their decisions follow authorization: blocking unauthorized actions while still allowing the same actions under valid permission. We introduce \bench{}, a benchmark that contrasts authorization evidence for the same operation in its language track. It combines expert-annotated natural-language scenarios with executed and verified operations, plus externally sourced native-policy requests. \bench{} checks each decision for correctness, usability and resulting effect, and tracks each request across guardrail changes. Our experiments show that many blocked operations stem from failed reviews, not correct denials. Repairing the output format restores usable decisions but changes which authorized requests are honored, and adding a second reviewer removes some errors while rejecting valid authorization. Guardrails should therefore be evaluated on both the unauthorized actions they stop and the authorized actions they let through.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 \bench{} 基准，通过"语言轨迹"对比同一操作的授权证据，评估护栏决策的授权一致性，即拦截未授权操作同时放行有效授权操作的能力。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体代用户写代码、转移资金、修改记录，判断动作是否被授权成为核心安全问题。现有护栏评测很少追问其决策是否真正遵循授权：即是否拦截了未授权动作，同时在有效权限下仍放行同一动作。
AI.method: 构建 \bench{} 基准，在其语言轨迹中对比同一操作的授权证据。基准整合了专家标注的自然语言场景、经过执行与验证的操作，以及来自外部的原生策略请求。对每个决策检查正确性、可用性与产生的实际效果，并跟踪每个请求在护栏变更下的表现。
AI.result: 实验表明，许多被拦截的操作源于评审失败，而非正确的拒绝。修复输出格式可恢复可用决策，但会改变哪些授权请求被放行；增加第二名评审者能消除部分错误，同时也会拒绝有效的授权请求。
AI.conclusion: 护栏应同时依据其拦截的未授权动作与被放行的授权动作进行评估。

title: 3D-VITAL: Visibility-aware Identity Training from Artificial Liftings of 3D Reconstruction model for Cross-View Object Re-Identification
summary: We address the Cross-View Object Re-Identification (ReID) task, aiming to match identities across drastically different viewpoints. We focus on Single-View Aerial-Ground ReID (SV AG-ReID), where models train on one viewpoint and must generalize to another at inference. To bridge this viewpoint gap, related work employs generative models to synthesize novel views from source images as additional training data. We leverage recent advances in large-scale single-view 3D mesh reconstruction to lift source images into textured meshes and to render them from new viewpoints. However, this pipeline produces unreliable data in two distinct ways. First, the reconstruction may fail and produce geometrically incorrect meshes, resulting in severe corruption in rendered novel views. Second, even when the geometry is correct, the rendered novel views contain hallucinated textures in regions not visible in the source image. The reconstructed mesh carries a per-pixel partition between regions visible from the source view and regions that the reconstruction model had to hallucinate, available as a deterministic byproduct of rendering. We introduce this per-pixel visibility map and exploit it in a two-stage design. Cross-View Consistency Filtering (CVCF) discards geometrically incorrect meshes by ensuring multi-view consistency between source and novel views over visible patches. Visibility-Aware Attention Supervision (VAAS) leverages the visibility map to guide the model's attention toward reliable regions of the rendered view during training. Combined, these two components enable our method, 3D-VITAL, to better leverage the synthetic signal from single-view 3D mesh reconstruction. 3D-VITAL sets a new state-of-the-art on three SV AG-ReID benchmarks. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/TurtleSmoke/3D-VITAL.

AI.tldr: 提出3D-VITAL方法，利用单视图3D网格重建的可见性图，通过两阶段设计提升单视图空-地跨视角行人重识别性能，并在三个基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 针对单视图空-地ReID（SV AG-ReID）中训练与推理视角差异大的问题，现有工作用生成模型合成新视角数据，但单视图3D网格重建管线会产生两类不可靠数据：几何错误导致渲染严重损坏，以及几何正确时对源视图不可见区域产生幻觉纹理。
AI.method: 将源图像提升为带纹理网格并渲染新视角，利用渲染的确定性副产品——逐像素可见性图（区分源视图可见区域与需幻觉区域），设计两阶段：1）跨视角一致性过滤（CVCF），通过可见patch上源视图与新视图的多视角一致性剔除几何错误网格；2）可见性感知注意力监督（VAAS），用可见性图引导模型关注渲染视图中的可靠区域。
AI.result: 3D-VITAL在三个SV AG-ReID基准上取得新的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 逐像素可见性图作为有效的确定性信号，结合CVCF与VAAS两阶段设计，能更好地利用单视图3D网格重建产生的合成信号，显著提升跨视角ReID性能。

title: Aligning Faithfulness for Theory-Scale Autoformalization
summary: Autoformalization (AF) requires more than compilation: formal statements must preserve the meaning of their informal sources, a property known as faithfulness. An emerging frontier is the automated evaluation of this property, yet most existing methods operate at the statement level and produce whole-item verdicts, failing to reveal how individual expressions correspond or which contextual interpretations support the judgment. This omission is consequential because AF is inherently theory-scale: target statements derive their meaning from surrounding mathematical material and unstated conventions. We formulate faithfulness evaluation as a context-aware align-then-label problem: identifying phrase-level correspondences between informal and formal statements and assigning a faithfulness label to each under explicitly specified contextual interpretations and assumptions. We also introduce FaithAlign, the first theory-scale faithfulness benchmark comprising 460 items and 4,982 annotated phrase-level links, alongside FaithAlign-Gap, a companion set of 146 items with informal context and assumptions withheld. Each FaithAlign item includes the target statement pair, relevant context, formal dependencies, and, where needed, assumptions specifying one given interpretation. Across 8 models, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest defect F1 at 47.8% and identifies all defects in only 4.5% of items with two or more defects. On FaithAlign-Gap, Astra identifies only 28.2% of undecidable items as such. These results show the difficulty of recovering context-dependent correspondences, establishing FaithAlign as a testbed for fine-grained, context-aware faithfulness evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文将自动形式化的忠实性评估重新表述为"上下文感知的先对齐后标注"问题，并构建了首个理论规模的忠实性基准FaithAlign及缺上下文版本FaithAlign-Gap，实验显示现有模型在细粒度、上下文依赖的忠实性判断上仍有很大差距。
AI.motivation: 自动形式化不仅要求形式语句可编译，还要求其忠实于非形式来源的语义。现有忠实性自动评估大多停留在语句层面，只给出整条判断，无法揭示具体表达式之间的对应关系，也无法说明是哪些上下文解释支持该判断。而自动形式化本质上是理论规模的：形式语句的意义依赖周围数学材料与未明说的约定，因此忽略上下文会带来实质性问题。
AI.method: 作者将忠实性评估形式化为"上下文感知的先对齐后标注"（context-aware align-then-label）问题：先识别非形式与形式语句之间的短语级对应关系，再在显式给定的上下文解释与假设下为每条对应赋予忠实性标签。为此构建FaithAlign基准，包含460个条目、4,982条短语级标注链接；每个条目给出目标任务语句对、相关上下文、形式依赖，以及（必要时）指定某一解释的假设。另构建FaithAlign-Gap，含146个条目，刻意隐去非形式上下文与假设。
AI.result: 在8个模型上评测，GPT-6 Astra取得最高的缺陷F1为47.8%，但仅能在4.5%的含两个及以上缺陷的条目中找出全部缺陷。在FaithAlign-Gap上，Astra仅将28.2%的不可判定条目正确识别为不可判定。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明恢复上下文依赖的对应关系十分困难，FaithAlign可作为细粒度、上下文感知的忠实性评估测试平台。

title: CLIVO: Differentiable Cluster-Based Instruction Mixing with Learned Validation Objectives
summary: Target-aware multimodal instruction selection requires useful examples and an appropriate balance of supervision. Sample-level rankings can overrepresent similar content without optimizing this balance; group-level methods face coarse units, predefined set-level validation signals, and costly or inaccurate mixture search. We propose CLIVO, a target-aware framework connecting fine-grained semantic allocation, automatically learned validation objectives, and differentiable mixture search. Specifically, semantic clusters provide independently adjustable shares at the hundred-cluster scale. Correlations between per-example merged-proxy losses and real probe performance identify target-relevant validation examples; learned nonnegative weights combine their losses into an objective. A single backward pass through the merged proxy supplies gradients for all shares, avoiding an additional mixture-response regression model. Selecting 100K instructions from an 8M pool, CLIVO attains 97.2% of the full-data four-target average score with only 1.25% of the data. It improves on the strongest evaluated selection baseline by 1.16 points using random within-cluster sampling; combining learned quotas with sample ranking increases this advantage to 1.55 points. Analyses show that finer units benefit most targets, short-trained experts preserve mixture responses, sample weighting retains useful validation information, and direct search consistently reduces the learned objective. CLIVO also supports interpretable allocation, modular selection, and reuse across targets and granularities.

AI.tldr: 提出CLIVO，一个面向目标的多模态指令选择框架，通过语义聚类配额分配、自动学习验证目标与可微混合搜索，仅用1.25%数据即达全量四目标平均分的97.2%。
AI.motivation: 目标感知的多模态指令选择需要有效样本与监督平衡，但样本级排序会过度代表相似内容且不优化平衡，组级方法又存在单元粗糙、集合级验证信号预设、混合搜索昂贵或不准确等问题。
AI.method: CLIVO将细粒度语义分配、自动学习的验证目标与可微混合搜索相连接：语义聚类提供百级规模可独立调整的配额；利用每样本合并代理损失与真实探测性能的相关性识别目标相关验证样本，并以可学习非负权重组合其损失构成目标；通过合并代理的单次反向传播为所有配额提供梯度，无需额外的混合响应回归模型。
AI.result: 从800万池中选取10万条指令，CLIVO以1.25%数据达到全量四目标平均分的97.2%；在随机簇内采样下比最强基线高1.16分，结合学习配额与样本排序后优势增至1.55分。
AI.conclusion: 分析表明更细单元对多数目标有益、短训练专家可保留混合响应、样本加权保留有用验证信息、直接搜索持续降低学习目标；CLIVO支持可解释分配、模块化选择，并可跨目标与粒度复用。

title: PathPilot: An Adaptive Question-Conditioned Multi-Magnification Navigation Agent for Whole-Slide Image Analysis
summary: The diagnostic capability of WSI agents relies on effective slide navigation to identify diagnostically relevant regions and efficiently integrate evidence across the slide. While in clinical practice, pathologists dynamically examine slides across multiple scales, integrating global and cellular evidence in a sequential manner, existing AI navigation approaches mostly operate at a single fixed magnification or rely on predefined magnification traversal. This mismatch prevents existing methods from modeling cross-magnification interactions and adaptive magnification selection inherent to real diagnostic workflows. We propose PathPilot, a clinically consistent multi-magnification WSI navigation agent that explicitly models cross-magnification localization and evidence-adaptive exploration. Specifically, we introduce a CrossMagLoc that learns magnification-specific diagnostic localization from pathologist viewing behavior and integrates information from adjacent magnifications to identify the diagnostically most relevant region within the current ROI, thereby providing a diagnostically informed starting point for subsequent question-conditioned exploration. We further introduce an EviRegionSearch that starts question-conditioned exploration from this region, progressively accumulating question-relevant evidence and adaptively determining the next navigation action according to the remaining evidence requirement. Their iterative interaction enables PathPilot to sequentially explore across ROIs and magnifications until sufficient evidence is acquired. Extensive QA evaluations across five cohorts demonstrate consistent superiority over competing SOTA methods on inter/external cohorts, respectively, validating question-conditioned evidence acquisition across regions and magnifications that mirrors the sequential, knowledge-driven navigation of pathologists.

AI.tldr: 提出 PathPilot，一种临床一致的多倍率 WSI 导航智能体，通过跨倍率定位与证据自适应探索模拟病理医生的序贯诊断流程。
AI.motivation: 现有 WSI 导航方法多在单一固定倍率下运行或依赖预定义倍率遍历，无法建模真实诊断中跨倍率交互与自适应倍率选择，与病理医生动态多倍率检视行为不匹配。
AI.method: PathPilot 包含两个模块：CrossMagLoc 从病理医生阅片行为中学习倍率特异的诊断定位，并融合相邻倍率信息，在当前 ROI 内识别诊断最相关区域，为后续探索提供诊断知情起点；EviRegionSearch 从该区域出发进行问题条件化探索，逐步累积问题相关证据，并依据剩余证据需求自适应决定下一步导航动作。二者迭代交互，实现跨 ROI 与跨倍率的序贯探索直至获取充分证据。
AI.result: 在五个队列上的大量 QA 评估中，于内部/外部队列上均持续优于竞争性 SOTA 方法。
AI.conclusion: PathPilot 验证了跨区域、跨倍率的问题条件化证据获取能力，能够复现病理医生序贯、知识驱动的导航行为。

title: The Last Mile of Coding Agents for Long-Document Tasks: An Empirical Study on Clinical Trial Protocol Digitization
summary: Clinical trial protocols serve as the source of truth for study design, but are mostly written and used as unstructured PDF documents. Digitizing protocols turns static content into structured, machine-readable data that clinical software can analyze, validate, and execute. Coding agents, which select tools, execute code, and revise their approach as they work, are increasingly applied to such long-document tasks, yet it remains unclear how reliably they turn complete documents into accurate structured outputs. We study this question using protocol digitization as a testbed. We introduce TrialPD-Bench, an expert-annotated benchmark of 150 publicly available protocol PDFs spanning four task categories. Beyond final-answer performance, our evaluation measures evidence recall from agent traces, agent behavior, and cost. Across nine proprietary and open-weight models in five coding-agent harnesses, even the strongest agents do not fully solve protocol digitization. Our analysis further shows that agents usually locate the required evidence but fail in the last mile of transcribing and structuring it. We further develop TrialScribe, a domain-specific harness that equips coding agents with task skills and a verification loop. TrialScribe improves a locally served open-weight model by 6.2-59.4 points across eight metrics, enabling it to match or surpass proprietary models such as GPT-5.6-Sol.

AI.tldr: 本文以临床试验方案数字化为试验床，提出专家标注基准TrialPD-Bench（150份公开方案PDF、四类任务），系统评测九个模型在五种编码智能体框架下的表现，发现智能体能定位证据但常在"最后一公里"结构化转录中失败，并据此提出专用框架TrialScribe。
AI.motivation: 临床试验方案是研究设计的"真相来源"，但多以非结构化PDF形式存在；数字化可将其转化为结构化、机器可读数据供临床软件分析、验证与执行。编码智能体虽被广泛用于长文档任务，但其将完整文档可靠转化为准确结构化输出的能力尚不明确，因此需要系统评测。
AI.method: 以方案数字化为测试场景，构建专家标注基准TrialPD-Bench：150份公开方案PDF、覆盖四个任务类别；评测不仅考察最终答案性能，还度量智能体轨迹中的证据召回率、智能体行为与成本；在五种编码智能体框架下评测九个专有与开放权重模型；并开发领域专用框架TrialScribe，为编码智能体配备任务技能与验证循环。
AI.result: 即便最强智能体也未能完全解决方案数字化任务；分析显示智能体通常能定位所需证据，但在转录与结构化的"最后一公里"环节失败；TrialScribe使本地部署的开放权重模型在八项指标上提升6.2-59.4分，达到或超过GPT-5.6-Sol等专有模型。
AI.conclusion: 现有编码智能体在长文档结构化转换任务上仍不可靠，瓶颈在于证据转录与结构化的末端环节而非证据检索；引入领域技能与验证循环的专用框架可显著缩小开放权重模型与专有模型之间的差距。

title: Acceptable Misalignment
summary: There is a specific challenge designers face in developing autonomous robots capable of open-ended learning. This challenge is how one can develop such systems in an ethically sound way when there are many unknowns during design time about their manner of deployment, what they can and will learn, and how these systems will act on the basis of what they have learned. One response to this challenge is to align, as far as possible, the activities and goals of autonomous robots with human values, raising the question of how to make this alignment possible, a question known as the value alignment problem. We argue that the value alignment problem faces a number of challenges that show that full alignment is both theoretically and practically impossible, meaning that misalignment incidents will keep occurring. This undermines current alignment approaches, as the attempt to maximize alignment cannot properly deal with the possibility that the risk of misalignment that remains after alignment methods have been implemented might still be unacceptable to society. To overcome this difficulty, we argue that a shift in perspective is required from a focus on the maximization of alignment to the conditions under which misalignment incidents become acceptable. In this paper, we explore what this shift in perspective entails. We introduce the concept of acceptable misalignment, formulate normative requirements for alignment mechanisms aimed at bringing misalignment incidents to an acceptable level, and we conclude by presenting a new methodological framework that consists of alignment mechanisms that can meet these requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文指出价值对齐问题在理论与实践上均无法完全实现，错位事件将持续发生。作者主张从"最大化对齐"转向探讨"何种条件下错位事件可被接受"，提出"可接受错位"概念及规范性要求，并给出新的方法学框架。
AI.motivation: 自主机器人具备开放式学习能力，其部署方式、学习内容及基于所学采取的行动在设计阶段存在大量未知，难以在伦理上可接受地开发此类系统。现有回应是对齐机器人目标与人类价值（价值对齐问题），但这一思路的局限需要被重新审视。
AI.method: 概念分析与规范性论证：论证价值对齐面临多重挑战，完全对齐在理论上和实践上都不可能；进而提出视角转换——从对齐最大化转向研究错位事件可接受的条件，提出"可接受错位"概念，并为对齐机制制定规范性要求，构建相应的方法学框架。
AI.result: 论证表明完全对齐不可能，残余错位风险将持续存在，这削弱了以对齐最大化为目标的现有方法；提出"可接受错位"概念及对齐机制的规范性要求，并给出由可满足这些要求的对齐机制组成的新方法学框架。
AI.conclusion: 应对自主机器人开放学习的伦理挑战，不应执着于对齐最大化，而应关注使错位事件降至可接受水平的条件；"可接受错位"视角及配套规范性要求与方法学框架提供了新的研究路径。

title: VAttnPO: Visual Attention-Guided Policy Optimization
summary: Multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards commonly assigns one sequence advantage to an entire response. This outcome-level signal distinguishes overall response quality but leaves changes in visual-evidence use across generated tokens implicit. We introduce VAttnPO (Visual Attention-Guided Policy Optimization), which uses answer-conditioned visual attention to refine token-level credit while preserving the verifier-derived trajectory-mean advantage. A frozen old policy constructs a visual reference by teacher forcing the known correct answer and produces a visual distribution for each rollout token. VAttnPO measures their agreement in visual-attention space using Jensen--Shannon divergence, rather than reading guidance from teacher output-token distributions or introducing an attention-matching objective. Trajectory centering, relative-position weighting, and credit balancing turn this agreement into a zero-mean, position-aware correction to the GRPO sequence advantage. Token intervention, visual-index permutation, and trajectory analysis provide diagnostic evidence linking this signal to model behavior, visual correspondence, and generation position. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, VAttnPO raises six-task image AVE from 70.97 with GRPO to 73.50 and scores higher on every reported structured, video, and MME metric. Gains over GRPO also hold on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and InternVL3-8B-Instruct.

AI.tldr: VAttnPO 利用答案条件下的视觉注意力，在保留 GRPO 序列优势的同时进行 token 级信用修正，在多个多模态基准上稳定优于 GRPO。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态可验证奖励强化学习通常将同一序列优势赋予整条回复，这种结果级信号只能区分整体质量，无法体现生成过程中对视觉证据使用情况的变化，导致 token 级信用分配不精细。
AI.method: 提出 VAttnPO：由冻结的旧策略在已知正确答案的教师强制下构建视觉参考，并为每个 rollout token 生成视觉分布；用 Jensen–Shannon 散度在视觉注意力空间度量二者一致性，而非依赖教师输出 token 分布或引入注意力匹配目标；再通过轨迹中心化、相对位置加权与信用平衡，将一致性转化为零均值、位置感知的修正项，叠加到 GRPO 序列优势上。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上，VAttnPO 将六任务图像 AVE 从 GRPO 的 70.97 提升至 73.50，并在所有报告的结构化、视频及 MME 指标上均更高；在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 与 InternVL3-8B-Instruct 上同样保持相对 GRPO 的增益。
AI.conclusion: 以视觉注意力一致性构造 token 级信用修正，可在不破坏 GRPO 轨迹级优势的前提下提升多模态强化学习效果；token 干预、视觉索引置换与轨迹分析等诊断结果支持该信号与模型行为、视觉对应关系及生成位置相关。

title: Imprinting: Knowledge Distillation Can Shift Student Behavior
summary: Knowledge distillation trains student models on teacher-generated responses to transfer task capability, but those responses may also carry behavioral tendencies of their source. We investigate whether the source teacher can shape student behavior beyond the capability that distillation is intended to transfer. We construct harm-accepting and harm-avoiding variants of the same base teacher, use them to generate responses to ordinary reasoning and knowledge questions unrelated to safety, and distill those responses into students with different base models. Students generally acquire task capability while their downstream decisions shift toward the source teacher's safety-pragmatism disposition, a phenomenon we call imprinting. Distillation from the harm-accepting teacher reduces harm avoidance, whereas distillation from the harm-avoiding teacher increases it. Imprinting varies across teacher-student pairs and does not extend uniformly across different forms of safety behavior. Excluding a sparse set of divergence tokens reduces imprinting, whereas response rewriting preserves the source-dependent effect and can introduce additional rewriter-dependent shifts. Post-distillation preference optimization raises harm avoidance but does not eliminate the source-dependent difference. These results show that behavioral tendencies can be intentionally imprinted through the source teacher, even with ordinary task supervision.

AI.tldr: 知识蒸馏不仅迁移任务能力，还会将源教师模型的行为倾向（安全实用主义立场）传给不同底座的学生模型，作者将这一现象命名为"印刻"。
AI.motivation: 以往研究普遍认为知识蒸馏主要用于迁移任务能力，但教师生成的响应可能同时携带其来源模型的行为倾向；作者希望验证蒸馏是否会在能力之外、在无关安全的普通任务上传递教师的行为倾向。
AI.method: 构造同一底座教师的"接受伤害"与"规避伤害"两个变体，用它们对与安全无关的普通推理与知识问题生成响应，再蒸馏到不同底座的学生模型中；进一步通过剔除稀疏的发散标记、响应改写以及蒸馏后的偏好优化进行干预与对照分析。
AI.result: 学生在获得任务能力的同时，其下游决策向源教师的安全实用主义倾向偏移；来自接受伤害教师的蒸馏降低学生的伤害规避，来自规避伤害教师的蒸馏则提高之。印刻程度随师生组合而变，且不统一延伸到不同形式的安全行为。剔除稀疏发散标记可减弱印刻，响应改写保留源依赖效应并可能引入改写者相关偏移；蒸馏后偏好优化提高伤害规避但未消除源依赖差异。
AI.conclusion: 行为倾向可以被源教师有意识地"印刻"到学生模型中，即使监督信号仅来自普通任务，这提示蒸馏数据的来源属性本身构成一种隐性影响渠道。

title: Transparency as Answerability: Role-Dependent Information Flow Modeling
comment: 30 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Under revision at ACM Journal on Responsible Computing
summary: Transparency in AI-supported decision systems is widely required but poorly defined. Existing approaches treat transparency as a property of systems or components, producing characteristic failures: assessments that do not transfer across organizational boundaries, stakeholder questions that cannot be formulated within the available frame of analysis, and component-level findings that say nothing about system-level behavior. We propose treating transparency as a relation: a system is transparent to a stakeholder to the degree that their legitimate questions are answerable from its structure. We formalize this using information flow networks, in which transparency questions are expressed in terms of network structure and answerability is the condition that the system settles them. The framework supports three dimensions of analysis: structural answerability from the network alone, compositional answerability across organizational boundaries for deployed systems, and role-dependent answerability given a stakeholder's accessible sub-network. We demonstrate the framework on a real pre-integration assessment of an AI recruitment tool in a public sector municipality. The assessment uses participatory design and interviews to model the decision system structure. We show how structural and role-dependent transparency questions can be formally stated and analyzed across the Provider and Deployer boundary where the AI system is composed together with the deployer's decision process.

AI.tldr: 该论文将透明度重新定义为一种关系：系统对特定利益相关者透明，当且仅当其合法问题可从系统结构中作答。作者用信息流网络形式化该定义，提出结构、组合与角色相关三个分析维度，并在某公共部门市政机构的AI招聘工具预集成评估中验证。
AI.motivation: 现有研究把透明度当作系统或组件的固有属性，导致评估结果无法跨组织边界迁移、利益相关者的问题难以在既有分析框架内表述、组件级结论无法解释系统级行为。因此需要一种新的透明度概念与形式化框架。
AI.method: 提出透明度即关系（relational transparency）：系统对利益相关者的透明程度等于其合法问题可从系统结构中得到答复的程度。使用信息流网络（information flow networks）进行形式化，将透明度问题表达为网络结构属性，将可答复性定义为系统对问题的"解决"条件。框架包含三个分析维度：（1）仅凭网络的结构可答复性；（2）面向已部署系统、跨组织边界的组合可答复性；（3）给定利益相关者可访问子网络的角色相关可答复性。案例研究采用参与式设计与访谈来建模决策系统结构。
AI.result: 在一个公共部门市政机构的AI招聘工具预集成评估中，框架能够形式化表述并分析跨越Provider与Deployer边界的结构性与角色相关透明度问题，该边界正是AI系统与部署方决策流程组合之处。
AI.conclusion: 将透明度视为关系并由信息流网络形式化，可克服属性式透明度观的三类典型失败，为跨组织、面向部署与角色差异的透明度评估提供可操作的分析框架。

title: FoveaTree: Information-Density Trees for Query-Guided Visual Token Pruning in Video Large Language Models
summary: Video large language models (Video LLMs) encode each frame into hundreds of visual tokens, making video inference expensive. Existing methods reduce this cost through similarity-based merging or attention-based selection but face two challenges: Hierarchy-blind Pruning, which overlooks regional compressibility and can discard critical evidence, and Attention Drift, where positional effects and attention sinks shift text-to-vision attention away from task relevance. We propose FoveaTree, a two-stage, training-free visual-token pruning framework. First, Merge-Gain Density Estimation measures the feature distortion caused by regional merging and constructs a quadtree-derived density map to guide token dropping, merging, and retention. Second, Attention Tree Pruning uses the surviving units and inherited tree topology to refine text-to-vision attention in intermediate LLM layers, preserving relevant regional evidence while removing low-relevance content. We evaluate FoveaTree on InternVL3.5-8B and Qwen3-VL-8B across five video question-answering benchmarks and one captioning benchmark at 50%, 30%, and 10% visual-token retention. FoveaTree consistently achieves overall state-of-the-art performance across the evaluated settings, offering a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

AI.tldr: FoveaTree，一种两阶段免训练视频视觉token剪枝框架，先基于合并增益密度估计构建四叉树密度图指导token取舍，再用注意力树剪枝在中间层精炼文-视注意力，在多个基准上以50%/30%/10%保留率取得SOTA精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 视频大模型将每帧编码为数百个视觉token，导致推理成本高昂。现有基于相似度合并或注意力选择的方法存在两大问题：一是"层级盲剪枝"，忽视区域可压缩性差异，可能丢弃关键证据；二是"注意力漂移"，位置效应与注意力汇使文到视注意力偏离任务相关性。
AI.method: 提出FoveaTree，两阶段免训练视觉token剪枝框架。第一阶段为合并增益密度估计：度量区域合并造成的特征失真，构建源自四叉树的密度图，指导token的丢弃、合并与保留。第二阶段为注意力树剪枝：利用存活单元与继承的树拓扑，在LLM中间层精炼文到视注意力，保留相关区域证据并移除低相关性内容。
AI.result: 在InternVL3.5-8B与Qwen3-VL-8B上，于五个视频问答基准和一个视频描述基准，分别在50%、30%、10%视觉token保留率下评测。FoveaTree在所有评测设置中整体达到SOTA，提供强精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: FoveaTree通过层级感知的密度估计与树结构注意力精炼，有效缓解层级盲剪枝与注意力漂移问题，在免训练前提下实现视频LLM推理的高效压缩与领先性能。

title: The Geometry of Language Model Logits: Generic Structure and Learned Departures
summary:
Autoregressive language models produce, at every prediction step, a vocabulary-sized logit vector whose structure determines the conditional next-token distribution. We empirically identify that the ordered vocabulary-head logits follow a remarkably consistent log-linear relation
  \[ z_{(r)} \approx μ- α\log r. \] across prediction contexts, architectures, and scales, emerging progressively during pretraining. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic analysis of the logit geometry underlying the distributional assumptions used in the prior decoding work. While controlled order-statistic baselines spanning bounded, light-tailed, and heavier-tailed distributions can largely explain the observed log-linear geometry, they do not explain the systematic shift in the slope $α$: trained language models exhibit $α\approx 1.4$--$1.7$, sitting well above the initialization baseline ($α\approx 0.2$) . Moreover, $α$ correlates with predictive performance, suggesting that it captures learned structure beyond generic extreme-value effects.

AI.tldr: 自回归语言模型每步预测产生的词表大小logit向量，其有序logit与排名呈稳定的对数线性关系 z_(r)≈μ-αlog r，且斜率α≈1.4–1.7显著高于初始化基线，并与预测性能相关。
AI.motivation: 已有解码工作依赖于对下一词分布的分布假设，但缺乏对其底层logit几何结构的系统分析。本文旨在实证刻画该几何结构，以检验这些分布假设的合理性。
AI.method: 在不同预测上下文、架构与规模下，对每个预测步的词表logit进行排序，拟合有序logit与排名r的对数线性关系 z_(r)≈μ-αlog r；并构建涵盖有界、轻尾与重尾分布的受控次序统计量基线进行对比，考察α在预训练过程中的演化及其与性能的关系。
AI.result: 有序词表logit普遍遵循对数线性关系，在预训练中逐步显现；受控次序统计量基线可解释该几何形态，但无法解释斜率的系统性偏移——训练模型的α≈1.4–1.7，远高于初始化的α≈0.2；且α与预测性能呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统分析了先前解码工作所依赖分布假设背后的logit几何；对数线性几何可由极值/次序统计效应部分解释，但斜率α反映了超出通用极值效应的学习结构，并与模型性能相关，可作为刻画下一词分布尾部结构的有效指标。

title: Observe, Share, or Predict? Disentangling Partner Information in Embodied Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: LLMs are used as high-level controllers for embodied agents, but it remains unclear whether they support collaborative reasoning, such as anticipating a collaborator's actions in real-time teamwork without dialogue. We ask if observing the partner's state, exchanging object knowledge, and predicting the partner's next action, shape task outcomes and coordination when agents can share percepts but never intentions, plans, or task-level messages, and whether the two agents occupy symmetric roles. Using the Habitat-based PARTNR benchmark, we introduce a Decoupled Partial Observability regime that enforces strictly individual perception, and we augment decentralized zero-shot ReAct planners with Other Agent's State (OAS) observation, object Knowledge Exchange (KE) between co-located agents, and Other Agent's Next Action (OANA) prediction, evaluated on the full 2 x 2 x 2 grid with four planners on 1,000 validation tasks. OAS observation improves task quality, reducing extraneous effort for every planner, whereas KE primarily improves execution efficiency, cutting simulation steps by up to 25% with little change in success. The two are largely redundant for strong planners but complementary for the weakest, for which KE without the OAS is the worst configuration. OANA prediction lowers the success rate in 15 of 16 model x context pairs while raising explicit partner mentions to 55-100%, and its accuracy gains lie mainly in the coarse action type, partly because agents recognize the action the partner is already performing. The robot retrieves objects sooner and completes its tasks earlier than the simulated human. Shared context reduces total task time by shortening the remaining duration that the human works alone. Also, coordination benefits arise from responding to shared context, especially the OAS, rather than explicit anticipation, yielding shallow, planner-dependent partner modeling.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于PARTNR基准提出"解耦部分可观测"设定，检验LLM具身智能体在无对话、无意图共享条件下能否通过观察伙伴状态、交换物体知识与预测伙伴动作实现协作，揭示协调收益主要来自对共享上下文的响应而非显式预测。
AI.motivation: LLM已广泛用作具身智能体的高层控制器，但其是否支持无对话实时团队协作中的伙伴动作预判尚不明确。作者希望在智能体仅能共享感知、无法共享意图/计划/任务级消息的严格条件下，厘清伙伴状态观测、物体知识交换与下一动作预测三者对任务结果与协调的影响，并考察两智能体角色是否对称。
AI.method: 基于Habitat的PARTNR基准，提出Decoupled Partial Observability机制以强制严格个体感知；在去中心化零样本ReAct规划器上分别加入三项能力：其他智能体状态观测（OAS）、共处智能体间的物体知识交换（KE）、其他智能体下一动作预测（OANA）。在完整2×2×2网格上用四种规划器、1000个验证任务进行评测。
AI.result: OAS观测提升任务质量，对每种规划器都减少多余动作；KE主要提升执行效率，仿真步数最多减少25%，成功率变化不大。两者对强规划器基本冗余，对最弱规划器互补，其中"KE无OAS"为最差配置。OANA预测在16个模型×上下文组合中有15个降低成功率，但将显式提及伙伴的比例提高到55%–100%，其准确度提升主要集中于粗粒度动作类型，部分原因是智能体识别的是伙伴正在执行的动作。机器人比模拟人类更早取物、更早完成任务；共享上下文通过缩短人类独自工作的时间降低总任务时长。
AI.conclusion: 协作收益主要来自对共享上下文（尤其是OAS）的响应，而非显式预判，伙伴建模呈现浅层且依赖规划器的特征。

title: The Midas Touch for Metric Depth: Interpretable Metricization for Generalizable Depth Perception
summary: Recent foundation models have drastically improved the generalization of monocular relative depth estimation, yet recovering accurate metric depth from their estimates for depth perception tasks remains challenging due to scale ambiguity and local metric-scale inconsistency. Existing approaches recover metric depth from sparse observations using either explicit global affine transformation algorithms or implicit data-driven depth completion networks. The former cannot accommodate spatially varying relative-to-metric relationships, while the latter are sensitive to the distribution of sparse observations and may not fully exploit generalizable relative depth priors. To simultaneously address these issues, this study extends our previous work MTD and proposes MTDv2, a hybrid metric depth perception framework that combines explicit depth metricization with data-driven metric depth refinement. The explicit depth metricization process performs segment-wise affine transformations to recover spatially varying metric scales while preserving the geometric structure of relative depth, followed by pixel-wise depth refinement that propagates metric observations along paths with minimal accumulated geometric variation. The data-driven depth refinement process subsequently extends the explicit single-path depth propagation to a learnable multi-path formulation while preserving its interpretability. Extensive experiments conducted on 16 public datasets demonstrate the robust and generalizable depth scale recovery capability of MTDv2 across diverse sources of sparse observations and different depth estimation paradigms, as well as its broad applicability to downstream 3D perception tasks. Code will be publicly available at https://mias.group/MTD upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MTDv2，一个混合式度量深度感知框架，结合显式深度度量化的分段仿射变换与数据驱动的多路径深度精炼，在16个公开数据集上实现了稳健且可泛化的度量尺度恢复，适用于多种稀疏观测来源与深度估计范式，并广泛适用于下游3D感知任务。
AI.motivation: 现有单目相对深度估计基础模型泛化能力强，但从其估计结果恢复准确度量深度仍存在挑战，主要由于尺度模糊和局部度量尺度不一致。现有方法中，显式全局仿射变换无法适应空间变化的相对-度量关系；隐式数据驱动深度补全网络则对稀疏观测分布敏感，且未能充分利用可泛化的相对深度先验。因此需要同时解决上述问题。
AI.method: MTDv2是在先前工作MTD基础上的扩展，是一个混合式度量深度感知框架，融合显式深度度量化和数据驱动度量深度精炼。显式深度度量过程执行分段仿射变换，在保留相对深度几何结构的同时恢复空间变化的度量尺度；随后进行逐像素深度精炼，沿累积几何变化最小的路径传播度量观测。数据驱动深度精炼过程将显式单路径深度传播扩展为可学习的多路径形式，同时保持其可解释性。
AI.result: 在16个公开数据集上的大量实验表明，MTDv2在不同稀疏观测来源和不同深度估计范式下均具备稳健且可泛化的深度尺度恢复能力，并广泛适用于下游3D感知任务。
AI.conclusion: MTDv2通过显式深度度量化和数据驱动精炼的混合框架，有效解决了尺度模糊与局部度量尺度不一致问题，兼顾可解释性与可学习性，具有良好的泛化性和下游任务适用性。代码将在发表后于 https://mias.group/MTD 公开。

title: Retrieval Disagreement as a Signal: Diagnosing and Steering Multilingual Dense Embedders
summary: Multilingual dense retrievers place all languages in one shared space so that a question finds relevant documents, regardless of which language they are written in. We show that the same question, asked in different languages, retrieves substantially different documents, and this disagreement is not because of weak language understanding. Each language performs well on its own and ranks candidates consistently with the other languages; divergence appears only when languages share an index. We trace the mechanism: each language keeps its own ranking, but in the shared index, its correct answers are pushed far down, buried under non-relevant documents that are either in the query's own language or in English, depending on the model. We introduce disagreement-guided steering: for each language, we contrast the documents that other languages agree on for a question against those that language retrieves idiosyncratically, and take the difference of their representations as a language-specific direction, added to that language's queries at inference. Against baselines of language-mean removal, subspace removal, and per-language rotation, it most strongly reduces same-language crowding while remaining competitive on recall, trading off against mean removal, which better preserves ranking quality.

AI.tldr: 多语言稠密检索器将所有语言映射到同一共享空间，但同一问题用不同语言提问会检索到显著不同的文档；这种分歧并非源于语言理解能力不足，而是由共享索引中的"同语言拥挤"现象导致。作者提出"分歧引导的转向"（disagreement-guided steering）方法，通过构造语言特定方向向量来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 多语言稠密检索器设计初衷是让任意语言提问都能找到相关文档，不受文档语言限制。然而现实中同一问题以不同语言提问，检索结果差异巨大，这破坏了该设计假设，且此前缺乏对该现象机理的清晰解释与针对性解决方案。
AI.method: 在跨语言检索中，每个语言的检索结果单独看都表现良好，且排序与其它语言一致，分歧仅在共享索引时出现。作者将这一现象归因于"同语言拥挤"：某语言的正确答案在共享索引中被大量非相关文档（同语言或英语文档，因模型而异）挤到较低位置。为此提出分歧引导的转向：对每种语言，将其他语言对某问题一致认可的文档与该语言特异性检索到的文档进行对比，取其表示之差作为语言特定方向向量，在推理时加到该语言的查询表示上。
AI.result: 与语言均值移除、子空间移除及逐语言旋转等基线方法相比，该方法最能有效降低同语言拥挤，同时在召回率上保持竞争力；与均值移除相比则各有权衡——后者在保持排序质量方面更优。
AI.conclusion: 多语言稠密检索中跨语言分歧的根源在于共享索引下的同语言拥挤，而非语言理解缺陷。通过对比跨语言共识文档与语言特异文档构造语言特定方向并进行查询转向，可有效缓解该问题，为多语言检索一致性提供了新的干预手段。

title: Neural Bayesian Networks for Modular and Scalable Decision-Making Under Uncertainty
comment: Main text 10 pages, extra is supplementary. ACM CCS: Computing methodologies~Artificial intelligence~Knowledge representation and reasoning~Probabilistic reasoning. Computing methodologies~Machine learning~Machine learning approaches~Neural networks. Computing methodologies~Machine learning~Machine learning approaches~Learning in probabilistic graphical models~Bayesian network models
summary:
Bayesian Networks (BNs) are established tools for letting agents reason under uncertainty in sequential decision-making. They split a joint distribution into local conditional mechanisms arranged on a directed acyclic graph, which makes them modular, interpretable, and ready to perform probabilistic inference. Their classical formulation, however, has limitations in both expressiveness and scale: each conditional is usually stored as a table or a linear-Gaussian form, and inference evaluates the graph one node and one query at a time.
  In this paper we introduce Neural Bayesian Networks (NBNs), in which each conditional is a differentiable, tensor-valued mechanism, while the graph and its factorization are unchanged. NBNs retain the modularity and local mechanisms of BNs, can represent any learnable conditional distribution, and run natively on GPUs. We also release NBN, a PyTorch-based library for learning and inference in NBNs, together with a public benchmark. Our evaluation shows gains in both expressiveness and scale: NBNs fit distributions that classical BN libraries struggle to represent, and on large networks and large batches of queries they run two orders of magnitude faster thanks to GPU parallelization. NBN is available at https://github.com/Giovannibriglia/NeuralBayesianNetworks.

AI.tldr: 提出神经贝叶斯网络（NBN），将BN的每个条件分布替换为可微的、张量化的机制，保持图结构与分解不变，兼具模块性与GPU原生推理，并发布PyTorch库与公开基准。
AI.motivation: 经典贝叶斯网络在表达能力和规模上存在局限：条件分布多存储为表格或线性高斯形式，表达能力受限；推理逐节点、逐查询执行，难以扩展。
AI.method: 将每个条件分布建模为可微、张量值的神经机制，同时保持原有图结构和联合分布分解方式不变；利用GPU张量化计算实现并行推理，并提供基于PyTorch的学习与推理库NBN及公开基准。
AI.result: NBN能拟合经典BN库难以表示的条件分布，表达能力更强；在大规模网络和大批量查询上，凭借GPU并行化实现约两个数量级的加速。
AI.conclusion: NBN在保持贝叶斯网络模块化与可解释性的同时，显著提升表达能力和推理规模，并开源代码供社区使用。

title: Image Tokenizers Should Be Trained Between Images
summary: Latent diffusion models generate images as codes of an image tokenizer, whose decoder turns them into the pixel image. Recent tokenizers improve how well these codes reconstruct an image and how easily a generator learns them. Yet a generator does not reproduce the codes of training images, and when a generated code lands outside what the decoder expects, the decoded image contains imperfections. Current methods make the decoder more robust to generated codes by adding noise during training. However, generated codes lie between the training codes and resemble their mixture more than one of them plus noise. To improve generated images, decoders should therefore be trained on codes in the space between training samples. We propose InterpTok, which fine-tunes MAETok to decode mixtures of image codes into natural images. Since no target image exists between two training samples, a discriminator judges whether each decoded mixture looks as natural as its two sources. A mixing ratio loss requires the decoded mixture to keep the mixing ratio of the two codes. Together, they prevent collapse to a trivial solution and yield a sharp and natural composition of both images. InterpTok keeps MAETok's reconstruction quality and improves interpolation quality more than threefold, the best of all tokenizers in a recent benchmark. Beyond interpolation, InterpTok improves the generation FID of a matched diffusion transformer from 11.61 to 8.48 without guidance, and even reaches 8.11 at an eighth of the sampling steps, where the generator on MAETok's codes worsens. The generator trained on our tokenizer also reaches the final result of the one trained on MAETok at half the training steps. Our findings show that the space between image codes can and should be explicitly supervised rather than ignored.

AI.tldr: 提出 InterpTok，通过微调 MAETok 使其能解码图像码的混合，让生成码落在合理空间内，从而提升插值与生成质量。
AI.motivation: 生成器不会复现训练图的码，当生成码落在解码器预期之外时图像会有瑕疵。现有方法靠加噪提升解码器鲁棒性，但生成码实际位于训练码之间的"混合"区域，更接近两码的插值而非"单码加噪"，因此应在训练码之间的空间上训练解码器。
AI.method: InterpTok 对 MAETok 进行微调以解码图像码的混合。由于两个训练样本之间不存在目标图像，采用判别器判断每个解码混合是否与其两个源图像同样自然；并引入混合比例损失，要求解码混合保持两码的混合比例。二者结合防止坍缩到平凡解，产出清晰自然的组合。
AI.result: 保持 MAETok 的重建质量，插值质量提升三倍以上，在近期基准中为最优 tokenizer。生成方面，匹配的 diffusion transformer 的无引导 FID 由 11.61 降至 8.48，在八分之一采样步数下达到 8.11（而基于 MAETok 的生成器在少步数时变差）；生成器只需一半训练步数即可达到 MAETok 的最终效果。
AI.conclusion: 图像码之间的空间可以且应当被显式监督，而非被忽视。

title: How Reliable Are System-One Decisions in Medicine? A Comparative Study of Jev, Jev-like Models, and LLMs
summary: Jev has attracted considerable attention for its rapid, generalizable decision-making, yet its medical reliability remains under explored. To address this gap, our study compares various types of system-one decision models across 15 medical datasets comprising 8,742 instances under a unified protocol. Beyond accuracy, we assess decision stability and the ability to recognize unreliable decisions. Our results show that Jev rivals leading models on primarily text-driven tasks but is less effective on numerically driven tasks, revealing a distinct capability boundary. Under question-format variations, Jev demonstrates strong robustness, achieving the lowest decision reversal rate and relatively small accuracy fluctuations. Among evaluated open-source alternatives, only StartLux exhibits comparable robustness. But these strengths do not extend to reliable abstention awareness: most evaluated models show limitations in both recognizing missing correct answers and using optional abstention. Moreover, we find that Jev's probability-based answer selection can be improved by changing how decisions are scored: normalizing option-wise binary scores yields higher retained accuracy than choice scoring. Taken together, our findings provide early guidance for improving and applying decision models in medicine.

AI.tldr: 论文在15个医学数据集、8742个实例上统一评测system-one决策模型，发现Jev在文本任务上可比肩领先模型但在数值任务上有能力边界，鲁棒性强但弃权识别弱，且证据归一化打分可提升其概率选答。
AI.motivation: Jev因快速、可泛化的决策能力受到关注，但其在医疗场景中的可靠性尚缺乏系统研究，因此需要在统一协议下对其决策能力边界与可靠性进行评测。
AI.method: 在统一协议下，跨15个医学数据集、8742个实例对比多类system-one决策模型；除准确率外，评估决策稳定性与对不可靠决策的识别能力；并测试问题格式变化下的鲁棒性、弃权机制，以及不同决策打分方式（选项级二值分数归一化 vs. choice scoring）对概率选答的影响。
AI.result: Jev在文本驱动的任务上可与领先模型匹敌，但在数值驱动任务上效果较弱，呈现明显能力边界；在问题格式变化下鲁棒性最强，决策反转率最低且准确率波动较小，开源替代中仅StartLux具可比鲁棒性；多数模型在识别缺失正确答案与使用可弃权选项上表现有限；将选项级二值分数归一化后，Jev的保留准确率高于choice scoring。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了system-one医学决策模型的能力边界与可靠性短板，并给出通过改进决策打分方式提升概率选答的可行路径，为医学决策模型的改进与应用提供早期指导。

title: Audit tools of the trade: Automated Auditor Elicitation Can Be Sensitive to the Context the Auditor Is Given
comment: 23 pages, 13 figures, 9 tables. Accepted at the Third Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD) at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Does providing additional context to automated AI auditors improve their effectiveness? Using the Petri tool to audit LLM coding agents, we test the impact of providing two types of resources (an external codebase and benchmark transcripts) to LLM auditors, across four auditor-target LLM pairs and three behaviours (harmful compliance, reward hacking, sycophancy). (1) External codebase: We provide the auditor LLM with a fixed, external open source codebase, which prior work finds improves the realism of synthetic audits. Providing this resource suppresses reward hacking in both auditor-target pairs whose baseline rate is above the floor (4.8 to 1.3 and 3.9 to 1.8 on Petri's default 1-10 scale); the remaining two pairs sit at the floor throughout. The suppression recurs in three of four pairs under a different scenario and resource bundle. (2) External benchmark transcripts: We provide the auditor with transcripts of the target's performance on benchmarks measuring similar behaviours, intended to inform the auditor about the target's behavioural patterns. Providing this resource raises reward hacking scores in all four pairs (from 1.7 to 6.1 in one case). However, subsequent experiments show that supplying only the related benchmark's abstract, without transcripts, also increases reward hacking, and the effect is absent under a different framing of the same behaviour. Overall, we find no consistent effect of either resource outside reward hacking, but we find substantial variability in judge-scored behaviour across conditions. Our results underscore the importance of careful piloting with tools such as Petri, as the measured rate of target behaviour is highly sensitive to configuration decisions. We hope our results inspire more research into the reliability and robustness of automated alignment auditing.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Petri工具审计LLM编码代理，测试向AI审计员提供额外上下文（外部代码库、基准测试记录）是否提升审计效果。结果发现：外部代码库可一致抑制reward hacking，而基准测试记录反而提升reward hacking，且该效应可被更弱的干预复现；除reward hacking外两类资源均无一致影响，审计结果对配置高度敏感。
AI.motivation: 自动化AI审计被用于评估LLM代理的安全性，但额外上下文是否真正提升审计有效性尚不清楚。本文旨在系统检验提供额外资源对LLM审计员的影响，并揭示自动化对齐审计的可靠性与稳健性问题。
AI.method: 使用Petri工具审计LLM编码代理，在4组审计员-目标LLM配对和3类行为（有害合规、reward hacking、谄媚）上，测试提供两类资源：（1）固定的外部开源代码库；（2）目标在相关基准测试上的记录。采用Petri默认1-10量表进行judge评分，并进行不同场景、资源组合和框架的重复实验。
AI.result: 外部代码库：在基线上高于下限的两组配对中抑制reward hacking（4.8→1.3，3.9→1.8），其余两组始终处于下限；该抑制在另一场景与资源组合下的4组中3组复现。基准测试记录：在全部4组中提高reward hacking得分（某组1.7→6.1）；但仅提供相关基准摘要、不给记录也会提高reward hacking，换一种行为框架后效应消失。除reward hacking外，两类资源均无一致效应，但judge评分行为在不同条件下差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 向LLM审计员提供额外上下文并不稳定提升审计有效性，仅在reward hacking上观察到一致（且方向相反）的效应。目标行为测得率对配置选择高度敏感，凸显使用Petri等工具进行谨慎预实验的重要性，并呼吁进一步研究自动化对齐审计的可靠性与稳健性。

title: Towards Complementary Keypoint Detection via Mixture of Detectors
summary: Keypoint detection plays a central role in geometric vision pipelines. Existing detectors exhibit complementary strengths across different scene structures and keypoint budgets, and reliance on a single detector often results in suboptimal keypoint distributions. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{Mixture of Detectors (MoD)} for dense matching pipelines, a unified framework for complementary keypoint detection through the adaptive composition of heterogeneous detectors. MoD first distills heterogeneous detectors into a unified model, allowing diverse detection maps to be predicted efficiently within a single forward pass. Detector selection is subsequently formulated as a patch-wise, budget-conditioned decision process, in which a lightweight router assigns the most suitable detector to each local region. To avoid heuristic supervision, the router is trained with task-driven rewards derived from downstream matching quality, jointly capturing both keypoint quantity and precision. Extensive experiments on MegaDepth, ScanNet, and HPatches demonstrate that MoD consistently outperforms strong baselines across a wide range of keypoint budgets, demonstrating its effectiveness in improving keypoint distribution and downstream geometric performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mixture of Detectors (MoD)——一种通过自适应组合异构检测器实现互补关键点检测的统一框架，用于稠密匹配流程。
AI.motivation: 现有关键点检测器在不同场景结构和关键点预算下各有优势，依赖单一检测器常导致关键点分布次优，因此需要组合异构检测器以充分利用其互补性。
AI.method: MoD先将异构检测器蒸馏为统一模型，单次前向即可高效预测多样检测图；随后将检测器选择建模为逐块、预算条件的决策过程，由轻量路由器为每个局部区域分配最合适的检测器；路由器采用源于下游匹配质量的任务驱动奖励训练，同时捕捉关键点数量与精度，避免启发式监督。
AI.result: 在MegaDepth、ScanNet和HPatches上的大量实验表明，MoD在广泛的关键点预算范围内持续优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: MoD能有效改善关键点分布，提升下游几何性能，验证了异构检测器自适应组合的有效性。

title: Empathy Is Not the Scapegoat for Declines in Factuality and Reliability
summary: Language models are increasingly expected to support users in stressful or uncertain situations, where warmth and empathy are desirable. While recent work associates warmer models with reduced reliability, we show that this conclusion is incomplete. Prior studies often train primarily on empathetic dialogue, making it difficult to separate tone effects from SFT-induced distribution shift. We revisit this issue at both the model and evaluation levels. We study prompting, SFT, and RL for inducing warm behavior, and comprehensively evaluate capability preservation using an 11-dataset benchmark suite and EMOFACT under emotional contexts. Across multiple model families, we find that warmth effects are task- and model-dependent, while task-aligned adaptive tone can improve empathy and targeted reliability, although some capability trade-offs remain. We further introduce human-validated empathy evaluators specifically developed to assess empathetic model responses. Our results suggest that models can be more supportive in social interactions while remaining reliable.

AI.tldr: 该论文重新审视"模型越温暖越不可靠"的结论，指出过往研究因主要在共情对话上做SFT而混淆了语气效应与分布偏移；作者在模型与评估两个层面系统研究prompting、SFT与RL诱导温暖行为，发现温暖效应具有任务与模型依赖性，任务对齐的自适应语气可同时提升共情与特定可靠性，尚存部分能力权衡，并提出了人工验证的共情评估器。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多地被期望在用户处于压力或不确定情境时提供支持，此时温暖与共情是有益的；但近期工作将更温暖的模型与可靠性下降相联系。作者认为该结论并不完整，因为已有研究多主要在共情对话上训练，难以将语气效应与SFT带来的分布偏移区分开来，因此需要重新审视。
AI.method: 在模型层面研究prompting、SFT与RL三种方式诱导温暖行为；在评估层面构建11个数据集的基准套件评估能力保持情况，并在情感语境下使用EMOFACT；跨多个模型家族进行实验，同时提出经人工验证的共情评估器以评估模型的共情回复。
AI.result: 跨多个模型家族发现：温暖效应具有任务依赖性与模型依赖性；任务对齐的自适应语气可以提升共情和特定维度的可靠性；但仍存在一些能力权衡。
AI.conclusion: 模型可以在社交互动中表现得更具支持性，同时保持可靠性，温暖与可靠性并非必然对立。

title: Transparent Information Flow Modeling for Role-Aware AI Act Assessment
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures. Presented at the CLEAR Workshop, ECAI 2025
summary: The European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act introduces a structured framework for governing high-risk AI systems, emphasizing transparency, risk management, and role-specific accountability. However, current assessment practices often rely on monolithic system views or disconnected checklists, limiting their ability to capture the socio-technical complexity of real-world deployments. We explore the use of the Information Flow Methodology (IFM), a modeling-based approach to AI Act compliance assessment. IFM represents decision systems -- whether algorithmic, human, or hybrid -- as networks of information sites and transformation channels, enabling structured analysis of how information, decisions, and responsibilities flow across organizational and technical boundaries. We apply IFM in a real-world case involving a recruitment support tool used by a public-sector organization, evaluating both the Provider's system and the Deployer's recruitment process. Our results demonstrate that IFM can serve as a scaffold to bridge both component-based and holistic perspectives, and how technical systems are situated within socio-technical contexts. In doing so, IFM supports transparency, identifies risk pathways, and enables alignment analysis between intended and actual use. We argue that such modeling provides a foundational tool for effective, context-sensitive AI governance and accountability -- offering capabilities beyond conventional checklist-based assessments.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨以信息流方法（IFM）进行欧盟《人工智能法案》高风险系统合规评估，通过将决策系统建模为信息站点与转换通道的网络，实现对技术与社会组织边界的结构化分析，并结合公共部门招聘支持工具案例验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 欧盟《人工智能法案》虽建立了高风险AI治理框架，强调透明度、风险管理与角色问责，但现有评估实践多依赖单一系统视角或割裂的清单式检查，难以刻画真实部署中的社会技术复杂性，因而需要一种能兼顾组件与整体视角的建模评估方法。
AI.method: 采用信息流方法（IFM）作为基于建模的合规评估途径。IFM将决策系统（算法的、人工的或混合的）表示为信息站点与转换通道构成的网络，据此结构化分析信息、决策与责任在组织与技术边界间的流动。研究以某公共部门组织使用的招聘支持工具为案例，同时评估提供方的系统与部署方的招聘流程。
AI.result: 结果表明，IFM可作为衔接组件视角与整体视角的脚手架，揭示技术系统如何嵌入社会技术情境；它有助于提升透明度、识别风险路径，并支持对预期用途与实际用途之间的一致性分析。
AI.conclusion: 这类建模为有效且情境敏感的AI治理与问责提供了基础性工具，其能力超越传统的清单式评估，能够弥补现有合规评估在社会技术复杂性刻画上的不足。

title: InfoVis: Unified Slide Image Generation and Editing
summary: Generating and editing presentation slides requires models to combine accurate text rendering, instruction following, visual grounding, aesthetic design, and precise editing within one canvas. Existing work covers only subsets of these capabilities and lacks large-scale slide-native supervision and diagnostic evaluation. We formulate four slide-centric tasks and build a scalable data engine with over 13M continual-pretraining records and 1.9M supervised fine-tuning records. We also introduce VisSlideBench, a benchmark of 1,527 manually screened instances that covers all four tasks with task-specific, multidimensional evaluation. Its automatic rankings agree with blinded, dimension-wise human rankings. Using these resources, we train InfoVis, a unified 9B slide generation and editing model. On VisSlideBench, InfoVis leads every evaluated open-source model on all eleven metrics and scores 7.94 overall against 7.99 for Nano-Banana-2. Starting from FLUX.2-klein-base-9B, slide-specific post-training adds 1.6 points overall, with the largest generation gains in content faithfulness; the remaining gap to proprietary models is smallest in content faithfulness and largest in aesthetic quality. Built on InfoVis, our document-to-slide workflow achieves the second-highest Aesthetics score on the external SlidesGen-Bench. We will release the model, code, data, and benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该论文面向演示文稿幻灯片生成与编辑，提出四项幻灯片核心任务，构建超1300万持续预训练与190万监督微调记录的数据引擎，并发布1527条人工筛选实例的VisSlideBench基准；据此训练统一9B模型InfoVis，在11项指标上领先所有开源模型，总体7.94分（Nano-Banana-2为7.99）。
AI.motivation: 幻灯片生成与编辑要求模型在单一画布内同时具备精确文本渲染、指令跟随、视觉定位、美学设计与精确编辑能力，而现有工作仅覆盖其中部分能力，且缺乏大规模幻灯片原生监督数据与诊断性评测。
AI.method: 将需求形式化为四项以幻灯片为中心的任务；构建可扩展数据引擎，产出超13M持续预训练记录与1.9M监督微调记录；提出VisSlideBench基准（1,527个人工筛选实例，覆盖四任务、任务专属多维评估）；基于FLUX.2-klein-base-9B进行幻灯片专属后训练，得到统一9B模型InfoVis；并构建文档转幻灯片工作流。
AI.result: VisSlideBench的自动排序与盲测分维度人工排序一致。InfoVis在全部11项指标上超过所有被评开源模型，总体得分7.94，对比Nano-Banana-2的7.99；幻灯片专属后训练相对基线带来1.6分总体提升，生成任务中内容忠实度增益最大；与专有模型的差距在内容忠实度上最小、在美学质量上最大。InfoVis驱动的文档转幻灯片工作流在外部SlidesGen-Bench上取得第二高的Aesthetics分数。
AI.conclusion: 大规模幻灯片原生数据与诊断性基准可有效支撑统一生成—编辑模型的训练与评测，后训练显著提升内容忠实度，但美学质量仍是与专有模型的主要差距；模型、代码、数据与基准将开源发布。

title: CREATE: Creativity Evaluation of VLMs using the Visual Remote Associates Test
summary: Vision language models (VLMs) are used in creative tasks such as visual storytelling, design ideation, art interpretation, and advertising. Yet we lack principled ways to measure the lateral reasoning of these models compared to human potential. We introduce CREATE, a semi-automatically constructed benchmark containing 155 visual Remote Associates Test problems. These problems require a solver to find an underlying connection among three seemingly dissimilar images. We conduct a human study (N=25) to validate and ground the quality of our benchmark, and evaluate 11 VLMs. Our findings show that most VLMs underperform humans on this task. Our experiments indicate that the associative ability of VLMs depends on the cue concepts provided in the text and does not universally extend to visual puzzles.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CREATE基准，包含155个视觉远距联想测试问题，用于测量视觉语言模型的横向推理能力，发现多数VLM表现不如人类。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型已广泛应用于视觉叙事、设计构思、艺术解读和广告等创意任务，但缺乏有原则的方法来衡量其横向推理能力，尤其是与人类潜力相比。
AI.method: 半自动构建CREATE基准，包含155个视觉远距联想测试问题，要求解题者在三张看似无关的图像中找到潜在联系；进行人类研究（N=25）验证基准质量，并评估11个视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 多数视觉语言模型在该任务上表现不如人类；模型的联想能力依赖于文本中提供的线索概念，并不能普遍迁移到视觉谜题中。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型的横向推理能力有限，且其联想能力主要受文本线索驱动，难以推广到纯视觉推理任务；CREATE为评估此类能力提供了标准化基准。

title: WeFair: Fidelity-Aware Alignment from Human Feedback for Personalized Query Rewriting in Short-Video Search
summary: Short-video search requires compact query rewriters that infer personalized intent from brief, ambiguous queries under strict latency constraints. The challenge is to decide when personalization is warranted and generate a reformulation that preserves the user's immediate information need. A rewriter optimized for fluency or engagement may still introduce unsupported details and redirect the search toward a different intent. Existing methods often underutilize users' actual reformulations and behavioral traces, relying instead on synthetic reasoning and indirect behavioral rewards that may produce more engaging candidates but cause intent drift. To build an effective rewriter that remains faithful to user intent, we propose WeFair, Fidelity-Aware Alignment from Human Feedback for Personalized Query Rewriting in WeChat short-video search. WeFair assigns real user behavioral signals to a progression from demonstration to preference to verification. We first mine actual human reformulations from search sessions, then apply multidimensional LLM screening and contextual verification to filter unsupported transitions without extensive manual annotation. During training, we begin with a supervised curriculum that progressively builds rewriting capabilities from large-scale human personalized query demonstrations, and then use direct preference optimization to align with users' subsequent consumption. In the final on-policy optimization stage, we construct a strict verification reward based on actual human reformulations to further boost performance with group relative policy optimization. Further analysis shows that auxiliary rewards can activate more rollout groups in GRPO but reduce intent fidelity. Online A/B testing in WeChat short-video search shows a 1.576% relative increase in effective clicked-query rate (VV>10s) and a 1.731% relative reduction in query reformulation rate.

AI.tldr: 提出WeFair——基于人类反馈的保真度感知对齐框架，用于微信短视频搜索的个性化查询改写，通过演示→偏好→验证三阶段对齐真实用户行为信号。
AI.motivation: 短视频搜索需在严格延迟约束下，从简短模糊查询中推断个性化意图。核心难点在于判断何时需要个性化，并生成不偏离用户即时信息需求的改写。现有方法对流利度或互动率的优化可能引入无依据细节、导致意图漂移，且未充分利用用户真实改写与行为轨迹，依赖合成推理与间接行为奖励。
AI.method: 将真实用户行为信号按"演示—偏好—验证"递进分配：(1) 从搜索会话中挖掘真实人类改写，经多维LLM筛选与上下文验证过滤无依据转换，无需大量人工标注；(2) 监督式课程学习，从大规模人类个性化查询演示逐步构建改写能力；(3) 用直接偏好优化（DPO）对齐用户后续消费行为；(4) 在策略优化阶段，基于真实人类改写构建严格验证奖励，用GRPO进一步提升性能。
AI.result: 分析发现辅助奖励能在GRPO中激活更多rollout组，但会降低意图保真度。微信短视频搜索线上A/B测试显示：有效点击查询率（VV>10s）相对提升1.576%，查询改写率相对下降1.731%。
AI.conclusion: 以真实人类改写为验证锚点的多阶段对齐框架，可在保持意图保真度的同时提升短视频搜索效果；辅助奖励虽能扩大探索但存在保真度权衡，需谨慎使用。

title: ViewStruct: View-Grounded Articulation and Connectivity Inference
summary: Interacting with unfamiliar objects requires understanding how their parts connect and move. We introduce ViewStruct, a framework for jointly predicting connectivity and articulation in objects and scenes. Given an RGB image with aligned part segmentation and depth, optionally supplemented by images or video, ViewStruct predicts rigid-body groupings, attachments, and joint parameters. Its view-grounded representation links predictions to observed regions and expresses joint geometry in a gravity-aligned, view-relative frame, without requiring category-specific canonical orientations. A pretrained vision--language model is adapted to predict structure in seconds, without requiring observed articulation motion or per-instance optimisation. Experiments demonstrate improved structural prediction over evaluated baselines and transfer to unseen categories, asset sources, and real-world human-interaction videos, despite task-specific training exclusively on synthetic data. Simulated manipulation experiments further demonstrate the utility of predicted joints for generating robot motion trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出 ViewStruct 框架，从 RGB 图像（含部件分割与深度）联合预测物体的连接关系与铰接结构，无需运动观测或逐实例优化，可泛化至未见类别与真实视频。
AI.motivation: 与陌生物体交互时，需理解其部件如何连接与运动。现有方法通常依赖类别特定的规范朝向、需要观测到的铰接运动或逐实例优化，难以泛化到新类别与真实场景。
AI.method: 输入 RGB 图像及对齐的部件分割与深度，可选补充图像或视频。模型预测刚体分组、连接关系（attachments）与关节参数。采用视图锚定（view-grounded）表示，将预测关联到观测区域，并在重力对齐、视图相对的坐标系中表达关节几何，无需类别特定的规范朝向。通过适配预训练视觉-语言模型，在数秒内完成结构预测，不依赖铰接运动观测或逐实例优化。
AI.result: 在评估基线上取得更优的结构预测性能，并能迁移到未见类别、新资产来源及真实世界人-物交互视频，尽管任务专用训练数据仅为合成数据。仿真操作实验进一步验证了所预测关节可用于生成机器人运动轨迹。
AI.conclusion: ViewStruct 通过视图锚定的关节表示与视觉-语言模型适配，实现了高效、免优化的连接与铰接结构联合预测，具备良好的跨类别与跨域泛化能力，并可支持机器人操作任务。

title: The Many Morals of AI: The cautionary bias of North American news narratives in global perspective
summary: The stories told about artificial intelligence (AI) play a central role in shaping public understanding, policy debates, and expectations about technological change. News media are especially influential in this process. Using a cross-regional corpus of 12,924 English-language news articles about AI published since 2022, we examine how storytelling about AI varies across media systems in four regions: North America, China, India, and the Middle East. Leveraging large language models, we extract the implicit narrative lessons conveyed by each article---commonly known as story morals---capturing value-laden interpretations that extend beyond thematic content or sentiment. We find that North American AI coverage is uniquely characterized by narratives of caution, while under-emphasizing narratives of innovation and collaboration that are more prevalent elsewhere. However, this pattern is largely explained by a broader regional negativity bias in North American news sentiment, rather than by heightened concern about AI itself. Our findings bring into view the culturally conditioned nature of AI news narratives.

AI.tldr: 通过12,924篇AI新闻的跨区域语料与LLM提取“故事寓意”，发现北美AI报道以谨慎叙事为主，但这主要由北美新闻整体的负面偏向解释，而非对AI本身的格外担忧。
AI.motivation: AI叙事影响公众认知、政策辩论与技术预期，新闻媒体在其中作用关键；但既有研究多聚焦主题与情感，缺乏对跨媒体体系、价值负载型“叙事寓意”的比较分析。
AI.method: 构建2022年以来英文AI新闻的跨区域语料（12,924篇），覆盖北美、中国、印度、中东四个区域；利用大语言模型提取每篇文章隐含的“故事寓意”（story morals），以刻画超越主题与情感的价值性解读。
AI.result: 北美AI报道独有的特征是谨慎叙事，同时相对低估在其他区域更普遍的创新与合作叙事；但该模式在很大程度上可由北美新闻情感中更广泛的负面偏向解释，而非源于对AI本身更高的关切。
AI.conclusion: AI新闻叙事具有文化条件性；跨区域比较需区分“AI特定态度”与媒体体系整体情感偏向，避免将区域差异直接归因于对AI的立场。

title: MADDIE: Multi-Agent Drug Discovery Engine
summary: Drug discovery remains a resource-intensive and time-consuming process, involving billions of dollars and a decade of development to advance a drug to market. While many in silico tools have accelerated this process, operating them still demands substantial time, effort, and expertise from medicinal chemists. Autonomous systems built on Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising solution, yet current designs limit their performance. Existing single-agent systems scale poorly to long-horizon, multi-step, and realistic tasks, whereas multi-agent systems typically execute predefined workflows that cannot capture the iterative, non-linear nature of a real drug discovery campaign. Here, we present MADDIE, a multi-agent drug discovery engine. It comprises a central agent, Orchestrator, and four specialized worker agents: HitIdentifier, LeadOptimizer, Synthesizer, and Evaluator, each representing a critical step in a drug discovery campaign. Under Orchestrator's orchestration and coordination, these worker agents are composed into flexible workflows, enabling MADDIE to adapt its strategy and navigate the drug discovery pipeline end-to-end. Across 50 protein targets, MADDIE produces molecules satisfying key property requirements and their synthesis routes, outperforming existing agentic systems, generative models, and general-purpose LLMs by a wide margin. Our analysis reveals how these agents collaborate and that MADDIE can employ different strategies across targets to achieve the campaign's goal, while still being efficient in time and tokens. Together, they demonstrate MADDIE as a low-cost, effective, and efficient autonomous engine for accelerating drug discovery. Code and dataset is available via https://github.com/ninglab/MADDIE.

AI.tldr: 提出MADDIE多智能体药物发现引擎，含一个Orchestrator中央智能体与四个专职工作智能体，可动态编排灵活工作流，在50个靶点上端到端产出满足关键性质要求的分子及合成路线，显著优于现有智能体系统、生成模型与通用LLM，且时间与token开销低。
AI.motivation: 药物研发成本高、周期长（数十亿美元、约十年），现有in silico工具虽加速流程但仍依赖药物化学家大量时间与专业投入；基于LLM的自主系统被寄予厚望，但现有设计性能受限：单智能体系统难以扩展到长时程、多步的真实任务，多智能体系统多执行预定义工作流，无法刻画真实药物发现中迭代、非线性的特征。
AI.method: 提出MADDIE多智能体药物发现引擎，由一个中央智能体Orchestrator与四个专职工作智能体组成：HitIdentifier、LeadOptimizer、Synthesizer、Evaluator，分别对应药物发现的关键环节；在Orchestrator的编排与协调下，工作智能体被组合成灵活工作流，使MADDIE能够调整策略并端到端导航药物发现流程。
AI.result: 在50个蛋白靶点上，MADDIE生成满足关键性质要求的分子及其合成路线，大幅超越现有智能体系统、生成模型与通用LLM；分析揭示智能体间的协作方式，并表明MADDIE可针对不同靶点采用不同策略以达成目标，同时在时间和token消耗上保持高效。
AI.conclusion: 上述结果表明MADDIE是一种低成本、有效且高效的自主引擎，可加速药物发现；代码与数据集见 https://github.com/ninglab/MADDIE。

title: X-Ragent: Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Chest X-Ray Reasoning
summary: Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation often requires integrating visual findings with task-specific evidence rather than relying on direct visual recognition alone. While tool-augmented medical agents can supply such evidence via external modules, they often lack explicit mechanisms for learning when auxiliary evidence is needed and for preventing inapplicable quantitative evidence from entering diagnostic reasoning. To address this, we propose X-Ragent, a post-training framework for tool-augmented reinforcement learning that decouples learned auxiliary-evidence seeking from validity-gated quantitative measurement acquisition for evidence-grounded CXR reasoning. We construct Rad-CoT, a 7.7K-sample corpus combining causally ordered tool-augmented trajectories with report-style diagnostic reasoning, and use it to initialize Qwen3-VL-8B via agentic supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We then optimize the policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using an accuracy-gated reward that applies process-level terms for measurement consistency and auxiliary-tool cost only to correct trajectories, preventing plausible process behavior from compensating for an incorrect diagnosis. Across three CXR benchmarks, X-Ragent achieves the strongest results, including an 8.6-point improvement on the fully held-out ChestAgentBench. By seeking evidence selectively and admitting only valid measurements, X-Ragent supports more faithful and evidence-grounded CXR reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 X-Ragent，一个面向工具增强推理的后训练强化学习框架，将"辅助证据寻求"与"有效性门控的定量测量获取"解耦，用于胸片循证推理。
AI.motivation: 胸片解读常需将视觉发现与任务相关证据结合，而非仅依赖直接视觉识别。工具增强的医学智能体虽可借助外部模块提供证据，但缺乏明确机制来学习何时需要辅助证据，也无法阻止不适用的定量证据进入诊断推理过程。
AI.method: 构建 Rad-CoT（7.7K 样本语料，含因果有序的工具增强轨迹与报告式诊断推理），初始化 Qwen3-VL-8B 进行智能体监督微调（SFT）；随后用 GRPO 优化策略，并采用准确率门控奖励，仅对正确轨迹施加测量一致性与辅助工具成本的过程级奖励项。
AI.result: 在三个胸片基准上取得最佳结果，其中在完全留出的 ChestAgentBench 上提升 8.6 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过选择性寻求证据并仅接纳有效测量，X-Ragent 支持更忠实、更循证的胸片推理。

title: Decomposing and Predicting Annotation Disagreement in Harmful Content Across Languages
summary: Annotator disagreement is increasingly recognized as a meaningful property of subjective tasks, rather than merely noise to be removed. Predicting which items are likely to be contested could help allocate annotation effort and route difficult cases to human review. We propose predicting disagreement from interpretable semantic properties of the text. An LLM answers a set of binary questions covering harmful-content characteristics, disagreement-related cues such as borderline severity and missing context, and language-sensitive cues such as local slurs. A classifier predicts disagreement from these answers, and we analyze which questions contribute most to the predictions. Across four datasets in English, German, and Turkish and three open-weight LLMs, our structured question features outperform direct prompting by 10.5 ROC-AUC points and the strongest text-based baselines by 5.0 points. A compact subset of eight questions performs within 1.5 ROC-AUC points of the full twenty-question set. In leave-one-dataset-out evaluation, models retain roughly 90-95% of their in-domain ROC-AUC. Across models and datasets, questions about derogation, missing context, and decision boundaries serve as the strongest predictors, suggesting that what makes harmful content contested is partly observable in the text.

AI.tldr: 提出用可解释语义问题预测主观标注分歧：由LLM回答一组二值问题，分类器据此预测争议，在英德土四数据集上优于直接提示10.5 ROC-AUC，八问子集接近全量，跨数据集保留90-95%性能，贬损、缺失语境与决策边界类问题最具预测力。
AI.motivation: 标注者分歧被视为主观任务的真实属性而非纯噪声；若能预测哪些样本易引发争议，可指导标注资源分配并将疑难样本转交人工复核。
AI.method: 让LLM回答覆盖有害内容特征、分歧相关线索（如边界严重性、缺失语境）及语言敏感线索（如本地俚语/贬称）的二值问题；以这些答案为特征训练分类器预测分歧，并分析各问题对预测的贡献。
AI.result: 在英语、德语、土耳其语四个数据集和三个开源权重LLM上，结构化问题特征比直接提示高10.5 ROC-AUC点，比最强文本基线高5.0点；八个问题的紧凑子集与二十问全集差距在1.5点内；留一数据集评估中保留约90-95%域内ROC-AUC。
AI.conclusion: 关于贬损、缺失语境与决策边界的问题始终是最强预测因子，表明有害内容之所以被争议，部分可从文本中观测；结构化可解释问题为预测标注分歧提供了有效且可迁移的方案。

title: PRAISE: A Reproducible Workflow for Non-Programmer Scientists to Implement Published AI Models
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) models are increasingly developed, published and used across scientific fields. Researchers, students and industry professionals who want to apply these models to their own research questions often lack the programming and data science expertise to do so. Existing guidelines cover single steps, but not the route from a published model to working predictions on one's own data. Here we present the hands-on workflow PRAISE, a Practical, Reproducible AI-model Implementation for Science and Education, that helps non-programmers implement published AI models step by step. Because implementations rarely work the first time, PRAISE anticipates common failures and provides a fallback route for each. As a proof of principle, three BSc chemistry students and their tutor applied PRAISE without prior programming or data science knowledge. They reproduced, validated and extended a state-of-the-art model that predicts enzyme-substrate interactions. This shows that with PRAISE, implementing an AI model from the literature becomes a learnable skill, one that turns non-programmer scientists from users into evaluators and improvers of AI models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PRAISE工作流，帮助无编程基础的科研人员逐步复现、验证并改进已发表的AI模型。
AI.motivation: AI模型在科研中日益普及，但许多研究者、学生和从业者缺乏编程与数据科学技能，难以将已发表模型应用到自身数据。现有指南仅覆盖单一步骤，缺少从已发表模型到在自己数据上获得可用预测的完整路径。
AI.method: 提出PRAISE工作流（Practical, Reproducible AI-model Implementation for Science and Education），面向非程序员，指导其逐步实现已发表AI模型；针对实现过程常出现的失败，预先设计常见故障的应对措施，并为每个失败提供后备路线。以三名无编程/数据科学背景的化学专业本科生及其导师为验证对象，复现、验证并扩展一个预测酶-底物相互作用的最新模型。
AI.result: 无编程与数据科学经验的学生成功复现、验证并扩展了预测酶-底物相互作用的最新模型，证明PRAISE可操作且有效。
AI.conclusion: 借助PRAISE，从文献中实现AI模型成为一项可习得的技能，使非程序员科学家从模型使用者转变为AI模型的评估者与改进者。

title: Carve VFM: Carving Specialists out of Generalists, Automatic Task-Specific Compression of Vision Foundation Models
summary: Vision foundation models (VFMs) provide transferable visual representations, but their inference cost limits deployment in many settings. Fine-tuning specializes a VFM without shrinking it; distillation shrinks it, but through expensive teacher-guided training. Structured pruning offers a more direct route by extracting a compact subnetwork from the VFM. However, as compression gets aggressive, existing methods fail because they treat subnetwork selection and recovery as separate axes. Across layers, capacity must follow task sensitivity rather than spread uniformly. Within a layer, a removal cannot be judged by importance alone; its impact also depends on how well the lost contribution can be recovered from what remains. Selection and recovery must therefore be decided jointly. We introduce Carve VFM, which resolves this interdependence. Given a VFM, a calibration set, and a parameter budget, it (i) searches for task-specific capacity allocations across layers; (ii) guides the search via an adaptive recovery-aware fitness criterion; and (iii) reconstructs removed behavior through iterative closed-form low-rank corrections merged into the surviving weights. The result is a dense encoder produced in minutes on a single GPU without backbone retraining. Across twelve benchmarks and four models from DINOv3 and MetaCLIP-2, Carve VFM achieves the highest reported mean accuracy in seven of eight backbone-budget configurations among the evaluated dense structured-pruning methods. Further fine-tuning surpasses the strongest evaluated edge model (88.1% vs. 85.8%), and carved models cut compute and memory while delivering 1.3-2.0x higher GPU throughput than the uncompressed one. These results show that the compact model you need is inside the VFM; it only has to be carved out.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Carve VFM，一种面向视觉基础模型（VFM）的密集结构化剪枝方法，将子网络选择与恢复联合决策，通过任务敏感度驱动的跨层容量分配、恢复感知的适应度准则搜索，以及迭代闭式低秩修正重建被剪枝行为，在单卡数分钟内产出紧凑编码器。
AI.motivation: VFM 具备可迁移的视觉表征能力，但推理开销限制了部署。微调不缩小模型，蒸馏缩小模型却依赖昂贵的教师引导训练。结构化剪枝更直接，可从 VFM 中抽取紧凑子网络，但现有方法在激进压缩下失效，原因在于它们将子网络选择与恢复视为两个独立的维度：跨层容量应按任务敏感度分配而非均匀分布，层内移除不能仅由重要性判断，还取决于损失贡献能否从剩余部分恢复。因此选择与恢复必须联合决策。
AI.method: Carve VFM 在给定 VFM、校准集和参数预算的条件下：(i) 搜索跨层的任务特定容量分配；(ii) 通过自适应、恢复感知的适应度准则引导搜索；(iii) 以迭代闭式低秩修正重建被移除的行为，并将其合并进存活权重。最终生成密集编码器，无需主干重训练，单 GPU 分钟级完成。
AI.result: 在十二个基准、来自 DINOv3 与 MetaCLIP-2 的四个模型上，Carve VFM 在被评估的密集结构化剪枝方法中，于八种主干-预算配置中的七种取得已报告最高平均精度。进一步微调后超过最强的被评估边缘模型（88.1% vs. 85.8%），剪枝模型降低计算量与内存，同时 GPU 吞吐相比未压缩模型提升 1.3–2.0 倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，所需紧凑模型本就内嵌于 VFM 之中，只需将其"雕刻"出来。选择与恢复的联合优化是实现激进压缩下高效结构化剪枝的关键。

title: From Hindsight to Foresight: Dissecting Clinical Evidence Acquisition in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often diagnose full sight, static clinical cases well yet struggle in foresight, dynamic diagnosis. Prior work has improved this limitation by quantifying the information models acquire and by developing stronger follow-up strategies to improve diagnostic accuracy. In contrast, we introduce a distinctive hindsight to systematically dissect why LLMs fail to acquire diagnostically critical evidence, tracing the failure from evidence identification, utilization and downstream diagnostic updating through not only diagnostic accuracy, but also evidence coverage, trajectory dynamics, and elicited probability and information entropy. Starting experiments from the breakdown at the level of capabilities, to the diagnosis of the pre-event state before the evidence arrives, and to the post-event state transition after the evidence arrives, our research has revealed the profound limitations and internal causes existing in the dynamic diagnostic process. At the same time, we have also conducted sufficient verification and generalization experiments to prove that these limitations are widespread. Together, these findings shift the central challenge from whether LLMs possess relevant clinical knowledge to whether they can identify, acquire, and effectively use the right evidence under clinical diagnosis and conduct a more detailed mechanism analysis to identify the exact location of the capability gap.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种"事后剖析"视角，系统解构大语言模型在动态诊断中失败的原因，将失败追溯至证据识别、利用与下游诊断更新三个环节，并揭示其内在机制与普遍性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在完整、静态的临床病例诊断上表现良好，但在需要前瞻性的动态诊断中表现不佳。已有工作多聚焦于量化模型获取的信息或改进随访策略以提升准确率，但缺乏对模型为何无法获取诊断关键证据的系统性剖析。本文旨在从能力缺口定位的角度，深入揭示动态诊断失败的内在原因。
AI.method: 引入"事后（hindsight）"视角，将失败过程沿证据识别、证据利用、下游诊断更新三个环节进行拆解。评估维度不限于诊断准确率，还纳入证据覆盖率、轨迹动态、诱发的概率与信息熵。实验设计从能力层面的崩溃点出发，依次考察证据到达前的事前状态与证据到达后的事后状态转移。同时开展充分的验证与泛化实验以检验局限性的普遍性。
AI.result: 研究揭示了动态诊断过程中存在的深层局限及其内在成因：模型在证据识别、获取与有效利用上均存在能力缺口。验证与泛化实验表明这些局限具有广泛性。
AI.conclusion: 核心挑战应从"大语言模型是否具备相关临床知识"转向"其能否在临床诊断中识别、获取并有效利用正确的证据"，并通过更细致的机制分析精确定位能力缺口所在位置。

title: Glasseek: A Transparent Recipe for Training and Trustworthy Evaluation of DeepSearch Agents
summary: Deep search enables language agents to solve complex information-seeking tasks through iterative web exploration. However, developing robust open-source agents remains challenging for three reasons. First, opaque trajectory-construction pipelines make training data difficult to audit and reproduce. Second, context compression can create a substantial mismatch between training and inference. Third, agents may retrieve benchmark content from the open web during evaluation, contaminating the results and overstating their performance. To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce Glasseek, a fully transparent deep search framework spanning the complete development lifecycle, releasing all data, model weights, training recipes, and code. Specifically, for data construction, we establish a verifiable trajectory curation pipeline that systematically generates high-quality exploration paths. For training, we propose Compaction-Managed GSPO (CM-GSPO), which uses the same policy for search and summarization while optimizing only execution sub-trajectories, enabling end-to-end search-policy training across context-compaction boundaries. For evaluation, we conduct the first systematic audit of test-set leakage in open-web agents and release a modular anti-leakage plugin that seamlessly integrates into existing evaluation harnesses. Under this rigorous evaluation protocol, our 9B agent outperforms frontier proprietary agents across almost all deep research benchmarks spanning diverse task types, and achieves the best overall performance among recent open-weight agents, setting a new state of the art at the 9B scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Glasseek，一个全透明深度搜索框架，覆盖数据、训练与评测全生命周期，9B模型在多数深度研究基准上超越前沿闭源智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有开源深度搜索智能体面临三大瓶颈：轨迹构建流程不透明导致数据难审计与复现；上下文压缩造成训练与推理的显著不匹配；评测时智能体可能从开放网络检索到基准内容，导致结果污染并高估性能。
AI.method: 1) 数据：构建可验证的轨迹策展流水线，系统生成高质量探索路径；2) 训练：提出Compaction-Managed GSPO（CM-GSPO），搜索与摘要共用同一策略，仅优化执行子轨迹，实现跨上下文压缩边界的端到端搜索策略训练；3) 评测：首次系统审计开放网络智能体的测试集泄漏，并发布可无缝接入现有评测框架的模块化反泄漏插件。
AI.result: 在严格评测协议下，9B智能体在几乎所有覆盖多样任务类型的深度研究基准上超越前沿闭源智能体，并在近期开源权重智能体中取得最佳整体性能，树立9B规模新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 全透明框架与反泄漏评测协议能有效解决数据复现、训练推理不匹配与基准污染问题，使小规模开源智能体达到领先水平。

title: Growing to See: Efficient Pretraining of Self-Supervised Vision Transformers
