We propose CameraVLM, which pairs a motion-state representation with state-language alignment. Camera tokens capture how the camera moves off screen, flow tokens capture how the subject and background move on screen, and a two-stage training strategy keeps language in the loop so that both are learned together with camera-motion semantics. With only 9B parameters, CameraVLM outperforms all open-source and camera-motion-specific models by a wide margin across three benchmarks and more than 20 baselines, and matches or surpasses GPT-6 Astra as well as human viewers in a 48-participant study. Project page: https://3dagentworld.github.io/CameraVLM/

AI.tldr: 提出 CameraVLM，通过运动状态表示与状态-语言对齐，使视觉语言模型具备相机运动（左右等）理解能力，在三个基准上大幅超越现有模型并接近人类水平。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型虽能解视觉谜题、处理长视频，但在判断相机运动方向（如向左还是向右）时表现接近随机猜测。此前尝试的加入相机运动数据或几何表示这两条路径各自独立进行，均未能弥合该能力缺口。作者认为相机运动理解需同时满足两个条件。
AI.method: 提出 CameraVLM，将运动状态表示与状态-语言对齐相结合：用 camera tokens 表征画外相机运动，用 flow tokens 表征画面内主体与背景的流动动态；采用两阶段训练策略，将语言模型保持在训练回路中，使两类表征与相机运动语义联合学习，而非作为独立的姿态或深度估计器训练。
AI.result: 仅 9B 参数，在三个基准、20 多个基线上大幅超越所有开源模型及相机运动专用模型；在 48 人参与的用户研究中达到或超过 GPT-6 Astra 及人类观察者的水平。
AI.conclusion: 相机运动理解需同时具备耦合画外相机运动与画内光流动态的表示，并由语言模型进行解释；CameraVLM 验证了该设计在性能上远超专用方法与通用大模型。

title: EPOCH: Coverage-Aware Evolution with Experiential Preference Optimization for LLM-based Automated Heuristic Design
summary: LLM-based automated heuristic design (AHD) discovers heuristics for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs), where an LLM generates candidates in an evolutionary search. Existing frameworks freeze the generator or fine-tune it on a scalar fitness signal hiding which instances each heuristic covers. Reflection-based frameworks improve heuristics with natural-language feedback, but it stays in the prompt and never reaches the generator's weights. We propose EPOCH, which makes instance coverage the objective of the evolutionary search and fine-tunes the generator to internalize reflection. Parent selection, operator allocation, and stagnation recovery all optimize how well the heuristics jointly cover the training instances, so the search returns a complementary heuristic ensemble. The generator learns from its own search by experiential preference optimization. A teacher LLM returns a natural-language insight on the generated heuristics, and the generator produces new heuristics with this insight. These improvements join the preference pairs for direct preference optimization (DPO). Since DPO only teaches the generator to rank these improvements, a reflective self-distillation (RSD) term makes it more likely to generate them on its own, and the gains accumulate over the long horizon of the search. Across COPs and open-source LLM backbones, EPOCH's heuristic ensembles outperform inference-only and fine-tuned baselines and generalize across problem scales.

AI.tldr: 提出 EPOCH 框架，将实例覆盖作为进化搜索目标，并通过经验偏好优化让生成器内化反思，从而产出互补的启发式集成，在多个组合优化问题上超越仅推理与微调基线并跨规模泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的自动启发式设计（AHD）中，生成器被冻结或仅用标量适应度微调，丢失了"每个启发式覆盖哪些实例"的信息；基于反思的框架虽用自然语言反馈改进启发式，但反馈仅停留在提示中，无法进入生成器权重。
AI.method: EPOCH 以实例覆盖为进化搜索目标，父代选择、算子分配与停滞恢复均优化启发式对训练实例的联合覆盖，从而返回互补的启发式集成。生成器通过经验偏好优化从自身搜索中学习：教师 LLM 对生成的启发式给出自然语言洞见，生成器据此产出新启发式，这些改进被纳入偏好对用于 DPO；由于 DPO 只教生成器对这些改进排序，引入反思式自蒸馏（RSD）项提高其自主生成此类改进的概率，收益在长搜索过程中累积。
AI.result: 在多种组合优化问题和多个开源 LLM 骨干上，EPOCH 的启发式集成优于仅推理与微调基线，并能跨问题规模泛化。
AI.conclusion: 将实例覆盖显式作为进化目标并结合经验偏好优化与反思式自蒸馏，可有效把反思内化到生成器权重中，产生互补且可泛化的启发式集成。

title: HybridDualPathNet: Cross-Fusion Attention of EfficientNetV2 and Swin Transformer for Brain MRI Classification of Alzheimer's and Parkinson's Disease
comment: Two experimental settings: Kaggle-only image-level evaluation and combined Kaggle and ADNI evaluation with patient-wise separation for ADNI subjects
summary: Separating Alzheimer's Disease (AD), Parkinson's Disease (PD), and Healthy Controls (HC) using structural MRI remains challenging because disease signatures overlap and model performance can be strongly affected by data partitioning. We present HybridDualPathNet, a hybrid architecture combining EfficientNetV2-S for local features and Swin-Tiny for global context through a Cross-Fusion Attention (CFA) module. We evaluate the model in two experiments. First, on the Kaggle APD-3-Class dataset using an image-level split, the model achieves 98.25% accuracy. Second, on a combined Kaggle and Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) dataset containing 17,859 slices, we use a per-source split with patient-wise separation for ADNI subjects. In this setting, the model achieves 73.37% standard accuracy and a macro AUC of 0.880. Source-stratified evaluation reveals a substantial domain gap, with 91.2% accuracy on Kaggle test images and 59.2% on ADNI test images. Temperature scaling reduces expected calibration error from 0.130 to 0.015, while split-conformal prediction achieves 89.5% coverage. Saliency analyses using Grad-CAM++, Integrated Gradients, and occlusion indicate that model activations concentrate on brain tissue. These results highlight the importance of patient-level separation, cross-dataset evaluation, and uncertainty estimation when assessing MRI classification systems. The findings also show that strong performance on a single dataset does not necessarily translate to reliable generalization across imaging cohorts.

AI.tldr: 提出HybridDualPathNet（EfficientNetV2-S+Swin-Tiny+交叉融合注意力），在图像级划分下Kaggle数据达98.25%准确率，但在含ADNI的患者级划分下仅73.37%准确率、宏AUC 0.880，暴露显著域间隙（Kaggle 91.2% vs ADNI 59.2%）。
AI.motivation: 区分阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）与健康对照（HC）的结构MRI分类存在疾病特征重叠问题，且模型性能易受数据划分方式影响；现有单数据集评估无法反映跨队列泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建混合双路径架构HybridDualPathNet：EfficientNetV2-S提取局部特征，Swin-Tiny建模全局上下文，经交叉融合注意力（CFA）模块融合。开展两组实验：①Kaggle APD-3-Class数据集、图像级划分；②Kaggle+ADNI合并数据集（17,859张切片）、按来源划分且ADNI按患者分离。并采用温度缩放、分裂共形预测及Grad-CAM++/Integrated Gradients/遮挡分析。
AI.result: 实验一准确率98.25%；实验二标准准确率73.37%、宏AUC 0.880，来源分层评估显示Kaggle 91.2%、ADNI 59.2%的域间隙。温度缩放将期望校准误差从0.130降至0.015，分裂共形预测覆盖率达89.5%；显著性分析表明激活集中于脑组织区域。
AI.conclusion: 评估MRI分类系统时须重视患者级划分、跨数据集验证与不确定性估计；单数据集上的高性能并不必然转化为跨影像队列的可靠泛化能力。

title: Learning to Play: Reinforcement Learning and Games
summary: Amazing breakthroughs in reinforcement learning have taken place. Computers teach themselves to play Chess and Go and beat world champions. There is talk about expanding application areas towards general artificial intelligence (AI). The breakthroughs in Backgammon, Checkers, Chess, Atari, Go, Poker, and StarCraft have shown that we can build machines that exhibit intelligent game playing of the highest level. These successes have been widely publicized in the media, and inspire AI entrepreneurs and scientists alike. Reinforcement learning in games has become a mainstream AI research topic. It is a broad topic, and the successes build on a range of diverse techniques, from exact planning algorithms, to adaptive sampling, deep function approximation, and ingenious self-play methods. Perhaps because of the breadth of these technologies, or because of the recency of the breakthroughs, there are few books that explain these methods in depth. This book covers all methods in one comprehensive volume, explaining the latest research, bringing you as close as possible to working implementations, with many references to the original research papers. The programming examples in this book are in Python, the language in which most current reinforcement learning research is conducted. We help you to get started with machine learning frameworks such as Gym, TensorFlow, and Keras, and provide exercises to help understand how AI is learning to play.

AI.tldr: 该文本是一本关于强化学习游戏的综合性著作前言/摘要，覆盖从精确规划、自适应采样、深度函数逼近到自对弈等最新方法，并结合Gym、TensorFlow、Keras的Python实现与练习。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在棋类与电子游戏中取得突破性进展，引发对通用人工智能的关注，但这些成功依赖多样技术，且因技术广度和突破新近性，少有书籍深入系统讲解。
AI.method: 以单一综合性卷册系统阐述游戏强化学习的最新研究方法，尽量贴近可运行实现，引用原始研究文献，并使用Python及Gym、TensorFlow、Keras等框架提供编程示例与练习。
AI.result: 书中覆盖并解释了游戏强化学习的一整套方法，提供贴近工作实现的说明、大量原始论文参考，以及帮助理解AI如何学会游戏的编程示例和练习。
AI.conclusion: 该著作旨在填补游戏强化学习领域缺少深入书籍的空白，为读者提供全面、前沿且可实践的学习资源。

title: SSM-Attack: Learning Where to Perturb for Black-Box Face Privacy
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Preprint submitted to Pattern Recognition
summary: Face recognition systems are deployed widely enough that a photograph shared online can be matched without its subject's consent. Generator-based protection methods rely on heavy pretrained backbones, multi-stage inference or visible semantic edits. We introduce SSM-Attack, a black-box face privacy framework built on Selective State Space Models. Rather than synthesizing the perturbation, the state-space model predicts in one linear-time pass a spatial allocation of the perturbation budget, marking which facial locations carry identity evidence; a short projected refinement then sets the values within this per-pixel budget. Against published benchmark results, SSM-Attack attains the highest average black-box attack success rate on all three evaluation sets: 87.10 percent on CelebA-HQ, 86.90 on LADN and 81.15 on FFHQ, the last from a network that never saw that dataset. The allocation network holds 5.73 million parameters, or 16.13 million with the frozen networks used by its quality terms. Under the same cap of 0.10 on the maximum per-pixel change, allocation improves structural similarity by 0.044, peak signal-to-noise ratio by 1.62 decibels and Frechet Inception Distance by 11.2 points over a uniform map while spending 37 percent of its capacity. Strong facial privacy protection therefore does not require a large generative prior; it requires knowing where to spend a small one.

AI.tldr: 提出SSM-Attack，基于选择性状态空间模型的黑盒人脸隐私保护框架，用一次线性时间前向预测扰动预算的空间分配（标记承载身份证据的面部位置），再用短投影优化设置数值。
AI.motivation: 人脸识别系统部署广泛，在线共享的照片可在未经本人同意的情况下被匹配。现有基于生成器的保护方法依赖庞大预训练骨干、多阶段推理或可见的语义编辑，成本高且易被察觉，因此需要轻量、黑盒、高效的人脸隐私保护方案。
AI.method: SSM-Attack：不改由生成器合成扰动，而是用选择性状态空间模型在一次线性时间前向中预测扰动预算的空间分配，标出哪些面部位置承载身份证据；随后通过一个短的投影优化步骤，在该逐像素预算内确定扰动数值。分配网络为5.73M参数，含冻结质量项网络共16.13M参数。
AI.result: 在三个评测集上取得最高的平均黑盒攻击成功率：CelebA-HQ 87.10%、LADN 86.90%、FFHQ 81.15%（FFHQ 上为未见该数据集的网络）。在最大逐像素变化上限0.10下，相比均匀分配，分配方案将结构相似度提高0.044、峰值信噪比提高1.62 dB、FID降低11.2点，且仅使用37%的容量。
AI.conclusion: 强人脸隐私保护不依赖大型生成先验，而在于知道如何高效使用小容量模型：通过学习扰动预算的空间分配即可实现更优的隐私保护与图像质量平衡。

title: Generalizable field of view extension for diffusion MRI via conditional flow matching
summary: Incomplete field-of-view (FOV) diffusion MRI (dMRI) acquisitions compromise whole-brain white matter analysis by excluding brain regions from tractography and connectivity studies. While deep generative models for dMRI FOV extension have been proposed, their generalizability remains limited by the acquisition-dependent nature of dMRI, where signal intensity varies with b-value, gradient direction, and scanner protocol, and the inherent 4D complexity of the data, making it difficult to train models that transfer across sites or acquisition schemes without retraining. We propose a flow-matching generative model that extends the dMRI FOV in both the superior and inferior directions by predicting apparent diffusion coefficients (ADC) in six directions, conditioned on the two nearest acquired slices and the full-FOV T1w image to enforce both local diffusion continuity and anatomical consistency. The ADC representation decouples the model from acquisition-specific b-values and gradient directions, providing a middle-ground across protocols. The model was trained on 3,103 subjects (5,105 sessions) across five different datasets spanning diverse acquisition schemes (b = 500 and 1000 s/mm$^2$; 21--192 gradient directions), four single-shell (b = 1000) and one multi-shell (b = 500/1000). Evaluated on 299 subjects across five independent datasets spanning b = 750--1500 s/mm$^2$ and 32--90 gradient directions, with single- and multi-shell schemes unseen during training, the proposed method achieves significantly improved bundle Dice score on downstream tractography (p < 0.01).

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于流匹配（flow matching）的生成模型，以ADC表示与T1w解剖先验为条件，实现dMRI视野（FOV）上下方向的外推，跨站点/跨采集协议具有良好泛化性。
AI.motivation: 不完全FOV的dMRI采集会遗漏脑区，影响全脑白质分析与纤维束追踪/连接组研究。已有深度生成式FOV外推方法泛化性受限：dMRI信号强度依赖b值、梯度方向与扫描协议，且数据为4D，导致模型难以跨站点或跨采集方案迁移，通常需重新训练。
AI.method: 采用流匹配生成模型，在上下两个方向外推FOV，预测6个方向的表观扩散系数（ADC）。条件输入为最邻近的两层已采集切片与全FOV T1w图像，以同时约束局部扩散连续性与解剖一致性。ADC表示使模型与采集相关的b值、梯度方向解耦，成为跨协议的折中表示。
AI.result: 训练集：5个数据集、3,103名被试（5,105次扫描），涵盖b=500与1000 s/mm²、21–192个梯度方向、4个单壳（b=1000）与1个多壳（b=500/1000）方案。在5个独立数据集、299名被试上评测，b=750–1500 s/mm²、32–90个梯度方向，且单/多壳方案均未在训练中出现；所提方法在下游纤维束追踪的bundle Dice指标上显著提升（p < 0.01）。
AI.conclusion: 以ADC为表示的流匹配FOV外推模型可跨采集协议泛化，在未见的b值与梯度方向设置下显著改善下游纤维束追踪质量，为无需重训练的全脑白质分析提供可行方案。

title: HairFlow: Modeling 3D Hair Strands with Multi-Modal Conditioned Diffusion
summary: Modeling 3D hair strands is challenging due to complex hairstyle geometry, scarce high-quality training data, and incomplete or noisy input observations. Foundation models offer broader hairstyle priors, but their outputs are not directly usable for strand-based rendering and simulation. Existing approaches require costly per-instance optimization to fit hair priors to meshes from foundation models and 2D orientations from specialized predictors trained on limited hair data, restricting efficiency and generalization. We present HairFlow, a multimodal conditioned diffusion framework for efficient and controllable hair strands modeling. HairFlow conditions strand generation on two complementary representations: a coarse mesh that constrains global shape and multi-view sketches that specify local strand flow. HairFlow combines an Orientation VAE with a conditioned diffusion transformer to generate volumetric fields that are traced into explicit strands. To overcome the lack of paired sketch-strand training data, we introduce an automatic synthesis pipeline that generates geometrically aligned multi-view sketches with diverse styles representative of inference-time inputs. Experiments show that HairFlow generates plausible 3D strands that faithfully follow the input conditions across diverse hairstyles, substantially reduces inference time, and supports flexible multimodal control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HairFlow，一种多模态条件扩散框架，用于高效、可控的3D发丝建模，通过粗网格与多视角草图双条件约束生成发丝。
AI.motivation: 3D发丝建模面临发型几何复杂、高质量训练数据稀缺、输入观测不完整或含噪等挑战。基础模型虽提供更广泛的发型先验，但其输出无法直接用于基于发丝的渲染与仿真；现有方法需要对每个实例进行昂贵的优化，将发型先验拟合到基础模型网格与有限数据训练的2D朝向预测器上，效率与泛化性受限。
AI.method: HairFlow 以两种互补表示为条件：约束全局形状的粗网格，以及指定局部发丝流向的多视角草图。方法结合 Orientation VAE 与条件扩散Transformer，生成体素场并追踪为显式发丝。为缓解配对草图-发丝训练数据缺失，设计了自动合成管线，生成几何对齐、风格多样且贴近推理输入的多视角草图。
AI.result: 实验表明，HairFlow 能生成合理的3D发丝并忠实遵循输入条件，适应多样发型，显著降低推理时间，并支持灵活的多模态控制。
AI.conclusion: HairFlow 通过多模态条件扩散与自动草图合成，实现了高效、可控且泛化性强的3D发丝建模，避免了逐实例的昂贵优化。

title: Agency as a New Organizing Abstraction for Computer Science
comment: An extended version of a paper to appear in Communications of the ACM, November 2026
summary: Advances in large-scale machine learning have enabled agentic AI systems: persistent, autonomous computational entities that pursue goals, initiate actions, and interact with open environments. These systems are often framed as applications of foundation models. We argue that this framing is incomplete: agency is also a candidate new organizing abstraction for computer science. What is new is not the concept of an agent, nor runtime policy generation per se, but its general-purpose, open-ended form, in which systems can synthesize courses of action from goals, observations, and memory, over tools and environments for which no complete task-specific model was specified in advance. Thus agency becomes a systems-level abstraction as well as an AI modeling concept. Where the process abstraction organizes computation around executing programs, agency organizes it around pursuing goals under bounded resources: a process executes a program; an agent pursues a goal. From this perspective, the recurring failures of deployed agentic systems (runaway resource consumption, behavior redirected by adversarial content, opaque continuous operation) are symptoms of structural abstraction gaps, not isolated engineering defects. We examine these gaps across six dimensions (execution, interfaces, correctness, oversight, coordination, and persistence) and argue that closing them requires coordinated advances in systems,

AI.tldr: 本文主张将"能动性（agency）"视为计算机科学中与"进程"并列的新型系统级抽象，而非仅视为基础模型的应用；agentic系统的反复失败源于结构性抽象缺口，需在六个维度上协同推进系统研究。
AI.motivation: 当前对agentic AI系统的通行理解是"基础模型的应用"，作者认为这一定位不完整。真正的新意不在于"智能体"概念本身，也不在于运行时策略生成，而在于其通用、开放式的形态：系统能从目标、观察与记忆中合成行动方案，并在事先未指定完整任务专用模型的情况下操作工具与环境。因此需要为计算机科学寻找新的组织性抽象。
AI.method: 概念性/立场性分析（position paper）。作者通过类比论证：进程抽象围绕"执行程序"组织计算，能动性抽象则围绕"在有限资源下追求目标"组织计算——进程执行程序，智能体追求目标。据此将agency同时确立为系统级抽象与AI建模概念，并沿执行、接口、正确性、监督、协调、持久性六个维度系统梳理抽象缺口。
AI.result: 识别出部署中agentic系统的典型失败模式——资源消耗失控、行为被对抗性内容重定向、不透明的持续运行——并将其重新解释为结构性抽象缺口的症状，而非孤立的工程缺陷；同时给出跨六维度的缺口分析框架。
AI.conclusion: 弥合这些抽象缺口需要系统、AI建模及相关领域的协同推进；能动性有望成为计算机科学中一类新的组织性抽象。摘要末尾内容不完整，未给出完整结论。

title: MID: Mask-Image Distributional Divergence for Evaluating Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Current evaluation protocols for medical image segmentation remain largely anchored in sample-wise comparisons, e.g., Dice and Hausdorff distance, which require each prediction to be paired with a ground-truth mask. Yet two limitations arise in practice: they are inapplicable when predictions are made on unlabeled data; and even when annotations are available, they cannot assess whether a collection of predictions matches the distributional structure of the ground-truth population. We introduce MID (Mask-Image Distributional Divergence), a distribution-level evaluation metric for medical image segmentation. MID builds upon the observation that segmentation quality is a property of the joint image-mask distribution: a mask may be anatomically plausible in isolation yet incorrect for the image it accompanies. MID compares the joint distribution of images and masks between a reference set and a set of predictions, without requiring sample-wise correspondence. This captures both mask realism and image-mask consistency. We evaluate MID across 13 publicly available datasets spanning CT, MRI, and MRA. Under anatomically realistic corruptions across 56 organ groups, MID tracks mean Dice and Hausdorff distance without per-sample ground-truth pairing. MID also detects distributional shifts across modalities and anatomies, identifies image-mask misalignment through controlled shuffling experiments, and produces reliable model rankings across real segmentation models. Official implementation available at github.com/erc-caravel/pytorch-mid

AI.tldr: 提出分布级医学图像分割评估指标MID，基于图像-掩码联合分布比较，无需样本级配对，可评估无标注数据并捕捉掩码真实性与图像-掩码一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分割评估方案（如Dice、Hausdorff距离）基于样本级配对比较，存在两大局限：预测在无标注数据上无法使用；即使有标注也无法评估预测集合是否匹配真实标签总体的分布结构。且分割质量本质上是图像-掩码联合分布的性质——掩码单独看解剖合理，但对其对应图像可能错误。
AI.method: MID（Mask-Image Distributional Divergence），一种分布级评估指标。通过比较参考集与预测集的图像-掩码联合分布，无需样本级对应关系，同时捕捉掩码真实性和图像-掩码一致性。
AI.result: 在覆盖CT、MRI、MRA的13个公开数据集上评估。在56个器官组的解剖真实扰动下，MID无需逐样本真值配对即可追踪平均Dice和Hausdorff距离；能检测跨模态和解剖结构的分布偏移，通过受控打乱实验识别图像-掩码错位，并在真实分割模型上给出可靠排名。
AI.conclusion: MID为医学图像分割提供了分布级评估范式，突破样本级配对限制，适用于无标注场景并评估预测集合的分布结构一致性。官方实现已开源。

title: SchemaWeaver: Accelerating On-Device Mobile Agentic AI via Schema-Guided Parallel LLM Decoding
summary: Large language models (LLMs) on mobile devices can act as agents that call external software tools to complete complex tasks, but the major challenge of supporting on-device mobile agentic AI with LLMs is the long latency of LLM tool calling on mobile devices. In particular, the decode phase is the main contributor of such long latency, but is hard to speed up on mobile processors as it is bound by memory bandwidth rather than compute power. To address this limitation, in this paper we present SchemaWeaver, a new on-device mobile agentic AI technique that enforces schema-guided parallel decoding in the decode phase of LLM tool calling, to reduce its latency by producing multiple tokens in each decode pass. SchemaWeaver can be generically applied to the LLM inference engine on mobile devices without involving any training efforts or changes on LLMs, and our experiment results on major mobile SoCs and LLM families show that SchemaWeaver can reduce the LLM tool calling latency by up to 3.9 times, compared to the competitive baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出SchemaWeaver，通过schema引导的并行解码，在移动端LLM工具调用中降低解码阶段延迟，最高提速3.9倍。
AI.motivation: 移动端LLM作为agent需调用外部工具完成复杂任务，但工具调用延迟高；其中解码阶段是主要瓶颈，且受内存带宽限制（而非算力），在移动处理器上难以加速。
AI.method: SchemaWeaver在LLM工具调用的解码阶段强制执行schema引导的并行解码，每次解码pass生成多个token。该方法可通用地应用于移动设备上的LLM推理引擎，无需任何训练或对LLM本身的修改。
AI.result: 在主流移动SoC和LLM系列上的实验表明，与竞争性基线相比，SchemaWeaver可将LLM工具调用延迟最多降低3.9倍。
AI.conclusion: SchemaWeaver通过schema引导的并行解码有效缓解了移动端LLM工具调用中解码阶段的内存带宽瓶颈，实现显著延迟降低，且无需训练或模型改动，具备良好的通用性。

title: WIRE: Weight Space Implicit Representation Encoding of Frozen Video LLMs
summary: Video language models represent a video as a long sequence of visual embeddings in a decoder's input. Every visual embedding is processed by every decoder layer during prefill, stored in the key value cache, and attended by every generated token, so a long video raises prefill, memory, and generation cost at once. We present WIRE (Weight Space Implicit Representation Encoding), which reduces this recurring cost by moving part of the video conditioned computation of a frozen video language model from its input activations into a temporary low rank update of its weights. WIRE keeps a short explicit visual context, so the update acts as a correction rather than a replacement of the video. WIRE first compresses the full resolution embeddings of each frame into a small set of carrier tokens using a question conditioned bidirectional selective scan, and physically contracts the decoder input so every decoder layer, cache entry, and decoding step operates on the shorter sequence. Hypernetworks at selected decoder layers read the compressed forward pass together with a readout of the full resolution features removed by contraction and generate LoRA updates to the attention and feedforward projections. The updates are merged after prefill, so autoregressive decoding runs the unmodified frozen backbone. On Qwen3-VL-8B, WIRE with 16 carrier tokens per frame contracts the visual stream by $3.5\times$, reduces decoder prefill time by $3.35\times$ at 256 frames and $4.14\times$ at 1024 frames, shrinks the key value cache proportionally, and keeps per token decoding latency approximately constant. Across nine benchmark settings at 256 frames, it obtains the highest average accuracy among efficient video language models we evaluate under a common 256 frame budget.

AI.tldr: WIRE 将视频条件计算从输入激活迁移到冻结视频语言模型的临时低秩权重更新中，在保持显式视觉上下文的同时大幅压缩序列，实现高效视频理解。
AI.motivation: 视频语言模型将视频表示为解码器输入中的长序列视觉嵌入，每个嵌入需经过所有解码器层处理、存入 KV 缓存并被每个生成 token 关注，导致长视频同时抬高预填充、内存与生成成本。现有方法难以在不破坏冻结模型能力的前提下同时缓解这三类开销。
AI.method: WIRE（权重空间隐式表示编码）保留短显式视觉上下文，将部分视频条件计算从输入激活迁移到冻结模型的临时低秩权重更新。具体地，先用问题条件化的双向选择性扫描将每帧全分辨率嵌入压缩为少量载体 token，并物理收缩解码器输入序列；在选定解码器层用超网络读取压缩前向传播结果及被收缩移除的全分辨率特征读出，生成注意力与前馈投影的 LoRA 更新；预填充后合并更新，使自回归解码运行未修改的冻结主干。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上，每帧 16 个载体 token 将视觉流收缩 3.5 倍，256 帧时解码器预填充时间减少 3.35 倍，1024 帧时减少 4.14 倍，KV 缓存成比例缩小，且每 token 解码延迟基本不变。在 256 帧统一预算下的九项基准设置中，取得了所评估高效视频语言模型中的最高平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: WIRE 通过权重空间隐式表示有效降低视频语言模型的长序列重复计算成本，在显著加速预填充、压缩 KV 缓存的同时保持解码效率与准确率，为高效长视频理解提供了可行方案。

title: Large Language Models Extend Known Research But Do Not Create New Research Directions
summary: The success of autonomous research systems relies on the quality of the scientific hypotheses they generate. Recent studies report that human reviewers often rate LLM-generated ideas as more novel than those from human experts, raising hope that AI can accelerate scientific discovery. Yet it is unclear whether these models can do more than extend existing knowledge. Can LLMs drive genuine innovation by revealing new research directions, or are they limited to repeating and recombining what science already knows? This unresolved question lies at the heart of discussions about AI and the future of science. To address this, we distinguish two types of novelty: distance, which measures how far a hypothesis lies from existing work, and direction, which captures whether the hypothesis pursues new lines of inquiry beyond those already present. These two measures diverge sharply for LLM-generated work. We represent scientific papers in a shared conceptual space using a pretrained scientific-paper embedding model. Within this space, we embed 26.9 million human-authored papers across 1,325 research topics in six natural-science fields and 524,308 LLM-generated hypotheses from eight models. Distance is measured using existing metrics. To quantify direction, we introduce the orthogonal novelty score (ONS). LLMs consistently generate ideas more distant from existing work than human-authored papers, up to 16\% further when the LLM is given the papers farthest from the centre of the topic. However, LLM hypotheses have a 15--23\% lower median ONS than published papers from the same topic. Thus, LLMs move further from what is already known, but remain within established directions. This pattern persists across changes in various configurations. As a result, LLMs excel at extending the frontier but the creation of new directions is still led by human scientists.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过区分新颖性的"距离"与"方向"两个维度，发现LLM生成的假设比人类论文距离现有工作更远（最多16%），但其正交新颖性分数（ONS）中位数比同主题已发表论文低15–23%，表明LLM擅长扩展前沿，但开辟新方向仍由人类科学家主导。
AI.motivation: 自主研究系统的成功取决于其生成科学假设的质量。已有研究显示人类评审常认为LLM生成的想法比人类专家的更新颖，但尚不清楚LLM能否带来真正的创新、揭示新研究方向，还是仅限于重复和重组已有知识。这一悬而未决的问题关乎AI与科学未来的讨论核心，因此作者试图厘清LLM新颖性的本质。
AI.method: 作者区分两类新颖性：距离（假设距现有工作的远近）与方向（是否追求超出既有研究的新探究路线）。使用预训练科学论文嵌入模型构建共享概念空间，嵌入六大自然科学领域、1,325个研究主题下的2,690万篇人类论文，以及来自8个模型的524,308个LLM生成假设。距离沿用现有度量，方向则通过新提出的正交新颖性分数（ONS）量化。
AI.result: LLM生成的想法的距离 consistently 大于人类论文，当给予距主题中心最远的论文时最多远16%。但LLM假设的ONS中位数比同一主题的已发表论文低15–23%。该模式在各种配置变化下均持续存在。
AI.conclusion: LLM在远离已知内容方面表现更强，但仍停留在既有方向内。因此LLM擅长扩展前沿，而新方向的创造仍由人类科学家主导。

title: Brain2Face: A Study on the Relation of EEG Signals and Spatio-temporal Head Avatars
summary: Driving digital head avatars is classically done by hand-crafted artist design or by image-based facial performance capture. In this work, we ask whether spatio-temporal tracking of the humans's head geometry and appearance can be performed solely from brain signals, i.e., Electroencephalography (EEG). Since prior work mostly focused on activity and emotion recognition, this task is relatively unexplored without even having publicly available high-quality datasets and benchmarks. Thus, we contribute a dataset featuring paired EEG and human head geometry as well as appearance annotations. We synchronize 64-channel EEG with per-frame expression latent codes of a personalized Gaussian head avatar. Second, we introduce a baseline to the task of expression recovery of a head avatar from EEG signals. To this end, we propose a dedicated EEG-to-expression model that takes a temporal sequence of EEG signals as input and regresses the latent expression parameters of the 3D Gaussian head avatar. Lastly, we validate our capture and algorithmic design choices through a benchmark protocol that we introduce to this task. We believe this work paves the way towards better understanding of the relation between EEG signals and facial surface as well as appearance changes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从脑电信号（EEG）直接驱动三维数字人头像的新任务：构建了64通道EEG与个性化高斯头像表情隐码同步配对的数据集，并提出EEG-to-expression回归模型实现表情恢复，同时建立了评测基准。
AI.motivation: 传统数字人头像驱动依赖手工设计或基于图像的面部表演捕捉。作者希望探索能否仅从脑信号（EEG）实现人头几何与外观的时空追踪。由于以往工作多集中于活动与情绪识别，该任务基本未被探索，且缺乏公开高质量数据集与基准。
AI.method: 1）采集并同步64通道EEG与个性化高斯头像的逐帧表情隐码，构建配对数据集；2）提出EEG-to-expression模型，以时序EEG信号为输入，回归3D高斯头像的隐式表情参数；3）设计基准协议验证捕捉方案与算法设计。
AI.result: 贡献了首个EEG与头部几何/外观注释配对的高质量数据集，给出了该任务的基线方法，并通过基准协议验证了数据捕捉与算法设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解EEG信号与面部表面及外观变化之间的关系开辟了道路，推动了脑信号驱动数字人头像这一新方向。

title: An FPGA-Based Spiking Neural Network for Spatiotemporal Pattern Learning and Classification
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are promising for energy-efficient spatiotemporal pattern recognition at the edge, but efficient deployment and on-device adaptation require specialized hardware. In this work, we present an FPGA implementation of multilayer SNNs for spatiotemporal pattern classification, in which both inference and training take place on the same hardware. Our design adopts a temporal-forward-only training algorithm that avoids the memory and latency overhead associated with traditional Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT). A mixed-precision scheme balances training stability with resource efficiency, and architectural optimization maximizes hardware and memory utilization. We further identify and resolve hazards that arise when inference and learning share the same memory, including port conflicts between the forward and backward access patterns and read-after-write dependencies in floating-point potential accumulation. Experimental evaluations on MNIST and five multivariate time-series classification datasets demonstrate that, with fully on-chip training, our SNN model achieves accuracy comparable to SNN or LSTM trained with BPTT. Compared to CPU and GPU based implementations, our FPGA design delivers 2.5 to 6 times higher throughput while consuming an order of magnitude less energy per sample.

AI.tldr: 提出一种支持片上训练与推理的多层SNN FPGA实现，通过时间前向训练算法、混合精度与架构优化，实现高能效时空模式分类。
AI.motivation: SNN在边缘端时空模式识别中具有能效优势，但其高效部署与设备端自适应需要专用硬件；传统BPTT训练存在显存与延迟开销，制约片上训练实现。
AI.method: 采用仅时间前向（temporal-forward-only）训练算法规避BPTT开销；设计混合精度方案平衡训练稳定性与资源效率；进行架构优化以提升硬件与存储利用率；识别并解决推理与学习共享存储时的冒险，包括前向/反向访问模式的端口冲突及浮点膜电位累加的写后读依赖。
AI.result: 在MNIST及五个多元时间序列分类数据集上，全片上训练精度与使用BPTT训练的SNN或LSTM相当；相比CPU与GPU实现，吞吐量提升2.5–6倍，单样本能耗低一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该FPGA设计验证了在单一硬件上兼顾SNN推理与训练的可行性，在保持精度的同时显著提升吞吐与能效，适用于边缘端时空模式识别部署。

title: Bottlenecked semantic compression by representation reconstruction
summary: Vision Transformers incur high computational costs when processing long visual token sequences. Existing reduction methods typically rank tokens independently and discard those deemed unimportant or redundant. We propose a reconstruction-guided framework for visual token condensation (ReConV), which summarizes the complete visual sequence with a compact Summary Bank (SMB) and retains tokens whose information is not adequately captured by the SMB, as indicated by their reconstruction residuals. At each compression layer, a lightweight position-conditioned decoder reconstructs the current tokens, leaving shared information compressed in the SMB while explicitly preserving poorly reconstructed details. Experiments on image classification and multimodal understanding demonstrate favorable performance-efficiency trade-offs: ReConV surpasses the uncompressed baseline with 48\% fewer GMACs on ImageNet and enables reusable image-level representations for efficient multi-turn inference. Code is available at TokenDrop.

AI.tldr: 提出重建引导的视觉token压缩框架ReConV，用紧凑Summary Bank总结完整视觉序列，保留重建残差大的token，在图像分类与多模态理解中实现更优性能-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 视觉Transformer处理长视觉token序列时计算开销大；现有压缩方法通常独立地对token排序并丢弃被认为不重要或冗余的token，可能损失关键信息。
AI.method: 提出重建引导的可视token压缩框架ReConV：使用紧凑的Summary Bank（SMB）汇总完整视觉序列；在每个压缩层用轻量级位置条件解码器重建当前token，将共享信息压缩进SMB，并根据重建残差显式保留未被充分捕获的token细节。
AI.result: 在图像分类和多模态理解任务上取得良好的性能-效率权衡：在ImageNet上以减少48% GMACs的情况下超过未压缩基线，并支持可复用的图像级表示以实现高效多轮推理。代码见TokenDrop。
AI.conclusion: ReConV通过重建残差引导的token保留机制，在适度压缩下实现优于基线的表现，兼顾效率与性能，并支持多轮推理中的表示复用。

title: REA: From Correct LLM Judgments to Safe Decision Delivery
summary: Generative safety guards must classify requests correctly and return outputs that applications can parse. Reasoning guards can improve classification accuracy while producing outputs that applications cannot parse. When applications cannot extract a correct prediction, fallback handling can allow harmful requests or block safe ones. We introduce Resolve--Express--Act (REA), a framework that traces judgments through parsing and fallback to application actions. Experiments on classifiers and safety guards show that correct predictions can appear in incorrectly formatted outputs. Parsing the safety verdict preserves the reasoning guard's accuracy advantage, while stricter explanation requirements reject additional correct predictions. Accepting formatting variations recovers most rejected correct predictions. Held-out tests confirm that output requirements and generation limits affect whether correct predictions can be parsed. In our fail-open replay, matching the parser to the output and fixing formatting reduced the fraction of harmful requests allowed despite correct guard judgments from 95.5% to 0%. A fixed-output comparison shows that model-based extraction can preserve guard verdicts, but is not automatically reliable; deterministic normalization already repairs the observed native-format failures. Fallback replay shows that the same correct prediction can lead to different safety actions depending on the parser and fallback policy, including allowing requests the guard correctly identifies as harmful.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Resolve–Express–Act (REA) 框架，将安全守卫的判断从解析到回退再到应用动作进行端到端追踪，揭示"正确预测"与"可解析输出"之间的鸿沟及其对实际安全后果的影响。
AI.motivation: 生成式安全守卫不仅要正确分类请求，还必须输出应用可解析的结果。推理型守卫虽能提升分类准确率，但其输出常无法被应用解析；一旦无法提取正确预测，回退策略可能放行有害请求或拦截安全请求。已有工作只关注分类准确率，忽视了"判断→解析→回退→动作"这一完整链路对最终安全性的影响。
AI.method: 提出 REA（Resolve–Express–Act）框架，将判断的解析、回退与应用动作串联追踪。在分类器与安全守卫上进行实验，分析格式错误输出中正确预测的存在情况；对比不同解析器（含模型抽取与确定性归一化）、解释性要求严格程度、格式变体接受度、输出约束与生成长度限制的影响，并进行 fail-open 回退重放与固定输出对比实验。
AI.result: 正确预测可存在于格式错误的输出中；解析安全判定可保留推理守卫的准确率优势，而更严格的解释要求会额外拒斥正确预测；接受格式变体可恢复大部分被拒斥的正确预测。在 fail-open 重放中，将解析器与输出匹配并修正格式后，尽管守卫判断正确却被放行的有害请求比例从 95.5% 降至 0%。固定输出对比显示，模型抽取能保留守卫判定但并非自动可靠，而确定性归一化已能修复观察到的原生格式失败。回退重放表明，同一正确预测因解析器与回退策略不同可导致不同的安全动作。
AI.conclusion: 安全守卫的有效性不能仅以分类准确率衡量，输出可解析性与回退策略同样决定真实安全后果。应让解析器与守卫输出格式对齐、优先采用确定性归一化，并审慎设计回退政策，以避免正确判断被"错误地"转化为不安全动作。

title: World-T3: Test-Time Training as Persistent Memory for Real-Time Video World Models
summary: Recent advances in video world models have enabled plausible interactive environments, yet long-horizon generation places a fundamental demand on visual memory: the previously observed world must remain consistent as the model continues to generate. Existing autoregressive approaches often implicitly rely on the generative model itself to retain such information, leading to spatial memory decay beyond the active context. We introduce World-T3, a camera-controlled video world model with a test-time training memory that consolidates past observations into dedicated model parameters. To robustly update this memory, we propose a recursive least-squares rule that incrementally absorbs novel visual features via online pose-keyed memory updates. Our TTT memory reads out previously observed scene features from the fast-weight state by camera pose, enabling consistent generation with constant storage and per-step computation regardless of rollout length. To facilitate real-time interactive generation with this robust memory, we further distill the autoregressive model into a few-step generator via dual-teacher distribution matching. On a long-horizon revisit benchmark, World-T3 raises revisit PSNR from 13.52 to 18.31 dB and reduces absolute rotation error from 3.344 to 1.075 relative to the strongest baseline on both metrics, while sustaining 20.6 FPS at 1280 x 704 on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU.

AI.tldr: 提出World-T3，一种相机可控的视频世界模型，通过测试时训练（TTT）的快速权重记忆与递归最小二乘更新规则，将历史观测固化为模型参数，实现恒定存储与计算量下的长时程一致性生成，并借助双教师蒸馏实现实时交互。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归视频世界模型在长时程生成中依赖生成模型自身隐式保留历史信息，导致超出有效上下文后空间记忆衰减，重访旧场景时一致性变差。需要一种显式、存储与计算开销不随 rollout 长度增长的视觉记忆机制。
AI.method: 核心为带测试时训练记忆的相机可控视频世界模型：1）以相机位姿为键（pose-keyed），将历史视觉特征在线写入快速权重状态；2）采用递归最小二乘（RLS）更新规则，增量式、稳健地吸收新视觉特征；3）记忆读出按相机位姿从快速权重状态检索已观测场景特征；4）通过双教师分布匹配将自回归模型蒸馏为少步生成器，支撑实时交互生成。
AI.result: 在长时程重访基准上，相比最强基线将重访 PSNR 由 13.52 dB 提升至 18.31 dB，绝对旋转误差由 3.344 降至 1.075；在单张 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上以 1280×704 分辨率维持 20.6 FPS。存储与单步计算量不随 rollout 长度增长。
AI.conclusion: 将长时程视觉记忆外化为可在线更新的参数状态，并配合位姿键控与 RLS 更新，可在常数开销下有效缓解空间记忆衰减，兼顾长时程一致性与实时交互性。

title: TacitVLA: Reasoning Vision-Language-Action Models Without Reasoning Latency
summary: Textual reasoning before acting has improved vision-language-action (VLA) models, but at the cost of latency: every action conditioned on the reasoning text must wait for autoregressive decoding. We show that actions do not need to wait for or condition on the generated reasoning to benefit from it, because the reasoning supervision already improves the backbone representation. We introduce TacitVLA, a reasoning VLA whose action expert never attends to the reasoning it generates for the current call. On long-horizon tasks where the reasoning text also serves as episodic memory, it can generate each entry during action execution rather than before acting. We evaluate it in a controlled study on four benchmarks spanning manipulation and autonomous driving, memory and non-memory tasks: RoboMME, RMBench, LIBERO, and PhysicalAI-AV. On all four, TacitVLA matches the performance of its explicit-reasoning counterpart at up to 3.4x lower latency, and matches the latency of the same architecture trained without reasoning at up to +17.1% success. In absolute terms, it surpasses the best previously published results on the RoboMME Counting suite (82.7% vs. 66.8%) and RMBench (77.5% vs. 56.5%), and reaches 72.9% on LIBERO-Plus and a 52.5% scene score on the public split of the PhysicalAI-AV closed-loop driving challenge. Project page: https://tacitvla.github.io.

AI.tldr: TacitVLA 提出显式推理不必被动作专家关注：推理监督本身已改善骨干表示，故动作可无延迟受益，在四个基准上实现同等性能、最高 3.4 倍更低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型在动作前进行文本推理（textual reasoning）虽提升性能，却带来延迟代价：每个动作需等待自回归解码完成。作者质疑动作是否必须等待或条件于生成的推理文本。
AI.method: 提出 TacitVLA：其动作专家（action expert）在当前调用中从不关注所生成的推理文本；推理监督通过训练改善骨干表示，而非作为条件输入。在长时程任务中推理文本充当情节记忆（episodic memory）时，可改为在动作执行过程中逐条生成，而非在动作之前生成。
AI.result: 在 RoboMME、RMBench、LIBERO、PhysicalAI-AV 四个基准（涵盖操作与自动驾驶、记忆与非记忆任务）的受控实验中：性能与显式推理版本持平，延迟最高降低 3.4 倍；与无推理训练的相同架构延迟相当，成功率最高提升 17.1%。绝对指标上，RoboMME Counting 达 82.7%（此前最佳 66.8%），RMBench 达 77.5%（此前 56.5%），LIBERO-Plus 达 72.9%，PhysicalAI-AV 闭环驾驶公开分榜场景得分 52.5%。
AI.conclusion: 显式推理文本无需被动作策略关注即可带来性能收益，其作用主要体现在表示学习中；TacitVLA 因此解耦推理与动作条件，在保持或超越性能的同时显著降低推理延迟。

title: Know-Thy-Not: Training-Free Targeted Negation in Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Models
summary: Dual-encoder vision-language models systematically fail at negation, scoring ''a cat without a dog'' nearly identically to ''a cat with a dog.'' We show that this failure is inherent to the single-embedding framework. Under contrastive training, single-embedding methods can at best ignore the negated concept (dilution) but never penalize its presence (rejection). We propose Know-Thy-Not (KTN), a training-free method that introduces an image-side rejection dimension to penalize the negated concept directly in the visual representation. We also introduce COCO-Confusion, the first benchmark requiring genuine rejection to succeed. Across 9 backbones, KTN improves COCO-Confusion mAP by up to +25.6 over vanilla VLMs and +9.6 over the strongest existing method.

AI.tldr: 双编码器视觉语言模型在否定语义上系统性失败，本文证明该缺陷源于单嵌入框架本身，并提出免训练的 Know-Thy-Not (KTN) 方法及 COCO-Confusion 基准来显式实现对被否定概念的拒绝。
AI.motivation: 双编码器视觉语言模型（VLM）对否定不敏感，例如"没有狗的猫"与"有狗的猫"得分几乎相同。作者旨在揭示这一失败的根本原因，并解决单嵌入框架无法惩罚被否定概念存在的问题。
AI.method: 理论分析表明，在对比训练下单嵌入方法最多只能忽略被否定概念（稀释，dilution），而无法惩罚其出现（拒绝，rejection）。据此提出免训练方法 Know-Thy-Not (KTN)，在图像侧引入"拒绝维度"，直接在视觉表示中惩罚被否定概念；同时构建首个要求真正拒绝能力的基准 COCO-Confusion。
AI.result: 在 9 个骨干网络上，KTN 在 COCO-Confusion 上将 mAP 相对原版 VLM 提升最高 +25.6，相对最强现有方法提升 +9.6。
AI.conclusion: 否定失败是单嵌入框架的固有局限，通过引入图像侧拒绝维度可在无需训练的情况下有效缓解，KTN 在需要真正拒绝能力的基准上显著优于现有方法。

title: Reference Wording Shapes Retrieval of Robot Task Instructions
summary: Identifying a robot task from a short instruction is sensitive to which descriptions are available for retrieval. We investigate this effect in the natural-language instructions included with the RLBench manipulation benchmark. We extract 296 fixed descriptions from 62 publicly available task files and compare five training-free lexical rankers over 80 random choices of one indexed description per task. Exact strings assigned to conflicting task labels are excluded from the primary score. Character n-gram TF-IDF achieves 61.3% mean top-1 accuracy on the resulting held-out instructions, compared with 55.6% for BM25 and 54.9% for word TF-IDF. Across gallery choices, character TF-IDF ranges from 55.2% to 66.8%; its 5th-95th percentile range is 56.9%-64.8%. Adding a second indexed description improves character TF-IDF by 7.0 percentage points on matched queries. These results quantify the influence of reference wording and representation choice on instruction-to-task retrieval under a consistent evaluation protocol.

AI.tldr: 在RLBench操作基准上量化了参考描述措辞与检索表示对指令-任务检索的影响：字符n-gram TF-IDF在留出指令上取得61.3%的平均top-1准确率，优于BM25与词级TF-IDF。
AI.motivation: 机器人任务识别依赖可检索的指令描述，但检索效果受可用描述措辞影响，此效应此前缺乏系统性量化。
AI.method: 从62个公开任务文件中提取296条固定描述；对每种任务随机选取一条索引描述的80种组合，比较五种免训练词法排序器；主分数排除与冲突任务标签对应的完全一致字符串；报告字符/词级TF-IDF与BM25的top-1准确率及其分布，并测试增加第二条索引描述的效果。
AI.result: 字符n-gram TF-IDF平均top-1准确率61.3%，BM25为55.6%，词TF-IDF为54.9%；跨图库组合字符TF-IDF范围为55.2%-66.8%，5th-95th百分位为56.9%-64.8%；增加第二条索引描述在匹配查询上提升7.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在统一评估协议下，参考描述措辞与表示选择显著影响指令到任务的检索性能，字符级表示更鲁棒，且适度增加索引描述可明显提升准确率。

title: TableVision: Recovering Verified Structure from Historical Tables
summary: Gaps, skips, and mistakes are the normal state of a historical register: rows go missing, tables cross page breaks, columns slip under wrong names, and column sums disagree with the corresponding row entries. Readers read digits correctly but lose the table structure. On seven clean panels of election returns, the best open-source reader reproduces 99.0\% of the digits but files only 83.7\% of the figures in the correct cells and gets 11 of 30 columns correct. TableVision treats table structure recovery as the problem. On three degraded 1888 pages, Amazon Textract files only 1 of 1494 figures correctly; TableVision correctly files 99.2\%, and all 51 columns its exact-total check releases are correct. A dynamic program cuts a volume into blocks by how many columns sum to their last line; witnesses read the cells; the gate classifies each column as exactly reconciling, flagged as faithful to a page whose arithmetic is wrong, or withheld. A theory of the sum check says which errors it cannot see and why its optimal block is about $θ^{-1/2}$ rows at defect rate $θ$. On 2201 columns of Wisconsin electoral data, the gate accepts 2042, flags 118, and withholds 41; failure rises with column length $R$ as $1-(1-θ)^R$ at 1.1 defects per 1000 cells in general elections; official returns confirm 933 of 934 testable accepted sums and all 35 testable flagged totals; and the deployment added 491\,359 gated precinct rows to a 9.3-million-row dataset. One implication is that the design of the verification block is critical.

AI.tldr: TableVision将历史表格的结构恢复作为核心问题，通过动态规划分块、单元格识别与基于“列和校验”的三态门控，在退化历史记录上大幅提升数字归档正确率，并在威斯康星选举数据上验证了其可靠性。
AI.motivation: 历史登记册普遍存在缺行、跨页断表、列名错位以及列和与行项不一致等问题。读者能正确识别数字，却会丢失表格结构。现有开源OCR/表格识别工具虽能高比例还原数字（如99.0%），但正确归档到单元格的比例很低（83.7%），30列中仅11列完全正确；在退化页面上表现更差（Amazon Textract仅1494个数字中1个正确归档）。因此作者主张应将表格结构恢复视为关键问题。
AI.method: TableVision以表格结构恢复为核心：使用动态规划依据“有多少列能与其最后一行求和一致”将卷册切分为块；由witnesses读取单元格；门控将每列分类为三类——精确对账、标记为忠实于算术本身错误的页面、以及扣留。方法还包括关于求和校验的理论，说明其无法检测的错误类型，并给出在缺陷率θ下最优块大小约为θ^{-1/2}行。
AI.result: 在三个退化1888页面上，Amazon Textract仅正确归档1/1494个数字，而TableVision正确归档99.2%，且其精确总和校验释放的51列全部正确。在2201列威斯康星选举数据上，门控接受2042列、标记118列、扣留41列；失败率随列长R按1-(1-θ)^R上升，大选缺陷率为每1000个单元格1.1个缺陷。官方结果确认934个可测接受和中的933个，以及全部35个可测标记总数；部署向930万行数据集新增491,359条门控选区行。
AI.conclusion: TableVision表明，将表格结构恢复而非单纯数字识别作为核心问题，可显著提升历史表格数据的正确归档率与可验证性。基于列和校验的三态门控能高精度地接受、标记或扣留数据，官方记录验证了其可靠性。研究的一个重要启示是：验证模块（verification block）的设计至关重要。

title: RAN-JEPA: An Action-Conditioned World Model for Energy-efficient Mobile Network Control
summary: Operational mobile networks are rich in observations but poor in interventions: they continuously generate large volumes of passive telemetry, while controlled action--response trajectories remain comparatively scarce and costly to collect. This observation--intervention asymmetry is a central obstacle to building practical world models for RAN control. We address this problem with RAN-JEPA, an action-conditioned world model that separates representation learning from intervention learning. The model first learns a predictive latent representation from observation-only network data, adapts that representation to the target deployment domain, and then learns action-conditioned latent dynamics from controlled sleep/wake trajectories while keeping the encoder fixed. We evaluate RAN-JEPA using public operator performance data for pretraining and a real-equipment four-cell 5G testbed for domain adaptation, post-training, and control. Across four future 15-minute intervals, RAN-JEPA achieves lower action-conditioned prediction error than a GPT-2 world-model baseline and a mechanistic rule, while remaining close to a strong persistence reference. What-if evaluation further shows that the model produces distinct and coherent future trajectories under matched SLEEP and KEEP plans. In closed-loop control, RAN-JEPA consistently supports higher sleep ratios than the two baselines at comparable congestion cost. These results show that observation-first, action-conditioned learning can turn abundant passive telemetry and limited intervention data into a practical predictive model for energy-aware RAN control.

AI.tldr: RAN-JEPA 提出一种动作条件世界模型，将表征学习与干预学习解耦：先在观测数据上预训练潜在表征，再在固定编码器的前提下用少量受控实验数据学习动作条件动态，用于节能 RAN 控制。
AI.motivation: 运维移动网络中存在"观测-干预不对称"：被动遥测数据丰富，但受控的动作-响应轨迹稀少且采集成本高，这成为构建实用 RAN 控制世界模型的核心障碍。
AI.method: RAN-JEPA 采用两阶段解耦：先用纯观测网络数据学习预测性潜在表征，并将其适配到目标部署域；随后在编码器固定的条件下，利用受控的 sleep/wake 轨迹学习动作条件潜在动力学。预训练使用公共运营商性能数据，域适配、后训练与控制使用真实四小区 5G 试验台。
AI.result: 在未来四个 15 分钟区间上，RAN-JEPA 的动作条件预测误差低于 GPT-2 世界模型基线和机理规则方法，且接近强持续性参考。What-if 评估显示，在匹配的 SLEEP 与 KEEP 方案下模型能产生区分度高且连贯的未来轨迹。闭环控制中，在相近拥塞代价下 RAN-JEPA 持续支持更高的 sleep 比例。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，"观测优先、动作条件"的学习方式可将大量被动遥测与有限干预数据结合，构建出面向节能 RAN 控制的实用预测模型。

title: Efficient Fréchet Distributional Decoder Alignment for Latent Generative Models
summary: Fréchet Distributional (FD) objectives provide an effective distribution-level signal for post-training generative models. For latent generative models, however, existing FD-based post-training methods optimize only the latent generator while keeping the decoder frozen: the decoder is trained on reconstruction latents obtained from real images but deployed on generator-produced latents at generation time. When these latent distributions differ, this \textbf{decoder train-generation mismatch} means that the decoder is deployed on inputs drawn from a distribution it was not directly trained on. We introduce \textbf{Fréchet Distributional Decoder Alignment (FDDA)}, an efficient post-training method that freezes the latent generator and directly optimizes the decoder on generation-time latents using an FD objective. A single epoch of FDDA consistently improves gFID and gFDr$^6$ across diverse flow-based and autoregressive latent generative models. Across all 11 evaluated models, FDDA reduces gFDr$^6$ by 34.0-59.6\% from the original pretrained models and provides a further 10.2-57.2\% reduction after generator-side FD post-training. FDDA also reduces total wall-clock time by factors of $3.6\times$-$328.7\times$ relative to generator-side FD post-training across these models. These results show that generator-side post-training alone does not exhaust the benefits of FD optimization, and that further gains can be obtained by adapting the decoder at substantially lower cost.

AI.tldr: 提出FDDA方法，冻结潜生成器、直接用FD目标在生成时潜变量上优化解码器，以极低成本缓解"解码器训练-生成不匹配"问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Fréchet Distribution(FD)目标的潜生成模型后训练方法只优化潜生成器而保持解码器冻结；解码器在真实图像得到的重建潜变量上训练，却在生成时接收生成器产出的潜变量，两者分布不一致，形成"解码器训练-生成不匹配"，导致解码器被用于其未直接训练过的输入分布上。
AI.method: 提出Fréchet Distributional Decoder Alignment(FDDA)：一种高效后训练方法，冻结潜生成器，直接以FD目标在生成时潜变量上优化解码器，仅需一个epoch。
AI.result: 单epoch FDDA在多种基于flow和自回归的潜生成模型上稳定提升gFID与gFDr^6。在全部11个评估模型上，FDDA相对原始预训练模型将gFDr^6降低34.0-59.6%；在生成器侧FD后训练之后再额外降低10.2-57.2%；同时相对生成器侧FD后训练将总wall-clock时间减少3.6倍-328.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 仅做生成器侧后训练并未穷尽FD优化的收益，通过以显著更低的成本适配解码器可进一步获得增益，说明解码器侧对齐是提升FD后训练效果的重要且高效的补充方向。

title: Verifier-Harness Co-Evolution for Training-Free Self-Improvement on Open-Ended Tasks
summary: Training-free self-improvement lets an agent use feedback to revise the response it is about to return and to update the harness state that shapes how it handles later tasks. On open-ended tasks that feedback rarely comes from reference answers or executable tests, so the agent has to rely on a model-based verifier. When the verifier is wrong, the current response can get worse, and misleading experience can persist across the task stream. A verifier that never changes also grows stale as the agent's responses improve and task demands shift. We introduce Unified Co-Evolution (UCoE), a training-free method that evolves an executable verifier program together with the agent's harness state while all model parameters stay fixed. UCoE synthesizes candidate verifier programs and tests them on response contrasts, pairs of responses that differ in one declared property and have a known preferred side. It selects the candidate whose discrimination on its weakest contrast family is highest, a quantity we call driving capacity. The selected verifier diagnoses one weakness in each draft, guides a single repair, decides which response is served, and determines whether the accepted repair may enter the harness state. As tasks complete, their diagnostics seed new candidate verifiers, which must beat the current verifier on the same contrasts before adoption. Across six open-ended benchmarks, UCoE averages 59.00% preference against matched direct generation with Qwen3-8B and 57.19% with Qwen3.8-27B, margins of 9.00 and 7.19 percentage points. On three verifiable benchmarks, the same method raises the mean from 36.06% for direct generation to 38.48%. Code is available at https://github.com/tianyi0216/Unified-Co-Evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练统一协同演化方法 UCoE，在模型参数固定的前提下，让可执行验证器程序与智能体 harness 状态协同演化，通过“响应对比”合成并选择验证器，提升开放式任务表现。
AI.motivation: 免训练自改进依赖反馈修正回答并更新 harness 状态，但开放式任务缺少参考答案或可执行测试，只能依赖模型验证器。验证器一旦出错会恶化当前回答，并在任务流中持续传播误导性经验；同时固定不变的验证器会随智能体能力提升和任务需求变化而过时。
AI.method: UCoE 保持所有模型参数冻结，合成候选验证器程序，并在一组“响应对比”（仅在一个声明属性上不同的成对响应，且有已知偏好侧）上测试它们；以“驱动能力”为准则，选择在最弱对比族上判别力最高的候选。被选验证器诊断每个草稿的一处弱点，指导单次修复，决定最终提供的响应，并判定接受的修复能否进入 harness 状态。任务完成后其诊断结果用于生成新候选验证器，新验证器必须在相同对比上胜过当前验证器才被采纳。
AI.result: 在六个开放式基准上，UCoE 对 Qwen3-8B 平均获得 59.00% 偏好，对 Qwen3.8-27B 获得 57.19%，分别高出匹配的直出生成 9.00 和 7.19 个百分点；在三个可验证基准上，该方法将均值从直出生成的 36.06% 提升到 38.48%。
AI.conclusion: 免训练条件下，验证器程序与 harness 状态的协同演化可有效缓解验证器错误与过时问题，在开放式与可验证任务上稳定优于直接生成，且代码已开源。

title: Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Scene Reconstruction: Methods, Systems, and Trade-offs
comment: Accepted version to Els Pattern Recognition
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) allows for high-quality real-time novel-view synthesis. Since its inception in 2023, its explicit and highly configurable scene representation has been extended toward sparse-view generation, dynamic reconstruction, efficiency and compression, streaming, and simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). Although Gaussian Splatting can provide real-time rendering, rendering an existing representation is distinct from constructing, updating, or maintaining the scene itself. In this survey, we synthesize current literature, categorize them and provide a connection of current approaches and tools towards an end-to-end pipeline. Explicitly, we categorize GS scene reconstruction into five overlapping families: single-shot generation, dynamic representations, efficiency and compression, streaming and immersive systems, and Gaussian Splatting SLAM. We distinguish render-only throughput from task-specific scene generation, update, tracking, mapping, and optimization costs, and combine controlled sparse-view benchmarking with native evaluations to identify cross-family quality, latency, memory, and update-cost trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的综述，将现有文献归类为五大重叠方向，并串联为端到端流程。
AI.motivation: 3DGS自2023年提出后，其显式且高度可配置的场景表示被拓展至稀疏视图生成、动态重建、效率与压缩、流式传输及SLAM等方向。然而实时渲染已有表示与构建、更新、维护场景本身存在本质差异，亟需对现有工作进行系统梳理与关联。
AI.method: 将GS场景重建划分为五个相互重叠的类别：单次生成、动态表示、效率与压缩、流式与沉浸式系统、GS SLAM；区分纯渲染吞吐量与任务相关的场景生成、更新、跟踪、建图及优化开销；结合受控稀疏视图基准测试与原生评估进行对比。
AI.result: 通过跨类别比较，识别出在质量、延迟、内存与更新成本之间的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 该综述将当前方法与工具连接为端到端流程，为理解3DGS在渲染之外的场景构建与维护任务中的权衡提供了系统性框架。

title: OpenDepth: Repurposing Image Editing Priors for Robust Open-World Monocular Depth Estimation
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026. 18 pages, 9 figures, including supplementary material
summary: Recently, the integration of generative priors has revolutionized Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE), achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with remarkably high data efficiency. However, although methods based on Text-to-Image (T2I) models excel in general scenes, their efficacy degrades sharply when confronted with open-world environmental perturbations, such as illumination variations and adverse weather. Since T2I priors are optimized for semantic synthesis rather than preserving pixel-level structure, they struggle to decouple geometry from appearance under severe visual shifts, easily triggering structural hallucinations. Therefore, our core insight is to model open-world depth estimation as consistent geometric inference across multi-style images, fully leveraging the powerful structure-preserving editing priors of Image-to-Image (I2I) models. Based on this, we propose OpenDepth, a robust open-world MDE framework that introduces "Intra-Domain Awareness" -- the capability to map diverse stylistic inputs sharing identical geometry into a unified latent space. To achieve this, we first align shallow features within the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) to anchor degraded observations to unified geometric representations. Additionally, we introduce a joint RGB latent reconstruction task, requiring the model to recover clean RGB information from degraded inputs. This multi-stage strategy effectively decouples environmental style interference, compelling the model to focus strictly on underlying geometric recovery. Extensive evaluations show that OpenDepth sets new SOTA records for robust zero-shot depth estimation across standard and extreme weather benchmarks, demonstrating exceptional structural integrity and adaptability.

AI.tldr: 提出 OpenDepth 框架，利用 I2I 编辑先验与域内感知实现鲁棒的开放世界单目深度估计。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 T2I 生成先验的 MDE 方法虽数据效率高、在通用场景表现优异，但 T2I 先验面向语义合成优化而非像素级结构保持，在光照变化、恶劣天气等开放世界扰动下难以解耦几何与外观，易产生结构性幻觉。
AI.method: 核心思路是将开放世界深度估计建模为多风格图像间一致的几何推理，利用 I2I 模型的强结构保持编辑先验。具体：1) 在 DiT 浅层特征上做对齐，将退化观测锚定到统一几何表示；2) 引入联合 RGB 潜变量重建任务，要求模型从退化输入恢复干净 RGB；通过多阶段策略解耦环境风格干扰，聚焦底层几何恢复。
AI.result: 大量评估表明，OpenDepth 在标准与极端天气基准上均刷新了鲁棒零样本深度估计的 SOTA 记录，展现出色的结构完整性与适应性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将开放世界 MDE 重构为跨风格一致的几何推理，并借助 I2I 编辑先验与域内感知机制，可有效抑制结构幻觉，实现强鲁棒、高结构保真的零样本深度估计。

title: TwinPrune: Density-Aware Two-Phase Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models
comment: Our code is availabel at https://github.com/Kai-Liu001/TwinPrune
summary: We propose a unified spatial-density signal to score token importance for both inference phases: bipartite merge for prefill and KV eviction for decode, yielding measurable gains in each stage. To isolate the two phases, we split benchmarks by scoring logic. Prefill probes (MMBench, POPE, ScienceQA) evaluate only the first decoded token; their accuracy reflects prefill logits argmax before any decode KV eviction. Full-pipeline probes (TextVQA, DocVQA, MM-Vet) assess the complete generated sequence and capture both phases. We identify a critical evaluation pitfall: decode pruning claims validated solely on prefill probes measure prefill quality, not decode performance. Experiments show discarding all visual KV during decode barely affects prefill-probe accuracy but degrades TextVQA and MM-Vet drastically; this insensitivity stems from the scoring rule, not compression intensity.Evaluated on seven model variants (InternVL-3.5, Qwen3-VL, LLaVA-1.5) and three full-pipeline benchmarks, our method achieves a three-way Pareto frontier across compute, memory and accuracy. Density-based prefill compression maintains strong accuracy, scales linearly with visual token count, and delivers 100x faster token selection at high resolution. For decode, density top-k KV eviction consistently outperforms strong baselines H2O, SnapKV and StreamingLLM on TextVQA and MM-Vet across three retention ratios. At 0.125 keep ratio on TextVQA, it surpasses H2O by 9.6 points; InternVL-3.5 models (2B to 38B) maintain a 7 to 10 point advantage. Compression scales favorably with model size: every measured 8B to 38B model transition reduces accuracy loss instead of worsening it. We suggest MM-Vet or DocVQA as mandatory full-pipeline validation for any decode-phase claims. Our code is available at https://github.com/Kai-Liu001/TwinPrune

AI.tldr: 提出统一的"空间-密度"信号为预填充与解码两阶段打分token重要性，并揭示仅用预填充探针验证解码剪枝的评估陷阱。
AI.motivation: 现有解码阶段KV剪枝方法常仅用预填充探针（如MMBench、POPE、ScienceQA）验证，其准确率实际反映的是预填充logits的argmax质量，而非解码性能，导致评估结论失真；同时需要一种能同时服务于预填充压缩与解码KV驱逐的统一打分准则。
AI.method: 提出统一的空间-密度信号（spatial-density signal）为两阶段打分：预填充阶段采用bipartite merge（二分匹配合并），解码阶段采用基于密度的top-k KV eviction；按打分逻辑拆分基准，预填充探针只评估首个解码token，全流程探针（TextVQA、DocVQA、MM-Vet）评估完整生成序列；在InternVL-3.5、Qwen3-VL、LLaVA-1.5共七个模型变体上评测。
AI.result: 方法在计算、内存与准确率三方达到Pareto前沿；密度预填充压缩保持较强准确率、随视觉token数线性扩展、高分辨率下token选择快100倍；解码端密度top-k KV驱逐在TextVQA与MM-Vet上三个保留率下均优于H2O、SnapKV、StreamingLLM，TextVQA 0.125保留率下超H2O 9.6分，InternVL-3.5（2B至38B）保持7–10分优势；压缩随模型增大更有利，8B到38B每步过渡均降低而非增加准确率损失；丢弃全部视觉KV几乎不影响预填充探针准确率，但显著降低TextVQA与MM-Vet，证明该不敏感性源于打分规则而非压缩强度。
AI.conclusion: 建议将MM-Vet或DocVQA作为任何解码阶段主张的强制全流程验证基准；统一空间-密度信号可同时提升预填充与解码两阶段性能，代码已开源。

title: MAS-Gate: Unlocking Multi-Agent System Lifecycle via Node-Centric Quantification
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) can solve complex problems beyond the reach of a single agent by decomposing tasks and coordinating complementary capabilities. Despite extensive research on MAS, existing work largely focuses on specific aspects or individual phases of their development and operation, resulting in fragmented perspectives with objectives and signals that are difficult to reconcile across these different settings. To bridge these disconnected perspectives, we conceptualize MAS development and operation as a three-phase lifecycle spanning design-time orchestration before execution, runtime intervention during execution, and post-hoc attribution after execution, and introduce MAS-Gate, a unified node-centric quantification applicable across these phases. Modeling each execution as a directed acyclic graph, MAS-Gate combines within-node utility, which estimates a node's contribution through changes in reference-answer likelihood, with inter-node strength, which approximates semantic uptake and potential downstream reach. We adapt this shared quantification to three objectives: providing a structure-aware dense reward for Orchestrator training, training an Editor to act on execution prefixes using paired rewards from completed edited and unedited trajectories, and supplying risk-ranked nodes as auxiliary evidence for LLM-based post-hoc attribution. Experiments spanning interaction environments, knowledge-intensive multi-hop question answering, general reasoning, and post-hoc attribution demonstrate that MAS-Gate improves workflow construction, targeted runtime editing, and LLM-assisted error localization over corresponding phase-specific baselines. Together, these results establish MAS-Gate as a unified structural interface for improving MAS generation, dynamic editing, and error attribution throughout the lifecycle.

AI.tldr: 该论文将多智能体系统（MAS）的开发与运行建模为三阶段生命周期（设计时编排、运行时干预、事后归因），提出统一的节点级量化框架 MAS-Gate，并将其适配为密集奖励、编辑奖励与风险排序证据，从而在多个任务上改进工作流构建、运行时编辑与错误定位。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的 MAS 研究多聚焦于特定方面或单个阶段，视角碎片化，各阶段的目标与信号难以协调统一，缺乏一个跨阶段共享的结构化量化接口。
AI.method: 将 MAS 开发与运行统一为三阶段生命周期，并把每次执行建模为有向无环图。MAS-Gate 以节点为中心组合两种度量：节点内效用（通过参考答案似然变化估计节点贡献）与节点间强度（近似语义承接与潜在下游影响范围）。该共享量化被适配到三个目标：为 Orchestrator 训练提供结构感知的密集奖励；用已完成编辑与未编辑轨迹的配对奖励训练 Editor 作用于执行前缀；为基于 LLM 的事后归因提供风险排序节点作为辅助证据。
AI.result: 在交互环境、知识密集型多跳问答、通用推理与事后归因等实验中，MAS-Gate 在工作流构建、定向运行时编辑以及 LLM 辅助错误定位上均优于相应的阶段专用基线。
AI.conclusion: MAS-Gate 可作为贯穿生命周期的统一结构化接口，用于改进 MAS 的生成、动态编辑与错误归因。

title: CrossPortrait: Cross-Species Portrait Animation via Adversarial Motion Alignment
summary: Cross-species portrait animation, which aims to animate a source portrait of species A using a driving video of species B, is particularly challenging due to substantial anatomical differences in facial structures across species. Previous works typically fine-tune human portrait animation models on animal video datasets but often suffer from driving-species leakage. To address this, we propose CrossPortrait, a novel framework for expressive cross-species portrait animation, supporting diverse scenarios including human-to-animal, animal-to-human and cross-species animal-to-animal (e.g. cat-to-dog) animation. Specifically, we decompose the portrait motion into rigid head poses and expression keypoints. To accommodate species-specific facial structures while facilitating cross-species expression alignment, we introduce a species-routed expression encoder that incorporates species-specific LoRAs into a unified expression encoder. Furthermore, we introduce expression-level adversarial domain adaptation (Ex-ADA) to suppress driving-species-specific information in the expression latents, thereby mitigating species leakage and promoting a shared expression space across species. Extensive experiments show that our method enables expressive and identity-preserving portrait animation across diverse species and outperforms other state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出 CrossPortrait 框架，通过物种路由表情编码器与表情级对抗域适应，实现跨物种肖像动画，抑制驱动物种信息泄漏。
AI.motivation: 跨物种肖像动画需用物种B的驱动视频驱动物种A的肖像，但不同物种面部结构差异大；现有方法在动物视频上微调人类动画模型，常出现驱动物种信息泄漏（driving-species leakage），难以泛化到人-动物、动物-人及动物-动物等多样场景。
AI.method: 将肖像运动解耦为刚性头部姿态与表情关键点；设计物种路由表情编码器，在统一表情编码器中注入物种特定 LoRA，以兼顾物种特有面部结构并实现跨物种表情对齐；引入表情级对抗域适应（Ex-ADA），在表情潜变量中抑制驱动物种特有信息，缓解物种泄漏，构建跨物种共享表情空间。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法可在多种物种间生成富有表现力且保持身份的肖像动画，并优于其他最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: CrossPortrait 通过解耦运动、物种路由 LoRA 编码与表情级对抗域适应，有效缓解驱动物种泄漏，统一支持人-动物、动物-人、动物-动物等跨物种肖像动画场景。

title: Executable Prefix Values for Locating Agent Failures
summary: Work on debugging LLM agents treats the "first mistake" marked by a human or LLM judge as ground truth for where a trajectory failed. We ask whether such labels point at causes or symptoms, and make the distinction executable: we restart the agent from reconstructed intermediate states of a failed trajectory and estimate its prefix value V(h_t), the probability of success from each step, with a certified point of no return (PNR) for a failure. On 150 SWE-bench Verified tasks with two frozen open-weight agents, we build such curves for 47 and 60 failed trajectories and probe every step labeled by four frontier judges under the Traverse rubric. We find that the labels do not mark what a controller needs. Judges of different lineages agree on the exact step in only 21/57 cases, and the newest judges flag mistakes in 8/10 and 10/10 successful runs. For 66% of the labels, the agent's success probability does not drop at the labeled step; only 7/188 answers name the decisive step. Restarting at the measured restart point raises expected success from 0.44 to 0.57 offline, and real restarts confirm the advantage, whereas restarting at a judge's label does not (-0.08 to -0.03). We release our code, curves, and labels.

AI.tldr: 该研究质疑现有LLM智能体调试中"首个错误步"标签的可靠性，提出用前缀价值曲线与认证的不可逆点(PNR)来定位失败真因，并在SWE-bench Verified上验证：评判标签多为症状而非原因，按测量重启点重启可提升成功率，而按标签重启无效甚至有害。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体调试工作把人类或LLM评判者标记的"首个错误"当作轨迹失败位置的真实标注，但作者质疑这类标签究竟指向失败的因果原因还是仅仅指向表面症状，因此希望使这一区分可执行、可度量。
AI.method: 从失败轨迹重构中间状态并重启智能体，估计前缀价值V(h_t)即每一步的成功概率，并给出带认证的不可逆点(PNR)。在150个SWE-bench Verified任务、两个冻结的开源权重智能体上，为47条和60条失败轨迹构建价值曲线，并用四个前沿评判者在Traverse评分框架下探查每一步标注。
AI.result: 不同来源的评判者仅在21/57个案例中对具体错误步达成一致；最新评判者在8/10和10/10的成功轨迹中误标错误。66%的标签处智能体成功概率并未下降；188个答案中仅7个点出决定性步骤。在测量得到的重启点重启，离线期望成功率从0.44升至0.57，真实重启也证实该优势；而在评判标签处重启无效(-0.08至-0.03)。
AI.conclusion: 评判者标注的"首个错误"多为症状而非可操作的失败原因，无法满足控制器需求；基于前缀价值曲线测量的重启点才是有效干预位置。作者开源代码、曲线与标注。

title: FlashVSR+: Efficient Video Super-Resolution via Hybrid Attention and Reward-Yield Distribution Matching
summary: Recent video super-resolution (VSR) models achieve efficient one-step generation through diffusion distillation. However, high-resolution inference remains costly, and distilled models are difficult to align with human preferences. These challenges call for improvements in both model architecture and training strategy. We present \textbf{FlashVSR+} to address both limitations. On the architecture side, we introduce hybrid attention based on the strong locality observed in pretrained VSR models, while retaining sparse global interaction for long-range consistency. It achieves up to $2\times$ DiT speedup and 45\% lower peak memory, enabling spatially untiled 4K VSR on a single 24GB RTX 4090. On the training side, we propose Reward-Yield Distribution Matching Distillation (Ry-DMD) for preference-aligned one-step generation. Ry-DMD uses reward-weighted teacher rollouts to incorporate black-box rewards into distribution matching, without backpropagating through the reward model. We further show that Ry-DMD generalizes beyond VSR to T2I generation. Together, FlashVSR+ delivers stronger restoration quality and substantially improves high-resolution efficiency, with consistent gains in user preference. We release our code, models, and training data at \href{https://www.flashvsr.tech}{\textcolor{FlashBlue}{\textbf{www.flashvsr.tech}}}.

AI.tldr: FlashVSR+ 通过混合注意力架构与奖励产出分布匹配蒸馏（Ry-DMD）训练策略，同时解决高分辨率视频超分推理成本高与蒸馏模型难对齐人类偏好的问题。
AI.motivation: 近期基于扩散蒸馏的视频超分（VSR）模型虽能实现高效一步生成，但高分辨率推理依然昂贵，且蒸馏模型难以对齐人类偏好。这两大挑战需要在模型架构与训练策略两方面同时改进。
AI.method: 架构层面：基于预训练 VSR 模型中观察到的强局部性，提出混合注意力机制，在保留稀疏全局交互以维持长程一致性的同时降低计算开销。训练层面：提出 Reward-Yield Distribution Matching Distillation（Ry-DMD），利用奖励加权的教师 rollout 将黑盒奖励纳入分布匹配，无需通过奖励模型反向传播。
AI.result: 架构实现最高 2× DiT 加速与 45% 峰值显存降低，可在单张 24GB RTX 4090 上进行无分块的 4K VSR；Ry-DMD 实现偏好对齐的一步生成，并可推广至 T2I 生成。
AI.conclusion: FlashVSR+ 在还原质量与高分辨率效率上均有显著提升，并带来一致的用戶偏好增益；代码、模型与训练数据已开源。

title: Beyond Bias Scores: Answerability Confounds in Activation Steering with Gradient-Constrained Direction Design (GCD)
summary: Bias scores in language-model evaluations often conflate what a model prefers with whether it answers at all. We identify this confound in \textsc{BBQ}, whose ambiguous score factorizes into answerability and signed preference. Across 11 categories, 28,}824 items, and five models, contrastive steering lowers the signed ambiguous score in 11/11 categories but lowers the signed disambiguated preference score in only 8/11. Across 99 configurations, the answerability channel exceeds half of the observed score change in 17\% and accounts for the entire change in 11%. In a six-category disambiguated evaluation, 20.8\% of 1,500 items flip to the unknown option, where abstention is incorrect; \textsc{StereoSet} shows no analogous answer-rate shift. The effect reflects selection and near-orthogonality between the contrastive and preference-gradient directions. We introduce Gradient-Constrained Direction Design (\textsc{GCD}), an option-gradient construction with a first-order unknown-logit constraint. Under a matched Qwen-7B protocol, GCD reduces answer-rate distortion 14-fold and yields a 4-fold larger preference change, while ablations show similar gains for alternative and unconstrained option-gradient directions; nulling the unknown gradient alone is not responsible for the gain. We recommend reporting answerability alongside published scores.

AI.tldr: 本文识别出BBQ评测中"回答意愿(可答性)"与"偏好"两个因素被混淆的问题，并提出GCD方法来解耦二者。
AI.motivation: 语言模型评测中的偏见分数常把"模型偏好什么"与"模型是否作答"混为一谈。作者在BBQ中发现这一混淆：其模糊分数可分解为可答性与带符号偏好两部分，若不加以区分，会导致对模型偏见的误读。
AI.method: 作者在11个类别、28,824个条目、5个模型上使用对比式引导(contrastive steering)进行分析，将BBQ模糊分数分解为可答性与带符号偏好；并开展六类别去歧义评测及StereoSet对比实验，分析选择效应以及对比方向与偏好梯度方向的近正交性。进而提出梯度约束方向设计(GCD)——一种带一阶unknown-logit约束的选项梯度构造方法，并在匹配的Qwen-7B协议下进行消融。
AI.result: 对比式引导在11/11类别降低了带符号模糊分数，但仅在8/11类别降低了去歧义偏好分数。在99种配置中，可答性通道贡献超过观测分数变化一半的占17%，占全部变化的占11%。去歧义评测中，1,500个条目有20.8%翻转为unknown选项（此时弃答是错误的），而StereoSet未见类似回答率偏移。GCD将回答率失真降低14倍，并使偏好变化增大4倍；消融显示替代及无约束的选项梯度方向也能取得类似增益，单独将unknown梯度置零并非增益来源。
AI.conclusion: 偏见评测分数中混杂了可答性成分，会扭曲对偏好的解读。作者建议在报告分数时一并报告可答性指标，并指出GCD能有效解耦二者、提升评测可靠性。

title: Benchmarking Self-Supervised 3D Medical Vision Foundation Models and Transferability Estimation
summary: Self-supervised pretraining has expanded the pool of 3D medical foundation models, but published evaluations use different datasets, endpoints and fine-tuning protocols. Models also differ in architecture, pretraining objective and data, while downstream targets range from voxel-level masks to patient-level diagnoses and outcomes. As a result, published findings provide little directly comparable evidence for choosing a model for a new task. Direct comparison of adaptation performance requires fine-tuning candidates on labelled target data, at substantial computational cost. We benchmark 23 candidates across the same 14 segmentation, classification and regression tasks spanning multiple anatomies and modalities. No candidate ranked among the top three across all segmentation tasks or across all classification and regression tasks; a convolutional encoder could outperform a transformer trained with the same objective on one task but underperform it on another. We benchmark transferability estimators against the fine-tuned rankings and find that their agreement varies across dense segmentation, classification and regression. InsightRank uses task-appropriate frozen-feature statistics and architecture-aware pairwise comparisons to rank candidates before fine-tuning. Across the 23-model pool, mean Kendall tau-b was 0.431 for segmentation and 0.352 for classification and regression. The segmentation Top 3 contained a task winner on four of nine tasks; the image-level Top 3 contained none on the five tasks, despite better full-ranking agreement than the matched conventional estimators. A three-model shortlist reduced recorded extraction-plus-training job time by 85.8% across seven segmentation tasks. Together, the benchmark provides a common reference for model selection and InsightRank offers a lower-cost way to prioritize fine-tuning, with shortlist performance that differs by target type.

AI.tldr: 该研究在14个任务上统一基准测试23个3D医学基础模型，发现无模型能全面领先；并提出免微调的迁移性估计器InsightRank，用于低成本模型筛选。
AI.motivation: 已发表的3D医学基础模型评估使用不同数据集、终点与微调协议，模型在架构、预训练目标和数据上也各异，下游目标从体素级掩码到患者级诊断不等，导致结论缺乏直接可比性；而直接微调比较候选模型的计算成本很高。
AI.method: 在同一套覆盖多解剖部位与多模态的14个分割、分类与回归任务上对23个候选模型进行基准测试；以微调后的排名为参照，评估多种迁移性估计器；提出InsightRank，利用任务适配的冻结特征统计与架构感知的成对比较，在微调前对候选模型排序。
AI.result: 没有候选模型能在所有分割任务或所有分类回归任务中均进入前三；同一目标下卷积编码器在某些任务上优于Transformer、在另一些任务上则劣于Transformer。迁移性估计器与微调排名的吻合度在密集分割、分类和回归间存在差异。InsightRank在23个模型池上平均Kendall tau-b为分割0.431、分类回归0.352；分割Top 3在9个任务中的4个包含任务最优模型，图像级Top 3在5个任务中均未包含。三模型候选短名单使7个分割任务的"提取+训练"作业总时长减少85.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为模型选择提供了共同参照，InsightRank提供了更低成本的微调优先级排序方式，但其短名单性能因目标类型而异。

title: When Should Enterprise Policy Decisions Be Learned, and When Should They Be Reasoned?
summary:
An enterprise agent that answers under a written policy must choose an action before it says anything: answer, ask for a missing fact, ask for confirmation, call one or several tools, escalate, or refuse. Holding one 27B Korean enterprise model fixed, we vary whether the decision is a generated JSON object or a single constrained token, and whether the model may reason first.
  On 2800 in-distribution items we did not detect an accuracy difference between the two deployed paths (93.46% vs 94.14%), while they differ about tenfold in restart stability (3.00% of actions flip vs 0.29%); they also differ in reasoning, so this is an operational comparison.
  On a sealed benchmark of 300 items whose labels come from a hidden executable policy, reasoning is worth +17.3 points [+12.3, +23.0] on exact action. With reasoning off, the format difference was 0.0 points [-4.3, +4.0], a failure to detect an advantage for either interface, not equivalence; with reasoning on it is unresolved. Against a token-matched random control, boundary-targeted supervision moves the two covered boundaries by +17.5 and +20.0 points and leaves a held-out boundary unchanged. In a 3-seed training x reasoning factorial, the sealed-rendering interaction is -4.9 [-8.1, -1.7], consistent with partial substitution.
  All supervision was Korean. On independently rendered English versions, the model is 0.82 points lower [-2.68, +0.93] with reasoning on, the same order as re-rendering in Korean; the reasoning-off gain from targeted supervision is not stable in either language, so we do not claim transfer.
  The original text stays private as the confirmatory set. An open-model re-rendering made after these results reproduced the reasoning effect and the English verdict; the interaction kept its sign but did not replicate under item-clustered intervals. We release the model and that re-rendering with gold labels.

AI.tldr: 在固定的27B韩语企业模型上，比较"生成JSON对象"与"单一受限token"两种动作接口、以及是否允许先推理，对策略遵循型代理动作决策的影响；结果显示推理带来显著收益，接口格式差异在多数条件下无法检出，且结论的可迁移性有限。
AI.motivation: 企业代理需在书面政策约束下先决定动作（回答、追问缺失事实、请求确认、调用工具、升级或拒答）再生成输出。作者希望厘清两个工程选择——动作接口形式（JSON生成 vs 受限token）与是否允许先推理——对准确率、稳定性及泛化的实际影响，而非依赖直觉或单一指标下结论。
AI.method: 固定同一27B韩语企业模型，构成2×2因子：接口（生成JSON对象 vs 单一受限token）× 是否先推理。评估包括：2800条同分布项上的准确率与重启稳定性（动作翻转率）；300条封存基准，标签来自隐藏的可执行策略，报告精确动作上的区间估计；token匹配的随机对照，检验边界定向监督效果；3种子训练×推理因子实验考察交互；以及独立渲染的英文版本与开放模型再渲染的可复现性检验。
AI.result: 同分布2800项上两种部署路径准确率未检出差异（93.46% vs 94.14%），但重启稳定性相差约十倍（翻转率3.00% vs 0.29%）。封存300项上，推理使精确动作提升+17.3点[+12.3,+23.0]；关闭推理时格式差异为0.0点[-4.3,+4.0]（属未检出优势，非等价），开启推理时结论未定。相对token匹配随机对照，边界定向监督使两个覆盖边界分别提升+17.5与+20.0点，留出边界不变。3种子因子实验中封存渲染交互为-4.9[-8.1,-1.7]，符合部分替代。英文版本推理开启时低0.82点[-2.68,+0.93]，与韩语重渲染同量级；关闭推理时定向监督增益在两种语言均不稳定，故不主张迁移。开放模型再渲染复现了推理效应与英文结论，交互项符号一致但在项聚类区间下未复现。
AI.conclusion: 推理是动作决策准确率的主要驱动因素，而接口格式（JSON vs 受限token）的准确率优势在多数条件下无法检出；但格式选择显著影响重启稳定性。定向监督有效但限于被覆盖的边界，跨语言与跨渲染的迁移证据不足，作者据此不宣称迁移，并将模型与带金标的再渲染公开、保留原文为确证集。

title: Physical-Field-Bridged Material Parameter Inference from Multi-View Deformation Videos
summary: Estimating simulation-ready material parameters from visual observations is crucial for deformable-object manipulation but challenging because material properties are only indirectly revealed through physical responses. We introduce physical-field-bridged material inference, a single-pass framework that uses dense physical responses to connect multi-view RGB deformation videos with constitutive-type classification and continuous parameter regression. Unlike inverse-physics methods requiring per-scene reconstruction, online tuning, or simulation-in-the-loop optimization, our model predicts force/contact masks, projected motion-flow fields, and projected stress-response maps, then conditions material inference on these fields to reduce reliance on appearance or category shortcuts. We construct DeformFieldBench, a 3DGS MPM learning environment comprising 5,000 simulations across 100 object shapes and five mechanically informative loading modes, with dense pixel-aligned physical supervision. Our method achieves the best median errors on all four continuous parameters, improves stress-hotspot recall from 0.0762 to 0.5121, and attains 0.8676 SSIM/36.82 dB PSNR in same-simulator replay on unseen objects. Under a protocol-matched GSO evaluation, inference and future-state prediction take approximately 30 seconds, compared with 15-120 minutes for per-scene optimization. The method also yields measurable replay agreement on five real-world sequences. These results support dense physical fields as an effective bridge for fast material inference, while cross-simulator and real-world tests reveal remaining domain and identifiability gaps.

AI.tldr: 提出"物理场桥接"的单次前向材料推断框架，用稠密物理响应连接多视角RGB形变视频与本构类型分类及连续参数回归，并构建DeformFieldBench基准，实现快速且准确的材料参数估计。
AI.motivation: 从视觉观测估计可仿真的材料参数对可形变物体操作至关重要，但材料属性只能通过物理响应间接体现。传统逆物理方法需要逐场景重建、在线调优或仿真在环优化，依赖外观或类别捷径，速度慢、泛化差。
AI.method: 提出物理场桥接的材料推断框架：单次前向预测力/接触掩码、投影运动流场、投影应力响应图，并将材料推断条件化于这些稠密物理场，降低对表观或类别捷径的依赖。同时构建DeformFieldBench，基于3DGS与MPM，涵盖100个物体形状、5种力学负载模式、5000次仿真及像素对齐的稠密物理监督。
AI.result: 在全部四个连续参数上取得最优中位误差；应力热点召回率从0.0762提升至0.5121；同仿真器回放在未见过物体上达到0.8676 SSIM / 36.82 dB PSNR；匹配协议的GSO评估中推断与未来状态预测约需30秒，而逐场景优化需15-120分钟；在5段真实序列上取得可测量的回放一致性。
AI.conclusion: 稠密物理场可作为快速材料推断的有效桥梁，但跨仿真器与真实世界测试仍存在域差距与可辨识性缺口。

title: Can Agents Truly Forget? Explore Machine Unlearning for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown strong capabilities in interactive problem solving, tool use, and long-horizon task execution. However, they may also acquire sensitive or private knowledge during training and expose it during deployment. Retraining a model from scratch to remove such knowledge is prohibitively costly, making machine unlearning a more practical approach. Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted undesirable knowledge from trained models without retraining from scratch while preserving general utility. When language models are deployed as agents, parameter-level unlearning becomes insufficient: forgotten information may still persist in memory artifacts or be reacquired via tool calls. In this paper, we formulate the problem of agent unlearning as removing private information from an LLM-based agent across three information channels: parametric knowledge, persistent memory, and tool-call acquisition. To study this problem, we introduce we introduce Agent Unlearning Benchmark (AUBench), a controlled benchmark that extends the fictitious-author setting of TOFU into an agent environment with persistent memory, an offline web snapshot, tool-accessible documents, and provenance-tracked interaction trajectories. By evaluating existing parameter-level and memory-level unlearning methods in this setting, AUBench reveals the gap between model-level forgetting and system-level agent unlearning, and provides a foundation for developing unlearning methods that operate across the full lifecycle of LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"智能体遗忘"问题，将私有信息移除扩展到参数知识、持久记忆与工具调用获取三条通道，并发布受控基准AUBench以评估现有方法。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在交互式问题求解、工具使用与长周期任务中表现强大，但训练中可能获取敏感或私有知识并在部署时泄露。从头重训以移除这类知识成本过高，因此机器遗忘是更可行途径。然而当模型作为智能体部署时，仅做参数级遗忘不够：被遗忘信息可能仍存于记忆工件中，或通过工具调用被重新获取。
AI.method: 将智能体遗忘形式化为跨三条信息通道移除私有信息：参数化知识、持久记忆、工具调用获取。构建Agent Unlearning Benchmark（AUBench），将TOFU的虚构作者设定扩展到智能体环境，包含持久记忆、离线网页快照、工具可访问文档以及可溯源交互轨迹。在该设定下评估现有参数级与记忆级遗忘方法。
AI.result: AUBench揭示了模型级遗忘与系统级智能体遗忘之间的差距，表明现有参数级/记忆级方法无法覆盖全部信息通道。
AI.conclusion: 参数级遗忘对智能体部署不足，需要跨智能体全生命周期的遗忘方法；AUBench为这类方法的研究提供了基础与评估平台。

title: Tanawpamana: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Philippine Cultural Heritage Sites
summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used to identify and describe places, yet their recognition and knowledge of specific cultures remain poorly understood, particularly in underrepresented regions such as the Philippines. This study introduces the Tanawpamana Dataset, a repository of Philippine heritage site images with metadata based on the Talapamana registry of the National Commission for Culture and the Arts of the Philippines. We also introduce the Tanawpamana Benchmark, comprising 4,046 tasks designed to evaluate models' recognition and knowledge of heritage sites. Evaluating seven vision-language models, we find that they struggle more with fine-grained visual discrimination among similar heritage sites than with coarse recognition, and that their geographic knowledge is weaker when inferred from image inputs than from text.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了面向菲律宾文化遗产的Tanawpamana数据集与基准（4,046项任务），评估7个视觉语言模型后发现：模型在细粒度视觉区分上比粗粒度识别更困难，且从图像推断的地理知识弱于文本。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型日益用于识别与描述地点，但对特定文化（尤其菲律宾等代表性不足地区）的识别与知识仍缺乏理解。
AI.method: 以菲律宾国家文化艺术委员会Talapamana遗产名录为基础，构建含遗产地图像与元数据的Tanawpamana数据集，并设计包含4,046项任务的Tanawpamana基准，评估7个视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 模型在相似遗产地之间的细粒度视觉判别上的表现弱于粗粒度识别；从图像输入推断地理知识的表现弱于从文本输入。
AI.conclusion: 现有视觉语言模型对菲律宾等欠代表地区文化遗产的识别与知识仍存在明显不足，尤其在细粒度区分与图像地理推断方面。

title: RoTA-Bench: Evaluating 3D Spatial Reasoning through Interactive Projection Alignment
