summary: Can vision-language models turn 2D observations into 3D understanding that supports precise action? This requires inferring object geometry, anticipating the effects of rotation, and refining actions through visual feedback. We introduce RoTA-Bench to evaluate these abilities through interactive 3D-to-2D projection alignment. Given a target silhouette, a model observes a rotated object and chooses successive rotations to recover the target projection within a limited action budget. Our automated pipeline constructs silhouette-preserving 3D objects from 2D icons and uses reversible initialization to guarantee solvability, yielding 674 tasks and a stratified 100-task test set. Empirically, we find that (i) a substantial human-model gap persists: GPT-5.6-Sol succeeds on only 17% of tasks, whereas 20 undergraduate participants collectively complete the test set four times with a 100% success rate; (ii) image-space and pose-space progress can diverge: at matched states, the model more often improves silhouette overlap while worsening pose alignment than humans (19.4% vs. 10.9%); and (iii) fine-grained control is sensitive to interaction history: removing it leaves 96.8% of the model's actions at a coarse 30-degree step size and sharply reduces observed task success. These findings highlight the challenge of converting visual evidence into precise 3D control, beyond recognizing or matching individual images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoTA-Bench，通过交互式 3D 到 2D 投影对齐任务评估视觉-语言模型将 2D 观测转化为精确 3D 控制的能力，发现其与人类仍存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 精确的 3D 操作需要模型推断物体几何、预测旋转效果并利用视觉反馈修正动作，而现有评测多停留在识别或图像匹配层面，缺乏对"从视觉证据到精确 3D 控制"这一能力的系统考察。
AI.method: 构建 RoTA-Bench：给定目标轮廓，模型观察一个已旋转物体，在有限动作预算内通过逐步旋转恢复目标投影。采用自动化流水线从 2D 图标构建保轮廓的 3D 物体，并使用可逆初始化保证可解性，共生成 674 个任务及分层抽样的 100 任务测试集。
AI.result: (i) 人机差距显著：GPT-5.6-Sol 仅完成 17% 任务，而 20 名本科生累计 4 次全部完成任务（100% 成功率）；(ii) 图像空间与位姿空间进展可能背离：相同状态下，模型改善轮廓重叠但恶化位姿对齐的比例高于人类（19.4% vs. 10.9%）；(iii) 细粒度控制对交互历史敏感：移除后模型 96.8% 的动作停留在 30 度粗粒度步长，任务成功率明显下降。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉证据转化为精确 3D 控制对现有模型仍是重大挑战，其难度超越识别或匹配单张图像，需要几何推断、旋转效果预测与反馈式精细控制的综合能力。

title: Morphology-aware deep learning predicts colorectal cancer survival from whole-slide images
comment: Supplementary material included: one figure and two tables
summary:
Background: Five-year survival prediction from hematoxylin-and-eosin whole-slide images could support risk stratification, but the task is weakly supervised, and the tissue morphologies carrying prognostic information remain incompletely characterized.
  Methods: We conducted a retrospective secondary analysis using TCGA-COAD/READ (n=562) for morphology-specific analysis, Alliance/ CALGB 89803 (n=424) for model development, and SurGen (n=218) for external evaluation. We propose MorphContrast, a morphology-aware contrastive multiple-instance learning framework that uses tissue labels as structural supervision for five-year survival prediction. MorphContrast combines gated-attention pooling with three auxiliary objectives: patch-level morphology labels define within-patient contrasts, outcome concordance or discordance defines cross-patient contrasts within matched morphologies, and diversity regularization discourages representational collapse. Morphology-matched patches from patients with discordant outcomes serve as hard negatives, encouraging prognostic discrimination within comparable histologic contexts.
  Results: Morphology-specific models show weak but distributed prognostic discrimination: adipose tissue achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.622, stroma achieves 0.604, and both perform comparably to tumor epithelium (0.601-0.605). On Alliance/CALGB 89803, the single model achieves an AUC of 0.642, while the post hoc ensemble reaches a pooled out-of-fold AUC of 0.70 and a risk-group hazard ratio of 3.79 (95% confidence interval: 2.55-5.63). On the external SurGen colon cancer cohort (n=218), the single model and ensemble achieve AUCs of 0.669 and 0.678, respectively.
  Conclusions: These findings support tissue morphology as structural supervision for outcome-aware representation learning in colorectal cancer prognosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MorphContrast，一种形态学感知的对比式多实例学习框架，利用组织形态标签作为结构监督，从H&E全切片图像预测结直肠癌五年生存，并在多个队列上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 从H&E全切片图像预测五年生存有助于风险分层，但该任务属于弱监督学习，且承载预后信息的组织形态尚未被充分刻画。
AI.method: 采用回顾性二次分析：TCGA-COAD/READ（n=562）用于形态学特异性分析，Alliance/CALGB 89803（n=424）用于模型开发，SurGen（n=218）用于外部评估。MorphContrast结合门控注意力池化与三个辅助目标：以patch级形态标签构建患者内对比；在匹配形态下以结局一致/不一致构建患者间对比；用多样性正则化抑制表征坍缩。来自结局不一致患者的形态匹配patch作为难负样本，促使模型在可比组织学情境中区分预后。
AI.result: 形态学特异性模型表现出较弱但分布式的预后判别能力：脂肪组织AUC为0.622，间质为0.604，与肿瘤上皮（0.601-0.605）相当。在Alliance/CALGB 89803上，单模型AUC为0.642，事后集成达到合并的out-of-fold AUC 0.70，风险组风险比为3.79（95%CI：2.55-5.63）。在外部SurGen结肠癌队列（n=218）上，单模型与集成的AUC分别为0.669与0.678。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持将组织形态作为结构监督，用于结直肠癌预后中的结局感知表征学习。

title: Cowork-Gym: Synthesizing Interactive Work Environments at Scale
summary: Cowork agents navigate dependencies across tools and files while adapting to changing user requirements and edits to shared workspaces. Scaling such environments requires maintaining consistency among task objectives, executable resources, user behavior, and success criteria. We introduce Cowork-Gym, a framework that synthesizes Cowork environments through a build-execute-revise loop that uses execution evidence and review feedback to validate and repair generated environments. To capture realistic Cowork dynamics, a stateful user simulator responds to the agent's actions through dialogue and direct edits to the shared workspace. We synthesize 64.9K environments across 14 application scenarios and use them to post-train 9B, 27B, and 35B-A3B Qwen models with supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation. Averaged across six agentic benchmarks, these models outperform their corresponding base checkpoints by 8.7, 6.4, and 4.1 points, respectively. Ours-27B ranks second overall among the evaluated models and achieves the highest average scores on PawBench and ClawEval, outperforming models with over 100B total parameters on both benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Cowork-Gym 框架，通过 build-execute-revise 循环合成 Cowork 环境，并合成 64.9K 环境用于后训练 Qwen 模型，在六个智能体基准上平均提升 4.1–8.7 分。
AI.motivation: Cowork 智能体需在工具与文件间处理依赖关系，并适应变化的用户需求和共享工作区编辑。规模化此类环境需保持任务目标、可执行资源、用户行为与成功标准之间的一致性，而现有环境难以满足这一需求。
AI.method: 提出 Cowork-Gym：利用 build-execute-revise 循环，借助执行证据与评审反馈来验证和修复所生成的环境；并引入有状态用户模拟器，通过对话与对共享工作区的直接编辑来响应智能体动作。基于此合成 64.9K 个环境，覆盖 14 类应用场景，用于对 9B、27B、35B-A3B Qwen 模型进行监督微调、强化学习与同策略蒸馏后训练。
AI.result: 在六个智能体基准上平均，后训练模型较对应基座检查点分别提升 8.7、6.4、4.1 分。Ours-27B 在全部评估模型中位列第二，并在 PawBench 与 ClawEval 上取得最高平均分，均超过参数量逾 100B 的模型。
AI.conclusion: Cowork-Gym 能以可扩展方式合成高一致性 Cowork 环境，有效支撑后训练，使中小规模模型在多项智能体基准上达到甚至超越更大模型的水平。

title: PLEDGE: Progressive Lossy Error-Bounded Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) codecs report reconstruction quality after compression, and give users little control over the distortion of individual primitives. We present PLEDGE, a training-free, progressive, error-bounded codec that translates four user-declared tolerances into per-primitive quantization bounds: screen-space position, footprint deformation due to rotation and scale, view-dependent color, and opacity. The bounds apply throughout a declared camera domain, including previously unseen viewpoints. Position and opacity are bounded directly; footprint deformation is bounded under the rasterizer's affine projection model, and color is bounded over all viewing directions. PLEDGE organizes quantized residuals into a progressive bitstream with explicit error bounds for every valid prefix. Experiments across thirteen scenes verify all declared per-mechanism bounds and demonstrate competitive rate-distortion performance. The four tolerances incur substantially different rate costs, so users can spend rate where their application needs it.

AI.tldr: PLEDGE 是一种无需训练、渐进式且带误差上界的 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）编解码器，将用户声明的四种容差转化为逐基元的量化边界，并在声明的相机域内（包括未见视角）保证误差上界，同时提供渐进码流和竞品级率失真性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 3DGS 编解码器仅报告压缩后的整体重建质量，用户对单个基元的失真几乎无法控制，缺乏可解释、可约束的误差管理能力。因此需要一个能让用户按需指定各类误差容限、并在整个相机域内（含未见视角）严格保证上界的编解码方案。
AI.method: PLEDGE 无需训练，将四类用户声明的容差映射为逐基元量化边界：屏幕空间位置、由旋转与缩放引起的足迹变形、视角相关颜色、以及不透明度。位置与不透明度直接约束；足迹变形在光栅器的仿射投影模型下约束；颜色在所有观察方向上约束，且边界在声明的相机域内全程有效（含未见视角）。量化残差被组织为带显式误差上界的渐进码流，使每个合法前缀都能保证误差界。
AI.result: 在十三个场景上的实验验证了所有声明的逐机制误差上界，并展现出有竞争力的率失真性能。四种容差带来的码率开销差异显著，用户可据此在应用最需要的维度上分配码率。
AI.conclusion: PLEDGE 通过将用户容差转化为可验证的逐基元量化边界并组织为渐进码流，实现了可控、可保证的 3DGS 压缩，兼顾误差约束与率失真性能，并提供按需分配码率的灵活性。

title: Encounter-Driven City-Scale Human Mobility Generation with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for human mobility generation by modeling individual routines, activities, and mobility preferences. However, existing approaches remain largely resident-centric: generating realistic individual trajectories does not necessarily recover the encounters that emerge when multiple residents co-occur at the same place and time. To this end, we study encounter-aware human mobility generation, which jointly preserves individual mobility and population-level interaction structure. We propose EncounterMob, an encounter-driven LLM framework consisting of a coarse-to-fine Encounter Generator and an Iterative Coupling Framework. The Encounter Generator first captures city-level encounter rhythms and then instantiates participant-time-venue encounters, while the Iterative Coupling Framework coordinates these encounters with personal mobility behavior through successive refinement. We further introduce an encounter recovery protocol covering encounter marginal and joint distributions over residents, times, and venues. Experiments on the Japan and NYC datasets show that EncounterMob outperforms all external baselines on all seven encounter metrics and all six personal mobility metrics. Compared with ELLMob, it reduces the participant-time-venue joint error by 40.4%/41.7% and the mean personal mobility error by 58.8%/32.7% on Japan/NYC, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出EncounterMob，一个以相遇（encounter）为驱动的LLM框架，在生成个体移动轨迹的同时保留人群层面的交互结构。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的人类移动生成方法大多以居民个体为中心，生成逼真的个体轨迹并不必然恢复多居民在同一时空共同出现所产生的相遇结构，即缺乏对人口级交互结构的刻画。
AI.method: 提出EncounterMob框架，包含：粗到细的Encounter Generator（先捕捉城市级相遇节律，再实例化“参与者-时间-地点”相遇）与Iterative Coupling Framework（通过迭代细化协调相遇与个人移动行为）；并设计覆盖居民、时间、地点上的相遇边际与联合分布的相遇恢复协议。
AI.result: 在日本和NYC数据集上，EncounterMob在全部7项相遇指标与全部6项个人移动指标上均超过所有外部基线；相较ELLMob，参与者-时间-地点联合误差在Japan/NYC分别降低40.4%/41.7%，平均个人移动误差降低58.8%/32.7%。
AI.conclusion: 以相遇为驱动、并与个人移动迭代耦合的LLM生成范式能同时提升个体移动质量与群体交互结构还原度，验证了encounter-aware移动生成的有效性。

title: Smartphone-Based, Field-Deployed AI Inspection System for Power Distribution Infrastructure
summary: Routine inspection of power distribution infrastructure remains challenging for utilities operating geographically dispersed networks, where conventional manual inspection can be difficult to perform consistently and at scale. This work presents a smartphone-based AI inspection system for assessing targeted distribution-infrastructure conditions from images captured by field personnel. The proposed workflow integrates image-quality and viewing-perspective validation with AI-assisted assessment of pole lean, crossarm and top-cleat tilt, voltage level, vegetation-clearance risk, and distribution-transformer (DTR)-ground clearance. The system integrates deep-learning models with monocular depth estimation, geometric analysis, and rule-based processing within a common multi-stage inspection workflow designed for practical field operation. The system was pilot deployed across five selected distribution feeders within the Eastern Power Distribution Company of Andhra Pradesh Ltd. (APEPDCL), where 1,222 defect instances were identified across the assessed categories and subsequently tracked through a rectification and verification workflow, with 84 defect instances recorded as rectified during the study period. Feeder-level interruption records were also examined over the study period; however, the available observations do not provide sufficient evidence to establish a reliability improvement attributable to the proposed system. A curated multi-module field-captured dataset, PD-Defect, is also publicly released to support reproducible research in distribution-infrastructure inspection. The field deployment demonstrates the practical integration of smartphone-based AI-assisted inspection into field inspection and maintenance activities, providing a mechanism for systematic identification, documentation, rectification tracking, and verification of targeted distribution-infrastructure defects.

AI.tldr: 提出基于智能手机的配电设施AI巡检系统，融合深度学习、单目深度估计、几何分析与规则处理，在APEPDCL五条馈线上试点识别1,222个缺陷实例，其中84个完成整改，并公开PD-Defect数据集。
AI.motivation: 配电网络地理分散，传统人工巡检难以一致、规模化执行，需要可落地的智能化巡检手段以支撑缺陷识别、记录、整改跟踪与复核。
AI.method: 构建智能手机端AI巡检流程：先进行图像质量与拍摄视角校验，再对电杆倾斜、横担与顶扣倾斜、电压等级、植被净空风险、配变对地距离等进行AI评估；技术层面集成深度学习模型、单目深度估计、几何分析与规则处理，形成多阶段巡检工作流。
AI.result: 在印度APEPDCL五个选定配电馈线试点部署，识别1,222个目标类别缺陷实例，其中84个在研究期内完成整改；馈线级中断记录未提供足以证明可靠性提升的证据；同时公开发布现场采集的多模块数据集PD-Defect。
AI.conclusion: 现场部署验证了智能手机AI辅助巡检可嵌入实际巡检与运维流程，形成缺陷系统化识别、记录、整改跟踪与复核机制；但系统对供电可靠性的改善尚缺乏充分证据。

title: Stable Token-level Scheduling for Serverless LLM Inference
summary: Serverless inference is emerging as an efficient deployment model for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to its ability to elastically scale resources, improve GPU utilization through resource sharing, and reduce infrastructure costs. However, existing approaches primarily optimize time to first token (TTFT) while overlooking inter-token latency (ITL), a key determinant of user experience during response generation. We observe that LLM inference comprises a computation-intensive prefill stage and a bandwidth-bound decode stage, where admitting new requests can disrupt ongoing decoding and increase latency. To address this, we propose Token Window Pacing (TWP), a closed-loop scheduling framework that leverages runtime feedback from ITL, queue depth, and workload characteristics to regulate request admission at the token level instead of the batch level. TWP dynamically adjusts a selfregulating token window and incorporates chunk-based prefill to minimize interference from incoming requests. Experiments on realistic serverless workloads show that TWP delivers stable TTFT, significantly reduces latency spikes, lowers P99 tail latency, minimizes ITL variation, and improves throughput by up to 45% over ServerlessLLM and 58% over conventional schedulers. These results demonstrate that feedback-driven tokenlevel scheduling enables stable, high-throughput serverless LLM inference without modifying the underlying model.

AI.tldr: 提出Token Window Pacing（TWP）闭环调度框架，基于ITL、队列深度和负载特征的运行时反馈，在token级别（而非批级别）调节请求准入，并通过分块预填充减少干扰；实验表明其在稳定TTFT、降低P99尾延迟和ITL波动的同时，吞吐量较ServerlessLLM提升最高45%，较传统调度器提升58%。
AI.motivation: 无服务器推理因弹性伸缩、资源复用提升GPU利用率、降低基础设施成本，已成为LLM的高效部署模式。但现有方案主要优化首token时延（TTFT），忽视了对响应生成阶段用户体验起决定作用的token间时延（ITL）。作者观察到LLM推理由计算密集的预填充阶段与带宽受限的解码阶段构成，新请求的准入会打断正在进行的解码并抬高延迟，因此需在调度层面解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出Token Window Pacing（TWP）：一个闭环调度框架。它利用来自ITL、队列深度与工作负载特征的运行时反馈，把请求准入的调节粒度从批级别细化到token级别；动态调整一个自调节的token窗口，并引入基于分块（chunk-based）的预填充以最小化新到请求带来的干扰。该方法无需修改底层模型。
AI.result: 在真实无服务器负载上，TWP实现了稳定的TTFT，显著减少延迟尖峰，降低P99尾延迟，减小ITL波动；吞吐量相较ServerlessLLM提升最高45%，相较传统调度器提升58%。
AI.conclusion: 反馈驱动的token级调度能够在不修改底层模型的前提下，实现稳定且高吞吐的无服务器LLM推理，说明将调度粒度下沉到token级别并纳入ITL等运行时反馈是提升生成阶段服务质量的有效途径。

title: 4LC: 4D Latent Cache for Efficient Conditioning in Dynamic World Modeling
summary: For video generation in dynamic world modeling, observed static and dynamic content should be efficiently reused to provide conditions for repeated generation at different times and viewpoints. We introduce 4LC, a 4D latent cache with composite visual representations and a flexible spatiotemporal access interface. As a latent cache, 4LC directly reuses visual representations of static and dynamic content to provide generation conditions, avoiding per-request RGB rendering and re-encoding. As a composite cache, 4LC binds visual representations from multiple visual encoders (e.g., VAE, DINO, V-JEPA, VGGT) to shared geometry and motion, allowing the composite representations to describe the dynamic world with rich information. Besides, we design a flexible spatiotemporal interface, which directly reads the cache at independently specified times and viewpoints and combines readouts across observations, providing a common conditioning format for diverse downstream tasks. Building on 4LC, we develop 4LC-Video to address multiple video generation tasks through different configurations of source observations, spatiotemporal requests, and historical reuse, including camera control, temporal control, novel-view synthesis, scene revisits, and long-term generation. Our experiments show more efficient condition acquisition, effective spatiotemporal controllability, and scene consistency across tasks using a single 4LC-Video model without task-specific fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出4LC，一种带有复合视觉表示和灵活时空访问接口的4D潜在缓存，并基于此构建4LC-Video，用单一模型统一支持相机控制、时序控制、新视角合成、场景重访与长期生成等多种视频生成任务。
AI.motivation: 在动态世界建模的视频生成中，观测到的静态与动态内容应被高效复用以支撑不同时间与视角下的重复生成。但传统方法通常需要逐次进行RGB渲染与重新编码，效率低且信息受限，缺乏统一的条件获取与访问机制。
AI.method: 提出4LC（4D latent cache）：1）作为潜在缓存，直接复用静态与动态内容的视觉表示作为生成条件，避免逐请求的RGB渲染与再编码；2）作为复合缓存，将多个视觉编码器（如VAE、DINO、V-JEPA、VGGT）的视觉表示绑定到共享的几何与运动上，形成信息丰富的复合表示；3）设计灵活的时空访问接口，可在独立指定的时间与视角直接读取缓存，并跨观测组合读出，为多样下游任务提供统一的条件格式。在其上构建4LC-Video。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于单个4LC-Video模型、无需任务特定微调，即可在相机控制、时序控制、新视角合成、场景重访和长期生成等任务上实现更高效的条件获取、有效的时空可控性以及跨任务的场景一致性。
AI.conclusion: 4LC通过复合潜在缓存与统一时空接口，实现了高效复用与统一条件注入，使单一视频生成模型能够泛化到多种时空控制与生成任务，验证了缓存式4D表示在世界建模中的有效性与通用性。

title: Training LLMs for Multi-Agent Collaboration with Verifiable Information Rewards
summary: Effective collaboration among large language model (LLM) agents in multi-agent systems requires sharing relevant evidence, requesting missing information, and incorporating teammates' contributions into decisions. Training these behaviors is challenging because final task outcomes provide limited feedback on the value of individual messages. We introduce CoSIR (Collaboration via Surprisal-based Information Rewards), a post-training approach that uses a simple, verifiable environment to teach collaboration behaviors that generalize to more complex, unseen tasks. We propose a Bayesian evaluator that scores shared information by its reduction in team surprisal, defined as the sum of the negative log probabilities assigned to the correct option given each agent's available evidence. Requests are scored by the potential reduction in the same quantity if the requested information were truthfully provided. Separate rewards encourage agents to use the received information in their private choices and calculations. We post-train Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-3-4B-it through self-play and evaluate transfer to seven unseen natural-language collaboration tasks. CoSIR achieves the highest aggregate score, while its performance in general tasks remains competitive. Behavioral analyses show increased disclosure of private evidence and fewer judged failures to use teammates' input.

AI.tldr: 提出CoSIR后训练方法，用基于surprisal的信息奖励在简单可验证环境中训练LLM智能体的协作行为，可迁移至未见复杂任务。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中，LLM智能体需共享证据、请求缺失信息并整合队友贡献，但最终任务结果对单条消息价值的反馈有限，难以直接训练这些协作行为。
AI.method: 设计可验证的简单环境；提出贝叶斯评估器，以团队surprisal（各智能体在已有证据下对正确选项所赋负对数概率之和）的降低量来为共享信息打分；请求则以若如实提供后该量的潜在降低量计分；另设独立奖励鼓励智能体在私有决策与计算中使用所获信息；通过自博弈对Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和Gemma-3-4B-it进行后训练，并评估向七个未见自然语言协作任务的迁移。
AI.result: CoSIR在七个未见任务上取得最高总聚合分数，同时在通用任务上保持竞争力；行为分析显示私有证据披露增加，且被判定的未能使用队友输入失败减少。
AI.conclusion: 以surprisal降低为可验证信号的信息奖励可有效训练可迁移的协作行为，优于仅依赖最终任务结果的反馈方式。

title: MedEvo: Medical Reasoning Evolution through Knowledge Navigation
summary: Medical multimodal reasoning models are typically trained on teacher-generated rationales, discarding the valid reasoning in students' own failed trajectories, while general-domain correction methods offer little guidance for errors in image reading, anatomical context, or differential diagnosis. We propose MedEvo, which uses medical knowledge, namely a tag taxonomy and error-type diagnosis, to navigate both trajectory repair and data selection. For each failed rollout, a gold-blind auditor locates the first consequential error and provides a minimal, answer-free hint; the same student retains the valid prefix and regenerates the erroneous suffix. After each round, MedEvo identifies capability gaps across medical tags on a held-out feedback set and prioritizes related questions for new rollouts and repairs. With supervised fine-tuning (SFT) alone, MedEvo raises Qwen3.5-9B mean accuracy across seven benchmarks from 65.57% to 69.12% (47.40% to 54.50% on the multimodal track of MedXpertQA (MedXpertQA-MM)), surpassing teacher-distillation SFT (66.93%). It also raises Qwen3.5-35B and Qwen3.5-397B mean accuracy from 67.91% to 73.04% and from 71.83% to 74.95%, respectively. Our analyses show that failed trajectories contain reasoning worth preserving, that repair success does not imply learning value, and that independent feedback is key to sustained improvement.

AI.tldr: MedEvo利用医学知识（标签分类体系与错误类型诊断）指导失败轨迹修复与数据选择：由金标盲审计者定位首个关键错误并给出无答案提示，学生保留有效前缀并重生成错误后缀，再按医学标签识别能力缺口以优先采样，仅用SFT即显著提升多个模型在七项基准上的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态医学推理模型通常基于教师生成的推理链训练，丢弃了学生自身失败轨迹中仍具价值的有效推理；而通用领域的纠错方法难以针对图像阅读、解剖语境与鉴别诊断等医学特有错误提供指导。因此需要一个能利用医学知识进行轨迹修复与数据选择的框架。
AI.method: MedEvo以医学知识（标签分类体系与错误类型诊断）为导航：对每条失败轨迹，使用金标盲（gold-blind）审计者定位首个关键性错误，并给出最小化、不含答案的提示；同一学生模型保留有效前缀并重新生成出错后缀。每轮结束后，在留出的反馈集上按医学标签识别能力缺口，并优先选取相关问题进行新的采样与修复。
AI.result: 仅使用监督微调（SFT），MedEvo将Qwen3.5-9B在七个基准上的平均准确率从65.57%提升至69.12%，在MedXpertQA多模态赛道（MedXpertQA-MM）上从47.40%提升至54.50%，超过教师蒸馏SFT的66.93%；并将Qwen3.5-35B与Qwen3.5-397B的平均准确率分别从67.91%提升至73.04%、从71.83%提升至74.95%。
AI.conclusion: 分析表明：失败轨迹中包含值得保留的推理；修复成功并不等同于具有学习价值；独立反馈是实现持续改进的关键。

title: FrameLite: Decision-Oriented Aesthetic Cropping with a Compact Vision-Language Model
summary: Aesthetic image cropping improves composition by balancing subjects, context, and image boundaries. Large vision-language models bring semantic knowledge to this task, but their scale limits lightweight photography assistance. We propose FrameLite, a compact cropping model built on Qwen3.5-0.8B. Our approach is motivated by the observation that a small model can generate better crops than its first answer suggests. We develop three-stage training to turn this potential into stronger direct predictions. Spatial and composition training establishes localization and framing preferences. Quality-Guided Online Supervision (QOS) then learns the highest-quality complete answers among the current policy's generated candidates. Greedy-Referenced Optimization (GRO) further refines the policy using positive and negative quality differences relative to its current greedy answer. Both online stages use annotation-derived feedback, while inference returns one coordinate answer without search or an external scorer. Experiments show that FrameLite outperforms the compared large-VLM croppers across public benchmarks with a substantially smaller backbone. Controlled studies confirm that selecting high-quality training answers improves the final model beyond online sampling alone. We will release our code and model weights at https://github.com/JianzeLi-114/FrameLite .

AI.tldr: FrameLite是一个基于Qwen3.5-0.8B的紧凑型图像裁剪模型，通过三阶段训练（空间构图训练、质量引导在线监督QOS、贪心参考优化GRO），让小模型直接输出优于其首答的裁剪坐标，推理时无需搜索或外部评分器。
AI.motivation: 美学图像裁剪需平衡主体、上下文与边界。大型视觉语言模型（VLM）虽能引入语义知识，但规模过大不利于轻量级摄影辅助。作者观察到小模型其实具备生成更优裁剪的潜力，只是其首次答案未能充分体现，因此希望将这种潜力转化为更强的直接预测能力。
AI.method: 基于Qwen3.5-0.8B构建紧凑裁剪模型，采用三阶段训练：1）空间与构图训练，建立定位与取景偏好；2）质量引导在线监督（QOS），在当前策略生成的候选中学习最高质量的完整答案；3）贪心参考优化（GRO），利用相对当前贪心答案的正负质量差异进一步精炼策略。两个在线阶段使用标注衍生的反馈，推理时仅返回一个坐标答案。
AI.result: 在公开基准上，FrameLite以远小的骨干网络超越了所对比的大型VLM裁剪器。对照实验证实，选取高质量训练答案可带来优于单纯在线采样的最终模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 小模型经由高质量答案引导的在线训练可显著提升直接裁剪预测能力，实现轻量且高效的图像裁剪。代码与模型权重将在 https://github.com/JianzeLi-114/FrameLite 发布。

title: Chain of Thought Monitoring Can Fail Even When CoT Is Necessary
summary: Chain of Thought (CoT) monitoring is used by frontier labs to detect misbehaviour of AI systems. Yet, its reliability remains poorly understood. We attribute this to the lack of a successful organizing principle that leads to generalizable conclusions about monitoring reliability in different regimes. Recent work attributes monitoring failures to the CoT not being necessary for the answer, and argues that CoT becomes monitorable when it is necessary. We show that this binary necessary/not-necessary organizing principle is too coarse by demonstrating that monitoring failures persist even if the CoT is necessary for the answer. In response, we introduce a more fine-grained organizing principle based on a hierarchy of four CoT necessity levels. Building on this hierarchy, we develop a framework for measuring CoT monitorability at the three lowest levels via intervention experiments. We demonstrate monitoring failures at all three of these levels on realistic, hard prediction tasks. On a difficult medical-diagnosis task, patient sex and a clinical attribute influence the answer in at least 19% and 24% of correct responses with a necessary CoT, respectively, yet their influence is almost never articulated. These results show that even when CoT is necessary, it is not guaranteed to be monitorable.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出"CoT必要性"这一二分判据过于粗糙：即使CoT对答案必要，监控仍会失效。作者提出四层级CoT必要性层级作为更细粒度的组织原则，并基于最低三层构建可监控性测量框架，在真实困难预测任务上验证了各层的监控失效。
AI.motivation: 前沿实验室用思维链（CoT）监控来检测AI系统的错误行为，但其可靠性缺乏可推广的理论理解，根源在于缺少一个能对不同情境下监控可靠性给出可泛化结论的组织原则。既有工作把监控失败归因于"CoT对答案非必要"，并主张CoT必要即可监控——这一二分原则过于粗糙，需要更精细的解释框架。
AI.method: 1）反例论证：构造CoT对答案必要但监控依然失败的案例，否定二分必要性原则；2）提出四层级CoT必要性层级（hierarchy of four CoT necessity levels）作为更细粒度的组织原则；3）基于该层级，设计通过干预实验（intervention experiments）在最低三层测量CoT可监控性的框架；4）在真实、困难的预测任务（含高难度医学诊断任务）上评估，考察患者性别与某临床属性等潜在影响因素是否被CoT显式表达。
AI.result: 在三个最低必要性层级上均观测到监控失败。在困难医学诊断任务中，对于CoT必要且回答正确的样本，患者性别与某临床属性分别至少在19%和24%的回答中产生了影响，但几乎从未在CoT中被表达（articulated）。
AI.conclusion: CoT必要性并不保证CoT可监控性；二分必要性原则不足以刻画监控可靠性。需要采用多层级必要性框架来评估与提升CoT监控的可靠性，否则即使CoT必要，隐蔽影响仍可能逃逸监控。

title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
summary: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了单细胞RNA测序中"基因表达转图像(GE2I)"策略的内在机制，揭示了空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的权衡关系，并指出一对一的基因-像素映射可提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: scRNA-seq可进行细胞层面异质性分析，但从高维、无序的基因表达谱中学习有效表征仍具挑战。GE2I策略通过将基因值排布到像素网格上供CNN使用，提供了有效的学习方式，但其内在机制尚不清晰，需要深入探究以指导实践。
AI.method: 在完整转录组数据上研究GE2I，同时固定网络结构与训练流程。对比分析结构化映射（Structured mapping）与随机映射（Random mapping），考察空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的关系，并测试一对一基因-像素分配对不同视觉骨干网络的影响，以及预训练和数据增强的效果。
AI.result: 发现空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间存在权衡：结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，支持更快的早期优化，但将多个基因映射到同一像素会掩盖表达差异并可能降低预测性能。这解释了当基因数量较多时随机映射为何能与结构化布局竞争。一对一的基因-像素分配在测试的视觉骨干上均提升了预测性能，即使图像平滑性下降。预训练和数据增强的收益取决于骨干网络与映射方式。
AI.conclusion: 该研究阐明了GE2I的机制，为像素分配策略以及将视觉先验迁移到基因表达数据提供了实用指导，强调在映射设计时需权衡优化速度与基因级信息保真度。

title: MemAct: Streaming Spatial Understanding with Memory and Active Exploration
summary: Spatial understanding is essential for embodied agents navigating and interacting with the physical world. As observations arrive incrementally, agents must reason in a streaming manner. Yet streaming understanding must also be closed-loop: task-relevant evidence may require both recalling past observations and actively acquiring new views. Existing streaming approaches largely emphasize processing incoming observations, leaving task-driven active exploration underexplored. We introduce MemAct, a framework for streaming spatial understanding with memory and action. A shared vision--language model incrementally writes structured historical memory, retrieves records and past frames on demand, and acquires additional evidence through movement and turning. Retrieved evidence and action observations inform subsequent decisions, enabling the agent to continue exploring or answer within a unified reasoning loop. We develop the MemAct suite, a data generation pipeline and collection across real and simulated environments, with approximately 1M training examples for spatial reasoning, memory writing, retrieval, and exploration. Its MemAct-bench comprises 20,000 main QA pairs evaluating current-observation understanding, historical evidence use, and active exploration, plus 2,000 separate Timing questions. MemAct combines supervised fine-tuning for memory and interaction with counterfactual action optimization using cumulative evidence gains, action costs, and terminal answer quality to improve exploration and stopping decisions. Experiments show that MemAct outperforms existing spatial understanding and streaming baselines and approaches frontier multimodal models on MemAct-bench while retaining streaming inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出 MemAct 框架，将记忆写入、按需检索与主动探索统一在流式空间理解闭环中，并构建约 100 万训练样本的数据管线与 2 万问答的 MemAct-bench，性能超越现有流式与空间理解基线。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体的空间理解需要在观测增量到达时进行流式推理，且必须是闭环的：任务相关证据既可能来自对过去观测的回忆，也可能需要主动获取新视角。但现有流式方法主要关注对已到达观测的处理，忽视了任务驱动的主动探索。
AI.method: MemAct 使用一个共享的视觉-语言模型：增量写入结构化历史记忆；按需检索记忆记录与历史帧；通过移动和转向获取额外证据；将检索到的证据与动作观测共同用于后续决策，形成统一推理循环。数据方面构建 MemAct suite（真实与仿真环境的数据生成管线与数据集，约 100 万条训练样本，覆盖空间推理、记忆写入、检索与探索）；训练上结合监督微调（记忆与交互）与反事实动作优化，其奖励/目标综合累计证据增益、动作成本与终局答案质量，以改进探索与停止决策。
AI.result: MemAct 在 MemAct-bench 上优于现有空间理解与流式基线，并接近前沿多模态模型水平，同时保持流式推理效率。MemAct-bench 包含 20,000 个主 QA 对（评估当前观测理解、历史证据使用、主动探索）与 2,000 个单独的 Timing 问题。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆机制与主动动作统一到单一推理循环中，可有效提升流式空间理解的闭环能力与探索/停止决策质量，为具身智能体的在线空间理解提供了新框架与评测基准。

title: Monitoring latent reasoning in looped language models
summary: Looped language models (LMs) reuse one block of layers several times per token generation, promising more latent computation at no additional storage cost. Despite their rising popularity, the analysis of looped LMs is still in its infancy: little is known about whether the iterative transformations actually improve their capabilities, or whether these models remain stable under prompt perturbation. We construct an inspection protocol rooted in Mechanistic Interpretability comprising five diverse lenses. We apply it to examine eight looped LMs from four families. Models differ in many aspects but the key one is whether the prompt is transmitted only within the looped state (carry loops: Ouro, LoopUS) or re-supplied at every iteration (re-read loops: Parcae, and Rec-OLMo & Huginn from the Raven family). The results of our study provide valuable insights concerning safety and efficient use of looped language models.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于机械可解释性的五视角检查协议，对来自4个家族的8个循环语言模型进行剖析，重点比较"携带式循环"与"重读式循环"两类模型，揭示其迭代变换是否真正提升能力及在提示扰动下的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型通过复用同一层块多次进行token生成，以不增加存储成本的方式换取更多潜在计算，虽日益流行，但其分析仍处于起步阶段：尚不清楚迭代变换是否真正提升模型能力，也不清楚这些模型在提示扰动下是否保持稳定。
AI.method: 构建一个根植于机械可解释性的检查协议，包含五个多样化视角；将该协议应用于来自4个家族的8个循环语言模型。模型在多个方面存在差异，关键差异在于提示信息是仅在循环状态内部传递（携带式循环：Ouro、LoopUS），还是在每次迭代时重新提供（重读式循环：Parcae，以及Raven家族的Rec-OLMo与Huginn）。
AI.result: （摘要未给出具体实证结果，仅说明通过五视角协议对8个循环LM的比较分析得出了相关发现。）
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为循环语言模型的安全性与高效使用提供了有价值的见解。

title: A Node Embedding Framework for Model-Centric Conformance Checking in Process Mining
summary: Evaluating the quality of process models discovered from event logs is a fundamental challenge in process mining. Traditional evaluation relies on conformance metrics such as fitness and precision, which are highly sensitive to noise and deviations in event logs and therefore often fail to give a consistent assessment of discovery algorithms. We introduce a model-centric evaluation framework that combines node embeddings with Procrustes alignment to enable cross-graph comparability, since embeddings derived from different graphs reside in distinct vector spaces. The proposed PetriNetGraph method transforms Petri net process models into graph representations compatible with embedding algorithms. Comparing the node embeddings of ground-truth and discovered models through a parameterized cosine distance yields a unified and bounded metric for evaluating process discovery across datasets and methods. We evaluate the framework under static and context-aware scenarios to examine how prior knowledge of activity existence influences the assessment of structural similarity. The framework also integrates a compliance checking mechanism that localizes deviations at the activity level and an entropy-regularized node distance aggregation function that quantifies global deviations across the model. Experiments on nine publicly available event logs show that the approach provides a reliable embedding-based conformance indicator that reflects the behavior of fitness and precision. Experiments on synthetic logs with controlled noise levels confirm that it is substantially more robust to log deviations than traditional conformance metrics, PetriNet2Vec, and its dynamic-window and Procrustes-aligned variants, while remaining sensitive to process model degradation. All implementation details and datasets are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出以模型为中心的评估框架，用节点嵌入与Procrustes对齐实现跨图可比，将Petri网转为PetriNetGraph，并以参数化余弦距离给出统一有界一致性指标。
AI.motivation: 流程挖掘中传统一致性评估依赖fitness和precision，对日志噪声与偏差高度敏感，导致对不同发现算法的评价不稳定，缺乏一致、可比的评估方式。
AI.method: 用PetriNetGraph将Petri网流程模型转为适合嵌入算法的图表示；结合节点嵌入与Procrustes对齐解决不同图嵌入空间不可比问题；通过真实模型与发现模型节点嵌入的参数化余弦距离构建统一有界指标；集成活动级偏差定位的合规检查机制与熵正则化节点距离聚合函数以量化全局偏差；并在静态与上下文感知两种场景下考察活动先验知识对结构相似性评估的影响。
AI.result: 在九个公开事件日志上，该方法提供可靠的基于嵌入的一致性指标，其行为与fitness和precision相呼应；在受控噪声水平的合成日志上，比传统一致性指标、PetriNet2Vec及其动态窗口和Procrustes对齐变体对日志偏差更鲁棒，同时对流程模型退化保持敏感。
AI.conclusion: 该模型中心评估框架通过嵌入对齐与统一距离指标，缓解传统一致性指标对噪声的敏感性，为跨数据集、跨方法的流程发现评估提供更稳健且可定位偏差的方案，且实现与数据公开。

title: Open-o3-Video-v2: Seek, Ground, and Reason with Verifiable Spatio-Temporal Evidence
comment: Extension of Open-o3-Video (https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.20579). V2 extends single-pass grounded reasoning to agentic multi-turn evidence seeking and grounding, enabling models to actively acquire and reason over missing visual evidence. We further introduce STGR-v2-CoT-135K and CS-GRPO to improve evidence acquisition and grounded reasoning
summary: Reliable video reasoning requires models to produce correct answers and expose supporting visual evidence. Open-o3-Video enables verifiable reasoning by embedding timestamps and object-level bounding boxes into reasoning traces, but is restricted to frames from an initial sparse sampler. We introduce Open-o3-Video-v2, which formulates video reasoning as a unified agentic evidencegrounded process. The model identifies missing information, acquires additional observations, grounds the moments and objects supporting its reasoning, and writes this evidence into the trajectory before continuing or answering. To support this behavior, we construct STGR-v2-CoT135K, including 52K multi-turn agentic grounded reasoning trajectories, and STGR-v2-RL-13K for reinforcement learning. We further propose Clue-Seek GRPO (CS-GRPO), which tracks how tool calls change accumulated evidence, rewards clue coverage and step-wise gains, and penalizes excessive, repetitive, or uninformative retrieval. On V-STaR, Open-o3-Video-v2-4B achieves 40.4% mAM and 56.3% mLGM, outperforming its Qwen3-VL-4B backbone by 8.5% and 12.6%, respectively. It also delivers consistent gains across general video understanding, long-video reasoning, and temporal grounding benchmarks. These results show that active evidence acquisition and verifiable object-level grounding are complementary for reliable video reasoning. The code and models are released at https://msalab-pku.github.io/projects/Open-o3-Video-v2.

AI.tldr: Open-o3-Video-v2 将视频推理建模为统一的智能体式证据落通过程，结合自动主动获取观测与可验证的时空定位，并配套构建训练数据与 Clue-Seek GRPO 算法，在多项视频理解基准上显著超越骨干模型。
AI.motivation: 可靠视频推理不仅要求答案正确，还需给出支撑性视觉证据。已有工作 Open-o3-Video 将时间戳与物体级边界框嵌入推理轨迹以实现可验证推理，但受限于初始稀疏采样帧，无法在推理中途补充缺失信息，证据获取是被动的。
AI.method: 提出 Open-o3-Video-v2，将视频推理重构为统一的智能体式证据落通过程：模型识别信息缺口、主动获取额外观测、定位支撑推理的时刻与物体，并将证据写入轨迹后再继续推理或作答。构建 STGR-v2-CoT135K（含 52K 多轮智能体式落链推理轨迹）与 STGR-v2-RL-13K 强化学习数据。提出 Clue-Seek GRPO（CS-GRPO），追踪工具调用对累积证据的改变，奖励线索覆盖与逐步增益，惩罚过度、重复或无信息的检索。
AI.result: 在 V-STaR 上，Open-o3-Video-v2-4B 取得 40.4% mAM 与 56.3% mLGM，较其 Qwen3-VL-4B 骨干分别提升 8.5% 和 12.6%。在通用视频理解、长视频推理与时序定位等基准上均获得一致性增益。
AI.conclusion: 主动证据获取与可验证的物体级定位对可靠视频推理具有互补作用。代码与模型已开源于 https://msalab-pku.github.io/projects/Open-o3-Video-v2。

title: Consider, Then Choose: Order-Invariant Decisions in System One Models
summary: System One models answer typed questions in a single forward pass and promise the same answer for the same input. For choice questions, this promise fails: the answer depends on the order of the options, increasingly so as they grow in number, and averaging over their cyclic shifts reduces this dependence without removing it. Scoring each option alone, which the order cannot affect, shows that the order changes the answer mostly when the model is unsure among its top few options, even though the listwise answer looks confident. We therefore propose $\textbf{Runoff}$, which considers, then chooses: it scores each option alone to keep a few candidates, then compares them in listings where each candidate takes every position. It needs no training and can run in two forward passes, and its answer does not depend on the option order by construction. On two open models and five datasets, it changes no answer under shuffling, against 9.3% for cyclic averaging, and with 20 options it is about as accurate and three to four times faster. Wrapped around eight System One models, it removes the order dependence of the five benchmarks, while cyclic averaging changes up to 15.4%.

AI.tldr: 提出Runoff方法：先单独评分每个选项保留少量候选，再在每个候选占据所有位置的列表中比较，无需训练、两次前向传播，答案与选项顺序无关。
AI.motivation: System One模型对同一输入应给出相同答案，但在选择题中答案依赖选项顺序，且选项越多依赖越强；循环移位平均只能减弱不能消除该依赖。单独评分显示，答案变化主要发生在模型对前几个选项不确定时，尽管列表式答案看起来自信。
AI.method: Runoff分两步：先用选项单独评分（不受顺序影响）保留少量候选，再将每个候选置于所有位置进行列表比较。无需训练，两次前向传播即可完成，构造上保证答案不依赖选项顺序。
AI.result: 在两个开源模型和五个数据集上：Runoff在打乱选项时不改变任何答案，而循环平均改变9.3%；20个选项时准确率相当且快3-4倍。包裹八个System One模型时，消除了五个基准的顺序依赖，而循环平均最多改变15.4%。
AI.conclusion: Runoff以低成本、免训练方式消除了选择题答案对选项顺序的依赖，在准确率和效率上均具优势。

title: Adaptive-Group Process Rewards for GUI Agents
summary: Training graphical user interface (GUI) agents with reinforcement learning suffers from sparse outcome rewards, leading to inefficient learning. Process rewards offer a promising direction for credit assignment to intermediate actions; however, accurately evaluating an action requires identifying evidence across long-horizon GUI trajectories, as its value may depend on information beyond its immediate state and observation. In this paper, we propose an adaptive-group process reward framework that dynamically partitions a GUI trajectory into semantically coherent subgoal groups, enabling process reward estimation at both the action and group levels. At the action level, a critic evaluates each action based on the visual changes and subsequent actions within the group for action correctness and contribution to the subgoal. At the group level, the framework aggregates action-level evaluations to assess subgoal completion and contribution to the overall task, and further refines these assessments by leveraging the context of all groups in the trajectory. The process reward of each action is obtained by combining its action-level evaluation with the refined group-level evaluation. We further augment GRPO's outcome advantage with the proposed process rewards to provide finer-grained guidance for GUI agent training. Experiments on process reward benchmarks and downstream RL training demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应分组过程奖励框架，将GUI轨迹划分为语义连贯的子目标组，在动作级和组级估计过程奖励，并结合GRPO训练，在过程奖励基准和下游RL训练中验证有效性。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体的强化学习面临结果奖励稀疏导致学习效率低的问题；过程奖励有助于中间动作的信用分配，但准确评估动作需跨长时程轨迹识别证据，因动作价值依赖于即时状态与观测之外的信息。
AI.method: 提出自适应分组过程奖励框架，动态将GUI轨迹划分为语义连贯的子目标组，实现动作级与组级的过程奖励估计。动作级由critic基于组内视觉变化和后续动作评估动作正确性及对子目标的贡献；组级聚合动作级评估以判断子目标完成度及对整体任务的贡献，并利用轨迹中所有组的上下文进行细化。每个动作的过程奖励由动作级评估与细化后的组级评估组合得到，并用于增强GRPO的结果优势，为GUI智能体训练提供更细粒度指导。
AI.result: 在过程奖励基准和下游强化学习训练上的实验证明了该框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该自适应分组过程奖励框架通过动作级与组级双层评估及上下文细化，缓解GUI智能体RL中的稀疏奖励问题，提升信用分配与训练效果。

title: ScenePercept: Scenario-Conditioned Perceptual Assessment of Real-World User-Generated Content Images
summary: The rapid development of mobile imaging and social platforms has led to explosive growth in user-generated content images, making their systematic and comprehensive perceptual assessment increasingly important. Existing image perception benchmarks are typically task-oriented, curating specific scenarios for quality or aesthetic assessment and applying a uniform perceptual criterion across diverse scenarios. This limits their ability to capture the scene diversity and perceptual complexity of real-world UGC images. To address these limitations, we introduce ScenePercept-Bench, a benchmark designed to reflect the distribution of real-world UGC images, comprising 23,100 images across 21 categories and 105 fine-grained scenes. To account for the influence of scene context on human perception, we design a hierarchical, scene-aware annotation protocol, covering visual quality, aesthetic perception, and scene semantics, with 15 attributes in total. Each image is annotated with an overall score, 15 attribute-level scores, and structured explanatory reasoning. Building on this benchmark, we further introduce Scenario-Conditioned Perceptual Alignment, a training framework that tackles the heterogeneity of perceptual criteria across scenarios. SCPA jointly optimizes absolute score prediction, preference ranking, and cross-scenario calibration, preserving the model general perceptual assessment ability while encouraging it to explore and adapt perceptual criteria across different scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SCPA achieves state-of-the-art performance in UGC image perception and generalizes effectively to established IQA and IAA benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了ScenePercept-Bench基准（23,100张UGC图像，覆盖21类、105个细粒度场景，含15个属性与结构化推理标注）以及SCPA训练框架，通过联合优化绝对分数预测、偏好排序和跨场景校准，实现UGC图像感知评估的SOTA性能并有效泛化到现有IQA/IAA基准。
AI.motivation: 移动成像与社交平台的发展使UGC图像激增，其系统化感知评估日益重要。但现有图像感知基准多为任务导向，针对特定场景策划数据集并对所有场景采用统一感知标准，难以反映真实UGC图像的场景多样性与感知复杂性；且感知标准在不同场景间存在异质性，需要场景条件化的对齐方法。
AI.method: 1）构建ScenePercept-Bench：覆盖21个类别、105个细粒度场景，共23,100张图像，反映真实UGC分布；采用分层、场景感知的标注协议，涵盖视觉质量、美学感知与场景语义，共15个属性，每张图像标注总体分、15个属性分及结构化解释性推理。2）提出Scenario-Conditioned Perceptual Alignment（SCPA）训练框架：联合优化绝对分数预测、偏好排序与跨场景校准，在保持通用感知评估能力的同时鼓励模型探索并适配不同场景的感知标准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SCPA在UGC图像感知任务上达到state-of-the-art性能，并能有效泛化到已有的IQA和IAA基准。
AI.conclusion: 场景感知的基准构建与场景条件化对齐训练能够更好地刻画真实UGC图像的感知复杂度，SCPA兼顾通用感知能力与跨场景适应性，为UGC图像感知评估提供了新的基准与方法范式。

title: Judges Follow the Reference: The Derivation Gap in Verifying Tool-Call Arguments
summary: Tool-call judges evaluate argument values proposed by LLM agents. We find that they accept a correct value less often when their input holds no reference for it, that is, no text that says what the value should be. This happens when the value is a default value from the function schema that the user did not mention, when it has to be inferred, or when the text it comes from was cut from the judge input. We call this drop in acceptance the derivation gap. It appears across all seven judges we evaluate, including System One models CLM and Jev. The gap is not only a truncation artifact: correct default values have the largest gap on a benchmark with no truncation. A controlled source-relocation test shows that judges follow the reference in their input: they favor a visible incorrect value over a correct value whose source is hidden. We introduce DeRef (Derived Reference): a separate model reads the full history without seeing the candidate and writes a reference for the judge. Across three benchmarks, DeRef improves overall argument AUROC for all judges tested. On the controlled test, it raises AUROC from chance or below to between 98.40 and 99.59.

AI.tldr: 论文发现工具调用评判器（tool-call judges）在输入中缺少参考依据时，对正确参数值的接受率下降，称之为"derivation gap"；该现象普遍存在于7个评判器（含System One模型CLM与Jev），且非截断伪影；提出的DeRef方法让独立模型在不看候选值的情况下撰写参考，从而显著提升评判表现。
AI.motivation: 工具调用评判器用于评估LLM agent提出的参数值，但其可靠性存疑。作者怀疑评判器并非真正独立验证值的正确性，而是依赖于输入中是否显式存在支持该值的参考文本，因而需要系统性检验这一偏差并加以缓解。
AI.method: 1) 定义并测量"derivation gap"：当正确值来自函数schema默认值、需推断、或来源文本被截断而未出现在评判器输入中时，统计接受率下降。2) 评估7个评判器（含CLM、Jev）。3) 在无截断基准上检验默认值场景。4) 开展受控的"来源迁移"（source-relocation）测试，比较可见错误值与来源隐藏的正确值。5) 提出DeRef：由独立模型阅读完整对话历史（不看候选值）生成参考文本供评判器使用。
AI.result: derivation gap在全部7个评判器上均出现，且在无截断基准上默认值的差距最大，说明并非截断伪影。受控来源迁移测试显示评判器会追随输入中的参考，偏好可见的错误值而否定来源被隐藏的正确值。DeRef在三个基准上提升了所有被测评判器的整体参数AUROC；在受控测试中，AUROC从随机水平或更低提升至98.40–99.59。
AI.conclusion: 工具调用评判器的判断高度依赖输入中是否存在显式参考，而非真正核查值的正确性，导致derivation gap。通过DeRef（独立模型生成参考）可有效缓解该问题，显著提升评判准确性，表明将"参考生成"与"候选评判"解耦是改进评判器的有效方向。

title: ECG-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Targeted Electrocardiogram Waveform Evolution
summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) models need supervision that targets evolving weaknesses and remains faithful to waveform evidence. We introduce ECG-RSI, a recursive self-improvement framework combining verified waveform synthesis with feedback-guided intervention search. Signal remeasurement verifies waveform edits; construction errors guide generator repair, while learner errors motivate interventions compared on a separate selection set. Across seven benchmarks, three rounds raise Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's mean question-answering accuracy from 34.57% to 56.04% and mean classification F1 from 24.27 to 34.03. Across the retained trajectory, the preferred supervision shifts from direct reinforcement to confusion-focused contrasts. Continued feedback correction yields diminishing external gains. These results motivate separating error diagnosis from intervention selection and checking whether gains on the feedback set transfer to independent benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 ECG-RSI 递归自我改进框架，将经波形验证的合成数据与反馈引导的干预搜索结合，在三轮迭代中持续提升心电模型性能，并发现有效监督形式随训练推进由直接强化转向针对混淆的对比学习。
AI.motivation: 心电模型需要能够针对不断演化的能力弱项进行监督，同时必须忠实于波形证据。现有监督方式难以同时满足"靶向演化弱点"和"证据可验证"两个要求，因此需要一种可递归迭代、并带验证机制的自我改进方案。
AI.method: ECG-RSI 框架包含两条互相耦合的回路：（1）经波形验证的合成数据生成——通过信号重测量（signal remeasurement）校验波形编辑，生成错误用于修复生成器；（2）反馈引导的干预搜索——学习器错误触发候选干预，并在独立的选择集（selection set）上比较择优。二者在递归循环中交替执行，共进行三轮迭代。
AI.result: 在七个基准上，三轮迭代将 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 的平均问答准确率从 34.57% 提升至 56.04%，平均分类 F1 从 24.27 提升至 34.03。在保留的改进轨迹中，最优监督形式由直接强化（direct reinforcement）逐渐转向以混淆为中心的对比（confusion-focused contrasts）。持续进行反馈纠错带来的外部增益递减。
AI.conclusion: 应将对错误的诊断（error diagnosis）与干预方式的选择（intervention selection）分离，并需检验在反馈集上获得的增益能否迁移到独立基准，以避免在反馈集上过拟合的虚假提升。

title: Hierarchical Curriculum Learning for Surgical Video Generation: Focusing on Bilateral Axillo-Breast Approach Robotic Thyroidectomy Datasets
summary: High-fidelity surgical video generation is increasingly important for surgical education, simulation, and downstream AI training, as conventional simulation pipelines are limited by cost, realism, and scenario diversity. Adapting generic text-to-video diffusion models to surgical procedures remains difficult, however, due to complex anatomical structures, intricate tool-tissue interactions, the inherently hierarchical nature of surgical workflows, and the scarcity of curated training data outside a few well-studied procedures. We propose a surgical video generation framework that combines hierarchical procedural annotation with curriculum transfer learning. Surgical procedures are decomposed into three levels (phase, task, and action) and a pretrained text-to-video diffusion model is progressively adapted from coarse to fine-grained surgical context, supported by a dynamic sampling strategy that handles variable-resolution and variable-length surgical clips. We instantiate the framework on Bilateral Axillo-Breast Approach robotic thyroidectomy, a procedure for which no curated benchmark currently exists. Relative to the preceding task-level model, the final action-level model reduces FVD by 20.1% and FID by 15.7%, and a matched-budget ablation indicates that these gains arise from the curriculum design rather than from additional training. A user study with six clinicians rates visual realism highly while highlighting remaining gaps in anatomical accuracy and clinical reliability. The proposed framework offers a step toward AI-driven surgical simulation in procedures where curated data are scarce.

AI.tldr: 提出层级化手术视频生成框架，结合阶段-任务-动作三层标注与课程迁移学习，在缺乏基准数据的机器人甲状腺切除术上实现FVD降低20.1%、FID降低15.7%。
AI.motivation: 高保真手术视频生成对手术教育、仿真与下游AI训练具有重要意义，但传统仿真流程受成本、真实感和场景多样性限制。将通用文本到视频扩散模型迁移到手术领域面临解剖结构复杂、器械-组织交互精细、手术流程本身具有层级性，以及除少数成熟术式外缺乏精心整理训练数据等困难。
AI.method: 将手术流程分解为三层：阶段（phase）、任务（task）、动作（action）；对预训练文本到视频扩散模型按由粗到细的手术上下文进行渐进式课程迁移学习；并引入动态采样策略以处理变分辨率、变时长的术式片段。在双侧腋乳入路机器人甲状腺切除术上实例化该框架。
AI.result: 相对于前一阶段的任务级模型，最终的动作级模型FVD降低20.1%，FID降低15.7%；等预算消融实验表明增益来源于课程设计而非额外训练。六位临床医生的用户研究对视觉真实感评价较高，但指出在解剖准确性和临床可靠性方面仍存在差距。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为在缺乏整理数据的手术中实现AI驱动的手术仿真迈出了一步。

title: Rethinking Projector Training in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal LLMs are typically trained by first aligning a vision encoder with a language model via projector training on large image-caption datasets, followed by joint training of the full multimodal model. Despite its widespread use, the role of the projector training stage remains poorly understood. We find that (i) using only $10$ to $20\%$ of the data for training the projector already recovers most downstream performance gains, and (ii) projectors trained on different datasets can be linearly interpolated while largely preserving performance. These results suggest that projector training mainly performs a coarse alignment, which many different projectors achieve equally well. Motivated by these findings, we propose PORTAL, a training-free projector initialization that requires neither paired image-caption data nor gradient-based optimization, but only per-modality summary statistics. PORTAL computes an optimal-transport-based map between Gaussian approximations of the vision and language feature distributions on a shared principal subspace, so that the projector training stage can be skipped entirely. Without any paired data, PORTAL matches the standard pipeline trained on 558k image-caption pairs across six LLM backbones, two vision encoders, and 16 benchmarks. It outperforms that pipeline in $3$ of $7$ (vision encoder, LLM) settings and reaches an average $98\%$ of its score across the other four.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示多模态LLM中投影器训练阶段主要起粗对齐作用，并提出无需配对数据与梯度优化的投影器初始化方法PORTAL。
AI.motivation: 投影器训练阶段虽被广泛使用，但其作用仍缺乏深入理解；作者希望厘清该阶段的实际贡献并据此简化训练流程。
AI.method: 通过实验发现仅用10%–20%数据训练投影器即可恢复大部分下游性能，且不同数据集训练的投影器可线性插值而性能基本保持；据此提出PORTAL，利用各模态汇总统计量，在共享主成分子空间上对视觉与语言特征的高斯近似求最优传输映射，实现免训练投影器初始化。
AI.result: PORTAL在无需配对数据情况下，在6种LLM主干、2种视觉编码器和16个基准上匹配使用55.8万图像-文本对的标准流程；在7种（视觉编码器，LLM）组合中的3种超过该流程，其余4种平均达到其98%的分数。
AI.conclusion: 投影器训练主要完成粗对齐，可被免训练的最优传输初始化替代，从而完全跳过投影器训练阶段并保持甚至超越标准流程性能。

title: Keep Your Receipts: Trustworthy Cleanup of Agent-Built Knowledge Graphs
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
summary: Agents build knowledge graphs as memory, and building them has become easy. Maintaining them has not. When a source is retracted, overruled, or erased, everything built on top of it (entity merges, entailed edges, community summaries) must be re-examined, and the maintainer must choose between deleting too much and too little. Deployed pipelines delete only the directly extracted facts: on our corpus that reduces contaminated queries from 32.2% to 28.0% under a real retraction and changes nothing under predicate revocation. Rebuilding is no repair for a constructor that samples: two builds of the same 300-document corpus differ in 29,475 artifacts, five times the 6,248 that removing the 61 retracted documents changes. PolyGraph instead asks the constructor for receipts: for every artifact, alternative bundles of source evidence, each claimed sufficient on its own, emitted in the call that creates it. Cleanup is then set arithmetic over the receipts, with no model calls. Because receipts are the model's own self-report, a re-derivation audit checks them by deleting the cited evidence and testing whether the constructor still produces the artifact. The audit finds that a receipt is trustworthy when it is shaped like the claim it backs. Merge receipts, each backing one narrow claim, agree with re-derivation 68% and 85% of the time. Summary receipts, elicited per sentence but stored as one flat list for the whole text, are wrong about two thirds of the time, almost always by keeping dead content. One receipt per sentence instead is 100% and 88% faithful and lets cleanup keep 33 of 35 touched summaries. The result holds under a second oracle model, a claim-blind prompt, ten further deletions, a second domain and a second constructor. Distrusting the summary layer cuts contaminated queries to 0.4% and 0.8% at 99.8 to 100% of the recall a perfect maintainer would return.

AI.tldr: 提出 PolyGraph：让构建器在生成每个产物时输出"收据"（可独立充分支撑该产物的证据束），将知识图谱维护转化为对收据的集合运算，无需模型调用，并通过再推导审计验证收据可信度。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱作为智能体记忆的构建已很便捷，但其维护尚未解决。当源文档被撤回、推翻或删除时，所有依赖该源的上层产物（实体合并、蕴含边、社区摘要）都需重新审视，维护者面临"删太多"或"删太少"的两难。现有部署流水线只删除直接抽取的事实，效果有限（32.2%→28.0%），谓词撤销时甚至无效；而重新构建因构建器采样随机性而无法作为修复手段（两次构建差异 29,475 项，是删除 61 篇撤回文档所改变 6,248 项的五倍）。
AI.method: PolyGraph 在创建产物的同一调用中，要求构建器为每个产物附带"收据"——即多组各自声称充分的替代证据束。清理时对这些收据做集合算术（无需模型调用）。由于收据是模型的自我报告，进一步引入再推导审计：删除被引用的证据后测试构建器是否仍能产生该产物，以此检验收据可信度。对比了两种摘要收据形式（整篇扁平列表 vs 每句一条收据）以及合并收据。
AI.result: 再推导审计显示：收据可信度取决于其形态是否与所支撑的声明匹配。合并收据（支撑单一窄声明）与再推导一致率为 68% 与 85%；摘要收据（按句引出但整篇存为扁平列表）约三分之二情况下错误，且几乎总是保留已死内容；改为每句一条收据后忠实度达 100% 与 88%，清理可保留 35 条受影响摘要中的 33 条。结论在第二套 oracle 模型、声明盲提示、额外十次删除、第二领域与第二构建器下均成立。对摘要层采取不信任策略后，污染查询降至 0.4% 与 0.8%，同时保留完美维护者召回率的 99.8%–100%。
AI.conclusion: PolyGraph 表明，通过让构建器输出证据"收据"并以集合运算方式清理，可高效解决知识图谱维护难题；收据的粒度与形态需与其所支撑声明的粒度对齐（故每句一条收据优于整篇扁平列表），并可用再推导审计进行无监督验证。该方法在不同模型、领域与构建器下具备稳健性。

title: SWORD: Scene-Grounded Wasserstein Object-Relation Distance for 3D Scene Graph Prediction
summary: 3D scene graph prediction is commonly optimized with object-node and relation-edge classification losses. These objectives encourage exact object and relation label recovery, but they do not directly optimize semantic proximity to the ground-truth scene graph: two wrong graphs can receive comparable penalties even when one is much closer in object roles and relation contexts. A direct graph-distance loss is difficult in general, since graph matching and graph edit distance require correspondence search and edit-cost design. Our key observation is that prior supervised 3D scene graph prediction protocols are conducted on fixed object-node indices and supervised edge slots. This can turn a scene graph comparison into a well-defined aligned graph-distance problem. To this end, we propose SWORD, a Scene-Grounded Wasserstein Object-Relation Distance that builds block-normalized object and relation ground distance metrics from training scene graph annotations through a deterministic base-to-context order, without external semantic priors. SWORD lifts these metrics to Wasserstein distances over aligned node and null-augmented edge marginals, providing semantic graph-distance supervision beyond exact-label penalties while preserving the ground-truth graph as the unique zero-distance solution in aligned marginal probability space. We prove that SWORD is a strict metric on aligned marginal probabilistic scene graphs, preserves scene-graph-grounded substitution ordering, controls additive graph-grounded semantic observables, and yields a surrogate upper-bounding decoded semantic error.

AI.tldr: 提出SWORD——一种场景锚定的Wasserstein对象-关系距离，在固定对齐的节点/边概率空间上构建语义图距离监督，保持真实图为零距离唯一解，并提供严格度量性质与误差上界。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景图预测多采用对象节点分类损失与关系边分类损失，只鼓励精确标签恢复，不直接优化与真实场景图的语义接近度：两个错误图即使对象角色与关系上下文差距悬殊，也可能得到相近惩罚。直接使用图距离损失较困难，因为图匹配与图编辑距离需对应搜索和编辑代价设计。
AI.method: 利用已有监督协议在固定对象节点索引与受监督边槽上进行的特性，将场景图比较转化为良定义的对齐图距离问题。SWORD通过确定性的"基础到上下文"顺序，从训练场景图标注构建块归一化的对象与关系ground distance度量，无需外部语义先验；再将这些度量提升为对齐节点边际与空增强边边际上的Wasserstein距离，从而在精确标签惩罚之外提供语义图距离监督。
AI.result: 在对齐边际概率场景图上证明SWORD是严格度量；保持场景图锚定的替换排序；可控制加性图锚定语义可观测量；并给出对解码语义误差的代理上界。真实图在对齐边际概率空间中仍是唯一零距离解。
AI.conclusion: SWORD为3D场景图预测提供了超越精确标签惩罚的语义图距离监督，兼具良好理论性质（严格度量、排序保持、误差上界），且不依赖外部语义先验，适用于固定对齐的监督协议。

title: Beyond Answer Voting: Fine-Grained Correction of LLM Reasoning through Graph Alignment across Sampled Traces
summary: Large language models increasingly tackle tasks that require multi-step reasoning, where errors in intermediate claims can affect the final answer. Self-consistency (SC) improves reasoning by voting over sampled final answers, but its vote leaves intermediate disagreements unresolved. To address this problem, we introduce DDRG (Disagreement-Driven Verification Guided by Reasoning Graphs), a framework for selective correction from a frozen bank of reasoning traces. Our insight is that graph alignment can expose claim-level disagreements and provide correction evidence without expanding the sampled trace bank. DDRG builds source-grounded claim graphs and sends localized conflicts to an answer-blind verifier. A verifier-supported refutation that reaches the majority answer's supporting path triggers one focused repair; otherwise, DDRG returns the exact SC vote. Experimental results across five benchmarks show that native zero-shot DDRG improves macro-average accuracy over direct answering by 8.65 and 15.83 percentage points for Qwen2.5-7B and Llama3.1-8B. It also exceeds CoT, the evaluated GoT and GoV question-answering adaptations, and SC on this macro metric. DDRG links local verification to selective correction without enlarging the initial candidate bank.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DDRG框架，通过推理图对齐暴露声明级分歧，在冻结的推理轨迹库上实现选择性纠错，在五个基准上优于直接回答、CoT、GoT、GoV及自一致性方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型处理多步推理任务时，中间声明的错误会影响最终答案。自一致性（SC）通过对采样最终答案投票来改进推理，但投票无法解决中间过程的分歧。
AI.method: DDRG（Disagreement-Driven Verification Guided by Reasoning Graphs，分歧驱动、推理图引导的验证）基于如下洞见：图对齐可在不扩展采样轨迹库的前提下暴露声明级分歧并提供纠错证据。方法构建源依据声明图，将局部冲突发送给一个对答案盲的验证器；当验证器支持的驳斥指向多数答案的支持路径时，触发一次聚焦修复；否则返回精确的SC投票结果。
AI.result: 在五个基准上，原生零样本DDRG相比直接回答，在Qwen2.5-7B和Llama3.1-8B上宏平均准确率分别提升8.65和15.83个百分点。在该宏指标上，DDRG还超过CoT、所评估的GoT与GoV问答适配方法以及SC。
AI.conclusion: DDRG将局部验证与选择性纠错相连接，且无需扩大初始候选库。

title: Upstream Influence, Downstream Re-Anchoring in LLM Agent Chains
summary: People act on evaluative judgments produced by LLM agents, and in multi-agent systems those judgments pass through several agents before reaching a person. We show that a workflow's information architecture---source access, handoff format, and which model reads the untrusted content---governs how much of a coordinated manipulation reaches the end. On 32 Taiwan~2025 recall cases, ten authentic Threads comments shown to one agent move its stance by $+0.171$ toward the injected position, and a mirrored set moves it the other way. Passing that judgment down a chain removes more than half of the shift by the third agent; keeping the comments in front of every agent sustains more of it. The reduction is not attrition in transit: each receiver discounts the inherited stance in proportion to how far it sits from its own reading of the evidence, returning to what that evidence implies for the case rather than to neutrality---consistent with partial re-anchoring. Handoff format is a second lever: a stance relayed without its reasoning is largely discounted. Susceptibility at the exposed seat varies fourfold across models, while the chain's arrangement does not matter at all. None of this is visible in the transcripts---the injected claims are almost never restated, so reasoning-trace audits miss the attack.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多智能体LLM工作流中协调性操纵如何随信息架构传播至最终决策者。在32个案例上，单个智能体的立场可被注入评论移动±0.171，但经链条传递后第三次交接已衰减过半；衰减源于接收者对继承立场的"部分再锚定"而非传输损耗。交接格式（是否附推理）与暴露席位模型是主要杠杆，链条排列方式无关。此类操纵几乎不在推理轨迹中显现，因此审计轨迹会漏检。
AI.motivation: 现实中的评估性判断由LLM智能体产生并经多智能体系统逐级传递后才到达人类，而注入的操纵内容在这一链路上如何被放大或衰减尚不清楚。作者希望明确工作流的"信息架构"（来源访问、交接格式、由哪个模型阅读不可信内容）在多大程度上决定协调性操纵的最终影响力，并检验常规推理轨迹审计能否发现此类攻击。
AI.method: 在32个案例（台湾2025年召回案例）上构造注入实验：向某一智能体展示十条真实Threads评论，使其立场向注入方向偏移（镜像组则反向偏移），随后沿多智能体链条传递该判断。系统操纵三个架构变量——不可信内容的暴露席位、是否让每条评论始终呈现在所有智能体面前、以及交接格式（是否携带推理）。通过对比各环节立场偏移量，区分"传输损耗"与"再锚定"两种解释，并跨多个模型测量暴露席位的易感性差异。
AI.result: 单个智能体被十条评论移动立场+0.171；镜像组反向移动。传递至第三个智能体时偏移衰减超过一半；若评论持续展示给每个智能体则保留更多偏移。衰减并非传输损耗：接收者按继承立场与其自身证据解读之间的距离成比例地打折，回归到证据所暗示的立场而非中立，符合部分再锚定机制。交接格式是第二杠杆——不带推理的立场传递被大幅打折。暴露席位的易感性跨模型相差四倍，而链条排列方式完全无影响。注入主张几乎从未被复述，因此推理轨迹审计无法发现该攻击。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体工作流中协调性操纵的存活率由信息架构决定，而非由链条拓扑决定。关键设计杠杆是减少不可信内容的多点暴露、强制交接携带推理，以及选择不易受影响的模型担任暴露席位。由于攻击不体现在推理文本中，仅依赖推理轨迹的透明度与审计机制不足以防御此类操纵，需要转向对信息流与交接结构的架构级审查。

title: A Differentiable 3D Scene Graph Metric via Contextual Hellinger Triplet Geometry
summary: 3D scene graph prediction is commonly supervised with local object and predicate classification losses. Although effective for slot-wise label prediction, this formulation does not provide a graph-level semantic distance between a predicted scene graph and its ground truth: semantically mild label errors and structurally disruptive relational errors can be treated similarly, and subject-predicate-object facts are not compared as scene-level units. We propose Contextual Hellinger Triplet Geometry, a graph-level supervision objective that measures the semantic and structural discrepancy between 3D scene graphs. Our key idea is to reinterpret the conventional classifier outputs of a 3D scene graph predictor as an aligned probabilistic scene graph field, where object and predicate predictions jointly define contextual subject-predicate-object facts. This formulation yields a differentiable metric-based training objective with an efficient factorized implementation and can be applied to existing 3D scene graph prediction architectures without modifying their network design. Experiments on 3DSSG demonstrate that our supervision improves downstream graph-conditioned 3D scene generation, while ablation studies confirm the complementary roles of the proposed graph-level terms and user studies show better graph descriptiveness, relation plausibility, and structural preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出Contextual Hellinger Triplet Geometry（CHTG）图级监督目标，将3D场景图预测器的分类器输出重新解释为对齐的概率场景图场，用语义与结构差异度量替代局部标签损失，无需改动网络结构即可提升图条件3D场景生成。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景图预测通常采用局部的物体与谓词分类损失。尽管对逐槽（slot-wise）标签预测有效，但该形式无法提供预测场景图与真值之间的图级语义距离：语义上轻微的标签错误与结构上破坏性的关系错误可能被同等对待，且主谓宾（subject-predicate-object）事实未作为场景级单元进行比较。
AI.method: 提出Contextual Hellinger Triplet Geometry（CHTG），一种衡量3D场景图间语义与结构差异的图级监督目标。核心思想是把3D场景图预测器的常规分类器输出重新解释为一个对齐的概率场景图场，物体与谓词预测共同定义上下文化的主谓宾事实。由此得到可微的、基于度量的训练目标，并具备高效的因子化实现；可直接应用于现有3D场景图预测架构而无需修改其网络设计。
AI.result: 在3DSSG数据集上，该监督改善了图条件的3D场景生成；消融研究证实所提出的图级项具有互补作用；用户研究显示其在图描述性、关系合理性与结构保持性方面表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 将场景图预测的局部分类监督升级为图级语义-结构度量监督，可在不改变网络结构的前提下提升下游图条件3D场景生成质量，且各图级项互补、在描述性与结构保真度上更具优势。

title: To Align or Not To Align: Check Your COMPASS Before You Train
summary: Combining pretrained models is a common strategy for building AI systems, whether by aligning a vision encoder with a language model or merging fine-tuned checkpoints. However, finding compatible pairs typically requires costly empirical search, as compatibility is known only after alignment or merging. We propose COMPASS (COMPatibility ASsessment Score), a theoretically motivated diagnostic that estimates whether a model pair will be compatible prior to alignment or merging. Building on the observation that representational convergence is most robust at the level of local neighborhoods, COMPASS decomposes model compatibility into two cheap-to-compute axes: a pair-specific ease, defined as the $k$-NN overlap between the two encoders, and a paradigm-level ceiling, capturing the maximum overlap their training paradigms allow. Together, these two axes provide a ranking of candidate model pairs and prescribe how to act on each pair: (i) prioritize pairs that already agree and whose paradigms are compatible, (ii) invest additional compute on pairs with compatible paradigms but low initial agreement, (iii) switch the pretraining paradigm when it cannot support sufficient agreement, or (iv) deprioritize pairs that score poorly on both axes. We apply COMPASS to $72$ cross-modal alignment experiments and $392$ task-arithmetic model merges and show that compatibility estimates by COMPASS strongly correlate with downstream success, achieving average Pearson correlation of $0.91$ on cross-modal alignment tasks and $0.70$ on model merging.

AI.tldr: 提出COMPASS诊断指标，在跨模态对齐与模型合并前预测模型对兼容性，基于k-NN重叠的"易度"和训练范式"上限"两轴评分，与下游表现强相关。
AI.motivation: 组合预训练模型（如视觉编码器与语言模型对齐、微调检查点合并）是常见策略，但兼容性只能在事后得知，寻找兼容模型对通常依赖昂贵的经验性搜索，缺乏可提前评估的诊断手段。
AI.method: 基于"表征收敛在局部邻域层面最为稳健"的观察，COMPASS将兼容性分解为两个廉价可算的轴：(1) 对特定的易度，用两个编码器间的k-NN重叠度量；(2) 范式级上限，刻画二者训练范式所允许的最大重叠。两轴共同给出候选模型对的排序，并指导行动策略。
AI.result: 在72个跨模态对齐实验和392个任务算术模型合并上验证，COMPASS的兼容性估计与下游成功强相关：跨模态对齐任务上平均Pearson相关系数0.91，模型合并上0.70。
AI.conclusion: COMPASS可作为对齐或合并前的低成本诊断工具，预测模型对兼容性并给出四类处置建议：优先已一致且范式兼容的对、对范式兼容但初始一致性低的对追加算力、范式不支持足够一致性时更换预训练范式、两轴均差的对降低优先级。

title: Evidence-First Agentic Verification
summary: Long-horizon, semi-verifiable agentic tasks often rely on rubric-based evaluation, but the evidence needed to assess these tasks can be spread across the environment state and the execution trace. A judge may overlook this evidence or accept unsupported claims, including an agent's own reports of success. When rubric verdicts serve as reinforcement-learning rewards, such errors can reinforce undesirable behavior. We introduce Sauron, an evidence-first agentic verifier that investigates both state and trace and relies on a claim only after independently validating it against its source. Bounded queries and joint investigation of related criteria reduce context use and redundant work, and each verdict carries an auditable receipt of its supporting evidence. Across 2,586 human-labeled criteria from 100 personal-assistant episodes, Sauron achieves the highest F1 of five verifiers on all eight backbones tested while costing less than Gandalf, the strongest baseline. With GPT-5.6 Sol, it reaches 0.96 F1 versus Gandalf's 0.92 at 23% lower cost, with a wider margin on process criteria. On a paired fault-injection suite covering 13 families, several of which simulate reward hacking, Sauron detects 97% of injected failures while flagging only 2% of clean controls, outperforming baselines even when they are given the full trace. On TRAIL, a benchmark for detecting and localizing real agent errors, Sauron leads both Gandalf and TRAIL's own judge on all three quality metrics.

AI.tldr: Sauron 是一种"证据优先"的智能体验证器，先独立核验状态与执行轨迹中的证据，再据以判定评分标准，兼顾准确率、成本与可审计性。
AI.motivation: 长周期、半可验证的智能体任务常依赖评分标准（rubric）进行评测，但支撑判定的证据分散在环境状态与执行轨迹中。评判者可能遗漏证据或轻信无依据的说法（包括智能体自报的成功）。当 rubric 判定被用作强化学习奖励时，此类错误会强化不良行为。因此需要一种主动取证、验证主张来源的验证器。
AI.method: 提出 Sauron：证据优先的智能体验证器，同时调查环境状态与执行轨迹，仅在独立对照来源验证后才采信某一主张；采用有界查询（bounded queries）与对相关准则的联合调查，以降低上下文占用与重复工作；每条判定附带可审计的证据回执（auditable receipt）。
AI.result: 在 100 个个人助理回合的 2,586 条人工标注准则上，Sauron 在测试的 8 种骨干模型上均取得五种验证器中最高的 F1，且成本低于最强基线 Gandalf；使用 GPT-5.6 Sol 时 F1 达 0.96（Gandalf 0.92）且成本低 23%，在过程类准则上优势更大。在覆盖 13 个故障家族（含模拟 reward hacking）的配对故障注入套件中，Sauron 检出 97% 注入故障，仅误报 2% 干净对照，即便基线获得完整轨迹仍被超越。在 TRAIL（检测与定位真实智能体错误的基准）上，Sauron 在三项质量指标上均领先 Gandalf 与 TRAIL 自带评判者。
AI.conclusion: 以证据为中心的主动核验机制能显著提升 rubric 判定的准确性与鲁棒性，并降低验证成本；可审计回执增强了判定可追溯性，使其更适合作为强化学习奖励信号，减少奖励攻击风险。

title: From Token Correction to Claim Admission: Training-Free Hallucination Mitigation for Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models often exhibit object hallucination, generating claims that are not supported by the input image. To mitigate this issue, we propose Evidence-Guided Visual Claim Admission (EGVCA), a training-free framework that admits a semantic claim only when it receives sufficient image-dependent support. EGVCA measures this support by comparing the claim likelihood under the observed image and a visual-null input. For captioning, it controls semantic expansion without altering token generation. For binary visual question answering, it combines atomic visual support with the image-induced change in the model's native Yes--No margin. Experiments on CHAIR, POPE, and MME across three LVLM backbones show that EGVCA substantially reduces object hallucination while preserving caption quality. It achieves the highest POPE F1 in eight of nine backbone--sampling settings and improves the native MME total score on all three backbones. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of claim-level admission as a simple alternative to token-level distribution correction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练的EGVCA框架，通过比较图像与视觉空输入下的语义声明似然，仅在获得充分图像相关支持时才接受声明，从而降低LVLM物体幻觉并保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉-语言模型常出现物体幻觉，即生成输入图像不支持的内容。现有缓解方法多从token级分布校正入手，本文希望探索声明级准入这一更简单的替代思路。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架EGVCA：通过对比观察图像与视觉空输入下声明的似然来度量图像依赖支持。用于描述任务时控制语义扩展而不改变token生成；用于二值VQA时结合原子视觉支持与图像引起的原生Yes-No margin变化。
AI.result: 在CHAIR、POPE和MME上，跨三个LVLM骨干的实验中，EGVCA大幅减少物体幻觉并保持描述质量；在九组骨干-采样设置中八组取得最高POPE F1，并在三个骨干上均提升原生MME总分。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明声明级准入是token级分布校正的一种简单有效替代方案。

title: BLADE: Auditing Information Use for Failure Attribution in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language model multi-agent systems extend individual agents' capabilities through collaboration across specialized roles, tools, and workflows. Yet collaboration makes failures harder to diagnose: one agent may misinterpret a correct result while others carry the mistake forward. Failure attribution therefore seeks to identify the responsible agent and decisive error step. Recent methods trace dependencies, but knowing where information came from is not the same as knowing where it went wrong. We introduce BLADE (Blame Localization via Audited Dependency Evidence), a training-free framework that moves beyond tracing information to auditing its use. Using Jev for structured probabilistic judgments, BLADE uses dependency probabilities to select relevant source-decision handoffs for auditing. At these handoffs, it examines whether receiving decisions use their sources faithfully and within task requirements, distinguishing error introduction, propagation, and repair. These findings inform a global diagnosis that considers all execution steps. Without reference answers, BLADE achieves the best or tied-best step accuracy among eight strategies under a shared Jev decision interface on 1,228 failed runs across five Who&When and Who&When Pro subsets, outperforming All-at-once by 2.2-11.1 percentage points. Making responsibility evidence explicit offers a path toward more interpretable and reliable agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练框架 BLADE，从“追踪信息流向”转向“审计信息使用”，通过依赖概率筛选手递环节并结合 Jev 结构化概率判断，实现多智能体系统失败的全局归因。
AI.motivation: 多智能体协作使失败更难定位：某智能体可能误读正确结果，后续智能体继续沿用错误。已有方法只追踪依赖来源，但“信息从哪来”不等于“错在哪一步”，因此需要审计信息是否被忠实、符合任务要求地使用。
AI.method: BLADE（Blame Localization via Audited Dependency Evidence）为免训练框架：1）用 Jev 进行结构化概率判断；2）基于依赖概率选择相关的源决策—接收决策手递点；3）在手递点审计接收决策是否忠实使用来源并满足任务要求，区分错误引入、传播与修复；4）综合所有执行步骤形成全局诊断。
AI.result: 在五个 Who&When 与 Who&When Pro 子集的 1,228 个失败运行上，共享 Jev 决策接口、无参考答案条件下，BLADE 在八种策略中取得最佳或并列最佳步骤准确率，较 All-at-once 高 2.2–11.1 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式化责任证据有助于提升多智能体系统的可解释性与可靠性。

title: Safety for Whom? Benchmarking Understanding Beyond Refusal in Egocentric Multimodal Assistants
summary: Egocentric multimodal assistants see through the user's eyes and guide what the user does next, so their outputs directly shape physical actions, including those that affect bystanders. Yet existing safety evaluations do not distinguish whom a response would harm, and score only whether a model refuses. Pooling all harms into one refusal rate hides two failures: a model may protect one target but not another, and it may refuse without understanding the risk, or understand it and comply anyway. We present STOU, a benchmark of 2,902 egocentric video-audio and video-text queries whose potential harm targets the user (Self), co-present individuals (The Others), or society at large (Others). Our evaluation decouples safety understanding from refusal behavior: beyond refusal, we score whether the model recognizes the user's intent, the presence and target of harm, and its downstream consequences. Across 10 open and closed source omnimodal and multimodal LLMs, we find that refusal varies systematically with the harm target, and that models often recognize a harm yet still assist with it. These results show that refusal rates alone cannot certify an assistant as safe, and that safety alignment must account for who would be harmed. Project page: https://onedayoneyeah.github.io/safety-for-whom

AI.tldr: 该论文提出STOU基准，用2902条第一视角视频-音频/视频-文本查询评估多模态助手的安全性，将潜在受害对象区分为用户自身、共同在场他人及社会，并将安全理解与拒绝行为解耦评分，发现拒绝率随受害对象系统性变化，模型常能识别危害却仍协助。
AI.motivation: 第一视角多模态助手通过用户视角观察并指导后续动作，输出会直接塑造影响旁人的物理行为；但现有安全评测不区分回应会伤害谁，仅以是否拒绝作为评分标准，将所有危害合并为单一拒绝率，掩盖了"保护某一对象却不保护另一对象"以及"不理解风险而拒绝"或"理解风险仍照做"两类失败。
AI.method: 构建STOU基准，包含2902条第一视角视频-音频与视频-文本查询，其潜在危害对象分为用户自身（Self）、共同在场个体（The Others）及社会大众（Others）。评测将安全理解与拒绝行为解耦：除拒绝外，还评估模型是否识别用户意图、危害的存在与对象，以及其下游后果。在10个开源与闭源的全模态及多模态大语言模型上进行测试。
AI.result: 在10个开源与闭源的全模态及多模态大语言模型上，拒绝行为随危害对象呈现系统性差异，且模型常常识别出危害却仍然提供协助。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭拒绝率无法证明助手是安全的，安全对齐必须考虑"谁会受到伤害"。

title: DT-LoRA: Reaching Beyond the Tangent Space of Low-Rank Adaptation
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) often underperforms full fine-tuning. We investigate this performance gap through a tangent-space lens: factorized updates are confined to the tangent space of the current low-rank factors, leaving gradient components outside this space unexploited. An analysis of ten representative LoRA variants reveals that these residual components account for most of the gradient energy and exhibit strong spectral concentration. Motivated by this finding, we propose Dynamic Tangent LoRA (DT-LoRA), which partitions a fixed rank budget into a stable branch and a dynamic branch to capture the principal residual gradient directions. We show that these directions define the optimal update of a local quadratic model under orthogonal-complement and rank constraints. Matrix-free randomized SVD recovers them without materializing the residual gradient, while controlled write-back preserves accumulated updates and stabilizes training within the allocated rank. DT-LoRA adds no trainable parameters or inference cost over LoRA. Experiments across computer vision and natural language processing tasks demonstrate consistent improvements over LoRA and its variants. Moreover, despite being a general-purpose adaptation method, DT-LoRA outperforms task-specific approaches to open-vocabulary domain generalization for semantic segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art results. Code is available at https://github.com/Snipine/DT-LoRA.

AI.tldr: 本文从切空间视角解释LoRA性能差距，提出DT-LoRA，将固定秩预算分为稳定分支与动态分支以捕获残差梯度主方向，不增加可训练参数或推理开销，在视觉与NLP任务上一致超越LoRA及变体，并在开放词汇域泛化语义分割上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: LoRA常弱于全量微调。作者认为其瓶颈在于分解式更新被限制在当前低秩因子的切空间内，切空间之外的梯度分量未被利用。对十种代表性LoRA变体的分析显示，这些残差分量占据大部分梯度能量且具有强谱集中性，因而值得显式建模。
AI.method: 提出动态切空间LoRA（DT-LoRA）：将固定秩预算划分为稳定分支与动态分支，用于捕获主要的残差梯度方向；理论证明这些方向是在正交补与秩约束下局部二次模型的最优更新；采用免矩阵随机SVD在不显式构造残差梯度的情况下恢复该方向，并通过受控写回保留累积更新、在分配秩内稳定训练。
AI.result: 相比LoRA不增加可训练参数与推理成本。在计算机视觉与自然语言处理任务上，性能一致优于LoRA及其多种变体；作为通用适配方法，在语义分割的开放词汇域泛化任务上超过任务专用方法，达到state-of-the-art。
AI.conclusion: 从切空间残差梯度视角定位LoRA的不足，DT-LoRA以零额外参数/推理代价有效利用残差主方向，兼具通用性与强性能，代码已开源。

title: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against bound evidence and applicable environment checks while carrying forward unaffected records and jointly updating execution context. Experiments on OSWorld 2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus show improved gains of 5.8% and 7.0% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, respectively. Project page: https://ethannju.github.io/carryon

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CarryOn——一个面向对象的长时程上下文运行时，以可复用的任务对象而非交互历史组织上下文延续，并通过跨折叠的载体记录增量更新机制维持复用基础的有效性，在 OSWorld 2.0 与 BrowseComp-Plus 上分别提升 5.8%/7.0% 且显著降低 token 消耗。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体将进展累积在持久化任务状态中，却反复重新处理描述"进展如何达成"的交互历史。这引出核心问题：长时程上下文能否围绕可复用的"进展"来组织，而非围绕产生该进展的历史？
AI.method: CarryOn 是一个面向对象的上下文运行时，将延续建立在可复用任务对象上。其上下文视图由三部分构成：延续载体（continuation carriers）、补充执行上下文、以及近期交互的实时尾部（live tail）。核心挑战在于历史被淘汰后如何保持复用基础的有效性，避免每次折叠时重建完整表示。CarryOn 跨折叠维护载体记录，依据绑定证据（bound evidence）与适用环境检查对受影响记录进行修订，同时保留不受影响的记录，并联合更新执行上下文。
AI.result: 在 OSWorld 2.0 与 BrowseComp-Plus 上分别取得 5.8% 与 7.0% 的性能提升，同时总 token 使用量分别降低 51.9% 与 22.9%。
AI.conclusion: 以可复用进展对象为中心的上下文组织方式能够替代对交互历史的重复处理，在提升长时程任务表现的同时大幅压缩 token 开销，验证了"围绕进展而非历史组织上下文"这一思路的可行性。

title: DuplexAct: How Interactive Are Frontier Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models?
summary: End-to-end (E2E) full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) enable simutanous listening and speaking continously, requiring models to take appropriate interaction actions as conversations unfold. However, existing benchmarks lack a structured action-level formulation, often evaluate action occurrence rather than success, and provide limited coverage of diverse real-world conversations. We introduce DuplexAct, a benchmark for evaluating interaction action taking in E2E FD-SLMs. DuplexAct defines a three-level action taxonomy spanning eight interaction actions and 24 corresponding interaction conditions. We further characterize successful action-taking through immediate execution and subsequent follow-through, and develop action-specific evaluation metrics for both. DuplexAct contains 4,691 test instances spanning casual conversation, meetings, customer service, and interviews, including 2,531 instances derived from real-world conversational recordings. Together, DuplexAct provides a structured and real-world-grounded framework for systematically assessing how E2E FD-SLMs participate in ongoing spoken interaction.

AI.tldr: DuplexAct 是一个用于评估端到端全双工语音语言模型（FD-SLM）交互动作能力的基准。它定义了三级动作分类体系，涵盖 8 种交互动作和 24 种条件，并通过即时执行与后续跟进两个维度衡量动作是否成功，包含 4,691 个测试实例。
AI.motivation: 现有基准缺乏结构化的动作层面表述，通常仅评估动作是否发生而非是否成功，且对多样化真实对话场景覆盖有限。因此需要构建一个结构化、贴近真实场景的评估框架，以系统衡量 E2E FD-SLM 如何在持续语音交互中采取适当的交互动作。
AI.method: 提出 DuplexAct 基准：定义三级动作分类体系，包含 8 种交互动作与 24 种对应交互条件；将成功动作执行刻画为即时执行（immediate execution）与后续跟进（subsequent follow-through）两方面，并针对每种动作设计相应评估指标。
AI.result: DuplexAct 共包含 4,691 个测试实例，覆盖闲聊、会议、客服和访谈四类场景，其中 2,531 个实例源自真实对话录音。
AI.conclusion: DuplexAct 提供了一个结构化且贴近真实世界的评估框架，可系统评估 E2E FD-SLM 在持续语音交互中的参与方式与交互动作执行能力。

title: AttenIR: Aligning Dense Visual Attention with Mesh Warping for Unsupervised Image Retargeting
