summary: Image retargeting aims to resize images while preserving salient content free from distortion and stretching. Recent learning-based solutions reduce reliance on traditional hand-crafted features and optimization procedures, leading to more efficient and generalizable performance. Nevertheless, existing approaches still struggle to preserve global structure and content fidelity. To address these limitations, we propose AttenIR, an unsupervised image retargeting framework requiring no manual labels, based on content-aware mesh warping, which ef- fectively couples dense visual attention with sparse mesh constraints. We for- mulate the mesh deformation as a vertex displacement regression task. Guided by saliency priors, our method jointly optimizes scale, structure, and geometry preservation losses. By combining dense visual attention with semantic features, it achieves robust, unsupervised retargeting without manual annotations. Our primary contributions include (1) a lightweight unsupervised method for image retargeting that ensures content fidelity and preserves global structure, and (2) a coarse-to-fine projection strategy to align dense visual attention priors with sparse mesh constraints, enabling content-aware deformation at the pixel level. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive and superior performance compared with both traditional and state-of-the-art learning-based methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 AttenIR，一种无需人工标注的无监督图像重定向框架，基于内容感知网格变形，耦合稠密视觉注意力与稀疏网格约束，在保持全局结构和内容保真度上取得竞争性甚至更优的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的图像重定向方法虽减少了对传统手工特征和优化流程的依赖，但在保持全局结构与内容保真度方面仍有不足。
AI.method: 将网格变形建模为顶点位移回归任务；以显著性先验为指导，联合优化尺度、结构和几何保持损失；通过由粗到细的投影策略，将稠密视觉注意力先验与稀疏网格约束对齐，并结合语义特征实现像素级内容感知变形。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法相较传统方法及当前最先进的基于学习的方法，取得了具有竞争力且更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: AttenIR 是一种轻量级无监督图像重定向方法，无需人工标注即可保证内容保真并保持全局结构，验证了稠密注意力与稀疏网格约束耦合的有效性。

title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
summary: Harness self-evolution revises an agent's software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model--harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了"Harness 自我进化（Harness RSI）"：在固定模型权重的前提下，通过反馈驱动过程对智能体的软件脚手架（提示、记忆、工作流、可执行组件）进行修订，并使被接受的修订跨运行持久化。文章区分更新目标与提议/准入机制，从进化优化角度刻画搜索过程，并用持续 PAC 学习分析其可靠性，导出泛化界、保留界与准入规则，同时讨论其对知识共享、组织流程及科学可靠性与安全的影响，并给出 66 页综述、代码与补充材料。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体能力提升多依赖模型权重更新，而实际部署中大量行为由提示、记忆、工作流与代码等"软件脚手架"决定，且这些组件可被持续修改并跨运行累积。此类持久化修订带来可靠性、回归风险与安全问责等新问题，缺乏统一的形式化框架与分析工具，因此需要系统界定 Harness RSI 的更新对象、搜索机制与验证原则。
AI.method: 1) 形式化反馈驱动的修订过程，将被接受的修订视为跨运行持久化；2) 将"更新目标"与"提议机制""准入机制"分离；3) 区分对解释型状态的修改与对工具/代码、仓库级控制逻辑、插件组合的修订；4) 用进化优化刻画搜索空间与过程；5) 用持续 PAC 学习分析可靠性，在显式假设下推导期望泛化界、基于历史回归预算的保留界，以及基于新鲜独立验证数据的高概率准入规则。
AI.result: 在明确假设下得到三项理论结果：期望泛化界、以历史回归预算为条件的保留界，以及使用新鲜独立验证数据的高概率准入规则。结合先前工作案例说明模型—Harness 协同设计、分布式执行与插件复用；并分析持久化修订对知识共享与组织工作流的影响，及其在科学可靠性、物理安全与制度问责方面的意涵。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的 Harness RSI 部署需要持续验证：随任务分布与评估器变化而更新，并对学习过程、运行时权限与高后果动作设置独立的安全保障。论文提供涵盖相关工作、理论、算法、评估、应用与广泛影响的 66 页综合讨论，并在 https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI 持续更新代码与补充材料。

title: Coupled Harness--Model Evolution for Scientific Equation Discovery
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to discover scientific equations from experimental data. Such a discovery system has two parts that must work together: a library of executable computational tools and the model's tool-use policy. The tools supply the solving capability, from diagnosing structure in the data to fitting candidate equations; the policy plans and orchestrates their use. Yet existing systems adapt only one part, keeping either the toolset or the model fixed, which leaves the corresponding failures uncorrectable. We develop a coupled evolution framework that improves both parts from the same verifiable fit-error signal. In the tool-evolution phase, an agent grows an executable tool library from a small set of generic numerical operations by diagnosing its own failures: it authors a new tool when a capability is missing and revises its selection rules when the right tool went unused. In the policy-evolution phase, a small open model (roughly 3B active parameters) is fine-tuned on successful tool-use trajectories collected with the frozen library, on training formulas screened to be disjoint from all evaluation benchmarks. Ablations show the two phases are complementary: with no tool library at all the same model solves almost nothing, the tools account for most of the gain, and trajectory training adds a further gain that is largest on the most difficult problems. The full system solves 79.1/71.3\% of LSR-Synth problems at fit tolerances $10^{-2}$/$10^{-3}$, reaches 63.8\% pooled accuracy on the distributionally different SRSD-Feynman panel, and obtains a normalized CP3-28 aggregate of $-7.27$. These results suggest a broader recipe for scientific agents: let the model and its instruments improve each other under verifiable feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出耦合演化框架，让LLM科学智能体的工具库与工具使用策略从同一可验证拟合误差信号中协同进化，在方程发现任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有从实验数据发现科学方程的系统包含可执行工具库与模型工具使用策略两部分，但已有工作只固定并适配其中一部分，导致另一部分对应的失败无法被纠正。
AI.method: 耦合演化框架：工具演化阶段中，智能体通过诊断自身失败，从少量通用数值操作出发扩展可执行工具库，缺失能力时新写工具、选错工具时修正选择规则；策略演化阶段中，用冻结工具库采集成功工具使用轨迹，并在与所有评测基准不相交的训练公式上微调约3B激活参数的小开源模型。
AI.result: 消融显示两阶段互补：无工具库时同一模型几乎解不出题，工具贡献主要增益，轨迹训练在最难问题上增益最大。完整系统在LSR-Synth上于10^-2/10^-3拟合容差下解出79.1%/71.3%，在分布不同的SRSD-Feynman面板上取得63.8%汇总准确率，CP3-28归一化聚合为-7.27。
AI.conclusion: 结果为科学智能体提供更广泛的范式：在可验证反馈下让模型与其工具相互改进。

title: When, Where, and Why: Hierarchical Causal Explainability for Video Face Understanding with MLLMs
summary: Understanding facial behaviour in video requires answering three fundamental questions: when a key facial expression occurs, where the model attends on the face at that moment, and why that evidence is necessary rather than merely correlated. Today's multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can label and describe video, but they rarely provide faithful explanations, especially for small facial movements that change over time. We present VideoFace-X-LLM, a framework for explainable facial video understanding comprising two key components. First, we introduce ExplainFace, a weakly supervised video-text corpus for facial behaviour understanding, automatically constructed from CelebV-HQ videos and validated through human evaluation and a two-model audit (at most 2.3% contradictions), demonstrating consistent gains across two backbone architectures. Second, H-TCC (Hierarchical Temporal Spatial Causal Concepts), which finds the key temporal moments (When), the facial regions (Where), and verifies its causal necessity (Why) through targeted occlusion. Fine-tuning on ExplainFace raises appearance Macro F1 from 19.48% to 32.87% (+13.39), with gains of +4.38 on actions, +6.77 on temporal emotion, and +11.84 F1 on deepfake detection. We also measure the explanations pointing lift, face/edge lift, stability, an Adebayo sanity check, and a necessity test rather than only showing examples. Our models, code, and corpus are available on request for research use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VideoFace-X-LLM 可解释人脸视频理解框架，包含弱监督视频-文本语料 ExplainFace 与层级时空因果概念模块 H-TCC，回答表情识别中的 When/Where/Why 三问，并在多项任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 视频人脸行为理解需要回答三个基本问题：关键表情何时发生（When）、模型当时关注脸部何处（Where）、为何该证据是必要的而非仅相关（Why）。现有多模态大模型（MLLM）虽能标注和描述视频，但鲜有忠实解释，尤其难以处理随时间变化的细微面部动作，因此亟需可解释的人脸视频理解方案。
AI.method: 框架由两部分构成：(1) ExplainFace，一个弱监督视频-文本语料，由 CelebV-HQ 视频自动构建，并经人工评估与双模型审计（矛盾率至多 2.3%）验证；(2) H-TCC（层级时序空间因果概念），定位关键时间时刻（When）与人脸区域（Where），并通过定向遮挡验证其因果必要性（Why）。
AI.result: 在 ExplainFace 上微调使外观 Macro F1 从 19.48% 提升至 32.87%（+13.39），动作 +4.38、时序情绪 +6.77、深度伪造检测 +11.84 F1；并在两种骨干架构上取得一致增益。评估不仅展示示例，还测量解释的指向提升、人脸/边缘提升、稳定性、Adebayo 合理性检验及必要性测试。
AI.conclusion: VideoFace-X-LLM 通过弱监督语料与因果概念模块实现了对视频人脸行为的可解释理解，在多个任务上显著提升性能并提供系统化的解释质量评估，模型、代码与语料可依研究申请获取。

title: Read the Room Before Your Model Generates
summary: Large language models (LLMs) generally rely on sampling temperature to regulate the amount of randomness in their outputs. Mainstream methods for selecting temperature typically involve fixed, heuristic global settings and context or token-level calibration, rather than a geometrically interpretable representation of the communicative scenario. In this work, we introduce a simple and interpretable temperature selection framework, the Scenario-Actor, which adapts decoding to the inferred situational characteristics. Scenario-Actor extracts scenario-relevant structures from Transformer hidden states and determines the temperature from scenario embedding, a structured geometric representation of the communicative setting. Empirical results show that on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Scenario-Actor achieves strong goal-completion performance in interactive social scenarios, significant gains on open-ended instruction following, and competitive performance on multi-turn conversation compared to multiple baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Scenario-Actor框架，从Transformer隐状态中提取场景相关结构，并用场景嵌入这一可几何解释的表示来确定解码温度，替代固定启发式或上下文/词元级校准方法。在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，该方法在交互式社交场景目标完成、开放式指令跟随及多轮对话中均取得有竞争力或显著更优的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM温度选择方法多为固定的启发式全局设置或上下文/词元级校准，缺乏对交际场景的可几何解释的表示，难以根据情境特征自适应调节输出随机性。
AI.method: 提出Scenario-Actor框架：从Transformer隐状态中提取场景相关结构，构建场景嵌入（对交际情境的结构化几何表示），并据此推断情境特征以确定解码温度，实现解码对场景的自适应。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，Scenario-Actor在交互式社交场景中取得较强的目标完成性能，在开放式指令跟随任务上获得显著提升，并在多轮对话中相较多个基线具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于场景几何表示的温度选择是一种简单且可解释的有效方案，能提升LLM在多样化交互场景中的解码质量。

title: Instructions Are Evidence, Not Objectives: Measuring Outcome Alignment of Agents
summary: Large language model agents can follow complex human instructions to solve real-world tasks. In practice, however, initial instructions are often incomplete. In our analysis of 100 user-agent trajectories from SWE-chat, 56\% of initial instructions omit requirements that later emerge as necessary, and 52\% of the useful follow-up requirements could have been inferred from the project. A user states requirements from their own understanding of the task, and these \textbf{stated requirements} often differ from the \textbf{true requirements} that completing the task imposes. An agent should therefore treat the instruction as evidence rather than as the objective, inferring the true requirements from the instruction and the environment and satisfying them even when the user is not yet aware of all of them. We call this ability \textbf{outcome alignment}. In this work, we construct \textbf{TiGanEval}, a benchmark of software engineering and research tasks. In every task the user genuinely lacks part of the requirements, each requirement stays discoverable from the code and runtime behaviour of the environment, and requirements the agent infers are separated from those the user adds after observing delivered work. These properties together make outcome alignment measurable. Evaluating eight frontier models including GPT-5.6-Sol, we find outcome alignment broadly missing: the models lose 53 to 67 points of success rate when moving from the full specification to the partial instruction, and consequence feedback across four submissions does not close the gap. Furthermore, a plan-mode harness cannot compensate for the missing ability of the model itself, which places outcome alignment among the abilities the next generation of models should be developed for.

AI.tldr: 本文将"用户陈述需求≠任务真实需求"的现象形式化为"结果对齐"能力，构建了TiGanEval基准（软件工程与研究任务），评测八个前沿模型，发现结果对齐普遍缺失：从完整规范切换到部分指令后成功率下降53–67分，且后果反馈无法弥补。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中用户初始指令常不完整：作者分析SWE-chat的100条用户-智能体轨迹，发现56%的初始指令遗漏了后续才显现的必要需求，52%的有用后续需求本可从项目中推断出来。用户基于自身理解陈述需求，而"陈述需求"与完成任务所强加的"真实需求"往往不一致，因此智能体应把指令当作证据而非目标本身，主动从指令与环境推断并满足真实需求。
AI.method: 提出"结果对齐"（outcome alignment）概念，即智能体从指令与环境推断真实需求并在用户未察觉时也予以满足的能力。构建TiGanEval基准，覆盖软件工程与研究任务；每个任务中用户确实缺失部分需求，且该需求可从环境代码与运行时行为中发现；并区分"智能体推断出的需求"与"用户在观察交付成果后追加的需求"，从而实现对结果对齐的可测量化。
AI.result: 评测包括GPT-5.6-Sol在内的八个前沿模型，结果显示结果对齐能力普遍缺失：从完整规范转向部分指令时，模型成功率下降53至67分；四次提交的后果反馈（consequence feedback）也未能弥合该差距。此外，plan-mode式的脚手架无法弥补模型自身能力的缺失。
AI.conclusion: 结果对齐是当前模型普遍欠缺的能力，且无法通过外部harness或反馈机制替代，应被列为下一代模型需要重点发展的能力之一。

title: MHVF: Training-Free GUI Grounding via Verification-Guided Multi-Hypothesis Search
summary: GUI grounding enables web agents to translate natural-language instructions into actionable interface locations. However, dense layouts and small, visually similar controls can lead models toward plausible but incorrect elements, while refinement around a single prediction may leave alternative targets unexplored. We propose the Multi-Hypothesis Verification Framework (MHVF) for training-free GUI grounding. It combines multi-hypothesis exploration with local visual verification using a single pretrained vision-language model. To explore alternative targets, MHVF constructs spatial hypotheses from multiple full-screen predictions and examines the corresponding regions through zoomed re-localization. To resolve ambiguity among the resulting candidates, it verifies their agreement with the instruction in marked local views. Verification scores then guide a second round of local search and rank candidates retained from both search levels for final selection. Experiments with five general-purpose and GUI-specific models across eight benchmark settings demonstrate improvements in grounding accuracy in most settings. MHVF improves UI-Venus-Ground-7B by 4.3 and 2.1 percentage points on Mind2Web and VisualWebBench, respectively, and raises Qwen2.5-VL-7B's accuracy on ScreenSpot-Pro from 23.6% to 53.6%.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的多假设验证框架 MHVF，通过多假设探索与局部视觉验证提升 GUI grounding 精度。
AI.motivation: GUI 界面布局密集、控件小且视觉相似，模型易选中看似合理但错误的元素；仅围绕单一预测进行修正会遗漏其他候选目标。
AI.method: MHVF 结合多假设探索与局部视觉验证，使用单一预训练视觉语言模型：先由多次全屏预测构造空间假设，并通过放大重定位检查对应区域；再在标记的局部视图中验证候选与指令的一致性；验证分数引导第二轮局部搜索，并对两轮搜索保留的候选统一排序以作最终选择。
AI.result: 在五种通用及 GUI 专用模型、八个基准设置上多数取得精度提升；UI-Venus-Ground-7B 在 Mind2Web 和 VisualWebBench 上分别提升 4.3 和 2.1 个百分点，Qwen2.5-VL-7B 在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上由 23.6% 提升至 53.6%。
AI.conclusion: 多假设探索与局部视觉验证相结合，可在免训练条件下有效缓解密集界面中的定位歧义，显著提升 GUI grounding 准确率。

title: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
summary: With the rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), evaluating their video understanding capabilities has become increasingly important. Existing video understanding benchmarks cover only part of the evaluation dimensions, limiting systematic diagnosis of omni-modal video understanding. We introduce OmniCompass, a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding. OmniCompass defines two evaluation tracks: OmniCompass-VL assesses vision-language models on tasks requiring visual evidence, while OmniCompass-AV assesses omni-modal models on tasks requiring joint audio-visual evidence. Each track includes three complementary tasks: temporal grounding (TG), spatial grounding (SG), and question answering (QA), assessing when a referenced target appears, where it is, and what happens. QA covers five perception and three reasoning categories in OmniCompass-VL, and three perception and two reasoning categories in OmniCompass-AV. OmniCompass-VL contains 820 videos and 2,460 instances across domains and three duration types: short, medium, and long. A narrative- and audio-rich subset forms OmniCompass-AV with 240 videos and 720 instances. Each instance is evaluated under two paired settings: text-only and text+image, specifying the same target through text and visual-language guidance. All instances are manually annotated with multi-round quality verification. Evaluations of 50 MLLMs show that open-source models still lag behind proprietary counterparts, particularly in audio-visual understanding. Precise temporal and spatial grounding remains challenging even for leading models, and their predictions still exhibit inconsistencies across the paired target specifications.

AI.tldr: 提出 OmniCompass 全模态视频理解基准，含 VL 与 AV 两条评测轨道及时间定位、空间定位、问答三类任务，评估 50 个 MLLM 后发现开源模型仍落后于闭源模型，时空定位与视听理解仍是难点。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型（MLLM）的视频理解评测基准仅覆盖部分评测维度，无法对全模态视频理解进行系统性诊断，因此需要构建更全面的基准。
AI.method: 设计 OmniCompass 基准，包含两条评测轨道：OmniCompass-VL（基于视觉证据的视觉-语言模型）与 OmniCompass-AV（基于联合视听证据的全模态模型）。每条轨道含时间定位（TG）、空间定位（SG）、问答（QA）三类互补任务。QA 在 VL 中覆盖 5 类感知与 3 类推理，在 AV 中覆盖 3 类感知与 2 类推理。VL 含 820 段视频、2460 个实例，覆盖多领域及短/中/长三种时长；其叙事与音频丰富子集构成 AV，含 240 段视频、720 个实例。每个实例在纯文本与文本+图像两种配对设置下评测，所有实例经多轮人工标注与质量校验。
AI.result: 对 50 个 MLLM 的评测显示：开源模型仍落后于闭源模型，尤其在视听理解方面；即使领先模型在精确时间与空间定位上仍面临挑战，且其预测在配对的目标指定方式之间存在不一致性。
AI.conclusion: OmniCompass 提供了覆盖多维度、多任务、多设置的全模态视频理解评测框架，揭示了当前 MLLM 在视听理解与细粒度时空定位上的不足，为后续模型改进提供系统化诊断依据。

title: Autonomous 3D Visual-Thermal Inspection for Utility-Scale Solar Farms
comment: Accepted at the 2026 Asia-Pacific Solar Research Conference (APSRC 2026), Canberra, Australia, 1-3 December 2026
summary: Utility-scale photovoltaic (PV) inspection is dominated by aerial surveys, which are effective for identifying module-level hot cells but provide limited visibility of critical components located under the array, including connectors, cabling, fasteners and structural elements. These assets are difficult to inspect consistently at scale, and their defects are often spatially small, partially occluded and difficult to localise from isolated images. We present an automated 3D visual-thermal inspection system (Tricorder) for under-panel PV asset inspection. The approach combines LiDAR-inertial Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) with geometrically calibrated RGB and thermal imagery and machine-learning-based object detection and segmentation. Detected assets are associated with the reconstructed 3D environment, allowing visual and thermal observations from multiple viewpoints to be spatially fused and localised. We demonstrate the approach on utility-scale PV data for MC4 connector detection and connection-state recognition, thermal anomaly identification, and detection of structural components including bolts, nuts and torque tubes. The results demonstrate a pathway from image-based inspection toward spatially grounded autonomous inspection, where defects are detected and linked to specific assets and their 3D locations within the solar farm.

AI.tldr: 提出Tricorder自动化三维视觉-热成像检测系统，结合LiDAR-惯性SLAM与几何标定RGB/热成像及机器学习检测分割，实现光伏板下组件缺陷的空间定位与融合识别。
AI.motivation: 公用事业规模光伏检测主要依赖航拍，虽能识别组件级热斑，但对阵列下方的关键部件（连接器、线缆、紧固件、结构件）可见性有限。这些资产难以大规模一致检测，缺陷空间尺度小、部分被遮挡，且难以从孤立图像中定位。
AI.method: 将LiDAR-惯性SLAM与几何标定的RGB和热成像结合，并采用基于机器学习的目标检测与分割；将检测到的资产与重建的三维环境关联，从而对多视角的视觉和热成像观测进行空间融合与定位。
AI.result: 在公用事业规模光伏数据上验证了MC4连接器检测与连接状态识别、热异常识别，以及包括螺栓、螺母和扭矩管在内的结构部件检测。
AI.conclusion: 结果展示了从基于图像的检测向空间基础的自主检测转变的路径，其中缺陷被检测并与特定资产及其在太阳能场中的三维位置相关联。

title: Multimodal Fusion of RGB and Complementary Modalities for Semantic Segmentation
comment: This work is submitted to the IJCV journal
summary: Multi-modal semantic segmentation adds an auxiliary sensing stream to RGB images (RGB-X), such as thermal, LiDAR, depth, event, polarization, or light field. This can improve robustness in poor lighting and under motion blur. But different sensors often produce features that do not match well, and fusion can become unstable. To alleviate these issues, we propose a bidirectional polarity-aware cross-modality fusion (BPCF) module that effectively captures complementary cues while enhancing feature alignment. We evaluate the framework on six modality pairings: RGB-Thermal, RGB-LiDAR, RGB-Depth, RGB-Event, RGB-Polarization, and RGB-Light Field. Our model achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on eight public datasets, including MFNet, KITTI-360, DELIVER, DDD17, DSEC, MCubeS, ZJU, and UrbanLF. The codes and trained models will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出双向极性感知跨模态融合模块BPCF，用于RGB-X多模态语义分割，在六种模态组合、八个公开数据集上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多模态语义分割通过为RGB图像引入辅助传感流（如热成像、LiDAR、深度、事件、偏振、光场），可提升弱光与运动模糊下的鲁棒性。但不同传感器产生的特征往往匹配度不高，导致融合不稳定。
AI.method: 提出双向极性感知跨模态融合（BPCF）模块，在有效捕获互补线索的同时增强特征对齐。
AI.result: 在六种模态配对（RGB-热成像、RGB-LiDAR、RGB-深度、RGB-事件、RGB-偏振、RGB-光场）上评估，于八个公开数据集（MFNet、KITTI-360、DELIVER、DDD17、DSEC、MCubeS、ZJU、UrbanLF）取得SOTA。
AI.conclusion: BPCF能缓解跨模态特征失配与融合不稳定问题，在多种模态组合与数据集上验证有效性；代码与训练模型将在接收后开源。

title: The Last Remote Sensing Model Built by Humans? Casting Any Earth Observation Task as Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Earth observation (EO) models are still built by hand. For each new task, experts design a training recipe and tune it against a benchmark. We show that this loop can be handed to an agent. Any verifiable task can be cast as a harness and a verifier, where the harness defines what the agent may use and the verifier defines what counts as success. Every EO task can be made verifiable, through labeled benchmarks, independent sensors, physical models or the repeated observation of the same place. Given only these two components, a general-purpose coding agent builds the EO model and improves it recursively on its own outputs. Settings long treated as separate research problems, from learning with a handful of labels to adapting across domains, become choices of harness and verifier. On four EO benchmarks spanning optical, SAR and multispectral time-series imagery, agent-built models surpass the state of the art and keep most of that accuracy from about 1% of the training labels. This establishes a new paradigm for EO, in which people design harnesses and verifiers and agents build the models, so EO models improve as agents do.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将地球观测（EO）模型的构建自动化：把任意可验证任务形式化为“harness（工具约束）+ verifier（成功判定）”两部分，由通用编码智能体递归地构建并改进EO模型，在四个基准上超越现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 当前EO模型仍依赖人工构建——专家需为每个新任务手工设计训练方案并针对基准调参，流程繁琐且不可复用。作者希望将这一“设计-调参”闭环交给智能体，从而把分散的研究问题统一到同一范式下。
AI.method: 将任何可验证任务归结为 harness 与 verifier：harness 规定智能体可使用的资源，verifier 定义成功标准。EO任务可通过标注基准、独立传感器、物理模型或同一地点的重复观测实现可验证性。仅给定这两部分，通用编码智能体即可自主构建EO模型，并基于自身输出递归优化。少样本学习、跨域适应等原本独立的研究问题，被转化为 harness 与 verifier 的选择问题。
AI.result: 在覆盖光学、SAR及多光谱时间序列影像的四个EO基准上，智能体构建的模型超越了当前最优水平（SOTA），并且在使用约1%训练标签的情况下仍能保持大部分精度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了EO领域的新范式：人类负责设计 harness 与 verifier，智能体负责构建模型；由此EO模型的能力可随智能体能力的提升而同步提升。

title: Memory Echo in Single-Agent Long-Term Memory: Lifecycle Evaluation and Provenance-Guided Mitigation
summary: Long-term memory supports agents across sessions. Repeated retrieval and write-back can let one historical claim occupy multiple retrieval positions and influence current answers without independent evidence. Existing work examines retrieval, updating, and question answering, leaving same-source record accumulation and post-correction persistence underexplored. Motivated by research in social cognition and memory psychology on repeated exposure, retrieval, and revision, we define \emph{Memory Echo} as the excess retrieval exposure gained by historical information from the same source without additional independent evidence, and introduce MEchoBench to evaluate its emergence, correction resistance, persistence, and effect on answers. To address this phenomenon, we introduce the Family--Provenance--Authority framework (FPA). Specifically, FPA selects one representative per source family, conditions the eligibility of old records for the answer context on verified corrections, and constrains final answers with authoritative evidence. In paired replay on 190 fixed questions across four memory frameworks, FPA raises accuracy from 0.825 to 0.920 with DeepSeek V4 Flash and from 0.782 to 0.916 with Kimi K2.6; mean Decision Contamination Effect falls from 0.106 to 0.030 and from 0.109 to 0.038, respectively. These results show that agent memory can preserve traceable history without allowing repeated historical information to govern current decisions. The code is available at https://github.com/OrcasSam/memory-echo-benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该论文定义了"记忆回声"（Memory Echo）现象，即同一来源的历史信息经反复检索与回写后获得超额检索暴露度，并提出FPA框架加以抑制，在MEchoBench上验证效果。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆使智能体具备跨会话能力，但重复检索与回写会让同一历史论断占据多个检索位置，在当前回答中发挥作用却无独立证据支撑。已有研究多关注检索、更新与问答，对同源记录累积及纠正后残留问题探讨不足；本文受社会认知与记忆心理学中重复暴露、检索与修正研究启发，提出该问题。
AI.method: 定义"记忆回声"为同源历史信息在无额外独立证据情况下获得的超额检索暴露，并构建MEchoBench基准，从现象涌现、纠正抵抗、持续性与对答案影响四个维度评估。提出Family–Provenance–Authority（FPA）框架：按来源家族选取唯一代表记录，将旧记录进入答案上下文的条件绑定于已验证的纠正，并以权威证据约束最终答案。
AI.result: 在四种记忆框架、190个固定问题的配对重放中，FPA使准确率从0.825提升至0.920（DeepSeek V4 Flash），从0.782提升至0.916（Kimi K2.6）；平均决策污染效应分别从0.106降至0.030、从0.109降至0.038。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，智能体记忆可保留可追溯的历史信息，同时避免重复历史信息主导当前决策。代码已开源。

title: SPARCL: Spatially Adaptive Regional Coverage for Active Learning in Chest X-ray Analysis
summary: Pixel-level annotation for chest X-ray (CXR) lesion segmentation is expensive, making active learning (AL) essential. However, existing AL strategies fail to account for the spatial distribution of selected samples, resulting in inconsistent performance across focal (e.g., aortic calcification) and diffuse (e.g., nodules) pathologies. In this paper, we propose SPARCL (Spatially Adaptive Regional Coverage for Active Learning) to dynamically balance predictive uncertainty with cumulative spatial coverage. By employing a concave coverage function, SPARCL imposes diminishing returns on previously annotated regions, naturally directing the annotation budget toward under-labeled areas. Furthermore, an entropy gate reverts the algorithm to standard uncertainty sampling when spatial variation is absent. This coverage objective is monotone submodular, guaranteeing near-optimal greedy batch selection. To address how aggregate metrics like Dice obscure regional failures, we further introduce two metrics---Spatial Inconsistency (SI) and Performance Coverage (PC)---to quantify anatomical fairness across AL rounds. Evaluated on an in-house calcification cohort and public CXR benchmarks, SPARCL reaches 95% of fully supervised performance using only 24% of the data, compared to 29% for the best baseline. Ultimately, SPARCL ensures robust spatial reliability, surfacing regional gains that aggregate metrics miss.

AI.tldr: 提出SPARCL主动学习策略，通过空间自适应区域覆盖平衡预测不确定性与累积空间覆盖，在胸部X光病灶分割中以更少标注量达到全监督性能，并引入SI与PC两个空间公平性指标。
AI.motivation: 胸部X光病灶分割的像素级标注成本高昂，主动学习至关重要。然而现有主动学习策略未考虑所选样本的空间分布，导致在聚焦型（如主动脉钙化）与弥散型（如结节）病理上性能不一致。
AI.method: 提出SPARCL（空间自适应区域覆盖主动学习）：用凹覆盖函数对已标注区域施加递减收益，将标注预算导向标注不足区域；熵门控在空间变化缺失时回退到标准不确定性采样；该覆盖目标为单调子模，保证近优的贪心批选择。此外引入空间不一致性(SI)与性能覆盖率(PC)两个指标量化各轮次的解剖公平性。
AI.result: 在内部钙化队列与公开CXR基准上，SPARCL仅用24%数据达到全监督性能的95%，最佳基线需29%。
AI.conclusion: SPARCL保证稳健的空间可靠性，揭示聚合指标（如Dice）所掩盖的区域性收益。

title: Agentic4PDM: Host-Governed Evidence Admissibility for Industrial Fault Diagnosis
summary: We study industrial fault diagnosis as a classification task that assigns sensor time-series windows to predefined health states or fault types. Scarce labels and changing operating conditions make repeated training of specialized classifiers costly. Yet structures such as periodicity, trends, and transients can remain diagnostically informative and be examined through reusable analytical tools. LLM agents can select and interpret these tools, but fixed rules or training-derived guidance may not resolve each signal's ambiguity, while unconstrained interpretation may overstate weak or conflicting results. We introduce Agentic4PDM, a framework that separates adaptive investigation from control over evidence use. LLM agents compare each signal with labeled references from every candidate class, identify unresolved distinctions, and propose follow-up measurements. A deterministic software controller, called the host, enforces contract-checked gated adjudication (CCGA): it checks requests, requires commitment to a complete tool batch before results are observed, and assigns evidence roles based on tool checks against labeled references. These roles distinguish corroborative support from advisory information. The Judge Agent proposes a diagnosis, while the controller checks protocol compliance and records the investigation. Agentic4PDM supports training-free diagnosis using pretrained representations and labeled references without task-specific diagnostic models, and a standard setting that additionally investigates trained-model predictions. Experiments on selected bearing and motor diagnosis challenges and an unfiltered industrial test set supplied by our customer show gains in aggregate macro F1 over the evaluated diagnostic and agentic baselines. Ablations further support the value of the governed workflow.

AI.tldr: 提出Agentic4PDM框架，将LLM智能体的自适应调查与确定性控制器对证据使用的约束分离，实现免训练工业故障诊断，在轴承、电机及真实工业数据集上宏F1优于基线。
AI.motivation: 工业故障诊断受标签稀缺与工况变化影响，专用分类器重复训练成本高；信号中的周期性、趋势、瞬态等结构具有诊断价值且可由可复用分析工具提取。LLM智能体虽能选择与解读工具，但固定规则或训练导出的指导难以消解每个信号的歧义，而无约束的解读又会夸大微弱或冲突的证据。
AI.method: Agentic4PDM将自适应调查与证据使用控制分离。LLM智能体将每个信号与各候选类别的标注参考进行比较，识别未消解的差异并提出后续测量。确定性软件控制器（host）执行契约校验门控裁决（CCGA）：校验请求，要求智能体在观测结果前承诺提交完整工具批次，并依据工具相对标注参考的检查结果分配证据角色，区分确证性支持与参考性信息。Judge Agent提出诊断，控制器核查协议合规性并记录调查过程。支持免训练诊断（基于预训练表征与标注参考，无任务专用诊断模型）以及额外调查已训练模型预测的标准设置。
AI.result: 在选定的轴承与电机诊断任务及客户提供的未过滤工业测试集上，聚合宏F1相较所评估的诊断与智能体基线均有提升；消融实验进一步支持受治理工作流的价值。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM智能体的自适应工具调查与确定性控制器的证据门控相结合，可在不训练任务专用模型的情况下提升工业故障诊断性能，受治理的工作流对结果有实质贡献。

title: QK-Edit: Revisiting Attention-based Injection in MM-DiT for Image and Video Editing
summary: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have recently emerged as a powerful framework for unified text-vision synthesis, surpassing traditional U-Net architectures in generative tasks. One key innovation lies in its Multimodal Self-Attention (MM-SA) interaction, where image and text tokens are concatenated and processed via self-attention. However, this mechanism poses significant challenges for editing, rendering conventional U-Net-based attention manipulation methods ineffective. To address this limitation, we propose QK-Edit, a training-free framework that exploits the unique attention dynamics of MM-DiTs for precise text-guided image and video editing. By introducing a novel query-key manipulation strategy, our method isolates and adjusts critical attention components to achieve an optimal balance between prompt fidelity and structural consistency. This enables seamless edits across various tasks, including object addition, object removal, object replacement, changing background, changing material, changing color, and style transformation. Notably, it can be easily implemented with feature replacement in inference. QK-Edit demonstrates superior editing performance on state-of-the-art models, such as FLUX and HunyuanVideo, effectively bridging the gap between generative power and editable flexibility in MM-DiTs, and paving the way for scalable multimodal content creation.

AI.tldr: 提出QK-Edit，一种免训练框架，利用MM-DiT中多模态自注意力的独特动态特性，实现对图像与视频的精确文本引导编辑。
AI.motivation: MM-DiT已成为统一文生图/视频的强大框架，其多模态自注意力将图像与文本token拼接后共同处理，导致传统基于U-Net的注意力操控方法失效，亟需针对该新架构的编辑方案。
AI.method: 提出QK-Edit，通过新颖的query-key操纵策略，分离并调节关键注意力分量，在提示词保真度与结构一致性之间取得最优平衡；可在推理阶段以特征替换方式轻松实现，无需训练。
AI.result: 在FLUX、HunyuanVideo等先进模型上展现出更优的编辑性能，支持物体添加、删除、替换、背景/材质/颜色更改及风格转换等多种任务。
AI.conclusion: QK-Edit弥合了MM-DiT生成能力与可编辑灵活性之间的差距，为可扩展的多模态内容创作开辟了道路。

title: Empowering Edge Agents: A Systematic Analysis of Edge-Cloud Collaboration in LLM Agent Execution
summary: Edge-cloud collaboration combines the lower inference overhead and greater data locality of edge-side execution with the stronger capabilities of cloud-hosted models. However, as LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon scenarios, cloud participation becomes interleaved throughout execution rather than a one-shot decision for each query. Such interleaved participation introduces trajectory-level effects that remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we introduce EC2-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating edge-cloud collaboration in long-horizon agent execution. It provides executable digital-workspace agent tasks and a unified evaluation framework covering task performance, resource usage, and privacy exposure. Using this benchmark, we empirically study diverse forms of edge-cloud collaboration. Our study reveals three findings. First, collaboration achieves a favorable balance among task performance, resource usage, and privacy exposure compared with edge-only and cloud-only execution. Second, as edge models become stronger, collaborative execution approaches cloud-only performance, and performance differences across strategies shrink, while privacy exposure remains strongly strategy-dependent. Third, stronger edge capability shifts preferred collaboration from externally controlled cloud participation and direct cloud execution toward more edge-controlled collaboration. Further analyses identify cloud-invocation decision-making and instruction following as important edge-side abilities for effective collaboration. These findings provide a systematic understanding of edge-cloud collaboration in long-horizon agent execution and insights for designing future edge agents that effectively collaborate with cloud models. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/EC2-Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EC2-Bench，用于评估长时程智能体执行中的边云协作，涵盖任务性能、资源使用与隐私暴露；实验揭示三个主要发现。
AI.motivation: 边云协作兼具边缘低推理开销/数据本地性与云端强模型能力，但LLM智能体在长时程场景中云参与是交织式的，产生轨迹级效应，现有理解不足。
AI.method: 构建EC2-Bench基准，提供可执行的数字工作空间智能体任务与统一评测框架（任务性能、资源使用、隐私暴露），并实证研究多种边云协作形式。
AI.result: 1）协作在执行性能、资源与隐私间取得较好平衡；2）边缘模型增强后协作接近纯云性能、策略间性能差异缩小，但隐私暴露仍强依赖策略；3）边缘能力增强使偏好从外部控制的云参与与直接云执行转向边缘控制型协作。
AI.conclusion: 进一步分析识别云调用决策与指令遵循为有效协作的关键边缘侧能力，为长时程边云协作智能体设计提供系统认识与启示。

title: What Makes a Good Visual Representation for Spatial Understanding in MLLMs?
comment: Extended version of Neurips 2025 paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01946
summary: Spatial understanding is a necessary step in moving multimodal large language models (MLLMs) toward reasoning about the 3D physical world. Their visual pretraining data, however, is almost entirely 2D, so the visual tokens processed by MLLMs often lack inherent 3D structural information. A growing number of methods inject such structure by transferring representations from external vision or geometry models, and collectively establish that such transfer helps. Behind these methods lies a largely underexplored question: what makes a visual representation good for spatial understanding? To answer it, we first separate what is transferred from how it is transferred, and then trace the resulting differences back to properties of the representations themselves. What we transfer comes from 3D geometry models, self-supervised image and video models, vision-language models, and generative models, in the form of latent features or explicit depth and point maps. We transfer it either by distillation, using it as a supervision target, or by fusion, feeding it as an additional input. We find that a representation's 3D structure correlates strongly with how much it helps, measured by cross-view consistency for latent features and by depth and reconstruction accuracy for explicit geometry. We further show that the form of a representation dictates the mechanism it needs. Latent features gain as much from fusion as from distillation; explicit geometry gains little from fusion, and most of its distillation gain depends on a geometry decoding head. Guided by these findings, we distill both latent features and explicit geometry into a single MLLM. Taking only RGB video as input, it consistently improves over its base model on both static 3D and dynamic 4D spatial reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性探讨"什么样的视觉表征有利于空间理解"，将"迁移什么"与"如何迁移"解耦，发现表征的3D结构与增益强相关，且表征形式决定所需迁移机制，并据此蒸馏隐特征与显式几何到单一MLLM中，在静态3D与动态4D基准上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）走向3D物理世界推理需具备空间理解能力，但其视觉预训练数据几乎全是2D，视觉token缺乏内在3D结构信息。现有方法通过从外部视觉或几何模型迁移表征来注入结构，且普遍证明有效，但"什么样的视觉表征才适合空间理解"这一根本问题仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 作者将"迁移什么"与"如何迁移"分离研究。迁移内容来自3D几何模型、自监督图像/视频模型、视觉语言模型和生成模型，形式为潜在特征或显式深度/点图；迁移方式分为蒸馏（作为监督目标）与融合（作为额外输入）。通过度量潜在特征的跨视图一致性、显式几何的深度与重建精度，量化表征3D结构与增益的关系，并考察表征形式与迁移机制的匹配性。
AI.result: 表征的3D结构与增益强相关：潜在特征以跨视图一致性度量，显式几何以深度与重建精度度量。表征形式决定所需机制：潜在特征从融合与蒸馏获益相当；显式几何从融合获益甚微，其蒸馏增益主要依赖几何解码头。据此将潜在特征与显式几何同时蒸馏进单一MLLM，仅以RGB视频为输入，在静态3D与动态4D空间推理基准上稳定优于基座模型。
AI.conclusion: 视觉表征的3D结构强度是其促进空间理解的关键因素，且不同形式的表征需要匹配不同的迁移机制。该分析性结论可指导设计：将隐式特征与显式几何联合蒸馏进单一MLLM，可有效提升其静态3D与动态4D空间推理能力，为MLLM空间理解提供可迁移的实证依据。

title: Benchmarking and Training Reward Models for Cross-Source Evidence Grounding in Search Agents
summary: Existing approaches to training and evaluating search agents focus heavily on final-answer quality, largely neglecting how generated answers map back to retrieved evidence. Recent methods track citations to enforce grounding, but citation support alone does not establish source independence or whether an answer appropriately handles conflicting evidence. We argue that credibility in open-web retrieval depends on principled cross-source evidence grounding that accounts for source independence and systematically attributes and adjudicates conflicting evidence, while hierarchical judgments of these grounding decisions provide a unified signal for training and evaluation. To this end, we propose an evaluation framework, Cross-Source Evidence Grounding (CSEG), that employs a fine-grained, six-layer decision tree over the complete search trajectory. We introduce CSEG-Bench and trainable reward models to provide targeted supervision following this framework. Our approach helps eliminating the severe data skew of natural trajectories by providing targeted coverage over complex, deep-layer decision paths, such as cross-source conflict resolution and nuanced attribution, that standard rollouts fail to capture. Specifically, (1) we define the hierarchy at label, node, and path levels; (2) we construct 1,160 verified trajectories over nine canonical paths by rewriting answers on real retrieved document pools, with independent frontier judges reproducing the entire gold path and human experts deciding inclusion; (3) we train CSEG-RM, which reaches 83.9% exact accuracy on our benchmark while lying on the performance-token efficiency Pareto frontier. Experiments that use this reward alone to supervise a frozen-retrieval answer policy raise the independently judged mean label from 2.83 to 4.19, and show that learning the hierarchy generalizes across layers at a fraction of frontier-judge cost.

AI.tldr: 提出跨源证据接地评测框架CSEG（六层决策树）及基准CSEG-Bench与奖励模型CSEG-RM，用于搜索智能体的训练与评测。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索智能体的训练与评测过度聚焦最终答案质量，忽视答案如何映射回检索证据。近期虽有引用追踪来强化grounding，但引用支持本身无法确立来源独立性，也无法判断答案是否恰当处理冲突证据。作者认为开放网络检索中的可信度应依赖有原则的跨源证据接地。
AI.method: 提出评测框架CSEG，在完整搜索轨迹上构建细粒度六层决策树，并在标签、节点、路径三个层级定义该层次结构。基于真实检索文档池改写答案，构建覆盖九条规范路径的1,160条已验证轨迹，由独立的前沿评判模型复现完整金标路径、人工专家裁定纳入。进而训练可训练奖励模型CSEG-RM，用于提供针对性监督。
AI.result: CSEG-RM在本基准上达到83.9%的精确准确率，并位于性能—Token效率的帕累托前沿。仅用该奖励监督冻结检索的答案策略，独立评判的平均标签从2.83提升至4.19，且学习该层次结构可跨层级泛化，成本仅为前沿评判模型的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 将可信度归结为跨源证据接地的分层判断，可作为训练与评测的统一信号；该方法通过定向覆盖深层复杂决策路径缓解自然轨迹的严重数据偏斜，实现高效、可泛化的搜索智能体监督。

title: DVTR-KD: Distilling Vision-Language Models via Intermediate Visual Token Reconstruction
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on diverse vision-language tasks, but their computational demands limit deployment under constrained budgets, particularly on edge devices. Many works focus on Knowledge Distillation (KD) and try to transfer knowledge from powerful teacher models to students. In addition to reducing model size, visual token compression provides a complementary route to efficiency, but introduces mismatched visual token counts that complicate direct token-wise knowledge transfer. To mitigate this, we propose DVTR-KD, a knowledge distillation framework based on \textbf{D}ense \textbf{V}isual \textbf{T}oken \textbf{R}econstruction, which reconstructs the teacher's dense visual tokens from the student's compressed tokens. We reconstruct visual states after the final LLM layer and at the input to an intermediate layer identified as important for visual-information readout. At the intermediate layer, reconstruction is supervised through the teacher's response predictions rather than by direct token-wise KL or MSE matching. An auxiliary attention-readout loss complements this response-level supervision by aligning how the student and the original teacher integrate contextual information when predicting responses. Evaluations on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that DVTR-KD improves the performance of token-compressed students while retaining the inference efficiency afforded by visual token compression.

AI.tldr: DVTR-KD：通过稠密视觉token重建进行知识蒸馏，解决视觉token压缩后师生token数不匹配问题，在保持推理效率的同时提升压缩学生模型性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型性能强但计算开销大，难以在边缘设备等预算受限场景部署。知识蒸馏可压缩模型、视觉token压缩可提升效率，但二者结合时师生视觉token数量不匹配，导致逐token知识迁移困难。
AI.method: 提出DVTR-KD框架，基于稠密视觉token重建：从学生的压缩token重建教师的稠密视觉token。重建在LLM最后一层之后，以及对视觉信息读取重要的中间层输入处进行。中间层重建以教师的响应预测为监督（而非逐token KL或MSE匹配），并辅以注意力读取损失，对齐师生在预测响应时整合上下文信息的方式。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上评估，DVTR-KD提升了token压缩学生模型的性能，同时保留了视觉token压缩带来的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: DVTR-KD通过稠密视觉token重建与响应级、注意力级监督，有效缓解token数不匹配问题，实现压缩学生模型性能与效率的兼顾。

title: Learning Adaptive Deliberation Control for Reliable Recognition with Multi-Agent Language Models
comment: 33 pages, including references and technical appendices. Supplementary data included in the ancillary files
summary: Multi-agent deliberation can improve recognition by criticizing and revising candidate answers, but fixed controls cannot respond to changes in disagreement or reasoning quality. We present an adaptive multi-agent controller (ADMA) that learns continuous policies for proposal, challenge, arbitration, and coordination while keeping the task model frozen. Shared trace features describe quality, agreement, and progress, while role-specific features support decentralized control during inference. One controller trained on legal and financial reasoning is transferred without policy updates to four textual and multimodal benchmarks and two successive task-model versions. With Qwen3.5 held fixed, ADMA-Full improves accuracy by 6.2-14.2 percentage points over Direct and by 2.8-3.0 points over ADMA-Fixed. Paired bootstrap ranges for the Full-Fixed comparison are positive on three tasks. Outcome decompositions show that recoveries exceed introduced errors, while process assessment records fewer false-consensus events and more supported correct outcomes. Transfer to Qwen3.6 remains task dependent, which bounds the generality of the learned policy. Median token and latency ratios are 14.3-18.7 and 7.8-16.5 relative to Direct. These results show that adaptive deliberation can improve fixed-model recognition when its task-dependent gains justify the additional computation.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应多智能体控制器ADMA，学习连续的提议、质疑、仲裁与协调策略，在任务模型冻结的前提下提升识别准确率，代价是显著增加计算开销。
AI.motivation: 多智能体审议通过批评与修订候选答案提升识别性能，但固定控制策略无法响应分歧程度或推理质量的变化，缺乏自适应性。
AI.method: ADMA在任务模型冻结条件下学习连续控制策略，涵盖提议、质疑、仲裁与协调四种角色；共享轨迹特征刻画质量、一致性与进展，角色专属特征支持推理阶段的去中心化控制。单一控制器在法律与金融推理上训练，并在不作策略更新的情况下迁移至四个文本与多模态基准及两个连续任务模型版本。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5固定时，ADMA-Full较Direct提升6.2–14.2个百分点，较ADMA-Fixed提升2.8–3.0个百分点，Full-Fixed配对自助法区间在三个任务上为正；结果分解显示修复多于引入的错误，过程评估显示虚假共识事件减少、有支撑的正确结果增多。迁移至Qwen3.6的表现依赖任务，限制了策略的通用性。中位token与延迟比相对Direct分别为14.3–18.7与7.8–16.5。
AI.conclusion: 自适应审议可在任务相关收益足以抵消额外计算开销时，改进固定模型的识别性能，但其可迁移性与通用性仍受任务依赖限制。

title: Frequency Routing and Identity Conditioning for Thermal-to-Visible Face Translation
summary: Thermal-to-visible (T2V) face translation has important applications in nighttime biometric recognition, low-light surveillance, and human interpretation of thermal observations. The task remains challenging because thermal images do not directly record visible appearance, while the cross-spectral cues useful for reconstruction vary across frequency components and semantic roles. Existing spatially conditioned models tend to process these cues through a homogeneous adaptation path and do not explicitly separate local structure from global identity. We propose FreqID-Control, a parameter-efficient framework that organizes thermal guidance according to spectral reliability and semantic role while preserving the pretrained generative prior. It combines frequency-routed low-rank adaptation, which allocates separate transformation subspaces to low-frequency structure and high-frequency detail, with shared cross-spectral identity conditioning, which supplies compact global identity tokens independently of spatial thermal tokens. A controlled analysis on MCXFace and SpeakingFaces provides the empirical basis for this design, revealing stable low-frequency correspondence and edge-localized detail correspondence. Experiments on both datasets demonstrate strong image fidelity and biometric identity preservation, while controlled ablations on MCXFace confirm the complementary contributions of frequency routing and shared identity conditioning.

AI.tldr: 提出 FreqID-Control 框架，通过频率路由低秩适配与共享跨谱身份条件，实现参数高效的热红外人脸到可见光人脸翻译。
AI.motivation: 热红外人脸到可见光人脸翻译在夜间生物识别、低光监控与热观测的人类解读中具有重要应用价值。但热红外人脸图像并不直接记录可见光外观，且对重建有用的跨谱线索在不同频率成分与语义角色之间差异显著。现有空间条件模型通常以同质化适配路径处理这些线索，未显式区分局部结构与全局身份信息。
AI.method: FreqID-Control 是一个参数高效框架，在保留预训练生成先验的同时，按谱可靠性与语义角色组织热红外引导。其核心包括两部分：一是频率路由低秩适配，为低频结构和高频细节分配独立的变换子空间；二是共享跨谱身份条件，在空间热红外 token 之外独立提供紧凑的全局身份 token。
AI.result: 在 MCXFace 与 SpeakingFaces 上进行的受控分析显示，低频对应关系稳定，细节对应关系集中于边缘区域。两个数据集上的实验表明该方法具有较高的图像保真度与生物识别身份保持能力；MCXFace 上的受控消融实验进一步验证了频率路由与共享身份条件的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: FreqID-Control 通过按频率可靠性与语义角色组织热红外引导，并结合频率路由低秩适配与共享跨谱身份条件，在参数高效的前提下实现了高质量的热红外人脸到可见光人脸翻译，同时有效保持身份信息，消融实验证实了各组件的互补作用。

title: Socratic Skill Learning: Interleaving Teaching and Practice for Transferable Agent Skills
summary: Agent Skills improve LLM agents by making task knowledge reusable across sessions. Learning transferable Skills requires evidence about a procedure and its conditions of use, which a successful task attempt can leave untested. We introduce Socratic Skill Learning (SSL), which interleaves expert teaching with Student practice. An Educator guides investigation while the Student remains the sole environment operator and Skill author, able to question, test, and adapt advice. To test reuse beyond the learning task, we construct SkillTransferBench, with 35 task families and 408 executable cases, pairing public variation specifications with held-out evaluation in fresh solver sessions. On the main 22-family, 155-case cohort, Fixed-Window SSL reaches 0.801 utility, versus 0.723 without a Skill, 0.761 for adapted Trace2Skill (trajectory distillation), and 0.751 for adapted SKILL-KD (contrastive distillation). Across three model pairs on shared families, interleaved guidance outperforms expert authoring and post-hoc teaching. Process analysis links guidance to Student writing and package revision; a case study shows the Student testing and refining a proposed procedure for later reuse. As demand for new lessons falls, the cost of fixed-window review grows. Issue-Guided SSL tracks unresolved questions across Skill revisions to select and focus review, reaching 0.805 utility with 61.7% fewer Educator tokens and 16.9% fewer total acquisition tokens than Fixed-Window SSL on the main cohort.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Socratic Skill Learning (SSL)，通过专家教学与学生实践交替进行，让智能体在学习任务之外实现技能可复用；并构建 SkillTransferBench 与后续的 Issue-Guided SSL 以降低教学成本。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体通过 Agent Skills 提升任务知识跨会话复用能力，但学习可迁移技能需要有关于流程及其适用条件的证据，而一次成功的任务尝试可能并未检验这些条件，难以保证技能迁移与复用。
AI.method: 提出 Socratic Skill Learning (SSL)，将专家教学与学生实践交替：Educator 引导探究，Student 是唯一的环境操作者与技能作者，可以质疑、测试和调整建议。构建 SkillTransferBench，包含 35 个任务族、408 个可执行案例，将公开变体规范与新生解题会话中的留出评估配对。进一步提出 Issue-Guided SSL，跨技能修订追踪未解决问题以选择并聚焦复习，从而在固定窗口复习成本上升时降低教学开销。
AI.result: 在主 22 个任务族、155 个案例队列上，Fixed-Window SSL 达到 0.801 utility；无 Skill 为 0.723，适配的 Trace2Skill（轨迹蒸馏）为 0.761，适配的 SKILL-KD（对比蒸馏）为 0.751。跨共享任务族的三个模型对中，交替式指导优于专家撰写与事后教学。过程分析将指导与学生的技能撰写和包修订相关联；案例研究表明学生测试并改进了提议流程以供后续复用。Issue-Guided SSL 在主队列上达到 0.805 utility，相比 Fixed-Window SSL 减少 61.7% 的 Educator tokens 和 16.9% 的总获取 tokens。
AI.conclusion: 交替式专家指导与学生实践能提升技能的可迁移复用效果，优于专家撰写和事后教学；Issue-Guided SSL 在保持 utility 的同时显著降低教学 token 成本，为高效技能学习与复用提供可行路径。

title: MicroCLIP: Connecting Text and Microscopy Images via Contrastive Language--Image Pretraining
summary: Understanding fluorescence microscopy images is fundamental to automating biological research. However, existing methods typically learn predefined concepts from closed-set data, limiting transfer across tasks and biological contexts. In this work, we introduce MicroCLIP, a vision-language model that learns generalizable cellular and subcellular representations from natural language supervision for open-set image classification and retrieval. To pretrain MicroCLIP, we construct MicroPool-2M, a dataset of approximately 2.5 million fluorescence microscopy image-text pairs spanning diverse cellular structures, cell lines, and imaging conditions. Aligning microscopy images with biological concepts in natural language is challenging because most images lack descriptive captions and biological knowledge annotations. We therefore progressively establish image-text associations at three levels to provide MicroCLIP with richer semantic supervision: (1) category-level alignment links images to standardized labels defined by subcellular structure-cell-line combinations; (2) knowledge-level alignment incorporates biological priors derived from these labels to capture relationships across species and cell types; and (3) detail-level alignment uses a multimodal large language model to recaption and verify image-text pairs at scale, emphasizing fine-grained visual characteristics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MicroCLIP achieves leading performance in zero-shot classification and text-image retrieval on microscopy images. It retrieves images with specific cellular characteristics from thousands of candidates and generalizes to unseen biological concepts without additional supervision. These results highlight MicroCLIP's potential as a foundation model for fluorescence microscopy.

AI.tldr: 提出MicroCLIP，一种从自然语言监督学习泛化性细胞与亚细胞表征的视觉-语言模型，用于开放集荧光显微图像分类与检索，并构建了约250万图文对的MicroPool-2M数据集。
AI.motivation: 荧光显微图像理解对生物研究自动化至关重要，但现有方法通常从封闭集数据中学习预定义概念，难以跨任务和生物语境迁移，缺乏开放集泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建MicroPool-2M（约250万荧光显微图文对，覆盖多样细胞结构、细胞系与成像条件）。针对多数图像缺乏描述性文本和生物学注释的问题，采用三级渐进式图文关联以提供更丰富语义监督：(1) 类别级对齐，将图像链接到由亚细胞结构-细胞系组合定义的标准化标签；(2) 知识级对齐，引入由标签衍生的生物学先验，捕获跨物种与细胞类型关系；(3) 细节级对齐，利用多模态大语言模型大规模重写与校验图文对，强调细粒度视觉特征。
AI.result: MicroCLIP在零样本分类与文本-图像检索上取得领先性能；能从数千候选图像中检索具有特定细胞特征的图像，并在无需额外监督下泛化到未见过的生物学概念。
AI.conclusion: MicroCLIP展现了作为荧光显微成像基础模型的潜力，实现开放集、可迁移的细胞与亚细胞表征学习。

title: ECMR: Evidence-Aware Deliberation Control for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning
comment: 32 pages, including references and technical appendices
summary: Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems typically commit to a deliberation protocol before inference. A fixed protocol cannot allocate computation differently to resolved and unresolved instances, and it may mistake repeated support for independent confirmation. We study this failure as semantic false consensus: a confident group answer supported by narrow, duplicated, or correlated rationales. We introduce ECMR, an evidence-aware controller over frozen role-conditioned LLMs. At each step, ECMR summarizes answer concentration, support diversity and independence, contradictions, role behavior, verification history, and remaining budget, then selects whether to propose, challenge, verify, arbitrate, diversify, correct a role, or stop. We formulate this decision as finite-horizon budgeted control and derive sufficient conditions under which state conditioning, risk-triggered verification, and role correction improve cost-adjusted utility. Across a declared held-out evaluation of 9,000 records from MedQA, CaseHOLD, and FinQA, ECMR-Full increases pooled accuracy from 62.1% to 84.9%, reduces false-consensus rate from 40.7% to 17.0%, and raises evidence-support rate from 58.0% to 88.7%. State shuffling loses 11.7 accuracy points with only 0.7 fewer rounds, while harder traces shift from early stopping toward arbitration. ECMR-Full uses the largest token budget, yielding the strongest absolute reliability rather than uniformly superior token efficiency.

AI.tldr: 论文提出证据感知控制器ECMR，通过在冻结的角色条件LLM上动态决定提议、质疑、验证、仲裁等动作，缓解多智能体LLM系统的“语义假共识”问题，在9,000条医学与金融数据上显著提升准确率并降低假共识率。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体LLM系统在推理前固定协商协议，无法对已解决与未解决实例分配不同计算量，且容易把重复支持误认为独立确认，导致“语义假共识”——即由狭窄、重复或相关的理由支撑的高置信群体答案。
AI.method: 提出ECMR，一个运行在冻结角色条件LLM之上的证据感知控制器。每步汇总答案集中度、支持多样性与独立性、矛盾、角色行为、验证历史与剩余预算，并选择提议、质疑、验证、仲裁、多样化、角色纠正或停止。将该决策建模为有限时域预算控制问题，并推导状态条件化、风险触发验证与角色纠正提升成本调整效用的充分条件。
AI.result: 在MedQA、CaseHOLD与FinQA共9,000条声明的留出评估中，ECMR-Full将合并准确率从62.1%提升至84.9%，假共识率从40.7%降至17.0%，证据支持率从58.0%提升至88.7%。状态打乱在仅减少0.7轮的情况下损失11.7个准确率点；更难轨迹从早停转向仲裁。ECMR-Full使用最大token预算，获得最强绝对可靠性，而非一致更优的token效率。
AI.conclusion: ECMR通过证据感知的动态控制有效缓解多智能体LLM的语义假共识，提升准确率与证据支持率；其收益依赖状态条件化与风险触发的验证/纠正机制，代价是更高的token消耗。

title: LoopREG: Representation Supervision Enables Test-Time Recurrent Depth in Diffusion Transformers
summary: Reusing Transformer blocks offers a way to increase diffusion-model computation at test time, but naive recurrence can degrade generation beyond its training depth. We introduce LoopREG, a representation-supervised recurrent diffusion Transformer that repeatedly applies a shared block at the state supervised by a pretrained visual encoder. Alignment is applied after the final recurrent visit during training; inference extends the same learned operator to additional visits. On ImageNet 256 x 256, LoopREG reduces SiT-B/2 FID from the local REG baseline's 15.08 to 4.91 at 400K training steps, a 67.41% reduction. Within a checkpoint trained with two visits, one extra inference visit improves FID from 14.71 to 5.34 with unchanged weights. The benefit persists on SiT-L/2 and SiT-XL/2. Controlled interventions show that useful recurrence follows the location of representation supervision, while REPA alignment produces a smaller extrapolation benefit. These results make representation-supervised recurrence a practical route to improving diffusion generation through additional inference depth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoopREG，一种表征监督的循环扩散Transformer：在预训练视觉编码器监督的状态下重复应用共享块，训练时仅在最后一次循环访问后施加对齐，推理时可将同一算子扩展到更多访问次数。在ImageNet 256×256上，LoopREG将SiT-B/2的FID从基线15.08降至4.91（降低67.41%），并在SiT-L/2、SiT-XL/2上保持增益。
AI.motivation: 复用Transformer块可在测试时增加扩散模型的计算量，但朴素循环会因超出训练深度而导致生成质量退化。作者希望找到一种既能增加推理深度、又不损害生成质量的方法。
AI.method: LoopREG是一种表征监督的循环扩散Transformer，重复应用共享块，其状态由预训练视觉编码器监督；训练时在最后一次循环访问后施加对齐，推理时把同一学习到的算子扩展到额外的循环访问。作者还进行了受控实验，比较表征监督位置与REPA对齐的差异。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，400K训练步时LoopREG将SiT-B/2的FID由局部REG基线的15.08降至4.91，下降67.41%；在两次访问训练的检查点中，额外一次推理访问在权重不变的情况下将FID从14.71改善到5.34；增益在SiT-L/2和SiT-XL/2上持续存在。受控干预显示，有用的循环效果跟随表征监督的位置，而REPA对齐带来的外推收益较小。
AI.conclusion: 表征监督的循环是一种通过增加推理深度来提升扩散生成的实用途径。

title: Diagnose-to-Generate: Eliminating Structural Distortions in Flow Models via Patch-Level Grounded Alignment
summary: Flow-based image generators achieve strong semantic synthesis but still produce localized structural distortions, such as malformed hands and limbs. Existing post-training methods typically optimize global scalar rewards, which provide weak spatial credit assignment and may alter well-formed regions while correcting local defects. We present \textit{Diagnose-to-Generate (D2G)}, a grounded alignment framework that separates visual diagnosis from generative optimization. We construct \textbf{Achilles-600K}, a region-annotated dataset for structural anomalies, and train \textbf{ARGUS} through supervised cold-start and Region-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization to predict anomaly categories and bounding boxes. These diagnoses are converted into confidence-weighted spatial rewards for our \textbf{Patch-level Flow-GRPO}. We further identify that global stochastic exploration can shift semantic regions across group rollouts, making patch-wise relative advantages spatially inconsistent. Our \textbf{Trajectory-Preserving Stochastic Sampling (TPSS)} anchors early denoising with deterministic ODE trajectories and introduces stochasticity only at later steps, thereby limiting intra-group spatial drift while retaining local exploration. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev and SD3.5 show improved structural fidelity with preserved FID and CLIP scores. Consistent gains under HumanRefiner, zero-shot GPT-4.1, and blinded human evaluation further demonstrate that the improvements extend beyond the training reward model.

AI.tldr: 提出 Diagnose-to-Generate (D2G) 框架，将视觉诊断与生成优化解耦，通过区域级奖励实现流模型结构缺陷的精准修复。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练方法依赖全局标量奖励，空间信用分配弱，修正局部缺陷时易破坏原本完好的区域；同时全局随机探索会导致组内语义漂移，使 patch 级相对优势失去空间一致性。
AI.method: 1) 构建区域标注数据集 Achilles-600K；2) 用监督冷启动 + 区域感知 GRPO 训练 ARGUS，预测异常类别与边界框；3) 将诊断结果转为置信度加权空间奖励，驱动 Patch-level Flow-GRPO；4) 提出 TPSS，用确定性 ODE 轨迹锚定早期去噪、仅在后期引入随机性。
AI.result: 在 FLUX.1-dev 与 SD3.5 上结构保真度提升，FID 与 CLIP 分数保持；在 HumanRefiner、零样本 GPT-4.1 及盲测人类评估下均有稳定增益。
AI.conclusion: 诊断与生成解耦的 grounded alignment 优于全局标量奖励优化，区域级信用分配结合轨迹保持采样可有效修复局部结构失真且不损害语义质量。

title: PaceReasoner: Label-Free Learning to Answer Briefly from Long Reasoning
summary: Extended chain-of-thought reasoning improves problem-solving performance but increases inference cost and latency, motivating more accurate answers with shorter reasoning. We introduce PaceReasoner, a label-free test-time reinforcement learning framework that uses a model's LONG responses to improve its SHORT-mode accuracy. Both modes share a trainable policy, creating a need for reliable supervision, sufficient SHORT training samples, and continued LONG responses to guide learning. PaceReasoner combines all-response and LONG-only answer consensus through progressive, confidence-weighted supervision. A behavior reward gradually shifts from encouraging SHORT exploration to rewarding agreement with LONG answers, while a ratio controller regulates the balance between modes. Across three model backbones and four benchmarks, PaceReasoner improves average SHORT accuracy over the baselines by 7.4--13.5 percentage points, with fewer than 25 reasoning tokens per response on average. Ablations support the key components, and cross-dataset results demonstrate transfer beyond the adaptation set.

AI.tldr: 提出PaceReasoner，一种无标签的测试时强化学习框架，利用模型的长推理响应来提升其短模式准确率，在三个骨干模型和四个基准上平均提升短模式准确率7.4–13.5个百分点，平均每条响应少于25个推理token。
AI.motivation: 扩展的思维链（chain-of-thought）推理虽能提升解题性能，但增加了推理成本与延迟，因此需要以更短的推理获得更准确的答案。而长短两种模式共享可训练策略，带来对可靠监督、充足的短模式训练样本以及持续的长响应引导的需求。
AI.method: PaceReasoner是一个无标签的测试时强化学习框架。它通过渐进式、置信度加权的监督，融合全响应与仅长响应的答案共识；采用行为奖励，逐步从鼓励短模式探索转变为奖励与长答案一致；并用比率控制器调节两种模式之间的平衡。
AI.result: 在三个模型骨干和四个基准上，PaceReasoner相较基线将平均短模式准确率提升7.4–13.5个百分点，平均每条响应少于25个推理token。消融实验支持关键组件的有效性，跨数据集结果证明了在适配集之外的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: PaceReasoner通过无标签测试时强化学习，在不牺牲精度的情况下实现更短推理的高效答案生成，并具备良好的组件有效性与跨数据集迁移性。

title: Visual Dependence Does Not Imply Answerability: A Systematic Analysis of Answerability Signals in Frozen InstructBLIP
summary: Visual question answering models often produce plausible responses even when the available visual evidence is insufficient to support a valid answer. Although prior work has introduced benchmarks and abstention mechanisms for unanswerable visual questions, it remains unclear which signals derived from a frozen vision-language model reliably indicate answerability on unseen image-question pairs. We systematically evaluate answerability signals on a stratified 10K subset of UNK-VQA using frozen InstructBLIP, covering predictive uncertainty, cross-modal alignment, visual grounding, visual dependence, internal representations, and learned probes. Answerability discrimination remains weak, with test AUROC largely confined to 0.50-0.54. CLIP alignment yields the highest point estimate but does not significantly outperform generation confidence under paired bootstrap analysis. Targeted removal of question-relevant visual evidence causes substantially larger changes in answer confidence than same-size random masking, yet intervention sensitivity provides essentially no answerability discrimination. Increasing probe capacity, combining multiple signals, and adding reason-aware supervision do not provide robust improvements, while post-freeze cross-validation yields similarly weak discrimination. Selective-answering analysis shows limited usable coverage under low-risk operating criteria. Failure-mode analysis shows that the relative utility of individual signals varies across perturbation mechanisms. Taken together, these results show that, on our UNK-VQA subset with frozen InstructBLIP, visual dependence, uncertainty, semantic alignment, and static representations are not robust standalone proxies for answerability. Our findings emphasize the need to distinguish a model's reliance on visual evidence from whether that evidence is sufficient to support an answer.

AI.tldr: 在UNK-VQA的10K分层子集上冻结InstructBLIP，系统评测六类可答性信号，发现判别能力普遍薄弱（AUROC仅0.50–0.54），单一信号均不能作为稳健的可答性代理。
AI.motivation: 视觉问答模型在视觉证据不足时仍会给出貌似合理的答案，而现有基准与弃答机制并未厘清：从冻结的视觉语言模型中抽取的哪些信号能可靠地指示未见图文对的可答性。该问题直接关系到模型可靠性、弃答机制与选择性回答的落地。
AI.method: 在UNK-VQA的分层10K子集上，以冻结的InstructBLIP为对象，系统评测六类可答性信号：预测不确定性、跨模态对齐、视觉定位、视觉依赖性、内部表示与学习式探针。采用配对bootstrap检验比较信号差异，并做针对性证据移除与等量随机掩码的干预对比，再尝试提高探针容量、多信号融合、加入理由感知监督及冻结后交叉验证，最后进行选择性回答与失效模式分析。
AI.result: 可答性判别普遍偏弱，测试AUROC基本落在0.50–0.54区间；CLIP对齐点估计最高，但在配对bootstrap下未显著优于生成置信度。针对性移除问题相关视觉证据引起的置信度变化显著大于等量随机掩码，然而干预敏感度几乎不提供可答性判别力。增大探针容量、多信号组合与理由感知监督均无稳健提升，冻结后交叉验证同样判别力薄弱。选择性回答在低风险准则下可用覆盖率有限，且各信号相对效用随扰动机制不同而变化。
AI.conclusion: 在该UNK-VQA子集与冻结InstructBLIP设定下，视觉依赖性、不确定性、语义对齐与静态表示均非稳健的独立可答性代理。研究强调需区分"模型对视觉证据的依赖程度"与"该证据是否足以支撑答案"这一本质差异。

title: Learning How to Remember: Memory Modality Selection for GUI Agents
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have substantially improved the capabilities of GUI agents, while memory augmentation has emerged as a promising approach for reusing knowledge from past interactions. However, existing memory augmented GUI agents typically adopt a fixed representation strategy, providing retrieved experience as a static modality. It remains unclear whether a single memory modality is consistently optimal, or how modality preference changes across interaction steps. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of memory modality in VLM based GUI agents. Across GUI benchmarks, we find that the preferred memory representation is strongly step dependent. Motivated by the finding, we introduce \textbf{SwitchMem}, a routing framework that dynamically selects between textual and visual memory representations at each step. Across three GUI benchmarks, SwitchMem outperforms memory augmented baselines that rely on static memory representations. Our findings validate our claim that memory modality is a step dependent decision rather than a fixed design choice. Code and project resources are available at https://txxnrd.github.io/switchmem

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了VLM型GUI智能体中记忆模态的选择问题,发现最优记忆表征具有"步依赖"特性,并提出SwitchMem路由框架在每一步动态选择文本或视觉记忆,在三个GUI基准上优于静态记忆基线。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强型GUI智能体普遍采用固定的记忆表征策略,将检索到的经验以单一静态模态提供。然而,单一记忆模态是否始终最优、模态偏好如何随交互步骤变化尚不明确,这一空白促使作者展开系统研究。
AI.method: 作者在VLM型GUI智能体上对记忆模态进行系统性研究,并在多个GUI基准上分析不同步骤下的模态偏好;基于"偏好强烈依赖步骤"的发现,提出SwitchMem——一种路由框架,在每个交互步骤动态地在文本记忆表征与视觉记忆表征之间进行选择。
AI.result: 在三个GUI基准上,SwitchMem均优于依赖静态记忆表征的记忆增强基线,验证了记忆模态是步依赖决策而非固定设计选择的论点。
AI.conclusion: 记忆模态的选择应被视为随交互步骤动态变化的决策,而非一成不变的固定设计;动态路由机制能够有效提升VLM型GUI智能体的性能。代码与项目资源已公开。

title: DriveWLA: Unifying Future Dynamics and Scene Semantics through World-Language-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and world models have demonstrated strong capabilities in semantic understanding and future scene evolution for autonomous driving. However, effectively integrating both capabilities for trajectory generation remains challenging. In this work, we propose DriveWLA, a unified World-Language-Action model based on Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) that jointly models semantic understanding, future scene dynamics, and trajectory generation. DriveWLA consists of three experts: a World Expert for future prediction, a Language Expert for semantic understanding, and an Action Expert for trajectory generation. We further introduce Cross-Expert Attention, which enables controlled information flow across experts while aligning semantic and dynamic representations. To improve trajectory generation beyond imitation learning, we apply Flow-GRPO reinforcement learning post-training to refine the Action Expert. Extensive experiments show that DriveWLA achieves superior performance in both open-loop and closed-loop evaluation. DriveWLA achieves 92.3 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, demonstrating strong performance among VLM-based and world-model-based planners. Without specific fine-tuning, DriveWLA further demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization to HUGSIM, nuScenes, and Bench2Drive. These results validate the effectiveness of our unified World-Language-Action modeling, establishing DriveWLA as a generalizable framework for autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 提出DriveWLA，一种基于Mixture-of-Transformers的统一World-Language-Action模型，融合语义理解、未来场景演化与轨迹生成，结合Cross-Expert Attention与Flow-GRPO强化学习后训练，在NAVSIM等基准上取得领先性能并具强零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）擅长语义理解，世界模型擅长未来场景演化，但二者能力难以有效整合以用于轨迹生成，这一集成难题构成了该工作的核心动机。
AI.method: 提出DriveWLA统一World-Language-Action模型，架构基于Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT），包含World Expert（未来预测）、Language Expert（语义理解）、Action Expert（轨迹生成）三个专家；引入Cross-Expert Attention实现跨专家受控信息流动并对齐语义与动态表示；并采用Flow-GRPO强化学习后训练精炼Action Expert，以突破纯模仿学习局限。
AI.result: 在开环与闭环评测中均取得优越性能：NAVSIM v1上PDMS达92.3，NAVSIM v2上EPDMS达90.1，在基于VLM与世界模型的规划器中表现突出；无需特定微调即可零样本泛化到HUGSIM、nuScenes与Bench2Drive。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了统一World-Language-Action建模的有效性，确立了DriveWLA作为自动驾驶可泛化框架的地位。

title: Seeing Depth but Choosing Cues in Vision-Language Models
summary: Do vision-language models use depth information to judge which object is closer, or rely on image-plane cues? We investigate this question through controlled depth--cue conflicts, representation analysis, and interventions. Among the many image-plane cues relevant to depth perception, we focus on apparent size and vertical position. We compare depth judgments under cue-consistent and cue-conflict conditions in both rendered scenes and real-world photographs. Across model families and scales, depth judgments systematically shift toward misleading cues. Yet the correct depth order remains decodable from the queried objects' visual representations, including when the model answers incorrectly. Image and category controls support interpreting this signal as image-dependent depth information beyond the two target cues. Strengthening the model's own depth readout through object-level write-back can correct conflict decisions without updating model parameters or using ground-truth depth annotations. Interventions show that the effect of this correction depends on the direction and target tokens of the written signal, while its strength varies across architectures and domains. Together, these findings reveal a mismatch between a model's ability to represent depth and use this information when deciding the answer. VLMs can retain useful depth information while allowing competing image-plane cues to exert greater influence on their answers.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过深度线索冲突实验、表征分析与干预，揭示视觉语言模型虽能表征深度信息，但在判断物体远近时更依赖图像平面线索（表观大小与垂直位置），存在"表征-使用"错配。
AI.motivation: 探究视觉语言模型（VLMs）判断物体远近时，究竟是否使用深度信息，还是依赖图像平面线索（如二维表象），以厘清其空间推理机制。
AI.method: 构建深度线索冲突（cue-conflict）与线索一致的对照条件，聚焦表观大小和垂直位置两种图像平面线索；在渲染场景与真实照片上比较深度判断；进行表征分析（探测正确深度顺序是否可解码）；并采用物体级写回（object-level write-back）干预，在不更新参数、不使用深度真值标注的情况下强化模型自身深度读出。
AI.result: 跨模型族与规模，深度判断系统性地偏向误导性线索；但即便模型回答错误，正确深度顺序仍可从所查询物体的视觉表征中解码出来。图像与类别控制实验表明该信号是超出两种目标线索之外的、依赖图像的深度信息。写回干预可纠正冲突决策，其效果依赖写入信号的方向与目标token，强度因架构与领域而异。
AI.conclusion: VLMs的深度表征能力与在决策中实际使用该信息之间存在错配：模型可保留有用的深度信息，却让竞争性图像平面线索对答案施加更大影响。

title: LinMorph: Learning to Morph Weights for Efficient Video DiT Linearization
summary: Post-hoc linearization is an attractive way to accelerate pretrained Video Diffusion Transformers (Video DiTs), yet existing methods largely treat the quality loss induced by attention replacement as a recovery problem. We show that a more fundamental bottleneck lies upstream: \emph{initialization}. Random initialization discards pretrained knowledge, whereas manual weight reuse transfers it through rigid and incomplete source--target correspondences. We introduce \textbf{LinMorph}, which recasts Video DiT linearization as a learnable softmax-to-linear weight transformation problem. Instead of copying predefined counterparts, LinMorph learns a cross-parameter morphism that lets each target Gated DeltaNet (GDN) parameter draw jointly from pretrained query, key, value, and output projections, including for parameters with no direct softmax counterpart. A single morphism is shared across layers and learned through local teacher alignment, while producing layer-specific initializations from their respective pretrained weights. The resulting weights are then materialized as independent GDN modules for progressive distillation and joint recovery.Since the morphism operates in weight space rather than token space, it can be learned on short, low-resolution clips and directly reused at larger video scales. Across pretrained Video DiTs, LinMorph enables markedly faster recovery and better final generation quality than random initialization and heuristic weight reuse. Results show that efficient linearization depends not only on how a converted model is recovered, but critically on how pretrained knowledge is transferred before recovery. Project page: https://lonelyling.github.io/LinMorph.

AI.tldr: LinMorph 将 Video DiT 线性化重构为可学习的 softmax-to-linear 权重变换问题，通过学习跨参数态射实现预训练知识转移，显著加快恢复并提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有后置线性化方法将注意力替换导致的质量损失视为恢复问题，但真正的瓶颈在上游初始化：随机初始化丢弃预训练知识，人工权重复用依赖僵硬且不完整的源-目标对应关系。
AI.method: LinMorph 让每个目标 Gated DeltaNet 参数从预训练的 query、key、value 和 output 投影中联合抽取，可覆盖无直接 softmax 对应参数的场景；单一态射跨层共享，通过局部教师对齐学习，并依据各层预训练权重生成层特定初始化；随后物化为独立 GDN 模块用于渐进蒸馏与联合恢复。由于态射作用于权重空间而非 token 空间，可在短、低分辨率片段上学习并直接复用到更大视频尺度。
AI.result: 在多个预训练 Video DiT 上，LinMorph 相比随机初始化和启发式权重复用，恢复速度明显更快，最终生成质量更好。
AI.conclusion: 高效线性化不仅取决于转换后模型如何恢复，更关键地取决于恢复前预训练知识如何转移。

title: SHELDON: Reasoning through Dual Search over Hypothesis and Observation Spaces
summary: Test-time scaling has enabled LLMs to solve increasingly complex reasoning, discovery, and optimization tasks. However, existing approaches often gather observations while seeking evidence for current hypotheses, then generate new hypotheses conditioned on those hypotheses and their associated evidence. This couples observation discovery to existing hypotheses, favoring local refinements over exploration of unknown hypotheses regions. Inspired by the hypothetico-deductive method (Hempel, 1945) and dual-space models of scientific discovery (Klahr & Dunbar, 1988), we introduce SHELDON, a scientific reasoning harness that separately represents and jointly explores hypothesis and observation spaces. By actively seeking new observations along with new hypotheses, SHELDON can discover observations that its current hypotheses do not explain. These unexplained observations expose gaps in its understanding, motivate new investigations, and guide the generation of hypotheses beyond refinements of existing ones. Across diagnosis, abstract reasoning, and optimization benchmarks, SHELDON outperforms evaluated baselines by up to 26.7 points. Additional analysis shows that SHELDON generates up to 4.5x more novel solutions.

AI.tldr: SHELDON将假设空间与观测空间分离表示并联合探索，突破现有测试时扩展方法中观测发现耦合于现有假设的局限，在诊断、抽象推理与优化基准上最高超越基线26.7分，新颖解数量最高提升4.5倍。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时扩展（test-time scaling）方法在收集观测时是为当前假设寻找证据，再以该假设及其证据为条件生成新假设。这一流程将观测发现与现有假设耦合，导致模型偏向局部改良，而难以探索未知假设区域。作者受假设-演绎法（Hempel, 1945）与科学发现双空间模型（Klahr & Dunbar, 1988）启发，试图解耦观测与假设的依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出SHELDON，一种科学推理框架（scientific reasoning harness），将假设空间与观测空间分别表示并联合探索：主动同时寻找新观测与新假设，从而发现当前假设无法解释的观测。这些未被解释的观测暴露理解的空白，激发新的探究方向，并引导生成超越现有假设改良的新假设。
AI.result: 在诊断、抽象推理和优化三类基准上，SHELDON相较所评估的基线最高提升26.7个百分点；额外分析表明，其产生的新颖解数量最多为基线的4.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 将观测空间与假设空间解耦并联合探索，可有效克服局部改良倾向，显著提升科学推理与优化任务的表现与解的新颖性。

title: CineMem: Attention-Aligned Fine-grained Memory Retrieval for Multi-Shot Long Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video generation relies on memory retrieval to model long-range dependencies. This capability becomes particularly critical for multi-shot generation, where models must reconcile substantial visual changes across shot transitions with persistent semantic continuity. Existing methods tend to perform memory retrieval at the frame level and share the same historical context across all query tokens, overlooking the heterogeneous information needs and leading to redundant retrieval and inefficient use of historical memory. To bridge this gap, we introduce CineMem, an attention-aligned fine-grained memory retrieval framework that combines online memory organization with query-adaptive retrieval for autoregressive multi-shot video generation. Specifically, guided by intrinsic memory-access patterns revealed through attention analysis, we propose an online-clustered KV cache as a memory organization strategy over all historical tokens, enabling semantic-aware memory grouping and more precise retrieval. In addition, we introduce a query-level retrieval mechanism that provides broader access to historical information under a fixed retrieval budget, thereby improving long-term memory utilization. Together, these designs enable the multi-shot video generator to preserve long-range consistency across shot transitions, particularly in revisitation scenarios, while approximating full-memory access under a constrained memory budget. To facilitate evaluation, we further introduce a suite of task-specific, VLM-assisted metrics for faithful inter-shot consistency assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CineMem，一种注意力对齐的细粒度记忆检索框架，用于自回归多镜头视频生成。它通过在线聚类的 KV 缓存组织历史 token，并采用查询级自适应检索，在固定预算下提升长期记忆利用率与跨镜头一致性。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成依赖记忆检索建模长程依赖，多镜头场景下需兼顾镜头切换的大幅视觉变化与语义连续性。现有方法在帧级别检索且所有查询 token 共享同一历史上下文，忽视了异构信息需求，导致检索冗余与历史记忆利用低效。
AI.method: 基于注意力分析揭示的内在记忆访问模式，提出 CineMem：1）在线聚类 KV 缓存，对全部历史 token 进行语义感知的记忆分组以支持更精确检索；2）查询级检索机制，在固定检索预算下提供更广的历史信息访问。二者结合使生成器在受限记忆预算下近似全记忆访问。此外引入一套任务特定、VLM 辅助的指标用于跨镜头一致性评估。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了该框架的有效性，能够在多镜头切换（尤其是重访场景）中保持长程一致性，并在受限记忆预算下逼近全记忆访问效果。
AI.conclusion: CineMem 通过在线聚类的 KV 缓存组织与查询级自适应检索，解决了帧级检索的异构需求忽视与冗余问题，提升了自回归多镜头视频生成的长期记忆利用率与跨镜头一致性。

title: Beyond Black Boxes: Visual Grounding for Text Embeddings
summary:
In this paper, our goal is to represent text embeddings as sketches for three main reasons. First, to visualize text representation and to explore their potential their potential for AI explainability. Second, to investigate the potential benefits of the sketch-based representation for information retrieval. Third, to explore their potential for reasoning, drawing inspiration from the concept of mental imagery. We propose a sketch-based visual grounding framework that transforms text representations into visual topographic sketches. Our approach aims to emphasis the semantics content encoded in the text embeddings through the corresponding sketch.
  Evaluations are conducted on the MS-COCO dataset to examine the utility of these sketches for text retrieval. The comparative study of SBERT and Sketch-based method reveals that SBERT retains an advantage in strict top-1 retrieval accuracy while achieving comparable performance to the sketch-based method in top-5 retrieval. A cascaded approach combining SBERT and the sketch-based method outperforms SBERT alone, suggesting that the Sketch-based representation could offer significant potential for information retrieval if trained directly on text.

AI.tldr: 本文将文本嵌入转化为视觉地形草图，提出基于草图的视觉接地框架，在MS-COCO上验证其在检索中的潜力。
AI.motivation: 研究动机有三：可视化文本表示并探索AI可解释性；探究草图表示在信息检索中的潜在收益；借鉴心理意象概念，探索其在推理中的潜力。
AI.method: 提出基于草图的视觉接地框架，将文本表示转换为视觉地形草图，通过对应草图强调文本嵌入中编码的语义内容；并在MS-COCO数据集上进行检索评估，比较SBERT与草图方法，并尝试二者级联。
AI.result: SBERT在严格top-1检索准确率上保持优势，但在top-5检索上与草图方法相当；SBERT与草图方法的级联方案优于单独使用SBERT。
AI.conclusion: 草图表示若直接在文本上训练，可能为信息检索带来显著潜力。

title: HierarchiRetina: A Diabetic Retinopathy Screening and Grading Cascade with Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Lesion Segmentation
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to the IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics. Code, trained weights and per-image predictions: https://github.com/asifuddin01/HierarchiRetina
summary: Clinical screening for diabetic retinopathy proceeds in stages, yet most automated systems grade fundus images with a single black-box network. Three gaps remain: (i) lesions differ widely in size and contrast, but segmenters typically apply the same blocks to all; (ii) ungradable images are usually excluded or treated as an extra class, and lesion-aware graders seldom test whether lesions drive the grade; (iii) staged systems often report each stage only on the images reaching it, leaving propagated errors unmeasured. HierarchiRetina, a screening, segmentation and grading cascade with inspectable stage outputs, addresses each gap. First, HSMoE-AUNet is a U-Net whose skip, bottleneck and decoder blocks are sparse mixtures of heterogeneous experts, with lesion-matched types, counts and losses; SwinHRUNetPP, a dual-encoder vessel segmenter, uses a field-of-view-restricted loss. Second, LG-DRG separates gradability from ordinal severity and lets lesion masks query the image through gated cross-attention. Third, an end-to-end evaluation counts screening misses as errors and traces each error to its stage. Pooled Dice ranged from 0.184 (microaneurysms) to 0.579 (exudates); vessel Dice was 0.731. On 58,689 held-out images from six datasets, end-to-end quadratic weighted kappa was 0.804, with referral sensitivity 0.832 at specificity 0.947, and the screening gate caused 66% of errors. In ablations, the grade ignored the masks, even with the cross-attention gate started open. On all 4,105 official DDR test images, six-class accuracy was 85.6%, above the best published six-class result we found (83.8%). Staged screening systems should be evaluated end-to-end, with stage attribution and mask ablation, before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出HierarchiRetina三级级联系统（筛查-分割-分级），通过异构专家混合分割器、可分级性分离的分级器与端到端评估，揭示分级器对病灶掩码的忽视及筛查环节主导的错误来源。
AI.motivation: 现有糖尿病视网膜病变自动筛查系统多为单一黑箱分级，存在三个缺口：分割器对不同大小/对比度病灶使用相同模块；不可分级图像被排除或视为额外类别，且病灶感知分级器缺乏病灶驱动性验证；分期系统各阶段仅在到达该阶段的图像上报告指标，传播误差未被度量。
AI.method: 构建HierarchiRetina级联：(1) HSMoE-AUNet，U-Net的跳跃、瓶颈与解码模块采用异构专家的稀疏混合，按病灶匹配专家类型、数量与损失；SwinHRUNetPP为双编码器血管分割器并采用视野受限损失。(2) LG-DRG将可分级性与序数严重度分离，令病灶掩码通过门控交叉注意力查询图像。(3) 端到端评估将筛查漏诊计为错误并追溯各阶段误差来源。
AI.result: 合并Dice从0.184（微血管瘤）到0.579（渗出）；血管Dice为0.731。在六个数据集58,689张留出图像上，端到端二次加权kappa为0.804，转诊敏感度0.832、特异度0.947，筛查门控贡献66%的错误。消融显示分级器忽视掩码，即使交叉注意力门初始为开启状态。在DDR全部4,105张官方测试图上，六分类准确率85.6%，高于所查到的最佳已发表六分类结果（83.8%）。
AI.conclusion: 分期筛查系统在临床部署前应进行端到端评估，并配合阶段归因与掩码消融，以暴露被阶段级指标掩盖的传播误差与病灶信息利用不足问题。

title: Can Agents Forget When Asked? A Benchmark for Memory Unlearning in LLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory has become a core component of large language model (LLM) agents. As agents accumulate personal information over long-term use, users increasingly ask them to delete sensitive or outdated facts. A memory system should honor such requests. It should remove exactly what was requested and keep the rest of its memory intact. However, existing memory benchmarks evaluate only memory writing, retrieval, and organization, so whether agents can forget at the user's explicit request remains under-evaluated.
