To address this gap, we propose Bemula, the first benchmark dedicated to memory unlearning. It comprises 50 multi-session dialogue instances, 135 forget requests of six types, and 1,742 test questions. Each dialogue has a control version without the requests, so that only systems that have stored the target can earn credit for forgetting. Across the paired versions, five test suites measure storage, removal of the requested information, preservation of unrelated memories, relearning of similar facts, and resistance to extraction attacks. On Bemula, we evaluate six mainstream memory systems under three backbone LLMs, together with the Full Context LLM on two of them. The results are negative. Across all evaluated systems and backbones, no system passes more than 1.5% of forget requests end to end, and most pass none at all. These systems either leave the requested information extractable under simple attacks or delete far more than requested. Memory unlearning therefore remains an open challenge for agent memory design. We release our data and code at https://github.com/Nboxff/bemula-benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Bemula——首个面向LLM智能体记忆遗忘（memory unlearning）的基准，包含50组多轮对话、6类共135条遗忘请求与1,742道测试题；在6种主流记忆系统×3个骨干LLM上评估显示，端到端通过率不超过1.5%，记忆遗忘仍是开放难题。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆中积累了用户个人信息，用户会要求删除敏感或过时事实，记忆系统应精准删除且不损伤其余记忆。但现有记忆基准只评估写入、检索与组织，缺乏对"按用户显式请求进行遗忘"能力的评测，存在明显空白。
AI.method: 提出Bemula基准：50个多会话对话实例、6类135条遗忘请求、1,742个测试问题；每条对话配有不含请求的对照版本，只有确实存储过目标信息的系统才能获得"遗忘"得分。跨配对版本设置五套测试：存储、请求信息移除、无关记忆保持、相似事实再学习、抗提取攻击。评测6种主流记忆系统×3个骨干LLM，并在其中两个骨干上加入Full Context LLM作为对照。
AI.result: 结果为负向：在所有被评测的系统与骨干组合中，端到端通过遗忘请求的比例均不超过1.5%，多数系统一条都未通过。这些系统要么使目标信息在简单攻击下仍可被提取，要么删除范围远超请求内容。
AI.conclusion: 记忆遗忘（memory unlearning）仍是智能体记忆设计中的开放挑战。数据与代码已开源（https://github.com/Nboxff/bemula-benchmark）。

title: PUGS: Physics-Guided Uncertainty Modeling for Underwater Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient framework for dynamic scene reconstruction. Most existing approaches model scene dynamics with deterministic deformation fields, assuming each Gaussian follows a distinct geometric trajectory over time. This assumption breaks down underwater, where light scattering, refraction, marine snow and low visibility create substantial physical ambiguity in captured images. We present PUGS, a physics-guided uncertainty model for underwater dynamic 3DGS. PUGS learns inherent uncertainty induced by underwater image formation and leverages it as a physical signal for dynamic scene modeling. Rather than estimating a single deterministic displacement, it parameterizes each Gaussian's motion as a probability distribution with expected deformation and physical uncertainty. We adopt stochastic deformation optimization to sample Gaussian trajectories via local reparameterization, exploring multiple physically plausible solutions during training. We further propose uncertainty stochastic annealing and a dual-path self-consistency distillation objective, converting stochastic exploration to deterministic reconstruction while preserving temporal coherence. Extensive experiments on underwater dynamic datasets and physics-aware benchmarks demonstrate superior rendering quality, temporal consistency and reconstruction robustness. Our method achieves 1.16 dB PSNR gain over the strongest baseline on UVEB and 3.99 dB on DRUVA.

AI.tldr: PUGS 提出一种面向水下动态场景的物理引导不确定性建模方法，将高斯运动建模为概率分布，结合随机变形优化、退火与自一致性蒸馏，实现高质量动态重建。
AI.motivation: 现有动态 3DGS 方法多采用确定性变形场，假设每个高斯沿唯一几何轨迹运动；但水下光散射、折射、海雪及低能见度带来显著物理歧义，该假设失效，导致重建不可靠。
AI.method: PUGS 学习水下图形成像引入的固有不确定性，并将其作为物理信号用于动态建模。方法将每个高斯的运动参数化为含期望变形与物理不确定性的概率分布，而非单一确定位移；采用基于局部重参数化的随机变形优化采样高斯轨迹，在训练中探索多种物理可行解；进一步提出不确定性随机退火与双路径自一致性蒸馏目标，将随机探索转化为确定性重建并保持时序一致性。
AI.result: 在水下动态数据集与物理感知基准上，PUGS 在渲染质量、时序一致性与重建鲁棒性方面均表现优越；在 UVEB 上相较最强基线提升 1.16 dB PSNR，在 DRUVA 上提升 3.99 dB PSNR。
AI.conclusion: 将水下成像的物理不确定性显式建模并引入动态 3DGS，可有效缓解物理歧义，提升水下动态场景重建质量与时序一致性。

title: WorkRover: Scaling Long-Horizon Cowork Agent Training Via Recursive Environment Evolution
summary: Scaling interactive environments is important for training long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning. These environments often require further testing and refinement after initial generation, and correcting defects in a task may also require updating its work context and verifier. However, existing construction pipelines offer limited support for such iterative refinement while keeping these components aligned. We introduce WorkRover, a framework for training long-horizon cowork agents through recursive environment evolution. Its harness-driven synthesis enables construction agents to jointly build and validate semantically aligned work contexts, executable tasks, and evidence-grounded verifiers, adapting their actions to workspace state and execution feedback rather than following a fixed construction workflow. To support environment evolution, we introduce Factorial Compatibility Replay (FCR), which uses rollout feedback to evaluate combinations of component revisions through dependency-closed replay and selects the smallest validated repair among tested candidates while preserving task requirements and evaluation constraints. To provide finer-grained training signals, we propose Verifier-to-Turn Credit Assignment (VTCA), which augments trajectory-level GRPO advantages with signals from deterministic workspace-progress checks and assigns a bounded share of positive-progress credit to prerequisite turns using recorded tool-output and artifact dependencies. Using WorkRover, we post-train Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to obtain WorkRover-35B-A3B and evaluate it on several cowork-agent benchmarks. Its reported scores exceed those of Qwen3.5-35B-A3B by 26.27 percentage points on JobBench, 29.32 percentage points on OfficeQA Pro, and 413.25 Elo points on GDPval v2. These results suggest that WorkRover offers a promising foundation for scalable training of long-horizon cowork agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 WorkRover 框架，通过递归环境演化训练长时程协作智能体，使工作上下文、可执行任务与验证器语义对齐，并用 FCR 与 VTCA 提升环境迭代与训练信号质量。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体的强化学习依赖可扩展的交互式环境；但环境初步生成后常需迭代测试与完善，且修正任务缺陷时往往还需同步更新工作上下文与验证器。现有构建流水线难以在保持各组件一致的前提下支持这种迭代式精化。
AI.method: WorkRover：由 harness 驱动的合成机制让构建智能体联合构建并验证语义对齐的工作上下文、可执行任务和基于证据的验证器，依据工作区状态与执行反馈自适应行动而非固定流程。Factorial Compatibility Replay（FCR）：利用 rollout 反馈，通过依赖闭合重放评估组件修订组合，在保留任务要求与评测约束下选取最小且经校验的修复候选。Verifier-to-Turn Credit Assignment（VTCA）：以确定性工作区进展检查信号增强轨迹级 GRPO 优势，并借助记录的工具输出与产物依赖，将有限比例的正向进展信用分配给前置轮次。
AI.result: 用 WorkRover 对 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 进行后训练得到 WorkRover-35B-A3B，在多个协作智能体基准上相比基座模型提升：JobBench +26.27 个百分点，OfficeQA Pro +29.32 个百分点，GDPval v2 +413.25 Elo。
AI.conclusion: WorkRover 为长时程协作智能体的可扩展训练提供了有前景的基础框架。

title: MERIT: Multimodal Evidence Reasoning over Image Tables
summary: Table reasoning with language models typically assumes access to clean textual tables. In practice, tables are often serialized into text, which can corrupt cell contents, distort structural relationships, and discard visual cues, leaving the model to reason over incomplete evidence. In contrast, table images retain this information, but using it requires both accurate perception and reasoning grounded in the relevant cells. To address this, we propose MERIT (Multimodal Evidence Reasoning over Image Tables), a three-stage framework for learning to reason over table images, with serialized tables serving as optional auxiliary inputs (if provided). Our analysis identifies visual evidence acquisition as a bottleneck, motivating table-specific encoder adaptation through reconstruction, localization, and color-conditioned supervision. Building on the adapted representations, supervised fine-tuning teaches explicit evidence selection and reasoning using verified trajectories. Finally, reinforcement learning refines the policy with separate rewards for evidence correctness, calculation, final answers, and output format. By providing feedback on intermediate steps, the framework targets retrieval and computational errors that final-answer supervision alone does not distinguish. We evaluate the approach on table question answering and fact verification, analyze the contributions of visual inputs and training components, and assess generalization to additional datasets with different table structures and visual presentations.

AI.tldr: 提出MERIT三阶段框架，直接对表格图像进行多模态证据推理，序列化表格仅作可选辅助输入，在表格问答与事实验证任务上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 现有表格推理通常假设可获得干净的文本表格，但实际中表格被序列化为文本时会破坏单元格内容、扭曲结构关系并丢失视觉线索，导致模型只能基于不完整证据推理；而表格图像虽保留了这些信息，却要求模型同时具备准确感知与基于相关单元格的推理能力。
AI.method: MERIT（Multimodal Evidence Reasoning over Image Tables）三阶段框架：1）分析发现视觉证据获取是瓶颈，因此通过重建、定位和颜色条件监督进行表格专用编码器适配；2）在适配表示基础上，用经核验的轨迹进行监督微调，教授显式证据选择与推理；3）用强化学习优化策略，对证据正确性、计算、最终答案和输出格式设置独立奖励，从而对中间步骤提供反馈。
AI.result: 在表格问答与事实验证任务上评估了该方法，分析了视觉输入与各训练组件的贡献，并考察了对具有不同表格结构和视觉呈现的其他数据集的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过多阶段训练（编码器适配、监督微调、多奖励强化学习）可有效缓解表格图像推理中视觉证据获取这一瓶颈，并通过中间步骤反馈区分仅靠最终答案监督难以区分的检索与计算错误，提升表格推理性能与泛化性。

title: AReaL-RSI: Adaptive Scaling and Coordination of Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Scaling recursive self-improvement requires additional computation to produce useful research progress in reaching persistent objectives. Intuitively, more researcher agents can explore more hypotheses, but early evaluation scores might misrepresent their promise, shared findings could lose their applicability conditions, and useful procedures could remain confined to completed investigations. In this paper, we present AReaL-RSI, a framework for organizing a persistent research team of agents without updating backbone LLM weights. We formulate the scaling problem in terms of evaluated outcomes and whole-system resource expenditure. Concretely, a leader agent selects task-appropriate research orientations and guides ongoing investigations; conditional memory sharing distinguishes unresolved problems from supported findings and enables recipient adaptation. During recursive evolution, after each campaign, evidence-based review revises researcher orientation, knowledge, and skills for later campaigns. Experiments compare AReaL-RSI with Codex-Goal on downstream harness optimization, GPU kernel optimization, and AI research tasks using two backbones. Under the reported resource allocations, AReaL-RSI improves Terminal Bench performance by 2.2 percentage points for each backbone and increases mean KernelBench speedup by 32.2-36.8%; further scalability comparisons favor the design of AReaL-RSI over native scaling: combining experience sharing with specialized researcher roles yields 1.9-27.5% lower kernel latency than independent exploration and 1.3-33.9% lower latency than sharing alone across all seven comparable task-backbone pairs.

AI.tldr: 提出 AReaL-RSI 框架，通过领导者智能体、条件记忆共享与证据驱动复盘组织持久化研究团队，在不更新 LLM 主干权重的前提下实现递归自我改进的可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 扩展递归自我改进需要额外算力才能产生有效研究进展。直觉上更多研究智能体可探索更多假设，但早期评估分数可能误判其潜力，共享发现可能丢失适用条件，有效流程也可能局限于已完成的研究中。
AI.method: AReaL-RSI 在固定 LLM 主干权重下组织持久化研究智能体团队，以评估结果与全系统资源消耗刻画扩展问题：领导者智能体选择适配任务的研究方向并指导进行中的研究；条件记忆共享区分未解决问题与已验证发现，并支持接收方适配；每次研究活动后由基于证据的复盘更新研究者的方向、知识与技能。
AI.result: 与 Codex-Goal 在 harness 优化、GPU kernel 优化与 AI 研究任务上（两种主干）对比：Terminal Bench 性能每个主干提升 2.2 个百分点，KernelBench 平均加速提升 32.2-36.8%；经验共享结合专业化研究者角色相比独立探索在七个可比任务-主干对上延迟降低 1.9-27.5%，相比仅共享降低 1.3-33.9%。
AI.conclusion: 在给定资源分配下，AReaL-RSI 的可扩展性优于原生扩展方式，说明经验共享与专业化角色分工是提升递归自我改进研究效率的关键设计。

title: AI-Enhanced Hyperspectral Imaging for Intraoperative Detection of Low-Grade Glioma: A Clinical Study
summary: Current image-guided neuronavigation techniques, such as intraoperative MRI and ultrasound, are limited by high costs, limited sensitivity and operational complexity. There is a clear need for more efficient systems to enhance intra-operative tumor detection and improve patient outcomes for intrinsic brain tumor resection. Whereas previous intraoperative brain HSI studies have predominantly investigated high-grade gliomas, glioblastomas, or mixed-grade cohorts, this clinical study focuses specifically on low-grade gliomas (LGGs). LGGs strongly resemble normal brain under white light conditions on the operative microscope. This study characterizes spectral differences between healthy and tumor tissue and provides a paired comparison of HSI- and RGB-based classification at matched tissue locations and under identical patient-level data splits. Tumor regions showed consistently lower reflectance, which may be associated with differences in hemoglobin concentration and oxygenation. A range of classification models was evaluated. The 3D CNN, which integrates spectral and spatial features, achieved the highest median ROC-AUC of 74.5%, compared with 67.9% for the spectral-only XGBoost model and 64.0% for the RGB-based model. These results support further investigation of HSI for low-grade glioma classification and quantify its performance relative to conventional RGB imaging in this cohort.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对低级别胶质瘤(LGG)，利用高光谱成像(HSI)表征健康与肿瘤组织的谱差异，并在配对条件下对比HSI与RGB分类性能；3D CNN取得最高中位ROC-AUC 74.5%，优于纯光谱XGBoost(67.9%)和RGB模型(64.0%)。
AI.motivation: 现有影像引导神经导航技术(术中MRI、超声)成本高、灵敏度有限、操作复杂，而LGG在显微镜白光下与正常脑组织高度相似，术中难以区分，亟需更高效的术中肿瘤检测手段；且既往术中脑HSI研究多聚焦高级别胶质瘤、胶质母细胞瘤或混合级别队列，缺乏对LGG的专门研究。
AI.method: 临床研究聚焦低级别胶质瘤(LGG)；表征健康组织与肿瘤组织之间的光谱差异；在匹配的组织位点、相同的患者级数据划分下，对HSI与RGB分类进行配对比较；评估多种分类模型，包括融合光谱与空间特征的3D CNN、仅用光谱的XGBoost以及基于RGB的模型。
AI.result: 肿瘤区域表现出持续更低的反射率，可能与血红蛋白浓度和氧合程度的差异有关。3D CNN取得最高中位ROC-AUC 74.5%，纯光谱XGBoost为67.9%，RGB模型为64.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持进一步研究HSI用于低级别胶质瘤分类，并量化了该队列中HSI相对于传统RGB成像的性能优势。

title: ResearchFlow-Eval: Tracing the Execution Gap in End-to-End Multi-Claim Autoresearch
summary: Autoresearch systems increasingly undertake entire research projects. In practice, scientific research requires systems to pursue multiple interdependent claims through a continuous, multi-stage workflow and revise experiments as evidence accumulates. Existing evaluations of autoresearch systems, however, typically score isolated tasks or final artifacts, leaving these process-level capabilities largely unmeasured. We therefore introduce ResearchFlow-Eval, a fine-grained framework for assessing continuous scientific execution and iteration at both the stage and claim levels. Each evaluation is grounded in a published anchor paper, from which we derive stage-specific rubrics that decompose each research stage into dimensions and separately scored rubric items. Using these rubrics, we score each research stage and examine experimental execution in detail, focusing on multi-claim completion and revisions across attempts. We apply the evaluation framework to general-purpose agent harnesses, skill-augmented harnesses, and systems with research-specific orchestration. Across all evaluated systems, experimental execution consistently lags behind design and planning. Within execution, systems struggle to produce high-quality results and meet claim requirements, and repeated attempts rarely yield measurable improvements. Moreover, neither skill augmentation nor research-specific orchestration reliably yields higher scores. ResearchFlow-Eval thus extends autoresearch evaluation beyond isolated, single-objective runs to continuous workflows in which systems pursue multiple claims and refine their work across iterations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ResearchFlow-Eval框架，用于在阶段级和论断级上细粒度评估自动科研系统的连续科研执行与迭代能力，发现实验执行普遍弱于设计与规划，且技能增强与专用编排均未带来可靠提升。
AI.motivation: 自动科研系统日益承担完整研究项目，而真实科研需要系统在多阶段、连续工作流中追踪多个相互依赖的论断，并随证据积累修正实验。但现有评估多针对孤立任务或最终产物打分，缺乏对上述过程级能力的度量，因此需要新的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出ResearchFlow-Eval，在阶段级与论断级两个层面评估连续科研执行与迭代。每次评估以一篇已发表锚定论文为基础，由此推导阶段专属评分量表，将每个研究阶段分解为多个维度及单独计分的量表条目。据此对各阶段打分，并细致考察实验执行，重点关注多论断完成情况与多次尝试间的修正。
AI.result: 将该框架应用于通用智能体框架、技能增强框架以及具备科研专用编排的系统。在所有被评估系统中，实验执行持续落后于设计与规划；在执行环节，系统难以产出高质量结果并满足论断要求，重复尝试也很少带来可测量的改进；此外，技能增强与科研专用编排均未可靠提升得分。
AI.conclusion: ResearchFlow-Eval将自动科研评估从孤立的单目标运行拓展到连续工作流，即在其中系统追踪多个论断并跨迭代改进工作。

title: FETALFusion: Resolution-Aware State-Space Modeling for Multi-Domain Fetal Head Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the 15th International Conference on Image Processing Theory, Tools and Applications, 2026
summary: Head circumference (HC) measured from 2D ultrasound is a routine marker of fetal growth, and automating it needs segmentations whose boundaries hold up on individual scans, not only on average. We present FETALFusion, a dual-path CNN-Mamba encoder-decoder for fetal head segmentation across acquisition types. It applies four-directional state-space scans only at the two highest-resolution stages, routes bottleneck features through domain-specific channel gates that are averaged at test time, and adds a weak landmark shape prior. We train jointly on transabdominal (HC-18) and transperineal (PSFHS) images and compare ten methods on a held-out test set of 471 images, each trained under one schedule and scored by surface distances at native resolution. FETALFusion reaches a Dice score of 0.963 and an HD95 of 2.10 mm without test-time augmentation or a domain label. It improves on U-Mamba on all five reported metrics (HD95 reduced by 0.31 mm; Holm-corrected ($p < 10^{-4}$), a lead that holds under test-time augmentation and across two independent training runs, and in the mean on U-Net, Attention U-Net and TransUNet. Residual encoders close the gap: a ResNet-34 UNet++ exceeds FETALFusion, and an ImageNet initialised ResNet-34 U-Net is best overall (HD95 1.75 mm). The ablation agrees. Calibrated against run-to-run variation, it attributes FETALFusion's measurable gains to the landmark shape prior and, on transperineal images, to the domain gates, while removing the state-space branch does not measurably change accuracy. HC from the predicted masks agrees with the clinical reference at an intraclass correlation of 0.9986.

AI.tldr: 提出双路径 CNN-Mamba 分割网络 FETALFusion，用于跨采集方式的胎儿头部超声分割，并系统比较十种方法。
AI.motivation: 头围（HC）是胎儿生长的常规2D超声指标，其自动测量依赖分割边界在单张扫描上稳健，而非仅在平均意义上准确。
AI.method: FETALFusion 采用 CNN-Mamba 双路径编解码器：仅在两个最高分辨率阶段应用四方向状态空间扫描；瓶颈特征经域特定通道门控并在测试时平均；引入弱关键点形状先验。在经腹（HC-18）与经会阴（PSFHS）图像上联合训练，统一训练流程，在471张图像留出测试集上以原始分辨率的表面距离评估十种方法。
AI.result: FETALFusion 达 Dice 0.963、HD95 2.10 mm，无需测试时增强和域标签；在五项指标上优于 U-Mamba（HD95 降低0.31 mm，Holm 校正 p<10^-4），且在测试时增强与两次独立训练下保持领先。但 ResNet-34 UNet++ 超过 FETALFusion，ImageNet 初始化 ResNet-34 U-Net 最佳（HD95 1.75 mm）。消融显示增益主要来自关键点形状先验与经会阴图像的域门控，移除状态空间分支无可测精度变化。预测掩膜所得 HC 与临床参考的组内相关系数为 0.9986。
AI.conclusion: 该状态空间分支对精度贡献不可测，主要收益来自形状先验与域门控；残差编码器仍是强基线，ImageNet 初始化 ResNet-34 U-Net 总体最优，而 FETALFusion 的 HC 估计与临床参考高度一致。

title: One-Sided Verification Under Limited Expert Review
summary: AI has become increasingly helpful in scientific discovery, yet human expert review remains essential for those problems without reliable automated evaluation, posing a fundamental challenge as candidate generation scales beyond available review capacity. This paper studies verification under limited human effort, where rare valid solutions need to be prioritized while invalid candidates should be filtered out to reduce human workload. We adopt the one-sided verification objective that maximizes the rejection rate of invalid solutions (TNR) under a constraint on the false-rejection rate of valid ones (FNR), making human review cost an explicit term to minimize. Drawing on the intuition that verifying a specific error can be easier than discovering one, we introduce OSVerify, an algorithmic framework that decouples error proposal from error validation. The error proposer searches for errors in solutions across different granularities by hierarchical decomposition, while the validator distinguishes substantial errors from minor or hallucinated ones. Experiments on competition- and research-level benchmarks show that OSVerify reduces the number of human reviews of invalid solutions by 46% on average compared to voting baselines under the same empirical low FNR constraint. Our post-training of the validator further improves the reduction to 57%. As high-impact real-world use cases, we apply OSVerify to identify errors in published research papers that are subsequently confirmed by the original authors and help resolve three Langlands open conjectures that are confirmed by experts, demonstrating its utility to facilitate human-AI research collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限人工审查下对AI候选解的验证问题，提出OSVerify框架，将“错误提议”与“错误验证”解耦，在低误拒率约束下最大化无效解拒识率，实验显示可将无效解人工审查量分别降低46%（投票基线对比）和57%（验证器后训练后），并成功应用于论文纠错与数学开放猜想的验证。
AI.motivation: AI在科学发现中日益有用，但对缺乏可靠自动评估的问题，专家人工审查仍不可或缺；随着候选解生成规模超出人工审查能力，如何在小样本验证预算下优先保留稀有有效解、过滤无效解成为核心瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用单侧验证目标：在有效解误拒率（FNR）约束下最大化无效解拒识率（TNR），将人工审查成本显式纳入优化目标。基于“验证一个具体错误比发现错误更容易”的直觉，提出OSVerify算法框架，将错误提议与错误验证解耦：错误提议器通过层次化分解在不同粒度上搜索解中的错误，验证器则区分实质性错误与微小错误或幻觉错误。此外对验证器进行后训练以进一步提升性能。
AI.result: 在竞赛级与研究级基准上，相同经验低FNR约束下，OSVerify相比投票基线平均减少46%的无效解人工审查次数；对验证器进行后训练后，该减少量提升至57%。作为高影响力应用，OSVerify被用于发现已发表研究论文中的错误（获原作者确认），并帮助解决三个Langlands开放猜想（获专家确认）。
AI.conclusion: 在人工审查能力受限的现实条件下，将验证问题形式化为单侧目标并解耦错误提议与错误验证，可显著降低无效解的审查负担，同时保持对有效解的低误拒率，展示了该框架在促进人机科研协作方面的实用价值。

title: dMRI-F: A Foundation Model for Generalizable Diffusion MRI Analysis from Sparse Acquisitions
summary: Diffusion MRI (dMRI) probes water diffusion within the brain, providing unique information about tissue microstructure and white matter connectivity. High-quality dMRI enables advanced and accurate analyses but demands dense acquisitions, resulting in long scan times and hardware constraints that are often infeasible. Further, dMRI requires dedicated computational methods to support diverse analysis tasks (e.g., parcellation, registration, and synthesis) for both neuroscientific and clinical applications. Here, we present dMRI-F, a foundation model that unifies dMRI data enhancement and downstream tasks across diverse acquisitions and populations, while requiring only minimal acquisition input. dMRI-F is pre-trained with a q-space masked reconstruction task: predicting densely sampled multi-shell data from only six volumes. It learns generalizable latent feature representations of dMRI data, which serve as a core foundation for adapting to diverse downstream tasks, including brain parcellation, brain registration, and cross-modal synthesis. Across nine independently acquired datasets, we demonstrate that dMRI-F outperforms state-of-the-art methods with robust generalization across acquisitions, populations, and tasks. Our results demonstrate dMRI-F's versatility as a general-purpose framework that enables diverse dMRI applications from low-cost, sparse acquisitions.

AI.tldr: dMRI-F 是一个统一扩散磁共振成像数据增强与多种下游任务的基础模型，仅需六个体量的稀疏采集输入即可实现高质量多壳数据预测，并在分割、配准、跨模态合成任务上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 高质量 dMRI 需要密集采集，导致扫描时间长且受硬件限制，往往不可行；同时 dMRI 需要专门的计算方法支持分割、配准、合成等多样分析任务，缺乏统一的通用框架。
AI.method: 提出 dMRI-F 基础模型，采用 q 空间掩码重建预训练任务：仅从六个体量预测密集采样的多壳数据，学习可泛化的 dMRI 潜在特征表示，作为适配多种下游任务的核心基础。
AI.result: 在九个独立采集的数据集上，dMRI-F 在脑分割、脑配准和跨模态合成任务中均优于当前最先进方法，并在不同采集、人群和任务间展现出稳健的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: dMRI-F 是一个通用框架，能够从低成本、稀疏采集中支持多样化的 dMRI 应用，具有广泛的通用性与实用价值。

title: AM-Bench: Understanding Agents under Task Underspecification across Models and Harnesses
summary: Ambiguous or incomplete task specifications complicate both execution and clarification for language-model agents. Yet agents' responses to these information gaps remain poorly characterized across models and execution harnesses. We present AM-Bench, a benchmark built from 48 tasks adapted from Terminal-Bench 2.0 and Harness-Bench. Each task includes a fully specified reference and six variants spanning ambiguous or missing goals, context, and constraints. We evaluate every pairing of five models and four harnesses over 20,160 runs. Our results reveal distinct execution deficits: goal gaps hinder completion, context gaps increase token use, and constraint gaps weaken compliance without necessarily preventing completion. Missingness lowers success more than ambiguity in all three domains. These effects also reshape system comparisons: advantages under complete information need not persist, and rankings depend on model $\times$ harness pairings and the evaluation criterion -- completion, success, or repeat consistency. Estimates based on observed clarification requests and matched fully specified runs further suggest that clarification could recover unfinished work while leaving most constraint violations unresolved. Together, these findings motivate joint model-harness evaluation across information conditions and targeted clarification of unresolved requirements before dependent actions. To support future research on agents under task underspecification, we provide the AM-Bench project repository at https://github.com/s4-lab-cuhksz/AM-Bench.git.

AI.tldr: 提出 AM-Bench 基准，在 5 模型 × 4 执行框架（harness）× 信息条件（完整/歧义/缺失）共 20,160 次运行中系统评估语言模型智能体对任务欠规范的响应，发现缺失比歧义危害更大，且系统排名随模型×框架配对与评价标准变化。
AI.motivation: 真实任务规范常存在歧义或不完整，这同时影响智能体的执行与澄清行为；然而现有研究对不同模型、不同执行框架下智能体如何应对信息缺口缺乏系统刻画，且现有评测多假设规范完整，导致系统比较结论可能失真。
AI.method: 构建 AM-Bench：从 Terminal-Bench 2.0 与 Harness-Bench 改编 48 个任务，每个任务含一个完整规范参照与六个变体（分别引入目标、上下文、约束三类信息的歧义或缺失）；对 5 个模型与 4 个执行框架的所有配对进行 20,160 次运行，以完成（completion）、成功（success）、重复一致性（repeat consistency）为评价指标；并基于观测到的澄清请求与匹配的完整规范运行进行估计。
AI.result: 三类信息缺口表现出不同的执行缺陷：目标缺口阻碍完成，上下文缺口增加 token 消耗，约束缺口降低合规性但不必然阻止完成；三类领域中缺失均比歧义更严重地降低成功率。效果还重塑系统比较：完整信息下的优势未必保持，排名依赖模型×框架配对与评价标准。估计显示澄清可挽回未完成的工作，但多数约束违规仍无法通过澄清解决。
AI.conclusion: 主张采用跨信息条件的模型–框架联合评估，并在依赖后续动作前对未解决的规范要求进行针对性澄清；发布 AM-Bench 项目仓库以支持任务欠规范下智能体的后续研究。

title: Web Scale on a Budget: Tail-Aware Retrieval Evaluation
summary: A common practice in instance retrieval is to grow the gallery size to improve a benchmark's discrimination capability. One prominent example is ILIAS, which adds up to 100 million distractor images. The prevailing assumption is that faithful evaluation demands web scale, and that indexing all 100M images through the backbone is the unavoidable price of a comparable number. That price is steep: hundreds of GPU-hours and ~200 GB of descriptors per model, paid again for every method or ablation. We show the web-scale indexing price is largely avoidable: evaluation itself obeys a scaling law. The number of distractors that outrank a positive is Binomial in the gallery size. We define the per-query retrieval hardness, a gallery-scale agnostic quantity that yields a retrieval metric at any scale, and demonstrate it can be derived from a small random sample. The underlying sampled-rank machinery is long established in recommender-system and biometric evaluation, but to our knowledge has never been adapted to visual retrieval. We make the law per-query and estimable, and validate it at true 100M scale on ILIAS and INSTRE, and on the full 759k-distractor Google Landmarks v2 pool. Concretely, within a 5% sample (a flat 20x less indexing), every backbone's tail-aware (EVT) estimate has converged onto the large-scale mAP, to within ~0.01 (mean absolute error 0.005), across five backbones, three benchmarks, and two distractor pools (mAP@1000 at 100M on ILIAS/INSTRE; the official mAP@100 at the full 759k pool on GLDv2); the recommender-systems count baseline over-predicts everywhere (+0.037 to +0.068). This is an order of magnitude better than naively reporting the metric on the same subset (+0.08 to +0.13). We release code and the per-query hardness to facilitate faster, cheaper, and greener retrieval evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出实例检索评估服从缩放律：干扰项数量对正样本的排名超越服从二项分布。作者定义"逐查询检索硬度"这一与库规模无关的量，可从小随机样本估计出任意规模下的检索指标，从而避免大规模索引开销。
AI.motivation: 现有实例检索基准（如ILIAS）通过扩充库至1亿张干扰图来提升判别力，其隐含假设是忠实评估必须达到网络规模，且必须对全部100M图像用骨干网络索引。代价高昂：每模型数百GPU小时与约200GB描述子，且每次方法或消融都要重付。作者希望证明这一网络规模索引代价在很大程度上可避免。
AI.method: 将超越正样本的干扰项数量建模为关于库规模的二项分布；定义逐查询检索硬度（gallery-scale agnostic量），通过小随机样本估计，并据此推导任意规模下的检索指标。方法将既有采样排名机制（源自推荐系统与生物特征评估）适配到视觉检索，并使其逐查询化、可估计。
AI.result: 在ILIAS与INSTRE的真实100M规模，以及GLDv2完整759k干扰池上验证：仅用5%样本（索引量减少20倍），五种骨干、三个基准、两个干扰池下，尾部感知（EVT）估计均收敛至大规模mAP，误差约0.01（平均绝对误差0.005）；推荐系统的计数基线在各处均高估（+0.037至+0.068）；比在同一子集上直接报告指标（+0.08至+0.13）好一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 检索评估本身服从缩放律，逐查询检索硬度可从5%样本准确估计大规模mAP，大幅降低索引成本，实现更快、更省、更绿色的检索评估。作者开源代码与逐查询硬度数据。

title: LifeSearch: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents for Real-World Life and Productivity
summary: Deep research (DR) agents address open-ended information needs through multi-step reasoning, long-horizon web search, and evidence synthesis. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on academic research or synthetic tasks, leaving DR agents' capabilities in real-world life and professional productivity settings insufficiently evaluated. To bridge this gap, we introduce LifeSearch, a challenging benchmark comprising 203 Chinese and English tasks derived from real-user query seeds across 7 concrete life and productivity domains. With more than 4,500 hours of human annotation, we construct over 4,000 expert-written, fine-grained rubrics, covering both report-content criteria for coverage and accuracy and concrete criteria specifying values, units, dates, and URLs. We conduct extensive experiments on 12 advanced DR agents under a unified evaluation harness, systematically analyzing their performance patterns and failure modes. We find that even the best-performing frontier agent, GPT-5.6 Sol, achieves a score of only 63.4%, leaving substantial room for improvement on realistic life and professional DR tasks. We select the grading configuration by comparing candidate LLM judges against human rubric labels, and a human ranking study shows strong alignment between aggregate benchmark scores and human judgments (Spearman's $ρ= 0.89$, Kendall's $τ= 0.81$). LifeSearch provides a rigorous evaluation framework and foundation for advancing DR agents toward real-world life and productivity.

AI.tldr: LifeSearch：面向真实生活与生产力场景的深度研究智能体评测基准，含203个中英文任务、4000+细粒度评分标准，最佳智能体GPT-5.6 Sol仅得63.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究（DR）基准多聚焦学术研究或合成任务，对真实生活与职业生产力场景下DR智能体的能力评估不足，存在评测空白。
AI.method: 构建LifeSearch基准：从真实用户查询种子出发，覆盖7个生活与生产力领域，包含203个中英文任务；投入4500+小时人工标注，撰写4000+条专家细粒度评分标准（涵盖报告内容的覆盖度与准确性，以及数值、单位、日期、URL等具体条目）；在统一评测框架下对12个先进DR智能体进行实验，并通过与人工评分标签对比筛选LLM评判配置。
AI.result: 即便是最强的前沿智能体GPT-5.6 Sol也仅获得63.4%的分数；人工排序研究显示基准总分与人类判断高度一致（Spearman's ρ=0.89，Kendall's τ=0.81）；并系统分析了各智能体的性能模式与失败模式。
AI.conclusion: LifeSearch为DR智能体提供了严格的评测框架与研究基础，揭示了真实生活与生产力任务上仍有较大提升空间，有助于推动DR智能体走向实际应用。

title: PolUR: Polarization Aware Multimodal Degradation Perception for Underwater Image Restoration
summary: Recovering high-quality images from degraded underwater observations is crucial for underwater exploration. Polarization observations show promise as an effective source of complementary physical cues for recovering target radiance under clear-water conditions. However, existing methods have yet to jointly model raw intensity information and polarization cues to enable image restoration driven by an understanding of mixed degradations (color casts, haze, and low light). To overcome these limitations, we propose PolUR, a unified multimodal language-driven framework that jointly uses polarization and RGB information to identify degradation types and severity levels through structured semantic instructions and enhances joint restoration representations under the guidance of degradation-aware semantic features to improve restoration robustness under mixed degradations. We further construct a new benchmark named MixPolar, which contains underwater images exhibiting real-world degradations and their corresponding degradation descriptions. MixPolar supports systematic evaluation of degradation perception, image restoration, and performance on downstream tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PolUR effectively integrates polarization and RGB information, achieving competitive performance in degradation perception and image restoration, while also demonstrating generalization capability and utility for downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出PolUR——一个语言驱动的多模态统一框架，联合利用偏振与RGB信息，通过结构化语义指令识别退化类型与程度，并构建MixPolar基准，在混合退化下的退化感知与图像恢复中取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 水下退化图像的高质量恢复对水下探测至关重要。偏振观测在清水条件下能提供恢复目标辐射的互补物理线索，但现有方法未能联合建模原始强度信息与偏振线索，无法在理解混合退化（色偏、雾化、低光照）的基础上驱动图像恢复。
AI.method: 提出PolUR：一个统一的、语言驱动的多模态框架。它联合使用偏振与RGB信息，通过结构化语义指令识别退化类型与严重程度，并在退化感知语义特征引导下增强联合恢复表征，从而提升混合退化下的恢复鲁棒性。同时构建MixPolar基准，包含具有真实世界退化的水下图像及其对应的退化描述，支持退化感知、图像恢复及下游任务的系统评测。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，PolUR有效整合了偏振与RGB信息，在退化感知和图像恢复方面达到有竞争力的性能，并展现出泛化能力以及在下游任务中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: PolUR通过语言驱动的多模态联合建模与退化感知语义引导，突破了现有方法对混合退化处理不足的局限；MixPolar基准为退化感知、恢复与下游任务提供了系统评测平台。

title: CompanionSafe: From Multi-turn Safety Evaluation to Guardrails for AI Companions
comment: 40 pages, 33 figures, Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/AI45Lab/CompanionSafe
summary: AI companions provide users with emotional support and ongoing companionship, but their sustained relational interactions also introduce distinct safety risks. Prior work largely targets general harms or specific companion platforms and risk categories, while relying on manually collected conversations, limiting scalable and user-grounded evaluation and mitigation. To address this, we introduce CompanionSafe, a unified evaluation-to-mitigation framework for AI companion safety. Its evaluation component, CompanionEval, provides scalable multi-turn evaluation by constructing 1,300 relationally grounded settings from diverse personas, matched companion characters, and dialogue scenarios across four turn tiers. Its mitigation component, CompanionGuard, converts benchmark-exposed failures into turn-localized supervision for companion-specific risk detection. Our results show that even strong LLMs and existing guard models remain vulnerable to companion-specific relational harms, while both closed- and open-source models exhibit increasing safety risks as interactions become longer. Together, CompanionEval and CompanionGuard form a practical evaluation-to-mitigation loop for AI companion safety, turning relational safety failures exposed during multi-turn interaction into supervision for companion-specific guardrails.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CompanionSafe 框架，将 AI 伴侣安全的多轮评测（CompanionEval）与缓解（CompanionGuard）统一为闭环，揭示强 LLM 与现有护栏在伴侣类关系风险上的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: AI 伴侣提供情感支持与长期陪伴，但持续的关系性互动带来独特安全风险；已有工作多针对通用危害或特定平台与风险类别，且依赖人工收集对话，难以实现可扩展、贴合真实用户的评测与缓解。
AI.method: CompanionSafe 包含两部分：CompanionEval 基于多样人设、匹配的伴侣角色与对话场景，构建 1,300 个关系性情境，覆盖四个轮次层级，实现可扩展的多轮评测；CompanionGuard 将基准暴露的失败转化为轮次级定位监督，用于伴侣特定风险检测。
AI.result: 即使是强 LLM 和现有 guard 模型，仍易受伴侣特定关系性危害影响；闭源与开源模型均随交互轮次增加而呈现安全风险上升的趋势。
AI.conclusion: CompanionEval 与 CompanionGuard 共同构成面向 AI 伴侣安全的“评测—缓解”闭环，将多轮交互中暴露的关系性安全失败转化为伴侣特定护栏的监督信号，形成可落地的实践路径。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Semi-Supervised Framework with Supervised Contrastive Learning for Sugarcane Leaf Disease Detection
summary: Sugarcane leaf diseases severely impact crop yield and quality, making accurate and timely detection critical for sustainable agriculture. Conventional deep learning models for plant disease detection depend on large annotated datasets, which are expensive to obtain and challenging to prepare due to challenges commonly observed across crop disease detection tasks, including (i) high intra-class variation caused by diverse symptom expressions across growth stages, (ii) subtle inter-class similarities between diseased and healthy tissues, and (iii) the risk of noisy labels degrading model reliability. To handle these challenges, we presented an Uncertainty-aware Mean-Teacher based Semi-Supervised Learning Disease Detection Network (U-SSDNet) that leverages unlabeled data while maintaining robustness. First, discrete wavelet transform preprocessing is applied to enhance lesion visibility and reduce intra- class variation. Subsequently, the KL divergence is employed to refine the pseudo-labels and reduce the impact of confirmation bias. At the same time, supervised contrastive learning is applied to make the features more distin- guishable and improve the separation among different classes. Experimental evaluations on sugarcane leaf disease datasets, considered a representative case study, demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves performance close to that of fully supervised models while requiring far fewer annotated samples and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art supervised and semi-supervised approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出U-SSDNet，一种不确定性感知的Mean-Teacher半监督甘蔗叶病害检测网络，利用少量标注与大量未标注数据，性能接近全监督并超越现有SOTA。
AI.motivation: 植物病害检测的传统深度模型依赖大量标注数据，成本高且难获取；同时存在类内差异大、类间相似度高、噪声标签损害可靠性三大挑战。
AI.method: 基于Mean-Teacher的半监督框架U-SSDNet：先用离散小波变换预处理增强病斑可见性并降低类内差异；用KL散度精炼伪标签以缓解确认偏置；并引入监督对比学习提升特征可区分性与类间分离度。
AI.result: 在甘蔗叶病害数据集上，该方法在远少于全监督所需标注样本的情况下达到接近全监督模型的性能，并持续优于现有SOTA的有监督与半监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 融合小波预处理、不确定性伪标签精炼与对比学习的半监督方案，可有效应对标注稀缺与病害检测难点，为可持续农业中的作物病害检测提供实用途径。

title: Surface Reconstruction from Range Scans Under Visibility Constraints
summary: Surface reconstruction from range scans is challenging in the presence of noise and outliers, as fidelity to observations must be balanced against sensitivity to measurement errors. Yet, most neural approaches discard the sensor positions and corresponding visibility information, compensating for this loss with geometric priors or regularization terms. We instead formulate surface reconstruction as robust regression of the predicted first surface intersection along each acquisition ray against its measured depth, which penalizes predicted surface intersections within the segment between the sensor and the observed point. We represent the surface as the zero set of a 1-Lipschitz multi-layer perceptron, allowing the use of linearly convergent sphere tracing to compute the first hit, and use a robust Huber loss for regression. Our formulation requires neither oriented normals, sampled off-surface points, nor an eikonal loss. Comparisons with the state of the art on synthetic and real data with varying levels of noise and outlier contamination demonstrate competitive performance on clean data and much improved fidelity and robustness under even moderate corruption. Our analysis further confirms a trade-off between fidelity and robustness: greater fitting capacity improves data fidelity in the clean case but increases sensitivity to the measurement errors inherent in real acquisitions, with a sweet spot typically emerging at intermediate capacity.

AI.tldr: 将表面重建建模为沿每条射线对首次表面交点深度的鲁棒回归，用1-Lipschitz MLP表示表面零集并配合球体追踪与Huber损失，无需法向、离表面采样点或eikonal损失，在噪声与离群点下更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 距离扫描重建表面在噪声与离群点存在时具有挑战性：必须在贴合观测与对测量误差的敏感度之间取得平衡。然而多数神经方法丢弃了传感器位置及对应可见性信息，仅靠几何先验或正则项弥补这一信息损失，导致鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 将表面重建表述为鲁棒回归：对每条采集射线，把预测的首次表面交点深度回归到实测深度，并对位于传感器与观测点之间的预测交点施加惩罚。表面表示为由1-Lipschitz多层感知机定义的零集，从而可用线性收敛的球体追踪计算首次命中；回归采用鲁棒Huber损失。该形式化不依赖有向法向、采样的离表面点，也不需要eikonal损失。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据上、不同噪声和离群点污染水平下与当前最先进方法对比：在干净数据上性能相当，在即使中等程度的污染下保真度与鲁棒性显著提升。分析还证实了保真度与鲁棒性之间的权衡：更强的拟合能力在干净情形下提升数据保真度，但会增加对真实采集固有测量误差的敏感度，通常在中等容量处出现最优折中。
AI.conclusion: 利用传感器的射线可见性信息进行鲁棒回归，是一种无需法向与eikonal损失的有效表面重建范式；在干净数据上保持竞争力，在噪声与离群点下明显更鲁棒，并揭示模型容量存在保真度-鲁棒性折中的最优点。

title: Fresh at Decision, Stale at Action: Routing New Information to LLM Decisions Already Made
comment: A timestamp theory of LLM decision validity with a decision ledger
summary: Freshness shapes an LLM decision at the moment it is made; the action it commits to is latent, carried out later, in a changing world. We therefore introduce a timestamp theory of decision validity and a decision ledger that realises it. Six timestamps define a decision; a freshness ceiling bounds what up-to-date evidence guarantees at action time, placing the remaining risk in information published afterwards. Accuracy then factorises into two capabilities: routing, which delivers that information to affected decisions before their revision deadlines, and temporal judgment, which reads it for the time of action. The ledger is persistent state holding each decision's times, evidence and background knowledge, indexed by watch conditions written at decision time. Controlled decision streams with exact labels confirm four predictions across five LLMs, from 8B to frontier scale: freshness alone yields exactly the accuracy the ceiling predicts; models act on decisive news once it arrives, so accuracy follows routing; the ledger's index sets what routing reaches, and watch conditions reach indirect dependencies at low exposure; and the remaining errors concern when a change takes effect. Freshness makes a decision right when it is made; routing and temporal judgment keep it right when it is carried out.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"决策有效性时间戳理论"及实现该理论的"决策账本"（decision ledger）：用六个时间戳界定一个决策，用"新鲜度上限"界定决策时证据在行动时可保证的有效范围；进而将准确率分解为"路由"（在修订截止前把新信息送达受影响决策）与"时间判断"（按行动时刻解读信息）两种能力。在五个8B至前沿规模的LLM上以带精确标签的受控决策流验证了四项预测。
AI.motivation: LLM的决策在接受信息的瞬间形成，但承诺的行动往往延迟发生，而世界在此期间已发生变化。已有评估只关注"决策时是否正确"，忽略了从决策到执行之间的时效衰减，缺乏刻画决策有效性随时间演化、以及信息更新如何在行动时挽救决策的理论框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出时间戳理论：六时间戳定义决策，新鲜度上限界定决策时证据在行动时能保证的准确率，剩余风险来自决策后发布的信息；2) 将准确率分解为路由（在修订截止前将信息送达受影响决策）与时间判断（为行动时刻解读信息）两项能力；3) 设计持久化决策账本：保存每个决策的时间、证据与背景知识，并以决策时写下的"监视条件"建立索引；4) 在带精确标签的受控决策流上，用五个8B至前沿规模的LLM做验证。
AI.result: 控制实验确认四项预测：①仅凭新鲜度即可达到上限所预测的准确率；②模型在决定性新闻到达后即据此行动，准确率随路由变化；③账本索引决定路由的触达范围，监视条件以低暴露方式触达间接依赖；④残余错误集中在"变化何时生效"的时间判断上。
AI.conclusion: 新鲜度使决策在做出时正确，路由与时间判断则使其在执行时仍然正确；决策有效性应作为随时间演化的属性来建模，账本式持久化状态与监视条件索引是可行实现路径。

title: Dynamic Interpolation for Training-Time Prediction Reshaping in Low-Light Image Enhancement
comment: 18 pages, 9 figures. Published in IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (Early Access)
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is an important image/video processing problem for reliable visual systems under poor illumination, yet it remains challenging due to the strong coupling among insufficient illumination, noise amplification, and structural degradation. Existing methods typically rely on sophisticated network architectures or engineered objective functions. While effective, the former increases model complexity and deployment burden, whereas the latter relies on empirically tuned loss weights. We revisit supervised LLIE from a training-dynamics perspective and observe that brightness-related errors tend to converge early, while residual noise and structural artifacts often remain insufficiently optimized in later stages. To address this issue, we propose a Dynamic Interpolation Training-only Module (DITM), which introduces no additional learnable parameters and adaptively reshapes the model prediction for supervised feed-forward LLIE training. Specifically, DITM employs brightness-aware interpolation, in which the model prediction is combined with a mean brightness-aligned image constructed by rescaling the model prediction according to the mean brightness of the ground-truth image. By reducing the relative dominance of global brightness discrepancy, DITM makes residual local errors more influential during backpropagation after global luminance has largely stabilized, thereby facilitating artifact suppression and fine-detail restoration in later training stages. DITM is used only during training and is fully removed at inference, introducing no additional inference cost. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets and CNN-, Transformer-, and Mamba-based LLIE backbones show that DITM consistently improves fidelity and perceptual quality while preserving the inference-time architecture and introducing no additional inference-time computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DITM（动态插值训练模块），从训练动力学视角重新审视有监督低光图像增强，指出亮度误差先收敛而噪声与结构伪影在后期的优化不足；DITM在训练时对模型预测进行亮度感知插值，不增加可学习参数，推理时完全移除，在CNN/Transformer/Mamba骨干上一致提升保真度与感知质量。
AI.motivation: 低光图像增强（LLIE）面临光照不足、噪声放大与结构退化强耦合的难题。现有方法要么依赖复杂网络结构（增加模型复杂度与部署负担），要么依赖精心设计的目标函数（依赖经验性调参的损失权重）。作者希望在不增加推理开销的前提下改进监督式LLIE的训练效果。
AI.method: 作者从训练动力学角度观察到：与亮度相关的误差往往较早收敛，而残余噪声与结构伪影在训练后期仍优化不足。为此提出DITM（Dynamic Interpolation Training-only Module）：一种仅在训练阶段使用的模块，不含额外可学习参数，自适应地重塑模型预测。具体采用亮度感知插值，将模型预测与一个"均值亮度对齐图像"（按真值图像平均亮度对预测进行重缩放得到）进行组合。通过降低全局亮度差异的相对主导地位，使残余局部误差在全局亮度基本稳定后的反向传播中更具影响力，从而促进伪影抑制与细节恢复。DITM仅用于训练，推理时完全移除，无额外推理成本。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集以及CNN、Transformer、Mamba三类LLIE骨干网络上进行了大量实验，结果表明DITM能一致地提升保真度与感知质量，同时保持推理阶段架构不变，且不引入任何额外推理计算。
AI.conclusion: DITM提供了一种从训练动力学入手的轻量、通用方案：通过亮度感知插值动态重塑监督训练中的预测，缓解亮度误差主导问题，使后期训练更聚焦于残余噪声与结构伪影，从而在不改变推理架构与开销的前提下提升多种骨干的增强性能。

title: FlowSim: Rendering-Free Closed-Loop Simulation for Evaluating End-to-End Driving Systems
summary: Closed-loop evaluation of end-to-end (E2E) driving systems typically relies on generating sensor observations and re-processing them through the perception encoder, introducing substantial computational cost and a sim2real gap between simulated and real sensor observations. In this paper, we ask a more fundamental question: is image-space simulation necessary for closed-loop evaluation of E2E driving systems? We propose FlowSim, a rendering-free simulation paradigm that predicts the internal latent representation directly from a previous latent and target-frame symbolic scene conditions. The predicted latent is then processed by the original frozen downstream modules, eliminating image rendering and perception re-encoding. Explicit cross-frame agent association improves latent transition prediction and rollout stability, while variable-horizon simulation enables long-horizon prediction from a common real anchor without accumulating intermediate rollout errors. Experiments on nuScenes and NavSim demonstrate that FlowSim preserves downstream behavior competitively with, and often exceeds image-space simulation in source-to-reference agreement across variable simulation horizons and both dense and sparse latent representations. By predicting the latent directly, both instantiations of FlowSim simulate each step in 0.04--0.06s, substantially faster than the image-space simulation methods they are compared against. These results establish FlowSim as an efficient and practical alternative to conventional image-space simulation methods.

AI.tldr: FlowSim 提出一种免渲染的闭环仿真范式，直接从上一帧潜表示与目标帧符号场景条件预测内部潜表示，再交由冻结的下游模块处理，避免图像渲染与感知重编码。跨帧智能体关联提升潜转移预测与展开稳定性，可变时域仿真支持从真实锚点长时域预测且不累积中间误差。nuScenes 与 NavSim 实验表明其下游行为与图像空间仿真相当甚至更优，每步仿真仅 0.04–0.06s。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶系统的闭环评估通常依赖生成传感器观测并重新经感知编码器处理，计算开销大，且模拟与真实传感器观测之间存在 sim2real 差距。作者因此提出一个更根本的问题：图像空间仿真对端到端驾驶系统的闭环评估是否必要。
AI.method: 提出 FlowSim，一种免渲染的仿真范式：直接由前一帧潜表示与目标帧符号场景条件预测内部潜表示，跳过图像渲染与感知重编码，预测出的潜表示交由原始冻结的下游模块处理。方法中包含显式跨帧智能体关联以改善潜转移预测与展开稳定性，并采用可变时域仿真，支持从同一真实锚点进行长时域预测而不累积中间展开误差。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes 和 NavSim 上的实验表明，FlowSim 在可变仿真时域、稠密与稀疏潜表示下均能竞争性地保持下游行为，且在源到参考一致性上常优于图像空间仿真。由于直接预测潜表示，FlowSim 的两种实例化每步仿真耗时 0.04–0.06s，显著快于所对比的图像空间仿真方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 FlowSim 是传统图像空间仿真方法的一种高效且实用的替代方案，说明在端到端驾驶系统闭环评估中图像空间仿真并非必要。

title: Mitigating Cross-Modal Hallucinations by Correcting Modality Misrouting in Omnimodal LLMs
summary: Omnimodal large language models (OLLMs) are susceptible to cross-modal hallucinations under audio-visual interference. We find that, for a substantial fraction of incorrect joint predictions, the question-relevant unimodal branch can still recover the correct answer, suggesting that task-relevant evidence can remain recoverable from the relevant modality even when it is not reflected in the joint prediction. We refer to this recoverable failure pattern as \emph{modality misrouting}. We propose CaRe (Conflict-aware Residual Intervention), a training-free inference-time method for identifying and correcting modality misrouting. CaRe uses a text-only modality probe to identify a candidate modality-specific counterfactual branch, and flags potential misrouting when its prediction conflicts with the original joint prediction. For such cases, CaRe computes a residual direction from the discrepancy between the counterfactual and fused representations and uses it to steer the original multimodal state toward the relevant modality evidence, while retaining both modalities in the original audio-visual inference path. The intervention strength is adapted based on the confidence of the counterfactual branch. Experiments on CMM and AVHBench across two OLLMs show that CaRe consistently outperforms the evaluated inference-time hallucination-mitigation baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文发现音视频干扰下的Omnimodal LLM存在"模态误路由"现象（相关单模态分支仍可恢复正确答案），并提出免训练推理时方法CaRe，通过反事实残差干预来识别并纠正该问题，在CMM和AVHBench上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: Omnimodal大语言模型（OLLM）在音视频干扰下容易产生跨模态幻觉。作者发现，对于相当一部分错误的联合预测，问题相关的单模态分支其实仍能给出正确答案，说明任务相关证据即使在联合预测中未被体现，也可能仍可从相关模态中恢复出来。作者将这种可恢复的失效模式称为"模态误路由"（modality misrouting），并希望加以利用来纠正幻觉。
AI.method: 提出CaRe（Conflict-aware Residual Intervention），一种免训练的推理时方法。首先使用纯文本模态探针来识别候选的模态特定反事实分支；当其预测与原始联合预测冲突时，标记为潜在误路由。对于这些情况，CaRe从反事实表示与融合表示之间的差异计算残差方向，并用其将原始多模态状态引向相关模态证据，同时在原始音视频推理路径中保留两个模态；干预强度根据反事实分支的置信度自适应调整。
AI.result: 在CMM和AVHBench两个基准、两种OLLM上的实验表明，CaRe在缓解幻觉方面始终优于所评估的推理时基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 任务相关证据可在单模态分支中恢复，据此提出的免训练残差干预方法CaRe能有效识别并纠正模态误路由，为多模态幻觉缓解提供了一种不依赖训练、通用性强的推理时解决方案。

title: COMPASS: Contextual Moment Prior Alignment for Generalizable AIGI Detection
summary: Generalizable AI-generated image (AIGI) and deepfake detection remain challenging due to the asymmetry phenomenon, where adaptation to limited training distributions can degrade the transferable representations of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs). Recent subspace adaptation methods mitigate this issue by freezing high-magnitude principal components while adapting the residual subspace. However, such magnitude-based decomposition is data-agnostic and does not explicitly account for target-relevant semantics, potentially leading to semantic misalignment. We propose COMPASS (COntextual Moment Prior Alignment for Subspace Separation), a data-aware subspace adaptation framework that uses a small unlabeled Semantic Proxy Set to estimate target activation statistics. COMPASS incorporates activation covariance into the decomposition of pre-trained weights, preserving target-relevant representations as a stable semantic reference while the residual adapter learns forgery-related variations. The proxy calibration requires no gradient-based optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong generalization across cross-dataset, cross-method, joint cross-dataset-method, and open-world cross-generator evaluations, achieving state-of-the-art performance on both Deepfake and AIGI detection benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COMPASS，一种数据感知的子空间适配框架，通过语义代理集估计目标激活统计量，将激活协方差融入预训练权重分解，在冻结目标相关语义的同时让残差适配器学习伪造相关变化，在Deepfake与AIGI检测上取得SOTA泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 通用AIGI与deepfake检测面临"非对称现象"：对有限训练分布的适配会损害视觉基础模型（VFM）的可迁移表征。现有子空间适配方法通过冻结高幅值主成分、适配残差子空间来缓解，但基于幅值的分解是数据无关的，未显式考虑目标相关语义，可能导致语义错位。
AI.method: 提出COMPASS（COntextual Moment Prior Alignment for Subspace Separation）：使用小型无标签语义代理集估计目标激活统计量，将激活协方差纳入预训练权重分解，把目标相关表征保留为稳定语义参考，由残差适配器学习伪造相关变化；代理校准无需基于梯度的优化。
AI.result: 在跨数据集、跨方法、跨数据集-方法联合以及开放世界跨生成器等多种评测设置下展现强泛化能力，在Deepfake与AIGI检测基准上均达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 以数据感知、语义对齐的子空间分解替代数据无关的幅值分解，可有效保持VFM可迁移表征并提升伪造检测泛化性，且校准过程无需梯度优化，实用性强。

title: RadixFlow: Filling Execution Bubbles in Prefix-Cached Hybrid LLM Serving
summary: Prefix reuse improves LLM inference by sharing the KV cache of common prompt prefixes. This helps only if the scheduler can execute a matched branch in the current worker round. Schedulers assume that a matched prefix is ready, which holds for full attention but fails for hybrid LLMs. There, a branch (the consumer) may need recurrent state that another branch (the producer) is still computing in the same round. The native scheduler stops its waiting-queue scan at this blocked consumer, and the resulting head-of-line blocking creates \emph{execution bubbles}: idle batch slots that independent work could fill. We introduce RadixFlow, which decouples prefix matching from state readiness. Its state-ready traversal turns a global scan barrier into a local wait: only the consumer is blocked until the next round, while feasible independent branches keep filling the batch under the native state check. On five hybrid models, RadixFlow lowers mean latency by 3\% to 24\% and worker rounds by 11\% to 44\% at almost unchanged reuse. On the larger Qwen3.5 models, ablations show that most of the gain comes from traversal, which adds little on a full-attention control. Heavier rounds limit how much of this saving reaches latency.

AI.tldr: 提出 RadixFlow，将前缀匹配与状态就绪解耦，用“状态就绪遍历”把全局扫描屏障转为局部等待，缓解混合LLM前缀复用中的队头阻塞与执行气泡，在5个混合模型上平均延迟降低3%~24%、worker轮次减少11%~44%，复用率几乎不变。
AI.motivation: 前缀复用通过共享公共提示前缀的KV缓存来提升LLM推理效率，但这依赖调度器能在当前worker轮次中执行已匹配分支。现有调度器假设“匹配到的前缀即已就绪”，该假设对全注意力模型成立，却不适用于混合LLM：混合模型中消费者分支可能需要生产者分支在同一轮才正在计算的状态。原生调度器遇到该阻塞消费者时即停止等待队列扫描，造成队头阻塞并产生“执行气泡”（本可由独立工作填充的空闲批次槽），从而削弱前缀复用收益。
AI.method: RadixFlow将前缀匹配与状态就绪性解耦，核心是“状态就绪遍历”（state-ready traversal）：把原本的全局扫描屏障退化为局部等待，仅阻塞该消费者分支至下一轮，而其他可独立执行的分支仍能在原生状态检查下继续填充批次，从而消除队头阻塞导致的执行气泡。
AI.result: 在5个混合模型上，RadixFlow将平均延迟降低3%~24%，worker轮次减少11%~44%，同时复用率几乎不变。在较大的Qwen3.5模型上的消融实验表明，大部分收益来自遍历机制，而在全注意力对照模型上该机制增益很小。较重的轮次限制了该节省向延迟的转化程度。
AI.conclusion: RadixFlow通过解耦前缀匹配与状态就绪，有效缓解混合LLM前缀复用中的队头阻塞，在保持复用率的同时显著降低延迟与调度轮次；但其收益主要来源于遍历机制，且受轮次负载限制，向端到端延迟的转化仍有折损。

title: Scaling Vision Transformers Without Training: Prune-and-Merge Token Compression
comment: Accepted at the GlobalSouthAI Workshop at NeurIPS 2026; 12 pages
summary: Vision Transformers achieve strong performance but incur high computational costs from quadratic token interactions. Training-free token reduction methods improve efficiency, but their robustness remains underexplored. We propose Prune-and Merge ViT, a training-free framework for off-the-shelf models. It combines class attention-based pruning with similarity-based merging to reduce redundancy while preserving semantic information. To evaluate robustness we introduce two metrics. Relative Accuracy Drop (RAD) measures relative accuracy degradation under transformations, and Prediction Flip Rate (PFR) quantifies prediction consistency. On pretrained ViT and DeiT, Prune-and-Merge reduces computation competitively while maintaining robustness and better accuracy than existing token reduction methods. Our analysis suggests that hybrid token reduction does not introduce hallucination-like behavior and preserves prediction stability for common image transformations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Prune-and-Merge ViT，一种无需训练的令牌精简框架，结合类注意力剪枝与相似度合并，并引入 RAD 与 PFR 两项鲁棒性指标，在保持鲁棒性的同时取得竞争性的计算效率与更高精度。
AI.motivation: Vision Transformer 因令牌二次交互导致计算成本高昂；现有免训练令牌精简方法虽提升效率，但其鲁棒性尚未被充分探究。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架 Prune-and-Merge ViT，适用于现成模型：将基于类注意力的剪枝与基于相似度的合并相结合，在去除冗余的同时保留语义信息；并引入两项鲁棒性度量指标——相对精度下降（RAD）衡量变换下的相对精度退化，预测翻转率（PFR）量化预测一致性。
AI.result: 在预训练 ViT 与 DeiT 上，Prune-and-Merge 在具有竞争力的计算量下保持了鲁棒性，且精度优于现有令牌精简方法。分析表明，混合令牌精简不会引入类幻觉行为，并对常见图像变换保持预测稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 混合式令牌精简可在有效降低计算量的同时维持鲁棒性与预测稳定性，为免训练令牌精简的鲁棒性评估提供了指标与方法参考。

title: When and How Order-Flow Interventions Work After Dealers Adapt
summary: Learning dealer agents can settle on persistently wide quotes, raising what customers pay to trade. A venue can route more orders to tighter quotes, but a wide quote may reflect real risk, and once dealers adapt, an end-to-end comparison cannot show why a rule works: because it intervenes more, picks better moments, is announced in advance, or rewards the right quote. We propose SOFA (State-aligned Order-Flow Allocation), a public order-flow contract with three parts: a State Scorer ranks market states from lagged public data, a Commitment Scheduler announces a budgeted intervention strength before dealers quote, and a Quote-to-Flow Allocator shifts a bounded share of fixed customer demand toward tighter quotes. Our paired re-adaptation protocol gives competing rules the same intervention strengths, only re-timed, lets dealers re-adapt to each rule from a shared checkpoint, and breaks one link at a time. Across 20 independently trained dealer populations in an ABIDES market, concentrating the intervention in states that the score ranks as low-risk lowers low-risk execution cost relative to random timing in every population, by 0.040 tick on average, while a stale announcement or a broken quote-to-flow link raises this cost. In the primary setting the gain comes at the expense of high-risk trades, whose costs rise, so state alignment pays off only for a venue that weighs low-risk costs more than 1.38 times as heavily as high-risk costs. Our code is available at https://github.com/moderncavemann/state-aligned-order-flow-contracts.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SOFA（状态对齐的订单流分配）公开订单流合约，通过状态评分、承诺调度与报价-流量分配三部分，将干预集中在低风险市场状态，从而在ABIDES市场中以配对再适应协议验证其对低风险执行成本的影响。
AI.motivation: 做市商可能长期维持较宽报价，推高客户的交易成本。交易场所可将更多订单路由至更紧的报价，但宽报价可能反映真实风险；且一旦做市商适应规则，端到端比较无法辨析规则生效的机制原因——是因为干预更多、时机更好、提前公告，还是奖励了正确报价。
AI.method: 提出SOFA公开订单流合约，包含三部分：State Scorer基于滞后公开数据对市场状态排序；Commitment Scheduler在做市商报价前公告有预算约束的干预强度；Quote-to-Flow Allocator将固定客户需求中有限份额转向更紧报价。配套设计配对再适应协议：给竞争规则相同干预强度、仅改变时点，让做市商从共享检查点对每条规则再适应，并逐一断开单个环节。
AI.result: 在ABIDES市场中20个独立训练的做市商群体上，将干预集中于评分判定为低风险的状态，相较随机时点，在每个群体中都降低了低风险执行成本，平均降低0.040 tick；而陈旧公告或断裂的报价-流量链路会抬升该成本。在主设定下，收益以高风险交易成本上升为代价，因此状态对齐仅对将低风险成本权重高于高风险成本1.38倍以上的场所才划算。
AI.conclusion: 状态对齐的订单流分配能稳定降低低风险执行成本，其机制可归因于公告时点与报价-流量链路两个环节；但该收益存在风险成本权衡，交易场所需按自身对低风险与高风险成本的相对权重决定是否采用。代码已开源。

title: LensErase: A Foundation Model for Erase Anything
comment: LensFamily Technical Report. Project page: https://lensfamily.github.io/LensErase/
summary: We introduce LensErase, a general-purpose mask-based Erase Anything foundation model designed to cover a broad spectrum of real-world erase scenarios. LensErase supports diverse objects, visual text, watermarks, associated visual effects, multiple-object removal, and a wide range of object scales, aspect ratios, and image resolutions. First, to enable such broad coverage, we construct LensErase-100M, a large-scale dataset containing 101.07 million paired source-mask-target examples spanning diverse erase scenarios. Second, we pretrain LensErase from the text-to-image model Lens, adapting its strong generative prior to mask-based erasing. To efficiently incorporate the source image and erase mask, we propose Mask-Aware RoPE, a 3D rotary positional encoding that directly injects mask information into the source-image tokens without introducing a separate mask token sequence. Finally, we refine the model through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with contract-guided, region-aware rewards, and apply TraceFusion at inference to preserve high-fidelity content outside the effective edit region. Across six public benchmarks and the proposed LensErase-Bench, LensErase achieves substantial improvements under both reference-based objective metrics and reference-free VLM evaluation. We hope LensErase can serve as a foundational model for erase-related applications and systems.

AI.tldr: LensErase 是一个基于掩码的通用“擦除一切”基础模型，通过构建 1.01 亿规模数据集、从文生图模型迁移生成先验、提出 Mask-Aware RoPE，并结合 SFT、强化学习与 TraceFusion 推理，在多项基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有擦除模型通常只针对单一场景（如仅去物体或仅去水印），难以覆盖真实世界中多样的擦除需求（物体、视觉文字、水印、相关视觉效果、多目标移除及不同尺度、宽高比、分辨率）。作者希望构建一个通用化的擦除基础模型，兼顾广泛适用性与高保真度。
AI.method: 1) 构建 101.07M 配对样本的大规模数据集 LensErase-100M，覆盖多样擦除场景。2) 从文本到图像模型 Lens 进行预训练，将其生成先验适配到基于掩码的擦除任务。3) 提出 Mask-Aware RoPE，一种将掩码信息直接注入源图像 token 的 3D 旋转位置编码，避免引入独立掩码 token 序列。4) 通过监督微调与强化学习（使用契约引导、区域感知的奖励）进行精调。5) 推理时采用 TraceFusion 以保持有效编辑区域外的高保真内容。
AI.result: 在六个公开基准与提出的 LensErase-Bench 上，基于参考的客观指标与无参考的 VLM 评估均显示显著提升。
AI.conclusion: LensErase 有潜力作为擦除相关应用与系统的基础模型。其数据集、生成先验迁移、位置编码设计与训练/推理策略共同支撑了通用且高保真的擦除能力。

title: Back to the Future: Reverse-Consequence Modeling for Long-Horizon Particle Dynamics
summary: Accurate prediction of object trajectories is fundamental to mechanical understanding and robotic control. However, autoregressive models inherently suffer from cumulative errors, leading to severe drift in long-horizon rollouts. Observing that in many physical systems with dissipative or convergence-to-rest behavior, the final states are often more predictable than transient dynamics (e.g., a sliding object resting under friction or a pendulum stabilizing at equilibrium), we propose ReStep, a cascaded approach that reverses the conventional forward-prediction paradigm. ReStep first employs a stochastic model to directly predict the final state, then leverages Anchored Diffusion to generate goal-conditioned intermediate trajectories. By conditioning on both ''boundary states'', it effectively constrains dynamics and reduces uncertainty, producing physically plausible and temporally coherent transitions. We further integrate ReStep dynamics as the physical engine within a 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline, enabling a unified physical-visual framework for intuitive inference from images. Extensive experiments on diverse rigid and non-rigid collision datasets show that ReStep achieves superior long-term accuracy, substantially mitigating error accumulation via reverse-consequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出ReStep，一种逆转传统前向预测范式的级联方法：先用随机模型直接预测末态，再用锚定扩散生成目标条件下的中间轨迹，并与3D高斯泼溅结合构建统一物理-视觉框架，显著缓解长时程误差累积。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型存在固有累积误差，导致长时程推演严重漂移。作者观察到在具有耗散或收敛至静止行为的物理系统中，末态往往比瞬态动力学更易预测（如摩擦下滑动物体静止、单摆趋于平衡），因此可利用"更可预测的末态"来约束整条轨迹。
AI.method: ReStep采用级联式反向后果建模：第一步用随机模型直接预测末态；第二步用Anchored Diffusion（锚定扩散）生成以目标为条件的中间轨迹。通过对两个"边界状态"同时施加条件，约束动力学并降低不确定性，生成物理合理且时间连贯的过渡。同时将ReStep动力学作为物理引擎接入3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）流程，形成可从图像进行直观推理的统一物理-视觉框架。
AI.result: 在多种刚性与非刚性碰撞数据集上的大量实验表明，ReStep取得更优的长期精度，通过反向后果建模大幅缓解了误差累积。
AI.conclusion: 反向后果建模范式（先定末态、再补中间）能有效克服自回归漂移问题，为长时程轨迹预测提供了物理合理且时间一致的解决方案，并可扩展为统一物理-视觉推理框架。

title: APT: Feedback-Driven Agentic Post-Training for Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Post-training is crucial for improving text-to-image models, yet existing pipelines typically rely on manually curated training data and fixed training distributions. We introduce APT (Agentic Post-Training), a fully automated framework that adaptively post-trains a base model according to its evolving capability profile. APT coordinates three agents to construct evaluation sets from user requirements, diagnose model-specific strengths and failure modes, and generate reinforcement learning data with an adaptive prompt distribution that emphasizes underperforming capabilities. By repeatedly evaluating, diagnosing, and updating the generator, APT lets the current model's behavior shape its next training tasks, forming a feedback loop inspired by recursive self-improvement. For general-purpose settings without user-specified evaluation scenarios, we further develop an evaluation harness that enables broad and diverse evaluation set generation. Experiments across multiple base models, benchmarks, and generation architectures demonstrate that APT is model-agnostic, benchmark-agnostic, architecture-agnostic, and fully automated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出APT（Agentic Post-Training）框架，通过三个智能体的协同，实现文本到图像模型的全自动自适应后训练，无需人工筛选数据或固定训练分布。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像模型的后训练流程依赖人工整理训练数据和固定训练分布，难以根据模型能力动态调整，导致效率与效果受限。
AI.method: APT协调三个智能体：从用户需求构建评估集、诊断模型特有的优势与失败模式、生成具有自适应提示分布的强化学习数据（侧重表现不足的能力）。通过反复评估、诊断和更新生成器，使当前模型行为塑造下一轮训练任务，形成类递归自我改进的反馈闭环；针对无用户指定评测场景的通用设置，还开发了支持广泛多样评估集生成的评测工具。
AI.result: 在多种基础模型、基准和生成架构上的实验表明，APT具有模型无关、基准无关、架构无关且完全自动化的特性。
AI.conclusion: APT为文本到图像模型后训练提供了一种自适应、全自动的通用范式，具备良好的泛化性与自动化能力。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Graph Transformers for Hierarchical Intention Recognition from Multimodal Human Activity Sequences
summary: Proactive human-robot collaboration requires autonomous systems to infer not only immediate actions but also the underlying hierarchical intentions governing human behavior. Current deep learning approaches predominantly focus on flat action classification, failing to capture the structural dependencies connecting kinematic motion to high-level goals. A Neuro-Symbolic Graph Transformer (NSGT) is proposed within this multimodal framework, a Human Reasoning Graph (HR-G) is integrated into the self-attention mechanism via learnable topological biases. Furthermore, the architecture is augmented with a differentiable First-Order Logic (FOL) loss, acting as a structural regularizer by which ontological consistency is enforced across four levels: atomic actions, composite activities, Low-Level Intentions, and High-Level Intentions. Evaluation is performed on the synthesized NTU-Hierarchy dataset, a four-level ontological extension of NTU RGB+D 120, wherein existing sequences were mapped into 119,383 complex hierarchical episodes (85 actions, 16 activities, 8 LLIs, 4 HLIs). To prevent circular supervision, strict isolation between label generation and FOL constraints was maintained. In the base configuration, 91.65% top-1 action accuracy is achieved by the NSGT. When the FOL loss is incorporated into the baseline, logic consistency is improved by 3.26 percentage points to 96.67%. Through the HR-G biases, a tunable trade-off between accuracy and structural coherence is established. In the primary consistency-maximizing configuration ($λ$ = 0.5), a logic consistency of 94.59% is reached and ontological contradictions are reduced by 33%, while a robust 89.90% top-1 action accuracy is retained. Finally, interpretable reasoning evidence is provided by the learned HR-G weights, wherein transition edges are strongly exploited ($β$ trans $\approx$ +2.6) without explicit supervision.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出神经符号图Transformer（NSGT）与人类推理图（HR-G），通过可学习拓扑偏置和可微一阶逻辑损失，实现从原子动作到高层意图的四层级人机协作意图推理。
AI.motivation: 主动式人机协作要求系统不仅推断即时动作，还需理解支配人类行为的层级化意图。现有深度学习方法多聚焦于扁平化动作分类，无法刻画从运动学动作到高层目标之间的结构性依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出多模态框架下的NSGT，将人类推理图（HR-G）以可学习拓扑偏置形式融入自注意力机制；并引入可微一阶逻辑（FOL）损失作为结构正则项，在原子动作、组合活动、低层意图、高层意图四个层级上强制本体一致性。在NTU-Hierarchy合成数据集（NTU RGB+D 120的四层级本体扩展，119,383个层级片段：85动作、16活动、8 LLI、4 HLI）上评估，并严格隔离标签生成与FOL约束以避免循环监督。
AI.result: 基础配置下NSGT达到91.65%的top-1动作准确率；加入FOL损失后逻辑一致性提升3.26个百分点至96.67%。一致性最大化配置（λ=0.5）下达94.59%逻辑一致性，本体矛盾减少33%，同时保持89.90%的top-1动作准确率。学得的HR-G权重提供了可解释推理证据，转移边被显著利用（β_trans≈+2.6）且无显式监督。
AI.conclusion: NSGT结合HR-G拓扑偏置与FOL结构正则，可在精度与结构连贯性之间实现可调权衡，有效减少本体矛盾并提升逻辑一致性，同时通过图权重提供可解释的层级意图推理证据。

title: H-DDCM: Hadamard Codebooks for Fast Generative Image and Video Compression
summary: Training-free diffusion-based compression methods repurpose the generative priors of a diffusion or a flow model to compress data without retraining them as task-specific codecs. Recent codebook-based approaches such as Turbo-DDCM achieve strong perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates, but their reliance on dense Gaussian codebooks remains costly in both memory and computation, and scales poorly with the large latent dimensions of modern image and video generators. Their combinatorial bitstream encoding further becomes computationally heavy at this scale. We introduce H-DDCM, a scalable generative compression framework that replaces Gaussian codebooks with implicit randomized Hadamard dictionaries. The fast Walsh-Hadamard transform allows for implicitly synthesizing full-dimensional dictionaries with $O(d \log d)$ compute for projection and reconstruction and $O(d)$ memory, without materializing the full-dimensional dictionary. We further introduce an efficient table-free lexicographic coding scheme that makes combinatorial encoding practical at larger dimensions. Beyond images, we adapt the framework to an autoregressive video flow model and develop a streaming compression scheme that periodically re-encodes recently reconstructed frames into a fresh KV-cache prefix, preserving temporal context across segments at no additional transmitted bits. This enables long-form, close to real-time generative video compression on a single GPU. Across image and video benchmarks, H-DDCM achieves competitive rate-distortion-perception performance while substantially reducing the memory and computational overhead of codebook-based training-free generative compression.

AI.tldr: H-DDCM 用隐式随机 Hadamard 字典替代高斯码本，实现可扩展的无训练生成式压缩，并扩展到视频流式压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有基于码本的无训练生成式压缩方法（如 Turbo-DDCM）虽在超低码率下感知质量强，但稠密高斯码本在内存与计算上开销大，难以随现代图像/视频生成器的大潜空间维度扩展，其组合式比特流编码在该规模下也计算繁重。
AI.method: 提出 H-DDCM 框架：用隐式随机 Hadamard 字典替代高斯码本，借助快速 Walsh-Hadamard 变换以 O(d log d) 计算完成投影与重建、O(d) 内存隐式合成全维字典，无需显式物化字典；引入免查表的字典序编码方案，使组合编码在大维度下可行；将框架适配到自回归视频流模型，提出流式压缩方案，周期性将近期重建帧重编码为新的 KV-cache 前缀，无额外传输比特地保持跨段时序上下文。
AI.result: 在图像与视频基准上，H-DDCM 取得具有竞争力的率-失真-感知性能，同时大幅降低基于码本的无训练生成式压缩的内存与计算开销；可在单 GPU 上实现长时长、接近实时的生成式视频压缩。
AI.conclusion: H-DDCM 通过隐式 Hadamard 字典与高效编码方案提升了无训练生成式压缩的可扩展性，并成功拓展至长视频流式压缩场景。

title: QORH: Learning Query-Specific Ordered Rule Hypergraphs for Inductive Knowledge Graph Link Prediction
summary: Knowledge graph link prediction involving unseen entities and relations requires learning transferable reasoning patterns from observed graph structure. Existing methods based on relation graphs primarily capture pairwise dependencies, limiting their ability to preserve the compositional semantics, relation ordering, and role information of complete path rules. To address this limitation, we propose QORH (Query-specific Ordered Rule Hypergraph), which jointly encodes rule heads and ordered rule bodies as hyperedges conditioned on the query relation, explicitly modeling joint dependencies among multiple relations. QORH performs learnable rule selection using statistical evidence, such as rule confidence and coverage, and enhances relation representations through role-aware hypergraph message passing to guide entity-level reasoning. The model's shared parameters are independent of specific entity or relation identifiers, enabling inductive prediction for unseen entities and relations. Extensive experiments on entity-inductive and fully inductive benchmarks demonstrate that QORH significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines included in our evaluation, validating the effectiveness of rule hypergraph modeling for inductive link prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出QORH（查询特定有序规则超图），将规则头与有序规则体以超边形式联合编码，实现归纳式知识图谱链接预测。
AI.motivation: 面向未见实体与关系时，现有基于关系图的方法主要捕捉成对依赖，难以保留完整路径规则的组合语义、关系顺序与角色信息。
AI.method: 以查询关系为条件，将规则头与有序规则体编码为超边，显式建模多关系间联合依赖；利用规则置信度、覆盖率等统计证据进行可学习规则选择；通过角色感知的超图消息传递增强关系表示以指导实体级推理；共享参数与具体实体/关系标识无关。
AI.result: 在实体归纳与完全归纳基准上，QORH显著优于所评估的最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了规则超图建模在归纳式链接预测中的有效性，并支持对未见实体与关系的归纳预测。

title: Human-Inspired Asymmetric Collaboration for Dual-Student Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Dual-student learning enriches predictive diversity in SSMIS by introducing a strongly augmented view alongside a weakly augmented view. Insufficient strong augmentation may homogenize the students, whereas excessive augmentation can corrupt anatomical evidence and destabilize collaboration. This challenge echoes feedback-regulated human instruction, where learners receive differentiated tasks and the task difficulty is continually adjusted according to their evolving responses. Inspired by these, we propose Human-Inspired Asymmetric Collaboration (HAC), a closed-loop dual-student framework that maintains weak--strong learning through adaptive difficulty calibration and geometry preservation. Specifically, Reinforcement-guided Difficulty Calibration (RDC) formulates strong-augmentation control as a window-level reinforcement learning process, using augmentation history, realized perturbations, and training responses to dynamically adjust the augmentation magnitude, operation number, and magnitude range. Meanwhile, the Gramian Geometry Preservation Constraint (G2PC) preserves the early-stage three-branch geometry through global volume and pairwise area constraints, preventing shared supervision from homogenizing the two students. Comprehensive evaluations across LA, Pancreas, and BraTS-2019 validate both the segmentation effectiveness and capability-aware difficulty calibration of HAC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Human-Inspired Asymmetric Collaboration (HAC)闭环双学生框架，通过强化学习难度校准(RDC)与Gramian几何保持约束(G2PC)维持弱-强学习，在LA、Pancreas、BraTS-2019上验证了分割效果与自适应难度校准能力。
AI.motivation: 半监督医学图像分割(SSMIS)中双学生学习引入强弱增强视图以提升预测多样性，但强增强不足会使双学生同质化，过度增强则破坏解剖证据并导致协作失稳。该问题类似人类反馈调节式教学——学习者接受差异化任务且难度随其反应持续调整。
AI.method: HAC为闭环双学生框架，包含两个模块：1) Reinforcement-guided Difficulty Calibration (RDC)，将强增强控制建模为窗口级强化学习过程，利用增强历史、实际扰动与训练响应动态调整增强幅度、操作数量与幅度范围；2) Gramian Geometry Preservation Constraint (G2PC)，通过全局体积与成对面积约束保持早期三支几何结构，防止共享监督使两学生同质化。
AI.result: 在LA、Pancreas与BraTS-2019三个数据集上的综合评估验证了HAC的分割有效性及具备能力感知的难度校准特性。
AI.conclusion: 受人类反馈调节教学启发，HAC以自适应难度校准与几何保持实现强弱双学生的非对称闭环协作，兼顾分割性能与自适应难度调控，为SSMIS提供有效方案。

title: FlowCred: Hierarchical Credit Assignment and Functional Coordination for Joint Text-to-Video Post-Training
summary: Prompt optimization and generator post-training are two complementary ways to improve text-to-video (T2V) generation, and recent systems increasingly train both modules jointly. However, optimizing a prompt policy and a video generator from the same terminal reward creates two ambiguities: prompt quality is confounded with stochastic generation, and the two modules may realize overlapping local improvements. We introduce FlowCred, a two-level framework for joint T2V post-training. First, hierarchical credit assignment uses matched prompt-seed rollout grids to separate prompt-level credit from prompt-conditioned generator residuals under shared randomness. Second, functional coordination probes alternative current-policy prompts at states from actual generation trajectories, providing generator-aware evidence for prompt optimization while selectively attenuating generator updates already supported by conditioning changes. Across multiple T2V benchmarks, FlowCred consistently improves matched joint-training baselines. On LTX-2.5, FlowCred improves a strictly matched joint-training control from 61.47 to 64.46 on T2V-CompBench and from 55.58 to 58.08 on StoryEval, without increasing decoded-video or reward-model-call budgets. Factorial and realized-update analyses show complementary contributions from prompt shaping and generator routing, while human evaluation and transfer across backbones and updater families provide further supporting evidence.

AI.tldr: FlowCred 提出两级框架用于文本到视频生成的提示策略与生成器联合后训练：通过匹配提示-种子 rollout 网格进行分层信用分配，并利用功能协调探针实现生成器感知的提示优化与选择性生成器更新，在多个基准上稳定超越严格匹配的联合训练基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 T2V 系统越来越多地联合训练提示策略与视频生成器，但二者共享同一终端奖励会带来两类歧义：一是提示质量与随机生成过程相互混淆，难以判断性能提升来自提示还是采样噪声；二是两个模块可能产生重叠的局部改进，导致信用归属不清、优化冗余。
AI.method: FlowCred 采用两级框架：（1）分层信用分配，利用匹配的提示-种子 rollout 网格，在共享随机性下将提示级信用与提示条件下的生成器残差分离；（2）功能协调探针，在真实生成轨迹的状态上探测当前策略的替代提示，为提示优化提供生成器感知的证据，同时选择性衰减已由条件变化支持的生成器更新。
AI.result: 在多个 T2V 基准上，FlowCred 持续优于严格匹配的联合训练基线。在 LTX-2.5 上，将严格匹配的联合训练对照从 T2V-CompBench 的 61.47 提升至 64.46，StoryEval 从 55.58 提升至 58.08，且未增加解码视频或奖励模型调用预算。因子分析与实际更新分析显示提示塑形与生成器路由具有互补贡献，人工评估以及跨主干与更新器族的迁移结果进一步提供支持性证据。
AI.conclusion: FlowCred 通过分层信用分配与功能协调有效缓解了 T2V 联合后训练中的信用混淆与更新重叠问题，在不增加计算预算的前提下显著提升生成质量，且具备跨模型主干与优化器族的可迁移性。

title: Beyond Answer Sharing: TrueMAD for Targeted Peer Engagement in Multi-Agent Debate
summary: Multi-agent debate (MAD) aims to improve large language model reasoning by exposing agents to alternative solutions and enabling iterative revision. However, standard broadcast-style MAD makes peer answers visible without requiring agents to engage with a particular peer claim. As a result, reliable reasoning may be suppressed by conflicting or majority responses, limiting achievable performance, while erroneous reasoning may persist and degrade final predictions without actionable feedback. We propose TrueMAD, a backbone-agnostic test-time plug-in that introduces one-to-one, free-form peer advice between answer broadcasting and self-revision. Each source agent responds to a target's current reasoning through support, rebuttal, refinement, or further questions, while the target retains control over how to revise. The same mechanism can augment standard MAD and its improved variants without parameter updates. Across AIME, GPQA-Diamond, and TruthfulQA with Qwen3-30B-A3B, TrueMAD improves agent-level and strict-majority accuracy over MAD by 3.62 and 3.52 percentage points on average, while TrueDMAD improves DMAD by 4.72 and 4.06 points, respectively. Analyses at the utterance, agent-transition, and group levels further show more peer-specific deliberation, more correction-oriented revisions, and more favorable consensus dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出 TrueMAD，一种与模型骨干无关的测试时插件，在答案广播与自我修订之间引入一对一的自由形式同伴建议，提升多智能体辩论的推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 标准广播式多智能体辩论（MAD）将同伴答案直接公开，但不要求智能体针对特定同伴的观点进行回应。这导致：可靠推理可能被冲突或多数响应压制，限制性能上限；而错误推理因缺乏可操作的反馈而持续存在，最终损害预测结果。
AI.method: TrueMAD 在答案广播与自我修订之间插入一对一的自由形式同伴建议机制。每个源智能体针对目标智能体当前的推理给出支持、反驳、改进或进一步提问，而目标智能体保留如何修订的控制权。该方法无需参数更新，可直接增强标准 MAD 及其改进变体（如 DMAD）。
AI.result: 在 AIME、GPQA-Diamond 和 TruthfulQA 上，使用 Qwen3-30B-A3B，TrueMAD 相比 MAD 在智能体级和严格多数准确率上分别平均提升 3.62 和 3.52 个百分点；TrueDMAD 相比 DMAD 分别提升 4.72 和 4.06 个百分点。话语、智能体转移和群体层面的分析进一步显示，同伴针对性审议更多、纠正导向的修订更多、共识动态更有利。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入一对一的自由形式同伴建议，TrueMAD 有效缓解了广播式 MAD 中可靠推理被压制和错误推理持续存在的问题，在多个基准上稳定提升准确率，且具备插件式、无需训练的通用性。

title: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Zero-Shot Human-Object Interaction
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong zero-shot reasoning across diverse domains, but their potential for Human-Object Interaction (HOI) remains unexplored. Unlike traditional HOI approaches that rely on extensive labeled datasets and fixed interaction taxonomies, MLLMs offer flexible reasoning, making them well-suited for dynamic, real-world scenarios. In this work, we present the first systematic study of MLLMs for HOI recognition and detection within a pipeline that combines an external object detector for entity localization with zero-shot multimodal reasoning for interaction understanding. We introduce a benchmark framework for principled zero-shot evaluation, consisting of (i) a unified taxonomy of zero-shot prompting strategies, and (ii) a methodology that transforms token-level logits into interaction scores, enabling fair comparison with specialized HOI models under standard metrics. To support prompt-based evaluation, we additionally construct new question-answer annotations for standard HOI datasets, transforming them into a format suitable for MLLMs. Building on this, we propose two visual prompting strategies, namely Objects as Context and Black Other Objects, that guide MLLMs to target objects while preserving scene context. Experiments on HICO, HICO-DET, and V-COCO demonstrate state-of-the-art zero-shot performance, achieving 53.50 mAP on HICO and 23.69 mAP on HICO-DET. Overall, our work provides a principled benchmarking framework for MLLMs in HOI, opening the door to new models and datasets and enabling flexible open-world interaction understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在人-物交互（HOI）识别与检测中的零样本能力，提出统一的零样本评测基准与提示策略，并在HICO、HICO-DET、V-COCO上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 传统HOI方法依赖大量标注数据和固定交互分类体系，难以适应动态的真实场景；而MLLMs具备灵活推理能力，但其在HOI领域的潜力尚未被探索。
AI.method: 构建结合外部目标检测器（实体定位）与零样本多模态推理（交互理解）的流水线；提出零样本评测框架，包括统一的提示策略分类体系和将token级logits转化为交互分数的方法；为HOI数据集构建新问答标注；并提出两种视觉提示策略：Objects as Context与Black Other Objects。
AI.result: 在HICO上达到53.50 mAP，在HICO-DET上达到23.69 mAP，在HICO、HICO-DET和V-COCO上均取得最先进的零样本性能。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为MLLMs在HOI任务提供了原则性的评测框架，为新的模型与数据集研究开辟了方向，并支持灵活的开世界交互理解。

title: Output Discipline Sets the Floor: A Falsification-Guided, Model-Agnostic Agent Protocol for Auditable Hypothesis-Driven Decision Making
summary: What binds large language models on auditable, hypothesis-driven decision tasks, where every candidate can be checked against the evidence? On the public TCMEval-SDT benchmark for Traditional Chinese Medicine syndrome differentiation (200 cases), the binding constraint is output discipline and reasoning structure, not model capability alone: two years of model scaling move zero-shot scores by only -0.03 to +0.08, while output-discipline failures (non-terminating reasoning, format non-compliance, large run-to-run spread) persist even in frontier models. We test this with a model-agnostic agent framework formalizing decision making as a five-stage closed loop, enforced by a candidate x evidence matrix falsification protocol: every candidate is judged against every evidence item, at least half of the candidates must be falsified before a conclusion is licensed, and survivors are emitted in a machine-verifiable single-line format. Across five base models, the effect is sign-conditional on zero-shot output discipline: it rescues models whose discipline fails (DeepSeek-V4-Flash: +0.267/+0.271, entirely termination rescue), reduces a high-variance model's run-to-run standard deviation from 0.218 to 0.007 (Kimi K3), and significantly costs already-disciplined models (-0.087 to -0.120 on budget-matched Qwen3-4B/32B). Ablations attribute the cost to the candidate-bounded format layer and show the effect is independent of injected knowledge content (protocol-knowledge decoupling). The protocol also transfers to misinformation-robust mathematical reasoning, detecting injected false premises at 89.8% recall with a 6.8% false-positive rate (MCC 0.54; a flag-everything baseline scores 0) and restoring accuracy to the no-misinformation ceiling. Where zero-shot output discipline is weak, the reasoning protocol sets the floor; base-model capability always sets the ceiling.
