AI.tldr: 在TCMEval-SDT中医辨证基准（200例）上，约束大模型可审计决策任务的主要瓶颈是输出纪律与推理结构，而非模型能力；作者提出模型无关的五阶段闭环智能体框架（候选×证据矩阵证伪协议），效果符号取决于零样本输出纪律：对纪律差的模型救场、对纪律好的模型有代价，且可迁移至抗错误前提的数学推理。
AI.motivation: 在候选可逐条对照证据核验的"可审计、假设驱动"决策任务中，大模型的实际瓶颈尚不明确。作者指出两年模型规模扩展对零样本得分仅带来-0.03至+0.08的微小变化，而输出纪律失败（推理不终止、格式不合规、运行间方差大）在前沿模型中依旧存在，因此需要区分"能力"与"输出纪律/推理结构"两类限制。
AI.method: 提出模型无关的智能体框架：将决策形式化为五阶段闭环；用候选×证据矩阵证伪协议强制每个候选与每条证据逐一比对，结论放行前须证伪至少半数候选，存活候选以机器可验证的单行格式输出。方法在五个基座模型上测试，并进行消融（定位代价来源为候选受限格式层）与"协议—知识解耦"检验；另迁移到含错误前提的数学推理任务。
AI.result: 效果符号条件于零样本输出纪律：拯救纪律失败模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash +0.267/+0.271，全部来自终止性救援）；将高方差模型Kimi K3的运行间标准差从0.218降至0.007；对已具备纪律的模型（预算匹配的Qwen3-4B/32B）显著带来-0.087至-0.120的代价。消融显示代价源于候选受限格式层，且效应与注入知识内容无关。数学推理迁移中：错误前提检出召回89.8%、假阳性6.8%（MCC 0.54；"全部标记"基线为0），并将准确率恢复到无误导上限。
AI.conclusion: 在零样本输出纪律薄弱处，推理协议设定性能下限；而基座模型能力始终设定性能上限。

title: VARI: Robust Text-to-Video Generation via Group-Structured Intent Alignment
summary: Modern text-to-video (T2V) models generate visually compelling videos, yet meaning-preserving changes in prompt wording can substantially alter semantic realization and overall quality. Existing prompt rewriting modifies the inference input, whereas conventional post-training constructs supervision from one prompt formulation at a time; neither explicitly optimizes reliability across equivalent forms. We introduce VARI (Verified Alignment over Representations of Intent), a group-structured framework that treats automatically verified formulations of the same visual intent as a shared supervision unit. VARI builds matched form-seed rollout pools, cross-scores each video against all forms, and applies a wording-independent structured intent audit to identify valid realizations and hard semantic failures. Group-Consistent Distillation (GCD) aligns every verified form with interchangeable valid realizations, while Form-Contrastive Flow-DPO (FC-DPO) learns group-level preferences from audited positive-negative pairs, prioritizing same-seed, different-form contrasts. On HunyuanVideo-1.5, VARI attains the highest T2V-CompBench, VBench, and StoryEval scores among the evaluated methods. On prompt-form extensions of T2V-CompBench and VBench, it improves weakest-form alignment over the strongest prompt-level baselines by 2.45 and 3.55 points and reduces cross-form drop by 30.5% and 32.2%, respectively, while preserving visual quality. Human evaluation, natural-caption controls, prompt-enhancement experiments, diversity analyses, and transfer to LTX-2.3 further support the robustness and transferability of these gains, while VARI requires no additional inference-time module.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VARI框架，将同一视觉意图下经自动验证的多种提示改写形式视为共享监督单元，通过组一致性蒸馏与形式对比Flow-DPO提升文本到视频生成的跨形式可靠性，且不增加推理时模块。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到视频模型对提示措辞的细微改写敏感，意义保持的改写会显著改变语义实现与整体质量。提示改写仅修改推理输入，而传统后训练每次仅基于单一提示表述构造监督，二者均未显式优化跨等效形式（equivalent forms）的可靠性。
AI.method: VARI构建匹配的"形式-种子"采样池，将每个视频与所有形式交叉打分；采用与措辞无关的结构化意图审计，识别有效实现与硬性语义失败。方法包含两个组件：组一致性蒸馏（GCD）将每个已验证形式与可互换的有效实现对齐；形式对比Flow-DPO（FC-DPO）从审计得到的正负样本对中学习组级偏好，优先采用同种子、不同形式的对比。
AI.result: 在HunyuanVideo-1.5上，VARI在所评估方法中取得最高的T2V-CompBench、VBench和StoryEval分数。在T2V-CompBench与VBench的提示形式扩展集上，最弱形式对齐较最强的提示级基线分别提升2.45和3.55分，跨形式性能下降分别减少30.5%和32.2%，同时保持视觉质量。人工评估、自然描述控制、提示增强实验、多样性分析及向LTX-2.3的迁移进一步支持其鲁棒性与可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 将等效提示形式作为组级共享监督单元并配合组一致性蒸馏与形式对比偏好优化，可有效提升T2V生成的跨形式一致性与最弱形式对齐，且无需额外推理时模块，具有良好的鲁棒性与可迁移性。

title: A dataset of formalised theorem statements from the Annals of Mathematics
comment: Accepted at AI-MATH@NeurIPS, the 6th workshop on mathematical reasoning and AI, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Recent progress in autoformalisation of mathematics using AI has been impressive. Measuring this progress requires datasets of formal statements that are both hard and trustworthy. We present AnnalsChallenge: 50 formalised theorem statements written by hand in Lean 4 using Mathlib. Each is the main result of a paper published in the Annals of Mathematics since 2020. Every formalisation was manually reviewed and then audited by AI. We release them without formalised proofs.

AI.tldr: AnnalsChallenge 是一个包含 50 个 Lean 4（Mathlib）形式化定理陈述的数据集，均取自 2020 年以来发表于《Annals of Mathematics》的论文主结果，仅提供陈述不带形式化证明，并经过人工评审与 AI 审计。
AI.motivation: 评估 AI 数学自动形式化（autoformalisation）的进展，需要既困难又可信的形式化陈述数据集。现有基准在难度与可信度上难以兼顾，因此作者构建了这一高难度、经审核的形式化定理陈述集合。
AI.method: 选取 2020 年以来发表于《Annals of Mathematics》论文的主要定理，手工用 Lean 4 与 Mathlib 进行形式化，形成 50 条定理陈述；每条形式化结果先经人工评审，再由 AI 进行审计；数据集仅发布形式化陈述，不包含形式化证明。
AI.result: 公开了 AnnalsChallenge 数据集：50 条高难度形式化定理陈述（Lean 4 + Mathlib），全部经过人工评审与 AI 审计，且不含形式化证明。
AI.conclusion: AnnalsChallenge 为衡量自动形式化进展提供了困难且可信的基准，可用于评估 AI 将前沿数学论文定理转化为形式化陈述的能力，后续工作可在此基础上补充形式化证明。

title: Closing the Estimation Gap: Training-Free Transductive Inference for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Action Recognition
summary: Cross-domain few-shot action recognition (CD-FSAR) aims to recognise unseen action classes in a target domain from a handful of labelled videos. Despite advances in representation learning, CD-FSAR inference still relies on prototypes estimated from extremely limited support examples. To assess this bottleneck, we perform an oracle analysis with the representation fixed. Constructing oracle prototypes and decision boundaries from ground-truth query labels improves 5-way 1-shot accuracy by 7--20 percentage points across five target datasets. This reveals a substantial estimation gap: the representation contains useful discriminative information, but prototypes and boundaries estimated from scarce supports fail to capture each episode's true class structure. Motivated by this, we propose TRACE, a training-free transductive inference framework that improves episode-level estimation without modifying the backbone. TRACE comprises two complementary stages. Confidence-Thresholded Transductive Prototype Refinement (CTPR) refines support-based prototypes using confidently predicted queries. The refined prototypes initialise a lightweight per-episode classifier, which Transductive Classifier Refinement (TCR) further adapts by encouraging confident, class-balanced predictions over all queries. Together, the two stages improve prototype and boundary estimation, enabling better use of information in the unlabelled queries. Across five target datasets (HMDB51, UCF101, SSv2, Diving48, and RareAct) in both 1-shot and 5-shot settings, TRACE consistently improves a strong CD-FSAR baseline, including gains of more than six percentage points on HMDB51 1-shot, while recovering much of the oracle-estimated gap. These results suggest that improving test-time estimation is a powerful, broadly applicable complement to representation learning for CD-FSAR under extreme support scarcity.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示跨域小样本动作识别中"原型/决策边界估计"是主要瓶颈，并提出免训练直推式框架TRACE，通过两阶段优化episode级估计，显著提升基线性能。
AI.motivation: CD-FSAR推理依赖极少量support样本估计的原型，尽管表示学习已有进展，但原型与决策边界的估计误差仍是瓶颈。作者通过oracle分析验证：固定表示、用真实query标签构造oracle原型与边界，5-way 1-shot准确率在五个目标数据集上提升7-20个百分点，说明表示中包含可判别信息，但稀缺support导致估计失败。
AI.method: TRACE为免训练直推式推理框架，不修改backbone，含两阶段：1) CTPR（置信度阈值化直推原型精炼）利用高置信度预测的query精炼support原型；2) TCR（直推分类器精炼）以精炼原型初始化轻量级per-episode分类器，并通过鼓励高置信、类别平衡的全query预测进一步适配。
AI.result: 在HMDB51、UCF101、SSv2、Diving48、RareAct五个目标数据集、1-shot与5-shot设置下，TRACE持续提升强CD-FSAR基线，HMDB51 1-shot提升超过6个百分点，并恢复大部分oracle估计的差距。
AI.conclusion: 在极端support稀缺下，改进测试时估计是表示学习的强有力且广泛适用的补充方向；TRACE验证了episode级估计优化的有效性。

title: Efficient Safety Guardrails through Latent Dual-Hypothesis Reasoning with On-Demand Trace Reconstruction
summary: Guardrail approaches that rely on reasoning-based large language models (LLM) improve safety decisions, but come with substantial inference overhead due to the explicit reasoning. We introduce LR-Guard (Latent Reasoning Guardrail), an efficient and explainable guardrail that jointly learns structured latent reasoning and on-demand reasoning reconstruction. Our method distills a frozen teacher's analysis of safe and unsafe prompt interpretations and their comparison into compact latent representations. Joint training optimizes these representations for both safety prediction and reconstruction of the teacher's explicit reasoning traces, enabling human-readable explanations without requiring intermediate text generation for every decision. Experiments show that LR-Guard outperforms its explicit-reasoning teacher in most in-domain and out-of-domain settings on safety classification and explanation extraction, while achieving a 19.4x inference speedup at batch size one. Further, reconstructed reasoning traces from the latent information exhibit high semantic similarity to the teacher's explicit reasoning.

AI.tldr: LR-Guard 通过联合学习结构化潜在推理与按需推理重建，在保持可解释性的同时大幅降低推理开销，取得 19.4 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 基于推理的 LLM 护栏虽提升安全决策质量，但显式推理带来显著的推理开销，需要在效率与可解释性之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出 LR-Guard：蒸馏冻结教师模型对安全/不安全提示解释及其比较的分析为紧凑潜在表示；联合训练使潜在表示同时服务于安全预测与教师显式推理轨迹的重建，从而实现无需对每次决策生成中间文本的可读解释。
AI.result: 在多数域内与域外设置下，安全分类与解释抽取均优于显式推理教师模型；batch size 为 1 时获得 19.4 倍推理加速；由潜在信息重建的推理轨迹与教师显式推理具有高语义相似度。
AI.conclusion: 潜在推理可有效替代显式推理，在提升安全分类与解释质量的同时显著降低推理成本，验证了潜在表示承载可解释推理信息的可行性。

title: Heading Hierarchy Reconstruction for Complex and Long Documents with Level-Wise Multimodal Memory
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have been widely adopted for document parsing and optical character recognition (OCR), as they can accurately extract page-level elements. However, downstream applications such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) also require coherent document-level structure. Although these models indicate heading levels using different numbers of preceding ``\#'' symbols, page-by-page prediction often lacks document-level consistency. In practice, input-resolution and context-length constraints make it infeasible for a VLM to jointly process all page images in documents containing tens or hundreds of pages. To address this limitation, we propose a VLM-based framework that incrementally reconstructs heading hierarchies with a \emph{level-wise multimodal memory}. The memory retains a compact subset of all previously processed pages, selected by anchors. Our framework supports flexible anchor selection, and in this work we select the most recent node at each level, allowing the VLM to observe the visual, textual, and layout patterns of headings at every level. For comprehensive evaluation, we also introduce the Complex and Long Document Heading Hierarchy Reconstruction Benchmark (CLDoc-HHRBench), comprising 250 documents and 11,212 pages with expert-verified annotations. Experiments on CLDoc-HHRBench and three existing benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于VLM的文档标题层级重建框架，通过“逐层多模态记忆”增量式整合跨页标题信息，并发布CLDoc-HHRBench基准，在多个数据集上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在文档解析与OCR中可精确抽取页面级元素，但RAG等下游任务需要连贯的文档级结构。模型虽用“#”数量表示标题层级，逐页预测却缺乏文档级一致性；而输入分辨率与上下文长度限制使VLM无法同时处理数十乃至数百页的整份文档。
AI.method: 提出VLM框架，利用“逐层多模态记忆”增量重建标题层级。记忆通过锚点从已处理页面中挑选紧凑子集，保留各级标题的视觉、文本与版式模式；框架支持灵活的锚点选择策略，本文选取每一层级最近的节点作为锚点。
AI.result: 在新建的CLDoc-HHRBench（含250份文档、11,212页、专家校验标注）以及三个现有基准上的实验，证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 逐层多模态记忆可有效缓解VLM逐页处理时的文档级一致性缺失问题，实现长文档标题层级重建，并为该任务提供了新的评测基准。

title: Complex materials engineering via Provenance Action Graphs: potential, structure and demonstration
summary: This work discusses and tests the potential of reaction graphs for material synthesis, in which events consist of reaction steps (actions) and their outputs (observations). The importance comes from the requirement to synthesize technologically useful materials, especially those that are kinetically stabilized. Often, it is a science that follows years of trial and error, culminating in (published) successful recipes, but is truly driven by far more (unpublished) failures. The entry into the era of AI provides an opportunity to use learning algorithms to encode rules from multi-dimensional synthesis pathways, regardless of their technological usefulness, and to decode both forward prediction and inverse learning modes. The main incentive is to accelerate material discovery by generating a global knowledge base that can be shared among data agents and contributed to by them. We will focus on several scenarios in the common synthesis process during solid-state synthesis, primarily because these reactions are kinetic in nature and require closer monitoring and control of the reaction history.

AI.tldr: 该工作探讨并测试"反应图"在材料合成中的潜力：将合成事件建模为反应步骤（动作）与其产物（观测），借助AI学习算法从多维合成路径中编码规则，实现正向预测与逆向学习，从而加速（尤其是动力学稳定）材料的发现并构建可共享的全球知识库。
AI.motivation: 技术上有用、尤其是动力学稳定的材料合成长期依赖多年试错，成功配方被发表、大量失败却未被记录。进入AI时代后，有机会利用学习算法从多维合成路径中自动编码规则，突破传统试错的低效瓶颈。
AI.method: 以"反应图"为核心表示，将事件定义为反应步骤（动作）及其输出（观测）；对多维合成路径应用学习算法进行规则编码，并同时支持正向预测（由条件预测产物）与逆向学习（由目标产物反推路径）两种模式。研究聚焦固相合成的若干典型场景，因其反应本质为动力学控制，需对反应历程进行更细致的监测与控制。
AI.result: 论证了反应图用于材料合成的可行性与其在正、逆两类学习模式上的测试潜力，说明可从合成路径中提取可迁移规则，并具备构建由多个数据代理共同贡献与共享的全球知识库的前景。
AI.conclusion: 反应图为整合分散的成功与失败合成经验提供了统一框架，可在不依赖材料技术实用性的前提下学习合成规律，赋能正向与逆向预测，最终通过共享知识库加速材料发现，并以固相动力学合成为重点落地场景。

title: LiFUSE: Frequency-Spatial Unified Self-Supervised Pretraining for Liver Disease Analysis on Non-contrast CT
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (BIBM 2026)
summary: Given the growing global burden of liver tumors and diffuse liver diseases, non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT) is increasingly used for opportunistic screening because of its low cost and favorable safety profile. However, downstream tasks such as tumor detection and fine-grained disease diagnosis remain challenging due to NCCT's inherently low tissue contrast, lack of hemodynamic enhancement, and complex anatomical background. These limitations make subtle, heterogeneous, and multifocal hepatic lesions difficult to identify. Although large-scale self-supervised pretraining can learn robust representations from unlabeled NCCT scans, conventional voxel-wise reconstruction does not fully exploit the complementary information available in NCCT. Under weak NCCT contrast, low-level intensity patterns become less informative for pathology recognition, limiting the capture of lesion-specific discriminative features. In this paper, we propose the Liver Frequency-Spatial Unified Self-Supervised Pretraining (LiFUSE). The frequency branch applies random band-stop masking and spectrum reconstruction to encourage the model to capture subtle differences between lesions and surrounding tissues, while the spatial branch performs hybrid-granularity masked volumetric reconstruction to accommodate lesions of diverse sizes and morphologies. Finally, a cross-domain consistency scheme couples the spatial and frequency branches, yielding more discriminative representations for hepatic structures and lesions. Extensive experiments on three clinically relevant tasks across internal cohorts and a public target-domain transfer setting show that LiFUSE consistently outperforms strong baselines. These results suggest that unified frequency-spatial learning can improve liver disease analysis on NCCT, highlighting its potential for large-scale screening.

AI.tldr: 提出LiFUSE自监督预训练框架，融合频域与空域重建以提升NCCT肝脏病变分析。
AI.motivation: NCCT成本低、安全性好，适合机会性筛查，但其组织对比度低、缺乏血流动力学增强、解剖背景复杂，导致肿瘤检测与细粒度肝病诊断困难。现有体素级自监督重建未充分利用NCCT互补信息，低层强度模式对病灶判别性不足。
AI.method: LiFUSE包含双分支：频率分支采用随机带阻掩蔽与频谱重建，捕捉病灶与周围组织的细微差异；空间分支进行混合粒度掩蔽体积重建，适配不同大小与形态的病灶；通过跨域一致性机制耦合两分支，学习更具判别性的肝脏结构与病灶表征。
AI.result: 在内部队列的三个临床相关任务及公开目标域迁移设置上，LiFUSE持续优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 统一的频率-空间学习可改善NCCT肝病分析，展现大规模筛查潜力。

title: AssetForge: Asset-Augmented Task Synthesis for Business Automation Agents
summary: Training business automation agents requires executable tasks that connect a natural-language request to an application state and a verifiable end state. Traditional Rubrics requires Authors to recreate application interfaces, initial records, policy evidence, and outcome checks for each task, entangling business logic with repeated infrastructure work. We introduce AssetForge, an asset-augmented task-construction pipeline that pairs a reusable construction-asset library with task-specific Rubrics. The assets provide application interfaces, world-state components, policy/evidence carriers, and native assertion definitions; the Rubric directs their instantiation for a particular business task. Executable checks and an additional model-based review validate each candidate, return targeted feedback, and support bounded repair before acceptance. On AutomationBench v1.0.6 public-600, fine-tuning Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on 6,000 AssetForge examples yields 41.17% on the official strict pass@1 metric, 4.4 times the 9.33% base score (+31.83 points). With the same backbone and GLM-5.3 supervision, AssetForge reaches 41.17% versus 30.33% for traditional Rubrics, a 10.84-point gain (35.7% relative) at the same accepted-example scale (6,000 versus 6,000 examples). Both DeepSeek- and GLM-supervised AssetForge models improve AppWorld completion over the base model on Test-Normal and Test-Challenge. These results establish the advantage of AssetForge's complete construction pipeline on AutomationBench public: the coupled asset-Rubric interface directs Authors toward business logic, while executable checks and model-based review validate their tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AssetForge，一种“资产增强”的任务构建流水线，通过可复用构建资产库与任务特定 Rubric 的耦合，替代传统 Rubric 中重复搭建基础设施的方式，用于训练业务自动化智能体。
AI.motivation: 训练业务自动化智能体需要可执行任务，将自然语言请求与应用状态、可验证终态相连接。传统 Rubric 要求作者为每个任务重建应用界面、初始记录、策略证据与结果校验，导致业务逻辑与重复性的基础设施工作纠缠在一起，效率低且难以复用。
AI.method: AssetForge 将可复用构建资产库与任务特定 Rubric 配对：资产库提供应用界面、世界状态组件、策略/证据载体与原生断言定义；Rubric 指导这些资产在特定业务任务中的实例化。每个候选任务经可执行检查与额外的基于模型的审查进行验证，返回针对性反馈，并在接受前支持有界修复。
AI.result: 在 AutomationBench v1.0.6 public-600 上，用 6,000 条 AssetForge 样本微调 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，官方严格 pass@1 达 41.17%，为基线 9.33% 的 4.4 倍（+31.83 点）。相同骨干与 GLM-5.3 监督、相同接受样本规模（6,000 对 6,000）下，AssetForge 达 41.17%，传统 Rubric 为 30.33%，提升 10.84 点（相对 35.7%）。DeepSeek 与 GLM 监督的 AssetForge 模型均在 AppWorld 的 Test-Normal 与 Test-Challenge 上优于基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了 AssetForge 完整构建流水线在 AutomationBench public 上的优势：资产—Rubric 耦合接口引导作者聚焦业务逻辑，而可执行检查与模型审查则保证任务有效性。

title: FALLNEST: Dual-Domain Dataset Condensation of Imbalanced IMU Data for Wearable Fall Detection
summary: Wearable fall detection is hampered by rare fall events, scarce labeled IMU data, and the cost of training deep models on large, imbalanced corpora. Existing methods either rely on hand-crafted features with shallow classifiers, which limits learning from raw signals, or train deep networks on full datasets that require re-sampling to counter class skew and demand substantial data and compute. To address this, we propose a novel Fall detection framework via Normalized-gradient and Embedding matched Synthetic Time-frequency condensation, dubbed FALLNEST, a data-centric approach that distills large, imbalanced IMU datasets into tiny, class-balanced synthetic training sets. Building on dual-domain time-series condensation (CondTSC), FALLNEST introduces a fall-specific 7-channel input with accelerometer vector magnitude, class-balanced K-Means initialization, and normalized gradient matching with gradient clipping, combined with MMD-based embedding alignment and multi-view Fourier-domain augmentation, so that class balance arises from the condensed set itself rather than from re-sampling. We evaluate on SisFall, KFall, and MobiFall using strict subject-wise splits and naturally imbalanced test sets, reporting accuracy, Macro-F1, and PR-AUC over five seeds. A 102K-parameter TinyCNN trained on only 32 to 146 synthetic windows (about only 1% of the training windows) reaches 93.5-95.8% mean accuracy and 0.89-0.98 PR-AUC, with standard deviations of 1.0-1.7% in accuracy, demonstrating the efficacy of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出 FALLNEST，一种以数据为中心的可穿戴跌倒检测框架，通过归一化梯度与嵌入匹配的合成时频压缩，将大规模不平衡 IMU 数据蒸馏为极小的类别均衡合成训练集，仅用 32–146 个合成窗口即可训练 TinyCNN 达到 93.5–95.8% 准确率。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴跌倒检测面临跌倒事件稀少、标注 IMU 数据稀缺，以及在大规模不平衡数据上训练深度模型成本高的问题。现有方法要么依赖手工特征与浅层分类器，难以从原始信号中充分学习；要么在全量数据上训练深度网络，需重采样以应对类别偏斜，并消耗大量数据与算力。
AI.method: FALLNEST 基于双域时间序列压缩（CondTSC），引入跌倒专用的 7 通道输入（含加速度计矢量幅值）、类别均衡的 K-Means 初始化，以及带梯度裁剪的归一化梯度匹配，并结合基于 MMD 的嵌入对齐与多视角傅里叶域增强，使类别均衡由压缩集自身产生而非依赖重采样。在 SisFall、KFall、MobiFall 上采用严格按受试者划分的划分方式与自然不平衡测试集，报告五个随机种子下的准确率、Macro-F1 与 PR-AUC。
AI.result: 仅用 32 至 146 个合成窗口（约为训练窗口的 1%）训练 102K 参数的 TinyCNN，达到 93.5–95.8% 的平均准确率与 0.89–0.98 的 PR-AUC，准确率标准差为 1.0–1.7%。
AI.conclusion: FALLNEST 通过数据压缩而非重采样解决类别不平衡，在极小合成训练集上即可实现高精度、低方差的跌倒检测，验证了以数据为中心的时频压缩方法在可穿戴跌倒检测中的有效性。

title: Choosing LLMs for Strategic Agent Interactions
comment: NeurIPS workshop on Foundations of Agentic Systems Theory (FAST), 2026
summary: Game-theoretic benchmarks claim that large language model (LLM) strategic decision-making varies across game types, interaction structures, and capability dimensions. However, they only evaluate strategic performance across individual fixed models. In parallel, contemporary LLM routers pick models under quality-cost trade-offs, but with no notion of a strategic structure. They do not account for an opponent that might be unknown, and that can adapt over time and shift the feedback signal. To address this, we extend the game-theoretic evaluations and define strategic selection as the meta game layered on top of the base game. In each round, a strategic selector fields an LLM from a portfolio of models to navigate a game payoff matrix that is latent and learned online. We find that the evaluation signal is game-specific, and that extracting a reliable signal requires a much higher number of seed runs $N$ compared to traditional benchmarking setups. Evaluating across 5 games and 10 LLMs, we show a model's strategic competence varies significantly depending on the game setup and the opponent faced. Building on this, we implement a suite of selector methods and find that approaches that rely on query embeddings or LLM self-reflection do not consistently capture the underlying strategic signal. A lightweight multi-armed bandit algorithm performs more reliably across games, though it still falls short of the best fixed model. Finally, we show that simple non-stationary and adversarial bandit variants fail to outperform a stationary bandit baseline, pointing to a gap in how current methods handle a shifting opponent in strategic settings.

AI.tldr: 本文将博弈论评估扩展为“策略选择”元博弈：每轮从LLM池中选模型参与潜在收益矩阵博弈，发现评估信号具博弈特异性、需更多种子运行；在5个博弈与10个LLM上，模型策略能力随博弈设置和对手显著变化，查询嵌入与LLM自省方法难以稳定捕捉策略信号，轻量多臂老虎机较可靠但仍不及最佳固定模型，非平稳/对抗bandit也未超越平稳bandit基线。
AI.motivation: 现有博弈论基准仅评估单个固定模型的策略表现，而LLM路由器只在质量–成本权衡下选模型，缺乏策略结构、未考虑未知且可随时间适应并改变反馈信号的对手，因此需要定义并研究“策略选择”这一元博弈问题。
AI.method: 将博弈论评估扩展为叠加在基础博弈之上的元博弈：每轮策略选择器从LLM组合中派出一个模型，应对潜在且在线学习的博弈收益矩阵；跨5个博弈与10个LLM评估；计算所需种子运行数N以提取可靠信号；实现并比较多类选择器方法，包括依赖查询嵌入、LLM自省、轻量多臂老虎机、非平稳与对抗bandit变体，并与平稳bandit基线及最佳固定模型对比。
AI.result: 评估信号具博弈特异性，且相比传统基准需要显著更高的种子运行数N；模型的策略能力随博弈设置和对手差异显著；查询嵌入或LLM自省类方法无法一致捕捉底层策略信号；轻量多臂老虎机跨博弈更可靠但仍低于最佳固定模型；简单非平稳与对抗bandit变体未能超越平稳bandit基线。
AI.conclusion: 策略选择应被视为基础博弈之上的元博弈问题；当前方法在应对随时间变化、可适应的对手时存在明显缺口，平稳bandit是较强基线，非平稳/对抗方法未能带来提升，表明需要新的方法处理策略环境中的对手漂移。

title: Traditional and Recent Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 1)
summary: Infrared small target detection is often used in different civilian and military applications to detect static or moving targets in scenes like in ground, air and sea surveillance. First valuable research has emerged since 30 years ago and the two last decades witnessed very significant publications in this field following the rise of low-rank and sparse decomposition (model-based methods) and deep learning models (data-based methods). Furthermore, several surveys can be found in the literature but none of them addresses an overall review in this field. In this context, the aim of this paper is to provide a complete survey of the traditional and recent approaches in infrared small target detection. First, we categorize the different approaches found in the literature in terms of the modeling models, i.e mathematical models, machine learning models and signal processing models. Then, we have discussed them in terms of the critical situations that they claim to handle. Furthermore, we present the available resources, datasets and libraries. Then, we conclude with several promising directions for future research. For the sake of reading, this survey is divided into two parts: 1) "Traditional and Recent Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 1)" about conventional and low-rank and sparse decomposition (model-based methods), and 2) "Traditional and Recent Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 2)" about deep learning models (data-based methods).

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇红外小目标检测领域的综述（分为两部分），系统梳理了传统方法与近期方法，按数学模型、机器学习模型和信号处理模型等进行分类，并讨论其适用场景、可用资源、数据集与库，最后展望未来研究方向。第1部分聚焦传统方法与低秩稀疏分解（基于模型），第2部分聚焦深度学习（基于数据）。
AI.motivation: 红外小目标检测广泛应用于地面、空中和海上监视等民用与军事场景。该领域已有约30年研究历史，近二十年在低秩稀疏分解（基于模型）和深度学习（基于数据）推动下出现大量重要成果。现有综述虽多，但缺乏对该领域的整体性回顾，因此需要一篇完整的综述来系统归纳传统与近期方法。
AI.method: 综述方法：将文献中的各类方法按建模方式分类，即数学模型、机器学习模型和信号处理模型；并针对各方法声称能应对的关键情形（critical situations）进行讨论；同时整理现有资源、数据集和库。全文分为两部分：第1部分涵盖传统方法与低秩稀疏分解（基于模型的方法），第2部分涵盖深度学习模型（基于数据的方法）。
AI.result: 提供了一份完整的红外小目标检测综述：对传统与近期方法进行分类与讨论，梳理了可用资源、数据集与库，并总结了若干有前景的未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述填补了红外小目标检测领域缺乏整体性回顾的空白，系统整合了基于模型与基于数据的两大类方法，为该领域研究者提供了全面的参考框架，并指出未来研究的若干方向。

title: ABot-ER: Unified Embodied Reasoning through Agentic Data-Model Co-Evolution
summary: We introduce ABot Embodied Reasoning (ABot-ER), a unified embodied reasoning foundation model that breaks the tension between breadth and depth in embodied reasoning. Embodied intelligence demands the joint mastery of perception, planning, and execution, yet reconciling generality with specialization across this spectrum remains an open challenge. Within a single unified model, ABot-ER commands specialist-level depth across all three competencies, spanning spatial, scene, and temporal reasoning in perception; long-horizon action organization in planning; and point grounding and affordance in execution. The Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine continuously adapts data strategies to the model's evolving capability state. The Task-Conditioned Adaptive Training Strategy uses task tokens to activate lightweight low-rank residuals over a shared backbone, separating updates from heterogeneous output formats while retaining shared embodied knowledge. Across a systematic evaluation on twelve benchmarks covering three core competencies and five capability dimensions, ABot-ER achieves state-of-the-art overall performance across perception, planning, and execution within a unified parametric framework, demonstrating that breadth and depth can coexist in unified embodied reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的具身推理基础模型ABot-ER，在单一参数框架内同时实现感知、规划与执行三个能力的专家级深度，在12个基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 具身智能需要同时掌握感知、规划与执行，但在整个能力谱系上兼顾通用性与专业性是未解难题；现有方法难以在单一模型内打破"广度"与"深度"之间的张力。
AI.method: ABot-ER通过两项关键机制实现：（1）Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine，依据模型能力状态持续自适应调整数据策略；（2）Task-Conditioned Adaptive Training Strategy，利用任务token在共享backbone上激活轻量级低秩残差，在保留共享具身知识的同时分离异构输出格式的更新。
AI.result: 在覆盖3项核心能力、5个能力维度的12个基准上进行系统评测，ABot-ER在单一参数框架下于感知、规划、执行三方面均取得整体SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明广度与深度可以在统一具身推理中共存，为构建通用且专业的具身基础模型提供了可行路径。

title: Efficient Scene-Text Refinement via Pixel-Space Grouped Image Generation
summary: Generated images often have coherent layouts and visual content, yet local errors in small text and complex characters still limit their readability and practical use. Scene-text refinement requires accuracy, preservation, and efficiency. Existing methods based on variational autoencoders (VAEs) can lose fine strokes during reconstruction, while full-image editing can shift background colors. In this work, we introduce PixText, a model that formulates local text refinement as grouped image generation in pixel space. Conditioned on the original image, PixText generates only the target regions, preserves unedited content, and uses MeanFlow for four-step generation. We further introduce Text Refinement Bench to evaluate text correction and image preservation in generated images. On this benchmark, PixText achieves 83.06% glyph pass and 94.66% exact target-character OCR accuracy, versus 36.77% and 52.31% for the strongest baseline. Its four-step MeanFlow variant retains an 81.84% pass rate with less than one GPU-second of amortized generation cost per image.

AI.tldr: PixText将局部文本精修建模为像素空间的区域化图像生成，配合MeanFlow四步生成，在新建的Text Refinement Bench上实现83.06%字形通过率与94.66%目标字符OCR准确率，远超最强基线(pass率36.77%、准确率52.31%)，四步版本以每图不足1 GPU秒的摊销成本保持81.84%通过率。
AI.motivation: 生成图像虽整体布局与视觉内容连贯，但小文本与复杂字符的局部错误仍损害其可读性与实用性。场景文本精修需兼顾准确性、保真性与效率。基于VAE的方法在重建时会丢失细笔画，而全图编辑又会引起背景颜色偏移。
AI.method: 提出PixText：将局部文本精修表述为像素空间中的分组图像生成，以原图为条件仅生成目标区域、保留未编辑内容，并采用MeanFlow实现四步生成。同时构建Text Refinement Bench，用于评估生成图像的文本纠正效果与图像保真度。
AI.result: 在Text Refinement Bench上，PixText取得83.06%字形通过率与94.66%精确目标字符OCR准确率，而最强基线仅为36.77%与52.31%。其四步MeanFlow变体以每张图像不足1 GPU秒的摊销生成开销，仍保持81.84%的通过率。
AI.conclusion: 将局部文本精修转化为像素空间的区域生成，可在避免笔画丢失与背景漂移的同时，以低步数、低开销实现高精度的字形与字符级修正，为生成图像的文本可读性提供高效方案。

title: Delegating Earth science model calibration to knowledge-guided LLM agents
summary: Applying process-based Earth science models to new sites and questions often requires expert calibration decisions. Reliable delegation to language-model agents must preserve scientific competence and reproducibility. Here we develop a general calibration harness (GCH) for end-to-end delegation from a calibration request to assessed results. Constrained by a knowledge infrastructure (KI) and a validation convention, agents define parameter domains, observation mappings and objectives, and generate model-specific code. GCH checks the formulations against the same declarations and freezes them before numerical search and assessment, which require no further agent judgement. Agent-authored workflows executed across six model families, with assessment identifying unmet criteria. In snow-model tests, five of five knowledge-guided specifications executed on the first attempt, compared with none of five given only the model name, achieving validation Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency (NSE) of 0.81-0.94 against 0.57 for defaults. Under a common objective, independent GR4J formulations yielded scores within 0.001 NSE; re-evaluating eleven saved parameter vectors reproduced their metrics. In ten paired VIC tests with matched budgets, fixed search was non-inferior to continuing agent proposals (margin, -0.02 NSE; median difference, -0.003). This separation enables end-to-end calibration delegation with inspectable scientific choices and reproducible numerical evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通用校准框架（GCH），在知识基础设施与验证约定约束下，让语言模型智能体端到端委托水文/地球科学模型校准：智能体负责科学决策与代码生成并被冻结，数值搜索与评估不再需要智能体判断，从而兼顾科学能力与可复现性。
AI.motivation: 将过程式地球科学模型应用到新站点与新问题时，往往依赖专家的校准决策。若把校准全权委托给语言模型智能体，必须既保持科学能力又保证可复现性，而已有做法往往将科学判断与数值搜索混在一起，难以审查和复现。
AI.method: 提出通用校准框架（GCH），实现从校准请求到结果评估的端到端委托。在知识基础设施（KI）和验证约定约束下，智能体定义参数域、观测映射与目标函数，并生成模型专用代码；GCH 依据相同声明检查公式并在数值搜索与评估前冻结，后续流程不再需要智能体判断。跨六个模型族执行智能体编写的工作流，并通过评估识别未满足的准则。
AI.result: 在融雪模型测试中，知识引导的五份规范全部一次执行成功，而仅给出模型名称的五份全部失败；验证期 NSE 为 0.81–0.94，默认配置为 0.57。在共同目标下，独立生成的 GR4J 公式得分差异在 0.001 NSE 以内；重新评估十一个已保存参数向量可复现其指标。在十个配对 VIC 测试、预算匹配条件下，固定搜索不劣于继续由智能体提出方案（裕度 −0.02 NSE，中位差 −0.003）。
AI.conclusion: GCH 将智能体的科学决策与数值评估分离，使端到端校准委托具备可审查的科学选择与可复现的数值评估，验证了语言模型智能体在地球科学模型校准中的可靠委托路径。

title: LongForcing: Scaling Temporal Manifold Matching for Long-Horizon World Rollout
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models have emerged as a foundation for long-horizon world rollout. However, when extended far beyond their training windows, these models suffer from progressive drift: visual quality deteriorates, motion becomes inconsistent, and object identity gradually collapses as generated frames are recursively reused as context. We study a supervision-horizon gap: short-horizon distillation leaves later rollout states without direct supervision. We show that matching short-window marginals need not determine long-horizon behavior, while longer on-policy trajectories expose delayed failures to training. This motivates temporal manifold matching at scale for long-horizon world models. Building on this insight, we introduce LongForcing, a distillation approach that scales teacher supervision to long student self-rollouts. LongForcing preserves the short-horizon teacher-forcing and causal ODE-distillation stages, while replacing the realscore teacher in the final distribution-matching stage with an extended-horizon bidirectional teacher. The long-horizon teacher supervises extended student self-rollouts using the standard distribution-matching formulation, without modifying the student architecture or increasing inference cost. We evaluate LongForcing on text-to-video generation and interactive action-conditioned world models, achieving a VBench Quality score of 85.52 and improving WorldRoamBench 60s action score by 23.9 points in first-person ablations. Qualitative stress tests further sample interactive rollouts up to 24 hours, far beyond the training horizon. These results suggest that scaling supervision along the temporal axis is a practical step toward long-horizon world models. The project website and code are at https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LongForcing，通过将分布匹配阶段的教师从短时域实时评分模型替换为扩展时域双向教师，把监督信号扩展到长学生自回归轨迹上，缓解自回归视频扩散模型在超出训练窗口后的渐进漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型用于长时域世界推演时，一旦生成远超训练窗口，递归复用生成帧作为上下文会导致视觉质量下降、运动不一致与物体身份逐渐崩溃。作者指出其根源是"监督时域差"：短时域蒸馏使后期推演状态缺乏直接监督；匹配短窗口边缘分布不足以决定长时域行为，而更长的on-policy轨迹才能暴露延迟失效。
AI.method: LongForcing是一种蒸馏方法，将教师监督扩展到长学生自回归推演。它保留短时域teacher-forcing与因果ODE蒸馏阶段，在最后的分布匹配阶段用扩展时域双向教师替代realscore教师。长时域教师以标准分布匹配形式监督延长的学生自回归轨迹，不修改学生架构、不增加推理开销。
AI.result: 在文本到视频生成与交互式动作条件世界模型上评估，VBench Quality得分为85.52；在WorldRoamBench第一人称消融实验中60秒动作分数提升23.9分。定性压力测试进一步采样至长达24小时的交互推演，远超训练时域。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，沿时间轴扩展监督是迈向长时域世界模型的可行一步。

title: The Singularity Has a Distribution: Exact Timing Laws and Detection Limits for a Stochastic Intelligence Explosion
comment: 24 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/xiaoyulics/singularity-distribution
summary: Automating AI research creates a positive feedback loop between software capability and research effort. We study a stochastic realisation of this loop in which independent, positive, multiplicative improvements arrive at a rate proportional to a power of current capability. Within this model, randomness leaves the deterministic explosion threshold unchanged but replaces the blow-up date by an explicit distribution. For equal-sized improvements the explosion time is a geometrically weighted sum of independent exponentials; its $q$-series representation gives its transforms, moments and tail behaviour, including a two-term small-time asymptotic. For Lomax-distributed improvement sizes the explosion time is exactly Gamma distributed. Self-similarity implies that, with parameters known, the relative uncertainty about the remaining time does not vanish as explosion approaches. We formulate a fixed-sample test between constant and geometrically increasing idea-arrival rates. If the baseline rate and the alternative log-rate increment $\ell$ are known, the minimum sample size at error level $α$ is asymptotic to $(12z_α^2)^{1/3}\ell^{-2/3}$, where $z_α$ is the upper-$α$ standard normal quantile. Uncertainty about the growth exponent near its critical value produces a $1/t$ tail with an explicit constant, and hence an infinite conditional mean waiting time, although explosion is certain given a positive exponent. Separate extensions show that a fixed deployment delay prevents explosion in the specified delayed-feedback models, that power-law diversion of effort shifts the growth threshold, and that in a deterministic oversight race a fixed allocation share does not change the asymptotic regime, except at a critical equality of exponents. Numerical illustrations, which are not empirical forecasts, show how timing and detectability depend on the granularity of improvements.

AI.tldr: 研究AI研究自动化中"能力—研究努力"正反馈回路的随机模型：随机性不改变确定性爆炸阈值，但把爆炸时刻变为显式分布，并给出检测该增长的样本量理论。
AI.motivation: 自动化AI研究会在软件能力与研究投入之间形成正反馈回路，可能引发能力爆炸。本文旨在刻画该回路的随机实现，量化爆炸时间的不确定性、检测增长的可行性，以及延迟、投入转移和监管竞赛等情形的后果。
AI.method: 构建随机过程模型：独立的正向乘性改进以正比于当前能力某次幂的速率到达。分析相等改进规模（爆炸时间为独立指数变量的几何加权和，用q-级数给出变换、矩与尾部行为）与Lomax分布改进规模（爆炸时间恰为Gamma分布）两类情形；利用自相似性讨论剩余时间相对不确定性；构造常数率与几何增长到达率之间的固定样本检验；并扩展到固定部署延迟、幂律式努力转移与确定性监管竞赛。
AI.result: 随机性保持确定性爆炸阈值不变但使爆炸日期具有显式分布；等规模改进下爆炸时间有q-级数表示与两期小时间渐近，Lomax改进下爆炸时间为Gamma分布；自相似性导致趋近爆炸时剩余时间相对不确定性不消失。当基线率与对数率增量ℓ已知时，显著水平α下最小样本量渐近为(12z_α²)^{1/3}ℓ^{-2/3}。增长指数在临界值附近的不确定性产生1/t尾部与无穷条件平均等待时间，尽管正指数下爆炸必然发生。固定部署延迟可阻止特定延迟反馈模型中的爆炸；幂律式努力转移会移动增长阈值；确定性监管竞赛中固定分配份额一般不改变渐近 regime，仅在指数相等的临界点例外。
AI.conclusion: 该随机正反馈框架给出爆炸时间的分布性刻画与增长可检测性的样本量标度律，表明爆炸的必然性与等待时间的不确定性可以并存；延迟、努力转移与监管分配对爆炸阈值和渐近 regime 具有结构性影响，而时机与可检测性依赖改进的粒度。

title: Unsupervised and Supervised Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 2)
summary: Since the rise of supervised deep learning modelet dets, researchers has attempt to solve infrared small targection using various models like conventional neural networks, GANS, Transformers, Mixture of Experts and recent graph/hypergraph neural networks. Moreover, these deep neural networks methods surpassed the traditional unsupervised models and the low-rank and sparse decomposition unsupervised models reviewed in "Traditional and Recent Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 1). In this context, the aim of this paper is to provide a complete survey of the deep learning models in infrared small target detection. First, we categorize the different approaches found in the literature in terms of the modeling models of strategies. Then, we have discussed them in terms of the critical situations that they claim to handle. Furthermore, we present the specific performance evaluation. Then, we conclude with several promising directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文综述红外小目标检测中的深度学习模型，按建模策略分类，分析其针对的关键场景、性能评估方法，并展望未来方向。
AI.motivation: 随着监督深度学习兴起，研究者尝试用CNN、GAN、Transformer、混合专家及图/超图神经网络等解决红外小目标检测问题，这些方法已超越传统无监督及低秩稀疏分解方法。因此需要一篇对深度学习模型在该领域的完整综述。
AI.method: 对文献中的不同方法首先按“建模模型与策略”进行分类；随后从它们声称可处理的关键/困难场景角度进行讨论；并提出具体的性能评估方式。
AI.result: 给出了红外小目标检测深度学习方法的分类体系，围绕关键场景进行了对比讨论，并介绍了相应的性能评估指标与方式。
AI.conclusion: 该文系统梳理了红外小目标检测的深度学习模型，指出若干有前景的未来研究方向。

title: Thinker-WM: A Unified World Model with Shared Multimodal Representations for Embodied Intelligence
summary: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Thinker-WM，一个统一多模态世界模型，在共享的 Unified Dynamics Transformer 中联合建模并生成 RGB、度量深度与机器人动作，支持多种具身智能任务，并在多个评测榜单上排名第一。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型在建模模态与支持功能上较为碎片化：视觉动力学、几何结构与可执行动作通常通过独立接口或下游模块耦合，而非在共享动力学模型中被联合表示与演化。作者希望以统一表示实现外观、几何和动作的联合建模。
AI.method: 提出 Thinker-WM，采用共享的 Unified Dynamics Transformer 作为中间结构，配合模态特定的编码器与解码器。在表示层进行多模态统一：将外观、几何、动作转换为共同的动态表示，由共享参数联合演化，同时保留各自不同的输出结构。单一参数化支持多种功能，包括联合视频-动作生成、世界预测、策略推理、动作条件生成、视频到动作生成与逆向动力学。引入轻量级运动探针，验证冻结的视觉表示包含可恢复的运动信息。训练数据为异构语料：约2万小时第一人称视频、1万小时真实机器人数据、1千小时仿真数据，其中约4千小时真实机器人数据含对齐深度监督。
AI.result: 在具身世界模型评测中表现强劲，在 EWMBench、WorldOlympiad 与 WorldArena 上均排名第一。对照实验进一步证明了动作条件化、几何交互以及共享表示下多任务训练的收益。
AI.conclusion: 共享表示能够有效捕捉动作相关信息，统一的多模态世界模型在多个具身任务与基准上具有显著优势，为具身 AI 提供了可扩展的统一动力学建模范式。

title: Robust Logical Anomaly Detection under Capture Shifts via Synthetic Anomalies
summary: Detectors of logical anomalies, such as missing, extra or wrongly combined parts, usually score a test image by its distance from normal (good) images. They achieve near-perfect image-level AUROC on standard industrial anomaly detection benchmarks such as MVTec LOCO, but their robustness to changes in capture conditions remains largely unexamined. Under a heterogeneous perturbation protocol in which each test image is randomly kept unaltered or subjected to a brightness reduction or a zoom-out transformation, the normal-reference methods we tested lose 9.7 to 34.1 AUROC points, and two of the strongest, CSAD and SALAD, fall from 97.7% and 96.4% to 68.1% and 62.3%. We propose a framework in which a classifier, trained on normal images and on synthetic anomalies, scores a test image without comparing it with normal data. From a short description of each product, a language model derives anomaly types and editing instructions, an image editor applies them to normal images, and the classifier learns to separate the edited images from automatically discovered normal sub-modes. With its full training recipe, the framework reaches 94.9% AUROC on clean images, 1.5 to 2.8 points below SALAD and CSAD, and 94.1% under the perturbation protocol. Trained without brightness or zoom-out augmentation, so that neither test perturbation occurs in training, it still reaches 92.5% (93.2% clean). These results suggest that clean benchmark scores can hide a strong sensitivity to capture conditions, and that learning the decision from both normal images and rule violations may reduce it.

AI.tldr: 基于正常图像距离度量的逻辑异常检测方法在工业基准上表现接近完美，但在图像采集条件变化下鲁棒性差；本文提出用分类器（正常图像+合成异常）替代正常参照比较，显著提升扰动下鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有逻辑异常检测器（如CSAD、SALAD）依靠测试图像与正常（good）图像的距离进行评分，在MVTec LOCO等标准工业基准上取得接近完美的图像级AUROC，但其对采集条件变化的鲁棒性尚未被系统考察。作者发现这类"正常参照"方法在异质扰动（亮度降低、缩小放大变换）下性能大幅下降，因此希望提出不依赖与正常数据比较的检测框架来缓解这一敏感性。
AI.method: 提出一个不将测试图像与正常数据比较的分类框架：1）由语言模型根据每个产品的简短描述推导出异常类型与编辑指令；2）图像编辑器依据指令对正常图像进行编辑，合成异常样本；3）分类器在正常图像与合成异常上训练，学习区分编辑图像与自动发现的正常子模式（sub-modes），从而直接给出测试图像分数。此外还进行了不包含亮度或缩放扰动的消融训练。
AI.result: 在异质扰动协议下（每张测试图像随机保持原样或被施加亮度降低或缩小变换），所测试的正常参照方法损失9.7–34.1个AUROC点，其中最强的两种CSAD与SALAD分别从97.7%与96.4%降至68.1%与62.3%。所提框架在完整训练配方下干净图像达94.9% AUROC（比SALAD和CSAD低1.5–2.8点），在扰动协议下达94.1%。即使训练时不含亮度或缩小增强（即测试扰动不出现在训练中），仍达92.5%（干净图像93.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 干净的基准分数可能掩盖模型对采集条件的强敏感性；同时从正常图像与规则违反（合成异常）中学习决策，可有效降低这种敏感性，在扰动条件下获得更稳健的性能。

title: Autonomous Science Bench: Evaluating AI Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
summary: AI agents for autonomous scientific discovery must decide which experiments to run under a limited budget. Most benchmarks for science agents provide fixed datasets, while others that support active experimentation largely rely on simulation. We introduce Autonomous Science Bench, an initial release comprising six budgeted design-build-test-learn campaigns grounded in published experiments across biology, chemistry, and materials science. Agents select batches of designs, receive measurements from a lab service, and use the results to guide subsequent experiments before delivering a predictive model. Success requires passing two calibrated gates: a discovery gate, which evaluates the designs the agent measured, and a learning gate, which evaluates its model's ranking of held-out designs. In a pilot evaluation of eight agent-model configurations and 144 trials, the best configuration succeeds in 67% of trials, while the hardest campaign is solved in only three of 24 attempts. The two gates reveal different weaknesses: some agents build accurate rankings but find too few promising designs, while others find promising designs but fail to predict which unseen designs will perform well. These differences are obscured by overall success rates alone. We release version 0.1 of the campaigns, lab runtime, and public leaderboard at https://yibow.me/autonomous-science-bench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Autonomous Science Bench（初始版本），包含六个基于已发表实验的预算受限“设计-构建-测试-学习”闭环任务，通过“发现门”和“学习门”双重评估，揭示智能体发现设计与学习预测两类不同能力短板。
AI.motivation: 自主科研智能体需在有限预算下决定运行哪些实验，但现有科学智能体基准多提供固定数据集，支持主动实验的基准又主要依赖模拟，缺乏真实实验环境下对预算约束决策能力的评估。
AI.method: 构建六个预算受限的设计-构建-测试-学习（DBTL）任务，取自生物学、化学和材料科学的已发表实验；智能体成批选择设计，由实验室服务返回测量结果并据此指导后续实验，最终交付预测模型。成功需通过两个校准门：发现门评估智能体实际测量的设计，学习门评估其模型对留出设计的排序。并开展八种智能体-模型配置、144 次试验的初步评测，并发布 0.1 版任务、实验室运行时与公开排行榜。
AI.result: 在 144 次试验中，最优配置成功率为 67%，最难任务 24 次尝试中仅成功 3 次；两个门暴露出不同弱点：部分智能体排序准确但发现的候选设计过少，另一些能发现优质设计却无法预测未见设计的表现。
AI.conclusion: 仅看总体成功率会掩盖智能体在“发现”与“学习”两类能力上的差异；双重门评估能更细粒度地诊断自主科研智能体的弱点，该基准为预算受限的主动实验智能体提供了可复现、贴近真实实验的评测框架。

title: AffectWorld: Benchmarking Emotion-Driven Future World Prediction
summary: The world encompasses both physical environments and human actors. Predicting its evolution requires understanding both physical laws and how emotions shape human actions. However, existing world model benchmarks primarily assess physical plausibility and perceptual quality, leaving emotion-driven world evolution largely untested.We introduce AffectWorld, a benchmark that evaluates the chain Emotion-Action-World State through three tasks: World-State Consistency, Emotion-Action Consistency, and Causal Consistency. It comprises 1,498 everyday video samples annotated with plausible emotions, action tendencies, and atomic world-state constraints. A counterfactual subset of 233 samples tests whether changing an agent's emotion under fixed scene and event conditions yields corresponding changes in actions and consequences. We define eight metrics across the three tasks and an additional counterfactual metric, combining automatic visual assessment with human-calibrated VLM/LLM judgments. Evaluations of five SoTA world models (e.g., Cosmos3) required world-state change scores of 0.100-0.280 and counterfactual emotion sensitivity scores of 0.027-0.070 on a [0, 1] scale. These results reveal substantial gaps in generating the consequences of emotion-driven actions and adapting future predictions to emotional interventions. AffectWorld provides a testbed for advancing world models that capture how emotions shape future physical and social states.

AI.tldr: 提出 AffectWorld 基准，通过三项任务与反事实子集评估世界模型对"情绪—行动—世界状态"链条的建模能力，结果显示现有先进模型存在明显不足。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型基准主要评估物理合理性与感知质量，忽略了情绪如何驱动人类行动并进而影响世界状态演化，缺少针对"情绪—行动—世界状态"链条的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建 AffectWorld 基准，包含 1,498 个日常视频样本，标注合理情绪、行动倾向与原子化世界状态约束；设置 233 个反事实样本，在固定场景与事件条件下改变智能体情绪以检验行动与后果是否相应变化。定义覆盖三项任务（World-State Consistency、Emotion-Action Consistency、Causal Consistency）的八项指标及一项反事实指标，结合自动视觉评估与人工校准的 VLM/LLM 判断。
AI.result: 在五个 SoTA 世界模型（如 Cosmos3）上评估，世界状态变化分数仅为 0.100–0.280，反事实情绪敏感度分数为 0.027–0.070（[0,1] 区间），表明模型在生成情绪驱动行动的后果以及适应情绪干预两方面均存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: AffectWorld 为推进能够刻画情绪如何塑造未来物理与社会状态的世界模型提供了测试平台。

title: ReTerm: Recovery Training for Self-Improving Terminal Agents
summary: Terminal agents have shown strong abilities in complex coding tasks. However, they often struggle to recover from errors during long-running execution (e.g., command errors, faulty implementations), eventually leading to task failures. To this end, we present ReTerm, a self-improving terminal agent trained by learning how to recover from its own failed terminal tasks. To support its training, we construct a customized data pipeline and produce ReTerm-10K, a high-quality dataset that provides effective recovery demonstrations for SFT cold start. Furthermore, we propose ReTerm-GRPO, an online RL algorithm that forks from the agent's own failure states to generate multiple independent self-recovery attempts. By learning from whether these attempts successfully complete the task, the agent self-improves through its own recovery experience. Built on Qwen3.5-9B, our ReTerm-9B achieves 34.8% Pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2.0, improving over the base model by 14.6 points. Further analysis shows that our method achieves consistently higher recovery rates across diverse error categories compared with standard GRPO training. All code, data and model are released at https://github.com/twothsnd/ReTerm.

AI.tldr: ReTerm 是一种"从自身失败中学习恢复"的自改进终端智能体，配合 ReTerm-10K 数据与 ReTerm-GRPO 在线强化学习算法，在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上把 Qwen3.5-9B 的 Pass@1 提升至 34.8%（+14.6 分）。
AI.motivation: 终端智能体在复杂编码任务中能力较强，但在长时程执行中难以从错误（如命令错误、实现缺陷）中恢复，最终导致任务失败。核心痛点是缺乏针对"错误恢复"这一关键能力的训练方法与数据。
AI.method: 1) 构建定制化数据流水线，产出 ReTerm-10K——为 SFT 冷启动提供有效恢复示范的高质量数据集；2) 提出 ReTerm-GRPO 在线强化学习算法，从智能体自身的失败状态分叉，生成多条独立的自恢复尝试，并以这些尝试是否成功完成任务作为学习信号，使智能体通过自身恢复经验实现自改进。基础模型为 Qwen3.5-9B。
AI.result: 基于 Qwen3.5-9B 的 ReTerm-9B 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上取得 34.8% Pass@1，较基座模型提升 14.6 个百分点；进一步分析显示，相比标准 GRPO 训练，本方法在多种错误类别上均获得更高且一致的恢复率。代码、数据与模型均已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模"从失败中恢复"并利用失败状态进行在线强化学习，可有效提升终端智能体的长时程错误恢复能力与任务成功率，验证了以自身失败经验驱动自改进路径的有效性。

title: Omni-RS: Unifying Multi-Task Understanding and Generation in Remote Sensing
summary: Practical remote sensing applications often require both understanding and generation capabilities for the same geographic scene. However, most existing methods address either understanding or generation in isolation, while existing unified remote sensing models' generative ability is limited to text-to-image. To bridge this gap, we propose Omni-RS, a unified framework supporting four remote sensing understanding tasks and five generation tasks. Specifically, we introduce the "Scene-Guided Two-Stage Training" strategy, which first adapts a multimodal large language model to remote sensing understanding and then uses its hidden states to guide a diffusion transformer for image generation. To enable joint learning across diverse generation tasks, we construct UniGen, a unified multi-task generation dataset, by organizing heterogeneous remote sensing data into a unified format. Furthermore, we introduce "Detailed Visual Conditioning", which uses visual conditions encoded by a VAE to guide the generation process, thereby supporting additional generation tasks that require reference images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Omni-RS performs exceptionally well in understanding tasks and has achieved outstanding results in a variety of generative tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Omni-RS，一个统一遥感框架，同时支持四项理解任务与五项生成任务，通过"场景引导两阶段训练"策略和 UniGen 多任务数据集实现理解与生成的协同。
AI.motivation: 遥感实际应用常需对同一地理场景兼具理解与生成能力，但现有方法大多将理解与生成割裂处理，而已有的统一遥感模型生成能力仅限于文本到图像，无法满足多样化生成需求。
AI.method: 提出场景引导两阶段训练策略：先使多模态大语言模型适配遥感理解任务，再利用其隐藏状态引导扩散 Transformer 进行图像生成；构建 UniGen 统一多任务生成数据集，将异构遥感数据组织为统一格式以支持联合学习；引入"详细视觉条件"机制，利用 VAE 编码的视觉条件指导生成过程，从而支持需要参考图像的额外生成任务。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Omni-RS 在理解任务上表现优异，并在多种生成任务中取得突出结果。
AI.conclusion: Omni-RS 通过统一框架弥合了遥感理解与生成之间的鸿沟，验证了两阶段训练、统一生成数据集与视觉条件机制的有效性，为遥感场景下的多任务统一建模提供了可行方案。

title: ShoeFit: A New Dataset and Dual-image-stream DiT Framework for Virtual Footwear Try-On
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2025. Project website: https://colorful-liyu.github.io/ShoeFit/ , including proposed multi-view footwear try-on dataset MVShoes-clean
summary: Virtual footwear try-on (VFTON), a critical yet underexplored area in virtual try-on (VTON), aims to synthesize faithful try-on results given diverse footwear and model images while maintaining 3D consistency and texture authenticity. Unlike conventional garment-focused VTON methods, VFTON presents unique challenges due to (1) Data Scarcity, which arises from the difficulty of perfectly matching product shoes with models wearing the identical ones, (2) Viewpoint Misalignment, where the target foot pose and source shoe views are always misaligned, leading to incomplete texture information and detail distortion, and (3) Background-induced Color Distortion, where complex material of footwear interacts with environmental lighting, causing unintended color contamination. To address these challenges, we introduce MVShoes, a multi-view shoe try-on dataset consisting of 7305 well-annotated image triplets, covering diverse footwear categories and challenging try-on scenarios. Furthermore, we propose a dual-stream DiT architecture, ShoeFit, designed to mitigate viewpoint misalignment through Multi-View Conditioning with 3D Rotary Position Embedding, and alleviate background-induced distortion using the LayeredRefAttention which leverages background features to modulate footwear latents. The proposed framework effectively decouples shoe appearance from environmental interferences while preserving high-quality texture detail through decoupled denoising and conditioning branches. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our method substantially improves rendering fidelity and robustness under challenging real-world product shoes, establishing a new benchmark in high-fidelity footwear try-on synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出虚拟鞋类试穿（VFTON）任务，构建多视角数据集 MVShoes（7305 个三元组），并提出双流 DiT 架构 ShoeFit，通过多视角条件与 3D RoPE 缓解视角错位、借助 LayeredRefAttention 抑制背景引起的颜色失真，在高保真鞋类试穿合成上取得新基准。
AI.motivation: 虚拟鞋类试穿是虚拟试穿中关键但研究不足的方向，需在多样鞋款与模特图像间生成保持 3D 一致性与纹理真实感的试穿结果。相比以服装为主的 VTON，VFTON 面临三大独特挑战：(1) 数据稀缺，难以将商品鞋与穿着同款鞋的模特完美配对；(2) 视角错位，目标脚部姿态与源鞋视角常不一致，导致纹理信息不完整与细节扭曲；(3) 背景引起的颜色失真，鞋类复杂材质与环境光照交互造成非预期颜色污染。
AI.method: 1) 构建 MVShoes 多视角鞋类试穿数据集，含 7305 个标注良好的图像三元组，覆盖多样鞋类类别与具挑战性的试穿场景。2) 提出双流 DiT 架构 ShoeFit：采用多视角条件化（Multi-View Conditioning）结合 3D 旋转位置嵌入（3D RoPE）缓解视角错位；采用 LayeredRefAttention 利用背景特征调制鞋类隐变量以减轻背景引起的失真。框架通过解耦的去噪分支与条件分支，将鞋类外观与环境干扰解耦，同时保留高质量纹理细节。
AI.result: 大量定量与定性实验表明，该方法在真实世界商品鞋的挑战性场景下显著提升了渲染保真度与鲁棒性，建立了高保真鞋类试穿合成的新基准。
AI.conclusion: VFTON 的三大挑战（数据稀缺、视角错位、背景颜色失真）可通过专用数据集与双流 DiT 设计有效缓解；ShoeFit 在解耦鞋类外观与环境干扰的同时保持纹理细节，为高保真鞋类试穿提供了新的基准与范式。

title: The Smart Buildings Challenge: Learning Foundation Models for Real-World Optimization at Scale
comment: This is for a Neurips 2026 competition
summary: Buildings cause nearly 40\% of carbon emissions in the US. Of total building emissions, HVAC systems are responsible for approximately 40-60\% and account for 15\% of global energy consumption. Despite advances in artificial intelligence, most buildings still operate as inefficiently as they did decades ago. Building optimization, perhaps more so than any other optimization problem, has enormous potential for Machine Learning (ML) driven impact on climate change, in both the short and long term. One of the biggest obstacles for building optimization is the lack of policy transfer. Most building control systems, whether simulation or learning based, don't generalize: they only work well for the building they were developed for, but not for other buildings. To solve this problem, we propose a challenge for the development of building foundation models that easily adapt to new buildings with minimal configuration and thereby enable building optimization to scale across the globe. Participants will build control policies on a set of simulated buildings, and have their policies evaluated on an unseen set of buildings. The buildings vary in size, layout, weather, material properties, and HVAC system. Successful outcomes from this initiative promise a massive leap forward in global sustainability efforts and demonstrate the great potential of ML to combat climate change.

AI.tldr: 本文提出构建"建筑基础模型"的挑战赛，以解决建筑控制策略难以跨建筑迁移的问题，从而推动建筑优化在全球范围内规模化应用并助力应对气候变化。
AI.motivation: 建筑占美国碳排放近40%，其中HVAC系统占建筑排放的40-60%、全球能耗的15%。尽管人工智能已有进展，多数建筑仍以几十年前的低效方式运行。建筑优化是ML应对气候变化最具潜力的方向之一，但最大障碍在于缺乏策略迁移：现有基于仿真或学习的建筑控制系统缺乏泛化能力，仅适用于开发时所针对的特定建筑，无法应用于其他建筑。
AI.method: 提出一项挑战赛，旨在推动"建筑基础模型"的开发，使其能以最小配置快速适配新建筑。参赛者在若干仿真建筑上训练控制策略，并在未见过的建筑集合上进行评估；这些建筑在规模、布局、天气、材料属性和HVAC系统等方面均存在差异。
AI.result: 论文本身为挑战赛提案，未报告实验结果；其预期成果是使建筑优化控制策略能够跨建筑、跨地域泛化，从而支撑全球范围的规模化应用。
AI.conclusion: 该倡议若取得成功，将推动全球可持续发展工作实现重大飞跃，并展示机器学习在应对气候变化方面的巨大潜力。

title: CityCode: Building Agent-Operable 3D Cities from Sparse Aerial Observations
summary: Urban spatial intelligence calls for 3D cities that agents can measure, interpret, and modify across successive tasks. Maintaining such cities as persistent, code-based states requires lightweight acquisition and support for consistent state updates without repeated dense reconstruction. We therefore formulate a new setting for grounded urban world construction: generating large-scale, instance-level parameterized 3D cities from one low-altitude aerial RGB image per region and known camera parameters, while recovering metrically scaled buildings and explicit road geometry and connectivity. We introduce CityCode, an agent-operable representation that unifies metric geometry, urban topology, visual semantics, and 3D assets through persistent entity identities, with dependency-aware versioned execution for validated updates and historical restoration. We further develop Air2Code to construct this representation by combining visual structure extraction with adapted metric depth estimation. To address occlusion and incomplete coverage, recovered structure and observed appearance guide generative completion and subsequent structure-aware 3D generation for buildings and backgrounds. Experiments on CitySample-Aerial and UrbanScene3D demonstrate substantially more accurate metric structure recovery and superior visual fidelity to the target cities compared with the evaluated baselines. Across 50 task chains of 50 steps each, CityCode supports continued querying, editing, planning, and historical restoration over evolving city states. Together, CityCode and Air2Code turn sparse aerial observations into persistent, agent-operable urban worlds for long-horizon urban spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出从单张低空航拍RGB图像生成大规模、实例级参数化3D城市的新设定，并给出可被智能体操作的表示CityCode及构建方法Air2Code，实现度量几何、拓扑、语义与3D资产的统一及版本化更新。
AI.motivation: 城市空间智能需要智能体能够测量、解读并跨任务修改的3D城市，且需保持持久、基于代码的状态，避免重复的稠密重建。现有方法难以在轻量采集下获得度量尺度建筑与显式道路几何及连通性，也难以支持一致的状态更新。
AI.method: 提出CityCode表示，通过持久实体标识统一度量几何、城市拓扑、视觉语义与3D资产，并采用依赖感知的版本化执行以支持经验证的更新与历史恢复。构建方法Air2Code结合视觉结构提取与适配的度量深度估计；针对遮挡与覆盖不全，利用恢复结构与观测外观引导生成式补全，并进行结构感知的建筑与背景3D生成。
AI.result: 在CitySample-Aerial与UrbanScene3D数据集上，相比评估基线，度量结构恢复更准确，对目标城市的视觉保真度更高；在50条任务链（每条50步）中，CityCode支持对演化城市状态的持续查询、编辑、规划与历史恢复。
AI.conclusion: CityCode与Air2Code可将稀疏航拍观测转化为持久、可被智能体操作的城市世界，服务于长时程城市空间智能。

title: Lost in Implicit Routing: How LLM Agents Fail to Load Relevant Skills at Scale
comment: 22 pages, including references and appendices. Code: https://github.com/jinlinll/lost-in-implicit-routing
summary: Reusable skills let LLM agents load task-specific instructions on demand, but they make execution depend on implicit routing over skill metadata. We test whether this design scales by holding SkillsBench tasks and their golden skills fixed while adding irrelevant skills. We find skill routing collapse: agents increasingly load fewer or no skills, even though the relevant skills remain available. With 1,000 irrelevant skills, loaded-skill recall falls from 73.6% to 27.4% and the zero-load rate rises from 9.3% to 51.6%, whereas explicit selection from the same library retains 73.9% recall. Loading other skills, including plausible alternatives to golden skills, is too rare to explain this decline. Masking only the descriptions of irrelevant skills largely restores skill loading, yet with the metadata intact, explicitly asking agents to plan skill use still yields lower recall than preselection. These findings point to semantic interference from descriptions and instruction interference when skill choice competes with task execution. We also evaluate explicit preselection as a practical mitigation, including its coverage and latency trade-offs. Our analysis informs skill protocols and evaluation for agents with growing skill libraries.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM智能体可复用技能机制的可扩展性问题：在固定任务与黄金技能的前提下加入大量无关技能，发现"技能路由崩溃"现象——智能体加载相关技能的召回率大幅下降、零加载率显著上升；指出语义干扰与指令干扰是主因，并评估显式预选作为缓解方案。
AI.motivation: 可复用技能允许LLM智能体按需加载任务相关指令，但执行效果隐含依赖于对技能元数据的路由能力。随着技能库规模增长，这种隐式路由是否仍然可靠、是否可扩展，此前缺乏系统检验。论文旨在验证该设计在技能库扩张下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 控制变量实验：固定SkillsBench任务及其黄金技能不变，仅逐步加入无关技能以扩大技能库。测量加载技能召回率与零加载率，并设置对照条件：从同一技能库中显式选择、加载其他技能（含黄金技能的合理替代项）、遮蔽无关技能描述、保留元数据但显式要求智能体规划技能使用，以及显式预选。
AI.result: 在1,000个无关技能下，加载技能召回率由73.6%降至27.4%，零加载率由9.3%升至51.6%；而同一技能库的显式选择仍保持73.9%召回率。加载其他技能（包括黄金技能的合理替代项）的比例过低，无法解释该下降。仅遮蔽无关技能的描述即可大幅恢复技能加载；但在元数据完整时，即使显式要求智能体规划技能使用，召回率仍低于预选。
AI.conclusion: 技能路由崩溃源于两类干扰：无关技能描述带来的语义干扰，以及技能选择与任务执行相互竞争造成的指令干扰。显式预选是一种可行的缓解手段，但需权衡覆盖率与延迟。研究结果为技能协议设计与技能库增长场景下的智能体评测提供指导。

title: Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes
summary: City-scale 3D grounding is commonly formulated as candidate ranking, which requires precomputed instance proposals and becomes inefficient in large outdoor scenes. We propose Urbex, an agentic vision-language framework that instead casts grounding as active spatial search. Urbex represents a city-scale 3D scene as an interactive multi-view environment, allowing a VLM agent to query landmarks, zoom into local regions, render oblique views, and commit a grounded bounding box. We optimize this tool-use policy with reinforcement learning on CityRefer, using smooth localization rewards and lightweight shaping rewards for efficient exploration. Experiments show that Urbex achieves the best Hit@1 and IoU on CityRefer, supports candidate-free grounding without ground-truth boxes, and is substantially faster than the strongest city-scale ranking baseline. Zero-shot results on STPLS3D-Refer further indicate improved cross-scene robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出 Urbex，将城市级3D定位重构为主动空间搜索，用VLM智能体在多视角环境中交互查询并直接输出定位框，通过强化学习优化工具使用策略，在CityRefer上取得最优性能且显著提速。
AI.motivation: 现有城市级3D定位多采用候选排序范式，依赖预计算的实例候选框，在大规模室外场景中效率低下。
AI.method: 将城市场景表示为可交互的多视角环境，VLM智能体可查询地标、缩放局部区域、渲染斜视图并提交定位框；用强化学习在CityRefer上优化该工具使用策略，采用平滑定位奖励与轻量塑形奖励促进高效探索。
AI.result: 在CityRefer上取得最佳Hit@1与IoU；支持无需真值框的候选无关定位；相比最强的城市级排序基线大幅提速；在STPLS3D-Refer上的零样本结果显示出更强的跨场景鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将3D定位转化为主动空间搜索是可行且高效的方向，智能体式视觉语言框架可在无候选框条件下实现准确的城市场景定位并具备良好泛化性。

title: Input-Conditioned Search for Efficient Test-Time Scaling of Recursive Reasoners
summary: People often tackle difficult problems by thinking more deeply or exploring more possibilities. Similarly, recursive reasoners, which reason by repeatedly applying a learned update rule to latent states, can also scale inference through more updates (depth) or additional trajectories generated by perturbing latent states (width). When people hit a dead end in their thinking, they may step back and approach the problem from a fresh angle. However, neither depth scaling nor perturbation-based width scaling of recursive reasoners can reliably achieve this: both may converge to incorrect attractors. To address this, we propose to explore diverse reasoning traces by applying different update maps to the same latent state, without any additional training. We realize this idea through \emph{Input-Conditioned Search (ICS)}, which searches over input conditions to induce alternative update maps from the pretrained reasoner. Across six reasoning tasks, ICS achieves the highest mean accuracy, while requiring up to two orders of magnitude fewer model FLOPs than the evaluated scaling baselines. Controlled experiments confirm that ICS can redirect trajectories from the same state. Our theoretical analysis and rigorous numerical verification also confirm that ICS can locally eliminate incorrect attracting fixed points. Together, these findings establish ICS as an effective axis for efficient test-time scaling and motivate further research on shaping recursive reasoning during training and at test time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Input-Conditioned Search (ICS)，通过对输入条件进行搜索，从预训练递归推理器中诱导出不同的更新映射，从而在相同隐状态上探索多样化推理轨迹，实现高效测试时扩展。
AI.motivation: 递归推理器可通过增加更新次数（深度）或扰动隐状态生成多轨迹（宽度）来扩展推理，但这两种方式都无法可靠地"换角度思考"——它们可能收敛到错误的吸引子。人类遇到思维死胡同时会退后一步，从新角度重新审视问题，因此需要一种能真正改变推理轨迹动力学的方法。
AI.method: 提出 ICS：无需额外训练，在同一隐状态上施加不同的更新映射以探索多样推理轨迹。具体通过搜索输入条件，从预训练推理器中诱导出替代的更新映射。并辅以理论分析与严格的数值验证。
AI.result: 在六项推理任务上，ICS 取得了最高平均准确率，同时相比所评估的扩展基线减少了最多两个数量级的模型 FLOPs。受控实验证实 ICS 能将轨迹从同一状态重定向；理论分析与数值验证确认 ICS 可在局部消除错误的吸引不动点。
AI.conclusion: ICS 是一种有效的测试时高效扩展方向，并为训练期与测试期塑造递归推理的进一步研究提供了动机。

title: Hallucination-aware Faithful Reasoning in Remote Sensing
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated promising capabilities for remote sensing reasoning, yet they frequently generate visually unsupported reasoning that contradicts the visual evidence. Existing post-training methods optimize primarily for final-answer correctness, providing limited supervision for identifying and correcting hallucinations that arise during the reasoning process. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{FaithRS}, a hallucination-aware self-reflection framework for faithful reasoning in remote sensing. We first construct \textbf{SFHD-43K}, a dataset of 43K structured, fine-grained hallucination annotations, and train a detector to identify hallucination types, underlying causes, and supporting visual evidence. FaithRS then incorporates this diagnostic feedback into a Safe Detector-Guided Corrective Rollout framework, where a safety-aware gate selectively determines whether and how to revise the response. Training is driven by a composite reward that jointly optimizes answer accuracy, reasoning faithfulness, hallucination reduction, format compliance, and revision safety. Experiments with Qwen3.5 backbones (0.8B, 4B, and 9B) show consistent improvements across four remote sensing benchmarks, with gains of up to 11.64 points.

AI.tldr: 提出FaithRS幻觉感知自反思框架，通过构建SFHD-43K数据集与安全检测器引导的纠正式回放训练，提升遥感多模态大模型推理的忠实性，在四个基准上最高提升11.64分。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在遥感推理中常生成与视觉证据相矛盾的、缺乏视觉支撑的推理内容。现有后训练方法主要以最终答案正确性为优化目标，对推理过程中产生的幻觉识别与纠正监督不足。
AI.method: 1) 构建SFHD-43K，包含43K条结构化、细粒度的幻觉标注，并训练检测器识别幻觉类型、成因及支撑视觉证据；2) 将诊断反馈融入Safe Detector-Guided Corrective Rollout框架，由安全感知门控选择性决定是否及如何修正回答；3) 采用复合奖励联合优化答案准确率、推理忠实性、幻觉削减、格式合规与修改安全性。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5（0.8B、4B、9B）骨干模型上，于四个遥感基准上取得一致性提升，最高增益达11.64分。
AI.conclusion: 面向推理过程而非仅答案正确性的幻觉感知自反思训练，可有效抑制遥感多模态推理中的幻觉，提升推理忠实性，且在不同规模骨干上均具泛化性。

title: Rethinking Quality in Large Language Model Routing: Security-Conditioned Model-and-Budget Selection
summary:
Large language model (LLM) routers reduce serving cost by choosing which model to call and how many output tokens to grant it for each query. Existing routers rank model-budget actions using a single quality metric. This does not work for mixed workloads. For ordinary queries, a good answer is correct and useful (utility); for security-sensitive queries, a good answer refuses harmful requests or resists malicious instructions (security). These two objectives prefer different models and budgets.
  We propose SCRouter, a router that learns when to prioritize security and how to allocate the token budget. For each model-budget pair, it estimates the probability that the response finishes within budget. It uses this probability to predict utility and security separately. A small probe determines how to weight these two predictions for each query. SCRouter then selects the model and budget by balancing the weighted utility and security against cost. We also build SCRouterBench, a benchmark of 38,869 utility and security queries spanning nine security dimensions, each answered under all 144 combinations of 12 models and 12 budgets, plus 2,753 out-of-domain queries. SCRouter improves the baselines by 13-29 points in-domain and 19-23 points out-of-domain.

AI.tldr: 提出SCRouter路由器，分别预测效用与安全性并按查询动态加权，联合选择模型与token预算；构建SCRouterBench基准，域内提升13-29点，域外提升19-23点。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由器用单一质量指标对"模型-预算"动作排序，无法处理混合负载：普通查询追求效用（正确有用），安全敏感查询追求安全性（拒答有害请求或抵御恶意指令），两目标偏好不同的模型与预算。
AI.method: SCRouter为每个模型-预算对估计"响应在预算内完成"的概率，并以此概率分别预测效用与安全性；用一个轻量探针（probe）为每条查询确定两个预测的权重；最后在加权效用与安全性之间权衡成本，选择模型与预算。同时构建SCRouterBench：38,869条效用与安全查询，覆盖九个安全维度，每条查询在12个模型×12个预算共144种组合下作答，另含2,753条域外查询。
AI.result: 在域内相比基线提升13-29点，域外提升19-23点。
AI.conclusion: 将安全与效用解耦并按查询自适应加权，可有效提升混合负载下LLM路由的效用与安全性，同时兼顾成本与跨域泛化。

title: SchemaPose: RGB-Based Category-Level Pose Estimation with Parametric Category Schema
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://souglad21.github.io/SchemaPose/
summary: RGB-based category-level 9D pose estimation remains highly challenging because a monocular system must generalize across unseen object instances while jointly inferring 3D translation, 3D rotation, and 3D size. Unlike instance-level pose estimation, the category-level setting requires the network to learn both what is shared across objects within a category and how individual instances vary in structure. This challenge is amplified in the RGB-only setting, where pose cues, category-level commonality, and instance-specific variation are entangled in appearance without direct geometric constraints, making it difficult for existing frameworks to learn a representation that is truly aligned with the category-level estimation objective. To address this problem, we propose SchemaPose, a schema-guided framework for RGB-based category-level pose estimation. SchemaPose equips the estimation pipeline with an explicit parametric schema for modeling category-level regularities together with structured instance variation, and uses the inferred schema variables to guide pose-related prediction in an end-to-end query-based framework. The same formulation also supports template instantiation, synthetic annotation, and pose learning within a unified framework. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that SchemaPose achieves state-of-the-art performance among RGB-based methods for category-level 9D pose estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SchemaPose，一个基于"schema"引导的框架，用于纯RGB的类别级9D位姿估计，在合成与真实数据上取得RGB类方法的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 类别级9D位姿估计需泛化到未见实例并联合推断平移、旋转与尺寸；仅用RGB时，位姿线索、类别共性与实例差异在表观中相互纠缠，缺少几何约束，现有框架难以学到与类别级目标一致的表示。
AI.method: SchemaPose引入显式参数化的schema来建模类别级规律及结构化的实例变化，并在端到端的query-based框架中用推断出的schema变量引导位姿预测；同一形式化还统一支持模板实例化、合成标注和位姿学习。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据上的实验表明，SchemaPose在基于RGB的类别级9D位姿估计方法中达到state-of-the-art性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将类别级规律与实例变化显式解耦并由schema变量引导预测，SchemaPose有效缓解了RGB设定下的表征纠缠问题，为类别级9D位姿估计提供了统一且高效的范式。

title: Configuring RAG Systems: What Breaks, Where Originates, and How to Fix
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a dominant paradigm for improving Large Language Model (LLM) by intertwining it with other components, such as a vector/graph database. Therefore, the resulting RAG systems are often highly configurable, under which a non-trivial amount of failures are related to the configurations. However, there remains a lack of systematic understanding regarding the configuration issues for RAG systems. To bridge this gap, in this paper, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 654 real-world configuration issues collected from 10 diverse RAG systems. Drawing on this, we provide a complete categorization of the symptoms, root causes, relevant stages, and fix patterns of configuration issues for RAG systems, as well as several new observations. Our findings not only reveal the characteristics of configuration issues, but also strongly link them to the unique pipeline stages of RAG, e.g., we found that most symptoms can be observed at the early or late stage, while the stage of the root cause might not be at the same stage as where the symptom is identified. We also provide nine actionable insights to the practitioners on testing, localizing, and fixing the configuration issues for RAG systems.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对RAG系统中的配置问题开展大规模实证研究，基于10个真实RAG系统的654个配置问题，构建了症状、根因、阶段与修复模式的完整分类体系，并提出九条可操作建议。
AI.motivation: RAG已成为提升大语言模型能力的主流范式，其系统高度可配置，导致相当比例的故障与配置相关。然而，学界对RAG系统配置问题缺乏系统性认识，存在研究空白。
AI.method: 从10个多样化的真实RAG系统中收集654个配置问题，进行大规模实证分析，对配置问题的症状、根因、相关阶段及修复模式进行分类归纳，并识别新的观察结果。
AI.result: 揭示了RAG配置问题的特征，并发现其与RAG独特流水线阶段的强关联。例如，多数症状出现于流水线早期或晚期，而根因所处阶段可能与症状被识别的阶段不一致。
AI.conclusion: 该研究系统刻画了RAG系统配置问题的全貌，提供了完整的分类体系，并为实践者在测试、定位和修复配置问题上给出九条可操作建议。

title: Noise2Match: Self-Supervised Low-Dose CT Denoising via Adaptive Inter-Slice Matching
summary: With the rapid development of deep learning, supervised convolutional neural network methods have greatly improved the performance of low-dose computed tomography (CT) denoising. However, they require paired noisy-clean training data, which is difficult to obtain in practice. Some classic self-supervised denoising methods rely on the assumption of pixel-wise independent noise, making them ineffective for correlated noise in low-dose CT (LDCT) images. Considering the high similarity and weaker noise correlation between adjacent CT slices, several recently proposed self-supervised methods use adjacent LDCT slices for training. Nevertheless, these approaches fail to effectively account for the non-rigid misalignment between slices caused by anatomical variation, hindering them from satisfying the equal-mean condition required by the classic Noise2Noise framework. In this paper, we propose Noise2Match, a self-supervised LDCT denoising method based on adaptive inter-slice matching. Noise2Match introduces an inter-slice matching network to model the label transition process between adjacent slices, and then applies correction to the denoiser's outputs to better satisfy the equal-mean condition. We theoretically prove that, under idealized conditions, training Noise2Match using adjacent LDCT slices is equivalent to supervised training with paired noisy-clean images. We further find that Noise2Match can also effectively perform low-dose conebeam CT (CBCT) denoising, which could be attributed to its correction operation that reduces inter-slice noise correlation. To the best of our knowledge, Noise2Match is the first effective image-domain self-supervised method for low-dose CBCT. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Noise2Match outperforms existing image-domain selfsupervised methods, offering broader applicability and higher practical value.

AI.tldr: 提出Noise2Match，一种基于自适应层间匹配的自监督低剂量CT去噪方法，通过建模相邻切片间的标签转换过程并校正去噪器输出以满足等均值条件，理论证明其等价于监督训练，并首次实现有效的图像域自监督低剂量CBCT去噪。
AI.motivation: 监督式CNN低剂量CT去噪性能优异，但依赖难以获取的成对噪声-干净数据；经典自监督方法假设噪声像素独立，对LDCT的相关噪声无效；近期利用相邻切片的自监督方法又未能有效处理解剖变化导致的非刚性错位，难以满足Noise2Noise的等均值条件。
AI.method: Noise2Match引入层间匹配网络来建模相邻切片间的标签转换过程，并据此对去噪器输出进行校正，使其更好地满足等均值条件；训练仅使用相邻LDCT切片。
AI.result: 理论上证明了在理想条件下，用相邻LDCT切片训练Noise2Match等价于用成对噪声-干净图像进行监督训练；实验表明Noise2Match优于现有图像域自监督方法，并能有效完成低剂量CBCT去噪。
AI.conclusion: Noise2Match是首个有效的图像域自监督低剂量CBCT去噪方法，归因于其校正操作降低了层间噪声相关性，具有更广的适用性和更高的实用价值。

title: Order-Consistent Latent Geometry for Reliable Short-Horizon Planning in World Models
comment: Accepted for poster presentation at STEAI 2026 (ECCV 2026 Workshop)
summary: Latent planners often rank candidate action sequences by terminal Euclidean distance to a goal latent. Exact agreement with transition distance would make this score ideal, but is stronger than planning requires: along a transition-shortest rollout, the essential requirement is that latent distance does not reverse true transition progress. We show that this pathwise no-reversal requirement is precisely the classical self-approaching condition. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to identify self-approachingness as a planner-facing compatibility condition for terminal Euclidean latent planning and to connect its violation to an exact finite-horizon candidate-order reversal. Because visual world models predict discrete latent sequences, we analyze their polygonal interpolation. We prove that an acute bend creates a nonempty region in which terminal Euclidean distance ranks a transition-worse candidate ahead of one that makes genuine progress, even under exact rollouts. We further interpret latent dimension as angular capacity through a classical spherical-code bound. A controlled six-branch experiment, including a zero-padded three-dimensional baseline, validates the predicted ordering failure and separates angular arrangement from ambient dimensionality.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将"自逼近性（self-approachingness）"识别为终端欧氏潜在规划（terminal Euclidean latent planning）的规划器兼容条件，并证明视觉世界模型中离散潜在序列的折线插值在出现锐角弯折时会产生候选顺序反转，即终端欧氏距离会把过渡更差的候选排在真正有进展的候选之前。
AI.motivation: 潜在规划器常以到目标潜在表示的终端欧氏距离对候选动作序列排序。若该分数与转移距离完全一致固然理想，但规划实际只需更弱条件：在转移最短的 rollout 上，潜在距离不应逆转真实转移进展。作者希望formalize这一更弱要求，并解释视觉世界模型为何会违反它。
AI.method: 1) 将"路径无逆转（pathwise no-reversal）"要求 formalize，并证明其恰为经典的自逼近条件；2) 将违反自逼近性与有限时域候选顺序反转精确对应；3) 针对视觉世界模型预测的离散潜在序列，分析其折线插值，证明锐角弯折会形成非空区域，使终端欧氏距离在精确 rollout 下也产生排序错误；4) 借助经典球面码（spherical-code）界将潜在维度解释为角度容量；5) 设计六分支受控实验，含零填充三维基线。
AI.result: 理论证明锐角弯折导致排序失败，并通过球面码界建立潜在维度与角度容量的联系。六分支受控实验验证了预测的顺序失败，并将角度排布与环境维度（ambient dimensionality）的影响分离开来。
AI.conclusion: 终端欧氏潜在规划的理想性依赖于潜在空间轨迹的自逼近性；视觉世界模型的离散潜在折线插值若含锐角弯折，即便在精确 rollout 下也会产生候选顺序反转。该工作为潜在规划器的潜在空间几何兼容性提供了理论判据与实证支持。

title: ReDiS: Reasoning-Diagnosis Self-Evolution for Multimodal Reasoning in Remote Sensing
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for remote sensing understanding, yet reliable reasoning remains challenging when tasks require fine-grained visual grounding and multi-step inference. Existing approaches typically rely on either costly pre-constructed reasoning trajectories or self-generated signals such as response consistency, which can reinforce shared errors and provide unreliable supervision. We introduce \textbf{Reasoning--Diagnosis Self-Evolution (ReDiS)}, a framework that separates reasoning exploration from candidate evaluation while allowing the two processes to evolve jointly. ReDiS instantiates two role-specific experts from a shared multimodal backbone: a \textbf{Reasoner} that explores diverse visual evidence--answer candidates and a \textbf{Diagnoser} that jointly evaluates the complete candidate set and provides credibility-aware feedback. As the Reasoner evolves, it exposes new candidate distributions and failure modes; the Diagnoser adapts to these changes and, in turn, reshapes the learning signal for subsequent exploration. To handle groups in which all sampled answers are incorrect and group-relative advantages vanish, we further introduce \textbf{Failure-Triggered Recovery (FTR)}, which provides minimal outcome-level correction without prescribing intermediate reasoning trajectories. Experiments on LHRS-Bench, MME-RS, and CHOICE show consistent improvements over Qwen3.5 backbones at 0.8B, 2B, and 4B scales. ReDiS improves category-averaged accuracy by 6.47 percentage points at 0.8B, while ReDiS-4B achieves the highest average performance among the compared remote sensing MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ReDiS框架，通过分离推理探索与候选评估两个角色并让它们协同进化，配合失败触发的恢复机制，在遥感多模态大模型推理任务上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在遥感理解中具有潜力，但当任务需要细粒度视觉定位和多步推理时，可靠推理仍然困难。现有方法要么依赖昂贵的事先构建的推理轨迹，要么依赖响应一致性等自生成信号，这容易强化共同错误并提供不可靠的监督。
AI.method: 提出Reasoning–Diagnosis Self-Evolution（ReDiS）框架，将推理探索与候选评估分离，同时允许二者联合进化。ReDiS从共享多模态骨干网络中实例化两个角色专用专家：Reasoner探索多样化的视觉证据–答案候选，Diagnoser联合评估完整候选集并提供可信度感知反馈。随着Reasoner进化，它会暴露新的候选分布和失败模式，Diagnoser随之适应并反过来重塑后续探索的学习信号。针对所有采样答案均错误、组相对优势消失的情况，引入Failure-Triggered Recovery（FTR），在不规定中间推理轨迹的前提下提供最小化的结果级纠正。
AI.result: 在LHRS-Bench、MME-RS和CHOICE上，ReDiS在0.8B、2B和4B规模的Qwen3.5骨干网络上均取得一致改进。0.8B规模下类别平均准确率提升6.47个百分点，ReDiS-4B在对比的遥感多模态大模型中取得最高平均性能。
AI.conclusion: ReDiS通过分离并协同进化推理与诊断过程，并借助FTR处理全错样本组，有效提升了遥感多模态大模型的可靠推理能力，在不同模型规模上均验证了其有效性。

title: LLM Agents for Automated Post-Training via Structured Recipe Optimization
summary: Automated post-training transforms pre-trained large language models (LLMs) into models capable of handling diverse domains by automatically constructing and optimizing a recipe of coupled decisions over data sources, data processing, cross-domain composition, and training configuration under a limited experimental budget.
