Existing automation either searches predefined recipe spaces that enable systematic optimization but remain fixed rather than adapting their available choices to the target tasks, or uses open-ended agents that discover task-specific choices but leave them implicit in trial-level edits, limiting their systematic reuse and recombination across trials. To fill this gap, we introduce optimization over a task-adapted recipe space, a novel paradigm that can adapt the recipe space itself to the target tasks while representing its choices explicitly for systematic reuse, recombination, and joint optimization. We instantiate this paradigm with Structured Recipe Optimization (SRO), comprising an LLM-based Recipe-Space Designer that constructs the task-adapted recipe space and a Multi-Domain Recipe Optimizer that uses structured trial evidence to guide LLM candidate construction and multi-objective Bayesian trial selection. Extensive experiments show that SRO achieves the highest average score in all evaluated target-model and agent-LLM combinations. In joint post-training across three capability domains and six benchmarks, SRO reaches 41.1 versus 15.4 for the strongest baseline on Qwen3-1.7B with GPT-5.4, and 53.8 versus 40.8 on Qwen3-4B with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Our code is available at https://github.com/RuohLiuq/SRO.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"任务自适应配方空间上的优化"新范式，并实例化为结构化配方优化（SRO）框架，通过LLM配方空间设计器与多域配方优化器，在有限实验预算下自动构建并优化后训练配方，在多目标基准上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 自动化后训练需在有限实验预算下，对数据源、数据处理、跨域组合及训练配置等耦合决策进行自动构建与优化。现有方法存在两类局限：一是搜索预定义配方空间，可系统优化但空间固定、无法随目标任务调整可用选择；二是采用开放式智能体，能发现任务特定选择但将其隐含在逐次试验的编辑中，难以系统性地复用与重组。
AI.method: 提出"任务自适应配方空间上的优化"这一新范式，使配方空间本身可自适应目标任务，同时将选择显式表示以支持系统性复用、重组与联合优化。以结构化配方优化（SRO）实例化该范式，包含两部分：基于LLM的配方空间设计器（Recipe-Space Designer）负责构建任务自适应配方空间；多域配方优化器（Multi-Domain Recipe Optimizer）利用结构化试验证据指导LLM候选构造，并进行多目标贝叶斯试验选择。
AI.result: 在所有评估的目标模型与智能体LLM组合中，SRO取得最高平均分。在三个能力域、六个基准的联合后训练中，Qwen3-1.7B配合GPT-5.4时SRO达41.1，最强基线为15.4；Qwen3-4B配合DeepSeek-V4-Flash时SRO达53.8，最强基线为40.8。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过让配方空间随目标任务自适应并显式表示其选择，SRO实现了对后训练配方的系统性复用、重组与联合优化，在有限预算下显著优于现有自动化方法，验证了"任务自适应配方空间优化"范式的有效性。

title: Bifocal: Training-Free Mixed Granularity Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Visual token pruning for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) appears highly effective, with existing methods retaining over 95% of unpruned performance on common VQA benchmarks using a quarter of the visual tokens or fewer. However, our extensive evaluation of ten methods across three MLLM families and five ability groups reveals a critical gap: strong general performance often comes at the cost of severe degradation on fine-grained tasks such as OCR and visual grounding. We trace these failures to two limitations of the prevailing paradigm of retaining the highest-ranked native patches. A single importance ranking overlooks the complementary evidence required by different tasks, while sparse patch selection disrupts both image content and spatial integrity. To address these limitations, we propose Bifocal, a training-free, two-stage pruning method built on a mixed-granularity framework. It allocates separate budgets to query-focused and image-intrinsic evidence, complemented by a pooled coarse representation of the entire image. Before the LLM, Bifocal matches question words to visual regions through a soft conjunction balanced against norm-debiased image saliency, while selecting image-intrinsic evidence to maximize representational coverage. Inside the LLM, it further prunes tokens using density-adjusted text-to-image attention. With roughly a quarter of the original visual tokens, Bifocal is the only evaluated method to retain over 90% of unpruned performance in every ability group across all three models, and ranks first on average in all nine model-budget settings. The code is available at: https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Bifocal

AI.tldr: 本文指出主流视觉token剪枝方法在细粒度任务（OCR、视觉定位）上性能严重下降，提出免训练的两阶段混合粒度剪枝方法Bifocal，在三个模型、九个设置下均保持90%以上性能并排名第一。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法在多模态大模型上表面高效（用不超过1/4的视觉token即可保留95%以上通用VQA性能），但作者在3个MLLM家族、5类能力组、10种方法上的广泛评测发现：通用性能强往往以细粒度任务（OCR、视觉定位）严重退化为代价。其根因在于主流"保留最高排名原生patch"范式的两大缺陷：单一重要性排序忽略了不同任务所需的互补证据；稀疏patch选择破坏了图像内容与空间完整性。
AI.method: 提出Bifocal——一种免训练、两阶段的剪枝方法，基于混合粒度框架。它将预算分别分配给查询聚焦证据与图像内在证据，并辅以整幅图像的池化粗粒度表示。在LLM之前，Bifocal通过软合取（soft conjunction）将问题词与视觉区域匹配，并与去偏置范数的图像显著性相平衡，同时选择图像内在证据以最大化表示覆盖度；在LLM内部，进一步利用密度调整的文本到图像注意力进行token剪枝。
AI.result: 在约1/4原始视觉token的条件下，Bifocal是唯一在三个模型的所有能力组中均保留超过90%未剪枝性能的方法，并在全部九个"模型-预算"设置中平均排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 单一重要性排序与稀疏patch选择是现有剪枝范式在细粒度任务上失效的关键原因；通过混合粒度、双预算（查询聚焦与图像内在）+粗粒度全局表示的两阶段设计，Bifocal在保持高效的同时显著提升了对细粒度能力的鲁棒保持。代码已开源。

title: Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops
comment: Initial version released to encourage open discussion and share preliminary findings. Evaluations of additional open-source System One models are ongoing
summary: System One models choose an agent's next action by scoring a supplied set of options in a single pass. This makes them fast and cheap, but when they choose wrongly there is nothing to inspect: did the model misread what the agent has seen, or read it correctly and still act wrongly? We answer behaviorally. On a frozen benchmark of agent decision states from simulated environments, customer-service policies, tool use, web navigation and coding, we pair every next-action question with factual probes about the same state, each answered independently. Across seventeen fast systems and a reasoning model, the answer is consistent: most wrong actions follow correct reading, and the more accurate a system, the more of its errors take this form. These errors are not noise; they gather on the same states across systems of every kind. Where the probed facts provably determine the action, models that read every fact still fail to combine them, and their own answers, composed by code, repair the failure. On real states, what is missing is often not a fact but the next sub-goal.

AI.tldr: 论文在冻结的智能体决策基准上，将每个下一步动作问题与针对同一状态的事实探针配对，独立作答。结果发现：十七个快速系统及一个推理模型的大多数错误动作发生在"读对了"之后，即感知正确但决策/组合失败，且越准确的系统其错误越集中于这类形式。
AI.motivation: System One 式模型单次前向即对候选动作打分，快速廉价，但出错时无法区分错误来源：是模型"误读了状态"，还是"读对了却仍做错"。论文旨在行为层面（行为性地区分，而非依赖内部机制）厘清错误归因，从而定位失败真正发生在感知还是决策组合阶段。
AI.method: 1) 构建冻结的智能体决策状态基准，覆盖模拟环境、客服策略、工具使用、网页导航与编程等场景；2) 为每个"下一步动作"问题配套关于同一状态的事实探针，探针独立作答以避免相互干扰；3) 在十七个快速系统和一个推理模型上对比"动作正确性"与"事实读取正确性"，进行错误归因；4) 进一步用探针事实确定动作，并在代码层面重组模型自身答案以检验组合失败；5) 在真实状态上检查缺失的是事实还是下一步子目标。
AI.result: 跨全部系统结果一致：大多数错误动作发生在正确读取之后；系统越准确，其错误中属于"读对却做错"的比例越高。这类错误并非随机噪声——它们在各类系统间聚集于同一批状态，具有系统性。在探针事实可证明地决定动作的情形下，即使模型读对了所有事实仍无法将其组合，而用代码组合模型自身的答案即可修复该失败。在真实状态上，缺失的往往不是某个事实，而是下一步子目标。
AI.conclusion: 快速智能体模型的主要失败瓶颈不在状态感知/事实读取，而在于将已正确读取的事实组合为正确决策，以及推断下一步子目标。这为改进方向提供了依据：提升事实组合与子目标推断能力，而非仅强化感知。

title: Resource-Efficient 3D Shape and Orientation Estimation of Road Users using Roadside RGB Camera and 3D Radar
comment: Accepted at the 18th IEEE Symposium Sensor Data Fusion: Trends, Solutions and Applications (SDF 2026), Bonn, Germany
summary: End-to-end deep learning pipelines for camera-radar 3D object detection are well established in driver assistance systems and autonomous vehicles; however, adapting them to roadside-mounted infrastructure presents significant challenges. On vehicles, sensor heights, pitch angles, and relative geometries remain largely uniform, allowing end-to-end models to generalize effectively. On the contrary, roadside sensor installations vary drastically in height, tilt, and field of view across locations, rendering end-to-end models prone to failure and difficult to adapt without massive location-specific datasets. Hence, instead of designing a complex end-to-end pipeline for direct 3D bounding box estimation, a low-cost, resource-efficient two-stage approach is proposed for real-time 3D shape and orientation estimation. The first stage utilizes any off-the-shelf, state-of-the-art method to extract 2D camera bounding boxes and associated 3D radar points for each road user. The proposed second stage then processes these inputs to construct 3D oriented bounding boxes where radar data determines 3D position, predefined templates define size for each road user, and a tiny neural network predicts a site-specific and optimized yaw angle. The algorithm is successfully validated at a curved road with a junction for pedestrians, bicycles, and cars, where it achieves 25 frames per second on an NVIDIA Jetson ORIN for real-time applications.

AI.tldr: 提出一种低成本、资源高效的两阶段方法，用于路侧相机-雷达实时3D形状与朝向估计，在NVIDIA Jetson ORIN上达到25 FPS。
AI.motivation: 车载端到端相机-雷达3D检测已成熟，但路侧安装的高度、俯仰角与视场差异大，端到端模型易失效且难以在缺乏大量特定地点数据时适配，因此需要一种无需复杂端到端管线、可快速适配的替代方案。
AI.method: 第一阶段使用任意现成的SOTA方法提取2D相机边界框及对应的3D雷达点；第二阶段据此构建3D有向边界框：雷达数据确定3D位置，预定义模板决定各类道路使用者尺寸，并用一个微型神经网络预测站点特定且优化的偏航角。
AI.result: 在带交叉口的弯道场景下，针对行人、自行车和汽车完成验证，在NVIDIA Jetson ORIN上实现25帧/秒的实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 该两阶段方案以低成本、资源高效的方式实现了路侧实时3D形状与朝向估计，规避了端到端模型在多变路侧布设下的泛化与适配难题。

title: Compare to Correct: Pairwise-Guided Logit Adjustment for LLM Test-Time Scaling
summary: Sampling-based test-time scaling enhances LLM reasoning by aggregating multiple reasoning paths for the same query. Existing methods use answer frequencies or path confidence to compute candidate scores, which do not explicitly characterize comparisons between competing answers. Inspired by the Condorcet principle in social choice theory, we introduce pairwise confidence comparisons between paths supporting different answers to capture answer-level comparative advantage. We combine this comparative evidence with voting support through a KL-regularized objective. Theoretically, we show that this comparative-advantage is equivalent to the adjustment to the traditional voting logits. In this way, our proposed Pairwise-Guided Logit Adjustment (PGLA) framework allows comparative evidence to compensate for weaker voting support and correct voting-based ranking errors. Experiments on 10 challenging benchmarks including mathematical reasoning, knowledge reasoning, and code generation with 7 models ranging from 1.7B to 32B parameters speak to the effectiveness of this plug-and-play term. Additional evaluations with external reward scores and online sampling further demonstrate its applicability.

AI.tldr: 提出PGLA框架，用成对置信比较结合KL正则化目标调整投票logits，提升LLM测试时推理的答案排序准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于采样的测试时扩展方法主要依赖答案频率或路径置信度来给候选打分，无法显式刻画竞争答案之间的比较关系，导致投票排名存在错误。
AI.method: 受社会选择理论中Condorcet原则启发，引入支持不同答案的路径间的成对置信比较，捕捉答案级比较优势；将其与投票支持度通过KL正则化目标结合，理论证明该比较优势等价于对传统投票logits的调整，形成即插即用的PGLA框架。
AI.result: 在数学推理、知识推理和代码生成等10个挑战性基准上，使用7个1.7B至32B参数模型进行实验，验证了该即插即用项的有效性；外部奖励分数与在线采样评估进一步证明其适用性。
AI.conclusion: PGLA通过引入成对置信比较作为投票logits的调整项，可补偿较弱的投票支持并纠正基于投票的排序错误，是一种有效且通用的测试时扩展增强方法。

title: CoTL: Compact Token Learning for 3D Scene Representation
summary: We present CoTL, a framework that learns a compact set of tokens that preserves scene geometry and appearance from unposed multi-view images. Our encoder compresses the input images into small per-view sets of latent tokens that aggregate information across views to form a view-consistent scene representation. Each additional view expands the representation with only a small, resolution-independent set of tokens, allowing its capacity to grow with the available observations. To force this compact bottleneck to retain sufficient scene information, a query-based Gaussian decoder uses scene-independent queries to attend to the learned tokens and recover an explicit, renderable set of 3D Gaussian primitives. Novel-view rendering supervision trains the compact representation end to end through the reconstructed Gaussian scene. Experiments on RealEstate10K and ACID show that the resulting compact, unstructured token set supports competitive novel-view synthesis and can serve as the latent space of a generative model for 3D Gaussian scene generation. Together, these results show that 3D Gaussian reconstruction is an effective objective for compact scene representation learning and the learned token space provides a basis for broader downstream tasks in 3D vision.

AI.tldr: 提出CoTL框架，从无位姿多视角图像学习紧凑的潜token集合，保留场景几何与外观，可支持新视角合成及3D高斯场景生成。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景表示往往依赖显式且体积庞大的结构（如点云、高斯原语或辐射场），容量随观测增长而不易压缩，且难以作为生成模型的潜空间。作者希望获得一种紧凑、与分辨率无关、可随观测扩展的场景表示，同时保留足够几何与外观信息。
AI.method: 编码器将输入图像压缩为每个视角的小型潜token集合，并通过跨视角聚合形成视角一致的场景表示；每新增一个视角仅扩展少量与分辨率无关的token。为约束该紧凑瓶颈保留场景信息，采用基于查询的高斯解码器：使用与场景无关的查询关注学习到的token，恢复显式、可渲染的3D高斯原语集合。通过新视角渲染监督，端到端训练整个紧凑表示。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K与ACID数据集上，该紧凑、非结构化token集合支持具有竞争力的新视角合成，并可充当生成模型潜空间，用于3D高斯场景生成。
AI.conclusion: 3D高斯重建是紧凑场景表示学习的有效目标；所学token空间为3D视觉中更广泛的下游任务提供了基础。

title: Auditing Future-Memory Use in Point-in-Time Language Agents
summary: Point-in-time (PIT) agents can recall post-cutoff facts even when their external evidence respects a historical cutoff. We examine whether this access predicts evidence gathering in 48 historical company-comparison tasks. Independent closed-book revenue probes identify the better-remembered company for each model on tasks with unequal recall, fixing the predicted direction before agent runs. We then compare paired runs with real or anonymized company identities while keeping external evidence PIT-valid. Both Qwen and DeepSeek recalled future facts, but neither supported the prespecified shift toward the better-remembered company. Qwen's four allocation estimates on 28 unequal-recall tasks were negative, with descriptive intervals spanning zero. A prospective DeepSeek replication showed an inverse pattern across all four metrics on 20 such tasks, with intervals below zero. These estimates remained negative after each company, pair, and future-fact omission, and all four post-hoc max-T-adjusted sign-flip p-values were below .05. In a prospectively specified follow-up, explicit future facts produced small estimated shifts away from the supplied-fact company, with intervals spanning zero, while final choices shifted toward it. The mechanism behind the natural inverse pattern remains unresolved. These findings support separate assessments of memory accessibility, search allocation, and final outputs alongside cutoff checks on external evidence.

AI.tldr: 研究考察时点(PIT)智能体在外部证据遵守历史截止点的前提下能否凭内部记忆获取截止点后事实，以及这种记忆可及性是否预测其证据搜集行为。48项历史公司比较任务显示：Qwen与DeepSeek均能回忆未来事实，但均未按预注册方向偏向记忆更好的公司（Qwen四项估计为负、区间跨零；DeepSeek四项指标呈反向、区间低于零）。记忆可及性、检索分配与最终输出需分别评估。
AI.motivation: PIT智能体即便外部证据符合历史截止点，仍可能通过参数记忆回忆截止点后事实，构成时间泄漏风险。作者欲检验这种"记忆可及性"是否实际影响智能体的证据搜集资源配置，即内部记忆是否驱动检索行为。
AI.method: 设计48项历史公司比较任务。用独立闭卷收入探针在记忆不均等任务上识别每模型"记忆更好"的公司，预先固定预测方向。比较真实公司名与匿名化公司名的配对运行，同时保持外部证据PIT有效。对Qwen与DeepSeek分别估计公司在检索分配中的份额，并进行DeepSeek前瞻性复制、逐公司/配对/未来事实剔除稳健性检验及max-T校正符号翻转检验。后续前瞻性研究中操控显式未来事实。
AI.result: Qwen与DeepSeek均能回忆未来事实。Qwen在28项不均等记忆任务上的四项分配估计均为负，描述性区间跨零，未支持预注册方向。DeepSeek前瞻复制在20项任务上四项指标呈反向模式，区间低于零；剔除任一公司、配对或未来事实后估计仍为负，四项max-T校正符号翻转p值均<.05。后续研究中显式未来事实导致小幅偏离被提供事实的公司（区间跨零），但最终选择反而偏向该公司。
AI.conclusion: 记忆可及性并不能稳定预测证据搜集方向，自然出现的反向模式机制尚未明确。建议对记忆可及性、检索分配与最终输出进行分离评估，并在外部证据PIT检查之外增加相应检验。

title: EmoGenie: Benchmarking and Evaluating Expressed and Evoked Emotion in T2I Generation with MLLMs
comment: Comments: Corresponding author: Xiongkuo Min. Equal contribution: Zixuan Xing and Lancheng Gao
summary: Rapid advances in artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) have significantly promoted using text-to-image (T2I) models to generate images with specific affective intentions. However, the emotional effects conveyed by generated images frequently deviate from target expectations, and it remains unclear whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reliably interpret the emotion of AI-generated visual content. Existing affective benchmarks are predominantly built on natural images, while affective studies of generated images have largely focused on emotions expressed in portraits, lacking a unified benchmark for studying the emotions expressed and evoked by generated images. We therefore introduce EmoGenie, a benchmark of emotion for AI-generated images that evaluates capabilities in T2I generation and MLLM understanding across expressed and evoked emotions. It comprises 6,400 images generated by eight T2I models using 800 emotion-targeted prompts, annotated with question-answer (QA) pairs, termed EmoGenie-QA, and continuous human ratings, termed EmoGenie-Assess. EmoGenie-QA contains 90,000 closed-set questions in single-image and image-pair settings, as well as 1,057 open-ended questions for emotion description. EmoGenie-Assess benchmarks continuous affective and aesthetic prediction using 13,175 mean opinion scores (MOSs) aggregated from human ratings in terms of valence, arousal, dominance, and aesthetic quality. We further develop EmoProbe, which combines emotion question answering with response-aligned, dimension-specific regression heads for continuous score prediction. Experimental results show that EmoProbe achieves superior results on emotion-related QA tasks, while its affective and aesthetic predictions correlate better with human ratings, demonstrating its state-of-the-art capabilities of unified coarse-to-fine affective understanding for AI-generated images.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EmoGenie 基准，用于评估 AI 生成图像在表达情感与诱发情感方面的 T2I 生成与 MLLM 理解能力，并开发 EmoProbe 模型实现由粗到细的统一情感理解。
AI.motivation: AIGC 与 T2I 模型发展迅速，但生成图像的情感效果常偏离预期；MLLM 能否可靠解读 AI 生成视觉内容的情感尚不明确。现有情感基准多基于自然图像，生成图像的情感研究又主要聚焦人像，缺乏统一基准来研究生成图像所表达与诱发的情感。
AI.method: 构建 EmoGenie 基准：包含 8 个 T2I 模型基于 800 条情感目标提示生成的 6,400 张图像，并标注两类数据——EmoGenie-QA（90,000 道单图与图像对封闭式问题及 1,057 道开放式情感描述问题）与 EmoGenie-Assess（13,175 个 MOS，涵盖效价、唤醒度、支配度和美学质量）。此外提出 EmoProbe，结合情感问答与响应对齐的维度特定回归头进行连续分数预测。
AI.result: EmoProbe 在情感相关 QA 任务上取得更优结果，其情感与美学预测与人类评分相关性更好，展现出面向 AI 生成图像的统一由粗到细情感理解的最先进能力。
AI.conclusion: EmoGenie 为 AI 生成图像的情感表达与诱发提供了统一基准，EmoProbe 验证了结合离散问答与连续回归的有效性，推动了生成图像情感理解研究。

title: AgentStripes: An Evidence-Graded Maturity Model for AI Agents
comment: 32 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables, 116 references; supplementary information (15 pages, 8 figures, 21 tables) included in the same PDF. Code and data available on request
summary: Benchmarks report what an Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent can do on a task suite, but not whether one released version has been engineered with the controls that make it reliable, safe and observable, or how strongly that is shown. This paper proposes AgentStripes, an evidence-graded maturity model for AI agents. It defines levels (0 to 7 stripes), process areas (12 areas holding 40 capabilities), three gates (basic, safety, proof) that hold an agent at a level however high its score, and evidence grades E0 to E5. Each applicable capability receives a rating from 0 to 3 and a separate evidence level; these are combined into a credit, aggregated into a severity-weighted score and converted into stripes that the gates limit. Instruments gather evidence, language-model judges interpret it under explicit criteria, and the arithmetic is deterministic. The model is compared with standards at topic level without a claim of conformance, and an unexecuted validation protocol is specified. An empirical evaluation (exploratory, non-confirmatory) of 30 public Python agent repositories, with static evidence only, is a demonstration and not a validation: static evidence caps every final stripe at 2, 26 repositories end at one stripe and 4 at two, and this distinction is unreliable, since re-judging changed the final stripe of 4 of 22 repositories (engine, dossier and panel changed), whereas none of 8 panel-only repeats, all at stripe 1, changed. The parameters are expert conventions without outcome based calibration, and the stripes have not been shown to predict reliability or safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentStripes——一个面向 AI 智能体的证据分级成熟度模型，以 0–7 条纹等级、12 个过程域（40 项能力）、三道闸门与 E0–E5 证据等级构建评级框架，并用 30 个公开 Python 智能体仓库进行探索性演示性评估。
AI.motivation: 现有基准只报告 AI 智能体"能做什么"，不反映某个发布版本是否具备可靠性、安全性与可观测性所需的工程控制，也不体现这些控制的证据强度。因此需要一个能同时刻画能力与证据强度的成熟度模型。
AI.method: AgentStripes 定义 0–7 条纹等级、12 个过程域（含 40 项能力）、三道闸门（基础、安全、证明，无论得分多高均可将智能体限制在某等级）及 E0–E5 证据等级。每项适用能力获得 0–3 评级与独立证据等级，二者合成 credit，聚合成严重度加权分数，转换为条纹并被闸门限制。由工具采集证据，语言模型评审员按明确标准解读，算术过程确定性。模型与相关标准仅在主题层面比较，不主张符合性；并给出未执行的验证方案。实证部分为探索性、非确证性评估，仅使用静态证据，覆盖 30 个公开 Python 智能体仓库。
AI.result: 静态证据使所有最终条纹上限为 2：26 个仓库止于 1 条纹，4 个达 2 条纹；该区分不可靠——重新评审使 22 个仓库中 4 个的最终条纹发生变化（engine、dossier 与 panel 均变），而 8 次仅 panel 的重复评审（均为 1 条纹）无一变化。
AI.conclusion: AgentStripes 是一项演示而非验证：其参数为专家约定，未基于结果进行校准，条纹尚未被证明能预测可靠性或安全性。

title: $\mathrm{S}^3$-PnP: Plug-and-Play Denoising for Scientific Imaging with Self-Supervised Score Priors
summary: Modern image restoration methods increasingly rely on large-scale supervised training, yet clean targets are often prohibitively difficult to obtain in scientific imaging modalities such as hyperspectral imaging (HSI) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Plug-and-play ADMM (PnP-ADMM) with pretrained diffusion priors offers a promising alternative, but the learned prior distribution can mismatch both the target scientific image distribution and the distribution of ADMM denoiser inputs induced by dual feedback. To mitigate these mismatches, we propose $\mathrm{S}^3$-PnP, a self-supervised plug-and-play restoration framework that learns a score prior directly from observation-derived ADMM intermediate states, without clean training targets or externally pretrained weights. Specifically, the learned score corrects the input to the analytical prior update, combining observation-driven corrections with analytical regularization. We further analyze the convergence and reconstruction error of the corrected ADMM algorithm assuming an ideal score and quadratic data fidelity. Experiments on reference-guided HSI restoration, single-image HSI denoising, and MRI denoising demonstrate consistent improvements over competing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出S³-PnP自监督即插即用恢复框架，直接从观测导出的ADMM中间状态学习得分先验，无需干净标签或外部预训练权重，在HSI与MRI任务上优于对比方法。
AI.motivation: 现有图像恢复依赖大规模监督训练，但HSI、MRI等科学成像中干净目标难以获取；基于预训练扩散先验的PnP-ADMM虽为替代方案，但所学先验分布既可能与目标科学图像分布不匹配，也可能与对偶反馈引起的ADMM去噪器输入分布不匹配。
AI.method: 提出S³-PnP：从观测导出的ADMM中间状态直接学习得分先验，无需干净训练目标和外部预训练权重；所学得分用于修正解析先验更新的输入，将观测驱动修正与解析正则化相结合；并在理想得分与二次数据保真假设下分析修正后ADMM算法的收敛性与重建误差。
AI.result: 在参考引导的HSI恢复、单图HSI去噪和MRI去噪实验上，相较竞争方法取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: S³-PnP通过自监督学习与ADMM中间状态对齐的得分先验，缓解了分布不匹配问题，并为修正ADMM提供收敛性与误差理论保障，在科学成像恢复任务中有效。

title: MFVSR: A Multi-Style and Fine-Grained Benchmark for Video Subtitle Removal
comment: 31 pages, including appendix. Code: https://github.com/hxyiiii/MFVSR ; Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/siiian/MFVSR
summary: Video subtitle removal (VSR) is an important video restoration task, yet existing evaluation remains limited by low-resolution datasets, fragmented test sets, and generic video-inpainting protocols that fail to adequately capture localized restoration errors, unintended modifications, temporal instability, and incomplete outputs. In this paper, we introduce MFVSR, a large-scale multi-style benchmark for fine-grained and reliability-aware video subtitle removal evaluation. MFVSR distinguishes itself through three key features: (1) Large-scale and diverse data, comprising 3,000 paired videos from Real-HQ, Real-LQ, and AI-Generated sources, with an auxiliary set of 953 in-the-wild real videos for real-world coverage analysis; (2) Controlled subtitle diversity, spanning 16 languages and four factors covering spatial layout, temporal behavior, visual style, and language mode; (3) Fine-grained evaluation, introducing an information-conditioned, spatially decoupled protocol that separates blind from mask-guided removal and measures Restoration Fidelity, Preservation Fidelity, Temporal Fidelity, coverage, and failures. Experiments on six representative methods reveal substantial discrepancies between local restoration, outside-region preservation, temporal consistency, and full-set reliability that are obscured by conventional full-frame metrics. MFVSR therefore provides a more comprehensive and diagnostic foundation for evaluating and advancing video subtitle removal methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MFVSR，一个面向视频字幕去除（VSR）的大规模多风格基准，包含3000对配对视频与953个真实视频，覆盖16种语言，并引入信息条件化、空间解耦的细粒度评测协议，揭示传统全帧指标掩盖的局部恢复、区域外保持、时序一致性与全集合可靠性差异。
AI.motivation: 现有VSR评测受限于低分辨率数据集、碎片化测试集以及通用视频修复协议，难以充分刻画局部恢复误差、非预期修改、时序不稳定与输出不完整等问题，因此需要更全面、更具诊断性的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建MFVSR基准：数据涵盖Real-HQ、Real-LQ与AI-Generated共3000对配对视频，另有953个真实视频用于真实场景覆盖分析；字幕多样性由16种语言与四类因素（空间布局、时序行为、视觉风格、语言模式）控制；评测采用信息条件化、空间解耦协议，区分盲去除与掩码引导去除，并度量恢复保真度、保持保真度、时序保真度、覆盖率与失败情况。
AI.result: 在六种代表性方法上的实验显示，局部恢复、区域外保持、时序一致性与全集合可靠性之间存在显著差异，而这些差异在全帧指标下被掩盖。
AI.conclusion: MFVSR为视频字幕去除方法的评测与推进提供了更全面、更具诊断性的基础。

title: Can an Agent Learn to Predict Its Own Failure? Outcome-Grounded Confidence Calibration in LLM Agents
summary: Controlling an acting LLM agent means deciding, at each step of a long-horizon task, whether to trust its next action, abstain, or hand off to a human. That decision needs a per-step confidence signal predicting whether the current rollout will eventually succeed. The agent's own self-reported verbalized confidence is the natural candidate, but existing reinforcement learning methods calibrate it against the correctness of a decision at the current step. We propose a method to calibrate it against the eventual outcome of a multi-step episode: under GRPO, the group of rollouts for a task supplies success labels, and a proper scoring rule scores each step's confidence against the realized outcome. In offline RL on recorded trajectories of a Qwen2.5-7B agent in ALFWorld, TextWorld, and WebShop environments, the AUROC of step confidence against episode outcome rises from near chance to 0.68-0.85, and the top-10% of steps the agent is most confident about succeed ~4.3x more often than average. In online RL on the live ALFWorld agent, four calibration rewards improve early-step AUROC, expected calibration error goes from 0.42 to below 0.12, and selective execution improves over both the untrained agent and a format-only RL control, without degrading task success. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that separates episode depth, task difficulty, and attempt-level foresight, which shows where the gain lies: the trained agent recognizes from its first step which tasks it will fail, while telling a succeeding attempt from a failing one at the same task is harder, with some early-window signal emerging on TextWorld.

AI.tldr: 提出在GRPO框架下将智能体每步言语化置信度与整条回合最终成败对齐校准的方法，并引入分离回合深度、任务难度与尝试级预见性的评测协议。
AI.motivation: 控制长时程LLM智能体需要每步置信信号以决定信任、弃权或转交人工。现有强化学习方法仅将置信度校准到当前步决策的正确性，无法预测整个多步回合的最终结果，因此缺乏可用于长时程控制的可靠逐步置信信号。
AI.method: 在GRPO下利用同一任务的一组rollout提供成功标签，用proper scoring rule将每步置信度对照实际回合结果评分，从而把置信度校准到最终outcome。在ALFWorld、TextWorld、WebShop的Qwen2.5-7B记录轨迹上做离线RL，并在在线ALFWorld智能体上用四种校准奖励训练。另设计评测协议，将回合深度、任务难度与尝试级预见性分离。
AI.result: 离线RL下，逐步置信度对回合结果的AUROC从接近随机升至0.68–0.85，最有信心的前10%步骤成功率约为平均的4.3倍。在线ALFWorld中，四种校准奖励提升早期步骤AUROC，期望校准误差从0.42降至0.12以下，选择性执行优于未训练智能体与仅格式RL对照，且任务成功率不下降。评测协议显示：训练后智能体可从第一步识别将失败的任务；同一任务下区分成功与失败尝试更难，TextWorld上出现少量早期窗口信号。
AI.conclusion: 将言语化置信度校准到整条回合的最终结果，可得到可用于选择性执行与人工转交的每步置信信号，且不牺牲任务性能；其增益主要来自对任务级将失败情形的早期识别而非尝试级预见。

title: Simplifying and Improving On-Policy Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion
summary: Few-step distillation reduces the sampling cost of diffusion and flow models, but existing approaches often require auxiliary score models or specialized architectures. We show that simple on-policy velocity regression already provides a strong foundation for 4-NFE generation. To represent teacher velocity variation within each coarse transition, we introduce Pivot, a training-only residual proxy that separates local corrections from the student's interval-mean prediction. We further repel the student from weaker teacher predictions, providing a lightweight mechanism for avoiding undesirable modes. The resulting framework, Simplified Matching Distillation (SMD), remains entirely regression-based, requires neither online score estimation nor adversarial training, and leaves the deployed generator unchanged. We evaluate SMD on image generation and editing, 3D generation, video synthesis, and joint audio--video generation, scaling to 33 billion parameters. At 4-NFE, SMD outperforms strong few-step baselines and surpasses multi-step teachers on several benchmarks. It also supports cross-model, multi-teacher, and causal-video distillation.

AI.tldr: SMD提出一种纯回归式的少步蒸馏框架，仅用on-policy速度回归+残差代理Pivot+弱教师排斥，无需辅助分数模型或对抗训练，在4-NFE下超越强基线并跨图像/3D/视频/音视频任务。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流模型的少步蒸馏可降低采样成本，但现有方法通常依赖辅助分数模型或特殊架构，增加了训练复杂度与部署约束，作者希望用更简单的回归范式实现高质量4-NFE生成。
AI.method: 核心是on-policy速度回归。引入训练期残差代理Pivot，将局部修正从学生的区间均值预测中分离，以刻画粗粒度转移内的教师速度变化；并加入对较弱教师预测的排斥项，避免不良模式。整个框架保持纯回归，无需在线分数估计或对抗训练，且不改变部署生成器。
AI.result: 在图像生成与编辑、3D生成、视频合成以及联合音视频生成上验证，规模扩展至330亿参数。4-NFE下SMD优于强少步基线，并在若干基准上超过多步教师；同时支持跨模型、多教师与因果视频蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: 少步蒸馏不一定需要辅助分数模型或专门架构；简洁的on-policy速度回归配合Pivot残差代理与弱教师排斥，即可作为强基础，实现高效、可扩展且部署友好的少步生成。

title: Two Routes to Interoceptive Prioritisation: Dissociating Likelihood Precision and Preference Reweighting in Active Inference
comment: Accepted at IWAI 2026, forthcoming in the Springer proceedings. 17 pages: the 13-page camera-ready paper, reproduced without alteration apart from one typographical fix, followed by 4 pages of supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/sgrimbly/interoceptive-prioritisation-iwai2026-snapshot
summary: An embodied agent must prioritise among competing bodily needs. In active inference, it can respond to an urgent need by increasing the precision of information about that need or by increasing its preference for outcomes that relieve it. We compare these two interventions, separately and together, in a foraging gridworld with three lethal needs, and ask how each changes survival, perception and the body model the agent learns. Precision sharpens interoceptive posteriors and improves survival. Preference reweighting keeps bodily states further from their lethal boundaries and changes the states from which the agent learns, so its learned model covers fewer need levels, with lower quality across all levels but slightly higher quality on the levels it visits. An experiment on 72 further layouts does not establish the predicted preference benefit on difficult layouts, but both interventions improve average survival there and their interaction is positive. Survival alone therefore gives an incomplete account of how a model prioritises needs and learns about its body.

AI.tldr: 具身智能体需在多重生存需求间排序。本文在主动推断框架下比较两种应对紧迫需求的手段——提高关于该需求信息的精度、提高对缓解该需求结果的偏好——及其组合，在三项致命需求的觅食网格世界中考察其对生存、知觉与身体模型学习的影响。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体面临竞争性的生理需求，必须进行优先级排序。主动推断中存在两种可能的干预方式（提高精度与提高偏好），但二者对生存、知觉以及智能体所学身体模型的具体影响尚缺乏系统比较。
AI.method: 在三项致命需求的觅食网格世界中进行实验，分别、以及同时施加两种干预：一是提高关于紧迫需求的内感受信息精度，二是提高对缓解该需求结果的偏好；并在此基础上比较其生存表现、知觉（内感受后验）变化及所学习的身体模型，随后在72个额外布局上重复实验以检验预测。
AI.result: 精度干预锐化了内感受后验并改善生存。偏好重加权使身体状态远离致命边界，并改变了智能体进行学习的状态分布，因此所学模型覆盖的需求水平更少，整体质量更低，但在其访问过的水平上质量略高。在72个额外布局上的实验未能证实所预测的偏好收益，但两种干预均提升了平均生存率，且二者交互作用为正。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭生存指标无法完整刻画模型如何对需求进行优先级排序并学习其身体；需结合知觉与所学模型的质量等维度加以评估。

title: Physics-Aware Deepfake Detection via Distance-Speech Consistency
summary: Recent progress in generative models has made talking-head deepfakes highly realistic and easy to create, jeopardizing public trust. However, most audio-visual deepfake detectors rely on lip-speech synchronization and are designed for static, frontal videos, limiting their reliability in dynamic, in-the-wild recordings where the speaker moves and lip cues are degraded or missing. As an alternative, we propose a physics-aware detector for dynamic speaking videos that leverages an acoustic constraint: in real recordings, speech energy varies predictably with speaker-to-camera distance, whereas deepfake generation can break this coupling. Our method combines distance estimates from video with distance-dependent acoustic measures from speech to detect deepfakes. Experiments on in-the-wild benchmarks show that the proposed physical cue is effective in dynamic scenarios, and that it complements lip-sync-based detectors, with a simple ensemble achieving consistent gains across datasets. Codes are available at https://byulharang.github.io/PADD/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出物理感知的动态说话视频深度伪造检测器，利用真实录音中语音能量随说话者-相机距离变化这一声学约束，结合视频距离估计与距离相关声学测量来检测伪造，在真实场景基准上有效并可与唇形同步检测器互补。
AI.motivation: 生成模型的进步使说话头深度伪造逼真易造，威胁公众信任。但多数音视频检测器依赖唇语同步，且针对静态正面视频设计，在说话者移动、唇部线索退化或缺失的动态真实场景中可靠性受限，因此需要新的检测线索。
AI.method: 提出物理感知检测器：利用真实录音中语音能量随说话者-相机距离可预测变化的声学约束，而深度伪造生成可能破坏这一耦合。方法将视频估计的距离与语音中距离相关的声学测量相结合来检测伪造。
AI.result: 在真实场景基准上的实验表明，所提出的物理线索在动态场景中有效，并能与基于唇形同步的检测器互补，简单集成即可在多个数据集上取得一致性提升。代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 物理感知线索为动态说话视频深度伪造检测提供了有效且与现有唇形同步方法互补的新途径，简单集成即可稳定提升性能。

title: EgoOmniWorld: Unifying Egocentric Understanding via Ego-Action-World Interactions
summary: Egocentric video understanding spans diverse capabilities, modalities, and evaluation formats, yet these are often studied in isolation despite their tight coupling in real-world interaction. We propose the Ego-Action-World interaction loop as a unifying principle: the wearer perceives the world, forms goals, acts, changes the world, and uses feedback to guide subsequent behavior. Based on this view, we introduce EgoOmniWorld, a benchmark organized around four complementary interaction structures: Node captures ego, action, and world states; Edge captures directed relations among them; Chain captures linked dependencies; and Loop captures feedback-closed interactions. We develop an interaction-first, evidence-grounded data pipeline that extracts structured interactions from egocentric videos, grounds them in visual and auditory evidence, and generates questions according to their interaction structure. Required modalities and single- or multi-turn formats follow naturally from the supporting evidence and dependencies. EgoOmniWorld contains 24,166 QA groups, including 20,284 training and 3,882 test samples. Experiments on representative open- and closed-source multimodal large language models reveal substantial and uneven limitations across interaction structures. Models trained on EgoOmniWorld improve in-domain interaction understanding and generalize to existing egocentric benchmarks. EgoOmniWorld provides a unified foundation for evaluating and advancing egocentric video understanding. Data, code, and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出以"自我-动作-世界交互循环"为统一原则的基准 EgoOmniWorld，通过 Node/Edge/Chain/Loop 四种交互结构组织任务，构建交互优先的数据管线，包含 24,166 个 QA 组，揭示现有多模态大模型的交互理解局限并验证其训练收益。
AI.motivation: 自我中心视频理解涉及多种能力、模态与评估形式，但现有研究往往孤立处理，忽视了真实交互中它们之间的紧密耦合。作者希望以统一原则整合这些分散的研究维度。
AI.method: 提出 Ego-Action-World 交互循环作为统一原则（佩戴者感知世界、形成目标、行动、改变世界、利用反馈引导后续行为）。据此构建 EgoOmniWorld 基准，围绕四种互补交互结构组织：Node（自我、动作、世界状态）、Edge（节点间有向关系）、Chain（链式依赖）、Loop（反馈闭环交互）。开发交互优先、证据扎根的数据管线：从自我中心视频抽取结构化交互，用视觉与听觉证据进行落地，并按交互结构生成问题，所需模态与单轮/多轮格式自然由支撑证据与依赖关系决定。
AI.result: EgoOmniWorld 包含 24,166 个 QA 组，其中训练集 20,284、测试集 3,882。对代表性开源与闭源多模态大语言模型的实验显示，模型在不同交互结构上存在显著且不均衡的局限。在 EgoOmniWorld 上训练的模型提升了域内交互理解能力，并能泛化到现有自我中心基准。
AI.conclusion: EgoOmniWorld 为评估和推进自我中心视频理解提供了统一基础，数据、代码与模型将开源发布。

title: Knowing the User Is Not Knowing What We Established: Grounding Awareness in Personal Agents
summary: Personal-agent memory has largely focused on learning what users know, prefer, and want. However, knowing the user does not necessarily mean knowing what the user and the agent have established together. An assistant's proposal should not become an authorized instruction merely because it is remembered. We introduce Grounding Awareness, the ability to distinguish accepted, unacknowledged, revised, and scoped arrangements when selecting actions. We develop a controlled benchmark to test whether agents can tell the difference between proposals users have accepted and those they have not, and whether they apply accepted arrangements only where appropriate. Across multiple agents and memory systems, we find that strong memory performance does not ensure Grounding Awareness. More surprisingly, providing more complete user information can increase execution of unacknowledged proposals, while persistent memory can cause agents to treat these proposals as if they were user instructions. We trace these failures through memory writing, retrieval, and action selection. Finally, we introduce Grounding Layer, a lightweight, training-free extension that explicitly tracks grounding status and checks consequential actions, substantially improving agent behavior without modifying models or memory systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Grounding Awareness"概念，要求智能体区分被接受、未被确认、被修改及有范围限制的约定，并构建受控基准进行评测；发现强记忆能力并不保证该能力，且更完整的用户信息与持久记忆反而会加剧对未确认提议的错误执行；最后提出免训练轻量扩展 Grounding Layer 来显式追踪 grounding 状态并校验关键动作。
AI.motivation: 现有个人智能体记忆研究聚焦于"知道用户知道什么、偏好什么、想要什么"，但"了解用户"不等于"了解用户与智能体共同确立了什么"。核心风险在于：助手提出的建议一旦被记忆，就可能被误当作已获授权的指令。因此需要一种能力，使智能体在行动选择时能辨别哪些约定已被用户接受、哪些尚未确认。
AI.method: 1) 形式化提出 Grounding Awareness 概念，区分四类 grounding 状态：accepted（已接受）、unacknowledged（未确认）、revised（已修改）、scoped（有范围限制）。2) 构建受控基准，测试智能体能否区分用户已接受与未接受的提议，以及是否只在恰当场景应用已接受的约定。3) 在多种智能体与记忆系统上开展评测，并从记忆写入、检索、动作选择三个环节追踪失败来源。4) 提出 Grounding Layer：一种免训练、轻量级扩展，显式追踪 grounding 状态并对重要动作进行校验。
AI.result: 在多个智能体与记忆系统上，强记忆性能并不能保证 Grounding Awareness。更出人意料的是，提供更完整的用户信息会提高对未确认提议的执行率，而持久记忆会使智能体将这些提议当作用户指令来对待。失败可追溯到记忆写入、检索与动作选择各环节。Grounding Layer 在不修改模型与记忆系统的前提下，显著改善了智能体行为。
AI.conclusion: 智能体的记忆能力与其对"共同约定状态"的判别能力是分离的，仅提升记忆质量甚至可能带来反效果。通过引入显式追踪 grounding 状态并在关键动作前进行校验的轻量机制，可以在不重训模型、不改动记忆系统的条件下有效提升智能体行为的合规性与可靠性。

title: Dual-Domain Sparse-View 4D CBCT Reconstruction with Spatial-Temporal Consistency Learning
summary: Four-dimensional cone-beam computed tomography (4D CBCT) provides phase-resolved volumetric images for image-guided radiotherapy. Yet good reconstruction quality usually needs many projections. This increases scan time and radiation dose. We propose STCNet, a sparse-view 4D CBCT reconstruction framework that uses spatial-temporal consistency learning. STCNet reconstructs high-quality images from only 16 projections in each respiratory phase. STCNet integrates physics-driven positional encoding to enforce geometric consistency in the projection domain and introduces temporal encoding in latent space to capture respiratory motion dynamics across phases to capture dynamic respiratory motion across phases. A dual-domain collaborative strategy jointly optimizes both projection and image domains, enhancing structural fidelity and temporal coherence. We tested STCNet on the TCIA-LUNG dataset and a CIRS thorax phantom dataset. STCNet performed better than conventional methods and recent deep learning baselines in image quality, artifact reduction, and structural preservation. On TCIA-LUNG, STCNet reached PSNR values of 33.311, 32.695, and 32.658 dB at phases 2, 5, and 8. The corresponding SSIM values were 0.845, 0.823, and 0.825. On CIRS, STCNet achieved PSNR values up to 36.497 dB and SSIM values up to 0.877. These results support STCNet as a promising framework for low-dose, phase-resolved 4D CBCT reconstruction in image-guided radiotherapy.

AI.tldr: 提出STCNet框架，通过时空一致性学习从每呼吸相位仅16个投影重建高质量4D CBCT图像。
AI.motivation: 4D CBCT可提供相位分辨的容积图像用于图像引导放疗，但高质量重建通常需要大量投影，导致扫描时间延长和辐射剂量增加。因此需要稀疏视角下的高质量重建方法。
AI.method: STCNet融合物理驱动的位置编码以在投影域约束几何一致性，并在潜空间引入时间编码以捕获跨相位的呼吸运动动态；采用双域协同策略联合优化投影域与图像域，提升结构保真度与时间连贯性。
AI.result: 在TCIA-LUNG数据集与CIRS胸部体模数据集上，STCNet在图像质量、伪影抑制和结构保持方面优于传统方法与近期深度学习基线。TCIA-LUNG上相位2、5、8的PSNR分别为33.311、32.695、32.658 dB，SSIM分别为0.845、0.823、0.825；CIRS上PSNR最高达36.497 dB，SSIM最高达0.877。
AI.conclusion: STCNet为图像引导放疗中的低剂量、相位分辨4D CBCT重建提供了一种有前景的框架。

title: Unlocking Token Rewards via Training-Free Reward Attribution
comment: token-level reward, credit assignment, PRM, RL
summary: In this paper, we propose an extremely efficient, training-free method to extract token-level reward signals directly from an existing deep reward model. Our core idea is to attribute the overall process reward to individual tokens by estimating each token's influence. This influence is defined as the change in the final macroscopic reward (e.g., the process reward) when a token is replaced with a semantically null token. Naively calculating this influence is computationally infeasible, requiring N forward passes through the PRM for an N-token sequence. We overcome this bottleneck by proposing a highly efficient gradient-based estimator. Specifically, we use a first-order Taylor approximation, which simplifies the influence calculation to the inner product of the difference between the token embedding and the null token embedding, and the gradient of the reward with respect to the token embedding. This requires only a single forward and backward pass. The resulting token-level rewards enable standard RL algorithms to perform precise credit assignment without requiring additional reward model training. Experiments on challenging reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method substantially improves policy optimization efficiency and enhances the generalization of LLM reasoning capabilities. Our P2T outperforms the outcome reward by +4.9% on MathVista for Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, and +11.5% on AIME24 for Qwen2.5-Math-7B. The code will be released via https://github.com/stonewst/P2T.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的P2T方法，用一阶泰勒近似从过程奖励模型高效提取token级奖励，实现精确信用分配并提升LLM推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有过程奖励模型(PRM)提供的是宏观序列级/过程级奖励，无法直接用于RL中的token级信用分配；而直接逐token替换计算影响需N次前向传播，计算代价过高。
AI.method: 核心思想是将整体过程奖励归因到各token，定义token影响为将其替换为语义空token时最终宏观奖励的变化量。采用一阶泰勒近似，将影响简化为"token嵌入与空token嵌入之差"与"奖励对token嵌入的梯度"的内积，仅需一次前向和一次反向传播即可估得token级奖励，无需额外训练奖励模型。
AI.result: 在挑战性推理基准上显著提升策略优化效率并增强LLM推理泛化能力。Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct在MathVista上较outcome reward提升+4.9%；Qwen2.5-Math-7B在AIME24上提升+11.5%。
AI.conclusion: P2T以极低计算开销从现有深度奖励模型提取token级奖励信号，使标准RL算法无需额外奖励模型训练即可完成精细信用分配，有效改进策略优化效率与推理泛化性能。

title: Meta-Video: Efficient Standardized Evaluation for Video Understanding
summary: Video understanding benchmarks are the primary yardstick for measuring progress in video-language modeling, and a growing body of work relies on them to claim improvements. The reported benchmark scores in these works, however, are almost always produced by frameworks (e.g., lmms eval) used as black boxes: certain evaluation choices like frame sampling, preprocessing, and input formatting are inherited from preset defaults and seldom inspected carefully. We show these unexamined choices are a major source of variance. Even for the same model checkpoint, evaluation configuration alone can shift accuracy by up to 19.5pp. Hence, it is unclear whether reported gains reflect genuine improvements in capability or differences in evaluation setup. Moreover, many benchmark samples offer little evidence of visual capability, since they can be answered without the video, and the full suites are expensive to evaluate. We address these issues in two parts. First, we curate existing suites for discriminability and efficiency, producing Meta-Video, a balanced 1,000-question benchmark over 791 videos spanning diverse tasks and durations, which largely preserves model rankings, at 5 times inference speedup for a full-frame count sweep experiment (4-128 frames). Second, we establish a standardized evaluation protocol by sweeping the configuration space to isolate choices that measurably affect results, distill them into best practices and reporting standards, and release reproducible reference scores across five models and seven benchmarks. We hope that the proposed evaluation framework and the Meta-Video benchmark will support video understanding research by providing a reproducible and efficient foundation to measure progress in a reliable way.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出视频理解基准评测中框架默认配置（帧采样、预处理、输入格式）会带来高达19.5pp的精度波动，导致提升归因不明；为此提出Meta-Video精简基准与标准化评测协议。
AI.motivation: 现有视频-语言建模进展依赖基准分数，但这些分数多由黑盒评测框架产出，配置沿用默认值而未被审视；作者发现这些未检验选择是方差的主要来源，同一模型checkpoint仅因评测配置差异精度可变化至19.5pp，难以判断性能提升源自模型能力还是评测设置。此外，许多样本无需视频即可作答，且完整套件评测代价高。
AI.method: 工作分两部分：一是对现有套件按可区分性与效率进行筛选，构建Meta-Video——覆盖791个视频、1,000道题的均衡基准，涵盖多样任务与时长；二是建立标准化评测协议，通过扫描配置空间识别对结果有可测量影响的选项，提炼为最佳实践与报告规范，并在5个模型、7个基准上发布可复现参考分数。
AI.result: Meta-Video在基本保持模型排名的同时，在4-128帧的全帧数扫描实验中实现约5倍推理加速。配置扫描确认帧采样、预处理与输入格式等选择对精度影响显著，并据此给出标准化评测实践。
AI.conclusion: 作者希望所提出的评测框架与Meta-Video基准为视频理解研究提供可复现、高效的基础，从而可靠地衡量进展。

title: Beyond the Verdict: Agentic Code Judging with Verifiable Feedback
summary: Test-time scaling for large language models (LLMs) can involve generating multiple candidate solutions for selection or revising an earlier attempt. To guide selection and revision, we need a verifier that can estimate candidate correctness and provide evidence of failure. In competitive programming, however, official judging systems provide authoritative verdicts under finite submission budgets, without revealing failure explanations or failing inputs. To provide informative feedback without consuming official submissions, we formulate a task in which a model judges and diagnoses a candidate program using only the problem statement and source code, with generated counterexamples serving as checkable evidence. To evaluate this task, we build USACO-JUDGE from the USACO 2026 contests, using accepted and unaccepted programs written by human experts and multiple LLMs. We then train ARBITER, a 35B mixture-of-experts (MoE) agentic verifier, with reinforcement learning in a generic execution sandbox. Training raises counterexample success on incorrect programs from 40.61% to 62.67% and mean binary verdict accuracy on USACO-JUDGE from 71.41% to 87.41%, approaching frontier verification performance. Beyond verification, ARBITER outperforms baselines in both code selection and refinement. In an IOI 2026 case study, ARBITER-guided refinement raises GPT-OSS-120B's expected score above the gold-medal threshold under the official submission limit.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出在无官方提交预算条件下对竞赛编程候选程序进行判定与诊断的任务，构建USACO-JUDGE基准并训练35B MoE智能体验证器ARBITER，显著提升反例生成与判定准确率，并在代码选择、修复及IOI 2026案例中超越基线。
AI.motivation: LLM测试时扩展需要验证器来估计候选正确性并提供失败证据，但竞赛编程的官方评测系统在有限提交预算下仅给出权威判定，不揭示失败原因或失败输入；因此需要在不消耗官方提交的前提下，仅依据题面与源代码进行判定和诊断，并以可检验的反例作为证据。
AI.method: 基于USACO 2026竞赛构建USACO-JUDGE基准，包含人类专家与多种LLM编写的被接受和未被接受程序；训练ARBITER，一个35B混合专家（MoE）智能体验证器，在通用执行沙箱中使用强化学习。
AI.result: 训练将错误程序上的反例成功率从40.61%提升到62.67%，USACO-JUDGE上的平均二元判定准确率从71.41%提升到87.41%，接近前沿验证性能；在代码选择与精化任务上均优于基线；IOI 2026案例研究中，ARBITER引导的修复使GPT-OSS-120B在官方提交限制下的期望分数超过金牌阈值。
AI.conclusion: ARBITER证明了在不消耗官方提交预算的情况下，通过强化学习训练智能体验证器可有效完成竞赛编程的判定与诊断，并以反例作为可检验证据，在验证、选择与修复等下游任务中均具优势。

title: Beyond the Encoder: Object-Centric Representations Emerging from Segmentation Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models are increasingly used as feature extractors for downstream tasks with limited data, typically through representations obtained from their encoders. However, foundation models trained for structured tasks such as segmentation also form object-specific representations during task execution, whose transferability remains largely unexplored. We investigate Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) object pointers, compact object-level representations produced through the segmentation pathway, as transferable representations for downstream tumour prediction. Through experiments on two PET/CT tumour prediction tasks, we find that object pointers learned using segmentation supervision alone already encode tumour-discriminative information, despite never being optimised for the downstream labels. We further introduce task-guided object pointers, where an auxiliary objective jointly shapes the object pointer space for the downstream prediction together with segmentation. Task-guided pointers improve cancer-type classification, outperforming conventional encoder-based transfer and radiomics, while segmentation-only pointers perform best on the more challenging recurrence prediction task. Representation analyses reveal associations between object pointers and interpretable radiomics features, class-dependent organisation of the learned representation space, and explicit spatial grounding around the segmented tumour. Together, these findings suggest that useful transferable representations can emerge through the execution of a foundation model's primary task, providing an alternative to conventional encoder-based transfer.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索SAM2分割通路产生的"物体指针"作为可迁移表征用于下游肿瘤预测，发现仅用分割监督即可编码肿瘤判别信息；提出任务引导物体指针进一步优化下游任务，效果优于传统编码器迁移与放射组学，并揭示了其可解释性与空间定位特性。
AI.motivation: 基础模型常被用作下游任务的特征提取器，但通常只利用其编码器表征；而面向分割等结构化任务的基础模型在执行任务时也会形成物体特定表征，这类表征的可迁移性尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 研究SAM2的物体指针（分割通路产生的紧凑物体级表征）作为下游肿瘤预测的可迁移表征，在两项PET/CT肿瘤预测任务上开展实验；并提出任务引导物体指针，通过辅助目标将物体指针空间与分割联合塑造以适配下游预测。
AI.result: 仅用分割监督的物体指针已编码肿瘤判别信息，无需下游标签优化。任务引导指针提升癌症类型分类，优于传统编码器迁移和放射组学；仅分割指针在更具挑战性的复发预测任务上表现最佳。表征分析显示物体指针与可解释放射组学特征相关、表征空间具类别依赖组织、并在分割肿瘤周围有明确空间定位。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型在执行主要任务过程中可产生有用的可迁移表征，为传统基于编码器的迁移提供了替代方案。

title: Jeva: System One Models from First Principles
summary: System one models enable direct, low-latency decision-making. Yet recent practice of predicting an answer from serialized text does not, by itself, respect the structure of a decision problem. We argue that current designs underemphasize four important structural requirements. (i) null-aware: Models should distinguish answer absence from uncertainty among candidates; (ii) permutation-invariant: Reordering alternatives should not change the decision; (iii) option-scalable: Growing candidate sets should not require redefining the output space; (iv) cacheable: Request-independent computation over recurring alternatives should be reusable across requests. We introduce Jeva, a decision-native architecture that addresses these requirements jointly. A shared encoder independently represents the request and each option, while a compact decision stack refines only the request state against immutable option memory. Symmetric aggregation yields permutation-equivariant probabilities; shared scoring accommodates variable-size candidate sets. A separate coverage estimate distinguishes answer absence from candidate competition, enabling explicit null outcomes. Request-independent option representations and layer projections support reuse across newly assembled sets. These mechanisms unify Choice, Noul, and Score outputs. Across evaluations, Jeva combines strong typed-decision performance with near-perfect null detection and no decision flips under any tested permutations. It scales to thousands of candidates and substantially reduces latency through cross-request reuse without changing decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出决策原生架构 Jeva，同时满足空值感知、排列不变、选项可扩展、可缓存四项结构要求，统一 Choice/Noul/Score 三类输出。
AI.motivation: 现有"将决策问题序列化为文本后预测答案"的 System one 模型，直接由序列化文本预测答案，本身并不尊重决策问题的结构。作者认为当前设计忽视四项重要结构要求：(i) null-aware，需区分"答案缺失"与"候选间不确定"；(ii) permutation-invariant，重排选项不应改变决策；(iii) option-scalable，候选集增大不应要求重定义输出空间；(iv) cacheable，对重复出现的选项所做的与请求无关的计算应可跨请求复用。
AI.method: Jeva 采用决策原生架构：共享编码器独立表示请求与每个选项；紧凑的决策栈只针对不可变的选项记忆来精化请求状态。对称聚合产生置换等变概率，共享打分机制适配变长候选集；单独的覆盖度估计区分答案缺失与候选竞争，从而显式支持空结果。与请求无关的选项表示与层投影支持在新组装的候选集上复用。上述机制统一了 Choice、Noul 与 Score 三种输出。
AI.result: 在各项评测中，Jeva 兼具强类型化决策性能与近乎完美的空值检测，且在所测试的任何排列下均无决策翻转；可扩展至数千个候选，并通过跨请求复用显著降低延迟，同时不改变决策结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享编码、不可变选项记忆、对称聚合与独立覆盖度估计等设计，Jeva 将四项结构要求联合满足，统一多类决策输出，兼顾性能、鲁棒性与效率。

title: Denoise X: Self-Supervised U-Net for Quantum Mottle Suppression in Chest Radiography
summary: Deep learning for medical image restoration is often constrained by the need for paired training data. Acquiring perfectly registered clean-noisy radiographs in vivo is impractical due to patient motion and radiation-dose limits. To address this, we employ a self-supervised Noise2Noise paradigm that trains on independently corrupted observations without paired clean images. We propose Denoise X, a lightweight self-supervised U-Net model (7.79M parameters) for suppressing quantum mottle and electronic readout noise in low-dose chest radiographs. It is trained on the NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset (112,120 images) using a stochastic Poisson-Gaussian noise simulator. Zero-shot evaluation on the unseen Montgomery County dataset achieved a PSNR of 36.09 dB and SSIM of 0.8806, outperforming the Bilateral filter while preserving high-frequency anatomical details. Using patch-wise inference, Denoise X processes native-resolution chest radiographs in ~2.2 s per image on a Tesla P100 GPU. Cross-domain evaluation on the Shenzhen dataset achieved 36.44 dB PSNR and 0.9099 SSIM, showing strong generalization. For resource-constrained deployment, the model was converted into a 31.16 MB ONNX model for efficient CPU inference on non-DICOM images.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量自监督U-Net模型Denoise X（7.79M参数），利用Noise2Noise范式与Poisson-Gaussian噪声模拟器，在无需配对干净图像的情况下抑制低剂量胸片噪声，跨数据集零样本泛化表现优于传统滤波器。
AI.motivation: 医学图像复原的深度学习通常依赖配对训练数据，但活体条件下获取完全配准的干净-噪声胸片不切实际，原因在于患者运动与辐射剂量限制。因此需要摆脱对配对干净图像的依赖，实现自监督去噪。
AI.method: 采用自监督Noise2Noise范式，仅在独立加噪观测上训练；提出轻量U-Net模型Denoise X（7.79M参数），在NIH ChestX-ray14（112,120张图像）上使用随机Poisson-Gaussian噪声模拟器训练；推理时采用分块（patch-wise）方式处理原始分辨率胸片。
AI.result: 在未见过的Montgomery County数据集上零样本评估：PSNR 36.09 dB、SSIM 0.8806，优于双边滤波并保留高频解剖细节；跨域评估在Shenzhen数据集上达36.44 dB PSNR、0.9099 SSIM，泛化性强。Tesla P100 GPU上约2.2 s/张；转换为31.16 MB ONNX模型以支持CPU高效推理。
AI.conclusion: Denoise X以自监督方式有效去除低剂量胸片中的量子斑点与电子读出噪声，无需配对数据即可实现强跨域泛化，并通过ONNX轻量化满足资源受限环境下的部署需求。

title: Observation Quality in DSM-Assisted Aerial Localization: A Benchmark and Base-Anchored Uncertainty Calibration
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables; supplementary material integrated into the main text
summary: Aerial map matching provides position observations for navigation, but a position error alone does not determine how an observation should be weighted. We define five benchmark tasks: position availability and agreement, grouped error structure, predictive uncertainty, controlled updates, and temporal accumulation. A case study in digital-surface-model-assisted localization evaluates base-anchored uncertainty calibration within this framework. The method combines propagated image and map sensitivities with the second moment of a compact configuration subset relative to the reported position. The reported position remains unchanged, and scale is fitted using separate position references without local surface-height ground truth. Thirteen covariance models are evaluated on two held-out query sets from locations represented in the calibration data. Relative to a constant full-matrix baseline, the method reduces equal-location normalized position-update risk by 7.70% on 728 conditions and 5.46% on a separate 142 conditions under an independent prior, with all localization failures included. On the primary set, equal-location negative log likelihood improves by 2.571 nat. These results show improved reference-based weighting at seen locations. Exploratory base-quality and conditional-addition controls leave the incremental update benefit of configuration disagreement unresolved. Navigation benefit and real temporal accumulation remain untested.

AI.tldr: 本文提出航空地图匹配的五个基准任务框架，并在数字表面模型辅助定位中进行案例研究，通过融合图像与地图敏感度及局部构型二阶矩实现基准锚定不确定度标定，使相对恒定全矩阵基线的等位置归一化位置更新风险降低7.70%（728条件）与5.46%（142条件），负对数似然改善2.571 nat。
AI.motivation: 航空地图匹配可为导航提供位置观测，但仅有位置误差不足以决定观测应如何加权，缺乏系统的评价基准与不确定度标定方法。作者据此定义五个基准任务以规范化评估。
AI.method: 方法在数字表面模型辅助定位中评估基准锚定的不确定度标定：将传播的图像与地图敏感度同紧凑构型子集相对于报告位置的二阶矩相结合；报告位置保持不变，尺度利用独立位置参考拟合（不使用局部地表高程真值）。在两个来自标定数据所代表位置的留出查询集上评估13种协方差模型。
AI.result: 相对恒定全矩阵基线，方法在728个条件下将等位置归一化位置更新风险降低7.70%，在独立先验下的另一142个条件下降低5.46%（均含全部定位失败）；在主集上等位置负对数似然改善2.571 nat。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明确在已见位置改进了基于参考的加权。探索性基准质量与条件追加对照未解决构型分歧带来的增量更新收益，导航收益与真实时间累积仍待验证。

title: Parameter-Efficient Multimodal Brain Tumor Segmentation With Stage-Wise Shared Adapters
summary: Different MRI modalities reveal different parts of a brain tumor. Segmentation models combine information from these modalities to outline tumor regions. Many models use a separate encoder for each modality. However, exchanging features among these encoders at several stages can increase model complexity. We introduce the Block-Wise Shared Adapter (BWSA), which combines compressed features from the modality encoders in a shared path and returns adapted features to each stream. In its fixed-blending form, BWSA adds the adapted features to the original features. Its trainable-gated variant (TG-BWSA) instead learns separate weights for the original and adapted features at each modality and encoder stage. We evaluate both variants on BraTS 2020 and BraTS 2023 with four segmentation backbones. On the official BraTS 2023 online validation set, BWSA increases average region-wise Dice by 1.3--7.6 percentage points relative to the corresponding unmodified backbones. TG-BWSA increases it by 2.8--7.7 points. Both variants add approximately 0.85--3.73% parameters and reduce average HD95 relative to the unmodified backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出模块级共享适配器BWSA及其可训练门控变体TG-BWSA，通过共享路径融合多模态编码器特征再回传，在BraTS 2020/2023上以极小参数开销提升分割精度。
AI.motivation: 不同MRI模态提供脑肿瘤的不同信息，分割模型需融合多模态特征。常见做法是为每个模态配置独立编码器，但在多个阶段进行编码器间特征交换会显著增加模型复杂度，因此需要一种低复杂度的跨模态特征融合机制。
AI.method: 提出BWSA：将各模态编码器的压缩特征汇入一条共享路径进行融合，并把适配后的特征返回各模态流。固定混合形式直接将其加到原始特征上；可训练门控变体TG-BWSA在每个模态与编码器阶段为原始特征和适配特征学习独立权重。在BraTS 2020与BraTS 2023上，用四种分割主干网络进行评测。
AI.result: 在BraTS 2023官方在线验证集上，BWSA相对对应未修改主干将区域平均Dice提升1.3-7.6个百分点，TG-BWSA提升2.8-7.7个百分点；两种变体仅增加约0.85-3.73%参数量，并相对未修改主干降低了平均HD95。
AI.conclusion: BWSA与TG-BWSA以极小的参数增量实现有效的跨模态特征适配，在多个主干和数据集上稳定提升分割精度与边界质量，是一种高效的多模态融合模块。

title: Detecting Unreliable Classifications from Quantized Models
summary: Post-training INT8 quantization is typically validated by checking accuracy retention, which requires ground-truth labels often unavailable in low-resource clinical settings. We show a label-free alternative: comparing a model's own output before and after quantization. We compute cosine similarity between the FP32 and INT8 models' output probability vectors for each prediction, which requires only a single forward pass. This output-agreement similarity separates lower-accuracy predictions across four evaluated architectures (ResNet-50, VGG-16-BN, Wide ResNet-50, and ViT-B/16) under fixed-percentile splits, outperforming a confidence-only baseline for all four. These results show that quantized models can be compared to their baselines to assess their drift and determine whether they are well suited for clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无标签的INT8量化验证方法：通过计算FP32与INT8模型输出概率向量的余弦相似度来衡量输出一致性，仅需单次前向传播，可在四种架构上区分低准确率预测，效果优于仅用置信度的基线。
AI.motivation: 训练后INT8量化的验证通常依赖准确率保持度，而准确率评估需要真实标签，在低资源临床场景中往往难以获得。因此需要一种无需标签的替代验证方案。
AI.method: 以模型自身量化前后的输出作为比较对象：对每个预测计算FP32模型与INT8模型输出概率向量之间的余弦相似度（即输出一致性相似度），该方法只需一次前向传播，无需标签。
AI.result: 在ResNet-50、VGG-16-BN、Wide ResNet-50和ViT-B/16四种架构上，采用固定百分位划分，输出一致性相似度均能区分出准确率较低的预测，且在四种架构上均优于仅使用置信度的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 可将量化模型与其基线模型进行输出一致性比较，从而评估量化带来的漂移，并判断模型是否适合临床部署。

title: Who Improves the Robot? Toward Physical Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Robots are increasingly autonomous in task execution, yet their improvement remains largely human-driven. This study investigates Physical Recursive Self-Improvement (Physical RSI), in which physical experience guides lasting updates to both a robot's capabilities and its improvement procedure, making subsequent improvement more effective across tasks. Physical RSI faces challenges from noisy observations, continuous dynamics, costly trials, and irreversible consequences. We present an L0-L5 framework that differentiates capability-level from meta-level updates and within-task from across-task gains, reserving L5 for independently verified recursive gain. We study existing methods around harness adaptation and model training, alongside safety and control mechanisms that govern execution and successive updates. Our analysis reveals that, despite substantial progress in self-improvement, the surveyed literature does not yet demonstrate Physical RSI as defined by our framework. We identify research priorities in reliable feedback, causal attribution, safety preservation, and benchmarking, outlining a path toward robots that autonomously improve how they learn while ensuring safety. The GitHub repository for Physical RSI is available at https://github.com/SAIL-Research-Lab/Physical-RSI.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"物理递归自我改进"(Physical RSI),提出L0-L5框架区分能力层与元层更新、任务内与跨任务增益,并综述现有方法后指出目前尚无工作真正实现所定义的Physical RSI。
AI.motivation: 机器人任务执行日益自主,但其改进仍主要依赖人类驱动。作者希望探究机器人能否利用物理经验同时更新自身能力与改进流程,使后续改进更高效,即实现Physical RSI。该方向面临噪声观测、连续动力学、高昂试验成本和不可逆后果等挑战,因此需要系统性梳理与界定。
AI.method: 论文提出L0-L5分级框架,从"能力层vs元层更新"和"任务内vs跨任务增益"两个维度刻画自我改进,并将L5定义为经独立验证的递归增益。围绕harness适配与模型训练两类现有方法,结合治理执行与后续更新的安全与控制机制展开分析,并对相关文献进行综述与归类。
AI.result: 分析表明,尽管自我改进领域已取得显著进展,但所综述的文献均未展示符合该框架定义的Physical RSI,即尚无系统同时实现能力与改进流程的持续递归更新并通过独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 作者指出可靠反馈、因果归因、安全保障和基准测试四个研究优先级,勾勒出机器人自主改进"如何学习"并确保安全的路径;相关GitHub仓库已公开。整体上,Physical RSI仍是一个待实现的目标。

title: LLM2R: From Large Language Models to 3D Reassemblers
summary: 3D part assembly aims to reconstruct a complete shape from a set of unassembled parts by predicting a rigid SE(3) transformation for each part. Because the placement of a part is rarely determined by its own geometry, the task demands reasoning over the entire part set, and existing methods, which rely on pairwise relations or iterative generation and verification, scale poorly to objects with many parts. We present LLM2R, which casts part assembly as sequence modeling with a pretrained decoder-only large language model (LLM): a Point-BERT encoder and a Q-Former compress each part into a block of geometric tokens, the blocks of all parts are concatenated, and a causal LLM adapted with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) processes the sequence in one forward pass. Causal attention, however, lets the hidden states of a part observe only the parts that precede it. LLM2R therefore appends a block of learnable summary tokens after the last part: these tokens follow every part, so their states aggregate the whole assembly at a constant token cost, and a part-aware pose head fuses each part's states with them before predicting its rotation and translation. One architecture thus handles semantic and geometric assembly and predicts all poses in a single non-autoregressive pass. LLM2R achieves the highest part accuracy and success rate on all three PartNet categories, the best rotation error, translation error, and part accuracy on PartNeXt, and the lowest translation error and fastest inference on Breaking Bad, where only a fracture-specialized method is more accurate. Its advantage grows with the number of parts: at 100 parts it exceeds GARF by 33.5 points in part accuracy on Breaking Bad and Assembler by 29.1 points on PartNet, and it transfers zero-shot to unseen categories with more than 16 points higher part accuracy than the strongest of three baselines.

AI.tldr: LLM2R将零件装配建模为序列生成任务，用预训练解码器LLM一次前向预测所有零件的SE(3)位姿，通过追加可学习摘要token解决因果注意力信息受限问题，在多数据集上取得领先且可扩展性好。
AI.motivation: 3D零件装配需为每个零件预测刚性SE(3)变换以重建完整形状。由于单个零件的放置位置很少由其自身几何决定，任务需对全部零件集合进行推理。现有方法依赖成对关系或迭代式生成与验证，在零件数量较多时扩展性差。
AI.method: 将零件装配视为序列建模，使用预训练仅解码器大语言模型（LLM）。用Point-BERT编码器与Q-Former将每个零件压缩为几何token块，拼接所有零件的token块，由经LoRA适配的因果LLM单次前向处理。针对因果注意力仅能观测前序零件的问题，在最后一个零件后追加一块可学习摘要token，使其状态以恒定token开销聚合整个装配信息；再由part-aware位姿头将各零件状态与摘要token融合，预测旋转和平移。单一架构同时处理语义与几何装配，非自回归一次预测全部位姿。
AI.result: 在PartNet三个类别上均取得最高零件准确率与成功率；在PartNeXt上取得最佳旋转误差、平移误差与零件准确率；在Breaking Bad上取得最低平移误差与最快推理，仅一种断裂专用方法准确率更高。优势随零件数增加而扩大：100个零件时在Breaking Bad上零件准确率超GARF 33.5个百分点，在PartNet上超Assembler 29.1个百分点；并以零样本方式迁移到未见类别，零件准确率比三个基线中最强者高逾16个百分点。
AI.conclusion: LLM2R以LLM序列建模统一语义与几何装配，实现单次非自回归全位姿预测，兼具高精度、强扩展性与零样本迁移能力。

title: MFG: Multi-turn Feedback Guided Molecular Optimization
summary: Multi-objective molecular optimization is a critical process in drug discovery that aims to modify a given molecule to simultaneously improve multiple properties while maintaining a similar overall structure. This process often requires iterative modifications guided by computational or experimental feedback. Recent large language model (LLM)-based methods have begun to explore this iterative approach; however, these methods are not explicitly trained to leverage such feedback, while existing approaches primarily focus on single-turn molecular optimization. To address this gap, we introduce Multi-turn Feedback Guided (MFG) molecular optimization, a reinforcement learning framework that trains an LLM to progressively optimize molecules using feedback from previous turns. MFG introduces a feedback vector capturing both property improvements and source molecule similarity, alongside a feedback-aligned reward function that promotes progressive improvement across turns. We apply MFG over $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O}$, a state-of-the-art LLM model for multi-objective molecular optimization, evaluate $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O-MFG}$ on ten multi-objective molecular optimization tasks. The results demonstrate that $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O-MFG}$ achieves the highest average similarity-constrained success rate ($81.50%$), outperforming the base model $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O}$ ($70.81%$).

AI.tldr: 本文提出MFG（多轮反馈引导）分子优化框架，通过强化学习训练LLM利用历史反馈逐步优化分子，在10个多目标分子优化任务上取得81.50%的平均相似度约束成功率，优于基线模型。
AI.motivation: 多目标分子优化需要基于计算或实验反馈进行迭代修改，但现有LLM方法未被显式训练以利用反馈，且主要聚焦单轮优化，无法有效支持渐进式多轮优化。
AI.method: 提出MFG强化学习框架，训练LLM利用前几轮反馈逐步优化分子；引入反馈向量（捕捉性质改进与源分子相似度）和反馈对齐的奖励函数，以促进跨轮次的渐进式改进；将MFG应用于最先进的GeLLM³O模型得到GeLLM³O-MFG。
AI.result: 在10个多目标分子优化任务上评估GeLLM³O-MFG，其平均相似度约束成功率达81.50%，超过基础模型GeLLM³O的70.81%。
AI.conclusion: MFG框架能有效训练LLM利用多轮反馈进行分子优化，显著提升多目标分子优化的成功率和渐进改进能力。

title: Recasting DiT for Extreme Image Compression with Hierarchical Visual Priors
summary: Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful generative priors for extreme image compression, but their stochastic, iterative generation processes are not designed to decode compressed representations directly. We present PrismCodec, which recasts a pretrained Diffusion Transformer (DiT) as a bitstream-grounded one-step generative decoder. PrismCodec uses the decoded representation in two complementary roles: a projected codec state defines the starting state for generation, while hierarchical visual priors derived from the same decoded latent provide semantic and structural guidance. To bridge the gap between stochastic, iterative generation and deterministic one-step decoding, we develop a progressive adaptation strategy. We first learn codec-conditioned transport from a noisy neighborhood centered on the codec state, distill it into a one-step mapping, and finally anneal the source perturbation to zero during end-to-end optimization. The resulting decoder reconstructs deterministically from the received representation without additional conditioning bits. Across Kodak, CLIC, and DIV2K, PrismCodec consistently improves rate-perception performance over prior generative codecs, achieving BD-rate reductions of 70-75% in LPIPS and 75-81% in DISTS over StableCodec. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: PrismCodec将预训练DiT改造成基于比特流的一步式生成解码器，通过渐进式适配策略弥合随机迭代生成与确定性一步解码间的差距，在极端图像压缩上取得领先的率-感知性能。
AI.motivation: 预训练扩散模型为极端图像压缩提供了强大的生成先验，但其随机、迭代的生成过程并不适合直接从压缩表示中进行解码。
AI.method: 将解码表示用于两种互补角色：投影后的码流状态定义生成起始状态，同一解码潜在导出的分层视觉先验提供语义与结构引导；提出渐进式适配策略——先在以码流状态为中心的噪声邻域学习码流条件传输，再蒸馏为一步映射，最后在端到端优化中退火源扰动至零。
AI.result: 在Kodak、CLIC和DIV2K上，率-感知性能持续优于先前生成式编解码器；相比StableCodec，LPIPS的BD-rate降低70-75%，DISTS降低75-81%。
AI.conclusion: 该解码器无需额外条件比特即可从接收表示确定性重建，验证了将预训练扩散Transformer改造为一步解码器的有效性。

title: AesCode: Aesthetic Code Generation with Decoupled Cross-Modal Rewards
summary: Generating information-rich visual artifacts such as slides, posters, and dashboards as code is appealing because the outputs are structured, editable, and verifiable. Yet code models cannot see how their choices of layout and color come together on the canvas, often limiting spatial planning and aesthetic quality. Image generators excel at visual design but can misrender requested content, making their outputs unreliable targets for direct reproduction. We therefore introduce AesCode, which generates code grounded in the content prompt while using an image generated from the same prompt as an aesthetic guidance. To do so, AesCode represents the target as a design graph that describes the whole canvas and makes each property attributable. From this graph, we derive complementary cross-modal rewards: deterministic verifiers score properties parsable from code and rendering, while a VLM judge assesses the non-parsable ones with a sample-specific Visual Graph Rubric (VGR) tied to graph elements and relations. We optimize these decoupled rewards through reinforcement learning with per-channel normalization to jointly improve spatial planning, aesthetic quality, and verifiable correctness. To evaluate this setting, we build a benchmark that scores verifiable correctness and visual quality separately, with visual scores highly consistent with human judgments. We find that reference images substantially improve the visual quality of code generated by existing models, and ablations show that AesCode benefits from references both as model input and as a source of visual rewards. Relative to same-scale Qwen3-VL baselines given the same references, AesCode-8B and AesCode-32B improve visual quality by 31.1 and 22.4 percentage points, reaching scores comparable to those of closed-source frontier models such as GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8.

AI.tldr: AesCode：以同 prompt 生成的图像作为美学引导、以设计图（design graph）为中间表示，通过解耦的跨模态奖励（确定性校验器 + VLM 评委的 VGR）做 RL 优化，提升代码生成类视觉产物（幻灯片、海报、仪表盘）的视觉效果与可验证正确性。
AI.motivation: 以代码形式生成幻灯片、海报、仪表盘等信息密集型视觉产物具有结构化、可编辑、可验证的优势；但代码模型看不到布局与配色在画布上的最终效果，空间规划与美学质量受限。图像生成模型擅长视觉设计却容易错误渲染所要求的内容，直接复现不可靠。因此需要一种兼顾"内容忠实"与"美学质量"的生成范式。
AI.method: 提出 AesCode：以内容 prompt 生成代码，同时用同一 prompt 生成的图像作为美学引导。用设计图（design graph）表征整张画布并使命名个属性可归因；由该图导出互补的跨模态奖励——确定性校验器对可从代码与渲染中解析的属性打分，VLM 评委借助与图元素及关系绑定的、样本特定的 Visual Graph Rubric (VGR) 评估不可解析属性；通过带分通道归一化的强化学习优化这些解耦奖励，联合改进空间规划、美学质量与可验证正确性。同时构建了分别评测可验证正确性与视觉质量的基准，其视觉分数与人类判断高度一致。
AI.result: 参考图像能显著提升现有模型生成代码的视觉质量；消融实验表明参考图作为模型输入和作为视觉奖励来源两种用途均有收益。与给定相同参考图的同规模 Qwen3-VL 基线相比，AesCode-8B 与 AesCode-32B 的视觉质量分别提升 31.1 和 22.4 个百分点，达到与 GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8 等闭源前沿模型相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: 以图像作为美学引导、以设计图为可归因中间表示并据此构造解耦的校验器/VLM 奖励，是提升代码类视觉产物质量的有效路径；AesCode 在可比规模下将视觉质量大幅推向闭源前沿模型水平，且基准的视觉评分具备与人类判断的一致性。

title: VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction
summary: Visual agents must turn video observations into timely decisions to track progress and choose what to do next. Building on the emerging System One paradigm, we introduce VideoJev, a family of models that cast video understanding and interaction as structured decision tasks. We adapt pretrained multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by replacing autoregressive answer decoding with a shared head that scores temporal intervals and textual options against video evidence. These scores yield event spans or answer choices, unifying temporal grounding and multiple-choice video question answering. This combines the semantic flexibility of MLLMs with efficient decisions that agents can use directly. As an interaction unfolds, new goals and intermediate results prompt further queries about the same visual history. VideoJev therefore reuses visual computation through Cached inference for queries as they arrive and Joint inference for multiple queries in a single forward pass. Across three temporal grounding benchmarks, VideoJev-4B and VideoJev-35B-A3B improve mean mIoU over their backbones by 6.7 and 10.8 points, respectively, with measured inference speedups of $2.8$-$3.1\times$. On four video QA benchmarks, both achieve performance comparable to their backbones in Thinking mode, with measured inference speedups exceeding $100\times$. These results offer a unified, reusable decision interface for composing structured visual judgments into complex, open-ended workflows.

AI.tldr: VideoJev将视频理解与交互统一为结构化决策任务，用共享打分头替代自回归解码，实现时序定位与视频问答的统一，并借助缓存与联合推理显著提升效率。
AI.motivation: 视觉智能体需要将视频观察快速转化为决策，以跟踪进度并选择下一步行动。现有多模态大模型虽语义能力强，但自回归生成答案的方式效率低，难以直接服务于需要及时决策的交互场景。
AI.method: 基于System One范式，提出VideoJev系列模型。对预训练MLLM进行改造，将自回归答案解码替换为共享打分头，对时间区间和文本选项结合视频证据打分，得分用于输出事件时间跨度或选项答案，从而统一时序定位与多选视频问答。推理层面引入Cached inference复用视觉计算，并支持Joint inference在一次前向中处理多个查询。
AI.result: 在三个时序定位基准上，VideoJev-4B与VideoJev-35B-A3B相比各自骨干平均mIoU分别提升6.7和10.8个点，实测推理加速2.8–3.1倍；在四个视频问答基准上，两者性能与Thinking模式的骨干相当，实测推理加速超过100倍。
AI.conclusion: VideoJev提供了一种统一、可复用的决策接口，可将结构化视觉判断组合进复杂、开放式的智能体工作流中。

title: Subgraph-Aware Training of Language Models for Knowledge Graph Completion Using Structure-Aware Contrastive Learning
summary: Fine-tuning pre-trained language models (PLMs) has recently shown a potential to improve knowledge graph completion (KGC). However, most PLM-based methods focus solely on encoding textual information, neglecting the long-tailed nature of knowledge graphs and their various topological structures, e.g., subgraphs, shortest paths, and degrees. We claim that this is a major obstacle to achieving higher accuracy of PLMs for KGC. To this end, we propose a Subgraph-Aware Training framework for KGC (SATKGC) with two ideas: (i) subgraph-aware mini-batching to encourage hard negative sampling and to mitigate an imbalance in the frequency of entity occurrences during training, and (ii) new contrastive learning to focus more on harder in-batch negative triples and harder positive triples in terms of the structural properties of the knowledge graph. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to comprehensively incorporate the structural inductive bias of the knowledge graph into fine-tuning PLMs. Extensive experiments on three KGC benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of SATKGC. Our code is available.

AI.tldr: 提出子图感知训练框架 SATKGC，将知识图谱结构归纳偏置融入 PLM 微调，用于知识图谱补全。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 PLM 的 KGC 方法仅编码文本信息，忽视了知识图谱的长尾分布及子图、最短路径、度数等拓扑结构，成为精度提升的主要障碍。
AI.method: SATKGC 包含两点：(i) 子图感知 mini-batch，促进难负样本采样并缓解训练中实体出现频率的不平衡；(ii) 新的对比学习，基于图谱结构特性更关注批内较难的负三元组与正三元组。
AI.result: 在三个 KGC 基准数据集上的大量实验证明了 SATKGC 的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次全面地将在知识图谱结构归纳偏置融入 PLM 微调，代码已开源。

title: MajorTOM:Elliot Pretrain, A Multi-Sensor, Multi-Temporal Pretraining Dataset for Earth Observation
summary: Pretraining generalist Earth observation foundation models requires data that combine several sensors, varied temporal sampling and, increasingly, text, yet open datasets rarely provide all three in one consistent, easily accessible form. We introduce MajorTOM:Elliot Pretrain, a collection of 279,166 tiles of 10 km drawn from the Major-TOM grid by clustering AlphaEarth embeddings. Each tile stacks Sentinel-2 L1C, Landsat-8/9, Sentinel-1 RTC, Copernicus DEM and ESA WorldCover on a shared 1056x1056-pixel, 10 m grid, complemented by cloud masks, OpenStreetMap entities and ERA5 weather. The tiles are partitioned into three temporal regimes, Monotemporal (250,000 tiles, one acquisition), Monthly (12,500 tiles, twelve acquisitions spread over the annual cycle) and Burst (16,666 tiles, six acquisitions within 30 days), and are released as 6.3 TB of Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs indexed by TACO v3 Parquet metadata, a standard that allows cloud streaming, efficient data access, and filtering before any pixel is read. A companion library derives sensor-tagged fact sheets, captions and 16 families of vision-language tasks from these layers at load time. We test our design choices in short pretraining runs of OlmoEarth-Base. First, a 25% subset of Major-TOM Core-S2L2A curated with AlphaEarth embeddings matches or exceeds the full corpus on 8 of 9 benchmarks. Second, on Elliot-Pretrain, adding Landsat-8/9 improves or matches Sentinel-2 only pretraining on every benchmark. Third, using DEM and WorldCover as prediction targets during pretraining further improves 8 of 9 benchmarks, while giving the same maps to the encoder as inputs degrades 5 of 9. Fourth, Sentinel-1 helps on 7 of 9 benchmarks, particularly on benchmarks with radar inputs. Fifth, rule-based captions match a small language model at no cost. The dataset is openly available at https://source.coop/major-tom/elliot-pretrain.

AI.tldr: 该文介绍MajorTOM:Elliot Pretrain数据集：279,166个10 km瓦片，融合Sentinel-2/1、Landsat-8/9、DEM、WorldCover、OSM与ERA5，按三种时间制度组织，共6.3 TB COG及TACO v3元数据，并附带视觉-语言任务生成库；通过OlmoEarth-Base短预训练验证了五项设计选择。
AI.motivation: 通用地球观测基础模型预训练需要同时具备多传感器、多时间采样和文本的数据，但现有公开数据集很少能在一个一致、易访问的形式中同时提供这三者。
AI.method: 基于Major-TOM网格用AlphaEarth嵌入聚类抽取279,166个10 km瓦片，将Sentinel-2 L1C、Landsat-8/9、Sentinel-1 RTC、Copernicus DEM和ESA WorldCover统一到1056×1056像素、10 m网格，辅以云掩膜、OSM实体和ERA5天气；数据分为Monotemporal（25万）、Monthly（1.25万）和Burst（16,666）三种时间制度，以6.3 TB Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF发布并用TACO v3 Parquet索引；配套库在加载时生成传感器标注事实表、说明文字及16类视觉-语言任务。以OlmoEarth-Base进行短预训练消融实验。
AI.result: (1) 用AlphaEarth嵌入筛选的25% Major-TOM Core-S2L2A子集在9项基准中的8项上匹配或超过全量语料；(2) 在Elliot-Pretrain上加入Landsat-8/9在每项基准上均提升或持平；(3) 预训练中以DEM和WorldCover为预测目标在9项基准中的8项上提升，而将其作为编码器输入则使5项退化；(4) Sentinel-1在9项基准中的7项上有帮助，尤以含雷达输入的基准明显；(5) 基于规则的说明文字以零成本达到小型语言模型的效果。
AI.conclusion: 多传感器、多时间制度与文本对齐的统一预训练语料可有效支撑地球观测基础模型；数据筛选、辅助传感器、预测目标设定与说明文字生成等设计选择均经实验验证。数据集已公开于https://source.coop/major-tom/elliot-pretrain。

title: Selective Knowledge Control for Continual GUI Agent Learning over Application Streams
summary: Continual learning is a crucial capability for Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents to adapt to evolving applications while retaining knowledge acquired from previous applications. Such application streams pose a challenging knowledge modeling problem: new applications often share underlying knowledge with past ones, yet also introduce specific knowledge that must not interfere with historical knowledge. In this paper, we propose activation-conditioned selective knowledge control, a lightweight method that achieves selective knowledge retention via neuron-level gradient manipulation. Our method maintains a compact historical knowledge state to protect highly activated MLP neurons that preserve previous knowledge. When a new application arrives, it performs real-time gradient surgery conditioned on forward activation. Concretely, the protected neurons are categorized into two types: unactivated neurons holding specific knowledge, whose gradients are truncated to prevent interference; and activated neurons holding shared knowledge, whose gradients are orthogonally projected to preserve stability while enabling adaptation. After each application stage, newly identified critical neurons are merged into the historical state for future learning. Empirical evaluations on multi-app sequential benchmark demonstrate that our method effectively mitigates catastrophic forgetting on prior applications while sustaining robust adaptation to new ones.

AI.tldr: 提出激活条件选择性知识控制方法，通过神经元级梯度操控实现GUI智能体的持续学习，兼顾旧应用知识保留与新应用适应。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体需适应不断演进的应用流，而新应用既可能与旧应用共享底层知识，也引入不可干扰历史知识的特有知识，构成挑战性的知识建模问题。
AI.method: 维护紧凑的历史知识状态以保护高激活MLP神经元；新应用到来时基于前向激活进行实时梯度手术：对承载特有知识的未激活神经元截断梯度以防干扰，对承载共享知识的激活神经元做正交投影以在稳定与适应间平衡；每阶段后将新识别的关键神经元合并进历史状态。
AI.result: 在多应用顺序基准上的实证评估表明，该方法有效缓解了对先前应用的灾难性遗忘，同时对新增应用保持了稳健的适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 激活条件选择性知识控制是一种轻量方法，通过神经元级梯度操控实现选择性知识保留，为GUI智能体的持续学习提供了有效方案。

title: ST-GRU PredRNN-V2: A GRU-Based Reformulation of PredRNN-V2 for Video Prediction
summary: Video prediction requires models to capture complex spatiotemporal dependencies and to retain relevant information over long sequences. PredRNN and its successor PredRNN-V2 address this challenge with spatiotemporal Long Short-Term Memory (ST-LSTM) units that maintain two separate memory states, at the cost of a relatively complex recurrent building block. In this work, we investigate whether the simpler gating of Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) can be transferred to spatiotemporal predictive learning. To this end, we develop a spatiotemporal GRU (ST-GRU) unit as a GRU-based alternative to the ST-LSTM. The ST-GRU replaces the ST-LSTM's three gates per memory state with two GRU-style gates (update and reset), and merges the temporal memory state into the hidden state, which reduces the number of parameters by about 5%. We incorporate the ST-GRU into PredRNN-V2 and evaluate the resulting model on the Moving MNIST video prediction benchmark, following the original experimental protocol. Averaged over ten predicted frames, the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 achieves an MSE of 55.1, an SSIM of 0.883, an LPIPS of 0.065 and a PSNR of 19.53dB. It does not surpass the original ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2 on MSE, SSIM or PSNR, but it achieves a lower LPIPS and performs on par with the earlier ST-LSTM-based PredRNN, while using a simpler recurrent cell. These results suggest that ST-GRUs are a promising building block for spatiotemporal predictive learning and motivate further work on their design and integration.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ST-GRU单元，用GRU式门控替代ST-LSTM，并嵌入PredRNN-V2，在Moving MNIST上以更简结构获得相当性能。
AI.motivation: 视频预测需建模复杂时空依赖并保持长序列信息。PredRNN系列用ST-LSTM双记忆状态实现此目标，但循环单元结构较复杂。作者想探究是否可将更简洁的GRU门控迁移到时空预测学习中。
